༄7ོ/ /dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉〉zhes pa 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ 'di ni mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog nas spyi'i gtso skyong dang rgyab skyor 'og dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mis gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen pa las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/ rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig zhib 'jug khang gis bka' gdams rnying ma'i gsung rab skor po ti bdun cu tsam 'tshol bsdu byas yod pa las/ dpe dkon po ti sum cu tham pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te 〈〈bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrigs〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs bod ldeb ma dpe ji ma ji bzhin par slog gis par bskrun zhus te rgyal khab phyi nang du bkram yod pa lags/da char slar yang de'i rmang gzhi'i steng du dpe dkon gces pa rnams las btus te 〈〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs deb gzugs su bsgrigs — 1 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gartses btus las/ ar byang chub ye shes kyi gsung chos skor/te / 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam las kyis mu mthud nas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu yin pa dang / 'di 'dra'i dpe skrun mnyam las kyi go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin zhing /las ka 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog chen po dang mthong chen gyi skul ma legs po thob/〈〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉dkus pa'i dpe tshogs chen po 'di ni jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i srol 'byed chen po dpal ldan a ti sha slob brgyud gtso bor gyur pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas / 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge sogs sngon byon bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gsung las dbu ma/ phar phyin/ tshad ma / 'dul ba/ lam rim/ bstan rim/ blo sbyong / gdan rabs/ rig gnas skor bcas te nang don rgya che zhing sna mang 'dus pa'i rin chen sgrom bu lta bu'i dpe tshogs shig yin/〈〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉〉kyi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing / bris tshugs 'dra min gyis spyir btang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang la lo mang nyams myong dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus pas phal cher tshegs med par yi ge gsar du rgyag thub pa byung / 'on kyang dpe rnying mang po dbu med nas dbu can du phab pas tshig gi gcod mtshams/ tsheg dang shad bkod stangs / tshig sbyor dang dag cha deng dus dang mi mthun pa cung mang tsam 'dug pa dang /grangs tshig yod pa thams cad la ang ku bris 'dug de'i skor la zhib 'jug dang rgyus lon byed 'dod rnams kyis 〈〈bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrigs〉phro gzigs na nges shes 'drongs nus/ 'di dag ni dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen yin pas phal cher sor bzhag thog dag cha mi 'dra ba kha shas dpe mtshon tsam du gug rtags brgyab ste de'i — 2 —

dpe skrun gsal bshad/nang du yongs grags kyi 'bri stangs bkod yod/dper na/ gsungs ste ( te) / log rtogs ( rtog) / sngon ( mngon) mtho nges legs / gsum gyis ( gyi) rang bzhin / shes pa'i bdag nyid kyi ( kyis) mi dmigs pa'o/ / rgya ( brgya ) rtsa bcu gnyis / lta bu'o/ /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan 7 na dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i shes yon chu tshad dman pas da dung nor 'chug yod srid pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug por stsol bar mkhyeyid zhu/ /krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2006lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 26la/

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i zhu tshig (1—3)bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ (1—4)rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (1—3)༄༅/ /pha thershaganyi shu rtsa drug lasazhusalan gyi dngos gzhi'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /ka1 zhu lan nor phreng las khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba'i lelā (1)kha2 de las lha bzhi la ji ltar gdams pa'i lelga (8)ga3 bka' sde snod gsum la 'dam kha ji ltar btang ba'i lelā (14)nga4 sbyor bar ji ltar 'bad par bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa/ (22)ca5 dbang po'i sgo bsdam/sa te sems ji ltar 'dzin pa'i le'u ste lnga pa/ (24)cha6 le lan thams cad gcig la ji ltar gda' ba'i le'u ste drug pa/ (28)ja7 spang bya ji ltar spangs nas dge ba la 'jug pa'i le'u ste bdun pa/ (32)nya8 'phags pa'i nor dang 'khar gsil gyi le'u ste brgyad pa/ (37)ta9 zhu lan nor phreng las rnam par dag pa'i glu'i le'u ste dgu pa/ (42)

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tha10 bkur bskyangs dang mthong tshul phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u ste bcu pa/ (48)da11 dam pa'i spyod pa ji ltar skyong ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa/ (51)na12 'dod pa'i 'dam las brdzes bcangs ji ltar bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa/ (58)pa13 rnam thar gtsang ma'i pha phogs ji ltar zhus pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa/ (90)pha14 sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bcad de bying rgod mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa/ (94)ba15 snang stong grag stong gi ngang du blo ji ltar sbyor ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa/ (100)ma16 sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la sogs pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa/ (105)tsa17 chos lugs phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa/ (118)tsha18 gzhan gyi sems bsrung ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa/ (122)dza19 rtag tu gzhan don byed pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa/ (126)wa20 chos gzhan la skur ba mi 'debs par zab chos nyams su len pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa/ (130)zha21 bsngo zhing sdig pa bshags pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa/ (134)za22 nor bdun du bsdus te gnyer gtad pa'i le'u ste nyer gnyis pa/ (144)'a23 brtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa/ (150)ya24 rngog chos nyi shu bo bstan pa/ (154)༄༅/ /bu snaji(nyi shu rtsa gnyisabazhugasaso/ /ka1 dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa bram ze'i khye'u gsal bar ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i lephywa (157)kha2 yul ko'u shi bhir rgyal bu chags pa med par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lersā (169)—2—

dkar chagag3 yul yangs pa can du rgyal bu kun tu dgar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (182)nga4 yul ba ra na sir rgyal bu lha skyes su sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (195)ca5 yul bde ldan du rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs su sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (206)cha6 yul rbha ga lar rgyal bu dad pa brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (263)ja7 yul rbha ga lar rgyal bu dad pa rab tu brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (316)nya8 rgya yul hwa shang gnas pa'i sar rgyal bu blo gros 'phel du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (331)ta9 yul ba ra na sir khye'u dga' 'dzin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (342)tha10 yul ba ra na sir dge bsnyen btsun par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (352)da11 yul sgra bcas su khye'u nor bu bzang por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (359)na12 yul ma ga dhar khye'u zla bar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (363)pa13 yul sgra ldan du khye'u rin chen snying por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (369)pha14 grong khyer sgra ldan du khye'u padmar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (373)ba15 yul yangs pa can du khye'u 'od zer du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (377)ma16 yul yangs pa can du khye'u byams par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (382)tsa17 grong khyer rtswa mchog tu rgyal bu seng ge sgrar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (387)tsha18 grong khyer rdo mchog tu rgyal bu bde mchog tu sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u/ (394)dza19 chu bo ya mu na'i gling du lha'i rgyal por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (403)wa20 yul padma can du khye'u dge 'dun 'phel du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (433)zha21 bka' rgya/ khu chos gnyis/ lung bstan/ rdor glu/ kha skong rnams bzhugs so// (439)—3—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung ches kyi skor/za22 bka' rgyas btab pa'i le'u bzhugs so// (439)'a23 khu chos dang po bzhugs so/ (474)ya24 khu chos gnyis pa grong khyer bde ldan du rgya bu skyabs sbyin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelā (521)ra25 'bul mo che dang lung bstan sogs ther bu rnams bzhugs so/ (527)༄tsho/ /jo bo'i gsung thor bu'i dkar chag bzhugasaso/ /malhas/ lta ba/ka1 bden gnyis 'jog tshul/ (592)kha2 dbu ma'i man ngag rin po che za ma tog kha phye ba/ (594)ga3 chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu/ (609)nga4 lta sgom chung ngu / (619)ca5 lta sgom 'bring po/ (623)cha6 lta sgom chen po/ (628)ja7 dbu 5ri 'i man ngag gi 'bum/ (642)nya8 bden gnyis kyi 'bum/ (668)ta9 bden gnyis spyi bshad dang bden gnyis 'jog tshul/ (697)mdo/ spyod pa/ka1 spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron me/ (752)—4—

dkar chagakha2 snying po bsdus pa/ (753)ga3 snying po nges par bsdus pa/ sa (754)nga4 byang chub sems nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ (756)ca5 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa/ (757)cha6 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdus pa/ (596)ja7 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ (764)nya8 mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag (765)ta9 rigs kyi smon lam/ (768)tha10 theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig (769)da11 rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba/ (779)na12 mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bstan pa/ (781)pa13 las rnam par 9)byed pa zhes bya ba/ (782)ma14 'phrin yig sum/ cu pa/ (789)tsa15 rin po che za ma tog kha phye ba/ (791)tsha16 dran pa gcig pa'i man ngag (808)dza17 jo bo'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ (809)wa18 rin po che za ra tshags/ (811)zha19 jo bo'i gdams pa gnad kyi khongs zer/ (818)za20 sde snod kyi chos thams cad sgom pa dbu ma'i man ngag (827)

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lta spyodazung 'brel/ka1 byang chub lam gyi sgrol ma/ (830)kha2 spyod 'jug 'khor lo lta bu'i lam rgyud la ji ltar skye ba'i rim pa/ (834)ga3 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad/ (864)sngagasa'od gsal/ka1 jo bos dgon pa ba la gnang ba'i phyag chen/ (876)kha2 bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs/ (879)ga3 mngon rtogs rnam 'byed/ (886)nga4 rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs/ (906)ca5 dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ (910)cha6 de kho na nyid bcu pa/ (918)sgyu lus/ka1 spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi rim pas sgrub pa/ (925)kha2 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ (940)ga3 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ (942)nga4 'phags pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ (945)ca5 dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ (949)—6

dkar chagacha6 dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ (951)ja7 yi ge brgya pa'i sgrub thabs/ (952)nya8 tshe'i sgrub thabs/ (953)ta9 sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ (954)tha10 blo gros mi zad pa'i sgrub thabs/ (955)da11 seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ (956)na12 rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs/ (957)pa13 rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ (958)pha14 nor sbyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ (959)ba15 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs/ (960)ma16 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/ (963)tsa17 las sgrib rnam sbyong gi gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ (963)tsha18 ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga (964)dza19 mi 'iXgrag pa'i sgrub thabs/ (966)wa20 spyin sreg gi cho ga (967)zha21 dam tshig srung ba'i sgrub thabs/ (968)za22 gtsug tor dri med kyi cho ga (970)'a23 mgon po nag po'i gtor ma/ (971)ya24 sgrol ma dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ (974)ra25 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ (977)—7—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo pe'i gsung chos kyi skor/la26 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs/ (979)sha27 sgrol ma'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ (980)sa28 sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ (981)ha29 sgrol bstod nyer gcig ma/ (982)a30 mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ (987)i31 mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/ (991)u32 sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs/ (1003)e33 j-i bha la dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ (1009)o34 gsang 'dus dkyil chog (1014)sngagasablo spyong /ka1 sngags kyi don la 95dug pa/ (1040)kha2 dam tshig sbas pa/ (1041)ga3 dbang gi man ngag (1042)nga4 lta ba'i lung / (1043)ca5 zab pa'i rim pa/ (1044)cha6 spyod pa'i de kho na/ (1045)ja7 mya ngan las 'das pa/ (1046)nya8 longs spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ (1047)ta9 khrus kyi cho ga (1048)—8—

dkar chagatha10 gzhal yas khang sbyin pa/ (1049)da11 lha mchod pa'i rim/ pa/ (1050)na12 tshogs kyi mchod pa/ (1051)pa13 dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga (1052)ba14 rab tu gnas pa/ (1053)ma15 bdun tshigs kyi cho ga (1054)tsa16 sbyin sreg gi cho ga (1055)tsha17 ro sreg gi cho ga (1056)dza18 ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi lelā (1057)wa19 sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas/ (1058)zha20 lhung ba ngatanags pa'i cho ga (1065)za21 sems bskyed dang sdom paskya cho ga (1070)'a22 sman bla'i sgrub thabs/ (1075)ya23 sa gzhi byin che ba'i 'khor lo bca' thabs (1076)ra24 dus mchod chen po bzhi'i phan yon/ (1077)la25 bde mchog gi bstod pa/ (1086)sha26 rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la bstod pa/ (1087)sa27 rje rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ (1088)ha28 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstod pa/ (1089)a29 dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ (1090)—9—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ki30 khro rgyal mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ (1093)khu31 khro rgyal mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ (1094)ge32 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ (1095)ngu33 tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/ (1096)ci34 nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga la bstod pa/ (1097)chu35 rtsa ba'i lhung ba'i rgya cher 'grel dang dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa/ (1098)je36 dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa/ (1105)nyu37 dam tshig kun las btus pa/ (1113)

༄༅/ /sdon 'gro'i zhu tshigade la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis/ 'byung rtsis/ sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/ bar du gtan la phab rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrang na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad/ rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ oka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhang / / gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang /bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi — —

bka' gdams dpe dken gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye sker/byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len chul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems meod 'obyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bad yangs grags ltar lags/rig gnas gsar brje mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyam/sa pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis/ bka' gdams rnying ma'i gsung rab rnams 'tshol bsdu ci thub byas pa po ti brgya lhag tsam zhig yod pa las/da lta jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i srol 'byed chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i slob rgyud gtso bor gyur pa/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/rdzog lo blo ldan shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge slob brgyud dang bcas pa/ gnyal zhing 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bu dgu brgyud pa dang bcas pa sogs/ mdor na gsang bde gung gsum/ dga' skyo zul gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i sngon gyi chos sde rnams su —2—

sngon 'as zhu tshigabyon pa'i skyes chen dam pa lnga bcu nga lnga tsam gyi gyi gsung / po ti 30la chos tshan 128tsam gyis bkang ba'i bka' gdams phyogs sgrig gi dpe tshogs shig ma dpe ji ma ji bzhin par bskun zhus te rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul zin pa dang / dus mtshungs su da lan yang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha slob brgyud dang bcas pa'i gsung chos 〈 bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs deb gzugs ma 'di bzhin mu mthud nas par bskrun zhus te rgya che'i mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul bzhin pa dang 'bul rtsis lags/'byung 'char nga tsho'i 〈 bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di par bskrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi phyi mo g.yar nang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang /don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gaher byed/'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/ mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2006pa'i zla12tshes8la gus phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal ngayand/de yang bka' gdams pa zhes pa'i chos brgyud 'di ni jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i sku dus su dbu brnyes / dge bshes 'brom ston pas srol btod/sku mched gsum gyi ring la dar zhing rgyas/ glang shar bya yul sogs kyi sku ring la shin tu dar zhing rgyas pa byung zhes lo rgyus kun zhal mthun par smra ba'i chos brgyud la zer zhing / de yang bka' gdams zhes pa'i nges tshig ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag lam nyams su len pa'i gang zag zhig gi gdams par go ba la de skad zer zhing / gdams par go byed ni skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rnams yin la/ de yang bod du jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas thog mar byang chub lam/ gyi sgron ma/'i bstan bcos mdzad pa nas bzung /bod du jo bo'i slob brgyud rnams kyis lam rim dang / bstan rim/ blo sbyong snyan brgyud chen mo dang / blo sbyong gi man ngag phran tshegs sogs ches ma/nga po ma/dzad de/ blo sbyong lam/ rim gyi bstan srol rgya cher dar ba de rnams nyams len gyi gtso bor 'dzen pa dag la bka' gdams pa zhes bya/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la chos brgyud 'jin pa'i slob ma//lo chen rin bzang gi slob brgyud dang /nag tsho chul khrims rgyal ba'i slob brgyud/khu ston brtso na 'grus g.yu drung gi slob brgyud/rngeg khu dbon gyi slo ba brgyud/ 'brom ston pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdam/sa gzhung gdam/sa ma/na ngag gsum/ gyi brgyud pa/ dge bshes dgon nga/ ba nas phyag chen gyi brgyud 'dzen sogs mang po zhig byung ba yin/jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung 'bum rnams da sngon phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa ni/ blo sbyong 'thor bu'i skor 'ga' shas tsam las khyon yongs nas gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig zhig byung med pa'i khar/ bka' gdams nga/ zhes pa'i mtshan yang phal che bas 'brom ston pa nas brgyud pa/ sku mched gsum gyi slob brgyud gtso bor gyur pa nyung shas zhig las ngos 'dzin yang gnang med la/ gsung 'bum rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te 'phrin las byung ba ni de bas kyang med/ des na da lta nga tsho'i bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig 'di la jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i slob brgyud gtso bor gyur pa/ dus rabs bcu gcig nas bco lnga pa'i stod bar du byon pa'i bla ma rnams ni/chos lugs la mtshon na rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud/sa skya/dge lugs sogs la rgya'i nga ro sgrog pa'i grub mtha' mngon gsal can gang gi khongs su'ang ma gtogs par bdag med du lus pa ltar gyur/ da — —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/lan gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bdag rkyen la brten nas nye ba'i lo bcu phrag tsam gyi ring /bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams la srung skyob kyi zhabs zhu sgrub skabs/bka' gdams bla ma'i gsung rab btsal 'tshol thub pa dper na/ khams dpal spungs dgon nas blo sbyong lam rim skor gyi dpe dkon mang po mjal rgyu byung ba dang / 'bras spungs dgon du rngog lo blo ldan shes rab kyi slob brgyud gtso bor gyur pa gsang phu'i gdan rabs dang / snar thang gdan rabs/ zul phu'i gdan rabs sogs bka' gdams bla ma rnams kyi gsung / gzhung bshad dang blo sbyong sogs da sngon mtshan tsam yang go myong med pa mang po zhig mjal rgyu byung ba rnams kyi lo rgyus gzan dkar rin po cher snyan zhu phul bar/ khong nas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung 'bum rnams phyogs sgrig bya dgos pa'i bka' slob phebs pa dang / grogs mched shes rab bzang po dang mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje gnyis nas kyang spro snang chen pos gros mthun byung ba bcas kyis / jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung rab rnams phyogs sgrig gi las ka la 'bad brtson bya rgyu'i gros gtan 'khel / de nas 2003lo'i zla 1tshes 3 la mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma rgya nag lho phyogs grong khyer hrin kren du phebs par/ mdun bcar zhus te 'bras spungs dpe rnying la srung skyob bya chul dang / bka' gdams phyogs sgrig gi 'char gzhi bcas la bka' 'dri zhus par/ khong nas zhib phra'i slob ston dang 'gro song gnang ba bcas kyis dngos gzhi'i las ka 'go 'dzugs byas pa yin/ma dpe 'tshol bsdu byas pa'i yul ni gong zhus kyi khams dpal spungs dgon dang / 'bras spungs dgon pa gnyis dang / se ra dgon nas rngog blo ldan shes rab dang / gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ 'chus dar ma brtson 'grus sogs kyi gsung dang / zha lu dgon dang rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde dgon gnyis nas jo bo rje dang / bya 'chad kha ba/ gtsang nag pa/ byang chub skyabs/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chu mig pa seng ge dpal/ 'jad pa gzhon byang sogs kyi gsung dang / spo mi spyan drug phyogs nas rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi gsung rgyud bla ma'i spyi don dang / phywa pa chos seng gis mdzad pa phyi nang gi grub mtha'/ mngon pa kun btus kyi 'grel ba sogs dang / mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mdun nas bya 'chad kha ba'i blo sbyong gi khrid dang / 'jam gsar ba'i zhal gdams sogs dang / dgen 'jam dbyangs lags kyis gnyal zhiog 'jam dpolo rdo rje'i gsuong sher phyin 'grel chen dang / bsod nams lha dobang gi bko' gdams chas 'byung / skya stan rnam thar sags mkha 'dan gnang byung ba dang / khams sprul bsad nams dan grub nas rngog lo'i dag yig bsdus pa/ 'brug pa karma phun tshogs nas dpe chos rin chen spungs pa/ khang dkar tshul —2—

bsdu sgrig gsazhel bshad/khrims skal bzang nas gtsang nag pa'i tshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel ba'i ma dpe g.yar gnang byung ba sogs dang /gathen yang mtshur phu dgon sogs khams dbus sa gnas mang po nas 'tshol bsdu byas pa'i bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig stod cha glegs bam sum cu tham pa la/ chos tshan 128 bla ma 55 cam gyi gsung ma dpe ji lta ba bzhin du zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang du par bskrun zhus zin pa dang /slar yang da lam jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i slob brgyud dang bcas pa'i bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus shig kyang thos bsam don du gnyer ba'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu yin/ de yang 'dir jo bo rje'i bla ma gser gling pa dang / byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnyis kyi gsung dang / jo bo rje'i gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig bcas par skrun zhu rgyu las/ da sngon jo bo rje'i gsung pha chos bu chos gnyis lhan du bsgrigs pa tsam las gsung gzhan rnams kyi phyogs sgrig zhig byung med/ nye char nga tshos lo ngo bcu lhag tsam gyi ring / jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung rab rnams 'tshol bsdu byas pa'i brgyud rim nang / jo bo rje'i gsung mdo phyogs kyi lta ba gtso bor ston pa dbu ma bden chung dang / dbu ma'i man ngag sher snying gi 'grel ba/ spyod pa gtso bor ston pa spyod bsdus sgron me dang / lta spyod zung du ston pa spyod 'jug dang byang chub lam sgron/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang lhung bshags sogs dang / sngags kyi lta ba gtso bor ston pa phyag chen gyi khrid yig dang chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu sogs/ sgom pa gtso bor ston pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon rtogs rnam 'byed dang / dgyes rdor sgrub thabs de kho na nyid bcu ba sogs/ spyod pa gtso bor ston pa rtsa stung gi rgya cher 'grel ba dang / dam tshig bsdus pa/ dam tshig kun las btus rnga/ snyelesnyesmi nyi shu rtsa lnga pa sogs dang / sngags kyi las phran tshegs skor la rab gnas dang / bdun tshigs kyi cho sa dang / sbyin sreg sogs/ bstod tshogs skor la gsang 'dus kyi bstod pa dang / bde mchog gi bstod pa sogs / gtam tshogs skor la rang gi bya ba'i rim pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las lam bstan pa sogs / gzhan yang smon lam shis brjod dang bcas pa chos tshan lnga cu par skrun zhus pa 'di dag ni/ ma dpe re re las ma rnyed pa'i rkyen gyis rjod byed deng dus kyi brda dag dang mi mthun pa mang po 'dug pa rnams kyang / mi bcos thabs med re zung tsam las ma dpe gzhir bzung byas te bzhag yod/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos gnyis ni lag bris dang shing par kha shas kyi ma dpe rnyed son byung ba'i nang nas/ kun gsal sgang po che'i par ma 'di'i sbyin bdag gung thang rgyal po'i gdung rabs nyi shu pa/ khri kun bzang nyi zla grags pa dang / ma yum dkon bzang rgyal mo/ bdag mo yar 'brog ma tshe ring rgyal mo sogs kyis sbyin bdag mdzad de/ bod rab byung dgu pa'i sa phag spyi lo 1539

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la shing par du bkod gnang ba zhig red 'dug pa dang / ma dpe 'tshol phyir btsun pa chos dbang rgyal mtshan kyis gsol dpon nam mkha' dkon mchog dbus gtsang sogs su mngags pas/ dbus nas smyug la paṇa chen gyi dbon brgyud nang so sku mched kyis/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ste par du bkod pa zhig yin 'dug pa bcas kyis khungs ldan dang / shing par rnams kyi nang nas snga shos su ngos 'dzin byas chog kyang / tshig gi nyams dang le'u rnams kyi go rim sgrig stangs bcas la gzhigs nas dpal gling par ma 'di la ma phyi bzung nas/ sdur byed kun gsal sgang po'i par ma dang / bkra shis lhun po'i par ma/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi par ma bcas par du bkod pa'i dus tshod kyi go rim bzhin du dpe bsdur byas te/ gtso bo kun gsal sgang po'i par ma dang dopal gling par ma gnyis bsdur nas deng dus kyi 'gro lugs ltar mi 'dra ba rnams gugs rtags nang du bcug yad/dpal gling sgang zhes pa 'di ni sa gnas gang yin gsal po zhu ma shes rung tshod dpag byas na lho brgyud zhig yin par mngon ste/ de yang par byang las/ go phog bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang / /gcung po bkra shis dpal gnas sku mched gnyis/ /kun gyi dpon dang bla mar bzhugs pa dang / /lho na yod pa'i rgyal brgyud gad gnyis pa'i/ /bsod nams stobs dang jo mo nga dkar ma/ /bstan srung chen mo bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyis / / zhes sa gnas gang yin bstan pa dang / yang / gad gnyis pa sogs lho yul khag bzhi yi/ /yon mchod marpā' yas thugs bsam rnam dag pas/ /zhes spyin bdag bstan pa dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul mkhan gsum gyis/ /rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan sgrog tshogs pa yi/ /gnas brtan bstan 'jin bzang po zhes bya bas/ /zhes par rko mkhan bstan pa rnams la dpyad 'jog byas pa lags// //dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib lajug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—4—

༄༅/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus/ / 7/ shing rta chen 23) 11la 'dzin mar me mdzad/ /ces bsngags pa legs sbyar gyi skad du di paṃ ka ra shrī dzña na bod skad du dpal mar me mdzad ye ro/sa/ mtshan gzhan jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha zhes yongs su grags pa'i bdag nyid chen po de ni sna tshogs kyi lo zhes pa chu rta ste/ spyi lo 982lor sku zhabrungs pa dang rab byung dang po'i rgyal ba'i lo zhes pa shing rta ste/ spyi lo 1054lor sku gshegs/ /bdag nyid chen po de gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs za her te/ de na bha ga la zhes pa'i grong khyer chen po mi khyim 'bum phrag du ma yod pa/ de'i dbus na rgyal ngo/'i pho brang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can zhes bya ba longs spyod mnga' thang bsam/ gyi mi khyab pa yod pa de lta bu'i pho brang du mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang gdung rgyud gcig pa'i za hor gyi rgyal po dge ba dpal zhes bya ba dang / yum dang/la mo/ 'od zer can 'es bya ba gnyis kyi sras gsum gyi 'bring por jo bo nyid sku 'brungs/ dgung lo lnga lon nga/ nas chos gsung mkhyen nga/ dang /nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i chigs bcad kyang zhal nas thogs med du gsung thub nga/ 'ig yen/ dgung lo bcu'i bar sgyu rtsal la sbyangs shing / de nas dgung lo bcu'i ring mu stegs nga/ dang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi sgra rig nga/ dang / chad ma rig pa la slob gnyer gnang / khyad par du dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i che rigs thigs char gcig gsan nga/sa phyi rol ba'i rtog ge pa las rnam par rgyal/ de nas je tā ri'i drung du phebs nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed zhus/ bla ma byang chub bzang po'i drung nas sem/sa bskyed zhus / rigs pa'i khu byug gi drung nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gdams pa spyi dang / khyad nga/ra du dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i lta ba'i man ngag rnams zhib par gnang ste/ rigs pa'i khu byug gi bka' lung ltar bla ma a wa dhu ti ba'i zhabs drung du phebs nas lo bdun bsten te dbu ma/'i lta ba la mnga' brnyes / bla ma a wa dhu ti ba'i bka' lung ltar ri nag po'i gcug lag khang gi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal kyai rdo rje'i zhal gzigs shing rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan thob pa'i bla ma ra hu la gupta la dbang yongs su rdzogs par zhus shing / gsang mtshan ye shes gsang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya bar btags/ de nas dgung lo nyer gcig nas nyer dgu'i bar du rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' dag la sbyangs shing thugs nyams su — —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzhes pas lhag pa'i lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ dgung lo nyer dgu la 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba'i sde pa slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bka' brgyud/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po sbyor ba'i lam pa shī la rakṣi ta zhes bya ba la mkhan po zhus nas rab tu byung / mtshan dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzña na zhes bya bar btags so/ /de nas mtshan nyid theg pa'i sde snod gsum ga la zhib tu sbyangs shing / mngon pa sde bdun gyi gnad kun bsdus pa'i bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa chen po zhes bya ba bam po brgyad brgya tsam yod pa'i bstan bcos chen po de lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gsan nas mtha' chod par sbyangs/ de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par gsan pa'i phyir tshong pa lam rgyus can dang 'grogs te rgya mtsho la gru gzings dang bcas nas zla ba bcu gsum ring rgya mtsho'i steng la byon te bla ma gser gling ba'i zhabs drung du bcar nas sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che'i don gyi snying po byang chub kyi sems rin po che ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes zin gong nas gong du spel ba dang / de'i thabs su theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du gsan / de nas jo bo dpon slob rnams rgya mtsho la gru gzings dang bcas te rgya gar du phebs nas bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad/ de nas rgyal po mahā pa la'i ring la jo bo rje bi ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/gtsug lag bco brgyad kyi bdag po mdzad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i tshe/ mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi gser mang po'i 'bul ba dang bcas lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge mngags te bod du gdan 'dren par btang yang gdan drangs ma thub/ de nas pho brang byang chub 'od kyis yid thang ma chad par sku'i gcen po 'od lde btsan gser 'tshol du btang bas rkyen ngan sna tshogs kyi 'og tu gcen po gar log tu sku gshegs/ khong gi zhal chems ltar nu bo pho brang byang chub 'od kyis me glang ste/ spyi lo 1037la slar yang nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba mngags nas bod du gdan zhu gnang bar rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang bi ka ma shi la'i mkhan po dge 'dun dang bcas pas bod du lo gsum bzhugs chog pa'i gnang ba thob nas dgung lo nga dgu pa bzhes pa dpa' bo zhes pa lcags 'brug ste/ spyi lo 1040 'otsware lo mjug la gdan bteg khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul la bal yul du phebs nas lo gcig bzhugs/ re gcig pa chu rta ste/ spyi lo 1042la mnga' ris su byon nas las rgyu 'bras dang sems bskyed las brtsams pa'i chos gtso bor gsungs shing byang chub lam gyi sgrol ma rang 'grel dang bcas pa mdzad/ chu mo lugs te/ spyi lo 1043la rgya gar du phyir phebs rtsis la skabs der bal yul mtha' mtshams su 'khrug pa langs nas phebs ma thub/ dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa'i nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing pho sprel te/ spyi lo 1044la spu rangs su —2—

rnam thar/bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dge bshes ston pas rang lo zhe gcig bzhes pa'i steng du jo bo dang por zhal mjal nas dbus su gdan drangs te/ dgung lo re drug bzhes pa'i me mo phag ste/ spyi lo 1047 lor bsam yas su phyag phab/ lo de'i mjug snye thang du phebs pa la byams 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bgro ba mdzad pa'i bum chu byin / dgung lo re dgu bzhes pa'i rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags pho stag la yer ba lha ri'i mgul du dge bshes ston pas 'bul nod byas/ de ltar na jo bos mnga' ris su lo gsum/ dbus gtsang gzhan du lo gnyis/snye thang du lo ril po brgyad dang ngo dgu ste/ bod du lo bcu gsum gyi ring bka' drin mchog tu stsal ba'i slob ma'i mchog mnga' ris nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ lo chen rin bzang / rma dge slong / nag tsho ste bzhi/ gtsang nas 'gar 'gos yol gsum/ leng 'brog gnyis/ se ston sgra 'dzin/ zangs gzhon nu 'bar te bdun/ lho brag nas chag khri mchog dang btsun pa dge sbyong gnyis/ dbus nas rigs gsum gyi rnam 'phrul khu rngog 'brom gsum / khams nas rnal 'byor ba chen po a mes byang chub/ 'dzeng dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor ba shes rab rdo rje ste rnal 'byor ba gsum/ phyu dar ston pa dang bzhi'o/ /brtsams chos kyang byang chub lam sgron sogs shin tu mang po mdzad nas mthar don gsum bzhes pa rgyal ba'i lo zhes pa shing pho rta ste/ spyi lo 1054lo'i dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang du gshegs/ /'di dag ni gtsor bor lam yig gsang 'khor ma sogs kyi dgongs pa yin zhing / 'on kyang gsang 'khor mar / de ltar rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ me pho rta ste/ spyi lo 946la rgya gar du 'khrungs/ drug cu'i bar du rgya gar chos kyis bskyangs/ chu pho rta ste/ spyi lo 1042la bod du byon zhes me rta la 'khrungs par gsungs pa ni yi ge ma dag pa kho na ste/ drug cu'i bar du zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal bas so/ /lam yig chen mo las bod du lo bcu bdun bzhugs par gsungs pa yang / bstod pa las/ khyod sngon so ma pu ri na/ rtog ge 'bar ba gsungs pa'i tshe/ da ni lo ni nyi shu na/ zhes dang / de nas gnyis 'das pa na/ bod du 'byon pa'i dus su ni/ da ni lo ni bco brgyad na/ /lus 'di bod du bzhag nas ni/ /dga' ldan gnas su 'gro'o zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas bstan 'dzin blo gros kyis/

༄7/ /pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ka1 nor phreng las/ zhu lan khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba'i leg༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ /bo dhi sa twa ma ṇi a ba li/ bod skad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i nor bu'i phreng ba/rgyal ba rgyal sras rnams dang ni/ /nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis//rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri bo chen po po ta la dang mchungs pa'i grub gnas chen po dpal gyi yer pa/ de'i nang nas sgrol ma'i zhabs g.yas pa phyugs rdzi lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i khang pa 'od gsal 'ja'i gur nang bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i pho brang rgyal ba dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i padma'i steng / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i gdan khri la/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal dpa' ldan ma/ra me ma/jad bzang po/ ma/ dag pa'i gdul bya la dus drug tu gzigs shing bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ snyigs ma'i mgon po rgyal ba bdun dang / rang gi ston pa shākya thub pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang/ rgyal ba de dag thams cad kyi sras nye ba brgyad dang /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dag pa'i snang ba la mdo nas gsungs pa bzhin/ khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa dang / nyan thos chen ngo/ du ma dang / rang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sprul pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa dang bcas te bzhugs nga/'i dbus su / 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes grags pa/ spyir nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad du rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba can gyi sems can/ dpe dang tshad las 'das pa rang rang gi spyod tshul du ma dang bcas pa spyod pa de dang mthun pa'i mos pa yang du ma dang bcas pa/ mdor na rigs drug gis bsdus pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i rgyu 'bras la spyod pa tshad las 'das pa rnams kyi blo ngor de dang mthun pa'i lus kyi bkod pa/ de dang mthun pa'i skad rigs/ de dang mthun pa'i rgyan cha lugs kyi sgo nas/ de dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa dang / de la phan pa'i 'dod dgu sgrub pa dang/ skal ba dang mthun pa'i lam gong du spel ba la sogs pa'i sku'i bkod pa du ma'i sgo nas gdul bya dang mthun pa'i 'phrin las mdzad na'ang / gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal blon byang chub sems — —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dpa' rim pa bzhin du bsten nas thams cad chos dang dpal 'byor gzhi che ba la bkod/ skabs 'dir zag pa med pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'ba' zhig la snod dang ldan par bkod nas/ slad kyis kyang gangs can pa'i sems can rnams 'dod pa che la 'dod thag nye ste/ cig 'og tu cig mi 'dzul zhing dmu rgod pas/ la la mtho 'grogs la dga' ste yar chad/ la la le lo che zhing sgyid skyur ste mar chad/ chos pa phal cher yang mi dge ba'i las rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem bag mi byed par/ de las med na lta zer zhing phra zhing phra ba rnams khyad du gsod/la las shes bzhin du khyad du gsod/ la las mi shes te sgrub par ma nus/ la las theg pa chen po'i chos kyi tshig re tsam khar khyer nas/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i lag len zab mo khyad du gsod/ la las chos bya 'dod kyang ma shes nas bsdugs/ (rdugasakal las shes 'dod kyi chos zhu bar 'tshal kyang slob dpon ches nas ma spobs/ la las bshad pa dang lag len sbrel nas ston shes pa'i slob dpon ma byung / de ltar tshogs pa'i chos spyod las nyams pa mang bar gzigs nas/ byang gi nang nas 'brog phyogs su sku 'khrungs/ 'brog pa'i nang nas 'brom rjer mdzad pa ni/ 'brog pa blun po zas su srog za ba rnams la thugs brtse ba dang / gzhan yang khyim pa du ma rab tu byung nas chos byed par ma nus pa rnams la thugs brtse ba dang / phyi rabs rang gi rjes su ha cang btsun tshugs bzang ste rab tu byung ba ma gtogs pa'i chos la skur ba btab kyis dogs nas de spang ba'i phyir dang / gzhan yang mi dang mi ma yin drag po mang po sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa rnams snying rjes thabs kyis sgrol dgos pa'i phyir dang / la la 'brom ston pa 'dra ba'ang dge bsnyen yin/ dge bsnyen 'di kun bsrung sla la phan yon che zer nas bsnyen gnas la sogs pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la 'jug pa dang / de dag rim gyis kha drang ba'i phyir dang / rang nyid dmyal bar skyes kyang sla/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung dang rten rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / de la brten nas sems can thams cad dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas bde zhing skyid par bya ba'i phyir du/ spang bya thams cad spangs zin na'ang / dge bsnyen gyi tshul bzung nas shin tu mngon tshan chung bar 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa/ rab tu zhi ba dul ba/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod pa/thabs mkhas te chos sgor zhugs pas khyim pa tha mal pa thams cad kyi gral nas bud cing / de dag gis bsod nams gsog pa dang / mchod pa'i yul du byed/ de dag gis kyang bkur sla ba'i stobs kyis/ bsnyen bkur cha phra mo re la'ang spyan drangs shing / bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa la sogs pa skal ba bzang po la 'god / nang ma gcig la sbyin bdag nyi shu byung kyang cig gi sar mi 'dab/ (ldab1du ma'i sar re re byon kyang gzhan gyis mi mngon/ des nam mkha'i mthas khyab tshad kyi sbyin bdag la'ang 'gre bar spyod la/ yang ngur smrig —2—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gi cha lugs ma bzung pas nga dge bsnyen skad du tshul khrims ldan pa rnams spyi bor mchod/ tha na na bza'i ras ma yan chod blangs nas spyi bor 'jog btsun chung chung chung cig byung kyang khyed dge 'dun yar 'byon par zhu/ zer nas khong rang dge 'dun gyi khyu nas bud pa skad zer kyang / khong rang las rgyu 'bras thams cad lag len du mdzad pas/ su la bslab bya mdzad kyang mad lags zer nas mi nyan pa cig kyang mi 'ong / gzhan yang bod kyi nor rdzas thams cad phyogs cig tu hril gyis dril kyang / dge bsnyen chen pos rgya/ bal po/ kha che/ bod kyi sems can dbul zhing 'phongs pa rnams la nyin gcig byin pa'i nor rdzas mi sdebs/ de yang 'ching ba can rnams kyis rtogs pa med/ spyir yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'god pa dang / spyod pa la mthun 'gyur brjod pa la sogs pa du ma mdzad na'ang / lhag par du yon tan du ma'i gzhir gyur pas chul khrims rin po che la 'god pa dang / spyod pa la mthun 'gyur brjod pa la shin tu bsngags pa mdzad de/ rang gis sprul pa'i dge slong du ma byung zhing sems can gyi don du ma byed pa la sogs pa ni 'og na mar la shes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang mkhyen pa rgya mtsho lta bu la brten pa'i dgongs tshul du ma yod de/ 'dir bshad kyis mi lang bas ma bkod/ de 'dra ba'i mgon po chen po de gong du brjod pa bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa de'i tshe 'di snyam du / da lta thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs pa'i dus su legs nyes kyi the tshom bcad pas chog kyang / gdul bya'i dbang gis rgyal ba zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa srid na/ bdag gis zhu bar dka' ba dang / ding sang snyigs ma'i dus su gyur pa dang / sems can rnams kyang dmu rgod pas gdams ngag zab mo bstan kyang nyams len mi byed par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sdig gsog srid pas/ de'i dus su nga'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dge sbyong phal cher/ blo gtad thub pa'i chos shig zhu dgos snyam pa dang lhag par du'ang / de ring lha'i bu dang / bu mo mang po sprin 'khrigs pa'i gseb na mar la rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs pas brgyan/ mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa khyer te/ la la ni gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnams thogs/ la la ni rin po che'i ba dan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams thogs/ la la ni lha'i bdug spos dang snang gsal la sogs pa rnams thogs nas gda'/ la la ni gling bu dang pi wang la sogs pa rol mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbyangs snyan pa dang bcas te gda' ba dang / me tog gi chun po bsam gyis mi khyab pa bar snang nas 'thor zhing lus kyi cha smad sprin gseb na thim zhing / cha stod snyeng byas nas chos don du gnyer te 'dus pa 'di dag la byin brlabs tshogs gnyis kyi bsnyen bkur 'tshal te/ tshogs gnyis de lta bus bsnyen bkur ba'i nus pa ni/ bla ma'i bla ma mtshan byin brlabs can de rnams la yod pas/ bla ma dam pa la mtshan byin brlabs can de rnams sgrog par zhu dgos

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/snyam nas 'di skad du/ lha yi lha mchog mar me mdzad/ /gang gis 'gran zla mi mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i mgon po cig pu khyod/ /mkhyen pa'i dbang gis nga la gson/ /ding sang rgyal ba bzhugs dus su/ /phan bde'i chos kyi lde mig gang / /skal ldan dbang gis 'dir bzhugs tshe/ /bdag gis the tshom ma bcad na/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis chos rgyal khyed/ /zhing khams gzhan du gshegs srid na/ /snyigs ma'i dus su zhu bar dka'/ /dmu rgod sems can ma rungs pa/ /chos bstan nyams len mi byed par/ /drin lan bshes gnyen slu ba'i tshe/ /blo phugs thub pa'i chos shig zhu/ /e ma ya mtshan ltad mo mthong / /rgyal ba sras bcas mkha' la byon/ /zhi bde gnyer ba'ang rdzu 'phrul lhags/ /dag pa'i lha phran dpag med rnams/ /'od gsal sprin phung 'khrigs gseb na/ kha dog du ma 'od stong 'gyed/ /mdzes pa'i gdugs mchog steng na skyabs/ /mdzes pa'i ba dan phyogs na spur/ /lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dbus na 'dzin/ khrag khrig sman gyi dri spos 'thul/ /mkha' la brdungs pas sa ldir ba'i/ /chos rnga chen po rab tu 'ur/ /rgyud stong ldan pa'i pi wang sgra/ /'gyur stong 'tsher ba'i nga ro can/ /dus gsum dge ba'i tshig 'brur gsal/ /e ma mtho ris yid dbang 'dzin/ /gling bu snyan pas mya ngan sel/ /'dod yon rtag 'dzin mi rtag bskul/ /bde 'dzin yid 'byung skyed pa gang / /sprul pa'i chos rgyal mtho ris rgyal/ /e ma ngo mtshar bzod 'bras can/ /dung ltar dag dang g.yu ltar dag /gser gyi brtan 'dra mar gad 'dra/ /padma rā ga lta bu dwangs / / gzhon 'jam bshan cing rtsa mi mngon/ /rked phra mnyen zhing rab tu 'khyug /'od gsal nad kyis ma gos pa/ /tshe ring longs spyod dpal 'byor can/ /nyi ma lta bur mkha' la byon/ /'di 'dra'i bkra shis kun la shog / mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 'di phul bas/ /mtho ris bde ba dam chos kyi/ /bar chad mi byed lam 'jug shog / blo ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /lha yi tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /rin chen gtsug tor can 'dra ba / / a wa dhū ti gser gling pa/ shwanti pa dang rakṣi ta/ /'dze tā ri la sogs pa yi/ /mtshan mchog byin brlabs ldan pa yi/ /mtshan rab gang yin bsgrag tu gsol/ /mtshan legs dpal dang rin chen zla/ /gser bzang mya ngan med pa'i lha/ /chos grags mngon mkhyen rgyal po dang / /bee ḍūrya dang mi mjed kyi/ /ston pa shā kya'i rgyal po mchog / 'bral med rgyun du spyi bor bzhugs/ /g.yin yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dang / /nye ba la sogs sems dpa' rnams/ /chos grogs spel phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /zhi bder thugs dam bcas pa yang / /rang gi btsan sa mthar phyin nas/ /pha ma'i khrel gzhung bskyang ba'i phyir/ /bzod stobs bskyed la nga bzhin du/ /yun ring brtse bar bzhugs su gsol/ /bde btagags bstan srung dpa' bo mchog /gdug gdug gzugs su brtse ba can/ /me 'bar mtshon thogs rngam stabs can/ /gnod sbyin dri za grul bum sogs/ /'jigs pa'i cha byad hūṃ sgra can/ /—4—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos ga'i rnor bu'i phreng ba spe'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dmi bca' brtan las ma nyams par/ /thugs rjes bstan pa bskyang du gsol/ /ji srid 'khor bar nga bzhin du/ /mi skyo me phung gos su gyon/ /dug lnga'i bud shing thal bar thul/ /ye shes lnga yi rlung la bskur/ /byang chub mkha' la thim par mdzod/ /sku gsum mngon gyur gang yin dang / /gnas lugs bden pa'i rang bzhin dang / / mi phyed tshogs pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /nga yi bstan pa rgya mtshor shog /ces gsol te/ de ni zhu ba dang po'i tshoms so/ /bde legs kun gyi gter chen mchog /dpal gyi 'byung gnas rin po che/ /mi pham bla ma'i spyan snga nas/ /ljags kyi dbang por rab bkram ste/ /sras kyi mchog la 'di skad gsung / /kun gyi gnyen cig nga la gson/khyod kyi gsung la 'khrul ba med/ /lha yi tshogs rnams 'od kyis bltams/ /dpag med dga' ba'i dbyangs sgrog cing / / sprin tshogs mchod pa'i tshogs rab khyer/ /thams cad dag pa'i sprin gseb na/ /rnam dag gus pa'i sems kyis gda'/ /bde gshegs dpa' med rab 'khod pa'i/ /sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ /phun tshogs dpag med rgyal ba yi/ /de ring bkra shis dang po yin/ /bzang po tshogs rab rab spel ba'i/ /skal ba bzang po dang po yin/ /de ring lha tshogs dpag med 'khod/ /lha dang mi yis mchod byed pa'i/ /rten 'brel bzang po dang po yin/ /sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ /lha dang khyod bcas gnas 'dir tshogs/ /bdud rtsi'i snying po khyod kyis blangs/ /da ni ji skad gsung ba bzhin/ /lha dang klu dang dri za dang / /gnod sbyin mi dang mi'am ci/ /gzhan yang dpag med gus 'khod pa/ /kun gyis tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /bstan pa'i snying po phan pa'i chos /sbyin mdzad bla ma'i mtshan brjod na/ /gang gis sgrib pa zad 'gyur bas/ /bla ma'i mtshan rab spel bar bya/ kho bo'i rang rgyud chos kyis phyug /chos rnams thams cad lung can yin/ /lung gi brgyud chul blo ldan la/ /dngos sam brgyud pas bstan par bya/ /thos pa tsam gyis tshim par 'gyur/ /de ni zhus pa'i lan du smras/ /da ni mtshan nyid bstan par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ni lan gyi skabs so/ /gu ru sarba na maḥ 'gro ba thams cad rab tu skyob byed pa'i/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang sangs rgyas ye shes 'khas / / bla ma mar me mdzad bzang yi ge ba/ /karna pa dang mkhan po ye shes dpal/ /theg pa thun mong bdag la sbyin mdzad pa/ /drin chen bla ma drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bskyod pa dang mgon po 'od dpag med/ /rin chen 'byung dang bcom ldan don yod grub/ /rnam snang chen po rgyal ba kun gyi gtso/ /bdag la gsang sngags ma lus dbang bskur ba'i/ /rigs lnga bla ma mnyam med rdo rje 'dzin/ /bde legs bskrun phyir kun nas phyag 'chal lo / / 'gro mgon klu sgrub nyid dang 'phags pa lha/ /ma ti tsa la te lo yo gi ba/ /ca ti pa la mañdza shrī bha dra/ /bo dhī —5—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bha dra bla ma shānti ba/ /gsang sngags ma lus bdag la sbyin mdzad pa/ /drin chen bla ma brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang gsang ba pa/ /zhi ba ku su lu dang ku su lu/ /gsang sngags ma lus bdag la sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin chen bla ma lnga la phya 'tshal lo/ /ind+ra bhū ti klu mo rnal 'byor ma/ /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub snying po dang / / tsa na kirti birtswa mi tri ba/ /tso bi ba dang rol pa'i rdo rje dang / /sa 'gebs zhabs dang mnyam med shānti ba//gsang 'dus sbyin mdzad bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub zla grags rig pa'i khu byug dang / /mnyam med ku su lu dang ku su lu/ /bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma lnga la phyag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang padma ba/ / chos rgyal ind+ra bhū ti lcam legs smin/ /spyi bos skyes dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang / /sangs rgyas ye shes kai pa la yi zhabs/ /rol pa'i rdo rje dang ni sa 'gebs zhabs//mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma shānti ba/ /bcu gcig gsang 'dus sbyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lo i dhang ki pa dang dha ri ka / rtsaba'i bla ma bram ze 'dze tā ri/ /bdag la gsang sngags ma rgyud sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ma la rakṣi ta mkhas pa'i mchog /nag po pa zhes che ba'i dpal mnga' ba'i/ /gshin rje gshed kyi gdams pas sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sangs rgyas zhi ba dang / /sangs rgyas gsang ba dang ni ku su lu/ /ku su lu zhes kri ya yo ga yi/ /gdams pa sbyin mdzad lnga la phya 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub zla grags rig pa'i khu byug dang / /bla ma a wa dhū ti che chung gnyis/ /lta ba'i bla ma lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ /btsun/ pa grol sde rgyal sras mchog gi sde / / rgyal sras dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i dpal/ /seng bzang rin chen bzang dang rin chen sde/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyam med gser gling pa/ /rgya chen rnam dag spyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang blo gros mi zad pa/ /e la rha ri dpa' bo rdo rje dang / /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po gser gling pa/ /bdag la rgya chen spyod pa sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma bco brgyad 'jig rten skyabs kyi gtso/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag dang bdag gi rjes su 'brang ba rnams/ /'bral med byang chub bar du gzung du gsol/ /bla ma klu sgrub nyid dang 'phags pa lha/ /zla ba grags pa te lo yo gi pa/ /rig pa'i khu byug ye shes byang chub dang / /'jam dpal bzang po ratna ā ka ra/ shwanti sngags dang phar phyin sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub nyid dang rgyal sras 'phags pa lha / / ma ti tsi tra tai lo yo gi ba/ /tsa ti pa la mañdzu shrī bha dra/ /bo dhī bha dra bla ma shānti ba/ / sngags dang pha rol phyin pa sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub thob chen po 'jam dpal bzang po dang/ /—6—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dus rnams rtag tu gang dang gang gi chos/ /bzang po'i bsam pa yang yang sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /grub thob shānti ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon phyag na rdo rje padma ba/ /rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti lcam legs smin/ /dzñā na bo dhi tsi la la ba pa / / badzra bo dhi mañdzu shrī bha dra/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyam med shānti ba/ /grub thob chen po dgu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /rje btsun tai lo ba dang nā ro ba/ /byin rlabs mchog ldan bla ma ḍio bhi ba/ /byin rlabs bla ma bzhi la 'tshal lo/ /mkhas grub chen bo buddha pā li dang / / sangs rgyas ye shes sangs rgyas zhi ba dang / /sangs rgyas gsang ba mnyam med ku su lu/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can ku su lu/ /byin brlabs bla ma drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen blo gros brtan/ /ku su lu gnyis bla ma gser gling pa/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /drin chen bla ma bdun la phyag 'tshal lo//byams pa'i skyes mchog grub chen rnal 'byor pa/ /rakṣi ta zhes rang sha'ang gzhan la ster/ / thun mong ma yin sems bskyed sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma dpa' bo gnyis la 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal dang ni a wa dhū ti pa/ /mar me mdzad bzang shākya bshes gnyen dang / /ri bo bzang po dang ni bsod snyoms zhabs/ khu byug zhabs dang sa 'gebs zhabs dang ni/ /mkhas pa chen po ratna ā ka ra/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa shānti ba/ /gzhan yang grub mtha' kun la mkhas pa yi/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa dgu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub dang ni klu yi byang chub dang / /spyod pa ba dang bla ma shānti ba/ /man ngag gter mdzod sna tshogs sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /sbyin bdag rin chen lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu sgrub zla grags rig pa'i khu byug dang / /bla ma a wa dhū ti gser gling pa/ /thun mong ma yin gdams pa sbyin mdzad pa/ /drin chen bla ma lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa klu sgrub nyid dang 'phags pa lha/ /zla ba grags pa tai lo yo gi ba/ /ma ti snyi ra dzñā na bo dhi ste/ /man ngag gter mdzod drug la phyag 'tshal lo lha dang mi dang lha min skal ldan 'dir/ /bde bar tshogs pa thams cad drang slad du/ /rtse gcig chu rgyun kha gnyis kha gsum pa/ /zlos pa lta bur bstan yang rgyud lugs bstan/ /sngon dus tshe rabs thams cad de dag gis/ /dngos su chos bstan da lta yan chod du/ /mkha' la byon zhing chos ni ston mdzad pa/ /la la nyid kyis sprul zhing bstan pa'ang yod/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams/ /mi/ ma/ngon dbyings na bzhugs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgya dang lnga cu'i tshogs rab bzang po rnams/ /rgyun chad med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bde bar gshegs dang dbyer med pa'i/ /mkhas grub dpag med gyur pa yi/ /chos dang mtshan rab brjod gyur pas/kho bo'ang khungs bzang bzang por bstan/ /der brten 'dir tshogs 'gro ba rnams/ /'di nas skye ba thams cad du / / bla ma'i zhabs drung rab brgyud nas/ /tshogs gaṭaṃṭwāṃ mchog rab gong du rgyas/ /mthar thug bde chen chos

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/kyi sku/ /gzugs sku'i yul can thob par shog /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / / legs so drin can bla ma mchog /legs so mtshan rab bzang po thos/ /der brten chos kyi tshogs rab des/ /legs par dril na 'di lta ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las yul khyad par can la phyag btsal ba'i le'u dang po'o// // kha2 lha bzhi la ji ltar gdamaba'ipa'i lephywade ba dharma sarba sapta na ma/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i sprin phung nas/ /bdag gi bsod nams lasa'akhrungs pa'i / / mtshungasapa med pa'i a ti sha /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu mchog /grag stong snyan pa'i gus tshig 'di / / thugs rje'i dbang gis gsan du gsol/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bar chod mang / /dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam dkon/ /de bas dngos grub 'dzed pa nyung / /nga la bzang po'i lha cig zhu/ /nor bu rin chen 'di skad gsung / / 'dod dgu gnyer ba nga la gson/ /thub pa dbyer med spyan ras gzigs/ /mi g.yo mgon dang sgrol ma yin/ /gser dang kha ba dung ltar dkar/ /mthing ga ljang gu kha dog mdzes/ /dmar po mgrin pa'i a la mdzod / / rigs lnga'ang khyod nyid khyod kyang yin/ khyod nyid ye shes lnga yin te/ /ye shes lnga yang khyod nyid do/ /yig 'bru gsum yang khyod nyid de/ khyod kyang gsum po de nyid do/ /yig 'bru drug ni khyod nyid de/ khyod kyang drug po de nyid do/ /'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bzang por rgyal/ /sras kyi thu bo 'di skad gsung / /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu mchog /dbang gi rgyal po nga la gson/ /chesalhag gsung pa shin tu legs/ /nga yi lha nyid lha bzhi ste/ /nges par de nyid bstan par bya/ /nor bu'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /lha yi tshogs rab dpag med mchis/ /gsang sngags chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /phyi yi chos kyang du ma nyid/ /'on kyang las 'brel gang yod yin/ /de ring legs par 'dam kha thong / /sras kyi thu bos 'di skad zhus / / sdug bsngal mi skyob lha mi 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsgral dka' zhing / /sdug bsngal rnams kyang bzod par dka'/ /pha mar bcas pa bskyab dgos pas/ /gtan gyi btsan sa zhu ba la/ /dkon mchog gsum las lhag ma mchis/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum la bgyi/ /zhing rab 'phags pas chos byas pas/ /'broba'ibu sku gsum sangs rgyas 'byung / /dka' spyad 'bras bu rgyal bar gda'/ /mthar thug skyabs gnas mchag tu bzang / / sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing sa med / / de phyir bdag gis skyabs su bgyi/ /'phral du phan zhing phugs su bde/ /ko long yi dam mchod na —8—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /mnyes / / dad pa yod na sgrub thag nye/ /le lo mi mnga' rtag tu bsrung / /legs par rnyed do dkon mchog gsum / / rjes su bzung ngo sku mched gsum/ /rgyud du mchod cig rjes 'brang rnams/ /slu mi srid do the tshom chod / / de gsum nang na'ang sangs rgyas mchog/ /sangs rgyas nang na'ang bskal ba 'dir/ /rgyal ba stong las lhag ma mchis/ /stong la'ang mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir/ yākya'i rgyal po 'ba' zhig go /de la bdag gi lha cig bgyi/ /legs nyes thams cad thub chen shes/ /mthar thug skyabs gnas khyod nyid yin/ /jo bo'i zhal nas legs zhes gsung / /de la yi dam brtan par mdzod/ /legs so rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dam kha mkhas/ /gzhan yang sras kyis 'di gdams pa/ /dus gsum bde gshegs chos kyi sku/ /mtha' med 'gro ba kun gyi mig /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i lha/ /sa bcu'i tshul bzung 'gro ba 'dzin/ /thugs rje chen po mtshungs pa med/ khyad par bod kyi lha skal yin/ /e ma lo lnga'i bu chung yang / /'bru drug zab mo kha nas 'byin/ /dbang po ma tshang du ma yang / /yul min mi zer 'di nyid 'byin/ /bsgom la snying rje chen po ste/ /phan che 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol/ /bod kyi lha skal nyid du nges/ /'bru drug pha rol phyin drug ste/ /oṃ ni a yin de bzhin no/ /de ni skye med sher phyin no/ /ma ni mar gyur dpag med rnams/ /rtse gcig snying rjes rgyan tshig yin / / gzhi yang bzhi ldan phun sum tshogs/ /rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal yang / /'bru drug 'di yis sel 'gyur te/ /sdug bsngal kun sel sman du bzang/ /'di la'ang bdag girsā lha cig bgyi/ /legs nyes thams cad thugs mkhyen can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dri med shes/ khyod kyang skyabs kyi mthar thug yin/ /brtse bar mdzod cig 'gran zla bral/ /dbang gi rgyal po nga la gson/ /lha mo skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /yon tan 'ba' zhig legs bltams pa/ /bde gshegs ye shes 'ba' zhig ma/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob nyer mkho 'di/ /bla ma'i lha yin slob ma'i yang / /mchod pa'i lha yin spyi bor bkur/ /da ni gtan gyi skyabs gnas yin/ /da ni 'bralamed rgyun du bzung / /bdag gis lha cig 'di la bgyi/ /nyes na'ang bla ma'i yi dam yin/ /slob ma'i lha yang desa'ong mchi/ /dbang gi rgyal po nga la gson/ /gang dag rgyun du mchod byas nas/ /'chi khar dbugs len byed pa mthong / /de 'dra'i lha ngan 'dre bas btsog /mchod 'phro nyid nas brdung par rigs/ /de bas phyi ma ngan 'gror 'dren/ /mchod bstod nongs pa cig gis 'joms/ /rdor legs dpe dkar (be dkar kal sogs pa//don med 'gong pos dgos pa med/ /rtag tu dngos grub ster ba'i lha/ /bde gshegs sku las rab 'khrungs pa'i / / bcom ldan gang gis mi g.yo mgon/ /lha yang 'di nyid chos skyong nyid/ /'phrin las thams cad rab bsgrub gsol/ /ji srid nam mkha' ma brlag par/ /g.yo bar ma mdzad nga bstan srungs/ khyed 'dra bsten nas —9—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nga g.yos na/ /nam mkha' chu yis khengs kyis dogs/ /e ma khyed la lha cig bya/ /'di ni 'brom gyi lha bzhi yin / / a ti sha yis legs par gnang / /byin brlabs chu rgyun yun du mchi/ /thugs rje'i pha tshan dpung du che//rdzu 'phrul spyan zhes thogs med ldan/ /nga yi 'khor 'dab mtha' med rgyas/ /de la lha bzhi nye bar mkho/ /phyi yi lha yang 'di nyid yin/ /nang gi lha yang 'di nyid yin/ /gsang ba'i lha yangaske'adi bzhi ste/ /de nyid lha yang 'di nyid do/ /'di bzhin rtag tu brten byed gang / /dge legs thams cad lhun gyis grub/ /nor bu'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /sras kyi thu bo nga la nyon/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang dpag med cing / /sras kyi tshogs la'ang zhi khro gnyis / / de la'ang lha dang lha mo yod/ khro bo khro mo dpa' bo dang / /dpa' mo la sogs du mar bshad/ /cung zad lha bzhi ma nyungs sam/ /sras kyi thu bos 'di skad zhus/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lha cig pu/ /da dung zhu tshig 'di gsan 'tshal/ /rnam snang la sogs dpag med kyang / /rgyal ba thams cad dbye ba med/ /dbyer med thub pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas 'dus sku rin chen te/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug rab brgyan nas/ /slar yang snying gi dkyil du bzhugs/ /gsang sngags dag kyang de la zhu/ /zab chos gzhan rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /sras brgyad la sogs dpag med kyang / /zhi khro gnyis su ma tshang med/ /zhi ba thugs rje mtshungs med pa/ /thugs rje tshogs rab dpag med kyang / /spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /e ma de yang rgyal ba dang / /rgyal sras ma lus kun gyi yab / / rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i/ /pho brang nyid kyang de nyid yin/ /bu ga cig na'ang rgyal ba yi/ /zhing rab dpag med mchog tu rgyas/ /cig gi de nyid su yis rtogs/ /legs par dpyad na 'di lta ste/ /sku bzhi'i sangs rgyas ma lus dang / /zhi khro dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ /kun gyi dkyil 'khor gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu nyid brten kun gyi skyob/ /zhi ba'i lha 'dus brjod par zad/ khro tshogs bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon/ khro bcu la sogs khro bo yi/ /pho brang nyid yin dpa' bo yang / /dpa' bo'i tshogs brten drag por ston/ /stobs chen gtum po thugs rje can/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug rab brgyan nas/ /slar yang snying dkyil brgyan par mdzod/ /gsang sngags chos kyang de la zhu/ /chos g.yin rgya mtsho smos ci dgos/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sgrol ma mchog khro mo dpa' mo lha mo'i tshogs/ /zhi bar bcas pa kun gyi bdag /kun gyi pho brang mchog nyid na/ /kun gyi ngo bo sgrol ma mchog / e ma lha mo 'di bstan na/ /lha mo ma tshang su zhig yod/ /kun gyi dkyil 'khor nyag cig ma/ /lha mos 'dul gang bskyab slad du/ /bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /slar yang snying gi rgyan du byon/ /gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags sogs/ /dpag med zab mo khyed la zhu/ /phan bde g.yin rnams smos ci dgos / / de ltar bsam mi khyab pa yi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i lha mchog bzhi/ /ji srid 'gro ba gnas kyi bar/ /—10—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /thun mong ma yin byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'brang ba/ khyed kyi zhabs la legs btud nas/ /gsol ba btab tshe mi snyel bar/ /dus la 'doms par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar lha bzhi gdams pa'i tshe/ /ser 'jam 'ja' yi gur gseb nas/ /rigs lnga ser 'jam 'ba' zhig gis/ /sa bcu'i sras la 'di skad gsung / / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams/ /'di ltar rigs lnga'i rang bzhin yin/ /de yang gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ yākya'i rgyal po yin na 'brom/ /thugs rje'i nang gi gzhal yas bzhin/ /bkod pa dpag med bstan du gsol/ /'brom rje'i thugs ka rab phye bas/ /rang gi thub pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rigs lngas nam mkha' gang tshul du/ /thugs kyi nam mkha' rgyal bas gang / /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin no gsung / /jo bo'i zhal nas sras kyi mchog /'dam kha ma log sras kyi mchog /rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'di ltar gda'/ /legs par gdams pa'i phan yon yin/ /'gro ba'i don du nges 'gyur gsung / /dkar 'jam sprin gyi gur gseb nas/ /zla ba lta bur sems dpa' rnams/ /ji ltar rgyal sras mang gyur kyang / /'di ltar thugs rje chen po las/ /g.yo ba 'ga' yang yod ma mchis/ /nyid kyi nang gi gzhal yas khang / /mtshungs pa med par gsal bar mdzod/ /de nas 'brom rje legs zhes gsung / /thugs kyi pad sgo rab phye nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams bstan/ /ljang gu sprin gyi gur gseb nas/ /ljang gu'i mdog can lha mo'i tshogs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang yar la gson/ /sems ma dpag tu med gyur kyang / /'di bzhin 'di dag rnams su 'dus/ /'di yang sgrol ma'i rang bzhin te/khyed kyi thugs kyi gzhal yas bzhin/ /'brom rjes legs zhes rab gsol nas/ /thugs kyi pad mo sgo rab phye ste / / sgrol ma'i zhing khams dpag med bstan/ /mthing 'jam sprin gyi gur gseb nas/ /mthing mdog khro bo du ma rnams/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis bdud sde skrag /'dzum chags gar gyis 'brom rje bstod/ /sras kyi thu bo 'di la gson/ khro zhing dpa' bo dpag med kyang / /mi g.yo bstan pa nyid yin no/ khyed bstan bsrung zhing bar chad bsal / / ji ltar khyod kyi zhing khams kyi/ /dpag med nang du gsal ba bzhin/ /'brom rjes legs zhes thugs sgo gsal/ khro bo'i zhing khams dpag med bstan/ /de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /lha bzhi legs par gdams pa'i tshe/ /mar me mdzad dpal rab tu mnyes/ /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i/ /ngo bor gyur pa spyan ras gzigs/ /de ltar lha rab dpag med rnams/ /de ring ji ltar gzigs pa yin/ /bsdus pa'i ngo bo lha bzhi yin/ /sku 'dra bzhi bzhengs kho bo yis/ /bzo zhing rab tu gnas pa'ang bya/ /zhes gsung ngo/ /de ni lha bzhi gdams shing zhal gzigs pa'i tshoms so /bla ma'i gsung rab bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje yis/ /thang pa yer pa chu ris la/ /bsod — 11 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nams bsags phyir rgyu blangs nas/ /lha bzhi'i sku gzugs bzhengs su gsol/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / / lder so ma mdzad ri mor bzhengs/ /ches na shul mas bskyang par dka'/ /de skad ma gsung zhes gsol nas/ /bzang gzhi rin chen du ma sbyar/ /'jim pa ri chung tsam sbyar nas/ /rje la 'di skad lde gu mchis/ /'gro la phan don bzhengs su gsol/ /de nas mgon po a ti sha /rang nyid 'dra ba bcu drug mdzad/ /rgyan cha du ma rab tu gsol/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /lde gu'i mtha' ma mdzes par bskor/ /sngo ljang bu mo du ma yis / / tsan dan chus bran lde gu g.yos/ /ring por ma thogs lha bzhi tshad/ /byams ba'i sku tshad bzhi bzhedasagyur / / de nas 'od dpag med pa 'khrigs/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur gyis bkab/ /mchod pa'i lha mo du ma yis / / mchod tshogs khyer zhing rab tu mchod/ /gzhan yang sems dpa' dpag med kyis/ /rig 'dzin gzugs kyi bkra shis brjod/ /gtum po khro bo'i gzugs can rnams/ /mi g.yor bcas te bgegasaskrod mthong / / rang gi bla ma paṇḍi ta/ /thub pa chen po lham mer gda'/ /de yang bcu drug rim can du/ /sku gzugasabazhi la rab gnas mdzad/ /de la sras mchog ya mtshan skyes/ /yud cig dag pa'i snang bar 'byams/ /ting 'dzin de las langs pa dang / /rang gis bzhengs pa'i lhar bcas pa/ /mi snang bla ma nyid bzhugs te/ /e ma snyam nas 'di skad zhus/ slu ba med pa'i skyabs gcig pu/ /phun sum tshogs bcasagang du thal/ /da ci phun tshogs du ma na/ /da ni sems kyi lhag ma tsam/ /e ma rmi lam tshul dang 'dra/ /snang ma thag tu ye med gyur/ /rje yi zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /chos rnams rmi lam tshul 'dra na/ khyod kyi dka' spyad lha bden nam/ /rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba rnams/ /snang ngo'i dus na stong gyur na/ khyod kyi lha bcas bden gyur ram/ /rten 'brel 'jig pa'i chos can la/ khyod kyis sbyar ba rtag 'gyur ram/ /nga ni sprul pa'i dge slong yin/ /de yang stong pa'i chos rnams la/ /de yi sprul pa ji ltar bden/ /brdzun pa'i lha bzos byas pa'i lha/ /brdzun pa'i brdzun pa lhar mi rigs/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de 'dra'i tha tshig gsung rigs sam/ /bden brdzun brjod pa'i skabs ma yin/ /legs par bzhengs pa'i lha de zhu/ /brdzun pa snang med ha cang thal/ /gsung gleng da gzod ga las bgyi/ /de ring zog por ma btang cig /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / khyod kyi lha bzhi dga' ldan gshegs/ /dge ba rjes dran grags 'dod yin/ /ma 'phreng grags 'dod med par bzhugs/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rab gnas su gshegs/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de ring mi srid gsung rab thos/ /dga' ldan mi las dbul gyur te/ /rang gis ma 'byor mis bzhengs pa'i/ /lha bzhi ma phyin khyer gyur ang / /gal te ma byin len gyur na/ /dga' ldan bzang por rung gyur ram/ /jo bo zhal 'dzum mdzad gyur nas/ /—12—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dga' ldan lha yis phongs pa'ang med/ /ma byin len sems mi mnga' yang / /'on kyang snyigs ma'i gdul bya yis / / sku gzugs mchod pas mi bskyangs pas/ /rje btsun byams pas spyan/ drangs gshegs/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /jo bo gsung gdugs (rdugs)tha tshig 'dra/ /phyi ma'i gdul byas mi skyongs (skyong)pas/ kho bo'i yi dam yar drangs gsung / /'o na gdul bya ma dag pas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa ma bskyangs sam/ / e ma jo bo lha de zhu/ /dga' ldan lha yi ma phongs kyi/ /gdul bya dad pa che che kun/ /jo bo yab sras rin chen gyis/ /bzhengs pa'i lha yin zer zhing bskor/ /mchod tshogs rtag tu med gyur kyang / /sku gzugs phongs par ga la 'gyur/ /de bas 'dir 'ongs dad can rnams/ /gang 'byor phyag dang mchod pa 'bul/ /gal te zhig ral byung gyur kyang / khyed la le lan ga la 'ded/ /de bas grong pa mgu bar dka'/ /rgyu cha phul ba'i lha 'drir 'ong / /de tshe dga' ldan song byas kyang / /brdzun sgrigs (sgrig ka'ol du mi 'tsham zhing / /gzhan yang yid ches ga la skye/ /re ltos che bas bslus gyur na/ /log lta skyes te khong rnams bden/ /rang bzhin lha bzang yod bzhin du/ /'dra 'bag dgos pa'i dga' ldan a/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'brom rje de skad ma zer cig /lan du de bas ma gsung cig /e ma 'dus byas mi rtag kyang / /de 'dra'i khrims zhig gang na yod / / 'o na 'khor ba stongs su bsha'/ /de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /ye shes lha bzhi mdun du byon/ /'brom rje gtam 'di gsan du gsol/ /gzugs la lha ru ma 'dzin/ cig /lde gu rgyu ru ma 'khrul zhig /de bas 'khor ba ma stong par/ /bdag cag 'bral med rgyun du 'ong / /lhag par ding sang byin gyis brlabs/ /nang par chos la 'dam kha thong / khye che g.yang sa med par 'doms/ /de tshe nged kyang drung du 'ong / /lhag par sgrol mas 'di skad gsung / / sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ khyed kyi rjes 'brang kho mos skyob/ kho mo'i gdams pa 'di long la//rjes su 'brang la bstan par gyis/ /skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod/ /lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te/ /ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod/ /'gro ba ma lus pha mar bsom (somasaka/ /sems kyi gnas lugs stong par spyod / / lnga bo de yi skya bar nas/ /dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod/ /de yi sngon du gzungs 'di long / /bye ba 'gyur du rgyal bas gsungs/ /sras mchog de ni 'di lta ste/ /oṃ sambha ra sambha ra bhi ma na ma ra dza bha ba hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā / / sras kyi thu bo da yang nyon/ /de ni gong du spel byed yin/ /bsgyur bar byed pa bsngo ba mchog /dus gsum dge rtsa mchog bsags pas/ /mchog rab mchog gi lam nyid la/ /mchog gi sems kyis mchog tu bsngo / / de ni sgyur byed bsngo ba yin/ /de ni sangs rgyas mchog nyid do/ /stong par shes na chud mi za/ /'khor gsum dag par ma lus mdzod/ /jo bo'i zhal nas legs zhes gsung / /'brom rje dga' ldan gnas skyes tshe/ /—13—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzhengs pa'i lha yang mngon du mchi/ /sras kyi zhal nas 'di skad gsung / kha ngoms tshe na btung mi 'tshal/ /skyabs su gyur nas skyabs gzhan ci/ /mang lags mod kyis khyed gsung la/ /'gal bar byas na nyes par 'gyur / / da ni legs pa nyid du shog /legs pa'i lam ston a ti sha /bsam gyisami khyab lha bzhi thob/ /da ni thog mtha' kun tu bzang / /sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i tshoms so/ /'di ltar/ dad pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /du mar gsungs kyang de nyid lags/ /drung nas 'brom rje der 'dus so/ /ngo mtshar khyod ni bsdud (sdud)la'ang mkhas / / zhes gsung ngo / /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ lha banil ji ltar gdams pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o// //ga3 bka' sde sdod gsum la 'dam kha ji ltar btang ba'i lersārang rgyud tha rgod 'bangs ('bags1pa'i dus/ /dam chos sbrang char nyin mtshan du/ /thugs rje'i sprin phung rgyun chad med/ /dge ba'i 'od zer glog rab 'byug /phan bde'i 'brug stong grags pa'i tshe/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i mkha' shed na/ /snang stong 'ja' yi gur cig byung / /bltas pas rgyal rigs gser mdog cig /mnyan pas tshig 'bru dus gsum dge /btugs (gtugs3pas rang lus dung ltar gyur/ /e ma ya mtshan de tshor nas / / sras kyi thu bo 'dod pa 'phel/ /de tshe rje la 'di skad zhus/ /pha bzang sras kyi thu bo nga / /lha bzang bzhi yis byin brlabs nas/ /chos bzang gtan gyi mdun ma dran/ /'khor 'dab che bas 'dod pa 'phel pha tshan du mas byin pa yi/ /'khor ba'i khang chen sdug bsngal stong / /kun 'byung 'gron (mgronakapo du ma la/ /lam rab bzang po'i 'gron (mgronakabyed pas/ /sde snod dpag tu med pa zhu/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba rin chen gsung / / phun sum tshogs nas 'di skad byon/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la mtha' med pas/ /'khor ba'i rgyu 'brasabaden pa gnyis/ /gting mtha' yangs pa'i khang chen du/ /rigs drug srid pa'i khye'u spel/ /byang chub sems kyi 'gron (mgron3yin gsung / /bsam gtan zas kyis bsnyen bkur phyir/ /sde snod 'od zer sde snod ni/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos yin/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yang grangs mang zhing / /theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam mi khyab / / bstan bcos gang zhig gang zhig las/ /skyob cing bde ba'i lam ston pa/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang las 'chos byed yin/ /blang dor zab mo legs bstan nas/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin sangs rgyas su/ /'chos par byed pa'ang bstan bcos yin/ /'byung gnas rang nyid gang mos par/ /rgyal ba bskyed la legs par 'doms//—14—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la gang nye ba'i/ /mthar thug chos shig zhu lags te / / phyi rab don du 'gyur ba'ang 'tshal/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de'i /ka 14na 1rgo'abrom te/rgyu ci yod/ 'tshang rgya ba la nye ba cig dgos na/ gsang sngags zab mo rnams la 'doms/ khyad par du do ha sems la tshud/ 'tshang rgya ba la de las thag nye ba med/ ston dus kyi lo thog kham rum me ba de dang 'dra/ grub thob chen po rnams kyi nyams len yin/ khyad par du do ha 'di kun byas na lung stong na phar la rnal 'byor pa bzang po nyams gar rtse zhing ḍa ma ru khrol le ba 'ong srid/ blo rab la chos rab 'tsham/ khyod kyi cha lugs 'di kun la lhag par du'ang 'di mthun gsungs pa'i glu ni/ /sras rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs theg pa gsum gyi gzhal yas khang / /blo khyad par 'phags pas gzhan don gnyer/ /dus gtan gyi mdun ma rdzogs gyur kyang / /ma grangs med don du mthar thug phyir/ /sku rin chen gsum la nye ba'i chos/ /lam mthar thug zab mo dgos so gsung / /gson gsang sngags theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /dgos dam chos zab mo do ha de/ /rje sa ra ha yis nga la byin/ /bu thugs kyi dkyil du 'di chongs gsung / /lar gsang sngags theg pa'i spyod tshul ni//phyi dpag med lha yi gzhal yas khang / /nang pho mo lha yi rang bzhin te/ /de bskyed pa'i rim pa tsam du zad/ /kye rdo rje 'dzin pa 'brom rje mchog /chos ye stong lhun grub zab mo de/ /don rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin no bsgom (sgoms3/ /kye phyi yi cha lugs du ma yang / khong gdul bya'i blo la bskyed rim yin/ /don ye stong zab mo'i rang bzhin la/ /phyi cha lugs drang don tshugs mi thub/ /bu mthar thug dgos na de la mdzod/ /mi khyed 'dra byung na lung stong rnams/ /rje rigs 'dzin du ma'i gar gyi gang/ /skom smyo chu 'thung kyang 'o mar 'gyur/ /grogs bdud mos bskor kyang lha mor 'char/ /de'ang legs par dpyad na shes rab dbyings/ /sems rab mthar phyin pa'i 'khyer lugs yin/ /rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'brom rje mchog /zas nam dran zos kyang bsam gtan yin/ /rtsa rig pa rlung sems dbu mar gnas/ /sems bzang po'i thig le nyag cig yin/ /de nyams su long cig 'brom rje mchog /sras kyis glu'i lan btsal ba ni/ rje nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /lha dri ma med pa spyi bor byon / / semasabade stong nam mkha'i dbyings shed na/ /dpal 'gran zla med de 'di skad gsung / /sras thu bo theg pa'i yang rtse 'di/ /mi khyod kyis legs par 'doms zhes gsung / /chos zab mo thos so drin can pa/ /de kho bo'i snying du skyong ngo rje/ /las bzang po kun la spel lo rje/ /sems g.yo ba med par bzung ngo rje/ /nyams dben pa'i gnas su skyong ngo rje/ /gnas lung stong chags med 'grim mo rje/ /snod gzhal yas khang du bkod do rje / / nang dag pa'i lhar bcas bskyed do rje/ khyed bla mas byin pa'i chos lugs yin/ /da myur du rdzogs sangs —15—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rgyas kyang sla/ /ma dpag med myur du 'drongs kyang sla/ /chos theg pa chen por 'brom ston rgyal/ /da rnam rtog phang phung ka 14 ba4 phaṭa phud/rlung la bskur/ /sems rnam rtog shing phreng me la bsreg /rgyud tha rgod rengs pa chu yis shon/ /nga bstan pa'i sa chen rab bgrod nas/ /mtha' bde gshegs shes bya'i nam mkhar 'gro / / rdo rje /ka 14 ba5 do /theg pa'i yang rtse snying du blang / /ha rnam shes thogasamed 'od gsal ba/ /chos spyi la'ang ma chags gzhan don spyod/ /de legs sam mgon po a ti sha /tshig 'gal lam skyes mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ /mgon po a ti sha'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /kye nga la gson dang mchog rab sras/ /sras khyod kyi mdzad spyod dpag med pas/ /lan bzang po de 'dra kho bo re/ /mi khyod kyis gang byas phun tshogs na'ang/ /rgyud ma dag sems can du ma zhig /rgyu tshogs gnyis sngon du ma song bas/ /chos theg pa che dang phrad gyur kyang / /chos sde snod gsum gyi ro ma myong / /gzhi tshul khrims gtsang ma gang dgar bor/ /rdzas chags med 'byor pas gzhan ma bskyangs/ /tshur bzod dka'i gnas rnams ma bzod cing / /las bzang po kun la spro ma byas/ /sems rtse gcig byang chub mi spyod par/ /ma shes rab yum gyis bslus pa mthong / /bu thabs med stobasadang smon lam shor / / kun mkhyen pa'i yul can ye shes bral/ /des btsan sa ma zin 'dod thag nye/ /gang ma yog do la rngam sems bskyed/ /rang theg pa chen por khas blangs nas/ /zhi las 'bras zab mo khyad bsad de/ /zas sha chang sgog gsum gdol pa'i zas/ /dus nam rnyed kha sgor gang byung za/ /lus spyod lam mchongs rgyug rgyags 'bog rtse / / ngag bag med phyogs med gdol thabs smra/ /sems ma zhig phyi yi ngo tsha btang / /lto ma phyid mi thod lag tu bzung / ༈ gos ma phyid zhe sdang khyi sbags dkris/ /ming zhig po grub thob dag tu 'bod/ /kye sras kyi thu bo nga la nyon / / nged sngags pa'i rigs rgyud yin no zhes/ /med kha med thig le gzhan du stor/ /nyams mi lan kha med bskyed rdzogs bral/ /rang bzang 'dod rtsa lhung tshig gis skyel/ /kye sras kyi thu bo nga la nyon/ khong nyan thosangan yang dge sbyong gi /chos bzhi ldan sems kyis dang du len/ /tshur bsdeg (brdegs3pa la yang slar mi sdeg (rdeg3 /mtshang 'bru ba la yang slar mi 'bru/ /tshur gshe ba la yang slar mi gshe /tshur khro ba la yang slar mi khro / khong nyan thos chos kyang de 'dra na/ /sras byang chub sems dpa' bzlog gam ci/ /rgyud sems can du ma snang gyur kyang / /mar ma gyur sems can su yang med/ /rang ngan song gsum du skyes gyur kyang / /ma sems can 'drongs na 'dod don yin/ khong shin tu dpa' ba'i go cha can/ /rje sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod yin/ /sras thu bo 'brom rje nga la nyon/ khong bla med rig 'dzin chen po rnams/ /de man chad theg pa dma' bo zhes/ /nged mthar thug rig 'dzin yin no gsung / khong snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /gnas dag pa'i gzhal yas —16—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /nyid yin zhing / /bcud rigs can 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nang lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin/ /zas ci za ci 'thung tshogs rab rnams/ a la la bdud rtsi rnam lnga yin/ /rje bla ma sangs rgyas ngo bo la/ /grogs thams cad rdo rje mched grogs yin/ /kye rig 'dzin pho mo gang tshogs kyang / /lha dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin la/ /dus dkyil 'khor cig tu dbyer med cing / /kun dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig lags/ /da de las gzhal yas mi 'khrul lam/ /lha pho mor mi 'dzin gzhan 'khrul lam/ /rje bla ma
