sangs rgyas mi shes sam/ /grogs rdo rje'i spun la sdig gsog gam/ /chos gsang sngags zab mo khrom sgrog gam/ /sems bskyed rdzogs mi byed tha mal lam/ /zas byin gyis mi brlob (rlobakatha mal lam/ /zas bsgyur ba mi shes rang mtshan nam/ /sems rnam rtog rlung gi skyod byed dam/ /yang bzang ngan chags sdang mi snyom mam/ /rten sngags pa ma yin dam nyams yin/ /de ngan 'gror lhung na thar ba dka'/ /chos dam tshig ma nyams legs bsrungs na/ /dus ring por mi thogs mngon sangs rgyas/ /chos mthar thug theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ /de shin tu zab ste bsrung bar dka'/ /bcud bzang po seng ge'i 'o ma de/ /snod ngan pa so skye'i rdza phor du/ /dus blug tsam nyid nas rdza phor chag /kye bla ma bzang po thabs mkhas pa/ /dus dang por dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs/ /dus gnyis par bskyed rim rim gyis bsten/ /dus gsum par gsang sngags snod gyur pa/ /dus de tshe nus med nus gyur cing / /rten theg pa chen po mchog tu bsngags / / sras thu bo 'brom rje nga la nyon/ /rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen grogs bzang ba/ /dus rten 'brel 'dzom na gsang sngags yin/ /gzhan bu chung sha khog za dang mtshungs/ /sras mi cig g.yang sa'i pha rol tu/ /lus stobs med 'dod pas pha rol mchongs/ /rgya gal te myur du sleb pa srid/ /rgya gal te rong du lhung gyur na/ /lus tshe srog 'bral ba nyen du che/ /kye de bas bde ba'i lam bskor nas/ /lus 'phral bde phugs su btsan pa yin / / chos bzang po sde snod rin chen gsum/ /gnas stan thog cig tu nyams blangs nas/ /nyen ngan song mi che mtha' phugs bzang / /rje sangs rgyas bstan pa dam chos yin/ /chos tshul bzhin byed pa dge 'dun yin/ /de 'dul ba'i sde la rag las pas/ /bu rgyal ba'i bka' lung 'dul ba bsten/ /mi khyod kyis gsang sngags skyong na yang / / phyi gnyen po btsan sa ma zin pa'i/ /chos zab mo'i grags pas sngags pa 'khrul/ /las 'khor ba'i gting rdo byas kyis dogs/ khyod gsang sngags zab mo rgyud la bsten/ /ngag gsang sngags khas len ma che cig /dpal bstan pa spyi yi zhabs tog tu/ /chos sde snod rin chen che bo bu/ /de phugs su dge'o 'brom rje mchog /ces pa'i gsung de thos nas/ 'brom gyi dgongs pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung lugs kyis/ sangs rgya ba la theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di shin tu nye ba'i theg/ pa'i yang rtse cig yin te/ 'di nyams su lon na ta/ sangs rgyas — 17byu

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sgrub pa la 'di bas nye ba med de/ so so skye bo 'ching ba mtha' dag gis bcings pa/ blo sna mang la 'dod thag nye ba cig gis ma zin par gnyis pa gsum pa sgrub par 'dod/ rang gi btsan sa ma zin par gzhan gyi snyan grags kyi rjes su 'brang / de yang chos zab mo mang po thos nas 'dun pa byed du 'gro ba ngo mtshar che ste/ zhu ba dang 'dor ba gnyis gang mgyogs byed/ kho bos ta nyams su blangs nas/ phyis kyi sku mched gsum 'dra ba snod dang ldan pa 'ga' re lung stong du khrid cing bsgom nyams sdol(brdolaka/ 'od gsal gyi rig shes 'bar/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gar gyis 'gengs pa 'ong nyen yod de ci phan/ bstan pa spyi la sems dgos par gda' ba/ dper na rgyal po rgyal srid skyong ba la/ rang nyid kha ngoms/ lto 'grangasaskyid pas phan par gda' ye/ nga dusagasum gyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyal srid bskyang dgos pa la/ gsang sngags sgeg mo'i sha 'dra ba nyug pa tsug sped pa tsug byed pa 'dis bstan pa skyongs so/ /nga mi rgan nyi ma 'de ba 'dra ba/ sde snod thang mar brdal nas/ su reg reg su lta lta/kha reg kha snum/ lag reg lag snum/ khe ri tsam pa/ nyen mgo bo tsam pa gang thob thob rgyal ba'i chosashig mi byed dam/ da gzod ngas do ha la rtsal thon pa cig byas/ thu bo gsum la sogs pa 'ga' zhig khrid nas/ lung stong cig na bzang po 'ga' zhig /ka 16ba 1 kha cig/'dug go zer ba'i sgra cig sgrog tsa na/ grub thob ngo mtshar can yod/ chos zhu ru 'gro dgos zer nas/ nor bag tsam re khyer te nga'i rtsa ru 'ong ba yin mod/ de dus su ngas ta snod brtags nas bstan pa'i chog ste/ la la mthun rkyen sna re tsam tshang bas chog snyam nas ngo mtshar che / khyed bsod nams chen po bsags theg pa chen po 'di 'dra ba mnyan du yod pa zer nas/ snod ci 'dra mi lta bar / bcud che re nye re blugs te/ da gzod bla ma 'brom gyi rnam par thar ba lags zer nas/ gsang sngags zab mo'i las skal tsho mi byed par/ zas skal tsho za/ bdud rtsir ming btags nas chang bag med 'thung /thabs su ming btags nas sha bag med du spyod/ za dus su sems can gzhan gyis go ba blangs nas 'chi ba ma byung bas/ sngagasapa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rang gis lag bdar te/ byang chub semasadapa'i pha ma/ sngags pa'i lha gsod pa lags mod/ de dus su ba glang gi mchod sbyin gyi nyen du che bar gda'/ de nas tshogs 'khor skad du ming btags nas/ bag med mang po 'dus nas bag med du 'khrab/ grub thob mang po bzi nas 'gyel/ des mi 'do (ste rang nyid sangs rgyas gson ma yin pa skad du/ sangs rgyas bdud rtsis nga rgyal te 'thab/ de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung ni 'di lta ste/ nga dang / khyod dang / nan tar na ci ma mnyam dang / nga bla ma su cig po'i sras po yin/ su cig ro/'i dbon po yin/ dgon pa 'di la nga las dbang che ba su yod/ yul 'di na ngas dbang ma bskur ba'i mi su yod/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba yin rgyu nged kyi yin zer nas/ byis pa bu mo rang gi —18—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /snabs lud 'phyid mi shes pa re la bla ma slob dpon du ming btags/ sgam sgom nyon mongs pa du mas gzer ba blang dor mi shes pa res/ bla ma sangs rgyas su bos pas/ 'o na nga rang yang a tsi bar 'ong ang snyam du sgom ni bzang / sangs rgyas kyi bya ba sems can cig mi 'drongs/ yang theg pa chen por khas blangs nas/ gzhan tshul khrims gtsang ma/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ rab tu dben par sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyis phyi rab tu mdzes pa/ nang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ gsang sngags phun sum tshogs pas rgyud phyug pa/ bla ma a ti sha lta bu la/ nyan thos sgom chung gis sa mi chod zer nas/ btsun tshugs can la nyan thos la sogs pa theg dman du ming 'dogs/ la la re zhig tshul khrims rin po che yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi mo mthar thug sa lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba sde snod gsum nas ji skad gsungs /ka 17 na3 byung / pa de bor nas/ theg pa chen po'i sngags la 'jug lo gcig byas/ de nyams su ma lon par sngags pa yin mod zer nas khyim cig (zhig1byas/ gos ngur smrig cig gyon/ pho khyom byas nas gral gyi mtho sa cig na yar la 'gro/ rang gi tshul khrims 'chal ba'i 'bras bu (zhigaka la ngo tsha mi shes par sras por ming btags nas/ shākya'i dge slong gi mgor sdod/ re res mang po phung la btang ba'i khrims yod/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags las ngo mtshar che ba gang na yod/ thams cad kyis rgyud sde nas ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du las skal dang / zas skal rten 'brel du 'dzom nas/ 'gro ba'i dpal mgon chen por gyur na/ de las lhag pa med/ ngo mtshar che ste de mi byed par/dam tshig nyams pa mang po cig byas/ yul khams su nad rims mang/ char chu dus su mi 'bab/ dmag dang /rme zhabrug dang / khyes ma 'tsheng nyen gyis khyer pa'i khrims yod/ da hril te dril ba'i mdo don la/ gsang sngags zab mo snod min rnams la legs par gsang la 'tshang rgya ba la 'di las bsngags pa med pas snod ldan rnams la 'di dben par bsten cing bstod bkur bsngags gsum bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor nang du bzhengs par bya'o/ /de zab byas kyang sde snod gsum du 'dus/ /rgyud nyon mongs pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu rnams spang byar shes nas bstan cing gdams pas rgyud dge 'dun du 'chos te/ ma dag pa dngos su dge 'dun du bskyed pas bskyed pa'i rim pa yin / de nas sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i mar bskyed/ tshad med bzhis ci 'drongs su bskyed/ byang chub kyi sems khyad par can gyis sa lam rim gyis bgrod pa'ang bskyed rim yin/ de nas shes bya rang mtshan dang spyi mtshan la dpyad nas gtan tshigs chen po bzhi'i rigs pas/ rang dang spyi'i chos ma lus par ye stong rgyu rkyen gyis ma skyed pa/ gnas lugs spros bral stong pa chen por rtogs pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin/ yang thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin/ sems stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ stong pa ye stong spros bral gyi rang bzhin du shes pa ni ye — 19—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/shes yin/ de sangs rgyas su gsungs pas sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i lha med/ mthar thug gi lha sangs rgyas chen por yongs su rdzogs pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin/ yang chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pa ni bskyed rim / spros bral don dam pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa ni rdzogs rim/ bsdoms na bskyed rdzogs gnyis po der sngags 'dus sam ma 'dus gsung / 'dus na des chog 'di nyams su blang / bskyed rdzogs gnyis su ma 'dus pa'i sngags kyis dgos pa med/ yang sngags de tshul khrims su 'du'am mi 'du/ 'du na de tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin/ tshul khrims de 'dul ba'i sde snod kyis ston pas 'dul ba las ma 'das par 'dug tshul khrims su yang ma 'dus na/ gzhi ma med pa'i chos des phugs mi thub/ gzhi med kyi chos kyis dgos pa med/ yang sngags de sems kyi bslab par 'dus sam ma 'dus/ 'dus na mdo sde'i sde snod kyis ston par byed pas de mdo sde'i sde snod las ma 'das par 'dug ma 'dus na spyod pa med pa'i lam rab dka'/ spyod pa bzang po lam rab dang ldan pa med na/ 'bras bu mthar thug tu mi phyin/ sems kyi bslab pa med/ spyod pa dang lam phun sum tshogs pa med/ des skyed pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas med pa'i chos de phar zhog yang sngags de shes rab kyi bslab par 'du'am mi 'du/ de la 'du na gnyis/ zag med dang zag bcas gnyis las/ de gnyis gang du 'du/gnyis kar du 'du na de mngon pas ston par byed pa yin pas mngon pa'i sde snod du 'du bar 'dug zag bcas dang zag med med kyi shes rab gnyis kar mi 'du na/ shes rab ma yin pa'i sngags de phar zhog shes rab gnyis gang du 'du yang mngon pa las ma 'das/ de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gtan la 'bebs par byed pa 'dul ba/ sems dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gtan la 'bebs par byed pa mdo sde dang mngon pa ste/ de la sde snod gsum zhes grags/ legs rung / nyes rung / bka' sde snod gsum bya ba yin / da de la brten pa'i bstan bcos sde snod gsum bya ba 'byung / hril te gril kadrilaka na/ nang par nas bla mas gang zag gi blo tshod gsum du bsdus nas stan thog cig tu hril te gril (drilaka nas nyams su len pa'i chos shig bla mas gnang bar yod/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyang bslab pa gsum po 'di yin dgos/ yang na 'di min dgos/ lar gsum po 'dir ma 'dus pa'i gsang sngags cig yod de/ tshul khrims kyang ma yin/ sems kyang ma yin/ shesarab kyang ma yin/ de na ni skyon che'o/ /hril te gril (dril1 na sde snodagasum las gzhan pa'i sngags med/sngagasam yin pa'i sde snod gsum kyang med/ de na jo bo chen po nga'i bsam sno (mno 1'di yin/ dge 'dun gyi chos byas pa la 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'ong / dge 'dun bya ba tshul khrims dang ldan pa cig la zer ba yin/tshul khrims rab cig bsrung ba la 'dul ba rab cig shes dgos/ tshul khrims 'bring cig bsrung ba la 'dul ba —20—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /'bring cig shes dgos/ tha na rtsa bzhi bsrung ba la'ang rtsa bzhi mi shes pa'i thabs med/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge 'dun la rag las/ dge 'dun dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la rag las/ 'dul ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa la rag las pas/ kho bos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsams nas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la chos skal cig bgyi'o/ /drang ba'i don/ nges pa'i don/ sngon rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis dka' ba spyad tshul la sogs pa zab dgu thams cad mdo sde la yod pas/ mdo sde la'ang kho bo'i chos skal cig bgyi'o/ kho bo kun brdzun la'ang mi mkhas/ mngon shes thogs /ka 18 ba 2 rgopa med pa'ang med pas//shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ston pa la/ ri bo mchog rab la sogs pa'i tshad dbyibs gling bzhi stong gsum la sogs pa mngon pa la brten nas so so skye bos kyang shes su rung bas/ byang chub la dmigs te mngon pa la'ang kho bo'i chos skal cig bgyi'o/ /sde snod gsum zhes kyang rung / bslab pa gsum zhes kyang rung / chos 'dul ba ka 18 ba3 rgogasum po/'di ni phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la byin te/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas sa gzhi gang ba tsam byas/ de dag gi rgyud thams cad sde snod gsum gyis rgyas par byas te sangs kyi bstan pa yongs su gsal bar bya'o snyam du nan tan du thugs la bcer cing bcer zhing sems pa na/ lha bzhi yang drung na slebs nas gda'/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang / sras kyi thu bo bsgom 'phel yang dang yang du bsgom /ka 18 ba4— mo/ //chos kyi 'dam kha de ni mchog go /ji ltar sems pa bzhin du/ gsang sngags thams cad kyang der ma 'dus pa med do// khye che la nyen chung ba'i chos rigs de yin/ thabs mkhas la shes rab che ba'i chos rigs de yin/ chos lam du 'gro ba'i chos rigs kyang de yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su/ lha bzhi'i zhal nas/ don spyi la sems pa'i skyes bu mchog /chos 'dul ba lha mchog khrims ldan bskyed/ /chos mdo sde lha mchog 'phags pa bskyed/ /chos mngon pa lha mchog rgyal ba bskyed/ /kye de yang gtso cher bstan par zad/ /chos gsum khas rgyal ba mchog tu bskrun/ /chos rig pa snod 'dir ma tshang med/ /chos bslab gsum lam ston rab gdams pa/ /rgyud gdul bya dag pa dpag med 'byung / /bka' zab mo 'dam kha ma log rje/ /dus thog mtha' bar gsum rab tu btsan/ /chos 'di gsum bcas par byin gyis brlabs/ /da the tshom ma byed sgrub la brtson/ /mthar theg pa'i lam du gang 'gro ba/ /sems the tshom ma mdzad sgrub la brtson/ /nged rnam dag lha yi gzhal yas rnams/ /sems the tshom ma mang sgrub la brtson/ /sras khyod kyi the tshom rab spangs nas/ /sngags zab mo 'dam kha legs so rje/ /gsang zhes pa chos kyi skyon ma yin/ /rje sangs rgyas sgrub la rab bsngags kyang / /snod tha mal rnams kyis 'chun par dka' / / mi khyod kyi snod dang rab bstun nas/ /bu sngags kyi dkyil 'khor nang du bsten/ /zhes gsungs nas —21 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rnam par dag pa'i mkha' la yal/ yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ thugs the tshom ma mang sde snod zung / /dus gtan gyi 'dun ma 'di nyid bzang / /blo the tshom can la byang chub dka'/ /sems rtse gcig ngang du bsgrub par mdzod/ /lar the tshom thams cad rnam spangs nas/ khong rgyal ba'i bka' lung dpag med kyi/ /don sgrub la nan tan gces su mdzod/ /rten le lo can rnams the tshom 'phel/ /don gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrubs pas nyams/ /don legs par soms shig sras kyi mchog /chos ji ltar zab kyang nyams len gtso/ /nga bka' gdamasarin chen bya bar bzang / /'brom gyi zhal nas/ zab chos du ma gsungs gyur cing / kho bos chosarnamasaro gcig par/ /sde snod gsum du gdams pa yang / /lha dang bla mas legs gsungs nas/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag gsungs pa rnams / / legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /the tshom thams cad spang bya zhing / /sgrub lanan tan gcesasu bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ bka' sde snod gsum la 'dam kha ji ltar btang pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //nga4 spyor ba ji ltar 'bad par bya ba'i lelgayang dus re zhig jo bo yab sras gnyis/ snye thang 'or na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom po tho rangasakyi dus la bab pa'i cha la/ mnal cig mdzad nas yod pa'i dus su/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ lha chos bdun ldan yar la bzhengs / / dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par dka'/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba dkon/ /mi rtag myur du 'gro ba'i chos/ /chu bo'i rba dang cis ma mtshungs/ /rtse gcig sems la gros thob la/ /nyams len sems la btsan sa bzung / / gnyid dang rmugs pa don med pas/ /dkon mchog bstan la dal 'byor rnyed/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma ding sang nyid/ /sgrub la le lo ma mdzad cig /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'gro ba'i bla ma a ti sha /bde skyid du ma ster byed gter/ /mad lags rmongs pa'i spyod tshul bstan/ /dus su gnyid log gdol pa 'dra/ /mi rtag rtag 'dzin 'ching ba che/ khyed gsung yal bar ga la 'dor/ /tshe 'di yud tsam snang ba yin/ /gnyid rmugs le lo byed phod dam/ /bla ma bdag gi sgo gsum rnams/ /kun nas kun tu byin gyis rlobs/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /gzungs chu gtsang mas lus khrus la/ /mi brjed gzungs kyi ting 'dzin bsgoms(sgomasaka/ /ting nge 'dzin med lhug par zhog /rjes la byams dang snying rjer spyod/ /slar yang log la gnasalugs bsgom(sgomasaka/ /lan du 'brom rjes 'di skad zhus/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rnyed gyur nas//gnyid rmugs le lo'i dbang song ba'i/ /mi de don med ma gyur tam/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /—22—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /rmongs pa nyin phyed gyur pa na/ /gnyid log bya ba bzhag gyur nas/ /nam phyed gzugs rnams mi mthong tshe/ /lag nom du mas bo sgyel byed/ /slar 'gyod 'phyis te le los lan/ /de bzhin skye bo rmongs pa rnams/ /mi lus rin chen thob pa'i tshe/ /bde sdug gzugs la mi lta bar/ /nongs pas ngan song skyes pa'i tshe/ /'gyod pa mi dran 'gyod kyang 'phyis/ /la la btso sreg du mas gzir/ /la la bkres skom phongs pas gtses/ /la la gsod bkol g.yin dbang gyur/ /sdug bsngal du ma thog babs kyang / /nam phyed lag nom byed dang mtshungs/ tages sam 'brom rje de dgongs la/ /gnyid rmugs le lo rab tu spongs/ /tshe 'di ji ltar byas kyang sla/ /'di yi dbang du ma song bar/ /gnyid 'di khrel med phyi thag thung / /le los 'dun ma/ thams cad sgyel/ /zhes gsung ngo/ /de dag ni gnyid rmugs dang le lo'i nyes dmigs bstan pa'i tshoms so /yang lan cig 'brom gyis 'di ltar zhus te/ kun gyis mgon po a ti sha /myur du byang chub sgrub byed na/ /gang dang ldan pa grogs su bzang / /ji ltar 'bad na btsan sar phyin/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /brtson 'grus go chas brgyan pa'i mi/ /mthar thug byang chub myur du 'grub/ /tha mal bya ba byed pa yang / /brtson 'grus med na 'bras mi mthong / /gtan gyi btsan sa sgrub pa la/ /brtson 'grus chen pos ma 'bad na/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol ji ltar sgrol/ /de bas brtson 'grus go cha long / /nam bzhag (zhagakagatan la 'bad par mdzod / / tshad med chos kyi gzhung lam la/ /dad pa'i gzhon (bzhonaka pa rab mnan nas/ /brtson 'grus lcag gisabrabs gyur na/ /don gnyis skye dgu'i btsan sar slebs/ /sras cig don med phyi shol (bsholakazhog /deng bya sang dang gnang ( gnangs1la lus/ /tha mar mi tshe zad 'gyur bas/ /de bas de ring nyid du bsgrubs(sgrubs3 / /e ma bdag gi sras gcig pu/ /dpa' bo rnams la dgra mi chugs/ /brtson 'grus can la bar chod sdug (rdugs3 /kun gyi btsan sa zin pa la/ /brtson 'grus go yis ma bsgyur na/ /bdud sde'i tshogs ni mtshon cha rno/ /nyes pa'i tshogs ni snying thag nye/ /du ma spangs kyang sbrang char 'bab/ /sde snod gser gyi khang rab tu/ /tshul khrims mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /bsam gtan bde ba'i zas kyis tshim/ /shes rab 'od kyis rab bltams nas/ /brtson 'grus yon tan 'phel byed gang / /thar ba'i lam la 'bad byas na/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma mi thogs par/ /ci bsams nyid na grub par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /mtho risathar ba ma lus pa'i/ /'grub byed brtson 'grus chen po ste/ /grogs ngan gnyid rmugs rab spangs shing / /le lo'i dbang du mi btang 'tshal/ /legs par bsdoms na 'di lta ste/ /gnyid rmugs le lo rab spangs shing / /rtag tu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba —23—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/las / sbyor bas ji ltar 'bad par bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi ba'o// // ca5 dbang po'i sgo brdomasate semasaji ltar 'dzin pa'i lersāyang jo bo yab sras gnyis snye thang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom gyis jo bo la 'di skad zhus pa/ spyir 'khor bar skyes/ de'i nang nas kyang mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'dir skyes/ rang gi sems la gdeng ma thob/grogs ngan gyi byur shal gos par sla/ khyed lta bu'i bla ma dam pa bsten pa la/ stan thog cig tu bsdad de/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma lings te skyur nas/ nam bzhag (zhagakagatan gyi 'dun ma de ring 'grub bam snyam pa cig (zhigakadagos par gda' bas/ khyed rgya gar nas byon pa'i nyams dga' la/ dge bsnyen rgan po mi cig gi sar / khyed paṇḍi ta chen po cig byon/ kho bo 'dra ba'i tha mal pa cig la yi dam gyi lha mang pos lung bstan thugs rjes bzung / bla ma rnams kyis kyang yul 'dir bskul/ da dge bshes khu gcig pu la bsams nas kyang gtan gyi 'dun ma de ring la mi bsgrub (sgrubakapa'i skabs med pas/ /'dun ma'i sgrub lugs shig zhu dgos par gda'o / / zhes zhus pa ni 'di lta ste/ /snye thang 'or mo'i skyo bsangs su/ /u pa si ka'i skyo bsangasaphyir/ /jo bo'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas dgongs su gsol/ /rtsod dus snyigs ma 'di ltar 'dra/ /stobs med gzhan don khur chen la/ /rgya gar gnas nas 'dir byon pa/ /lha dang bla mas lung bstan nas/ kho bo rjes bzung drin du tshor/ /da ni gtan gyi 'dun ma rnams/ /hril de gril (dril3 ba'i nyams len zhu/ /gang la bltas kyang dal glags med/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ de la nga la thabs chen po yod/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma lings te lag len la thob la skyur/ bshad pa dang khas len mang pos don mi 'grub/ 'di ltar dben pa'i gnas su gong du bshad pa ltar bla ma dang yi dam la gsol ba thob/ sde snod gsum skyes bu gsum du hril te gril(dril1/gnyid rmugs dang le lo'i bdud ma zhugs par brtson 'grus chen pos lha dang bla ma mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon pa la/ sgo gsum gyi sgo nas yan lag bdun pa rgyas par phul/ dad gus dung pa gyis la bla ma dang yi dam mdun na 'o skol gnyis gsung gleng byed pa bzhin du 'bral ba med par bsgoms(sgomasaka / u pa si ka bla ma yi dam la thugs rje yod/ chos mthu btsan/ khyod la dad gus kyi lung yod/ khyod rang zer ba bzhin du the tshom thams cad hril te spongs/ da lus dum bu brgyar song yang bsgrub (sgrub1pa 'di 'dor bar mi bya'o snyam du bsgrub (sgrubakapa la nan tan gces spras su byas nas/ dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni/ stan bde ba la lus gnad legs par bcas/ sems can dmigs yul du byas nas skyabs 'gro phun sum tshogs par byas/ yang gzhan —24—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gye dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ de nas sems gzung bar bya ste/ rang gi snying gi dkyil du paṃ kar po zhu ba'i padma'i steng la a thig le 'bring po tsam bskyed/ de zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang de tsam bskyed/ de nas de'i steng du hrīḥdang oṃ dkar ser gang kyang (yang3rung kho bo bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med par bskyed la/sems rtse cig tu de nyid la bzung ste/ mig gi dbang po'i sgo bsdams te phyi rol gyi gzugs la mi spro/ rna ba'i dbang po'i sgo bsdams te/ phyi rol gyi sgra la mi spro/ de bzhin du sna/ lce/ lus/ yid rnams/ dri ro reg bya rnam par rtog pa la ma 'byams par bya ste/ bla ma dran pas mi brjed par byas/ shes bzhin gyis brtan par bya/ bag yod pas dad gus phun sum tshogs par bya ste/ bla ma'i sku nas gang tsam gsal la dag pa dri ma med pa'i kha dog lnga'am drug phyogs bcur 'phro ba de lta bu zhig la sems legs par bzung ste/ yid kyis phyag bya mchod pa bya/gsol ba 'di ltar gdab ste/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta yan chod kyi nyes pa phra zhing phra ba rnams byang bar mdzad du gsol/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa rnams gdul bya'i don las skad cig kyang ma g.yos par mkhyen brtse'i lam du zhugs pa rnams dang rang nyid kyang grogs la de dag la chags sdang cig kyang mi mnga' bar dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig gis rjes su yi rang phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de dag la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar gsol zhing bdag gis bskul ma thag tu dus gsum du dge ba la sogs pa rtswa dang shing gel pa la sogs pa'i bem po yan chod kyis ston cing bskor bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol / bdag gis rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa de dag la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa cam gyis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can re re'i mdun du yang / rgyal ba sras bcas cha tshang bar bzhugs nas / de dag dang mthun pa'i chos ston cing / de dag rim gyis 'dren cing bzhugs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol / gzhan yang bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsngos pa thams cad mdzad pa'i rkyen dang bral nas/ sa bcu rim gyis bgrod cing mthar sems can gyi don du bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang thogs pa med par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang bdag gis gnas skabs su sems can gang la gang 'dod pa rnams smon lam btab pa tsam gyis 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de dag mi 'byung ba'i gegs bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba grol par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i khong skran zhi nas rab tu mi gnas par dbu ma chen po'i thugs kar/ dbu ma chen por gyur pas spros pa dang bral ba'i sku/dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'di bzhin du gnas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes gsol ba yang btab/ de bzhin tu gyur cig ces smon lam yang gdab/ de bzhin du yang dang yang du dran —25—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pas bskul/ shes bzhin gyis zin par byas/ bag yod pa'i sgo nas de bzhin du bya'o/ /de nyin mor ma zad/mtshan mor ma zad/ de yang nyin gsum mtshan gsum du/ u pa si ka blo hril te gril (dril3/ skabs 'dir zab zab po mang po mi 'tshal/ thabs shes rab kyi tshom bu'i skabs 'dir khab rtse gnyis pa mi 'tshal/ stan thog gcig tu zab mo mang po hril te gril (drilakanas nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir blo the tshom rtse gnyis mi 'tshal / bsgrub (sgrubakapa la nan tan gces su mdzod/ gnyid rmugs dang le lo rab tu spangs shing brtson 'grus chen pos dran pa shes bzhin bag yod phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas dus drug tu de ltar sems gzung bar bya ste/ rang gi sems kyi rgyud la'ang brtags nas bla ma yi dam la skyabs 'gro chad ma chad lta/ the tshom gyis sgrub pa bor ma bor lta/ gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i bar chod kyis khyer ma khyer lta/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba chod ma chod lta/ gzhan don phyogs re bar song ma song lta/ de ltar spyod pa'i blo thams cad 'das pa'i cha dngos med/da lta'ang dngos med/ ma 'ongs pa'i cha dngos med/ dngos med rang stong / rang stong dbu ma/ de ltar gnas pa de la shes rab zer/ sems bla ma la 'dzin pa la thabs zer/ bla ma'i sku chung ngu na bskyed pa'i dgos pa ci yin na/sems gsal la zin pa'i dgos pa yod/ rnam rtog mi 'phro ba yin/ yang chos dbyings la sogs sam/ yig 'bru la stim na'ang sla ba yin/ u pa si ka de thig le dang po yin/ yang long che na long che na byas pas kyang mi yong / 'di las gal che ba cig (zhig3gang na yod/ 'di las gal che ba cig (zhig3byung na bdud zhugs pa yin/ da bdud ma zhugs par bla ma'i sku nas rdog tsam pa de'i thugs kyi dkyil du yang / paṃ ser po las padma ser po/ de'i lte bar a (āḥ3 dkar /ka 22 na 5rgopo/thig le 'bring po tsam/ de yang zla ba de cam/de'i steng du oṃ ser po de yang thub pa sngar gyi bla ma tsam/ de la yang sngar gyi bla ma la ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de ni thig le gnyis pa'o/ /yang thub pa nas rdog tsam de'i thugs kar paṃ sngo ljang las padma sngo ljang de'i lte ba la a dkar po thig le 'bring po tsam/ de yang zla ba de tsam/ de'i steng du ṭwāṃ sngo ljang / de yang sgrol ma sngar gyi thub pa de tsam mo/ /de la yang sngar gyi bla ma'i skabs su ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /sgrol ma de'i thugs kar yang paṃ dkar po las padma dkar po/ de'i lte ba la a dkar po thig le 'bring po tsam/ de las zla ba de tsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po de yang spyan ras gzigs sngar gyi sgrol ma de tsam mo/ /de la yang sngar gyi bla ma'i skabs su ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bya'o/ /yang spyan ras gzigasakyi thugs kar de yang paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba de'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag de yang mi g.yo ba che chung nas tsam de la dmigs te sems bzung / ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du gong bzhin du dang / bstan pa yun ring skyong ba dang / gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bar gcod mi 'byung ba —26—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dang / gsol ba gang mos su gdab par bya'o/ /'di'i skabs su/ u pa si kas phyag mtshan gang bgyi zhus pas/khyed gsol ba gang la 'debs gsung / de gtso che ba da ci nas kyi de rang lags zhus pas/ 'o na thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pas chog sgrol ma la phyag brgyad dang / thugs rje chen po la phyag stong spyan stong la sogs pa byas kyang 'gal ba med/ bzhugs lugs thams cad mthun par byas pas chog yang sgrol ma phyed skyil/ mi g.yo ba g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum du byas kyang chog gzhan 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs yin/ thams cad rdo rje skyil krung dang mnyam bzhag tu byas na byin brlabs che gsung / yang 'brom gyis/ phongs pa nor zhu ba lta bu cig (zhigaka la gsol ba ji ltar gdab zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ thams cad lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba'am/ nor bu rin po che khyer ba la sogs pa byas pas chog gzhan yang 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la sogs pa de dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul la sogs pa gzhan nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du byas pas chog de ring gi 'di sems 'dzin pa'i man ngag yin/ spros pa mang po mi 'tshal/ thams cad chung la gsal ba 'od 'phro la dwangs pa/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis byin/ brlabs 'byung ba/ skyil krung zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa 'ba' zhig byas pas chog g.yin rnams rang rang gi bskyed rim gyi sar ston// 'gro 'dug la sogs pa spyod lam gyi tshe na sngar gyi theg le lnga bo de dag yang yang gsal 'debs pa las/ rang bzhin du gshegs pa la sogs pa mi 'tshal/ byed na mi g.yo ba rang gi yig 'bru la thim nas rim gyis gdan dang bcas pa spyan ras gzigs la thim/ de bzhin du thub pa'i bar du thim nas/ jo bo'i sku 'ba' zhig lham mer bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag mchod la sogs pa byed/ de nas dbang po lnga yul la cung zad spro ba na/ rmi lam sgyu ma'am/ gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa snang la zhen pa med pa 'a le 'o le 'o /ka 23 na2 'al le 'o le 'o/cig (zhigakagi na/nga du 'di ltar brdzun (rdzuka / slu mi bden na/ nga'i pha ma rnams don med par sdug bsngal ang / snying re rje snying re rje/ nga la drang bar bab/ bskyed pa cig (zhigaka bya dgos/ 'di dag bde ba cig (zhig3bya dgos/ 'di dag myur du sangs rgyas la 'khod na ci ma rung / bdag 'di dag gi don byar yod pa/ gnas lugs shes pa/gong ma rnams la gsol ba gdab tu yod pa de re dga' snyam du tshad med pa dungs dungs pa bsgom (sgomasaka /yang 'di rnams thabs yin/ nang du bsgom pa de rnams shes rab yin/ u pa si ka thabs shes rab gnyis ka dang ma bral ba gal che/ dbang shes drug po yul la g.yengs ma gyur/ /zhes pa'i don go ru gda'/ der 'brom gyis zhus pa/ shin tu drin che/ de ring lha chos kyi bsgom lugs legs por thob cesagasungs nas/ bla mas du ma bstan gyur kyang / /mdo don gril (dril3na 'di lta ste/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo —27—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rnams rtag tu bsrung / /nyin mtshan dus gsum yang dang yang / /sems kyis rgyud la brtag par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig (zhigakalas mi gda' yi/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom de de bzhin no/ /hril te gril (drilakab la'ang mkhas / de ring yan chod bshad tshad spyi sdom cig (zhigakayi ger 'debs na ji skad zer/ jo bo'i gsung rnams gril (dril3na 'di tu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /dran/ dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams rtag tu bsrung / /nyin mtshan dus gsum yang dang yang / /sems kyis rgyud la brtag par bya/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /kye du/'brom gyis phyag gsum btsal te/ sems kyi 'dzin lugs la sogs pa thugs la btags te/ sems can rnams kyi rgyu ni ma rig pa dang / sred pa dang / len pa gsum gyis byas/ rkyen ni 'du byed srid pas byas/'bras bu rnam par shes pa ming dang gzugs/ skye mched drug reg pa/ tshor ba/ skye ba/ rga shi rgyu rkyen 'bras gsum kho ra khor yug tu ma dag pa'i 'khor 'o 'ba' zhig bskor nas/ rang skyon thams cad thal mos 'gebs/gzhan skyon thams cad mdzub mos 'bru/ bla ma'i gsung slob mas mi sgrub/ pha zer la bu mi nyan/ jo bo chen po dus ngan pa 'di 'dra shar nas gda' ba/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis ma dag pa'i 'khor lo la sems can spyi spyod kyang / spyi nor la sgos su snyigs ma'i sems can gyis spyad nas gda' bas/ phyi rabs don gnyer ba /ka 23ba6 /can/ re re gnyis gnyis la phan srid pas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi bshad pa cung zad tsam zhig zhu zhus pas/ jo bo na re/ da gzod 'dam gyi brdze bcangs cig (shigakabyed tsa na bshad kyis gsung / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ 'o na 'ching ba'i rtsa ba gang lags/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gsung / bdag tu 'dzin pa gang lags zhus pas/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad bdag gcig pu la dgos pa/ nyes pa thams —28—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba spe'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /cad gzhan kho nas len par byed pa cig (zhigakayin gsung / 'o na de 'dra'i bdag 'dzin bdag 'dzin ces 'dogs kyin 'dug gsung / jo bo 'dzin pa can de 'dra cig /ka 24 na2 yod pa/ yod dam zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ ga na yod dam zer/ de rang rgyud lags mod zhus pas/ u pa si ka rang rgyud gang lags gsung /de mi dgos dgu dgos 'dzin pa can lags mod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bo yang de skad zer gsung /'o na bdag 'dzin 'di gnas pa gang na gnas zhus pas/ cha med kho bos mthong ma myong / gnas bya med pa'i gnas byed mi shes/ ngo bo med pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog mi shes gsung / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ 'o na 'di 'dra'i nyams thag pa cig mi 'ong la thang a zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ smig rgyu'i chu dang / zla gnyis dang/ rmi lam gyi rta glang la sogs pa'ang mi mthong la thang a gsung / /jo bo de 'khrul snang lags mod zhus pas/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bo de bzhed/ bdag 'dzin kho yod na chags sdang byed pa ma yin/ gzhong stong gi phyir du lung stong du khyi zugs/ gzhi med la rang rgyud chen po 'brul/ jo bo dpe de 'dra na/ bdag 'dzin rang ye med 'dra zhus pas / jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'dra bya ba ci la zer dngos yin mod gsung / jo bo 'o na ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa dang / mtho ris kyi yon tan dang / blang dor la sogs pa'i 'grig 'grig bya byed gda' ye ang zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ rmi lam rmi byed gda' ye ang gsung / jo bo de dang mi 'dra/ rmi lam rang gis byas pa min/brdzun (rdzun1 bzhin du byung ba yin/ mtho ris ngan song spang blang la sogs pa 'di tsho byas pa yin zhus pas/jo bo na re/ sus byas gsung / de sems kyis byas lags mod zhus pas/ kho bo'angade zer/ rmi lam kyang sems kyis byas pa yin / u pa si ka sems kyis ma byas na sus byas g.yin gyis byas sarme// gzhan gyis kyang ma byas/sems kyis kyang ma byas na/ u pa si kas brdzun la nyid brdzun byas/ rmi lam gyi yul rang gzhan thams cad kyis stong pa'i rdzun pa yin/ de bzhin du ngan song la sogs pa'i spang blang yang sems kho rang gis sprul zhing spang blang byed pa yin mod gsung / 'o na chags sdang gi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin/ de rang sems yin nam ang zhus pas/sems de'i kha dog gang du gda' gsung / de kho bos mthong ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na dbyibs ci 'dra cig (zhig3 gda' gsung / jo bo kho bos mthong ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis char ma —29

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/grub mig gis mthong ma myong tsa na/ gzugs su med pa'i rtags yin/ gzugs kyis stong gis la phar zhog u pa si ka sems de sgra snyan mi snyan dang che chung la sogs pa gang du gda'/ jo bo kho bos thos ma myong zhus pas/ 'o na sgra snyan mi snyan dang che chung la sogs pa gang du yang mi snang bas/ rna bas ma thos na/ yod na rna bas thos dgos pa la med/ da sems sgras kyang stong pas phar zhog /u pa si ka khyod kyis sems de dri zhim mi zhimu ci ru 'dug gsung / jo bo/ sems kyi dri'am de mnom myong lags zhus pas/ 'brom dri cig (zhigakayod na snas ma mnams dogs med/ da snas ma tshor tsa na/ sems dris stong pa'i rtags yin/ dris stong pa'i stong nyid de phar zhog 'brom khyod kyi sems de ro zhim mi zhim ci ru 'dug gsung / 'brom na re/ jo bo'i gsung nas ci yang 'byon par 'dug sems zos pa'i ro zhim mi zhim bya ba'i khrims shig rang yod de ang zhus pas/ 'brom 'o na med dam ang gsung / jo bo sems za ba'ang ga na yod/ ro tshor ba'ang ga na 'ong zhus pas/ 'brom khyod kyi sems de ro ma yin pa'i rtags yin/ ro zhig yin na lces tshor 'ong / lces ma tshor tsa na ro ma yin pa'i rtags yin / ros kyang stong pa de phar zhog 'brom khyod kyi sems de reg bya 'jam rtsub gang du 'dug gsung / jo bo sems kyi reg bya lta ma myong zhus pas/ 'brom de ci yin gsung / sems kyi reg bya bltas pa'i khrims gda' zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ sems can dmu rgod pa la khrims med mang ba yin te/ sems lus kyi yul du ma gyur /ka 25 na1 rgotsa na/pa ni reg byas stong pa cig (zhig3 yin pa'i rtags yin/ reg bya'ang ma yin pa'i sems de phar zhog 'brom 'o na yid kyi yul na ji 'dra cig (zhigakagada' gsung / jo bo yid kyi yul du 'ong ba la dbang po'i de ma thag rkyen dgos par gda' ste/ sngon la dbang po'i yul du ma gyur pas de ma thag rkyen yid yul du mi mchi zhus pas/ de rtog pas rang bzo byas pa'ang 'ong gsung pas/ jo bo rang bzo la'ang bag chags shig sngo na du song 'tshal/ gzhan yang dbang po lnga'i yul du ma gyur pas/ yul lnga med pa'ang khyab ma ches sam zhus pas/ u pa si ka ci zer/ yul thams cad der rtsis pa med/ khyod kyi sems de'i steng du rtsis pa yin / sems de de dag tu yod na khyod kyi bltas tsa na/ yang na gzugs su yod pa'am/ sgrar thos pa la sogs par 'gyur dgos kyis/ de dag gang du'ang mi snang na/ sems de gar sdod/ u pa si ka 'jig rten tha mal pa kun yang / ngas de 'dra mig gis mthong ba yang med/ rna bas thos pa'ang med/ dri ma tshor/ ro ma myong / yid kyi dgu la mi gda'o zer nas zhe zhag par lag pa phyi la g.yob/ khyed bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis smin par byas / yi dam lha'i dngos grub zhugs/ bka' sde snod gsum stan thog cig tu nyams su len pa'i mi cig gzhi med kyi yal 'dab ma 'dogs/ de ltar thams cad sems yin te/ sems kyi gnas lugs de 'dra/ nga a wa sgru —30—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ti'i bu yin pas shes pa yin/ da ngan mtshang brus kyang sems yin/ bstod ra btang kyang sems yin/ skyid de sdug gi sems yin/ sems ma yin pa mnyam po la/ bdag med bdag snang gi rgyud la nyes pa byung tshad 'bur 'joms gyis la sgrogs la thong / ma grub pa'i phugs der ma grub pa'i nyes pa de 'dra ba 'tshang don med/ de dug tu song nas nad bskyed don med/ nad grangs lnga ru nges don/ med/ des thar ba'i srog gcod/ ngan song gsum du skyur don med/ rmi lam rdzun yang sdug bsngal rmis pa dgos pa med/ 'brom/ hes pa zog ma de rnams phyir phyung / nyes pa dag pa'i shul de legs na'ang legs/ ma legs na'ang ma legs/ sems brdzun (rdzunakapa'i snang ba mnyam po la gzhan kun bstod ra btang bas dga' bar 'dug na thong la thong / khyod rang la tshol byed med pa'i khong gi 'khrul ba ma btsal/ sped pa mnyam po la rang gi yon tan /ka 25 ba 2 rgornams/ sbos/dgos pa'i dus su slebs nas 'ong ba yin/ sgrog pa mnyam po la gzhan gyi yon tan sgrogs/ gzhan dga' nas rang la brten te sdig pa mi gsog chags sdang nyon mongs kyi smang (rmang3'gyel ba'i dgos pa yod pa yin/gzhan gyi yon tan gang 'dug pa'i sna rtse re nas bsgrub (sgrubasakal bstod par gyis/ u pa si ka thams cad sems su go'am gsung / go lags zhus5 pas/ 'o na sems kyi gnas lugs shes sam gsung / shes zhusag pas/'o na sems de la 'dod pas ci byed yin/ tshe 'di'i bde skyed ster bar byed pa'i drin can pha ma yin/ des na byas pa shes shing drin du gzo bar bya / de la bla ma la gus mchod bsgrub (sgrub3 pa la sogs pas thekhas thog par bya/ pha ma la drin lan du byams pa tshad med pa dang / snying rje tshad med pa dang / legs na dga' ba tshad med pa dang/ nye ring phyogs ris med pa'i btang snyoms dang / ma thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas ci thob tu bya ba the tshom spangs te / bsgrub pa (sgrub3 la nan tan gces su bya/ gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i bar chod spangs te brtson 'grus kyis 'bad par bya/ 'brom/ byas pa shes shing drin gzo zer kyang / byams snying rje la sogs pa tshad med bzhi bsgom zhing /byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa/ gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa/ smon 'jug gi skya bar nas pha ma 'drongs ngos shes pa cig (zhigakal tshe 'di'i rang 'dod spangs nas 'dod pa ltar snang / pha ma 'dren 'dod kyi bsam pa/ drin lan 'jal 'dod kyi bsam pa bzang po de lta bu cig (zhig3la zer ba yin gsungs pa dang /—31 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'brom gyi zhal nas/ jo bos legs pa du ma dag gsungs kyang bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /bdag gi nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing / / gzhan gyi 'khrul ba btsal mi bya/ /bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag ka26 na 2 bsgrub/ par bya/ /rnyed dang bkur sti spang bya zhing / khengs gregs(grags1rtag tu spang bar bya/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes dang / /byas la drin du gzo bar bya/ /byams dang snying rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ de de bzhin no/ /legs par bsdus na der 'dus gsung ngo / /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ le lan thams cad gcig la ji ltar gda' ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //ja7 sbang bya ji ltar sbangasanasadage ba la 'jug pa'i lersāyang bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom gyis/ jo bo chen po lags / sngar zhus pa de dag gi spang bya gang lags/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ mtshams med /ka 26 na 5waṃlnga/dang de dang nye ba lnga khyed la mi 'ong / mi dge ba bcu yin/ gu ru dī paṃ ka ra nyes pa u pa si ka la 'ong nas zhus pa min/ kho bo'i phyi gzhug la gdul bya ci tshod cig (zhig3'ong zhus pas/ jo bo thal mo sbyar nas/ nga'i u pa si ka mad/ brgyad khri dang stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /dpal chen po kho bo de dag gi spang bya 'dri ba yin/ u pa si ka khyod kyi bu tsha bo yang tsha gsum la mi dge ba bcu yang spyod pa nyung na/ mtshams med pa dang / de dang nye bar spyod pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas kyang khyod kyi rjes su 'brang ngos shes pa rnams ni ji lta bu'i dus la thug kyang mtshams med dang / de dang nye ba lnga yang mi spyod/ khyod kyi rnam par thar ba la brten pa rnams ni mi dge ba bcu la mi 'bag thugs rje chen po nga la gson cig lus kyi mi dge rnam gsum mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang/ de bzhin gshegasapa dang / chos kyi mig can rnams ni yul khyad par can yin pas bsad na bar do med par sngags pa kun na re/ rdo —32—

bya'o/ /gsod du gzhug par mi bya'o/ /gsod pa la rjes su yi rang bar mi bya'o/ /gal te mir skyes na yang nad mang tshe thung ngo / /gzhan yang bdag pos yongs su bzung ba'i nor/ mthu dang sngags dang 'jab bu la sogs pas ma byin par blang bar mi bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ mi brku/ mi 'phrog /tha na kha gsag dang gzhogasaslong yan chad mi bya'o/ /gal te byas na gong bzhin du ngan song las lam med/ phal che ba thams cad yi dwags su skye bar bshad / 'brom/ gal te mir skyes kyang longs spyod kyis dbul zhing phongs/ bzar med/ btsal du'ang med/gyon rang /ka 27 na 3 du'ang/ med pa mi'i lus blangs tsam mo/ /'brom/ mi tshangs pa rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi spyad/ ma sring la sogs pa nye 'brel rnams sun mi dbyung / dge slong ma la sogs pa sdom bsrung ma rnams sun mi dbyung / gzhan yang dus ma yin par gzhan na ba'am/ nyin mo'am/ rma sgo gzhan du spyod pa la sogs pa ni 'dod pas log par g.yem pa zhes bya ste/ ngan song mu mtha' med par 'gro ba'i rgyu yin pas mi tshangs spyod dang bcas te rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ /gal te mir skyes kyang khyim gyi sdug bsngal chen pos mnar te/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang gzhan spyod du 'jug pa dang / rjes su yi rang byed pa la'ang gong dang mthun/ gzhan yang brdzun (rdzunakadu smra ba dang / phra ma dang /ngag 'khyal dang / tshig rtsub mo 'di dag gis kyang ngan song mu mtha' med par skye ba'i rgyu che bas rnam pa thams cad du spang bar bya'o/ /gal te mir skyes kyang gzhan gyi tshad mar mi 'dzin cing skur ba mang ba dang / ngag mi btsun zhing gzhan gyi co 'dri ba'i gnas su byed pa dang / mi dang mi mdza' zhing gzhan gyis rang nyid mthun pa'i —33—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/grogs dang 'byed pa dang / mi kha sdang zhing don med pa thams cad kyis kyang brlang po'i tshig brjod du 'ong ba la sogs pas mi'i bde ba dang yang bral/ des na mi dge ba bdun po de dag spong ba dge ba bdun du bsten par shes par bya ste dge ba bdun la gzhan yang 'god/ bsgrub (sgrubakapa rnams la'ang rjesasu mthun 'gyur brjod / 'brom khyod rang 'dra ba'i btsan sa zin pa rang 'khor bar skyes kyang sla ba/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa la ni mi dge ba bdun thabs dang sbyar te spyad/ de ni mi dge ba ltar snang ba'o/ /'brom bla ma dang dkon mchog gi nor dang / nad pa dang ma nus pa'i nor la sogs pa gzhan gyi rdzas rang la yod na ci dga'i brnab sems mi bya/ yin na ci ma rung ci thob bya'o snyam pa'i brnab sems mi bya'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' la'ang bkag gzhan yang/ gzhan nyes na dga'/ rlag na dga'/ bsad semasal sogs pa gnod pa'i sems thams cad rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyasami bden/ chos mi bden/dge 'dun mi bden/ 'jig rten snga phyi med/ las rgyu 'bras med zer zhing chosabyas pas sdug bsngal byung ba rnams rtags su 'god/ de dag ni log par lta ba bya ba yin/ de 'dra ba'i las kyis 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar mi srid de/ de ni rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du mi bya'o/ /'brom mi dge ba bcu nyes dmigs dang bcas pa mdor mtshon tsam bshad/ gzhan khyed rang mdo sde legs par ltos/ lar kyang gdul bya rmongs pa blo 'khrug pas rags pa de tsam re ston/ mang na gdul bya rmongs pa la mi phan pa yin/ de ltar na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gong du bshad pa de dag yul du byas nas khro zhing 'brug par mi bya/ lam du mi 'gro ba'i nga rgyal gyis khengs par mi bya/ khro 'khrug byung ma thag tu gnyen pos gzhom par bya ste/ rang nyid dman pa'i sems kyis zhi zhing dul bar bya'o / / log pa'i 'tsho bas rnam pa thams cad du 'tsho bar mi bya ste/ chos kyi 'tsho ba 'ba' zhig gis nyin dang mtshan du 'tsho bar bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas mkhyen nam/ khro bas ni bskal ba du ma'i dge rtsa 'joms/ nga rgyal gyis ni bag yod bstan pa'i myu gu 'joms/ log pa'i 'tsho bas dge sbyong gi chos las nyams par byed/'brom de ltar na mi dge ba bcu dang 'brel ba'i chos de dag kyang mi bya'o/ /rags pa de tsam cig 'o skol gnyis blo phebs pa'i gsung gleng yin/ 'gal 'brel mang po'i skabs ma yin/ 'brom de dag khyed kyi thugs la 'tshal lam gsung / 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas gsung gleng mang po byed long yang mi 'ong / /mi dge bcu yi rnam thar de kun la/ jo bos de kun las 'dus la rgya che ba gtsang la don phyin pa/ legs po cig rang gsungs na 'ong ba lags te/ bdag cag yab sras gnyis kyi gsung gleng gi lugs la brul tsam yin zhus pas/ 'jo bo'i zhal nas / 'brom/ kho bos tshig sgrig ma shes pa ma yin/ khyod gcig pu'i blo ngor bstan pa ma yin/ /'o na kho bos —34—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /saṃ skṛ ta'i skad las bshad na ji 'dra cig mchi/ mi dgos khyed bod kyis de kun kyang mi go der ma zad lto za lugs gos gyon lugs spyod lam byed lugs/ mas bu chung la slob pa 'dra ba cig byed dgos pa'i lugs yin/zlos skyon spang ba la sogs pa'i skabs de 'di min/ 'brom bod kyi skye bo thams cad nga'i mdun du 'dus nas/sems la phan pa'i gdams ngag cig (zhig3 zhu zer na/ de dag la kho bos 'di skad bshad na ci 'dra cig (zhigaka mchi/ thams cad mkhyen dang mkhyen lam de bsgrub pa/ /dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mi rtog kyang / /gang gis legs gsol dgos 'dod bskrun par byed/ /rin chen ljon rtser skal ldan bya tshogs bsdud (sdudaka //'dab la dga' che 'bras bu bzang po za/ /nyi 'od stong ldan dpag med rab bde ('dekazhing / /bden gnyis gshog brkyangs /ka 28na 6rgyang/ byams pa'i mchu yis 'dren/ /thabs shes rkang ldan yan lag brgyad ldan par / / rnam dag mkha' lding chags pa mi mnga' ba/ /spros pa'i mtha' bral tshig 'bru rab tu bzang / /byang chub phyogs ldan gshag sgro rab tu rgyas/ /sgro re'ang thabs shes dbu ma chen po'i gzhung / /mkhas pas gnyis la'ang legs par spyad gyur na/ /bye brag yul phran rten 'brel dpag med gda'/ /rtsa ba gtsang ldan rtse mo rab tu rno/ /shin tu phra yang rlung gis mi g.yo'i spu/ /shin tu 'jam yang reg byas gzhan mi slu/ /rnam par mi rtog spyad na ya mtshan rgyas/ /e ma gnas lugs chos ni de ltar zab/ /rnam par mi rtog nyi ltar gzhan don byed/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma khyab ci yang med/ /nyon dang 'khrig pas legs sbyar mtho ris rnams/ /thig le nyams pas nyon mongs sgang bu rgyas/ /bkra shis skyid pa'i dga' bde 'phral bzang bas/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /ngo mtshar che'o 'di ni me tog rgyas/ /nyams dga' srid pa'i bung ba'i tshogs rnams bstan/ /e ma sprin med dwangs pas ma bcom na/ /me tog nyi 'od tsha yang ga la 'joms/ /ngo mtshar che'o zag pa'i bde bas bskyed/ /rgyun chad med do srid pa'i chu klung 'bab/ /'khor 'brel bzang ngo rten 'brel bcu gnyis po/ /gzhi ma che'o thog mtha' ci yang med/ /legs par go'am 'dir tshogs kun 'byung can/ /rgyu bzang 'bras bus slus par ma mdzad cig /legs par gsal lo rtswa yi sgron me 'dra/ /shin tu brtan no lbu ba bsdos pa kun/ /nyams len mdzod dang chu shing snying po la/ /sngon chad las ro mo gsham gces phrug 'dra/ /zag pa'i me tog rgyas pa'i gzhon nu kun/ /gzhon nu lang tsho 'bras bu mthar thug rnams/ /nyon dang gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub (sgrubaka'adod na/ /nyon mongs pha ma srog dang bral na bde/ /de yis ma byin mthar thug blangs na bde//de la mi tshangs yum la spyad na bde/ /chos rnams mi bden rdzun gyis bslus na bde/ /dge dang mi dge dben gyis phral na bde/ /nyon mongs mi ngoms ngag 'khyal bden med bde/ /de 'dra'i pha (ka 28 ba 6phra 3ma —35—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tshig rtsub glang (brlang ka pos choms/ /gzhi spyad skyes bu dam pa bde ba yin/ /mchog rab don gnyer brnab sems bskyed na bde/ /bstan pa'i dgra 'joms gnod sems bzang po bstan/ /rang don bzlog la thar ba'i mchog la ltos/ /log pa'i lam la mi dge bcu po 'di/ /yang dag lam la dge ba bcu po bsten/ /de la'ang zhen na 'chi ba chen pos te/ /de las bzlog la mchog la dad pa bskyed/ /dad pa'ang gang la gang zhig dad pas stong / / ji ltar dad pa dbu ma chen po yin/ /bzlog ste khro ba'ang nga rgyal bya mi rigs/ /de na nga rgyal med pa dman pa'i mchog /dbyings su skyur la ma 'dzin lhug par zhog /de ltar gnas na log pas log pa zhig /ji ltar bslus te rang nyid ji ltar 'tsho/ /e ma log 'tsho spong la tshe rabs su/ /chags med chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar mdzod/ /'brom rje ngas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyis sbyar ba la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis ma bshad du zin kyang / de tsam zhig sbyar kyang skye bo rnams kyis ji ltar go gsung gleng gsung gleng yin/ snyan ngag snyan ngag yin/ khyed bod kyis zla ba mang po brtsams kyang / nga'i glo bur gyi tshigs bcad de lta bu mi thon/ kho bos sngar nas bzung nas shar ba 'dra gsungs nas bzhad/ 'brom khyod kyang nga'i man ngag sngar yod pa rnams mi 'dri bar/ rdugs ka skur bas so ma so ma 'dri ste kho bo mi nyan/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pas dpe la mi ltos/ a cang de kun ku re yin/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa bya ba sangs rgyas la zer ba yin/ khyod la blo phebs nas ngag 'khyal du kha pho en re'ang 'chor ba gda' gsungs pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ de tsam zhig 'tsham/ 'o na'ang bla mas gsung ba bzhin du blo tshod dang bstun zhing gsung 'tshal/ de ma mdzad na rmongs pa mi 'drongs/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe kha 'ug ma 'de ma'i tshul byung zhus pas/ jo bo na re/ sngon ma de med pa ma yin/ phyi ma de kun gyisamang po mi 'drongs/ phyi ma de khyod rang 'dra ba rnams la med pa ma yin/ yang 'brom gyis/ jo bo 'di dag la nor log gda' ye gsungs nas/ sngar gsungs pa de dag jo bo mdo 'don pa 'dra ba cig shar bas/ jo bo'i zhal nas / khyod kyi blo 'di 'dra ba 'jig rten na mang po yod na dga' ste/ btsal du rnyed dam gsungs/ yang 'brom na re / jo bo 'di 'dra byas na ji 'dra 'ong / tshe 'di mi rtag chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra/ /myur du 'gro ste sus kyang gzung du med/ /dpag med sems can du ma'i tshogs rab la/ /pha mar ma gyur skye bo cig 'ga'ang med/ kho bo chos dang mjal nas bslu rung ngam/ /che'am chung yang sla ste srog chags rnams/ /pha ma yin phyir rang nyid ji 'dra yang / / mi gsod de la rtogs par ji ltar byed/ /spyir yang nor ni 'ching ba du ma'i rgyu/ /sgos su pha mas nor rdzas ma byin pa/ /bdag la dgos med ma byin ga la len/ /sngar yang 'khor ba'i 'ching pas bcings gyur na/ /da yang mi tshangs 'dod log spyod pa'i las/ tanas bzhin khyad gsod log lta ga la byed/ /rdzun pa'i nyid rdzun —36—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gzhan bslus ci zhig bya/ /mi shes chags sdang mthun pa 'byed gyur na/ /e ma shes bzhin mdza' ba su zhig 'byed / / thams cad don med 'khyal ba'i tshig gis bcings/ /shes bzhin kho bo de phyir ji ltar 'brang / /thams cad drin can pha ma 'ba' zhig na/ /snyan pas dbugs 'byin mi byed sdang tshig smra/ /de 'dra dam pa su yi chos lugs yin/ /chags med thar ba'i lam la 'gro ba'i tshe/ /rang nor dgos med gzhan nor ci zhig bya/ /nor rdzas sha khrag bur bcas ster dus tshe/ /e ma gzhan gyi nor la brnab sems a/ /mnyam nyid dag pa'i dbyings su 'gro ba'i tshe/ /log lta bdud kyi dpung tshogs dgos pa med/ /de tshe (tshogashes nas spong ba mkhas pa yin/ /gzhan gyi mi dge bdag gis spong bab na/ /rang gi byed pa'i chos pa su zhig smyo/ /rang gi sha khrag chags med gtong ba'i tshe/ /pha ma'i sha khrag za ba'i chos pa su/ /srog lan rgyun mar 'ded dus mi 'khyod dam / / e ma da ni pha ma dpag med don/ /de ring nyid las ma g.yos bsgrub (sgrub3pa la/ /bya gzhag phal ba thams cad pha tshad bzhugs/ /sgo gsum nyon mongs thams cad pha tshad bzhugs/ /rnam rtog 'ching phur thams cad thon la skyur/ /e ma da gzod 'brom rjer ma gyur ram/ /zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gyur gyur sngar nas gyur gyur pa cig yin/ khyod kyis legs par smras da de ltar bshad pa la mnyan pa rnams 'dus par gda'am gsung / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ bla ma 'di lta ste/ mi dge bcu ni spang bya zhing / /rtag tu dad pa brtan par bya / khro dang nga rgyal gzhom bya zhing / /dman pa'i sems dang ldan par bya/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba mi bya zhing / /chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' ste/ /de'ang phar phyin drug ldan du sbyar kyang chog par gda'o / / de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ spang bya ji ltar spangs nas dge ba la 'jug pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'// //nya8 'phags pa'i nor dang 'khar gsil gyi lephywayang bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bod kyi rab tu byung ba mang po paṇḍi ta'i zhal lta chos kyi 'brel ba re tsam yang 'jog zer nas byung / de'i dus su 'brom rje'i zhal nas/brtul zhugs grub pa mthong bar dka' ba bya yin/ zang zing gi nor gyis 'phags pa'i nor 'tshol ba'i dus tshod yin / lo brgyags zla bas 'tshol ba dang 'dra bar/ nam zhag gtan gyi 'dun ma tshe 'di nyid la bsgrub (sgrubakapa'i dus tshod du gda'/ de yang nyi ma nyin gcig la go cha blang dgos pa'i lugs yin/ yul dbus su skyes pa la dgos pa gzhan med/ dge 'dun gdan drang mi dgos par bstan pa dar ba'i ltas ston cing 'byon pa 'di —37—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rang nyams dga'/ khong yon bdag pa kun gyis bsnyen bkur byed pa'i gral mgo rer bsdad/ bsod nams gsog pa'i 'gyur khyad 'chad cing bshad pa tsha mo gtong ba cig yod de/ de ring yon bdag rgyal 'byung rang la mdzub mo nang du bkug la btang ngo / /nyin mtshan du mi rtag pa bsgom zhing / zang zing gsog pa mi 'khob par gda' yis/ dge 'dun gyi gter khung du brubs te dgos dus tshe na ma chad par blangs la bza' yi gsungs nas dga' bzhin spro bzhin du bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la brnyen bkur bzang po mdzad/ de'i dus su / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ 'khor ba pa'i 'tshogs lugs kyi skabs su de dang mthun pa'i nor rdzas kyis tshim par bya 'tshal/ de ring rnam byang gi 'tshogs lugs kyi skabs 'dir de dang mthun par 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug par bya dgos par gda'o/ /de la sgrib pa spangs nas 'khor ba'i chos las rab tu 'phags te chags pa med par gzhan don du 'di ltar sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyi tshul bzung ste/ gzhan du bsod snyoms rgyu zhing /'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa cig gal che ba yin par gda' bas/ de'i don jo bos gsung bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas / dge 'dun kun na re/ dge bshes pa'i gsung de skabs su bab/ thugs la btags gsung / de nasajo bo'i zhal nas/ dge 'dun kun nyer mkho'i chos 'di gson gsungs nas/ zang zing sgyu ma'i nor zhes pa/ /snying po med la 'phel 'grib che/ /rang nor btsongs shing gzhan nor 'gugs/ khe tshong bzo yi 'dun ma yis/ /nor phyir brel bas bde ba btang / /bde 'dod 'dod pas kun la rgyug /'dod pas ma tshim sdug bsngal blangs/ /nags kyi sna la me mched bzhin/ /dang por sna la ma mched 'tshal/ /sa yis nags khrod tshig pa byung / /de bas chung nas 'dzem mo kun/ /zang zing dug gi me tog 'dra/ /byis pa gzhon nu dga' bzhin len/ /'grogs pas khar shor srog dang bral/ /zang zing lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra/ /dga' bzhin blangs pas skom pa 'phel zang zing rngo can 'phrug dang mtshungs/ /za zhing phrugs pas za ru 'gro/ /zang zing 'jigs pa'i nor dang mtshungs/ /phan par zhabrul te dgra bos khur/ /thams cad bdag gi rtsa ba ste/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i ro la rgyug /'dod pa zang zing yul la chags/ /de bas zang zing 'byor ba rnams/ /phugs slu don med mchis rtogs mdzod/ /skyabs mchog bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /skyabs kyi yul du legs bsten la/ /dad 'dod yid ches bzang po yis/ /dge ba'i sa chen dad pa bsten/ /de ni 'phags pa'i nor mchog yin/ /dad pas dud dang gus pas 'dren/ /de yis legs mchog byang chub 'dren/ /de bas dad nor phugs su btsan/ /da ni 'dir 'tshogs dad ldan kun/ /yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /spang blang don gnyer tshul khrims bsrung / /dge ba'i ljon shing ma lus pa/ /gshin pa'i sa chen khrims las byung / /rang 'dod ma che gzhan don mdzod/ /mi dge spangs la dge la brtson/ /—38—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /spang bya ma lus sdoms shig kun/ /'di ni tshul khrims 'phags pa'i nor/ /sha khrag la sogs phyi nang gi /dngos po thams cad chags med thong / /'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas de nyid de/ /'phags pa'i nor chen gtong ba yin/ /ma chags zang zing thong zhig kun/ /spang gnyen ma lus ngos 'dzin pa/ /zin nas len 'dod thos pa yin/ /thos pas kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i gzhi/ /'phags pa'i nor yin 'bod cig kun/ /ngo tsha shes pa'i gos rab gyon/khrel yod ska rags rgyun du bcings/ /ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa/ /'di ni 'phags pa'i nor mchog yin/ /rgyun du mdzod cig 'dir 'tshogs kun/ /shes rab nor dang ma bral bar/ /thams cad byang chub dbyings su khyer / / bsngo ba chen po'i mdzod du skyongs/ /mi skrag mi rlom lcags kyus bzung / /de ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun te / / mi gzhan rnams kyis bsgrub (sgrub1 par dka'/ /lhag par ngan song spyod yul min/ /nor mchog 'di bsten phugs su bzang / /'phral du lha mi kun gyis mchod/ /e ma de ni 'phags pa'i nor/ /lus 'tsho zang zing don gnyer na/ /ro snyoms ldum bu'i zas su bsten/ /ljon shing g.ya' ri gangs khongs dang / /dur khrod nags khrod dben gnas su/ /g.yeng med bsam gtan bsgom gzhi mdzod/ /der yang chags na chags med rgyus/ /me chu rlung gis mi nyams pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog ni/ /'khar gsil yin gyis gus pas chongs/ /mchod yul mchod tshogs sems la bsgoms (sgomasaka / /rnam byang 'dus la nor sbyin yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ de ring bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or 'dir jo bo'i drung du/ kho bos zhus shing gnang na / hril te gril (drilakab la g.ya' gong la sogs pa'i gnas mal dang / zas ro snyoms bsod snyoms kyi zas kyis 'tsho ba dang / rten pa (sa3chu la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis mi gnod pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'khar gsil chongs gsung zhing gda'/ de yang mtshon don mchod yul mchod pa sems la bsgoms (sgomasakagasung zhing gda' na/ de ji ltar yin zhus pa ni 'di lta ste/ bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or du ni/ /las can u pa si ka yis / / jo bo rje la 'di skad zhus/ /blo ldan snga ma dgongs su gsol/ /mdud pa gcig dang dum bu gsum/ /bar shing gsom dang smad zhogs (gzhogasakabadun/ / stod zhogs (gzhogs3 brgyad dang rwa chen bzhi/ /mchod rten gnyis dang 'khor lo gyu/ /sbubs gnyis stong dang zung du 'brel/ /a long bcu gnyis yod pa 'di/ /bdag gi the tshom bcad pa'i phyir/ /gang ltar lags pa gsung du gsol/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /mdud pa gcig tu yod pa ni/ /ngan song sgo gcod mtshon pa'i brda/ /dum bu gsum du yod pa ni/ /tshul khrims sems dang shes rab ste/ /bslab pa gsum po mtshon pa'i brda/ /bar shing gsom du yod pa ni/ /dge sbyong sems ni yangs shing gsong / /g.yo sgyu med par mtshon pa'i brda/ /smad zhogs (gzhogasakabadun du yod —39—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa ni/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po mtshon/ /stod zhogs (gzhogs|brgyad du yod pa ni/ /'phags lam brgyad po mtshon pa'i brda/ /rwa chen bzhi ru yod pa ni/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi mtshon pa'i brda/ /mchod rten gnyis su yod pa ni/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis mtshon pa'i brda/ /chos sku spros bral brjod las 'das/ /'khor lo 'di ni bden bzhi yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sprul sku yis/ /ba ra na sir lnga sde dang / /'khor gyi tshogs la bskor ba mtshon/ /lcags kyu 'di ni thugs rje yis/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dren par mtshon/ /stod sbubs stong par yod pa ni/ /chos bdag rang bzhin med pa'i brda/ /smad sbubs stong par yod pa ni/ /gang zag bdag med mtshon pa'i brda/ /stod smad zung du 'brel ba ni/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis po mtshon/ /a long bcu gnyis yod pa ni/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ /ming gzugs skye mched drug dang ni/ /reg tshor sred len srid skye dang / / rga shi dang ni bcu gnyis te/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis mtshon pa'i brda/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas / / nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyag 'khar mchod rten brda mtshon yin/ / mdo nas gsil byed bya bar gsal/ /slar yang u pa si ka yis/ /jo bo rje la 'di skad zhus/ /'di la lugs ni rnam pa du / / 'di la 'chang lugs ji ltar bgyi/ /'di thogs pa la yon tan ci/ /'di thogs gang zag su zhig yin/ /gong du gsungs pa kho na'am/ /'di 'chang rnams kyi bya ba ci/ /'di thogs bsod snyoms ji ltar rgyu/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'di la lugs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /'das pa'i lugs dang ma 'ongs lugs/ /da ltar lugs dang gsum spyod lugs/ /mar me mdzad dus bden pa gnyis/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste/ /rwa chen gnyis kyis mtshon pa yin/ /'di ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas lugs/ /byams pa mgon dus bden pa gcig /mya ngan 'das pa bden gcig po/ /rwa chen gcig gis mtshon pa yin/ /'di ni ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lugs/ /shākya thub dus bden pa bzhi/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam/ /rwa chen bzhi yis mtshon pa yin/ /'di ni da lta sangs rgyas lugs/ /gsum ga spyod lugs phar phyin drug /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab 'di drug go /lugs bzhi 'di la mkhas par gyis/ /'di la 'chang lugs 'di ltar bgyi / / mdung /ka32 na7 thogs bzhin du mi spang / thung thog ma bzhin mi bslang zhing / /dong thogs bzhin du mi sgyer ro/ /ma ni bu gces 'dzin pa bzhin/ /sems kyi bslab pa thugs kar 'chang / /gu gu rā ku ku /tsa la sogs pa/ /gang na 'jigs pa yod pa'i sar/ /gang ltar byas kyang nyes pa med/ /bslab gsum thabs dang shes rab ni/ /nam yang 'bral bar mi bya'o/ /mchod rten yin pas gus par bcangs/ /brda chos yin pas nyams su blangs/ /'di 'chang yon tan bstan pa 'dzin/ /mi khom brgyad spangs skam par (saraka—40—

ri chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi rber bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gnas / / gang na 'di 'chang yul gyi dbus/ /mtha' 'khob rnams na 'di 'chang med/ khyim pa rnams kyi spyod yul min/ khyim pa rnams ni sdug bsngal ba/ /'di 'chang rnams ni bde ba yin/ khyim nas phyung la 'di ni chongs//'dod pa chung zhing chog shes la/ /rab tu dben pa gang yin pa/ /'di 'chang pa yi gang zag yin/ /sde snod gsum ldan su spyod pa/ /'di 'chang pa yi gang zag yin/ /gnag la zlum pa drang srong snod/ /tshad dang ldan pa su 'chang ba/ /'di 'chang pa yi gang zag yin/ /ngur smrig gru bzhi phu rung med/ /rung ba'i gos ni sus gyon pa//'di 'chang pa yi gang zag yin/ /rtag tu bsod snyoms zas tshol ('tshokā/kwa ba/ /'di 'chang pa yi gang zag yin / / lung med snod ni 'gril snying 'dod/ /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /gru bzhi gos ni 'bud snying 'dod/ /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /phongs pa kun la thugs brtse bas/ /rtag tu bsod snyoms zas tshol ('tshol3ba/ /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /pha yul bdud kyi btson khang 'gyel/ /mi chos las kyi 'ching thag chad/ /mdza' ba'i bshes dang sdang ba'i dgra/ /las ngan chags sdang yul las bros/ /zhing med 'brog kyang de la med/ /nor tshol ('tsholaka bzo dang gzhan dpon dang / khe tshongs ('tshol|g.yog kyang des mi 'ong / /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /mi gral nas bud ri dwags 'dra/ /'phral la zas tshol ('tsholakabya dang 'dra/ khag ste langs pas gzhi rdzogs pas/ /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /sa gcig gnas gcig mi bsten pa/ /nyi zla bzhin du kun du rgyu//shes rab gsum gyis rgyud sbyong zhing / /bya ba ngan pa mtha' dag spong / yākya seng ge'i rnam thar la/ /bya ba mang po 'ong re skan/ /rang dga' ma yin mdo rnams ltos/ /zhib par yod kyis don gnyer ma/dzod/ /bya ba med par thar lam las /ka 33 na2 gnas/ / /rnam mkhyen go 'phang brtson pas bgrod/ /'di thogs bsod snyoms rgyu ba'i tshe/ khyim pa rnams kyi sgo drung du/ /ngan song sgo gcod rgya mdud kyis/ /ngan song sgo gcod rme/tshon pa'i phyir/ /ma them la ni lan gsum du/ /dus gsum lan gsum brdung bar bya/ /de bzhin ya them longs sku yis / / chos kyi sgo mo 'byed pa'i brdar/ /mi mthun spang bya de yang brdung / /bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis sgra/khyim pa rnams la si li li/ /sgra dang ldan pas bsgrag par bya/ /'o dod rgyang bos mi bya zhing / /mi dad spyod nga/ rnam spangs te/ /bag yod spyod pas legs gnas la/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis sgrol bar bya/ /'tsho ba mi rung ma gtogs pa / / dman yang gang phul blang bar bya/ / bzang ngan chags sdang rnam spangs te/ /dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam btab / / dman cha blangs la mtho sa bskyangs/ /rtag tu bsod snyoms don yod rgyu/ /thub pa'i rnam thar mi nub bzung / / lung dang mthun par rigs pas sdebs/ /de bsten sku gsum mnyes par shog /ces gsungs pa dang / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ jo bo chen po lags/ de ring bstan bcos chen po cig (zhigakathosatsā/ zang zing —41 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/spangs nas tshe 'di'i 'dun mar ma shor bar nam zhag gtan gyi 'dun ma/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyis bya dgos pa yin te/ /thams cad 'khar gsil gyis gsal bar byas/ /de ltar du ma cig gsungs na yang //hril te bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /zang zing thams cad spang bya zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis brgyan par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las / 'phags pa'i nor dang 'khar gsil gyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //ta9 zhu lan nor phreng lasarnam par dag pa'i glu'i legayang bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po lags/ 'o na zang zing thams cad spangs nas 'phags pa'i nor gyis 'tsho ba'i gnas gang la bya/ rnam par g.yeng ba ci spang zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ skyed mos tshal dang grong khyer dang / /'du 'dzi la sogs rnam g.yengs bar/ /ngag 'khyal tshig gis kun bslangs nas/ /zang zing bdud kyis khyer ba srid/ /'brom rje gang na gnas gyur kyang / /rang 'dod 'khri ba 'bur 'joms gyis/ /'khor ba'i bde la bzang ma zhen/ /tha mal slu brid bdud kyi las/ /phyi ma'i btsan sa ma zin pa'i/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma las ro ni/ /chu seb /ka 33 ba4 sler/mkhar lan byed dang mtshungs/ /gzhi med gsum thog legs brgyan te//bkra ba'i tshon gyis ri mor bkod/ /bad chung dra ba dra phyed bcas/ /'og gzhi chu yis bying gyur tshe/ /gzab pa don med mchis dogs mdzod/ /zhabs rdol snod la mi blta ba/ /snod mthong bcud kyis 'gengs pa'i tshe/ /klen (glenakapa zhabs rdol mi lta'i skyon/ /ring por mi thogs bo bar 'gyur/ /de ltar nyon dang 'brom rje mchog /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor legs thob nas/ /sdom gsum khrims la mi brten par/ /lo 'dod tshe 'di'i 'dun ma can / / long med tshe srog 'gags pa'i tshe/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams don med par/ /gos med gcer bu zas dang bral/ /grogs med bshes dang bral gyur nas/ /rnam shes bar do 'grim pa'i tshe/ /sngar byas las la 'gyod gyur cing / /bsags pa'i nor la phreng gyur te/ /mdza' ba'i gnyen la yus che zhing / kho bo'i phyi la thong smras kyang / / ci phan kho ni shi lo zer/ /nor la sbar sha zhabrug pa sbyor/ /nye nyes mya ngan zhag 'ga' byed/ /mi phan khrel med mya ngan yin/ /ngu brang kha ru sa btab kyang / /e ma rang la gnod par zad/ /phan pa mi byed mi phan rem / / de nas ring po ma lon par/ /gshin po sdug bsngal che ba'i tshe/ khrel med mya ngan bayid gad gyur/ /mig gis mi mthong rnar mi thos/ /bsags pa'i nor gyis ma phan steng / /ser sna'i dbang gis ngan song myong / /—42—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos ga'i nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /re sdug snying med 'dun stor rnams/ /'brom rje de 'dras dben gyur pa'i/ /dgon pa rin chen sems la bsten//gang zhig chags sdang rab gdungs pa'i/ /srid pa'i chu klung gru med pa/ /'di yi 'dun mas khyer ba mang mi rtag snying por ma zhen par/ /'du 'dzi gnas mal nyon mongs 'phel/ /dug gi ljon pa rab snyol la/ /bde ba bskyed pa'i sman gcig po/ gzhan don ljon pa legs par skyongs/ /zhi bde'i sems kyis dben pa yi/ /dgon pa mchog de sems la bsten/ /mkhyen nam 'brom rje sras kyi mchog /bdud kyi rigs 'di g.yo sgyu mkhas/ /'dod chen nor gyi rnam pas 'brid/ /chos pa chos ltar 'chos pas 'brid/ /btsun po bzang 'dod rlom pas 'brid / / mkhas pa nga rgyal khengs pas 'brid/ /bzang po sku bsod che zhes 'brid/ /rnam g.yeng glu gar gzhas kyis 'brid/ /phal cher gzhon nu lang tshos 'brid/ /phal cher mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis 'brid/ /sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje nyon/ /bsam gtan 'phel tshe thos pa gtong / /thos bsam 'phel tshe sgom pa dran/ kha thon byed tshe'ang bsam gtan gtong / /e ma bsam gtan 'phel lags te/ /bsam gtan ma zin kha thon bzhag /mi cig shing la 'dzeg pa na/ /yal ga phyi ma ma zin par/ /snga ma btang tshe bar dor lhung / /de bzhin dge sbyor gang byed tshe/ /snga ma mtha' ru ma skyol bar/ /phyi ma gzhan byed gnyis ka nyams/ /da dung nyon dang sras kyi mchog /tha mal btsan sa ma zin pa'i/ /gnyen po skoltar snang bdud kyis khyer/ /phal cher grogs ngan dgra bos slu/ khyim spangs nags na bsgom pa yi/ /bu gcig mi chos rags gyur pa/ kho shi mo na sdug bsngal zhes/ khyod la bzhugs pa'i skabs ma ma/chis/ /la 'ur yul du byon par zhu/ /pha ma rgan rgon 'di 'dra na/ /snying ring chos kyis ci la phan/ /su zhig mo yi bu kun la/ /pha ma la sogs bskyang ran mkhas/ /mi smon rang skyid 'byor ba che/ /mi la sbyin tshad rang nyid la'ang / /kun 'dun dpal 'byor che re dga'/ /mchi ma 'don zhing yus che skad/ /phugs slu 'phral du snying nye skad/ /e ma 'brom rje nga la nyon/ /thos chung bdud las mi shes pa'i/ /bya blo che yang mi shes pas/ /gnyan pa srog med so ma zin/ /bden no snyam nas lhur ('durakacing rgyug /de nas tshe 'di thu gyur ba'i/ /na 'chi ngu 'bod mthong gyur tshe/ /sems 'khrugs 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis bskyod/ /de tshe'ang blo sbyong mi bsgom par/ /ngu la bltasashing ngu bar byed/ /de nas bya ba mang pos g.yengs/ /chos pabee dgon pa rnam g.yeng 'phel e ma shes sam 'brom rje mchog /de 'dra'i dbus su gnas gyur na'ang / /'khor ba'i snang tshul 'di 'dra zhes/ /grogasamed mya ngan 'das par 'gro/ /e ma gzhan gyi sdug bsngal rnams/ /bdag gi snying la thim gyur cing / /sems dpa' bdag gi bde ba rnams/ /gong du 'phel zhing gzhan smin shog /nyon dang sdug bsngal 'dir 'tshogasakun/ /skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad pa —43—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yin / / bu nor dbang gis mi stong par/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis khyer ba yin/ /de tshe cis kyang mi stong pas//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /blo phugs lings te gtod la skyobs/ /'khor ba'i gnas lugs 'di 'dra bas / / 'di bde'i 'dun ma spangs gyur nas/ kho bo nags khrod dben par bsgom (sgomasaka/ /'dod la rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin/ /da ni nga la sems gyur na/ /ngu 'bod ngag 'khyal ma smra bar/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa rab bsgom zhing / /bsam pa nges par dkon mchog la/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba thob/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rab ma lus pa/ /dag par gyur zhes bshags par gyis/ /gzhan du nyes tshogs ngag bsdams shing / /chagasapar ma byed lhod de skyur/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /mtshan nas brjod cing sems bskyed dbog /de ltara'akhor ba ma lus pa'i/ /nyes dmigs lta zhing gzhan don byed/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nga la nyon/ /de 'dra'i gnas ni 'du 'dzi yin/ /nyan thos dgon pa lus dben yin/ /rgyal sras dgon pa sems dben yin/ /rang 'dod spangs shing gzhan don pa'i/ /gnas mchog bzang gang dgon pa yin/ /grong ngam skye bo'i dbus kyang rung / / thams cad pha ma'i sems ltar sbyangs/ /bu bzhin snying rjes ma lus bskyangs/ /brtse bas le lo'i bdud bcom nas/ /brtson pas skad cig nyid la bsgrub(sgrubs3/ /de yang rags pa tsam du bstan/ /sems dpa'i sems dpa' snying rje can/ /rtag tu brtson pa'i go cha can/ /mtha' med khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /gang du gnas kyang dben gyur pa'i/ /skyes bu mchog de dpa' bo yin/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng med lam 'khyer ba'i/ /thabs mkhas mchog de dpa' bo yin/ /nyon mongs gnyen pos thug 'joms pa'i/ /skyes bu mchog de dpa' bo yin/ /nor rdzas dpag med dbus gnas kyang / /chags pa med de dpa' bo yin/ /ya mtshan stong gis bskor gyur kyang / /mi rtog sems de dpa' bo yin/ /gnod pa brgya yis rab gtses kyang / /ji mi snyam de dpa' bo yin/ /bstod ra tshig gis rab mchod kyang/ /dga' bar mi sems dpa' bo yin/ /sgeg mo bye bas bkur sti yang / /dbang du mi 'gro dpa' bo yin/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo chen po zhig /g.yul du zhugs kyang mi 'khrugs par/ /snying rjes 'thab gang dpa' bo yin/ /ro mchog brgya yis rab mchod kyang / /sred len mi 'phel dpa' bo yin/ /dpa' bo sras mchog nga la nyon/ /dpa' bo rab brtan par bzhugs nas/ /dpa' bo'i bstan pa dpa' bos bskyangs / / dpa' bos dpa' bo ma g.yos par/ /dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs rab tu choms/ /dpa' bo me dong g.yang sa las/ /dpa' bos dpung bskyed pha ma drongs/ /dpa' bo gar gyi rnam par bzhugs/ /dpa' bo mtshan mas ma g.yengs par/ /dpa' bo mi rtag rdo rje'i gar/ /dpa' bos 'du 'dzi'i tshogs rab gtor/ /dpa' bos sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad/ /dpa' bos 'ching sa rab tu chod/ /dpa' bos dpa' bo bla ma ste/ /dpa' bo mi —44—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi 'er bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /rtog rdo rje'i thugs/ /dpa' bo de yi gzhal yas su/ /dpa' bo phyir la lan gsum bud/ /dpa' bos ngan song rtsad nas chod/ /dpa' bos mdun du lan gsum nur/ /dpa' bos mtho ris zhen rtog chod/ /dpa' bos gyen du lan gsum spur/ /dpa' bas mchag lta dmangs su skyur/ /dpa' bas sa la lan gsum bsnun/ /dpa' bos sa bdag klu gnyan thul/ /dpa' bos khyug khyug spyan mig bsgrod/ /dpa' bos shes bya ma lus gzigs/ /dpa' bos pad skor phyogs bcur spur/ /dpa' bos dpa' bo pad steng khug /dpa' bos dpa' bo rdo rje gsor / / dpa' bos bdag lta'i ri bo choms/ /dpa' bos 'dzum 'dzum dga' bde bsdus/ /dpa' bos sdigs mdzub bar chod skrod/ /dpa' bos thabs shes thod rnga brdungs/ /dpa' bos grags stong mi rkang bus/ /dpa' bos tshangs dbyangs dril bu dkrol/ /dpa' bo 'brom rje gzhal yas yod/ /dpa' bo yar byon thig ler byon / khyod la kho bos gdams pa spyin/ khyod la nang gi dbang chen bskur/ khyod la bdag gis bstan pa gtad / / yar byon bla ma'i thugs kar byon/ /mi rtog yar byon ze 'brur byon/ /'od gsal yar byon zla steng byon / / chos rgyal yar byon 'od gur du/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bsam gtan zo/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa'i / / gtum po mi rtog med dpung gos/ /ha ha rab sgrogs (sgrog|'dzum bag can/ /hi hi rab sgrogs (sgrogakazhe dul can/ /hu hu rab sgrogs (sgrogakartogs pa can/ /he he rab sgrogs (sgrog3 dga' ba can/ /hūṃ hūṃ rab sgrogs (sgrog3 snying rje can/ /eo oṃ rab sgrogs (sgrog3 skye med sku/ /a a rab sgrogs (sgrog3 skye med gsung / /kun yid kun gyi rgyal po khyod/ /kun gyi dpal mgon go cha can/ /gnas 'di 'du 'dzi rab spangs pa'i/ /ma dag rab dben dgon pa yin/ /'khyal tshig rab dben dgon pa yin/ /phyi ngag bsdams te nang du hrīḥ /gnyis med dbyings su bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas 'brom rje tshim gyur te/ /dga' bzhin bla ma'i thugs dkyil du/ /spro bzhin padma'i ze 'bru la/ /mi rtog 'od gsal zla steng mnan/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs ltas/ /rnam rto/ga chos kyi dbyings su khyer/ /tha snyad zab mo'i lam du sgrags/ /lta ba spros las ma g.yos par / / sgom pa gnas lugs ngang du bzhag/ spyod pa mchog rab bzang por spyod/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin gar du rtses/ /thabs shes sgra yis bzang po'i gnas/ /ma lus khyab par rab tu sgrags/ /de tshe lta ba'i glu blangs pa//rje nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos dbyings/ /nga ngas stong lta ba dbyings su yal/ /nga 'dzin med gzung ba dbyings su yal / / kye mi snang dgu snang dpag med kyang / /dus dang po 'di nas byung sa stor/ /dus tha mar 'dir 'gro ci zhig mchis/ /dus da lta gang dang ma 'brel ba/ /dus gsum gyis stong pa'i chos lugs la/ /phar ltar med yul gyis bslus par gyur/ /tshur ltar med rang gis bslus par gyur/ /nga gnyis med shes rnga/ ltar med pa/ /kye yal —45—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yul mang ste rang tshugs zhig kho spar spur mang ste dpyad na 'jig khyod med bzhin don med ci la zhabrul/ /'brom shel gyi me tog rang dwangs la/ /sku bden med snang ba'i sangs rgyas byon/ /las rten 'brel bzang ste bzang snang yin/ /de zhen na 'ching bas pha tshad bskyur/ /a de kun gzhi med tshig gi lhang / /zhen bya zhen byed blo yis stong / /blo rang tshugs mi thub gsal tsam na/ /gnas gang la ji ltar zhen par 'gyur/ /gsal bya rtog med bde stong yin/ /kye ma sna tshogs mdzes mdzes 'dra/ /ha dpyad na mi gda' ji ltar lags/ /a skye med rang gis bstad pas len/ /phaṭa dwa ni rang grol lhug par zhog /'brom kho bo'i 'du 'dzi spong lugs yin/ /'brom nga yi dgon pa de 'drar gda'/ /kye dga' bar soms shig rjes 'brang rnams/ /da nyan thos nang nas bka' gdams pa / / chos lta ba'i glu skad de sgrog na/ khong theg chen khas len ji skad zer/ /lar a wa sgru ti'i rjes 'brang ba'i//pha a ti sha yi rjes 'brang la/ /mi theg dman yin zhes theg chen su/ /nga btsun po meongs par ma shor ba/ /chos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bskyangs pa'i drin/ /nga mkhas pas btsun tshugs ma bcom pa/ /las rgyu 'bras zab mo bsgoms pa'i drin/ /nga bsgoms pas kha thon mi 'joms pa/ /bka' mdo sde zab mo bltas pa'i drin/ /nga klog pas bsam gtan mi 'joms pa/ /rje bla ma'i man ngag 'chun pa'i drin/ /chos thams cad gcig tu rab bsdus nas / / gnas stan thog gcig tu sgom shes pa/ /kye dka' spyad chos la spyad pa'i drin/ /rje sangs rgyas bya ba kun mkhyed yin/ /de spangs rtogs tshogs gnyis mthar phyin yin/ /nga pha ma'i don du de 'dod pas/ /dus dang por thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gnyis par bsams nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /dus gsum par bsgoms nas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /kye de yang gcig nyid ma yin te/ /nga thos dus tshe na bsam bsgom bsngo/ /nga bsam dus tshe na thos bsgom bsngo/ /nga bsgom dus tshe na thos bsam bsngo/ /nga gcig tu ma lus bsdoms byas nas / / chos lam du khyer nas 'gro shes pa/ /nga bka' gdams phyogs charam lhung pas/ / nyon /ka 37 na2don/ rgya 'bag mig bzhin 'khrul shes pa'i/ /legs kun tu rtogs te bka' gdams yin/ /nyams dga'o rje btsun a ti sha /bkra shis so lha chos bdun ldan du/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum yin thams cad 'du/ /lar chos lugs gang yin ci zer kyang / /skyabs dkon mchog gsum du 'dus ma 'dus/ /der 'dus na kho bo'i blang bya yin/ /yang chos par khas len chags sdang na/ /chos lam du mi 'gro gsum po min/ /de phar zhog nga ni dkon mchog gsum/ /lar 'on kyang nga yi skyabs bya yin/ /chos lam du 'gro na su yin bzang / /las gzhan don byed na gang zag mchog /kye nyon dang chos byed bsam shes kun/ /mi smyon pa la la 'di skad zer/ /chos thams cad stong pa'i gnas lugs yin/ /don de la las dang rgyu 'bras med/ /nga kha sgor gang byung rtog med zo/—46—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /kho rtog bcas rnams ni phung zhes zer/ /mi kho bo de las zlog de smra/ /mi khyod la ci yang ma grub na/ /zas dus min gang rnyed za ci dgos/ /kye mo gsham bu la ltogs mi mnga'/ /rgya gal te dngos por grub gyur na/ /nyon yang na rtag tu za bar 'gyur/ /yang zos dang ma zos don med 'gyur/ /kye yod par grub na chad mi 'gyur/ /kye med par gyur nas zos ci phan/ /nga a ti sha yi rjes 'brang lugs/ /chos zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa yin/ /chos bden pa med pas sna tshogs snang / /don yod ma myong bas byung zhing 'gag /kye rtog bcas me chu 'gal bar smra / / me dmar 'bar gzugs brnyan chu nang gda'/ /don bden na chu nang 'byung mi srid/ /rgya dpag tshad lnga bcu'i (cu'i3zla ba de/ /chu ting phor gang na snang ba mthong / /don rdzun pas 'byung bar kho bos 'tshal mig rdul phran mi tshugs mi gzugs shar/ /don brdzun (rdzun| pa yin par kho bos 'tshal/ /kye med pa'ang ma yin sna tshogs snang / /ltos yod pa ma yin 'pho mi srid/ /lar dbu ma'i nang du sna tshogs snang / /chos thams cad rdzun pa'i snang ba yang / /gzugs med na gzugs brnyan ga la 'byung / /des rgyu song brdzun (rdzunakayang 'bras 'byung bas/ /las khyad du mi gsod nyams len pa'i/ /nga lta ba'i brgyud pa'i bka' gdams yin/ /nga thig le gcig tu dpag med pa'i/ /lha gzhal yas bskyed de mchod byed kyang / /las phra zhib ston pa'i chos rnams la/ /nga sgro skur mi 'debs nyams len pa/ /nga byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bka' gdams yin/ /chos snang stong sgyu ma'i gzhal yas su/ /yar sa lam rim gyis bgrod gyur te/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas pa / / nga spyod pa'i lugs kyi bka' gdams lugs/ /don 'di la snyad 'tshol bdud sde yin/ /rdzas kha ba dung la nag mthong ba/ /mig rang mig skyon can nyid du lta/ /dpal 'gran zla med pa'i mar me mdzad/ /rje mun pa'i dri mas ma gos gsal/ /thugs rnam dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /sras kho bos glu de snyan du gsol/ /don hril te gril (drilakan snang stong yin/ /tshig legs par mnyan na grag stong yin/ /don legs par bsam na spros bral yin/ /nyams dga' nas tshig de kha sgor shor/ /don nyes skyon byung na bzod par gsol/ /tshig cal col byung na'ang dbyings su skyur/ /da dge ba bzang po gang thob de/ /sus dbrog tu med ba'i btsan sa dgos / / las rgyu 'bras bden na 'grub par shog /kye de la'ang lhag ma cung zad lus/ /chos thams cad brdzun (rdzunaka pa'i snang ba la/ /las rgyu 'bras bden par ga la 'gyur/ /ci de yang bslu ba med par brtags / / mthar sku gsum ma lus byung na mchog /da bden rne brdzun ne ci thob shog /ces gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom gyis dam pa chos kyi rtse mo legs po mdzad/ de ring kho bos chos kyis bcun/ da dpon slob gnyis kyi gsung gleng rnams/ /legs par bsdus gsungs nas/ 'brom na re/ bla ma dam pa nga la gson/ /—47—
