bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thams cad dril na 'di ltar gda'/ /'du 'dzi thams cad spang bya zhing / /dgon pa la ni gnas par bya/ /'khyal ba'i tshig rnams spang bya zhing / /rtag tu ngag ni bsdams par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las rnam par dag pa'i glu'i le'u ste dgu ba'o// //tha10 bkur bskyangasadang mthong tshul phun sum tshogs pa'i lersāyang bzhugs gnas snye thang 'or na jo bo yab sras bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ bla ma mkhas pa paṇḍi ta/ /'jig rten dag na bzang mang yang / /tshul khrims gtsang ldan nyin skar tsam/ /tshul khrims gtsang ldan dpag med kyang / /rang 'dod med pa re re tsam/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba zhugs gyur na/ /de ni tshul khrims gtsang ma min/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma don gnyer dag /phun sum chogs mthar phyin pa yin/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /nyan rang bzang po ma lus pa/ /rang gi chos lugs la ltos nas/ /nyon mongs cig kyang mi mnga' ba/ /rang gi bde ba don gnyer de/ khrims ldan gtsang por mi 'gyur ram/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'brom rje legs so de nyid de/ /rang lus dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /bde ba'i skam la rab phyin pa/ /zag pa'i chu bor ma bying btsun/ /rang gi bde ba mthar phyin pa/ /'di ni btsun po kho na yin/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /byang chub sems dpa' la ltos nas/ /nyan rang btsun par cang 'gyur ram/ /de dang mi mthun cang btsun nam/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /byang chub sems dpa' gsum kha yin/ /nyan rang rnams dang dper mi rung / /nyes pa ltar ston ltar snang yin/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de bas btsun po mang gyur kyang / /rang 'dod med pa nyung zhes smra/ /rang 'dod 'khris pa'i btsun po de/ /nyan rang yin no bla ma rje/ /rang 'dod ma 'khris btsun po ni/ /rgyal sras 'phags pa yin no rje/ /de 'dra'i bzang btsun dpag med kyi/ /drin lan bkur byed gang zhig yin/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de ni bla ma mkhan slob yin/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung/ /de yi mthun grogs gang zhig yin/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung/ /gang zag chos kyi mig can yin/ /tshogs lam sna la zin pa yin/ /dang po'i sems can rgyal ba yis/ /rjes su byin gyis brlabs gyur pas/ /de yang mthun pa'i grogs po yin/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de dag mthong tshe ji ltar bsgom/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /bla ma mkhan slob nam mthong yang / /gus par mchod pas brgyan pa dang / /yid kyis phyag dang g.yas bskor zhing / /spyi bor blang ba'i 'du zhes bya/ /mkhas btsun bzang po 'di yi drin/ /drin can ci —48—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /mnyes bya bar bab/ /chos mkhas pa dang chos mthong dang / /rgyu 'bras mi slu gzhan 'dzin cing / /mkhyen brtse can la rang 'dren pa'i/ /ston pa yin zhes dag par bsgoms (sgoms3 / /las dang po yi sems can yang / /bzang po'i gzhi mar nges dgos pas/ /de yang phan bde ster byed yin/ /de yang ston pa nyid du bsgoms/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ /de la 'du shes ji ltar bsgom//jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /rgan pa thams cad pha mar bsgoms (sgoms| / /gzhon nur gyur pa 'di lta ste/ /bu dang bu mo nye bar bsgoms (sgoms3 / / rang dang mnyam pa 'di lta ste/ /spun zla sring mo nyid du bsgoms(sgomasaka / /pha mar ma gyur su yang med/ /bur ma gyur pa'ang cig kyang med/ / pha ma bu tsha 'ba' zhig yin/ /de dag tshad med bzhi yis drang / /skal ba bzang na dam chos bstan/ /skal ba med kyang bag chags bzhag / 'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /blo ldan mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /legs bshad kun gyi gter mdzod mchog /bstan pa'i sgron me gnas lugs gsal/ /skyabs kyi gco bo bla ma mchog /dpal gyi 'byung gnas drin can pa/ /gdul bya bdag 'dra nyer bzung nas/ /smon dang 'jug pas sems bskyed cing / /sems can ma lus khyod ma zhes/ /'di don sangs rgyas ci thob ces/ /sangs rgyas thob la smon pa can/ /de yang snying nas thag pa'i sems/ /de nas gang la gang dgos pa'i/ /rdzas ni bu dang bu mo dang / /snying khrag sha dang rus pa dang / / gzhan yang nang khrol pags pa dang / /mgo dang nying lag mig sogs rnams/ /chags pa med par gtong la 'jug /rin chen lnga dang rta mchog dang / /glang po ma/ he 'dod 'jo dang / /skyed mos tshal dang khang bzang dang / /'bru dang bang mdzod ro brgya'i zas/ /gos dang rgyan dang bdug spos dang / /yod dam bsgrubs te'ang sbyin par bya/ /de yang lam la lījug pa nyid/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan la sogs pa'i/ /chos kyi sbyin pas tshim byas te/ /rang gi sdug bsngal mi lta bar/ /dka' spyad bzod cing pha ma drang / /de ltar bla ma sa/san du gsol / / smon 'jug shing rtas rab drangs nas/ /sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba gang / /bla mas bstan la rab tu byung / / de 'dra'i bzang po gang yin pa/ /ston byed bla ma yin phyir du/ /rim gro byed pas spyi bor byon/ /gzhan yang yig 'brus lhar bskyed cing / /ye shes sems dang 'dres /ka 39 na7 bsres/gyur nas/ /chos dbyings chen por rdzogs pa yang / /dbang bskur bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /de yang bla mas mdzad phyir du/ /rim gro byed pas spyi bor byon/ /bla ma zhes pa de gnyis yin/ /sngon chad bag med khyim pa las/ /slar bzlog so sor thar ba yi/ /sdom pa ster byed mkhan slob yin/ /gzhan yang legs bshad ma lus pa/ /ster zhing nyes lam 'chos pa gang / /de yang mkhan slob nyid du bzang / /de yang drin rab ster phyir du/ /rim gro byed pas spyi bor —49—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byon / / sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /sdig pa bshags shing yi rang bsgoms(sgoms3/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing mi 'da' bar/ /dge rtsa bsngo zhing bzhugs su gsol /rtag tu gus pas mchod par byed/ /gzhan yang mgon po a ti sha /thos bsam bsgom (sgom1 pa'i shes rab can/ /shes rab mig gisarab sbyangs pa/ /gang zag mchog de grogs su bzang / /chos kyi mig can spyi bor byon/ /ston pa'i tshul du mchod par bya/ /las dang po yi sems ldan yang / /bzang po'i sems bskyed bstan pa'i phyir/ kho bos ston par gsol ba gdab/ /gzhan yang ston pa rab bsgom (sgom1zhing / /bsam pa bzang las ma g.yos par/ /spyi bor mchod pas bzhugs su gsol/ /de ni kho bo'i bkur bya yin/ /des ni bkur bya'i tshoms bstan pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas chos kyi bla ma mchog /rbha ga lar bltams chos rgyal sras kyi mchog /'gro ba'i mig gcig mar me mdzad dpal bzang / /blo gros mtshungs med kun la khyab pa'o/ /gang la'ang mkhas kyang rlom pas ma khengs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs mdzad pa kho bo'i snying du bzhugs/ /bdag gi pha ma nyon mongs dgra bos khyer/ /dgra bor bcas pa skye rga na 'chi yi/ /chu bo bzhin du rab tu bying bar gyur/ /thar ba'i gzigs bcas bla ma mnyan pa mcheg /phan bde'i skya bsakha lo rab bsgyur nas/ /bdag gi pha ma skam la 'don du gsol/ /phal cher mu mtha' re/da pa'i rgya mtshor shor/ /bla ma klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu can/ /nga yi pha ma bde ba'i skam la drongs / / mthu dpal rmad mnga' khyed kyis drang du gsol/ /blo ldan snying rje chen po nga la gson/ /nga yi pha ma la la me yis tshig /nga yi pha ma la la mtshon gyis gsheg /nga yi pha ma la la srin bus zos/ /nga yi pha ma la la khwa tas zos/ /nga yi pha ma la la khro chur bying / /sdug bsngal ma bzod thang la bros gyur pas/ /thang chen spu gris gtams pa'i lam du song / /de la rab tu skrag ste bros gyur pas/ /bsil nags 'khrigs te ral gris rab tu rnyil / / gzhan yang gos med grang bas rab tu gdungs/ /a chu rab tu chu bur rab tu rdol/ /padma ltar gas utpal bzhin du gyes/ /da re nga'i (yikapha ma de 'dra ba/ /mi cig pha ma me dong lhung gyur na/ /snying yod mi bzod skam la 'phar tshe na/ /nga yi pha ma de 'dra bzod lags sam/ /a tsa ma na 'brom rje ma snyoms shig /nga yi pha ma gos med skom pa dag /zas med mgrin phra lto ba rab tu che/ /yan lag phra zhing stobs med gyur ba rnams/ /ji ltar bzod dam 'brom rje de la soms/ /gti mug gyur ba'i pha ma bltas na yang / /dbang med bzod dka'i sdug bsngal rnams kyis gtses/ /phal cher rang nyid dgra bor langs par gyur/ /la la spu lpags sha rus dgra bor langs/ /la la rang stobs khur chen dgra bor langs/ /la la mgyogs pas bkol te dgra bor langs/ /la la dbang med 'byung bzhis brdungs par gyur/ /pha ma de 'dra bzod dam 'brom rje soms/ /e ma mtho ris —50—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /bde skyid zhes grags pa'ang / /drang por skyes pa'i lus ni sgur por gyur/ /nag por skyes pa'i skra ni dkar por gyur / / dkar ser dmar mdangs 'jam zhing gnyer med pa/ /sngo skam gnyer ma la sogs dag tu nyams/ /kun gyi yi gar mi 'ong pha rol nye/ /bskyangs pa'i bus kyang sdang mig lta bar byed/ /de yang mi rtag pha rol 'gro ba rnams/ /bzod dam 'brom rje de la bsam par rigs/ /thams cad pha ma bu tsha'i rang bzhin yang / /gang gis gang du mi 'dzin sun 'byin pa'i/ /dmu rgod bzod dam 'brom rje de la soms/ /da ni pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes las/ /g.yo bar mi byed byams pas drang bar bya/ /de byas nyes par 'gyur ram a ti sha /legs par dgongs dang blo ldan snying rje can/ /byin gyis rlobs shig mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal/ /'bral thabs med de 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /pha ma'i don du kho bo bskyang du gsol/ /da ni sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe pha ma bu tsha'i sems kyis 'dren tshul te/ /bdag gis bskyang bar bya ba'i tshoms yin no/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /gsung gleng snyan no sras kyi gtso/ /thams cad de 'dra'i sems su mdzod/ /bdag la'ang de las lhag ma mchis/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /zhus dang gsungs pa mang gyur kyang / /hril te gril (dril)na 'di lta ste/ /bla ma mkhan po mthong ba'i tshe/ /gus pas rim gro bskyed par bya/ /gang zag chos kyi mig can dang / /las dang po yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes bskyed/ /ces bya ba gcig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las bkur bskyangs dang mthong tshul phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u ste bcu ba'o// //da11 dam pa'i spyod pa ji ltar skyong ba'i lelgayang jo bo yab sras gnyis thang po che nasasnye thang du byon pa'i dus su/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ yi dam lha mos lung bstan nas/ jo bo'i snying du bde gshegs byon/ /bdag gi gnas su bag phab ste/ /'gro ba'i don chen spyad lagasakyang / /jo bo mkhas pa bu yis mchod/ /'on kyang snyun dang mi ldan nam/ /rgyal ba zo mdog bde gyur tam—/ / bde legs gnas la spyod gyur tam/ /sku nyams phun sum tshogs gyur tam/ /sman pa'i rgyal po bla ma yi / / spyan sngar sman gyi sdum ra 'dir/ /me tog blang phyir kho bo lhags /brtse ba brtse bas gnang du gsol/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /bod kyi mgon po nga la gson/ /bdag la nyes pa mi mnga' yang / /bod kyi dam pa bzang por gnas/ kho bo de las dman ltar gda'/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nga la nyon/ /gang na sdig grog gnasapa'i gzhi/ /dge ba bzang por mi 'gyur bas/ /chags sdang grogs las dben gyur pa'i/ /bzang —51 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/po'i grogs gnas gang na mchis/ /e ma sdig grogs rab spangs nas/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten na bzang / kho bo nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /snang snang 'dra ste bzung bar bka'/ kho bo 'od kyi gur dang 'dra/ /legs legs 'dra ste bzung bar bka'/ kho bo nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ /nyes skyon sprin gyis ma bsgribs gsal/kho bo sman gyi ljon pa 'dra/ /bsten na 'phral dang phugs su bde/ /'brom rje dben gnas gang na mchis/ khyed la bsam nas 'ongs so dgongs/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad gsung / /bla ma skyo ba sangs pa'i gnas/ /snye thang bde ba'i zhing khams yod/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi dag /sdod nyams dga' zhing me tog 'khrungs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis rab tu mchod/ /rgyal ba'i skyo sangs gnas chen yin/ /ston dang dbyar du bab pa'i tshe /gsing ma'i ne thang me tog bkra/ /ljon shing yal 'dab mdzes par rgyas/ /chu mig rdzing bu bsil ngad ldang / /mdzes pa'i me tog zhabrungs pa la/ /bung ba'i khyu rten snyan pa 'byin/ /gzhan yang snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i/ /mdzes pa'i 'dab chags du ma gda'/ /sa gshin 'bru sna du ma 'khrungs/ /skye bo'i tshogs rab 'byor pas bde/ /rdzing bu dpag med nang na yang / /ngang pa ngur pa chu bya rnams/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bag phebs rgyu/ /dgun yang me tog 'khrungs pa der/ /rgyal ba byon dang sdig grogs med/ kho bos sdig grogs rab spong zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyed la bsten/ /gzhan yang gdul bya bde la 'god/ /bla ma zhing der gshegs su gsol/ / mar me mdzad dpal 'di skad gsung / /sras kyi thu bo nga la nyon/ sdang dang mi bde'i sems spangs zhing / /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya/ /sras kyi thu bo snying rje can/ /sems can kun gyi las la soms/ kho bo dge ba'i gnas su drongs / / sdig grogs med pa'i zhing du 'deng / /de 'dra'i gnas de chos spyod 'phel/ /gsung zhing ci la'ang ma thogs par/ /rgyal ba sras bcas lam zhugs tshe/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /sdig pa'i grogs po ji 'dra yin/ /de nyid spang na ji ltar bya/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji 'dra yin/ /de nyid bsten na ji ltar bya/ /sdang ba'i yul de gang zhig yin/ /mi bde'i sems de gang zhig yin/ /bde ba'i gnas su ji ltar 'gro/ /bla ma mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /phan bde'i thugs kyis bstan du gsol/ /bla ma'i gsung nas 'di skad gsung / /thar ba'i srog dang 'brel ba gang / /shan pa de ni sdig grogs yin/ /dngos dang mtshan mas 'ching ba yi/ /thag pa de ni sdig grogs yin/ /btsun po khrims dang 'brel ba yi/ /'chal ba de ni sdig grogs yin/ /dam nga/ dmangs su 'bebs pa yi/ /dregs pa de ni sdig grogs yin/ /tshad med tshad kyis ston byed pa'i/ /tshod 'dzin mkhan de sdig grogs yin/ /nang par 'chi ba 'ong nges kyang / /da dung tshe 'di'i 'dun ma bsten/ /mi rtag skad cig mi bsgom pa'i/ /ngang ring po de sdig grogs yin/ /tshe 'di nyid kyi 'dun ma can/ /phan phan skad du gros 'debs —52—

pha chos di shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gye dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /pa / / phyi ma nges par 'joms pa yi/ /slu brid mkhan de sdig grogs yin/ /yon tan kun gyi zhing sa mchog /chul khrims bum pa sgyel ba de/ /'chal pas bltas na dga' dga' 'dra/ /dga' mo ma kun sdig grogs yin/ /'dod yon glu gar mdzes pas brgyan/ /gos bzang zas kyis phyug pa yi/ /bzhad gad di re tshogs pa yi/ /nyams dga' can kun sdig grogs yin/ /'khor bar gnas kyang ma gos par/ /gzhan don byed la dben pa ster / / slob gnyer mkhas de sdig grogs yin/ /chags med gtong ba'i lag nas 'dzin/ /nor med mi la bde ba bral/ /ma byed nya ra gyis zer ba'i/ /sha tsha mo de sdig grogs yin/ /gzhan dag gnod sems med gyur kyang //ci ngan byas pa bsten pas 'phung / /bu yis mi bsad pha phung 'dra/ /las ngan po de sdig grogs yin/ /dam pa mi mchod grogs po skyong / /pha ma mi skyong bdud mo gso/ /drin lan mi 'jal ngan lan dmar/ khrims med po de sdig grogs yin/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba bdag 'dzin che/ /'dod dgu thams cad rang 'dod pa'i/ /dam pa yin yang gzhan smod pa'i/ /rang nyid gcig pu sdig grogs yin/ /spyi skyid dgos bde mi shes par/ /spyi phung rang bde 'dod pa yi/ /gnas lugs ma mthong blo lhag can/ /mkhas pa de kun sdig grogs yin/ /gal te dge ba byed 'dod kyang/ /phyi bshol 'debs pa sdig grogs yin/ /da lta sgrub tu yod bzhin du/ /phyi thes rtsi ba'i 'dun ma can/ /rting la 'gyod pa'i go ma chod/ /pho rdugs po de sdig grogs yin/ /ci la bsams kyang mi phan pas/ /chos cig (shig) dgos so mi zer bar/ /chos kun skyid pa'i sla'o zer/ /sdug rings po de sdig grogs yin/ /sras kyi snying po 'brom rje mchog /shes par mdzod la sdig grogs spongs/ /de yi gnyen por dge bshes bsten//de 'dra'i gnas mal ngan pa ni/ /btson khang nyid dang cis ma mtshungs/ /'dul khrims gtsang ma bsrung ba'i tshe/ /theg pa chen po'i brod kha can/ /gzhi ma bzhig pa'i 'byor thogs can/ /sdig pa'i grogs po yin pas spongs/ /sha khrag chang gi longs spyod rnams/ /'dul ba mdo sde rab ltos la/ /gnang shas che na rung ba yin/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni bslu med yin/ /gnang bar ma gyur su za ba/ /slob gnyer byed pa'ang sdig grogs yin/ /rang bde yal bar dor gyur nas/ /spyod lam sna tshogs skur bstan cing / /mi za dgu sa nyon mongs 'dra/ /gnas lugs shesanas spyod pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzang po la/ /btsun tshugs med ces gshe ba yang / /sdig pa'i grogs po yin pas spongs/ /rnam rtog rang sar chom pa yi/ /bskyed rdzogs bsam gyis mi khyab la/ khyi phag 'dra zhes smod pa yang / /sdig grogs yin pas shes par spongs/ /mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi /bde ba'i lam la bar gcod pa/ /gang zag ci 'dra yin kyang rung/ /sdig grogs yin pas shes par spongs/ /de ni sdig pa'i grogs spong ba'i tshoms so —53—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje nyon/ /de ring lam 'di chos kyis bskyal/ /sa phyogs 'di ni bye stong che/ /snye thang de yang shul (bshulakathag ring / /rgya gar gnas nas 'dir 'ongs pa'ang / /tha mal gtam la 'ongs pa min/ /sems la mi phan nyan bshad rnams/ /ltar snang don med las ro yin/ /sems la phan na gdamasangag yin/ /nyams su len na sdod ldan yin/ /thar ba'i yon tan rab ston cing / /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rab tu ston/ /spang dang blang bya'i thabs ston pa/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas bsten/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu/ /sems bskyed dam chos ston mdzad pa/ /gang zag ci 'dra yin kyang rung / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas bsten / / sdig grogs rnams kyis gang ston pa'i/ /chos las bzlog ste ston pa gang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog yin pas/ /gus pa'i yul du bsten par mdzod/ /thabs mkhas shes rab bzang po yis/ /tshad med bzhi dang 'brelab yi/ /pha rol phyin drug sus ston pa/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas bsten/ /de ni gtan du phan pa yin/ /dge ba'i bshesaganyen bsten pa'i tshoms so/ /sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje nyon/ /mu stegs log pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan la rab tu sdang / /'dzin byed dge 'dun rnams la sdang / /de 'dra'i gnas de mi bde'i gnas/ /des na mi bde'i sems 'byung bas / / sdang dang mi bde'i sems spangs la/ /de yi dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /'chal ba'i tshogs rnams khrims la sdang / /dam nyams dag kyang bzlog la sdang / khrims ldan dam tshig ldan pa rnams/ /sdang dang mi bde'i sems spangs zhing / /bde ba'i gnas su gshegs na bzang / /'dod pa can gyi mi dag ni/ /bsdu rnam bzhi yis gang spyod pa'i/ /bsod nams can dag mi bzod par/ /phrag dog dbang gis sdang bar byed/ /de bas sdang dang sdang yul rnams/ /spangs la bde ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /'jig rten dag na rmongs pa rnams/ /rang dang mi mthun chos yin kyang / /nga dang kho zhes gzhan la sdang / /skyes nas chags sdang lhan skyes pa'i/ /dmu rgod de ni rang nyid las/ /gzhan par gyur na su la'ang sdang / /sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje nyon/ /go cha'i rgyal po 'brom rje nyon / / bas mtha'am yang na dgon pa'am/ /dur khrod gnas sam shing drung ngam/ /rgya mtsho'i 'gram mam gad skyibs sam/ /dben pa'i gnas su rab gnas te/ /sdang dang mi bde ma byung tshe/ /dge sbyor ci 'phel gzhan don bya / / gal te sdang dang mi bde'i tshe/ /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya/ /phyin nas zhag gsum yang na bdun/ /zla phyed zla gcig lo re tsam/ /sdang dang mi bde ma byung tshe/ /dgon pa yin pas bsgrub par bya/ /byung ma thag tu 'di lta ste/ /ri bong mal nas langs pa bzhin/ /bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar bya/ /nyon dang 'brom rje sras kyi mchog/mkhar lan mi bzang rang shong tsam/ /gzhan gyis mi dmigs skyabs yod tsam/ /'jog kyang mi chags bong —54—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ra'am / / g.ya'am lo ma'i spyil bu'am/ /gad pa'i phug gam brag skyibs bsten/ /gang du bsdad kyang dkon mchog gi /mchod dang mchod yul rgyun chad med/ khrims ldan thar ba gnyer ba rnams/ /rgyun chad med par skyob par byed/ /de tshe lha rten la sogs pa'i/ /mchod yul mang yang chags pa'i rgyu/ /mdun gyi mkha' la yig 'bru las / / pad sdong bskyed de bla ma dang / /dkon mchog yi dam bzhugs gsol te/ /yan lag bdun pa 'bul byed cing / /'phral dang phugs su rab bde ba'i/ /gsol ba snying nas gdab par mdzod/ /yang na rang gi snying dkyil du/ /ram̐ las ye shes me bskyed la/ /nyon mongs tshogs rnams rab tu bsregs/ /sha khrag phung po'ang sbyin sreg gyis/ /de nas me yi rang bzhin du/ /gsal la mi rtog rang dwangs pa/ /gzhan gyi sgrib pa'ang rab tu bsregs / / de nas me dpung cher bskyed la/ /bdud dang mu stegs dpa' skong la/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs stobs dang / /smon lam ye shes chen po yis/ /thams cad byang chub phyir slad du/ /yi ge bcu po 'di bsgrag go /oṃ tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ /chos spyod bcu po 'di bsgrags pas / / me yi dbus su hūṃ bskyed la/ /hūṃ de me yi rnam par zhu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brkyang bskum can/ /sku mdog mthing nag rngam pa'i sku/ /shes rab ral gri rab tu 'phyar/ /sdigs mdzub bdud sde rab tu sdigs/ /sbrul zhags klu tshogs zil gyis gnon/ /stag gi sham thabs gcan gzan sdigs/ /spyan mig dmar zlum phyogasabacur gzigs/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzes/ /de 'dra'i lus su rab bskyed la/ /stong pa'i gnas lugasasnying rje bsten/ /phan bde'i bsam pas bstan pa bsrung / /de yang dben pa'i gnas sdod tshe/ /chags pa med pa'i chos su bzang / /mkhyen/ par mdzod dang sras kyi gtso/ /de yang dam pa'i gnas mal yin/ /de ni bde ba'i gnasamal dag /bstan par byed pa'i tshoms yin no/ /de nas 'brom gyi zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma 'dir/ /rje bla ma'i gsung rab la berten nas/ /chos nor bu rin chen nyams su blang / /gnas chags sdang med pa rab tu bsten/ /grogs chags rdomeyu'akhalas ci thar bya/ /skyabs dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'bral med bsten/ /'khor thar ba gnyer ba 'ba' zhi tobaskyangs/ /gnas spangs ljongs me tog mdzes pa'i sar/ /chos tshad med bsgom zhing bag chags bzhag /mthar zhingakhams gtsang mar brgyud cing 'gro/ /ma ma lus rin chen gling du drang / /lus padma'i sbubs su legs bltamasanas/ /tshul byams pa'i thu bar rab tu blang / /bu snying rus bskyed cig rjes 'brang rnams/ /lo lnga bcu ( tsun6 lhag nas 'byung srid do/ /'di legs par ltos dang mig can kun/ /las legs nyes btang snyoms ga mi mdo yin/ /ya'i 'dam kha byed pa'i dus su gda'/ kho rtog shugs thal ba'ang lnga bcu (cukalhag khyod —55—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/khrel med zas kyi ma bslus par/ kha byi khung tsam la gros 'debs ran/ /kye mi yi zas la chags rin med/ /zas zhim po bdud rtsi'i nying khu yod/ /dus gtan du zhim pa bsam gtan zas/ khyod gzhong ba'i chu dang 'dra ba yin / / phyogs g.yas nas btsal na g.yon du 'bod/ /phyogs g.yon nas btsal na g.yas su 'bod/ /nor snying po med la zhen ma che/ /zas gtan du zhim pa tshogs gnyis spel/ /da nang du phab pa'i grosa'adebs yin/khyed snying yod yod na gdams par che/ /dus de ring lam gyi skyel thung yin/ /zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/sras kyi thu bo 'brom rje mchog /de ring nyid nas rten 'brel legs/ /skyo ba lam du sangs pa byung / /ci byas lam du 'gro ba'i chos/ /cis kyang 'ong bar kho bos shes/ /thar ba gnyer ba'i mi dag ni/ /spyod lam ji ltar byed gyur kyang / /chos kyi longs spyod kho nar zad/ /rmi lam na yang chos snang 'byung / /'jig rten byis pa'i kun spyod la'ang / / bram ze'i bu ni rig byed rtse/ /rgyal po'i bu ni rgyal srid rtse/ shan pa'i bu ni bsha' bshu rtse/ /rol mo mkhan po glu gar rtse/ /ri mo mkhan po ri mo rtse/ /mdor na pha ma gang byed pa'i/ /lad mo khye'u dag kyang rtse/ /thams cad bag chags shes par mdzod/ /de bas thos bsam bsgom pa yi/ /bag chags bzang po rab sbyangs nas / / rmi lam bar do skye shi dang / /srid pa bar do kun tu 'brang / /sangs rgyas can la sangs rgyas 'byung / /mtho ris can la mtho ris 'byung / /zhing khams gtsang la zhing khams 'byung/ /gcong rong can la'ang gcong rong can / / longs spyod che zhing ster ba yang / /de dag nyid du rjes su 'brang / /yod kyang ser sna byed pa yang / /med pas 'phreng zhing yi dwags 'brang / /sdig rngams can la dmyal ba 'brang / gti mug can la byol song 'brang / /zhes sdang can la 'thab rtsod 'brang / /bzod stobs can la lus mchog ste/ /brtson 'grus can la chos rgyal 'brang / / tshul khrims can la mtho ris te/ /mtho ris rten la bde skyid 'brang / /thams cad rgyu yi rjes su 'gro / / 'dra bas 'dra ba skyed byed yin/ /des na bag chags rjes su 'brang / /bag chags 'jig pa mnyam po la / / phun sum tshogs pa'i bag chags zhog /rgyas par brdzes bcangs byed tshe ston/ /'brom rje gzhan snang 'khrul ba la/ /jo bo yab sras ngal ba skad/ khul ring lam ni bgrod dka' skad/ /mi ngan chom po 'ong ngo skad/khyed kyis myur du phar la drongs/ /gsung zhing rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis byon/ /snye thang 'or du phyag phebs tshe/ /sems can rang rang gang mthun pa'i/ /snang ngor rnam 'phrul du ma bstan/ /slar yang zhal nas 'di skad gsung //zhal gyis bzhes pa'i me tog shog /'brom rjes na yi me tog bstan/ /zhal nas 'brom rje drang don mkhas/ /lha yi tshogs rab gnas 'dir shog /lha yi me tog gnas 'dir shog /e ma ho mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po'i me tog la/ /kye ma chung chung 'brom rje gzigs/ /'o le 'dab ma'ang skyes te gda'/ /dod —56—

sgru/ chos snye shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dod rdzun phugs ma/ rdib cam/ /gsung ba'i ljags de nga la ston/ /de nas 'brom rjes ljags brkyang skad/ /gzigs pas de la'ang me tog cig/ /skyes pa gzigs nas jo bo mnyes/ /kye ma ho ya mtshan de na 'dug /'brom gyi lce ni rne thang 'dra/ /bung ba zhal du mi 'tshang tsam/ /'o na'ang mngar rtsi med dam ci/ /slar yang 'brom rjes ljags brkyang ba'i/ /me tog steng na'ang jo bo gda'/ /jo bos gzigs nas 'di skad gsung / /a re ci yang dgod re bro/ /bdag la 'brom gyis dbyung ba byas/ kho bo re chung nas rdarmog tsam/ /re dod gsung zhing phyag gis reg /padma'i steng gi jo bos bzhad/ /de nas jo bo'i bzhad srin langs/ /yang dang yang du bzhad par gyur//de nas 'brom gyis 'di skad smras/ /dgun dus zhabrungs pa'i me tog dkar 'bur ba/ kho bo zog mar ma btang drin che'o/ /spyir yang mtha' 'khob gnas 'dir grang gzhi che/ khyad par dbu ru byang phyogs 'khris 'khyags mang / / ding sang dgun dus me tog 'dab lnga pa/ /sa la skyes pas jo bo mnyes gyur na/ khyad par rdzun med 'brom gyi lce la 'khrungs/ /bung ba dris pas bde gshegs sku gzugs byon/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad bde gshegs 'di 'drar bzhad/ /mtshar mos rang gi byad mthong bzhin du bzhad/ /lha mo rang gzugs ston pa bzhin du bzhad / / bkra shis bla ma mnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /slar yang bla ma rje btsun 'di skad gsungs/ /'brom rje da dung ljags kyi me/ tog ston/ /slar yang ljags brkyang gzigs su phul ba yis/ /bla ma'i mdun na'ang 'brom/ chung chung chung cig /'dzum 'dzum bla ma'i zhal la rab blta/ zhing / /bu chung skad sgra snyan pa'i sgra 'byin gsan/ /gzigs ma thag tu shin tu dgyes gyur nas/ /me tog 'di 'dra rgya gar yul na'ang med/ /zab mo'i yab sras ljags kyi steng na'ang gda'/ /ngo mtshar che'o nang gi ya gi gnyis/ /'brom rje ljags de gul gul ma mdzad cig/sku khams gso phyir 'brom gyis rab g.yos pas/ /leg leg ldeg ldeg 'brul la khad de gda'/ /rab tu bzhad cing 'brom rje ga le mdzod/ khye'u gzhon nu sran rdog za dang mtshungs/ /lce yi steng na ral ril ltad mor che/ /bde gshegs ljags kyi padmo las 'khrungs pa'i/ /dod por bzhugs pa'i gzugs can ya gi gnyis/ /mar byon bdag cag gnyis ni nang du 'gro/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas lan du 'di skad zhus/ /'jig rten sgron ma yar la gshegs su gsol/ kho bos phyin pas khong gnyis mi lus mchi/ /de nas rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes bzhin du/ /gzims khang nang du gshegs te byon pa'i tshe/ /lha yi tshogs kyis me tog dpag med 'thor/ /de nas jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'brom rje me tog mchog la mnyes gyur na/ kho bos sa phyogs 'di dag byin brlabs la/ /rin chen lnga yi me tog 'byung bar bya/ /lan du 'brom rjes thugs la thogs zhus pas/ /gser dngul la sogs me tog bzang po yis/ /snye thang khongs rnams rab tu gang bar gyur/ /de nas jo bo'i zhal nas —57—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di skad gsung / /bla mas byin brlabs mar me mdzad dpal ngas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog 'di kun bas / / 'brom gyi rjes 'brang mchod tshogs 'phel bar shog /lan du 'brom gyi zhal nas 'di skad zhus/ /bzang po'i sa chen bzang pos byin brlabs pa/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rab ma lus bzhes su gsol/ /bdag cag gdul bya zhing khams dpag med du/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs me tog pad steng du/ /dri mas ma gos rdzus te skye bar shog /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten zhing khams rab 'byams na/ /'di ltar rin chen lnga yi me tog rnams/ /phun sum tshogs par gang yod lha la 'bul/ /'di dang 'khor tsho'i tshe rabs ma lus par/ /me tog sbubs su chos kyi snang ba rgyas/ /rgyal bas kha 'byed rgyal bas skyong bar shog /bdag gi rnam thar padma'i 'dab 'dra ba / /gtsang ma gtsang mar phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag gi rnam thar shel gyi maṇḍal bzhin/ khod snyoms 'jam zhing rab tu dwangs par shog /bdag gi rnam thar gser gyi mchod rten bzhin/ /lta bas mi ngoms ya mtshan mchog tu shog /bdag gi rnam thar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin /rnam rtog med par mun pa sel bar shog /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma'i rnam thar mi nub 'dzin par shog /thub pa'i rnam thar rin chen gsal byed cing / /rnam dag spyod pas phyogs mthar rgyas par shog /chos rnams thams cad thog mtha' bar dge zhing / /bka' sdod rnamasakyis rtag tu skyong bar shog /'bral med rgyun du rjes dran drug po yang phan bder rtse gcig rtag tu dran par shog /ces zhus pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ /'brom bkra shis so gsung /'brom gyi zhal nas/ gsung du ma cig glengs kyang / skabs don dum bu gcig la 'dus par gda' zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas bsdus pa'i skabs la bab gsung / /de nas 'brom gyi zhal nas/ zhus lan du mar byas gyur kyang / / legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /sdig pa'i grogs po spang bya zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /sdang dang mi bde'i sems spang zhing / /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ dam pa'i spyod pa ji ltar skyong ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //na12 'dod pa'i lam lasabarjesabacangasaji ltar bya ba'i lelgan mo ratna gu sa gu ru ratna gu mā zag med bde ba'i chu klung gis/ /'gro ba'i tsha gdungasa'ajoms mdzad pa / / skyabs kyi gtso bo phan bde'i mgon/ /kun gyi zhabs la spyi bos 'dud/ /tshogs gnyis rgya mcho las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus can/ shwakya'i rgyal po mtshungs pa med/ /bde gshegs gtso —58—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /la'ang spyi bos 'dud/ /gsal la ma 'dres kun dge ba/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i yul/ /gang gis blangs kyang mi slu ba'i/ /'phags bzhi'i yul la'ang spyi bos 'dud/ /de dang de sgrub phyir mi ldog /skyob par nus pa'i dpa' bo rnams/ /srid pa'i chu yis mi skrag pa/ /srid las bskyab phyir spyi bos 'dud/ /padma dkar po rab mdzes pa/ /'dab ma brgya stong mdzes pas phyug /rtsa ba gser gyi sa las 'khrungs/ /yu ba shel dkar mdzes pas bteg /ze 'bru rin chen lhun pos spud/ /'dab mdzes bar mtshams dpag med kyang / /yan lag brgyad ldan bde ba yi/ /chu bo chu phran rdzing bu dang / /chu mig khron pa mdzes pas bltams/ /ljon pa yan lag stong ldan pa'i/ /'dab ma me tog shing thog mdzes/ /gang de'ang shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /gser dang dngul dang shel dang ni/ /mar gad padma rā ga sogs/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs can bya tshogs rnams/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin khyu yisabastan/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu na/ /ngang ba skad snyan yid 'ong 'phyo/ /ne gsing spang ljongs me rtagabakra/ /gang de'i gzhi yi bde 'gro yi/ /'byor ba dpag med 'bru chags zhabrungs/ /padma'i 'dab ma'i ngos layang / /chu mig dwangasam zil ba 'phro/ /dgun dus shel gyi mchod rten 'brungs/ /dbyid dus g.yu yi spu rab langs / / dbyar dus utpal nyid 'gyur te/ /de la'ang rin chen sna lnga yis/ /mdzes pa'i me tog dpag med 'brungs / / chu mig shel gyi za ru can/ /tsha dus nyid na rab tu bsil/ /sus bsten skom pa'i gdung ba sel/khu byug lding lding dga' bas lding / /bya yi tshogs kyang khrims la gnas/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyang yid phebs gyur/ /ston dus gser gyi me tog nyid/ yākya'i dkyil 'khor ji 'dra ba/ /snying po thams cad rab bde zhing / /rin chen lnga yi me tog kyang / /'dab mdzes 'bras bu rgyas par 'gyur/ /dpal 'byor lha yi zhing khams bzhin/ /dbul ba'i skabs med tshogs rab bde/ /bar mtshams dag kyang rjes su 'brang / khyad par du yang 'di lta ste/ /mtsho mo rdzing bu dbyar dus che/ /g.yu yi maṇḍal gser byas brgyan/ /dgun dus shel gyi maṇḍal te/ /ston dpyid mdzes pa'i khrem gnyer can/ /'khor lo bya ba dbus nas 'gyed/ /rba rlabs chen po mtha' nas g.yo/ /rang las byung zhing rang la thim/ /sgra med zab chos ston pa yod/ /de 'dra'i ze 'bru chen po la/ /shel gyi mchod rten bye boganas/ /bang rim thams cad 'phags pas brgyan/ /thug col mi byed bka' rab bsdams/ /bang rim dang por skyabs su 'gro/ /bang rim gnyis par smon sems bskyed/ /bang rim gsum par 'jug sems bskyed//bang rim bzhi bar nyes dmigs lta/ /bang rim lnga bar rnam byang rdzogs/ /gnas dang gnas la brten pa rnams//dri mas ma gobashaphyi nang gsal/ /bya ba rgyu 'bras chos la spyod/ /gos ni tshul khrims mdzes pas brgyan/ /ska ragasango tsha khrel yod bcings/ /zhwa ni rnam dag lta ba gyon/ /zas ni dam chos bsam gtan za/ /spyod lam —59—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/thabs shes zung du 'jug /grogs ni lha dang drang srong bsten/ /chos ni lhag pa'i rin chen gsum/ /pha ni snying rje chen po ste/ /ma ni gnyis med sher phyin yin/ /bu ni rnam rtog rang grol yin/ /ci byed dam chos zab mo ste/ /dam chos rgyu 'bras 'brel chags yin/ /'brel ni tshul khrims gzhi ma ste/ /ngos ni rnam dag dad pas skyabs/ /zur ni tshad med bzang pos bsgron/ /ka ba gnyen po dpag med de/ /phugs ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /bla gab bla na med pa'i chos/ /bad ni kun mkhyen nor bus spras/ /bad zur yan lag drug bcus (cus) brgyan//rgya ni 'gro bas gang khyab pa/ /'phangs yang de tsam nyid du zad/ /sras ni nor bu rin chen te/ /sras ni brtson 'grus mdzangs ma yin/ /byang sgo gtong ba'i rgyal pos bsrung / tanar sgo dbang sdud rgyal pos bsrung / /lho sgo snyan grags rgyal pos bsrung / /nub sgo don grub rgyal pos bsrung / /bsam gyis mi khyab ga'akha yas khang / /mtshungs pa med pa'i pad 'dab dbus/ /rgyal ba stong gi 'od 'khrigs pa'i/ khres rab yum gyi gur nang na/ /shel gyi khye'u 'khar ba can/ /'khar bsil rtse la pad sdong bzung / /dbus na mtshan dpes brgyan pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bzhugs/ /pad re'i 'dab stong sras kyis brgyan/ /lung bstan bzhin du lung mchog gsung / / shel gyi khye'u'i sku mchog la/ /bde gshegs 'khor bcas lham mer shar/ /phyi nas ci 'dra na ka47 ba 5rgonang nas /yang / /'byom du mi gda' zlo du gda'/ /zur de ma bcag zur de bsgron/ /'di ni rin chen sa bon yin/ /'di las rin chen dpag med 'khrungs/ /rgyal ba zhes kyang rab brjod de/ /'byung gnas nyid kyang 'di nyid yin/ /rgya mtsho mchog kyang 'di nyid yin/ /sa chen thams cad 'di yis 'degs/ /sa chen nyid kyang 'di nyid de/ /'dod dgu thams cad 'di las 'byung / khye'u 'di yi ba spu yi/ /bu ga gcig kyang rgyal ba yis / / dpyad par mi nus nyan 'phags ci/ /stong gsum mang yang bu ga gcig /'di ni 'jig rten kun gyi rje//zlo rje khyod kyis mdzad spyod la/ khyod la bdag gi gdul bya yi/ /e ma khyod kyis 'khor lugs bzang / /don gnyer skye bo mig can kun/ /zlo 'di 'dam du bying bar phangs/ /'dod pa bskyed la brdze bcangs gyis/ /cis kyang zlo 'di yar la thon/ khrel dkar shel gyi maṇḍal la/ /rin chen chu yis byi dor gyis/ /gsol ba thob dang rin chon ster/ /ding sang 'dam nas oṃ gyis bton/ /mchog gi 'dod pa can 'di ni/ /'dam gyi brdze bcangs dang po'i tshoms so/ /hrī7gle dzñā na ye shes gsal/ /padma stong gi dbus shed na/ /stong gi stong chen dbus shed na/ /yang mchog gser gyi ze 'bru la/ khrel dkar zla ba'i gdan steng na/ /zla ba zhun ma'i khye'u cig /oṃ shrī dzñā na ye shes lnga'i/ /'od kyi dbyings na snying po 'brang / /rtse gcig dam chos rab bskyed pas/ /rnam dag nam mkha'i dbyings shed na//—60—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos ga'i nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ye shes sems dpa'i dge slong cig /chags pa med par mi gang na/ /dag pa'i khye'u dri ma med/ /da ni ye shes dri ma med/ /rbha ga la pa'i dī paṃ nga / /rnam dag dbyings 'dir nyin mtshan du/ /ci ste a ti bsgrub par byed/ /de nas chu shel zhun ma yi/ khye'u chung lo brgyad lon 'dra ste/ /lo brgyad nyis ldab khye'u'i grangs/ /rang dang mtshungs pa'i lha mo yang / /bzhi bzhi phyogs bzhir rab tu bkod/ /mar me zhal zas la sogs pa'i/ /bdug spos dri chab rgyun mar 'bul/ /de nas ñdzu rje 'di skad du/ /mig stong gus pas rab bltas te/ /phyag stong spyi bor rab spyar nas / / sgo gsum 'dud cing khyad par du/ /ngag gi bstod dbyangs 'di bzhes 'tshal/ /ye shes chen po brtse bar dgongs/ /mtshungs med bsregs bcad brdar bas gser/ /zhun ma dri mas ma gos mdog /lta bas mi ngoms lham mer mdzes/ /ji ltar snod dang mthun pa'i dbyibs/ /gang du bkod kyang 'gran bral ba/ khyod ni nas doog tsam la yang / /nas ni bye bas ga la khugs/ /nas ni mi yi srog 'dzin te/ /rin chen khyod ni mtshungs pa med/ /gang gi bla ma mtho ris kyi/ /yon tan ster ba bye bas kyang / /ye shes khyed cig ga la yod/ /bla ma khyed kyigazhal yas khang / /'og min chen por nges na yang / /pad dkar gser gyi ze 'bru can/ /drang thad mi gang mi mtho bar/ /chags med mi bskyod rab bzhugs pa'i/ /zhabs gad spyi bor blangs te rgyal/ khyod sku gaṅgā'i bye mar yang / / sprul nas de nyid zhing bgrod mod/ /zlo rje'i zhing khams dbu ma'i yul/ /pad sdong bye ba'i thang du byon/ /gang de'i sku la shel btud nas/ /dri med yid kyis bstod phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig mi lus rin chen mchog /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur te/ /mi shes dbang gis slar 'bog rnams/ khyed kyis rjes de 'dren byed rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i sku la drin gzo'i phyir/ /pha ma drangs zhes spyi bos 'dud/ /de ni stong pa'i brdzes bcangs te/ /shes nas brdze ba gnyis tshoms so/ /lag pa'i me tog pad sdong las/ /yu ba mi gang mchis pa yi/ /pad 'dab dbus kyi bde gshegs bteg /de ltar bkur sti gdan bting nas/ /de ltar rnyed pas mchod pa ni/ /bzang po'i zhing khams dpag med na/ /snang ba'i mchod tshogs gang yod pa/ /sgrib pa mi mnga' mngon sum du/ /rin chen lnga yis rab mdzes pa'i yan lag brgyad kyis phyug pa yi/ /mtsho dang mtsho phran rdzing bu'i tshogs/ /rin chen bye bas rab brdal zhing / /mdzes pa'i me tog kun gyis bskor/ /dpa' zhing 'phyo la lding ba'i bya/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin mchod pa yang / /blo yis blangs nas mngon du 'bul/ /rin chen gling na lhun po dang / /dag pa'i zhing na dag pa'i rdzas/ /bdag pos ma bzung mchod tshogs rnams/ /blo yis blangs nas mngon sum 'bul/ /snang ba tsam gyis shes bya na/ /mchod 'os mchod pa ci yod pa/ /de la mchod pa ma tshang med/ /bsdoms te dri med dri med bzhes/ /'di 'dra'i mchod tshogs —61 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dam pa yang / /'dam gyis ma gos brdzes te 'bul/ /'dam ni ser sna re ltos yin/ /'dam gyis brdzes bcangs gsum tshoms so /de nas zhun ma'i thugs ka sa /'gro ba'i sdig tshogs dpag med rnams/ yīn tu gsal bar blangs gyur nas / / de dag phung po rab g.yo zhing/ /de yi rtsa na'ang shel dkar gyi/ khye'u mdzes cig shel lusalas/ /me ston sgrib shing rab tu bsreg /slar yang sgrib pa rab mnan tshe/ /du med ye shes me ru 'bar/ /re zhig sgrib pa zad gyur te/ khye'us me shul rjes dpyad pas/ /thal ba ma rnyed me shel nyid/ /rab tu mdzes shing mer mer gsal / / shin tu gsal ba me yi bu/ /sngon tshe bram ze gsal shes pa'ang / /chu shel me dang lhan cig tu/ /mi 'gal mkhas par blor tshud na'ang/ /bshad na byin pa skrag pas gsongs/ /de nas me shel chu shel gnyis/ /phyi nang rgyan te bzhugs pa na/ /dbusan khye'u dwangs pa cig /de ring rgyal sras chags pa med/ /chags med gnas na rab bzhugs mthong / /sngon tshe chags pa med pas byin/ /nga yi dad pa'ang mi g.yo zhing / /nga la dkon mchog 'bangs zhes grags/ /da yang dkon mchog skyabs 'og nas/ /dad pa brtan pas chags pa med /pha ma'i tshogs kyi sdig pa bshags/ /de nas mtha' 'khob du ma 'grim/ /'di nas 'di yi nub phyogs su/ /thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i/ /snying rje che bas rgyal bar grags/ /de nas re zhig dga' ldan 'gro/ /slar yang mtha' 'khob dpag med du/ /chu shel khye'u 'di skad gsung / /nga yi chu mig ring mo las/ /chu phul tsam zhig nub phyogs su / / mtha' 'khob ze 'brus spud par byed/ /de nas phyi nang gsum 'dus nas/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rab 'di bshags pas/ /ji srid mkha' yis khyab gyur pa'i/ /gnas na rgyud can gang zhig gis/ /dngos sam brgyud pas nyer gyur pa'i/ /'ching ba'i tshogs de 'dir bsdoms nas/ /ma lus chags pa med par bshags/ /e ma rang gi rjes 'brang ba/ /nyes pa'i tshogs gang sdom sems kyis/ /'gyod cing chos kyi dbyings su gshegs(bshagasaka/ /'ching ba gang de skad cig kyang / /gnas su bzhag par mi bya'o/ /bshags yul bla ma dkon mchog rnams/ /mtha' med 'khor bar rtse gcig tu/ /bsgral dka' sgrol ba'i go cha la/ /kun nas rjesasu yid rang ngo / /da dung 'khor ba ma stong par/ /gang dang mthun par dge ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad cing //g.yo ba med par bzhugs su gsol/ /btsan sa 'da' bar mdzad gyur na/ /gal te mi 'da' su zhig yod/ /de bas chos dbyings ma brlag par/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum kun tu rgyun dge ba'i / / dge ba'i las rnams gang spyad pa/ /'gro ba kun dang thun mong du/ /byang chub chen po brnyes par bsngo/ /de 'dra'i btsan sar ma phyin par/ /'gro don de dang dbyer med pa/ /phyogs cha med par spyod par shog /de yi —62—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhe nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gnas lugs de 'dra ste/ /da ni nam mkha' ma brlag par/ /mya ngan 'da' bar ma gyur cig /da ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /nyer mkho kho nar gyur pa las/ /nam yang dbyings su bde ma gyur/ /ji srid 'khor ba mu med par/byas pa byas zin ma gyur cig khrel gzhung phyi thag ma bcad phyir/ khur chen 'dor bar ma gyur cig /padma dkar po 'di bzhin du/ /dri ma med la kho lag yangs/ /rin chen 'dab rgyas rin chen 'bru/ /rgyal ba rgyal bas 'debs par shog /shel gyi mchod rten ci 'dra bar/ /mchod rten mchod rten 'degs par shog /ye shes lnga ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ni yan lag lnga yin te/ /sdig pa'i 'dam du ma bying bar/ /yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs gsol ba'i/ /'dam las 'dren pa'i brdzes bcangs mchog /'di ni brdzes bcangs bzhi ba'i tshoms so / /de nas zla ba zhun ma yi/ /ljags las shel gyi dza dkar cig /'od kyi rnam par sku la 'phros/ /de ma thag tu spyi bor byon/ /de nas shel gyi hūm̐ dkar cig /bde bar gzhegs pa'i thugs kar 'phros/ /rgyal ba tshangs pa'i bu gar thim/ /de nas shel gyi baṃ dkar cig /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs khyab par 'phros/ /thugs rje che dang dbyer med gyur/ khrel gyi ho zhes gnyis med bskor/ /thugs rje chen po mnyes gyur te/ /thams cad ser dang dkar po yi/ /'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ma lus 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs gser mdog 'dra/ /lham me lhan ne zhing 'dir 'khod/ /sems dpa' shel dkar gzugs can yang //dpag tu med pas zhing de gang / /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa/ /rgyal yum nga ro cig gis sgrog /zhing khams thams cad 'ed kyis gang / /gzhan yang mchod spungs sprin du 'thibs/ /de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ / gling bzhi mchog dang rab tu gda'/ /de nas zhun ma'i thugs ka nas/ /sprul pa'i dge slong de thon te/ /dga' ba'i gsung gis rab gleng zhing / /phan tshun mthun par 'khod pa'i tshe/ /zhun mar gyur pa'i sne rje yis/ /sprul pa'i dgeḥsmoong kun mkhyen la/ /kun la phan pa'i tshig 'di gsol/ /blo ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /ma dag 'jig rten rigs drug na/ /bcu gnyis dag gis rab sbrel te/ /rgyun chad med par 'khor bar gyur/ /kun gyi rtsa ba gang zhig yin/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /zlo rje ma rig chen po ste/ /'di la brten nas bcu gcig 'byung / / bcu gcig la yang 'di nyid do/ /zlo rje'i shaṃl nas 'di skad gsung / /bcu gnyis 'di ni dper gsol na/ /gang dang 'dra bar rgyal bas gzigs/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ /de ni lung nas 'di skad gsung / / ma rig rgan mo long ba ste/ /'du byed dag ni rdza mkhan bzhin/ /rnam zhes spre'u lta bu ste/ /ming dang gzugs ni grur 'jug 'dra/ /skye mched yul 'khor stong pa ste/ /reg pa 'o byed 'dra zhes gda'/ /tshor ba mig —63—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la mda' brgyab ste/ /sred pa chang 'thung 'dra zhes gda'/ /len pa shing thog nyab (rnyab) 'dra ste/ /srid pa sbrum ma 'dra zhes gda'/ /srid pa de la bu skyes te/ /rga shi ro khur 'dra shes gda'/ /bla ma'i zhal nas de gsungs pas / / sne rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /de yi 'dra chos ji ltar lags/ /bla mas slar yang gsung du gsol / / skyes mtha' rgud pas mig med ma/ /phyi rol kha dog dbyibs chags pa'i/ /legs nyes gzugs rnams dpag med kyang / /mig med stobs kyis ma mthong bas/ /bo sgyel la sogs khyad gsod byed/ /gzhan sdang rang sdug bde ba brlag /ci byas log pa nyid 'gyur bzhin/ /yun ring 'khor bar rgas pa yi/ khes rab mig med dge sdig rnams/ /ma mthong bo sgyel sna tshogs byed/ /kun sdang rang gi bde ba brlag /ma rig 'di las brdzes bcangs kyis/ /ma rig 'di las thar na bzang / /brdzes bya mi lus tshul khrims yin/ /nges par 'dam las thar na bde/ /ji ltar rdza mkhan dbyug gu dang / /thal car nal car rkyen 'dus nas/ /du ma'i snod rnams byed pa bzhin/ /rnam par shes pa ma rig pas/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gsum 'dus nas/ /'dam khrod chen po drug tu sbyor/ /'dod chags bya pho lta bu ste/ /kun la meongs kyang 'dod yul la/ /byams par byed de rmongs pa yin/ /gtsang dang btsog pa mi shes par/ /'bru dang tshigs pa snabs lud sogs/ /rang gi grogs la ster byed cing / /ngoms pa med par 'dod pa spyod/ /'dod pa 'ba' zhig don gnyer bas/ /phyogs med mi ster chung ma nyid/ khrel gzhung phan sems mi che yang / /phyogs cig gnyen de ci skyongs byed/ /rgyal na yod kyang krog krog 'bod/ /'ching ba can de ngan 'gror 'gro/ /zlo rje snyigs ma'i mi la sbyor/ /ma rig mun pa rab 'thoms pas / / dge sdig las rnams mi shes par/ /nyon mongs 'dus nas sdug bsngal byed/ /bla ma dkon mchog mi mchod la/ /pha ma drin can mi skyong zhing / /snying rje'i yul la'ang mi ster bar/ /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying 'gyur bas / / 'dod pa'i 'dam las brdzes gyur te/ /gang la chags pa spang bya ste/ /chags med gnas su phyin na bde / / ma rig rmongs pa'i bya pho de/ /shes rab mig gis g.yang ma mthong / /skyob pa'i thabs mkhas khrims ma mthong / / tshul khrims srung bar mi byed par/ /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba bzhin/ /zlo rje gdol ba'i mi la sbyor/khrims med 'dod 'dam rab brdzes nas/ /chags med khrims kyis phyin na bde/ /zhe sdang can ni sbrul dang 'dra//rang la mi bzod sman lces ldag /g.yin la phod gam /ka 51 na 3 kham/ dug lces skyong / /gang gi srog dang ci phral byed/ /zhe sdang 'dam chen de dang 'dra/ /thams cad rang 'dod rtsa ba yin/ /'dod khams 'dod pas bying ba mad/ /sbrul bzhin mi rigs gdol pa yang / /rang la cung zad mi bzod par/ /gzhan la ngan mtshang brgyud pas 'bru/ /stobs yod na ni gsod par byed/ /'phrog dang 'khyig dang rdung bar byed/ /ma zad —64—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u snye shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /'jig rten brlag par byed/ /stobs med na ni phag tu 'bar/ /thabs kyis gtso bo dbyen gyis 'byed/ /dug dang rkun ma'i tshul gyis bslu/ /a tsa ma na 'brom rje mchog /'dod pa'i 'dam chen brlag na bde/ /'dod pa'i 'dam chen sgrol na bde/ /tshul khrims na bza' yar la brdzes/ /ngang srings bzod bsran lham bu phud/ /thabs dang shes rab lag pa sbrel/ /cis kyang chags med gnas su bros/ /gti mug phag pa rmongs gyur pas/ /gtsang ma'i ne gsing grog por gtong / /dag pa'i zhing la yid mi chags/ /ma dag zhing du dga' bde bskyod/ /mi gtsang 'dam la rkan sgra tog /sngar yang de 'dras de 'dra'i gzugs/ /lus cig byol song skad mang sgrog /snga phyi dus las mi rtog par/ /da lta rmu rgod tsham tshom gcod/ /'di yi rtsa ba'ang 'dod nag yin/ /mi lus khrims kyi gos can rnams/ /'dam 'di spangs la chags med bros/ /blo sna ma ring yar la brdzes/ /gzhan yang gti mug phag pa nyid/ /nges par gsod kyang bdag por 'khrul/ /ci thar 'bros par mi rtsom par/ /spang tshol slu brid zhim zhim za/ /rghaṃ rje mi ngan gdol pa rnams/ /nges par slu yang 'jig rten pa'i/ /rgyal po ngan dang sdig dpon bsten/ /legs pa brgya yis ngo bzung kyang / /nyes pa gcig gis tshe srog 'phrog /nor rdzas thams cad ldab gyur kyang / /phrag dog phra ma gcig gis slu/ /de yis bslus kyang mi shes par/ /slar yang zhe sdang gti mug gis / / lan bslan 'dod pas rab gdungs nas/ /sdig dpon gzhan cig (zhigakabasten par byed/ /des kyang de las ma 'das na/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal du ma 'gugs/ /'dod pa'i 'dam las thar na bde/ /blo sna ma ring yar la brdzes/ /'dod pa spangs nas chags med bde/ /gzhan yang gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog /thugs rje che rnams mi bsten par/ /dbang phyug khyab 'jug la sogs pa'i/ /sdig rgyal lta bu'i lha rnams bsten//rigs brgyud bcas pas mchod byas kyang / /lan cig phud cig ma mchod na/ /yul lha su zhig ma dga' zhes / / blo phugs gtad pa'i tshe srog 'brel/ /mi shes 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis phung / /skyabs gnas log par ma byed par/ /nyes pa'i rtsa ba 'dod 'dam las/ /ngang ring ma byed yar la brdzes/ /gzhan yang gti mug phag pa ni/ /las 'bras chos la rmongs gyur pas/ /bza' chung nyes dmigs che ba yi/ /grog mo'i tshogs rab dbugs kyis 'dren/ /'dir yang kham gang mi myong na/ /pha ma stong gi tshe srog la/ /don med hab shes dmyal bar 'phangs/ /e ma ñtsā rje nga la nyon/ /mi lus tsam zhig blangs gyur na/ /rang gis kham gang mi myong bar/ /rgyal khams thams cad rlag par byed/ /pha ma mang po'i tshe srog 'brel/ /pha ma mang po zas dang 'brel/ /mang po gos dang gnyen dang 'brel/ /a tsa ma na sras kyi mchog /kun gyi rtsa ba 'dod 'dam yin/ blo sna ma mang yar la brdzes / / rdzes byed tshul khrims gtsang ma bzang / /de ltar ma rig chen po yis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gsum —65—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'dus nas/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal byed/ /de ni 'du byed rdza mkhan 'dra/ /gang ma rig pa rgyu 'bras dang / /chos nyid zab mo ma rig pa'o/ /gang gis ma rig rnam shes kyis/ /ji ltar ma rig long ba'i tshul//de rten sdug bsngal 'byung tshul ni/ /'dus nas byas pa'i rdzas sogs bzhin/ /dmyal ba btso sreg chen po ste//yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal nyid/ /byol song gti mug gsod bkol can/ /lha min 'thab rtsod sbrul dang 'dra / / lha la'ang 'chi ltas la sogs mang / /mtho ris mi la'ang 'di lta ste/ /sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /pha ma mnyam po'i bu tsha yang / /la la bu mo la la bu/ /bu yang la la gzugs mdzes shing / /la la shin tu gzugs ngan pa/ / mnyam po tsam zhig srid na yang / /la la spyang zhing la la glen/ /de yang mnyam po srid na yang / / la la btsan phyug phun sum tshogs/ /la la dbul phongs du mas gzir/ /de dag tsam du'ang mnyam srid na / / la la rgod po kun gyis bkur/ /la la dbang med kun gyis brnyas/ /mi zad la la sdig spyod cing / /rang gi 'dun ma'ang rlag byed na/ /cig ni dge ba'i las la spyod/ /gzhan gyi mdun ma'ang sgrub par byed/ /de ni lhas mchod dam pas bkur/ /cig ni dmyal ba'i gnas nyid do/ /bu mo cig la'ang (ka 52 na6 yangaka de bzhin sbyar/ /pha ma gnyis la nye ring med/ /bzo la khyad par ci zhig byas/ /thams cad dug gsum che chung ste/ /las ngan spyod pa su rem yin/ /mkhas pas bltas na gang na'ang zab/ /grong pa'i gnas na'ang de ltar gda'/ /glen pa yod bzhin mi mthong ba/ /long ba'i mdun gyi gzugs dang mtshungs/ /des na 'dod ba'i 'dam chen las / / blo sna ma ring brdzes gyur te/ /chags med gnas su myur du bros/ /rtag tu mi rtag dran byas nas/ /'dam las bsgral bar bskul ma thob/ /lus sems nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /da lta 'dus shing long med dengs / khrel med snying gi lung thag bstungs/ /nang du khug la shags ngan thob/ /tshe 'di ston ka'i me tog 'dra/ /long med bad kyis myur du 'byer/ /ngang ring hon stor byin pa kun/ /snying gi lung thag yar la brdzes/ /gshes ngan bdud kyi gces phrug kun/ /thar ba'i sa bon ma 'joms shig /nyon mongs nad kyi khye chung kun/ /bde ba'i srog dang ma phral cig /byur ngan me tog rgad ka 52 ba3 sgang /bu kun/ /mdzes ma'i slu brid ma byed cig/gzegs mo bu mo rgyangs chung ma/ /thar 'dod gzhon nu ma slu cig /lang tsho rgyas pa'i nga rgyal can/ /rtag tshugasami thub 'gyod par 'ong / /sang dang gnangs la zla ba 'ong / /de bsags lor 'gyur khyod nyida'agyur/ /snying med snying por ma 'dzin cig kha gdangs mche gtsigs gnya' na zhon (bzhon1/ /sdang mig bgrad de mtshon chas 'debs / / nges par 'chi'o rang mthong can/ /le lo ma byed sgyid skyur can/ /snyom las ma byed 'ching phur can/khyod kyi lus srog myur du 'bral/ khyod kyi btsan sa gang na yod/ /a tsa ma na snying med kun/ /nga rgyal byed las —66—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi rnor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /btsan dug 'gams/ /myur du shi na mnar mi 'gyur/ /'di yi rtsa ba'ang 'dod nag yin/ /'dod pa ma che shi tshe phung / / rtag 'dzin ma che blo sna brdzes/ /'dod pa'i 'dam 'dis phung ba mang / /ji ltar zhon (bzhonakapa 'dam shor bzhin/ /'bab tu ma bde zhon (bzhon3 ma bde/ /lag dmig ( rmig3bton tshe rkang mig (rmig3 shor/ /rkang mig bton tshe lag dmig shor/ /de bzhin re mos brgya sbrel yang / /tha mar stobs zad nyid 'gyur gyi/ /gang yang ma thon bzhi ka bying / /bzhon pa'i rjes su rang nyid bying / /rtsa ba 'dod pa chen pos lan/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i 'dam chen 'dir/ /chos par rlom pa'i dregs pa yang / /chos kyi gnas lugs mi shes par/ /byams pa bsgom /ka 53 na1 los 'dod pa skyes/ pa la sogs pa/ /'dod chags spangs 'dod zhe sdang skyes/ /zhe sdang spang 'dod gti mug skyes/ /mi sdug bsgom pa zhe sdang yin/ /byams brtse ltar snang 'dod chags yin/ /mnyam nyid ltar snang gti mug yin/ /dga' ba ltar snang nga rgyal yin/ /de yang ma shes gti mug pas/ /tshul khrims bsrung tshe mchog 'dzin bying / /brtul zhugs bzang tshe mchog 'dzin bying / /lta ba bzang tshe mchog 'dzin bying / /mkhas bzang 'dod tshe mchog 'dzin bying / /gos ngan dgun tshe nyal dang mtshungs / / mgo bo g.yogs tshe 'gab rtsa shor/ /'gab rtsa g.yogs tshe mgo ma 'thum/ /nyam thag brnab sems 'phel na yang / /cis phan 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying / /mi phan grol ba'i skabs mi ster/ /nyes dmigs ltos la snying thag brdzes/ /gzhan yang btsan phyug 'phan dar ba'i/ rigs dang ka 53 na4 bzang pha ma 'dzom pa yi/ /gces phrug gzhon nu g.yu rna can/ /'jam zhing yid 'ong kha dog mdzes/ /mdzes pa mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /ngo bsrung 'khor gyis mtha' ma bskor/ /dpon dang rje ru ming btags nas/ /kun gyis bkur zhing langs na ldang / /stan la 'dug tshe /ka53 na 5 rgo'ang/zas kyis mchod/ /pus mo btsugs shing thal mo sbyar/ /de tshe rang yang 'di snyam du/ /nga las lhag pa su zhig yod/ /'jig rten 'di na nyag cig yin/ /kun gyis bkur 'os kho bo yin/ /nga ni 'di las ma 'das snyam/ /e ma 'chi bdag kho re zhan/ /de 'dra'i gces phrug gsod re phangs/ /'khor gyi gseb nas gang du 'khrid/ /zas dang phral nas khyed ci ster/ /bde ba'i stan la'ang 'dug dbang med/ /rang gi khyim du mi 'jog par/ /e ma gces phrug gang du 'khrid/ /dkar 'jam sha ni gcer mor phyungs/ /gos dang rgyan cha gang du 'dogs/ /re sdug g.yu rna ci phyir gcod/ /snying nye pha ma sha tsha kun//'byor pa che la kun gyis bkur/ /'o na bu 'di gang du gtong / /gtong yang 'di 'dra'i btang lugs ci/ /'phyang zhing slu bar mi byed dam/ khrel med phyi thag ji ltar gcod/ /re 'jigs 'chi ba'i gnas lugs 'di/ /de 'dra de la'ang de 'dra mthong / /g.yin yang bu tsha tshar gyur te/ /legs par bsags shing 'byor pas brgyan/ /bu mo —67—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ joo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/brdzangs shing bu rnams phogs/ /kun gyis bkur zhing nyams dga' bar/ /'gro na bzhon pa bzang pos 'degs / / sdod na 'bol ba'i stan gyis bteg /gos bzang dro yang rab gyon nas/ /yon bdag pa zhes ming 'dogs shing / /da de bya ba bu la bskur/ /skyid skyong bzang gas byed gyur cing / /kun smon rgan rgon mi bzhugs par/ /'di las skyid pa gang du 'gro/ /'on te rang la dbang med par/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis dbang med khrid/ /'chi bdag phung rgan khrel med po/ /rgan rgon khrid nas gang du 'gro/ /g.yog po mi 'ong jo bo'am/ /re sdug dkon mchog mi mchod par/ /rang la stobs med rgan rgon ang / /ma yin drin lan 'jal ba yin/ /'o na bu nor dga' bde'i gseb/ /skyid po 'di nas mi 'khrid thang / /ma yin 'di la srog lan 'jal/ /bu bzang skyes pa don med 'gyur/ /pha ma'i ram zla mi byed par/ /ngu brang byed cing sdod khom mam/ /a tsa ma na khrel med bu / / pha mas bsags pa'i nor za zhing / /pha ma gcer mor gtong pa zhan/ /de yang shin tu nyes gyur na/ /me chu sa dang bya ster zhan/ /phod dam 'jig rten khrel med pa/ /bden te dbang med gyur pas lan/ /'o na dbang chen gang nas 'tshogs/ /'thab pas thub pa cig ma mthong / /e ma dbul zhing phongs pa dang / /skag lkugs 'on long (na nad can/ /bdud kyis 'di dag mi gsod thang / /'di dag kun kyang shi ba mthong / /a tsa ma na khrel med bdud/ khyod kyis mi gsod su zhig yod/ /nga yi pha ma 'dam du bsnubs/ /thar ba'i tshe srog yang yang phral/khyod la 'chi ba 'ong mi 'ong / /gal te 'ong na khyod re phung / khyod la thar ba'i skabs mchis sam/ khyod las 'dam che su zhig yod/ /a tsa ma na pha ma kun/ /de ltar bshad kyang mi go na/ /snying rang med pa yin nam ci/ /med na 'khor bar mi 'khyams thang / /yod na go ste 'gros re ran/ /gzhan du sdug bsngal mi bzod bzhin/ /ma 'gal bsdams nas ci la sron/ /snying gi lung thag hril te brdzes/ /da dung 'ong ngo hon stor kun/ /sngar gyi 'dam gyis ma bred dam/ /bred med bzang ste sdug pa ngan/ /lcag brobs lcag brobs myur du 'chi/ /la la dag ni rgan la 'chi/ /la la dag ni gzhon la 'chi/ /la la dar la babs tshe 'chi/ /la la skye long med/ par 'chi/ /drung po drung mo mthong thos can/ /tshe thar su mthong su zhig thos/ /su cig mo dang nyog ge shi /a tsa ma na sdug ge la/ /thos rting mdzub mo mi 'gugs par/ khyod gcig sdod dbang yod de a /ka 54 na4 rgo.ang /thams cad shi ba thos pa'i tshe rang la 'ong nges mi ser/sa par/ kho shi he he yi re mug /ma tha'ang ngo tsha mi shes par/ /mi shes dgu shes pho tshod can/ khyod kyis mi tshe ji tsam thub/ /phal cher lo brgya bgrang dogs med/ /myur du nad kyis thebs gyur te/ /smre sngags chen po 'bod nges so/ lke nas khyod kyi 'gro sa gang / /phal cher spyad pas brdegs byas 'chi/ /yang na g.yog po skyel byed dam/ /phal cher khyod kyi kun spyod 'dis/ /mgo la rwa cig skyes —68—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /pa'am / / lag pa gshog par song ba'am/ /yang na rkang med rgyu 'phrul rem/ /byol song gnas su nges par skye / / byas pas mi nyan ngang ring po/ /gti mug nam mkha' ji srid bar/ /ngang ring sgur ba bab kyis dogs/ /'on te ser sna'i che lugs sam/ /'dod pa'i 'dam la chags lugs sam/ /'di byed bya ba mang lugs sam/ /phrag dog 'a kyir bgegs /ka 54 na 7'bu/gas/ rgyas lugs sam/ /zhe sdang sems la me 'bar te/ /rang gi phyogs la pho khog yangs/ /gzhan gyi phyogs la zhib thig che/ /phan bde'i yan lag mi gda' na/ kha sgo chung la kha nad che/ /mgrin pa phra la lto ba yangs/ khog pa rkang pas mi theg par/ /cung zad zas myong khar me 'bar /gos med gcer bur dog par 'gyel/ /gal te 'gyel bar ma gyur kyang / /las kyis bza' btung btsal du med / / chu bo dag kyang rnag khrag ste/ /chu ru mthong kyang dgra bos bsrung / /ma dag snang ba 'ba' zhig las/ /bde ba'i skabs med gyur gyis dogs/ /de 'dra mi 'ong gdeng yod dam/ /rgyu 'bras 'chol ba 'byung ba dka'/ /nges par lus de blangs kyis dogs/ /de kun myong kyang dga' tshad yin/ khyed kyi rgyud la thes mi gda'/ /thub na ma lus gsod par 'dug /mkho na ci yang 'phrog par 'dug /de kun 'os su 'gro yang srid/ /mi mkho bzhin du'ang don med 'phrog /thob na ci yang rku bar 'dug khyod kyi spyod gshis 'di 'dra na/ /rdzun phra ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub kyis/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun stangs sgrub par thos/ khrims dor 'di nor sgrub pa mthong / /chos kyi snang ba bag re yang / / 'di yi khral dang 'u lag sogs/ /nyi tshe'i 'jigs skyobs 'ba' zhig las/ /nges 'byung cig kyang mi gda' bar/ khyod kyi 'dun phugs ma sdugs (rdugasakasam// bla ma dkon mchog rab bslu zhing / /drin can pha ma bslu bar byed/ /mthun pa'i grogs rnams sun 'byin cing / /bde ba'i mdun ma sgrub bsgrubs nas/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gnyer/ /'dod pa ma grub kun dang 'thab/ /pha rol brlag par bya 'dod nas/ /gzhan la gnod pa bskyal gyur pas/ /tha ma rang la rtag tu 'khor/ /thar med 'obs su lhung gis dogs/ /ro myags 'dam du bying gis dogs/ khro chu khol mar btsos kyis dogs/ /thal chen chu bo rab med la/ /nyin dang mtshan du brgal gyis dogs/ /phyogs dang ngos rnams mer 'bar ba'i/ /lcags kyi khang par tshud kyis dogs/ /de dag kun kyang mdor mtshon yin/ /lung nas bshad na bsam mi khyab/ /de 'dra'i las la rab bsams la ngan song sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /myong bar ma byed long yod 'dir/ /thabs stobs sbyor bas 'chos re ran / / glen pa'i rigs 'di bzod bsran che/ /ci phan bcos su yod bzhin du/ /'dam du bying ba ji ltar byed//blo sna ma ring brdzes bcangs mdzod/ /de ltar dug gsum rab 'dus pas/ /rigs drug sdug bsngal de ltar byed / / de ni ji ltar dper blangs pa'i/ /'dus byas tshoms te lnga ba'o/ /—69—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/de nas dwangs pa'i khye'u yis/ /chags med lha la 'di skad zhus/ /gting mtha' yangs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /'ching ba can ldan 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /sgrol bar mdzad pa'i bla ma mchog /nges pa'i tshig gis 'di skad du/ /gang zhiga'adam na nyon mongs pa/ /kun gyi rtsa ba 'dod chags yin/ /chags pas bde 'gro'i srog 'phrog cing / /thar ba'i bde las bslu bar byed/ des na 'dod chags 'dam chen las/ /rtse gcig mi rtag rab bsgoms te/ /nges par 'chi zhes lcag brabs nas/ /sems kyi zhags thag yar la drongs/ /'khor 'dab thams cad brdzes na phan / / 'ching ba thams cad bcad na phan/ /sdug phung thamasacad bshig na phan/ /nges par skyabs gnas btsal na phan/ /labs mang bzlas pas brid na phan/ /bya mang bskor bas brid na phan/ /ldang 'dug phyag gis brid na phan/ /gnyid can bsgom du bsgyur na phan/ /bza' 'dod bsam gtan spel na bzang / /grogs bzang zla zhun bsten na phan/ /sdug cing rtsa ba shes na phan/ /bdag 'dzin rlung la bskur na phan/ /dgra bo gnya' bar bskyon na phan/ /le lan rtag tu bdas na phan/ /gshis ngan gnyen pos gdungs na phan/ /nyug ma thag tu bcom na phan/ /gang na gan/sa kyang rab btsal te/ /rnyed ma thag tu bsad na bde/ /'di 'dra'i phung po rnam shes yin/ /bla ma dam pa 'di ji 'dra/ /dmu rgod 'di yi rtsa bdar chod/ /gshis ngan 'di'i mur 'gram shig /lasangan 'di yi srog dang phrol/ /'chal ba 'di la le len ded/ /dam nyams 'di la chad pa chod/ /nga 'o skad du 'di yis bslus / / mi dgos dgu dgos phung rgan 'di/ khe dang rgyal kha dgos lags so/ /yod pas mi phan lhag po dgos / / dgos pa'i dgos lugs nga rang nyid/ /bu dang bu mo nga la dgos/ /nyid dang khang pa nga la dgos/ /rdzas dang yo byad nga la dgos/ /gos dang rgyan cha nga la dgos/ /mdzod dang mdzod nor nga la dgos/ /gnyen dang g.yog 'khor nga la dgos/ /snyan dang bstod ra nga la dgos/ /dpe dang lha rten nga la dgos / /'khor dang bu slob nga la dgos/ /rnyed dang bkur sti nga la dgos/ /gnas dang dgon pa nga la dgos/ /nga yi nga la thamasacad dgos / / nga ni 'jig rten 'di na lhag /mkhas dang btsun pa nga nyid yin/ /rigs dang skye sa'ang nga nyid bzang //'jig rten 'di na nga nyid nga / /mi dgos dgu dgos nga bdag 'di/ /'dod pa'i 'dam na skye rtsing de/ /'o na 'di thon jo bo rje/ /go chod po 'di yar la thon/ /spyang po ma ni yar la thon/ /sgo drag po 'di yar la thon/ /'dun pa can 'di yar la thon/ /e ma nga re mi 'gyod dam/ /mi dgos dgu dgos thams cad dgos/ /dgos ngos shes pa'i phugs dgos med/ /'khor 'dab brlag tshar sa la nyil/ /'dod chags che zhing gti mug che/ /'dam du tshud na ldang stobs chung / /dgos pa'i gnyen pos bslus pa ni/ /lug thug 'dam du bying ba nyid/ /'khun bu che la ldang stobs chung / /'di 'dra'i ma dag sems can gyis/ /sla tshar brdzes shig thugs rje can/ /blo —70—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /rings chod cig thugs rje can/ /e ma rnam shes 'jug rtogs can/ /mar che na ni drang srong gral/ //sha che na ni spyang ki'i gral/ /chang mang na ni gdol ba'i gral/ /labs mang na ni mu cor gral/ /gzugs la dga' na mig sgor rgyug /sgra ladaga' na rna sgor rgyug /dri la dga' na sna sgor rgyug /ro la dga' na lce sgor rgyug /reg byar dga' na lusasgor rgyug /mi grub 'dun ma shom byed na/ /yid sgor mi rtog dgu la rtog /a tsa ma na spre rgan 'di//ci 'gaglamasagasung du gsol/ /sprul ba'i dge slong 'di skad gsung / /phung rgan 'di ni spre'u 'dra/ /bug sgo drug pa'i mkhar nang du/ /klad med spre'u 'di bcug tshe/ /nyug nyug nyug tu drug kar rgyug /de dang 'dra bas bltas pa'i tshe/ /'di yis 'khrug pa du ma sbyor/ /mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis sgo drug tu/ /phyin tshe spre'u drug go snyam/ /gzhan yang nags kyi khrod dag tu/ /me yis 'jigs tshe sa la 'bros /bya yis 'jigs tshe shing rtser rgyug /spyang shad che la glan par gda'/ /de bzhin rnam par shes pa yang / /spyang zhad che la phugs ma rtogs/ /'phral ni bya mang kun du rgyug /dug gsum po yi skyed 'phel byed/ /'bras bu ngan song sdug bsngal myong / /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab chen po ste/ /'dod yon lcags kyis 'ching bar 'gyur/ /'di nyid legs par thul gyur na/ /rnam shes ye shes nyid gyur te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rtsa bar 'gyur/ /rnam shes 'dam las brdzes pa ste/ /'di ni brdzes bcangs drug pa'i tshoms so /zlo rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /ming dang gzugs ni ji ltar lags/ /sprul pa'i dge slong 'di skad gsung / / ming ni tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam par shes pa ste/ /gzugs ni gru dang 'dra ba'o/ /tshor ba myong ba byed pa ste/ /'du shes spu ris 'dzin pa yin/ /'du byed 'dus nas rtsom pa ste/ /rnam shes so sor rig pa yin/ /gzugs ni gnyom du rung bar bshad/ /skye rga na zhing 'chi ba yi/ /chu bo chen po 'di nyid la/ /lus ni ko ba ji bzhin du/ /rnam par shes pa ko mkhan 'dra/ /dge sdig las ni ko skya ste/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed gsum // / ko ba 'dra ba'i gzugs su zhugs/ /mnyan pas phar tshur sgrol ba bzhin/ /rnam par shes pa 'du byed bcings / / skye ba snga phyi dpag med du/ /yang dang yang du 'pho bzlog byed/ reg pa gnyis gnyis 'phrad gyur te//dang por 'phrad pas reg pa bskyed/ /de la brten nas bde sdug tshor/ /de la brten nas sred pa 'phel/ /de la brten nas yang yang len/ /de la brten nas las ngan srid/ /de la brten nas 'bras ngan skye/ /de la brten nas rgasapa 'byung / /de la brten nas na ba 'byung / /de nas mya ngan smre sngags 'don/ /'chi snyam sdug bsngal yid mi bde / / skyes nas 'chi ba chos can pas/ /dbang med mi bzlog 'chi ba 'byung / /gnyis pa lce yi dbang bo la/ /mngar ba'i ro mchog reg pa na/ /chos nyid ma rig dbang po nyid/ /'dus pas rnam par shes pa yis/ /ro yi —71 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rnam pa tshor gyur te/ /de la rab tu sred cing len/ /de la brten nas chags pa srid/ /de la brten nas sdug bsngal skye/ /de la brten nas rga shi 'chi/ /gsum pa skyes mched drug po ni/ /gcig gis gzugs rnams skye sgo 'byed / / cig gis sgra rnams skye sgo 'byed/ /cig gis dri rnams skye sgo 'byed/ /cig gis ro rnams skye sgo 'byed//cig gis reg rnams skye sgo 'byed/ /cig gis chos rnams skye sgo 'byed/ /rnam shes sgo rnams kun tu rgyug /gzugs la chags sdang 'byed par byed/ /sgra la chags sdang 'byed par byed/ /dri la chags sdang 'byed par byed//ro la chags sdang 'byed par byed/ /reg la chags sdang 'byed par byed/ /chos la chags sdang 'byed par byed/ /don med cig la chags sdang 'phel/ /'di ni yul mkhar stong pa 'dra/ /bdag pos bzung ba'i yul mkhar du/ /glo bur gzhan gyis 'ongs pa'i tshe/ /smad ra btang ngam gnod pa bskyal/ /de dus de yi bdag po zhig /e ma nga yi yul mkhar la/ /don med gnod pa ci la skyel/ /btang bas chog dang tshad pas chog /glo bur ba de 'di snyam du / / yul mkhar 'di yi bdag re bzang / /de nas bdag po dgras bsad tshe/ /meng nas skyur kyang mkhar mi rtog / de bzhin skye mched drug sgo nas/ /nga bdag srog can yod pa'i tshe/ /gang gis 'bar ram mtshon rgyab tshe/ /e ma nga dang nga la zhes/ /gzhi med bdag 'dzin che che skad/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis bsad pa'i tshe/ /sgo drug rmang nas skyur gyur kyang / /nga 'o snyam du su zhig rtog /dmu rgod rtsa ba bdag 'dzin bral/ /'di ni dpe dang dpe ru bkod / / dbang po lnga po yul phrad tshe/ /reg pa nyid du tha snyad 'dogs/ /de ni 'o dang 'dra zhes gda'/ /reg la brten nas tshor ba 'byung / /de las len pa'i srid pa skye/ /mi bde 'dor 'dod sred pa skye/ /dper na mig la mda' rgyab (brgyab3 tshe/ /mi tshor mi srid de dang 'dra/ /srid pa chang 'thung ji bzhin du/ /phugs ngan zhim pa nyid du rtog /zhim par 'khrul nas yang yang len/ /dper na shing thog nyab (rnyabaka'adra ba/ /snga ma'i ro tshor phyi ma len/ /blangs pas chags shing sred pa yin/ /'phyon mas 'dod pa blangs pa yi/ khong du bu zhugs srid pa bzhin / / de nas dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal bu nyid skye ba bzhin/ /de la brten nas rgas pa ste/ /de la brten nas 'chi ba 'byung / /bde dang rgyab log ro khur bzhin/ /ñdzu rje mtha' med 'khor ba 'dir/ /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab thar med par/ /yang dang yang 'khor bying ba rnams/ /mkhas pa'i tshig gis ma go bas/ /blun po'i rna bar blug 'dra ba'i/ /gyod dal tshig 'dra 'di smras kyang / /mkhas pas mi shes skyon mi brjod/ /dper na bu chung g.yang 'gro la/ /rdzun med tshig gis mi bzlog pas/ /cang med lag na a lu zhes/ /mkhas pas thabs kyis 'dren dang mtshungs/ /'di ni nyon mongs 'khor ba'i chos/ /'di ni mkhas pas spang bya yin/ /rten 'brel tshoms te bdun pa'o/ /

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /hrīyī dzñā na gu ru rje/ /skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa gang / /ji ltar spyad de thar bar 'gro/ /ji ltar gnas lugs don la lta/ /sbrul pa'i zhal nas sprul pa 'di/ /grag stong gsal ba'i yig 'brus brgyan/ /nga ni sprul pa'i dge slong yin/ /nga la bden par ma 'dzin par/ /nga yi gdams pa nyams su long / /snang stong zung du 'brel bar mdzod/ /nga ni sgyu ma'i dge slong yin/ /nga la bzang por ma zhen par / /nga yi gdams pa nyams su long / / snang dang stong pa zung du sbrel/ /nga ni chu zla'i dge slong yin/ /snang snang 'dra yang bden pas stong / /stong pa yin te gzugs su shar/ /gzugs su snang ste stong pa nyid/ /'di las gzhan pa'i stong pa med/ /stong las gzhan pa'i gzugs med pas/ /gzugs 'dra gzugs la ma rlom par/ ṭwāṃ/gzugs kyi rang bzhin nyams su long / / zle rje shel gyi khye'u khyed/ /nyes skyon dri mas stong pa bzhin/ /nga ni 'od kyi dge slong yin/ /snang snang 'dra ste gzung du med/ /gzung med 'dzin par ma byed par/ /gnyis med rang grol lhug par zhog /gzhag bya bral na zle rje yin/ /bltar med blta na rin chen yin/ /gnyis med shes na dbu ma yin/ /shes pas stong na gnas lugs yin/ /nga ni nyi ma'i 'od zer yin/ /rnam rtog med de gzugs can gsal/ /gsal ba nyid de bzung bya bral/ /garnga/la stong spros bral rang dwangs pa/ /'dzin pa can gang nyi mar 'khrul/ /'khrul ba bya ba bden med yin/ /bden med stong pa'i tha snyad yin/ /stong pa shes na 'dzin pa 'jig /gzung 'dzin ga'is med blo las 'das/ /blo 'das bya ba chos dbyings yin/ /gzigs dang zlo rje bltar med la/ /bltar med shes na lta ba 'jig / 'jig med shes na dbu ma yin/ /dbu ma'i ngang du bzhag na zab/ /de yang bdag gi gdams pa yin/khug sna sprin dang 'od 'phro ba'i/ /snang stong dge slong dī paṃ nga / /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin thugs la 'khrungs/ /nga la dngos por ma zhen par/ /rnam dag khrims kyi cha lugs can/ /gzhan don spyod pas ma nyams pa'i/ /phan bde'i spyod pa rten 'brel zab/ /de 'dra'i spyod pa nyams su long / /zag med dge ba'i dge slong nga / /rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma skyed pa'i/ /dngos dang mtshan ma'i nad zhi ba/ /bde ba chen po lhun grub pa/ /byang chub spyod pas lam bgrod cing / /pha mar bcas te thar bar 'gro/ /nga la mtshan mar ma 'dzin par/ /nga yi gdams pa nyams su long / /stong dang snying rje zung du brel /ka 58 na1 sbrel/ / /'di ltar dpag med rab ston kyang / /ji ltar brag ri'i khrod dag tu/ /gang gis snyan pa'i glu blangs tshe/ /grag stong rjes su 'brang ba bzhin/ /nga yi tshig kyang grag stong yin/ /de la mtshan mar ma 'dzin par/ /de dang de yi gdams pa long / /grag stong chos kyi dbyings su khyer/ /nga ni mtshungs med gzugs 'dra yang / /gzugs kyi gnas lugs stong pa yin/ /stong la mtshungs pa'i dpe ma mchis/ /dpe med dbyings su nyams su long / /dri mas ma gos ñdzu rje nyon/ /mnyan bya bral —73—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/te tha snyad yin/ /lang tsho gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /mthun pa'i grogs dang nyams dga' rtse/ /mdzes dang mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /thams cad cig la cig chags kyang / /chags dang chags yul de 'dra ba/ /sad tshe'i yul la'ang de bzhin spyod/ /ji ltar mdo las 'di skad du/ /bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho byung zhing shi mthong nas/ /byung dga' shi na mi dga' ba/ /de bzhin chos rnams shes par mdzod/ /da dung sgra snyan gsan du gsol / / me long dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sgeg mos byad bzhin rab 'char bas/ /ji ltar rang bzhin med gyur kyang / /mthong ba'i dbang gis chags pa bzhin/ /nga nyid dag pa'i snang ba la/ /med kyang gzugs su rab shar bas/ /snang ba lta bur chos ston kyang / /bden pa med par nyams su long / /de skad du yang gsung rab las / / me long shin tu yongs da/ga la/ /ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi/ /gzugs brnyan snang ba de bzhin du/ /chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis/ /de bzhin bdag kyang de 'dra bas/ /bdag gi chos kyang de nyid las/ /ma 'das rdzun pa'i snang ba yin/ /de ni snang stong zung 'jug pa'i/ /gdams pa'i tshoms te dang po'o/ /slar yang padma'i lte ba la/ /shel gyi paṃ dkar 'od gsal ba'i/ /pad dkar 'dab ma bcu bar gyur/ /de yi steng na sne dkar cig /shel dang mu tig dkar po dang / /dwangs pa'i dngul dang zhu ba'i gser/ /rgyal dang 'byung dang gnas pa yi/ /'bru yi rnam par rab tu spungs/ /de las 'od dkar rab 'phros pas/ /'od rnams cig la cig 'thabs te/ /rtsa ba nyid nas rgya bskyed de/ /phyogs bcur 'dom gang rab 'phro zhing / /zlum po rtse mor 'dus gyur pas/ /nor bu rin chen gzugs 'dra ba/ /yig 'bru'i dkyil nas 'od zer cig /gser mdog 'dra ba thad kar 'phros/ /nor bu'i rtse mor kha gsum gyes/ /tog dang khyung mgo'i rnam pa 'dra/ /rin chen yig 'bru'i gseb shed na/ /hrīḥdakar zla zhun lta bu cig /byung ma thag tu khye'ur gyur/ /de yi lus las me shel gyis / / rwa cig 'od zer 'dra bar byas/ /de las sngon po'i 'od 'phro zhing / /byang shar nye bar 'phros te song / /de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /me shel khye'u dwangs pa cig /chu shel cig las chu drangs nas/ /gzhal yas nang du rab drangs te/ khye'u dwangs ma 'di lta ste/ /rgyal ba'i dben gnas rwa zhes par/ /chu 'dzom kho bos me skyel phyin//de nas chu mig ring mo las/ /zhi bde'i chu rgyun 'di drangs pas/ /gang du 'phros kyang bde 'gyur mchi/ /re zhig lon nas dwangs pa yi/ /chu yi rgyun 'dra dpag med pa/ /steng 'og phyogs bcu ma lus par/ /rta rnga sbom po tsam gyi rgyun / / bsam gyis mi khyab mdzes par song / /gtso bo'i khye'u dkar po de/ lken tu mnyes par 'dzum mdzad nas / / nga yi chu mig ring mo las/ /phan/ bde'i 'byung gnas dpag med 'phros/ /steng 'og phyogs bcu khyab par gyur/ /dag pa'i zhing khams dga' ldan sogs/ /zhing khams gtsang ma ma lus khyab/ /nga yi rnam thar shel —74—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /'dra ba / / gtsang ma mthar phyin der 'gro 'tshal/ /rkang pa gcig pa'i 'od cig snyel/ /'od gnyis kha khar 'gro byed cing / /dbus khams chu mig bsil 'gyur te/ /dam pa bzang dang bzang po 'phel/ /chu phul gang cam nub phyogs su'ang / /lce ldan gang zhig rab brjod pa/ /dri ma med cing bde bar gnas/ /rnam par thar ba gtsang ma 'di / / me tog 'dab 'drar rgyas gyur te/ /shar nub lho byang kun tu yang / /rab rgyas thub pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /gnas tshe gnas kyi nub nye yang / khres rab rma med byang chub dang / /chos dang brtson 'grus rgyal ba dang / /bzang po bzang ldan dam pa yis/ /gsal byed 'gro la bde ba ster/ /nub la nub nye nub byang du/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub byang gnas/ /las kyi sprin gyis g.yogs srid na/ /de nas gang gis gsal bar 'gyur/ /gsal la sgrib med dga' ldan nyid/ /hrīḥde'ang thor bu thor bu nyid/ /mkhas pas dpyad na rgyun chad med/ /de nas nor bu'i gzugs 'dra ba/ /shel gyi mchod rten gzugs 'dra ba/ /bang rim lnga ldan dwangs pa zhig /lham me lhan ne lhang nger gyur/ /de las 'od zer shar nub tu/ /'od kyis gseb nas dge slong zhig /nga yi bstan pa lham mer gsal/ /nga yi bstan pa sgrib pa med/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /dam chos nub par ga la 'gyur / / gal te gzhan snang ma dag pas/ /'phel 'grib 'byung ba ltar mthong yang / /shar ni zla ba'i dkyi' 'khor mdzes/ /zhun ma'i khye'u sprul pa 'gyed/ /'jig rten thams cad gsal byed cing / /snyesna dang bcas pa gsal bar byed/ /bstan pa nub la nye ba'i tshe/ /nyi ma/'i dkyil 'khor nub na gnas/ /de la'ang bsod nams mchog gi mtshan/ /lnga yis dngos sam brgyud pa bzung / /dkyil 'khor sgrib par mi nus par/ /dam pa'i zhing khams rab gsal zhing / /dngos sam brgyud pas gsal byed la/ /dkyil 'khor 'grib pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /'on kyang sprin gyis g.yogs ltar snang / /'od nyid dga' ldan gnas gyur tshe/ /e ma 'jig rten ji ltar gsal//byang chub spyod pa'i grogs ldan dang / /bsam/ gtan ting 'dzin mi g.yo ba/ /nga yi rnam thar khrims brgyan te/ /don mchog bde btanags lam mchod pa'i/ /bsod nams mchog rges me gsos te/ /lnga ldan bzang pos mi nub skyong / /bstan pa gsal mdzad gcig pu nyid/ /bdag gi chu rgyun ring mo las/ /'phros te de yang gsal bar gyur/ /hrīḥde yang grag stong chen po yin/ /thor bu'i tshoms te gnyis pa'o/ /slar yang lham mer rab mdzes pa'i/ /zla ba zhun ma'i khye'u yis/ /gsal dag snyan par 'di skad zhu/ /nyes skyon dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /ye shes sprul pa'i dge slong gson/ /'di ltar snang yul srid pa yi/ /chos la snang ba gomasapa yis/ /snang ba bkag kyang mi khegs pas/ /'di la nyams len ji ltar bya/ /thams cad ma/ 'dres so sor gsal/ /rang gi mtshan nyid du mas brgyan/ /dbyibs dang kha dog du ma bkod/ /yod yod 'dra 'di ji ltar —75—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsgom / / de nas sprul pa'i dge slong gis/ /gsal la ma 'dres so sor phye/ /bka' gdams mdzes pa'i khye'u khyod / / ya mtshan snang ba'i gzugs 'di ltos/ /'di ltar gsungs nas shel dkar gyi/ /me long gsal ba sne la bstan/ /sne gyis sku gzugs de shar gzigs/ /zlo rje 'di ltar nyams su long / /shel gyi nang na shel lus gda' / / yan lag rgyas shing skyon med pa/ /ma 'dres phyed par sna mig bcas/ /lham me lhan ner 'dzum chags pa / / phyag rgya mdzad na phyag rgya ste/ /g.yo na g.yo nyid bzhengs na yang / /bzhengs shing de bzhin bzhugs na yang / / bzhugs shing skyil krung bcas na yang / /skyil krung phyed skyil byas na yang / /phyed skyil pus mo btsugs na yang / /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar na yang / /thal sbyar phyag stong bkram na yang / /phyag stong spyan stong bstan na yang / / spyan stong lus kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rten 'brel tshul gyis lham mer gsal/ /med na mi 'byung rten 'brel te/ /yod na ltos phyir yod nyid na/ /ltos pa ci dgos med nyid na/ /gang la gang ltos de ltar snang / /snang ba gzugs kyi rnam par snang / /snang ba med min 'di ltar snang / /snang ba bden min 'dra ba tsam/ /'dra ba dngos min ngo bos stong / /stong pa nyid de gzugs su shar/ /shar ba nyid gang stong pa yang / /stong pa nyid las gzugs ma mchis/ /mchis pa med las mchis mthong na/ /mthong ba po de 'khrul bas 'khrul/ /'khrul ba gzhi med sgro btags yin/ /yin min mtshan mar su zhig 'dzin/ /'dzin na 'dzin pa nyid gang 'khrul/ /'khrul bas gang zhig bden pa mthong / /mthong ba med na mthong byed bral/ /bral ba shes na 'bras bu yin/ /'bras bu rang grol lhug par zhog /zhog ces tha dad cig pas stong / /stong la gzhag bya 'jog byed med/ /med kyang snang ba'i chos rnamaso la/ /snang ba'i nyams len dang po mdzod/ /stong kyang snang ba ltar snang ba'i/ /snang ba'i tshoms te gsum pa'/ /ñdzu rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'od gsal dag pa'i rmi lam na/ khrel gyi mtsho la 'khor lo stong / /'khor lo re la gzhal yas stong / /gzhal yas re la sprul pa stong / /sprul pa re la'ang sprul pa stong / /phan tshun chos kyi bgro ba mdzad/ /'di ltar thams cad gzugasabarnyan te/ /gzugs brnyan legs par dpyad byas na/ /dpyod pa po yang zhig par 'gyur/ /'gyur med chos kyi gnas lugs yin/ /gnas lugs spros dang bral na yang / / spros bral nam mkha' 'dra ba la/ /nam mkha' nyid las sprin 'dus te/ /sprin ni kha dog dpag med gsal / / gsal stong 'khor lo phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /'gyed bzhin nam mkha'i ngo bo ste/ /mkha' las byung zhing mkha' la yal/ /yal yul sprin tshogs mang na yang / /mang ba'i phyir na bden mi gda'/ /bden med phyir na kun tu rgyu/ /rgyu ba de yi mi rtag ston/ /mi rtag ngo bo stong pa yang / /stong pa goms rnams mi rtag ces/ /mi rtag —76—

pha chos te shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs se/ /chad pa nyid du 'khrul/ /'khrul par shes pa'i skyes bu nga / /nga med dbyings su cir yang snang / /snang stong zhus lan bzhi tshoms so/ /slar yang rnam dag khye'u yis/ /sprul pa'i rje la 'di skad zhus/ /skyes bu gang gi rmi lam na/ /skyed mos tshal dang ljon pa dang / /nags tshal kun ra khyad 'phags dang / /spang ljongs rne gsing bkra ba dang / /bya dang bung ba lding ba dang / /dga' ba'i glu len snyan pa dang / /sman dang spang spos ngad ldang dang / /nyi zla rgyu skar mar me gsal / / ro brgya'i zhal zas phun tshogs dang / khrims ldan stong phrag gsung rab sgrog /bde gshegs mang po mkha' la bzhugs/ /mchod dang mchod yul bsam mi khyab/ /shel gyi khye'u stong phrag kyang / /skyed mos tshal rab mdzes pa na/ /rta dang glang po ma he'i tshogs/ /bde bar bag phebs bskyod byed cing/ /'dod 'jo gzhon pa (bzhonaka la sogs pa'i/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rab mchod pa na/ khyad gzhi ye stong khyad chos snang/ snang la mi shes bzang por zhen/ /skyabs yul stong pa skyabs su 'khrul/ /smra brjod bral la kha thon byed/ /'gro dang 'ong ba med na yang / /bya dang bung ba lding lding rgyug /glang po rgyug cing rta rnga /ka 60 ba5 yang/rgyug /ma he bgrod cing 'dod 'jo 'gro/ /sna tshogs nyams dga' snang ba gsal/ /spang dang blang bya med na yang / /mi dge spong zhing dge ba sgrub/ /nyes dmigs
