ston cing phan yon 'chad/ /de tshe gang gis med byas kyang / /zhabrul ba can gyi blor mi shong / /'di ltar sna tshogs kun bden yang / khyod ni skur 'debs log par bsgom/ /ji ltar rmi lam sad dus tshe/ /wal le khyug ge yid la gda'/ /gda' ste mdang gi snang ba la/ tages nas zhen pa rang sar 'gag /mdang tshe skyes bu cig na re/ /'khrul bar ma byed med zer na/ /skur ba btab ces bzlog ste btab/ /ding sang gnasalugs kun ston pa'i/ /bla ma mdang gi skyes bu 'dra/ /ding sang shes bya kun snang ba'i/ /dngos po mdang gi shesabya 'dra/ /ding sang gzung 'dzin kun spyod pa'i/ /yul dang yul can du ma yang / /mdang gi skabs dang ci ma khyad/ /da gzod rmi lam nyid 'dra bar/ /chos rnams thams cad shes par bya/ /sprul pa'i dge slong 'di skad gasdang / / mkhas pa chen po nga la gson/ /chos rnams thams cad rmi lam 'dra/ /rmi lam thams cad 'khrul snang yin/ /'khrul snang rang gi rnam shes te/ /rnam par shes pas kun tu bkod/ /'god pa po yi ngo bos stong / /mkhas pas rmi lam dper mi len/ /rmi lam yul gyi bzang ngan rnams/ /rmi lam blo la bden par snang/ /rmi lam bden pas stong na yang / /'khrul shes rkyen de bden pa zhabrul/ /de bzhin 'di yul ma lus par/ /bden pas stong yang der 'dzin blo/ /bden pa nyid du mngon par 'khrul/ /mkhas pas rmi lam dper len pa/ /ji ltar sad dusashesapa la/ /rmi lam yul gyi bzang ngan rnams/ /yid la wal le snang gyur kyang / /de la brten nas —77—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di snyam du/ /mdang yul ci yang ma grub la/ /don med kho bos ci yang bzung / /da dung rnam pa wal le gda'/ /de nas mkhas pa 'di snyam du/ /chos rnams thams cad 'di dang 'dra/ /gtad med cig la gtad par bzung / /bden med cig la bden par bzung / /dngos med cig la dngos por bzung / /mtshan med cig la mtshan mar bzung / / spros med cig la spros par bzung / /bzung med cig la bzung byar bzung / /'dzin med cig la 'dzin par bzung / /gzung 'dzin gnyis med gnyis su bzung / /rnam rtog 'di yis ci yang shes/ /gzhi med mtshan nyid du ma 'god/ /da ni sna tshogs snang gyur kyang / /ci yang med kyis cir ma 'dzin/ /des na bde sdug la sogs pa/ /rnam rtog ci tsam 'dus gyur kyang / /snang ba tsam zhig kho nar zad/ /bden pa srid pa tsam yang stor//snang ba de bzhin nyid du sbyong / /sne rje bka' gdams rin chen gter/ /pho brang dbyings su de la gzigs/ /rnyed med rnyed na bka' gdams yin/ /snang ba'i las 'bras mi slu ba'i/ /snang tsam 'brel bas bka' gdams yin / / snang ba'i tshoms te lnga ba'o/ /padma dkar pos 'di skad gsung / /sgrib pa'i sprin gyis ma g.yogs pa'i/ /nam mkha' dri med nga la gson//za hor chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ /chos rgyal bde gshegs sgrol ma yi/ /rgyal tshab bzang po skyong mjad pa'i/ /lha cig dam pa gsan du gsol/ /gnas lugs gang la sgrib byed pa'i/ khrigs sgrib gang de bsal du gsol/ /snang med goms pa'i 'phags pa yis/ /snang med ngang du ji ltar bzhag /phyi rol yul la mi 'phro zhing / /rang gi sems la'ang mi rtog pa/ /gnyis med snang bar bsgom lags sam/ /'gag pa mi mnga' skye bas stong / /chad pa mi mnga' rtag mtha' bral/ /'gro 'ong re dogs mtha' yis dag /gcig dang tha dad rnam bral ba'i/ /rang grol nyid du 'jog lags sam/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal mchog /mun pa ltar snang bsal du gsol/ /gnas lugs chos de bstan du gsol/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'di skad gsung / /lus dang dri bral lhan skyes pa'i / / shel gyi khye'u nga la gson/ /rnam rtog gzhi med spros bral yin/ /spros bral dbyings su gang gnas pa'i / / chos kyi dbyings de snang med yin/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma skyed pa'i/ /'dus ma byas kyang rang grol ba/ /rang grol rang grol chen po ste/ /snang med yin no nam mkha'i bu/ /ye nas ma skyes 'od gsal ba/ /skye med gsal stong lhun grub de/ /ngo bo ma yin blo las 'das/ /snang med yin no dri med bu/ /gnas med nam mkha'i pad 'dra ba/ /dbyibs dang kha dog ye stong pa'i/ /snang med dbu ma chen po'i dbyings/ /snang med yin no 'od gsal bu/ /gang nas gang du 'gag bral ba/ /nam mkha'i me tog sad khyer de/ /gang gi blo la 'das gyur pas//snang med yin no chos kyi sku/ /dus gsum rang rang ye stong nga/'i/ /bong rwa ring thung mnyam gsum ste/ /ye shes —78—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u ni shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /yul na'ang mi snang bas/ /snang med yin te gsal stong sku/ /kun gzhi dus gsum ye stong pas/ /sgro skur gnyis kyi yul ma yin/ /bzang dang ngan las 'das gyur pa'i/ /don de snang med yin no bu/ /'phags pas spel bar mi nus shing / /byis pas 'brid par mi nus pas/ /bri gang med pa'i gnas lugs de/ /snang med yin no rnam dag sku/ /smra med bsam las 'das yi/ /ngo bo nyid kyi chos nyid gang / /glo bur ye dang bral ba de/ /snang med yin no ye shes sku/ /steng mtha' med cing phyogs mtha' med/ /dbus mtha' med cing kun la khyab/ /zab mo'i dbyings de blo las 'das/ /snang med yin no snang stong bu/ /gcig dang du mas stong pa yi/ /snang snang 'dra la srog med pa/ /dpyad na 'jig pa'i rang lugs de/ /snang med yin no rig pa can/ /blang dang spang bya kun snang yang / / dpyad na rang tshugs mi thub pa'i/ /go ma chod kyi rang lugs de/ /snang med yin no rig pa can/ /cig la cig brten ltar snang yang / /dpyad na ltos tshugs mi thub par/ /zog ma'i rang tshugs zhig pa de/ /snang med yin no rig pa can/ /skyes khungs gnas pa 'dir 'gro ba'i/ /rtsa ba dpyad na rang 'jig pa/ /dpyad na phung pa'i rang lugs de/ /snang med yin no rig pa can/ /yod med 'grig 'grig ltar ston yang / /skye ba dpyad na 'bras stor ba'i/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang lugs de/ /snang med yin no rig pa can/ /sa dang spyad ldan gzeg gzeg can/ /rang nyid dpyad na rang tshugs 'jig /tshugs med gzhan la 'phya 'dra ba/ khyod rang 'jig pa ngo re tsha / / ngo tshas 'jig na nyug thag chad/ /gab pa'i khungs kyang ma rnyed pa'i/ khungs med rnyed pa'i stong pa de/ /snang med yin no snang med bu/ /snang med nyid la bu cig a/ /rtsa ba med pa'i yal ga a/ /yal ga med pa'i me/ tog a / / me tog med pa'i ze'u 'bru a/ /ze'u 'bru med pa'i bzhugs mkhan a/ /bzhugs mkhan med pa'i /byeo'u a / khye'u med pa'i khyad chos a/ /a a skye med nyid du 'thad / /'thad pa snang med dbyings su yal/ /tha snyad tsam du snang med bstan/ /shes sam ñtsā rje sgrol ma bsgoms (sgoms3 / /snang med tshoms te drug pa'o/ /slar yang bka' gdams ñdzu rje yis/ /dri ma med la 'di skad/ zhus/ /snang dang snang med bsgom pa yis /'bras bu byang chub thob 'gyur ram/ /dri med zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /zab mo rgyud kyi lung yod nyon/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sems 'di yis/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms byas nas/ /sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgya'o / / gsung ste snang tsam bsgom pa'i lung / /da dung rghaṃ rje nga la nyon/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems 'di yis/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas pas/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsung de ni snang med lung / /gzhan yang snang med lung yod nyon/ /gzugs med mthong ba po ya/nga med/ /sgra med thos pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/ /ro med myong ba po yang med/ /lus med reg pa po yang —79

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/med / / yid med yid las byung ba'ang med/ /de yang snang ba med pa'i lung / /da dung snang ba'i lung yod nyon/ /gzugs ni dbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /tshor ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ /'du shes smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /'du byed rnams ni chu shing bzhin/ /rnam shes sgyu ma 'dra zhes gsung / /de lta sna tshogs kun snang yang / /stong pa nyid du goms par mdzod / / ji ltar stong pa'i gnas lugs kyang / /snang ba nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /des na snang stong 'dres mar bsgoms (sgoms) / /rnam dag khye'u sprul pa'i sku/ /snang stong 'dres pa'i lung yod nyon/ /kun rdzob gang yin don dam la/ /don dam gang yin kun rdzob ste/ /kun rdzob las ni logs shig na/ /don dam nye bar mi dmigs gsung / / des na kun rdzob snang ba la/ /dge dang sdig pa kun snang zhing / /'bras bu bde dang sdug bsngal snang //de phyir skye 'chi'i phreng ba byung / /de yang rgyu med ma yin pas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu ltar snang yang / /dpyad na 'jig pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /rgyu rkyen 'dus pa'i zog ma la/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis 'jig sla zhing / /skyabs gnas lhas kyang rkyen rnams skyob/ /de bas snang med goms gyis la/ /'chi bdag bdud kyis sbyar ba yi/ /'dod pa'i 'dam la blo snang brdzes/ /rtag 'dzin ma che thun bzhir bsgoms (sgomasaka / /mi rtag snang med spel mar gyis//de nas rang bzhin dag pa yi/ /padmo sku mchog rnam dag des/ /ljags kyi padma rab bkram nas/ /rje yi drung du 'di skad zhus/ /skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ /snang ba'i skur ston sprul pa'i sku/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin longs sku nyid / / padma bdag gi spyi bor bzhugs/ /zung du 'brel dang snang stong pa'i/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs legs gsungs nas/ /mjug sdud snang stong dbye ba med/ /snang ba thams cad rten 'brel gsung / /rten 'brel rgyu rkyen 'dus pa ste/ /de la skye 'chi'i phreng ba 'byung / /rgyu dang 'bras bu mi slu bas/ /rten 'brel gsob dang /ka 63na 4 ste/'chi bdag gis/ /'jig par sla zhes bkas gnang nas/ /'jig pa can gyi lus 'di yi/ /rgyu gang 'chi tshe ji ltar bya/ /spang bya gang zhig blang bya ci/ /'jigs pa'i skyabs gnas su zhig yin/ /man ngag gang yin bstan du gsol/ /dri med zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /sras kyi snying po nga la gson/ /'byung bzhis skyed pa'i lus ngan la/ /rnam shes thogs med rig pas brten/ /las kyi dbang gis phan tshun 'brel/ /btsan sa ma zin 'bral bar sla/ /mi mthun sdongs pas nad rigs mang / /bag chags dbang gis sdug bsngal 'phel/ /kun la 'byung ba'i rngams po che/ /'chi bar ming btags long med du/ /bzlog rgyu med pa thog ltar 'bebs/ /de ni spyi tsam bstan par zad/ /da ni yan lag 'dus pa yi/ /mgo dang rkang mthil yan chad kyi/ /tshogs pa 'di la lus zhes bya/ /mgo dang rkang pa lag pa dang / /nying lag pags pa nang khrol dang / /mig rna la sogs dbang po dang / khrag dang chu ser la sogs pa'i/ /mi gtsang rdzas dang srin bu'i rigs/ /brgyad khrir bcas rnams —80—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gye dnges ga'i rnor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ bzhugs so/ /'dus pa yi/ /sra ba'i cha rnams sa yis bskyed/ /brlan pa'i cha rnams chu yis bskyed/ /drod kyi cha rnams me yis bskyed / / g.yo ba'i cha rnams rlung gis bskyed/ /bye brag rlung mkhris bad kan dang / /'dus pa'i nad kyis gdungs pa'i lus/ /bshang gci la sogs mi gtsang yang / /'chi bdag bdud kyis za bar byed/ /mi rtag chen po mi 'dod kyang / /rang dbang rang la med gyur pas/ /thog tu bab tshe 'gro dgos 'byung / /phye na dpag tu med par 'gyes/ /brtags na stong pa'i ngo bo na'ang / /snang stong 'jig pa'i chos can las/ /nam zhig tshe zad gyur pa'i tshe/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas phyogs mtha' bskor/ /dbugs len gshed ma nyams dga' byed/ /'chi bdag chen pos gnya' nas mnan/ /ci zos dang gar mi 'ong zhing / /stobs med lus chugs mal du zhig /nye bar 'dod pa ngu zhing skyor/ /las ngan la la bon rtsis byed/ /bzang bzang gsung sgrogs gtor ma gtong / /la la rab tu sngangs gyur te/ /las su sman pa tshol zhes rgyug /la la phyogs nas bskor te ngu / /e ma mi 'chi e srid na / / gyod che zer zhing 'bug shub byed/ /sman pa la la rtsa blta zhing / /shab sheb (shibasakami 'dug rnam 'gyur byed/ /nyi ltar 'chos pa nga re zhes/ /ngus tshe nad pa lhag par ngu / /'chi bar 'dug snyam zug rngu ldang / /de tshe sdug bsngal chen po'i klong / /ci byas phan par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gtugs te thug pa'i dus shig 'ong / /nyon dang de la 'di lta ste/ /skyes pa'i dus na gzhibs te skyes/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre gnyis/ /rang dang rang gi bla gnyis so/ /lha des mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub/ /'gal rkyen thams cad spong bar byed/ /dge ba kun la bskul ma 'debs/ /dge ba gang byas yi ger 'god/ /sdig gam/ sdug na mya ngan byed/ /dge ba'am skyid na dga' ba bsgom/ /'dres ni de las bzlog (ldog3 par byed/ /ji srid dge ba stobs che zhing / /tshe yi 'phen pa ma zad par/ /dge ba gang dang gang byas kyang / /dmigs su 'gro ba 'di lta ste/ /dkon mchog spyi la mchod pa dang / / dge 'dun dag la bsnyen bkur zhing / /chos skyong 'byung por bcas pa la/ /gtor ma gtong zhing phongs pa la/ /sbyin pas tshim par byed pa sogs/ /gang dag yul du byas gyur nas/ /dge ba'i las la 'jug pa dang //rang gi bsgom dang kha thon dang / /dge ba ci dang ci byas tshe/ /lha yi lha la sgrog byed cing / /lha yis rim gro byed par 'gyur/ /de tshe lha ni 'di skad du/ /'bras bu rgyu yi rjes su 'brang / /mi 'dis dge ba'i bya ba spyad/ /'bras bu bde skyid rnyed rigs kyi/ /sdug bsngal don med 'dre phyir khyed/ /bdag cag lha yis bskyab bya yin/ /de nas 'dre tshogs sdug bsngal gyur/ /bar chod bya bar ga la nus/ /mi de nad med phun sum tshogs/ /dad dang 'byor bas brgyan par gyur/ /rang gzhan thams cad smon pa'i gnas/ /de nas bdud sde 'di lta ste/ /e ma bdag gis yul las 'das/ /'dis ni rang gzhan don gnyis phyug /bar chad lcogs tshad stong par byed/ /zhe sdang —81 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/can la zhe sdang gtong / /'dod chags can la 'dod chags sogs/ /gzhan la sdang 'i/nga rang la chags/ /sdig pa'i las la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /lhan skyes 'dre ni 'di skad du/ /'bras bu rgyu yi rjes su 'brang / /sdig pa sdug rigs lha phyir khyed/ /de nas lha de stobs chung ste/ /bla de 'dre yis 'khyer bar byed/ /de nas mig sogs dbang po dang / /lus kyi stod smad gang khyab tshe/ /na tsha chen po myong bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i tshogs kyang yi ger 'debs / / sdig pa 'phel na tshe bsring zhing / /slar yang sdig pa nyid la 'god/ /de tshe lha nyid 'di snyam du/ /e ma 'di ni sdug bsngal zhes/ /thabs kyis chos la sbyar ba yis/ /nad pa nad bdag 'di skad du/ /rim gro gyis zer dge las sam/ /mchod pa la sogs byas pa'i tshe/ /gong bzhin bla de lha yis 'dzin/ /de nas bla de legs par skyob/ /gang na na nas legs par gso/ /gong bzhin 'dre de phyir la skrod/ /e ma de nas 'di lta ste/ /mthun rkyen lha yis skyob byed cing / /'gal rkyen 'dre dang bral gyur nas/ /nad pa de nyid 'grag ('gragasakapar 'gyur/ /de tshe thams cad 'di skad du/ /rim 'gro byas pas bzlog go zer/ /de ni sngon gyi rgyu dang ni / / da lta'i rkyen bzang 'phrad pa yis/ /dge ba gang byas dmigs su 'gro/ /de las bzlog (ldogakan 'dre nyid rgyal//dge rtsa sna re tsam byas shing / /rim gro bag re byas gyur kyang / /sngon gyi las ngan tshabs che zhing / /de yi dbang gis sdig la spyod/ /'dre yi rkyen ngan bar chad pas/ /rim gro sna res ma bzlog par/ /'dre rnams lha la snying tshim bgrang / /lha ni mi dga' mchi ma 'don/ /bla de 'dre yi lag tu shor/ /a tsa ma na 'chi'o snyam/ /blo sna btung (stung kadus mi btung (stung 3par / /cung zad blo sna bsrings gyur nas/ /sems la gros 'debs byed pa'i tshe / / da gzod bdag gis go ma chod/ /'chi ba bya ba byung ba yin/ /bsags pa'i nor rnamasadon med 'gyur/ /chos la nyams len byas pa med/ /mar gyi gseb nas spu thon bzhin/ /nor dang longs spyod nye 'brel dang /grogs kyi gseb nas thon gyur nas/ /rang nyid gcig pur 'gro ba 'bab/ kho bo shi nas ji ltar bya/ /a tsa ma zhes 'gre ldog byed/ /rngam pa kha ru mi shong zhing / /go ma chod la 'gyod pa'i tshe/ lken tu 'phyis pa'i skabs su gda' / / de tshe stong pa su zhig yod/ /pha yis stong ngam ma yis stong / /bu yi stong ngam bu mosastong / /nor gyis stong ngam dbang gis stong / /gab pas thub bam bros pas thar/ /'thab pas thub bam bcings pabataphan/ /mtshar mo'i byad kyis bslus samed/ /lang tsho'i gzugs kyis thub pa med/ /mdzangs ma'i zas kyis mi bslus pa'i / / bzlog thabs med pa'i skabs shig 'ong / /go ma chod pa 'gyod de 'phyis/ /phyi bshol dus la bab ste 'phyis / / nye 'brel mang pos mtha' bskor zhing / khyod la 'chi ba'i skabs med ces/ /ngu brang sdug bsngal byas gyur kyang / /'chi ba bslus pa su zhig yod/ /nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab/ /de yang 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis —82

rgya phachosanyishurtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos ga'e 'er bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsurme pa bzhugs so/ /lan / / ngang ring rtag 'dzin brdzes na phan/ /snang med dbyings su bros na phan/ /'chi lugs ji ltar byung chul te / / tshoms su byas na bdun pa'o/ /da dung zlo rje nga la nyon/ /nga ni 'byung bzhi 'gyes pa'i tshul/ /de la dang po sa 'gro ste/ /lus 'di sa la bying ba snyam/ /gos la sogs pas mnan pa snyam/ /shes pa 'thib cing bying bar 'gyur/ /rtsa na yod la 'di skad du/kho bo yar la theg ces zer/ /'chi ba'i snga ltas dang ngo/ yin/ /zlo rje bag chags bzang po 'tshal/ /ngu cor mang po byar mi rung / kha chems mang po 'drir mi rung / /mi na dus su mi 'dri bar/ /gnad dus chen po'i sgang la 'dri//de las dgra che su zhig yod/ /ngan song gsum du skyur bar byed/ /de tshe nad pa dben par bzhag /g.yas phyogs phab la sna bug g.yas/ /zan la sogs pas dgag par bya/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan brjod cing //tshangs pa'i bu gar bla ma bsten/ /bla ma'i bya ba dag kyang bya/ /gzhan la byed na de nyid de/ /rang nyid dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis brgyan/ /yig 'bru gsum la sems bzung zhing / /spyi bor bla ma bzhugs byas te/ /rnams shes tshangs pa'i bu gar thon/ /de nas bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/ /gzhan yang ñdzu rje nga la nyon/ /de tshe shar nas bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ri bo tsam/ /rang gi kha dog nyid byas te/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snang bar 'ong / /de tshe bag chags bzang gyur na/ /lhar shes dga' ba skye 'gyur te/ /bag chags ngan na 'jigs skrag skye/ /rig pa brgyal nas 'gro bar byed/ /de yi rjes su chu 'gro ste/ kha skam so dreg chags 'gyur te/ /rkan skam lce yang 'khums par 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i snga ltas gnyis pa yin/ /de tshe lho nas bcom/ ldan 'das/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gong bzhin 'byung / /bag chags bzang na lhar dga' ste/ /ngan na 'jigs skrag skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'byung ba me 'gro ste/ /lus kyi drod rnams ldog byed cing / /lus kyi bkrag kyang yal bar 'gyur/ /da ni shi nas 'dug ces smra/ /'di ni 'chi ltas gsum pa yin/ /de tshe nub nas bcom ldan 'das/ /snang ba mtha' yas gong bzhin 'byung / /shes dang ma shes gong bzhin no/ /de nas 'byung ba rlung 'gro ste/ /de tshe rlung gis rig pa bteg /phyir rlung brang breng phyir 'phangs pas/ /rig pa cung zad sos pa snyam/ /labs shing gzhan la hrig hrig blta/ /rlung gi las kyis skom pa snyam/ /zas shig khyer la shog ces labs/ /blun po dur brgyags 'dod ces smra/ /la la log nas byung zhes zer/ /la la g.yo 'gul med pa'ang 'ong /de ni 'chi ltas bzhin ba yin/ /de tshe byang nas bcom ldan 'das/ /don yod grub pa gong bzhin 'byung / khres ma shes pa gong bzhin no/ /de nas drod rnams ma lus ldog /thams cad shi zhes 'gril chas byed/ /e ma dmu 'thoms long med par/ /skyel te ma shir skyel ba mang / /nyin zhag phrugs re bzhag na legs/ /phyi yi ltas —83—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ro be'i gsung chos kye skor/rnams rdzogs nas kyang / /nang dbugs rnams ni phyi ru shor/ /phyi dbugs nang du ma lon par/ /rig pa rtsa yi sbugs su 'tshangs/ /mkha' 'gro lha gnas rtsar song tshe/ /de dag kun gyi snang ba 'byung / /ma shes tshe na gong bzhin no/ /shes na dngos grub ster te dga'/ /gzhan yang rnam snang la sogs pa/ /lha yi tshogs rab du ma mthong / /ma shes na ni sdug bsngal bskyed/ /shes na dngos grub chen po nyid/ /mdor na bag chags bzang ngan gyis/ khro bo 'jig pa'i cha byad can/ /dpag tu med pa mthong na yang / /ngan pa 'di snyam a tsa ma/ /bdag la dgra bo byung ngo snyam/ /yang dag phyin ci log tu rtog /skyabs gnas dgra bo nyid du 'khrul/ /mdor na zlo rje nga la nyon/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag med mthong / /goms pa'i skyes bus shes gyur nas/ /grogs dang skyabs gnas dga' bar tshor/ /kun la skyabs 'gro gsol ba 'debs/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su 'brang / /de dag kun gyis gnas lugs ston/ /bla ma dag kyang der 'byon no/ /de tshe shes par byas gyur te/ /rnam shes rig pa thogs med pas/ /rab tu chos kyi dbyings su 'pho/ /'bring ni bla ma'i thugs kar 'pho/ /tha mar yi dam thugs kar 'pho / / gtan gyi btsan sa gzung zhing zhu/ /de tshe 'di dus gang goms pa'i/ /bag chags dngos su sad par 'gyur / / sne rje bdag gis bya btang ngo / /nges par 'ong ngo kun la ston/ /byung tshe nges par dran par gyis/ /shes na'ang ngan song skye mi srid/ /rgyus med rnams ni 'khrul te 'phung / /'pho ba gzhan la 'debs pa'i tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mchod pa phul/ /yan lag bdun pa'ang rgyasapar gyis/ /'pho ba thebs par gsol ba thob/ /de nas 'byung ba'i'i dus/ dus su/ /mgo nas kho yi ming bos la/ khyod las dga' ba su yang med/ /da ni yi dam zhal mthong ngo / /shar la gzigs dang sangs rgyas byon/ /sku mdog sngon po rab tu che/ /rgyan cha phun sum tshogs pas brgyan/ /sems dpa'i 'khor gyis rab tu bskor/ /skyob pa'i lha yin gsol ba thob/ /phung po 'di la ma chags par/ /rnam shes lha yi thugs kar 'phos/ /lha yi zhal nas 'di skad gsung / / chos kyi gnas lugs stong pa yin/ /bzang ngan rtog pa ci yang med/ /yod med mtha' la ma zhen par / / rig pa dbu ma chen po zhugs/ /lus ni shel gyi u bhi 'dra/ /gsal la dwangs pa'i spyi bo las/ /rig pa thon te nga nyid dang / /dbye ba med par dbyings su byon/ /ñtsā rje de bzhin brtan gyur na/ /nges par 'ong bas bde bar 'gro/ /legs nyes kun gyi sum mdo'i sa/ /sor bzhi'i tshad la'ang legs nyes 'byung / /gzhan yang gang zag rim pas brtag /bskyed rim bsgom la bskyed rim bstan/ /rdzogs rim can la rdzogs rim bstan/ /rnam dag tshul khrims gtsang ma la/ /zhing khams gtsang ma'i rnam pa bstan/ /tshad med byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bsam gyis mi khyab cho ga bstan/ /mdor na dge sbyor gang byed pa'i/ /bag chags brtan shos de nyid bstan/ /—84—

pha chos ti shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dnges garsha nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /zlo rje khyod kyi bka' rgyud rnams/ /rnam thar gcang ma blo che bas/ /dga' ldan bstan la 'pho ba btab/ /dran ma thag la zhing der 'gro/ /ci phyir zhe na lus 'di la/ /chags dang lhos pa ci yang med/ /de tshe rnam shes thogs med ldan/ /gang gi rnam pa skyes der sleb/ /de bas gcang ma'i rnam pa shar/ /gcang ma'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur//gang zhig ma dag rnam pa la/ /ma dag zhing der thogs med rgyu/ /rnal 'byol spyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ /dbu ma'i dbyings su dbu ma 'gro/ /shi ltas nam mkha' dwangs pa yin/ /chul khrims gcang ma me tog 'bab/ /byang chub sems la ring bsrel 'dzag /bskyed rim can la lha sku 'byon/ khrims gcang phung po gtsang ma de/ /lha rnams kun gyis bsu bar byed/ /phyir mi ldog la dung 'khyil te/ /'khor ba mi spong sems dpa' la/ /thugs dang ljags ni 'byon par bshad/ /spyir ni dam pa gshegs pa la/ /lha yi snga ltas 'ja' 'od 'byung / /gnas lugs snga ltas sprin med yin/ /de ni thun mong snga ltas cam/ /thun mong ma yin bsam mi khyab/ /la la kun nas bshad tsa na / / rlung sems dbu mar tshud ces gsung / /de la'ang skyon med rtog med 'byung / /gnas lugs bsgom pa mchog tu bzang / /gzhan du tha mal phal che ba/ /ma shes dbang gis brgyal gyur te/ /shi nas zhag po gsum lhag gam/ /bdun du brgyal bar 'gyur zhes gda'/ /la la chos kyi gnas lugs dag /ma bu 'phrod pa'i skabs yin skad/ /de la'ang skyon med gsung rab yin/ /mkhas pas de la yun ring 'tshal/ /shan nga/ mkhan la'ang 'ong mod kyi/ /mi shes dbang gis ngan 'gror 'gyur/ /e ma zle rje nga la nyon/ /skabs shig ma/ngon shes 'di 'dra mchi/ /snga phyi 'di gsum tshe rabs dran/ /snga ma gsum du gar skyes dran/ /phyi ma gsum du gar skye dran/ /'phos ma thag dang bdun du dran/ /de tshe de ni 'di snyam du/ /sngon yang sdug bsngal dpag med myong/ /e ma ngal gso 'dra ba yi/ /mi lus thob nas 'dug pa la/ /chos med sdig mang las dbang gis/ /ngan song 'gro ba a re snyam / / rab tu 'jigs shing skrag pa skyes/ /de nas cung zad brgyal nas 'gro/ /de las langs tshe mngon shes nyams / / lus ni ci yang med gyur kyang / /lus shig yod pa snyam byed cing / khag ste langs nas 'di snyam du/ /mi med lung stong 'di 'dra'i yul/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dpag med gda'/ /snang ba dag kyang mi gda' ba // / 'di ru 'ong ba ci yin na/ /snyam du thog med rgyug par byed/ /de tshe gshed ma'i zhags pas bcings/ /shas na ram mda' byed yod na/ /skrag pa'i tshul gyis nang du sleb/ /gshed ma de dang bral ba snyam// /gson po'i rjes su lad mo zlo/ /thams cad ngu zhing mchi ma 'byin/ /shi bar shes nas mya ngan skye/ /labs kyang gtam lan 'jal mkhan med/ /sor mo rnams kyang phyir bzlog gda'/ /gos kyang mgo mjug log pa snyam/ /byed kyang dge ba'i snang ba yis/ /ngan song sgo khegs mtho ris 'gro/ khul mas dge ba mi byed par/ /ngu 'bod byas —85—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/na 'di ltar 'gyur/ /la kha'i rtse nas 'bod par thos/ /'bod pa de yi sar phyin yang / /mi 'dug klung na grag par thos/ /log ste bltas kyang mi gda' ba/ /de bzhen sdug bsngal kun tu rgyug /bzhi bcu (cu)zhe dgur 'khyams zhes grags/ /de ni ma mtha' tsam du zad/ /de yi bar du ci rigs 'khyams/ /dam pa phal la mtshams med par/ /btsan sa'i gnas su yar la 'gro/ /pha ma gsod sogs mtshams med par/ /dmyal ba chen po'i gting du 'gro/ /sdig can rab ni dmyal ba ste/ /'dod chags can ni yi dwags shing / /zhe sdang can ni lha min te/ /gti mug can ni byol song nyid/ /de yang du ma nyid du sbyar/ /byol song nyid la'ang 'di lta ste/ /zhe sdang can ni gcan gzan sogs/ /gti mug can ni lug la sogs/ /gti mug 'dod chags bong bu sogs/ka67 ba2 can ni byol song nyid/ / /gsum ga khyi la sogs par skye/ /'gro ba g.yin la'ang de bzhin sbyar/ /dmyal ba tsam zhig mtshon byed na/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha 'dre dang / /rang nyid bcas te gshed ma yis/ /gshin rje'i mdun du khrid ces grags/ /de yis chos dang sdig la spyod/ /'dre yis sdig tshogs ston ces grags//lha yi dge ba ston ces grags/ /mnyam na me long ngos la blta/ /mi shes srang la 'degs so skad/ /sdig pasabatso sreg myong bar 'gyur/ /dge ba can ni de ltar min/ /sne rje de tsam rjes su ston/ /nges par 'chi ba'i dus cig 'ong / /'byung bzhi'i g.yar po de ltar gtong / /lus sems rten 'brel de ltar 'jig /lha yi tshogs rab de ltar 'ong / /bag chags ngan pa de ltar phung / /bag chags bzang ldan de ltar rgyal/ /mchog ni gnas lugs goms pa yin/ / nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /gdams pa yin no nges par phan/ /'chi ba mi 'ong su yang med / / 'di 'dra shes pa cig tu dkon/ /rghaṃ rje chos pa'i mal dag tu/ /mkhas pa rmongs par mi 'chi 'tshal /btsun po 'chal bar mi 'chi 'tshal/ /bzang po zog mar mi 'chi 'tshal/ /bhū rje bag phob sos dal la/ /byol song bzhin du phub mi nyal/ /'dod chags gan rkyal mi nyal zhing / /zhe sdang g.yon phyogs mi 'bebs par/ /g.yas phab g.yas rtsa mnan byas nas/ /rab tu chos dbyings chen por nyal/ /'bring du tshad med chen por nyal//tha mal tshul khrims dran par nyal/ /de ni spyod lam 'bring po tsam/ /gzhan du skyil krung mnyam gzhag ste/ /ji ltar zug gzer che gyur kyang / /de yi steng du /ka 68 na2 'ang/semasacan gyi/ sdug bsngal hril te blangs te na/ /'di yang bden pa ci yang med/ /don gyi ngo bo spros bral yin/ /skye 'chi med pa'i chos dbyings la/ /rig pa glod de gzhag par bya/ /gzugs mthong tshe na bla ma dang/ /yi dam chos skyong gnyis su bsgoms(sgomasaka/ /de yang bden med gzugs brnyan tsam/ /sgra rnams gnas lugs chen po'i tshig /de yang brag cha tsam du bzhag /bzang la chags pa rdul mi bya/ /ngan la spang 'dod ci yang med/ /rnam rtog skyes na thogs med 'jig /lus ngan —86—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyishurtsagasumapabazhugasaso/ / da wa zhig la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /rang dbang med par bdag gis 'ching / /de bas bdag tu mi 'dzin par/ /bdag de dbyings su bskyur bar bya/ /de ni rdo rje'i spyod lam ste/ /rtog pa med pa kun tu gces/ /'di ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'pho ba'i tshoms te brgyad pa'o/ /snying rje chen po'i gur nang nas/ /shes rab chen po'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ /thabs mkhas mda' ni thogs med 'dzin / / tshad med bzhi yi gshog pa can/ /snying rje'i ltong gis rgyud 'then zhing / /dpa' ba'i mde'u thogs med par / / rgyug cing gnyen po'i bcas kyis bsdams/ /bde ldan dpa' bo gser gyi bu/ /dge ba bskur ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad rab bkang nas/ /gzhu brdungs mda' 'phen shugs (shu|glu len/ /'dzum zhing 'jam par bag phebs te/ /btso ma gser gyi sku mchog la/ /shel gyi cod pan rab gtugs te/ /me tog kha 'bus stong du sbyar/ /yan lag drug bcu'i (cu'i1tshig 'brus brgyan/ /tshangs pa stong dbyangs zil gnon pa'i / / dbyangs kyis bstod phyag phun tshogs 'tshal/ /lha mo stong gis mchod tshogs 'bul/ khye'u stong gis sdig tshogs bshags/ /thun mong rjes su yi rang bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba btab/ /de na/sa gtso bo ñdzu rje yis/ /rje yi snyan du 'di skad gsol/ /'chi ba'i 'dam las rab brgal bar/ /byed pa'i 'pho ba go sla bar//'chi bdag rgyal pos bskul ma btab/ /'chi ba nyid kyis shes byas nas/ /'chi med dbyings su 'pho ba yis/ /ngang ring blo sna brdzes so rje/ /'dod pa dug mtsho khol ma'i 'dam/ /chags pa'i gnas su ma mthong nas/ /chags zhen brdzes te 'bros pa yis/ /'bros sa khyod kyis bstan no rje/ /gang zhig bde ba'i srog gcod pa'i/ /chags pa'i me 'obs chen po las/ /blo sna ring po brdzes gyur nas/ /me 'obs nyid las ci thar ba'i thabs mkhas drin no bla ma rje/ /ro myags 'dam zhes grags pa can/ khyod kyi rtsa ba 'dod chags yin/ /rtsa ba'i 'dam las ma brgal na/ /nga bdag can/ gyi bde skyid zad/ khyod kyi 'dam du bying gyur nas/ /'dod pa lcags kyi srin bu zhes/ /mchu ring bdag 'dras rab phug ste/ /'dam du bzod med sdug bsngal 'byung / /e ma 'dod pa chen pos lan/ /de yang bdag 'dzin dgra bos lan/ /'di ni chags sdang kun la rem/ /ngang ring brdzes la gtsang ma yi/ /zhing du 'gro ba'i thabs rnyed do/ /'dod pa dar gyis srin bu 'dra/ /rang la byung ba'i kha chu yis/ /rang nyid bcings nas 'gror mi ster/ /de bzhin bdag 'dzin chen po las/ /byung ba'i 'dam rdzab chen po yis//rang nyid btsan sar mi gtong bar/ /mi bzod bzhin du sgur du 'jug /ngang ring 'dam las rdzes bcangs kyis//cis kyang mi phan bros na bde/ /bla ma zlo rje nga la gson/ /mi lus gru yi mi dang 'dra/ /skam la phyin nam rgya mtshor 'chi / / shi gson bar na nas phyed de/ /gal te gru dang mnyan bzang na/ /skam pa'i gnas su phyin pa srid/ /—87—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gal te de nyid med gyur na/ /bzlog (ldog3 ste mtsho ru 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mi yi gru la brten pa yang / /dal 'byor bla ma bzang gyur na/ /pa rol thar ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /mi ldan 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'chi/ /de la 'di yis mtshams yin no/ /mtshams 'di zhig par ma gyur tshe/ /g.yobs shig brtson pa'i go cha can/ /skyobasashig bla ma mnyan pa mchog /mi lus gru 'di btsan sar drongs/ /'dir yang nad sogs sdug bsngal ba'i/ /gru 'di zag chus ma khyer cig /gru 'dis 'gro ba ma/ lus/ rī// /'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol byed pa'i/ /mnyan pa dam par byin gyis rlobs/ /nges par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ /e ma sprul pa'i chos rgyal gson/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams las 'khrungs pa'i/ /rghaṃ zhes snying rje chen po ngas/ /'khor ba 'di la cher bltas pas/ /rang dbang med par 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal zo chun khyud mo 'dra/ /ci byas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las/ /bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor mi gda' ba/ /rgyu 'bras chos la mig bltas pas/ /'gal 'gal 'dra la 'brel ba yi/ /zog po'i mtshan nyid rab bzung nas/ /drung po mang po bslus pa mthong / /nyon mongasalas las skyes pa yi/ /rig pa bkra la 'dun ma stor/ /tshe 'di'i dbu gtso bzang bzang 'dra/ /gtan 'dun rgyab log byas pa mthong / /gzhan la slob na mkhas mkhas 'dra/ /rang gi 'dun ma hon stor ba/ /don la gnyis pre da dgos phung ba/ /lab bzang rang srog skyel ba mthong / /shes rab bzo spyad kun la mkhas/ /kun gyis bkur zhing blo gtod gnas/ /phyi ma'i lha mo ma mthong bar/ /'di yi bdud mos bslus pa mthong / /tshul khrims sman gyi ljon 'dra ba/ /rang dang gzhan la phan pa de/ /'phral du kha nas phugs su skyur/ /bdud kyang khrel dgod byed pa mthong / /thos bsam sgom/ gsum rgyal po yi/ /gter mdzod 'dzad med 'dra ba de/ /'phral gyi nyams dgar ma mthong nas/ /'dod yon grong kha 'grim pa mthong / /'grub ngos shes pa'i nyams len dor/ /mi grub sangs rgyas khas len byed/ /bar do'i g.yang la lhung gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal rang mgo chag pa mthong / /skyob ngos shes pa'i dkon mchog bor/ /mthu chen 'dod pas dpe /ka 69 ba1 be/ dkar sgrub/ /'grub ma thag tu srog dang bral/ /shi nas ngan song 'grim pa mthong / / gnas lugs ston pa'i bla ma bor/ /bde ba 'phros pa'i grogs ngan bsten/ /rgyang mig mi mthong ha re long / / myur du glang pos brdzis pa mthong / /brtag dpyad mi gtong khyim so bzung / /dga' dga' bzhin du mthun sdebs nas/ /'di dang phyi ma kun stor te/ /'chi khar dbang med 'bral ba mthong / /lto phyir sdig pa kun bsags nas/ /tshe 'di'ang bde bar ma phyid par/ /thams cad kho la 'chi smon 'debs/ /phugs kyang ngan song lhung ba mthong / /gtan gyi bde ba skyed pa'i chos/ /snying nas sems la mi bsten par/ /tshe 'di'i dgra bo g.yob pa'i nor/ /shi la thug kyang gsog pa mthong / /shi nas bzhag la 'gro dgos kyang / /bza' btung tsam yang —88—

pha chos te shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos garsha nor bu'i phreng ba le'u te shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /mi nus par/ /zhen cing chags te bsags gyur bas/ /'chi khar mnar sbyangs byas pa mthong / /lus las skyes shing rab bskyangs nas/ /langs te legs par brgyan pa'i che/ /bkra ma shis kun nga 'gro zhes/ /pha ma bslu ba'i bdud mo mthong / /blo gtad nor rnams phog gyur te / kha bzung shags btab bur bskyangs pas/ /gshis ngan bdud mo gor blangs nas/ /drin can rgyang du 'phen pa mthong / /tshe 'dir dag pa'i snang ba sbyangs/ /chul khrims bsrungs shing chags med gtong / /bzang po'i gnas la mi/ dga' bar/ /ser snas rnag khrag 'thung ba mthong / /dgra bo snying du bcug gyur nas/ /thams cad dgra la mchod byed cing / /phyi rol yul la dgrar 'jin pa'i/ /log rtog bdud kyi 'ching phur mthong / /dgra bo cig choms ma lus po/ /choms pa'i gnad chen mi shes nga/ra//rnam rtog chags sdang 'chad gyur nas/ /'chad shul nang du brlag pa ma/thong / /'di ni ma dag ser/sa can gyi/ /log spyod rang mtshan 'khrul ba ste/ /nyon mo/ngas 'dam du bying ba yi/ /ma dag sems can yin par nges/ /ral gris rang la bsnun par nges/ dug chu rang gis 'thungs par nges/ /rang srog rang gis 'joms par nges// /gting rdo rang gis byed par nges/ /dgra phung rang nyid sbyong bar nges/ /gshed ma'i dgra bo phugs bcug nas/ /so dang sgo cha phyir bsdams te/ /bya ra rgyang du byed par nges/ /a cang grag stong ldem pe yin/ /don la grub pa ci yang re/da/ /snang snang 'dra ste bden pas stong / /mthong nges ri bong rwa dang 'dra/ khyad gzhi me/da la khyad chos phyir//de yi rno rtul rteg dang mtshungs/ / mo gsham khye'u sngon po cig /dug chu 'thungs pas 'od dang ldan/ /bdud rtsi 'thungs pas srog dang bral/ /rang ro rang gi khur bar mthong / /shin tu dpa' ba'i seng ge cig /mgo dgu g.yu ral mdzes pas brgyan/ /nam mkha' thang la 'bebs byed cing / /ral bas bcings te snyeriphen pa ma/thong / /mthong bar ma zad kho bos nges/ /e ma/ 'di yi spyod tshul zhan/ /zo chun bzhin du mi 'khor ram// /'on te bden med yal yul mang / /thar ba'i zhing khams mi bgrod dam/ /mchungs pa med pa'i bla ma rje/ /snang dang snang med mthong nges te/ /mjug sdud tshoms te dgu pa'o/ /thams cad dril na rnam byang tshoms/ /skye 'chi med par shes pa yin/ /dri med zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /ji srid nam mkha' khyab gyur ba/ /de srid khyod skus khyab gyur te/ /de tsam khyab pa'i pha ma yang / khyed kyis mi 'dren su yang med/ khyod sku ba spu gcig cig gi khung du'ang rgyal ba dpag med kyi/ /zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab na/ /lus sku bkod pa su yis rtogs/ /gang la'ang chags pa mi mnga' zhing / /chags med spyod pa'i bde gshegs sku/ /gang zhig gang la chags gyur pa'i/ /'dod pa'i 'dam chen 'dzin pa can/ khyod kyis mi rtag skul ma yis/ /rtag 'dzin bde dang ngang ring dang / /skyid 'dod le lo snyom las pa'i/ /'then thag gang de rdze byed pa//—89—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'then thag gang de bstung byed pa/ /gang la phan zhing bde ba yi/ /mgon po brtson pa'i go cha can/ khyod ni gsung rab ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus te bsgom mkhas na/ /nges par bsdus te bstan tu gsol/ /ñtsā rje'i zhes nas 'di skad gsung / /bla ma mchog rab gsan du gsol/ /de dag dril na 'di lta ste/ /snang ba dang ni snang med dang / / bzang po dang ni ngan pa dang / /spang bya dang ni gnyen po ste/ /gang la chags byed 'ching bar byed/ /de bas gang la'ang chags pa spang / /'dod cing chags pa'i 'dam las brdzes/ /chags med dbyings su bde bar 'gro / / gal te bzang la chags gyur kyang / /thar ba'i srog dang 'brel bar byed/ /gal te ngan la chags gyur na / / mtho ris bde 'gro'i srog dang 'brel/ /des bas rtag par 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam rtog 'ching ba'i gar bu ni//'dod chags 'dam las brdzes gyur te/ /gdul byar bcas te mnyam nyid du/ /'gag med dbyings su chags med 'gro/ /de ni 'bring du bsdus pa yin/ /de yang bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /gang la'ang chags pa spang bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /chags pas bde 'gro'ang mi thob cing / /thar ba'i srog kyang gcod par byed//ces bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de 'dra'i thos bsam las byung ba'i/ /dge ba bsgom dang ldan pa de/ /mtho ris sa bcur brgyud byas nas/ /nges par rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog /sne rje nga yi rnam thar rnam/sa/ khel gyi khye'u ltar gsal ba/ /padma dkar po'i ze 'bru la/ /rnam thar phun tshogs bkra shis shog /thub chen dpa' bo'i bkra shis shog /ye shes sgrol ma'i bkra shis shog /thugs rje chen po'i bkra shis shog /mi g.yo mgon po'i bkra shis shog /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i bkra shis shog /lhag bsam bzang po'i bkra shis shog /thabs shesamachog gi bkra shis shog /snang stong mkhas pa'i bkra shis shog /de nyid rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis kun 'dus bkra shis shog /'dod pa'i 'dam la ma byeng bar/ /mi rtag thun bzhir rab bsgoms nas/ /smon 'jug shing rtas drangs gyur nas/ /mthar thug theg pa phyin par shog /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las//'dod pa'i 'dam las brdzes bcangs ji ltar bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //pa13 rnam thar gtsang ma'i pha phogs ji ltar zhusapa'i lelga.oṃ ā hrīḥhūṃ/ thub chen ye shes sgrol ma dang / /thugs rje chen po mi g.yo ba/ /bslu ba med pa'i mgon skyabs bzhi / / spyi bor blangs nas phyag bgyi'o/ /spyir thub pa chen po'i zhing khams/ dgos spyan ras gzigasakyi pad sdong / nying dgos ze 'bru dang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma'i zhing khams/ mi g.yo ba rdo rje'i gdan steng / yer pa bla ma'i gzims khang du/ spyir 'gro ba yongs kyi bla ma la/ dgos rgya bod gnyis kyi mnga' bdag /rje za hor rgyal po'i —90—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gdung rgyud/ 'jig rten sgron ma rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ gnas gcig tu paṇḍi ta lnga bcu (cuka rtsa lngas mchod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab ma lus pa'i lde mig /ngur smrig 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mkhan po/ sde snod thams cad tshig bzhi pa gcig tu dril nas thugs rtse gcig tu 'dzin pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa po/ gsang sngags ma lus pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ man ngag sna tshogs pa'i gter mdzod/ 'gro ba'i bla ma a ti shar yongs su grags pa/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag de'i spyan lngar/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yab/ 'phags pa'i gang zag kun gyi rgyal po/ thugs rje dang mkhyen rab nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/mdzad pa dang 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang du len pa/ dka' spyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzod pa/ dus gsum du dge ba'i chos zab ma gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log pas thugs ngoms pa med pa/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ste/ bu ga re re'i zhing khams kyang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang dpyad par mi nus pa/ skad cig gcig la yang rigs drug gi gnas thams cad lus kyi bkod pas 'gengs par mdzad pa/ de dag gi sems can thams cad la'ang dbul phongs la zas skom 'byor pa/ rgyan rta glang po sman la sogs pa gang dang gang 'dod pa ster bar byed pa/ yi dwags kyi gnas na kha sar pa ṇi la sogs pa rigs drug rang rang skyob pa'i lha gang dang gang du sprul te/ chos thams cad kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu sdud/ drug po'ang yi ge drug tu sdud/ yi ge drug pos kyang rigs drug gi skye sgo 'gegs shing ston par mdzad pa/'dod chags can la 'dod chags can ltar bstan te/ lha mo gzhon nu ma dang lha phrug g.yion nu ma la sogs pa mdzes la 'dzum chags pa/ dkar la 'od 'phro ba/ dbyangs snyan la tshig 'bru gsal ba/ 'dod pa can bde ba bskyed pa'i lus su sprul te bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa la 'god pa/ zhe sdang can la sogs pa la'ang de dag nyid kyi rnam par ston par byed pa/ mdor na mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma 'jig rten dbang phyug bdag cag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mtshan byin gyis brlabs pa/ rgyal ba de dag thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dus ding sang gdul bya'i dbang gis byang phyogs 'brom rje'i gdung rgyud (brgyudaka du sku bltams pa/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas zhabs nas mchod pa/ de ltar mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma des/ 'di skad ces zhus pa/ zag med kun tu dge ba'i dpal/ /lta bas mi ngoms lhun chags pa/ /snyan pas mi tshim gsal dag pa/ /bsams pas mi rtogs zab yangs can/ /—91 —

bka' gdams dpe dken gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'gro ba kun la phan slad du/ /zhus lan gser gyi phreng ba 'thud/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu 'dra/ /bsams pas tshim pa'i 'dod dgu ster/ /'das pa'i bde gshegs ma lus dang / /ma 'ongs sgron ma gang 'byung dang / / da lta brtson 'grus mtshungs med kyis/ /rab tu bsngags pa'i rnam thar gang / /gtsang nas gtsang ma bskyed pa yi/ /chos lugs bzang po nga la dgos/ /ding sang pha phogs 'dod pa'i dus/ /pha cig mgon po a ti sha / ma 'ongs jo bo yab sras zhes/ /yab sras gnyis su 'bod dus su/ /chos rgyal pha ma brten byasanas/ /pha phogs ngan na gnyis ka nongs/ /ji ltar spyad kyang mi 'dzad pa/ /gang nas bltas kyang dri ma med/ /ji 'dra btab kyang mchog tu skye/ /gang nas zos kyang ro mchog zhim/ /yangs pa rtsibs stong dkyil dang 'dra/ /gcod lam rtsibs stong zur dang 'dra/ /phan yon de gnyis kun sdud cing / /bzang nas bzang la 'pho 'gyur can/ /rgyud chen kun la 'phos gyur kyang / /bzang lugs nyams pa mi mnga' ba/ /ji ltar sgron me gcig pu las/ /gang gi bye mnyam spros gyur kyang / /gcig pu mi nyams kun gsal ltar/ /gang gi rgyud la 'phosagyur kyang / /mthun phyogs thams cad sdud byed cing / /mi mthun phyogs rnams gcod byed pa'i/ /'pho bya 'pho byed kun rgyasapas/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur dgos/ kho bo yon tan kun da'i sbubs/ /sbas pa gang gis ma rnyed pa/ /yar ngo'i rim bzhin kha phye ste/ /brgyad khri brgyad khri lnga stong sras/ /'phags pa'i drang srong gtsang sbra can/ /bram ze blo gsal kun mkhas pa/ /sprul pa'i rabs bdun/ ci 'dra'i sku/ /gang gis bltas kyang mi ngoms pa/ /sbubs nas rim gyis gsal gyur te/ /zla ba'i bsil zer kun da'i gtsang / /sbubs kyi bcud kyang de 'dra ba/ /rgyu gtsang rkyen gtsang 'bras gtsang ba/ /gtsang ma'i zhing nas gtsang mar 'gro/ /gtsang ma'i bag chags gtsang mar 'khyer/ /gtsang ma'i gos dang gtsang ma'i zas/ /ro mchog bde ba thar skyed pa/ /'dul khrims gos yin lhag bsam zas / / shes rab gzhal yas bzang po na/ /sde snod mkho ba'i yo byad rgyas/ /bye brag nor bdun mdzes pas phyug /thabs mkhas bran 'khor rdzu 'phrul can/ khrel yod gzhung gi rked rgyan can/ /ngan song skyob pa'i lham bu can/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sham bu can/ /rnam dag lta ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /mchog dang thun mong rna rgyan can / / stobs dang mi 'jigs dpung rgyan can/ /tshul khrims bzang po'i mgul rgyan can/ /tshad med dga' ba'i sor gdub can/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi rkang gdub can/ /mkha' mnyam bgrod pa'i 'khor lo can/ /de ltar 'byor ba'i pha phogs kyis/ /sras rnams legs par 'tsho ba dgos/ /de dang mi ldan pha phogs ngan/ /de ltar mdzad na thams cad 'tsho/ /de ltar gnang na pha phogs bzang / /gnyis su med pa'i bla ma mchog /zhu ba'i tshoms te dang po yin/ /—92—

pha chos te shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos garsha mong bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /de nas mgon po a ti sha /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis dag snang bkod/ /gzhu gang shar gyi gyen gseg la/ /dmar po 'ja' yi them skas bcugs/ /de cam gzhu gang gyen gseg la/ /ljang khu mdzes pa'i them skas btsugs / / de bzhin sngo ser dkar po yi/ /them skas lnga pa'i yang steng na/ /rnam dag 'od kyi gzhal yas bzhedas / / de nas rang lus 'od gsal ba/ /bla ma lhar bcas bzhugs gyur te/ /snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bu yi/ /zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de nas 'brom la 'di skad du/ /kun da'i sbubs dang bcud bcas pa/ /bsil zer 'od kyi dbyings su byon/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi lam la byon/ /ye shes sbyor ba'i lam la byon/ /gnas lugs mthong ba'i lam la byon/ /chos dbyings goms pa'i lam la byon/ /mthar phyin mi slob lam la byon/ /gnas 'di bde ba chen po yin/ /gnas 'di kun da 'byed pa'i gnas/ /gnas 'di sras mchog spel ba'i zhing / /pha phogs len pa'i mdzod 'di na/ /ma dag dri bral bka' gdams pa/ /bag chags gtsang ldan bu gar rtses/ /lam gsum nang na them skas bcu/ /rim gyis 'dzegs la yang rtser byon/ /nam mkha' khyab tshad mthong bar 'gyur/ /gang na bde dang sdug bsngal ba'i/ /skye dgu gang de yar la drongs/ /rnam g.yeng che na rtse la byon/ /ltad mo ma tshang med par mthong / /rnam g.yeng chung na 'od dbyings su/ /chos dbyings rang grol lhug par zhog /gos sogs ji ltar 'dod pa rnams/ /de na yod kyi bde bar spyod/ /'di ni bde ba'i gnas chen yin / / gang du bde ba mthong ba der/ /spro bar mdzad de zhing der byon/ /the tshom skyes na mi 'grub rgyu/ /dang por gang bsams bzang mthar skyol/ /de nas rim gyis thams cad 'grub/ /gzhan du cig kyang 'grub mi 'gyur / / des na kun spyod gtsang ma'i bu/ /de 'dra'i sras mchog de 'dra ba/ /de 'dra'i sras mchog bzang 'dzin pa / khyod tshe'ang rigs gsum nyid kyis sprul/ /de tshe'ang rigs gsum nyid kyis sprul/ /de tshe'ang khyod kyi rnam thar 'dzin/ /e ma thams cad khyod kyi sras/ /mdzes par mdzes sbubs rab tu bltams/ /lha dang bcas pa'i mchog gnas yin/ /me tog sbubs kyang lha yis skyong/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i sras gcig pu/ /kun tu skyongs shig rab tu mdzes/ /de ni lan gyi tshoms yin no/ /de na/sa 'brom rjes 'di skad zhus/ /zhus dang lan du bcas pa yin/ /de ltar bag phebs rtsed mo rnams/ /legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /gang du bde ba'i chos mthong ba/ /der ni rtag tu 'bad par bya/ /thog mar brtsams pa gang yin pa/ /dang por de nyid bsgrub bya ste/ /de lta na ni kun legs byas/ /gzhan du gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ rnam thar gtsang ma'i pha phogs ji ltar zhus pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //—93—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pha14 sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bcad de bying rgod mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i lelgayang gnas de nyid du yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i drung du/ bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis 'di ltar zhus te/ mkhyen pa can gsan du gsol/ kho bos bod kyi sems can 'dul dgos par gda'/de la bod rang gi skad lam du 'gro la blun skad che ba/ tshig thos ma thag tu don go ba de 'dra cig zhu ba'i skabs la bab/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba gang lags/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom/ sdig pa yin/ jo bo sdig pa'i rtsa ba gang lags/ 'brom/ phung bo nga bdag yin/ jo bo/ nga bdag gi sdig rtsa ji ltar byas/ 'brom/ thams cad kho la dgos/ jo bo/ thams cad ji ltar dgos/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ rang nyid mtho la gzhan dma' ba cig dgos / jo bo de la ji skad zer/ 'brom/ rang 'dod chags sdang can zer ba yin/ jo bo/ de su la shasache/'brom / nyams len chung la nga rgyal che ba la shas che/ jo bo/ rang la yod pas nga rgyal ba ma lags sam/ 'brom/srin bu me khyer rang gi 'od min pa gzhan med snyam/ jo bo/ kho 'od dum tsam de yod pas nga rgyal ba lags/'brom / nyi ma dang zla ba kun nga mi rgyal/ 'o na jo bo/ nga rgyal lam du 'gro ba'am mi 'gro/ 'brom/ gzhan don byas na ngas gzhan don 'grub nges snyam du nga rgyal na lam du 'gro/ 'brom/ bslab bya byas na shes nges snyam du nga rgyal na lam du 'gro/ nga gnyen po che bas/ tshul khrims bsrungs na thub nges snyam nas nga rgyal na lam du 'gro/ jo bo / de kun yang nga rgyal mtshan nyid pa yin te ang / 'brom/ mtshan nyid pa yin byasapa med/ jo bo/ mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i nga rgyal rang 'ong nge ang / 'brom/ khyod la mtshan nyid ji 'dra cig dgos/ jo bo/ mtshan gzhi'i steng du mtshon bya mtshon nus pa cig 'tshal mod/ 'brom/ kha rog sdod/ de 'dra byas na lam du mi 'gro/ lam du 'gro ba de nga rgyal ltar snang yin/ jo bo/ ltar snang lam du 'gro ba khyed kyi gsungs pas drag 'o na 'brom/ ltar snang lam du mi 'gro'am/ jo bo/ ltar snang lam du 'gro ba ni gang na yod/ 'brom/ rmi lam na chos thamasacad rmi lam 'di dang 'dra snyam du shes pa de kun yin/ jo bo/ mtshan nyid pa zer na de la zer ba yin/ me'i mtshan nyid tsha bar shes pas lam du gar yang mi 'gro/ 'brom/ 'o na tsha ba me'i mtshan nyid ma yin nam/ jo bo/ 'o na chos thams cad rtag cing bden pa yin nam/ 'brom/ de dang mi 'dra rtag cing bden pa la gzhi med/ jo bo/ me'i mtshan nyid tsha ba bden pa la gzhi yod de 'ong / 'brom/ khyod tshig tsha ba cig 'dug jo bo/ 'o na de me yin nam/'brom / de ci yin/ jo bo/ me'i mtshan nyid tsha bar zhal gyis bzhes shing gda' ba/ 'brom/ 'dis bden —94—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /bden 'dra ba shes pa cig 'dug jo bo/ bden pa yod ma myong ba la 'dra ba las 'os mi gda' yis/ 'brom/khyod nga rgyal ba yin nam/ jo bo/ sgro btags lam du 'gro na nga rgyal bas chog 'brom/ mtho sems yin nam min / jo bo/ mtho sems spang bya yin nam min/ 'brom/ zhen na spang bya yin/ jo bo/ ma zhen na spang bya ma lags sam/ 'brom/ ma zhen pa'i mtho sems ltar snang yin/ jo bo/ zhen pa'i mtho sems la ji ltar bya/'brom / nga rgyal la 'bur 'joms bya 'tshal/ jo bo/ de la thabs ci yod/ 'brom/ bla ma nyams len can gyi gdams ngag dran par bya 'tshal/ jo bo/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gang lags/ 'brom/ srid pa chags nas da lta yan chad du bslabs nas/ da gzod bla ma la gdams ngag 'dri a// jo bo/ srid pa chags nas 'grogs nas da dung 'o skol gnyis 'grogs a/ 'brom/ 'di zhe zhags so/ /jo bo/ thugs zhags pa'i lan po cam du gda' ba/'brom / lan la re dmar/ jo bo/ dus la 'doms na lan yin/ 'brom/ khyod la dus la 'doms pa'ang yod dam / jo bo/ kho bo nam mkha'i me tog ma lags/ 'brom/ 'o na khyod su yin/ jo bo/ dkar po'i kha dog ci lags / 'brom/ 'di 'gag sgug mkhas/ jo bo/ 'gag la sgug na mkhas pa yin/ 'brom/ mkhas pa re brel/jo bo/ de ci lags/ 'brom/ 'gag thams cad la rgyug dgos pas/ jo bo/ de bas yin rung min rung rgyug pa de brel lags mod/ jo bo/ bzhad cing khyod bod 'dra/ jo bo/ dper na rgya gar ba'i kun du rgyu bzhin/ 'brom/'dis 'bras zer ma re la'ang so re/ jo bo/ de la rtsing zhib ran po cig 'ong ba lags so/ /zhus pa'i skabs 'dir / bu mo ljang khu ma cig gis/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bum pa gang khyer te/ shel gyi skyogs dkar ser gnyis su blugs nas yab sras gnyis la drangs te/ shags 'debs pa bya ba skom dad che ba yin/ kho mos kyang thugs zhags la ku co che ba de thos bden bden 'dra bar gda' ba de kho mos kyang nyan du 'ongs pa yin gsungs pa la/'brom gyi zhal nas bu mo khyed rang yang kun tu rgyu lags sam/ he he khye'u dkar po cig dang bsdongs te phyogs kun tu 'gro dgos pa cig byung lags/ jo bo'o zhal nas/ khye'u dkar po la de 'dra'i brel ba cig ci byung / jo bo kho la ma mang drags nas/ la la skyid drags nas dga' bde la yan/ la la sdug drags nas lta nyul byed/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ grangs ci tsam gda'/ jo bo/ grangs dang tshad yod na ta drag ste mi gda' lags pa/ bu mo tshad nam mkha' ma yin nam/ jo bos nam mkha' la tshad cig mdzod dang / jo bo'i zhal nas ngas mi shes/ 'brom kho rgyu 'grul rem pa yin dris/ khong spro bsdu la ni dga'/ nam mkha' la'ang tshad 'di tsam yod bya ba cig yod nas 'ong gis/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ jo bo/ kho bo spro bsdu ci tsam byed cing gda'/ 'brom/ spros pa nam mkha' tsam byed cing gda' ba/ jo bo gda' ba thugs la btags/ nam mkha'i tshad de bstan 'tshal/ /'brom 'di ci zer/—95—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/kho bos nam mkha' tshad kyis 'jal ma myong / jo bo'ang brdzun glo bur du mdzad par gda' ba/ da lta rang 'brom gyis spros pa nam mkha'i tshad tsam byas gsungs nas/ da lta nam mkha' la tshad ma byas gsung bar 'duga'abrom / nam mkha' tsam yod byas pa ma lags pa/ nam mkha' la tshad yod byas pa med/ jo bo/ 'brom la spros pa nam mkha' tsam yod gsung tsa na/ dpe don sbyar tsa na/ dpe don gnyis ka mkhyen 'tshal lags mod/ khyed mkhas pa cig gis mi mkhyen bzhin du sbyor ba yod de a/ 'brom/ da lan khyed bden du chug gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam zer ba la nam mkha' rang shes dgos na/ nam mkha' la dpe byed mkhan rang mi 'ong jo bo de rang mi shes bzhin du byed pa cig ma lags sam/ nam mkha'i mtha' rnyed pa'i blo cig rang dka'o/ /'brom/ 'o na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs nam mkha' lta bu zer ba de la tshad sus gzhal/ jo bo/ de tshad med pa dper len pa yin/ tshad yod na nam mkha' dper mi rung / 'brom/ rjes su yi rang / nga rgyal med la chos mkhas pa khyod 'dra ba 'ba' zhig gisabaskor na dga' ba la/ jo bo/ des phan par mi gda'/ de bas semasacan thams cad kho bo lta bur gyur nas/ khyed kyi drung du 'khod nas/ theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig la longs spyad na dga' ste/ bud med kyi rten la sangs rgyas thob par dka' ba ltar dkon par gda' ba zhus pas/ bu mo sngo ljang de de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur lam me byas gda'o/ /jo bo bzhad cing / mngon sum gyisagasal bar mdzad pa cha byad bzang gsung / 'brom na re/ bzang dang mi bzang sangs rgyas zin gyis ci yang ston nus/ kho bo nyen mongs pa'i 'ching ba can gyi bud med la zer ba yin/ de nas bu mo rang gzugs su mdzad nas/ snying rje chen po 'ching ba dang ldan pa'i bud med cig dang kho mo gnyis nyon mongs pa gang che/ kho mo ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa khur ba cig yin/ 'ching ba can de ni rang gi 'os skal las mi khur/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs par ni sangs mi rgya / nyon mongs pa ni de ltar rgya che/ 'brom na re/ 'o na kho bo rang nyon mongs pa che/ nam mkha' khur nas yod/ 'brom/ nam mkha' la bkur bya mi mnga'/ sgrol ma khyed la khur byed mi mnga' yi/ da mnyam pa nyid du skyur/ yang 'brom gyis jo bo la zhus pa/ nyon mongs pa khur bar byed pa de gang yin/ 'brom/bdag tu 'dzin pa su la yod yod yin/ 'o na sgrol ma la bdag 'dzin med de grol/ nged bdag 'dzin can rnams ji ltar spangs/ 'brom/ nyin cig la rnam rtog ci tsam zhig rgyu/ jo bo/ bsam gyisami khyab pa cig rgyu'o/ /'brom / chos dbyingasaci tsam cig skye/ jo bo/ rtog pasazil gyi mnan nasaskye ba mi gda'o/ /'brom/ de la bla ma a wa dhū ti pa'i bzhed pa de dgos pa yin gsung / jo bo/ bla ma'i gdams ngag de bstan 'tshal/ 'brom/rnam rtog byung tshad chos nyid du bsgyur ba yin/ jo bo/ sdong dum thams cad gser du song na 'dod pa can la mkho —96—

pha chos te shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gathi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /bar gda' ste/ ji ltar bsgyur du btub bam/ 'brom/ man ngag la brten nas gser 'gyur gyi rtsi byas pas lcags gser du 'gro ba yod/ gnad shes dgos pa yin/ jo bo/ gnad bstan 'tshal/ 'brom/ dgra 'joms pa la dgra ngos zin 'tshal/ jo bo/ dgra gang lags/ 'brom/ rnam par rtog pa yin/ jo bo/ de ji ltar 'joms/'brom / kho 'bur te byung tsa na 'joms 'tshal/ jo bo/ 'joms lugs ji ltar bgyid/ 'brom/ gzhi gang na 'dug lta/ dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa dpyad/ snga ma phyi ma la sogs pa dpyad/ 'gro sa dang byung sa btsal/ de dus su kho mi rnyed/ jo bo/ de ci lags/ 'brom/ kho yod ma myong bas mi rnyed pa yin/ jo bo/ ma rnyed na ji ltar bgyi/ 'brom/ rnam rtog chos dbyings su bsgyur ba bya ba yin/ btsal nas ma rnyed na chos dbyings yin pa'i rtags yin/ de la glod la zhog jo bo/ yang byung na/ 'brom/ yang 'bur 'joms gyis/ jo bo/ go la thabs kyis bya lags sam/ 'brom/ /ngas mi 'ong / gnyen pos bcom brdeg gyis/ jo bo/ spang bya gzhan yod dam med / 'brom/ blo sna ma mang / mdun ma cig tu hril te dril/ jo bo 'o na/ lam gzhan yod dam med/ 'brom/kha gnyis kyi lam gyis phugs su mi phyin/ lam chig chod la thong / jo bo/ 'dun ma gzhan yod dam med/'brom / 'dun ma mang na skabs don skyel lo/ /sab sub ma mang chig chod la thong / jo bo/ de lta lags te/ na tsha la sogs pa rkyen ngan byung na dka' mor gda'/ 'brom ci zer/ de las bzang ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen med / jo bo/ dge ba'i bshesaganyen du ci mchis sam/ gdon ngan cig gis gtad pa lags/ 'brom/ 'di ci zer / de las bzang ba'i sangs rgyas gang na yod/ jo bo/ sangs rgyas sam/ na tsha drag po gtong ba/ 'brom/khyod kyis ma go ba yin/ nad de sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing chen po cig yin/ jo bo/ sdig sgrib kyi phyags shing yin min cha med/ sdug bsngal chen po la gtod pa cig 'dug 'brom/ de la yang yang dpyad pas ma rnyed ca na chos dbyings kyi yo lang chen po 'ong ba yin/ jo bo/ 'o na sdug bsngal na rang dga'am/ 'brom/ chos gzha' ma cig bgyid na skyid 'dod kyiko rang mnan 'tshal/ jo bo/ sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo cig yod par ni gda' ye/'brom / dka' spyad chen po byas nas sdug la sdug 'thud 'tshal/ jo bo/ de rang 'thad 'thud 'tshal le/ 'brom/'thud na 'chad pa gnad du che/ jo bo/ de ci lags/ 'brom/ skyid gcig pu 'dod 'dod nas sdug pa cig lags kyis/ jo bo/ hril te gril (drilakan ji tsug byed/ 'brom/ bdag las ngan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas / pha shi ba'i ro bzhin du lings te skyur la thong/ jo bo/ blang bya gang lags/ 'brom/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi 'byung khungs yin pas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed pa bzhin du bcangs te long la thong jo bo/btang snyoms su gzhag bya rang ye mi bdog gam/ 'brom/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka skye med yin pas skye ba med —97—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/par mnyam pa nyid du lhod de skyur la thong / jo bo/ de 'o na bzhes cig(shigaka jo bo/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba spang bya gang yin/ 'brom/ rnam rtog chen po 'di yin no/ /jo bo/ 'di'i 'joms lugs gang lags/ 'brom/'bur 'joms las ma 'das so/ /jo bo/ gnyen pos ji ltar spang lags/ 'brom/ the mi tshom par bcom brdeg chen po'o/ /lam yang gcig po (puka de yis chod/ 'dun ma'ang gcig po (pu3 de la gril/ /na tsha la sogs pas dge ba la bskul bas chos mi byed ka med 'ongs pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang ngo / /gdon rkyen ngan la 'jigs pa bstan te/ de nas de la skyob pa'i thabs ston pa sangs rgyas su bzung / 'brom/ sangs rgyas kun so so'i skye bos mthong bar dka'o/ /'brom/ 'di kun mas brdung zhing legs la 'god pa dang 'dra/yid 'byung skyes nas chos bzang po dran/ sangs rgyas snying nye la bzang gsung / 'brom/ nad byung res kyis sems can thams cad kyi nad blangs pas/ dpa' bo chen po la sdig sgrib kyis bsdad pa'i glags med/'brom / sdug bsngal byung res kyi bdag 'dzin la le lan gda' zhing / btsal bas mi rnyed/ 'brom/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i rnam rtog brgya byung na/ 'tshol thengs brgya byas pas mi rnyed pa brgya tham pa 'ong / ma rnyed pa'i don rnyed pa de chos dbyings yin/ de la bla ma a wa dhū tī pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam rtog ngo bo chos dbyings yin / / byung na dga' ste bskul 'debs bzang / /ci phan rnyed par ma gyur bas/ /gnas lugs yo lang tsam du zad / / ces gsungs na/ 'brom/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa khong la yod/ 'brom/ kho bos kyang /nyi ma nyin gcig nyid la'ang bdag 'dzin la/ /mi dgos dgu dgos rnam par rtog pa brgya/ /'phros ma thag tu gnyen pos btsal ba yis/ /ma rnyed chos dbyings kho na yin par gda'/ /gal te yod na rnam rtog mang lugs la / / gal te gcig tsam ma rnyed khrims yod dam/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ /de ring gsung gleng nyams dga'/ lha mo byon pa'ang thugs la btags/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag zab/ de ni nga rgyal mtho ba'i sems byung ba'i tshe bla ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar dran par byas pa'i tshoms so/ /yang 'brom gyi zhal nas/ gal te sems 'di zhus drags na/ /bla ma ji ltar gsal bar bgyi/ /'brom/bsir zer g.yo ba'i rlung la bskyon/ /jo bo/ de la bzhon nas gang tsug bya/ /'brom/ dud 'gro rnamasakyi mang lugs la/ /mi lus thob pa nyams re dga'/ /jo bo/ blo de skyes nas ji ltar bsgom/ /'brom/ rnyed pas mi chog 'jigs par sla/ /jo bo/ de yi thabs su ji ltar bgyi/ /'brom/ tshul khrims gser gyi me tog thus/ /jo bo/ de yi gnas mal gang du bya/ /'brom/ zag med chos kyi rgya mtshor bya/ /jo bo/ rgya mtsho'i nang du ji ltar gnas/ /'brom / 'dzam bu'i chu bo gser la bza'/ /jo bo/ za lugs dris pa ma lags mod/ /'brom/ longs spyod med —98—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /pas ji ltar gnas/ /jo bo/ ting nge 'dzin la za ba yin/ /'brom/ de las che ba'i zas med do/ /jo bo/ zhus pa'i sems la ji ltar phan/ /'brom/ 'di 'dra yod pas dga'o snyam/ /jo bo/ de la dga' ba ci mchi'am/ /'brom / gtan gyi 'dun ma 'ong ste mchi/ /jo bo/ zhus pa gang la brten nas 'ong / /'brom/ gzhan gyi sdig rkyen byung na 'ong / /jo bo/ sdig rkyen ji ltar gsal bar bya/ /'brom/ bzod pa'i bskul 'debs yin no snyam/ /jo bo / bzod pa bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /'brom/ gzugs bzang 'dod na med thabs med/ /jo bo/ bzod pas gzugs bzang ji ltar thob/ /'brom/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po'o/ /jo bo/ de las gzhan pa mi thob bam//'brom / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug bcu (cuka thob/ /jo bo/ zhun pa bsal thabs shin tu legs/ /jo bo/bying rgod gnyis ka 'ong lags sam/ /'brom/ dmu rgod rnams la de 'dra mang / /jo bo/ de la bsal thabs ji ltar bgyi/ /'brom/ mnyam pa nyid las lhag pa med/ /jo bo/ snying rje bsgom na ji 'dra 'ong / /'brom/ dela'ang 'ong ste zhumu pa srid/ /jo bo/ byams pa cig rang bsgom lags sam/ /'brom/ de la'ang zhus pa srid lags so//jo bo/ dga' ba cig rang bsgom lags sam/ /'brom/ de la'ang rgod pa srid pa yin/ /jo bo/ 'o na btang snyoms bya lags sam/ /'brom/ de la'ang gti mug srid pa yin/ /jo bo/ 'o na bya sa mi 'dug pa/ /'brom/byar med rtogs na mnyam nyid lags/ /jo bo/ lags ta lags te des phan nam/ /'brom/ mi phan pa mi byed mkhan med/ /jo bo/ bya rgyu med pa ma lags sam/ 'brom/ khyod kyis da gzod go nas 'dug /jo bo/ 'o na tshad med ji ltar bsgom/ /'brom/ che re nye re bzhi ka bsgom/ /jo bo/ byi rgod 'byung ba ma lags sam/ /'brom/de bas bzhi ka bsgom pa yin/ /jo bo/ cig las bzhi ka mi thu'am/ /'brom/ cig gi gnyen po gcig yin mod//jo bo bzhi ka med pa mi mchi'am/ /'brom/ de la rgyu mtshan ci zhig yod/ /jo bo/ rdza ma 'thabs na ji 'dra mchi/ /'brom / ci zer de dang gang na 'dra/ /jo bo/ mi 'dra na yang skyon cig 'ong / /'brom/ bying mgo rgod pas gnon pa yin/ /jo bo/ rgod pa 'ba' zhig mi 'ong ngam/ /'brom/ rgod pa'ang bying bas gnod pa yin/ /jo bo/ 'o na de la brel bo mchi/ /'brom/ mi mchi cha mnyam byed pa yin/ /jo bo/ dod mnyam de la ji 'dra 'ong / /'brom/ /'byung bzhi snyoms na nad med 'dra/ /jo bo/ gang rung bsgom du mi rung ngam/ /'brom/ bsgom par nus pa gyis dang a/ /jo bo/ bying rgod byung gis dogs lags mod/ /'brom/ de yi phyogs la dogs chung gis/ /jo bo/ ma byung ring la bsgom lags sam/ /'brom/ yang dang yang du bsgom pas chog /jo bo/ bying na lam du 'gro lags sam / 'brom/ bying ba drags drags bsgom nus sam/ /jo bo/ de la srid pa mi khegs lags/ /'brom/ kho bo de 'dra rang cig 'dod/ /jo bo/ da ci'i bying skyon snyel lags sam/ /'brom/ bying skyon shes tshe bsal ba yin/ /—99—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kye skor/jo bo/ de ring gsung gleng sems la phan/ /'brom/ cal col labs rang ma myong ngo / /jo bo/ bying ba bsal ba'i tshoms cig gda'/ /'brom/ gnyis ka bsal ba'i tshoms kyang yod/ /jo bo/ mang lags tshom bu gsum du gda' / de ltar zhus lan bcas pa yi/ /bdag cag gsung gleng mang na yang / /legs par bsdus na 'di tsam yin / / rtag tu sdig dang dga' bral bas/ /gang du mtho ba'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe nga rgyal bcag bya zhing / /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par bya/ /zhus pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe/ /sems kyi gzengs ni bstod par bya/ /gnyis ka stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bcad de bying rgod mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi ba'o// //ba15 snang stong grag stong gi ngang du blo ji ltar stong ba'i lersāyang de 'dra'i bla ma dam pa'i gzhal yas khang du/ bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen des/ phyi rabs kyi sems can shes rab chung ba rnams la dgongs te/ 'di skad ces zhus pa ni/jo bo/ chos pa'i mtshang du gang zhig che/ 'brom/ chags sdang 'di rang che bar gda'/ /jo bo/ chagasasdang rtsa ba gang lags/ pha ches nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gye dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u te shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /khyod rang 'gros ltos zer/ /de nas dpal gyis zhon (bzhonaka pa dang/ /rta des dbang med nyid du khyer/ /de nas nyi ma nub pa dang / /rgyus med lung stong cig tu slebs/ /sdug rta 'di yis bslus so snyam/ /phar cher chur cher bltas tsa na/ /du ba 'phyur ba'i khang pa mthong / /de yi sgo rtsar mgyogs par phyin/ /sgo la brdung zhing bos ca na / / nang nas bud med rgan mo byung/ /legs so mi cig 'dug go zer/ /ma legs mi ma yin par 'dug /do nub 'di yis e bslu yin/ /bslus kyang bya rgyu ci yang med/ /gzhan na 'gro sa ye mi 'dug /stag dang spyang kis zos pa srid/ /de bas 'di la brten pa drag /snyam ste gnas mal thong byas pas/ /cis kyang nang du byon zer skad / / nang du phyin nas bltas tsa na/ /mo la bu mo gsum cam 'dug kho la bza' btung zhim po byin/ / mi khyod 'di ru sus bskyal zer/ /sngar kyi byung tshul bshad ca na/ /da mi khyod la 'gro sa med/ /'di ni gling phran bdag med yin/ /nged kyi skyesapa'ang gum nas med/ /bu mo cig dang khyim gyis la/ khyim 'di'i bdag kyang khyod kyisaugyis/ /phyin kyang gang yang mi sleb zer/ kho snyam de las 'os med snyam/ /bu mo cig dang khyim byas nas/ /bsdad pasalo yang mang po song / /bu tsha'ang ming sring gnyis gsum byung / /nyin cig ma/ de shing la song pha phad bzhi posachu 'gram du/ /rtse mo rtse zhing bsdad pa na/ /chu yi nang du zla ba shar/ /bu tsha cig gis len du phyin/ /de nas byis pa chu yis khyer/ /phas kyang ram mda' rgyugs tsa na/ /phyi la'ang bu cig khyer nas byung / /de nas the tshom du ma langs/ /phyi ma bzung bas snga ma shor/ /bar du gnyis ka ma zin par/ /'gram nas bu mo stag gis khyer/ /res 'ga' stag la ku co 'debs/ /gsum ga ma zin kho rang la/ /shi la khad pas skam la thon/ /sdug nas 'gyel te bsdad pa na/ /chung ma de ru slebs nas byung / /ci byung zer nas byung lugs bshad/ /chung ma'ang skrag nas chu la lcebs/ /ma bu thams cad shi ba mthong / kho bo 'dra ba'i tshogs ma bsags/ /la la dag dang gson bral byas/ /phyi ma bzhi dang shi bral byas/ /nga yang 'di ru shi na bde/ /snyam nas skra spu 'bal ca na/ /mgo yang dkar por song nas 'dug /snying rlung langs te bros tsa na/ /ji zhig tsam nas yul du slebs/ khyim du blta ru phyin tsa na/ /sngar gyi chung ma glu len zhing / /ci byed da dung nyi ma 'des/ kho mos zhabrud pa ma zin zer/ kho ni dad pa gting nas log kho bos ji 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong / /de cam zhig tu stor ba la/ /gcig tsam 'tshol du 'ong ba'am / / ma thang mya ngan mi byed par/ khyod kyi glu rgyang re snyan a/ /byung bas dga' sems mi byed par/ /nyi ma 'de ba'i bslab bya dang / /zer nas sngangs pa chung mas thos/ /chung mas bsams pa skyes pa 'di/ /'khrul lam smyos sam sgyu mas bslus/ /'di la ci zhig byung nas 'dug kho de khyod la ci byung ba/ /mo de yun ring de tsam bral/khyod la da dung rgyus med a/ kho de de 'dra ci la zer/ /da lta rang du lto zos nas/ /da dung 'khrud ma'ang ma zin pa//— 101 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di la ltos dang zer nas bstan/ /ci khyod grogs pos bslus par 'ong / /da dung skud pa'i 'khal 'phro ltos/ /phyi na nyig ge yod ngos shes/ /de nas dpal gyis bsams pa la/ /mo yi zer lugs 'dra na yang / /de kun nga rang 'byul 'khrul 'dra/ /'on kyang lo mang 'brul mi srid/ /bu tsha ming sring gsum tsam skyes/ yī chad rim pa de tsam mthong / /lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis yin/ /zhag po sum rgya drug bcu (cukamachi/ /nyin zhag gcig gi sdug bsngal la/ /de tsam 'khyams na chung ma 'dis/ /nga la slu brid gtong bar 'dug /skud pa blta ru phyin tsa na//da dung sgo drung de na 'dug /da gzod bsams pasasgro 'dogs chod/ /de nas cha /ka 79 ba7 zhag / shas lon pa na/ /grogs po sgyu ma mkhan po byung / khyod dang lo mang ma 'phrad pas/ /skyo bas de ring 'phrad du 'ongs /khyod kyis gang du phyin pa lags/ /dpal gyis sngar gyi byung tshul bshad/ /sgyu ma mkhan po na re mi'i/ /chos rnams sgyu ma'i slu brid lags/ /bden par gyur ba ci yang med/ /bu gsum ma ni mthong ba'ang med/ /lus kyi sbyor ba ga la srid/ /gom gang tsam yang phyin pa med/ /thag ring sleb pa gang nas 'ong / /yud tsam zhig kyang song ba med/ /lo mang sdug pa ga na mchi/ /ji ltar 'khor bar sdug bsngal yang / /bden bden 'dra ste khyod dang mtshungs / / yun ring bskal bar 'khyams gyur kyang / khyod kyi lo ltar 'khyams pa yin/ /rgas pa khyod kyi mgo dang 'dra/ /gzhen pa shi ba'i bu tsha bzhin/ /dgra bo chu ngan de dang 'dra/ /gnyen tshan rgan mo ma mad bzhin/ /pha yul gling phran de dang 'dra/ /nyi ma'i 'char nub slebs dus bzhin/ /bden med bden 'dzin de 'dra yin/ /brtag dpyad mi gtong khyim bdag dpal/ /ye nas stong pa'i gnas lugs de/ /chung ma'i tshig las thos pas go /skud pa mthong bas bsams pas go /da gzod gting tshugs goms pas go /da ni mnyan yod la sogs pa'i/ /yul dang yul can ma lus pa/ /'di dang 'dra'o de la dpyod/ /yang yang soms dang shes par 'gyur / / goms pa'i dbang gis don mthong 'gyur/ /sngon chad 'khor la yid mi ches/ /btsal na mtshan dngos ga la rnyed/ khyod kyis de tsam 'khor gyur kyang / /da gzod ltad med shes pa bzhin/ /sgyu ma mkhan pos de smras pas / / dpal gyis sgyu mas bslus par go /chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyur/ /'khor ba'i chos la yid ma ches / / gnas lugs don la goms byas nas/ /da lta'ang tshul khrims rgyal bar gyur/ /gnas lugs mthong zhing kun la mkhas/ /nga ni sprul pa'i dge slong yin/ /sprul pas sgyu ma sprul ba la/ /snang ba rang yang 'ong mi thang / / 'brom/ sgyu ma'i 'khrul gzhi de 'dra yin/ /'brom/ sprul pa bya ba de 'dra yin/ /'brom/ chags sdang yul yang de dang 'dra/ /'brom/ de bzhin rgyun tu shesapar mdzod/ /jo bo/ sgyu ma'i dpe de go rang bde/ /'brom / khyod la rmi lam go bde mod/ /jo bo/ rgya gar ba la gang go bde/ / 'brom/ sgyu ma 'di rang go bde —102—

'gyur shes nas 'tshal/ /chos pa 'chi khar gyur ba na/ /bag chags bzang po'i snang ba shar/ /rang 'dod ngan pa'i mun pa spangs/ /'di 'ong snyam nas chos la spyad/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun stengs (stangasakashor lags te/ /da ni phyi mar rgyal lo khyod/ /mi rtag lcag gis brabs pa'i tshe/ /'di ni cis kyang 'ong ngo byas/ /'di ru ma zad da rung 'ong / /byung yang da ni mi 'tsher ro/ /dga' zhing gda'/ /ba glang brtul zhugs nyams nas gda'/ /mi gtsang rkyal ba ral nas gda'/ /lo 'dod ljon shing chag nas gda'/ /ngan skyug phung po 'thor nas gda'/ /bsgom mi dgos par lha ru 'gro/ /dag pa'i snang ba rje khyod kyi pha phogs yin/ /'dzad med gter kha bye ba 'bum/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsir 'khyil/ khrus kyi rdzing bu stong phrag stong / /gser gyi sa gzhi g.yu yis brgyan/ /g.yu lo rgyas la sprul pa'i bya/ /kun tu rgyu 'dra bya bas gang / /g.yu mthing dga' bde nyams dgar lding / /yin nam mi dbang 'brom rje'i zhing / /sgo gsum dri ma med pa yin/ /dri med rgyal ba rtag tu mchod/ /nam mkha' khyab par 'gengs par byed/ /'brom rje khyod kyi pha phogs yin/ /glu gar rtse na zhing der rtses/ /nyon mongasagayang la lhung mi 'gyur/ /rgyan cha 'dogs na zhing der thogs/ /mi yi rgyan gyis dper mi rung / /'dod yon spyod na zhing der spyod/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin yin/ /e ma 'brom rje nga la nyon/ /drug bcu (cu3rtsa re'i sdug byas pas//da ni 'bras bu bde ba rgyas/ /bag chags gtsang mar rab sbyangs nas/ /nyam nga skyug bro skye mi srid/ /ma dag bsgoms kyang ga la skye/ /'brom rje sras bcas nyams re dga'/ /'brom rje sras bcas phugs re bde/ /dka 'a —106—

zhing der spyod/ /jo bo / gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /de 'dra mthong bas 'di 'dra spyod/ /nyom mongs bsgom pa chang zhim 'dra/ /'thungs pas skom zhing 'dod pa 'phel/ /yang yang 'thungs pas blo rgod skye/ /ci rnyed zos pas nyams dang ldan//sgog pa la sogs du ma'i slong / /pha sha ma sha khrag mtsho spyod/ /srin po gdong dmar mir gsol ba/ khrel med mjug rdum chu rdo'i lus/ /slong sdud rku 'phrog bla ma'i mtshan/ khyi khrag la shor ji bzhin du/ /rab tu rngams te spyod par byed/ kho bo 'brom rje tshig 'di nyon/ /dga' dga' 'dra ste rgyang ste skyur/ /skyid skyid 'dra ste rtsa ba chod/ /de 'drasami gtsang 'dam du skye/ /de 'dras ma dag zhing du skye/ /de 'dras khyi bong lug rta spyang / /phag pa bya rog lta ba'i lto/ /bza' rgyu mang ste a tsa ma/ /mi 'dis rang nyid ma bslus sam/ /rtog med skad du ci yang dgos/ /skom dad che la gsus pa yangs/ /spyod pa rtsing la tho co 'phel/ /rang gi sha la sus mi za/ /gzhan gyi phyogs la kun tu spyod/ /bya rog lta bu'i chos 'di dor/ /padmo'i tshal du yid mi chags/ /mi gtsang khrod du dga' gar rtse/ /stong ltong 'tsher zhing rdo rje 'gros/ /bya rog chos de rgyangs kyis skyur/ /mi rtag gti mug chen po'i klong / /kun shesa'adod chags chen po'i klong / /zhen med phrag dog chen po'i klong / /dag snang nga rgyal chen po'i klong / /rang phyogasazhe sdang chen por gsal/ /me dpung lnga yi klong dkyil na/ /tshul khrims me tog sreg par byed/ /bde 'bras zil ba skem par byed/ /thal ba g.yang sa gsum la bskur/ /rlung ni nam mkha'i gang khyab 'grim/ /ngo tsha bsrung lugs ro dang 'dra/ /ro ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying / /lus la nyon mongs srin bus za/ /ci byed de 'dra'i bslu brid phag /'bras bu blu po chos pa kun/ /de 'dra'i log shes dor na phan/ /'o na 'dor lugs ji ltar lags / / 'brom rje khyod kyis shod zer na/ /'dam las me tog skyes pa'ang yod/ /me tog 'dam gyis gos pa med / / shes nas skyur ba'i mkhas pa yin/ /shes pa mi rtog me tog 'dra/ /me tog tho cos dgos pa med/ /rnam rtog thog rdzis byed pa 'khrul/ /de bas dkyil 'khor 'di bzhengs mdzod/ /mi rtog dbyings su 'od gsal ba'i / / gzhal yas tshad las 'das par bzhengs/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rang grol ba'i/ /'od gsal lha tsho rta(dkyil 'khor bskyed/ /kun mkhyen sprul pas kun khyab pa'i/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar gyis khod/brgyad khri bzhi stong mi rtog pa'i/ /brag chas 'jig rten khyab par mdzod/ /rgyu rkyen nyon mongs ma khegs na/ /'brasabu de 'dra mi khegs pas/ /rtsa ba chod la dbyings du skyur/ /bskyed rim ye shes sku mchog yin/ /rdzogs rim tshogs gnyis mthar phyin yin/ /ye shes shes bya nyid dang mnyam/ /thugs rje nam mkha' lta bur yangs/ /sna ba'i gdan ni pad zla yin/ /skye ba mang ste rdzus skyes yin/ /mngal ni me tog sbubs su bshad/ /grogs ni —/07—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'od gsal lha tshogs yin/ /ye ge med pa'i gnas lugs la/ /'brom gyi bskyed rdzogs 'di 'drar zang/ /tha snyad yi ge hrīḥl gyis/ /a cang ser po oṃ la gyis/ /e ma ljang khu'i haṃ la gyis/ /mi g.yo mthing nag hūṃ rkyang yin / / de las de 'dra'i gzhal yas bskyed/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin te/ /'brom gyi bskyed rdzogs tsam du zad/ /a cang yi ge ye ges stong / /ye ge 'gyur ba mi rtog bral/ /pad zla nyi ma'ang ye stong pa/ /de la bzhugs pa gang bral ba'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshungs med la/ /dkon mchog 'dus par spyi bos gtugs / / phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i/ /rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal/ /skye gnas 'jig pas ma gos pa'i / / dri med mchod tshogs 'bul lo lha/ /sgo gsum skye gnas 'jig bral ba'i/ /nyes pa'i g.yang samathol lo bshags/ /stong yang sna tshogs skur ston pa'i/ /grangs med 'dren la rjes yi rang / /smon dang mtshan mas stong pa yi/ /'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol/ /skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyed/ /lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin la/ /gang du'ang 'da' bar ma mdzad cig /dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams/ /'di 'drar rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i/ /gzhal yas khang du 'drongs gyur te/ /gsang sngags 'di bzhin spyod par bsngo/ /gnas skabs sdi ya'i lha lnga bzhin / /pad dkar stong ldan lte ba la/ /zla ba zhun ma'i gdan steng du/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de nyid kyi / / bskyed rdzogs mchog tu bsngags par shog /glo bur 'di yang chos dbyings las/ /tha dad ci yang yod ma mchis / / tha dad med par phun tshogs pa'i/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /gtsang ma risakyi bkra shis shog / thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma las/ g.yos pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /'gro ba'i mgon po a ti sha/bdag gi pha phogs dam pa yin/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /bas mtha' dgon par rab gnas shing / /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /bdag gis bdag nyid sba gsung na/ /bdag gi gdul bya gang na yod/ /dgon pa dag kyang bstan par zhu/ /zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gangs can kun gyi mgon po mchog /phyi ma'i dusasu gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang gi cha nas byang phyogs su/ /rgyal yum rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' lung yod/ /byang phyogs 'di nas byang phyogs su/ /rwa sgreng zhes bya'i dgon pa yod/ /der song bdag gis byin gyis brlabs/ /rwa sgreng dpal gyi gtsug lag khang / /rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs par bzhengs/ /de ni khyod kyi dgon pa yin/ /gdul bya dag kyang der 'du'o/ /rwa ni rdul dang bral ba ste/ /chos kyi sgo mo yin zhes gsung //nyon mongs rdul bral chos kyi sgo/ /srid rtse'i mthar thug sgreng bar byed/ /de ni 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi lho phyogs/dmag dpon rin chen gyi lho nub/ khyim bdag rin chen gyi nub byang / btsun mo rin chen gyi byang phyogs/ glang po rin chen gyi byang shar/ nor bu rin chen gyi shar phyogs/ rta mchog rin chen gyi lho shar/ dpal thang rtsibs stong — /0ci—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nye shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gi mgo bo/ rgyal srid sna bdun mdun bstan/ nas/ rje rgyal zhabs la 'dud tshul lo/ /de yang sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng phyogs/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi 'og phyogs/ spang ljang me tog bkra ba'i tshal/ /lhun po sbosangad ldang pa'i 'dabs/ /g.yu mtsho g.yung drung 'khyil ba'i 'gram/ /rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i gseb/ /bya tshogs dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i sa/ /bag phebs ri dwags rgyu ba'i yul/ /grong yul dag la mi nye zhing / /ha cang ring ba'ang ma yin te/ /sus kyang bdag tu 'dzin pa med/ /de bas sa gtsang 'bru sna smin/ /chos la dga' ba'i lha klus gang / khri/ga pa gser ma lug tsam la/ /yal ga bcu ni mdzes par skyes/ khri1ga pa g.yu ma ra tsam la / / yal ga mdzes pa brgyad du 'khrungs/ /mi la ma nges snang ba tsam/ /klu la pho brang nyams dgar snang / /lha la dpag bsam ljon par gda'/ /de ni gser gyi pad sdong ste/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba der bzhugs nas/ /'od ze ra phyogs bcur 'gyed par byed/ /g.yu ma utpal sdong po ste/ /sems dpa' brgyad dang sems mar bcas/ /der bzhugs bde bar gshegs la 'dud/ /slob dpon mkhas btsun 'dzom pa'i rtags/ /dam pa mang bo 'du bar 'tshal/ /yul ni phun sum tshogs par bstan/ /phu rdzogs sangs rgyas gyi nyi ma shar/ /phugs 'bras bu bzang ba'i rtags su 'tshal/ /rgya rig pa'i chu bo mdun du 'bab/ /rje mkhas pa rnams kyis 'dud par 'tshal / / mda' bdud nub mu stegs 'chal ba 'gegs/ /'phral grogs bzang dam pa bsten par 'tshal/khong rgyu skar dag gis lam gsal zhing / /sa gru bzhi dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /gnam gru bzhi yang dag spong ba bzhi / / chu gru bzhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /gdong kha bzhi tshad med bzhi ldan par/ /las ci byed rtag tu dge ba'i rtags/ /rgyab nyon mongs rnam byang gnyen por rgyal/ /sems gdug rtsub g.yo ba'i rlung lam khegs/ /don bde gsal dag par lhan nee ba/ /ltas khyad par 'phags par kho bos 'tshal/ /mdun lho ri babs gyis gzhol ba yis/ /'od stong ldan gsal ba'i nyi ma 'dis/ /rgyu ma rig mun pa bsal bar 'gyur/ /rgyud las can mang po 'byung bar 'tshal/ /rje chos sku tha snyad bral na yang / /las skal ldan mang po'i bsod rnams la/ /rje rgyal ba mang po der lhags te/ /gnas byin gyis rlobs par kho bos 'tshal / /gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang na / / yul phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /chos theg pa chen po'i dga' ston la/ /las skal ldan mang po sdud dang mtshungs/ /rgya che dpangs mtho brjid chags pa'i/ /byang gi ri rgyal lhun po ni/ /rgyal po rgyal srid skyong dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas der gnas te/ /chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bar byed/ /byang shar ri rgyal lhun po ni/ /dmag dpon g.yul du zhugs dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas srung byed cing / /phasakyi rgol ba 'joms par 'tshal/ shar lho'i ri rgyal lhun po ni/ khyim bdag bang mdzod khengs dang mtshungs/ /rgyal —109

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba'i 'byung gnas mchod par byed/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal zhi bar 'tshal/ /lho yi ri rgyal lhun po ni/ /btsun mo skyil krung byas dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bkur byed cing / /dam pa mang po spel bar 'tshal/ lho nub ri rgyal lhun po ni/ /glang chen sna stobs brgyangs dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'degs par byed//theg pa brtan por kho bos 'tshal/ /nub kyi brag ri lhun po ni/ /nor bu'i lhun po brtsegs dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyas par byed/ /smon lam thams cad grub par 'tshal/ /nub byang ri rgyal lhun po ni/ /rta mchog rta sga bsgron pa 'dra/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dren par byed/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa mnga' bar 'tshal/ /mdun gyi dpal thang chen po ni/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong nyid dang mtshungs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas brtan par byed / / mi mthun phyogs kyang 'joms par 'tshal/ /mdun gyi chu rgyun ring ba ni/ /bstan pa yun du gnas par 'tshal/ /nyi ma'i 'char dus snga ba ni/ /slob ma myur du 'du bar 'tshal/ /nyi ma nub dus 'phyi ba ni/ /dam tshig yun ring bsrung bar 'tshal/ /shug nags phyogs mthar rgyas pa 'byung / /bka' gdams phyogs bcur rgyas par 'tshal/ /gangs ri'i dbus na gnas pa ni/ /slob ma'i tshogasarab 'du bar 'tshal/ /klu yi pho brang gnas pa ni/ /longs spyod phongs pa med par 'tshal/ /rus sbal brang kha mnan pa ni/ /'byung ba'i dgra bo non par 'tshal/ /yid chags sdod nyams dga' ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i gnas chen yin par 'tshal/ /lhun po chen po'i rtse mo la/ /ma 'dres g.ya' yi 'od zer g.yo/ /theg pa ma 'dres so sor gsal/ /blo sna mi mang rang tshugs 'dzin//skyes bu gsum gyis ston par 'tshal/ /ri rked spang gi 'od zer yod/ /gnyen po spyi bsdoms che bar 'tshal ri 'dabs nags kyi 'od zer yod/ /slob ma'i tshogs rab 'phel bar 'tshal/ /snyoms pa thang ka 'od zer yod/ /'gro don phyogs ris med par 'tshal/ /'bab pa chu yi 'od zer yod/ /nyon mongs tshad pa zhi bar 'tshal/ /dwangs pa nam mkha'i 'od zer yod/ /dmigs med rgya yis 'debs par 'tshal/ /snum pa zhag gi 'od zer yod /
