/ tshad med rdor gyis 'chun par 'tshal/ /shar gyi brag ri skya bo ni/ /rgya stag kha la 'phyo ba 'dra/ shar gyi phyogs ngan srung byed cing / /mnga' thang dgung dang mnyam par 'tshal/ /lho yi 'bab chu chen po ni/ /g.yu 'brug sa la babasapa 'dra/ /lho yi phyogs ngan srung byed cing / /snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab par 'tshal/ /nub kyi sman thang rgyas pa ni/ /bya dmar gzhog pa bkram pa 'dra/ /nub kyi phyogs ngan srung byed cing / /thab khar longasaspyod 'du bar 'tshal/ /byang gi lhun po chen po la/ /rus sbal rgyab nyi byed pa yod/ /phyogs ngan srung zhing mthun rkyen sgrub / / nga yi gdan sa non par 'tshal/ /shar dmag dpon dang khyim bdag gi dbus nas rom po btsan phyug gi g.yang 'du ste/ mar gser mod/ lho btsun mo dang glang po'i dbus nas klung shod mdzangs dang theg pa'i —/10—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /g.yang 'du ste nas zong mod/ nub nor bu dang rta mchog gi dbus nas 'phan yul rig pa bsam grub kyi g.yang 'du ste rgyags chu mod/ byang rta mchog dang rgyal po'i dbus nas byang snum rtsi'i g.yang 'du ste shar mar dang khams zong mod/ chu mig bcu phrag bcu dang brgyad/ /chu phran brgyad dang chu bor bcas / / phu mda' nags tshal phun sum tshogs/ /dbyar bsil/ dgun dro bsam gtan 'phel/ /kye snying dang 'dra ba'i slob ma/ nyams su len pa'i snod ldan/ thabs shes ldan pa'i mig can/ de dag ni phyi'i ltas phun sum tshogs pa ste/ 'di dag ni byis pa dag gis kyang mthong bar rung gis / 'di dag ni 'phags pa kho na'i spyod yul te / kho bos khyed la bstan par bya'o / / thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyed/ /zhing der rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis byon pa'i tshe/ /lha tshogs stong phrag du mas bsu bar byed/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis 'od spros te/ /mi dbang khyed la dbang bskur byed par 'gyur/ khyod la /ka 86 ba3 rgo'ang/'od zer dpag med 'phros gyur te/ /sa phyogs thams cad byin gyis rlob par byed/ /mkhas pa khyod la bslab bya bya yis nyon/ /gser ma g.yu ma gcod par ma byed par/ /me tog sdong bu dbus su tshud par mdzod/ /rgya bskyed spangs stod ka ba brgya rtsas theg /rin chen lnga las rab du grub pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang du phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas mdzad/ /smad du chu mig ring mo 'bab par mdzod/ /ye shes chu bo khrus kyi rdzing bu mchog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dam pa khyed kyi dbu skra phyogs bcur 'thor/ /nyi khri chig stong padma'i sdong bor 'brungs/ /de la'ang nyi khri chig stong pad 'dab rgyas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus der lhags te/ /gnas lugs yum gyi dga' ston 'gyed par byed/ /padma re la shun pa bdun bdun te/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos kyis brgyan par byed/ /kye de ni spong bdun gos kyis mdzes pa yin/ /mtha' skor dbyibs ni rgyal ba'i zhal nyid de/ /dbu ma pha rol phyin pa drug gis brgyan/ /smin ma smin phrag dkon mchog gsum gyis brgyan/ /spyan gnyis byams dang snying rje chen po ste/ /snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab tshul du yod/ /shangs gnyis 'phags pa'i bden pa gnyis su gda'/ /zhal ni brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo / / zag med bdun rtsi'i chu mig ring mo 'bab/ /der bstan pa yun ring du gnas pas pho brang phun sum tshogib(par bzhengs/ zhes pas thun mong ma yin pa'i 'byung tshul bslab bya dang bcas pa bstan/ pho brang chen po'i shar phyogs su shes ldan zhes bya ba'i padma'i sdong bo yangs shing rgya che ba 'phangs mtho zhing brjid chags pa/mdzesashing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa/ yal 'dab brgyad khri yod pa zhig 'byung la/ de la shar phyogs kyi rgyal ba brgyad khri sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs nas/ thugs rje chen po'i char rgyun 'byin par byed do/ /de yang 'di skad du/ khrel gyi padmo brgyad khri la/ /shar gyi rgyal ba brgyad khri'i tshogs/ /sems — 111 —

bka' gdams dnge/ dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/dpar bcas pa der bzhugs nas/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun 'byin par byed/ /ces bya'o/ /de'i mdun na rgyal ba brgyad khri sems dpar bcas pa rnams kyis/ byin gyis brlabs shing sprul pa shel ldan zhes bya ba'i chu mi/ga yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi na rin po che'i jing bu bzhi yod pa/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba yod de/de la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'dir 'dren zhing zhi bar byed la / ngan 'gro las thar bar byed de/ de yang 'di skad du/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi yi/ /chu mig rdzing bur bcas pa la/ /sus 'thungs de yi sdug bsngal rnams/ /'dren zhing ngan 'gro zhi bar byed/ /cesabya'o/ /pho brang chen po'i lho phyogs su gser ldan zhes bya ba'i padma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba 'phangs mtho zhing brdzid chags pa / mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa yal 'dab brgyad khri yod pa zhig 'byung la/ de la lho phyogs kyi rgyal ba brgyad khri sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs nas byams pa'i chu rgyun 'byin par byed do / / de yang 'di skad du/ gser gyi padma brgyad khri la/ /lho phyogs rgyal ba brgyad khri'i tshogs/ /sems dpar bcas pa der bzhugs nas/ /byams pa'i chu rgyun 'byin par byed/ /ces so/ /de'i mdun na rgyal ba brgyad khri sems dpar bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / sprul ba gser ldan zhes bya ba'i chu mig yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi na rin po che'i rdzing bu bzhi yod pa bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba yod de/ de la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'dir 'dren zhing zhi bar byed la ngan 'gro las thar bar byed do/ /de yang 'di skad du/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdun rtsi yi/ /chu mig rdzing bur bcas pa la/ /sus 'thungs de yi sdug bsngal rnams/ /'dren zhing ngan 'gro zhi bar byed/ /ces bya'o/ /pho brang chen po de'i nub phyogs su zangs ldan zhes bya ba'i padma'i sdong po yangs shing rgya che ba 'phangs mtho zhing brjid chags pa/mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa yal 'dab brgyad khri yod pa zhig 'byung la/ de la nub phyogs kyi rgyal ba brgyad khri sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs nas/ dga' ba'i chu rgyun 'byin par byed de/de yang 'di skad du/ zangs kyi padma brgyad khri la/ /nub kyi rgyal ba brgyad khri'i tshogs/ /sems dpar bcas pa der bzhugs nas/ /dga' ba'i chu rgyun 'byin par byed/ /ces so/ /de'i mdun na rgyal ba brgyad khri sems dpar bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / sprul ba zangs ldan zhes bya ba'i chu mig yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa phyogs bzhi na rin po cheli rdzing bu bzhi yod pa/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba yod de/ de la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'dir 'dren zhing zhi bar byed la ngan 'gro las thar bar byed do/ /de yang 'di skad du/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi yi/ /chu mig rdzing bur bcas pa la//—112—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /sus 'thungs de yi sdug bsngal rnams/ /'dren zhing ngan 'gro zhi bar byed/ /ces bya'o/ /pho brang chen po'i byang phyogs su g.yu ldan zhes bya ba'i padma'i sdong bo yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'phangs mtho zhing brjid chags pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa/ yal 'dab brgyad khri yod pa zhig 'byung la/ de la byang phyogs kyi rgyal ba brgyad khri sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs nas/ mnyam nyid kyi chu rgyun 'byin par byed do / / de yang 'di skad du/ g.yu yi padma brgyad khri la/ /byang gi rgyal ba brgyad khri'i tshogs/ /sems dpar bcas pa der bzhugs nas/ /mnyam nyid chu rgyun 'byin par byed/ /ces bya'o/ /de'i mdun na/ rgyal ba brgyad khri sems dpar bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing sprul ba g.yu ldan zhes bya ba'i chu mig yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ phyogs bzhi na rin po che'i rdzing bu bzhi yod pa bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba yod de/ de la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'dir 'dren zhing zhi bar byed la ngan 'gro lasathar bar byed do/ /de yang 'di skad du/ yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi yi/ /chu mig rdzing bur bcas pa la /sus 'thubs de yi sdug bsngal rnams/ /'dren zhing ngan 'gro zhi bar byed/ /ces bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/khyed kyis ka ba brgyad bteg pa'i pho brang chen po bzhengs kyang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas ni 'di ltar mdzad de pho brang chen po gru bzhi lham par yod pa/ shar phyogs ni shel/ lho phyogs ni gser/ nub phyogasani zangs/ byang phyogs ni g.yu/ /'og ni ind+ra nī la/ steng ni baiḍūrya phun sum tshogs pas gdugs ltar phub pa'o/ /de'i tshad ni 'di lta ste/ shar phyogs la dpag tshad nyi khri/ lho phyogs la nyi khri/ nub phyogs la nyi khri/byang phyogs la nyi khri ste/ mtha' skor la dpag tshad brgyad khri/ 'phangs la dpag tshad nyi khri ste/ gru bzhi lham par gnas so/ /de'i dbus na gser ma dang g.yu ma zhes bya ba padma dang / utpa la'i sdong po rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ 'phangs mtho la brjid chags pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa yal 'dab dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ gser ma'i lte ba la/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku lus gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na rdo rje/ g.yas g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rin po che'i glegs bam re re 'dzin pa/ sras phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bskor ba bzhugs nas/ chos skye ba med pa'i don rgyun mi'achad par ston pa'o/ /g.yu ma'i lte ba la/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po shākya thub pa sku lus gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ spyi gtsug bltar mi mngon pa dang ldan pa/ snam sbyar dang / bla gos dang / mthang gos gsol ba/'khar gsil dang lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sprul sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa la/ 'khor sems dpa' brgyad/ nyan —113—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thos kyi tshul gyis bskor nas yum chen mo rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i tshul gyis ston par mdzad do/ /mdor na pho brang chen po de'i nang du 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i mgon skyabs dam par gyur pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dpag tu med pa 'du bar 'gyur te/ de yang 'di skad du/ gser g.yu'i me tog dpag med la/ /yum chen sras dang bcas pa bzhugs/ /thog mtha' gnyis su dge ba yi/ /chu rgyun ring mo 'byin par byed/ /cesabya'o/ /de lta bu'i pho brang chen po'i mdun na yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sras phyogs bcu'i rgyal bar bcas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po shākya thub pa sras sems dpa' brgyad dang bcasapas byin gyis brlabasashing /sprul ba'i chu mig ring mor grags pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ zag pa med pa'i rdzing bu brgyad kyisabaskor ba / rin po che'i them skas sna tshogs pa yod pa sman sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyi spos ngad dang ldan pa/ de la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa rnams tshe 'di nyid la 'dren te/ la la'i yan lag na/ la la'i nying lag na/ la la'i nang khrol na/ dbyar dus mkhris pa ldang / dpyid dus bad kan ldang /dgun dus rlung rang skye/ ston gyi dus na 'dus pa 'byung ste/ las 'bras la yid ches pa rnams kyi ni/ dge ba'i bskur mar 'byung zhing / gnas lugs kyi don go bas ni tshe 'di nyid la sel bar nulote/ de yang 'di skad du/bstan pa'i chu rgyun ring mo la/ /zag med rdzing bu brgyad kyis bskor/ /'gro ba gang gisade 'thungs na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed/ /ces bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan te/ ma dag pa'i sems can rnams kyis ni thos par yang dka' na/ mthong ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ma ches shing / sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang pho brang po'i phyogs bzhi dang / mtshams bzhi dang brgyad na/ rin po che'i padma'i sdong po yal 'dab stong dang ldan pa bdun phrag gsum gsum ste/ phyogs bzhi na re re'o/ /mtshams bzhi na gnyis gnyis te/ bcu phrag brgyad dang bzhi 'byung ngo / /de dag la byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / khye'u dang / bu mo'i gzugasasu 'dug pa/ pad 'dab dang mnyam par bzhugs nas/ gdul bya phun sum tshogs pa'i chu rgyun 'byin te/ de yang 'di skad du/ phyogs bzhi dag dang mtshams brgyad na/ /padma'i sdong po brgyad bcu (cu1bzhi/ /yal 'dab stong dang ldan pa la/ /gzhon nu sems dpa'i tshogs rnams bzhugs/ /gdul bya skal ldan chu rgyun 'byin/ /tshad med sprin kyang bsdus par byed/ /cesabya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ gragasapa can gyi padma'i sdong po ni/ brgya dang bcu gsum 'byung ngo / /de dag gi mdun na yang / gzhon nu sems dpa'i tshogs stong phrag du ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / sprul pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu mig bzang po dang / /bzang —114—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ldan dang / /dga' ba dang / dga' ldan dang / dri med dang / dri bzang la sogs te bdun phrag gsum gsum 'byung ngo / /phyogs bzhi na re re'o/ /mtshams bzhi na gnyis gnyis te/ chu mig bcu phrag brgyad dang bzhi 'byung la / de dag la 'gro ba gang dang gang gis 'thungs pa de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'dir 'dren zhing zhi bar byed la/ ngan 'gro las thar bar byed de/ de yang 'di skad du/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na/ /gzhon nu sems dpas byin brlabs pa'i/ /skal ldan chu mig brgyad bcu (cukabazhi/ /sus 'thungs sdug bsngal kun las thar/ /zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i/ /shin tu bkra shis nyams dga' ba/ /sman sna brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi/ /dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldan pa/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na/ /gzhon nu sems dpa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzing bu yod/ /sus 'thungs sdug bsngal kun las thar/ /zhes bya'o/ /de dag kyang chu mig gi grangs dang mnyam par gnas so/ /mdor na rdzing bu brgya dang bcu gsum yod do/ /gzhan yang chu mig ring mo'i phyogs bzhi na/ shel dkar po'i chu mig drug /gser ser po'i drug /zangs dmar po'i drug /g.yu sngon po'i chu mig drug ste/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi rgenas la/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi chu gter dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brten nas thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul du gnas te/ chu de la ni 'phags pa rnams kho nas longs spyod par zad kyi/ byis pa rnams kyis ni de lta ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i chu mig kyang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na brgya dang bcu gsum tshang bar gnas so/ /byis pas mthong srid pa'i chu mi ga brgya rtsa brgyad/ mi mthong ba lnga ste/ brgya dang bcu gsum ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang //sprul pa 'i chu mig kho na yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ padma'i sdong po nyi khri chig stong / chu mig dang rdzing bu brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu rtsa drug gnas pa ni/ ma ga dha rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs pa'i gnas chen 'og min chos kyi pho brang dang mtshungs pa'i rwa sgreng dpal gyi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dkyila'akhor me bya'i gdugs phub pa ltar lta bas chog mi shes pa lham me lhang nge 'byung ngo / /de'i mdun na g.yu ma ki(na mo mthing gi mdog de bzhin gshegs pa la yon chab kyi mchod pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /dbyar gyi dus na rin po che'i thang g.yu yi maṇḍal dpag tshad zlum por gnas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog rigs mi 'dra rpābacu gsum 'khrungs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i pha bong rgyan phun sum tshogs par bkod pa/ rgyal ba la tshul du gnas so/ /ston gyi dus na/ gser gyi maṇḍal rgyar dpag tshad du yod pa rin po che'i me tog mi lta 'dra ba bcu gsum 'khrungs pa/ /rin po che sna tshogs pa'i pha bong rgyan phun sum tshogs pas bkod pa — 115—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rgyal ba la mchod pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /dgun gyi dus na/ shel gyi maṇḍal rgyar dpag tshad du yod pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi pha bong rgyan du mas bkod pa rgyal ba la mchod pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /dpyid kyi dus na/ shel gyi maṇḍal gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa la g.yu'i phra btab pa ltar yod pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi pha bong rgyan du bkod pa rgyal ba la mchod pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /rin po che lhun po sna bdun ni rgyal ba la mchod pa'i tshul du bskor te gnas so/ /rin po che'i sa gzhi la padma 'dab ma brgyad rgyal ba 'debs shing mchod pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /nor bu rin po che'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rgyal ba la gdugs phub pa'i tshul du gnas so/ /rang bzhin gyi 'od bdun/ nyi zla'i 'od dang brgyad rgyal ba la gsal zhing sgron me 'bul ba'i tshul du gnas so/ /btsun mo rin chen gyi ri bo rgyal ba la zhal zas 'bul ba'i tshul du gnas so/ /lhun po'i ngos la rdzas kyi rdo rje pha lam / gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon po can de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsrungs kyi tshul du gnas so/ /mdor na phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na/ bkra shis kyi rdzas/ bkra shis kyi rtags/ sa dgra gnon pa'i lha blos mi 'khyud cing dpag tu med par bzhugs te/ de dag gi rang bzhin 'phags pa rnams kho nas mthong ba'i chos so/ /lha rnams kyis ni rin po che'i ri dang / la las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / rgyal rigs la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam dang / me tog gi sdong po dang / dpag bsam gyi sdong po dang / chu mig dang /rdzing bu bdud rtsi chu mig dang / khrus kyi rdzing bur mthong ste/ mdor na lung pa dang / ri klung thams cad lha'i 'dra bar mthong ngo/ /mi rnams la ni dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis las/ dag pa rnams kyis lung pa'i phyogs ma nor ba / / ri klung chags legs pa/ shug pa'i nags tshal rgyas pa/ chu shing phun sum tshogs pa longs spyod dang ldan par mthong ngo / /ri rab lhun po'ang rgya che ba/ 'phangs mtho ba/ ri rtse drug tu gnas pa/ g.yasan ri dma' ba gsum / g.yon na dma' ba gnyis/ dbus ma lhag par mtho bar mthong ngo / /de'i 'og na spang ljongasaldebasache ba / de'i 'og na ri phran gsum yod pa/ g.yas dang g.yon na ri shal le ba gnyis yod pa/ shug gseb shar nub na shug pa cung zad srab pa gnyis yod pa/ de'i 'og cung zad na chu mig gnyis yod pa/ de'i 'og na chu mi/ga chen po cig yod pa/ de'i steng na gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs pa de lta bu zhig tu mthong ngo / /de'i 'og na chu chen po drag cing rgyun ring ba/ thang chen po pha bong mang po col le yod pa/ lung ba'i sul mang ba/ phu dang mda' cung zad dog pa/ lung ba'i mthil slang nga ltar zlum khyil bar yod pa/ nyi ma 'char snga ba rgas pa 'phyi ba de lta bur mthong zhing / bsam shes kun gyis bstod par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ khyod kyi dgon pa der bzhengs/ khyod kyi gdul bya rnams kyang der 'du/ chos nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa gnyis kyi dbu mdzad/ la la ni — 116—

sgru/ ches 'i shu rtsa cu ga snyesmus zhus lan gyi dngos gzhe nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /byang chub sem/sa dpa'i mtshan du grags pa/ la la ni dgra bcom pa'i ma/chan du grags pa/ la la ni byams pa'i /rka 91 zha 1rgo (rnal 'byor ba byams pa'i blo gros ) mtshan du grags pa/ la la ni shwakya'i (khams pa lung pa shwakya yon tan)mchan du grags pa/ la la (dgon ba ba dbang phyug rgyal mchan)ni dbang phyug gi mtshan du grags pa/la la ni brnga ma gtan gyi mchan du grags pa/ la la (rnal 'byor ba shes rab rdo rje)ni shes rab kyi mtshan du grags pa/ ma tshan don dang ldan pa mang po 'du bar 'gyur la/ thams cad kyang sems can gyi don phun sum tshogs par byed cing / khyed kyi bka' brgyud mi/ nyams par 'jin te// khyad nga/ra du'ang dkon ma/chog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad nga/ra byed nga/ gsum (sku mched gsum/) 'byung ste/ gcig (pu to nga/ rin chen gsal)gis bstan pa'i gzhung 'jin/ gcig (spyan snga ba chul khrim/sa 'bar) gis gdams nga/'i nying khu len/ gcig (phu chung ba gzhon du rgyal mtshan/ gis rang rgyud kyi tha rgod 'dul/ mdor na bka' gdams mthar rgyas par byed/ de dag ni dag pa'i mi'o/ /ma dag pa'i mi ni/ khyod kyis bka' brgyud la 'phya zhing / gnas der mi 'ong mi mthong / snyelas rgyu 'bras kyi shan mi phyed/ gnas lugs kyi don mi go de bas na khyod kyi gdul byar mi 'gyur te/sems can la skal ba med na rgyal bas kyang btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas /bdud sdig to can bar chad mang bas/ gal te khyod kyi gnas der byung srid na/ gdul bya mthu chung ba re re cam/ la las 'bras kyi rten 'brel cung zad sgrib ste/ sprul ba'i chu 'thungs pas sdug bsngal cung zad drangs pa'i sems can dag chu la smod cing / /sdug bsngal drangs par mi lta/ las 'bras zhib mo mi shes/ des log lta cung zad skye ste/ tshul khrims la gces spras su mi byed par ngan 'gror 'gro srid de/ sprul ba'i chu des yun mi ring bar thar bar byed do/ /zhes lung bstan pa dang / /'brom gyi zhal nas/ jo bo/ zhus lan du ma gsungs na yang //hril te gril (drilakan 'di lta ste/ /bas mtha' dgon par gnas bya shing / /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /bdag gis bdag nyid sba bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la sogs pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'// //

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tsa17 snarsha(lugasaphun sum tshogasapa'i lephywayang gnas de nyid du de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des 'di skad ces zhus pa ni/ kye bla ma dam pa gsan du gsol/ /chos bzang po dge ba yang ldan te/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i chos su gnang / /lha 'gran zla med pa'i /ka91 ba3 dkon mchog gsum/chos su gnang / /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i rgyan du gnang / khrims yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten de/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i zhing du gnang / chos 'dzad med gser gi bang mdzod de/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i phogs su gnang / /sman ljon pa stong ldan nad sel de/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i sman du gnang / /las ci byed rtag tu dge ba de/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i bya bar gnang / /chos bstan pa zab mo'i chu rgyun de/ /nga gser bya spyod pa'i dga' bder gnang / /spyir phan bde'i man ngag rin chen mtsho/ /gzhi gram bu gser gyi bye ma brdal/ /mtha' stong ldan mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spud / / sems bzang ldan 'dzin pa'i legs bshad de/ /nga bka' gdams brtse ba'i gnas su gnang / /kye sum cu rtsa gsum khang bzang na/ khong lha dbang 'byor pa chos kyis brgyan/ /lha nye dbang rnams kyis rab mchod cing / / nyams dpag med dga' ba'i zhing khams bzhin/ /nga bka' gdams tshad med khang bzang nas/ /chos 'byor ba bslab gsum ngang gis 'phel/ khong drang srong khrims ldan du mas bskor/ /nyams dpag med dga' ba'i lo 'dab rgyas/ /bkra shis so bka' gdams lhar bcas rnams/ yar shag cig grangs med sems can rnams/ /nga skyob bo lha chos bdun ldan gyis/ /phugs btsan no thar ba'i zhing khams yin/ /'phral bde'o g.yang sa med pa'i chos/ /grogs bzang ngo chos ldan 'ba' zhig yin/ /don bzang ngo 'di bde'i ro las dben//nga kun tu dge ba'i bka' gdams la/ khong gtsang ma'i rigs rnams ma lus 'dun/ /da dga' ba sgoms shig nyams len can/ /drin che'o bla ma a ti sha /chos go bde zab rgyas mang po thos/ /da de la'ang nan tan bslab bya mdzod / / rje khyed kyi bka' dang mi 'gal lo/ /sras thu bos dbyangs su de zhus pas/ /lan rjes su mthun par 'di gsung skad/ /'brom gting mtha' zab pa'i rgya mtsho khyod/ khyod gting mtha' gang gis mi g.yo bar/ kha g.yo ba ltar snang khrem gnyer can/ /'brom khyod la mthu yod skal bar bzang / /rje bde gshegs gsung rnams brgyud pa yi/ /rje bla mar bcas la ngas zhus nas/ /sras thu bo khyod la'ang gang 'byor byin/ /da (de1dam bca' 'dor na dam pa min/ /da khur chen ma bor yi dam chos/ /bu le lo snyom las sgyid lug rnams/ /tshe mi rtag mi shes rnams la 'byung / khyod rtag 'dzin bral la de byung na/ /dgra bdag gis byas pa'i le lan ded/ khyod sngar gyi —118—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u ni shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /sdug la ma bred par/ /dus da dung bred shul 'grim mam ci ya'i pha mar bcas pa 'di yis bslus/ /tshul bdag 'dzin dgra mgo mi 'joms par/ /phar spang bya mang po spong spong nas/ /de spang byar ma lang thams cad 'jog / dgra ngos ma zin pas lan pa yin/ /ngos stong gi rtswa phur ji bzhin du/ /bsdoms rtswa phur 'dra bas bdag bslus nas/ /ngos stong dang 'dra ba'i spang bya rnams/ /bdag de dang 'dra bar ga la 'gyur/ /kye rtswa phur 'byin pa gnad du che/ /chu 'go brgya zam pa gcig tu 'du/ /'go thams cad bskor na ga na lang / /de shes par byas na mkhas pa yin/ /da zam pa 'grim pa gnad du che/ /shing ta la byur du shes pa gang / /rtse yan lag bcad kyi ga la lang / /gzhi rtsa ba gcod pa gnad du che/ /'brom phung byed thams cad bdag 'dzin yin/ /bdag 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /don yod med shes na mkhas par grags/ /'di yod par zhen na dmyal khams 'grim/ /dus nyin mtshan med par rngan bgrang zhing / /'dir le lo snyom las 'bad pas choms/ /'brom ji skad gsung bzhin de 'dra ba'i/ /rgyud mi rtog gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs rnams/ /las phra zhing phra ba'i nyes byas kyang / / mig dbang bo dwangs ma'i rdul bzhin du/ kho ji ltar chung yang mi bzod par/ /las 'bad pas 'dor la nan tan mdzod/ /kye brtul zhugs 'di yis mtha' 'bras ni/ /'brom khyed ni mtshungs pa med pa yin/ /bu theg pa rin chen them skas la/ /dus rim gyis 'dzegs dang btsan sa zin/ /kye chig chod gsungs pa yod na yang / khong drang don rgyal ba nyid la dgongs/ /bu khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos dka'/ /bu ltos pa med pa'i ltos chos dka'/ /bu gzhag bya med pa'i 'jog byed dka'/ /'brom rgyu med pa yi 'bras bu ci/ khong rgyal la byis pa 'gran pa rnams/ /'brom 'phral du ji ltar nyams par 'gyur/ /phugs ci thob byed na rim gyis bzang /de shes par mdzod la rgyu 'bras la/ /yid gzhan du ma 'chugs gces par mdzod/ /don bden med ngang du khyer dang 'brom/ /de bdag gi bslab bya nan yin no/ /yang bla ma'i gsung de gsan nga/ dang / sras mtshungs pa med par dga' bzhin du/ /gdan me tog padma'i steng bzhugs nas/ /rgyud tshul khrims dag pa'i mdo bton tshe/ /'brom rang gi grogs po rnal 'byol ba/ /gnas rgya gar yul na bzang ba cig /rje bla ma'i drung du mjal zer nas / / rje mtshungs pa med kyi zhabs btud nas/ /legs 'gran zla med kyi a ti sha /nged rnam rtog med pa'i rnala'abyol ba/ /gnas mi gtsang khrod dang pad tshal la/ /don cung zad tsam yang khyad mchis sam/ /nged rtog med bag yangs skyong ba la/ /las nyon mongs mi skye ji ltar skye/ /'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gsung tsa na'ang //ngaji mi mnyam pa sras su mnyam/ /kye gzigs dang snying rje 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zas dkar gsum mngar dang 'di dag la/ khyad cung zad tsam yang mchis sam 'brom/ khong thod par dri chen rab blugs nas/ /phyag srin lag —119—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/g.yon pas rab dkrugs shing / /ro zhim zhim skad du rkan sgra tog /gos lwa ba phud nas gcer mor byung / /sku dag kyang dri ma dag gis byugs/ /dus dang por skye bas stong ngo 'brom/ /dus tha mar 'chi bas stong ngo 'brom/ /dus da lta gnas pas stong ngo 'brom/ /nga de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /gnas 'khor bar dbang med ga la 'khyams / / rdzas gang la'ang bzang ngan zhen pa bral/ /nga gang du bsdad kyang gtsang btsog med/ /nga rnam rteg rang grol theg pa yin/ /sems gtsang mar bzung na rtog bcas yin/ /nga rtog pa med pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /nga rtog pa med pa'i rnal 'byor gtsang / /nyams dpag med dga' na de dga'o/ /grogs rnal 'byor mchog gis de gsungs pa/ /'brom dge bsnyen ston pas de gsan pas/ /sku zla ba zhun ma lta bur bstan/ /skra g.yu yi ral ba sil bur gsil/ /lus mdzes pa phyi gsal nang gsal ba/ /rje bde gshegs gsal ba'i me long bkram/ /lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ /phyag g.yas na gser gyi gzhu chung bsnams/ /phyag g.yon na g.yu yi pe wang bzung / / sku padma'i steng na cung zad 'gying / /'dzum 'od zer stong ldan phyogs bcur 'phro/ /gzhu de yis pe wang rab bsgyur bas/ /sgra snyan pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'tsher/ /sa thams cad dal bus g.yo ba snya/ma/ /lus thams cung zad 'dar ba snyam/ /'od me tog sbrang char dal bus 'bab/ /ltas de dag gtsang ma'i lha yi/ thos/ /dus skad cig nyid la sa phyogs der/ /'brom dkar gsum mngar gyis mchod byed cing / /'brom ji ltar mdzad pa'i rjes su 'jug /'brom tshig 'bru bzang po 'di gsungs pa/ /hrī:skye ba med pa'i chos dbyings nas/ /gzugs snang stong 'ja' ltar shar na yang / /don bdag med snang bar khyab mod kyang / /sku 'di ltar mdzes pa su la sgrib/ /zas 'dod yon chos dang bral na yang / /zas 'di ltar gtsang bas ci la sgrib/ /don bden med dag pa'i snang ba la / / las smon lam dbang gis 'di 'dra ste/ /nga zhen pa'i rnam rtog ci yang med/ /lar 'on kyang snang cam mnyam po la/ /gzigs de dang 'di la khyad par gsal/ khong rgyal la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / khong gdul bya dang ba 'dren na legs/ /mtshan dpe byad brgya dang bcu gnyis kyang / /don legs par dpyad na bden bral mod / / 'dir 'di 'dra'i sku la khyad 'phags mod/ /gnas mi gtsang khrod rnams ye stong yang / /gnas 'di las pad tshal khyad 'phags mod/ /gnas 'khor ba dag tu khyad med kyang / /lha mnar med dag la ga la smon/ /ya'i chosal bzang ngan bral na yang / /nga mu stegs rjes su ga la 'jug /zas bden pa'i chos las 'dasan yang / /zas 'di la yid smon su zhig 'cha'/ /gos stong pa'i gnas lugs nyid yin yang / /'dir ro langs spyod pa ji ltar skyong / /nga snang tsam pañtsa li ka'i gos/ /rje rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mgo bo brgyan/ /gnas thamasacad rgyan cha dus mas brgyan/ /lus 'di 'dra bstan yang 'di 'dra nyid/ /'khor 'di 'dra brje yang 'di 'dra nyid/ /'phral —/20—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dnges ga'e nor bu'i phreng ba le'u te shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /'di 'dra phugs kyang 'di 'dra nyid/ /kye grogs po pad sdong gnas 'dir byon/ /lus de la snang cam cung zad bsgyur / / nga 'jig rten kun tu dag snang bas/ /grogs khyed kyi lus kyang shel dkar 'dra/ /nga 'di las ma g.yos kun tu spyod/ /mi khyod la 'dra yang gzhan mi 'dra/ /lha phag gi sku dang 'od dpag med/ /mi khyod la 'dra ste gdul bya gang / /legs nor bu brtsegs 'drar 'dod rnams la/ khyod gsal la ma 'dres 'phags par 'gyur//dus da dung nga yi rjes 'brang rnams/ /rgyud brtul zhugs 'di las ma g.yos par/ /dus rgyun chad med par 'di bzhin shog /sras grub thob gnyis kyi gsung gsan nas/ /chos thun mong nyid du 'di lta ste/ /gson mar me mdzad dpal bzang po nga / /spyir 'khor 'das chos la mkhas gyur kyang / khong don la grub pa cang mi gda'/ /lar kun rdzob 'di la ci yang snang / /chos thams cad mnyam nyid rtogs pa rab/ /gnas gcang zhing mi gcang du ma na/ /zas bzang dang ngan pa dpag med kyang / /sems rnam rtog med par mkhyen pa rgyal/ /lar ma ga dha yi gdan steng du/ /rje rgyal ba du ma/ sangs rgyas pa'ang / /'brom ji 'dra de 'drar mngon sangs rgyas/ /thugs ḍio bhi khyed dang khyad mi mnga'/ /sgos gdul bya'i rnam 'dren 'brom rje'i lugs/ /don gsal la ma 'dres so sor phyed / / sems snang ba cam/ po sus bltas kyang / /don 'di ni gdams par 'os pa'i rigs/ /don hril te gril (drilakan ches dbyings/ las/ /dus skad cig cam yang 'da' ba med/ khyed zhabs tog chen po grub thob gnyis / / dus da dung 'di bzhin rang sar mdzod/ /chos gnad du phyin na gang yang zab/ /dpe khyed kyi 'di dang mtshungs pa yid/ /rje bla ma'i gsung de thob pa dang / /sras a wa dhū ti'i dbyings su gshegs/ /sras 'brom rje sngar las ma g.yos par/ /rje bla ma'i drung du 'di skad gsung / /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po a ti sha /rje bla ma/ dam pas byin brlabs nas/ /nged slob ma gnyis dang lhan cig tu/ /dus de ring zhus lan ma/nga na yang / /don hril te gril (drilaka na 'di cam yin/ /rtag tu yi dam brtan bya zhing / /le lo snyom pa'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe bdag la rngan bgrang zhing / /brtul zhugs snying po dran par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ dam bca' mi 'dor ba dang / chos lugs phun sum tshogs pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'// //

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tsha18 gzhan gyi semasabazung ba'i lelgayang gnas de nyid du de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du/ /bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des 'di skad ces zhus pa ni/ jo bo gzhan dag mthong na ji ltar bgyi/ /'brom/ zhi ba des pa gsong por smyos//jo bo/ gnod pa skyel na ji tsug bya/ /'brom/ lan du khro gtum zlog ma byed/ /jo bo/ ma byas kyang ni gnod skyel na / 'brom/ mi rtog rtag tu 'dzum me sdod/ /jo bo/ de rang dka' mo rang lags so/ /'brom/ dka' bas bsod nams che ba yin/ /jo bo/ bsod nams che ba ji ltar lags/ /'brom/ lag len byas ngos shes pa'i phyir / / jo bo/ zhi des gsong por ji ltar smra/ /'brom/ 'khur tshig bstod ra gang shes bya/ /he he mad lags mi shesasam/ /jo bo/ bdag gisabyasapas 'tshal lags kyi/ /'brom/ ci zer dang du len pa yin/ /jo bo/ skad kyang che chung ran por byed/ /'brom/ de la shin tu gzhung sring 'tshal/ jo bo/ nyin re'i 'grogs bdes cang mi phan / / 'brom/ ring du bzhu na lcags kyang 'dzad/ /'brom/ gser gling pa yi zhal snga nas/ /zhi zhing dul la smra mkhas pa'i/ /'khur skyong mkhas pa'i sems dpa' gang / /nag po bdud kyis mi brdzi na/ /drag po gang gis de 'khrugs 'gyur/ /'brom/ a wa dhū ti'i zhal snga nas/ /phan sems zhi dul ldan pa yi/ /semasadapa'i tshig de thos na bde/ /byad bzhin ci 'dra'ang yi gar 'ong / /mthong na bde ba skyed byed yin/ /'brom/ dze tā ri yi zhal snga nas/ /yon tan gzhi legs gong na med/ /blo gsal kun gyi dpyad gzhi che/ /bram ze gtum yang khro ba med//rtag tu 'dzum pa'i ngang can yin/ /'brom/ rakṣi ta yi zhal snga nas/ /gshin rjes gsod kyang gsong bor smra/ khro gnyer gting du khro byed na/ /sdang lan sdig par ldog ste 'joms/ /di paṃ khyod bzhin zhi na bzang / /'brom/ shānti pa yi zhal snga nas/ /bzhin mthong tshe na pha ma 'dra/ /gtam ni khyim gsar sgeg mo bzhin/ khro gnyer rgyan cha dang mtshungs so/ /'dzum chags lha mo'i tshul bzhin no/ /'brom/ ḍio bhi pa yi zhal snga nas/ /sgra rnams gling bu'i sgra dang mtshungs/ /ci te snyan cing zhi mi smra/ /chos rnams rmi lam don 'dra na/ khro gnyer ngo dgas ci zhig bya/ /rtag tu gzhan gyi sems zhabrugs na/ /nyin gcig 'dzum pas ci ste stong / /'brom/ rig pa'i khu byug zhal snga nas/ /brag cha lta bu'i sgra rnams la/ /bden dang chen pa mi mnga' bas/ /mtshan mar ma 'dzin lhod de skyur / /smra na zhi des gsong bor smros/ /gzhan la khro gnyer bzhin gnag na/ /'bras bu rang gis lus ngan thob/ /snang ba tsam gyis lus rgas na'ang / /myur du dī paṃ khyed 'dra bgyi/ /dbu ma'i dbang ni khyod la bskur/ /chos rnams 'di las ma g.yos so/ /nyams len sgro skur med par mdzosdo/12/༵di ni bdag gis gdams pa yin/ /bla ma de 'dra

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gsungs nas gshegs/ /'brom/ nā ro pa yi zhal snga nas/ /ji ltar srid pa g.yos kyang rung / /'jam des phan sems ma g.yo cig /ji ltar pha mas bsad kyang rung / /sdang tshig khro ba ma smra zhig /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la'ang / / sdang tshig bsam ngan mi rgyu zhing / /snying rje chen pos bsgral bar rigs/ /rang lus ji ltar brlag kyang rung / / sangs rgyas bstan pa de ltar min/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung bya nyid/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba thabs mkhas nyid / / gdams pa yin no di paṃ gsung / /'brom/ shes rab bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ /tai lo chos kyi dbyings bzhugs nas/ /log pa'i lam du gol ma myong / khro tshig 'khon du mi 'dzin cing / /bsdu ba rnams bzhis lag len gyis/ /dam pa'i spyod pa gzhan don yin/ /de la su la gshe zhing khro/ /'brom/ slob ma mang ste nga la gnang //bdag kyang dam pa yin par bstan/ /bdag gis chos 'di khyed la gnang / /dam pa yin par kho bos shes/ /jo bo / rjes su yi rang legs par gsungs/ /jo bo/ rgyun du mthong na ji ltar bgyi/ /'brom/ drin can nyid du shes par mdzod/ /jo bo/ de la phan lan ji ltar gdags/ /'brom/ chags pa med par dgos tshad byin/ /jo bo/chags pa med pa'i mtshan nyid ci/ /'brom/ /ser sna mi byed ster ba yin/ /jo bo/ ster tshul gcig tsam gsung bar zhu/ /'brom/ bla ma rnams kyis gnang ba yin/ /yod na rgyal srid sbyin par thong / /gzhan gyis thob tshe dga' ba bsgoms (sgomasaka / /gang yod rang yul sbyin par thong / /yul 'khor nor rdzas sbyin par thong / /zas gos sman rnams chags med thong / /rta dang 'dod 'jo spyin par thong / /bran g.yog la sogs ci dgos byin / / gzhan yang mgo dang rkang pa dang / /lag pa dag dang sor mo dang / /klad pa klad rgyas snying khrag dang / /rgyu ma gnye ma mchin pa dang / /glo ba zhag dang mkhal ma dang / /mdor na mi gtsang lus ngan 'dis/ /rin chen rin thang med pa yi/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sku mchog ci thob kyis/ /chags med gtong ba gnad du gsung / /stag mo lus sbyin la sogs pa'i/ /dka' spyad mdo na gsal ba yang / /nyin dang mtshan du blta bar 'tshal/ /'brom/ sa ra ha yi zhal snga nas/ /lus 'di stong du gyes kyang sla/ /phangs pa med par gtong ba gces/ /re dang ltos pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /sbyin pa mchog de dag pa yin/ /'khor gsum dag la ma zhen par/ /gtong ba mchog de bsngags pa yin/ /lus 'dis gzhan rgyud tshim pa la/ /dga' ba mchog de sbyin pa yin/ /'brom/ rnal 'byor klu mo ma yi zhal snga nas/ /lus ngan mchan dper bsgyur ba yi/ /dpa' bo mchog gang kho mos mthong / /srog chags ma lus bsad byas nas/ /shi ba med par bde bar mthong / /nga lus sangasporgyas bstan las skyes/ /skyed byed gang de drin chen yin/ /drin lan 'jal bar mi byed par/ /de las khur chen su zhig yin/ kho mo de khur mi byed par/ /snyoms par byed pa ga la rigs/ /des dza lus kyang chags — /23—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ —med par/ /bstan pa'i don du btang bar bya/ /de ni pha ma nyid kyang yin/ /chags pa med par gang dgos byin/ /sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs par g.yab/ /snyan par smra ba'i tshig gis dgrol/ /don bstan lus kyi bag phab ste/ /gtan gyi gros chen gdab par rigs/ kho bo'i bla ma de bden gsung / /jo bo/ mkhyen rab rgyasapa'i gang chen mtsho/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yangs pa'i gzhi/ /gang nas spyad kyang mi 'dzad pa/ /'gro ba'i lam ston 'phags pa'i yab/ /bla ma'i gsung rab rin chen thos/ /tshe 'di nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'du long che ste 'jig par sla/ /da ni 'gro ba gang mthong yang / /zhi ba gang dang nges pa gang / /'jam pa gang dang mnyen pa gang / / gsal bar smra dang lhag chad med/ /gang la phan par smra bar bya/ khro dang bzhin 'gyur mi ston cing / /ngo dga'i 'dzum gyis ma bslus par/ /rtag tu gting nas 'dzum par bya/ /rgyun chad med par gzhan mthong yang / /pha ma gnyis las ma 'das na/ /de drin yal bar ga la 'dor/ /lus dang yo byad chos rnams kyis/ /skal ba mnyam par tshim par bya/ /gang dang gang zhig tshim pa'i mthar / /dga' ba rgyas pa'i snang ba las/ /'gyod sems skad cig mi bya'o/ /'brom/ tshe rabs kun tu de bzhin mdzod/ /de ni rnyed pa'i mchog tu bsngags/ /de ni gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /ji ltar bya ba'i tshoms yin no/ /jo bo/ ding sang snyigs ma'i dus tshod 'dir/ /'og ma rnams ni phra bas 'tshog /gong ma rnams ni mgo bos brdung / /mnyam po rnams la lag pas 'tshog /ma dag kun spyod 'di 'dra ba'i/ /snyigs ma'i dus tshod byung de gda'/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang 'das tshul bstan/ /dgra bcom rnams kyang gzhan du gshegs/ khyed kyis gsal bar ma mdzad na/ /bod 'di da tshod brlag par 'gyur//jo bo/ bdag la de gsum skyes gyur na/ /bdag gis de dag ji ltar spang / /'brom/ rtsa ba thamasacad phrag dog yin / / gong ma mi theg skur ba 'debs/ /snying rje med pas 'og ma 'joms/ /ngo tsha khrel med mnyam la 'dzugs / / phrag dog spangs na zhi gnas 'gro/ /dga' ba bsgom pa thabs su che/ /'brom/ zla ba gragasapa'i zhal snga nas/ /phrag dog rang gi dge rtsa 'joms/ /gzhan la phan na rang don mchog /dpa' bo spyi ched byasapa yi / / spyi yis dpa' bo bkur ba bzhin/ /ston pas gdul bya bskyangs pa yis/ /gdul byas ston pa mchod dang mtshungs / / e ma gzod nas ma skyes pa'i/ /snang tsam 'di la ci yang 'byung / /snang tsam khyad gsod mi byed pa'i / / skyes bu gang de gnas lugs blang / /rgyal po rgyal srid nyams pa yang / /phrag dog nyid kyis nyams par grags / / 'brom/ he ru ka yi zhal snga nas/ /phrag dog chags sdang du ma'i gzhi/ /chags sdang can gyis lha mi mthong / / de la mchog gi dngos grub nyams/ /phrag dog so sor rtog pa yi/ /ye shes mchog tu bsgyur shes pa'i / / skyes bu de ni dpa' bo yin/ /ngo mtshar che gsungs/ /jo bo/ rnyed dka'i dal 'buor mchog thob nas/ /— 124—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus snyepan gye dnges gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u te shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs se/ /thar ba'i bud shing nyon mongs kyi/ /me yis bsreg par ga la byed/ /gzhan mthong pha ma mthong ba yin/ /rang dang mnyam pa ngo mtshar gyis/ /dma' ba gong du drang bar rigs/ /bskal ba me lcer gyur ba yang / /gzhan gyi don du brtson byed na/ /phrag dog byed pa su zhig smyo/ /jo bo/ smyon pa'i spyod pa mi bya'o/ /'brom/ phrag dog spong ba mchog tu bsngags/ /'di ni gdams pa rin chen yin/ /legs par gsungs so a ti sha /phrag dog spong ba'i tshoms cig gda'/ /jo bo/ gzhan sems bsrung na ji ltar bya/ /'brom/ rtsod pa thams cad spongs la thong / / jo bo/ rtsod pa spong na ji ltar bya/ /'brom/ rang la khug la len no gyis/ /jo bo/ des kyang long bar ma gyur na/ /'brom/ dgra de snying khong phod du tshud/ /jo bo/ /dgra de ngan 'gror shor na ji cug bya/ /'brom/ gnod lan bde na dam par gsungs/ /jo bo/ de 'dra rang yang ci mchi'am/ /'brom/ ci zer sdug bsngal blang dgos mod / / jo bo/ gzhan yang drang lugs gsung du gsol/ / 'brom/ kho yi don du smon lam gdab/ /jo bo/ smon lam gcig gnyis gdab tu gsol/ /'brom/ sngon gyi las kyis 'dir ded pa'i/ /bsam pa ma dag las ngan 'dis / / bdag gi lus la gnod skyel kyang / /gnod lan yong ye ma gyur cig /bdag gi lus 'dis 'grongs gyur cig /'di yis srog gcod mtha' mar gyur/ /'brom/ smon lam 'debs shing mi khro ba'i/ /skyes bu de ni dam pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mchog tu bsngags/ /jo bo/ bdag lus stong du rab gtubs kyang / /'khrug pa yong ye ma gyur cig /da ni bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /thams cad 'grongs pa dang du blang / /bla ma'i gsung ngag mi bcag par/ /'di bzhin gzhan sems gzung bar bya/ /'brom/ legs par bsdus la mkhas pa yin / / legs par bsdus la nga la phul/ /jo bo/ zhus lan du ma mdzad na yang / /legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste / / gal te gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /zhi des gsong bor smra ba dang / khrod gnyer ngo 'dzum spang bya zhing / /rtag tu 'dzum zhing gnas par bya/ /rgyun du gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /ser sna med cing sbyin la dga'/ /phrag dog thams cad spang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi sems ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rtsod pa thams cad spang bya zhing / /rtag tu bzod dang ldan par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yis/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ /gzhan gyi sems /ka 97 na 5 rgoji ltar/ bsrung ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //— /25—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dza19 rtag tu gzhan don byed pa'i lelgayang gnas de nyid du de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du/ bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des 'di skad ces zhus pa ni/ jo bo/ mi dang 'grogs pa'i man ngag cig zhu/ 'brom/ nyi ma nyin cig gi ngo dga' dang che mthor gyis tshugs mi thub pas/ dus rtag tu ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyis tshugs thub par gyis/ jo bo/yon tan gyi gzhi ma mi gzhi legs po dang dad pa gal gang che/ 'brom/ gnyis ka gal che/ jo bo/ mi dang 'grogs na gal gang che/ 'brom/ thun mong du mi gzhi legs po gal che/ bzang sna 'dren pa la dad pa gal che/jo bo/ mi gzhi legs po byed pa la ji 'dra cig 'tshal/ 'brom/ khyod bod kyi mi chen 'dra ba byas na mi gzhi legs po mi 'ong / yon tan gang gi phyogs nas che yang / nga mi rgyal ba mtho dman bar gsum gyi 'og tu zhugs nas / mi rung ba ma gtogs pa ci zer 'dzum gyis sgrub pa cig dgos pa yin/ jo bo/ blo sna yar la 'khrid pa'i dad pa de ci 'dra ba cig dgos/ 'brom/ yul khyad par can mthong tsa na mig mchi ma 'khrug lus kyi ba spu g.yo rjes su yi rang dang / re ltos kyi yus kyis shugs rings 'don zhing gsol ba 'debs pa cig 'ong ba yin/ jo bo / kho bo'i dad pas gzhan blo sna yar la ji ltar 'khrid/ 'brom/ kho mi gzhi legs pas thams cad kyi sems zin pa de dang ma ngu na bu ngu ba bzhin du kho la brten nas dad pa mi skye rang dbang med pa cig 'ong ba yin/'brom / gsha' ma byed byed pas gang byas kyang mdzes pa cig 'ong ba yin/ des smras pa'i gtam la'ang tshad mar 'dzin pa cig 'ong ba yin/ jo bo/ 'o na slob ma'i snod brtag pa rang la'ang mi gzhi rang brtag 'tshal lam/'brom / nyon cig spyir rgyu nyon mongs pa la byas/ mtho ris mir skye lo byas kyang / nang sems kyi rgyan khrel gyis btang / phyi ngo mo'i gos kyis bslus/ phyi thag gser gyi mjug ma bcad/ rgyud la khro gtum gyi phra btab/ gzhi ma ko skam gyi lham gyon pa la rgyan dam pa lha chos pas snod pas ni/ khong skye bo mi chos pa'i snod du'ang mi rung / mi de'i rigs la ni/ dgra dang dbul phongs kho na mod pa yin/ jo bo/ de 'dra ba'i mi rigs la brten na ji ltar 'ong / 'brom/ bzod pa bsgom na rang rten 'tshal/ bzod pa mi thub na dge ba bcom pa srid/ jo bo/ zhing khams gtsang ma kun nas btsal yang ma rnyed pa yin par 'dug 'brom/ 'o cag mi mjed 'jig rten pa la de mod pa cig yod kyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bgos rgyal lo/ /ma bslus pa ni 'tshal lo/ /jo bo/ 'di la bzod pa bsgom na tshe phyi ma rang la gzugs bzang po thob ste 'ong / 'brom/ phyi ma'i sngon du 'di nyid rang la bzod pa gang bsgom rgyal nas 'ong / ma tha'ang khrom rgyal sdes khas 'byed pa yin/ jo bo/ gsar 'grogs byed — 126—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /pa'i mi la ji 'dra cig 'ong / 'brom/ dang po ngo shes tshad bshes su song / tha mar thams cad dgra ru song ba cig 'ong / jo bo/ 'o na ngo dga' che mthor byed pa de la ji 'dra cig 'ong / 'brom/ de la'ang thams cad kyis dang por 'grogs bde mor brtsi/ kho'i gnas lugs rtogs nas klad sla na kha brdar kha gsag mkhan de la rgyu mtshan ye med zer nas mjug kun gyis brnyas pa cig 'ong / jo bo/ de rang ci mchi'am/ dus ngan gyi mi bya ba/ phugs ci 'dra na'ang 'dra/ 'phral ngo dga' che mthor re cam byas na/ yod sa med sa nas phan 'dogs par snang /'brom / de'i rigs des khong rang gnyis ka de kho nar sgrub bo/ /de yang phyi ma zhan zhan tsam yin/ jo bo/ da lta mi 'ga' zhig sngar yang ngan song gsum su skyes/ phyi ma'ang ngan song gsum du skye/ de ma rtogs par 'di'i snang ba 'ba' zhig byed la/ phyi ma'i don skad cig kyang mi byed pa de ci 'dra/ 'brom/ mi 'dod pa can cig gis mya ngam gyi thang stong pa chen po cig la/ ngal stegs tsam med par khur chen po cig khur nas phyin na/ bsdad na mi longs / ma bsdad na shin tu ngal te/ gsigs pas khur chen po ni yo/ 'chos su ni ma bde sdug bsngal bzhin du phyin pa na/ ngal stegs cung zad cig rnyed pa'i steng du/ ngal bsos pas bde ba chen po cig rnyed/ bde ba de la chags nas/ khur po mi 'chos par nyal te/ da lta rang khur te phyin pas ring por ma phyin pa na 'di snyam ste/ a tsa ma nga 'dra ba cig da ci ngal bso (gso dus su khur po mi 'chos par/ nga thang stong 'di la phog ste bcos na ni mi longs/ ma bcos na ni 'di ltar nyam thag snyam mo/ /ci bya la stor de 'phyis pa yin/ 'brom/ de bzhin du/sngar ngan song chen po'i mya ngam la sdug bsngal/ 'gror ma bde/ sdod du ma bde/ khur po 'chos su ma bde/ nyam thag pa'i rjes su mir skye ba blangs/ de ngal gso ba dang 'dra/ de'i dus su khur chen po mi/ 'chos par/ tshe 'di'i gsog rum dang / khengs grags dang / rang re'i kha 'dzin shags 'debs/ tshe 'di'i nyon mongs kyi bde ba la chags nas/ yang sdug bsngal gyis khur khur nas 'chi ba lags mod/ de nas shes pa skye ba bdun gsal gyi dus su/ nga 'dra ba'i tshogs ma bsags pa/ tshe snga ma ngan song gsum du skyes nas gda' ba/ 'dir ngal stegs du ma cig byung nas 'dug pa la/ de la phyi ma'i 'dun ma ma byas par/ nga yang ngan song gsum du skye bar 'dug snyam nas/ sdug bsngal gyi snang bas khrid de/ ngan song du ci bya la stor ba'i dus cig 'ong / 'brom/ khur chen po 'chos dus yin/ dus skye ba gtan gyi btsan sa de ring la bzung ran no/ /jo bo dpe 'grig 'brom/ don yang de bzhin no/ /'brom/ gser gling pa gi zhal snga nas/ khrel gzhung med pa'i mi dag ni/ /rang 'dod bsam pa'i g.yo sgyu yis/ /skye bo gang zhig tshig gi slu/ /nyi ma 'ga' zhig mchod byed cing / /phyi nas sngar yang don med pa'i//'dun mas bshes kyang dgra bor len/ /de 'dra de ni bsten mi bya/ /des ni dang po'i sems bskyed bral/ /de ni —127—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/bdud du shes te spongs/ /yang na snying rjes sdug bsngal lam/ /yang na de nyid gang dga' bya/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam/ /zhes gsungs/ bla mas gnang ba'i chos zab/ de ni ngo dga' dang gsar 'grogs mi byed pa'i tshoms so// //jo bo/ so so'i skye bo ma dag pa'i blo la/ rang gi phyogs thams cad nas 'bungs kyang / kho la rnam rtog phyin ci log tu gyur nas ci byas kyang mgu ba'i dus mi 'ong bar gda' ba/ de 'dra'i rigs la ji ltar bya/ 'brom/ kho ji 'dra na'ang 'dra/ rang gis brnyas pa'i sems skad cig kyang mi byed par/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gus pa'i sems kyis byas na/ lhas mi khrel ba yin/ jo bo/ de lta bu'i gang zag de ci 'dra yin/ 'brom/ gang zag bzang po la bzang pos tshod lta ba'ang 'ong / sdig tos byin gyis brlabs pa'ang 'ong / jo bo/ sdig tos byin gyis brlabs pa la gus pa byar rung ngam/ 'brom/ kho'i rjes su nyon mongs pa ma 'brengs pas chog pa yin/ gzhan kho gang dga' ba ltar byed pa de thabs mkhas pa yin/ jo bo/ gnas lugs kyi don la sgrib pa la sgrib pa gang che/'brom / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa 'di che ba yin/ jo bo/ de sems can nyon mongs pa la tshan che bar yod na/ de dag bsal nas gdams ngag byed na ji 'dra cig bgyid lags/ 'brom/ snying rjes phan sems gal che / jo bo/ chos thams cad rang la snying rje phan sems gal che ba ma lags sem/ 'brom/ de bas kho bo de skad zer / de med na gzung 'jin gi rnam par rtog pa shas chen po rnams mi thul/ jo bo/ 'o na 'jig rten gyi yams nad chen po 'go ba'i nad kyi gseb tu/ phan sems kyis phyin na 'go'am mi 'go 'brom/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ma zhugs par phan sems kho nas phyin na/ de mi 'go bar ma zad/ sngags nag gi phur pa dang / mu stegs kyi ngan sngags kyi sna dang / ma mo'i rbod kha dang / /dmag 'khrug byed pa'i gseb tu phyin kyang / de la gnod pa 'ong mi srid/ jo bo/ phan sems chen po de skye ba la rgyu gang gal che/ 'brom snying rje drag po thun mong ma yin pa de gal che'o/ /jo bo/ snying rje bsgom pa'i thabs shig zhu 'tshal/ 'brom/ zhu ba che/ sems can nad drag pos gzir ba'i rtsar rgyug de sems can thams cad 'a/ dmigs pa kho bo la/ sems can thams cad kyis 'di lta bu'i lus blangs pas lus 'di yod na nad 'di 'byung mdze thog tu phol/ gnyan thog tu gzer/ /gzer thog tu'ang gzer bsnan/ sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba 'ba' zhig 'ong ba snying re rje/ a tsa ma/ 'di gzhan min/ nga yang yang skyed pa'i pha ma yin pa snyam du rtsa ba'i ma me dong du lhung ba'i snying rje tsam du mi bzod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du dbul ba dang / phongs pa dang / bkres skom/ gos med pa rnams kyi rtsar phyin zhing / yang de kho na bzhin du snying rje sgoms/ rang gi spyil bu na gnas pa'i tshe yang / dmyal ba yi dwags la sogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sems — 128—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhe nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /brtse yam yam pa sgoms/ de yang bzod glags med par bsgoms (sgomasaka / de yang bying rgod la sogs pa yang sngar bstan pa bzhin du sel /ka 99 ba2 spel zhing spel/ zhing bsgoms (sgomasaka/ 'brom/ gcig gi skyo bsangs gcig la byas pas 'ong ba yin/ yang snying rje re dang / tshad med re dang / mi rtog pa re spel zhing spel zhing bsgoms pas 'ong ba yin/ jo bo/ snying rje'i mtshan nyid ji 'dra zhig yin/ 'brom/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sems la bzod glags med pa cig yin/ jo bo/ nga'i lugs kyi tshad med bzhi'i 'go gang nas rtsom/ 'brom/ sems la bzod glags med pa cig byung na/ de la 'dod 'dod kyi sems skye ba cig 'ong ba yin / dper na bu mo dong du lhung na/ ma la bzod glags med pa'i sems skye ste/ bya ba gal che che bo thams cad lang nge long nge skyur nas/ bu gcig pu ci thon gyis sems su sdos /ka 99 ba5 rngams/ (bsdos3nas 'gro'abrom / gzhan du bu la byams pa chen po yod kyang / bu de tsam du mi nyes na bya ba gzhan gtso bor byed do/ /'brom / sems cad thams cad la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje yod na/ bya ba thams cad dor nas/ sems can ci 'drongs byed pa cig 'ong / de la brten nas pha ma yin ngos shes par go nye ring cig kyang med/ de dag bde na dang skyid na dga' ba'i sems 'ba' zhig spyod do/ /de yang sangs rgyas thob na bde skyid thams cad zhor la 'ong bas/ sangs rgyas la ci 'khod byed pa 'ong / 'brom/ des na snying rje chen po nas 'go bzung la/ snying rje ba'i sems can rnams su yin pa ltos/ pha mar shes tsa na/ phan ci thogs kyi byams pa gyis/ byams sdo (bdo1 tsa na/ thams cad skyid na dga' ba/ sangs rgyas na dga' ba'i dga' ba bsgoms (sgor/saka /dga' sdo (bdo3tsa na/ thams cad la nye ring dang phyogs ris med pa/ rang skyid pa la nye ring med pa ba'in/btang snyoms chen pos khyab par gyis/ thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis sleb bar gyis/ 'brom/de ni phan sems kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin/ snying rje la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad kyang 'byung na / gang zag re re la phan sems byed pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ jo bo/ 'o na phan sems kyi gdams ngag gi dngos gzhi rang gang la bstan/ 'brom/ dang po yul khyad par can la skyabs su 'gro/ bar du 'khor 'das kyi skyon yon shes par byas nas/ gzhan don byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ de nas lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la 'bad lugs/ 'khor ba'i nye dmigs bstan zhing bskul ma 'debs pa/ mthar bsngo ba smon/ lam dang bcas te phan seskas kyis ston pa de zer ba lags mod/ jo bo/ de ltar zhus lan mang na yang / skabs don hril gyis gril (drilakan 'di lta ste/ ngo dga' med cing gsar 'grogs med/ /rtag tu tshugs ni thub par bya/ /gzhan la brnyas pa spang bya zhing / /gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas par bya/ /gzhan la gdams ngag byed pa'i tshe/ /— 129—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/snying rje phan sems ldan par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/rtag tu gzhan don byed pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu ba'o// //wa20 chosagazhan la skur ba mi 'debasapar zab chosanyamasasu len pa'i legayang gnas de nyid du/ de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du/ /bdag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des / / 'di skad ces zhus pa/ jo bo/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ chos pa rigasami 'dra ba du ma re la chos lugs kyang rigs mi 'dra ba du ma re re/ de la lag len gyi byed lugs kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa re re/gzhan phar bzhag pa'i bla ma cig gi gsung la'ang / slob ma du yod pa de'i 'dod lugs re re/ thams cad kyang da khyod/ nged kyi chos lugs dang / khyed kyi chos lugs/ 'gal 'gal 'dra ba mang po gda' ba las jo bo/khyed kyis kun mkhyed pas de rnams la nges par gang lam du 'gro ba yin/ gang mi 'gro ba yin zhus pas/'brom / 'di kun sangs rgyas kyi shes bya yin/ chos gang la'ang skur ba mi 'debs pa dang / rang rang gang mos pa de la 'dun pa drag tu byed pa dang / rang gi chos lugs de la bla ma mkhas pa'i gsung gis sgro 'dogs bcad/bde bar gshegs pa'i lung na ci 'dug re re'i rig pas kyang lam du gang 'gro dpyad nas/ lam du 'gro nges shes pa de la/ ye ge 'bri mchod la sogs pa'am/ dge ba bcu'am/ pha rol phyin pa bcu'am/ yang na 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon bsam pa/ de'i blang dor gyi lag len/ yan lag bdun pa/ de dag thams cad kyi rjes dge ba'i rtsa bar bsngo ba ste/ chos spyod bcu'am/ dge ba bcu bo de dag skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sbyod pa yin pas nyin dang mtshan du phyed mar 'bad par bya'o/ /'brom/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal snga nas/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos spyod bcu ldan pas/ /dge ba bcu ni nyin dang mtshan du 'phel / / blang dor shes shing yan lag bdun ldan bsngo/ /dam pa'i spyod pa 'di bcu bsten cig rje/ /zhes gsung / 'brom/ bcom ldan klu sgrub snying bo'i zhal snga nas/ mi rtog pha rol phyin bcu nyin mtshan du/ /yan lag bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab brtson/ /'di ni skyes bu dam pa'i spyod pa yin/ /des ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas kun sangs rgya/ /'brom/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi zhal snga nas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chang dang kha thon byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang bsgom pa'o/ /chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /gsung / zab zab/ jo bo/ slob dpon dbyigs gnyen gyi de g.yin na yang grags pa yod/ jo bos de gar gsan/ 'brom/ kha che khri bstan byang phyogs na/ kho bo mi rtog rgyu —130—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ba'i tshe/ /ba su ban dha mkhas pa mchog /dī paṃ nga la rab gzigs nas/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho mkhas gyur kyang / /bsdus nas bcu ni mi len na/ /gar gyi bshad pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /bzo rig bsdus te yi ger bris / / bsam gyis mi khyab mchod par bzhes/ /chags pa med par kun tu byin/ /ji ltar mkhas kyang thos la brtson / / klog pa'i 'khor lo rgyun du bskor/ /ma lus dril la sems la longs/ /bshad tshogs rgya mtsho rgyas par mdzod/ /bar la kha thon kun tu spyod/ kha thon ma bsams tshig tu zad/ /bsams nas bsgom na mchog tu bshad / / stan thog gcig tu 'di ltar mdzod/ /tshig bzhir bris la 'dod la byin/ /dam pa dag la mchod pa nyid / / bshes med rang gi bklags te mnyan/ /tshig don sems la blangs te bcangs/ /mngon dang mi mngon kun la bshad/ /bklags te ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang / /don la bsams shing yang yang bsgom/ /bdag gi nyams len yin gyis long / /chos spyod 'di bcu sus spyod pa/ /tshad las 'das pa'i bsod nams thob/ /'brom/ de lta bas na nyams len bya 'tshal/ jo bo/ chos lugs de ltar mang yang / lam du 'gro ba'i gnad de gang lags/'brom / gzhan don du sangs rgya bar 'dod nas de'i gegs bdag gnyis su 'dzin pa spong zhing / chags sdang gi dri mas ma gos pa de lags mod/ jo bo/ de 'dra ba'i blo mi skye ba'i chos pa mang / gnas skabs gyi 'bras bu bde ba thob pa ni mang / 'brom ci byed rang don du byas/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor bdag phyed dang gnyis las ma 'das pa tsam du byas/ 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i skyid 'dod can des sangs rgyas su mi phyin/ jo bo/ skyabs kyi khyad par rang che lags sam/ 'brom/ skyabs la khyad par che/ 'khor ba la 'jigs shing skrag nas/ dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bsgom pa ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song na/ thabs sna tshogs kyis chos lugs gang mos pa la 'jug /lam gyi 'gro lugs gang byas kyang / mthar sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed/ jo bo/ lab lob mang kha na med/ chos lugs gang byed/ cha lugs ci byed/ grogs su dang 'grogs/gnas mal gang du sdod/ spyod lam ci byed kyang ngang gis grangs med par 'khyams par shes pa cig dgos/ de la skye 'chi'i phreng ba 'ba' zhig la spyad/ shi thengs re la skye thengs re/ skye thengs re la pha ma re pha ma re la'ang grangs med skyes/ pha ma nam mkhas khyab tshad snying snyoms pa pha ma bu tshas khyab par byas/ pha ma 'di dag rgyu nyon mongs pa 'ba' zhig la spyod/ 'bras bu ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong /'di dag nga la drang ba bab/ las rgyu 'bras 'di bden ngos shes/ mi slu zhing rjes su 'brang ngos shes/ 'di ltar mnyagapo la'ang bde sdug go bzlog (ldogaka pa mang po gda' ba snyam du 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la che re nye re lta'atshal/ skyid ji tsam zhig 'dug /sdug ci tsam zhig 'dug las ngan pa ma bsags pa'i sdug ni mi myong /—131 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dge ba sna re tsam ma byas pa'i bde ba ni mi myong / jo bo/ mkhyen rgya che yang sems can la mi phan pa'i gdams ngag la dgos pa mi snang / 'dus la bdag 'dzin la 'jug pa cig dgos pa yin/ da 'di 'dra ba'i 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong bzhin du pha ma skyobs tshigs mi byed pa'i khrel med po/ le lo dang phyi bshol byed pa'i snyom las can 'dis thar ba thob pa'i skabs med/ jo bo/ mi tshe hril bo la chos mi byed pa la snyad gsum las med/kho dang po chung dus su da gzod yar la tshar tsa na chos shig bya yis da dung mi 'ongs snyam/ kho na so dar la bab tsa na nga yar la ma rgas/ mar la ma gzhon/ da lta gang yang 'ong ba'i dus 'dir nor bsags dgra btul/ gnyen bskyangs / rgas khar bu tsha bo tshar nas/ mi rgan la zhabs tog byed tsa na a pos chos shig bya yis da lta mi 'ong snyam/ kho da gzod rgas shing 'khogs/ gang gi yang 'khos ka med tsa na/ da nga kun rgas pa yin/ na ning nas gzhon pa'i dus de tsa na chos shig byas na 'ong ba cig yong ba yin te ma byung / da khyed gshon pa rnams kyis gyis dang zer nas/ phu phu bu zer zhing sug bzhi btsugs nas langs pa'i dus su/ bu tsha re ltos can de kun gyis snyan ming du sdug rgan rlag rgan shi dus med pa 'di kun shi na phan te zer/ jo bo/ kho la skyid cig byung nas mi gda'am kho la chos byung na ri bong la rwa skyes/ snyad gsum pyoode las chos 'dor ba'i thabs che ba med/ jo bo/da der ma shor ba cig cis kyang 'tshal/ gzhon na gzhon te gzhon nu rab byung chos byed palidus/ dar la babs na sgo gsum gyis dge ba gang byed kyang 'ong bas chos byed pa'i dus/ rgas na rgas te da cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba la nye 'chi kha ma'i chos bsam/ nges par 'ong ba phyi ma'i rgyags phye cig dgos snyam du chos mi 'jog pa'i rkyen gsum byas te/ shi la thug kyang chos la brtson pa gal che/ pha ma drang ba gal che/ pha ma ma rung ba rnams drang ba la/ bdag la bskos med pas mi 'drongs kyang / mgon skyabs grogs ldan dkon mchog la zhuso snyam du 'jigs pa las skyob pa la jo bo bzang po dgos pas/ lha jo bo dkon mchog gsum la blo snying brang gsum gtad la/ bdag pha ma dang bcas pa rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol/ pha ma'i don du bdag myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes skyabs 'gro byed cing / spang bya 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gnyen po gcig pu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon bsam par bya 'tshal / jo bo/ de gnyis shes/ spang bya spangs/ blang bya blangs/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa ni sangs rgyas yin/sangs rgyas thob nas sems can sgrol ba cig 'tshal mod/ de med par lam du mi 'gro/ mtho ris thob pa'i gzhi gcig po (puka tshul khrims sna re tsam bsrung ba'am/ ha re long rnams skye shi la sogs pa sdug bsngal char bzhin du 'bab bzhin du/ da nga la 'chi ba cig 'ong snyam pa'am/ shi bas mi chog skye dgos/ ngan song gsum du —132—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos ga'e nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /skyes na ji cug byed snyam pa'am/ ma tha mi rtag pa skad cig ma re'ang mi bsgom par/ phar lta chur lta/ res 'ga' mi 'tshengs pa re la'ang bzhad gad byed/ dga' dga' 'dra ba re shes/ res 'ga' sdug bsngal ma 'tshengs pa re myong ba la'ang mya ngan ngu 'bod smre sngags 'don/ chen po la mi ngu chung ngu la pu pha ma thams cad sdug bsngal ba la mi ngu / gcig gum na ngu / gcig pu de yang rtag tu skye 'chi byed pa de la mi ngu bar lan gcig shi ba de la ngu / snga phyi med pa mthong ba'i sdug bsngal nyi tshe ba/ phugs ma mthong ba'i 'phral nyes par lta/ khyi ngan pa'i rnam thar bya ba lags / khyi kho bdag pos phyin nas/ dgra bo'i 'jigs pa 'ong pa'i dus su'ang / khos zugs na dgras cher nas gnod pa skyel du 'ong bas/ bdag pos thag pa btags te/ phugs su sbas na/ kho gsod pa cam/ du tshor nas mi nyan/ phugs su ngu zhing mi bzod par phyir bros nas rmugs pas dgras gsod/ zhor la bdag po'ang 'gro / de dang 'dra par tshe 'di'i 'dun ma 'ba' zhig las phyi ma lta rgyu ye med par tha na skyabs 'gro tshig gcig byed pa'am/ thos pa rna ba gang byed pa'am/ kha thon sna re tsam re byed pa'am/ yul khyad par can la phyag gus pa cig 'tshal ba'am/ bskor ba bskor ba cig byed pa'am/ gzhan chos byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba cam cig byed pa'am/ ma mtha' tshe 'di la'ang phan la re/ gtor ma deb rtse cig gtong ba'am/ de 'dra med par ming chos par btags nas/ gzhan chos byed ngos shes pa cig 'dug na de la zog por 'dogs/ tshig ma/spas pa cig 'dug na kha bshad/ yon tan cha cha nas che na ye mi theg /bcun tshugs can la nyan thos/ nyan bshad pa la bshad pas mi phan/ dge slong bzang po la lhung ba'i snod kyis dgos pa med/ su mi rung ba la 'dzem pa la rtog pa'i gag /ka 103 na2 gang zag/tshud zer/ jo bo/ de 'dra ba la lam du 'gro mi 'gro'i don med/ hril te gril (drilakan/ chos byed pa'i mi de la 'di 'dra cig dgos/ ngas bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa la yun ring du bsten nas/ gzhung man ngag thams cad kyi the tshom chod par byas/ da dung nga la bya rgyu chos las mi 'dug / legs na'ang dkon mchog gsum shes/ nyes na'ang dkon mchog gsum shes/ tshul gnas thos bsam sgom gsum la skal ba ma pham par blangs pa yin/ ma shi na'ang tshogs gnyis bre sogs phul sogs legs / gzhan du da lta shi na yang 'gyod pa med zer ba cig dgos/ gnyen po gzhu bzang po'i rgyud 'dra ba spring nge ba cig dgos/ /sbyor ba tsan dan gyi me 'dra ba tsha ba cig dgos/ chos zhus na gla hel 'dra ba gang nas 'then 'then yod pa cig dgos/ de 'dra ba'i gang zag la cha lugs ngur smrig 'dzin pa yin na'ang rab yin mod/gzhan rang rgyud thul na'ang gang byas kyang skyon mi mchi/ rab tu cig byung phan chad bdud mo mtshar mo brgyas slu mi nus pa/ bdud nag po brgyas kyang chos dang 'brel mi nus pa de 'dra cig 'tshal/ de lta bu'i chos pa gang la'ang — /33—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/skur ba btab tu mi rung / byed lugs sna tshogs pa cig 'ong ba yin/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so ma 'chugs na des chog pa yin/ zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom/ 'di khyed rang gis shes na nga la dri ci dgos/ 'o na'ang de rnams la skyon mi gda' yis/ jo bo/ rang gis shes pas ci phan gzhan phan gyi chos la zlos pa'i skyon med/khyed bla ma yin pas zhus pa yin mod da gzod rang dga' spang sla ba'i dgos pa yod/ gzhan yid ches pa'i dgos pa yod/ 'brom/ khyod kyi de la skyon med/ ngas chos thams cad hril te gril (drilakab cig khyod la sbyin / jo bo zhu 'tshal/ chos bya ba de 'dra cig dgos/ mang na nyams su mi lon pa yin/ /legs po mang na 'dam kha mi rigs pa yin/ 'brom/ 'di sems la zung zhig bdag thong / g.yin long / 'od kyi gur la bzhugs / snang ba la ltos/ gzhi rtsa chod/ ngo bosastong / dpyad na ma rnyed pa/ de lam du song lam de mi ldog pa yin no/ /jo bo/ chos de zab pa cig byung / 'brom/ gnas lugs tshad med rgyud la gril (dril1/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas chod/ de ni mi ldog pa yin no/ /nam mkha' gnas kyi bar du bsten/ 'brom/ chosalugs mang yang rang lugs bzung / /rang lugs ma zhen gzhan la'ang slobs/ /gzhan lugs dag la sgro skur spongs/ /thams cad slob la gcig tu gril (drilaka / /'brom/ zhing sagashin na gang btab skye/ /bsam pa bzang la 'dod dgu 'byung / /brtson sbyor can la bar chad med/ /blang dor mkhas pa thar bar 'gro/ /'brom/ de yang 'di lta ste/ snang ba'i thabs kyis 'gro ba drongs/ /shes rab dbyingasasu gzims la bzhugs/ /jo bo/ legs so mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /hril te gril (dril1na 'di nyid yin/ / /ka 103 ba5 rgode ltar zhus lan mang na yang / kho bos bsdus na 'di lta ste/ //chos la skur ba mi 'debs shing / /gang mos de la 'dun pa dang / /chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgo nas ni/ /nyin mtshan med par 'bad par bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhuso len nor bu'i phreng ba las chos gzhan la skur ba mi 'debs par zab chos nyams su len pa'i le'u ste nyi shu ba'// //zha21 ba11 shid sdig pa bshagab(pa'iletha/yang gnas de nyid du de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du/ bdag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa desa'adi skad ces zhusapa ni/ bdag gi bla ma a ti sha /yang dag lam ston dge pa'i bshes/ /sdom pa gsum gyis phyug pa yi/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa khyed/ /seng ldeng nags dang khyad med pa'i/ /sgrol ma'i zhing khams gnas mchog 'dir/ /grong gi pha ma bu tsha bzhin/ /bag phebs zhus len nor bu'i phreng / /blun po rnams dang —134—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /mthun slad du/ /thun mong go bde 'ba' zhig gleng / khyed kyi yon tan ma lus spyad/ /snying gi thig le la sogs pa'i / / gsang dbang zab mo sems la bskur/ /rdo rje 'dzin par byin gyis brlabs/ /ye stong ngang du bdag gzhan gnyis/ /brje bar mdzad pa mdo sde yi/ /chos dbang zab mo sems la bskur/ /blang dor mkhas pa 'dul ba yi/ khrims gyi pad tshal nyi zla rnams/ /yon tan gzhi rten mchog tu snang / /phar phyin drug la nyin mtshan du/ /thos bsam bsgom par dril te 'bad/ /da ni sgo gsum dge ba yi/ /dus gsum dag tu 'bad pa rnams / / mthar thug mchog tu bsngo bar rigs/ /lha cig mi g.yo 'dzum bag can/ /skad rigs mi 'dra dpag med kyang / khyod kyis ma 'dres so sor gsungs/ khyed kyis phra rags nyes pa'i tshogs/ /gang gis ma gos khrims gtsang ba/ /phra zhib rgyu 'bras gsal mdzad pa/ khyed ni bdag gi bla ma yin/ /tshad med stobs kyis skad cig kyang / /'gro ba yal bar mi 'dor bar/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos spyod par/ khyed ni bdag gi bla ma yin/thams cad snang stong zung sbrel nas/ /spyi dang byed brag ma 'dres par/ /so sor phyed par mkhas mdzad pa/ khyed ni bdag gi bla ma yin/ /sgo gsum dbyings na bzhugs na yang / /thams cad lha skur gsal mdzad de/ /bskyed rdzogs nang du gsal mdzad pa/ khyed ni bdag gi bla ma yin/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs na yang / /las 'bras khyad du mi gsod par/ /sgo gsum dge bar 'khol mdzad pa/ /'dren pa khyed ni bla ma yin/ /nyes pa ma lus spangs na yang / /sdom brtson nyid du ston mdzad pa/ /rgyal rigs dge slong dam pa khyed/ yākya'i sras yin bla ma yin/ /thams cad thugs su chud na yang / /mi mngon nang du sped mdzad pa/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dam pa khyed / / skal ldan nga yi bla ma yin/ /gsang sngags zab mo nyin mtshan du/ /dbang bzhi bskyed rdzogs sbrel na yang / / dam tshig nyams chags mi srid pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma yin/ /bskyed rdzogs cig gis kun ston kyang / gsang sgrogs ci yang mi mnga' ba'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rigs 'dzin khyod/ /ces gsung pa'i skabs su jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom tshud 'brom tshud gsungs nas/ 'brom rje bdag gi bla ma yin/ /thams cad rigs lnga'i skor ldog kyang / /thabs kyis nyan thos skur ston pa'i/ /chos rgyal ye shes lnga yi bdag /bka' gdams bdag gi bla ma yin/ /des jo bo mnyes yul gyi skad kyis ma bsgribs kyang / /gzhan ngor bod skad ma byed par//nga la lhug par ston mdzad pa'i/ /skal ba gzigs te bla ma yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams dpag med kyang / /dbu ru byang phyogs 'dir byon nas/ /nga yi zhing bcur sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /las 'phro gzigs de bla ma yin/ /e ma ho 'gran zla med pa'i sku/ /yan lag drug bcus (cusakaphyed pa'i gsung / /yon tan thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs/ /dkon mchog gsum nyid bla ma yin/ /byang chub sems da/pa' ma lus yab/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun — 135—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gyi rje/ /rnam thar gtsang ma dang len yang / /nyan rang zhi tshol ('tsholakabla mar 'dzin/ /gang la gang ston mkhas pa'i gnad/ /zab don sped la mkhas pa'i gnad/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mi mngon gnad/ khrigra 'bras phra mo nyams len gnad/ /gnad kyi nyan rang blo dman zhing / /stong dang gsang sngags zab mo yi/ /tshig kyang blo la mi shong na'ang / /nga yi bla ma mchog tu 'dzin/ /gzhan du phal chen sde pa yin/ /nang gi gnas lugs mthong gyur na/ /nyan thos 'dra yang bskrad pa srid/ /mi sprod dge slong spyi bor 'khur/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bla ma khyed/ /brjod kyis milang yon tan rdzogs/ /bla ma gcig pu rnyed dus 'dir/ /gtan gyi btsan sar ma bsngos na/ /de nas dpang po btsal bar dka'/ /da ni bsngo ba mdzad du gsol/ /gces par bzung ba'i lus la sogs/ /nges par dgos pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma dge rtsar bcas/ /gcig tu bsdus te dbul bar bgyi//jo bo chen po gsan du gsol/ /nga ni gsang sngags kun gyi bdag /de don ji bzhin nyams len pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog yin pas/ /'di dang mthun pa'i bsngo ba zhu/ /gzhan yang rim bzhin zhu bar bya/ /bstan pa'i snying po 'brom rje nyon/ /dri ma med cing lta na mdzes/ /shel gyi mchod sdong rab 'dra ba'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dpal zhes pa/ khyod ni bdag gi thu bo yin/ /nyi ma sprin gyis ma g.yogs ltar/ /skyon gyis ma gos gzi mdangs can / / bstan pa spyi yi mig gcig po(puka/ khyod ni bdag gi thu bo yin/ /gsang sngags rig sngagasagazugs sngags kyi/ /bang mdzod dam par lhas skyong na'ang / /rtog bcas byis pa'i skur ston pa/ /zab yangs khyod ni thu bo yin/ /nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab kyang / /mngon par mi mdzad byang phyogs 'dir/ /ku su lu yi spyod mdzad pa / / spyan ras gzigs khyod thu bo yin/ /lus kyi bkod pas 'jig rten khengs/ rgyal ba mang yang khyod ma 'das / / stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams khyod/ kho bo'i sras kyi thu bo yin/ /gsang sngags thams cad khyod la bskur / khyod kyi dkyil 'khor nang du bzhengs/ /da ni zong du mi 'tshong bar / /don la spyod par gnyer gtad yin / khyod la tshul khrims bslab pa byin/ /don gnyer khrims las ma 'das par/ /las 'bras khyad du mi gsod par/ /gnas lugs spyod pa gnyer gtad yin/ khyod la sems kyi bslab pa byin/ /las can gzhan don nyid la 'god/ /gzhan don gcig pus dus 'da' yang / /gnas lugs spyod pa gnyer gtad yin/ khyod la sems kyi bslab pa byin/ /'gal 'gal 'dra yang mi 'gal bar/ /nyams len rtse gcig brtson pa yis/ /mkhas btsun bzang por don ldan pa/ /snang tsam spyod pa gnyer gtad yin/ khres bya gang dang gang mkhas kyang / / gzhan /ka 105 ba1 bshad/don so sor ma shor bar/ /rtse gcig sems la nyams len pa/ /de ni khyod la gnyer gtad yin/ /da ni rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon/ /bsngo ba'i gzhung don gsum du bshad/ /sbyor ba dngos —136—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gzhi rjes gsum yin/ /sbyor ba skyabs 'gro gzhan don yin/ /dngos gzhi la yang gsum du gda'/ /zhing dang bsam pa dngos po bzang / /zhing yang gsum du 'chad par byed/ /yon tan zhing dang phan 'dogs zhing / /sdug bsngal ba yang zhing du bzang / /bsam pa 'khor gsum dag pa yin/ /dngos po mchod 'os rang nor yin/ /bsngo ba'i don ni 'di lta ste/ /gang gis bsngo ba bsams pas bsngo/ /gang zhig bsngo ba dngos po bsngo/ /gang du bsngo ba bde gshegs so/ /ji ltar bsngo ba snang stong tshul/ /de yi dpang po rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /bla rma yi dam tha dad bral / / dngos gzhi'i dngos gzhi 'di ltar 'chad/ /mdun 'dir paṃ dang a dkar las/ /padma zla ba rgya chen bzhengs/ / de yi steng du bla ma dang / /yi dam rigs lnga dbyer med par/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dpang por bzhugs/ /dus gsum dge ba snang stong rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog gis bsdus / / de nas 'di ltar bsngo bar bya/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams/ /ye shes thugs rje thogs med pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog ldan pa'i/ /dbang dang bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chos / / dus gsum spyad pa dkyil 'khor 'dir/ khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs slad du/ /mchog gi mchog tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /ji srid nam mkha' ma brlag par/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang lhan cig tu/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rab bskor zhing / /dngos grub gnyis dang ldan par shog /snod rnams lha yi gzhal yas te/ /bcud rnams lha dang lha mo las/ /ma dag snang ba yongs ma gyur/ /thabs shes gnyis kyis 'da' bar shog /de dag thamasacad bskyed rim yin/ /rdzogs rim dmigs med dbyings su bzhugs/ /de ni mchog gi bsngo ba yin/ /bla ma dam pa a ti sha /rdo rje 'dzin pa yar la mchod/ /da ni byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /bdag gzhan brjes pa mang po yod / / gnas 'dir dka' sbyad mang po khur/ /sha khrag lus 'di yang yang btang / /mi gtsang lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang gnas 'dir byon/ /smon 'jug gnyis kyi bsngo ba bya/ /gser gling pa yang gnas 'dir byon/ khyod kyi chos lugs bskyang bar bya/ /a wa sgru ti gnas 'dir byon/ /dbu ma chen po'i dbyings su bsngo/ yākya'i rgyal po snying rje can/ /brtson 'grus seng ge slad bzhin 'brengs/ /bskyed rdzogs kun gyi dbang po nyid/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi yab gcig pu/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa he ru ka /spyan 'dren mi 'tshal slad bzhin 'brang / /shrī ya'i lha tshogs ma lus pa/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams / / spyan ras gzigs las ma 'das par/ /spyan 'dren mi 'tshal snying la 'khor/ /e ma thams cad snying la 'khor/ /nye ring can gyi lha tshogs med/ /byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ /mchog ste dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i dpal/ /seng bzang ku su lu gnyis gser gling pa/ /bla ma thugs rje che rnams zhing —137—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'dir byon/ /klu sgrub zla grags rig pa'i khu byug dang / /gnas lugs ston pa'i mig gcig sgrol ma rnams/ /gnas 'dir dmigs med rgya yis 'debs su byon/ /mi rtog mod kyi snang ba'i rten du bzhugs/ /thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /chos gzigs tai lo pa dang nā ro pa/ /dpal mchog ḍio bhi ba la sogs pa yi/ /drin can bla ma thams cad gnas 'dir byon/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /rang gi sras dang bcas pa zhing 'dir byon/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi nga dang mi 'bral ba/ /thams cad khyed dang ngo bo dbyer med pa/ /nga dang tsan dan dri bzhin rtag par byed/ /thugs rje chen po snying gar bzhugs su gsol/ /da ni dpang por thams cad 'dus/ /pad 'dab khengs par nam mkha' gang / khyed la phyags 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sdig bshags rjes su yi rang bskul/ /bzhugs la bdag gi dpang po mdzod/ /bla mas bsngo ba mdzad du gsol/ /'brom / phyogasabacu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /bla ma rnams dang dbyer med par/ /byang chub semasadapa' bdag la dgongs/ /ji srid nam mkhas khyab gyur pa/ /gnas pa'i drin can pha ma rnams/ /smon dang 'jug sems stobs ldan pa'i/ /tshogs gnyis dus gsum spyad pa rnams/ /rtse gcig sems la rab bsdus nas/ /sa bcu bgrod nas mi slob par/ /gzhan don lhun gyisagrub par bsngo/ /ji srid gnas der ma phyin par/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs kyis/ /dbang med 'khor bar mi 'khyams par/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis bskor bar shog /nyag thag rnams kyi dbugs 'byin shog /tsha bas gdungs rnams bsil bar shog /grang bas gdungs rnams dro bar shog/ bkres pas gdungs rnams 'grangs par shog /skom pas gdungs rnams ngoms par shog /nad kyis gdungs rnams gso byed shog /'chi bar gyur rnams 'tsho bar shog /sman gyi ljon shing rgyas par shog /dug gi ljon pa skam par shog /chu bo sgrol ba'i gzingasasu shog /chu phran sgrol ba'i zam par shog /shul rings bgrod pa'i bzhon par shog /re 'dod skong ba'i nor bur shog /gzhan yang 'dod 'jo la sogs pa/ /skyed mos tshal dang khang bzang dang / /gang 'dod 'byor ba nyid du shog /bud med dbul po bus 'tsho zhing / /nor yod bu med bur gyur te/ /bu rnams chos la 'god par shog /zhing der nam yang dmag ma gyur / / dam nyams 'chal bar ma gyur cig /dgra bo chom rkun dug sbrul rnams/ /'jigs pa brgyad gyi dgrar ma gyur/ /char chu dus su 'bab pa dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa/ /thams cad rtag tu dges /ka107 na 1 bde/par shog /cesagasungasapa dang / /'brom gyi zhal nas/ /dpang po rnams da dung bzhugs/jo bo/ tshul khrims thos bsam sgom gsum la/ /spyi dang bye brag bsngo ba zhu/ /'brom/ don mdzad phyogasabacu rnams na bzhugs pa yi/ /bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen rab thugs rje can/ /thar ba gnyer la mkhyen brtses —138—

pha chos ti shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dgongs su gsol/ /sgo gsum bag med dbang du ma btang bar/ /dus gsum yon tan kun gzhi tshul khrims mchog / rgyal ba'i lam mchog thos bsam sgom gsum gyi/ /nyin dang mtshan du thun du spyad pa yis/ /pha ma ma lus 'dren pa mchog tu bsngo/ /dpang po mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /sgo gsum nyes pa rab bsdams nas / / gzhan don chos su sdom bya te/ /blang dor tshul khrims mthar phyin pa/ /nges par byang chub chen por bsngo / / dpang po mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bshes gnyen mchog las thos pa yi/ /gang la sgro 'dogs chod pa gang / /blang dor ngos 'dzin dge ba des/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin sgrib med shog /dpang po mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gzhir byas nas/ /spang blang ma lus rab bsams pa'i/ /the tshomi chod gang dge ba des/ /nges par byang chub thob par bsngo/ /dpang po mchog rnams dgongs su gsol/ /thos nas legs par bsams pa'i don/ /rtse gcig bsdus nas bsgom pa yis/ /chu bor bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams / / thar ba'i skam la 'drongs par bsngo/ /jo bo/ byang chub sems dpa' de kun yar la chod/ da ni thun mong ba'i bsngo ba zhu/ 'brom/ dgra bcom mngon shes thogs med dang / /'phags pa thams cad dgongs su gsol / / 'di dang dus gsum dger gyur pa'i/ /tshogs gnyis bzang po gang thob cing / /'phral dang phugs su dge ba rnams/ /gzhan don yongs rdzogs 'grub par bsngo/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sku ma thob par mtho ris dbang po mchog gis brgyan/ /skye rga na 'chis mi 'khrugs par/ /tshogs gnyis rtag tu goms par shog /jo bo de gzhir zhog la nyan rang kun gyi bsngo ba cig mdzad par zhu/ 'brom/ 'di'i skabs su/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa bya ba byas pa byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su bcad pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la dpang por bzhugs pa zhig dgos pa yin/ bsngo mkhan dge ba'i bshes gnyen theg pa chen po nyan thos kyi cha lugs can yin na/ dpang po thams cad kyi ngo bo'ang / theg pa chen po rnam pa skyes bu zung bzhi nyan thos kyi rnam pa can byas pas/ drang don du /ka 107 ba4 bsngo ba/bzang ba yin/ bsngo ba 'di lta ste/ 'ching ba che las bsgral ba yi/ /skyes bu mchog rnams dgongs su gsol / /nyon mongs 'dam las nges 'byung nas/ /srid pa'i 'ching bas ma bcings par/ /zhi bde'i lam la rab gnas pas//zhi ba mchog tu phyin par bsngo/ /gzhan yang sngon gyi dge ba dang / /ji ltar dge bar 'gyur ba dang / /tshe 'di don med ma gyur pa'i/ /dge bas bdag med mthong bar bsngo/ /jo bo/ rnam byang gi bsngo ba de kun yar chod/ de dgon bu re tsam bzung / ming che sa re nas 'bod kyin byas/ dad rdzas kyi gter thams cad sbed pa'i gnas byed pa'i dus su/ skye bo blun pos go la/ bsngo ba rdzogs pa cig zhu 'tshal/ 'brom/ 'di'i skabs su/ dkon — /39—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mchog gsum la sogs pa yul khyad par can rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa yin pas mos pa mdzod cig zer ba yin/ phan yon chen po rnams bstan nas brod kha bkur ba yin/ rang gis sna drangs pa'i lad mo gsal po gsal po byed du bcug na bag chags brtan pa yin/ phyis kyang dad nas zhu ba'i dgos pa yod/ de nas rang rang gi ming 'don du bcug yang ming nas mi zin na/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i skabs su/kho rang gi ming 'don du 'jug pa yin/ 'brom/ khong gis dus gsum gyi dge ba sdom mi shes/ khyed kyisabasdoms nas khong kha ru 'don du 'jug pa yin/ de nas 'di skad byas te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas/ bla ma dam pa'i chos/ 'dir bzhugs pa la sogs pa bla ma 'phags pa'i dge bdun/ bdag gi mgon skyabs rnams brtse bas ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis dus gsum du bsags pa dang / gsog pa dang / gsog pa 'di dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba lus ngag yid gsum gyisadakon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang / dge 'dun la
