bsnyen bkur ba dang / de la brten nasagator ma btang ba la sogs pa dang / drin can gyi pha ma gus par bskyangs pa dang / dbul phongs rnams la sbyin pa byin pa dang /bsnyen gnas la sogs pa'i bsrung sdom dang / ma ṇi la sogs pa'i bzlas brjod dang / de 'dra ba'i gdams ngag thos pa la sogs pa dang / chos pa dang / ma nus pa la sogs pa'i bde sdug bsam pa dang / dad gusadang /snying rje bsgom pa la sogs pa bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / da gzod de'i gnas lugs shes pa'i ye shes la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba ci dang ci byas pa thams cad kyis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde 'bras phun sum tshogs pa mthar phyin par bsngo'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas thob nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi don 'ong ba la dga' ba bsgoms (sgoms1shig zer ba yin/ gnas skabs su yang skye ba nas skye ba thams cad du/mi'i lus rin po che yan lag bdun dang ldan pa/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung ba/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba/ theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag la bslabs shing lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas/ myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig byas la smon lam gdab 'tshal/ 'brom/ de kun sa bon yin mod/ bsod nams gsog pa posabasod nams gang bsagasapa de gtso bor byas nas/ gzhan yang zhor la bsngo ba yin/ 'brom/ dge ba thams cad thun mong du bsngo na/ 'di 'dra ba'i lugs kyang yod/ dkon mchog gsum bdag la dgongs su gsol / sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brten nas byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thos bsam sgom gsum la sogs pa dam pa yang dag pa sems kyi rgyan/ sems kyi yo byad rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog rim gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur nas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du —140—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /skem par gyur cig bya ba'i lugs kyang yod/ gzhan yang / dkon mchog gsum po bdag la dgongs su gsol / / bdag gi mgon skyabs khyed kyi rjes 'brangs na/ /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang / /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs bsgom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas shing stobs kyis btsun pa dang / /smon lam dag cing ye zhes mchog ldan pa'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dge ba phun tshogs des/ /grangs med gyur ba'i pha ma drang slad du/ /chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas thob par bsngo / / byas na'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi bzang ba yin/ 'brom/ gzhan yang dbang bo rnams la dbang po'i gnyer las med/ 'ub ste gril (dril3na 'di skad rang byas pas chog /bdag gis dam pa'i spyod pa byas pa dang / /byang chub bar du byed par 'gyur ba dang / /ding sang sgo gsum dam par spyad pa yis/ /pha ma'i don du tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog /jo bo/ 'di ni bsngo ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bya ba yin/ da yan lag bdun pa'i sgo nas smon lam mdzad par zhu/ 'brom/ nyon cig tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten/ /phun sum tshogs par yang gyur nas/ /dkon mchog gsum la sgo gsum gyis/ /phyag dang mchod pas bkur bar shog /stobs bzhi tshang bas sdig bshags shing / /dge ba kun la yi rang shog /chos kyi 'khor lo skor byed pa'i/ /bskul ma rtag tu thebs par shog /mya ngan 'das ston gang bzhed la/ /mi 'dar gsol ba thebs par shog /ji ltar bsngos shing smon pa rnams/ /bsam pa nyid nas 'grub par shog /jo bo/ de ltar rgyu rkyen phun tshogs pas/ /'gro ba mang po'i don slad du/ /sgo gsum dge ba rgyas mdzad cing / /de yang byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /gnas skabs smon lam btab pa yis/ /bla na med pa'i mchog thob bam/ /'brom/ de dang de ltar mdzad gyur na/ /tshogs gnyis bzang po'i gzhon pa (bzhonakayis/ /zhing khams lam lngas rab bgrod de/ /mi slob lam du gnas pa nyid/ /de ni mi lus don yod yin/ /legs par rnyed do nyams su long / /jo bo/ bsngo dang bsngo sa mi 'grub pa'i/ /gegs rang gang yin bstan du gsol/ /'brom/ rgyu ni 'dod chags zhes sdang gti mug yin/ /sgo ni lus ngag yid gsum 'di nyid yin/ /ngo bo mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga/ /de dang nye ba lnga la zer mod kyi/ /phye na sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum spong pha ma la sogs pa'i/ /gus yul 'khur bar mi byed slu ba yin/ /bsdoms na nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa chen pos rab tu bcings pa yin/ /yul ni pha ma bla ma mkhan slob dang / /dkon mchog gsum dang chos kyi grogs po yin/ /drin can yul dang phan 'dogs yul yin no/ /gzhan ni nyon mongs can gang sems can yin/ /de yang yul du byas nas gsod sogs pa'i / / ngo bo skyed pa'i dus ni 'di lta ste/ /'khor ba thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /sdig pa phal cher rang gis— 141 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dngos su byas/ /sdig pa phal cher gzhan dag byed du bcug /byed pa mthong na'ang rjes su yi rang ba'i/ /dmu rgod dag la bsngo ba bsngo yul stor/ /jo bo/ a tsa ma na dmu rgod sems can rnams/ /'di yis thams cad dmyal ba'i gnas su skyur/ /yi dwags byol song bzod glags med pa myong / /lha dang lha min 'thab rtsod 'chi ltas bcas/ /dbang med sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa rnams/ /'khor tshe da lta yan chod nyes pasalan/ /a tsa ma na mngon shes med gyur kyang / /yun ring sdig pa dran par nus re thang / /jo bo/ dug chu 'thungasapa'i 'gyod tshabs che lugs la/ /a ru ra yi thang bzhin bshal thabs zhu/ /'gyod pas skyug pa'i thabs shig cis kyang 'tshal/ /dug gsum rgyal bas khong pa rab tu brgyangs/ /mnar med gnas su da lta mi skyur ram/ /ram zla mdzod cig sman pa chen po mchog /da lta 'chi la phyi bshol long yod dam/ /'brom/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes na bshags thabs yin/ /'khyags pa'i mtsho la bya rnams yid mi chags/ /me shor nags la bya rnams yid mi chags/ khra men ma la bu ni yid mi chags/ /pha rol 'bus bzhig bu ni chags mi 'gyur/ /dur khrod nagasasu dga' ba ga la skye/ /btson khang gnas su sdod na ga na dga'/ /me yi 'obs su bsil sems ga la skye/ /dgra bo mthong na dga' ba ga la skye/ /'chi nad can la yid bde ji ltar skye/ /btso bsreg dmyal ba bde bar su zhig 'dzin / / yi dwags 'byor pa can du gang zhig 'byul/ /byol song rang dbang can du ji ltar gnas/ /'thab rtsod med na lha min ji ltar 'thob/ /'chi ltas lhung bas lha yang sdug bsngal lo/ /kun gyi rtsa ba dug gsum ngo bo yin / / de gsum med na las ngan 'byung sa med/ /thug 'phrad ngo bo mi dge mngon gyur can/ /drin can yul du byed pa'i khrel med po/ /bzang po dmangs su 'bebs pa'i gting rdo khyod/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas rjes 'brangs nas/ /e ma dran par nus bzhin mi spong ba'i/ /mi lus ltar snang khyod ni ngo re tsha/ /de 'dra'i sdug bsngal chen po mthong bzhin du/ /'gyod pa drag pos ngu brang mi brdung bar/ /srog snying 'phrog kyang sgur nas sdod dam ci/ /smyon pa yang dang yang du 'gyod sems bskyed/ /sngar byas las la 'gyod pa ma skyes na/ /da dung dug mtsho khol ma gsum du 'tshod/ khyod kyi sdug bsngal nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /bu gcig mdun du gshed ma chen po yis/ /pha ma'i snying phyung sha khrag zos gyur na/ /bu de khrag skyugs 'chi bar mi 'gyur ram/ /kyi hud de ni nyi tshe'i sdug bsngal yin/ /pha ma rtag tu 'khor bar de 'dra na/ /sdug bsngal rgyu nas 'gog par mi byed dam/ /ci ste smyon pa khyod kyis bzod par 'gyur/ /de ni las ngan bsags pas myong shes nas/ /de las bzlog thabs myang 'das mi 'tshol bar/ /dug tu shes bzhin skyug par mi byed dam/ /dper na mi bcus dug can shes bzhin du / / dga' dga' bzhin du dug sha longs spyad pas/ /gsum ni 'gyod bzhin ma phan shi bar 'gyur/ /gsum —142—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /ni 'gyod bzhin 'chi bar nye ba na/ /gsum ni na ba'i gtan tshigs du ma ldang / /gcig ni sngangs te rnam rtog 'di ltar rgyu/ /a tsa ma na grogs ngan dbang song bas/ /srog lan de 'dra'i sha cig za dran pas/ /la la shi zhing la la 'chi la thug /la la 'chi nad dag la bsnyen par 'gyur/ /da re de 'dra'i zas shig khong du song / /da ni zug gzer ngang du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'o na shes bzhin spyod pa'i snying med po/ /phung rgan khyod ni 'di 'dra rtag tu yin / / nye 'brel kun gyis 'dzin par mi byed zhan/ /da ni ji ltar kho bo 'tsho ba sred/ /a tsa ma na nga 'dra yod pa snyam / / 'di la mi lus thob bo byed pa'am/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus cis kyang thob par snang / nad ni 'tsho ba'i sman pa gang nas rnyed/ /da ni shi ba bya ba byung ba yin/ /snyam zhing 'bad de thams cad skyug par byed/ /ci bya la stor tsab tsub du ma ldang / /nye 'brel bdag kyang phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed / /sngar gyi sha la de ltar bred gyur na/ /da ni za ba smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ /sha tsam mthong yang de la skrag sems skye/ /ma bsdams na ni 'chi ba nyid du shes/ /'brom / 'gyod pa bas kyang sdom 'dod gces pa yin/ /da ni skyugs sman lta bu'i bshags pa byed/ /'brom/dngos por rang tshugs mi thub 'gyur bzlog mang / /rgyu mtshan med par gang thod thod kyis kyang / /rgyu rnams 'gyur te myug tshe sa bon bzhin/ /ngo bo'ang 'gyur te sngon po'ang skya bo 'gyur/ /dus kyang mi rtag dbyar dgun la sogs bzhin/ /'di la rang bzhin ci yang med par shes/ /yod tshugs mi thub med tshugs dag kyang 'jig /rmi lam chu 'dra thams cad 'gyur nas 'gro/ /da na'ang mi gda' rang bzhin med par 'tshal/ /yod na ci 'gyur mdang bzhin yod par 'tshal/ /dus gsum 'khor ba mi dge'i rgyu 'bras rnams/ /skye 'jig du ma rang tshugs mi gda' ba/ /'o na sngar gyi sdig rnams gang na gda'/ /'o na da lta'i ngo bo ji ltar gda'/ /'di yi ngo bo ma 'gyur gang du 'gro/ /'di la bden/ pa rdul tsam mi gda' na'ang / /zhabrul ba'i blo la rjes su 'brang 'gyur bas/ /sdig pa dbu ba rdos 'dra'i snying po la/ /gnyen pos rig par mi bzod 'jig par sla/ /sdig de glo bur zad pa bzang po yis/ /skyob par nus pa'i 'phags pa dkon mchog la/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing tshogs gnyis rab bsags nas/ /sbyo/ sgo ngo bo yul sogs ngag smos shing / /snying nas zhe thag sdom 'dod drag pos nga'inags/ /lan gnyis lan gsum bar du ches par bshags/ /gnyen po 'di ni chu bu'i rgyun bzhin gces/ /bskal ba'i me bzhin stobs dang ldan par 'tshal/ /gnyen po 'di yis spang bya du ma gzhom/ /'phrad 'joms thug 'joms kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ /de nas sdig las slar ldog sor chud de/ /dga' ba bskyed cing rang bzhin med par bzhag / byang chub sems ni gtso bo'i rten du bzang / /dkon mchog dpang dang skyabs 'gro'i rten du bzang / /sun 'byin drag po 'joms pa'i stobs su bzang / /gnyen po kun sleb brtson pa'i stobs su bzang / /bshags —143—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nas mi zlog sdom pa'i stobs su bzang / /rang bzhin shes pa rgyal ba'i ma ma yin/ /'gyod pa mang ba dpa' bo sdar ma yin/ /dus tshod shes na dus la 'doms te dga'/ /dran par nus pa bla ma'i man ngag yin/ /mang yang 'khor ba 'di las ma 'das so/ /'gro sa thar lam phyin na thar ba yin/ /'brom rje khyod kyi dgra bo ngos zin no / / shes nas 'dzem la gnyen po bag yod bsten/ /nyin mtshan khyod kyis dge sbyor mthil mar gyis/ /'di ni sdig pa 'joms pa'i stobs bzhi yin/ /ji ltar bye ma'i ri la rbab brgyab 'dra/ /chu tshan steng du kha ba babs dang mtshungs / / mtshan med nye ba dag kyang 'dzad 'gyur na/ /ci ste mi dge phra mo mi 'dzad srid/ /'di ni sdig pa kun gyi bshags pa yin/ khyod la skyob pa'i rin chen lha bzhi yod/ /'di la ma 'dus ci yang med na yang / /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras dgongs su gsol lo zhes/ /dpang por gsol na thams cad 'dus pa yin/ /'brom/ bla ma'i gdams ngag nyid las ma 'chugs par/ /legs par bsdebs te bshags shing bsngo bar gyis/ /legs par bsdus na bsag sbyang gnyis su 'dus/ /de ni sgrib pa sbyong ba'i tshomasasu gda' / / bla med byang chub thob pa'i thabs su che/ /jo bo 'brom gyis 'thud ma 'di bgyi lags/ /gadran dang bla ma a ti sha /sgo gsum gus pas bdag cag gis/ /dus gsum dag tu dge ba'i blos/ /bla ma bde gshegs sras bcas kyi/ /sku gsum thugs kyi rten bzhengs pas/ /ma dag lus ngag rab dor nas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras sku/ /yan lag drug bcu'i (cu'i3gsung mnga' ba'i/ /kun mkhyen chos rgyal thob par bsngo/ /'brom / 'thud ma dang bcas pa'i tshoms chung de legs/ /jo bo/ de ltar zhusalan mang na yang / /legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bsod nams sems can rnams la brdar/ /rtag tu yan lag bdun pa yi/ /smon lam chen po gdab par bya/ /de ltar byas na bsod nams dang / /ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa gnyis kyang zad 'gyur te/ /mi lus thob pa don yod pas/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ /de ltar na zhusalan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ bsngo zhing sdig pa bshags pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o// //za22 nor bdun du bsdusate gnyer gtad pa'i lephywayang gnas de nyid du de 'dra ba'i bla ma'i drung du/ de ltar chos zab la rgya che ba rnams 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs la gsal bas/ ji lta ba bzhin du rang dang 'dra ba'i slob ma la gsal bar byas nas/ /bsam gtan dang po'i sems thob pa ltar drung du slebs te/ sngar gyi rnams kyang zhus pas/ /bdag cag gi bla mas tshar ba —144—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /gcig bskyar/ yang lung thob ma thag tu 'di dag kyang rnyed par gyur te/ jo bo/ sngon chad chos kyi dga' ston thob / / da ni nor cig zhu 'tshal lags/ /'brom dad pa'i nor ni dbang sdud yin/ /'phags pa thams cad dbang 'du na/ /'jig rten pa dag smos ci 'tshal/ /dad pa sa yi dang po yin/ /dad pa lam gyi mgo bo ste/ /dad pa phan bde'i myu gu yin/ /dad pas dge ba'i lo thog 'byin/ /dad pas chags sdang 'joms par byed/ /dad pa dag snang nyi ma ste/ /seng ge'i khri ltar rgyal ba 'degs/ /dad pa lo thog padma 'dra/ /'phags pa thams cad khur byed cing / /'phags pa'i bde 'byor rgyas par byas/ /'brom/ nor gyi nor mchog dad pa yin/ /dad med khyi dang gdol pa 'dra/ /bya rog phag pa ji bzhin te/ /dga' la mi dga' bzang mi shes/ /dad pa sgron ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /rang nyid gsal la gathen yang gsal / /mun pa bsal nas gzugs can ston/ /dad pa 'dod pa'i zas dang mtshungs/ /gang gi rjes su stobs kyang 'brang / /de bas dad pa brtan par mdzod/ /nor gyi nor mchog dad pa yin/ /jo bo/ kho bo lha chos bdun ldan la/ /nor yang bdun dgos da rung drug /gzhi che babs chags 'dzad med gter/ /gang nas spyad kyang spyad bde ba/ /mkho ba'i dus su sleb par zhu/ /'brom/ blang bya kun gyi gzhi rten mchog /tshul khrims zhing sa gshin pa nyid/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu mchog /sman gyi ljon shing phan bde bskrun/ /kun tu dge ba'i lam yangs pa/ /zag med bde ba'i lam gcig pu/ /mtho ris thar ba'i bde 'bras rnams/ /med na mi 'byung nor mchog ni/ khyod kyis 'phags pa spel ba'i gzhi/ khyod kyi me tog ldum rar mdzes/ /'di ni rang gi srog bzhin 'tsho/ /'di yod phongs pa kun dang bral/ /'di yod bang mdzod rgyas par 'gyur/ /'di yod bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /'dis ni zhing khams gtsang rme/ra 'gro/ /'brom/khyod kyi nor mchog gnyis pa yin/ /'brom/ dad pa tsam dang tshul khrims tsam/ /theg pa dman la'ang 'byung mi khegs/ /rgyal srid ma lus gtong ba dkon/ /bu dang bu mo gtong ba dkon/ /mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba dkon / / de bas re ltos med pa dkon/ /chags med gtong ba nor mchog yin/ /bskal ba grangs med dang po la / / dpa' bos thams cad rab btang nas/ /de nas thams cad re ltos bral/ /chags pa med par 'dod la btang / / da ni 'di ltar 'gro ba'i bla/ /mtshungs pa med pa shākya'i rgyal/ /mtshungs pa med pa chos kyi rgyal/ /dge mthar phyin pa 'di 'drar 'gyur/ /gtong ba'i nor ni mchog tu gces/ /'brom/ zang zing sbyin la phongs pa sol / / chos kyi sbyin pas lam mchog ston/ /mi 'jigs sbyin la bar chod sol/ /'di ni 'khor 'das kun kyi chos / / bla na med pa'i nor yin no/ /nor gyi nor mchog gsum par gda'/ /'brom/ dad pa'i khrims bsrung sbyin gtong yang/ /thos pa rgya mtsho mi 'tshol na/ /gang zhig bar du lhung ba srid/ /rang gis sa dang lam ma shes//—145—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bdud kyi rigs 'di g.yo sgyu mkhas/ /pha ma longs spyod 'khor 'dab dang / /mkhan slob grogs mched rgyal ba'i skur / / rdzus nas lam zhugs lam nas bzlog /de ltar skyon yon dpyad pa'i phyir/ /thos pa'i nor ni mchog tu gsungs / / de las bsam sgom 'byor ba 'du/ /de las mi slob mchog tu phyin/ /thams cad ngos 'dzin sman pa 'dra / nor gyi nang nas mchog yin pas/ /bka' gdams mchog khyed gzhud chen shog /rgyal ba thob pa'i thabs su bzang / /ji srid nor 'dis 'tsho bar gyis/ /nor gyi nor mchog bzhi pa yin/ /'brom/ ji ltar ngo tsha mi shes shing / khrel yod gos dang mi ldan na/ /'jig rten dag na'ang tha chad de/ /grong pa dag kyang smod par byed / / pha la phar 'dzin mi byed cing / /ma la mar 'dzin mi byed pa/ /rgan rabs rgan por mi khur na/ /de las phongs pa su zhig yod/ /brku dang 'phrog dang gzhog slong dang / /ngag 'khyal phra ma smyon pa 'dra/ /pho bla thams cad phos 'tshong zhing / /mo bla thams cad mos 'tshong ba/ /bza' ma'i nang du'ang sdug 'thab 'chor/ /yul pa dag dang 'byon par byed/ /de lasadabul ba su zhig yod/ /pha ma drin can slu byed cing / /bzang lan mi byed ngan sna 'dren/ /bskyangs pa'i jo bo slu bar byed/ /phan 'dogs stong du byas 'gyur kyang / /lan cig 'bar na de yis 'joms/ /de las khrel med su zhig yod/ /'jig rten dag na'ang smad gnas yin/ /de bzhin chos par ming btags kyang / /mkhan slob dam pa sun 'byin cing / /mched grogs dag dang 'gras par byed/ /dam pa bslu zhing ma rabasa'athem/ /nges par byed nas gsog run byed/ /chags med dus su zhen pa che/ /rtsa ba'i chos lugs dor byas nas/ /chos gzhan dag la mtho 'grogs byed/ /rang gi chos grwa smod byed cing / /gdan sa'i zhabs tog zhabs nas 'dren/ /rang lugs shor tsam gzhan ma lon/ /go ma chod pa mi 'gyod par/ /chos kyi lan zer tshul khrims gtong / /ngo tsha med la khrel yod ci/ /chos ltar 'chos shing log 'tsho skyong / khrel med zas kyis ma phung ngam/ /dmyal ba'i mnar rdor mi 'gyur ram/ /des kyang chos pa'i gral du zhugs/ /nga'o skad du dad rdzas za/ khrel med de yang gzhan yang bslu/ /nor bdun spangs nas nor min sgrub/ /chos mi byed la ngo mi tsha/ /chos bzhin byed pa ngo tsha zer/ /gos med lto med phongs pa la/ /ngo tsha mi zer phongs pa yin/ /'jig rten rmongs pa'i ngo tsha kun/ /dri chu dag dang de lam la/ /ngo tsha zer te phung mi nus/ /ngo tsha bya ba khrel med yin/khrel med bya ba log sgrub yin/ /log sgrub mkhan de dmyal bar 'gro/ 'brom rje de dag bor gyis la/ /ya rabs dag ni ngo tsha zer/ /btsun pa dag nas mi rung zer/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrel gzhung skyong / /gzhan sems bsrung na ngo tsha mkhas/ /'khur 'os 'khur na ngo tsha mkhas/ /skyabs 'os bskyangs na ngo tsha mkhas/ /drin lan dmar na ngo tsha mkhas/ /dad pa che na ngo tsha mkhas/ /rab tu byung la'ang de bzhin sbyar/ /bla ma mkhan slob spyi —146—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /bor khur/ /mched grogs dag la chos bzhin 'grogs/ /dang po'i khas blangs mi 'dor bar/ /ji ltar longs spyod phongs gyur kyang / /rang gi sgo gsum dge bskul nas/ /chos grogs spel zhing gdan sa bskyangs/ /de ni khrel gzhung ring ba yin/ /gal te shes rab che gyur cing / /gdan sa mkhas pas skyong gyur na/ /na dang sbyar te chos mthun pa'i/ /chos grwar mkhas la bslab bya ste/ /rang gi gnas nyid bskyang bar bya/ /jo bo/ de skad bya ba ci la gsung / /sdug zhen che na su yang 'phung / /rang lugs gzhan lugs chags sdang yin/ /nga khyod mang po dmu rgod che/ /zhen na gang du zhen kyang phung / /zhes gsung / chags sdang che na bros nas 'gro/ /zhen chen 'dra na bskyur nas 'gro/ /gang du sdod kyang sdom khrims srungs/ /su dang 'grogs kyang chos mi skyel/ /ji ltar byas kyang blo sbyong 'phel/ /bstan pa spyi la ma phan na/ /dgon chung chags sdang rab byung gang / /bskyangs nas ci byeng bzhag mi phung / /snabs lud bzhin du 'dor rgyu yin/ /bya pho 'dra bar zhen gyur te/ /ri dwags lta bur ci ste chags/ /brtson khang gnas nas thar na bde/ /dgon pa'ang bzang btson gnas su che/ /lha khang stong pa'i khyi dang 'dra/ /'dod pa che la sdang thes med/ /ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod na/ /bde ba'i ba/nas nas bde bar 'gro/ /ngo tsha shes nor lnga ba yin/ /'brom/ kho bos zhen pa dga' ma byas/ /gang bder 'gro na khrel gzhud thung / /bstan pa spyi la phan na mchog /zhen pa med pa kun la gces/ /zhan med ngang nas ngo tsha bsrungs/ khrel yod nor mchog drug pa yin / / 'brom/ shes rab nor ni kun tu gces/ /shes rab mchog ldan kun la mkhas/ /shes rab mchog la legs bshad 'du/ khres rab me yis sgrib pa bsreg /nor gyi nor mchog shes rab nor/ /nor kun sdud rnams shes rab yum/ /shes rab mchog gis thar bar phyin/ /shes rab don gnyis kun la 'jug khes rab che na thabs la'ang mkhas/ /shes rab che na tshul khrims bsrung / /shes rab che na chags med gtong / /shes rab can gang thos pa 'tshol/ /shes na ngo tsha khrel gyis brgyan/ /bzod stobs che zhing brtson par mchi/ /rtse gcig gnas lugs thabs kyis bsgom/ /stobs chen dpa' bo kun spyod kyang / /smon lam rta yis ye shes 'dren//shes rab nor ni kun la gtong / /nor mchog 'di yod phyug par 'gyur/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis zhus lan yang / /gnas 'dir ma tshang ci yang med/ /'di ni nor mchog dam pa yin/ /nor 'di khyod la brtse bas bstan/ khyod kyis khrom du ma sgrog cig /zhing khams 'di ni khyed kyis kyang / /thams cad khyed kyis mi ma yin/ /mi ma yin la brjod byed na/ /bdud sdes mi bzod 'khrugs gyur te/ khyod kyi shing rta gcog par byed/ srol 'di ma nyams thig ler skyongs/ /'phang los dpag tshad khyab na yang / /lte ba mi 'dzin mi ma yin/ /mu khyud rtsibs la sgro skur 'debs / / gzer bu mi 'thob gnas su brdeg /thob nas gzer bu mi sdom par/ rab tu brtse nas 'dor bar —147—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byed / / de nas thog ma'i khar khyer nas/ /de nas chos la ji mi snyam/ /chos 'di bstan pa'i gnas bshad nyen//nga dang khyod la zhe thag pa'i/ /ngur smig gos kyis lus brgyan pa / /rnam thar snying po snying du len/ /'dul ba bzhin du 'dul khrims bsrung / /mdo sde bzhin du lhag bsam spyod/ /mngon pa bzhin du lhag shes rgyas/ /gzhi ma ma 'chugs tshul khrims gtsang / /lam sna ma 'chugs tshad med 'gro/ /'bras bu mi 'chugs sangasargya ba'i/ /skyes bu de ni 'di bstan yul/ /'di yi bya ba rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi gral nas bud ri dwags 'dra/ /'phral la zas 'tshol bya dang 'dra/ khag ste langs na gzhis rdzogs pa'i/ /byar med de ni bstan yul yin/ /skyesabu des kyang len par 'gyur/ /'brom rje 'di kun nyen du che/ /nga dang khyod la dad pa skad/ khyod kyis bka' brgyud 'dzin pa skad/ /bzang por rlom pa'i log lta can/ /chos rnams thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ /gtugs nas sgro 'dogs mi gcod par/ /rang gis mthong thos med pa rnams/ /rtags su bkod nas sgro skur 'debs/ /'phags pa rnams ni de la khrel/ /des kyang rang la 'chal bar zad/ /sgrub pa rtse gcig ma byas pas/ /spyan dang mngon shes med gyur pa'i /dmu rgod rang rgyud rengs pa kun/ /lha dang zab don ma rtogs par/ /lkog gyur don la sgro skur 'debs/ /gang zhig 'di ston 'brom rje la'ang / /'brom rje tsam du mi 'dzin na/ /spyan ras gzigasadabang smos ci 'tshal/ /de bas 'di smos rang bzo mkhan/ /bdud rigs skad du bkur gyis dogs/ /'brom rje khyod la gzer bus btab/ /gnad par soms la bka' rgya ltos/ /dgra bo dag la bros pas thar/ /bu ru rdzus nas 'joms pa yin/ /chos lugs tha dad 'di mi spyod/ /ma mthong sgro skur mi 'debs kyis/ /rang lugasaskad du khas len pa'i/ /chos pas 'di ni bslus kyis dogs/ /gser 'tsho ma dang 'od 'tsho ma/ /bstan skyong ma dang yid 'dzin ma/ /stobs mo che dang drag zhul che/ khrag mdog ma dang dud kha ma/ /thogs med ma dang stobs mo che / / dbang sdug ma dang las 'joms ma/ /bcu gnyis stobs chen bstan srung kun/ kho bo'i bstan pa mi skyong na / / ci ste kho bo'i slad bzhin 'brang / /zhus lan ngan la ma spel cig /nor bu dgra la ma skyel cig /gcig tsam gcig gi phyi la rgyug /bcu gcig rdo rje gdan du song / /spyan ras gzigs kyi bstan pa srungs/ /da ni lo gcig zla phyed nas/ /byams pa'i drung du shog ces gda'/ /mchog gi dngos grub 'brom la long / /stobs chen gtan gyi btsan sa zung / /ri rab thal bar rlog nus kyang / /'gro ba ma bsgral don go chung / /de nas bu mo bcu gnyis tsam/ /rgyal ba yab sras spyi bor blangs/ /sbyan ras gzigs dbang khyod rjes 'brang / /'di la sgro skur 'debs byed pa'i/ /sdig can 'ga' zhig bsgral bar bya/ /la la sa yi bstan ma yin/ /la la nam mkha'i rdo rje yin / khros na nyi zla'ang sa la 'bebs/ /dga' na rgya mtsho'ang mkha' la skyel/ /mi dbang rgyal ba a ti sha /—148—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /dbus nas mtha' 'khob 'dir khrid nas/ /bdag cag bzhag nas yar gshegs sam/ /gzhan dbugs bcad na bka' las 'da'/ /gzhan du chos kyi 'tsho ba gang / /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ khyod ni 'brom gyis 'tsho bar byed/ /'brom gyi bka' las ma 'da' cig /'brom gyi zhal nas 'di skad du/ /bu mo bcu gnyis nga la nyon//gser 'di snod du blugs pa la/ /ko long sprug rdeb ma byed cig /snod min gzhan gyis khyer gyur na/ /sgyid lug le lo ma byed cig /chos la snyad btags ma gsod cig khyed kyi steng na'ang brgyad bcu (cu3yod/ /brgyad bcu'ang snyom las ma byed cig /bu mo bcu gnyis 'di skad du/ /bcud 'di snod du 'jo ba'i tshe/ /bdag nyid dgu bcu (cu1go gnyis la/ /zhu ba mi byed ko long 'ong / /gtor ma mi gtong brnyas pa byas/ /dkon mchog mi mchod chos pa min/ /snying rje med na 'di mi skyongs/ /mkhyen par mdzod la rjes su mnos/ /gzhan du 'di dag bskyang bar bya/ /snod skyon bral na snod du bzang / /'di la mi brtsi bsgral bar bya/ /sgo gsum mi gus myur du 'jig / nged ni bskos pa'i bstan ma yin/ /da gzod bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bdag la gson / / lha chos bdun ༷ ldan /ka 115 na3 la/mi spyod pa'i/ /gdug pa can rnams bsgral mi bsgral/ /gseb tu zhugs nas dkrug par byed/ /dkrugs shing bton na mi bde'am/ /'brom gyi zhal nas 'di skad du/ /bcu gnyis mi rabs mang rab nas/ /bsgral na nad rims mang po 'ong / /'di tsam zhig gi gnyer gtad kyi/ /dal yams chen po ma btang cig /btang na nged dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ /thugs rje po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ /yig 'bru drug gis phar phyin drug /'khor lo bskor ba 'di lta ste/ /shar du jo bo chen po bzhugs/ /lho ru thugs rje can gyi bzhugs/ /nub tu gsang bar nus kyi bzhugs/ /byang du sgrol ma mchog gi bzhugs/ /dkar po brgyad bcus (cusaka g.yas nas bskor/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis g.yon nas 'khod/ /oṃ nas bzung nas g.yas nas bskor/ /bzhi bzhi 'khor nas gnyis la thim/ /bla ma byams pa'i ti nge 'dzin/ /thugs rjes snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ /gsang mtshan dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /ma ni kun la khyad par bzhugs/ /thams cad sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings nyid na/ /sher phyin nyid kyis sna drangs nas/ /pha rol phyin lnga rjes su 'brang / /de ltar sgrub pas mchod byas nas/ /dkon mchog rdzas kyis mnyesapar byas/ /dgu bcu (cu1 gtor mas tshim byas nas/ /bsngos shing dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs / / de nas 'brom rjes 'di skad du/ /bla ma dam pa gsan du gsol/ /de ltar bsam mi khyab pa rnams / / legs par bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /dad pa'i nor dang tshul khrims nor/ /gtong ba'i nor dang thos pa'i nor / khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ /shes rab nyid ni nor bdun te/ /nor gyi dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mi zad pa — 149—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yi gter bdun te/ /mi ma yin la brjod mi bya/ /zhes bya ba cig las mi gda' yi/ de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las/ nor bdun du bsdus te gnyer gtad pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //'a23 brtag pa gnyiba'ipa'i legayang gnas phun sum tshogs pa de nyid du/ bla ma dam pa de'i drung du/ bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas/ 'di skad du zhus pa/ bla ma dam pa gsan du gsol/rgya chen po sdud pa'i bstan bcos 'di shin du dka' ba yin/ da thams cad bsdus pa'i nyamasalen zab pa cig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ smra ba mang po sdig pa'i rgyu/ /rnam g.yeng che ba sdig pa'i rgyu/ /bstod ra'i tshig dang smad ra'i tshig /snyan par smra dang mi snyan dang / /log par smra dang drang por smra/ /dngos su smra dang shugs la smra/ /smad de bstod dang bstod de smad/ /gting tshig smra dang khengs pas smra/ /nyon mongs dbang gis ngag 'khyal smra/ /'dod chags smra dang zhe sdang smra/ /gti mug smra dang phrag dog smra/ /nga rgyal smra dang rta dgod smra/ /slu ba'i rdzun dang ku re'i rdzun/ /spyang glen gzhan rnams rgod 'dod tshig /mi chen bshig pa'i tha mal tshig /gsod dang rgyob dang ngan mtshang 'bru/ /ngo dga' che mthor nga rgyal tshig /tshong gi tshig dang smon pa'i tshig / dmag gi tshig dang pho rus tshig /chung ngus nyon mongs chen po slong // /sems can nyon mongs rgyu las byas / / phrag dog khong khro lhan skyes pas/ /gcig la bstod na gcig khro zhing / /don med khong khrosadage rtsa 'joms / / ming ngan 'dogs shing zur za byed/ /bstod pa gcig la smad pa brgya/ /ngag gi nyes pa dgra bo 'gugs / / ngag gi nyes pa bshes dang bral/ /ngag gi nyes pas lce dag la/ /meod dor stong gisameod ces thos//'jam po'i tshig kyang mang gyur na/ /skad kyi dpangs kyis 'byed par byed/ /la la dag la bstod byas kyang / /dogs pa blangs nas mtshang la 'phog /bstod pas dgra bor 'gyur ba srid/ /ngan la bstod ra btang gyur na/ /lhag par rang nyid khong khro ldang / /bzang la bab kyis brjod gyur kyang / /smad ra bzhin du khro bar 'gyur/ /spyir yang mang na smra bar dka'/ /de bas blo mi mthun la dka'/ /de bas che 'dod dag la dka'/ /de yang blo chung dag la dka'/ /ku re'i tha ma 'thab mor 'gro/ /ngag gi tha ma lus gnyis rtsod/ /lus kyi tha ma srog dang 'bral//srog gi tha ma ngan 'gror 'gro/ /ngag la brtag pa grung /ka 116 na2 dang/po yin/ tanisanas mi spong glen pa yin/ /gnyis pa ngag la dpyad par bya/ /dpyod pa'i dang po yul la dpyad/ /du ma 'dug na smra bcad bzang //dad can 'dug na bzang por smra/ /mkhas pa 'dug na yon tan bstod/ /btsun po 'dug na btsun la —150—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /bstod / / bzang po 'dug na lag len smra/ /sdig can 'dug na babs kyis gzhol/ /gnyen por 'gro na gang yang smra/ /gzhan du ngag gi nyes pa bsdams/ /gnyis pa gzhan la smra ba'i tshe/ /ngag de megrin par bskyil byas nas / / de la re ltos 'dug mi 'dug /chags sdang gnyis bcas 'dug mi 'dug /rang 'dod 'khri ba 'dug mi 'dug / gnyan ( /ka 116 na4 gzhan/ la gshe bar 'dug mi 'dug /sgro skur tshig tu 'gro mi 'gro/ /ngag 'khyal yin nam rdzun tshig yin/ /phra ma yin nam tshig rtsub yin/ /zur gyis phog gam 'debs (ldebasakakyis phog /dngos kyis gnod dam shugs kyis gnod/ /'phags pa'i tshig gam byis pa'i tshig /don dang ldan nam mi ldan lta/ /'gro na smra sgor btang bar bya/ /mi 'gro mgrin pa'i āḥl bstim/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan bsgom pa'i rtsar/ kha thon klog par mi bya'o/ /dred po skur ba 'debs pa'i rtsar/ kha thon lag len mi bya'o / / gzhan yang theg pa dman pa la/ /theg chen bsgrags na skyon du 'gyur/ /bla ma mkhan slob la sogs la/ /rang nyid dad gus che gyur kyang / /chags sdang can gyi rtsar mi bstod/ /snod min tha mal skye bo la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa'ang byur du che/ /mdor na mngon shes ma thob bar/ /spyir yang ngag ni bsdams pa gces/ /sgos su mang po'i gseb tu chod/ /chos la rgyab kyis phyogs pa yi/ /pho rgod smra mkhas lab bzang po/ /mtho dman bar gsum srang la 'jal/ /la la bstod pas la la 'o9spyog /spyi byed (chedakalabs pas sgos /ka 116na7 dgos/mi 'khrug /sgos gtam labs na spyi dgra ldang / /nam med gyur na chal chol smra/ /gcig lan brgya la de lan stong / /tha mar ngag gis ngage rtsa 'joms/ /mi rgod po yis dmyal bar sleb/ /rnam g.yeng bdud kyis byin brlabs nas/ /mang po'i nang du'ang lha nger lab/ /der 'tshogs thams cad phugs khrel na'ang / /'phral ni bzhad gad slu zhing bstod/ /dmu rgod lce la zhun lcags 'debs/ /de bas 'brom rje ngag la dpyod/ /smra ngan chod la bzlas brjod brtson/ /snyan dang sdang ba'i tshig thos kyang / /lkugs pa'i tshul du gnas par gyis/ /rang rgyal rnams kyang ngag brtag na/ /rgyal sras bzang po ci ste col/ /dus la 'doms na mkhas pa yin/ /gnad du phyin na dpa' bo yin/ /tshig 'bru bzang na dam chos yin/ /snyan ngag byin na dbang shes 'dzin/ /shes na smra ba kun la gces/ /des na ngag la brtag pa gces/ /yul dang ngag la brtag pa yi/ /tshoms te gnyis pa yin no dpyod / / smra ba'i skyes mchog a ti sha /ngag gis nyes pas ma gos pa'i/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i dpal/ /chosagasung mchog khyod gsan du gsol/ /de ni mang po'i bslab bya yin/ /da ni gcig pur nyams len pa'i/ /snying por bsdus pa gnad kyi mchog /dben par gnas pa'i chos shig zhu/ /'brom/ gcig pur 'dug na sems ladapyod/ /rje bla ma'i thabs kyis bkrol na gsal/ /'brom/ sems med yul rnams su yis 'dzin/ /rje/— 151 —

bka' gdam/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kye skor/'dzin pa po med 'dzin mi 'gyur/ /'brom/ sems med gang la su yis smra/ /rje/ smra ba po med chags sdang ci/ /'brom / yul dang yul can de 'drar zad/ /rje/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa gang zhig lags/ /'brem/ kho bos 'di skad rnyed ma gyur/ /rje/ rnyed par mi/ 'gyur ji ptar lags/ /'brom/ skye gnas 'jig pa mi gda' ba/ /rje/ sna tshogs rig pa ji ltar lags/ /'brom/ skye gnas 'jigs pa mi gda' ba/ /rje/ sna tshogs rig pa ji ltar lags/ /'brom / 'di ni snang med snang ba yin/ /rje/ snang ba de nyid ma lags sam/ /'brom/ snang ba bya ba ci la zer/ /rje / sna tshogs yul du dmigs pa lags/ /'brom/ yul nyid dmigs sam sems nyid dmigs/ /rje/ sems kyis yul rnams dmigs pa yin/ 'brom/ sems de dpyod pa'i dus la bab/ /rje/ 'di yi dpyod lugs dus la bab/ /'brom/ khyod kyi rig pa snga ma ston/ /rje/ 'das pa 'di ru bstan ma mchis/ /'brom/ 'o na ma 'ongs rig pa ston/ /rje/ ma 'ongs 'di ru 'byung srid dam/ /'brom/ 'o na da lta'i sems 'di ston/ /rje/ mdzu gu gtad pa mi gda' ba/ /'brom/ de 'dra 'ong ba ci zhig yin/ /rje/ de bas khyed la 'dri ba yin/ /'brom/ sangs rgyas kun kyang 'di la gdugs (rdugs3/ /rje/ kun la mkhas pa ma lags sam/ /ribrom/ ma/bas nga/ log shes ga la yin/ /rje/ 'o na sems rang med dam ang / 'brom/ yod yod 'dra mo shes kyin gda'/ /rje/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir su zhig 'khyams/ /'brom/ spyang po ya ma brla cig 'khyams/ /rje/ thams cad de ltar ma/ lags sam/ /'brom/ de bas khyod kyang gsog gsob yin/ /rje/ snying po med la snying por bzung / /'brom/'khor ba pa yi kun spyod yin/ /rje/ kun spyod med pa ma lags sam/ /'brom/ kun spyod yod ces su yis smras / / rje/ da lta kun spyod lags gsungs pa/ /'brom/ /tha snyad tshig la bden ma 'cha'/ /rje/ 'o na rdzun po mjad lags sam/ /'brom/ de mdzad mi dgos rang gis mchis/ /rje/ rdzun pa lam du 'gro lags sam/ /'brom / thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bshad/ /rje/ sems kyang sgyu ma'i sems lags sam/ /'brom/ rmi lam sprul pa gsal tsam yin/ /rje gsal tsam bskyed rdzogs ji ltar bya/ /'brom/ dkyil 'khor thams cad nang du bzhengs / / rje/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs lugs ji ltar bgyi/ /'brom/ gsal tsam rig tsam dag tsam mo/ /rje/de la dgos pa ci tsam yod/ /'brom/ /gsang sgrogs mi 'ong rtogasapa 'phel/ rje/ de la bar chod mi 'ong ngam /'brom / / bdud sdes mi tshor mngon sangs rgyas/ /rje/ stong pa'i rjes la thabasabasgom mam/ /'brom/ thabs shes thams cad nang du 'phel/ /rje/ gang zag de la ji skad zer/ /'brom/ sbasapa'i brtul zhugasa'adzin pa yin / rje/ de dag hril te gril (drilaka la byon/ /'brom/ /byams brtse bskyed gsal lhod de bshig /rje/gzugs la 'phro na ji ltar brtag /'brom/ sems de'i dbyibs dang kha dog brtag /rje/ sgra la 'phro na ji ltar —152—

pa ches nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dnges garsha rber bu'i phreng ba spe'u nye shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs/ so / /brtag / 'brom/ sems la sgra 'dug mi 'dug brtag /rje/ dri la 'phro na ji ltar brtag /'brom/ sems la dri 'dug mi 'dug brtag /rje/ ro la 'phro na ji ltar brtag /'brom/ sems la ro 'dug mi 'dug brtag /rje/reg la 'phro na ji ltar brtag /'brom/ de yi reg bya brtag par bya/ /rje/ chos la 'phro na ji ltar brtag/'brem / / de min chos rang gang na yod/ /rje/ rnam par rtog pa'i rang bza'/ /'brom/ rnam/ par rtog pa'ang de bzhin brtag /rje/ /rtog mkhan rang la ji ltar rtog/ 'brom/ /lus zhig yan lag gang du thal/ /rje/ de ni med na mi 'byung lags/ /'brom/ de ltar brtag pa kun tu gces/ /rje/ brtag nas zhig tshe ji ltar bya/ /'brom/ma rnyed 'ja' chen ma/kha' la yal/ /rje/ ma/ rnyed pa de mchog lags sam/ /'brom/ rnyed ma rnyed ni skye 'phags khyad / / rje/ yang yang bcal zhing ma rnyed na/ /'brom/ rang lugs yang yang mthong ba yin/ /rje/ ma rnyed pa pa bzhag lags sam/ /'brom/ lhod de glod na dam pa yin/ /rje/ gnas don 'di yi brgyud pa gang / /'brom/ /rgyal dang sgrol ma nga nyid yin/ /rje/ bdag gi gzhan la ji ltar byin/ /'brom/ snod ldan snying gi thig ler long / / rje/ dkyil 'khor gong dang mthun lags sam/ / 'brom/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor ga'/da du che/ /rje/'di yi mthun rkyen gang zhig lags/ /'brom/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par mjod/ /rje/ brtag pa gnyis po drin che lags/ /'brom/ shes par mdzod la nyams su long / /rje/ de ltar zhus lan dpag med kyang / /bsdus na nor bdun nyid du gda'/ /de yang bsdus na brtag pa gnyis/ /brtag gnyis le'ur rdzogs par bstan / / brtag gnyis bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /mang po'i nang du ngag la brtag /gcig pur 'dug na sems la brtag / bkra shis gnas 'dir thams cad 'dus/ /legs/ bshad nor bu'i phreng ba yin/ /bka' rgya sbas pa'i brtul zhugs yin/ /phan bde nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal/ /'od dpag med nga/sa spyi gcug brgyan/ /mgon po khyod kyi chabs la gtugs/ /de ltar gsung gleng bag chags pas/ /thams cad bag phebs rgyas par rbe|ga /rtsa ba lta bur bsdus pa 'di/ /bla ma'i gsung yin 'khrul ba me/da/ /logs su bkod la ming ma smos/ /nor bu'i phreng ba zhus lan gsal/ /zhus dang lan yang der ma smos/ /jo bo'i gsung de dang blangs nas/ /skad cig nyid la yig 'brur bkod/ /ye ge'ang rdo rje gdan pa'i lus/ /na mo spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung / /mi mngon phyogs mthar rgyas par shog /dam nyams 'chal ba rgyun chad 3|ga /bag la nyal kun 'joms par shog /ma rig gling nas phyin par shog /sa lam rim gyis bgrod par shog /lam du bar chad med par shog /kun gyi don du kun mkhyen shog /bka' gdams mtha' nas rgyas par shog /padma'i steng du pad 'drar shog /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas par shog /mkhas btsun bzang por kun du 3|ga /ma lus mgon du bdag gyur cig /tshogs gnyis — /53—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gter la bdag spyod shog /gter kha mi 'dzad kun 'god shog /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs 'dzin pa'i/ /chu bo'i rgyun 'di gnas par shog /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba las brtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal ldan mar me mdzad ye shes snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //e ma ho/ bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtha' yas pa'i/ /don gdams par legs ston glegs bam mchog/rgyas sngon chad sbas pa'i lugs mdzad na'ang / /da gsal bar ston phyir spyir bzhengs pas/ /bka' gdams pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur nas/ /spyir ma gyur sems can thams cad dang / /dgos rta mchog zung bul dmigs yul ni/ /yul gang gnyis spyi dpon pra dar dpun/ /bdag bsod snyoms pa la re bcas pa'i/ /rgyu yo byad sbyor ba'i sbyin bdag kun/ /dus myur bar sangs rgyas thob phyir du/ lleng dngul dkar me long 'jam legs pa/ /rig 'phrul yig lha mo'i gzugs bkod pa/ /gtsang zha lu dge 'dun dpal grub dang / shab lhun rtse'i chos ldan legs pa gnyis/ /chos khyad 'phags glegs bam yongs rdzogs 'di/ /dpon mkhas pa brgyad kyi gzab bris brkos// mo ga lam̐ bha wantu/ shu rghaṃ// //ya24 rjog chosanyi shu'i migasasu bcad pa//ka 116 na4 waṃ༄༅/ /pu rgyal bod kyi byang phyogs su/ /grub thob brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gnas/ /dpal gyi dpal gnas yer pa der/ /rgyal ba yab sras bgro mdzad tshe/ /gsang phu'i nags khrod dben pa ni/ /legs pa'i shes rab shes bya'i don/ /'gal 'grel dag par dpyod pa'i tshe/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs mchog der byon nas / / shes bya'i don la khyod mkhas kyang / /gnad du phyin par ma gyur pas/ /bu slob lnga brgya'i tshogs rab rnams/ /bshad nyan nyid la rab 'khod la/ /ma chags yer pa'i nang du song / /di paṃ ka ra bod kyi rje//rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas mtshungs pa me/da/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas gzigs nas/ /zhus lan nor bu rin po chen che/ /gser gyi phreng ba lta bu dag /nyin dang mtshan du mdzad cing yod/ /'di ltar bla ma'i mtshan bzung nas / / bsam gyis mi khyab 'di gsung zhes/ /lhag chad med par gsung de bstan/ /skad cig nyid la lha mi snang / / ya mtshan gzugs mthong chos sgra thos/ /lus stobs med kyang 'phur snying 'dod/ /ring por mi thogs yer par 'gro/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gsung pa nyan/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam pa ni/ /legs pa'i mchog yin byas mos kyi/ /sgom pas nyon mongs ma phyung zhing / /sems la brtan pa ma thob pas/ /nges par gnas der —154—

pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las zhus lan gyi dngos gzhi nor bu'i phreng ba le'u snye shu rtsa gsum pa bzhugs so/ /smin par bya/ /de ltar dga' ba rab rgyas nas/ /slar yang tshogs pa'i dbus su 'ongs/ /de ring thams cad gnas 'dir 'dus/ /nga yi tshig nyon le lo phrol/ /sngon chad bshad pas dus 'das kyang / /man ngag gnad du ma phyin pas/ /da gzod sems la gzer bu 'debs/ /thams cad nyan bshad rang sar brtson/ /sems la phan na nyan bshad bzang / /zhi zhing dul na thos rtags yin/ /nyon mongs chung na sgom rtags yin/ /gnas lugs mthong na rnal 'byor yin/ /lung rigs 'phrod na ston pa yin/ /gnad du phyin na mkhas pa yin/ /thos bsam mi tshe bsgril gyur kyang / /spang blang mi shes las ro yin/ /dge bshes bgros kun bshad pa yi/ /go cha cher gyon slob ma kun/ /thos bsam steng nas nyams len mdzod/ kho bo zla ba gnyis gsum cig /bsgrub gnas yer par rgyal ba yi/ /zhal lta chos nyan nyams len byed/ /don dag yod na de ring gyis/ /de nas rnam g.yeng dgos pa med / / ji srid gnas 'dir ma log par/ /mjal ba skad dang 'bod pa skad// /tsab tsob mang po ma byed cig /nga ni yar rgas phyi ma gnyer/ /dad gus yod na gang zer nyon/ /da ni jo bo yab sras dang / /shes rab rgyal mtshan thugs rtse cig khyod kyis nga yi zhabs tog gyis/ /dgos cha kun kyang khyod kyis skyol/ /de nas phyir log chos khrims gyis/ /mthon po'i gnya' chog dma' ba skyongs/ /chos min skrod la chos pa khur/ /nor dang mi chen dgos pa med/ /sdig grogs sbal ba rma can yin/ /chos pa ma gtogs ngo mi 'dzin/ /nga la mjal zhes don yod skad / / slu brid byung na bdud yin chom/ /nang par snga mor yer bar 'gro/ /mkhas btsun lnga brgya the tshom zos/ /sngar ni thugs sgam bka' mi bkyon/ /do zhag bzhugs sa nags su byed/ /de ring drag po'i gsung 'byon zhing //bshol btab dogs nas mtha' rgya gcod/ /da ni bzhugs par gsol ba dka'/ /gsung bzhin sgrub las mi shes so/ /shab shib (shubaka gros su de skad smra/ /la la dag tu mchi ma 'byin/ /la la sems gso ma ngu zhes/ /ring por mi zug myur du mchi/ /sku gshegs ma gyur de yis chog /nang par ri la nyi shar tshe/ /mdzo pho cig la khal bka' zhing / /mdzo pho cig la bzhon pa byas/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan ma gtogs pa/ /gcig kyang phyogs su me bsten to/ /gsang mda' mar la phyin tsa na/ /skye bo kun dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /the tshom zos nas 'di skad du/ /sngon chad lnga cu mi nyung bar/ /rta bzang chibs te gshegs gyur na/ /de ring 'di 'dra ci yin na/ /gzhan gyis thugs sun ma byung ngam/ /zer zhing mgyogs po mgyogs po dag /gsang phur phyin nas bya btang ngo / /de nas yer pa'i gnas su slebs/ /sngar bzhin rgyal ba sras dang mjal/ /sngar gyi byung lugs snyan du gsol/ /de nas sgo gsum legs brgyud nas/ /'bral glags med par gsol ba btab/ /skyes rabs khyad 'phags nyi shu de/ /legs pa'i shes rab bu chos su/ /jo bos gsung bzhin thugs su chud/ /pha chos nyi shu drug po la/ /nyi shu rtsa — 155—

gcig nags khrod du/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dag par gsungs/ /gcig kyang ma lus thugs su chud/ /slebs ma thag tu le'u gnyis/ /de ni rang gi chos dus su/ /nyi shu ba la bka' rgya thos/ /mthar thug rdo rje'i glu yis rdzogs/ /de ni lo rgyus kyi tshoms so/ /de dag gis rngog chos nyi shu bo thal lo// //

༄tsho//'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnabashakyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu cholo bsdosanathagi theg//ka1dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa bram ze'i khye'idri gsal bar ji ltar skye ba bzhethag pa'i 6pesdosgo )tsho//jo bo yab srasa'i gnyis yer ba lha ri bheng pa'i mgul na bzhugs pa'i dus su/skregan legardzu pa'i shes raX kyas 'brom/ rgyal ba' ༷byung gnas la 'ad skad ces zhus pa/khyed rgyaswā ba yab sraswā gnyas kyas la rugasum/ gya bar du zhus lan nor bu' phreng ba zhes bya ba sduzhan dang thun meng ma yan ru//le'u nya shu ༷ gsum/ gya sgo nas/chos zab mo/ dpag tu med pa gsungs nas /de' ṭwāṃng na ma/ra la/the tshom/ tham/sa cad spang bya zhang //sgrub la nan tan gcesdu su bya//zhes gsungs gda' na/khyed stas sngon the tshom/ tham/sa cad spangs nas bsgrub (sgrubaXpa la nan tan ja sna' bu mjad/༷dag la thusdus brtse ba' sgo ༷sa bstan du gsol/zhes zhus dku/ dang /'brom/ gya dzol nas / /bo bo byas dku/ so so' skye bo 'chang ba du ma/sa bcangs nga/ la/the tshom/sa tham/sa cad spangs ri/ ga la srad/ma/ngon par shes pa me/da pas sngon bsgrub (sgrub1ri/ la nan tan gces spras su byas pa'ang bahūm̐n tre/ra dka'/kho bo la the tshom tham/sa cad spangs nas sgrub sgo / la nan tan gces spras su byas pa med mod kya/sbyar thar sgo/ 'dod pa la the tshom thams cad spangs nas bsgrub (sgrubakapa la nan tan gces sdis su byed dgos ḍi/ra gsal mod gsungs pa dang 'i/gsang phu bas/jo bo la phyasdu gsum bsdul te/rgyal ba' 'byung gnas 'ad yon tan thams cad gab nas ma ༈ོna par gda' dris/khong ga yon tan cag bla mas gsungs bar sdo//khong /ro yon taX yod / bla ma la sgro skur ma mnga'/༷nga ga yon tan thos pa la brten nas dad gus sgom zhang /phya raXs kya sems sdun laXng phan ོ༷gas nga/sa/cas kyang bla mas ༷stan par zhu zhus pasdu/jo bo'i zhal nas/khong ga sdon tan 'ad kun ran ༷ che' gter dang 'dra/yon tan ༷༷ tu che ste gzhan gya st+rior shong par darka'/khyod kyas gadzon la bshad du 'im rung /khyod rang gzung bar bya ba' phyar cung zad bshad kyas 6na sasungs pa dang /rgyal ba' 'byung gnas kya zhal nas/bla ma dam pa khyed la thog mtha' bar gsum/ du dge b.ri chas zab me bstan du

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yod bzhin du bdag 'khor bar 'khyams tshul mang po bstan pa la dgos pa ci bdog de bas ma 'ongs pa na sems can dmu rgod dad pa'i zhing sa log rtog gi bud kyis khyer ba 'ga' zhig 'o na ta ka 2 ba 4dag/zer nas 'ong ba las/ sngar zhus pa bzhin chos zab mo ston par rigs kyi/ bdag gi snying phyir ma 'don zhes zhus pa dang / rngog gi zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ nga de ltar kha yangs klad pa chung ba zhig kyang min / grwa ba lnga brgya bzhag nas/ 'dir the tshom gcod du 'ongs kyis/ khyed rang mi gsungs kyang / jo bos gsung ba la gegs mi mdzad par zhu kho bo'i mgo dang gnyer ma 'di dag la'ang gzigs thugs kyi gzung 'tshal thugs kyi gzung 'tshal zhus pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas kyang / gtam gog po de gsan pas cang gsung ma nus/der jo bo yang yus che che skad du/ legs pa'i shes rab khyod bden/ kho bos thag bcad la bshad kyis/rang re yab sras gsum gyi snying gtam kho na yin pas/ gzhan la ma mched par mdzod gsungs nas/ sngon ser skya'i grong na// bram ze legs skyes shes bya ba/ bram ze'i rig byed thams cad la mkhas pa zhig la/ chung ma yid 'ong ma zhes bya ba cig yod pa la bu zhig skyes pas/ de chung ngu'i dus na blo gsal ba rgan po'i spyod pa byed pa cig byung / der ma na re/ 'di skyes tsam nyid nas rgan po'i spyod pa byed pa/ blo gsal ba zhig 'dug pas las can zhig yin nges ming yang gsal ba zhes bya bar rang bzhin gyis thogs pa zhig 'dug /'di la rig byed thams cad slob dgos zer nas/ yab yum gnyis char gyis bslabs pas/ tshegs med du shes pa cig byung / des lo bdun lon pa na/ bram ze'i rig byed la mkhas pa/ skye bo thams cad kyi ya mtshan gyi gnas su byed pa cig byung ste / de'i tshe ser skyar bram ze rig byed la mkhas pa thams cad 'tshogs te/ rig byed la rtsod pas/ bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba de thub pa ma byung/ der bram ze dag na re/ khyed 'di 'dra ba'i na gzhon pa cig rig byed la 'di ltar mkhas pa ci yin zhes dris pas/ khye'u na re/ nga la ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yod/ skyob pa dam pa'i chos yod/ 'dren pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun yod dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis/las 'bras la yid ches pas the tshom mi za ba rgyu sngon song gi 'bras bu chud mi za ba dge ba la brtson par byed/des kho bo na gzhon kyang rig byed la mkhas par gyur/ zhes smras pa dang / khong rnams na re/ 'di'i zer lugs kyis sprul pa cig yin nges/ rtsod par mi nus zer te gyes nas song ngo / /de nas bram ze'i khye'u gsal bas rang gi pha ma ga la ba der phyin pa dang / pha ma gnyis na re/ de ring khyod kyis rig byed kyi sgra la mkhas pa'i grags pa thob par byas sam/ khye'u na re/ yab yum dkon mchog gi bdag rkyen la brten nas de ltar gyur to/ /der pha ma —158—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gnyis na re/ khyod la dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag rkyen bzang ba'i rgyu ci yin/ khye'us smras pa/ yab yum dkon mchog gsum la sems can gyi don las med pa dang / kho bo las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'i rten 'brel 'dzom mo/ der pha mas smras pa/ las 'bras zab mo de 'dra sus bstan/ khye'us smras pa/ sngon ser skya'i grong khyer 'dir/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba/ zas gtsang gi sras su bstan pa'i dus su/ kho bo bram ze'i khye'u snang ba zhes bya bar gyur te/ kho bo grong khyer gyi sgo na 'dug pa'i tshe/ rgyal bu blon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te grong khyer gyi sgo la byon pa dang / kho bo 'dzom ste/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ bram ze'i khye'u 'bras bu thams cad ni rgyu dang 'dra ste/ 'chol ba ma yin no/ khyod grong khyer gyi sgor bag med par ma 'dug cig sngar tshul khrims kyi mthu can gum pas/ deng sang yang mir skyes so/ /deng sang yang tshul khrims dang ldan par gyis shig ma 'ongs pa na yang bram ze'i khye'u gsal bar gyur te/ las 'bras la mkhas par spyod cing / las 'bras bden rdzun la the mi tshom par bsgrub (sgrubaka pa nyams su blangs te/ sems can gyi don las mi nyams par byed do zhes zer ro zhes smras pas/ der pha ma gnyis kyis sprul pa yin par shes pa dang smras pa/ khyod khyim du gnas te sems can gyi don byed dam/ 'on te rab tu byung nas sems can gyi don byed ces smras pa dang / khye'u na re/ kye yab yum khyim na gnas pa ni me dong dang 'dra/ rang gi btsan sa ma zin par su 'don par byed/ rab tu byung ba ni bsil khang na gnas pa dang 'dra/ gzhan me dong du lhung ba dag 'dren par byed do/ /yab yum kho bo khyim na gnas te 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab sbyar na/ khyed gnyis la bu ma skyes kyi/ rang nyid kyis kyang btsan sa ma zin / khyed gnyis kyang ma 'drongs/ sems can gzhan yang drang bar ma nus na/ bdag gis mi lus thob pa don med de/ dal 'byor don med pa'i phyir ro zhes zer/ yab yum na re/ sems can gyi don byed pa la gnyis/khyim pa dang / rab tu byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /gsal ba grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba'i mi rigs bzhi yod pa/ bzo'i rigs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad yod pa/ mi chos rgyal gyis byin gyis brlabs pas 'byor ba can mang / dad pa'i gzhi che/ des bsod nams gsog pa'i yul yang mang / de'i stobs kyis yon tan can la gtsigs kyang che/ khyad par du 'u cag bram ze'i rig byed 'di gtsang zhing gya nom/ gsal ba 'di rang du bsdad de sems can gyi don byed/ de'i mgon skyabs dkon mchog la 'chol/ rig byed kyi sgra la mkhas pas ma rmongs par lam la zhugs te/ spyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyinatshopa dang / sa dang lam dang pha rol yon tan gyi chos rnamasal ngoms pa med par spyad pa drag mod ces smras pas/ bu na re/ yab yum gnyis gsung ba mad/ spyir chosal gnyis/ nang pa dang / phyi ba'i chos te/ phyi ba'i chos ni dgag bya yin pas shes par ni bya dgos la/ nang — 159—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chas kyi sker/pa'i chos ni spyi dgos thams cad la phan te phyi rol pa'i blor mi shong / ngan pa'i blor mi shong ba rang gi bzang po yin pas mtshon pas/ nang pa'i chos 'di blang bya yang yin te shes par yang bya dgos/ de la gnyis/ theg pa chen po dang chung ngu gnyis/ theg pa chung ngu ni nyan rang gi chos so/ /de gnyis kyang phyi rol pa la ltos nas ni shin tu zab la/ drin can gyi pha ma dpag tu med pa yal bar dor nas rang nyid zhi ba dul ba gtso bor byas te gnas pa ni khrel dang phyi thag shin tu thung bas spang bya yin yang shes par bya dgos shing / theg pa chen po ni pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong yang / de dag shes rab gsum gyis rang bzhin mede par shes par rtag tu de dag gi don las mi 'da' bar byed do/ /de ni sangs rgyas kyi sras yin lam yin la nyan rang gi chos de dag bskal bar byas pa bas/ 'di'i skad cig ma gcig bsod nams che'o/ /de bas na 'di blang bya yin pas shes par yang bya dgos so/ /de la gnyis/ dbu ma dang / sems tsam mo/ /dbu ma la gnyis te/ snang ba tsam gyi dbu ma dang / rab tu mi gnasapa'i dbu ma'o/ /snang ba tsam gyi dbu ma ni/ chos rdzun pa yin pa rdzun par gtan la 'bebs te/ rmi lam la sogs pa sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad kyis bstan no/ /de yang bstan bya ston byed gnyis ka 'khrul ba'i yul dang yul can yin pas spang bya yin la shes par bya dgos so/ /rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma ni/ sangs rgyas rnams byon yang rung / ma byon yang rung / chos rnams kyi chos nyid ye nas mi gnas par gsungs pas/ blang bya yin la shes par bya dgos so/ /sems tsam la gnyis te/ snang ba bden par smra ba dang / rdzun par smra ba'o/ /de dag gnyis car rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma la ltos te 'brul ba yin la shes par ni bya dgos/ kye yab yum chos kyi gnas lugs ni de ltar zad / dpyad na rab tu mi gnas par gda' ba la/ khyim na gnas na ni rnam par rtog pa'i 'jug ldog mang po spros pa'i mtha' dag la dga'/ bya ba mang la byed pa'ang gnas te/ spyir 'khor ba pa'i mtshan nyid sgos khyim pa rnams kyi chos yin no/ /kye yab yum gnyis kho bo la bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba zhes mi zer ram/ de ltar ma mthong na ni mun pa'o// khyim pa'i nang nas kyang ser skya ba 'di dag ni grong khyer che/ skye bo mang / rnam g.yeng la dga' bas/ grogs kyi stobs kyis grogs can yang song ba mang / kho bo na gzhon pa dang / gzugs mdzes pa dang / blo gsal ba'i grags pa che ba dang / khyed pha ma gnyis kyang byams pas g.yin gyis nyon mongs pa la bkod na mi rung de bas na don mi 'grub pa'i the tshom thams cad bcad nas 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa 'jig rten gyi mgon po sangs rgyas bsgrub (sgrubaka pa la nan tan dang gces spras su byas pa drag mod/ yab yum gnyis na re/ bu khyed rab tu byung na gnas gang du 'byung / mkhan slob su la zhu/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po sangs — /60—

'brom/ ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rgyas bsgrub (sgrubaka pa la nan tan gces spras su mjad pa'i dgon pa gang du byed/ des na grong khyer ser skya'i mthar 'gro ba la'ang thag ring na de las gzhan pa'i ri brag la sogs pa thag ring por 'gro na bdag cag gnyis bu dang bral/ khyod ni mig dang 'dra ste/ thag ring bar gyur na ni long ba'o// khyod ni snying dang 'dra ste/ de ltar song na ni shi ba dang 'dra'o/ khyod ni yan lag dang 'dra ste/ de ltar song na ni zha bo dang 'dra'o/ /kye gsal ba / sems can thams cad pha ma nyid du bsgoms na bdag cag pha gru/ gnyis 'di nyid du lus ston pa'i pha ma yin na/ ci ste sdug bsngal du 'jug smras pa dang / gsal ba na re/ khyed gnyis po bden/ pha yul ni bdud sdig to can gyi khang pa dang 'dra bar bshad de'i nang nas khyim ni btson dong dang 'dra ba nyid de/ bde ba'i srog dang 'bral bar byed/ mi chos ni las kyi 'ching thag chen po ste thar pa'i gnas su 'gro mi ster/ 'dod yon ni dug dang 'dra ste 'phral khar zhim la phugs srog 'phrog kye yab yum gnyis ser skya'i grong khyer 'di na kho bo the tshom bsal nas bsgrub (sgrub3 pa byed pa'i gnas med/ kho bo ni bsgrub (sgrub1 pa 'phel ba'i gnas 'tshol la/kye yab yum gnyis kho bo mig dang 'dra na/ mi/ga gzugs lta ba la dgos kyi/ gzugs mi mthong na ni mig med pa dang 'dra'o/ /kye yab yum kho bo khyim du bsdad de 'khar ba'i nyes dmigs ma/ mthong / mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon ma mthong na ni mig med pa dang 'dra'o/ kho bo snying dang 'dra ste snying gi bya ba byed dgos pa yin/ kho bo yan lag dang 'dra ste yan lag gi bya ba byed dgos pa yin/ de ltar snying dang yan 8pag me da na ni gsob yan lag me/da pa dang 'dra'o/ /kye yab yum kho bos thar pa'i srog brtan pa'i snying bya/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon len pa'i yan lag bya'o/ /de nas gang na gnas dben pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang na yod pa'i sar khyed yab yum gyis 'dren pa'i bla ma bya ste skyel bar zhu zhus pa dang / yab yum na re/ gsal ba mig dang 'dra ba khyed / / dben pa'i gnas su 'gro'o zhes/ /bsgrub (sgrubaka pa lhur len the tshom gcod/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gar yod par/ /nged kyis 'dren pa gyis zer na/ /'o na gnas 'dir dge ba spyod/ /ces smras pa dang /gsal ba na re/ yab yum bdag gis du ma zhig smras kyang 'ching ba'i gtam brjod pas zad kyis/ legs pa'i don lung mi ston par gsal bas/ ser skya'i grong khyer gyi dbus dang / tshong 'dus dang / grong khyer gyi bzhi mdo dang / skyed mos tshal la sogs par dga' bde spyod cing phyogs gang nas skye bo gang dag 'ongs pa la/ gang na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yod pa dang / dben pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'dri bar bya'o/ /der yab yum na re/ ser skya'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ rgyal ba'i sprul ba dpag med 'byung / /gdul bya las can lta bar byed/ /de ring dga' bder chos la spyod/ /bu gsal ba nyon mongs dbang ma 'gyur/ /— /6/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/grogs ngan dbang du ma song bar/ /gang na bshes yod dri bar mdzod/ /des kyang pha ma lung bstan byed/ /ces smras pa dang / gsal ba na re/ de ring dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa bdar/ yul khyad par can de la gsol ba'ang btab/ sems can don du smon lam rnam par dag pa'ang btab ste/ gang dang gang du phyin pa na/ sprul ba gang dag na re/ khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen pha ma yin pas/ de nyid du the tshom thams cad spongs la bsgrub (sgrubakapa gyis shig ces zer na ni/ yab yum ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o/ /gal te phyogs dang phyogs mtshams g.yin na bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang gnas kyang gzhan na yod ces zer na ni de dag tu 'gro bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yab yum dkon mchog gsum ni nusapa mthu btsan zhing skal ba can rnams 'dren pa'i dus las skad cig kyang mi 'da'o zhes zer nas/ nyin cig snga dro'i dus su gyur ba na/ ser skya'i lho phyogs na mtsho mo ngang ba lding zhes bya ba skye bo thams cad dga' mgur rtse ba cig yod pa der phyin pa dang / khye'u brgya phrag mang po dga' dga' bzhin rtse ba mthong ste/ gsal bsakyang de'i gseb tu phyin pa dang /pha ma gang zhig bu gcig pu mthong ba ltar khye'u de dag gsal ba'i thad du byung ste/ dga' zhing chags pa'i gtam mang po smras pa/ khye'u yid 'ong lta na sdug /'jam zhing snum zhing gser mdog sku/ /bag phebs blo gsal bram ze'i bu/ /lusakyang gser mdog phyis 'drar gda'/ /bdag cag bkra shis khye'u'i tshogs/ /brgya phrag mang po 'dir lhags nas/ /mtshan ldan khyod la gang dgos rnams/ /thogs pa med par bsgrub (sgrub1 par bya/ /gnas 'dir bde bar rtag tu byon/ /nee'u gsing me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bya sa rnams/ /dga' ba'i khyus rten khyod la mchod/ /mkhas pa mang po'ang 'dir lhags te/ /dag pa'i tshig gis mchod par byed / / sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa'i dgung gseb nas/ /sna tshogs mchod pa khyer ba yi/ /lha bran mang po dga' bzhin du/ /gus par mchod cing gnas 'dir lhags/ /nged kyi rjes su mthun par spyod/ /dang por ma 'phrad mi rtog kyang / /phrad nas khyod song zhum par 'gyur/ /de bas khyed gsung nged kyis bsgrub (sgrubaka / /gang dgos de yang tshig gis khrol/ /bdag cag lhan cig dga' bder rtse/ /zhes zer ro/ /gsal bas smras pa/ sngon chad mtho risargyu song ba'i/ khye'u mtshan ldan brgya phrag dag /gnas 'dir dga' zhing 'khod gyur te/ /bdag la dga' bas bstod pa mtshar/ /blo gsal rigs ldan khye'u'i tshogs/ /thar pa'i lam du mi 'gro ba'i/ /nyon mongs rtse dga' las ro yin/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa yi/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i chos la spyod/ /bla ma bzang po bsten byed cing / /thar pa'i grogs dang 'grogs na bde/ /bde ba'i pad tshal rgyas pa yi/ /thar pa'i tshal du brtse bar bya / / e ma blo gsal khye'u kun/ /lha mi'i bde skyid gang yin pa/ /sgo gsum dge ba rgyas pa yin/ /thar pa'i —162—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /lam mchog gang yin pa/ /gzhan gyi don la brtson pa yin/ /dpa' bo'i spyod pa gang yin pa/ /nyon mongs lam du 'khyer ba yin/ /nyon mongs lam 'khyer gang yin pa/ /spang bya gnyen pos bskul ba yin/ /gnyen po'i nang nas gang mchog pa/ /spang bya thug phrad byed pa yin/ /spang bya thug phrad gang zhes pa/ /skyes tsam nyid na 'joms pa yin/ /kye khye'u dag bdag gis smras pa'i tshig de dag ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu dge ba'i ngag yin gyis the tshom ma byed par/ de bsgrub (sgrubaka pa la nan tan gces su mdzod/ khye'u dag grong khyer ser skya na srog chags ji tsam zhig gda'/ de dag la mi ji tsam zhig mchis/ mi dag las bsod nams gsog pa ji tsam zhig mthong / khye'u dag gis smras pa/ kye mtshan ldan/ grong khyer ser skya 'di na ni/ srog chags shin tu mang na'ang / shin tu mang mod kyis byol song gi nyi shu cha tsam/ bsod nams gsog pa'ang de'i cha tsam mo kye bram ze'i khye'u bdag cag gis mthong ba tsam khyod la gsal mod kyis/ gzhan ni bdag cag la mngon par shes pa med par zhu bar mi spobs so/ /der gsal bas smras pa/ khye'u dag de bzhin du chos byed pa ni shin tu dkon na / khyed rnams bag med par sdod dam/ der ma zad kho bo yang bag med pa la bskul bar byed dam/ kye khye'u dag mi lus thob pa ni don yod par spyod cig ces smras pa dang / khye'u rnams na re/ khyed kyi khyim gang na yod/yab yum ji skad bya bar grags/ rgyal po'i snyan na khye'u khyed mchis sam/ gsal bas smras pa/ kho bo'i grong ni ser skya'i byang na yod/ /rig byed kun la mkhas pa bra ze'i rigs/ /legs skyes shes bya kun la rtsod pa med/ /yid 'ong ma zhes bud med blo gsal ma/ /rig byed kun la mkhas par rtsod pa med/ /de ni bdag gi ma yin khye'u kun/ /ser skya'i gnas 'dir kho bo mkhas par grags/ /rgyal po'i snyan na'ang yod mchi gtam skyes mang //'jig rten dag ni grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /'jig rten 'das pa gnas lugs spyod par byed/ khye'u brgya phrag mang po spyod na mkhas pa yin/ /bdag ni dben par 'gro zhing dam pa 'tshol/ /gsan nas khye'u brgya phrag du ma rnams/ kho bo'i the tshom chod na dgos pa yin/ /zhes smras pa dang / khye'u dag na re/ grong khyer ser skya 'di ni rin po che'i gling yin pas gang 'dod pa kun 'byung / khyed ji ltar dgos pa bzhin du gnas 'di nyid du 'byung mchi / bdag cag rnams kyang khyed dang lhan cig tu dam pa 'tshol zhing / khyod dang mthun par spyod do zhes smras pa dang / gsal ba na re/ 'o na rang rang gi pha ma gang na yod pa'i sar song la/ gnas dben pa dang / grogs bzang po dang / bla ma bzang po dag gang na yod pa dris shig smras pa dang / khye'u dag gsal ba la blta zhing ngag cog (gcogakani ma nus/ 'bral ba /7ba yang/ma phod par yod pa la/ lho'i phyogs shig nas ngang ba gcig gis sna drangs ngang ba dgu rim gyi rim gyi byung ste/ mtsho de'i nang du babs so/ /de yang ngang ba sngun ma des — 163—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/gser gyi bum pa g.yu'i maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhag pa ltar bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba la mdun gyis bltas te/ snyan pa'i sgra mang po 'byin cing 'dug pa khye'u dag gis kyang thos/ de'i 'khor na gnas pa'i ngang pa brgyad po de dag kyang / g.yu'i maṇḍal la gser gyi bum pas rgyan du bkod pa ltar phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi na mdzes par gnas so/ khye'u brgya phrag mang po de dag gis kyang de mthong nas shin tu ngo mtshar che ste/ mtsho'i 'gram du btud cing bltas pa dang / ngang pa de dag go rim ma zhig par khye'u gsal ba ga la ba der 'phos shing gnas so/ /der khye'u gsal bas ngang ba gzugs ya mtshan dang ldan pa gral gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs par 'khod pa de dag mthong ste de dag gi sgra snyan pa de la brtags shing dpyad pas/ ser skya'i grong khyer 'di ni rnam g.yeng che / / ser skya'i rgyal po 'di yang mi la dga'/ khye'u gnas 'dir yun ring bsdad gyur na// /rgyal pos grong du mnar na mi rung ngo / /zhes zer ro/ /bram ze'i khye'u gsal bas smras pa/ de bzhin ser skya'i grong khyer rnam g.yeng che/ /rgyal po 'di yang mi la shin tu dga'/ kho bo khyim du mnar na mi rung bas/ /bshes gnyen dben pa'i gnas mchog bstan par zhu/ /ngang bas smras pa/ e ma las can khye'u gzugs mdzes po mtsho mo ngang ba lding zes grags pa yi/ /dga' ba'i tshal rab me tog rgyas pa 'dir/ khye'u brgya phrag mang pos bskor byas nas / / dga' ba'i nyams skyong gnas 'dir 'khod pa la/ /bdag cag mkha' lding dbyings las 'dir 'ongs tshe / / g.yu yi maṇḍal dbyibs legs lta na sdug /mi gtsang rnyog mas ma gos dwangs pa mthong / /bdag cag sems kyi skyon bral ngang ba dgu/ /legs par 'khod de khyed la mchod par byed/ /da ni 'di gson khyod la snying gtam smra/ /'di nas lho phyogs rgyang grags lnga brgyar song / /de na dben pa'i ri brag chen po yod/ /bram ze'i btsun pa blo gros 'jigs med bzhugs/ /de las gdams pa long la the tshom chod/ /bsgrub (sgrub3 pa rtse gcig mdzod cig rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang / /mkhas pa de yin lnga brgya'i tha mar yang / khyod kyi mgon po des byed gdams pa len/ khye'u the tshom ma byed gnas der shog /dam pa'i chos ni bar chod shin tu mang / /pha mas bslu zhing grogs kyis bslu bar byed/ /nor gyis bslu zhing grags pas 'ching bar byed/ /gsal ba de ltar mthong ngam grags pa can/ /zhes zer ro/ /yang khye'u gsal bas smras pa/ ngang pa lding zhes tshal rab rgyas pa 'dir/ /sprul pa'i gser bya lta bas mi ngoms pa/ /lho phyogs rang bzhin dag pa'i nam mkha' las/ /ma chags gser btanog rgyas te mtsho 'dir babs/ /e ma g.yu yi maṇḍal mdzes pa la/ /gser gyi bum pa cig la gser bum brgyan/ /phyogs nas bskor te skad snyan sgrogs pa thos/ khye'u brgya phrag mang pos bskor gyur kyang / /ngang ba khyed mthong dga' ba 'ba' zhig las/ /gzhan du sems ni cung zad yengs — /64—

'brem ston pa/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ma gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / sprul pa'i ngang pa de dag na re/ bdag cag g.yu mtsho rnyog med dwangs pa la/ /gser bya ser po gcig la gser bya brgyad/ /phyogs nas bskor zhing tshig sgra rab tu sgrogs/ /e ma ya mchan bram ze'i khye'u mthong / /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra bzhin mdzes po/ /bag yod thabs kyis thar par brtson zhes thos/ /gang la'ang chags par ma byed myur du song / /bdud kyi bu mo 'jum zhing chas kyis brgyan/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin zhi zhing dul ba ltar/ khyod la bshol 'debs chags pas bslus srid pas/ /myur du gnas der shin tu brtson par song / /bram ze'i bcun pas bram ze'i khye'u 'dzin/ /zhes zer ba de thos pa dang / bram/ ze'i khye'u gsal ba'i rtog pa la/ bram ze'i bcun pa bro gros 'jigs med de ngang ba 'di nyid du sprul nas kho bo'i the tshom gcod du 'ongs pa 'dra bas slar dri dgos snyam pa dang / /ka 8 ba3 rgongang pa de dag/lho'i phyogs la 'phur te song ngo / /der bram ze'i khye'u de'i dgongs pa la long med myur du lho phyogs su shog zer ba'i brdar 'dug snyam ste/ slar log nas pha ma'i khyim ga la ba der phyin no/ /der sras sngar dang mi 'dra bar bzhin 'jum pa dang ldan zhing dga' bas rgyas pa de pha ma gnyis kyis ma/thong nas/ de ring gsal ba 'di bzhin 'angupa zhing dgyes nas gda' na/ pha ma gnyis la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas rgyu rkyen bshad du gsol/ gsal ba'i zhal nas/yab yum kho bo dga' ba rgyas pa'i ngag bshad kyis nyon cig de ring grong /ntur ser skya yi/ /lho phyogs padma'i chal rab der/ /ngang pa lding zhes mtsho mo la/ /mkha' dbyings dag nas gser gyi bya/ /gcig gis sna drangs dgu 'grengs te/ /mtsho mo g.yu yi maṇḍal la/ /gser gyi bum pa lto ba ldir/ /g.yu yi mchu can zangs kyi zhabs/ /mi g.yo spar mo dra bas 'brel/ /bde gshegs phyag bzhin brtan par gda'/ /phyogs bzhi de yi mtshams bcas na / / gser bum g.yu mchu sbar zangs can/ /goms pa mi 'degs g.yo zhing 'gul/ /bdag la blta zhing skad snyan 'byin/ kho bos de la dpyad pa la/ /ser skya'i gnas 'di rnam g.yengs che/ /rgyal po 'di yangami la dga'/khye'u gnas 'dir ring gyur na/ khyim du mnar na mi rung bas/ /lho phyogs rgyang grags lnga brgyar song / /de na dben pa'i nags khrod yod/ /bram ze'i bcun pa blo gros mchog /gang la'ang 'jigs med bya ba bzhugs/ /de la chos kyi gdams pa long / /rtse gcig bsgrub (sgrubakal nan tan gyis/ /gal te gnas 'dir ring gyur na/ /bdud kyi bu mos bslus pa srid/ /nye ba'i pha mas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis phan pa'i snying gtam yin/ /cis kyang gnas der myur du song / /spyir yang bdud rigs bar chad mang / khyad par gzhan don nyams par byed / / the tshom ma mang bsgrub pa mdzod/ /bram ze'i btsun pa 'jigs med des/ /bram ze'i khye'u khyed 'dzin zhes / / lho yi phyogs la 'phur te song / /long med rjes su shog ces go /yab yum gnas der lam sna mdzod/ /— sdi65—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nges par bsgrub pa bsam gtan byed/ /'jigs med bram ze chen po de/ /'das dang ma 'ongs kun tu yang / /bdag gi bla mar gyur 'gyur zhes/ /sprul pa'i gser bya de la thos/ /yab yum las dang rten 'brel 'dzom/ /bar gcod ma byed bdud las spongs/ /bram ze skyes pa blo gsal ba/ /chos la spyod na don dang ldan/ /de las gzhan na mu stegs yin/ /zhes smras pa dang / yum yid 'ong ma zhes bya ba rig byed la mkhas pa'i sgra mkhan mo des legs par dpyad nas chos la 'jug pa des sras la yid ches pa'i tshig gis 'di skad ces smras pa/ kho mo mngal bzang rgyal sras 'khrungs/ /bram ze blo gsal gsal bar grags/ khyod ni sprul par the tshomi med/ /ma bslabs rang byung chosagasung ba/ /gsal dag snyan pa'i tshig gis smra/ /nang pa'i nyi ma dgos su shar/ /mu stegs 'chal ba'i tshogs 'joms pa'i/ /chos kyi rdo rje dpa' bo ste/ /gar rgyab thal le lho phyogs su/ /rgyang grags lnga brgya'i ri brag tu/ /bram ze mkhas pa stong phrag gis/ /gtsug gi nor bur mchod byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa 'jigasamed la/ /deng sang ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /bram ze mkhas pa dag gi tshogs/ /phyogs nas bskor te rtsod gyur kyang / /rtsod pa ma nus gsal ba khyod/ /gdams pa len du 'gro ba legs/ /da ni kho mo cir gyur kyang / /bsgrub (sgrubakal bar chod mi bgyid do/ /yab kyis smras pa/ /gsal ba'i gsal ba bram ze'i rigs/ /dga' bar skyed mos tshal du song / /sprul ba'i gser bya ngang ba dgus/ /lho phyogs ri brag lhun po la / / bram ze'i bla ma 'jigs med dpal/ khyod kyi bla mar lung bstan na/ /legs kyisanges par chosabyed na//de yi drung du 'gro bar rigs/ /bdag kyang de la dgar gyur na/ /bar gcod byed pa ga la rigs/ / zhesasmras pa dang / khye'u rab tu dga' ste/ yab yum la smras pa/ mtsho las skyes pa'i ge sar de/ /tsha zer stong gis rab 'byed ltar/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho ge sar nga / /rnam dag sems kyi pad sdong che/ /'brel chags brjid kyis brgyan pa yi / khyed kyis grag stong bsgrags pa yis/ kho bo'i blo gros gsal bar byas/ /bsil zer rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyang / / zil gyis mnan te gsal byed ltar/ /bram ze phal rnams zil mnan te/ /nga ni myur du lho ru 'gro/ /legs skyes don dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /gsal ba'i sna drongs myur du 'dengs/ /mi bzhed na ni kho bo 'gro/ /zhes smras pa dang / yab yum na re/ nang par shar lho'i phyogs shig nas/ /dmar zlum nyi ma rab gsal zhig /dbus su shar tshe lho ru 'gro /mu stegs mun pa'i tshogasarnamasa'ajoms/ khye'usasmras pa/ zla bas sna drangs nyi mas rten / / 'od stong gsal ba dbus na gda'/ /rgyu skar tshogs rnams phyogs na 'dar/ /rgyang grags lnga brgyar phyin pa na/ /nyi ma'i nyi ma tshad med pa/ /zla ba brgyad kyis bskor gyur te/ /'od zer phyogs dang mtshams su 'gyed / / mi shes mun pas bsgribs pa rnams/ /rab tu bsal te thar bar bsgyur/ /de yang 'brel chags nyi ma —166—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yin / / zhes smras pa dang / yab yum na re/ gsal bas gsal bar ji skad smras pa bzhin du nang par nyi ma'i drung du 'gro bar bya'o/ /zer nas nang par nyi ma shar ba dang dus mnyam du lho phyogs dben pa'i nags khrod du bram ze'i btsun pa blo gros 'jigs med kyi drung du phyin pa dang / rgyang ma nas bram ze'i btsun pa blo gros 'jigs med ces bya/ bram ze'i btsun pa blogros gsal ba brgyad mdun na bdar te ma 'dres ma sbags ma'i chos ston pa mthong ngo / /der bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba/ ma bu gcig pu lo mang por ma phrad pa phrad pa tsam du dga'o/ /der yab yum gnyis kyi dbus su bzhugs te sor bcu'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ ngag snyan pas rig byed kyi sgra 'don zhing bla ma'i drung du phyi nas/ zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ phyag 'tshal/ chos bzhin du lan gsum bskor nas mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug ste 'di skad ces gsol ba/'jig rten sgron ma skyabs gcig pu/ /'das dang ma 'ongs kun tu yang / /bdag gi mgon po yin zhes thos / / bla ma khyed kyi thugs rje yi/ /bdag gi nyon mongs bsal du gsol/ /bram ze blo groms tha' yas rnams/khyod zhabs spyi bor blangs gyur te/ /gtsug gi nor bu bzhin du mchod/ /gang mchod sdug bsngal tha mar byed/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba yis/ /gling gi mun pa 'joms pa bzhin/ /bla ma khyed kyi 'od zer gyis/ /bdag gi ma rig bsal su gsol/ /bdag gi lus 'di brgyar gtubs kyang/ /'jigs pas the tshom mi za bar/ khyed kyi gdams pa nyams su blang / /mthar thug 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu/ /bsgrub (sgrub3la nan tan gces su bya / / drin can dpag tu med pa yi/ /yab yum gnyis kyang drang du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba khyod/ /nga yi drung du 'ongs pa legs/ /'bras bu rgyu la mi 'khrul bas/ /the tshom ma byed blo gros can/ /thar ba'i btsan sa gang yin pa/ /the tshom spangs te bsgrubs na 'byung / /chos kyi gnas lugs gang yin pa/ /sgro 'dogs skur ba'i mtha' las grol/ /shes rab gnas lugs gang yin pa/ /spros pa'i mtha' las grol ba yin/ /bram ze'i khye'u nga la nyon/ /rgyu rnams rang gi stong gyur na/ /de yis 'bras bu gang zhig skyes/ /sna tshogs 'khrul ba mang stobs kyis/ /ma shes blo can bden par 'dzin/ /de ni khyod kyi pha ma yin / / mig can khyod kyis drang bar rigs/ /byams dang snying rje phyogs med la/ /pha ma bde la dga' ba can/ /byasapa shes shing drin gzo ba'i/ /ded dpon rnams kyi spyod pa yin/ /bram ze'i khye'u nga la nyon/ /de ni thabs dang shes rab yin/ /de la the tshom ma byed par/ /de nyid bsgrub (sgrubaka la gces spras mdzod/ /bsam gtan 'bol ba'i stan la 'dug /tshul khrims dag pa'i gos mchog gyon/ /tshad med ting 'dzin zas su zo/ /spro ba'i brtson 'grus bran du khol/ /bzod pa'i go cha brtan par gyis/ /shes rab mtshon gyis dgra bo thul/ /thabs — 167—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mkhas blon po phyogs bcur khye/ /de ni nga yi gdams pa yin/ /nga ni gnas 'dir rtse gcig tu/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa/ /nyon mongs skyon dang ma 'dres par/ /dag pa'i sems kyis gzhan don spyod/ khyim na gnas kyang sems dpa' mchog /legs skyes dang ni yid 'ong ma/ /don ldan sems dpa' srasasu bltams/ /tshe rabs kun tu bde bar byed/ /rang gi bu la ma chags par/ /ser skya'i grong du g.yin don mdzod/ /de ni bdag gi gdams pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yab yum gnyis kyis gsol ba/ /bdag cag bram ze'i tshogs rab kyi/ /skyabs kyi dam pa bla ma mchog /bdag cag skal bar ldan pa yin/ /snying gi padma'i ze 'bru la/ /bla ma khyod bzhugs tshim par mdzod/ /da ni bdag cag 'gro bar bgyi/ /zhes byang gi phyogs su rang gi khyim ga la ba der song ngo / /bram ze'i khye'u gsal bas kyang bsam gtan gyi khang bu mi che ba cig byas te/ 'jig rten 'di'i the tshom thams cad bcad nas/ bla ma blo gros 'jigs med kyi drung du rab tu byung ste/ bsgrub (sgrub3 pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa na/ bdud sdig to can zhig rang gi bu gzhan gyis 'phrogs pa ltar ma dga' nas/ bla ma 'jigs med kyi cha lugs ji lta ba bzhin du khang bu'i nang du byung ste/ gsal ba khyod kyi rab tu byung / 'jig rten gyi rnam g.yeng spangs/ bsgrub (sgrubakapa la rtse gcig tu zhugs nas lo dgu tsam thal/ da ni spang bya spangs gnyen po thob/ khyod skyes bu dam par gyur gyis/ /da gcig pur sdod pa ni gzhan don las nyams pas/ khang bu 'di nas thon te/ grong khyer du gzhan don du spyod cing dga' bder spyod cig da ni khyod la bdag gis gnang ba ster ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /der bram ze'i khye'us smras pa/ bla ma'i gzugs can sdig to can/ /bden bden skad du slu bar byed/ /sngon chad rnam g.yeng bdud kyis bslus/ /da ni 'di las mi 'da'o/ /phyag 'tshal mtshungasapa med pa yi/ /'jig rten skyabs gcig dkon mchog gsum/ /da ni 'di nas gzung ste khyod/ /dngos su ma byung bar du gzhan / / bdag gi gan du byung gyur kyang / /'di las the tshom skad cig kyang / /mi za lhag par brtson par bya/ /'di ni bdag gis dam bca'o/ /zhes lhag par brtson 'grus cher song ngo / /de nas zla ba gcig 'das pa na bla ma blo gros 'jigs med nyid byung ste/ bu bdud kyis the tshom ma skyed dam/ /rtse gcig bsgrub (sgrub1las ma nyams sam/ /bdud la bla mar ma 'khrul lam/ /'on te brtson 'grus skyed par byas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /tshe dang ldan pa dkon mchog gsal bas zhus pa/ nyin cig rtse cig bsgom pa na/ /bla mar bcos pa'i bdud cig byung / khyod kyis bsam gtan lo dgur byas/ /da ni gang dgar spyod cig zer/ /the tshom ma skyes lhag par brtson / / dam bca' brtan zhing dam par gyur/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ skyes bu dam pa blo gros can / / legs so dkon mchog gsum gyi sras/ /ma 'ongs lnga brgyar gyur ba na/ /mtha' 'khob yul du bdag —168—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /cag gnyis/ /zab mo'i chos la longs spyod cing / /lhan cig 'gro don spyod pa na/ khyod kyi ma ni legs pa yi/ /shes rab mchog ces dam par 'gyur/ /de tshe deng sang 'byung ba yi/ /bdud kyi bar chad byas gyur kyang / /the tshom ma byung lhag par brtson/ /bsgrub (sgrubakal gces spras byas pa rnams/ khyed kyi ma 'dri kho bos ston/ /bag chags sad de shes par 'gyur/ /bram ze'i btsun pa de ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos la mkhas par gyur gyis/ da dung yang 'di las ma g.yos par ji srid gnas kyi bar du the tshom thams cad spangs te bsgrub (sgrubaka pa 'di las ma nyams par mdzod cig ces byin gyis brlabs shing bslab bya mdzad nas dag pa'i gnas su gshegs so/ /bram ze'i btsun pa des kyang bar du gcod pa ji tsam zhig byung yang / kho bo dkon mchog gsal bar byin gyis brlabs kyis/ dkon mchog gsal bar tshig dang don rme/thun par bya'o/ / des na bsgrub (sgrubaka pa bsam gtan 'di las skad cig kyang mi g.yo bar bya'o zhes lo lnga cu rtsa lnga'i bar du the tshom thams cad spangs te bsgrub (sgrubakapa la nan tan gces spras su byas so/ /legs pa'i shes rab de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i btsun pa blo gros 'jigs med ni kho bo nyid do/ /yid 'ong ma ni khyod nyid do/ /legs skyes ni /khu'o / / bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba kho bo la gdams pa thob nas dkon mchog gsal ba ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid do zhes gsung ngo / /de ltar/ the tshom thams cad spang bya zhing / /bsgrub (sgrubakal nan tan gces su bya / / zhes ba las brtsams te/ 'grom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ bram ze'i khye'u gsal bar ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //kha2 ko'u shi snir rgyal bu chags pa med par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lelga༄tsho/ /yang ye ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ legs pa'i shes rab kyis drung du phyin te phyag gsum btsal nas/ jo bo yab sras la 'di skad ces zhus pa/ gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis sngon skye ba snga ma la/ skye ba khyad par can bzhes lugs kha rtsang yang rgyas par bshad mod kyis/ de ring yang nor bu'i phreng ba 'di na mar la/ gnyid rmugs le lo rab spangs shing / /rtag tu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /zhes zhus lan dang bcas pa mang po gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di sngon gnyid rmugs dang le lo spangs nas brtson/ 'grus chen po ji ltar bgyis/ kho bo dad pa'i sems kyis nyan pa lags kyis/ lo 'dod dang re ltos gang yang mi bdog pas jo bos thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas gsung du gsolazhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas snod du mi rung ba'i mi mi gda'am/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ da lta rang re — 169—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yab sras gsum las mi gda' yis/ da gzod lhags pas rtsig gseb na phar skyel mod kyis/ de ring 'dzer bar 'gro ba gda' bas/ bla ma las sgro skur mi mnga'/ rngog khyed thos pa dang yon tan gyis nga rgyal med/ dad gus kyi gzhi che/ bla ma dang grogs po la/ bla ma dang grogs por 'dzin/ mi chos dang lha chos gnyisaka la mkhasapas / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la dngul gyi maṇḍal cig la dung chung dkar po'i rgyan bkod la phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal la gzigs la snying rje cig kyang bsgoms(sgomasaka/ bdag la'ang spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod la nyon cig jo bos kyang don dang mthun par gsung ba zhu zhes gnang ba dang / sngar med pa'i dri bzang po khyad par can zhig byung / me tog sngon po sol le ba'ang yang yang lhung zhing byung / rgyal ba yab sras chags sdang gi mtsho skam/ log rtog gi me zhi/bstan pa gsal byed kyi sgron me 'bar/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sku che ba'i yon tan bshad pasabod khams kyi sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par 'gyur/ zhes bya ba'i sgra snyan pa cig kyang thos/ 'brom nam mkha' la gzigs shing zhal 'dzum 'dzum gda' ba la/ rngog gi zhal nas/ khyed nam mkha' la gzigs lugs de dang / sgra snyan pa cig kyang gda' ba dang / ltas khyad par can gzhan yang gda' bas/ 'di yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams dge bar ston pa yin pa la the tshom/ med ces zhus pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sku che ba'i yon tan bshad pa la lha rnams dga' ste rang rang gi me tog dang bdug spos khyer nas mchod cing gda'o/ /lha mo sgrol ma'ang ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa 'bul zhing gda'o/ /rngog rang yang de dag blos long la phul cig khyod rang yang 'brom gyis gsungs pa bzhin du dngul gyi maṇḍal la dung gi rgyan khod la dngos su phul cig da ni don po dang ldan no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rngog gi zhal nas/ kho bo la di ring dngul gyi maṇḍal bas shing gi yang med de/ da des ma phan chos zab mo zhu ba la dka' tshegs cung zad ma bzod na mi rung bas/ di ring 'on 'chang rdo na mar phyin la maṇḍal de'i bsgrub (sgrubakayar byas la myur du log ste chos zab mo zhu'o zhes zhus pa dang / 'brom gyi zhal nas/ rngog blo sna ma mang lha thams cad kyang 'di na 'dug gda'/ mi gcig gi ring la lha mang po ldog tu bcug pas mi 'ong di ring nga rang gi maṇḍal nga rang gis bsham gyis gsungs pa la/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'brom khyod kyis maṇḍal
