ma shoms pa ma yin/ de ring rngog gi tshogs rdzogs dgos pas/ rngog la ngas cig dbul gyis gsungs nas/ na bza'i phag na tshur dngul gyi maṇḍal khru gang ba cig ljur ('juraka gyis bton nas/ de'i steng du dung chung brgya rtsa brgyad spungs te/ rngog gi phyag tu gtad nas/ 'di dag bla ma gser gling pa la sogs pa drin can gyi 'dren pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs —170—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /par bya ba'i phyir du khyod la 'bul lo/ khyod kyis kyang rang gi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la phul cig gsungs pa dang / legs pa'i shes rab kyis kyang bla mas gnang ba'i maṇḍal 'di bdag gi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i don du khyed la 'bul lo zhes 'brom la phul nas spyan sngar 'dug pa dang /jo bo'i zhal nas/ legs pa'i shes rab sngon yul ko'u shi bhi zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po 'od zer dpal zhes bya ba la/ btsun mo legs ldan ma zhes bya ba yod pa la sras gnyis 'khrungs te/ rgyal srid skyong thekha bya ba dang /chags pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyal srid skyong de ni sems kyi rtsal che ba/ nor dang longs spyod la dga' ba/ rgyal srid la bdag 'dzin che ba/ yul gyi mi thams cad la'ang dbang spyod pa/ dregs pa che zhing gar 'gro ba'i phyogs thams cad du khye'u dang / blon po mang pos g.yog byas te 'gro'o/ /ma chags pa de ni/ zhi ba dul ba/ rgyal srid la 'dod pa med pa/ zas gos la sogs pa gang byung gis chog shes pa/ thams cad la'ang ngag snyan pa'i tshig gisasmra ba/ skyed mos tshal la 'gro ba'i tshe/ khye'u rang dang mthun pa mang po khrid de/ rang nyid slob dpon gyi tshul du byas te de dag la chos ston pa dang / rdzing bu'i nang du rtsed mo'i gzings byas te skye bo mang po pha rol tu sgrol ba dang / gzhan dma' bar lhung ba dag 'dren pa dang / phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa dge ba'i ltas khyad par can gyi rtse mo byed/ pha mas rang la zas gang byin pa/ de'i gsum gnyis gzhan la ster/ rab tu byung ba mthong na/dpagatshad cig nas byung yang sngon du dga' bzhin du thogs pa med par phyin nas phyag dang bskor ba byas te/nges kyi pha ma'i gnas su gshegs/ nga yang khyed kyi drung du 'gro/ khyed 'dra ba cig la smon no zhes dge ba'i ltas khyad par can ston pas/ yul ko'u shi bhi'i rgan gzhon med pa/ 'di 'dra ba'i rgyal bu 'jig rten na dkon zhes thams cad kyis 'dud par byed do/ /rang dang 'grogs pa'i khye'u dag gis kyang gang nas rab tu byung ba mthong ba'i tshe/ rgyal bu de la ston par byed do/ /dus re zhig rgyal po 'od zer dpal zhes bya ba des ri brag la ri dwagasabashor du phyin pa'i tshe/ de'i nags gseb cig na/ dge slong chos gos gsum ma nyams par gyon pa/rtswa'i lo ma gdan du bting ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis dad pa phun sum tshogs pa skye ba cig 'dug pa/ rgyal po 'od zer dpal gyis mthong nas/ rta las babs te phyag byas pas/ 'khor lnga brgya tsam yod pa de dag gis kyang rgyal po deng mthun par byas so/ /der rgyal pos zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ nang par bdag gi pho brang du gdugs tsho'i la phebs par zhu zhes zhus pa dang / dge slong de'i zhal nas/ rgyal po 'od zer dpal zhes bya ba khyod/ thob par dka' ba'i mi lusathob/ de'i nang nas kyang rgyal srid che zhing mtho bar skyes pa la bya ba ngan pa ri dwags bsgor bas mi lus dang rgyal rigs thob pa don med par byas/ spyir yang sems can thams cad 'u cag gnyis — /71 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ kyi pha ma yin/ de'i nang nas kyang ri brag 'di la gnas pa'i ri dwags 'di tsho nged la bskyabs pa yin pa la khyod kyis bslus/ da nga khyed kyi sar gdugs tshod la 'ong ba'i skabs med ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal po'i bsams pa la/ 'di sprul ba'i dge slong zhig 'dug nga'i ming kyang shes/ ngo yang mi srung / bka' bkyon pa'i sgo nas gdams ngag 'doms shing gda' snyam nas slar zhus pa/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du mad/ da kho bos nongs pa rnams kyang bshags/ slan chad bsdoms te gus par mi 'bral bar bgyi/ sang ci nas kyang gdugs tshod la byon par zhu zhes nan du gsol ba dang / dge slong de'i zhal nas/ 'o na nged sang khyed kyi sar ci nas kyang 'ong dgos na/ khyod kyi bu chags pa med pa zhes bya ba de nged la sbyin dgos zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po na re/spyir rgyal po'i rgyal srid bus 'dzin dgos/ bu de yang thams cad kyis bkur ba cig dgos par gda' bas/yul ko'u shi bhi 'di na bdag gi bu chags pa med pa 'di la rgan gzhon med pas 'gran zla med par byas nas spyi bor khur/ de'i stobs kyi 'di kho bo'i rgyal srid 'dzin du gzhug 'tshal/ de las gzhan ci dang ci 'tshal bas 'phags pa khyed kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par bgyi zhes zhus pa dang / dge slong gi 695 nas/ khyod kyi bu yon tan de ltar du che bas kho bo 'dod pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na kho bo la'ang chags pa med pa zhes grags pas/chags pa can gyi byis pas dgos pa med/ khyod kyi bu chags pa med pa 'di ni sngar tshe rabs du ma zhig 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa byang chub snying po'i bar du'ang nga'i rgyal srid skyong ba'i bu yin gyis/ deng sang khyed yab yum bu gnyis ldan du byas pa tsam du zad kyis gzhan du na khyed kyi bu rgyal srid skyong kyang nga'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bu yin mod kyis/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bskyangs te/ khyed kyi rgyal srid 'dzin du gzhug go /gal te chags pa med pa rgyal srid 'dzin du 'jug na ni khyed kyi rgyal srid stongs so zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po'i bsams pa la nges par 'phags pa 'di sprul ba zhig yin par the tshom med/ bdag gi bu gnyis kyi yang ming ston cing yin tshul dang bcas pa yang brjod nas byung / chags pa med pa rgyal srid 'dzin du bcug na/ kho bo'i rgyal srid stong tshul zhig dri dgos snyam nas zhus pa/ chags pa med pas kho bo'i rgyal srid bzung na stong nas 'gro ba'i rgyu ci yin bshad du gsol/ dge slong gi zhal nas/ rgyal srid ni dug gi sdong po dang 'dra/ lo 'dab dang me tog yid du 'ong zhing mtshar la ro mngar zhing zhim ste gang gis zos pa de'i srog dang 'bral bar byed do/ /rgyal srid ni me dong dang 'dra ste/ gang der song ba thams cad 'dod pa'i mes sreg par byed do/ /rgyal srid ni btson khang dang 'dra ste mtha' ma dgras 'khor ro/ /rgyal srid ni 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog dang 'dra ste/ thar bar 'gror mi ster/ kye rgyal po de lta bas na chags pa med pa ni khyed kyi rgyal srid 'dzin mi srid/ de shi ba sla'i/ ngan —172—

'brem ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /song du lhung ba ni de lta ma yin no/ /deng sang yon tan thams cad kyi rten thob pa'i dus su chags pa med pa bag med par sdod dam/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po sems zhus par gyur/ kho bo'i rgyal srid 'di 'phags pas de ltar nye dmigs che bar bstan/ chags pa med pa ni snying rje chen pos nga'i bur skye ba blang pa cam du bstan/chags pa med pas bdag gi rgyal srid kyi nyes dmigs shes te/ dug gi sdong po dang / me dong dang / btson khang dang / 'ching ba'i lcags su shes te/ de dag dor nas chags pa med pa don dang mthun par bde bar 'gro bar bstan no/ /bu rgyal srid skyong yang yin pa sprul pa yin par bstan te/ ko'u shi bhi'i khyim pa dag gdul bar bya ba'i don du nga'i rgyal srid 'dzin par shes/ 'phags pa ji skad gsung ba bzhin du chags pa med pa 'di'i spyod pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa pha mas gang sbyin pa'i zas kyi sum cha'ang gzhan la ster/ rtsed mo thams cad kyang chos dang mthun par byed/ rab tu byung ba mthong na ni/ dpag tshad nas byon nas yang bsu bar byed pas las can zhig yin par nges/ 'phags pa gsung pa bzhin dbul ba las ma shes snyam nas/ de ltar gsung byon pa bzlog pa dka'/ 'phags pa ji skad gsung ba bzhin du chags pa med pa'ang dbul bar bgyi/ gzhan yang ci dang ci dgos pa thams cad thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du dbul bar bgyi/ nang par ci nas kyang 'byon par zhu zhes gsol ba btab bo/ /der dge slong gi zhal nas/ yul ko'u shi bhi'i rgyal po 'od zer dpal khyed kyi da gzod don ldan du khas blangs kyis/ de ring khyod rang gi yul du snyam par song la/ nang par khyed kyi pho brang du 'ong gis/ do nub pho brang du sleb pa dang / grong khyer ba thams cad la/ sang 'phags pa 'ong bar yod pas bsu ba la thams cad kyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro gyis shig ces kyang sgrogs shig gsungs pa dang / rgyal po 'od zer dpal gyis kyang / ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du yul ko'u shi bhi'i rang gi pho brang ga la ba der 'ongs shing / de bzhin du bsgo'o/ /der sras rgyal srid skyong na re/ mi dbang ri dwags kyi sha gang na gda'/rgyal pos smras pa/ sngon chad ri dwags du ma bsad/ /da ni pha ma nyid do zhes/ /de ring ri brag nyid du thos/ /sngar 'gyod de ring smos ci 'tshal/ /rgyal srid skyong zhal 'dzum byas te/ /mi dbang gzhan gyis dbang song na/ /phal ba bkri bar ci la nus/ /gal te rgyal srid nyams srid na/ /rgyal po blo sna mang bar 'gyur/ /gang gis rang tshugs mi thub pa/ /de ni gzhan gyis skyong bar byed/ /de bas dpa' bo phugs bzhag nas/ /rang gi btsan sa bzung bar rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ de ring ri brag der phyin pas/ khyod ni g.yin gyi bu zhes thos / / da gzod yin pas tshig gis 'tshal/ khyod kyis ma g.yos rgyal srid skyongs/ /'phags pas gnang gis gzhan ma gyur/ khyod ni khyim pa'i sems dpa' mchog /rtsub pa'i spyod pas snying rjer skyongs/ khyod kyi gcung ni — 173—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/chags pa med/ /rgyal srid spangs te bde bar 'gro /gzhan gyi don la brtson par byed/ /nags khrod dben par gnasagyur te/ /dug gi sdong po 'dra ba yi/ /rgyal srid spangs te thar bar 'gro /nang par gsal mchi rgyal srid skyongs / / zhes smras pa dang / rgyal srid skyong shin tu dga' nas smras pa/ rje rgyal gsung de su yisabastan/ /de bzhin rgyal srid 'di la ni/ /nyes pa zad kyis yon tan bral/ /mi dbang khyod kyi bsam pa dag /yongs su rdzogs phyir kho bo yis/ /rgyal srid skyongs te 'gro ba la/ /kun nasakun tu gang phan bya/ /gzhan du bdag kyang nges par 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po'i 'kha nas/ gsung de 'phagasapa cig lasathos/ /nang par pho brang nang 'dir byon/ /zhal ltos gsung gi bdud rtsir long / /'on kyang gcung dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ yab kyis gsung shes kho bo'i gcung / /chags med de nyid chags med 'gro /dug sdong spangasanas sman ljon len/ /me dong spangs nas bsil khang bsgrub(sgoms3/ /btson dong spangs nas thar bar 'gro /ding sang mi yis bkur byed na/ /ma 'ongs kun gyis mchod par byed/ /bdag 'dra'i blun po zhan pa la'ang / /gcung po chags pa med pa 'khrungs/ /rgyu gcig ljon pa gcig pu la/ /phal cher 'dzer ba 'khyog por gda'/ /la la me tog lo 'dab mdzes/ /ji bzhin bdag cag gnyis kyang mtshungs/ /me tog dam pa nagasakhrod gshegs/ /'dzer dum khyim gyi gnas su lus/ /da ni mang por smra mi bya/ /zhes gsungs nas gcung po skyed mos tshal na yod pa'i sa ga la ba der 'phreng ba'i sems kyis song ngo / /der gcung skyed mos tshal zhig na khye'u stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis bskor nas/ rtsed mo'i rnam par chos ston pa cig 'dug pa mthong ngo / /rgyal srid skyong gisakyang de'i gseb tu phyin pa dang / /gcung chags pa med pa rtsed mo bzang po'i gsung 'di skad du byon pa thosapa sosaka rab tu bkra ba'i me tog la/ /bung ba'i khyus bsten dga' ba'i sgra 'byin kyang / /nam yer cig gis bkrag med mog por byed/ /dus dang rang bzhin 'gyur ba shin tu mtshar/ khye'u me tog 'dra ba stong phrag dag /da lta gzhon nu yid 'ong lta na mtshar/ /gang zhig rgas tshe khyed la lta byed kyang / /rang bzhin du 'gyur ma 'ongs rgas pa'i tshe/ /skye bo bung ba 'dra ba'ang yid mi chags/ /lo brgyad pa yang rim gyis lnga bcur (cuka'agyur/ /lnga bcu (cukab yang tha ma brgya ru'agyur/ /tshe zad lus rgas gzhon nu smod par byed/ /sos ka bkra ba'i me tog mdzesapa de/ /dbyar na mi gnas rnam pa gzhan du gyur/ /dbyar gyi dus kyi me tog gang yin de'ang / /ston tshe nges par gzhan du 'gyur bar mthong / /dgun dus de la su zhig dga' bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gang la skye ba yod gyur ba/ /de ni mi rtag myur du 'jig par byed/ kho bos sos ka'i me tog mdzes pa ltar/ /ma nyams bzhin mdzesalusakyi skyon bral la/ /snyan pa bung pa'i khyu 'dra khye'u dag /nga la brten cing skye mos tshal 'dir 'tshogs/ /nga ni skyes pa'i chos —174—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /can 'jig pa ste/ /nga ni lnga bcu'i (cu'ikapha rol 'das pa na/ /ston dus me tog rnying ba lta bur 'gro / snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bung ba'i tshogs rnams kyang / /rang bzhin gzhan 'gyur bdag la chags mi 'gyur/ /shes sam khye'u blo gsal stong phrag rnams/ /mi rtag chos la rtag par ma 'dzin zhig /snying po med la snying por ma 'dzin zhig /tshong 'dus dbus su mgron po dpag med 'tshogs/ /tha ma rang sar gyes te gcig mi lus/ /chags ldan khye'u stong phrag tshogs pa rnams/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral bar shes par mdzod/ /la ka mthon por rtswa mchog skyes pa rnams/ /dbyar dus dga' dga' bzhin du yid chags kyang / /ston tshe bad kyis kha dog nyams par byed/ /dgun dus rab tu skams shing nyams byed 'gyur/ /bser bu gang nas langs te gar khyer bskyod/ /e ma bdag la brten pa'i khye'u rnams/ /mi lus mthon por skyes te dga' dga' 'dra/ /za ma zhag dang zla ba lo gsog ste/ /lan gcig 'chi bdag bad kyis khyer ta re/ /nam zhig bad des bcom par ma gyur bar/ /'og min stug po bkod pa'i me tog ltar/ /rtag tu kha dog bkra ba ma nyams par/ /btsan sa long yod skabs su bzung bar ran/ /zhes gsungs pa thos pa dang / rgyal srid skyong gi gcung la phyag 'tshal te/ nu bo me tog 'dra ba nags su 'grokho bo 'dzer dum 'dra ba khyim du lus/ /de tshe bdag gis bag yod ji ltar spyad/ /bdag gi lag pa g.yas 'dra gzhan gyur na/ /gzhan gyi bdag la brnyas par mi byed dam/ /de ring khye'u stong phrag du ma'i tshogs / / mdun du bdar te zab mo ston pa thos/ /da ni mi ring thar ba'i lam du 'jug /ces zhus pa dang /chags pa med pa'i zhal nas/ de ring 'od gsal nub la nye bar gyur/ khye'u'i tshogs kyang rang gi khyim du song / /bdag cag gnyis kyang pha ma'i khyim du 'deng / /thams cad dag pa'i dbyings su bsngo bar mdzod/ /ces thams cad rang sar gyes te/ rgyal bu gnyis kyis kyang pha ma'i khyim du phyin no/ /der yab rgyal po 'od zer dpal gyis//bu gnyis po rgyang ma nas byung ste rang gi khyim du song bar mthong ngo / /der rgyal po'i bsams pa la chags pa med pa 'di la de ring 'phags pa chags pa med pa gnas 'dir 'ong ba bshad na kho nyin mtshan du gnyid dang rmugs pa dang le lo la mi lta bas do nub rang la chags pa med pa'i drung du bsu ru phyin na 'dir ma byon srid/ de bas rgyal bu la gleng mo gzhan gyis kha drangs te 'phags pa'i gleng mo ma byas pa drag snyam nas/ ri dwags kyi sha lpags shig mdun du bzhag ste bsdad pa dang / sngar khu bos sna drangs te 'ong ba la de ring chags pa med pas sna drangs te pho brang gi nang du byung ngo / /der rgyal po ri dwags kyi sha lpags shig mdun na bzhag ste 'dug pa de mthong nas/ sras chags pa med pas smras pa/ sngon tshe 'khor ba thog med par/ /dri lan gdab bas mi 'khor ba'i / / pha ma ri dwags lta bu rnams/ khyod kyi bsad par byas lags sam/ /yab kyi smras pa nga la mngon shes ci —175—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yang med/ /pha ma yin min the tshom za/ /tshe srog phral bar byas mod kyis/ khyod nyid khrel bar ma byed cig /ces smras pa dang / rgyal srid skyong na re / yab chen zog ma ma bgyid mdzod/ /'di la mngon shes thogs med mnga'//de ring khye'u stong phrag rnams/ /mdun du bdar te chos ston mthong / /bzlog par dka' ba'i gsung rab thos/ /don med khye'u stong phrag rnams/ /spyi bor blangs te mchod byed na/ /yab cig sras la ci phyir smod/ /'di la bag phebs snying gtam shod/ /ngas ni drang bor smras gyur kyang / /sems zhus 'chal bar gyur gyis dogs/ /e ma yab chen de dgongs la/ /ji lta ba bzhin smra ba'i rigs/ /spyir yang rdzun rigs phyi thag thung / /sgos su rgyal po tshad ma yin/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang len phyir/ /rdzun tshig smra ba ga la rigs/ /'on kyang nyes na mthol bar mdzod / / ces zhus pa dang yab kyi zhal nas/ nang par nongs pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus te bshegs par bya'o / / mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i rgyal bu 'di yang / thugs dgongs nang par rdzogs nas mchi bas de ring pha ma'i bka' mi bcag par bya ba'i phyir/ do nub gzhan don la sems rtse gcig par bzhugs par zhu/zhes gsungs pa dang / chags pa med pas kyang rig cing dga' nas/ dkon mchog gi pho brang du song ste/ rkang pa gnyis gshibs/ lus drang bor bsrangs/ sor bcu thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ ngag snyan pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig ni 'di skad du/bskyab par dka' las skyob byed pa/ /me yi 'obs las bsil bar 'dren/ /dug khu sman du bsgyur ba'i lha/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /las kyi dbang gis 'khyams gyur kyang / /'dren pa'i bla ma rin chen gsum/ /bdag gi sgron me dam par gyur/ /thog mtha' kun tu dge ba'i dpal/ /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis kyang / /gang gi 'dod pa sbyin mdzad pa/ /nor bu rin chen gsum la 'dud/ /lus ngan brgya phrag zhig gyur kyang / khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da'o/ /zhes gsungs shing /lus kyi ba spu re re nas bslang / mig gi mchi ma 'khrug cing / gnyid dang rmugs pa khyad du bsad de/ brtson 'grus chen pos rtag tu de ltar spyod cing 'dug pa de mthong ba dang / pha ma gnyis kyi bsams pa la bdag cag gi bu ni shin tu gzhon pa tshe la da gzod spyad du yod bzhin du/ 'di ltar gnyid dang rmugs pa khyad du bsad nas/dkon mchog gsum la gus pa phun sum tshogs par byas te/ skyabs su 'gro zhing gsol ba drag po 'debs na//bdag cag gnyid log ste bag med par spyod nus sam snyam du langs te gnyid dang rmugs pas ched cher ma byas par bu'i rjes su zhugs so/ /nang par nyi ma shar du nye ba dang / pho brang gi nang du 'phags pa byon no/ /der rgyal bu chags pa med pa byung ste 'phags pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal na/sa bkur sti phun sum —176—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /tshogs pa'i sgo nas gdan bshams nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ khyed la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang pha ma 'di dag dpag med rnams/ /nyon mongs dag las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'di la bzhugs te brtsebar dgongs/ /ces gsol ba btab pa dang / 'phags pas kyang pha ma de gnyis kyis gtso byas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi pha ma rnams kyi don du sems bskyed phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bzhugs so/ /der rgyal bu chags pa med pa'i rjes su pha ma gnyis gcen dang bcas pa 'jug cing gsol ba btab pa ni/ sngon tshe 'khor ba thog med nas/ /mi gtsang khrod kyi srin bu bzhin/ /nyon mongs 'dam du bying gyur nas/ /dag pa'i gnas su 'gro ma nus/ /da ni 'phags pa thugs rje can/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun yun du srings/ /bdag 'dra'i skyes bu ma dag pa/ /nye'u skam la 'thon par gyur/ /sngon chad skye ba dpag med du/ /'phags pa khyed kyis rjes bzung kyang / /nyon mongs 'ching ba ma khrol bas/ /da ni 'ching ba bcad du gsol/ /ma 'ongs skye ba kun tu yang / /'phags pa khyed kyi drin 'og tu//drin can pha ma 'dren bgyid cing / /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas thob par shog /ces yid ches pa'i sgo nas gsol ba drag po btab bo/ /der dge slong de'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten dag na nor mang yang / /nor bu rin chen srid par zad / / mi lus thob pa mang gyur kyang / /dad pa can ni de dang mtshungs/ /rgyal bu khyod ni skal bar ldan/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur ba'i/ /dad pa'i zhing sa gshin par gda'/ /dge ba'i lo tog babs kyis 'phel/ /'gro ba skal bar ldan pa yang / khyed kyi rab tu bde bar byed/ khyod ni dad pa chen po ste/ /'jigs rten kun tu dge ba yi/ /rtag tu dge legs 'phel ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun yun du 'bab/ zhum par ma byed chags pa med/ /nga yang chags pa med ces grags/ khyod kyi 'ching ba kho bos 'grol/ /btsan sa zin pa kho bo ste/ /kun tu bshes gnyen kho bo yin/ /dag pa'i sems kyis nga la ltos/ /gang gis skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs yul yin/ /'jig rten sgrol ma nga nyid de/ /ma 'ongs mar me mdzad dpal tshe/ /sras kyi thu bo khyod nyid yin/ khyod la nyes pa mi mnga' na/ /'jig rten mthun phyir zhabrul bar bstan/ /da ni 'khrul ba'i dri ma rnams / / nyi tshe mun pa ji bzhin du/ /spangs nas nags kyi khrod du gshegs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / chags pa med pa yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gi 'tsho bar rung ba dkar gsum mngar gsum sbags pa dang btsog pa dang ma 'dres pa/ g.yos du ma'i gtsang sbras mthar phyin par byas te 'phags pa la drangs so/ /'phags pas kyang rgyal po yab yum gcen dang bcas pa'i tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir longs spyod de zad mi shes par bya ba'i phyir bsngo ba mdzad pa/ spyan dang mngon shes thogs med pa'i/ /dpang po dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'jig rten kun/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas mchog tu — 177—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsngo / / zhes gsungs pa dang / 'phags pas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyal po yab yum gcen dang bcas pas kyang bsngos nas/ rang gis kyang / tshe rabs kun tu 'di bzhin du/ /'phags pa dam pa mchod byed cing / /smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /mthar thug gnas su phyin par shog /ces smon lam btab bo/ /der rgyal bu chags pa med par bzhengs te/ yab yum gyi mdun du thal mo sbyar te/ 'di skad ces gsol ba/ kye 'jig rten 'di'i snang ba ster bar byed pa'i drin can gnyis bdag la thugs brtse'am/ yab yum gyis smras pa/khyed dang 'bral bar mi nus pa tsam mo/ /der rgyal bu na re/ yud tsam zhig mi 'bral ba la dga'am/ rtag tu mi 'bral ba la dga'/ yab yum na re/ de ni phyi ma'o/ /rgyal bu na re/ 'o na bdag gisa'aphags pa'adi'i rjesasu phyin la bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gos dang / malacha dang / rang gi rgyal po'i pho brang dang / skyed mos tshal dang / dga' bar rtse ba'i grogs dang / gnyid dang / rmugs pa dang / bag med pa'i spyod pa thamasacad spangs te / rtse gcig tu nam bzhag (zhag3 gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrubs nas tshe rabs nasatshe rabs thamasacad du gar skye ba len pa der khyed gnyis la pha ma bya zhing skye ba thams cad du mi 'bral bar bya'o/ khyed gnyis kyang kho bo dang mi 'bral bar 'dod na skyabs mi bslu ba dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ las rgyu 'bras 'brel zab pas nyes pa phra zhing phra ba la'ang 'dzem/ yon tan gyi rgya mtsho bsag kha na yod pas chu thigs tsam nas gsog thar ba'i gnas su 'gro ba la them skas dgos pas tshul khrimasabasrungs la mi lus kyis gzhi chos/chos zab mo la bdud 'jug pas rgyun mi chad par dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson/ 'khor ba 'dir 'ching ba'i rtsa ba chags pas byed pas gang la'ang ma chags par sgyu ma'i blos spyod/ 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyun chad med par bsgoms(sgomasaka/ de yang pha ma kho na yin pas nye ring dang phyogs ris ma byed par bde na dga' ba'i bsam pa bzang po bsten par mdzod/ kye yab yum gnyis de ltar byas na nga la brtse bar byas/ tshe rabs kun tu nga dang 'grogs pa'i smon lam 'grub par byas kyis / gzhan du na pha mar gyur pa'i sems can ni mang kho bo'ang du mar 'chi zhing skye/ pha ma gnyis kho na la nges pa med do/ /zhes smras pa dang / yab yum gyi zhal nas/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bu khyod 'phags pa'i rjes su btang na ma 'ongs pa'i tshe nged gnyis pha ma dang khyod bur 'gyur nges sam/ srasakyi zhal nas/ 'phags pa dpang po mdzod cig yab yum 'di gnyis ma 'ongasalnga brgya'i tha ma la/ kha ba can gyi yul gyi mgul/ u rgyan mkha' 'grosaming btags pa'i/ /'od zer dpal zhes bdag gi pha/ /yag bzher sku gshen 'brom du gda'/ /ma gcig legasaldan dad pa can/ khu 'od gza' lan cig ces grags/ /nga ni gangs ri'i mgul der bltams/ /de tshe chags pa —178—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /med pas 'dzin/ /'phags pa 'khrul bar ma gyur tam/ /zhes zhus pa dang / 'phags pa'i zhanya nas/ sras mchog ji skad zer ba bzhin/ /ma dag mtha' 'khob blun po'i yul/ /chos kyi sgron me ma shar bas/ /gling bar mun pa 'dra ba der / /zla ba lta bur khyod bltams nas/ /gang gi blo yi mun pa sel/ /de tshe chags pa med pa nga //nyi ma lta bur der lhags nas/ /skal ldan mang po nyin mor byed/ /de nas dga' ldan gnas su 'gro /chags med khyed ni chags pa ltar/ /ma dag pa dag 'dren cing bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/de tshe bla ma'i mtshan rab ci/ /bdag la ci zhes tshad mar 'dzin/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ nga ni zhing de'i mun sel ba'i/ /mar me mdzad dpal bya bar grags/ khyod ni bstan pa'i gter mdzod de/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bya bar grags/ /nga ni jo bo chen po ste/ /lha cig mtshan nas mchod par byed/ khyod ni dge bsnyen chos 'phel te/ /bshes gnyen ston pa bya bar mchod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal po yab yum gnyis na re/ bu de ltar mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa dang ldan zhing / grong la nyes dmigs su lta na 'gro don las nyams srid pas/'phags pa'i gnas ga la ba der byon cig rgyal bu gang dang gang gi spyod pa mdzad pa de nyid mthar phyin na dam pa yin gyis/ da ni nags khrod chen po der 'gro ba'i rjes la chos ma yin pa skad cig kyang ma bgyid cig gnyid dang / rmugs pa dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba la sogs pa la dad cher byed na ni/ skyes bu glen pa zhig kha zas ro brgya ba yod pa'i dus su mi spyod par/ nam zhig 'bras zer ma bya rnams kyis kyang bor ba la sogs pa gsog rum byed pa dang mtshungs so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu na re/ ji skad gsung ba bzhin du chos min bor te chos kho na la spyod par bya'o zer ro/ /der yab rgyal po bzhengs nas/ 'phags pa'i mdun du thal mo sbyar te/spyir sems can rnams la phan pa dang / /de la brten nas 'phags pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / yang snos su'ang bdag cag pha ma gnyis kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir du chags pa med pa snying dang 'dra ba 'di 'phags pa la 'bul gyis thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas bzhes/ sngar ri dwags mang po la pha ma yin par ngo ma shes te gnod pa bgyis pa'ang 'phags pa la nongs pa'i sgo nas bzod par gsol/ da ni rang gi srog la bab kyang pha mar gyur ba dag gsad par mi bya'o/ zhes gsol ba dang / 'phags pa shin tu mnyes te smon lam btab pa/ 'jig rten dag na rjer gyur ba/ /rgyal rigs mtho bar skyes gyur ba'i/ /btsun mo sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /chos phyir bdag la bu phul bas/ /'phags dang skye bo ma lus pas/ /kun du bu bzhin skyong bar shog /ces gsungs nas shad tsam zhig la 'phags pa chags pa med par rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs la rgyal bu chags pa med pa'ang drangs te/ rgyal bo'i pho brang gi nang nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /— 179—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/der chags pa med pa yab sras kyis nags chen po de'i khrod du sleb pa dang / lo ma'i spyil bu zhig rgyal bu chags pa med pa la gtad de/ khyod kyi mkhan po dang slob dpon bdag gis bya/ khyod ni chags pa med pas rab tu 'byin pa zhes bya bar byin gyis brlabs kyis/ tshe 'di ji srid ma brjes kyi bar du/ gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa dge ba'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad khyad du bsad de/ sems can thams cad pha ma yin par spyod/de dag 'khor ba na sdug bsngal ba la snying rje bar bsgoms(sgomasaka/ de dag mthar thug sangs rgyas nyid ci nas kyang thob par bya ba'i brtson 'grus skyed/ thams cad bden pa med pa'i ngang du dbang bsdus zhes gdams pa / sngon tshe skye ba dpag med bzhes/ /pha ma gcig las skyes ma yin/ /skye ba re la pha ma re/ /sems can dpag med snang gyur kyang / khyod kyi pha mar ma gyur med/ /snying rje chen po yod gyur na/ /nye ring med pa'i byams pa 'ong / / kun gyis sangs rgyas thob la dga'/ /de ni tshad med bzhi yin spyod/ /pha ma sdug bsngal sangs rgyas kyang / / tha snyad tshig zad don gyis stong / /spang dang gnyen por ma 'dzin bu/ /'di na sna tshogs chos rnams snang / / snang ba'i phyir na rdzun pa yin/ /rdzun pa'i phyir na yod ma myong / /med pa'i phyir na du mar snang / /dper na rmi lam rmis pa'i tshe/ /dang po rta rmis glang por gyur/ /glang po'am rnga mo'i gzugs su 'gyur/ /rnga mo khyir 'gyur tshugs mi thub/ /de ni dang po gang nas byung / /tha mar gar song dpyad par gyis/ /mi rnyed ma dpyad sna tshogs snang / /byis pa rnams ni bslu mod kyis/ /'phags pas ya mtshan ltad mori mthong / /chags med sbyin pa der spyod cig /smras pa dang / chags pa med par rab tu 'byin pa na re/ /rdzun pa'i sems can dpag med rnams / / bdag gi ma min su yang med/ /tshad med bzhi yis bsdus byas nas/ /gnas lugs ngang du drang bar bgyi / / zhes gsol ba btab nas/ lo ma'i spyil bu de'i nang du lo sum cu rtsa dgu'i bar du gnyid dang / /rmugs pa dang / le lo rab tu spangs te rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don la brtson 'grus chen po spyad do/ /lo sum cu rtsa dgu'i nyin par/ bla ma chags pa med pa byon te/ khyod kyis nga'i gdams pa blangs te nga'i dam tshig brtan par byas so/ /kye chags pa med pas rab tu 'byin pa sngon yul ko'u shi bhi'i skyed mos tshal du khyod dang lhan cig tu brtseba'i khye'u stong phrag bcu gnyis po de dag da lta ga na zhig ma 'ongs pa na gang du nges/ chags pa med pas rab tu 'byin pas smras pa/ la la ni tshe brjes te zhing khams gtsang mar song / la la ni las kyi dbang gis mngal sgo gzhan yang 'grim mod kyis mthar bde/ la la ni tshe ma brjes par yul ko'u shi bhi 'di na bdag gis bstan pa'i gdams pa la spyod do/ /kye bla ma chags pa med pa/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha ma la/ /gang ri'i mgul zhes grags pa na/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'od 'phros te/ /zhing khams dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon po spyan —/80—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ras gzigs dbang nga / /sprul pa du ma der ston to/ /de tshe chags pa med pa khyed/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis der byon to/ /de nas rim gyis nga yi sras/ /bla ma khyed kyis rjes bzung ba/ /rin chen gsal ba /ka ba20 rgo(pu to 'jams dbyangs/)sras kyi mchog gzhon nu (phu chung ba spyan ras gzigs/) bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /tshul khrims dri mas (spyan snga ba phyag rdor/) / ma gos pa/ /rigs gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po gsum/ /bstan pa gsal byed thugs rje can/ /dgra bcom stong phrag bcu gnyis su/ /gsum gyis ma tshang spel bar byed/ /bla mas mkhyen nam khye'u'i tshogs/ khyed kyi rjes bzung nga yi sras/ /the tshom med par zhing der 'gyur/ /zhes gsol ba dang / / bla ma chagasapa med pa'i zhal nas/ sras kyi snying po chags pa med/ /bdag gis rab 'byin mgon por gyur / / de bzhin khye'u stong phrag dag /lnga bdo snyigs ma ma rungs tshe/ khyod kyi srid 'dzin 'gro ba skyongs/ /mtha' 'khob yul gyi dbus su byed/ /rin chen phreng ba bstan pa'i dpal/ /nor bu brtsegs pa bzhin du skyongs/ /sa bcu'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dpal/ /bstan pa rin chen gsal bar byed/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs / / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par byed/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshul khrims me lce rab 'bar te/ /'chal ba'i bud shing sreg par byed/ /sras kyi thu bo bstan pa yi/ /rin chen lhun po rab gsal bas / / nga dang khyod kyi gzhung lugs rnams/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin yang dag 'brel/ /e ma 'jig rten ma lus pa'i/ /sgron me rigs kyi gtso bo gsum/ /dgra bcom stong phrag bcu gnyis dang / /dge sbyong chen po'i gdung 'dzin pa/ khrims ldan dpag tu med pa dag /tshes gcig zla ba'i 'od bzhin du/ /dgon pa pa zhes rab grags shing / /shes rab mi bskyod mtshungs pa med/ /byang chub dpal nas rab bzung ste/ /gsum las stong phrag bcu gnyis jidang / /brgyad khri dam pa mchog tu 'phel/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / chags pa med pa'i zhal nas / / bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /chos dbyings rang bzhin dag pa'i mthus/ /de bzhin phun sum tshogs par shog /da ni bde ba can du 'gro /bla ma rtag tu mi 'bral bar/ji srid khyed dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro don dpag tu med par bgyi/ /zhes bde ba can du 'pho ba btab ste song ngo //zhes gsungs pa dang / legs pa'i shes rab bzhengs te spyan chab sran rdog tsam pa nyel le byas nas/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po yon tan 'di lta bu yod bzhin du gab pa/ gzhan dag gi bla ma ni yon tan til 'bru tsam la/sgro tā la'i sdong po tsam btags te smra bar byed na zhes 'brom gyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ khyed ci'i phyir 'di ltar sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis yon tan thams cad sbed par mdzad ces zhus pa dang / 'brom gyi zhal nas / nga la ta yon tan de tsam med/ 'on kyang bla mas gsungs pa la zhabrul ba che zhes bya ba ma yin te/ 'jig — /81 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rten gyi mgon po shākya thub pa nas bzung nas/ da lta bla ma zhal bzhugs pa yan chod yon tan thams cad sbas nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin/ bla ma dam pa'i rjes su mi 'jug na slob ma 'chal ba yin/ lar kyang nang na yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod na phyir g.yeng mi 'tshal rang bzhin gyis 'od 'phro/ rmongs pas mi mthong ste/mkhas pas mthong / phugs na nor yod na phyir nor yod ces ma bsgrags kyang thabs kyis rang gzhan la phan pa yin gsungs pa dang / rngog gi zhal nas/ 'o na de'i dus su yab yum la sogs pa de dag su dang su yin zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ nga'i gtam 'phro yin/ ngas bshad kyis/ yab yum gnyis po gong du lung bstan pa de nyid kyis gsal mod/ rgyal srid skyong ni khu chen po yin/ chags pa med pa nga yin mod/ chags pa med pasarab tu 'byin pa ni 'brom nyid yin pas smos mi 'tshal/ legs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis/de ltar gnyid dang / rmugs pa dang / le lo rab tu spangs te / gzhan don bsgrub (sgrubakapa la brtson 'grusargyun mi 'chad par mdzad do/ /zhesagasungasaso/ /de ltar/ gnyid rmugs le lo rab spang shing / /rtagatu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/rgyal bu chags pa med par ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs gnyis pa'o// //ga3 kul yangasapa can du rgyal bu kun tu dgar sku skye ba bzhesapa'i lelga/ka 21 ba5 rgodage ba'i bshes gnyen pa yul yangs pa can du rgyal bu kun tu dgar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lesdomi bsdokyigs so/ //༄༅/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ yab sras gnyis ka la phyag gsum gsum mdzad de/ de ring yang sngar zhus pa bzhin du/ yab sras gnyis kyi zhus lan 'di na mar la/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams rtag tu bsrung / / nyin mtshan dusagasum yang dang yang / /sems kyi rgyud la brtag par bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis dran shes bzhin bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nasadabang po'i sgo bsrungasate/ nyin mtshan med par sems kyi rgyud la ji ltar gzigs/ yang bla mas gsung du gsol/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kha sang bzhin du/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul cig ngasabashad kyis gsungs nas/ sngon yul yangs pa can zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po dga' rab ces bya ba la/ btsun mo dga' byed ma zhes bya ba yod pa la/bu dga' ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / kun tu dga' zhes bya ba gnyis yod do/ /der rgyal po dga' rab ces bya —182—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ba de/ phyi rol ba'i ston pa dang / nang pa gnyis kar gyi sbyin bdag byed pa las/ rgyal po'i pho brang shar nub gnyis su yod pa shar du nang pa dag bzhugs/ nub tu mu stegs pa dag sdod/ der rgyal bu dga' ba'i dpal zhes bya ba de pho brang shar du bzhag ste nang pa dag la bsnyen bkur byed du bcug chung shos kun du dga' de pho brang nub tu bzhag ste mu stegs pa dag la bsnyen bkur byed du bcug go /des rgyal bu kun tu dga' de pha ma'i gsung mi gcog par bya ba'i phyir du mu stegs pa de dag la bsnyen bkur ni phun sum tshogs par byas/ phyag mi 'tshal zhing smra ba bcad de/ phyi rol ba'i ston pa de dag 'dug pa'i tshe na khong 'greng / mu stegs pa de dag 'greng ba'i tshe khong 'dug der mu stegs pa de dag gi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu gzhon nu ma 'di bdag cag la 'phral bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa la bdag cag dang spyod lam mi bstun cing phyag kyang mi byed/ 'di la chags sdang gi rtog pa med/ pho brang shar gyi dge sbyong 'di dag gis bsgyur ba yin snyam ste/ tshod blta ba'i phyir du rgyal bu la smras pa/ kun du dga' do nub mchod sbyin zhig byed pas ba glang gi sha khrag khyer la shog ces smras pa dang / rgyal bu cang mi/ smra bar/ rang gi ma dga' byed ma khrid nas byung ste/ mu stegs pa de dag gi lag tu gri gtad de/ sha khrag 'di la gyis kyi brda byas pa dang / 'di khyod kyi ma yin mod/ bsad par ga la rung / ba glang gi sha khyer la shog ces zer ro/ /der rgyal bu cang mi smra bar zan che chung mnyam pa dbyibs dang kha dog la khyad par med pa gnyis khyer nas byung ste/ mu stegs byed kyi mdun du bzhag nas/ gris zan gnyis ka la che chung med pa re bcad cing mu stegs kyi lag tu'ang gtad/ kho rang gis kyang gsol/ der mu stegs byed kyi rtog pa la kho bo'i brda 'di nged kyis shes te/ bdag gis ba glang gi sha khrag khyer shag byas pa la/ kho rang gi ma khrid 'ong ba 'di ba glang nga'i ma yin pas bsad du mi rung zer bar 'dug nged kyi lag tu gtod pa ni/ khyed rang nga'i ma gsod par nus na gsod zer bar 'dug 'di khyed kyi ma yin mod/ ba glang gi sha khrag khyer shog byas pas kyang zan dbyibs dang kha dog 'dra ba che chung med pa gnyis khyer nas bdag cag gi mdun du bzhag ste gris gnyis ka che chung med par bcad cing / nged la'ang ster/ kho rang za ba ni/ ma 'di gnyis ka'i ma yin pa la khyad par med/ zan 'di gnyis la gris bcad pa ltar/ gnyis ka'i ma la bcad pa khyad par med/ che chung ji tsam bcad par yang ma la bcad par khyad par med/ nged la'ang ster/ kho rang yang za ba de gnyis kar gyi ma yin pa la/ gnyis kar gyis bcad cing zos par 'gyur zer bar 'dug pas/ 'di ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lha zhig gi sprul pa cig yin par nges/dge sbyong 'di dag gis kyang bslabs par mi 'dug da rgyal po 'di yang bu dad che ba bdag cag mchod pa'ang bu 'ong du re ba dang / gzhan yang thun mong gi dngos grub 'ong du re nas mchod pa yin gyis/ bu 'di med par byas — 183—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus snyelas/ jobo'igasungachosakyiskor/ da na ni/ rgyal po yab yum gnyis shin tu mi dga'/ bdag cag bla mchod kyang nongs par 'gyur/ gal te rgyal bu 'di rang yang bdag cag gis med par bya ba'ang/ khe yang mthu stobs dang ldan pa cig yin srid pas mi rung /de bas rgyal po 'di nyid la nor rdzas blangs te gnas gzhan du phyin pa drag snyam mo/ /de nas mu stegs byed de dag gis/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin te/ nged bla mchod yin pas rgyal po khyed kyi longs spyod kyis phongs pa med par gyis shig nged yul gzhan du 'gro'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ khyed cis nongs/ mu stegs byed dag na re/ rje'i sras kun tu dga' 'di bdag cag la mi mos par gda' bas/ des na gnas gathen du bcas te/ rgyal po la dngos grub rgyang nas sbyin no/ /der rgyal pos smras pa/ da dung bag phob la bzhugs shig /kun tu dga' la gus pa'i sgo nas mchod cig ces bsgo bar bya'o/ /der rgyal pos blon po btang ste/ kun tu dga' 'tshol du btang ba las ma rnyed nas/ der rgyaruwa snge/ teng kyis nang pa yod pa'i pho brang du phyin pa dang / rgyal bu kun tu dga' nang pa'i rab tu byung ba de dag la 'u pyo retshal zhing gtam mi mang bar 'di skad du/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i yul la mi rteg ri/ra/ /rang ge gnas lugs ston byed pa/ /de nyid rtag tu nges par mdzod/ /ces zer ba thos so/ /der rgyal pos/ kun tu dga' la smras pa/ khyod bskos pa'i bya ba bzhag ste/ ma bskos pa'i gnas su spyod/ smra dus su mi/ smra/ ri/ smra ba'i dus su bstod par byed/ slar nub tu song la phyi rol ba'i ston pa dag la phyag 'tshal zhing ji skad zege ba ba'in du gsong bor smros byas pa dang / rgyal bu cang mi smra bar 'di nyid du sdod kyi rnam 'gyur byas te phyir song ngo re zhig nas grong khyer gyi dbus nas shan pa mkhan gyi bu zhig khrid nas byung ste khang pa'i nub ngos su bzhag nas/dge 'dun shar ngos na bzhugs nga/ rnams la rgyab bstan te/ shan bu de la phyag 'tshal ba'i rnam 'gyur byas pa dang / dge 'dun rnams kyis rig ste shin tu mnyes/ rgyal pos kyang rig ste/ rgyal bu 'di'i rnam 'gyur 'di shes / rgyal pos tha mal ba la phyag 'tshal ba rung ngam/ de'i nang nas kyang rigs ngan shan pa la phyag 'chal ba rung ngam zhes dper byed par 'dug nga nang pa sangs rgyas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyal bu yin pa la mu stegs byed la phyag 'tshal ba mi 'ong bas/ 'di dag ni shan bu 'di dang 'dra/ dge 'dun la rgyab bstan te phyag 'tshal ba ni mu stegs byed la phyag 'tshal na/ nang pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang 'dra/ kho mi rigs pa'i spyod pa byed pa ni/ mu stegs byed 'di dag la blo phugs gtad mi thub zer bar 'dug snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas rgyal bus zas zhim po phun sum tshogs pa zhig blangs te/ rgyal po la thal mo sbyar gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas te/ zas de shan bu de la byin nas/ shan bu de phyir phyung ste sgo bcad nas/ phyi mig kyang mi lta bar — 184—

ribrer ston sgo rgyasnye rī/ ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos ba/zhugs so/ /slar log nas dge 'dun dag la phyag snyerichal nas/ 'di skad smra ba thos pa/ lam/ gyi ma/chog rab sangs rgyas lugs / / skyabs kyi nyag cig dkon ma/chog gce/ /de bsgrub (sgrubaka yo/na tan dge 'dun te/ /nyi ma'i 'eod zer spangs gyur nas/ /srin bu 'od la brten nga/ gang / /skyes bu gdol bar bdud kyis brlabs/ /sngon chad sem/sa snyel skyon re/da kyang / /las kyi dbang gis dam/na pa'i las/ /mi/ 'dod bzhin du gzhan dbang nyid/ /rje yi bka' las 'da' ma/ nus/ /nyes gang ma/thol gyi 'phags nga/ dag /hes nga/ra mi bzung bskyab tu gsol/ /'es gsel ba btab nga/ dang / rgyal po'i bsam/sa nga/ la/ 'di nges nga/ra mu stegadra/ kyi ston nga/ dag la blo mi/ rigro bar nang nga/ kho na la rngi/sa par 'dug 'di nyid na shin tu gzhon te/ loring bdun cam/ las ma/ song na/ da nang nga/ra nges/ kyi rting la bu gnyis po zhabs thog brjes te/ rang rang gus nga/'i yul la ma/ched nga/ byed bcug nga/ drag snam/ ste / dga' ba'i dpal la smras nga// khyod pho brang nub tu song la kun tu dga'i bya ba gyis shig smras pa/ dang /dga' ba'i dari /snyer/ gyis bsam/sa pa/ la/ /spo bo dang ngo/ bsod nam/sa bsags la/ phyis ma/ ma/ bsags/ kun du dga' yab kyis bskos bzhin du'ang 'dir 'ongs na nga der 'gro snyam/ sde/ yab snyel smras nga// /le bo bsi8la khang bzhag gyur te/ /me/ dong ci zhig ster bar byed/ /nga/dma'i dru/ gu bzhag gyur teo/ /mi/ gcang 'dam nger ji snyersha ra 'gro /gtan gyi skyabs gnas bzhag gyur te/ /'di'i (/ka23 ba 7 che / lo snyerided ji rsha/ra bsden/ /ddhar bu rin chen srid nga/ cam// /mi/ gcang ridam/ du skyur ba phongs/ /sku snyel yon tan stong phrag du ma/sa brgyan pa 'i dge slong byang chub sem/sa dang/'a 'od zer snyi/nga nge/ ri/bor dgra bcom/ chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs/ nga snyepa 'dud nga/ra mi/ byed par / mu stegs gdel ba /bye dang phag dang ba glang gi brtul zhugs spyed nga// drin che ba'i pha ma/ bsad de sha khrag la longs spyod nga/ che 'di'i 'dun ma/ 'ba' 'ig la brten pa/ thar nga/'i bsam/ pa skad cig kyang ma/ zhugs nga/'i re/ dong ngam// mi gcang ba'i 'dam/ khred lta bu der ci ste 'gro zhes smras pa/ dang / rgyal ngo/ na re/ dga' ba'i dang/la/de bla ma 'od zer snying ngo/sa bslabs sam khyed rang las shar ba yin/ rgyal bus smras nga// /byed rang zer ba'i chig de yang bla ma 'od zer snying pos bslabs sam /byed rang gis 'chal/ rgyal ngo/sa smras nga// bla ma 'od zer snying ngo/sa ma/ bslabs par ro/sa/ gzhan nda/sa bslabs/ kye rgyal po chen po gdugs sa la babs nga/'i tshe de'i 'od kyis gang gi lus dros pa de'i tshe de dag gang gis bslabs/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de ma/ bslabs nga/ra nyams su myong ba'o/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ kye rgyal po de bzhin du bla ma 'od zer snying po 'kher brgya phrag dang bcas pa 'di dag ni dag pa'i thugs dgongs kho na dang ldan pa la ma dag pa'i rnyog pa rgyal po'i pho brang nub na yod pa ltar/ rgyal bu bdag 'dra'am/ rgyal po khyed lta bu stong gis gsol ba btab kyang / bla ma 'od zer snying po 'khor dang bcas pa — /85 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la ma dag pa'i spyod pa mi mnga' ste/ 'di ltar/ lus kyang padmo lta bu ste/ /ngag kyang padmo lta bu dag /yid kyang padmo lta bu ste/ /sgo gsum padmor dag pa la/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba bzhugs pa las/ /'tshal ba de la su zhig bsten/ /chags sdang rlung gis rab bskyod pa'i/ /mu stegs 'chal ba mang po dag /rang gi rtog pas bcings pa yi/ /rtag chad mtha' la brten par byed/ /des ni log pa'i lam khrid cing / /thar pa'i lam las gol bar byed/ /padmo lta bu dag pa des/ /de ltar de'i 'bras bu 'byin/ /'phral gtsang phugs gtsang rgyu 'bras gtsang / /'od gsal lhun chags dga' bde'i gnas/ /bde skyid ma lus 'byin byed cing / /gtan gyi btsan sa rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / bla ma 'od zer snying po'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ rgyal bu chos kyi 'phags pa dga' ba'i dpal khyod sngar yang las rgyu 'bras la yid ches/ bla ma la bla mar 'dzin/ mched grogs la dag pa'i mched grogs su 'dzin/ chos kyi rgyal srid ni yang dag par skyong / de dang 'dra ba'i rgyal srid ni snang ba'i tshe na mun pa bzhin du byung ba nyid nas dgag par bya'o/ /da lta'ang 'di lta bu rab tu byung ba gtsug gi nor bu bzhin du mchod cing bkur la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bsngags pa brjod/ de'i mi mthun phyogs mu stegs byed la ni/ rgya mtsho chen po dang ro bzhin du shes rab kyi rba rlabs kyis skad cig tsam yang mi 'grogs par yang dang yang du spong bar byed do/ /ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha mar yang / 'jig rten gyi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag spangs na'ang / sems can nyon mongs pa can dag tu bstun te/ de dag dang mthun pa'i chos ston cing /log pa'i shes rab rgyang du bsrings/ legs pa'i shes rab kyis shes bya la dpyod/ 'gal 'brel rnam rtog gi ra bar ma zhugs pas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis chos kyi dbyings su 'khyer bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i dus na khyed kyi gcung rgyal bu kun tu dga' ni/ 'jig rten na kun tu dga' ba ste/ /sems can kun la phan la dga' ba can / / thar pa'i grong du brtson la dga' 'gyur zhing / /lag pa g.yas 'drar khyed nyid sras su'ang 'gyur/ khyod kyi zhing der thos la smod byed pa'i/ /gti mug lam bzhugs rtog pa 'gyur ba dag khyod kyis so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bkram/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa dpag med spel bar byed/ /phal cher dga' ldan gnas su spel bar byed / / phal cher zhing der bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /rtag chad log pa'i lam zhugs khyod kyis 'joms/ /bstan pa'i 'byung gnas khyod kyis 'degs par byed/ /ces gsudzas pa dang / rgyal bu dga' ba'i dpal gyis 'di skad zhus pa/ bla ma'i gsung rab thos pa mtshar/ /ma 'ongs gcung gi sras mchog tu/ kho bo legs pa'i shes rab ces/ /lag pa g.yas pa byed do gsung / /bdag gis gti mug lam zhugs pa'i/ /bsam gtan ltar snang zhi byed cing / /gzhud lugs rgya mtsho 'byed par byed/ /slob ma'i tshogs rab spel gsung na/ /dngos su mkhas —186—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pa ji tsam 'byung / /brgyud nas mkhas pa ji tsam spel/ /zhus pa dang / bla ma 'od zer snying po'i zhal nas/ gcung gi gdul bya thos pa can/ khyod kyi brgyud pa'i slob ma yin/ /lnga bcu (cukartsa lnga mkhas pa'i mchog /dngos su khyed kyis byin gyi rlobs/ /gzhan yang thar 'dod dpag med 'du/ /des na dngos dang shugs kyis dge /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po dga' rab kyi rtog pa la/ bdag gi bu 'di gnyis de ltar ngo mtshar che ba yin par 'dug pa la/ bdag gis ma rtogs par slar mi rigs pa'i gtam re re gnyis gnyis byas/ khong mched gnyis mu stegs byed kyi zhabs tog mi byed pa bden par 'dug bdag gis ma rtogs par zad/ mu stegs 'di dag mchod gnas ngan pa yin par gda' ba la/ nang pa 'di dag dang mnyam po tsam du khur/ da phyi thag bsring ba'i phyir du/ mu stegs byed kyi ston pa dag ji skad zer ba bzhin du/ longs spyod phongs ba med par byin la rang dga' ba'i gnas su btang ngo snyam ste/ rgyal pos mu stegs byed gnas pa'i pho brang du byon nas smras pa/ bdag cag yon mchod 'brel zab sngar kyang shin tu 'phrod na'ang / kun tu dga' 'di las 'brel ngan pa la shar ba cig gda' bas/ phyag dang spyod lam la sogs pa mi mthun par nang pa'i sar 'gro zhing 'dug zer ba thos/da dga' ba'i dpal 'di rang re'i zhabs tog la 'dir yong na 'ong ste/ nang pa'i dge sbyong 'di dag chags sdang chung / bsnyen bkur phyi rol ba'i ston pa dag la gyis shig zer/ sngar mchod gnas chags sdang med pa la da kho tshur 'ongs na ma mnyes srid/ kun tu dga' 'di la'ang skyon gzhan med de/ na gzhon pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ngang tshugs mdzes pa de la chags pa dang / zhi dul che zhing gzhan sems bsrung ba dang / 'phral gyi mchod pa thams cad kyang ka ra dang / bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang / gzhan yang srog chags dang ma 'dres pa 'i sgo nas mchod/ myos par mi byed cing dri nga ba'i zas ngan pa'ang mi za/ lha thams cad kyang gzhon nu ma thams cad dga' ba 'jig rten gyi yid du 'ong ba gda' bas/ nang pa de dag la'ang kho drang 'dod med kyi sngar zhus pa bzhin du/ na gzhon pas kho zhen gda' bas/ da khyed rang la gang dgos pa gsung byon cig dang bdag gis 'bul lo/ /de nas khyed rang /ka 25 ba4 rgogar/mnyes pa'i sar gshegs par byed dam/ 'on te kun tu dga' med kyang 'dir bzhugs par byed ces smras pa dang / mu stegs byed kyi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu 'di dag ni chos la dad/ rgyal po 'di'ang lcugs la tshad mar 'dzin/ blon po dang bran dag ni rgyal po'i ngo bsrung / lcugs nye bar ma byung ba rang du gtsang mar phyin pa dga' snyam nas/ rgyal po la smras pa/ khyod kyis gang sbyin pa bdag cag la da lta nyid du stsol cig khyed la dngos grub rgyang nas spyin par byed cing / sa gzhan na phar 'gro zer bas/rgyal po'ang don la dga' ste/ 'byor ba chen po byin nas thag ring po na phar la phyi thag la bskyal lo/ /legs —187—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung tshes kye skor/pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di ni de ltar thabs mkhas te/ yab rgyal po'i bka' mi gcog par/dam pa'i chos la dran shes bzhin bag yod dang ldan par byas te/ dbang po'i sgo la nyes skyon thams cad bsrungs nas/ thabs kyis mu stegs pa dag bskrad do/ /de'i dus su rgyal po dga' rab kyi bur skye ba ma blangs na ni/ /mu stegs byed de dag nang du zhugs te nang pa la tho 'tsham/ rgyal po'ang chos las bzlog par byed pa las / bur skyes pas mu stegs pa la rgyal ba'i bla mchod byed pa la rgyal po'i bu la nyes pa byed mi nus pa dang /ngag gi sgo bsdams te yid kyis chos bstan pas legs nyes dang dbyes kyi tshig mi 'chor/ lus rjes su ma zhugs pas nang pas nang par nges/ spyod lam ma bstun pas phyi rol ba dag gnas der mi 'dug pa'i thabs su gyur te/ thams cad dkon mchog gsum du bsam pa mthun par gyur to/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ de'i dus su/ bla ma 'od zer snying po des grogs ngan pa med pas sa dag par mkhyen / grub mtha' ngan pa'i rtog pa khegs pas nang gi chos kyi snod du rung bar mkhyen nas yab rgyal po dga' rab dang / yum dga' byed ma dang / gcen dga' ba'i dpal dang / gcung kun tu dga' byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa'i tshogs mang po dag bshom du bcug go /yab yum sras dang bcas pas kyang sem/sa can ka26 na 5 rgothams cad/ dmigs yul du byas te mchod pa phun sum tshogs par bshams te bla ma la zhus pa//bdag cag sngon tshe rabs thams cad du phyi nang gang du'ang shan shun ma phyed pa la deng sang sprul pa'i rgyal bus chos kho na la sbyar/ nged mi la dbang kyang chos la dbang ma thob pas chos zab mo'i dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas chos dbang zhu bar sla ste/ dam tshig bsrung ba shin tu dka'/ sla ba de thob mchi ste / dka' ba de srung nus sam gsungs/ srog la bab kyang bka' las mi 'da'o zhes khas blangs pa dang / nang gi chos mang po'i dbang bskur ro/ /der rgyal bu kun tu dga' zhes bya ba de/ don chen po thob par mkhyen nas/bla ma 'od zer snying po'i drung du phyin te/ phyag lan gsum btsal/ g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor te/mdun du tsog tsog pur bzhugs te/ 'di skad ces gsol ba/ las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur ba'i/ /'jig rten log pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag med pas/ /dbang lnga phyi rol yul la 'byams/ /nang gi sems nyid dag pa las/ /ji ltar g.yengs bzhin rings par 'gyur/ /e ma sman pa chen po lags/ /nad kyi rtsa ba ma zin par/ /ji tsam sman btang log par 'gyur/ /chos kyi gnas lugs rang dwangs la/ /rtsa ba'i sems kyi ngos ma zin/ /dbang lnga yul la g.yengs 'gyur te/ /chos zhes sman du zhen gyur kyang / /log par 'byams kyis yang dag min/ /da ni 'di nas bzung ste yang / /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo — 188—

ribrom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bsrungs rang 'dod kyi/ /g.yeng bas dben zhing dgon par gnas/ /rnam pa ltar zhugs rang bzhin ni/ /chos sku dbyer med cig tu gnas/ /thig le dbyer med stong pa nyid/ /stong pa dbyer med thig le nyid/ /thig le dbyed med rang grol la/ /gnas pa 'gag med dang bral ba/ /ma bcos rang dwangs chen por bzhag /gti mug mun sgrib bying 'thibs spangs/ /spang bya dbyer med der spang bya/ /gang gi skyon bral rnam dag pa/ /kun gyi skyon bral ro gcig pa/ /skyon cig dag gis kun la sgrib/ /mun pa cig gis gzugs can tshogs/ /ma lus sgrib par byed dang mtshungs/ /mun pa de nyid dag gyur na/ /gzugs can ma lus so sor phyed/ /mun pas gzugs la gnod ma byas/ /mun pa rang grol dbyer med yin/ /gzugs yod mun pa med pa yin/ /gzugs nyid mun pa'i ngo bo ste / / mun pa dag na gzugs nyid dag /mun pa chos dbyings chen po ste/ /de yi ma khyab gang yang med/ /da ni sna tshogs chos rnams la/ snang bar zad kyi zhen mi byed/ /de la nyes gang gsung byed cing / /legs na de yin gsung rab ste/ /gang dri the tshom nges par bcad/ /kun gyi shes rab mig gcig tu/ /bla ma khyed kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ ye stong lhun grub zag med la/ /gang la gang 'dzin chen pa khrol/ /lus kyi rnam pa lha ru snang / /lha nyid rang bzhin dag par lhos/ /rnam shes yul la ma yengs shing / /nang gi gnas lugs nges par mdzod/ /de yi gnas lugs shes gyur na/ /gzhan ni ngang gis 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dge 'dun brgya phrag cig dang yab yum gcen por bcas pa thams cad kyis bskyed rdzogs dbyer med zung 'jug tu bstan par go dge 'dun brgya phrag cig gis lhag par du me la bud shing bsnan pa ltar rtogs nga/ la rtogs pa bsnan te mnyam pa nyid la blo 'byongs pa byung / yab yum gcen dang bcas pa dag kyang lus la lha'i snang ba shar/ dngos po la zhen pa 'gags te/ der yab yum na re/ de ring spang bya spang rngo med / / gnyen po logs na btsal du med/ /spang bya'i ngo bo chos dbyings zhes/ /gnyen po chos dbyings gnyen por shar/ /chos dbyings cig la spang gnyen bral/ /spang gnyen med par lhug par zhog /de ni gnas lugs chen po ste/ /'od gsal chen po yin zhes thos/ /zhes zer ro/ /dga' ba'i dpal na re/ sngon chad dga' ba'i dpal zhes grags/ /ming dang don du da gzod mthun/ /kun tu dga' yi dam chos gsungs/ /bla mas mthun 'gyur legs par brjod/ /mchod gnas mnyam pa nyid du bskul/ /pha ma chen pa'i 'ching ba bral/ /zhes smras pa dang / bar snang la gzugs med pa'i sgra cig grags pa ni/ dga' rab dga' byed kun tu dga'/ /dga' ba'i dpal yang mchog tu dga'/ /brgya phrag dge 'dun mnyam nyid 'phel/ /skyabs kyi gtso bo lha ru snang / /'jig rten sgron mar lham me ba/ /kun gyi 'khrul ba bsal ba mtshar/ /zhes zer ro/ /rgyal bu kun tu dga' nam — 189—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mkha' la gzigs te/ ye stong nam mkha' dag pa la/ /gzugs med brag cha'i skad du 'tsher/ /tshig gsal sgro skur med pa dang / /deng sang gnas lugs ston pa thos/ /zhes smras pa dang / bla ma'i 'kha nas/ las dang skal bar ldan pa la/ /ye nas dag pa'i nam mkha' nas/ /rtse shing nags tshal la sogs pa/ /gzhan las sgra 'byung smos ci 'tshal/ /kun la chos kyi sgra 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa dang / /kun tu dga'i zhal nas/ ma dag rnams la bde gshegs kyi/ /nges pa'i tshig kyang mi thos na/ /rtsi shing bar snang la sogs pa/ /gzhan las sgra 'byung smos ci 'tshal/ /yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten kun gyi phan bde ni/ /rin chen gser dang 'dra ba yi/ /bsam pa bzang las 'byung 'gyur na/ /ma dag gzhan las 'byung ba dkon/ /rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ 'od ni nyi ma dgalas 'byung / / mi gtsang 'dam las bcos gyur kyang / /nus med 'od 'byung smos ci 'tshal/ /de bzhin ma dag sems la'ang mtshungs/ /yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ myu gu phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /sa gshin sa bon bzang las byung / / brag skam sabon rul mi 'byung / /ma dag sa bon med la'ang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skabs 'dir rngog gi zhal nas/ bla ma yab sras gnyis kyi zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba zhig der kyang mdzad gda' na/bdag de'i dus na'ang zhus lan khyad par can nyan cing bdog ang / e ma kho bo bsod nams kyi bgo skal rgyal / rtag tu rgyal ba yab sras kyi gsung la longs spyad du yod/ gzhan kun na phar la nga rgyal gyi dregs pa gtsongs (btsongasaka pas nyen ri tsam gyi gun khugs/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi gsungs chos rgya mtsho lta bu'i khye tsho shor / da gzod thos nas 'gyod na/sa 'ong tsa na/ bdag gi snying tshim zhig bya yis/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ khyed de skad ma gsung / khong gang zag khyad par can la de 'dra ba'i skyon ga na mnga'/ de phyogasasu bzhugs pa'ang nga'i 'phrin las bsgrub (sgrubakagrogs yin mod/ spyir yang yul khyad par can la ngag gi sdig bsag tu ga la rung / de nas kyang deng sang jo bo dang khyed gnyis po yin mod/ gzhan bod na khong 'dra ba gang na yod gsungs pa dang / rngog gi zhal nas mad/ nongs na mthol lo bshags/ da ci nas gsung gi bar chod du'ang song / da thugs rje'i rgyun/ de bsring du gsol/ zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de ltar zhus lan mdzad pa'i rjes su/ yab rgyal po 'od zer dpal bzhengs te/ bla ma 'od zer snying po la'ang phyag btsal nas/ sras kun tu dga' la phyag 'tshal bar brtsams pa dang / sras bzhengs te byung nas/ e ma yab chen bzhugs su gsol/ /yab kyi dri lan bskal ba brgyar/ /spyi bos khur te mchod gyur kyang / /bdag gis 'khor bar ga la nus/ /zhes zhus pa dang / yab kyi zhal nas/ mtshungs pa med pa'i sras mchog khyed/ /deng sang sras su bstan mod kyi/ /gzhan du pha yin ma yang yin/ /de bas bdag gis 'khor mi nus/ /zhes smras pa dang / yum dga' byed ma — /90—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bzhengs nas byung ste/ sras la thal mo sbyar nas/ /byas shes drin du gzo byed pa'i/ /deng sang mtho ris rgyal po'i rigs/ /dge 'dun brgya yi sbyin bdag nyid/ /chos la spyod cing kun gyis khur/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ bdag la drin bkur yum chen ma/ khyed kyi nu zho 'thungs pa ni/ /rgya mtsho'i tshad kyang mi dpogs na / / su yis grangs su bgrang bar nus/ /yum gyis smras pa/ sems can thams cad der zad na/ kho mos dgos (sgos|su smos ci 'tshal/ khyod la'ang nu zho de tsam 'thungs/ khyod kyi drin yang de tsam mo/ /rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ sems can thams cad der zad mod/ /tshe 'dir khyod kyi bskyangs bar byas/ /rgyal srid gnas su khyod kyis bkod/ /deng sang khyod nyid mchod par rigs/ /yum gyis smras pa/ /che 'dir bdag gis bskyed byas kyang / khyod kyis rtag tu bde bar skyed/ khyod ni sprul pa'i rgyal bu la/ /bdag la ltos pa lta bur bstan/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu dga' ba'i dpal de ma dang nu bo la bltas te/ khyed gnyis khyim du skyes pa mtshar/ /zhing khams gtsang ma'ang 'di nyid de/ /padma'i sbubs nyid gnas nyid na/ /mngal la ltos par ji ltar rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / yum dang gcung gnyis mgrin gcig tu/ zhing khams gcang ma'ang 'di nyid de/ /padma'i sbubs kyang 'di nyid yin/ /mngal du skyes pa btags par zad/ /'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams yin/ /zhes smras pa dang /bla ma'i zhal nas/ kye kun tu dga' khyod nyid kun tu dga'i spyod pa gyis shig kun tu dgas zhus pa/ /kun tu dga'i spyod pa ji ltar bgyi/ rab tu 'byung bar byed dam/ khyim na gnas par byed/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ spyir rab tu byung ba ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin/ mtho ris kyi rgyu yin/ thar pa'i lam stegs yin mod kyis/ de dag chags pa can la de ltar bstan no/ /kun tu dga' khyed la chags pa med pas skye bo thams cad dang bstun zhing / skye bo thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba'i phyir du khyim gyi spyod pa mdzod cig yangs pa can gyi yul 'di nas khyed dang mthun pa'i grogs tshol zhig gsung de thos pa dang / yangs pa can gyi rgyal bu dang / bram ze'i bu dang / rje'u'i bu gzugs mdzes la spyod lam mkhas pa brgya tham pa khrid de shing rta'i nang du zhugs/ shing rta'ang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ rgyal bu'ang dar dkar bo'i gos dang / cod pan btags te shing rta'i dbus su bsdad / gyad stobs can bzhis shing rta drangs/ rol mo mkhan mkhas pas pi wang dang gling bu la sogs pa'i sgra bsgyur zhing yangs pa can gyi skye bo thams cad 'du ba'i gnas su phyin pa dang / yangs pa can gyi mi dag rgyal bu kun tu dga' zhes bya ba lo bdun lon nas phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi bstan pa bsnubs nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas phyir bton/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phangs bstod de/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor bkra shis par byas shing / deng sang rigs bzang bar grags pa'i khye'u brgya phrag cig gis bskor nas shing rta'i —/91—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung ches kyi skor/nang du bzhugs te de ring yangs pa can gyi skye bo thams cad 'du ba'i gnas su 'byon par yod zer ba skye bo thams cad kyis thos nas/ rang rang gi brgyan phun sum tshogs par btags te/ yangs pa can gyi skye bo thams cad 'du ba'i gnas ga la ba der phyin pa dang / rgyal bu lta bas chog mi shes pa byams pa dang / snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od rab tu 'bar te/ skye bo gang gis mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad yid 'dzin pas kun dga' bar gyur to/ /der skye bo tshogs pa de dag gi gseb na bram ze'i bu mo sha rtsi ser ba/ skra dmar ser/ gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu 'jam pa snum pa 'od 'phro ba/ ring thung rked so na mar sleb pa/ sen mo zangs mdog ltar dmar seng nge bar yod pa/ bzhin 'dzum la hur chags pa/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa ha cang bkrag mi che ba gyon pa de lta bu zhig 'dug pa mthong ngo / /bu mo 'di'i mtshan ltas kyis/ 'di'i rgyud la yon tan chen po yod nges snyam ste kha drang ba'i phyir smras pa/ gser mdog dmar ser skra can ma/ khun bag blta zhing bzhin 'dzum ma/ /dri med dri bral dkar bo'i gos/ /zangs mdog sen mo rno ba can/ /'jig rten 'jig rten dri ma can/ /skyon med skyon gyis dag pa'i phyir/ /gang du bde spyod bde bar gnas/ /thabs med shes rab mkhas dang bral/ /gang la de ldan don kun bsgrub (sgrubasaka / /de ltar rig gam rig byed ma/ /zhes smras pa dang / rig byed ma des rgyal bu mngon par shes pa dang ldan par rig nas smras pa/ nyi ma yod na nyin 'gyur zla ba'am zlar 'gyur te/ /gang zhig chu klung skems pa skem byed de yod na/ /chu klung med ces kun tu kun gyis de rig 'gyur/ /las kyi chu klung skem byed gnyen ldan gang ldan pa/ /zhes lan btab bo/ /yang slar rgyal bus smras pa/ gang la 'od yod de ni sa rang can zhes brjod/ /de med de la chu la me zhes 'gal bar grags/ /de rig spyod la nga yod de nyid der 'gro'o/ /mchungs par ldan dang mi ldan bag yod bsam ldan pa/ /de ni mkhas dang nges tshig sbyar ba'i don nyid de/ /de yang thar ba 'dod la yod kyis gzhan du min/ /zhes smras pa dang / de rig byed mas rig ste/ rgyal po'i rjes su pho brang du phyin no/ /de ltar bla ma 'od zer snying pos gzigs te/ rgyal po yab yum la 'di skad ces gsungs so// khyod kyi sras kun tu dga' 'di de ring yangs pa can gyi yul 'di na/ bram ze rig byed ma zhes bya ba phyi nang gi rig pa thogs pa la 'gran zla med pa/ lha mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul ba zhig yod pa de pho brang 'dir spyan drangs byung ngo / /yab yum dga' ste bltas pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug pho brang gi nang du rgyal bus bram ze'i bu mo de khrid nas byung ba dang / dge 'dun brgya phrag de dag kyang bzhengs/ bu mo des kyang phyag dang 'od zer gyis mchod pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do/ /der rgyal bu dga' ba'i dpal gyis — 192—

'brom/ sten ru / rgyasnyel ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bsams pa la/ bdag gi gcung 'dis de ring bud med rin po che zhig rnyed de byung ba 'di ni rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed/ gzhan du na phu bo yin pas yab yum gyis gang stsal pa'i bu mo dang 'grogs te/ rgyal po'i rgyal srid bskyang dgos pa las/ da ni gcung gis rgyal srid 'dzin/ nga ni bla ma 'od zer snying po'i drung du rab tu byung ste/ dkon mchog gsum mchod cing dkon mchog gsum dang mthun par bya'o snyam pa dang / de gcung gis shes te smras pa/ bdag gi gcen dga' ba'i dpal/ bla ma 'od zer snyi/nga pos bdag la 'di ltar gyis shig ces gsung byon no/ /da khyed kyis kyang yab yum gyis gang gnang ba'i bcun mo khab tu bzhes te rgyal srid gtso che bar bskyang dgos/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dag kyang 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis phongs nga/ med par bya dgos/ grong khyer gyi dbul phongs thams cad kyang rgyun bcad dgos/ yab chos kyi rgyal po 'di yang sku tshe gnas kyi bar du pha rol gyi rgol bas mi 'jigs par byas te/ gang dang gang gi sgo nas thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par bya dgos so zhes smras pa dang / gcen gyi zhal nas/ kye ma rte'u la glang po'i khal ma bkal/ nga ni khyed dang mi 'dra/rang rgyud nyon mongs pa las yon tan gyi bcud ma rgyas/ sngar kyang nyon mongs pas bcings pa la/ da nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba khyim du gnas pa ni mi rung ngo zhes smras pa dang / bla ma 'od zer snying po'i zhal nas/ kun tu dga'/gcen zer ba bzhin du rgya'/ srid khyod rang gis zung / gcen chen po rab tu 'byung du chug ces gsungs ri/ dang /kun tu dga' ba'i zhal nas/ 'o na bla ma'i gsung bcag par dka'/ rab tu phyung zhig khyod la bdag gi bla mchod bya'o/ /der bla ma 'od zer snying pos/ chul khrims ldan pa brgya phrag cig gi dbus su dga' pa'i dpal rab tu byung ste/ mtshan yang legs pa'i shes rab ces btags so/ /de rab tu byung ba nyid nas khyim pa'i spyod pa legs par spangs so/ /rab tu byung ba'i spyod nga/ legs par blangs pa/ dang ba 'dren zhing yid du 'ong ba dge ba la rtse gcig tu spyod pa zhig byung ste/ gcung shin tu dad cing dga' ste pha ma gcig gi bur mnyam pa la/ bdag gi gcen chen po 'di la 'di 'dra ba'i dge 'dun ngo mchar che ba cig byung 'dug snyam ste/ yid la bsams pa bzhin ngag tu yang smras pas/ dge 'dun brgya phrag de dag gi zhal nas/ rgyal ba kun tu dga'/ gcen 'di'i mtshan ci yin/ smras pa/ legs pa'i shes rab ces thos te 'di skad du/ blo gros /byim gyis ma bcings shing / /log pa'i lam la ma 'khyams par/ /legs pa'i lam la spyod pa ste/ /legs pa'i shes rab don dang mthun/ /dge 'dun brgya phrag cig gis smras pa/ bod khams kha ba can shed na/ /bdag cag 'dir tshogs brgya phrag gis / / grub pa thob pa'i gnas chen yod/ /mtho rgyal lhun po yer bar grags/ /der yang khyod kyi gcen mchog 'di/ /blo gros khyim gyis ma bcings shing / /log pa'i lam du'ang mi 'gro bar/ /legs pa'i lam la — 193—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/spyod pa ste/ /legs pa'i shes rab don dang ldan/ khyod dang bla ma 'od zer mtshan/ /gnyis la mchod cing gus par 'khur/ /'di yang de dus gleng bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /legs pa'i shes rab de'i dus su yang /khyed la rab tu byung ba legs pa'i shes rab ces grags/ skye ba de dge ba'i las kyis 'das par byas so/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di/ rgyal bu kun tu dga' de yin te/ lha mo khro gnyer can dang lhan cig tu gnas nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spyod pa la/ dran pa brjed pa med par byas shes bzhin gyis brtan par byas/ bag yod pas mi dge ba'i rnam pa tsam yang med par bstan/ dbang po'i sgo lnga chags sdang gi spyod pa cung zad tsam yang phyir bcil te bsdams so/ /nyin gsum mtshan gsum dus drug tu rang gi sems rgyud la rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba 'dug gam mi 'dug lta ba dang / khyim na gnas pa'i khyim gyi nyon mongs pas gos ma gos lta ba dang / gzhan don las nyams ma nyams lta ba dang / spyir yang mu stegs byed kyi spyod pa sems la zhugs pa mi tshor bas de zhugs ma zhugs lta ba dang / gzhan yang spang bya la gnyen por 'khrul ma 'khrul dpyod pa dang / gnyen po la spang byar 'khrul ma 'khrul lta ba dang / spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis chos dbyings su slongs ma slongs lta ba dang / nang du ting nge 'dzin de dag rgyas pa la brtson zhing shes rab chen po'i dbyings su 'khyer bas dus 'da' bar byed do/ /der yul phyogs thams cad bkra shis pa dang / rgyal srid 'phel ba dang / rgyal bu de yang mi'i dbang por bkur ba dang / chos kyi bla mar bzung ste thams cad kyi mchod par byed do/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ de lta bas na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis dran pa dang shes bzhin bag yod pa'i sgo nas/ khyim na spyod pa'i tshe yang dbang po'i sgo thams cad bsdams te/ nyin mtshan kun tu sems kyi rgyud la brtag dpyad byas so/ /de'i dus kyi yab de ni/ lha bla ma'o/ /yum de ni ka ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams rtags tu bsrung / /nyin mtshan dusagasum yang dang yang / /sems kyi rgyud la brtag par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ rgyal bu kun tu dga' bar ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs gsum pa'// //— 194—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nga4 yul ba ra na sir rgyal bu lha skyes su sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilersā/ka 31 na2 rgodage ba'i bshes gnyen pa yul wa ra ṇa sir rgyal bu lha skyes su sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le 'u bsdokyigs sa//༄7/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo yab sras gnyis ka la phyag gsum gsum bcal te/ 'di skad ces zhus so/ /zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba 'di na mar la/ bdag gi nyes pa bsgrags bya zhing / /gzhan gyi 'khrul ba btsal mi bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis sngon rang la nyes pa ji ltar byung ba bsgrags shing / gzhan gyi 'khrul ba la skyon du ma bzung ba/ bla mas gsung du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ sngar bzhin mgon po spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa legs par phul cig /ngas bshad kyis gsungs nas/ sngon ba ra na si zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po bsod nams 'phel zhes bya ba yod pa la/ btsun mo lhas byin ma zhes bya ba yod de/ de la sras lha skyes bya ba dang / lhas byin zhes bya ba gnyis yod/ der rgyal po bsod nams 'phel zhes bya ba de rgyal srid kyang rgya che/ blon po yang thabs la mkhas pa mang po yod pa la/ rgyal po de shin tu chos la dkar bas/ blon po dag gi bsam pa la rgyal po 'di nyid dad pa che ba zhig 'dug ste/ ha cang dad pa dang snying rje ches na/ ngan pas rngan byed du'ang 'ong / dgra mi thul/ srid mi skyong snyam nas/ rgyal po la zhus pa/ kye rgyal po chen po lags/ yul ba ra na si bya ba 'di mi sna dang / zong zog /ka 31 na rgodang / bzo /sna mang / skye bo phal gyis mgo thon par dka'/ rgyal po dag gis kyang sprul ba sna tshogs bya dgos/ mi dpa' bo la de bas kyang dpa' ba bstan dgos mkhas pa la de bas kyang mkhas pa bstan dgos/ bzang ba la'ang de lta bu zhig bstan dgos / mdor na yul gang dang gang yod pa de las lhag pa re ma bstan na/ gzhan gyis brnyas par byas te gzhan don las nyams par byed do/ /de las nyams na rang don kyang shin tu dka'/ kye rgyal po chen po lags/khyed dad pa dang brtson 'grus mtshungs pa med/ snying rje mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang 'dra ste de 'dra ba sems can yongs la che mod/ der yang dam pa'i spuod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa ngo mtshar che ste/ 'on kyang rgyal po khyed rgyal srid rgya che sems can thams cad kyang rnam par rtog pa re re ba 'ba' zhig yin pas 'dod lugs mi mthun/dge 'dun dag gsung tsa na/ sngon gyi 'phags pa rnams kyang sems can gang gis gang 'dul ba la de'i gnyen por gang 'gro ba'i spyod pa dang de dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa dang spyod pa sna tshogs su ston kyang bsam pa gzhan don las ma nyams pa zhig dgos gsung zhing gda' bas/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar zhi zhing dul bar bzhugs na — 195—

bka' gdams dnge/ dken gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/pha rol gyi dmag dbus 'dir lhags te/ rgyal srid las nyams srid pas gzhan gyi bsam/ pa ma rung ba dag spa bkong ba'i phyir du dpung bzhi'i dmag bshams te/ phyogs dang phyogs ma/cham/sa su bkram nas ji srid dmag ma byung gi gong rol tu/ yul dbus bde bar byas te rang gi bcan sa zin par byas nas re/ dbang khyod kyis gzhan don spyad par bya'o/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas deng sang ba ra na si'i skyes/ bu'i tshogs dang khyed blon po thams cad bde ba 'di su la brten te byung / blon po dag gis smras nga// de ni mi/ dbang khyod nyid la brten te byung ngo / /rgyal ngo/sa smras nga// kye blon po dag sngar nga'i rgyal srid 'di 'a gnod dzā / ji cam zhig byung / blon ngo/sa smras pa/ mi dbang khyed kyi sku tshe'i ring la gnod pa ci yang ma/ byung ngo / /rgyal ngo/sa smras pa/ de su'i mthu yin/blon pos smras nga// rgyal ngo/ ted kyis bka' stsal du gsol/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas/ kye rig pa can dag nga la'ang rgyal po lha dkon mchog gsum zhes bya ba zhig yod/des bdag bde bar byas rgyal srid kyang des gtad/ der ma zad mi/ lus 'di yang des byin/ mtha' dmag thams cad kyang des bsrung bar byed/ da dung yang de las ngo log na mi bde bar 'gyur gyis/ ga‘nan du na sa g.yos kyang bdag gis rgyal po dkon mchog gsum mi g.yo/ de ma g.yos na/ kho bo mi g.yo/ /the bo ma g.yos na rgyal srid mi g.yo/ rgyal srid ma g.yos na/ yul ba ra na si'i skye bo thams cad kyang bde zhing skyid la /byed blon po thams cad kyang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /der blon po dag gis smras pa/ /byed kyi rgyal po chen po de'i khrims ci 'dra zhig gnas/ khrim/sa de las 'gal ba na cir 'gyur/ rgyal ngo/sa smras nga// bdag gi rgyal nge/ de'i khrim/sa ni 'di snyelta ste/ sangs rgyas bstan la mi gnod nga/'i/ /pha ma gsod na khrim/sa dang 'gal/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa yi/ /dgra bo mi sgrosnyel khrims dang 'gal/ /pha ma'i don du 'gyur nga/ yi/ /ma byin mi len khrims dang 'gal/ /sgru/ ma'i don du mi 'gyur ba'i/ /ma byin pa len khrims dang 'gal/ /chos kyi rgyal srid mi/ 'jin pa'i/ /mi changs spyod na khrims dang 'gal/ /chos kyi rgyal srid 'jan pa yi/ /mi changs mi spyod khrims dang 'gal / / rgyal ba'i gsung dang 'gal gyur ba'i/ rdzu na du smra na khrims dang 'gal/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab bsgrub (sgrub3 pa yi/ /drang don mi smra khrims dang 'gal/ /mu stegs gzhan du mi bsgyur ba'i/ /phra ma smra na khrims dang 'gal / / mu stegs ngan pa 'khyed pa yi/ /phra ma mi smra khrims dang 'gal/ /phas rgol char gcod mi byed pa'i/ /tshig rtsub smras na khrims dang 'gal/ /pha rol rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /tshig rtsub mi smra khrims dang 'gal/ /gzhon nu 'dren par mi byed pa'i/ /'khyal tshig smra na khrims dang 'gal/ /gzhon nu lam la 'dren pa yi/ /dga' tshig mi smra khrims dang 'gal/ /lam du nam yang mi 'gro ba'i/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta dag /spong — 196 —

'brom sten pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu ches bzhugs so/ /bar mi byed khrims dang 'gal/ /de ni de yi rgyal khrim/sa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / blon pos smras pa/ rgyal po khyod kyi rgyal srid ni/ /'phags pa'i rgyasnyel srid skye bos skyong / /de las 'gal na ci 'gyur bar/ /gong du zhus bzhin gnang du gsol/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ che ba'i che khrims de 'gal na/ /theg dam/na g.yang la rab tu lhung //thar pa mchog tu phyin ma nus/ /de yang ma/chams kyi ngan 'gror 'gro /stong prag nyi shu'i 'og rol na/ /de yi 'bras bu mnar med yod/ /re/ yi 'obs la brnged (rngedaka byed cing / /rab tu cha ba bsam/ mi khyab/ /gzhan yang cha dmyal brgyad dang ni/ /grang dmyal brgyad dag rab sdug bsngal/ /'khor na lhag pa bcu drug gda'/ /dmyal ba der lhung bzod par dka'/ /lo dang bskal ba chen por yang / /chu thigs cam yang mi/ myong na/ /gos bzang zas kyis khyad par ni/ khrims dang 'gal bas smos ci 'tshal/ kha sgo chung 'ing /spa nang bcud/ /mgrin nga/ phra zhing lho ba che/ /yan lag rgya khab bzhin du skam/ /bu ga dgu nas me dgu 'bar/ /skra ser rtsi ba ma/ phyi la thon//ma sbyin ster na'ang ma che zhig /ngan pa nas byin khri la byin/ /nga la dgos zhes smra ngan 'byin/ /zas zos 'bras bu me ru 'bar/ /lus bsreg sdug bsngal dang/ga me/da skyed/ gti mug gsod bkol gzhan dbang can/ /ma/kha' la rgyu zhing sa la gnas/ /chu la gnas shing mi/ gcang khrod/ /mi lag 'grims dang bdag ma/ bzung / /sha bal pags pa rus pa dang / khrag la sogs pa ci phyir yang / /gang gi sreg len sdug bsngasnyepa ba/ /de yang khrim/sa ngang 'gal bas byas/ /de ltar rig gam blon po'i tshogs/ khrim/sa dang 'gal na de 'drar 'gyur/ /blon nge/ dag gis/ smras pa/ /de ring mi dbang chen po yis/ /rgyu 'bras zab cho/'i ches kyang bstan/ /rgyal ngo/'ang snyeriphags nga/ nyid du brjod / / 'phags pa'i blon po bdag cag yin/ /rgyal pos smras nga// kye blon ngo/ dag bdag de las mi/ mthun par mi brjod kyis/ gtso bo gang la brten pa de la phal pa dag kyang de'i rjes du lajug nga/ra rigs kyi/ bdag gi rgyal po'i rgyal khrims ni/ de ltar phun sum chegs pa yin la/ bdag kyang de'i rjes su ma/thun nga/ra spyod nga/sa/blon po dag nga'i rjes su ji skad bstan pa bzhin spyod cig ces gsungs nga/ ni 'di skogha ste/ gang la b.rīn pa gang de yi / / rjes su 'brang zhing mthun par spyod/ /'od dang mthun par snang byed cing / /gang la de med cho/ga por snang //rin chen gsum la rten byed pa/ /gang la skyabs 'gro de yi chos/ /srog gcod ma byin len pa dang / /mi tshangs spyod sogs spong byed pa/ /gang dag de spyod mthun brjod pa/ /rang nyid gtso bor cis mi rigs/ /skad cig bstan pas kun tu phan/ /gang la'ang slu bar mi byed pa/ /de ni skyabs ma/chog dam pa ste/ /nga yi rjes 'brang brten par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / blon po dag na re/ kye rgyal po/ bdud sdig to can gyis dkrug te mtha' dag /ka 33 na4 dmag/ gis rgyal srid la garnod pa byas na ji ltar bgyi/ rgyal pos smras pa/ lha yi — 197—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /skye dgu kun la bde ster zhing / /gang la 'dod pa sbyin mdzad pa/ /bsod namasaspel phyir gnas 'dir bltams/ /lha skyes lha sras dam pa la/ khyod kyi sgro 'dogs chod ces dris/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / blon pos gsol ba/ mi dbang sras de lha mchog gam/ khyod kyi rgyal srid srung byed dam/ /bdag cag blon 'bangs skyong mdzad dam/ /mnga' 'og kun la bde ster ram/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de la lha skyes mi zer ram/ /lha bzhin mdzes par mi gda'am/ /'dzum zhing bag dang ldan mthong ngam/ khyod kyis mi snyan zhig thos sam/ /blon pos gsol ba/ bzhin mdzes khro ba mi mnga' zhing / /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin bstod tshig smra/ /'jam ste bag phebs bgro bar byed/ /g.yeng ba spangs te nang na'ang gda'/ /gang la brten pa yul du bzang / /'jig rten kun la phan byed pa/ /'di ni spyan ras gzigs dang mthun/ /'di la the tshom ma byed cing / /sngar las lhag par gus bstan nas/ /skyabs kyi dam par spyi bor blang / /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyal bu lha skyes pho brang gi yang thog na byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin te/ phyag lan gsum du byas shing / zhabs la gtugs te thal mo sbyar nas zhus pa/ sngon chad ma dag sprin gyis bsgribs/ /nyi ma lta bu'i lha mchog khyed/ /rgyu skar tsam las ma bsgoms na/ /yab kyis sprin bsal da gzod 'tshal/ /zhes gsol ba dang /lha skyes kyi zhal nas/ nga la yon tan ci yang med/ /nga ni ma dag byis pa ste/ /las kyi dbang gisamir skyes tsam / / nyon mongs dbang gis mthar ma phyin/ /rig blon las can mkhas pa'i mchog /snang dag nyi ma shar gyur kyang / /rgyu skar 'od kyang bdag la med/ /'on kyang rig ldan blon po'i tshogs/ /yab ni mi mchog dam pa ste / / gang gi skyon nas mi lta bar/ /yon tan cung zad yod gyur kyang / /de nyid bstod de 'byin par byed/ khyed ni 'phags pa'i blon po ste/ / nga la dag par mthong du zad/ /ces smras pa dang / blon po dag na re/ skyes bu dam pa rang skyon ston/ /yon to gter du sped par byed/ /gzhan gyi 'brul ba mi g.yeng bar/ /rang gi yon tan de la bkur/ /gzhan gyi skyon sped rang gi len/ /de ni sems dpa'i spyod pa ste/ /sems dpa' mchog tu rgyal pos bstan / / da ni nges par spyi bor byon/ khyod nyid bla ma nyid du khur/ /'di yi skyabs nyid kun la gsal/ /gtan gyi skyabs nyid mdzad par zhu/ /dam pa khyod kyis gang gsungs la/ /skad cig tsam yang mi 'gal bar/ /rtag tu rjes su spyad par bgyi/ /e ma mi dbang rgyal po yi/ /sras kyang lha mchog khyod nyid na/ /lha yi sras kyang khyod nyid bsngags/ /de phyir bde bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / rgyal bus smras pa/ mi la lha zhes dag snang can/ /bdag la nges par gus byed na/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ /des ni slu bar mi 'gyur ro/ /blon pos gsol ba/ khyod kyi yab mchog mi dbang mchog /dad dang snying rje mtshungs pa med/ /drag — 198—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhus/sa so/ /po'i spyod pa cung zad cam/ /ston par mi byed gzhan mi non/ /gzhan gyi rang nyams blangs gyur te/ /gnas ni pham par mi byed dam/ /zhes zhus pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ shes sam blon po rig pa can/ /dgra bo bya ba rang rgyud yin/ /rang nyid chags sdang dgrar langs na/ /dgra bo'i g.yab mo chen por spyod/ /rang nyid byams par gnas gyur na/ / sems yod su zhig sdang bar byed/ /gal te bdud kyis brlabs gyur te/ /'ga' zhig dgra ltar rtsod gyur na/ /bdag gi khrims dmag dkon mchog yin/ /gzugs ni ri ltar che 'gyur zhing / /lus kyang me la mtshon cha'ang me/ /dpag med dgra ru langs gyur kyang / /dkon mchog gsum gyis bzlog byed na / / 'dom gang gru bzhi mda' gang tsam/ /mtshon cha khur te rtsod pa la/ /ci ste dkon mchog pham par 'gyur/ /blon po dag gis smras pa/ kye lha sras/ de ltar gsungs pa ni snyan par thos kyis/ ji srid dmag ma byung gi bar du khyod dang mthun par spyad do/ /zhes rgyal bu'i rjes su 'brang zhing / dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten la phyag dang mchod pa dang / bskor ba la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba dag la 'bad cing grong khyer du gnas pa dang / grong khyer gyi mi dag na re/ rgyal bu 'di gnyis 'brungs nas yul 'di'ang bkra shis pa cig byung / ston dus su sad dang ser ba la sogs pa'ang ma byung / dpyid dus su bkra mi shis pa rlung dmar chen po'ang ma langs/dbyar dus su sa g.yo ba dang glog gi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'ang ma byung / dus snga mo'i dus su dgun la bab pa na / mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa log pa'i rdzu 'phrul can grong khyer nas mi'i snying dang / khrag dron mo khyer te yul gzhan du 'gro bar byed pa la/ de dag kyang da med/ khyad par du blon po 'di dag sngar bas dal ba zhi ba dul ba rgyal bu lha skyes dang mtshungs par gda' zhes kun gyis bsgrags so/ /der ba ra na si'i byang phyogs 'ga' zhig na/ rgyal po nag po khyab 'jug ces bya ba spyir yang phrag dog che/khyad par du yang rgyal po bsod nams 'phel la ru za ba yod pa de rang gi pho brang gi sgo na yod pa la/ ba ra na si'i sprang mo rgan mo zhig kho bo'i gan du byung ste zas blangs pa dang / rgyal po na re/ khyed gang nas 'ongs/ sprang mo na re/ nga ba ra na si nas 'ongs/ der rgyal po na re/ nga la nag po khyab 'jug ces ma grags sam/ khyod yul ba ra na si'i rgyal po bsod nams 'phel zhes bya ba thams cad la sbyin gtong rgya chen po byed zer bas/ de la mi sdod par 'dir 'ong ba ci yin/ sprang mo na re/ rgyal po bsod nams 'phel de sbyin gtong yang rgya chen po byed/nged la'ang ster te/ rgyal po bsod nams 'phel rgyal bu dang / blon 'bangs dang bcas pa ni khyed la de skad mi zer bar gda'/ rgyal pos
