smras pa/ 'o na khong rang rnams ci zer/ ngas rgyal po la dngos su ma thos te/ lan cig grong khyer gyi dbus na yod pa na kho la bu lha skyes zhes bya ba cig yod pa de/ zas zhim po khyer nas byung ste/— 199—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nga la yang byin/ sprang po gzhan la'ang byin nas bslab bya 'di skad zer/ khyed rnams ba ra na si'i mi sna mang ba bsod nams chung ba rgyal po rgyal bu blon 'bangs dang bcas pa'ang / rgyal po khyab 'jug la ltos nas mi dpa' ba rang gi rgyal srid kho na la chags pa/ dman cha blangs nas sdod pa yin gyi/ rgyal po khyab 'jug bya ba nor longs spyod che ba/ dpa' zhing ster phod pa la khong mi che bas sus kyang slong ma nus/ khyed rang rnams phyin na khong gis phongs pa med par byed mod zer zhing gda'o zhes smras pa dang / nag po khyab 'jug ces bya ba tshe gang la 'dzum cig mi 'ong ba de/ 'dzum mul byas nas rgyal bu de/ de skad zer ba bden nam/ sprang mosasmrasapa/ kye rgyal po de skad mi zer na lto ni der ma phongs pa 'ong / rgan mo 'di na tshur skyong ba dka' las ci byed zer ba dang /rgyal po na re/ khong de skad zer ba legs/ ngas zer rgyu de khong gis byas/ khong chos rgyal pha bu yin pas/ rang gi nyes pa ci yang med kyang sgrog gzhan gyi 'brul ba che yang mi slong par yon tan du brjod/ da ngas ni sngar tshig dang bsam pa mi rigs pa 'ga' re byas pas de yang 'chags pa dang / khong gi pho brang du dga' bar gleng du 'gro / sprang mo khyod kyang skye bo gzhan dag phra mar smra ba la/ khyod drang por smra ba legs zer nas zas gos dang 'tsho ba byin no/ /sprang mo'i bsams pa la gtam gyi rigs ni drang por smras na chos su 'gro bar 'dug rgyal pos ji skad gsungs pa la sgro skur ma byas par smras pas rgyal po 'di yang dga' ste chags sdang gi dmag mi byed kyi steng du/ chos rgyal sras blon dang bcas pa'i drung du 'dud du 'gro bar 'dug snyam mo/ /der rgyal po nag po khyab 'jug ces bya ba de rta ba lnga stong chas te nor mang po'ang khyer la/ der rgyal po'i rtog pa la/ nga 'di ltar mang la rags par 'gro ba la/ yul de bas dmag tu 'khrul na mi rung snyam nas mtshon cha rnams sbas te phyin pa dang /rgyal po bsod nams 'phel gyi blon pos rgyang ma nas mthong ste blo ma bde nas/ rgyal po bsod nams 'phel gyi drung du phyin te/ 'di ltar rta ba'i tshogs shin tu mang ba gda' ba/ nag po khyab 'jug rgol ba ma yin nam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje las khong khros te 'byung ba mi rigs/ kho bo yang bsam pa bzang / sras kyang sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin pas khong byung kyang mi skyon/ dmag chas su ma zhugs par song la bsu ba gyis/ gzhan yang pho brang gi yang thog tu song la lha sras la dris shig blon po dag gis kyang pho brang gi yang thog tu phyin te/ 'di ltar rta ba mang bar gda'/ khyab 'jug 'byugs pa yin nam zhes zhus pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ rnam rtog dmag tu ma 'khrul cig khyab 'jug bsam pa bzang po ste/ /gnod pa'i sems med dga' bas 'ongs/ /mtshon cha med pa'i dmag mchis sam/ /der blon po rnams dga' ste/ lha bsu ba bgyi lags sam zhus pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ da lta song la/ ba ra na si'i khye'u dang bu mo rnamasal —200—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /chas dang rgyan legs par thogs la/ khyab 'jug gi mdun du glu gar phun sum tshogs pa gyis shig ces bsgo ba dang / blon po dag gis kyang ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du/ ba ra na si'i khye'u dang dang bu mo rnams la bsgrags pas / thams cad rgyal po'i gsung thos pa tsam gyis dang du len pa'i sgo nas thams cad chas su zhugs te 'ongs so / / der rgyal po'i bsod nams la/ khye'u dang bu mo yang / khyab 'jug gi 'khor dang ka 35 ba3rgograngs/mnyam pa byung ngo / /rgyal po'i 'khor du'ang blon po rig pa can dang / mi stobs dang ldan pa lnga brgya tsam 'khod de/ khyab 'jug gi mdun du phyin pa dang / khyab 'jug gis kyang rgyang ring po nas byung ba mthong ste/bsams pa la'ang / chos rgyal 'di la phag tu'ang phun sum tshogs par bstod na/ bdag gis dngos su yang nga rgyal bstan na mi rung snyam nas/ lnga stong gis rta las babs nas 'ongs te/ rgyal po'i drung du sleb pa dang /dga' ba'i gtam mang po glengs te gser srang lnga stong phyag tu phul la/ rgyal busakyang khye'u dang bu mo lnga stong gi glu dang gar la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa byed du bcug nas/ rang gi pho brang gi nang du spyan drangs so/ /der rgyal po bsod nams 'phel gyi bsam pa la/ mi dregs pa can sdig can 'dul ba la de dang rjes su mthun par bstan na mi thul bas/ de ring nga rgyal bcag pa'i chos shig bstan dgos snyam nas/ rang gi pho brang na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs pa la mi'i mchod pa la ma tshang ba med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams pa'i mdun du stan tsam yang med par tsog tsog pur 'dug ste/ spyan chab nyil le ngag snyan pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ skye bar dka' la 'jig sla ba'i/ /lus 'di khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi/ /'jig rten sgron ma skyabs kyi gtso/ /bdag gi nga rgyal gnyom du gsol/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mi gtsang ba'i / / 'dam rdzab 'di la zhen gyur te/ /gtan gyi btsan sa ma zin par/ /rgyal srid bdud kyis lam du bcom / / e ma lha mchog dkon mchog gsum/ khyed 'dra'i skyabs gnas mi bsten par/ /rnam rtog bdud kyis brlams pa yi/ /bdag 'dra'i rgyal la gzhan brten pa/ /de ni 'di yi 'dun mar zad/ /rang gi btsan sa ma zin par / / gzhan gyi skyabs su rlom pa yi/ /zog ma bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ khyed ni thugs rje'i dpung dang ldan / / bdag gi yul yang khyed kyis skyobs/ /rgyal srid 'dam rdzab lta bu 'dir/ kho bo mi gtsang srin bu 'dra/ /'phags pas gzigs na snying rje na'ang / /rang gis ma tshor bde bar 'khrul/ /zhes nyam thag skad du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing langs te byung nas/ khyab 'jug gdan phun sum tshogs par bshams pa'i steng du sdod du bcug ste/ khyab 'jug la 'di skad ces smras pa/ mi dbang gnas 'dir byon gyur tam/ /dregs pa bdag ni zhum gyur te/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin chen la/ /yus kyi dbang gis gsol btab phyir/ /bdag —201 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gi rig pa yar 'bar te/ /mi dbang byon pa ma 'tshal to/ /mi dbang dpung dang bcas pa dag /gnas 'dir byon pa shin tu legs/ /gdugs 'ga' dga' bar smra bar bya/ /thugs phob skyod par ma mdzad cig /ces gsungs pa dang / nag po khyab 'jug na re/ kho bo nag po'i rang bzhin la/ /mi dbang khyed kyis 'dud pa ni/ /rgyal gyis dmangs la 'dud dang mtshungs/ /de phyir bdag gis 'dir 'ongs so/ /der rgyal bu lha skyes kyis smras pa / stobs gyi dbang po gnasa'adir bskyod/ /bdag 'dra'i be'u bstan zhes thos/ /mi dbang khyod kyi sras mo de/ /bdag gis rgyal srid skyab /ka36 na7 bskyang /ba'i phyir/ /bdag la byin na rigs mod de/ /sngon yang rgyal srid bdag bzung bas/ /da lta 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khyams/ /da ni de las thar ba'i phyir/ /ngesapar 'byung ste dka' ba spyod/ /grong gi 'dab las rgyang bsrings te/ /gang la'ang chags par mi byed pa'i/ /nags khrod dben par bsam gtan bsgom (sgomasaka/ /phyin chad kun gyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /de ni bdag gi dam bca'o/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po khyab 'jug na re/ rgyal bu na ru ma son par/ /blo grosamatha' ru phyin par gda'/ khyed 'dra nags su dben par phangs/ /lha cig khyod la cis kyang sbyin/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ blo gros chos la song ba gang / /de bas khyim du gnas par phangs/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub (sgrub1pa gang / /'di yi 'dun mar song na phung / /zhes smras pa dang / khyab 'jug gi rtog pa la/ gzhon nu ma 'di'i chos skad smra lugs kyis/ /bdag gi bu mo byin yang bzhag ste chos la song ba'i khrims yod/ de bas rgyal bu lhas byin 'di la byin na drag snyam nas/ rgyal po bsod nams 'phel la zhus pa/ chos rgyal khyod kyi lhas byin la/ /bdag gi lha cig bzhes su gsol/ /lha skyes mi bzhed chos su gsung / /nges par mnyen du 'chams na bde/ /rgyal po bsod nams 'phel gyis smras pa/ lha yi lha yis byin brlabs pa'i/ /lha skyes zhes bya sprul pa'i bu/ /mtshan dang ldan pa 'di la bris/ /bdag gi shes rab 'di nyid yin/ /rgyal po khyab 'jug gi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu 'di'i smra lugs dang / rgyal po 'di'i zer lugs kyis/ rgyal bu 'di sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig yin pa la/ yul khams 'di thams cad kyang 'dis bkra shis par byas la/ rgyal po'i bur brten nas/ rgyal po'i 'dun ma thams cad kyang 'dis bsgrub (sgrubakacing yod par thag chod snyam nas/ rgyal bu lha skyes la smras pa/ kye lha sras khyed kyi gcung lhas byin 'di la bdag gi bu mo 'di sbyin gyis bzhes su gsol/ lha skyes kyi smras pa/ kye rgyal po/rgyal srid dug gi lo ma dang 'dra ba 'di stong kyang mi skyon mod/ 'on kyang mnga' ris kyi gdul bya rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ bdag gi gcung byang chub sems dpa' lhas byin 'di la/ lha'i sras mo sems dag pas dag par byin cig ces smras pa dang / rgyal po khyab 'jug na re/ mi dbang kha lo sgyur mdzad pa'i/ /lha las skyes pa lha —202—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yi sras/ khyod kyi 'khrul med gsung byon pa/ /legs kyis de bzhin brtan par bya/ /zhes khas blangs pa dang /rgyal bu lha skyes kyis yab rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ kye mi dbang / nag po khyab 'jug ces bya ba gdul bar dka' ba dad pa dang / snying rjes thul ba ni gcung la bu mo ster zer bas kho bos khas blangs so/ /yab kyi zhal nas/ lha sras bu mo de nam bsu/ rgyal bus zhus pa/ zas tshos dus su zos na mi rengs pas/ da lta nyid du rgyal po 'di nyid kyi zla ba rta dkar po gos dkar po can stong dang / sngon po sngon po can stong dang / dmar po dmar po can stong dang / ljang gu ljang gu can stong ste rta ba bzhi stong dang / thun mong ba stong ste lnga stong brdzangs nas/ rgyal po'i lha cig gnas 'di nyid du myur du drangs pa drag go /der yab rgyal pos kyang sras ji skad zer ba bzhin/rgyal po khyab 'jug la nor dpag tu med pa byin zhing / rta ba lnga stong gi 'khor brdzangs te/ de'i bu mo rang gi pho brang 'khor du sras kyi btsun mor bsu'o/ /de'i dus su lha skyes kyis gcung la bslab bya mdzad pa/ mi dbang sras kyi srid 'dzin pa/ /pha yi rjes su mthun par 'tshal/ /yab ni dkon mchog gsum gyi sras/ /de yi sras ni khyod nyid de/ /de yi rgyal srid khyod kyis 'dzin/ /de ni khrims las ma 'gal bar/ /spong ba bdun gyis brgyan par mdzod / / spyir yang 'khor ba'i sems can la/ khyod kyi pha mar ma gyur med/ khyad par yul de'i skye 'gro rnams/khyod kyi ma yin khyod la brten/ /lhas byin khyod kyis skyongs shig gcung / khyod kyis phan par ma mdzad na/ /sems can ma dag gnod 'tshe che/ /pha mar 'gyur ba gzhan gyis 'them /ka 37 na7 'thoms/ / /nyams thag nga ro 'bod pa'i tshe/ kho bo'i snying la gzer du 'jug /de tshe khyod kyi srid ma zin/ /nu bo'i bya ba ma byas so/ /thams cad khyod kyis bde bkod na/ /nga la byas so lhas byin pa/ /de tshe phan par byas so gcung / /ma 'ongs bde bar 'tshogs pa yi/ /smon lam dag go rin chen gcung / /zhes smras pa dang / gcung na re/ e ma bdag la thugs rjes gzung / khyed kyis rgyal srid mi 'dzin par/ /glang khal be'u la bskur ram/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po dben byed cing / /nyon mongs kho bo ma g.yengs gyur/ /'di la 'bras bu ci zhig 'byung / /zhes zhus pa dang /gcen gyi zhal nas/ bdag gi nyes pa gang yod sgrogs/ /gzhan gyi 'khrul la skyon ma 'dzin/ /snying rje phan sems ldan par mdzod/ /des na 'bras bu phun tshogs te/ /ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe/ /mtha' 'khob gnas su'ang 'di bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / /gcung gi zhal nas/ gcen chen po ji skad gsung ba bzhin du/ kho bos ngag bcag par mi nus pas khas blang gis bdag gi mgon skyabs thams cad mdzod cigaces gcen gyis ji ltar bsgo ba rnams lag len las ma 'das par byas so/ /de ltar lha skyes kyi dgongs pa la bdag gis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed / yab bsod nams 'phel gyi rgyal srid ni gcung gis legs par —203—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzung nga / /da nga sems can gyi don du brtson par byed pa la bla ma cig dgos pas/ de ba ra na si'i drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags gseb na/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa thugs rje'i sprin zhes bya ba/ rgyal srid spangs nas ri dwags sman (rman3ma bzhin du nga rgyal bcag ste 'gro ba'i don las ma g.yos par bsam gtan la rtse gcig tu bzhugs nas yod pas/ de'i drung du de'i rjes su 'gro dgos snyam du dgongs nas yab la zhusapa/ mi dbang khyod kyi rgyal srid ni gcung gis 'dzin/ bdag brtson pa chung ngus chog pa 'di rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed/da nga sems can ma lus pa'i don byed pa la brtson par 'dod pas/ ba ra na si drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags gseb na/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa thugs rje'i sprin zhes bya ba/ bdag gi tshe rabasathams cad kyi yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas/ de'i drung du phyin te mthar thug gi btsan sa zhu ru 'gro'o/ /kye mi dbang chags pa ni 'khor ba'i 'ching thag che bas kho bo la ma chags par bdag 'gro ba'i skabs phye zhig yab kyis smras pa/ khyed 'khor dpag tu med pa'ang bzhag rgyal srid longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la ma chags par ri dwags sman (rmanakam lta bu'i spyod pa la slob tu 'gro ba bdag cag zur nas skyo mod kyi/ 'phags pa'i bka' bcag pa dka' bas bar gcod mi bya'o zhes bka' gnang ngo / /der rgyal bu lha skyes kyisa'aphags pa dgra bcom pa thugs rje'i sprin ga la ba der phyin pa dang / 'phagasapa thugasarje'i sprin gyisagazigasate/ dga' ba'i tshig sgrogasapa/ las dang nyon mongasazad pa yi/ khye'u gsal dag bden smra ba/ /rgyal srid 'ching ba du ma'i rgyu / / chags pa'i gnas la ma chags par/ /nags kyi khrod du 'ongs pa legs/ /da ni rtse gcig bsgrub (sgrub1pa gyis/ /'jig rten bde la snying po med/ /long med tshe ni myur du 'gro /nam mkha'i glog ltar gsal gyur kyang / /skyes tsam nyid nas 'jig tshul ston/ /blo gsal khye'u sprul pa'i sku/ khyed kyi tshe yang de dang mtshungs//snying po med la der ma 'dzin/ /da ni gtan gyi btsan sa'i dus/ /da lta nyid du bsgrub (sgrubaka par rigs/ /phyisa'abyung dag ni smon par zad/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal bus zhus pa ma rig mun pa'i rgya mtsho mā /gti mug mun pa'i chu bo dag /nyin mtshan rtag tu rgyug par byed/ /rang nyid 'thoms te meongs phung na/ /drin chen dag kyang de la dkris/ /ngan pa bdag ni nongs par gyur/ /drin lan gzhal bas mi 'khor ba'i/ /pha ma mang po bdag gi bslus/ /ngan pa bdag gisaphung bar 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi yon tan dag pa la/ /bdag gi skyon gyisade sun phyung / /log pas yang dag sun 'byin pa'i/ /ngan pa bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /phyin chad nongasapar mi 'gyur bar/ khyed kyi spyan sngar sdom par bgyi/ /bdag rgyud gdams pas tshim par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba —204—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /btab pa dang / /'phags pa thugs rje'i sprin gyi zhal nas/ thams cad rang nyid bstod byed na/ /sprul pa khyod ni rang la smod/ /rang mtshang brus pas lta ngan 'byin/ /thams cad gzhan la smod byed na/ /sprul pa khyod ni gzhan la bstod/ /rang gi yon tan de yis 'byin/ /e ma rgyal bu nga la nyon/ /nyin mtshan dus gsum rtag par ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs lta bar gyis/ /de mthong snying rje'i chu rgyun 'byung / /byams pa'i rlabs kyis gzhan don mdzod / / dga' ba'i rgya mtshor pha ma drongs/ /mnyam nyid bsil bar gzhan don mdzod/ /nyon mongs tshad pas gdungs pa dag /rab tu zhi byed bkra shis pa'i/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos la spyod/ /mi dbang sras po bdag gis gtam / / tshad mar bzung la nyams su longs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal bus kyang / sngar gyi yon tan la bla ma'i gdams pa zab mo bsnan pas/ sgron me la mar bzhin gong du 'phel bar gyur to/ /de'i dus su rgyal bus/'phags pa thugs rje'i sprin la zhus pa/ bdag bsam gtan gyi khang bur bsdad de/ sems can gyi don la rtse gcig tu gnas par zhu zhes gsol btab pas/ thugs rje'i sprin gyi zhal nas/ sngon la yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa longs shig ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal bus kyang / thugs rjes gzung du gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur ba'i tshul khrims byin/ mtshan yang lha'i dbang po'i mchog ces btags so/ /der bla ma'i zhal nas/ tshe rabs dpag tu med par khyod kyi mkhan po nga / slob dpon nga / bla ma nga / dge ba'i bshes gnyen nga yin no/ /da nang par khyod rab tu byung ba'i rjes su pha ma'i pho brang du bsod snyoms la deng ngo zhes gsungs nas/ nang par pha ma'i pho brang du bsod snyoms la phyin no/ /der rgyal bu rab tu byung ba/ dang ba 'dren pa yid du 'ong ba phun sum tshogs pa cig byung ba de/ yab yum gcung dang bcas pas mthong bas ya mtshan skyes so/ /der yab kyis smras pa/ e ma ya mtshan ltad mo che/ kha sang tha mal skye bo'i gzugs/ /de ring dgra bcom 'phags pa'i sku/ /lta bas mi ngoms 'phags pa'i sras/ /de ring gnas 'dir byon pas tshim/ /gang bzhed mchod pa sbyar bar bgyi/ /zhes gsol ba dang / /lha'i dbang po mchog gi zhal nas/ e ma yab yum 'phags pa dgongs su gsol/ /ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur ba na/ /mi dbang khyod ni shākya dbang phyug ces/ /'phags pa thugs rje'i sprin gyi sras su 'gyur/ /lha dbang nga dang mthun par spyod par byed/ /lha byin 'di yis bdag la mnyan byas pas/ /'di ru smon lam dag cing ma 'ongs tshe/ /a mes byang chub bla ma'i spyan sngar skye/ /bla ma'i thugs 'dzin nga yi sras su 'gyur/ /lha byin ma zhes ma ste skyon bral ma/ /'gar sgom zhes bya bkra shis dge bar 'gyur/ /sprang mo nges (des3 ma legs pa'i shes rab ces/ /bla ma'i sras mchog nga yi sems 'dzin 'gyur/ khyab 'jug dbang phyug gzhon nur gyur ba ngas/ /nges (desakama'i —205—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dbang gis ji ltar btul ba bzhin/ /g.yung drung zhes bya mkhas pa'i dregs pa can/ /nges (desaka ma'i dbang gis der kyang 'dul bar byed/ /dgra bcom 'phags pa thugs rje'i sprin zhes pa/ /ma 'ongs lha cig ces bya bdag gi mgon/ /bdag ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes byar grags/ /gangs ri'i khrod du 'di nyid gleng bar 'gyur / / bla ma'i dbang gis de sgrogs 'khrul na chags/ /zhes smras pa dang / yab yum bla ma gcung dang bcas pa thams cad sras la mngon par shes pa thogs pa med par mnga' bar rig nas/ thams cad ngo mtshar skyes so / / de gcig nas gnyis su brgyud de/ rgyal po khyab 'jug gi yang rna bar thos te/ bla ma yang sras kyis yab yum gyi pho brang du/ gdugs tshod gsol te nags khrod du byon pa dang / rgyal po khyab 'jug dpon g.yog mi mang ba zhig nags khrod du byung ste/ na bza' dang / 'tsho ba'i chas phul te zhabs la gtugs nas/ sngar nongs pa rnams yab sras gnyis kyi drung du mthol/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na kho bo g.yung drung gi ming can zhig tu skye zer ba thos / de'i dus su yang 'phags pa yab sras kyi chos la spyod cing / nongs pa mthol/ legs par zhabasathog par shog ces smon lam btab ste song ngo / /de'i dus su lha'i dbang po'i mchog gis/ bsam gtan lo sum cu rtsa lnga byas so/ /de'i dus su yang rang gi nyes pa la rgya mtsho dang ro bzhin du phyir 'phangs so/ /nag po khyab 'jug la sogs pa nyes pa can dag gi mtshang la nyes par ma bltas so/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ de'i dus kyi yab yum dang bla ma la sogs pa ni gong gi des go'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar/ bdag gi nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing / / gzhan gyi 'khrul ba btsal mi bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skye rabs bstan pa las/ rgyal bu lha skyes su ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste (skyes rabs ) bzhi pa'o// //ca5 kul bde ldan du rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangasasu sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilersā/ka 39 ba4 waṃdage ba'i bshes gnyen pa yul bde ldan du rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs su sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs so/ //༄༅/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab ces bya ba/ bod phrug cig la shes rab che ba/ gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu thugs la mnga' yang / dad pa'i rdo rjes nga rgyal gyi ri bo bcom nas/ rgyal ba yab sras la zhus pa/ sngar kyang snying gtam dpag tu med pa thugs la btags/ da dung yang rgyal ba yab sras zhus lan 'di na mar la/ bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrub (sgrubaka par bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis sngon rang gi —206—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yon tan ji lta bu dag sbas nas/ gzhan gyi yon tan ji ltar bsgrubs bla mas gsung du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ sngar bzhin du mgon po spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul cig ngas bshad kyis gsungs nas/ sngon rgya gar shar phyogs be ta'i yul zhes bya bar/ rgyal po dpal ldan zhes bya ba dang / btsun mo gsal /ka 40 na1 dpal /ldan zhes bya ba rab tu byung ba brgya phrag cam 'degs pa/ ma rabs rnams la thugs brtse zhing phan sems che ba cig byung ste/ de dag la bu mo gzugs bzang ba yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa/ dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yod pa/ 'khor 'bangs kun gyis kyang rab tu bkur ba / pha ma dag kyang shin tu thugs gtsigs che ba cig yod de/ mtshan yang kun tu bzang mo zhes grags/ de'i 'khor na bran mo gnyis yod pa'i rtog pa la spyir yang mir skyes pa dang / yang sgos su bu mo dang / de yang khang pa gcig na gnas par mnyam pa la/ bdag cag gnyis la 'di ltar mi brtsi zhing / bu mo 'di ni kun gyis bkur bar byed pa mi rigs so snyam ste/ rje mo la smras pa/ bdag cag dpon g.yog gsum 'bab chu chen po'i 'gram/ne'u gsing dang / rdzing bu yod pa dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sar gos zhabrud du 'deng gis/ khyed rje mo yin pas / gser gyi gzhong pa dang / bdag cag gnyis bran yin pas zangs kyi gzhong pa khyer bar byas te/ dga' ba'i sems kyis gdongs te 'gro'o/ /zhes smras pa dang / lha cig gis kyang de bzhin byas te/ 'bab chu chen po'i 'gram du phyin pa dang / bu mo gnyis na re/ kye lha cig gser gyi gzhong pa dang / zangs kyi gzhong pa gang dga' chu'i steng du bzhag ste/ blta bar bya'o/ / zhes zer ro/ /der lha cig gis smras pa/ kye bu mo gnyis/ yab rgyal po'i nor khyad par can 'di dag chus khyer zhing nub na/ spyir yang 'u cag skye dman mi'i gral nas med la/khyad par du yang bdag cag gsum la yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas sdang bar byed do/ /de bas na bdag cag gsum gos bkrus te/ dga' bar rtse zhing 'grogs te pho brang gi nang du yab yum dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i drung du 'gro ba legs so zhes smras pa dang / bu mo gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha cig khyed rje yin yang mi shes par bdag cag gnyis la smod par byed kyis/ gser gzhong dang zangs gzhong chus khyer na rin po che ga la yin zer nas/zangs gzhong chu 'khor ba zhig gi steng du bzhag pas/ zangs gzhong yang bas ma nub/ ma khyer bar rlung gis gdugs bskor ba ltar 'khyil zhing gda' bas/ bu mo gnyis na re/ lha cig khyed 'di la ltos shig ces zer ro/lha cig na gzhon pas bden snyam nas/ gser gzhong kyang bzhag pas chu'i nang du nub bo/ /der bu mo gnyis kyis smras pa/ lha cig 'di yab yum bzang po'i bu mor skyes pas rigs mtho zhing kun gyis bkur ba zad kyis bsod nams re chung / zangs gzhong kyang chus mi 'khyer mi nub 'di ltar gda' na/ rin po che'i nang nas kyang —207—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lhag pa gser gyi gzhong pa chu'i gting du nub bo/ /spyir yang bu mo gzhon nu thams cad kyang dman par byas/khyad par du yang rang re gsum brlag par byas kyis/ da phyir log nas 'gro ba rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa la ngo tsha ste/ rgyal po'i rgyal srid bu dang nor gyis 'dzin par byed la/ de'i nang nas kyang nor gser gyi gzhong pa zhes bya ba 'di rgyal po su la yang yod yod mi 'dra/ khyod kyis nor khyad par can chu'i gting du nub par byas so zhes zer nas ngo bzhin gnag ste 'dug pas/ der lha cig yang ma dga' ste/ a ce song la yab yum gyi drung du gser gyi gzhong pa de ni chur nub kho mos 'ong bar ma spobs kyis bdag yul gzhan du 'gro'am/ stong par pha ma'i drung du 'ong / lan gsal bar bstan du gsol zhes zhus zer nas/ bran mo che shos de btang ngo / /der bran mo des kyang rgyal po yab yum gyi drung du phyin nas/ kye rgyal po yab yum/ lha cig ma des gser gyi gzhong pa chu'i gting du bskyur te/ de'i gnong gis pho brang du 'deng byas kyang mi gsan par kho mo yul gzhan du 'gro / khyed gnyis kyang 'gro bar gyis shig ces zer ro/ /der bdag gisakhab tu zhuso zhesabagyisanasa'adir mchis pas/ rjes bdag la lon bskur du gsol/ rje'i zhal nas/ bdag gi bu mo gcig po de sems re chung /bdag la nor yod kyis bu med pas ma dga' na bu mo de yang / yul gzhan du 'gro'am/ kye bu mo slar log la/lha cig la sems mi bde ba mi 'tshal/ dge 'dun gyi drung du myur du shog ces 'phrin bskur ro/ /der bran mo des bzhon pa bzang po zhig la sga bsgron te zas zhin po dang bcas pa khyer nas 'ongs pa'i lam du/ mu stegs byed kyi sbyin bdag zhig dang phrad de/ kye sbyin bdag khyod ni phyi rol pa'i sbyin bdag yin gyis/ nga yang khyod la mos / dpal ldan 'di ni khyod la rtag tu brnyas par byed do/ /bdag gis kho la bu med kyi steng du/ bu mo yang yul gzhan du sprug par bya yis/ khyod kyis yul 'dir rgyal po'i bu mo lha cig bran mo gnyis dang bcas pa gser gyi gzhong pa med pas mtsho chen por mchongs te nub ces sgrogs shig ces bran mos smras pas/ des kyang de ltar bsgrags so/ de nas rje mo'i drung du bslebs pa dang / rje mo la smras pa/ yab yum na re/ klu'i rgyal po la'ang yod par dka' ba'i gser gyi gzhong pa de med par byas kyi/ bud med kyi rting la bu mos rgyal sa mi zin/nor brlag par byed/ de bas khyed rang bzhon pa 'di bzhon nas /ka 41 na5 zas/ 'di khyer la yul gzhan du song zhig ces zer ro zhes smras pa dang / rje mo'i bsams pa la/ sems can rnams ni sdug bsngal ba/nor thams cad ming dang mthun par/ khyad par du'ang bdag gi steng du bab ste yul gzhan du 'gro dgos par gda' na/ sngar yang lha dkon mchog gsum gyis thugs rjes bzung gis/ da yang yab yum dang bu nor longs spyod la sogs pa ci dang ci dgos pa'i dngos po thams cad khyed rang gis mdzad du gsol zhes bsams nas/—208—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sngon tshe'ang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje yis/ kho mo las 'bras bzang la bkod / / da yang thugs rjesagazung du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ bzhon pa de la 'jus te smon lam btab pa/ 'di bzhin tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshul khrims yob tu rkang bcug ste/ /dad pa'i rta la bzhon gyur nas / / brtson 'grus lcag gis 'brab par shog /smon lam srab kyi kha lo sgyur/ /rdzu 'phrul bzhi yis bskyod byas nas/ /thar ba'i lam la zhugs gyur te/ /byang chub gnas su phyin par shog /ces smras nas/ rta la bayion pa dang / bran mo gnyis na re/ rje mo khyed dang 'bral bar mi phod pas/ nged gnyis kyang 'gro bar 'tshal/ nged na rgan pa dang / lam rgyus cung zad yod pas rta'i kha lo bsgyur bar bya'o zhes zer nas/ bran mo gnyis pos lha cig gi mdun du bzhon te phyin pa'i tshe/ lho phyogs kyi shul ring por nyin mtshan drug bdun tsam 'das pa dang rgyal po yab yum dang bcas pa ma dga' ste/ lha cig bran dang bcas pa chu bo'i 'gram kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed la/ chu gting du 'das par go nas/ lha cig gi don du/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/'byung po'i gtor ma/ 'gro dman la sbyin gtong dang bcas pa zhag bzhi cu rtsa dgu'i bar du rgyun mi chad par dra/bsdo thag/ /der dkon mchog gi byin rlabs kyis/ dgung zhag bdun 'das pa'i nyi ma phyed yol tsam na/ rgyal po bde spyod ces bya ba lo nyi shu tsam lon pa/ dad pa che ba blon po bcu tsam gyis bskor ba btsun mo med pa cig bde ldan zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen po zhig gi dbus nas phyir 'ong ba dang phrad de/ rgyal pos bu mo gsum gang nas 'ong / gar 'gro zhes smras pas/ bran mo che ba na re/ nged byang phyogs bkra shis pa'i yul nas 'ongs/ bkra shis pa'i yul gzhan yang blta ba dang / rkyen cung zad cig la brten nas 'dir 'ongs so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po na re/ khyod kyi pha su yin/ bran mos smras pa/ rgyal po'o/ /rgyal po su yin/ re zhig mi ston no zhes smras/ der rgyal po bde spyod na re/ pha mi ston pa'i bu mo khyed la ci dgos/ grogs phun sum tshogs pa rgyal bu gzhon nu dgos so/ /der rgyal po na re/ de nyid kho bo yin te/ bu mo la yon tan ci yod/ bu mos smras pa/ bal 'dab sna gcig gis mi brgya'i gos ldang ba shes so/ /bu mo mdzangs pho tha ma nor gyis phyug bya ba yin yon tan tha mar 'dug dbus mas ci shes/ 'bras phul gang gis mi brgya'i zas ldang ba shes so zer/ rgyal po na re/ bu mo khyod kyang mdzangs/ yon tan gong ma ltar 'dug tha mas ci shes smras pas/ lha cig na re/ rje gsan du gsol/bdag gi sngon tshogs gnyis ma bsags/ 'dir 'bras bu ma thob/ thabs la mi mkhas/ shes rab dman/ pha ma dang bral/ yul g.yin du 'chug yon tan de 'dra'o zhes smras pas/ rgyal po na re/ khyod gzugs mdzes shing —209—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/na gzhon pa cig kyang 'dug pa la/ smre sngags kyi rgyan mkhas/ chos rgyal zhig gi bu mo yin par nges khyod la yon tan gang yod cig bstan dgos/ der lha cig na re/ sngon tshe bsod nams ma bsags pas/ /deng sang longs spyod dag dang bral/ sngon tshe byams pa ma bsgoms pas/ /nye ba'i gnyen dang bral bar gyur/ /ye shesamig med mun par 'thoms/ /bdag gi yon tan bshad par dka'/ /zhes smras so/ /der rgyal po na re/ khyed tha mal ba ma yin par nges/ khyod la 'khang tshig cig kyang 'dug pas/ rkyen ci byung nga la smrosabyasapas/ bu mo na re/ rje bdag la gson dang / yon tan med pas 'dir 'ongs/ rkyen yang ngas byas so/ /rgyal po na re/ bu mo'i tshig sbram / nges par yon tan cig yod nges/ bstan du gsol/ zhesasmrasapa dang / bu mo'i bsamasapa la nga la yon tan gzhan ni med/ nor rnams kyi mchog dad pa'i nor yin/ lha rnams kyi mchog dkon mchog gsum yin/chos rnamasakyi mchog gzhan don yin pas/ rgyal po 'di bdag la chags 'dug pas/ 'di'i zhabasatog /ka42 na7 rgolegs par /bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan la brtsams nasasmra dgosasnyam nas/kye rgyal po gsan du gsol/ nga la mgon skyabasadakon mchog yod/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis byin rlabs kyis / / bdag gi 'dod pa bsgrub (sgrubakapar byed/ /zas gos dag kyang de yis stsol/ /sangs rgyasadag la skyabs 'gro bas/ /ro stod gser las byas pa yi/ /gzhon nu bdag la skye bar 'gyur/ /bdag ni chos la skyabs 'gro bas/ /rked pa dung las byas pa yi/ /gzhon nu bdag la skye bar 'gyur/ /dge 'dun dag la skyabs 'gro bas/ /ro smad g.yu las byas pa yi/ /gzhon nu bdag la skye bar 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bas/ /dung so bzhi bcu (cuka tshang ba yi/ /bzhin bzang gzhon nu skye bar 'gyur/ /zhesasmras so/ /der rgyal po mgu ste smras pa/ kye bu mo/ pho rab dag ni chos kyi phyug /pho 'bring dag ni bu yis phyug /tha ma dag ni nor gyis phyug khyod kyi yon tan che bar gda'/ khyod la bdag gi btsun mo bya/ /dkon mchog gsum yang mchod par 'gyur/ /pho rab yon tan de na gda'/ khyod la mtshan ldan bu mchog skye/ /'bring gi yon tan de na gda'/ /nor zas dag kyang 'du bar nges/ /tha ma'i yon tan de na gda'/ /zhes zer nas bu mo gsum po nang du khrid de/der yang bran mo gnyis la bran mo dang / lha cig la ni btsun mo byas so/ /der bran mo gnyis kyisam theg kyang /re zhig gnod pa bya bar yang ma nus/ legs pa'i shes rab de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di ni/ri bo po ta la na thugs rje chen pos dus drug tu 'gro ba dad pa can dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / 'dren pa'i lung yod pa dag gang na yod kyang de la gzigs par mdzad do/ /der bu mo de dad pa dang ldan/ pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod pa dang / sngar yang ma mang du mdzad pa dang / da dung yang —210—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sems can gyi don du skye ba len pa la yum de bzang bar gzigs nas grong khyer bde ldan der lha cig de'i lhums su zhugs so/ /der zla ba dgu song ba dang / bu btsa' pa'i dus la bab par bran mo gnyis kyis shes te/rgyal po la zhus pa/ rje btsun mo la sras 'khrungs bar gda' bas/ ma ma bzang mo btsal ran gda'o zer bas/rgyal pos kyang bran gyi ngag la mnyan te/ ma ma 'tshol du phyin pa'i shul du/ btsun mo la bu ro stod gser/ rked pa dung / ro smad g.yu la byas pa/ so dung so 'khor ma 'dra ba yod pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba cig skyes so/ /der bran mo gnyis kyis/ btsun mo la myos chu blud de/ mchan nas bu bton nas/ them pa'i 'og tu sbas te/ de'i shul du khyi gu'i ro cig btsud do/ /de nas rgyal pos ma ma bzhi khrid nas btsun mo'i drung du phyin te/ khyed la bu skyes sam zhes dris pas lan ma byung / bltas pa dang btsun mo myos pa'i 'dab na khyi gu'i ro zhig 'dug pa mthong ste / bran mo gnyis la btsun mo 'di la bu skyes yod par 'dug pas gang na yod dris pas/ btsun mo khas blangs can de'i bu khyi gu de yin no zhes zer ro/ /der rgyal po yid ma ches nas btsal bas kyang ma rnyed/ nang par btsun mo myorngage pa sangs te langs pa la dris pas bshad rgyu ma byung ste/ rgyal po bslus par go nas bran gnyis la btsun mo byas so/ /der rgyal po bu des yab kyi drung du mngon sum du 'thon na'ang 'thon du yod mod kyis/ ma 'ongs pa na dkon pa bstan pa'i phyir/ rgyal po byon gshegs nam byed pa'i na bza' nas 'then pas/ rgyal po na re/ ma them 'di sngar dang mi 'dra bar gos gsham 'thog pa cig byung / 'di 'chos dgos byas pa dang / bcun mo gnyis na re/ rgyal po bya ba ngan pa la 'jug pa ga la rung bdag cag gis bgyi yis zer nas/ bu ya them la sbas pas/ yang rgyal po'i dbu skra nas 'then pas yang sngar bzhin gsungs/ yang rgyal po'i cog tshe'i 'og tu sbas pas sngar bzhin gleng / rta bres su sbas pas/ bus rta skrogs/ der rgyal po na re/ ma them bcos pas ya them la 'phos / de bcos pas cog tse la 'phos/ de bcos pas rta bres la 'phos/ da lan nga rang gis rta bres 'chos dgos gsungs pas/ btsun mo gnyis ma nyan par bu bton nas rgyal po'i skyed mos tshal du sbas pas ljang bu rtse mo ser po/ rked pa dkar po/ rtsa ba sngon po yod pa zhig skyes pas/ de rgyal po'i lug rdzi zhig gis mthong nas/rgyal po la smras pas/ gzigs su byon pa'i tshe lug gis ljang bu zos pas mi snang ngo/ /der rgyal po thugs ma ches te/ phyogs kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed/ sa gzhi kun rlog kyang ma byung bar thugs kyis dgongs pa la bu rang mtshan pa ma yin pa/ mchod rten lta bu'am/ mo rang zer ba bzhin skyes nas/ sprul ba bstan pa zhig yin nam snyam nas/ slar log ste btsun mo la de bzhin dris pas/ btsun mo na re/ mngon sum du ma gyur ba'i tshig —211 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rdzun du 'gyur/ bdag gis mchod rten dang khyi gu skye ma zhus/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis sngar zhus pa bzhin du skyes so smras pas/ 'o na gar song gsung bas/ de ni kho mos ma 'tshal zhes zer bas/ 'o na khyod kyis rdzun smras sam/ de yang ma smras so zhes zer/ der rgyal po yid ma ches te/ 'di la ltas shig da gzod 'ong bar ngeos snyam nas btang snyoms su bzhugs pa las/ btsun mo gnyis po des kyang sngar khas blangs pa bzhin ma byung nga / /der rgyal po'i lug gcig la btsun mo zer ba bzhin lta bu'i lu gu zhig skyes pas/ rdzi bo'i bsams pa la/'di rgyal po la ni bstan du phangs/ nged rang la ni 'di 'jog pa'i gnas med snyam du dpyod pa'i tshe/ lug gu na re / khyed de ltar rnam rtog ma mang bar nged rang 'dir zhog la song / 'di lta bu 'dug gi gtam yang ma smra bar song shog zer te/ rdzi bos kyang de bzhin byas te 'ongs pas/ lug gu na re/ khyod 'dir nyol da pho brang zhig bzhengs pas 'di la 'gro ba rigs mi mthun pa mang po 'ongs pas/ khyed kyis mthong na tshe'i bar chad du 'gro bas ngas ji srid ma bslang gi bar du sgra la sogs pa mtshan ltas ci byung yang ma ldang zhig zer te/ sgra la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma byung yang de ma langs so/ /des nas re zhig nas lug gu na re/ langs la ltos shig zer te bltas pas/ pho brang nyams dga' ba/ ngos re la gzhu 'dom brgya brgya yod pa/ 'phangs su'ang de tsam yod pa/sa phyogs thams cad na rtse shing dang / nags tshal dang / chu mig dang / rdzing bu dang / zhing la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad mang po yod pa/ rta dang / glang po dang / nor bu la sogs pa dgos pa thams cad tshang ba/ de'i nang na rin po che'i khri dang / 'bru'i phung po la sogs pa nang gi rdzas kyang phun sum tshogs pa yod pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs par mthong nas/ lug gu de la/ glo bur du 'di lta bu 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang yin dris pas chos thams cad mi bden pa/ sgyu ma sprul ba'i grong khyer yin mod/ der rdzi bo na re/ mi bden pa la 'di tsam 'byung ba ci yin/ de na re/ khyed la rmi lam 'ong myong ngam/ bdag gis sna tshogs pa rmis so zhes smras pas/ de dag la bden pa 'dug gam/ mi gda'o/ /de dang chos thams cad mtshungs so/ /der rdzi bo na re/ kho bo yang rdzi bo'i 'phro bshol te/ sprul pa dang sgyu ma lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /der lu gu na re/ lug rdzi lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni/ sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas te chos byed pa lags/ khyod kyis kyang lug 'di dag yal bar mi 'dor bar snying rje chen po bskyed/byams par mdzod/ skyid na dga' ba bstan nye ring med par phan par gyis shig 'di dag gis khyod kyi pha ma ma byas pa cig kyang med do/ /der rdzi bo na re/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang / /tshad med bzhi yi skya bar nas/ /lug —212—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sogs pha ma mang po'i don/ /rgyun chad med par bstan par bya/ /zhes zer ro/ /lug gu na re/ lug dang bcas pa rgyal po'i khab tu song la/ sang 'dir shog snang tshul tsho yang rgyal po la ma bsnyad zer te/ ji skad zer ba bzhin du byas nas 'ongs pa'i tshe/ lug gu na re/ khyed rang de ring ma rnams skyongs/ ngas rgyal po'i khab tu 'gro yi zer nas/ sprang chas su rgyal po'i khab tu phyin te/ pho brang gi sgo brdungs pa dang / rgyal pos yang thogs nasamathong ste/ sgo drung du babs nas khyod gang nas 'ongs/ pha su yin dris pas/ gnyis ka thag nye/ gtam lo rgyus ni phrag dog mang zer/ der rgyal po na re/ skyon mi 'ong gis shod ces nan cher byas pas/ byis pa na re/gtam rgyud du bshad dam/ gleng mor bshad zer bas/ gtam rgyud ces rang shod gsungs pas/ der rgyal po dpal ldan gyi khab nas ma 'ongs tshul la sogs pa sngar ji ltar byung ba'i bar du bsnyad pas/ bran mo gnyis na re/ byis pa ngan pa ngag dam du sdoms/ sgro btags kyi gtam ma zlo/ de 'dra su las thos/ zhes rgal bas/byis pa na re/ sems can dag ni nyon mongs mang / /gzhan gyi bde ba mi bzod par/ /rje mo dag kyang dmangasasu 'bebs/ /drin lan log par gzhal ba yis/ /zhing la sa bon btab pa bzhin/ /sdug bsngal rang gis rtag tu myong / /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po ngo mtshar te byis pa gzhon nu ma las rgyu 'bras las brtsams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa smra ba/ kun tu bzang mos khas blangs pa'i bu de khyod yin nam/ /skyed mos tshal gyi ljang bu de khyod kyi sprul ba yin nam/ pho brang chen po'i nang du shog ces smras pa dang / byis pa na re/ rje rgyal bdag gis sgo drung nas / / thos khungs cung zad bshad pa la'ang / /btsun mos bzod par mi nus na/ /nang du 'ongs na myos par 'gyur / / zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur te/ rang gis sprul pa'i pho brang du slebs pa dang / rdzi bo de la/ khyod rang 'dod yon gang dga' ba'i zas zo la ma rnams ded la rgyal po'i khab tu song / rgyal pos gtam 'dri ste kha rog 'dug la sang yang 'dir shog ces smras nas/ rdzi bos kyang de ltar bgyis so/ /de nas gzhon nus rdzi bo la smras pa/ de ring rgyal po'i khab tu song la/ btsun mo gnyis blon po dang bcas pas rgyal po la bskor te/ de ring 'dir gdugs tshod la byon par zhu/ sngar med pa'i pho brang chen po bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i yul rig pa chags pa zhig gda'/ de na rgyal bu gzhon nu rgyal po'i mtshan tshang ba cig bzhugs te/ de nyid rgyal po btsun mo blon 'bangs dang bcas pa mchod par 'dod pas/ ci nas kyang de ring 'byon par zhu zhes sgron la spyan drong la shog zer te/ des kyang de bzhin du byas nas spyan drangs nas 'ongs pa la/ gathon nus rang dang mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad de/ rgyal po la gsol ba/ kye rgyal po chen po/ sems can nyon mongs las kyis bsgribs/ /rang gi bu yang mi shes na/ /phyi ma'i bde skyid ji ltar rig /dper na kun tu bzang mo —213—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzhin / / bdud kyi rigs ni bar chad mang/ /dam pa'i chos ni rnyed par dka'/ /mthun pa'i grogs ni nyin skar 'dra / / dper na kun tu bzang mo bzhin/ /gang la brtag dpyad mi gtong ba'i/ /bya ba gang de las ro yin/ /gnas lugs don ni ma go bar/ /tha snyad tshig gi rjes su 'brang / /skyes bu de ni glen pa yin/ /dper na kun tu bzang mo bzhin/ /kye rgyal po chen po/ kun tu bzang mo zhes bya ba 'di/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan gyi lha cig ma/khrims ldan brgya'i sbyin bdag ma/ 'bangs 'khor 'bum gyis bstod yul yin la/ 'di grogs ngan gyis bslus pa'i rjes su/ khyod rgyal po'ang 'brang ngam zer bas/ rgyal po na re/ kun tu bzang mo'i sras/ ro stod gser/rked pa dung / ro smad g.yu las byas pa/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa rgyal po'i mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de lta bu zhig dkon mchog gi mthu la brten nas skye zhes zer na/ de khyod yin nam zhes smras pas/ der rgyal bus/ sku stod gser btso ma lta bu/ rked pa dngul dkar phyis pa lta bu/ sku smad g.yu mdog 'dra ba de bstan nas / zhal 'dzum mdzad pas tshems dung ltar dkar ba bzhi bcu (cukatshang ba sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang 'dra ba de yang bstan te/ rgyal po chen po/ kun tu bzang mo'i mgon skyabs sangs rgyas yin/ /sangs rgyas sku mdog ci 'dra 'di 'dra ba/ /kun tu bzang mo'i mgon skyabs dam chos yin/ /dkar bo'i chos kyi sku mdog ci 'dra ba/ /bdag gi rked pa'i mdog kyang de 'dra'o/ /kun tu bzang mo'i mgon skyabs dge 'dun yin/ /sgo gsum nyes pas ma gos dag pa yi/ /lus kyi smad ni g.yu yi mdog tu gda'/ /rgyal po dkon mchog gsum gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /dad ldan kun tu bzang mo bzhin bzang ma/ /sras kyi snying po kho bo dkon mchog 'bangs/ /mi dbang khyod kyi sras kyang kho bo yin/ /e ma dpyad nas the tshom mi dpyod par/ khyod kyi sras su ma bzung yal bar bor /ka 45 ba2 dor/ / /zhes tshigs su bcad de smras pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bdag 'dra byis pa'i blo gros can rnams kyis/ /gting dpag dka' ba'i gnas rnams ga la rtogs/ /nyi ma nyin cig grong khyer chen po'i dbus/ /phyogs bcur bgrod pa skyes bu du ma'i lam/ /kun tu sa yangs gang yang mthong ba'i sar/ /rgyang nas bzhon pa cig la bu mo gsum/ kho bo'i thad du 'ong ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /bu mo gar 'gro su yi bu mo yin/ /bu mo gsum gyis bdag la 'di skad sgrogs/ /bdag cag bkra shis brgyan pa'i yul nas 'ongs/ /da yang bkra shis brgyan pa'i yul du 'gro/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu dag kyang don gnyer zer/ /de nyid bdag yin khyed la yon tan ci/ /bu mo gcig gis bdag la 'di skad bshad/ /bal 'dab gcig gis mi brgya'i gos ldang ba'i/ /mdzangs ma yod ces khas len chen po bgyis/ /'bras phul gang gi mi brgya'i zas ldang ba'i/ khas len chen po'ang gcig gis bshad par 'gyur/ /gcig gis skyon sgrogs yon tan sba bar byas/ /slar yang de la bdag —214—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu ches bzhugs so/ /gis du mar dris/ /tha mar bdag gi mgon skyabs dkon mchog yin/ /de yis bdag gi 'dod kun sgrub bo zhes / / bdag la snyan pa'i tshig gis smra bar byas/ /de la yid ches bdag gi bcun mor gsol/ /gnyis ni bran gyi dbang du 'khol bar byas/ /zla dgu lon nas mo la bu skye zhes/ kho bos ma ma 'tshol du phyin shul du/ /sngar gyi bu med khyi gu'i ro zhig gda'/ kho bo the tshom zos te bran la dris/ /btsun mos khas blangs bu ni khyi gu nyid / / e ma bdag gis rgyal bu ma mthong ba/ khyod kyis gar bsdad them pa cog tse dang / /rta bres la sogs sa phyogs sngar las 'gyur/ /the tshom zos te 'chos par bsgrags pa las/ /bcun mo ma nyan bdag gi bya ba bshol / / phyi nas skyed mos tshal du myu gu mchog /yum gyi tshig bzhin skyes pa kho bos thos/ /de mthong bdag gi yid dbang tshim gyur snyam/ /der ni sa phyogs kun tu btsal na yang / /ma rnyed the tshom zos te slar la log /bcun mo'i khab tu phyin te dris pa las/ /bstan rgyu ma byung bdag gis snyoms par bsdad/ /deng sang khyed rnyed bdag la dga' ba'i mchog /stor ba rnyed pas shin tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes sngar gyi byung tshul rnams tshigs su bcad de bu'i rna bar btang ba dang / btsun mo gnyis shin tu zhum par gyur te smra ma nus so/ /de'i dus na sprul pa'i byang chub sem/sa dpa' des/ bran mo gnyis po des sngar yang ma dag pa'i spyod pa mang po byung bar dgongs/da yang rang rgyud la sdig pa mang po bsags nas ngan 'gror 'gro ba mkhyen te/ de nyid du tshe la bar du bcad de/rnam par shes pa po ta lar 'phangs so/ /de nas yab la zhus pa/ khyod kyi bcun mo gang na yod/ rgya mtshor rtas khyer te gum mo/ /da khyod kyi bcun mo su yin/ khyod kyi ma'o/ /kye rgyal po/ ma zhes bya ba ni drin che/ nga rang gi mchod gnas bya'o// khyod rang gi btsun mo gzhan nas 'tshol zhig /bdag gi ma ni khyod kyi bcun mo bya bar yang mi rung bran du yang mi rung ngo/ /der rgyal po nongs te/ kha rog 'dug pa dang / rgyal bus smras pa/ rgyal po chen po thugs ma mnyes sam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ kho bo ni mi shes pa'i dbang gis nyams ma dga'o/ /der rgyal bu na re / kun tu bzang mo dang lhan cig gnas par 'dod na/ /'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid tshe ma 'das kyi bar du/dkon mchog la mchod pa rgyun ma chad par gyis/ dad pa'i rta dang brtson 'grus kyi lcag dang / smon lam gyi srab dang ma bral bar gyis/ gar 'gro ba'i lam ma nor bar gyis/ de ltar khas len nus na ni khyod la pha bya/ bdag gis bu bya/ kun tu bzang mos ma byas/ yab yum sras dang bcas pa pho brang nas pho brang du 'gro zhing sems rtse gcig tu byang chub don du gnyer bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /der rgyal po na re/ sngar yang ma rtogs pa dang / log rtog dang / the tshom gyi dbang gis gang byas log par song ste ngo gnong ngo / /da yang sras kyi gsung gcog gam/ khyed ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin thar ba don du —215—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gnyer zhing / lo ka 'di'i 'dun ma yang / yab yum sras dang bcas pa sems bstun te ma nor bar bya yis/yum sras gnyis kyis kyang de ltar thugs kyis dgongs shig sngar gyi nongs pa dag kyang mthol gyis gsan du gsol / kho bo ma rig mun pas bsgribs/ /de phyir khyod la nongs par gyur/ khyod kyis nongs par mi 'dzin par / / ma dag las rnams mthol zhing 'chags/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bu'i bsams pa la/ yab 'di shin tu nongs nas bdag cag gnyis la bshags par byed na/ de'i rkyen gyis lam mchog la sbyar bar bya'o snyam nas yab la/ mi dbang bsam pa dag pa yis/ /nyes pa dag la 'gyod byas nas/ /bdag la mthol zhes deng sang thos / / de phyir bdag gis khyod nyid drang / /zhes gsungs nas/ kye mi dbang lus ma dag pa dang / ngag ma dag pa dang / yid ma dag pa ste/ sgo gsum ma dag pa na ngan 'gror skyur bar byed la/ de dkon mchog yid la byas nas bshags na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa la brten nas/ nyes pa'i phung po chen po yang 'dag da yang dag pa'i lam la phyin par 'gyur bas/ dkon mchog gsum dpang du bzhag nas/ khyod nyid drang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas 'di skad du/ las 'bras bslu ba med pa dang / /chos nyid rang bzhin dag pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yis/ /mi dbang kun du dge bar shog /ces smon lam btab pas/ yab kyi thugs la bdag gi bu 'di ni sprul ba yin gyi/ bdag thugs rjes gzung ba dang / sems can gzhan yang drang ba'i phyir/kun tu bzang mo'i lhums su zhugs te btsa' bar 'dod na/ bdag nyon mongs pas sgrib pas mthong bar ma gyur te / yum la'ang brnyas par byas/ de ni phyogs dang phyogasamatshams nas rigs bzang zhing mdzangs dang ldan pa'i bu mo dag btsal te rgyal bu la dbul bar bya'o/ /des rgyal bu mang po'ang spel te yul 'di yang bkra shis shing longs spyod dag kyang rgyas/ dkon mchog gi pho brang dag kyang bzhengs/ dad pa can mang po'ang 'du ste/ de la brten nas skye bo mang po skyob par nus pa cig 'ong bar 'dug snyam nas bu la 'di skad du/ rnyed dka' rnyed pa'i nor bu mchog khyod ni sprul pa'i rgyal bu ste/ /bdag la brtse phyir sras su bstan/ /'gro ba gzhan yang drang ba'i phyir/ /kun bzang lhums su zhugs par mdzad/ kho bo'i mig 'bras sprin gyis g.yogs/ /rgyal bu khyod nyid ma mthong bas/ /kun tu bzang la brnyas par byas/ /da gzod mig 'bras dag pa dang / /yul phyogs dag kyang bkra shis shing / /dad ldan dag kyang gnas 'dir 'du/ /dkon mchog pho brang dam par bya/ /de bas phyogs nas rigs bzang zhing / /mdzangs ldan rje yis legasabakur ba'i/ /bu mo dam pa btsal byas te/ /rgyal po'i khab tu bzhengs par zhu/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ khyim ni btson khang dag dang mtshungs/ /nor ni 'ching ba'i lcags dang 'dra/ /grogs ni bdud kyi bu mo ste/ /thar ba'i srog dang 'bral bar byed/ /kye rgyal po kho bo —216—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /btson khang nang du 'jug gam/ nyon mongs drag po'i lcags kyis 'ching ngam/ rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus chud gson par byed dam/ rgyal pos smras pa/ rgyal bu khyod ni sprul ba ste/ /gang du bsdad kyang gzhal yas khang /su dang 'grogs kyang lha nyid de/ /'ching ba'i lcags su su yis 'jug /ces zer bas/ rgyal bu shin tu dga' nas yang smras pa/ khyod la mtshungs pa med pa yi/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje mchog /dge legs bsam pa bzang po ste/ /da gzod zhugs par kho bos 'tshal/ /yang rgyal po na re/ rgya 7 bu khyod nyid dkon mchog ste/ /sku yi stod ni rgyal bar gda'/ /rdo rje'i rked pa chos su gda'/ /sku yi smad ni dge 'dun mchog /yang rgyal bus smras pa/ khyod la dag pa'i snang bar shar/ kho bo dkon mchog gsum du mthong / /bden par mi 'dzin sprul par shes / / 'gro ba kun la phan par 'dod/ /ces de ltar yab sras gnyis kyi gsung gleng byas pas/ yum lha cig kyang shin tu mnyes te/ 'di skad du/ de ring ya mtshan chos sgra thos/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs mthong chos dang mjal / / sems la dga' ba'i snang ba rgyas/ /'gro la phan par kho mos 'tshal/ /der rgyal bus smras pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyis rjes su bzung ba yi/ kho bo'i skyed yum lha mo mchog /bdud mo gnyis kyis 'dir 'phangs pas / / rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes su shar/ /nga ni thar ba'i lam la 'gro/ /dga' ba rgyas pa khyod nyid bden/ /zhes smra ya ba yum sras dang bcas pas/ chos kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po gleng ba'i dus su/ bdag gi bla ma nā ga dzu na zhes bya ba dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas kyang / sprul ba sna tshogs pas byang chub sems dpa'i cha lugs bzung nas/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par byed pa de/ de'i dus na rgyal po dpal ldan zhes bya ba de rab tu byung ba dgra bcom pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad de/ mchod gnas brgya phrag tsam 'degs shing yod pa'i dbus na/ khong yang 'phags pa nyi ma'i 'od ces pa khyad par du 'phags pa de na bzhugs nas mngon par shes pa chags thogs mi mnga' ba thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad la dus drug tu gzigs shing yod pas de'i tshe yab yum gsum chos kyi bgro ba mdzad cing 'dug pa de dag gsan cing gzigs nas khong rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' mi mtho mi dma' ba la bzhugs nas kun tu dge ba'i gsung byon pa/ kye yab yum sras dang bcas pa dag 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa/ khams gsum pa thams cad stong pa/ srid par lhung ba thams cad sdug bsngal ba/chosathams cad ni bdag med par gsungs pa/ khyad par du khyim na gnas pa ni btson dong dang 'dra/ nor rdzas ni 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog yin/ grogs ngan bdud kyi bu mo ste/ thar ba'i srog dang 'bral bar byed pas phyogs 'di na rgyal bu la grogs med kyis kho u rgyan gyi yul du thong zhig gsung ngo / /rgyal bus de gsan nas slar zhus —217—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa ༈/ 'phags pas ji ltar gsungs pa dag dang mthun no/ /bdag gis kyang yul 'di na nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres pa'i bu mo ma mthong / pha ma ni 'jig rten dang mthun par 'di na rigs bzang ba'i bu mo zhig kho bo la bsu bar 'dod na/ rigs bzang mas kho bo bslu srid/ nor rdzas kyis bdud g.yabs pa srid pas/ rgyal po'i pho brang btson khang dang 'dra ba 'dir bdag cag bag mi phebs pas/ da gsung ba bzhin u rgyan du 'gro bar zhu bas de na bdag dang mthun pa'i grogs yod pas gzigs sam/ zhes tshigs su bcad de brjod pa/ las 'bras ma mthong pha ma dag /rigs bzang rlom pa nga rgyal can/ /nyon mongs byis pa'i gzugs mdzes ma thar ba bslu ba'i shan ma de/ /bdag gi grogs su bsu'o skad/ /deng sang dus la bab bo zhes/ /rgyal srid me dong 'dra ba 'dir/ /don yod mi lus bsreg go zhes/ /pha ma'i phan sems byur du langs/ /nges par u rgyan yul du 'gro / / zhes gsol ba dang / 'phags pa nyi ma'i 'od kyi zhal nas/ gzhon nu bzhin mdzesamakhyen pa can/ /rgyal srid nyon mongs 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /shes par mdzod la bag yod spyod/ /gnad du bsnun pa'i gdams pa yin / / zhes gsung ngo / /yang rgyal bus smras pa/ ji ltar mkha' la nyi phor bas/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa rnam bsal bzhin/ /'phags pa khyed ni kho bo'i thad/ /shin tu dag pa'i nam ma/ba' la/ /mi mtho mi dma' gsal bar byon/ /bdag gi yid kyi mun pa bsal/ /zhes smras pa dang / 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ bdag ni nyi ma'i 'od zer yin/ /'jig rten ma lus gsal bar byas/ /dad pa'i sa gzhi drod sgye da de/ khyed kyi bde 'bras smin par bgyi / / zhes gsung ngo / /yang rgyal bu na re/ mig can bdag gi lam sna mdzod/ khul ring lam ni bgrod par dka' / /u rgyan de yang mkha' 'gro'i yul/ /byis pa dag gis spyad par dka'/ /bdag gis grogs kyang mi shes pas/ /nges par khyed kyis skyab tu gsol/ /zhes zhus pa dang / 'phags/ pa'i zhal nas/ khyed ni skal ldan bzod stobs can/ /sras kyi thu bo tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /thabs kyi dbang gis sangs mi rgya/ khul ring skad cig nyid la bgrod/ /gsang ba ye shes bya ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /de ni khyod kyi grogs yin pas/ /gnas 'dir nyon mongs 'dul du drongs/ /rdo rje'i brag ces brtan pa'i ngos/ /gser g.yu brdal ba rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /lhun po brtsegs pa nags kyi 'dab/ /mkha' 'gro dpag med 'du ba'i sa/ /dam pasabyin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /dpal gyi pho brang bya ba yod/ /de na sprul pa khyod kyi rje/ /thogs med dus nas rjes bzung ba/ /dri ma med par grags pa yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu bzhugs/ /ci bsams 'dun ma 'grub gyur zhing / /lam gyi bar chad zhi bar gsol/ /dbang bzhi'i chos kyang de ru zhus/ /nges par don rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /rgyal po yab kyi dgongs pa la/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ bu 'di u rgyan du —218—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'gro ba'i lung ston cing gda' ste/ bu zer ba bzhin du shul ring gi lam ni bgrod par dka'/ u rgyan de yang sha za dang mkha' 'gro'i yul yin/ bu'i tshe srog la bar chad byung na mi rung bas 'phags pa la zhuso snyam nas mig nam mkha' la bltas pa dang / 'phags pa mi snang nas/ sras la zhus pa/ da ci nas/ mkha' la dbyangs kyi tshigs su bcad pa sgrogs pa de gar thal/ sras kyi zhal nas/ gzod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i 'phags pa la/ /gshegs dang bzhugs pa ga la mnga'/ /pha ma mig 'phrul ma 'dri zhig /der pha mas kyang sprul par shes nas/ bu dang 'phags pa la dad gus thun mong ma yin pa skyes so/ /de bus shes te/ pha ma la smras pa / don chen rnyed do yab yum gnyis/ /'phags pa'i zhal mthong gsung rab thos/ /bden stong sprul pa'i chos kyang thos/ /dad pa'i lo 'dab rgyas par gyur/ /zhe gsungs so/ /der ma na re/ sngar skyes pa nas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / sprul ba'i pho brang chen po bzhengs pa dang / bdud mo gnyis kyi dpung bcom pa dang / pha ma gnyis la'ang las kyi chos ston pa dang / sras nyid la'ang nam mkha' la 'phags pa byon nas chos gsung zhing gda' bas/sras kyi zhor la bdag cag gnyis kyis kyang 'phags pa'i zhal mthong / gsung thos dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyesaso/ /zhes smras pas/ der sras kyi zhal nas/ sa bcu'i nang nas dad pa'i sa/ zhes bya ba dang po yin/ de khyed gnyis kyi rgyud la 'khrungs/ dad pa brtan pa 'di las ma g.yos par bdag med pa'i don la sbyar dgos pas sgo gsum nyon mongs pa'i dbang du ma btang / bzod stobs skyed nyin dang mtshan du brtson 'grus chen po'i go gyon/ sems rtse gcig tu sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa las ma g.yos par mdzod/ spyir yang chos thams cad bden pa med pa yin/ khyad par du yang nga la bden pa ci yang med pas bu yin zhes chags par ma byed/ u rgyan gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma spyan 'dren du 'gro ba la bar gcod ma byed par skabs phye zhig ces gsungs pa ni/ dad pa'i sa chen brtan pa la/ /sbyor ba'i me rab 'bar ba yis/ /nyon mongs bud shing sreg par byed / / de bas tshogs dang sbyor la brtson/ /tshul khrims yon tan kun gzhi la/ /bzod stobs dpa' bo go cha gyon / / mi g.yo g.yeng ba med pa'i mchog /chags med shes rab mtshon ldan pa/ /thabs kyi theg dman zhi bar mdzod / / e ma 'di nyon pha ma gnyis/ /nga ni u rgyan gnas su 'gro/ /nga la bden pa ci yang med/ /bu ru zhen pa ma che bar/ /bar chod ma byed 'gro skabs phye/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / pha ma'i zhal nas/ spyir yang chos rnams bden pa med/ khyad par bu nyid sprul ba ste/ /bden med bzhin du bur zhen na'ang / khyed kyi bka' lung bcag par dka'/ /nges par u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi bgrod byed na'ang / /rgyal po dpal ldan zhes bya ba / /byang na khyed kyi mes po yod/ /bu mo med pa'i mya ngan pa'i/ /dbugs 'byin snyan pa'i gtam —219—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/skyel zhing / /brgya phrag 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /phyag skyol 'gro bar gnang ba zhus/ /e ma bdag gi yab chen de/ /sras mthong bzhin du dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sras kyi zhal nas/ drin can pha mas gnang ba byin/ /bka' lung mi bcag byang du 'gro/ /'phags pa'i zhal lta med la'ang mjal/ /mchod pa byed cing gtam snyan sgrogs/ /sprul ba'i rgyal po nga mthong tshe/ /mes dga' bdag kyang gnang ba zhu/ /zhesazhal gyis bzhes pa dang / /pha ma gnyis u rgyan du mi 'gro ba tsam du dga' nas/ yab bde spyod kyi pho brang du spyan drangs nas/ yum kun tu bzang mos/ yab la 'phrin yig phul ba/ dkon mchog 'bangs zhes sprul ba'i bu/ /byang phyogs gnas na be ta'i yul/ /pho brang nyams dga' zhes bya ba/ /rgyal po dpal ldan dad pa can/ /btsun mo gsal ldan de dang mtshungs/ /brgya phrag dge 'dun mtshungs pa med/ /'bangs 'khor bkra shis rje bor bkur / / de 'dra'i gnas su rgyal bu song / /rgyal po'i snyan du 'di skad phul/ khyed kyi bu mo bdud mo yis/ /lho phyogs rgyal po bde spyod khab/ /bde ldan zhes bya dga' ba'i gnas/ /ma mthong yul du spyugs par gyur/ /e ma rgyal po gsan du gsol/ /rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes su shar/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis byin brlabasapa'i/ /mtshan ldan rgyal bu sras su bltams/ /sprul pa'i pho brang dam pa bzhengs/ /'phags pas mkha' la lung bstan byon / / rgyal busngag rgyan gnas su byon/ /gsang ba ye shes spyan drongs zhes/ /'phags pa'i zhal mthong rjes gnang thob/ /slad ma rje dang zhal mjal nas/ /sngar gyi byung tshul bsnyad du gsol/ /zhes rgyal po'i snyan du dbul bar zhu zhes bsngags so/ /der rgyal bus sprul ba'i rta mchog cig la sga bsgron te/ sku la dar dkar gyi phod ka gsol/ dbu la dkon mchog gi thod kyis brgyan te/ byang phyogs be ta'i yul rgyal po dpal ldan gyi pho brang gi sgo skyed mos tshal gsal ba'i dbus su yong pa de/ rab tu byung ba dang / rgyal po'i blon po rnams kyis mthong nas/ rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te / dga' ba'i gtam mang po dris pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ rje'i mchod gnas blon 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams dga' ba'i sems kyis snyan pa'i gtam sgrog pa ni/ kho bo'i yon tan yin gyis zhes gsungs nas tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa/ /steng dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang na/ /rje sa bcu'i dbang phyug mi pham mgon / / lha skal ldan can la chos ston ltar/ /nga lha yi sras po dkon mchog 'bangs/ /sems dag pa'i dbang gis 'gro ba la/ /chos rtag tu dge ba'i gsungs rab mchog /ngag snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod par 'bul /dus ding sang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /mi bdag gi mngon du gyur ba la/ /sems dag pa'i yid kyis gus btud nas/ /ngag snyan pa'i nga ro dbyangs su bzhes/ /dus 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /las bsod —220—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nams bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /rten dal 'byor brten pa'i lha phrug thob/ /ngag grag stong snyan pa'i bden tshig gis/ /chos bde stong sgyu ma'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /gnas 'di ru mi sdod nub tu 'gro/ /nub u rgyan mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gnas/ /chos zab mo gsang sngags theg pa'i mchog /don gcig tu bsdus te nyams len pa'i//ma gsang ba ye shes shar du 'dren/ /gnas bde ldan sprul pa'i pho brang du/ /chos du ma ro gcig mnyam nyid dang / / dbyings tha dad bral bar lhan ne 'jog /ces bya ba dang / /las bya bzang sgrub pa'i blon 'bangs rnams/khyed dad gus zhing sa ma ral bar/ /las dge ba'i sa bon dus su thob/ /thabs 'bras bu dge ba'i bslab bya yin / / zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong zhig bzhengs nas byung nas/ mi mchog sprul pa lha yi sras/ /sprul pa'i rta mchog rdzu 'phrul can/ /mchod yul 'bangs dang bcas pa la/ /snyan pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa legs/ /nga yang rje yi dbugs phyung kye/ /sras mthong bzhin du dga' ba rgyas/ /rje rgyal che ba mi 'byin par/ /skyed mos tshal du bsu ru mchi / / zhes gsung ngo / /yang dge slong zhig bzhengs nas byung ste/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis byin brlabs pa'i / / dkon mchog 'bangs zhes grags pa can/ /kun tu bzang mo'i lhums su zhugs/ /bde spyod rgyal po'i sras su bltams/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yang dge slong zhig bzhengs nas byung ste/ po ta la yi rtse mo nas/ /bde ldan gnas su sku ston pa/ /u rgyan yul nas mkha' 'gro 'dren/ /be ta'i yul 'di bde bar byed/ /ces mngon par shes pa mnga' ba'i rab tu byung ba mang pos snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa mang po gsungs so/ /der skyed mos tshal der rab tu byung ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs mang po 'dus te dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa rgyal pos pho brang gi steng nas gzigs te blon 'bangs la smras pa/ rab tu byung ba dang skyes bu'i tshogs 'di dag dga' dga' ltar skyed mos tshal na 'dus pa 'di ci yin zhes dris pas blon pos smras pa/ rje'i sras mo kun tu bzang mo zhes bya ba de bran mo ngan ma de gnyis kyis bde ldan gyi gnas su spyugs yod par gda' ba la/ bde ldan gyi rgyal po bde spyod kyi btsun mor byas te dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'i rgyal bu lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig 'khrungs nas gda'o/ /de da yang mes chen po'i zhal lta ba dang / snyan pa'i gtam sgrogs pa dang /'phags pa'i dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal ba dang / u rgyan gyi gnas su 'gro ba'i gnang ba zhu ba dang / /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma be ta'i yul 'dir spyan drangs te yul phyogs bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir btsun mo byed zer zhing gda'o / / der rgyal po shin tu dga' ste/ /skyed mos tshal du rgyal po'i chas su zhugs nas 'ongs te/ rgyal bu la bltas pa dang / lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig 'dug ste/ khyed kun tu bzang mo'i sras yin zer ba bden nam zhes smras pas/ rgyal bu na re/ rje gsan du gsol/ chos thams cad bden pas stong na/ kho bo kho na kun tu —221 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzang mo'i sras su bden nam/ /rdzun par ni khas len nus so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po'i thugs la/ 'di sprul pa zhig yin par 'dug nga'i bu mo de dad pa che bas/ bskyab par bya ba'i phyir du sras su 'khrungs ngo shes snyam nas/ bu mo dris pa/ nga'i kun tu bzang mo snying dang 'dra ba de bran mo ngan ma de gnyis kyis sa phyogs de na phar sprugs/ da lta mo gang na yod/ lus la 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis ma btab bam/ sems la mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal ma byung ngam/ rgyal bus smras pa/ sngon chad sdug bsngal du ma na'ang / /ding sang dkon mchog dpal du shar/ /lus bde sems la sdug bsngal med/ /bdag kyang yul 'dir song zhes btang / /zhes gsungs nas/ sngar gyi yum gyi 'phrin rnams bsgrags pas/ rgyal po shin tu dgyes te/ /bu mo de dang myur du phrad dgos / khyod kyang nga'i bu nyid dang 'dra/ khyod rgyal po'i bu yin/ nga'i rgyal srid kyang khyod la skyong ba bab/ khyod kyi ming de yang snyan/ nga la rigs bzang gi bu mo mang po yod khyod la blang du yod mod kyis/ khyod sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa yin par 'dug pas/ u rgyan nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma spyan drangs na 'drongs pas/der 'gro ba la'ang gnang ba ster/ dkon mchog la'ang gsol ba 'debs/ khyod kyi ma de dang myur du phrad par bya dgos pas/ khyoda.u rgyan du ma phyin gyi gong du/ khyod kyis sprul pa'i pho brang de yang blta/ bde spyod de dang yang gleng mo byed pas de ring pho brang gi nang du gdugs tshod la shog gsungs nas nang du spyan drangs te bstod pa dang /bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa byas so/ /der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ nga u rgyan du 'gro ba dang / yum de yang rje la myur du phrad par 'dod pas/ nang par dge 'dun la zhus te/ bde ldan du gshegs zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga'i pho brang 'di dkon mchog gi pho brang yin pas su yis bsdad kyang yid chags/ khyod dkon mchog 'bangs su grags pas/ chos kyi gleng mo mdzad cing zhag bdun bzhugs mod gsungs pas /ka 51 ba 7pa dang/ / rgyal po na re/ khyod kyi 'di dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang lags te/ ngas na ning nas bsdad kyis rgyal pos da dung ma gzigs sam/ rgyal po'i zhal nas dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang yin par dag pa'i snang bar yod kyis/ sems dpa' khyod ni dngos su da lan las ma mthong ngo / /der rgyal bu na re/ de la skyon ma mchis/nang par gong bzhin 'gro bar 'tshal zhes smras pas/ rgyal po na re/ 'o na nga yang 'gro yis zer nas/ btsun mo gsal ldan la/ khyod kyi bu mo kun tu bzang mo bkra shis zhes zer ba ma thos sam/ btsun mos smras pa thos so//rgyal po na re/ 'o na bu mo'i rtsar 'gro bas dge 'dun tsho pho brang du spyan drongs shig der btsun mos gos dri ma med pa gyon/ lus dri spos kyis byugs/ pho brang dang srang mdo la byi dor byas te dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs te mchod pa phul te/ mkhyen nam 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag gi bu mo kun tu bzang mo de//—222—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dad pa'i dbang gis dge 'dun mchod byed na/ /bran gyis sprugs te bde ldan yul du song / /bde spyod rgyal po'i btsun mo byed do zhes/ /ding sang sras byung snyan pa thos par gyur/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /nang par tsha bo 'di dang lhan cig tu/ /bde ldan bde spyod rgyal po'i khab tu 'gro/ /kun tu bzang dang 'phrad kyis gnang bar zhu zhes zhus pa dang / 'phags pa dag mgrin cig tu/ rgyal po yab yum bde ldan gnas su song / /bde spyod khab na kun tu bzang mo yod/ /dga' ba'i gleng mo bag phebs rgyas par mdzod//slar yang gnas 'dir bde ba'i shugs kyis byon/ /zhes gnang ngo / /der rgyal po yab yum 'khor lnga brgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs kyis sna drangs te bde ldan gyi yul bde spyod kyi pho brang ga la ba der lhags so/ /der rgyal po bde spyod btsun mo dang bcas pas grong khyer gyi bzhi mdo nas bsu ste/ pho brang du spyan drangs so/ /de'i tshe lha cig kun tu bzang mos ma'i mdun du langs te 'di skad du/ 'jig rten dag na rnyed dka' ba'i/ /mi lus rin chen thob na yang / /skye ba dman pa bu mor gyur/ /yab kyi gdung las skyes gyur kyang / / yab kyi rgyal srid ma zin par/ /grogs ngan bran gyi dbang du gyur/ /drin can pha ma gnyis dang bral/ /bkur ba'i 'bangs 'khor dang yang bral/ /skyob pa dge 'dun dag las byol/ kho mo gnas 'dir khyim du tshud//tshe gcig la ni ci yang myong / /dang po rje mo bkur ba'i gnas/ /de nas bran mo dman mar gyur/ /de nas dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ kho mo rjes bzung rje mor gyur/ /ding sang yab yum dag dang mjal/ /da yang dkon mchog byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyu 'bras chos la yid ches nas/ /pha ma khyed dang gzhan don du/ /bde ba'i gnas nas bde bar 'gro/ /zhes smras pa dang / pha ma gnyis kyis mgrin cig tu bu mo la smras pa/ /nyi ma nyin cig gyur ba na/ /mig dang 'dra ba'i bu mo stong / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun btsal kyang / /ma rnyed mig gdong mchi mas gang / /slar log dkon mchog mchod pa bshams/ /bstan srung bcas dang 'byung po la/ /gtor ma rgya chen btang bar byas/ khyod kyi don du ma rabs la'ang / /gang 'dod sbyin pa phyogs med btang / /de nas dkon mchog thugs rje yis/ /'thar thug mgon skyabs 'phral du dge /grogs bzang rnyed cing sprul pa yi/ /rgyal bu khyed las bltams par gyur/ /da yang bdag cag lhan cig tu/ /smon lam dag pas phyogs dus kun/ /bkra shis nyi ma 'char bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ pha ma gnyen 'dzom phun sum tshogs / / de ring chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ /de nas u rgyan yul du 'gro /pha ma gnyen bcas nga la nyon/ /thog med srid par 'khyams pa yi/ /'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnams/ /pha mar ma gyur su yang med/ /rang nyid nyi tshe'i don byed pa/ /ma cig chu bor bying ba la/ /bag phebs bu la khrel yod dam/ /bu cig me dong lhung ba la/ /pha ma —223—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nyam nga mi byed pa/ /de la phyi thag cang yod dam/ /e ma gson dang bdag gi gnyen/ /'khor ba 'di ni bzod par dka'/ khyim gyi rig ni nyon mongs 'phel/ /ma dag sems ni chags sdang che/ /rmi lam bzhin du ma shes pas / / rang gi don yang mi 'byung na/ /gzhan mgo 'don pa ci zhig smos/ /lus 'di 'byung bzhi 'dus par zad / / sems 'di ye stong chos kyi dbyings/ /rten 'brel sgyu ma'i slu brid la/ /bden 'dzin ma che rgyangs te skyur / / zhes gsungs pa dang / yab yum gnyen tshogs dang bcas pa mgrin cig tu/ /gzhon nu blo ldan mkhyen pa can/ /de ring chos kyi char yang phab/ /de ring yid rab dga' ba rgyas/ /gzhan don mthar thug gdams pa 'byung / / sngar yang dkon mchog rtag tu mchod/ /da dung dkon mchog mchod byed cing / /ma nus snying rjes bu bzhin bskyangs/ /rgyal srid dkon mchog gsum gyi phyir/ /bsam pa bzang pos rab tu bskyangs/ /sdig can gang gis lus sems gnyis/ /lhan cig mi gnas phral na yang / /mar gyur pha ma ga la 'dor/ /chos rnamasasgyu ma sprul ba bzhin/ /bden med ngang du nyams su blang / /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ /'di nas gzhu 'dom lnga brgya na/ /bdag gis sprul pa'i pho brang yod/ /ma mthong pa dag gzigs su gshegs/ /sprul pa'i dpe yin gdams par che/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mes dpal ldan btsun mo dang bcas pa rnams rab tu dga' ste/pho brang der byon nas mthong ba dang / tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bkod legs gru bzhi lham par gnas/ /dbyibs leg kha dog bkra bar gda'/ /'phang mtho ba gam mdzes pa 'di/ /sprul pas sprul ba bden ma mchis//e ma rdzun pa'i snang ba la/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi bye brag shar/ /rdzun pa'i chos rnams sna tshogs na'ang / /snang ba'i phyir na yod ma myong / /zhes smras pa dang / kun tu bzang mo na re/ yab yum sprul ba'i rgyal bu yis/ /legs par sprul ba'i khang bzang 'dir/ /bag phebs dga' bar zla phyed bzhugs/ /yus dang bcas pa'i sla bo'ang yod/ /yab yum gyis smras pa/ brgya phrag phun tshogs dge 'dun rnams/ /bde bar myur du shog ces gsung / /'phags pa'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /nang par nges par 'gro bar bgyi/ /zhes smras pa dang /rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ nang par be ta'i yul du byon/ /spyir yang dkon mchog mchod par mdzod/ /lhag par dge 'dun bkur bar gyis/ /nga yang u rgyan gnas su 'gro/ /slar yang bde ldan gnas su 'ong / /chos kyi gleng bslangs de rjes bgyi/ /zhes gsungs nas/ nang par/ rgyal po dpal ldan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams be ta'i yul du gshegs so/ /sprul pa'i rgyal bu des kyang sprul pa'i rta mchog de la sga bsgron te/ 'di skad du/ dad pa'i rta mchog rin chen la/ /dad pa'i sga rab bsgron byas te/ /yid ches srab kyis kha lo sgyur/ /thar ba'i lam du 'gro bar shog /yang yob nang du rkang bcug ste/ mtho ris lha mi'i yob chen la/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang ba bzhag byas —224—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /te / / bag yod kun tu bsam gtan pa'i/ /byang chub gnas su phyin par shog /ces smras nas rta la bzhon te/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yis/ /bdag gis bsams pa'i don 'grub ste/ /nor bu rin chen thob par shog /ces smras te/ rta phal bas lo bcu gnyis kyis bgrod pa'i sa la nyi ma bcu gnyis kyis bgrod de u rgyan gyi yul du byon no/ /der rgya gar gyi yul gyi gtos rnams 'das nas/ u rgyan gyi yul la slebs pa na/ ma ta na zhes bya ba'i grong khyer longs spyod che ba 'dug ste/ der phyin pa na/ de'i dbus na rnal 'byor ma lag na ḍū ma ru thogs pa/ lwa ba gyon pa zhig byung nas/ blo ldan khyod gang du 'gro/ rgyal bus smras pa/ kho bo u rgyan gyi yul 'dir 'ongs/ khyod la ci dgos/ nga la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dgos/ 'o na gnas 'di na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma med/ 'o na gang na yod/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i ra ba bya ba na yod/ 'o na 'di na ye med dam dris pas/ gnas 'di na phal cher so so'i skye bo yin/ sprul pa'ang bag re yod/ u rgyan gyi gnas de ni so so'i skye bos mthong bar dka' na/ khyod kyis mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i ra bar 'gro nus sam zer/ 'o na ngas sngar yang rta phal pas lo bcu gnyis tsam gyis bgrod par dka' ba'i sa ngas zhag bcu gnyis kyis brgal te 'ongs/ da ji tsam zhig yod/ khyed sprul bar khas len par 'dug de ltar na myur du sleb zin te mi snang ngo / /yang phyin pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i ra bar yun mi ring bar sleb bo/ /der bltas tsa na/ ri phal cher yang rdo rje'i ri chen po/ khang bzang rnams kyang rgya phibs sngo thib be ba/ ra ba rnams kyang rdo rje'i ra ba/ gang du bltas kyang skyes pa tsam med pa/ bud med sma ra dang ag tshom skyes pa/ mig gsum pa/ ral pa kham shar re ba mdzes par bltas na mdzes pa'i snang ba/ 'jigs par bltas na 'jigs pa'i snang ba 'char ba/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ khros na sa g.yo ba/ rgod na ri rab sgyel bar nus pa mang po gda' ba la/ rtsar cig byung nas/ khyod su 'dod zer/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes 'dod ces smras pas/ de rang rnyed par dka' ste/ do nub khang bzang pha gi na mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs 'khor yod pas der shog zer te/ de bzhin du tshogs khang du phyin pa dang / nyi ma nub nas mkha' 'gro ma mang po der 'dus te/tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la/ las kyi slob dpon ma cig na re/ dkon mchog 'bangs khyed la ci dgos/ /mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes so/ /'o na nged mkha' 'gro ma rnams tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la dam rdzas khyer la shog ci dgos zhus pas/ 'di nas nub phyogs dang dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa'i pha rol na srin g.yag kham pa zhes bya ba/ g.yag mi sha za ba gzugs la rgyang grags byas pa yod/ de'i snying long la shog rgyal bus smras pa/ lam ci 'dra yod/ mkha' 'gro ma cig re/ khyod shes bzhin du 'dri bar byed dam/ 'di nas dpag tshad —225—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/brgya 'das pa na/ sa thams cad mtshos gang / chu bo'i rlabs kyis ri bo len nus/ chu mdog gnag gnam du khol / gru dang gzings kyis spyad par dka'/ khyod kyis bgrod par nus sam/ rgyal bus smrasapa/ don chen po la bzod stobs dang btson 'grus che dgos/ dkon mchog gi thugs rje la brten nas bgrod par nus mchi gsungs nas phyin pas/ dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na mtsho nag po khol ba rba rlabs kyis ri len nus pa chil chil khol ba zhig 'dug der rgyal bu'i bsams pa la 'di ni sprul pa'i rgya mtsho ste bden pas stong / dkon mchog la gsol ba btab na nges par thar/ der ma zad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la'ang sgrol nus snyam nas gsol ba btab pa/ rje mtshungs pa med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /chu kha dog gnag pa'i rba rlabs can/ /rlabs ri bo len pa'i stobs po che/ /me gang gis ma bskol rang khol ma/ /dus bskal ba'i chu klung lta bu 'di/ /dus da lta nyid du bsgral du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / /der chu de'i nang nas bu mo gzugs mdzes pa / phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ dkar sngo me shel dag pa lta bu rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa cig thon nas byung ste/ kye rgyal bu/ 'di 'dra ba'i chu drag po la bsdos te gar 'gro ba yin/rgyal bus/ mtsho 'di'i pha rol na srin g.yag kham pa zhes bya ba gzugs kyang rgyang grags tsam/ zas su mi sha za ba cig yod zer bas de'i snying len du 'gro/ mo na re/ tshod ma chung / srin g.yag kham pa de'i rtsar phyin pa la ni ma shi ba med/ gcig tu sha dad che/ gnyis su bang mgyogs gsum du stobs che/ khyod de'i snying gis ci byed/der rgyal bu na re/ shar phyogs be ta'i yul du/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes gdan 'dren pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma 'bum phrag cig la tshogs 'khor bya dgos pa byung / der mo na re/ khyod 'chi ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes lon pa gang 'dam/ phyi ma'o/ /mo na re/ de bas nga dang lhan cig tu sdod pa dga' mod/ khyod su yin/ nga ni chu'i lha mo'o// khyod la yon tan ci yod/ rgya mtsho skems par nus/ gzhan ci yod/ rgyal bu la ci dgos/'tshang rgya ba'o/ /der bu mo na re/ nga ni 'jig rten gyi lha mo yin/ khyod 'dod 'jig rten 'das pa ste/ kho mo'i spyod yul gang tāgakal yin/ /de bas mthun pa'i dngos grub long / /chu ltar gtsang zhing dri ma med/ /chu yi bu mo gzugs kyis brgyan/ /glo bur rgyan gyis legs par spras/ /rin chen lnga las grub pa yis/ /nga la khang bzang dam pa yod/ /der byon bdag cag dga' mgur spyod/ / /ka 54 ba2 /ces zer ro/ //der rgyal bus smras pa/ 'jig rten dngos grub zhabrul ba yin/ khyod kyi dngos grub nga mi 'dod/ khyod kyi gzugs la yon tan med/ /glo bur rgyan gyis ci zhig bya/ /mthar thug ster bar mi byed na/ /gnas skabs bde bar nga rang lhag/ces /ka 54 ba3 rgosmras /so/ /der bu mo de skyengs te cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /der rgyal bus khyod zhus mi —226—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dgos nga la lam phye smras pas/ bu mo na re/ khyod de cam du mthu chen 'di la thogs par mi 'os/ 'di'i pha rol dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na'ang / nags mtha' med gcan gzan dang dug sprul gyis gang ba yod/ de nas kyang dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na brag dang chu 'thab/ shar nub kyi ri thal mo rdeb pa lta bu yod/ de nas kyang dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi lha ma/ yin srin po'i cha byad can mang po lam bsrung zhing yod/ 'phags pa min pas thon par dka'/ /de nas dang/ga tshad brgya'i pha rol na/ da gzod sri na g.yag kham pa yod/ byis pa khyod kyis bgrod par mi nus ces smras pa dang / rgyal bus snying rje chen po bsgoms pas/ ma/tsho de dag g.yu'i maṇḍal chen po zhig tu song ste/ de'i steng nas yud cam zhig la dpag tshad brgya brgal te phyin pa na/ bu mo des zer ba'i nags mtha' med kyi dbus nas bu mo rang bzhin dang gnas skabs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig byung nas/ rgyal bu khyed shul ring gi lam nas 'ongs nas 'dug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rdzas 'tshol ba la/ byis pas mi bgrod pa'i yul du 'gro ba la bar dor sgyid lug srid pas/ glu 'di la nyon zer bas/ u rgyan yul gyi sa yi phyogs / / mkha' 'gro sna tshogs rgyu ba'i gnas/ /mtha' med nags kyi dbus shed na/ /gcan gzan dug skrul 'jigs pa'i sa/ khyod kyi tshe srog 'gyur gyis dogs/ /de bas nga la skyabs gyis la/ /pho brang nyams dga' gnas su 'deng / /rin chen sna tshogs spras pa'i khri/ /sna tshogs spos kyi ngad pa ldang / /de ru rang re gleng mo bgyi//grogs kyi skal ba kho mos bya/ /gzhan du khyod kyi grogs skal chad/ /ces zer ro/ /der rgyal bu/ bu mo khyod kyi yon tan ci/ /rgyal bu khyed la ci dgos/ /nga la 'tshang rgya ba'o/ /nga ni 'jig rten shing gi lha/ /gnas skabs dngos grub dpag med yod/ /'jig rten dag ni gzugs la chags/ /nga 'dra'i gzugs can khyod kyis bsten//rgyal bus smras pa/ /gnas skabs dngos grub slu brid yin/ khyod kyi gzugs kyis ci zhig bya/ /nyon mo/ngas ma dag dri ma che/ /phyi ltas mdzes pas bslus kyis dogs/ /bu mo skyengs nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /der rgyal bus nags 'di la khyod kyis lam sna gyis shig smras pas/ he he/ khyod la lam/ sna mi dgos pa cig gda' ste/ /ngag mi bcag pa'i don du lam sna bya'o/ /zhes zer nas lam sna drangs te dpag tshad brgya thug par bskyal nas mi snang ngo / /de nas cung zad phyin pa na brag nag po shin tu 'phang mtho ba kha byang du bstan pa la/ byang nas chu chen po zhugs te brag de dang 'thab pa brag la chu 'thab/ de'i dbus na sngar gzhan gyis 'grims pa'i shul ni mi 'dug / rgyal bus 'gro sa ma rnyed de/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhag pas/ de'i dbus na dar dkar brkyangs pa lta bu'i lam cig byung / de la shel gyi bu mo zhig zhugs nas byung ste byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa'i sku la bsu ba bya ba ma byung / lam 'di la byon par zhu zhes lam sna drangs nas cung zad phyin pa na/ shel gyi khang —227—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa ka ba brgya tsam btsugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba zhig tu spyan drangs te/ khyed sprul pa'i sku sa thag ring po nas don chen bsgrub (sgrubakatu byon pa 'gro ba la bka' drin che/ da re zhig 'dir dbugs phyung / der rgyal bus smras pa/ khyed su yin/ sa phyogs 'di'i yul bdag mo yin zer/ da srin g.yag kham pa len pa la thag ji tsam yod dris pas dpag tshad nyis brgya tham pa'o/ /de'i bar na 'jigs pa med dam/ shar nub kyi brag thal mo rdeb pa yod do/ /de la skyel ma cig zhu gsungs pas/ khyed byang chub kyi sems kyis 'gro ba la skyel ma dag ga la 'tshal/ byon par zhu zhes zer nas/ rgyal bu byon pas/ bu mos zer ba bzhin du 'dug ste/ de'i bar la 'gro sa mi 'dug pa la sngar bzhin du byams pa bsgoms pas/ lam legs par dod de yud tsam zhig la pha rol tu brgal lo/ /de nas dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi lha ma yin srin po'i gzugs su yod pa/bzhin mi sdug la/ mche ba rno ba mang po 'dug pa na re/ 'di tsam pa'i 'jigs sa bcad de gar 'gro ba yin zer ro / / rgyal busasmras pa/ srin g.yag kham pa'i snying len du 'gro zhes smras pas/ khong na re/ khyod snying stobs re che / bdag cag stobs che bar grags pa rnams kyis kyang ma lon/ mkha' 'gro ma ji tsam zhig gis sngar yang ma blangs pa la/ khyod kyis da len lon par byed zer na/ sngon la khyed rang gi snying nged kyis blang gis zer ro/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ 'jig rten dag /ka 55 ba5 kun/ tu bde ster ba'i/ /skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog gsum / / bdag dang rtag tu mi 'bral na/ /tha mal khyed kyis gnod nusasam/ /zhesasmras pa dang / khong rnams dpa' zhum ste cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /der rgyal bus/ srin po'i gzugs can zhig la smras pa/ da srin g.yag kham pa la ji tsam yod/ da dung 'di nas dpag tshad brgya yod/ rgyang grags tsam gyis gzugs rngam pa/ /zas su sha khrag za bar byed/ /kun gyis mi thub stobs dang ldan/ khyod rang song dang lon pa ni mi lon zer ro/ /rgyal bus ma nyan par dpag tshad brgya brgal te phyin pa na/ sngar zer ba bzhin du srin g.yag kham pa gzugs la rgyang grags tsam byas pa 'dug kho zhe sdang langs te kha rlangs sprin 'khrigs pa tsam du byung nas/ u rgyan gyi sa thams cad g.yos/ 'od chen po'ang byung ste/ rgyal bus smras pa/ mngon par shes pa thogs med ldan/ tags bya thams cad mngon du gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /thub chen dpa' bo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i/ /kun gyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ma rungs thams cad zhi mdzad pa/ /de yi yum lā phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dpa' brgyad sogs 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /zhi khro kun ston stobs po che/ /bdud dmag thams cad zlog byed pa'i/ /dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ring 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /thugs rjes 'di yi snying phyung ste/ /bdag la stsol gyis dkon mchog gsum/ /bdag gi spyod la'ang skyon mi 'tshal/ /—228—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs nas/ g.yag de'i rtsar phyin pa dang / mchi ma khrag tu 'dzags te rgyal bu'i drung du 'gyel to/ /der kho'i
