rig pa po ta lar 'phangs te snying 'byin par brtsams pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma ral ba shar re ba/ mig gsum yod pa stag lpags kyi sham thabs can zhig byung nas/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po 'di bsad du mi btub/nged mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi lha g.yag yin zhes zer ro/ /der rgyal bu'i thugs dgongs la/ 'o na snying long zer bar mi 'dug mkha' 'gro ma khyod kyi mdun du 'ong zer bar 'dug snyam nas smras pa/ 'o na mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes gang na yod/ mkha' 'gro ma de ni ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang rgya phibs bye ba /ka 56 na6rgo'abum/ yod pa/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i sa na yod do/ /'o na khyod kyis nga la bstan dgos smras pa dang / rdo rje'i brag ri chen po pha gi'i byang 'dabs na/ brag gi khung bu zhig yod de'i sgo la brdung dang / mkha' 'gro ma cig 'ong bas de la dris zer nas phyin pa dang / zer ba bzhin 'dug ste sgo la brdungs pas/ rnal 'byor ma rgan mo mgo la sro ma nyil le ba cig byung nas/ khye'u khyed la ci dgos/ nga la mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dgos pas/ khyod kyis bstan dgos/ de na re/ do nub ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro ma rnams tshogs 'khor byed zer/ nga yang der bkru ru 'ong bas/ khyed rang yang der byon dang dbang yang thob/ gsang ba ye shes kyi lung yang thob srid kyis zer nas phyir log song ngo / /de bzhin du nyi ma nub pa dang / ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs khang du phyin no/ /der mkha' 'gro ma gcig 'dus gnyis 'dus bye ba 'bum tsam 'dus/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i steng du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa tshogs kyi yo byad mang po bshams nas/ tshogs 'khor byed pa'i dus su/ las kyi slob dpon ma cig na re/ do nub khye'u khyod la tshogs rdzas ci yod/ da lta 'di yin bya bar rang med/ 'o na khyod la ci dgos/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dgos te / dpag tshad lnga brgya'i pha rol nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'dir lung bstan te 'ongs pa yin/ sngar yang dka' spyad chen po bgyis/ bdag la 'gro don las med pas khyed kyis bstan 'tshal zhes zhus pa dang / tshogs kyi slob dpon ma de na re/ dpa' bo chen po 'dir byon/ khyod de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras kyi thu bo zhig mi shes pas sgrib sgribs skad/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes 'dod zer na/ de ni khyod kyi ma yin mod/ mas grogs byed dam/ de ni khyod kyi lha yin mod/ lhas grogasabyed dam/ gzhan yang zhing khams 'di khyod kyi zhing khams yin mod/ gnas 'di na rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi bla ma/ khyad par du yang khyed kyi skye ba dpag tu med pa nas kyi bla ma/ mtsho'i padma ltar dge slong dri ma med par grags pa/ gnas 'di thams cad pho brang chen po ltar byin gyis rlobs pa/ skye ba bdun brgya bdun bcu (cukathams par dge slong tshul khrims —229—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gtsang ma/ nyes lhung dang dri mas ma gos pa/ rgya gar du grub thob lnga bcur (curaka grags pa la'ang 'di 'dul ba 'dzin pa mdo sde 'dzin pa/ mngon pa 'dzin pa rig pa 'dzin pa de yang nyan thos kyi cha lugs kho nar ston no/ /de ltar bu de khyed kyi bla ma yin la/ gnas 'di na bzhugs pa la de'i yum kyang mkha' 'gro ma 'di yin mod/ da khyed rang la cis kyang dgos na/ khyod rang bzhin gyis dbang thob pa zhig yin kyang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur gyis gsungs nas / dbang bskur te/ da skyes bu dam pa don chen bsgrub (sgrub1pa la bzod stobs che dgos pas/ lang ka pu rangs su song la/ srin po'i lag na mi snying dmar rtsa re ba bcu drug yod pas/ de 'dir long la shog /mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes len pa de nges par dgos pa'i rdzas yin gsungs nas lung bstan na/ /rgyal po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ /thog mar bdag gi bla ma de dang mjal na 'ong bar gda' ste/ bla ma dang mjal ba'i rten 'brel la dka' spyad rang bya dgos par mchi bas/ dang por srin yul lang kar phyin la mkha' 'gro ma zer ba bzhin du snying de dag blang ngo snyam nas srin yul lang ka'i lam la zhugs pa dang /dpag tshad brgya 'das pa na/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal po 'tsho skyong zhes bya ba'i pho brang bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba skyed mos tshal lnga brgya yod pa/ skye mos tshal re na'ang rdzing bu dpag tu med pa yod pa na/ngang pa la sogs pa'i bya dpag tu med pa gnas pa/ me tog bkra ba sna tshogs pa yod pa/ shing nags tshal nags thib be ba yod pa/ skye bo mang pos gang ba/ rin po che du ma las byas pa'i pho brang rab rim pa bdun byas pa / ra ba'i bar bar na rin po che'i pha gu'i gcal bkram pa/ de dag gi bar na yang rdzing bu mang po yod pa/ de dag la khye'u dang bu mo dga' mgur rtse ba de dag kyang nyon mongs pa'i spyod pa mi ston pa/ dkon mchog gsum las brtsams pa'i glu dbyangs kyi sgra sgrogs pa dag 'dug go /der rgyal bus sprul ba'i rta de la zhon (bzhonakanas skyed mos tshal du 'ongs pa khye'u dag gis mthong nas/ rgyal po 'tsho skyong ga la ba der phyin nas zhus pa/bdag cag gi skyed mos tshal na sprul pa'i khye'u lta bas chog mi shes pa cig 'ongs nas gda' bas rgyal po'ang gzigs su 'byon 'tshal/ zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po la mngon par shes pa mnga' bas gzigs pas/ shar phyogs bde ldan gyi rgyal po bde spyod kyi bu dkon mchog 'bangs yin par shes te/ rin po che dang / gos phun sum tshogs pa khyer nas skyed mos tshal du dkon mchog 'bangs kyi drung du 'ongs so/ /der dkon/ mchog 'bangs kyis gzigs pas/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la rgyal sa mdzad pa/ gzhon nu'i dus nas sems kyi rtsal rdzogs pa/ mtshan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ khye'u rig pa dang ldan pa brgya phrag gcig gis bskor ba de —230—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gzigs nas dga' ba'i sems kyis gnas so/ /rgyal po 'tsho skyong gis kyang gzigs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur ba mtshan phun sum tshogs pa lta bas chog mi shes par 'dug pa mthong nas smras pa/ thag ring bgrod dka'i lam zhugs pa'i/ /gzhon nur gyur ba'i sems dpa' mchog /gnas 'dir lhags pa shin tu dka' / kho bo'i pho brang nang du 'dengs/ khyod la bdag gi mchod gnas bya/ /bdag gis sring cig khyod la dbul / / rgyal srid dag kyang mnyam du spyad/ /e ma khyod ni bdag gi rje/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ sngon chad bsod nams bsags pa yi/ /bzhin mdzes brjid ba'i cha lugs can/ /gzhon nu rigs ldan brgya yis bskor/ /thag ring lam nas bsu ba legs/ /pho brang nang du nga mi 'gro/ /srin yul lang ka 'jigs pa'i sa/ /mi snying bcu drug mkha' 'gro'i rdzas/ /blang bar dka' ba kho bos len/ /zhes smras pa dang /rgyal po'i zhal nas/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par dka'/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba dkon/ /srin po'i yul du phyin gyur na/ /rje yi sku la bar gcod 'ong / /ma gsung bdag gi gan du gshegs/ /bsnyel gso bdag gis mchod par bya/ /zhes nan cher zhus pas/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ rgyal po khyed ni nga la nyon/ /gzugs ni dbu ba sdos (rdosaka par gsungs/ /tshor ba chu yi chu lhar zhes/ /'du shes smig rgyu lta bu ste/ /'du byed rnams ni chu shing 'dra/ /rnam shes sgyu ma'i yo lang la/ srin pos ci byed tshogs rdzas len/ /de ring khyed kyi bka' mi bcag/ces gsungs pas pho brang gi nang du byon pa na/ de'i bar bar na khrus kyi rdzing bu nyams dga' ba yod pa la/ khye'u bu mo mang po dga' mgur rtse bar mthong / de dag kyang rgyal bu mthong nas dga' ste/ 'di skad du/ /de ring lha yi sras po byon/ /nyi ma shin tu 'od ldan yang / khyod kyi 'od kyis zil mnan gda'/ /rtag tu gnas 'dir bzhugs na legs/ tags (zhes3 zer ro/ rgyal bus smras pa/ gzugs mdzes khye'u bu mo'i tshogs/ /dga' ba'i mig gis nga mthong tshe/ /tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa thos/ /zhag gcig gnas 'dir bsdad par bgyi/ /zhes smras pa dang / nang nas rgan mo g.yu'i 'khar ba thogs pa/ bu mo gzhon nu ma mang pos bskor ba zhig byung nas/ de ring gnas 'dir 'od stong 'phros/ /ding sang lha phrug dngos su byung / khyod kyi ltas su kho mos 'tshal/ /'bras bu dge bar the tshom med/ /yar byon pho brang gnas su byon/ /gang dgyes mchod pa bdag gis dbul/ zhes zer ro/der rgyal po rgyal bu g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa pho brang du byon te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa bsham pa'i dus su/ lha cig ma gser 'tsho zhes bya ba bzod pa'i 'bras bu rgyas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dad pa dang ldan pa cig yod pa de rgyal bu'i drung du 'ongs te/ dga' ba'i mig gi blta zhing bstod pa'i tshig gis bsgrags pa/ nyi ma'i 'od ltar rab 'tsher ba/ /bsil dwangs chu bo'i rgyun 'byin pa/ /'gal 'gal lta bur ltad —231 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mo ston/ /rtag tu gsal ba'i gnas 'dir skyongs/ /zhes /ka 58 ba1 rgosmras/ pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/bzhin bzang ma chags bdag la nyon/ khyim pa rnams la snying po med/ /rgyal srid dag ni btson khang 'dra/ /bdag cag ma nyes bsdad mi rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dad pa skyes te/ de ring chos zab mo yi char pa phab/ sprul ba'i sku yi zhal mthong ngo / ding sang bzhugs na dga' ste mi bzhugs par gda'/ dper na bu med rgyal po la/ /lan cig rgyal bu skyes gyur te/ /slar yang shi ba ji bzhin du / / chos thos da ni gshegs mi dga'/ /zhes smras so/ /der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ thams cad dang ba'i yid kyis nyon/ /da lta chos ston mdzad pa zad/ /lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs su/ /nga ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes/ /gangs can mgon po dam par 'gyur/ /de tshe 'tsho skyong rgyal po ni/ /rnal 'byor shes rab rdo rjer grags/ /bdag gis gdams pa ma lus len/ /'gro ba kun la phan par byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal po 'tsho skyong bzhengs te/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas/ gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa/spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag la dgongs/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can/ /rang rgyud bag chags ngan pa rnams/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyi mun bsal ltar/ /mgon po khyed kyi dge ba'i 'od/ /nyin re lta bur gsal bar mdzod / / bdag kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /yid kyi mun pa sel byed pa/ /chos kyi sgron me bltams par shogakhyed kyi sras su nges gyur cig /ces smon lam yang btab bo/ /der 'khor rnams kyang langs te/ dad pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa/ de tshe bdag cag zhing khams der/ /mgon po khyed kyi zhabs drung du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje yis/ /dge ba bcu la spyod par shog /bdag gis smon lam 'di btab pas/ /ring por mi thogs khyod kyi zhing / /gzhon nu rab byung tshul khrims can/ khyed kyi gdul byar bsgyur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / rgyal bus smras pa/ 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /skal ldan khyed dang mi 'bral bar/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa yis/ /smon lam mthu dang ldan par shog /ces smon lam btab bo/ de nas nang par nyi ma shar te/ sa phyogs dag pa'i dus su/ rgyal bus tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag ni zhing khams thams cad du/ /rgyu 'bras gsal ba'i nyi ma shar/ khyad gsod mun pa nub gyur nas/ /bdag gi bstan pa rgyas par shog /ces phyogs bcur gzigs te smon lam btab bo/ /de nas lang ka pu rangs ga la ba der byon te/srin po'i gnas la gzigs pas/ khro lcags la sogs pas lcags ri rim pa bdun yod pa de'i nang na/ la cha'i pho brang rgya che ba/ 'phangs dgu thog tu yod pa/ mi khrag gi mtsho bskyil ba/ mi sha'i mkhar brtsigs pa/ zas de dag la spyod pa mthong ngo / /der snying rje drag po thun mong ma yin pa skyes pas/ srin po rnams kyang zhi zhing dul —232—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nas / rgyal bu la bar gcod byed ma nus te pho brang du bzhugs pa dang / bu mo mtshan dang dpe byad gyis spras pa/kha ṭwāṃ ga lag na thogs pa mgo la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyon pa cig byung nas/ rgyal bu la smras pa/ sngon tshe bsod nams bsags pa yis/ /rgyal rigs mchog la skyes pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan ngang ring po/ /gnas 'dir ci dgos sprul ba mchog /srin pos bar gcod 'ong ba las/ /sa cig gnas su bsam gtan bsgoms/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bus/ cig tu bsdad na gzhan don nyams/ /gzhan don med pa'i bsam gtan ci/ kho bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis btang / /mi snying bcu drug long zhes zer/ /ding sang srin po'i gnas 'dir 'ongs/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis gnod mi 'gyur/ khyod ni mkha' 'gro yin par shes/ /nga la mi snying bcu drug gsol/ /zhes smras pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma na re/ khyod ni sems dpa' mchog nyid de/ /'gro ba'i don phyir gnas 'dir 'ongs / / mi snying bcu drug sgro btags te/ /nged cag mkha' 'gro bcu drug yin/ khyod la ci dgos bshad du gsol / / de nas bdag gis bstan par bya/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu na re/ nga la gsang ba ye shes dgos//bde ldan gnas ni bde la 'god/ /de bas u rgyan gnas su 'ongs/ /dka' spyad chen po nyams su myong / /zhes smras pa dang / de na re/ 'dug 'o na /ka 59 ba2 rgokhyod/ don chen po la gnas 'dir 'ongs/ mched mo/ rnams kyis kyang 'dir btang 'dug de ltar na rgyal po 'tsho skyong gi pho brang gi lho phyogs na/ chu mi/ga mgo dgu pa'i dbus na/ ljon shing yal 'dab rgyas pa zhig yod de/ de'i drung du nga sdod kyis/ 'jigs rten na gces pa'i mi snying bcu drug po de yang ngas khyer la 'ong gi zer nas/ mi snang bar gyur/ rgyal bu slar log nas/ rgyal po 'tsho skyong gi pho brang gi lho phyogs chu mig dang ljon shing ga la ba der phyin pa dang / de na sprang mo rgan mo zhig gda' ba la/ gnas 'di la ci zer dris pas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'du khang zhes grags/ khyod rang yang 'dir sdod zer nas / rgyal bu der bsdad pa dang / yun mi ring ba na/ bu mo bco lnga byung nas sbrang mo de la phyag bcal/ der cho/ sprul ba mo yin par shes nas/ rgyal bus smras pa/ khyod ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ kho bos rig par ma gyur ba//de ring khyod kyi mngon sum du/ /nyes gang de ni mthol zhing 'chags/ /zhes smras pa dang / de na re/ khyed la ma/khyen pa thogs med kyang / /mi shes tshul du 'chos par byed/ /'chags pa'i nongs pa ci zhig yod/ khyed ni dag pa'i rang bzhin yin zhes zer ro/ /der rgyal bus smras pa/ /gsang ba ye shes khyod yin nam/ /nga la dag pa'i tshig gis smos/ /de na re/ de nyid kho mo ga la yin/ /mched mos bos phyir 'ongs par zad/ yang rgyal bu na re/khyed dang lhan cig mched mo'i sar/ /the tshom gcod du 'gro bar bgyi/ /de na re / rgyal bu re zhig byams pa bsgoms(sgomasaka / /bu mo bco lngas dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo cung zad bskor/ /rgyal bu —233—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di la bslab bya bya/ /zhes zer te/ der mkha' 'gro ma bco lnga po des dkyil 'khor chen po cig bzhengs pa la/bgres mo des byin gyis brlabs pas/ rin po che'i gzhal yas khang rgya che la 'phang mtho ba cig byung ste/ de'i nang du mkha' 'gro ma bcu drug gis rdo rje'i gar mang po mdzad pas yang mkha' 'gro ma bcu drug byung ste sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis dga' ba'i gar rtses so/ /der glo bur gyi mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/ dpa' bo 'di la ci 'tshal/ gzhi ba cig na re/ khong la gsang ba ye shes 'tshal skad zer ro/ /de nas cig na re/ khong kha rtsang nas ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du gsang ba ye shes dgos zer nas byung ba la/ kho mo cag gis thag mi chod par khyed spyan 'dren du btang ngo / /da dpa' bo 'di la gsung legs par byon zer ba dang / sngar gyi tshogs kyi slob dpon ma de na re/ /cis kyang gsang ba ye shes dgos na/ lhun po brtsegs pa nags kyi 'dabs/ /gser g.yu brdal ba rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /mkha' 'gro sna tshogs 'du ba'i gnas/ /dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa yod/ /de na khyod nyid rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med/ /sprul pa'i dge slong du mas bskor/ /tshogs 'khor rgya chen bskor zhing yod/ /der song dbang zhus bka' lung nos/ /gsang ba ye shes der gsal mchi/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bus/ de la lam thag ji tsam mchi / khyed kyis bdag gis lam sna drongs/ /zhesasmras pa dang / de na re/ 'di nas dpag tshad brgya phrag cig /dpa' bo khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /yun ring mi thogs myur du bgrod/ kho mos lam sna drang mi 'tshal/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ kho bo dang 'grogs te mi 'gro na khyed rnams gar gshegs/ /de rnams na re/khyod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa de la gsol ba 'debs shing gnas 'dir sdod do/ /der rgyal bus sprul ba'i rta de la chibs te/ 'di skad du/ yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas pa'i/ /'jig rten skyabs cig dkon mchog gsum/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med/ /bdag gis mngon du 'gyur ba mdzod/ /ces smras nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med pa'i pho brang ga la ba der phyin pa las dpag tshad dgu bcu (cuka go dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na tshur tshe dang ldan pa dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa/ phyag g.yas na rnga yab thogs pa g.yon na ril pa spyi blugs bsnams pa/ zhi zhing dul ba/ mtshan dang ldan pa cig byung ste/ rgyal bu la 'di skad du/ u rgyan gyi yul 'di/ rang bzhin 'jam/ rnam pa rtsub/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma drag pos 'dul ba'i rnam par bzhugs pa/ sems thugs rje chen po'i ngo bor gnas/ khyed dkon mchog 'bangs yul sa thag ring po nas byon pa dang / rnam pa 'di dag gzigs pas sku ngal ba dang thugs skyo bar ma gyur tam/ rgyal bus zhus pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gsan du gsol/ /bdag gi lus 'di gzhan don las/ /skad cig tsam yang gzhan gyur na/ /de las nyes pa ga la srid/ /ding sang —234—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'gro ba'i don du bde/ /da dung bla ma'i drung du 'gro/ /rgyal ba 'jig rten sgron ma de/ /'gro ba'i don du bde gyur tam / / tshe dang ldan pas smras pa/ dpal gyi pho brang dam pa na/ /rgyal ba dri med lham mer bzhugs/ /'jig rten don las ma g.yos par/ /tshogs 'khor rgya chen bskor zhing gda'/ /bag yod rnam dag gus pa'i tshul/ /rtse gcig thugs rje chen po'i ngang / /bde ba chen po'i lam zhugs nas/ /rgyal ba'i drung du gshegs par zhu/ /gsungs nas/ dpal gyi pho brang ga la ba der spyan drangs so/ /de nas dkon mchog 'bangs kyis/ pho brang chen po'i nang du zhugs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi sgron ma dri ma med pa zhes bya ba skye ba bdun brgya bdun bcu (cukatham par dge slong dri ma med par brgyud mar mdzad pa/ nang rig pa 'dzin pa chen por bzhugs pa/ phyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong nyes lhung gi dri mas ma gos pa/ nyan thos chen po'i rnam par bzhugs pa cig sprul pa'i dge slong brgya phrag cig gis bskor ba'i gdan gyi dbus la bzhugs pa mthong ngo / /der rgyal bus sor mo bcu'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras pa/ /'jig rten mgon po dri ma med/ /ston ka'i zla ltar rab tu gsal/ /'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa 'joms/ /don ldan khyed la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rig pa 'dzin pa gsang ba'i mchog /lha yi rang bzhin dri ma med/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa snying rje can/ /bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i dpal mnga' ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med/ /rdo rje 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshal/ /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /brgya phrag dge 'dun dag gis bskor/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid dpal gyi gzhi/ /'dul ba 'dzin la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rang dang spyi yi mtshan nyid rnams/ /ma 'dres so sor phyed pa'i dpal/ /blo mig dri ma nges bral ba'i/ /mngon pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo / / zhes 'khas la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhal nas po ta la nas bde ldan du/ /sprul pa'i grong khyer gang brtsegs pa/ /'gro ba'i gnyen cig sa bcu'i mgon/ /dkon mchog 'bangs zhes byis par bstan / / u rgyan gnas 'dir thugs rje yis/ /gsang ba ye shes 'dren slad du/ /sprul pa'i rta la bzod pa'i ga /brtson 'grus lcag gis myur brabs nas/ /dag pa'i srab kyis kha lo sgyur/ /ding sang nga yi drung du lhags / / zhes gsungs pa dang / sprul pa'i dge slong rnams kyis smras pa/ rnam dag mtshan ldan dkon mchog 'bangs / / nyon mongs dri mas ma gos kyang / /gsang ba ye shes 'dren zhes skad/ /nges par 'drongs kyis phan bdes skyongs zhes gsungs pa dang / /dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal nas/ de la yon tan du zhig yod/ /mkha' 'gro du yis mchod par byed/ /de yi gnas ni gang na nges/ khyad par da lta gang na mchis/ /yang bla ma'i zhal nas / mthar thug mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren/ /'phral du thun mong dngos grub ster/ /nga yi ma yin khyod kyi —235—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yum / / da lta gsang ba'i brag la gnas/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yang rgyal bus zhus pa/ 'jig rten mgon po dri ma med / / gsang ba'i brag de gang na yod/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro du dang ldan/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji tsam bskor//zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ rdo rje'i brag gi byang ldebs la/ / gser gyi rdo rje bslang ba yi/ /rdo rje rked pa mdzes pa la/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rab brgyan nas/ /rdo rje'i glu gar rab tu rtse//rdo rje'i nga ros bdud rnams skrag /rdo rje'i 'gros kyi sa chen 'dul/ /zhes gsungasapa dang / bla ma'i thugasakar 'od zer rdo rje lta bu zhig byung ste/ g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor nas/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyi thugs kar thim/ der dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal nas/ mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma mchog /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongasasu gsol/ /'od zer rdo rje lta bu ste/ khyed la bskor te bdag la zhugs/ /bzang po'i ltasasu kho bos shes/ /nga ni sras kyi thu bor gyur/ khyed la lan gsum bskor ba de/ /sngar yang khyed kyis bskyangs pa'i rtags/ /da yang khyed kyis 'dzin par shes/ /da lta mchog tu thugs rjes 'dzin/ /e ma g.yasasu bskor ba ni/ /dam chosalam du 'gro bar shes/ /bdag gi snying la zhugs pa ni/ khyed kyi gdams pas phan par 'tshal/ /zhes zhus pa dang /bar snang la gzugs med pa'i sgra cig byung ba ni/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs/ /rgyal ba yab sras bgro ba mdzad/ /ding sang u rgyan yul du 'tshogs/ /ma 'ongs gangs ri'i khrod du 'du/ /sngon chad rdo rje'i gdan du 'dzom/ /bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su/ /yab sras tsandan dri bzhin du/ /'bral med 'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung / / zhes grag go /dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhas nas/ /grag stong snyan pa'i glu dbyangs thos/ /dusagasum dge ba'i lung bstan byung / /dkar po'i lha mchog yin par shes/ /ding sang rten 'brel 'dzom mo rje/ /rje'i zhal nas/ dkon mchog 'bangs ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ gangs ri'i mgul du/ 'du zhes pa'i sgra de thosasam gsungs/ bdag gis thos pas da lta tshigs su bcad de zhus so/ /zhes smras pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/'di nas shar phyogs na rdo rje'i gdan zhes bya ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas yod/ de'i byang phyogs na bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams zhes bya ba mtha' 'khob kyi yul chen po byams pa dang snying rje dang bral ba'i mi ma yin drag po dpag tu med pa yod pas/ de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad ngan song gsum du skyur bar byed pas ding sang bod khams der bdag gi sprul ba mthu dang ldan pa zhig btang la sngon la mi ma yin drag po de dag btul te gnod 'tshe dang gdug rtsub zhi bar bya/ skye bo thams cad kyang bde skyid dang bkra shis par bya'o// khyod kyis sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig thong la bod khams kyi sems can de dag yongs su drongs/ sprul pa mang po yang khyes/ rgya nag dang bal po'i yul na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa —236—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dngos yod pas gnas der spyan drongs/ bod khams de 'jigs sa che bas lha mo zhi khro gnyis spyan drongs/'jigs pa brgyad las skyob par byed cing / de nas yul gyi dbus su gyur nas skye bo phal la dad pa skyes te gdams ngag bstan du btub pa'i dus su/ byang phyogs de nas byang phyogs su/ bod na rigs btsun par grags pa thams cad kyis bkur ba zhig tu khyed kyis lus blangs te/ khyed kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba zhig rgya gar nas nga spyan 'dren du thong / gzod mi rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la dgod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi sgron ma ji skad gsung ba bzhin du bgyi'o/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong rnams na re/ rgyal ba sras bcas bod khams der gshegs pa'i rjes su/ u rgyan gyi gnas 'di sus skyong /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sus sdud/ srin po'i tshogs rnams sus 'dul/ zhes zhus pa dang / ding sang gangs ri'i khrod du mi ma yin 'dul du btang ba'i sprul ba de slar 'di nyid du log nas/ u rgyan skyong zhing mkha' 'gro ma rnams sdud par byed la/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po'ang bskor/ srin po gdug pa can yang des 'dul gsungs pa dang / sprul ba rnams shin tu mnyes te/ yab sras gnyis la bstod pa/ mngon par shes pa thogs med ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis phyogs bcur gshegs/ /'gro ba rnams la dus drug gzigs/ /skal ldan dus la snyel mi mnga'/ /thams cad mngon sum gzigs na yang / /ku su lu yi tshul mdzad de/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes sbas gyur nas/ /mi shes nyon mongs lta bur ston/ /mtshungs med sras dang bcas pa la/ /dang ba'i yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod do/ /bla ma'i zhal nas/ kye gsal ldan dag rnyog pa med pa'i sems kyis bdag cag gnyis la bstod kyis/ bstod pa dang / bkur ba dang / bsngags pa ni 'dud pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog yin no// /gsal ldan dag sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i phyir bla ma'i thugs dgongs gong nas gong du rdzogs pa'i smon lam chen po thob cig dge rtsa chos kyi dbyings su bsngos shigade ltar byas na skyes bu dam par 'gyur gsungs nas/ dkon mchog 'bangs la bslab bya mdzad pa/ khyod sems can gyi don la rings pas/ ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs khang bkra shis nyams dga' 'phel ba der song la/ tshig 'di smos shig chos dbyings bde ba chen po las/ /thug rje'i sprin gyi 'od zer 'khrigs/ /nyams dbyangs chos kyi sbrang char 'bab/ /bde stong snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrogs/ kho bo'i yum chen chos kyi sku/ /spyan ras gzigs dang lhan cig tu/ /bde spyod rgyal po'i khab tu song / /gnas de gzhal yas chen por sgyur/ /gang gi rang rgyud gdams pas thul/ /de ni bdag gi gdams tshig yin/ /zhes phrin du bskur ro/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas dkon mchog 'bangs kyis/ skad cig yud tsam la mkha' 'gro —237—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ma'i tshogs khang bkra shis shing nyams dga' 'phel ba der sleb bo/ /der ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pas/ sa bcu'i mgon po bla ma'i zhal gdams dang bcas te/ tshogs khang du 'ongs pa shes nas dga' ba'i gar 'khrab cing dkon mchog 'bangs kyi drung du byung ngo / /der dkon mchog 'bangs kyis smras pa/ mngon shes mkhyen pa thogs med pa'i/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dpag med rnams/ /dga' ba'i nyams kyis dga' gar rtse/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis 'ongs pa la/ /nyams dbyangs snyan pa'i glu zhig len/ /dam chos zag med gzhal yas na/ /gnas lugs chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs / / bde stong chos kyi nga ro can/ /ma chags yan lag drug bcu'i (cu'ikadabyangs/ /phyogs ris med par mnyam nyid sgrogs/ /bdag gi bla ma yin no kun/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas gdams pa bskur/ /zhesasmras nas / bla ma'i zhal gdamasarnams snyan du gsol bas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ ma bcosalhun grub chen po la/ /bde stong brag cha'i dbyangs su grag /gnas lugs ston pa'i nga ro de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs dang mtshungs/ /nyon mongs gso ba'i sman chen de/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje de/ /nad gso mdzad pa'i sman mchog yin/ /ding sang gdams pa dus la bab/ /do nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dpa' mo bye ba 'bum phrag la/ /dpa' bo dpag med cig tu bzhugs/ /dam chosadu ma ro cig la/ /zab dbyangs chu bo phyogasabacur 'bab/ /nang par brag gi byang ldebs na/ /gsang ba ye shes bla ma'i yum/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /'khor ba rtsad nas gcod pa yi/ /rtsibs stong chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /nang par gnas der dga' bar gleng / /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor bcas rnams/ /gzhal yas byin rlabs 'byon par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ do nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas/ rang bzhin gyi dpa' bo chen po slar yang dpa' bo chen por byin gyis brlabs so/ /sang nang par rdo rje'i brag la nyi ma rtse shar ba'i dus su/ /rdo rje brag gi byang ldebs na gsang ba'i brag khung zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro mas sprul ba 'dom gang gru bzhi ba cig yod pa der rgyal bu byon pa dang / rnal 'byor ma lo brgya dang brgyad tsam lon pa 'dra ba / mgo bo dkar pu re ba so rtse mo gsum la rtsa ba gcig tu byas pa de 'dra ba cig 'dug ste/ des rgyal bu mthong ba dang / byis pa khyod ci byed/ khyod 'dod pa yin byas so/ /nga su yin par zhabrul/ khyed mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes bya ba bla ma dri ma med pa'i yum yin mod/ 'o na khyod 'khrul nas 'dug mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes de la rgas pa mi mnga'/ 'khor kyang bye ba 'bum tsam yod pa la/ kho mo mo rengs mo rgas shing 'khogs pa 'di 'dra ba cig las med pa la/ khyed rgyal bu gzhon nu lta bas chog mi shes pa cig 'dug 'u cag gnyis rang mi —238—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'grigs / khyed kyi yul de yang thag ring nga la 'khos ka med pas/ dkyil 'khor yang 'di 'dra ba cig las bya bar ma nus zer nas khru gang ba cig bstan/ 'u cag gnyis sdongs nas sa phyogs der mi phyin zer ro/ /der rgyal bu na re/ lo brgya bas stong lon na'ang lon/ las la ngan te 'gro bar ma nus kyang khur te 'gro 'on kyang las la mi ngan/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs drag sngar yang dka' spyad du ma byas te btsal bas dus ding sang las ma rnyed/ da khar byung ba de lces mi 'phul 'tshal zhus pas/ der khong gi zhal nas/ khyod la ngas chog na do nub 'dir sdod/tshogs kyi 'khor lo chung ngu cig kyang bskor/ da dbul bas tshogs rdzas kyang chen po med de/ mdze pho'i klad pa thod chung gang yod/ khyod la'ang sbyin ngas kyang spyad gsungs nas/ maṇḍal khru gang bo de byin gyis rlob cing gda' ba la/ rgyal pos zhus pa/ sngon chad zag pa 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /'dod yon ro mchog brgya ba zos/ /ding sang bar du 'dir las kyang / /zhim zhing skad du rkan sgra tog /chags pa'i gdung ba zhi mdzad pa'i/ /mdze klad bdud rtsi ster ba legs/ /e ma khyed kyang longs spyod na/ /bdag longs spyod par cis mi rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang khong 'dzum mul te tshems rtse gsum pa de'i gseb nas 'od zer zhig 'phros te/ dkyil 'khor de la lan gsum bskor nas dpal gyi pho brang ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas nyi ma nub pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod pa ltag sprod kyi ḍa ma ru thogs pa cig byung nas/ bgres mo de la phyag btsal nas/ pho brang gi g.yon phyogs su 'khod do/ /de nas rim gyis mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum 'tshogs nas pho brang byin gyis brlabs te nang gi gar rigs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad rtses so/ /der ḍa ma ru dang hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgras sa g.yo ba tsam byung ba'i rjes la/ bla ma dri ma med pa zhes bya ba rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa brgyas bskor zhing dbu rgyan dang rna rgyan dang mgul rgyan dang dpung rgyan dang / ska rags dang se mo do dang do shal la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan te/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i gar byed cing pho brang gi g.yas g.yon du 'khod do/ /der mkha' 'gro ma rnams bzhengs te/ rdo rje'i glu bzhes pa ni/ shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ /ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ /mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maṇḍal yod/ /gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ /spang ser po gser gyi lhun po yod/ /dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ /tshon bkra ba gser gyi me tog yod/ /dbyar bkra ba g.yu yi me tog yod/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs / / ri padma stong ldan dbyibs legs pa/ /dus dgun gsum dkar po shel gyi mdog /dus dbyar gsum sngon po g.yu yi mdog /dus ston gsum ser po gser gyi mdog /dus dpyid gsum khra bo gzi yi —239—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mdog /mdog phun sum tshogs pa'i ri bo la/ /ltas khyad par 'phags pa'i mtshan ma yod/ /dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba la/ /dar dmar po rā ga'i cod pan yod/ /mi khyod kyi snyan pa phyogs bcur 'phel/ /dpal be'us ri bskor brgyan pa la/ /nags bkra shis yal 'dab rgyas pa yod/ /mi khyod kyi bu slob phyogs bcur 'phel / / ri bogs chad g.yu yi bum pa la/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan chu mig 'bab/ /mi khyod kyi thugs rjes bsil bar byed/ /gnam sngon mo g.yu bya'i gdugs su phub/ /las nyon mongs tshad pa zhi bar byed/ /mi khyod kyi dge bshes 'phel ba'i rtags/ /ri gsum brag gzhung gnam du mtho/ /nged mkha' 'gro rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa 'dra / / mi khyod kyi gnas der bstan pa spel/ /sa rtse brgyad lung ba phyogs su gyes/ /kye 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phab pa 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi mi mthun gcod pa'i rtags/ /thang po'i gseb na ri chung nyal/ /mtsho chen po'i nang gi nya mo 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi spyan snga 'phel ba'i rtags/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /mi khyod kyi zhing khams de na yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /'bru sna tshogs smin pa'i zhing sa can/ /'bru bang mdzod rgyas pa'i rtags su bzang / /shing sna tshogs skyes pa nags kyi khrod/ /gnas khang bzang 'phel ba'i rtags su bzang / /chu mi che rgya mtsho chen po med/ /chu mi chung chu bo dpag med 'bab/ /chu snyoms pas yul mi rtag tu bde/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ gnas de ni khyod kyi zhing khams yin/ /zhing de ni khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ shar lhun po'i rtse nas nyi ma 'char/ /phyogs gzhan gsum mi nor shugs las shes/ /'char mi snga snga dus bsam gtan 'phel/ /'char mi phyi nyi 'od smin pa la/ /lus bag phebs bde bar spyod par byed/ /rgas mi snga pho rab mdun stangs 'phel/ /rgas mi phyi mdzangs ma'i las rnams 'grub/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yul bkra shis 'byung de khyed kyi zhing / /zhing de na khyed kyi gdul bya yod/ /las skal ldan bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /chos dge bcu'i 'od zer bsngo (spro bar byed/ /'od stong ldan 'phro ba nyi ma'i 'od/ /sems dag pa'i dpe ru rab tu bzang / /gling de na khyod nyid nyi ma shar/ /gling de na bag phebs khyod la blta/ /pha 'brom ston skad du mchod par byed/ /nga dge bsnyen skad du dman cha 'dzin/ /grogs su dang 'grogs kyang chos su 'char/ /rgyud ma smin dag la las 'bras ston/ khyod rang bzo mi byed sde snod 'dzin/ /rje sangs rgyas bka' la dbang mi za/ /mi khyod kyi bsod nams bsam mi khyab/ /rje snyan pa'i glu gar de gsan nam / / zhes zer ro/ /der bla ma dri ma med par grags pa de thugs mnyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum bstan nas/ sgo gsum nas 'od zer kha dog gsum spros te/ 'od zer dkar po zhig dkon mchog 'bangs la phog dmar po zhig mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phog sngon po zhig rgyal ba nyid la lan gsum bskor te thugs kar nub/ spyan —240—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /g.yon pa'i zur gyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gzigs/ g.yas pa'i zur gyis dkon mchog 'bangs la gzigs / phyag g.yas na sprul pa'i ḍā ma ru bzung / phyag g.yon pa bkra shis kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing gsung tshangs ba'i nga ros 'di skad ces bsgrags pa/ /de de bzhin ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams/ /bod pur rgyal bod kyi mgon po 'di/ /mi kho bo'i sras kyi thu bo yin / / thugs ma sgrib thams cad sal le yang / /thugs sbas pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don spyod/ /rje rgyal ba rnams kyis lung bstan pa'i/ /yul byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs de/ /dbyibs padma stong ldan kha phye ba/ /gdan de la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba bzhugs/ /sras thugs rje chen pos byin gyis rlobs/ /kye dga' ba'i dga' mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs bde ba'i bde mchog sdug bsngal sel/ /chos dge ba'i dge mchog las 'bras zab / / mchog dpag med 'dus pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ /sku brdzid pa gangs ri'i lhun po 'dra/ /gsung brjed pa tshangs pa'i nga ro can/ /thugs brdzid pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas de/ /spyir sems can rnams kyi mgon po yin / / sgos gangs ri'i khrod du rgyal srid skyong / /mi khyod kyi thugs rjes mi skyong ba/ /bdud sdig to can gyis g.yo mi nus/ /mi khyod kyi zhing khams dag pa der/ /rgyud tshul khrims dag pa 'ba' zhig las/ snying mu stegs zhugs pa ga la 'byung / /cheX5 pa sras la gdams nas/ yang / sgra grag stong snyan pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /sku dpag med g.yo ba'i brjed chags ma/ /rje spyan rasagazigs kyi zhing khams su/ /bdud dpag med 'dul zhing pho brang bzhedas / / sras sems dpa'i bka' las ma g.yos par/ /las skal ldan byang chub lam la sbyor/ /dus ding sang nga yi sprul ba zhig /gnas de ru lha 'dre 'dul ba'i phyir/ /las stobs ldan drag po'i gzugs kyis song / /gnas re rer sbyin sreg re re yis/ /rgyud gdug rtsub zhe sdang lha 'dre'i tshogs/ /dus de nyid dag la zhi bar byed / / yul bod khams bde bar byas gyur nas/ /nged sras dang bcas pa der 'dzom ste/ /tshogs dpag med bsags pa'i skal pa can/ /rgyud dag pa rin chen snod ldan pa/ /bcud dge ba'i chos kyis tshim par byed/ /chos theg pa chen po'i dga' ston 'gyed/ khyed mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyang de ru gshegs/ /las stobs dang ldan no mkha' 'gro rnams/ /nyams dpag med dga'o skal ldan ma/ /ma dpag med smin no byang sems ma chos zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ro yum/ /zhes sras dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs la gsung tshangs pa'i nga ro yis/ dus rtag tu dge ba'i glu dbyangs mgur du bzhes so/ /der mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes bya ba de rus pa'i rgyan drug gis sku la brgyan/ phyag g.yas pas thod pa ltag sprod kyi ḍā ma ru bsnams/ phyag g.yon pa bkra shis pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad du/ rje rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la —241—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gson / / mi khyod kyi sras kyi thu bo 'di/ /thugs mngon par shes pa thogs med kyang / /ngas mi shesanyams thag bzhin no skad/ /mi g.yo sgyu can ni gnas 'dir byung / /da kho mo bde ldan gnas su 'khrid/ /mi kho yi phyag rgya byed do skad/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /ma gzhan don dpag med spel phyir du/ /bu rig pa'i khye'u chung spel lo skad/ /mi kho la ser sna ma mchis kyang / /pha rgyal srid 'dzin par byed do skad/ /mi kho la rnam g.yeng med na yang / /'bangs rig pa can rnams dgos so skad/ /mi 'di yi blo gros su yis rtogs/ /nged mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bran 'khol kyang / /nga gsang ba ye shes 'tshol lo skad/ khyed gson dang mgon po dri ma med / / mi khyod kyi sras 'di sbas pa'i bu/ /thugs yon tan rgya mtsho gting du sbed/ /nga ma smin skad du mkha' la 'phyar / / dus ding sang mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /sems rtse gcig bsgrubs kyang 'grub dka' na/ /mi kho bo'i mdun na dga' ba yi/ /gar bkra shisa'agying ba rtse bar byed/ /da myur du bde ldan gnas su 'gro/ /mi 'di yi sprul ba'i pho brang du/ /nga mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyisabaskor/ /tshogs rgya chen rol ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ /nyams bde stong rol ba'i dbyings su skyong / /ngag grag stong hūṃ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs/ /gar rdo rje 'gyings pas sa chen gnon/ /thabs shes rab grags pas bar snang gang / /ngas g.yas su sdang mig bgrad pa yis/ /bdud nag mo 'bum phrag bye ba bzhi/ /ngas g.yon du 'dzum mig bstan pa yis/ /lha dkar po bye ba 'bum phrag 'du/ /ngas rkang pa sa la brdabs pa yis/ /'og klu yi tshogs rnams dbang du 'du/ /gzugs shar du g.yo zhing bskyod pa yis/ /shar dri za'i tshogs rnamasadabang du 'du/ /gzugs lho ru 'gying zhing bskyod pa yis/ /lho grul bum tshogs rnams dbang du 'du/ /gzugs nub tu 'gying zhing bskyod pa yis/ /nub chu lha'i tshogs rnams dbang du 'du / / gzugs byang du 'gying zhing bskyod pa yis/ /byang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams dbang du 'du/ /gzugs steng du bskyod cing 'phar ba yis/ /steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang du 'du/ /nga 'dzum zhing 'dzum zhing 'od zer 'phro / / rgyud las 'phro can rnams sad par byed/ /nga khro zhing khro zhing mche ba gtsigs/ /dgra 'chi bdag bdud ni 'joms par byed/ /gnas de ru sems can smin byas nas/ /nga slar yang u rgyan gnas 'dir 'ong / /rje dkon mchog 'bangs 'di bod du 'gro/ /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yum rnamasa'adul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas der drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgron ma zag med la/ /mi kho yi btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /sa padma 'dab brgyad yul gyi dbus/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa'i 'og /phyogasabakra shis rtags brgyad yod pa'i sa/ /gnas phun sum tshogs pa dam pa'i yul/ /mi khyod kyi zhing khams dam pa —242—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yin / / gnas de ru las can dpag med 'du/ /chos bde stong rol ba'i glu len cing / /nyams bkra shis bde bar skyong ngo zhes/ /nga gsang ba'i ye shes mgur du sgrog /snyan de la gtad dam yab sras gnyis/ /zhes mgur du bzhes pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma gzhan rnams na re/ ma gsang ba ye shes khyod kyi bka'/ /gsung 'gyur ba med par kun tu grags/ /gnas sems can rnams la phan par 'tshal/ /ma grag stong snyan pa'i nga ro can/ /don skye ba med par mgur du bzhes/ nged de la mthu'o yum chen ma/ /zhes smras pa dang / ma gsang ba ye shes kyi zhal nas / / yang gsan dang yab sras mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /lar chos kyi gnas lugs ye stong la/ /nga brag cha'i chos sgra sgrogs par zad/ /chos don la grub pa ci yang med/ /gzhi skye med ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang / /blo ma bcos lhug pa nyid du bzhag /lam gnas med rang grol chen po yin/ /mthar 'gag med 'bras bu chen po la//dpe mi 'da' nam mkha' dag par zad/ /de gsan nam yab sras 'gro ba'i bshes/ /don nyams su long dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /nga gsang ba ye shes de 'dzer to/ /der dkon mchog 'bangs kyi zhal nas/ ma chos kyi gnas lugs de bzhin yin/ /nga gnas lugs de las ma g.yos kyang / /ma 'gro ba'i don du gzugs su shar//gzugs gzugs kyis stong ngo bden ma 'dzin/ /nga chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /ma 'gro ba'i don du sgra ru shar/ /sgra grag stong brag cha'i snang ba la/ khyed bden par ma 'dzin lhod de skyur/ /nga snang stong 'od kyi snang ba la/ khong mig can zhabrul ba ltad mo che/ /nga gangs ri'i mgul du chos kyi rgyal/ /sems g.yo sgyu med par gsong por smra/ /chos nus mthu btsan pas gzhan la phan/ /mi bdag gis yon tan sgam por sped/ /sems chags sdang bral bas gzhan la phan/ /nga snying rje che bas /ka 67 na6 zhing khams dag gzhan la phan/ /nga sna tshogs sprul ba ston na yang / /rgyud ma dag rnams la ci cha yod/ /nga bud med rnams la bur ston yang / /ma snying med rnams la ci cha yod/ /mi dbul ba dag la nor ston yang / khong mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /thang skam po dag la chur 'byin kyang / /mi mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /mi nad kyis gdungs la sman ston kyang / /nad sgrib pas g.yogs la ci cha yod/ /nga khrims ldan mkhan por skur ston kyang / /nga thugs rje chen por su yis shes / / nga gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /rgyud gang la gang phan ston gyur kyang / /mi mkhas par rlom la ci cha yod / / mi nga yi sprul ba phyogs ris med/ /chos lam du 'gro na bsgrub bya yin/ /mi nga yi bstan pa bzhig pa rnams / / tshe 'di la'ang tshe srog thung na yang / /mi nga yi la yogs shes mi 'gyur/ /bod kha ba can gyi gdul bya rnams / / bu snying med pa la gshe ba bzhin/ /nga phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin chen la/ /sems rtog pa che zhes smod par byed/ /kye khyung chen mkha' la lding ba la/ /bya 'tshal bu khyim nas 'phya ba bzhin/ /nga ye shes dbyings su —243—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lding ba la/ /sems khong skran can de 'phya bar byed/ /lar bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su/ /lha dkon mchog spyi bor mchod pa las/ /bdag nga rgyal rlom par ga la yod/ /mi bdag gi zhing khams gangs can der/ /lha thub pa'i nyan thos chen po mchog /rje gnas brtan bcu drug der bzhugs nas/ /rje rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' bar / / mi bdag gi bka' rgyud 'dzin par byed/ /kye rang rgyud tha rgod thul ba yi/ khong dge slong dpal ldan khur ba'i phyir/ /nga tshangs spyod dpal ldan dge bsnyen du/ /lus dman pa'i tshul du gnas par byed/ /kye gosala'ang brnyas par mi byed na/ khong dge 'dun mchod par cis mi rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/khyod bod kyi rgyal por skur bstan te/ /bod mtha' 'khob smin par byas gyur nas/ /slar po ta la yi rtse mo la / / chos dge ba bcu yi 'od zer 'gyed/ /bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /mi khyed kyi sprul ba dam pa cig / 'bangs mgon med mang po 'dren du 'gro/ /ri gangs kyi rwa bas bskor ba yis/ /thang ser po gser gyi maṇḍal la/ /rtsibs mu khyud stong gis legs brgyan te/ /rje rgyal ba stong gis byin brlabs pa'i/ /gser dri ma med pa'i mchod rten yod/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis dga' ba'i tshal/ /nyams bag phebs dga' bar skyong ba'i sa/ /kye rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag gcig /sems rtse gcig 'cham pa'i go ra yin/ /mi rgyal ba khyed kyis der bzhugs te/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag skyong byed cing / /thugs sbas pa'i tshul gyis gzhan don spyod/ /ma 'gro ba mang po smin par byed/ /yang mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/ byang rgyal po chen po'i mdun drung na/ /thang sngon po g.yu yi maṇḍal la/ /rtsibs mu khyud stong gis brgyan pa ste/ /rje rgyal ba stong gis byin brlabs pa'i/ /g.yu dri ma med pa'i mchod rten yod/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dga' ba'i tshal/ /nyams bag phebs dga' ba skyong ba'i sa / / kye rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag cig /sems rtse gcig 'chams pa'i go ra yin/ khong pha ma grangs med 'dren slad du/ /mi rgyal ba khyod kyis der bzhugs te/ /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag skyong byed cing / /thugs sbas pa'i tshul gyis gzhan don spyod/ /ma 'gro ba mang po smin par byed/ /yang mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/ mi spyan rasagazigs kyi dbang po khyed/ /sa brtan pa gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /rgyan rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ /rgyan la la gser gyi rus sbal yod/ /rgyan la la g.yu yi lcong mor yod/ /rgyal la la mchong gi sbal bar yod/ /klu dpag med nges par gnas gyur te/ /nor bang mdzod rtag tu 'bul byed cing / /nged mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi go ra la / / yid rtag tu gus pas 'dud par byed/ /sa de la bzhugs te bstan pa skyong / /nged mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ / chos zag pa med pa'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /mi dpa' bo dmag dpon rin chen mchog /mtshon —244—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /thogs med shes rab ral gri 'dzin/ /bdud phas rgol 'joms shing khyod la 'dud/ /mi khyim bdag rin chen dpal 'byor can/ /nor rin chen bdud ldan ser sna 'joms/ /mi khyod la 'dud cing gus par bzhugs/ /lha btsun mo rin chen mdzangs ldan ma/ /rgyud nyon mongs chags pas ma gos pa/ /mi khyod kyi rnam byang skyed par byed / / gzhi glang po rin chen theg pa can/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong dpal 'byor khur/ /mi khyod kyi bstan pa 'degs par byed/ /rdzas nor bu rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /las smon lam dag pa'i dbang po 'dzin/ /mi khyod kyi bsam par 'grub par byed/ /rgyan rta mchog rin chen rdzu 'phrul can/ /'gros tshad med shugs kyis pha rol bgrod / / mi khyod kyi 'phrin las rgyas par byed/ /sa padma 'dab brgyad byin chags pa/ /rje rgyal ba sras bcas der bzhugs nas/ /mi khyed kyi byin rlabs dpung du bskyed/ /steng 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rgyan du phul/ / chos zab mo lta bas rten gyur nas/ /las dngos 'dzin gdung ba sel bar byed/ /chu zag med bstan pa'i chu rgyun 'bab / / nags mthug po slob ma'i mtha' rgya can/ /ri lhun po rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khyed/ /dbyibs phun tshogs rgyal ba'i zhal du gda'/ /nged mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams gnas der 'du/ /mi khyed kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub (sgrub1par byed/ /thang dkar po shel gyi maṇḍal la/ /nged rdo rje mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /nyams dpag med dga' ba'i go ra 'cha'/ /gnas de ru mgon po khyed bzhugs te/ /nged rdo rje mkha' 'gro skyong byed cing / / mkha' 'gro mang po skyob bar byed/ /ces 'dzer to/ /yang mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/ /sngon phyogs bcu) rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /thang lag mthil ltar mnyam beeḍūrya/ /'phangs mthon po gser gyi ba gam can/ /gnas gzhal yas chen por byin gyis brlabs/ /des ya mtshan ngang gis 'byung ba ni/ /tshon kha dog bkra ba me tog rigs / / grangs sum cu rtsa gsum rgyun du 'khrungs/ /dus da dung rgyal ba dpag med bzhugs/ /rje rgyal ba rnams la 'khrungs pa yi/ /sras nyan thos chen po'i mchod rten brgya/ /sras rang sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten brgya/ /sras byang chub sems dpa'i mchod rten brgya/ /rje rgyal ba nyid kyi brgya phrag gnyis/ /kye phun tshogs mchod rten lnga brgya yod/ /zhing der ni mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /dus rtag tu bskor zhing 'khod par byed/ khyed sa bcu'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na bzhugs te gzhan don mdzad/ /ces zer ro/ /yang mkha' 'gro ma cig na re/ /kye bdag cag mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /lte re res glu dbyangs mgur bzhes kyang / /gnas gang zag bcas pa'i yon tan rnams/ /dus bskal bar brjod kyang mi rdzogs pas/ /nga mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum phrag kyang / / rje rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ khong bla mas gsungs pa kun la gsal/ /thugs rtse gcig thams cad gral la 'khod/ /ces zer nas/ dpa' mo rnams kyis g.yon du 'khod/ /dpa' bo brgya phrag cig gis g.yas —245—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/su 'khod/ bla ma dri ma med pas gung mnan te/ mngon par shes pa chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams la/ gnas der shel gong dag pa ltar mngon du gsal na'ang gnas dang gang zag gi yon tan ji lta ba bzhin brjod na 'gro ba thams cad la bde skyid 'byung bas thams cad thugs mthun par rgyal bas lung bstan pa ni/shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /pur rgyal bod kyi zhing khams grags pa can/ /sgos su kha ba can ljongs khyad 'phags na/ /nying sgos dbu ru byang phyogs de'i gnas/ /klung shod nag po tho rgyud 'brom gyi yul/ /chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /sa gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'di lta ste/ /ra zhes bya ba 'dod chags rdul dang bral/ /chags pa med pa dam pa'i chos kyi sgo/ /ra zhes bya ba zhe sdang rdul dang bral/ /byams pa chen po dam pa chos kyi sgo/ /ra zhes bya ba gti mug rdul dang bral / / shes rab chen po dam pa chos kyi sgo/ /ra zhes bya ba phrag dog rdul dang bral/ /mnyam nyid chen po dam pa chos kyi sgo/ /ra zhes bya ba nga rgyal rdul dang bral/ /zhi dul bag yod dam pa chos kyi sgo/ /sgo lnga'i rgyal mtshan/ mi g.yo brtan pa de/ /yod min med min skye med mthar thug par/ /mi mnyam rgyas par rtag tu sgreng bar byed/ /de ni spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang yin/ /gnas mchog de ru 'gro ba gang skyes pa/ /sngon gyi las 'phro stobs ldan sad pa yin/ /de ni ri bo po ta la dang mtshungs/ /gang gi bde 'bras rtag tu 'phel bar byed/ /sprul pa'i dbu la rigs lnga'i chos skus brgyan/ /rnam par snang mdzad chags med shes rab spyod/ /mi bskyod ting 'dzin bsam gtan bsgom par byed/ /rin chen 'byung gnas brtson 'grus mtshungs pa med/ /snang ba mtha' yas bzod stobs glang po che/ /don yod grub pa tshul khrims bde 'bras 'dzin/ /chos sku chags pa med pa'i spyin pa ste / / ser snas ma gos nor bu rin chen yang / /gdul bya'i bde 'bras bskrun phyir sbyin par mdzad/ /sprul pa'i dbu la sde snod gsum gyis brgyan/ /'dul ba khrims ldan dge 'dun rin chen te/ /mdo sde sems ldan dam chos rin chen yin/ /mngon pa shes rab sangs rgyas ngo bo ste/ /dkon mchog gsum ldan 'gro la bde skyid 'byin / / dkar po dmar po leb rgan btsod kha ste/ /dbu yi spyi gtsug 'od zer snang ba can/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid spel phyir phyogs bcur 'phro/ /bzhin ni gser gyi me long phyis pa 'dra/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus gsal bar byed/ /bye ba 'bum phrag ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /gnas de spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang yin / / mgon po spyan ras gzigs khyed der byon tshe/ /gser gyi pad sdong yal 'dab stong ldan pa/ /dbus na yum chen pha rol phyin ma bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas rab tu bskor byas te/ /zag med chos kyi dga' —246—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams buchos bzhugs so/ /ston 'gyed par byed/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang 'di/ /sras kyi thu bor nges par byin gyis rlobs/ /sras 'di'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /zhing khams nyi khri chig stong tshang bar gnas/ /de las 'od zer nyi khri chig stong 'phros/ /gnas der pad sdong nyi khri chig stong 'khrungs/ /re re la'ang yal 'dab nyi khri dang / /chig stong dbyibs dang kha dog rab tu gsal/ /de la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dpag med bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid dpal 'byor skrun par byed/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus dang bcas pa na/ /shel dang gser dang zangs dang g.yur bcas pa'i/ /chu mig brgya phrag cig dang bcu gsum yod/ /gang gis de 'thungs sdug bsngal zhi bar byed/ /rdzing bu brgya phrag cig dang bcu gsum yod/ /gang gis de 'thungs rgyal ba dag tu nges/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs drung 'byin mgon po 'di'i/ /ba spu'i bu ga re na'ang rgyal ba yi/ /zhing khams dpag tu med pa bzhugs na yang / /rgyal ba'i zhing khams nyi khri chig stong las/ /lhag par bkod pa ma mdzad mkha' 'gro kun/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'jig rten sgron ma/ yi/ /zhing kham/sa dang/ga med rang gi spyod yul ba/ /nan thos chen pos bltas kyang ma/theng ma/ yin/ /nam mkha'i ma/tha' khyab 'jig rten dpag med du/ /ba spu'i khung ba'i zhing khams ston par byed/ /e ma sras kyi thu bo snying gi mchog /nam ma/kha'i mtha' khyab zhing khams dpag med du/ /'gro ba dpag med don du mgon po 'di/ /sku yi bkod pa du ma/ra ston nga/ra byed/ /nyi ma zla ba rgyu skar 'ong lden dang / /rin chen lhun po dpag med brjid chags dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal rgyal ba'i skur ston cing / /gang snyer/ rtog pa mi mnga' lham mer gsal/ /re 'ga' rang byon rdo sku shing dang ni/ /ri mor bris dang yig 'bru dag tu'ang 'byung / /res 'ga' bu dang bu mo bran 'khor dang / khang pa khang bzang skyed mos tshal dang ni/ /chu dang chu phran gzings dang zam pa dang / /rta dang glang ngo/ rin chen khri steng dang / /'gro ba gang snye3 sang riges/ der sprul te / / gang gi 'dod pa thams cad tshim par byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang / /yang mokha' rerngo ru rngar/sa bzhengs nas / dga' ba'i gar rtse zhing / snyan pa'i tshig 'di skad ces grags pa/ bla ma khyed kyi thugs la 'khrul ba med//de yi(1 blangs ca co mi mnga' ba'i/ /brjid pa'i sku ldan de ltar gsungs pa legs/ /gsal lo gsal lo ma 'dresaphyed par gsal/ /ra ni rang bzhin rnam dag rang gis stong / /rang gi mtshan nyid rang rang rang dngas la//rang rig rang gsal rig pa rang gi mchog /rang ni rang bral rang la ngo bo med/ /rang bral chos dbyings rang gi mtshan nyid yin/ /rang nyid rang med rang la gzhi med pa/ /rang byung ye shes rang gi ngo bor rgyal/ /rags pa med phyir rags sogs bral ba yi/ /rang byung rang rgyal gnas 'di rgyal bar byed/ /rig pa'i lam ldan rig pa'i lam la 'gro/ /rig pa gcer bu dri mas ma gos pa/ /rdul med rdul bral ra yi rang bzhin te/ /sa ga khyed kyi —247—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kye skor/gnas su de bzang ngo / /sa ni brtan pa gser gyi sa gzhi yin/ /ga ni gang la gang gang chags med pa/ /rkyen yang gang yin sgra yi ngo bo nyid/ /nga zhes thugs rje chen po khyod kyi gnas/ /rwa sgreng dpal gyi gtsug lag khang zhes pa / /u rgyan mkha' 'gro bye ba dpag med kyi/ /sgra skad thun mong ma yin gnas der sgrogs/ /de ni bdag ngo/sa ma bzung gang gis kyang / /spyi ming tsam yang sgos kyi ming ma/ grags/ /'on kyang chu la ming btags car ci 'bod / / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i dpal/ /gnas de byin gyis rlob cing lhun por saza—dmag dpon dpa' bo khyim bdag 'byor ba can/ /btsun mo rin chen glang po theg pa can/ /nor bu rin — skumachog rdzu 'phrul can/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong dpag med mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi rgyal srid bskyang phyir 'khod/ /steng na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'phags lam brgyad/ /rnam dag lta ba mdzes pa yas kyi phub/ /rnam dag spyod pa rgyas par mtha' rnams rgyas/ /ngag dang 'tsho ba rtsol ba phun sum tshogs/ /dran dang ting 'dzin shes rab phun tshogs pa'i/ /sa chen padma 'dab brgyad dag pa la/ /mi dbang khyed bzhugs shin tu dben pa ni/ /gnam sa ga'u kha sbyar lta bus mdzes/ /zhes snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa dpag tu med pa mgur du bzhes nas mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum phrag de dag las 'od zer ser po de cam zhig 'phros te/ rdo rje 'jin pa dri ma med pa dpa' bo brgyas bskor ba la'ang mchod la/ lhag par du rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs la mched cing sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ 'dod yon chen po lnga/ phung po lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo la rnam pa mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo'i cha lugs su gnas pa la/ chags pa med pa'i chul gyis mchod cing rol lo/ /de nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad dkyil 'khor cig tu 'khod pa snyepa/ dkon mchog 'bangs kyis/bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ mched grogs rdo rje'i spun brgya phrag dang bcas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro / / rin chen mkha' 'gro la sogs pa thabs dang shes rab chen po'i dkyil 'khor la nga ro'i skad kyi 'di skad du/ skye med chos dbyings chen po'i gzhal yas na/ /sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar byed mkha' 'gro kun/ /rnam dag shes rab mchog la rtog mi mnga'/ /rgyus stong skye bral 'bras bu mi mnga' ba'i/ /rol ba chen por 'di skad gsung ba thos/ /ma 'dzin ma 'dzin yul la bden pa med/ /ma bzung ma bzung sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis bral chos dbyings chen po la/ /dkon mchog 'bangs kyis gsang ba ye shes 'dren/ /da ni bde ldan gnas su 'gro bar byed/ /dad ldan bde spyod rgyal po bya ba yod/ /bdag gi yum chen kun tu bzang mo yin / / sprul ba'i pho brang nyams dga' dpag med pa/ /rin chen gzhal yas mchungs pa med pa der/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs gnas der gshegs/ /dri ma med par grags pa rig pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa brgya phrag —248—

'brom/ ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /cig gis bskor/ /gnas der thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs nga/ra 'chal/ khyed ni 'gro 'ong kun las 'das na yang / /bltar re/da brjod 'das dga' ba'i nyam/sa skyong ba/ /g.yo med rdo rje'i gar ni phyogs bcur bgrod/ /de ni bdag gis gsol gyis dus la bab/ /ces gsol ba dang / bla ma rdo rje 'jin pa dri ma/ med par grags nga/ des shes rab sgron ma/ zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'arngin la ma/nyam par bzhag ste/ shar phyeogs bde ldan gyis yul ga la ba der gzigs nas/ sarba bud dha ḍā gi ma// shar phyegs bde ldan gyi gnas su jaḥ/ zhes gsungs nga/ dang /mkha' 'gro ma/ gsang ba ye shes ra/ gtogs pa tham/sa cad rang gi gnas su gshegs so/ /rgyal bu dkon ma/chog 'bangs dang / ma/kha' 'gro ma/ gsang ba ye shes ni rang gi rdzu 'phrul dang / bla ra/ rdo rje 'jin nga/'i byin rlabs la brten nas yud cam zhig la bde spyed sprul ba'i pho brang du snyesnags so/ /der phyogs de na sngar gyi lug rdzi ba de gnas nga/sa sngar med pa'i bu me zhig sprul nga/'i pho brang gi sgo drung na 'dug pa mthong ba dang / rgyal bu yod nga/ra shes te/ pho brang gi nang du phyin nga/ na/ de na rin po che gser gyi khri yod pa la rgyal bu sngar gyi de las kyang lhag pa/ra zhal 'jum/ pa dang bcas te gzigs pa/ ra/thong / 'o na ma/kha' 'gro ma/ gsang ba ye shes kyang yod nges snyam nas/ banee ra/ ri/sa/ /g.yu'i khri yod pa la rnal 'byor ma/ rban mo ral ba dkar po'i thor cog can lo brgya lhag lon pa 'dra ba 'ig snyeridug pa ma/thong nas/ rgyal ngo/'i drung du phyin te phyag bcal/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces gsol ba/ kye ches rgyal sprul pa'i sku khyed u rgyan shul ring bgrod dka' ba'i lam/ du bar chad ma mchis sam/ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin don grub bam/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gsang ba'i ye shes gang na mchis/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ thag ring kyang kho bo la bar chad mi/ ma/nga' skal ba dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi bsod nam/sa las don kyang 'grub/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ gsang ba ye shes de g.yu'i khri la bzhugs pa 'di yin gsungs pas/lug rdzi na re/ rig 'dzin gyi mkha' 'gro ma lus sem/sa la dbang thob pa la re rgan/ rgyal bu ni gzhon nur gyur ba mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras na/ grogs dang grogs can du ji ltar 'os zhes zhus pa dang / khyod lta bu'i sems can la rgan mor snang ba yang ya mtshan gyi/ gathen du na ni mi mthong ba nyid yin no// khyod la la la ltas nas dag pa'i snang ba can yin mod kyis/ mo'i rang bzhin la ltos nas ni 'khrul bas/ ngas byin gyis brlabs kyis / khyod rang bzod gsol gyis gsung ste byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdzi bos ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gzigs pas/ dwangs shing yid ches pa'i dad pa skyes nas/ blo 'khrul ba dag pa'i 'dod pa skyes te/ 'di skad cebasagasol ba/ /rab rib can dag gzhi med pa'i/ /gtsang ma'i snod dag skra yis gang / /sman gyis 'azhen par ma //ra bar/ /skra shad log pa nyid du rtog /sman pa mkhas pas gsos pa na/ /sngon chad dag la the tshom za da —249—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ni snang yang bden zhen bral/ /phyis ni the tshom tsam yang 'jig /bdarga ridra'i byis pa ma rig pas/ /chos kyi gnas lugs mi shebashashing / /mkha' 'gro lus sems dbang thob la/ /bgres pa'i rnam par 'khrul bar gyur/ /sems kyi kun slong ngag smras pa/ /mkha' 'gro khyod la bzod par gsol/ /phyin chad ma rig dag gyur te/ /don gyi gnas lugs mthong bar shog /ces smras pa dang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ khyod ni gang zag dam pa ste/ /sprul pas byin brlabs snod du gyur/ /rang rgyud dri mas ma gos par/ /bzod par gsol zhing smon lam 'debs/ /zhes gsung ngo / /der rgyal bu dgyes te/ thun mong du smras pa/ smon lam dbang gi gnas 'dir 'tshogs / / ma 'ongs 'di ni kho bo'i sras/ khri mchog dpal zhes yon tan ldan/ /rnal 'byor chos nyid rang ngo shes / / mkha' 'gros lung bstan rwa sgreng der/ /nga yi gdams pa'ang 'dzin par byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang /mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ ding sang nga la rgan mor mthong phyis dag pa'i snang ba shar ba'i rten 'brel gyis 'di de'i dus du khyed la dang por dam pa mi 'dzin gyis/ de nas khyed kyi 'phrin las kyi khyod kyi chos bstan pa'i snod du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung ngo / /der rdzi bo mnyes te/ bla ma de ltar yin na kho bo lhag par dga' ste slar yang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud par byed do/ /zhes phyag gsum byas te spyan sngar 'dug go /der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ de ring snga bar pho brang bde ldan du song la/ yab rgyal po'i snyan du 'di skad gsol cig /mi dbang khyod kyi sras mchog de/ /bar chad med par gnas 'dir mchis/ /lam du bar gcod mkha' 'gros bsrungs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'ang gnas 'dir byon/ /sprul pa'i pho brang bcud kyis gtams/ /slar yang rje dang mjal bar gda' / / zhes zhus shig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas kyang / kun tu bzang mo'i drung du song / khyod kyi spruruwa pa'i sras mchog de/ /ding sang gnas 'dir yum dang bcas/ /nye zho med par bde bar lhags/ /da ni myur du khyed dang mjal/ khyod kyang bag yod bde bar spyod/ /mkha' 'gro tshogs kyang gnas 'dir lhags/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyang bsham par 'tshal/ /be ta'i yul du pho nya thong / /yab chen dpal ldan yum bcas la/ /sprul pa'i rgyal bu lhags gyur bas/ /gnas 'dir dga' ba'i sems kyi byon/ /dge 'dun dag kyang spyan drangs 'tshal/ /mchod pa'i tshogasakyang snoms la byon/ /mi ring myur du sleb par gyis/ /zhes smros shig bgyi'o zhes bde spyod kyi pho brang ga la ba der lhags pa dang / rgyal po bde spyod na re/ rdzi bo khyod kyang de ring snga/ kho bo'ang de ring yid dga' 'di lasaskad snyan pa cig kyang zer zhing 'dug khyad par du'ang ding sang gi rmi ltas kyang bzang zhes smras pa dang / rdzi bo na re/ de rgyal po bden/ mi dbang khyed kyi sras lhagasanas gda'o zhes sngar gyi 'phrin de dag smras pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khong shul thag ring po nas 'ong ba la/ bsu ba bya ba'ang ma byung / da ni yun mi —250—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ring bar mjal bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /rdzi bos kun tu bzang mo'i drung du'ang phyin te/ khyod kyi sras yum dang bcas pa'ang lhags nas gda'o/ /zhes sngar gyi 'phrin smras pa dang / yum mthong lam skyes pa bzhin du dga' zhing / rang gi bya ba bsgrub (sgrubakapa'i blon po dag yab kyi sar pho nyar brdzangs te/ sngar mkha' 'gros bskur ba'i 'phrin de dag kyang nyid 'phrin du bskur ro/ /pho nyas rgyal po dpal ldan gyi pho brang du lhags pa dang / rgyal po dpal ldan gyi rtog pa la/ /pho nya 'di'i 'ong lugs dang / /do zhag rmi ltas bzang ba dang / bde ldan na dmag g.yo ba med par nges/ sprul ba'i rgyal bu de sleb pa yin nam snyam ste/ sa thag ni ring snyam du rtog pa'i tshe na/ dge slong nyi ma'i 'od ces bya ba de bzhengs nas byung ste rgyal po khyod gzhan du ma rtog cig rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog /ka73 na3 rgogasum gyis/gis byin gyis brlabs pa de/ u rgyan gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med pa la gdams pa mang po thob/ dbang bzhi thams cad rdzogs par nos nas/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes rab tu byin gyis brlabs nas/ ding sang bde ldan sprul pa'i pho brang na lhags nas yod de/ pho nya 'di dag ni de'i ltas yin / der rgyal po mthong lam skyes pa ltar dga' nas rang gi blon po rnams la pho nya de dag nang du spyan drangs (drongasakashig ces gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du blon po dag gis kyang nang du spyan drangs so/ /der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ blon po dag snyan pa'i gtam skyel du 'ongs sam gsungs pa la/ sngar gyi 'phrin rnams snyan du gsol lo / / der rgyal po'i zhal nas/ khyed blon po dang / btsun mo'i tshogs su bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshogs khyer te/ bde ldan gyi gnas su sprul pa'i rgyal bu mjal du 'deng zhes bka' bsgo ba dang / btsun mo gsal ldan ma na re/ 'o na mchod pa byed pa la dge 'dun yang dgos pas spyan drang bar 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ dge slong nyi ma'i 'od zer na re/ nged mchod yul sngon 'gro ba mi 'ong gis/ sngon la khyed song la mchod pa shom/ de nas spyan 'dren la ma ltos par 'ong gis shes gsungs pa dang / de de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/ rgyal po dpal ldan/btsun mo gsal ldan ma blon po dang bcas pas/ byi ru dang man shel dang a ka ru dang bdug spos la sogs pa khyer te bde ldan gyi gnas su lhags so/ /der rgyal po bde spyod btsun mo kun tu bzang mo dang bcas pas grong khyer gyi gzhi mdo nas bsus te tshig 'di skad du/ be ta'i yul gyi pho brang nas/ /rgyal po dpal ldan 'khor dang bcas / / ding sang dga' bar gnas 'dir phebs/ /lam du nyams par ma gyur tam/ /bde bar pho brang nang du gshegs / / sprul pa'i rgyal bu'ang der byon no/ /zhesasmras pa dang / rgyal po dpal ldan na re/ sprul pa de la phyag 'tshal du/ /de ring bdag cag gnasa'adir lhags/ khyed kyang gnyug mar bde gyur tam/ /pho brang nang du —251 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gshegs par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs nas/ bde spyod kyi pho brang du byon pa dang / gnyug mar gnas pa'i kun spyod dul bar mdzad do/ /der sprul pa'i pho brang na/ rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs bcun mo dang bcas pa bzhugasapas gzigs te/ dkon mchog 'bangs na re/ de ring yab kyi pho brang na mes 'khor dang bcas pa lhags nas gda' bas/ pho brang 'dir spyan drang 'tshal zhes smras pa dang / gsang ba ye shes na re/ yab yum gyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo cig bskor bas/ /yab kyi pho brang nyid du gshegs so zhes smras pa dang / de ltar dgongs nas gshegs par zhu zhes yab bde spyod kyi pho brang ga la ba der phyin to/ /der yum dang mes 'khor dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa la chos rgyal sprul ba'i sku de 'dir byon nas gda' bas gsang ba ye shes de yang lta bas chog mi shes pa cig yod nges snyam nas/ pho brang gi sgor bsu ba dang / rgyal bu sngar gyi bas kyang khyad par du 'phagos pa tsam du gda' ba la/ gsang ba ye shes ni shin tu bgres pa zhig 'dug nas yid ma ches te/ mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ mi dbang sras mchog u rgyan du/ /gsang ba ye shesa'adren no zhes/ khri1la rings bgrod dka'i lam la song / khyod med bdag cag 'khrumasapar gyur/ /u rgyan gnas de gzigs gyur tam / / dbang bzhi dag kyang thob gyur tam/ /dri ma med pa'i zhal mthong ngam/ /gsang ba ye shes 'di lags sam / / ding sang byon zhes dga' bar gyur/ /mchod phyir pho brang nang du gshegs/ /brgya phrag 'phags ge/ 'i tshogasarnams la/ /snyan gsan phab ste 'dir byon zhes/ /gsol ba btab pa'i 'byon par bzhes/ ldachong pa'i tshogs kyang sbyar te mchis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /ding sang bag chags brtan par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs spyan drangs nas/ dkon mchog 'bangs mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa gdan bshams pa la zhugs te/yab yum mes dang bcas pa la 'di skad du/ khyed cag bsod nams bsags pa yi/ kho bo bu dang tsha ru 'khrungs / / bdag kyang bsod nams bsags pa yis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /u rgyan gnasasu phyin pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas rig 'dzin du/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur tshangs par mdzad/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi gtso/ /gsang ba ye shes 'di yin na/ /rnyed par dka' ba gnas 'dir 'drongs/ /ma dag blo can the tshom za/ /dag pa dga' ba nang du rgyas/ /da ni do nub tshogs 'khor byed / / mchod pa dag kyang rgyas par bshams/ /nged kyis dag par byin gyisabarlab/ /ces smras pa dang / yum na re/ khyod kyis sprul pa'i pho brang mthong ba'i dbang gis dge 'dun brgya phrag cig gnas 'dir 'byon pa dang /mkha' 'gro tshogs kyang gnas 'dir spyan 'dren pa la pho brang 'dis rngo mi thogs te/ sgrub par gang nusabyed kyis khyed kyis kyang byin gyisabarlobs (rlobs3zhes zhus pa dang / gsang ba ye shes kyi zhal na re/ nga shong ba —252

'brem ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rang gis pho brang rgyas par mchi yis/ gzhan du na khyed kyi mchod pas kyang mi ldang / khyed rang thugs las chung ngur gyis shig /bo mos bya yis gsungs nas mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so/ /der rgyal po yab yum mes blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dgongs pa cig tu do nub mkha' 'gro ma mang po 'byon/ dge 'dun brgya phrag cig gis kyang 'dir 'byon pa zhal gyis bzhes na mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes ni dkyil 'khor kyang mi gshom / chod pa dang gtor ma'i tshogs kyang mi byed par gda' na/ da ni nyi ma'ang phyi mor song snyam nas rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs la smras pa/ do nub mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs mang po'ang 'ong zhing dge 'dun brgya phrag mang po la'ang snyan gsan phab yod pa la/ khyed yab yum ni dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i tshogs kyang mi bsham na ci la dgongs dus la bab gda'o/ /zhus pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ kho bos mkha' 'gro ma la zhu yis/ ngang ma thung zer nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i drung du phyin te/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa bsham ran / ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs par zhu zhes ṭa/sa pas lan ma byung / /der cung zhig tsam na mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs ka na tshur 'od dkar po cig nar gyis byung ba'i rjes su sgo mi gang ba cig dod nas byung / de ci yin mkha' 'gro ma mi gang tsam gyi thugs ka nas/ sgo yang mi tsam dod pa 'di bdag mig 'khrul ba yin nam snyam nas bltas pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug ste/ 'o na mkha' 'gro ma'i lus kyang chen per gyur to snyam nasabaltas pas kyang chen por mi 'dug 'o na ci yin snyam du the tshom zos pa na/ cung zhig len pa na/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgra chen po zhig thos te bltas pas/ ci yang ma mthong / sgra de ni 'ur sgra dang tshegs sgra cher song ba'i 'phro la thugs ka'i sgo de nas/ bu mo sku mdog dkar mo 'od gsal ba 'phro ba shel phyis pa lta bu zhig la/ skra snum la gnag pa rked so na mar la slebs pa/ lus la rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ snyan ngag du ma dang ldan pa'i ngag sgrogs pa/ dngul dkar gyi me long thogs pa zhig snying byas te/phyi'i lus 'di ni pho brang mi gsob kyi snang ba can yin gyi/ kho mo gsang ba ye shes zhes bya ba dge slong dri ma med pa'i yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro la sogs pa bye ba 'bum gyi gtso mo mi khyed kyi dka' spyad du ma byas nas btsal ba de 'di lags so/ /nang 'di na dkyil 'khor chen po yangs shing rgya che ba yang bshams/ tshogalokyi /ka 75 na1 rgo'akhor lo'i/rdzasakyang rgyud dang 'tsham par tshang bar mchis/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum kyang gral gyi g.yon la 'khod nas bzhugs/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med pas tshogs kyi gung mnan/ rig pa dzin pa brgya phrag cig gral gyi g.yas la 'khod/ khyed rang gi mes dpal ldan gyi mchod gnas dge 'dun brgya phrag cig kyang thabs cig tu g.yas la 'khod/ mdor na bla 253

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ma rdo rje 'dzin pas dbu mdzad rig pa 'dzin pa brgya phrag gnyis/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa pho brang gi nang na bzhugs pas/ khyed rang yang yab yum mes dang bcas pa tshogs rdzas gang 'byor khyer la pho brang gi nang du shog ces gsungs nas/ dkon mchog 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pas kyang / de bzhin du bsgrubs te nang du phyin pa dang / ji skad gsung ba bzhin du bsam gyis mi khyab cing blos mi 'khyud pa gda' ba la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba dpag tu med pa skyes so/ /de nasatshogasakyi slob dpon rdo rje 'dzin pa dri ma med pa'i tshogs dang gzhal yas khang thams cad bsam gyi mi khyab par byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro dang rig 'dzin thams cad bzhengs te/ dpa' bo'i gar/ dpa' mo'i gar/ khro bo'i gar/ khro mo'i gar/ zhi ba'i gar / nang gi gar/ gsang ba'i gar/ de kho na nyid kyi gar/ khro bo la yang / khro bo 'dzum pa'i gar/ khro bo shin tu khros pa'i gar/ /mdor na gar rigs sum brgya drug cu las/ /phyi'i gar ma gtogs pa thams cad mdzad do/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi gar ni 'di lta ste/ /bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur bstan pa'i dgra /dpa' bo dpa' bosarab tu brdung zhing 'khrab/ /nyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa spyan mig glog ltar 'byug /nem nem ling ling sachen g.yo bar byed/ /'ur 'ur chem chem 'brug stong rab tu sgrogs/ /mer mer yom yom rgya mtshor rab tu 'khrugs/ /nyal nyal shig shig bdud sde 'joms par byed/ /g.yas 'degs g.yon gnon snang mig bgrad de blta/ /g.yon 'desas g.yas gnon gnam la 'phar bar byed/ /mi mgyogs mi bul bskyod pa rdo rje'i 'gros/ /phyi phyer bskor zhing slar yang nang du 'gugs/ /g.yas mchongs g.yon rgyug phyogs bcur blta bar byed/ /dpa' mo'i gar ni 'di lta ste/ /bdud mo bye ba dung phyur bstan pa'i dgra/ /ram ram me lce chen pos rab tu sreg /yam yam rlung dmar chen pos g.yo zhing sreg /dud pa dmar nag 'jigs pa sprin du 'khrigs/ /ha ha hi hi hu hu he he ste/ /sna tshogasasgra skad 'byin cing rab tu 'khrab/ /g.yas mchongasagayon mchongs mkha' la lding bar byed/ /dpa' bo'i gdong du blta zhing 'byud par byed/ /slar yang phyir nur ling ling phyogs bcur mchongs/ /mgo bo sgril zhing rkang pa sa la brdebs/ /pad skor byed cing kun tu rgyug par byed/ kha nas me 'byin mig nas du ba 'thul/ /chu ltar zhabrugs shing me ltar rab tu tsha/ /rlung ltar g.yo zhing sa ltar rab tu sra/ khro bo gar ni 'di lta ste/ drag po drag pomig gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūṃ zhes rab tu sgrogs/ /rdo rje'i char 'bebasamig dmar phyogasabacur blta/ /ral ba ser po gyen la bskyod byed cing / /dud pa 'thul zhing kha nas me rab 'bar/ /sdigs mdzuspusgreng zhing shib shib sma ra 'gul/ /rab tu 'gying zhing phyogs bcur blta bar byed/ /mchongasashing mchongs shing rab tu rgyug cing blta/ khros shing khros shing mche ba bzhi bcu (cukaston/ /snga ma 'ded cing phyi ma phyi —254—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mar blta/ /sdod cing sdod cing slar yang rgyug par byed/ /rgyug cing rgyug cing slar yang sdod par byed/ /sku stod mi bskyod lus kyi cha smad sprug /cha smad dag kyang mi 'gul sku stod bskyod/ /gnyisachar mi 'gul rked pa bskyod par byed/ /rked pa mi 'gul gnyis char bskyod par byed/ /rdo rje 'gying zhing rab tu 'gying bar byed/ /rkang pa phrag bzhag lag pa gsham la 'byud/ gsus pa 'bur zhing stod smad phyi la dgyed/ /rked pa yan chad drang zhing sku smad lteng / /thams cad sprug cing rab tu 'phar ba yin/ /bzhin bsdus rab tu rngam pa'i cha lugasacan/ /hub 'debs phus 'debs za ba'i rnam 'gyur ston/ khugs ring 'byin cing rab tu phyi la 'phar/ /mche ba 'don cing 'khrur tshig cha byad byed/ /ha ha hi hi gad mor rab tu sgrogs/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed shin tu 'jigasapar ston / / ha ha hi hi rdo rje'i gad rgyangs can/ /rab tu 'dzum zhing kha nas mchod rten 'byin/ /gom pa mi che mi chung dal bus 'gro/ /rdo rje'i glu len yum la zur mig blta/ /mi rkang gling bu 'bud cing g.yasanas bskor/ /rgyab phyag zur phyag mdun gyis bltasate 'tshal/ /brkyang ste phyag 'tshal bskor zhing bskor zhing 'tshal/ /'phar zhing 'phar zhing phyag 'tshal 'dud cing 'tshal/ /lag pa g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs g.yas kyang brkyang / /g.yon bskums slar yang rab tu rgyug par byed/ /nang gi gar ni 'di lta ste/ yum la blta zhing yum la 'khyud par byed//yab la blta zhing yab la 'khyur par byed/ /chags med chags ltar ston cing 'dzum par byed/ /thabasadang shesarab mtshon byed bden mi mnga'/ /gsang ba'i gar ni 'di lta ste/ rab tu 'byud cing bsdams te thig le 'dren/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin chos dbyings chen por 'khyer/ /zhal bgrad gosamed gcer bur gnas par byed/ /mtshan masam gos thig le chen por 'dren/ /thig le 'od gsal mosakyi dbyings su 'char/ /chosadabyings rang grol rol ba chen por 'gags/ /de kho na nyid kyi gar ni/ bltar (ltaraka med brjod 'das blo yi spyod yul min/ /ye stong lhun grub rol ba chen po yin/ /snang stong 'od gsal chos dbyings chen por gsal/ /dpa' mo 'bum phrag dpa' bo cig la thim/ /de yang cig la thim te tha mar ni/ /ma lusarim gyisadapa' bo cig la thim/ /dpa' bo cig la cig thim tha mar ni/ /ma lus dri ma med la thim par gyur/ /dri ma med kyang rol ba por thim / / rol ba sprosabral de nyid chen po yin/ /du ma ro cig sum brgya drug cu'ang bzhi/ /de ni rang byung chosadabyings gzhal yas khang / /thams cad mnyam nyid cig tu 'dres par 'gyur/ /de nasanam gyi sum gnyisa'adasapa na/ /dag pa'i mkha' la sprin tshogasa'adus pa bzhin/ /thams cad chosakyi dbyings lasabazhengasate byung —/ / gdan la 'khod de tshogs la rol bar gyur/ /tshogs kyang rigasalnga'i dbyings su zim par gyur/ /dge rtsachosakyi dbyingasasu bsngo bar mdzad/ /thams cad dag pa'i smon lam mtshamasasu sbyar/ /de nas rgyal bu —255—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsupa ches kyi skor/dkon mchog 'bangs bzhengs te/ bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gso la ba/ do nub stong pa nyid bco brgyad kyi rang bzhin ya mtshan gyi ltad mo sna tshogs pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa mthong ba 'di/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs la brten nas byung gis/ gzhan mthu can sus kyang ma yin no/ /des kho bo la dkon mchog 'bangs su grags/ da yang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed kyis/ kho bo'i lus stong du zhig kyang de las mi 'da'o zhes gsungs pa dang / bla ma dri ma med pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis lus srog la mi lta bar btsal bas/mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ da yang ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur ba na/ gsang ba'i brag phug tu ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin du/ mkha' 'gro ma'i skad du/ ra sgreng zhes bya ba'i pho brang du lus dang srog la mi lta bar sems can gyi don byed do/ / zhes gsungs pa dang /rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ bla ma gsung ba bzhin du/ mkha' 'gro ma'i brda skad thun mong ma yin pa rwa sgreng zhes bya ba der/ dkon mchog gsum gyi thugasarje dang / mdzad pa 'phrin las la brten nas/ yab rgyal po bde spyod ces bya ba 'di bod kyi rigs la bzang ba 'brom/ de'i nang nas yag zher mkha' 'gro masabyin gyis brlabs pas / brda skad sku gshen zhes bya ba dang / ma kun tu bzang mo 'di/ mkha' 'gro mas byin gyisabarlabs pa'i brda skad/ khu 'od bza' lhan cig ces bya ba sprul pa'i yab yum gnyisa'abyung ste/ byang rtswasnye mo'i yuladu ri dwags ltar kho bo bskyed de/ khu 'od bza' lhan cig ni sprul ba mo yin pas/ kho bo la bstan pa'i khur bskur nas / yun mi ring bar mkha' spyod kyi gnasasu 'gro'o/ /yab yag zher sku gshen ni kho bo mosal 'dzud pa'i bshes gnyen ma cig bzhes te/ mnga' ris mtshams na bzhugs yod pa'i sar/ kho bo mda' bzhin du khyer te/'phags pa nyi ma'i 'od/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang dang ldan pa gzhen nu'i dusanas bod du skyes pa la shesarab che bar grags pa/ kho bo bsu ba la rgya bal yul du 'gro bar tha snyad btags te 'ongs pa'i steng du 'phen par byed do/ /der 'phen pa mngon du gyur ba dang / ma 'ongs pa rten 'brel 'jom ste/ 'ben snying po yod pa la mda' rnon po phog ste/ gang gis phral kyang 'bral par ma nus par khams kyi yul du pha mda' rtsal che bar grags par byed do/ /der yang kho bo tshe rabs nas tshe rab thams cad du pha la phar 'dzin pa dang / ma la mar 'dzin pa dang / rgan pa la rgan rabs su 'dzin pa dang / rigasakyi gtso bo la rigs kyi gtso bor 'dzin pa dang /bla ma la bla mar 'dzin cing rtag tu ngu bzhin du/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta/ lus dang srog la mi lta bar bla ma'i zhabs tog bya rbe byed pa'i khams kyi sa char sems can mang po'i don byas te slar bod kyi yul du 'gro'o/ /de nas/ kho bo'i sprul ba rgyal bu zhig gis kho bos byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba zhig btang ste/ rgya gar gyi —256—

'brem ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu ches bzhugs so/ /gnas nas bla ma dri ma med pa spyan 'dren par byed do/ /de nas gnas phun sum tshogs pa mang por sems can gyi don byas te/ bla ma'i bka' bsgo ste/ rwa sgreng dpal gyi gcug lag khang bzhengs/ sems dpa' brgyad gnas brtan bcu drug thugs rje chen po'i sprin tshogs dang ldan pa /ka 77 na6 rgobadag gi sprul ba/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ nga'i rnam par thar ba skyong zhing ngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sar bzhugs te sems can mang po'i don byed do/ /mes dpal ldan dang / gsal ldan ma ni ma 'ongs pa na kho bo'i bla mar gyur te/ zhang chen po dang / g.yung chos mgen no/ /de skad ces zhus pa dang / yab yum gnyis na re/ thos pa'i gtam snyan/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rwa sgreng dpal gyi gcug lag khang zhes bya ba de/ bdag cag gnyis kyis mthong bar byin gyis rlobs shig ces gsol ba dang / /bla ma mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal nas/ khyed rang gnyis ltos shig gsungs nas/ byin gyis brlabs nas bstan te bltas pa dang / phu shar du bstan pa dang / mda' nub tu bstan pa/ rgyab ri skyabs pa/mdun ri gzhol ba/ lung lag brgyad yod pa/ sa padma 'dab brgyad dang 'dra ba/ lung lag gi stobs kyis gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi rnam par yod pa/ rgyab ri ri phran bdun dang bcas pa/ rgyal po rgyal srid dang bcas pa'i rnam par yod pa/ thang chen po/ pha wang chol le ba yod pa/ la la ni stag gi gzugs/ la la ni seng ge'i/la la ni sbrul/ la la ni sbal ba la sogs pa srog chags kyi dbyibs rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs su yod pa/de dag la klu'i pho brang mang po gnas pa/ dbyibs 'khor lo rtsibs stong du yod pa/ thang de la me tog gi rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gsum bcu gsum rgyun du skye ba/ de'i steng du mkha' 'gro ma mang po nyams dga' ba'i gar gyi go rar rtse ba/ g.yu'i chu bo sngon po rgyun chad med par yon chab kyi tshul du yod pa/ lha shing shug pa'i spos ngad rgyun mi chad par yod pa/ sman sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyi dri ngad ldang ba/ chu mig brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa/ rdzing bu brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa/ shug pa nyi khri chig stong dang gnyis yod pa/ gzhan yang shing rnam pa sna tshogs pa la/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs pas skad snyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa sgrogs pas dge sbyor la bskul ba lta bu yod pa/ shug pa ni shel ldan ces bya ba dang / gser ldan/ zangs ldan/ g.yu ldan zhes bya ba'i phyogs bzhi na yod pa/ g.yin yang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams na rin chen 'phel zhes bya ba'i shug pa dang / bsod nam 'phel zhes bya ba dang /nor bu 'phel zhes bya ba dang / bkra shis 'phel zhes bya ba dang / 'od zer 'phel zhes bya dang / rgyal ba 'phel zhes bya ba dang / 'od zer ldan pa zhes bya ba dang / klu'i dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / dri ma med pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba dang / yan lag phun sum tshogs pa zhes bya ba dang / nad sel ba zhes bya ba dang / bkres pa sel ba ches bya —257

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/ba dang / skom pa zhi ba zhes bya ba dang / yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba dang / rin chen gtsug tor can zhes bya ba dang / beeḍārya'i 'od
