ces bya ba dang / sgrib pa sel ba zhes bya ba dang / mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba dang / 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa mthong ba dang / thos pa tsam gyisasdug bsngal sel ba/ skogs pa rim pa bdun yod pa/ shin tu dga' ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gos dang / dran pa brjed pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gos dang / chosathams cad ma 'dresapar so sor 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i gos dang / brtson 'grus kyi go chas le lo'i bdud 'jomasapa zhes bya ba'i gosadang / thar ba thob 'dod pa rnams la semasartse gcig tu bzhugs te 'di ltasakyi 'dun ma la mi 'chor ba zhes bya ba'i gos dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis dang nam du yang mi 'bral ba zhes bya ba'i gos dang / chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du spyod pa zhes bya ba'i gos te bdun ni/ byang chub don du gnyer ba'i yan lag bdun gyi gos so/ /yang de dag yan lag brgyad du'ang gnas te/ shug pa nyi khri chig stong gi rtsa ba'i 'og nas gnyis kyisasprel ba dang / sa mtshams na yod pa'i shug pa'i rtsa ba re rer yod pa dang / de dag gi yal ga du mar gyesapa dang / skogs pa'i rim pa bdun du gnas pa nyid dang / rgyal mtshan bslangasapa'am/ gdugasaphub pa ltar mdzesapa nyid dang / shing thog zlum po rusapa can yod pa nyid dang / ro kha ba nyid dang / nad mi skye ba nyid de brgyad do/ khug pa nyi khri chig stong gi rtsa ba sa'og tu gnyisal 'brel ba ni/a ti sha zhesabya ba dang / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba la gdamasapa zab mo thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba zhesabya ba las dang ldan pa'i slob ma dbusasu drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / dam pa de dag lasakyang mchod po dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba dang / gtsang du lnga bcu (cukartsa gnyisalas mang por mched pa dang / gzhan yang bod /ka 78 ba3 mdo /khamasal sogasapa phyogalobacur mched pa'i rten 'brel zab mo yin no/ /samatshams na rtsa ba gcig tu yod pa ni/ thamasacad bka' gdams su gcig pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /de las phyogs bcur yal ga du mar gyesapa ni/ rigasagasum mgon po'i sprul bas gtso byas skyes bu dam pa/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ma g.yos par 'dzin pa/ skyes bu dam pa chig brgya thub pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i rten 'brelazab mo'o/ khug pa'i rim pa bdun du yod pa nyid ni/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar 'gro ba 'dren pa'i smon lam thebs pa'i rgyal ba bdun gyis rgyun chad med par skyob pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ ṣeng thog zlum po rus pa can ni/ 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa khe che la g.yang sa chung ba'i chosa'aphral snying nye phugs rnam pa thamasacad mkhyen pa'i sangasargyasathob pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /ro kha ba ni semasacan nyon mongasapa can gang gis kyang mi tshugasapa'i rten 'brel zab mo'i/ /mi zhim kyang nad mi skyed pa ni/ /'phral du kha ste phugasashin tu dge ba'i —258—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i rgyu'i yan lag phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de dag gi steng na bya'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pa bag phebs par gnas pa ni/ de dag la brten nas sems can thams cad bde skyid la 'god pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /gdugs phub pa ltar gnas pa ni/ lā rnams kyisamachod cing lta ba phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /rgyal mtshan ltar gnasapa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi g.yo bar 'dzin cing spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /mdzes shing lhun chags pa ltar gnas pa ni/ sgom pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zab mo'o/ /yan lag brgyad du gyes pa ni/ lta ba rtag chad kyi mtha' las ma g.yos par gol sa chod pa dang / spyod pa khyi phag dang ba glang gi brtul zhugs su gti mug pa med pa dang / so sor rtog pa'i shes rab shes bya la tshod 'dzin pa med pa'i rtog dpyod zab mo dang /sgom pa glu gar dang / nyon mongs pa'i ngag rnam pa sna tshogs su spyod pa rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du zhi ba'i ngag dge ba dang / tshe 'di'i zas dang longs sbyod dang / snyan pa dang grags pa'i phyir du chos ston pa'i log 'tsho rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du zhi ba'i 'tsho ba dang / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde 'bras tshe 'di'i 'dun ma'i dbang du gtong ba rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad zhi ba'i rtsom pa dang / bla ma dam pas gang bsnyad pa spang ba'i gdams pa bstan pa la/ snod zhabs rdol gyi skyon byed pa rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du zhi ba'i dran pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du 'jol nyog tu gtong ba rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rten 'brel zab mo ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ston pa'i brda'o/ /yal ga bcur gyes pa ni gang la'ang chags pa med par gtong ba'i sbyin pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang 'chal ba'i dri mas ma gos pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can thams cad la zhe 'gras pa med cing khong khro ba dang 'khrug pa med pa'i bzod pa dang / dkar po'i chos thams cad sdud cing de la spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang / phyi rol pa dang /nyan rang dang gzugs med pa la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngan pa dang ma 'dres pa'i bsam gtan dang / thos pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa ngos 'dzin/ bsam pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs pa mgo gnon/ bsgom (sgom kapa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongasapa rtsad nas 'byin pa'i shes rab dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang /dgazhi ba dang / btang snyoms kyis sems can yongs su 'dren pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / ci nasakyang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas par gyur cig pa'i smon lam dang / bdud sdig to can la sogs pa mimathun pa'i phyogs gang gi yang dbang du mi 'gro ba'i stobs dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyalatshab dam par dbang bskur zhing rang gi shes bya thams cad ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/—259—

bka' gdams dpe dken gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung ches kyi skor/pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i rten 'brel zab mo'i/ /yal ga stong du gyes nga/ ni bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gnas te bzhugs shing / sems can mang po yongs su smin par byed pa'i rten 'brel zab ma'o/ /shar na chu mig shel ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ des ni chad pa'i nad zhi bar byed do/ /lho na chu mig gser ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ des ni rlung gi nad zhi bar byed do/ /nub na chu mig zangs ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ des ni grang ba dang /mkhris pa'i nad zhi bar byed do/ /byang na chu mig g.yu ldan zhes bya ba yod de/ des ni bad kan gyi nad zhi bar byed do/ /dbus na bstan pa'i chu mig ring rnge/ zhes bya ba yed de/ des ni 'dus pa'i nad zhi bar byed do/ /de'i phyogs bzhi na chu mig bzang po dang / bzang ldon dang / bde ba dang / bde ldan dang / dri med dang / dri bzang pe zhes bya ba drug drug yed/ la las ni yan lag gi nad ba zhi bar byed/ snyepa las ni nying lag la las ni nang khrel/la las ni don snying ste/ mgo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus kyi cha shas thams cad la nad gang dang gang yod pa de dang de /ka 80 na2 thams cad /zhi bar byed do/ /gzhan yang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad na chags med bsil ba zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / byams pa zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / so so/ra gsal ba zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / phyogs su ma lhung ba zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / zhi zhing dul ba zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / rgyas par byed pa zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / sdud par byed pa zhes bya ba'i chu mig dang / gser phreng zhes bya ba dang /spos ngad ldang ba zhes bya ba dang / me tog sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba dang / rgyan bkod pa zhes bya ba dang / nad med pa zhes bya ba dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba dang / zhi bde gnas pa zhes bya ba dang / dri ma 'khrud pa zhes bya ba dang / phyogs rgyan pa zhes bya ba dang / bsil ngad ces bya ba dang / bsil ngad snyesnan pa zhes bya ba dang / 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa chu mig brgya rtsa brgyad phyogs bzhi dbus dang bcas nga/sa brgyabyudang bcu gasdo/ma sdos grags rnga5/ /thams cad kyis mthong ba ni drug yod de/ phyi ma'i dus na bzhir 'gro de'i rjes la'ang rgyal ba 'byung gnas zhes bya ba dang / bstan pa'i bdag po nyid kyi chu mig ring mo ste gnyis nyid du bstan no/ /'phags pa rnams la ni chu mig brgya phrag cig dang sum cu la nyams pa mi mnga'o/ /zhes smras pa dang / dge slong nyi ma'i 'od kyi zhal nas / deng dkyil 'khor chen po cig tu 'dus pa dag chu mig dag byed dag byed ces bya ba yod do/ /gcang ma gtsang ma zhes bya ba yod do/ /shel ldan shel ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /gser ldan gser ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /zangs ldan zangs ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /g.yu ldan g.yu ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /bzang po bzang po zhes bya ba yod do/ /bzang ldan bzang ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /bde ba bde ba zhes bya ba yod do/ /bde ldan bde —260—

'brom sten pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so / /ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /dri med dri med ces bya ba yod do/ /dri bzang dri bzang zhes bya ba yod do/ /'od ldan 'od ldan zhes bya ba yod do/ /zag med zag med ces bya ba yed do/ /zhi bde zhi bde zhes bya ba yod do/ /bde skyong bde skyeng zhes bya ba yod do/ /bsil ngad lda nga zhes bya ba yod do/ /bde ba 'dzin par byed pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /de dag ni bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ gang dang gang gis de 'thung pa/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed/ zag pa me/da par gnas gyur te/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dbyings du 'gro kye skal ldan dag gnas 'di'i yon tan brjod pa ni/ sprang bus rgya mtsho 'dren pa dang mchungs te/ phyegs cam zhig brjod par zad kyis/ re re nas brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang brjod par mi/ nus so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / thams cad de lta bu'i gnas gang zag dang bcas pa la rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs bzhengs te/ bskal pa dpag tu re/da par tshokas bsags pa'i/ /las kyi mthu can gnas 'dir 'tshogs par gyur/ /nga yang dag nga/'i smon lam mchams sbyar te/ /'di ltar pho brang dag pa'i gnas su shog / ye shes zag pa me/da pa'i legs gtams te/ /'gro ba'i mi/ga cig sgron ma dam pa/ra shog /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden nga/ dang / /gnas lugs chos/ ngabiongs dag pa'i rang bzhin dang / /bo bo'i las 'bras phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /'jig rten skyabs su nges pa ra bdag gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos mtha' 'khob gnas su 'gro /kla klo'i skye bo dam pa'i chos la 'god/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gdung spel bar byed//thams cad dag pa'i snod du byin brlabs nas/ /slar yang po ta la yi gnas su 'ong / /de nas mi ring bod khams gnas su 'gro /sem/sa can gang la'ang de dang mthun pa'i chos/ /rang bzo med par rtag tu ston par byed / / de nas 'jig rten mgon po dri ma med/ /rgya gar rgyal ba'i zhing khams dam pa nas/ /bdag gis nges par sprul zhing byin brlabs pa'i/ /chul khrims bzang po'i mtshan ldan mchungs med pas/ /'gro ba'i skyabs su brtson par mchog tu 'dren/ /e ma rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jig rten gtso/ /gangs ri'i khrod der kun gyis bkur bar byed/ /rig 'dzin las can rig 'dzin nyid la sbyor/ /so sor thar 'dod de dag nyid la sbyer/ /snying rje chen po byang chub mchog la sbyor/ khyim na gnas pa'ang de dang mthun pa yi/ /sbyin dang chul khrims dag la sbyor bar byed/ /gang gis gang 'dul mngon shes thogs med pa/ /mar me mdzad dpal 'gro ba'i gnyen cig pu/ /mun pa'i smag rum bod khams gsal bar byed/ /cho kyi rgyal po mthu dpal spyan mnga' ba/ /dpag med skye bar bdag gi bla ma mchog /bdag dang skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar/ /bdag gi gdul bya'ang bla mas 'dokyil bar byed/ /nyon mongs btson khang gang gis thar med par/ /las kyi dbang gis las ngan lcags su tshud/ /dug —261 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lnga'i btson srung drag pos bsrungs pa yis/ /sems can mgon med rnams kyi dpung gnyen mdzad/ /'gro ba'i mar me mdzad dpal don dang mthun/ /ma rigs mun pa'i tshogs las thar bar byed/ zhas rab snang ba ster ba'i sbyin bdag mchog /thugs rje'i shugs kyis gang la'ang chagasamed par/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis ma lusargyasapar spyod/ /ces smrasapa dang / mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma dri ma med pa'i zhal nas/ chos kyi rgyal po lhun po brtsegasapa khyod/ /gangs ri'i lhun po padma dkar po mchog /'dab ma stong ldan ze 'bru ser po la/ /lha dbang sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa la/ /nye dbang rnams kyis legs par bskor ba bzhin/ /gang gi mi g.yo phyogs mthar rgyas pa yi/ /lhun po'i rgyal po khyod la 'jig rten rnams/ /mchod pa'i tshul gyis phyogs mthar bskor te gnas / / mi dbang khyed la bdag kyang mchod byed na/ /ma dag blo can 'jig rten smosaci 'tshal/ /'jin rten sgrool ma khyod yin skyes bu mchog /pha ma'i tshul la ltos la 'od zer khye/ /las can yal bar ma 'dor go cha gyon//lus dang srog la ma lta bzod stobasaskyed/ /rang bde'i ro la ma zhen bdud dpung choms/ /gang la'ang bden par ma 'dzin sgyu mar ltos/ /smig rgyu'i chu la mthong bzhin zhen 'dzin khrol/ /e ma dge slong bdag gi rig pa ni / / shes bya phal la thogs pa ci yang med/ /'byung bzhis ma bskyod lus kyang thogs pa med/ /gang du 'gro yang 'ching ba'i thogs pa med/ /'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rjes song / /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ ltas rgyan gnas su ji skad smras pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnasader lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /sprul pa cig ni rgya gar yul du 'gro / / sprul ba cig ni bal po'i mthil du 'gro /sprul ba cig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro /sprul ba cig ni rgya gar gnas chen 'grim/ /dge slong nga la bden pa yod med kyang / /mi dbang khyod kyi grogs byed rtag tu dge /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i lung bstan yin/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyang rang bzhin gnas su dengs/ /nga yang 'od 'dra mkha' la yal te 'gro /zhesagasungasapa'i mod la/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thamasartsocad kyang rang bzhin gyi gnasasu dengasate mi snang bar gyur/ bla ma dri ma med pa'ang chosakyi dbyingasasu thim nas mi snang bar gyur/yapayum mes 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyang 'od kyi rnam par mkha' 'gro ma'i pho brang nas 'thon te yab bde spyod kyi pho brang du 'khod do/ /de nasayab bde spyod kyis 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogasapa mdzad do/ /de nasayum kun tu bzang mo na re/ ding sang 'di ltar baposhis na/ ma 'ongasapa'i dusana'ang mtha' 'khob kyi yul du/ bdag cag gnyisakyis pha ma byas te/ sems can gyi don byed pa ni/ rnyed pa'i mchog legalopar rnyed pa yin no/ /kye yab yum gnyisagacung dkon mchog 'bangs kyis/ ding sang phun sum 262

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu ches bzhugs se/ /tshogs par mjad/ ma/chog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ da ni don chen po la dga' ba bsgom zhing / dge 'dun brgya phrag mchong pa'i don du rang gi pho brang du byon zhig ces smras pa dang / yab yum/ na re/ bu mos ji skad smras pa de de bzhin no/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams don chen po 'grub ste/ dga' ba bsgom/ zhing / dge ladun mchod pa/ dang rgyal sa skyong ba'i phyir du be ta'i yul du 'gra'i/ /zhes gshegs so/ /der rang gi sras kyi zhal nas/ yab yum rnyed par dka' ba ni rnyed/ thob par dka' ba ni thob/ nga yang sem/sa can gyi don las skad cig cam yang ma nyams par zhing khams nas zhing /bams su 'gro zhing / thabs dang shes rab chen po zung 'brel du spyod par smon no/ /zhes dga' ba'i chig sgrogs seo/ /kye legs nga/'i shes rab/ kha ba can gyi mgon pe 'ji/ rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la ma/khas kyang / sbas pa'i brtul zhugs ma/jad de/ ku su lu'i spyod pas 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad par mjad pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i chul de ltar sprul ba sna chegs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mjad pa yin la/ 'di'i yon tan khyod kyis legs par dris/ kho bos sgro ma btags skur ba ma/ btab par bshad kyis/ de la ma/ 'ongs pa'i dus na sems can drin lan log par 'jal ba 'ga' zhig gis cung zad cam/ nyes pa brjod srid na/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa /byed rang la bzod par gsel 'o / /megs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i byung gnas 'di yon tan rgya mtsho 'di lta bu yod kyang rang gi yon tan thams cad sbas te/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan cung zad car/ yang gzhan la ma bshad/ 'di'i yen tan kho bos khyod la bshad pa la'ang / bka' rgya du ma'i sgo nas dgag pa byas ba'i don yang bdag gis yon tan sba bya zhing / zhes bya ba 'di nyid las 'phros so zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bya ba las bcirtsam/sa te/ 'brom rgya' ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skye rab bstan pa las/rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs su ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs snyelnga pa'o// //cha6 kul snye ga lar rgyal bu dad pa brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'ile'//ka 82 ba4rgo dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa yul rbha ga lor rgyal po dad pa brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bsdokyigs sa/ /)sbyi/ /yang yer ba lha ri'i snying po'i mgul na jo ba yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo yab sras la phyag gsum gsum btsal te/ bdag gi zhu ba 'di lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra ste/bla ma yab sras kyis blud/ bdag gis 'thungs pa tsam gyis skom du thal/ /yang zhus lan nor bu'i phre ba 'di na —263—

bka' gdam/sa datree/ dkon gces btus las// jo baṃ'i gsung chos kyi sker/mar la/ rnyed dang bskur sti spang bya zhing / khengs grags rtag tu spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ bstan pa'i ma/nga' bdag bshes gnyen 'brom/ 'dis sngon rnyed pa dang bkur sdi la ma/ bltas/ /wengs nga/ dang grags nga/ la ma bltas/ nga rgyal gyis rang rgyud gang bar ma/ byas nga/ra/ gzhan don la dka' spyad ci cam bgyis/ bla ma/sa gsung du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i (zhal nas/ sngar bzhin du ma/gon po spyan ras gzigs la yan lag bdun pa phul cig ngas bshad kyis gsungs nas/ sngon shar phyogs rbha ga la bya ba na/ rgyal po rbha ga zhes pa la bcun mo nor 'byin ma zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de la sras shig 'khrungs te/ skye ma/ thag nas mi/ ngu ba/ rab tu byung ba dang / dkon ma/chog gi rten gsum mthong ba na de'i phyogs su pha mas bzung kyang mi nyan par 'gro ba/ gus nga/'i rnam 'gyur mang ngo/ byed nga/ cig byung bas/ ma na re/ bu 'di ltar chung ba nas dkon mchog i phyo gas su 'de ltar dad pa'i rnam 'gyur che ba cig 'dug da gzod 'di la dad pa brtan pa cig 'ong zer nas bu de'i rngo nga yang dad pa brtan par btags/ /de bzhin du cher song nas kyang dad pa brtan nga// dkobe ra/chog gi phyi ra du sha khrag thong zer kyang gtong nus pa cig byung / gzugs kyang gser gyi kha dog lta bu lta bas chog mi shes ge kun gyi ying 'phrog pa cig byung / rgyal po chen po rbha ga de ni mnga' ris nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' rgyas/ rgyal 'bangs skar ma'i tshogs ltar grangs mang / rgyal brgyud nyi zla bzhin/ du zil che/ dge ba'i mtsho la dad gus kyi padmo 'khrungs te/rang gi pho brang lha'i gzhal yas khang 'dra ba der/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po sangs rgyas dang de'i yum gsung rab bcu gnyis la sogs pa dang / de la slob par byed pa tshul /khrims sna re bsrung ba yan chad mtsho steng nga/dma'i ze 'bru'i steng du sems rtse gcig tu mchod par byed na'ang / da dung bdud sdig to can gyi dgra ma lus par ma/ choms pas/ dga' rab dbang phyug bza' mi gnyis kyi rtog pa la/ shar phyogs rbha ga la'i rgyal po/ rbha gar grags pa 'di yar dkon mchog mchod pa'i dad pa can/ ma/ra ma rabs skyong ba'i snying rje can/ bar du rgyal srid skyong ba'i phyi thag can/ blon 'bangs bkra shis pa'i bsod nams can 'di la bcun mo'ang de dang mchungs pa rgyal srid skyong ba la nges par dgos pa'i bu dang / nor 'byin par byed pa/ bzhin 'dzum zhing mdzangs phun sum tshogs pa'i gos kyis brgyan pa/ ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi ske rags bcings pa/ rang la 'khor tshad bu bzhin du skyong ba'i bud med rin po che zhig 'dug kho'i bu 'di yang gzugs dang na ma smin pa nas dad pa dang snying rje smin pa cig 'dug nged cag gi yul las 'da' ngos shes pa'i gza' (bza'aka mi 'ga' zhig 'dug pas/ sems can gzhan yang nga'i yul las phral na mi rung bas/ 'di dag la bar chad cig bya dgos snyam pa dang / bde ba can na dge slong mya ngan dang bral ba zhes bya ba mngon par shes pa thogs pa med par mnga' ba nyan thos kyi cha 264—

ribror/ sden nga/ rgyasnyepa ba'i 'byung sanas kyi skyes rabs bka' gangasmu/sa bu ches bzhugs so/ /lugs bzung nas/ byang chub sem/sa dpa' sem/sa/ dpa/ri chen po'i rnam/ nga/ra thar ba skyong ba cig yod pa des/bcun mo nor 'byin ma zhes bya ba dad pa phun sum/ chegs pa dang ldan pa de/ sem/sa can gyi las la bdud sdig te can gyis bar du bcad de 'gro bar mkhyen/ der ma/ zad rgyal ngo/ dang rgyal bu la'ang bar chad chen po 'ong de la brten nas sem/sa can ri la gyi bde skyid 'jad par ma/khyen nas/ rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pas rbha ga la'i pho brang du byon pa dang / rgyal bu dad nga/ brtan pa de dgung lo brgyad ba'es nga/ la bcu drug cam lon pa'i sku ma/nga' ba / dbu zlum zhing rgyas/ nga// dbu skra 'jam zhing snum pa// sha khrag dkar la 'jum chags pa/ zhal nas dkon ma/chog gsum gyi sgra ma yin pa mi/ 'don nga// dar dkar gyi gos dri ma med pa gyeon pa/ 'od phun sum tshogs pa yong pa/ 'ig 'dug pa de/ me tog snyim/ pa gang khyer te 'khor kyang med par gcig pur grong khyer mi/ /byim 'bum phrag cig yod pa'i nub sgor snyebs nas byung ste/ snyim pa'i me/ tog de dge slong mya ngan dang bral la phul te/ phyag richal zhing zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ dmus long gis gzugs mthong ba dang 'dra bar/ mthong bar dka' ba'i 'phags pa mthong ba 'di/ legs par rnyed nga/sa/ dkon mchog gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyal po rbha ga'i pho brang du gshegs so zhes spyan drangs/ gzhan du grong khyer chen ngo/ de ches pas phal cher mgo 'khor te pho brang du phyin par mi nus pa la/ khong gnyis ka la rdzu 'phrul ma/nga' bas pho brang du yud tsam zhig la byon te/ de'i lam du yang skye bo rnams kyis mthong ste/ de ring skya bcun gnyis mthong ba la lta bas chog mi shes pa de dag su zhig yin nam / mthong la yid ma ches pa zhig byung zhes zer ba la/ la la na re gathen la de 'dra ba'i phun sum tshogs pa rang mi 'ong / rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa rang yin mchi zer/ bsam shes su 'dod pa la la na re/ ci rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa yin na rta ba stong gis mi bskor mi srid lags/ gcig pur 'ong ba de bas srid dam zer/ yang la la na re/ rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa 'dis 'khor khrid na 'bum phrag dpag tu re/da pa'ang khrid nus mod kyi/ khong sku bltams nas da lta yan chod du 'khor dang nga rgyal dang dregs pa la lta ba rna bas kyang ma thos na/ mig gis mthong ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ khong chung ngu'i dus na'ang ma'i pang nas dkon mchog gi sku gosung thugs kyi rten dang dge 'dun gang yod pa der ma ma de dag la mi nyan par 'gro na/ da lta lta smos kyang ci 'tshal zhes zer zhing gda' skad/ der yon mchod gnyis kyis chos rgyal rghaṃ ga'i drung du sleb pa dang / rbha ga'i zhal nas/ dad pa brtan pa khyod kyis mthong bar dka' ba'i 'phags pa 'di gang nas spyan drangs zhes gsungs pa dang / dad pa brtan pas 'phags pa la che re gzigs pa dang / 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ nga khyed yab sras gnyis kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir du da nang bde ba can nas 'ongs gsung / der rgyal po'i dgongs pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa —265—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la 'phags pa las 'os med stam/ ste/ stan med nga/ra rkang pa gtis gshibs/ lus drang por bsrang / sor bcu'i thal mo spyi bor sbyar te phyag mang po btsal lo/ /'phags pa'i zhal nas/ sems can gyi las kyis khyed la bar gcod cig 'ong srid par gda' ste/ phal che ba cig bdag gis bskyab kyis/ khyed rang yang dkon mchog la gsol ba thob ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ 'phags pa la 'khrul ba mi mnga' las ngan pa sa 'og dang 'dra ba dag la dkar po'i 'od mi 'char bas/ bdag la bar gcod cung zad byung srid kyang 'phags pa thugs zhum par mi ma/jad par zhu/ zhes bsnye na bkur phun sum tshogs par mdzad do/ /de'i dus su 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ las kyi mtha' ni phra zhing zab/ /dgra bcom thob kyang bag chags 'byung / / gang gi gnas lugs shes gyur na/ /de yi skyon dang bral bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dad pa brtan pas/ 'phags pa gshegs par ma/khyen nas/ bdag gi mgon skyabs mdzad cing gnas 'di nid du bzhugs par zhu zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis bsams pa cam gyis kyang / / nga ni thogs pa med par 'ong / /skye ba dpag tu med pa yi/ khyed kyi bshes gnyen nga yin mod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / dad pa brtan pa na re/ khyed la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang / /bdag gi migashesathag ring bas/ /'phags pa med na skyo bar 'gyur/ /des na gnas 'dir bzhugs par zhu/ /zhes zhus pa dang / 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ khyod rang yab yum gyi sku tshe la bar gcod 'ong srid pas/ rgyal po'i bla ri bla shing la sogs pa dang /yum gyi bla shing la sogs pa la gzhan gyis gnod pa byas sam ma byas legs par ltos/ khyed kyi yum de dang de ring nga gnyis phrad na 'ong ba yin te yum mi gda' ba zhes gsungs nas/ 'phags pa mi snang bar gyur to/ /der dad pa brtan pa'i bsams pa la 'phags pa'i gsung lugs kyis ma de la bar gcod ma byung ba cig gal che snyam nas/ blon po'i tshogs rnams la khyed rnams song la/ rgyal po yab yum gyi bla shing gi ra ba thams cad bskor te gzhan gyi gnod pa byung ma byung legs par ltos/ khyad par du yum gyi bla shing de'i rtsa ba dang rtse mo la srog chags kyi gnod pa byung ma byung ltos/ de'i lam du khyed rang la yang bar gcod byung srid pas/ mtshon cha ring thung gnyis khyer la bag dang ldan par gyis shig ces bsgo ba dang / blon po lnga brgya tsam gyis rgyal po'i bla ri lhun po spang me tog can gyis gtums pa gzhan la ma 'byar ba/ phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa'i mtha' ma nas lcags ri rim pa bdun gyis bskor nas yod pa la bltas pas gnod pa ma byung bar 'dug de nas rgyal po'i bla shing gi ra ba lcags ri rim pa gsum gyis bskor ba sgo yang rim pa gsum btod pa/ shing 'od ma'i tshal dang gla ba dang tsan dan dkar dmar la sogs pa phun sum tshogs par skyes nas yod pa'i nang du phyin te bltas —266—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /pas / bla shing gi rtsa ba na phar la srog chags kyis 'ga' re rlogs (slog3nas 'dug pa mthong ste/ der srog chags bcal bas ma rnyed par slar log nas 'ongs te chos kyi rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa'i drung du 'ongs nas phyag lan gsum btsal te/ kye lta bas chog mi shes pa rgyal po'i bla ri lhun po la gnod pa ma mchis/ bla shing gi rtsa ba na gnod pa bag re gda' bas gnod byed ni ma rnyed ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ dad pa brtan pa'i zhal nas/ bla shing ra ba'i sgo gsum po legs par sdoms/ blon po lnga brgya'i tshogs kyis ra ba'i mtha' ma bskor/ nang na phag rgod zhugs nas yod mchi/ khyed kyis mtshon cha dang go cha sra ba gyon la/ rdza rnga dang zom rnga la sogs pa rol mo sgra can khyer te/ shing ra'i gseb nas sgra sgrogs la srog chags dag phyir ded cig nga srog gcod pa spangs nas tshangs par spyod pa'i sdom pa la gnas shing / dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' las ma 'da' bar dam bcas na'ang / gnod byed 'di dag gis bla shing la gnod pa bskyal na/ des rgyal po'i sku tshe la gnod pa 'ong / rgyal po med na blon 'bangs thams cad mi skyongs/ de med na mnga' ris nub nas 'gro /de la brten nas sems can mang po la gnod pa 'ong bar gda'/ kye 'di dag gi bde skyid rgyal po'i bsod nams la rag las pa la/ rgyal po med na ni de dang mthun par 'byung la/ rgyal po bzang na ni rgyal po la brten pa thams cad bde bas/ spyir pha mar gyur ba'i sems can yongs kyi don/ sgos yul rbha ga la'i sems can 'di dag bde bar bya ba'i don/ nying sgos su yang de dag gi rtsa lag dam par gyur ba/ bdag gi tshe 'di nyid du yang lus ston par byed pa rgyal po yab yum gyi sku tshe brtan par bya ba'i phyir du/ de ring bsam pa bzang pos gnod byed gang yin pa de bsgral bar bya'o / / gzhan du na khyed rnams kyis bsgral na 'ong ste/ nag po'i phyogs bsam pa ngan pas kun nas slong ba yin na ni khyed kyis bsgral bar mi nus pas/ de ring ngas lcags mda' lcags gzhu thogs te 'gag gzhan la mi sgug pa 'di nyid du bsdad de mda' bsnun par bya'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /der blon po dag gis ji ltar gsung ba bzhin du/ bla shing gi ra bar go cha sra ba gyon/ mtshon cha rnon po thogs te/ rdza rnga dang zom rnga thogs/ rnga dang rag dung la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra che ba mang po'ang khyer te/ bla shing gi ra bar phyin/ te sgra bsgrags pa dang /phag pa nag po shin tu che ba cig dang / phag mo khra mo de dang mnyam pa 'dug pa de rgyal bu ngos la nye bar song ba dang / rgyal bus them pa dbus ma'i steng du 'khas g.yon pa bzhag 'khas g.yas pa cung zad phyir brkyangs lcags kyi gzhu nag po zangs kyi rgyud can zhig phyag g.yon du thogs/ lcags kyi mda' zangs kyi gshog pa can cig ltong du bcug cig g.yas pa'i srin lag la bskyon te 'di skad gsungs pa/ pha mar gyur ba'i sems can dpag med la/ /gnod par byed pa'i sdig to bsam ngan can/ /sgrol bar byed pa khro bo sems dpa' la/ /—267—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je pe'i gsung chos kyi sker/bdag kyang mthu ste gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /byam/sa dang snying rje brtan pa'i gzhu bzang ste/ /brtso na 'grus snyel ba med pa'i rgyud dmar can/ /gang gis 'gengs par mi nus sra ba 'di/ /bdag gi brdungs te g.yon du rab tu bzung / /phan sems drag po shes rab rdo rje'i mda'/ /chad med bzhi yi gshog pa rab bsgron te/ /thabs kyi rgyud la ltong chen rab blangs te/ /pha rol gnad du rab tu bsnun par byed/ /phyi ma'i mda' yang de bzhin mtshungs par spyod/ /'di la nyes snang bden pa med na yang / /'khrul ba'i cha shas lha la bzod par gsol / / nyes pa'i bsams pa'ang cis kyang mi bgyid do/ /zhes/ pa'i mod la phag pa nag pos sna drangs/ phag pa khra mo de rjes su 'brangs te byung ba la mda' sngon ma bsnun pas/ phag pa nag po de'i dpral ba la phog ste/mjug tu thon nas tshe'i dus byas pas nga la snying rje zhig skyes pa'i bar la phag mo khra mo de shor ro/ /der rgyal bu shin tu ma mnyes te/ thugs ma bde ba'i bsams pas nga'i bla ma mya ngan bral de 'di nyid du nga'i rtsa ru byon na dga' ste snyam pa la/ de'i mod la bla ma 'phags pa nyid khrong ste byon nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thugs ngan ma mdzad / sems can gyi las la ci yang srid pa yin/ gsung ste mi snang bar gyur/ der pho brang du byon pa dang /yum la bsnyung gzhi cig babs nas gda' ba de/ rgyal bus gzigs pa dang / thugs ma bde ste/ yum la 'di skad ces smras pa/ yum chen sku mchog ma bde'am/ khyod lus nyams nyes gyur ba ni/ /bdag gi sems la gzer bur gyur/ /da ni mi phan btsan sa bzung / /ma smad skyob byed dkon mchog yin/ /de las ma g.yos rtse gcig tu/ /'di yi zhen pa khrol te skyobs/ /nag po'i phyogs ni bsam pa ngan/ /sman lan dug gis 'jal bar byed / / lus 'di 'byung bzhi'i g.yar bo yin/ /mi dbang g.yar bo btang bar bzang / /mtshan dang dnge/ byad kyis sprasapa'i/ /rang lus rang gis bzung na mtshar/ /skye 'chi'i phreng ba bya ba mang / /'chi med grong du gnasan bde / / ma/ chags ma chags 'ching ba yin/ /gang dang 'gran zla med pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku yang 'jig tshul ston / / dbu ba rdos pa lta bu'i lus/ /snying po med la ci phyir chags/ khyod la skyabs gnas dkon mchog yod/ /dad pa'i zhing sa rtag tu gshin/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun rgyun du 'bab/ khyed kyis dge ba'i sa bon thebs/ /srung skyob chos skyong mthu dpal yod/ /ra ba dran dang shes bzhin yin/ /'di lus bor te blangs na bde/ /yum chen lusal snying po long / /nam zhig bskal ba chen po yang / /dus la bab tshe 'jig par 'gyur/ /nges par mi 'jig gnasalugs yin/ /de la spyod cig bslab bya yin/ /zhes smrasapa dang / yum gyi zhal nas/ snying po med pa'i lus 'di la/ /chags par mi bya shi yang sla/ /'dren pa khyod yod sras su bzang / /rgyal po bkra shis blon 'bangs bde/ /chos dang dpal 'byor bzang po 'phel/ /bkra shis dbus su shi na bzang / /byang chub grogs —268—

riprem/ ston nga/ rgyal ba'i ribyung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /dang 'grogs/ nga bde/ /dad gus rta la rab bzhon nas/ /smon lam srab kyis kha lo sgyur/ /dkon ma/chog gnas na dkon ma/cheg gi /'ing du cho/sa nga/sa 'gro bar bya/ /da ni mi sdod gcang ma/ra 'gro /zhes yur/ nor 'byin ma/ zhes bya ba de ser sna dang nyon mo/ngas nga/sa ma/ bcings nga/sa/ bud me/da kyi skyon dang bral/ bu dang rnor 'phesnye pa bas bud med kyi yon tan rjo gas/ bkra shis pa'i dbus nas che 'phos te bkra shis/ pa/'i zheng du 'gro ba'i smon lam/ thebs / dkon ma/chog gsum/ la mi phyed nga/'i dad pa mnga' bas lam sna zin 'e (/ka 86 ba 4 te/ / /zhing khams gcang ma/ bde ba can du 'phags nga/ mya ngan bral bas sna drangs te gshegs so/ /der bcun cho/ ya mtshan can de gshegs pas rgyal ngo/ thugs ma bde/ rgyal srid bu nor gyi 'jin ngagos pa la bdag gi bcun mo bu nor 'byin pa de thams cad kyis bstod cing /khur bzhin du mchi ma 'byin du bcug ste/ mo zhing /bam/sa gcang mar gshegs so/ /nga 'bum phrag mang po'i rje dpon la yugs sa'i ming btags/ bu sprul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la dwa phrug gi ming btags bzhag blon 'bangs bu dang 'dra ba mang po yang ma dang bral bar byas shes rgyal po mi snyan pa'i smre sngags mang po 'don cing mya ngan du zhugs/ der rgyal bu'i bsams pa la/ yab 'di ma/ med nga/sa mya ngan du zhugs te ci phan/ kho bo na gzhon te yab la bslab bya zhig bya dgos snyam ste/ smras pa/ kye mi dbang / skye sa pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ /bsags pa'i tha ma snyerijad nga/ chi na/ /mthar rgyal po nid kyang gzhan du 'gro na mya ngan gyis rang rgyud bsreg pa las/ /bcun mo log nas kyang mi/ 'eng /btsun mo sang na yod pa'i sar kyang mi phan na/ bya ba ngan pa 'di lta bus ci zhig bya/ yum ni bde ba nas bde bar song / yab khyed la rgyal srid skyong ba'i lha mo'ang kho bos bcal gyis/ de ma rnyed kyi bar du ya mchan can gang mtheng kyang / brnab se/mas ma mdzad cig dkon mchog gi thugs rje ni chen po kho na yin pas sngar las ma g.yos par gsol ba theb cig ces smras pa dang / rgyal po'i bsams pa la 'di ltar na gzhon pa cig las 'di lta bu'i blo khyad par can skye na/ bdag mi'i dbang por 'dod pa la 'di lta bu'i blo skye bar mi rigs snyam nas khams kyang sos par byung / der rgyal bus rgyal po'i sku khams cung zad sos par mkhyen nas/ blon po dag la khyed dag btang snyoms su ma bsdad par phag pa khra mo de gang na 'dug par tshol la sgrol cig ces bsgo ba dang /blon po dag na re/ phag mo de phal cher nags mtha' med kyi gseb tu song yod/ da nags mtha' med de'i gseb tu 'a11 ba la/ 'phags pa jiX 'phrul can zhig ma yin pas thon pa dka'/ bdag cag rnams kyis nags mtha' med de'i gseb tu phyin par mi nus/ khyed kyi gsung bcag par yang mi nus na/ ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams sems las chung bar gyis shig nags de'i dkyil kho bos bcad/ khyed —269—

bka' gdams dnge/ dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/rang rnams sngar bzhin go mtshon thogs te rgyal po'i pho brang ngos kyi mtha' dag kha srungs shig ces bsgos nas/rgyal bus sngar gyi mtshon cha de dag bsnams te nags mtha' med de'i dkyil na yar zhugs pa dang / sngar kyi phag mo de ma rnyed par sngar mthong ma myong ba'i bu mo skra snum la nag pa/ bzhin mdzes mdzes ltar ston pa/ lus dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po ste kha dog lnga ru khra ba/ gos kyang de ltar khra ba gyon pa zhig nags de'i gseb na 'dug pa zhig mthong ste/ bu mo de la smras pa/ khyod su yin/ 'dir ci byed/ de na re/ nga sprul ba mo yin te khyed nags gseb 'dir 'thoms kyis dogs nas lam sna byed du 'ongs pa yin/ 'on kyang nags 'di la kho mo gnas shes zer ba dang / rgyal bu'i bsams pa la'ang/ khyod rang la'ang the tshom za snyam du tshad mar ma bzung / de nas kyang nags gseb thams cad btsal bas phag pa khra mo de ma rnyed par bu mo de byung /der rgyal bu'i dgongs pa la/ phag pa khra mo de bu mo 'di nyid yin pa 'dra ste/ bdag gi ma ni 'das/ 'dibasad na snying re rje snyam du re zhig la btang snyoms su bzhag ste nags kyi phyir thon pa dang / blon po dag dang phrad de/kye lta bas chog mi shes pa'i phag mo de gzigs sam/ bdag gisaphag mo 'dra ba zhig las ma mthong / khyed kyis mthong ngam/ blon ngo/ dag gis zhus pa/ bdag cag gis kyang phag mo de ma mthong bar bu mo ya mtshan che ba zhig mthong lags/ sngar de 'dra 'jig rten na grags pa yang mi gda'/ da dung yang 'byung ba dka'/ de rang ya mtshan che bas mi dbang gi btsun mo byas na rang 'thad/ gal te khyed kyi yum de rang gi sprul pa yin pa yang srid/rnam pa cig tu na shin tu gzhon par gda'/ khyed rang gi btsun mo bgyis na mi mchi'ar// zhes zhus ge/sa/ rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ blon po spyod la nga la nyon/ /sngon chad stag mo mgo dgu ma/ /'jig rten dag tu ma grags na/ /da lta byung na ltas ngan yin/ /phyin chad dag kyang de dang mtshungs/ /rgyal po btsun mos ra/ ro/ngas kyis/ /ma 'grogs mi shes bslus pa srid/ /gnyen bral nor med rgyus med ma/ /rgyal po'i btsun mor mi rigs pas/ /ma smra sems la brtan pa bzung / /ma yi sprul ba yin mi srid/ /nor 'byin ma de yin par dka'/ /gal te yin yang ma nyid la/ /bu yi btsun mor ga la rigs/ /ma min mnyam por bdag nyid kyis/ /btsun mo dam pa gzhan nas tshol / / yab la yum med ga la bgyid/ /'dod thag ma nye khad kyisabasgrub(sgrub3/ /cesasmrasapa dang / blon po rnams kyi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu thugs rje che yang / pho brang khab tu ma yar byung na mi mnyes par 'dug pas/rgyal bu 'di la da zhus kyang mi snang snyam nas/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin te/ gnas lugs rnams zhus pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rgyal bu mi mnyes na bzang mo zhig ma yin par shes mod kyis/ 'on kyang 'khrul ba srid pasabu mo de 'dir khrid la shog kho bos mtshan ltas blta bar bya yis gsungs pa dang / blon po rnams kyis bu mo de nang —270—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /du bos/ der rgyal po de bu mo de la chags par gyur te/ phugs skyon du 'gyur srid de/ 'di 'dra 'byung bar dka' bar gda' bas re zhig 'di la bcun mor byed gsungs nas khab tu bzhes so/ /der rgyal bus rig ste pho brang du phyin pa dang / rgyal po'i drung na bu mo de 'dug pa gzigs nas rgyal po la smras pa/ mi dbang bu mo 'dis ci bgyid/ rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di la khyod kyi ma'i tshab byed do/ /rgyal busasmrasapa / 'di rgyal po su'i bu mo yin/ 'di'i rjes su nor ji tsam 'brang / blon po ji tsam gyis bskyal/ bdag gi ma'i tshab byed na nor ji tsam zhig 'byin par byed/ sras ji 'dra ba zhabrungs/ dkon mchog la dad gusaji tsam yod/sngar 'grogs pa'i rgyus can yin nam/ zhes smras pa dang rgyal po'i zhal nas/ de dag dang ldan pa bdag la rgyus med / 'on kyang mtshan ltas bzang po zhig 'dug pa dang / 'jig rten na dkon pa dang / bcun mo yang med pa'i stobs kyis 'di bsu'o/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ rgyal po rgyus med cham/ tshom du spyod pa cis btugs/ sngar bdag gis rgyal po'i snyan du zhus pa dag kyang snyel lam/ gangs kyi seng ge grong khyer gyi/ /sgo khyi ma dang lhan cig tu/ /da ni seng ge nga rgyal ba/ /ji ltar khyi mos bzang mor byas/ /ces smras pa dang / rgyal bosasmra ma nus/ bdud mo de'i rtog pa la/ rgyal bu 'di'i zer lugs kyis nga la bzang po rang mi byed par thag chod/ rgyal po 'di nga la chags 'dug pas ci nas kyang / rgyal bu 'di dang lhan cig mi gnas par gzhan du 'gro ba'i thabs shig bya dgos snyam nas/ rgyal po chen po ci dgar byas pa'i mod la na ba'i rdzun chen po btab/ der rgyal po chen po'i bsams pa la/ 'di phun sum tshogs pa zhig kyang yod/ nga la yang gus pa chen po cig yod pa la/ 'di'i lusal nad kyis btab gda'/ 'di la phan pa'i sman gyi rigs sam/ sman pa ma//bas pa btsal dgos snyam nas btsal bas/ btsun mo de na re/ rgyal po chen po nga'i sman dang sman pa khyod kyis mi rnyed zer/ de ci yin zhes dris pas / nga ni lha mo zhig yin pas sman dang sman pa gtis ka lha rnyed na phan/ ma rnyed na rang res bya dgos/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na lha mi rnyed su yi sman bya zhes smras pas/ rgyal po khyed de ltar nga la thugs brtse na/ rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa 'di lha dang khyad med/ 'dis thag ring mo na/sasman blangs nas bdag la byin na phan te/ rgyal po khyed kyang / rgyal bu 'di la ha cang chags nas/ rgyal bu 'di la stobasayod kyang gar kyang gtong mi nus par gda' ba zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po na re/ gtong nus na sman gang na yod pa len du gtong /ka 88 ba4rgogasung / / da ltar lho nub srin po rgyu ba'i gnas na/ me tog ku sha na bya ba/ nged lha dag gso ba'i sman yod de de len du btang na rgyal bu 'dis lon/ nga'i nad 'di la phan par nges te/ rgyal bu 'di yang ma yar mor byung gis dogs na/sa mi mnyes pa cig 'dug rgyal po khyed kyang ha cang thugs chung nas gtong mi nus pas/ da kho mo 'gum 271 —

bkari sadar sa ngape dken gces btus las/ jo me'i gsu nga ches kyi sgor/pa las 'os gda' yi zhes smras nga/ dang / rgyal po'i rteg pa la/ rgyasnyel bu 'di nga 'a/ yang thugs brtse ba dang / sprul ba 'ig kyang yin pas/ sman de lon nges pas bcun mo 'di mi/ 'gum/ par bya ba'i don du/ kheng la gsol ba gdab dgos snyam nas/ rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa'i drung du phyin te/ khyed sprul pa'i rgyal bu snying rje dang phan sems phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba stobs dang yang ldan pas khyed nga la sems na/ lho nub srin po rgyu ba'i gnas na / me tog ku sha na zhes bya ba 'chi ba las 'tsho bar byed pa'i sman bzang po yod par gda' bas khyed kyis blangs nas de btsun mo 'di la sbyin dgos/ zhes smras pa dang / rgyal ngo/ chen po cis kyang dogs/ bdud mo tshe thung gis dogs/ rgyal srid ma brlag gis dogs/ khyed rang sku tshe yun ring du gnas pa la mi dga' bar bdag kyang na gzhon nu ma cig lho nub srin po rgyu ba'i gnas 'jigs shing ya nga ba 'phags pa ma yin pas bgrod par dka' ba der/ bltar mi rung ba'i gnas su gtong bar byed ces zer na/ kye rgyal po chen po nor rgyun ma 'phags ma lta bu de med pas rgyal po bdud kyis zil gyis mnan nam/ rgyal po chen po bdag gis 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa la phan par byed pa'i btsun mo bdag gi ma dang 'dra ba btsal te/ rgyal po la phul bas mi chog gam zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ sprul pa'i rgyal bu nged sbyorngo5 pos bya ba nyes pa byas kyang smra ba lan cig yin pas sgyur bar dka'/ de bas thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ sman de khyed kyis nges par blang dgos zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i bsams pa la/ yab rgyal po'i thugaba'il bdud mo zhugs/ bdag gis bdud mo med par bya nus kyis/ ro brgya ba'i zas ni nyon mongs pa skyed pa'i rgyu yin kyang sems can de la spyod pa rnams la med pa'i thabs med/ rgyal po 'di yang btsun mo zog ma 'di la de dang mtshungs par spyod pas/ bdag gis khas ma blangs na rgyal po 'di nyid shin tu mya ngan gyi zug rngu zug par 'gyur/ gzhan du na bdag gi dri can gyi pha yin pas sdug na mi rung ba dang / bdag la brtsams te yab kyi sdig pa bsags na yang rgyal po'ang yul du byas nas skye bo thams cad kyis sdig pa gsog par 'gyur/ bdag gis mi lus thob pa 'di ni gzhan don la thob kyis/ gzhan du na ma thob pa dang khyad par med/ des na bdag gi rted pa ma rnyed kyang sla/ gal te shi ste bdag gi ming dor kyang ci ma rung / drin che ba'i pha la phyi thag mi bsring ba dang / de la brten nas ngag gcog pa dang / pha yul du byas nas gzhan gyi sdipo/pa bsags na mi rung bas 'gro bar khas blang bar bya'o snyam ste/ yab kyi drung du phyin te/ kye mi dbang gsan du gsol/ khyed bdud mo la btsun mor 'khrul te/ lus lasachad pa'i bu mtha' la sprugasapar byed/ rgyal po chen po'i btsun mo 'di bdag gis skad cig nyid la med par bya nusamod kyis khyed dngos kyi pha yin pas sems 'khrugs na mi rung zhing phyi thag la bsams te 'gro bar bya'o// khyed kyi —272—

'bror/ ston nga/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bcun cho/ 'di yang nad gzhan mi na kho bo na/ kho bos rgyang ring bar phyin nga/ rang la sman la mi/ ltos par nad drag ma/chi zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po gnong zhing zhum par gyur te bu la ni brtse/ bcun mo la ni chags te/ sdod zer ba yang dka' song zer ba yang de dang 'dra nas bzhin bsdus te/ mchi ma/ 'jag cing gnas so/ /der blon po lnga stong gi tshogs dang / gzhan yang yul de na gnas pa'i rgan po shes pa dang ldan pa brgya phrag rgyal phran mang po dang / rang gi ma ma dag kyang bsdus te gdan la 'khod pa dang / rgyal bu bzhengs nas/ rang gi zas skal dang gos dag mdun du spungs te / yab kyi mdun du phyin nas/ 'di skad ces smras pa/ kye mi dbang chen po zas gos 'di dag ni/ bdag gi ma 'jig rten las 'das pa des kho bo la snying brtse ba'i sgo nas byin pa'i gos skal dang zas skal yin pas/ rgyal po gzhan yin par ma sems shig 'dir 'tshogs pa 'di dag ni bdag gis ma de'i bu yin/ 'di dag kyang ma de la shin tu brtse mod kyi/ las kyi dbang gis bzhag ste gzhan du song ngo / /da nga yang lho nub kye phyogs der srin po mi sha dang mi khrag la dga' ba de dag la bdag gi lus gzhon zhing gzhun pa 'di sha khrag drod ma yal bar sbyin par bya'o/ /sngon tshe rabs dpag tu med par bdag gis lus 'di du ma cig zhig sha za mang pos du ma zhig zos na'ang pha ma sems can gyi don du byin pa ni shas chung / da lan dngos kyi pha dang brgyud pa'i pha srin po rnams kyi don du spyin par bya'o/ /zas gos 'di dag ni mas bu la byin pa yin pas 'di dag la sbyin par bya'o zhes/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyang zas gos kyis tshim par byas pa dgar ma tshor bar rgyal bu 'jig rten na dkon pa bdag cag rnams la snying brtse zhing phan sems che ba byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje can de gsung de skad 'byin zhing / yul sa thag ring por gshegs pa'i sgra de thos pas / rnga mo rnge'u stong pa ltar sdug bsngal chen por gyur te/ la la ni nyam thag pa'i nga ro 'don/ la la ni skra 'bal / la la ni bzhin la sbar mos 'brad/ phal cher sa la 'gyel zhing rab tu sdug bsngal chen por gyur te ngu ba la/ rgyal bus smras pa/ kye bdag gi spun zla dag ma ngu bar yar la longs la bdag gi gtam 'di dag la nyon cig ces smras pa dang / rgyal bu'i gsung de shin tu bcag par dka' bas phal gyis dran pas bzung zhing langs/la la ni ldang bar ma nus kyang blo brtan pa dag gis phar la bteg ste/ cung zad langs pa'i mod la/ rgyal bus 'di skad ces smras pa/sdug bsngal ma byed mi lus can/ /mi lus rin chen rnyed par dka'/ /gtan gyi btsan sa 'jin nga/'i rten//rnyed dus mya ngan ma byed par/ /lha mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ /bzlog la gsol ba'i nga ro thob/ /lusa'adi sha khrag chu ser yin/ /da lta zhig kyang phangs pa med/ khyed rnams bdag la brtse gyur na/ /nga la mi dbang —273—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/chen po yis/ /nor skal gang byin de long la/ /cha cig chos dang sangs rgyas mchod/ /cha cig dge 'dun bsnyen bkur mdzod/ /cha cig ma rabs phongs la byin/ /nga ro chen pos dkon mchog la/ /bdag gi don du gsol ba thob / / nga yang dad pa brtan pa zhes/ /tha snyad ji skad thogs pa bzhin/ /dkon mchog gsum las ma g.yos par / / gsol ba 'debs shing 'gro bar byed/ /dkon mchog gsum ni rdzu 'phrul che/ /bden pa brjod na ci yang 'grub/ /byang chub gnas su phyin byed na/ /lho nub gnas der cis mi phyin/ /ri bo 'phen zhing mtsho 'khrugs pa'i / / bdud sde'i tshogasakyang 'joms byed na/ /srin po'i tshogs kyis ci byar yod/ /e ma dkon mchog rin gsum/ /nga yi mgon skyabs dpung skyed yin/ /pho brang nang du'ang skyong byed na/ /'jigasapa'i gnas su 'dor mi byed/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shesathogs med ldan/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje mtshungs med ldan/ /dad pa brtan pa zhesabya ba'i/ /thugasarje'i srasa'adi ga la 'dor/ /nga la bsams te ngu byed pa'i/ /sems ldan phyi thag ring po rnams / / gangasari'i mgul zhesagrags pa mā /dkon mchog dad pa brtan pa nga / /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'gyur ban/ /bka' gdamasarin chen bzang po'i dpal/ /bslab gsum rgyud la brten byed pa'i/ khrims ldan 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'gyur/ /e ma bsod namasaskal bar ldan/ /smon lam thobacig las can rnams/ /nub phyogasabade ba can zhes na/ /mya ngan bral zhes mkhasapa'i mchog /nga yi pha yin gsol ba thob/ /gnas 'dir 'byon gyisasdom pa long / /sna cig bsrung dang sna 'ga' dang / /phal cher bsrung dang yongs rdzogs dang / /tshangs par spyod dang ldan pa'ang rung / /rang dang 'tshams par khrimasalong la/ /gnas der 'tshogasapa'i smon lam sgrigs/ /de ltar byasan 'dir yang 'tshog /ma ngu ma ngu chos de sems/ /'phags pa'i chos yin 'jig rten na'ang / / ngus pa lasaro dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes sems la phan pa'i chosabashad pa dang / thamasacad semasasos te / rgyal bu la bltasashing 'di skad du/ ma 'ongs 'phagasapa khyed kyi zhing / /gangasari'i mgul der legasabaltamasponas/ khyed kyi rjes su slob byed pa'i/ /rnam thar gtsang ma dag tu shog /ces smosalam btab nas/yul de na bzang ba'i rta cig la sga bsgron te/ rgyal bu chibasasu gsol/ rang rang gisakyang rta phun sum tshogs pa mang po la sgo bsgron te bdag cag rnam kyang rgyal bu khyed dang lhan cig tu lho nub kyi phyogs der 'gro bar bya'o zhes grong khyer gyi gzhi mdo na mar la rgyal bu la brtse brtse bzhin du 'ongs pa dang / grong khyer gyi skye bo thams cad kyis kyang tshor nas mig gdong mchi masadag par byasate/ rgyal bu'i mdun du 'ongasanas/ yum 'phagasam lta bu de med kyi rjes su khyed kyang mi bsrun pa'i yul du gshegs par byed dam/ kye ma'o zhesargyal bu la bltasashing smre sngags 'don no/ /rgyal bu de ni skye bo thams cad kyi dbus na nga rgyal dang khengs pa thamasacad bsal nas —274—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gcam zhing dul la/ des chags par mdzad/ grong khyer ba'i skye bo thams cad la kye grogs po dag nam phugs rgyal po'i bu la'ang mi gda' ba/ 'phral gyi zas 'grangs cam khyi dang phag pa la'ang yod dus/ skye ba gtan gyi bcan sa ma/ zin na/ mthun pa'i pha ma dang gnyen gyis kyang 'der/ nor dang longs spyod mang yang mgron shul du lus / sdod na dgra bo ldang / gnyer khas rje'i bran du 'khol/ mthun na pha dang bu yang dgra bor 'gyed/rgod na nga dang khyod kyi rang srog skyel/ kye grogs dag yab rgyal por nor gyi nga rgyal/ nor gyis bdud mo bkugabadud mo/sa bdag spyugs par gyur/ kye grogs dag de lta bas na nor ni ming dang don mthun te/ mthun par shes rnga/ra gyis la spongs shig ces bsgo ba dang / skye bo dag na re/ e ma sngon chad gyur ba na/ /mi dbang skyon med kun gyis bkur/ /dad pa che dang dkon mchog 'dzin/ /snying rje che zhing kun la phan/ /da ni mig 'bras 'dra ba yi/ /rgya bu dam pa gang du gtong / /nang gi snying dang 'dra ba yi/ /phyi ru 'don glags med pa 'di/ /lo dang bskal bar phyogs bcu sa /cang shes zhon (bzhonakate mig stong gis/ /bcal kyang 'dra ba mi rnyed na/ /dngos nyid rnyed par smos ci 'tshal/ /e ma mi dbang ci la 'khrul/ /rnyed dka'i rin chen phugs mi brtan/ /brtan pas zog ma tshe bsring thabs/ /sna tshegs spyod pa don med 'gyur/ /rgyal bu khyed la mthu yod na/ /bdud mo sgrol zhing bdag cag skyobs/ /yul 'dir yun du mi bzhugs par/ /bdag cag brtse bar ci phyir 'jog /skyes mchog rin chen sned dka' ba/ /gcig gi den du kun ma btang / /mi dbang chags pa che cig yin/ /bdag cag chags pa 'khor ba'i bar/ /rgyasnyel bus che 'di'i don dag la/ /skye ba dpag med ma btang zhes/ /bdag cag skye bo mang po la/ /chos kyi bslab bya byed gyur na/ khyed rang de las bzlog ci rigs/ /yang na nged kyang mya ngan bral/ /'phags pa'i drung du skyel bar zhu/ /yang na khyed dang lhan cig tu/ /gdug pa'i yul der nged kyang 'gro /lha yisa'adren par mi nus pa'i/ khyed kyi sku mchog gtong byed na/ /sha khrag chu ser rus pa'i lus/ /zhe sdang khong khro'i rgyur song bas/ /ding sang mchungs par smin pa ni/ /ci ste gtong bar mi byed rigs/ /rgyal srid rgya mtsho bor gyur te/ /rnyed dang bkur sti khyad bsad nas/ /'khor med gcig pur 'gro 'gyur na/ / yi dgas gnasabazhin bkren gyur cing / /stobs med gzhan gyi dbang gyur ba/ /ci ste gnas 'dir zhen par byed/ /gang gis khyed kyi rjethangami 'brang / /bdag cag rnams kyang 'gro'o zhes/ khyed kyis rjes su gnang ba zhu/ /zhes pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa de gsan pa dang / de dag la brtse ba'i phyir du/ rgyal bus smras pa/ khrel gzhung phyi thag ldan gyur ba'i / / skye bo 'dir 'tshogs bdag la nyon/ /blo sna ma bskyod gnas 'dir 'dug khul rings 'jigs pa'i lam zhugs na/ /nyan thag chos dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /srin po'i zas ni sha khrag yin/ /lhag par mi sha dag —275—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus snyelas/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/la gdung / /nor 'byin ma de med gyur bas/ /rgyal po'i snying la bdud mo zhugs/ /bdag gis shes te bsgral nus kyang / /bdag la pha yi sdeg bsags na/ /rgyal ngo/ shan pa nyid dang mchungs/ /blon po mi bkur dmangs kyi 'bar / / yul 'brugs rgyal srid nyams par byed/ /mnga' 'og sdug bsngal nyid la 'god/ /de phyi/ra snyelas/ su 'gro byed na/ khyed rnams ci ste bskyed par byed/ /nga yang mi thogs myur du 'ong / /bde bar gshegs pas lam sna 'dren/ /dam pa'i chos kyis gzhogs nas brten/ /dge 'dun dag gis rgyab brten nas/ /ma chags zas kyis rang 'tsho zhing / /gzhan don khrims kyis rab brgyan te/ /mi yang bzod pa'i go cha rgyan/ /brtson pa'i dpa' bos dgra bcom zhing / /rtse gcig blo sna mi ma/nga bar/ /shes rab ma/tshon cha phyogs su 'phen/ /de ni bdag gi yon tan de/ /bsam pa sa la bzang gyur bas/ /lha yi me tog steng nas bkur ka 92 na1 bskyur / /bsam pa steng nas bzang gyur bas/ /klu yi mchod pa 'og nas byed/ /bsam pa dbus nas bzang gyur bas/ /phyogs skyong rgyal po bzhi yis bsrung / /nga bdag dgra bo rang choms pas/ /gzhan gyi dgra bo dbyings su 'gags / / chos de go'am rna dbang can/ /las bzang rgyun gyis ma g.yos na/ /glo bur bdud kyis ci zhig bya/ /tshe yi 'du byed dor gyur kyang / /chos phyir dor gyis skal ba bzang / /chos phyir 'chi nus dam/ pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / skye bo thams cad kyis kyang chos kyi go ba khyad par can rnyed rgyal bu la 'dod pa dang dad pa dang yid ches pa'i dad pa dang gsum ga skyes so/ /'di'i skabs su/ rngog gi zhal nas/ bla ma la 'di lta bu'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yod pa la/ bdag cag la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis mched grogs tsam du bsgoms pa'i 'dzol chen po byas pa yod/ dad pa gsum po de skyes pa de skye bo de rnams shin tu bden/ de 'dra ba'i yon tan la dad pa skye dgos/ mchi ma 'don pa shin tu bden te/ de 'dra ba'i rgyal bu yul ma rungs pa der gshegs pa/ rgyal po de 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar che ba zhig la/ blo sna de 'dra ba cig yod pa ci yin/ rgyal po de 'dra yang bud med kyis bslus na/ da lta'i nyon mongs pa can rnams 'os med ces/ rngog yang mchi ma mang po zag /ka 92 na5 waṃzagasaso/ // der jo bo'i zhal 'dzum mdzad nas / de'i dus du rgyal po de su yin na dpa' gsungs ba la/ 'brom yang rngog la phyag cab cab mdzad nas/rgyal po de 'dra zhig bu de na phar gtong ba bud med kyi rigs 'dis ci yang byed/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa kun yin na nga 'dra ba'i rgan po la'ang ser sna byed ces gsungs pa dang / rngeg gi zhal nas/ 'o na rang rgyal po de nga min na rung spyod tshul des chog pa yin zer bas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po la skyon med de'i dus su yang dad pa che bar grags/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs su skyes/ dkon mchog gsum mchod pa dang mi 'bral ba —276—

'brom ston pa rgyasnyepa ba'i 'byung gnas kye skyes rabs bka' gdams bu ches ba‘nyugs so/ /mkhas pa ma/nga po bsten pa'i stobs kyis chos kyi ge ba yang shin tu che/ rgyal bu de yul de na phar 'gro ba'i rkyen gyis sgrol ma/'i sprul pa ku sha na len pa'i bdag rkyen du 'gyur te/ da snyepta yan chod du las smon lam/ bzang ngo/'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs nga/ra gyur ba ni rang yin mod gsungs pas/ jo bo'i /kaisnyel nas/ 'brom/ gyi gsung la skyon me/da/ bdag gis gtam/ gyi 'apro bshad kyis/ de snyeltar skye bo tham/sa cad kyis dad pa'i sgo nas rjes su 'brang zhing thag ring por bskyal ba dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyang phyir log khyed tshe la 'di na phar 'gro ba'i stobs re/da/ mi/ rta ma/nga po'ang mgron du 'gro/ nga la rgyal ngo/ byas khyed kyis 'khor gyis bskor nas 'gro ba'i skabs de da lan gyi 'di ma yin pas/ rang sa rang sar rang gis gang thub pa/'i sdom/ nga/ bla ma mya ngan bral ba la long la/ rang gzhan tham/sa cad kyi don du srungs shig ces bsgo ba dang / thams cad kyang rgyal bu la 'phreng bzhin du mig mchi mas gang ste phyir nud byed cing / gom pa re la ngal re byed cing phyir log ste seng ngo / /de dag 'phags pa mya ngan bral ba zhes bya ba rgyal bu'i che rabs thams cad kyi bla ma/ mngon shes thogs nga/ re/da pa des mkhyen nas/ rgyal po'i shul du blon 'bangs thams cad kyi dbugs phyung / rang rang dang snyeritsham/ pa'i sngo ma nga/ rnams nos/ rgyal bu la bar chad mi mnga' ba'i chul ma/nga po brjod/ myur du ldog nga/'i lung bstan/ rgyapa kro/ pa'ang btsun mo des bar chod byas kyis dogs nas ma/nan nga/'i 'khor lo bcud/ lus la'ang srung ba btags/ der rgyal po dang grong khyer na gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyang yid cung zad sos/ da 'o na rgyal bu yang sku tshe'i bar gcod du ma/ gyur ba gnas 'di nyid du 'byon srid nga/ra 'dug bdag cag rnams kyang yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur ba'i chul khrims kyi bgo skal re'ang lon/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na skyes bu dam pa de'i gdul byar 'gyur ba'i las bsags/ da lan ma mjal kyang / ma/ 'ongs pa ni yun mi ring bas de dus su mjal na bya rgyu med kyis zer nas/ thams cad kyang blo ma/thun nga/ra/ rgyal bu sngar ji ltar mjad pa bzhin du dkon mchog gi mchod pa la sogs pa rgyal bu'i don du byas/ rgyal bu'i rtog pa la'ang / rgyal bu phal cher ma 'otswarmen srid/ gal te byon kyang nor gyis ldang snyam nas/ rgyal srid kyi phyed la sngar gyi blon 'bangs de dag dpang du bzhag ste/dkon mchog gi mchod pa la sogs pa rgyal bu ji skad zer ba bzhin du byas so/ /der rgyal bus kyang / lho nub kyi phyogs la/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang khengs grags bor te/ lo gsum zla ba gsum gyi bar du byon pa dang /yul de na ri tsam med pa la yun ring por phyin pa'i sa de na ri brag nag po mang po col le yod rnga// lce spyang dang khā ta la sogs pa gcan gzan dang bya mang po rgyu ba shin tu nyams mi dga' ba'i yul cig tu slebs pa na/grogs med pas cung zad skyo ba snyam byed pa na/ gzhan la mi 956gas pa'i lam 'gag cig tu mi ser po mig —277—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/dmar ldib (ljibs3 se ba ral ba dmar po rkang ba'i thad na mar nyil le slebs pa/ sbar mo rnams lcags kyi rnam par sngo seng nge ba rno ba/ sna rdog che zhing so rno ba/ lag na gser gyi ral gri thogs pa cig 'dug pa na re/mi'i bu sa thag ring po nas 'ongs/ khyod mtshar po zhig 'dug ste/ grogs kyis bor longs spyod dang bral rgyus med kyi mi/ 'ong ma myong ba'i lam du bzhugs pa/ rang stobs kyis 'ongs pa yin nam/ 'on te rdzu 'phrul gyi nga rgyal ba yin nam/ 'on te gzhan gyis dbang med du sprugs te 'ongs pa yin nam/ khyed su yin gar ci la 'gro zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du dris pa las/ rgyal bu gzugs can de mthong bas/ grogs med gcig pur 'di 'dra ba'i lus blangs te skyo ba snying re rje snyam du byams pa dang snying rje tshad med pa skyes/ sku na gzhen pa dang yun ring por grogs med du 'ongs pas kho mthong ba dang skyo ba sangs pa snyam byed de/ kho'i rtsar blo phab ste bsdad/rang gi blon 'bangs rnamasakyis bskur ba'i zas zhim po de dag kho la'ang byin nas sngar ji ltar byung ba'i gtam de dag gyu ru lugs su kho la bshad pas/ khong gi bsam pa bzang po de dang / khro gnyer med cing bzhin 'dzum rī/ dang snyeldan te/ gtam thams cad gsong bor smrasapas/ kho'i sems gdug rtsub can de yang rab tu thul te/phas bu mthong ba bzhin du shin tu dga' nas khos kyang smras pa/ kho bo mi mthong ba'i tshe sha khrag gi ro la rkan sgra tog pa la/ de ring ni kho bo'i sems 'di sngar las kyang 'gyur/ rgyal bu khyed mthong ba'i tshe phas bu mthong ba bzhin du skyo ba sangs te/ mi khyed kyi pha rgyal po glen pa cig yod par 'dug lo thog smin pa sad la bskur nas/sabon rul ba rol 'og tu 'debs/ bu nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu lho nub kyi phyogs 'dir 'phangs nas/ bud med gling bar gyi mun pa 'dra ba de khang par bsu/ da ni rgyal po dang blon 'bangs mig rno yang nyi ma med pa'i stobasakyis legs nyes kyi gzugs mthong ba dka'/ kye rgyal po shes nas nyes pa las ldog par byed dgos pas khyod la rgyal po'i sprugs byung 'dugame tog ku sha na bya ba de mo la phan pa'i sman min/ de ni srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu'i bu mo yin/sman zhes bya ba ni mi mtshar ba la zer ba yin/ me tog ces zer ba ni mdzes pas btags pa yin/ ku sha na zhes bya ba ni ming dngosayin/ de khyed kyis mi lon/ rgyu mtshan ni/ srin yul lang ka pu rangasazhes bya ba ni/ srin po ma rungs pa'i yul yin/ de la lcagasari rim pa bdun gyisabaskor/ phyi'i lcags ri nag po khro las byasapa la lcagaba'ikyi sgo bcug pa sno yang phyogs bzhi na btod pa/ lcags ri'i ngos re la rta mgyogs bul ran pa zhig gi nyin lam bco brgyad bco brgyad yod pa/ bar thams cad khro'i sa gzhi la khro'i me tog tsher ma can mang po skyes pa yod/ /lcags ri gnyis pa ni lcags nyid kyi lcags ri la zangs sgo dmar po phyogs bzhir btod pa/ bar —278—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /lcags kyi sa gzhi la lcags kyi me tog cher ma can skyes pa yod pa/ gsum/ pa ni zangs kyi lcags ri la ra gan kha bsgyur gyi sgo bcug pa yod pa/ bar thams cad kyang zangs kyi sa gzhi la zangs kyi me tog skyes pa yod/ ba'i pa ra gan gyi lcags ri la dngul gyi sgo bcug pa yod pa/ sa gzhi thams cad kyang ra gan gyi sa gzhi la ra gan gyi me tog skyes pa yod/ lnga pa ni dngul gyi lcags ri la gser gyi sgo bcug pa yod/ bar thams cad dngul gyi sa gzhi la dngul gyi me tog skyes pa yod/ drug pa ni gser gyi lcags ri la rin po che lnga'i sgo btod pa/ bar thams cad gser gyi sa gzhi dang / gser gyi me tog skyes pa yod/ bdun pa ni la cha'i lcags ri la rgya skyegs dam/ra po'i sgo btod pa/ bar thams cad kyang la cha'i sa gzhir yod la/ de la lcags ri dang po la srin ngo/ mgo gcig pas sgo srung byed pa nas/ sgo bdun pas sgo srung byed pas de la sus kyang thar bar dka'/ nang gi srin po'i rgyal ngo/'i pho brang dang phal ba thams cad kyi khang pa yang la cha dang rgya skyegs las byas pa yod do/ /srin po'i pho brang gi nang la ka ba stong bcugs/ g.yos khang rang la'ang ka ba brgya yod/ pho brang de'i nang na rin po che'i khri'i steng na mi lpags kyi mated byas pa legs po'i stan mthon po'i steng na/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu zhes bya ba mgo bcu gcig yod pa/ bcu gcig pa nyid rta mgor yod pa/ shin tu 'jigs shing ya nga ba yod/ de ltar pho brang che 'ing mtho ba'i dbus mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu (cukartsa gcig gi rtse mo nyis stong gi rtse mo na/ sman me tog ku sha na zhes bya ba 'od kyis nyi ma'ang zil gyis gnon nus pa/ sku mdog dkar bas dkar ngo/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ mjes pas mjes pa thams cad zil gyis gnon nga// bltas na mig 'jin/ nyan na rna ba 'dzin / bsnams na sna 'dzin/ reg na lus 'dzen/ de dag gi rjes su skyes bu'i yid 'jin pa/ phra sa na phra ba rdo rje 'dra ba/ sbom sa na sbom pa grims shing sha lus rgyas pa/ gnag sa na gnag pa skra snum zhing gnag pa/ sngo sa na sngo ba smin ma g.yu ltar sngo ba/ mig la dkar nag gi mdangs gsal ba/ so dkar la che chung snyoms shing 'grig pa/ lha'i gos phun sum tshogs pas lus brgyan pa/ de la'ang rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor mo'ang rang dang mchungs pa bdun la'ang / 'khor me bdun bdun te zhe dgus bskor ba/ lha dang mi dang srin po'i nor thams cad la longs spyod pa/ na tshod lo bcu drug ma'i na tshod du yod pa/ rtag tu lang ka pu rangs su sdod pa'i srin po rnams kyis kyang mi mthong ba tsam du yod na/ khyed kyis mthong bar dka'o/ /mthong ba tsam gyis chog na sla ste/ srin po gdug pa can rnams kyis zos pa'i khrims yod/ de bas phyir log pa mi rung ngam/ sa thag kyang ring po yod cesasmras pa/ rgyal bu na re/ bden pa khyod bden/ lus snying po med pa ni srin pos zos de bdag gi tshogs rdzogs pa sla'i/ pha drin can gyi bka' bcag ste nyes pa khur du 'khur ba ni de lta ma yin/ gal te phyir —279—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/log kyang khong gis bzang po byed pa yang dka'/ de'i stobs kyi nga phar la ku sha na cis kyang len du 'gro dkon mchog thugs rje che ba'i stobs kyis bar chod med par don grub pa srid ces smras pa dang / kho na re/ khyed dam bcas pa'i khur mi 'dor ba gzhung dang phyi thag can cig 'dug nga la'ang snying gtam mang po bag phab nas bshad / da khyed cis kyang 'gro ba'i rting la ngas kyang bslab bya cig bya ba la bab pas/ de na phar 'gro ba la khyed rta 'dis kyang phyin par mi nus pas/ nga la rta gang bsams par sleb pa bal gyi glang po che bya ba yod pas/ de la khyed skyon la btang dgos/ dus kyi dbang du byas na'ang nges med la phyin na mi rung bas/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin par dkar gsal 'od po che la gatshogs te 'gro dgos te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / khyed rang gi ston pa shākya thub pa zhes zer ba des dus khyad par can de'i nyin par srin po rnams la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phog sha'i nyes dmigs mang po bstan/ sha de yang pha ma'i sha 'ba' zhig yin zer na/sa/ nged srin po'i zas skal sha khras yin pas thams cad chod gsung ba la/ thams cad gcod par ma nus/ khyed mi rnams dang mi 'dra cham/ tshom la dam bca' mi byed / dam gang bcas pa las mi 'da' ba nged kyi lugs yin/ da dus khyad par can tshes bco lnga'i nyin par khyed 'byon dgos/ de ltar byon na srin po rnams kyis gnod pa mi byed kyi steng du zhabs tog byed pa'ang srid pas / de la sngar bshad pa bzhin du sgo dang po na srin po mgo gcig pa yod pa nas/ sgo bdun snye / na mgo bdun pa'i bar du srin po dag na re/ khyed gang nas 'ongs/ ci la 'ongs/ don su la gnyer ces pa la sogs pa mang po 'dri yang spyir mi chos pa dang lha chos pa thams cad la khrel dang phyi thag ring ba de chos su 'thad pa gda' bas/gtam gyi rigs 'di yang rdzun med na phyi thag ring ba cig 'ong bar gda'/ rgyu mtshan des gsong por smras na ri bong yang 'dzin nus pas khong 'dri ba la lan drang bor mang por thob/ rgya gar shar phyogs nas 'ongs pa dang rgyal po'i rigs su skyes pa dang / di ring tshes bco lnga'i dkar gsal 'od po che la rta gar bsams par sleb pa bal gyi glang po ches bskyal/ di ring khyed rnams sdom pa srungs zer bas/ ya mtshan che nas bltar 'ongs pa dang /gtso che bar srin po'i rigs rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu la mjal du 'ongs pa yin/ gnod pa ma byed par lam legs par thong zhes sgrogs shig de nas sgo rim pa bdun dang srin po phal ba thams cad kyi grong 'das nas/srin po'i rgyal po nyid kyi pho brang du slebs nas/ sus kyang gnod pa byed mi nus kyis/ de'i nang du sleb pa dang me tog ku sha na dang phrad pa la nye'o/ /me tog ku sha na de yang mig rno/ lta ba mtho/ de ni sngar gyi brjod pa bzhin du yon tan che la/ srin po dag ni de ltar ma yin/ gnas de na mo'i grogs su 'os pa cig kyang med/ der rgyal bu byon pa rang gis me dang pra ba 'phrad pa bzhin du 'gro srid ces bslab bya legs po byas te/ rta gar bsams —280—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sleb pa bal gyi glang po che zhes bya ba rta'i lus blangs pa la rdzu 'phrul che ba de khong la gtad/ rgyal bu'i rta mi'i nang na bzang shos su 'dod pa de ni sgo srung de la bzhag ste/ khyed rang gi lha gang yin pa la phyag 'chal la song shig ces bsgo ba dang / rgyal bus kyang de bzhin du/ rang gi lha la phyag 'tshal ba/ rtag tu bde ba chen po'i mchog / 'phral dang phugs su ster byed cing / /skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba'i/ /lha mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sgo gsum gyis btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ lho nub kyi mtshams la phyin pa dang / dpag tshad lnga bcu (cuka'adas pa na sbrul nag po gnya' shing cam zhig gis sprul dkar po de cam zhig gis lus sum gnyis cam zos par byas/ dkar po des kyang nag pe'i phyed cam zos par byas 'dug pa de rgyal bus mthong ba dang 'di lta bu'i sems can ma dag pa zhe sdang gi sgang bu phugs ma mthong bar 'phral rtsod 'phral gzhan la sngang zhing rang la chags pa ltar byed kyang / ma rig pa'i dbang gis phugs ni rang phung bar byas so/ /'di gnyis ni gcig gis gcig bsad snyam ste/ tha mar rang gi srog kyang chad par 'gyur ro/ /sems can nyon mongs pa rnams kyi spyod pa ni 'di kho na dang 'dra snyam ste/ de gnyis kyis kun nas bslangs te/ sems can thams cad la snying rje drag po skyes/ de gnyis sprul du shes kyang rang gi lus la gces spras su ma byas par de gnyis la brtse bas phral te btang ngo / /der gnyis kar lus rma can de dag la rang gi lce dmar sing nge ba res ldags te lusasos te mi snang bar song ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal bus smras pa/ chags sdang dbang gis dkrugs pa yis rang srog rang gis bskyal ba rnam/sa/ /phugs kyi don la mi dpyod par/ /lus ngan rgyun du sring bar byed/ /ding sang bdag gis phan sems kyis/ /sprul la ji ltar phan pa bzhin/ /kun gyis sman par bdag gyur te/ /sems can yongs la'ang phan par shog /ces rgyang grags cig tu phyin pa na/ mi dkar po/ rta dkar po/ gos dkar po/phod dkar bo btsugs pa zhig byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' khyed gcig pur sa thag ring po la snyel/ da nga'i pho brang du bsnyen bkur zhig byed pas dbugs 'byin cing gshegs par zhu/ khyed su yin smras pas/ nga kha sang gi sprul dkar po yin/ rgyal bus zhal nas smras pa/ sbrul nag po de su yin/ klu bdud nag po 'dzin pa lag mangs bya ba yin/ 'o na khyod la ji skad zer/ dkar po dung skyong zhes grags/ khyed gnyis mnga' risaci la ma 'cham/ spyir nged gnyis sa 'di'i bdag po yin/ de'i nang nas sa 'di la brten pa'i chu phal gyi bdag tu kho che / rtsi shing nags tshal gyi bdag po nga yin mod/ nged gnyis tshe mnyam la ma 'cham pa'i rkyen byung / gnyisaka gnyisakasaphung bar byed pa'i dus su/ rgyal bu khyed kyi byang chub sems kyis nged gnyis ka'i gdug rtsub zhi bar byasate rang rang gi lus kyang sos/ de'i nang nas kyang kho sos pas ni chu mod/ char chu dus su 'bab/ de'i rtsi —28/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/shing nags tshal kyang 'phel grogs byed/ sems can mang po la'ang phan bde 'byung / nga'i lus sos pas ni/rtsi shing nags tshal dang / rne'u gsing dang / me tog sna tshogs pa skye/ mi thams cad la yang nor 'dzin/ bu skye ba la sogs pa yon tan mang po 'ong / des na dngos su nged gnyis la phan btags/ brgyud nas sems can mang po la brtse bar mdzad pas/ khyed ci dgos dri can yin pas cis kyang nga'i sar 'byon par zhu zer ba dang / rgyal bu'i bsams pa la/ nga yang sa tharga ring po la dub nas gda' ba dang / klu 'di la nga drin che zhing / dri lan du gus par gda' ba dang / da dung gtam gsar pa'ang thos pa srid pas 'gro dgos snyam ste/ khas blangs nas phyin te/ dung skyong gi yul du sleb pa dang / dung skyong gis bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas nas/ rgyal bu khyed gang du gshegs par 'dod pa yin zer/ rgyal bus sngar gyi byung chul tsho brjod pa dang / dung skyong na re/khyod la rgyal po'i spyugs byung nas gda'/ me tog ku sha na srin po'i bu mo khyed kyis gang na lon/ sha za khrag 'thung gi rtsar gshegs pa bas/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa 'di'i nang du bzhugs te/ ji ltar mnyes pa bzhin du bdag gis bsnyen bkur zhing mchod gnas mdzad pa drag mo/da ces gsol ba btab pa dang / sngar srin po'i lam srung de la ji ltar bsnyad pa bzhin gleng bas/ dung skyong na re/ cis kyang gshegs na/ phyis 'khor srid na nged kyis 'dir mi 'byon pa'i thabs med/ g.yu 'di dag khyer la 'phral gang dgos pa'i mthun rkyen mdzod ces g.yu lnga bskur ro/ /yang rgyang grags gsum 'das par phyin pa na/ 'jen pa lag mangs mi nag gos nag phod nag btsugs pa dang yang 'phrad de/ sbrul dkar po dang ji ltar byung ba bzhin der yang mdzad de/ zhag gcig der bzhugs/ yun du bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang bar/ g.yu lnga phul ba bzhes te lang ka pu rangs su byon pa dang / lcags ri la bltas pas/ rgya che zhing dpangs mtho ba rin chen po'i snang ba skye ba gda' ba la'ang / rta mgyogs bul ran pa'i nyin lam bco brgyad yod pa'i ngos la snga dro la chod par byas te/ khro'i lcags ri dang po'i sgo brdungs pas srin po mgo gcig pa cig byung ste/ di ring bsnyen gnas bsrung ba min na mi rta gnyis la so rtsa mngar tsam 'ong ba gda' ba la/ di ring sdom pa bsrung ba'i dus yin pa dang / mi rta gnyis po 'di'i mtshan ltas kyis nang du btang dgos pa cig 'ong ngam/ 'on kyang gtam dris shing mnyan na go bas/ khyod gang nas ci la 'ongs su la don gasnyer du 'ongs zhes dris pa dang / lam srung gis sngar ji skad bslabs pa bzhin smras so/ /sgo 'byed kyi ston mo la g.yu rdog cig ske la btags so/ /de nas sgo bdun pa'i bar du yang g.yu re re byin cing bsgo ba dang dris lan sngar bzhin du byas so/ /der sgo bdun 'das pa'i nang du slebs pa dang / srin po srin mo'i srin phrug dang bcas pa mang pos mthong ngo / /za ba dang bsad —282—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sems med kyi steng du chags sems chen po skyes pa la/ rgyal bus srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu'i sgo gang na yod dris pas/ gtam len gser gyis nyos kyang mi khug pa de dag rgyal bu la gtam lan 'jal ba la su thob tu byas te/ da la cha dang rgya skyegs kyi khang bu sgo bzhir btod pa yod mod kyis shar phyogs nas 'ongs pa shar phyogs la song zhig zer ba thos pa dang / pho brang gi nang du phyin te slebs pa dang / gser gyi khri chen po mi lngags mnyed ma'i 'bol stan bting ba'i steng na/ srin po'i rgyal po mgo bcu gcig pa rtse mo rta mgor yod pa/sus rtsar phyin kyang bag khums nas 'gro ba cig gda' ba la khri de las langs nas byung ste/ de ring dus khyad par can la sprul pa'i sku cig byung dri ba yod zer nas/ mgrin pa dang po nas/ rgyal bu la zhus pa/ /mtshan ldan khyed ni gang nas 'ongs/ /gang gi rigs yin dpal 'byor ci/ /ci bzhed lam ring bgrod dka' sa /gdug pas gnod pa ma byung ngam/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs dag nas 'ongs/ /rbha ga la yi rgyal rgyud yin / / mnga' ris blon 'bangs rgyal po ni/ /nam mkha'i skar tshogs nyi zla 'dra/ /chos dang dpal 'byor lha dbang bzhin/ /de na bdag dang mthun pa yi/ /mtshan bzang grogs ni ma mchis pas/ /'di na'ang gang dang 'gran bral ba'i/ /srin po'i rgyal po khyod nyid la/ ku sha na zhes sras shig thos/ /'di na'ang mo dang mthun pa yi/ /grogs med nga nyid 'os pa skad/ /blo can mang po de skad zer/ /thag ring lam la myur du 'ongs/ /srin po'i rgyal pos mgrin pa gnyis pa nas smras pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad mdzes pa yi/ /rgyal bu mthong bar dka' ba khyod / / sus bskyal tshes grangs du la 'ongs/ /srin po'i rigs 'di sha la dga'/ khyed lus mtshan dpesaspras 'di la/ /brnab sems skyed du ma byung ngam/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ de ring rgyal bas phyin brlabs pa'i/ /dus la khyad 'phags bco lnga 'dir/ /ba glang shugs kyis 'dir 'ongs te/ /bsams pa bzang bas gnod ma gyur/ /yang mgrin pa gsum pa nas smras pa/ lta bas mi ngoms gzugs mdzes po/ khyed kyi snyan pa'i sgra byung bas/ /bdag gi yid dbang tshim par gyur/ /rin chen khri 'dir bde bar bzhugs/ /zhes zer te/ rin po che'i khri rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i steng na rgyal bu nyid dang mthun pa'i dar zab kyi gdan bshams te de'i steng du bzhugs su gsol ba dang / rgyal bus kyang bag ma 'khums par khri de'i steng du bzhugs te/ kye rgyal po chen po/bdag gis tshig 'di la snyan gtod cig /lang ka pu rangs bya ba 'dir/ /pha ma srin po gang yin la/ /bu yang phrin phrug nyid du skye/ /de las gzhan du mthong ngam ci/ /srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /de bzhin srog bcad sha zos pas/ /tshe thung phal cher dmyal bar 'gro /lan du'ang gsod gcod rang sha dag /gzhan gyis za zhing 'jomasapar byed/ /rgyu song 'bras bu'ang de dang mtshungs/ /srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ khyod kyis mi rnams —283—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsad pa gang / /sngon chad des kyang khyed rnams gsod/ /'dir bsad phyi mar khyed kyang gsod/ /mthon por spyod pa'i bya tshogs dag /lan du sa la 'bab pa bzhin/ /mi dge'i lan du sdug bsngal te/ /dge ba'i lan du bde ba yin/ /zhes smrasapa dang / /mgrin pa bzhi ba nas smras pa/ nga ni srin po'i rgyal po ste/ /srin po dag dang mthun bstan phyir/ /rgyu med 'bras bu ma mthong na'ang / /rgyu ngan bsad sha za dgosabyung / /rgyal busasmrasapa/srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /grogs ngan stobs kyis phung ba mang / /pha mar ma gyur med pa yi/ sha khrag zos na dmyal bar 'gro/ /mgrin pa lnga ba nas smras pa/ /sngon gyi las ngan 'phro btsan pas/ /mi 'dod bzhin du 'grogs dgos byung / /lto med bsran par ma nus pas/ /pha ma'i sha yang bza' dgos byung / /rgyal bus smras pa/srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /las kyi dbang gis dmyal 'phangasate/ /btso bsregs mtshon gyisagatubs pa na//grogs ngan ram zlar 'ong ngam ci/ /mgrin pa drug pa nas smras pa/ de 'dra'i sdug bsngal gyur ba'i tshe/ /grogs ngan nyid kyang rang phung na/ /bdag gi ram zlar smos ci 'tshal/ long bas long khrid gnyis lhung bzhin/ /rgyal busasmrasapa/ de ltar shesabazhin mi 'chos pa/ /de bas spyo ba gang nasa'atshol/ /de nyid myong bar the tshom med/ /las ngan rigasani 'brel ba gnag /mgrin pa bdun pa nas smras pa/ 'o na 'khor ba sdug bsngal che/ /grogaspu ngan shan ni mgo snying 'dod/ khyed kyang btsan sami 'dzin par/ /nga yi gnas 'dir ci don gnyer/ /rgyalabusasmras pa/ srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /skyob par byed pa'i grogs po gsum / / 'bral med rgyun du rjes su 'brang / /mgrin pa brgyad pa nasasmras pa/ 'bral med grogasade bstan du gsol / / skyob pa mchog de bstan du gsol/ /gru bo che de bstan du gsol/ /bdag gi mi shesabasal du gsol / / rgyal bus smras pa/ chos byed dge 'dun sangasargyas gnyer/ khyod kyi mi mthong nga yi yul/ /nyen mongs ltar 'chos bu mo 'dod/ /'brel zab khyod la phan par 'gyur/ /mgrin pa dgu pa nasasmras pa/ dkon mchog gsum po khyod kyi grogs/ /nga yi don la 'ongs pa legs/ /gzugs mdzes ma de 'di steng na/ /stong phrag cig gi rtse na gda'/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ 'di nas them skas ji tsam zhig khyod kyis lam sna byasagyur te/ /ku sha na dang phrad pa na/ /rang gzhan kun la phan par 'gyur/ /mgrin pa bcu ba nasasmras pa/ shes rab 'od gsalamig ldan pa/ /yan chod bdag gi spyod yul min/ /'di dag sha za khrag 'thung gnas/ /gtsang ma'i gnasader 'gro mi ster/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ 'o na bdag gis 'gro bar bya/ /ku sha na de blta bar bya/ /rgyal po khyed dang 'gro ba la/ /dngos dang brgyud pas phan par bya/ /mgrin pa bcu gcig pa nasasmras pa/ rta mchog can khyod mgyogs par spyod/ /dgu brgya dgu bcu (cu1rtsa gcig dang / /rtse dgu stong gi rtse mor song / /them skasasum —284—

'brer ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /brgya drug bcu (cu3yod/ /sgo bdun bu mo bdun gyis srung / /'das pa'i nang na lha mo yod/ /rgyal bus smras pa/srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' lung las/ / skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi bar bshad/ /shi tshe chos dang bral gyur na/ /'di yi 'byor ba don med 'gyur/ /shes bzhin log par spyod pa gang / /mi brgya gsod la de mi rung / /mnar med gnas nas ma thar bas/ /gtan gyi bde ba rlag par byed/ /srin po'i rgyal po nga la nyon/ /nga la rang 'dod ci yang med/ /nga ni bgrod dka'i lam zhugs pas/ /lus can sems can mngon gyur du/ khyod kyis sdug bsngal nyid la bkod/ /rgyud pas khyod nyid sdug bsngal 'gyur/ khyod dang sems can phan slad du/ /bzod stobs yal bar ma dor bar/ /bde skyid ro la zhen bral nas/ /phan par mthong phyir 'ongs pa yin/ khyod kyis lus la bcad gtubs te/ /gzhan gyis zos shing khrag 'thungs na/ khyod la sdug bsngal ci tsam mchis/ /rgyal po rang la'ang dpe long la/ /gzhan la gcod khams ma che zhig /rgyal po khyod las bdud 'gyur gyis/ /blo gros rtsal stobs nga che mod/ /nga rgyal bcag ste gcig pur 'ongs/ /dman cha blangs te thams cad khur/ /skad cig nyid la rgyal bu yis/ /mkha' las thog phab brag la brgyab/ /me lce 'bar te thal bar gyur / / 'di la gzigs la nga rgyal skyungs/ /zhes gdams ngag rdzu 'phrul dang bcas pa bstan pa dang / rgyal pos tshig rnams thos pa dang / sngar yang mtshan dpes spras pa'i lus mthong ba dang / glo bur du nam mkha' las thog chen po blangs te rgyal po'i pho brang gi mdun na brag ri chen po gnam snyogs (gnyogaka pa tsam yod pa de la brgyab pas/ brag ri yang thog gi rnam par me lce 'bar te/ la cha'i khang ba 'ju ba snyam byed/ lcags ri /ka98 ba5 rgorim pa / bdun po yang mer zhing g.yo/ mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu (cuka rtsa gcig po'ang maṇḍal bteg pas rgyan 'gul ba ltar ling ling 'deg cing 'jig pa snyam byed/ srin po'i rigs thams cad 'jigs shing skrag ste dngangs/ ltas chen po de mthong bas/ srin po'i rgyal po nyid kyis/ rgyal bu'i mdun du thal mo sbyar te/ de skad ces zhus pa/ rab tu 'jigs shing ltad mor che/ stobs yang blo gros mi zad pa/ /srin po'i gnas rnams khyed kyis g.yos/ /gdug pa can rnams skrag par byas/ /da ni khyod la 'dun pa 'bul/ khyod kyis nga la brtse bar mdzod/ /sems la phan pa'i gdams pa zhu/ khyod kyi bka' las mi g.yo bar/ /dam pa khyed gsung myur du bsgrub/ /phyi nas dam bca' 'dor na ngan/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal busasmras pa/ de phyir bdag/ gis de bstan to/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' zab/ /sems can re la'ang rang 'tsho yi/ /sdug bsngal gzhan gyis mi len par/ /bgos skal rang gis khur dgos pas/ /rtse gcig sems la snying po long / /'jigs pa'i skyabs gnas mchog tu tshol ('tsholaka / /sngar nyes las la 'gyod pa bskyed/ /phyin chad srog la bab gyur —285—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/kyang / / sdom 'dod drag pos brtan par gyis/ /skyabs gnas dam pa dkon mchog yin/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas gnyen gcig pu/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas bsten par 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mar gyur ba/ /gzhan don chos la brten par bya/ /de bsgrub (sgrub3phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ /dge 'dun mchog de spyi bosablang / /'di dang kun tu skyob par byed/ /gzhan gyi skyabs gnas bsten byas nas/ /nyes pa cig gis bzang po'i tshogs/ /dpag tu med pa 'joms par byed/ /de bas dkon mchog rin chen bsten/ /nyin dang mtshan du skyabs su song //'khor ba'i gnas las drongs zhes gsol/ /chos kyi mthar thug gzhan don pas/ /bsam pa bzang po rtag tu bsten / / sdig gi mthar thug srog bcod yin/ /srog gcod spongs la byams pa bsten/ /de nasargyal po bde bar 'gyur/ / dkar po'i tshogs kyis skyong bar byed/ /nag po'i tshogs rnams byer te 'gro /bkra shisadapal gyi gzhir gyur te/ /thar pa'i gnas su'ang phyin par byed/ /gzhan gyi skyabs su'ang khyod 'gyur ro/ /zhesasmras pa dang / srin po'i rgyal pos kyang / rang gisakhas blangs pa'i srog mi gcod pa'i datshibacas/ lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar dam bcas/ phyin chad bsam pa bzang pos blos blangs nas/ rgyal bu'i gsung la rjes su yi rang ba bsgoms so/ /de ltar mgrin pa bcu gcig gi bar du dris lan mang du byas te/ rgyal bus srin po'i rgyal po la g.yu gsum byin nas/ pho brang de'i nang du zhugs te phyin pa dang / de'i nang na gser gyi chu mig g.yu'i bye ma brngal ba 'dug pa la bltas pas gser gyi chu mig de'i nang na/ g.yu'i them skas kyi gzugs brnyan lam me shar ba mthong nas/ yar la gzigs pa dang / g.yu'i them skas chen po 'dug pa la 'dzegs te phyin pasagong na'ang rim pa bzhin du gser gyi them skas la sogs pa/ them skas sum brgya drug cu gda' ba 'kha'adzegs te phyin pa na/ rtsig pa dang po g.yu las byas pa la gser gyi sgo btod pa'i drung na/ g.yu'i bu mo zhig g.yu'i skud pa 'khal zhing / rgyal bu byung ba dang 'dzum byas te smras pa/ mtshan ldan gser 'od rab 'bar ba/ khyod la bdag gi yid dbang chags/ /sprul pa khyed ni gang nas 'ong / khyod la ci dgos der zhugs mdzod/ /rgyal bu na re/ ngas ni rghaṃ ga la nas 'ongs / / chos rgyal sras kyi thu bo yin/ /ku sha na de nga la
