dgos/ /de ni khyod nyid cang yin nam/ /bu mo na re / nga ni de yi sgo ma ste/ /bran la rje ru ma zhabrul zhig /sgo bdun 'dasapa'i pha rolan/ /nyi ma'i 'od ltar lham mer bzhugs/ /rgyal bu na re/ nga la sgo phye gnas der 'gro /bsam pa dag pas bag yod kyis/ /ser sna byas na bu mor skye/ /phrag dog ma byed sdig par 'gyur/ /bu mo na re/ nga ni 'dir bzhag 'di gnyer yin/ /gzhan du sgo drung khyi ni min/ /gang byung btang na go ma chod/ /sgo ma'i dam bca' nyamasapar 'gyur/ /rgyal bu na re/ g.yu yi —286—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bu mo g.yu skud 'khal/ /'jam des 'dzum chags tshig gsal ma/ /mgo gcig pa nas mgo bdun bar/ /srin pos btang na khyod kyis ci/ /seng ge sgrol nas wa la 'gags/ /tshul dang mi mthun sgo 'di phye/ /der bu mos tshig de thos nas/ khong gi sa thag ring po nas 'ongs/ srin po gdug pa can dag gis kyang btang nas khong zer ba bzhin seng ge la thar nas wa la 'gags na mi rung snyam du sgo phye nas smras pa/ bdag la bsod nams skal yod na/ khyod dang lhan cig dga' bzhin du/ /brtse zhing 'grogs par smon na yang / /dbang med gzhan gyi khol mor gda'/ /zhes rgyal bu'i gzugs la blta zhing pho brang gi nang du btang ngo / /de'i nang thams cad kyang g.yu'i sa gzhi la g.yu'i me tog sngon po mdzes par skyes par byas pa'i chu mig bdun bdun yod pa la/ bya dag dga' bar brtse bar mthong ngo / /de'i nang na rtsig pa gnyis pa gser las byas pa la g.yu'i sgo btod pa'i drung na/gser gyi bu mo zhig gser gyi skud pa 'khal zhing rkang pa gcig gi brang sa la btsugs/ gcig gi rting pa btsugs / skud pa nyag ma cig lag pas bzung / cig sos 'then zhing / lag pa gcig gis rgyal bu la gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byed/ mig gcig rgyal bu la blta/ gcig skud pa la blta zhing smras pa/ mthong ba tsam gyisayid 'dzin pa/ /mthon po'i gnas 'dir ci la 'ongs/ /'di ru sus bstan ci don gnyer/ /'on te sprul ba nyid yin nam / / rgyal bus smras pa/ gser gyi bu mo 'od ldan ma/ /gser skud 'khal nyid nga la smra/ /sosabazung lag pas 'then par byed/ /brang ba mnan zhing brang ba bteg /brkyang bskum gus pa'i phyag rgya can/ /phyed ni skud pa dag la blta/ /phyed ni nga mthong dga' ba ste/ /nga ni lhas skyal lha mo gnyer/ /sgo phye lha mo'i drung du 'gro /gleng mo mang po da gzod bya/ /zhes smras pa dang / bu mo na re/ sgo drung 'di na nga mdzes kyang / /nyi mas rgyu skar zil mnan bzhin / khyod ni lham mer mdzes par gda'/ /'on kyang las ka sgo gcod yin/ /rgyal bu na re/ /mgo gcig pa dang mgo gnyis dang / /mgo gsum pa dang mgo bzhi dang / /lnga drug bdun brgyad dgu bcu ste/ /bcu gcig mgo ldan srin po'i tshogs/ /gdug pa can gyis nyes med par/ /dga' ba'i tshul gyis 'dir btang na/ /sran med mdzes pa me tog 'dra/ kho bo 'khor lo 'dra ba dag khyod kyis sdom par byed dam ci/ /e ma de bas dga' bar mdzod/ /ces smras pa dang / bu mo na re/ gsung ba mad mad shes rab can/ /bdag kyang jo bo'i dbang du song / / gzhan du khyed dang ldan cig tu/ /dga' bar ci ste sdod mi rigs/ /zhesasgo phye ste/ lha mo nyi ma'i 'od lta bu de nang na lham mer bzhugs so zhes zer te nang du zhugs pa dang / de'i nang na'ang gser gyi sa gzhi la de'i me tog dang bcas pa'i rdzing bu la sogs pa'ang gong bzhin no/ /de'i nang na rtsig pa gsum pa dngul las byas pa la/ padma rā ga'i sgo btod pa'i drung na dngul gyi bu mo dngul gyi skud pa 'khal zhing / phyed skyil byas pa bzhin —287

bka' gdams dpe dkon gcesabatus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'dzum pa dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa de/ pus mo g.yon pa sa dang rkang ba g.yas pa'i mthil sa la btsugs/ lag pa g.yas pa rgyal bu la gus pa'i phyag rgya byed/ g.yon pas skud pa bzung ste/ rgyal bu la dga' ba'i mig blta zhing smras pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mnga' ba/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu rgyan can/ /ma nyams lus can gnas 'dir lhags/ /cung zad bzhugs la gleng mo mdzod/ /rgyal bu na re/ dngul gyi bu mo dngul skud 'khal/ /rkang mthil pusapo sa la btsugs/ /dga' ba'i mig gis blta ba khyed/ /sgo phye nang du bde bar thong / /bu mo na re / / ku sha na yis sgo 'dir bzhag khyod ni lha srasa'od zer can/ /gnas 'dir snang phyir 'ongasapa la/ /'gags na nga yi skyon yin byon/ /zer te sgo phye nas nang du bzhugasapa dang / sngar bzhin dngul gyi sagazhi la de'i me tog /ka 100 ba4 rgoskyes pa /dang byas (bcasakapa'i rdzing la sogs pa snang ngo / /de'i nang na rtsig pa bzhi pa padma rā ga las byas pa dngul dkar gyi sgo btod pa'i drung na/ padma rā ga'i bu mo dmar la mdangasachagasapa rin po che 'bar ba rgyab la btsugasapa/ de'i cha gsum ldodakon mchog gsum gyi sku bkod pa/ sangasargyasakyi sku/ chosakyi sku/ yum chen mo/ dge 'dun gyi sku/ padma rā ga'i skud pa 'khalab lusaphyed skyil du bsdad pa / dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra snyan par 'don pa/ skud pa lag pa g.yon gyis bzung ste/ rgyal bu mthong ba dang /rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sa la btsugs langs te bka' ma phyogs pa bzhin 'dzum pa dang bcasate/ lag pa g.yasapas gus pa'i phyag rgya byed cing / dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rin po che 'bar ba dang bcasapa las 'od zer rgyal bu la 'phros pa'i sna las/ bod dag lang ka la sogasapa'i/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo 'dul byed cing / /dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i/ /dad pa brtan pa brtan posabyon/ /zhesapa'i sgra de bu mosathos pas bu mo shin tu dga' ste/ kho mo bya bas ma g.yengasakyang / /thabs dang shesarab mtshon pa'i tshul/ /med na mi 'byung lhod par 'khal/ /shes sam rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bu/ /rgyal bu na re/ legs bshad kun la mkhas pa'i dpal/ /tshad med thabasani rgyud la brten/ /sras bzhi skrun mdzad skye med yum/ khesarab mthar phyin blo mnga' ba/ /gnyis su sdom ste kun tu 'gro /'ching bsam bcings rang lhod pa/ /mnyam nyid cig tu ston par byed/ khug pa rin chen thabasakyisasbrel/ /rtse mo kun/ 'phro chagasamed pa/ /phra zhing rtogs dka' 'phagasapa'i yul/ khyod 'khal bya ba mchog tu bzang / /ding sang sgo 'byed thabasashesayin/ /zhesasmrasapa dang / bu mo na re/ blo mnga' ma chagasa'adir byon na/ /'dir /ka 101 na3 chags/bzhugasami rigasagashegasapar zhu/ /sgo gsum nang na nyams dga' ba'i/ /'jig rten sgron ma lha mer bzhugs/ /zhesadangul dkar gyi sgo rab tu phye ste nang du zhugs pa dang / sngar bzhin du padma rā ga'i sa gzhi la de'i me tog dang bcasapa'i rdzing la sogasapa yang sngar —288—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bzhin du snang ngo / /de'i nang na rtsig pa lnga pa shel dkar po las byas pa/ padma rā ga'i sgo btod pa'i drung na/shel dkar po'i bu mo zhig shel dkar po'i skud pa 'khal zhing 'dug pa de/ lus phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba / nang nasabaltas na phyi gsal ba/ ngag nas dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra 'byin pa/ /rgyab la rin po che 'bar ba btsugs te/ de la'ang dkon mchog gsum bstod pa/ de dag las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro zhing / slar dngul dkar gyi lus la thim zhing 'gro ba de las mang po'i 'od zer rgyal bu la 'phro ba'i sna las/ bod dang lang ka la sogs pa'i/ /ma dag 'jig rten 'dul byed pa'i/ /skyabs gcig gnas 'dir 'ongs pa legs/ /gzhal yas bkra shis nang du byon/ /mthong bar dka' ba'i sems dpa' mthong / /nga dang lhan cig brtse dga' na/khyod ni 'jig rten sgrol ma yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu bdag tu bzung / /zhes pa'i sgra byung ba thos pa dang / rgyal bus lan du/ /gsal dag 'od zer 'phro ba'i lus/ /dbyangs snyan 'brel chags sgrog pa'i gsung / /bdag mthong dga' bder brtse ba'i thugs/ /nga la bdag med kun gyis bzung / /bu mo na re/ bdag med phyir na kun gyis 'dzin/ /bdag yod gang yin dgra bo yin/ /dgra bos bzung na mi 'dod 'bab/ /bdag med bshesamachog myur du byon/ /zhes chags pa'i sems kyis sgo phye ste nang du zhugasapa dang / sngar bzhin du shel gyi sagazhi la de'i me tog dang bcas pa'i rdzing la sogs pa'ang sngar bzhin du snang ngo / /de'i nang du rtsig pa drug pa/ mu tig dmar po las byas pa la shel dkar po'i sgo btod pa'i drung na/ mu tig dmar po'i bu mo mu tig dmar po'i skud pa 'khal zhing / mgo la mu tig dmar po'i thod gyon pa/ rked rgyan la sogs pa thams cad kyang mu tig kha dog rnam pa lngas dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa/ mu tig gi gzugs rnams kyang mi mgo'i rnam par yod pa/ de dag 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro zhing slar log nas mu tig dmar po'i lusadang rgyan la sogs pa la thim zhing 'gro ba de las 'od zer rgyal bu la 'phros pa'i sna las/ pu rengasadang ni lang ka dang / / bod dang bod yul byang gi phyogs/ /srin po dang ni srin 'dra'i tshogs/ /byang chub semasakyisa'adul byed cing / /phyag gis 'dzin cing lta byed pa/ /ma dag semasacan kun gyi gnyen/ /sras kyi thu bo mtshan dpe'i sku/ /dbyangs snyan thugs rjes 'dir byon legs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung 'dzin pa/ khyod kyi yum chen nang na mchis/ /phan bde'i blo can nang du byon/ /ma chags ma chags skyabs kyi gtso/ /'jig rten bskyab phyir lham mer bzhugs/ khyed dang lha cig brtse dga' na'ang / /ji srid 'grogs pa'i skal ba med/ /yang yang 'phrad par thugs kyis dgongs/ /dag pa'i snang ba yud tsam yin/ /ding sang smon lam dbang gis 'phrad/ /rgyal bus lan du rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan ma/ /rab tu snyan pa'i sgra sgrogasate/ /chagasamed chags ltar ston —289—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btusalas/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byed cing / /dpag med 'od zer 'gyed par byed/ /thabasadang shesarab skud pa 'khal/ /snang ba snang med zung du 'jug /snang stong sgyu ma khyod mthong tshe/ /lha mo nyid du snang ba shar/ /ma yengs ma yengasang lanyon/ /nga ni bden med sprul ba ste/ /gnas 'dir chagasamed bzhin du 'ongs/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dag pa la/ /mi rtog bzhin du nyi ma shar/ /gang gi mun pa bsal gyur te/ /gang las khyad 'phags lham me ba/ /sgron ma'i rang 'od dpag med de/ /dbyer med cig tu bsre ru 'gro /ma lusacig car gsal bar bya/ /zhesasmrasapa dang / bu mo desaskud pa resalag pa g.yas du khyer/ res g.yon du khyer/ gom pa mi che mi chung bar 'degs shing / gom pa 'degs pa dang tshig smra ba lhan cig tu lha phrug 'od ldan gsal mdzad pa/ /mi g.yo gsal ldan gnas 'dir byon / / gser 'dra gser 'od rab 'tsher ba/ /gang gi mun sel gnas 'dir byon/ /sgo gsum 'dud kyis tshig tsam yin/ /rang lus 'od ldan chags med pa/ /bsam dag 'od kyis khyed la 'bul/ /dus kyi ma bskal skal ldan khyed/ /rang bzhin ma bskal mngon du gyur/ /mig zhesanus ldan skal pa can/ /ma g.yos lham mer bltas pa na/ /nyi ma'i 'od yod ma sgrib pa/ /gsal bas gsal bar mthong ba bzhin/ /nga 'od 'tsher ba khyod la phog khyod 'od gsal ba bdag lathim/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yangasapa'i gzhir/ /zla ba bzhu nasabaltamasapa 'dra / / gzugs can ma lus gsal ba'i phyir/ /pho brang nang du gshegs su gsol/ /dga' ba'i gleng mo da gzod bgyid/ /zhes zer te sgo phye ba'i nang du zhugs pa na/ mu tig dmar po'i sa gzhi la/ de'i me tog dang rdzing bu la sogs pa'ang sngar bzhin du snang ngo / /de'i nang du rtsig pa bdun pa int+ra nī la lasabyas pa la/ mu tig dmar po'i sgo btod pa'i drung na/ int+ra nī la'i bu mo int+ra nī la'i skud pa 'khal zhing / /g.yu dang / gser dang /dngul dang / padma rā ga dang / shel dkar po la sogasapa'i dbu rgyan dang rgyan sna tshogasakyis spras pa/ lus dang rgyan las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing / slar lusal thim thim 'gro ba zhig gda' ba de/rgyal bu mthong ba dang / skud pa de dag mgo la dkris te pad skor gyi phyag rgya byed cing / g.yas phyogs na bskor zhing rgyal bu la mdun gyis bltas te 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros pa'i sna las/ lusacan dpag med mthong na yang / /'di 'dra'i lusacan nyin skar tsam/ /bag yod gzhon sha chags pa'i lus/ /gser ltar rab tu 'tsher ba'i lha/ /byon pa legasakyisaphebs par mdzod/ /rbha ga la yi rgyal srid de/ /bzang por sems la ma zug par/ /thag ring lam la bzod pasa'ongs/ /gdug pa'i tshogs kyis gnod ma gyur/ /da ni pho brang nang du byon / / 'jig rten dag na mtshungasamed pa/ /nyi ma brgya bsarab 'tsher ba/ /kusha na de nang na mchis/ /bag yod nang du gshegasasu gsol/ /rgyalabusalan du/ lha mo'i cha byad gzugs mdzesam/ /rin chen sna tshogs —290—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bkod pa'i 'od/ /'phro zhing 'phro zhing gnas su thim/ /slar yang bdag la spro byed cing / /chos skor bde ba'i dga' gar rtse/ /nga la ma chags lhug par zhog /nga ni chags med 'od du zad/ /ku sha na la blta phyir 'ongs/ /bu mo na re/ dga' ba'i dga' gar glu ru len/ /snyan mgur dag pa dbyangs su 'tsher/ /'ong sko nga snyelngan pa'i skyesabu khyed / / ma chags nang du gshegs su gsol/ /zhes zer nas sgo phye ste/ /rgyal busanang du zhugs pa dang / int+ra—nī la'i sa gzhi la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis bkod pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhi dang brgyad na/gser gyi rtsig pa g.yu'i ba gam can la/ shel dang mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa/ /zur thams cad la gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha dpyangs pa rlung bser bus bskyod pas las dge ba bcu'i sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa'i mkhar brgyad la rin po che'i sgo brgyad btod pa nang du lta ba/ de'i dbus na rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las byas pa'i mkhar/ rin po che sna bdun bdun las byas pa'i sgo phyogs bzhir btod pa/ zur thams cad la cung zhogs (gzhogasakaphra mo bdun bdun yod pa/ cung zhogs (gzhogasaka de dag gi mtshams mtshams na'ang gser gyi gzer bu re re yod pa/ de'i steng na gser la sogs pa'i byi'u chung re re yod pa dag sgra snyan pa 'byin pa/ /g.yu'i bad la khri 'phangs rim pa bdun yod pa/ khri 'phangs 'og ma'i mgo na padma rā ga'i mgul rgyan yod pa/ /de'i rtse mo'i zur bzhi mtshams bzhi ste brgyad na/ gser dang g.yu la sogs pa'i bya brgyad kha nas dril bu 'phyang ba la rlung bser bus bskyod pa na sgra snyan pa 'byung ba/ de dag la chu dang sa rdul la sogs pa mi chags pa/ khri 'phangs bdun po re re la'ang mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba/ rin po che ser po dag la sngon dra 'i phra btab/ sngon po la dkar po'i phra btab/ dmar po la ser po'i phra btab ste/ lta bas chog mi shes par gnas so / / de dag gi rmang rmang na me tog gi sdong po mang po skyes pa/ de dag gi steng na'ang bye'u mang po dga' bder rtse zhing tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs snyan pa sgrogs pa/ mkhar thams cad kyi ngos la mkhar thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba/ mkhar brgyad po de dag gi bar bar na 'dom bdun bdun gyi tshad yangs pa/mkhar gyi nang gi skor khang gi bar tshad ni/ 'dom nyi shu rtsa gcig rtsa gcig tu gnas pa/ gang la bltas kyang yid 'dzin cing lta bas chog mi shes par gda'o/ /der rgyal bu'ang yid chags par gyur te tshigs su bcad de smras pa / ye nas stong pa'i chos dbyings la/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang / /der 'dzin shesapa bsam mi khyab/ /chos rnams sprul pa'i snang ba la/ /ya mtshan gzugs kyi snang ba shar/ /lta bas mi ngoms rin chen mkhar/ /zur dang 'debs dang khri 'phangs dang / /rgyan la'ang rgyan gyis rab brgyan te/ /snyan pa'i sgra 'byin chos su sgrogs / / bsam mi khyab cing bde bar mthong / /sprul pa'i pho brang yid chags pa/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang —291 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la / / nye dbang bskor te mchod pa bzhin/ /sum brgya drug cu'i yang rtse na/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i/ /rin chen mkhar la brgyad kyis bskor/ /gcig kyang brgyad kyi nang du shar/ /brgyad kyang gcig gi nang du gsal / / brgyad par 'dom tshad bdun bdun gda'/ /dbus dang shar la nyer gcig ste/ /gzhan yang de dag mtshungs par gda'/ /zur med 'dzer med 'jam pa yi/ /'gal 'dra mi 'gal ya mtshan can/ /de ring phun tshogs ltad mo mthong / /'on kyang bden med 'khrul snang yin/ /ku sha na zhes grags pa can/ /gnas dang mtshungasapar yod par nges/ /gang gis bsams kyang mi 'grub na/ /'di yis mngon du gyur ba mtshar/ /gal te chags na mi bslu'am/ /zhes snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa dang / /pho brang gi nang nas rin po che sna tshogs pa'o sgo phye ste/ spos sna brgya rtsa brgyad kyi dud pa 'thul zhing / sgra snyan pa yid du 'ong ba yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas/ rgyal bu la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i lus kha dog dkar sngo ma rin chen lnga las byas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ dbu'i gtsug na dkon mchog gsum bzhugs pa/ /gzhan yang snyan rgyan dang /mgul rgyan dang / dpung rgyan dang / se mo do dang / ska rags la sogs pa rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/'od dkar po dpag tu med pa shar phyogs su 'phro ba/ de bzhin du phyogs gsum du'ang ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu 'phro ba/ phyi nasabaltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltasan phyi gsal ba/ dri zhim posaphyogasabacur dpag tshad du ma khyab pa/ zhi ba/ dul ba/ 'dzum du ma dang ldan pa/ lag na rdo rje rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa'i spos phor thogs pa/ de las sbyar ba'i dri phun sum tshogs pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i 'khor na bu mo ser ljang / sngo ljang gnyisadang / ljang mo/ ser mo/ dkar mo/ dmar mo/ sngon mo dang lnga ste/ g.yog mo bdun gyis bskor ba/ bdun po re re la yang kha dog bdun ldan gyi bu mo bdun bdun gyis bskor ba dag byung ste/bdun gyis ni phyag 'tshal/ bdun gyis ni mchod pa 'bul/ bdun gyis ni sdig pa bshags/ bdun gyis ni rjes su yi rang 'bul/ bdun gyisani mosakyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba gdab/ bdun gyis ni sems can gyi don du yun du bzhugs par gsol ba btab/ bdun gyis ni bsngo ba dang smon lam phun sum tshogs pa gdab/g.yog gi gtso mo bdun po de dag gis kyang / la las ni yon chab/ la lasani me tog la las ni bdug spos/la lasani snang gsal/ la lasani dri chab/ la lasazhal zas/ la las ni rol mo dang sil snyan phun sum tshogasapa bsnams te rgyal bu la rang dang mthun pa'i mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa phul zhing / me tog ku sha na'i gsung gi rjes su thams cad kyang dbyangs gcig par rgyal bu la 'di skad du/ sngon tshe skye ba dpag med du/ /chos —292—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs se/ /kyi sgron me sbar mdzad pas/ /'jig rten dge ba'i gzugs gsal zhing / /rang gi tshogs gnyis gong du 'phel//nam mkha' gar khyab 'jig rten du/ /chos kyi 'brug stong sgrags gyur bas/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'jigs skrag cing / / skal ldan gnyid las sangs par gyur/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer glog 'khyug pas/ /las can skad cig nyid la bsgral/ /thugs rje'i sprang char phab gyur nas/ /dad pa'i sa chen rab brlan te/ /thar pa'i myu gu smin par byas/ /rigs drug gnas rnams ma lus par/ /de dang mthun pa'i gzugs bstan nas/ /de yi sdug bsngal zhi byas te/ /gnas skabs mthar thug lam la dgod/ /rbha ga la yi chos rgyal khyod/ /padma 'dam gyis ma gosabazhin / / 'khor gnas 'khor bas ma gos pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs phyir gnas 'dir byon/ /bdag dang 'khor bcas 'dir tshogs pas/ /rnam dag dga' bas kun bslangs nas/ /dri med chos tshogs 'di sbyar te/ /chos rgyal thu bo khyed la 'bul/ /chags mi mnga' yang 'di bzhes mdzod/ /chags pa can la chags ston pa/ /chags med ngang nas chags bzhin skyobs/ /yid chags pho brang dag pa 'dir/ /rnam dag sems kyis dga' bder bzhugs/ /ro brgya sbyar ba'i lde gu gsol/ /yang 'jam mjes pa'i na bza' gyon/ /zag med bde ba'i stan la 'dug /'od gsal sems kyi me long ltos/ /grag stong snyan pa'i glu dbyangs bzhes/ /gshis/ ngan gdug pa'i srin po thul/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i lha mo bsten/ /sgrib med mdzes pa'i khye'u skyed/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rgyal srid skyongs/ /thabs mkhas blon po rtag tu khol/ /'jig rten bde bar byed pa yi/ /nor bu rin chen rnyed dka' ba/ ding sang lha mo'i dbus su lhags/ /sgrib med lha mo gtso mo gcig /de gsung rab sgrub lha mo bdun//de'i las bsgrub (sgrub1lha mo'i tshogs/ /bzhi bcu (cu1zhe dgu 'jig rten na/ /padma sngon po ltar dkon pa//mdor na drug cu rtsa gsum dang / /bzhir bcas skye dgu lhas mchod pa/ khyed la lus 'bul dga' bas bzhes/ /da ni gzhal yas khang du byon/ /zhes snyan pa'i glu dbyangs phun sum tshogs par blangs pa dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ dus ding sang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes grags pa/ yon tan bsgrags pas zad mi shes pa 'di dus de'i tshe/ sprul pa'i rgyal bu dad pa brtan par grags pa des/ lha mo rnams la lan du 'di skad ces smras pa/ blta bsami ngoms yid 'dzin pa'i/ /'jig rten sgrol ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i blo/ /gsal la rnyog pa med pa'i chul/ /ma yengs rtse gcig bag yod par/ /gling bu'i sgra skad lta bu yi/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa'i chos/ /grag stong 'brel chags bshad kyis nyon/ /bde legs ma lus skrun mdzad pa'i/ /skye dgu'i mgon skyabasarin chen gsum/ /bangag gi spyi bor thugs rjesabyon/ /'gro ba'i gnyen du byin gyis rlobs/ /nyi ma sprin gyis ma gos pa/ /'od zer cags bcur rab 'byed cing / /gling gi —293—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kye skor/mun pa sel ba bzhin/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan lha mo'i tshogs/ /lta bas mi ngoms 'od zer 'phro/ /ma rig gling du rab 'thoms pa'i/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams gsal bar byed/ /lta bas mi ngoms gzugs mdzes ma/ /snyan pa chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /sngon tshe smon lam /ka 105 na1 rgolas/grub pa yi/ /bkod legs khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas/ /yid 'dzin zhing khams gtsang mar gda'/ /ma 'brel tshig rnams rab spong zhing / /log rtog 'khrul ba rab gcod pa/ /bde gshegs gsung rab tshad med de/ kho bos bshad kyisabu mo'i tshogs//gdug rtsub rlung gis ma g.yos par/ /'od gsal sems la tshur bltas pas/ /chos nyid rnam dag rjen par mthong / / bden zhen ma che bu mo kun/ /thams cad 'od kyi snang ba la/ /phyogs cha ma byed bu mo kun/ /chosakyi mthar thug snying rje la/ /zhe sdang rlung tshub rgyangs te skyur/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas sangs rgyas la/ /the tshom ma za bu mo kun/ /chosadang dge 'dun dag pa la/ /grogs dang lam du bsten par 'tshal/ /dag pa'i snang bas gang chod pa/ /nga ni dus gsum bder gshegs kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyal bu yin/ /bzhi bcu (cu1zhe dgu dag pa yi/ /nang nas bdun bdun bu mo yis/ /nga la yan lag bdun ldan pa'i/ /mchod tshogs sbyar ba rab bkod de/ /snyan dngags drug bcu'i (cu'i3chos kyi sgra/ /'od dang 'od kyi zer dag las/ /nga dang yul la mchod byas pa'i/ /dge ba mi 'gyur phugs su dge zhes smras pa dang / bu mo dag na re/ sgo drung drisalan dman pa'i las/ /mi dbang bsu bar ma nus par/ / da dung 'dir labs chags gyur na/ /ci rigasanang du 'byon par 'tshal/ khyed ni dkon mchog gsum gyi sras/ /bdag cag la zlar mi rigs na'ang / /dam pa dag la rtog mi mnga'/ /dam pa yar byon nang du byon/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu rang bzhin gyis 'od phun sum tshogs pa de dang dkon mchog gsum gyi mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi 'od zer phun sum tshogs pa de yang rgyal bu la zhugs pas/ mar me gsal ba lnga bcu (cu3rtsa bdun gyi dbus na/ mar me che zhing 'od rab tu gsal ba zhig lham me lhan rner mar me gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du/ rgyal bu'ang lha mo dag gi dbus na lham me lhan neer bzhugs te pho brang gi nang du bzhugs so/ /pho brang shin tu dwangs shing 'od gsal bar de dag la rgyal bu'i sku du ma shar ro/ /rgyal bu'i sku de la 'od du ma yod pa de dag kyang bu mo de dag dang / pho brang de dag la phog pas/ rin po che'i me long la nyi ma'i 'od phog pa bzhin du gyur to/ /der bu mo de dag ya mtshan che ste/ bu mo re re'i rtog pa la rgyal bu re re byung ba'i snang bar shar zhing de dag la blta'o/ /de'i dus su rgyal bus 'di skad du/ gzugs can bden med gzugs brnyan tsam/ /ye nas bden par ma grub kyang //'khrul ba'i blo can bden par rtog /dper na 'od 'dzin blo dang 'dra/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i me long la/ /—294—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar ba la/ /'phags pas mi 'dzin byis pa 'khrul/ /dper na logs la nga shar ba/ /gcig med du ma/ra 'gal na yang / /bu mo dag ni nga yin zhes/ /so sor de la blta dang mchungs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi me long la/ khye'u nga yi gzugs brnyan shar/ /bden par ma 'dzin dag snang yin/ /nang du 'od la cher te ltos/ /mthong ngam bden nam bu mo kun/ /shes sam dag gam rtog dpyod can/ /yul dang yul can gnyis med la/ /so sor ma 'dzin rigs ldan kun/ /'od dang 'od las ma g.yos pa/'i/ /don du grub pa ci yang med/ /spros bral chen po gzugs sgrar shar/ /gzugs sgra nyid kyang spros bral yin/ /gzugs sgra nyid las ma g.yos pa'i / / chos nyid zur nas btsal du med/ /spros bral dag las ma g.yos pa'i/ /gzugs sgra'ang med do snyan mdzes kun/ /de lta bas na chos rnams kun/ /bden par grub pa yod min zhing / /brdzun pa'ang med pa ma yin la / / grub tsam nyid nas stong par snang / /blo ldan sprul pa'i bu mo kun/ /stong min gzugs sgrar ma 'khrul zhig / stong pa'i phyir na dbyangs snyan zhing / /gzugs 'dzin lta bas mi ngoms pa/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad la/ /bsgres te de bzhin shes par mdzod/ /bdag rkyen can gyi gdams pa yin/ /zhes glu ru blangs pa dang /sprul ba'i lha mo me tog ku sha na zhes bya ba de/ rin po che snyim pa gang thogs te/ snyan no stong pa'i nga ro can/ /bde'o dam pa chos kyi gsung / /tshim mo sems kyi mthil la phog /mad do gsung la 'khrul ba med/ /'od dang 'od kyi rnam pa la/ /bden par grub pa yod ma yin/ /gzugs brnyan brag cha lta bu la/ /gzugs sgra bden par yod ma yin/ /da ni chos rgyal gdan la bzhugs/ /gser khri g.yu yis spras pa la/ /dar zab padmo'i gdan du bkod / / mi bskyod ze 'bru'i dbus su bzhugs/ /g.yos mdags sbyar ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /lha mo mdzes pa'i me tog 'bul/ /dri bzang sman gyi spos ngad bzhes/ /snang stong 'od kyi mar me bltams/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan bzhes/ /rin chen gdugs kyi gur 'og na/ /snyan pa'i ba dan mdzes pa khyed/ /mi rtog bzhin du nged la gzigs/ /e ma de dag chos kyi dbyings/ /snang stong sgyu ma gar gyi gzugs/ /ya mtshan ltad mor shar ba yin/ khyed kyi sgo gsum skyon med la/ /nged kyang de dang mi 'gal bar/ /mthun par spyod cig gsal bar mdzod / / cesapa'i glu blangs snyan pa'i rjes su/ rgyal bus kyang / rin po che gser gyi khri la g.yu la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i dbus su zhugs so/ /der sprul pa'i bu mo me tog ku sha nas/ rgyal bu la gus par bya ba'i phyir du/ /rang gis lag dar de'i rjes su bu mo dag kyang 'jug cing / lha dang mi'i zas phun sum tshogs pa sbyar te rgyal bu la mchod do/ /rgyal bus kyang / lha dang mi la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir du tshad med par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang spel te gsol lo/ /der lha mo rnams kyis lus —295—

bka' gdams dnge / dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/ngag yid gsum dad pa'i sgo nas bkra shis pa'i glu gar phun sum tshogs pa'ang phul lo/ /de'i sang gi nyin par/lang ka mgrin bcu nyid ma gtogs pa/ srin po'i gtso bo rnams kyi rtog pa la/ kha rtsang nas rbha ga la nas 'ongs zer ba'i rgyal bu de dus la bzlog par mi nus pa tshes bco lnga la byung / rang bzhin las bzlog par mi nus pa'i sprul ba'i rta bal gyi glang po che la zhon (bzhon1byung / de'i stobs kyis sgo ba thams cad kyis kyang nang du shor byung / da me tog ku sha na zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar dka' ba de khos dbang du bsdus/ da kho bsad pa dang bzung bar dka'/ da 'di la ngag 'jam pos/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du btang na mi ma yin drag po sems can thams cad kyi gshed ma yod pa dang / gcan gzan sha za chen po rnams yod pas 'di zos na bdag cag rnams la khag mi 'byung bas/ nang par der btang dgos snyam nas srin po'i gtso bo cig gis srin po mgo che ba dgu brgya dgu bcu (cukatham pa yod pa'i mgo gsum yan chad srin po'i gros khang du bsags te sngar bsams pa bzhin du gros byas/ der rgyal bu chen po thugs phab ste rin po che'i khri'i steng na gzims nas yod pa'i tshe/ nam gyi srod/ tsam na me tog ku sha na de lus thams cad dri bzang gi chus bkrus/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa gyon/ dar dkar gyi lcibs thogs te rgyal bu'i dbu bteg bteg byas te/ kye rgyal bu chen po sa thag ring po la sku snyil ba med na'ang / /gzims na 'gro ba'i don/ las nyams nas 'gro bar gda' bas yar bzhengs / srin po mgo gsum pa yan chod tshogs nas gros byed kyin yos pas snyan gsan 'tshal zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal bus kyang bzhengs te/ ku sha nas sna drangs nas shar gyi mkhar cig gi nang na srin po rnams gros byed pa la/ rgyal bus 'dir nyon cig ces bsgo ste mnyan pas/ srin po rnams na re/ kha rtsang nas bsams pa bzhin du gleng zhing 'dug pa las/ re re gnyis kyi sdom pa shor kyang bya rgyu med/ rgyal bu de nang du ma shor bar dga' ba yin te zhugs/ de rting la bdag cag gis bzung ba dang / bsad pa ni dka'/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshad du btang ba drag der tshe srog la bar du gcod pa byung na'ang 'u cag la khag mi 'byung ste gang 'thad gang rigs shes gtso bo cig gis smras pa dang / gzhan dag na re/ srin po res gtam re smras na 'dun ma mi 'grig pa las ji skad zer ba bzhin thad do zer na/sa/ mi khrag bskol ba'i nang du mi tshil bzhu nas mi sha dang spel nas za zhing gda'o/ /de ma thag tu rgyal bus slar log ste/ me tog ku sha na des nang na/ g.yos mdags phun sum tshogs pa sbyar te / pho brang gi sgor nyan byas nas/ /sprul ba'i lha phrug byon lags sam/ /dbang shes legs par sgrims gyur te / / gdugs pa'i gros la dpyad gyur tam/ /mkhyen nam nang byon bzhes pa gsol/ /zhes pa dang / rgyal bu na —296—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs se/ /re / kho bos dbang shes gtad pa na/ /rgyal bu nang du btang bas nyes/ /da ni bsad bzung mi nus pas/ / dur khrod gnas thong shi khag med/ /der tshogs srin po de la mthun/ /lha cho/ de la dpyad par mdzod/ /ces rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa dang / lha mos zas phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa mjad de/ /srin po gdug pa can de dag la bsam pa dag pa cig kyang med/ nang par dur khrod chen por btang ba legs/ khyed byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dam bskul bar zad/ nang par nyi ma shar ba dang / srin po'i chegs de dag snying rje'i yul du byas te / / srin po 'du ba'i gnas su byon la/ srin po dag gang smra ba khas long shig nga'i shel dkar gyi me long 'di khyer la gang 'tshe ba byed pa de rnams la ston la/ sprul pa'i rgyal bu sems dpa' nga / /rbha ga la yi rgyal bu yin/ /ku sha na yi gtan grogs te/ /srin po'i rgyal po'i gang yin dpyod/ /gar bsams bal gyi glang chen la/ /su yis snyegs kyang zin mi srid/ /ces smros shig /kye rgyal bu khyod/ byang chub sems dpa' yin pa dang / yul 'di na yang nga bcan pa'i stobs kyis gang gis kyang gnod par bya bar mi nus so/ /der rgyal bu'ang thugs phebs te/nang par lha mos phul ba'i mchod pa bzhes te/ /bal gyi glang po che la zhon (bzhonakate/ srin po 'du ba'i gnas su byon pa dang / srin po dag gis rgyal bu la bsu ba byas te gus gus ltar ngag 'jam pos smras pa/ khyed sprul pa'i rgyal bu lang ka snyesprudir byon pa la ltad mo rgya chen po ma gzigs na mi 'thad pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du byon na ltad mo/ rngams che ba yod pas de ring der byon la ma 'phyis par byon par zhu/ rgyal bus smram pa/ /ced gnyen dag kho bo la sha tsha/ de ring dur khrod de blta 'tshal zer te/ bsil ba'i tshal du byon pa dang / mi ro shugs rings 'don zhing nyal ba dang / /rta ro 'tsher zhing /byi ro zug pa dang / /thod pa 'thab cing rtsib ma 'khrol ba dang / /gzugs med sgra skad rab tu 'byin pa dang / /lag stong 'ba' zhig rab tu gdengs pa dang / / bya dang lce spyang la sogs mi snyan pa'i/ /sgra skad mang po rab tu sgrogs pa thos/ //de tshe rgyal bus 'di skad glur blangs pa/ /mi ro shugs rings 'don zhing rta ro 'tsher/ khyi ro zug cing gzugs med sgra 'byin pa/ /lus med yan lag lag stong gdengs pa 'di/ /rab tu 'gal lo 'gal ba ma ston zhig /sgra skad 'byung na mi ro rta ro min / khyi ro ma yin gzugs med dag kyang min/ /lag pa lus la brten cing g.yob byed na/ /lus med yan lag 'byung ba rdzun pa yin/ /bya dang lce sbyang la sogs mi snyan sgra/ /rang skad rang la ngan gyis nga la min/ /nga la nga med nga ni ltad mor che/ /nga ni rbha ga la yi rgyal bu ste/ /nga ni ku sha na yi gtan grogs yin/ /nga ni bal glang zhon (bzhonakagyis snyegs mi zin/ /nga ni nga yin nga 'dra su yang med/ /nga bdag dkon mchog rin chen mthu btsan pas/ /nga la 'jigs med de yis skyob par byed/ /nga la 'jigs med chos kyi dbyings su yal/ /zhes —297—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/smras pa dang / bar snang las sgra cig byung ba/ bsil ba'i tshal du dpa' bo dam pa byung / /mi bskyod mi bskyod bal glang shugs kyis drangs/ /dpa' bo khyod la phal ba gang gis kyang / /cung zad tsam yang gnod par mi nus te / / dpa' bo khyod ni de bas dpa' ba 'joms/ /lus de 'dir zhog sems de ldog bar gyis/ /zer ba'i tshig de thos pa dang / rgyal bus lan du/ lus 'di nam mkha'i glog ltar rab tu 'khyug /gal te bzung bar nus na khyod kyis zung / /sems ni nam mkha'i padma bzhin du stong / khyod kyis 'dzin par nus na dpa' bo yin/ /e ma ya mtshan ltad mo ci yang mthong/ /stong pas stong pa'i sgra skad sgrogs pa thos/ /yod par ma mthong dpa' bor khas len byed/ /de tsam dpa' bo khyod nyid yin gyur na/ /de tsam nam mkha' rlag par byas la thong / /dad pa brtan pa dkon mchog dbu rgyan can/ /dkon mchog gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral bar/ /bsil ba'i tshal dang srin yul bod yul dang / /ma dag gdug pa'i yul rnams 'dul byed na/ khu 'phrig byung na dad pa brtan mi rigs/ /sgra gcan khyod ni sems can yin nam min/ /yin na bdag gi ma yin gnod mi 'byung / /min na gang gis gang la gnod par byed/ /gnyis min na yang sgra yang 'byung mi rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / spobs pa lan me/da du gyur te/ 'jigs pa'i ltad mo du ma mthong ste slar log nas 'ongs pa dang / srin po rnams na re/ rdzu 'phrul can gda' ste/ de ring rang sdug yod mchi zer zhing dpral ba lag pa bkab ste bltas pas/ rgyal bu byung ba mthong ste/kho slar log nas byung mi ma yin par shes zer nas bsu ba byas te/ rgyal bu dang phrad pa dang / de ring gnod pa ma byung ngam zhes dri ba byas pa la/ rgyal bus lan du ltad mo shin tu che'o zhes smras so/ /der srin po'i pho brang du zhugs te/ them skas sum brgya drug cu yod pa'i brgya nyi shu la 'dzegs pa dang / ku sha na 'khor dang bcas pas rol mo sna tshogs pa khyer te bsu ba byed cing 'di skad du/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes der/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs bsnyems par ma gyur tam/ yar byon pho brang chen po'i gnas su byon/ /g.yos mdags sbyar ba'i bzhes pa gsol bar 'tshal/ rgyal bus lan du/ de ring ya mtshan ltad mo ci yang mthong / /'gal ba pos zab mo'i chos rnams bstan/ /nyam thag ma gyur gnas 'dir bde bar sleb/ /lha mo kho bo 'phreng bar ma gyur tam/ /zhes pho brang gi nang du byon te/ rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa la/ me togaku sha na nyid kyis lag bdar te gzhan dag rjes su 'jug cing g.yos mdags byas pa'i zas dag rgyal bu la drangs shing / rgyal bus kyang bsam gtan gyi zas dang sbal zhing gsol lo/ /lha mo rnams kyis kyang bkra shis pa'i glu gar phun sum tshogs pa brtse zhing phul lo/ /de'i nub mo'i nam gyi gung la sleb pa'i dus su lha mo mdang gi bzhin chas nas byung ste/ mdang gi skad zer zhing / rgyal bu bzhengs su gsol te/ mkhar cig gi nang du khrid nas/ do nub srin —298—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /po gtso bo ma/go bdun pa yan chod tshogs nas gros byed pa 'di dag la nyon cig zer nas mnyan pas/ mdang gi zas de bzhin du sbyar nas za zhing / srin po mgo che ba cig na re/ mdang gi skad gleng zhing / khar rtsang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du btang ba yin te'ang log nas byung / da nang par sgo brgya 'byed du 'jug ste 'ong na gang 'thad gang rigs zer ba dang / gzhan rnams na re/ sngar tshes grangs la sogs pa thams cad kho bo'i rten 'brel 'grigs par zad/ da srin po res gtam re smras na 'dun ma 'jig rogs las mi 'ong bas/ nang par khyed zer ba bzhin du 'thad do zhes thams cad gros mthun par thos te/ rgyal bus slar log nas pho brang du 'ongs pa dang / me tog ku sha nas/ g.yos mdags legs par sbyar te sgo drung du nyan byas te/ sprul pa'i lha phrug byon lags sam/ /dbang po sgrims te gsan lags sam/ /nges sam nang byon bzhes pa gsol/ /bde bar rin chen stan la 'dug rgyal bus lan du/ sngar gyi tshig rnams gleng gyur cig /dur khrod gnas nas log ma legs / / nang par sgo brgya 'byed du 'jug /thams cad gros mthun kho bos 'ongs/ /shes (zhesakarin po che'i stan la 'dug pa dang / ku sha nas g.yos mdags phun sum tshogs pa sbyar te drangs nas/ nang par yang srin po rnams gang zer ba bzhin mdzod cig lde mig brgya tham pa khyed la gtad de sgo 'byed du bcug pa na/ thams cad phye la lde mig nag po gser gyi thig le can cig 'ong gis des sgo ma 'byed/ gal te 'byed dgos pa byung na/'di ston la sngar gyi chig de dag smros shig zer nas gser gyi sor gdub bskur nas/ nang par nyi ma shar nas/kha sang gi sar phyin pa na/ srin po dag na re/ sgo brgya phye nas ma phyin na srin yul ma mthong ba dang 'dra bas/ lde mig 'di dag khyer la sgo brgya phye la ltad mo ltos shig zer ba bzhin du phye ste rim pa bzhin du bltas pa dang /lcags ri'i nang ches pa'i stobs kyis sgo la la'i nang na dbyar/ la la'i nang na dgun la sogs pa dus so so bachin du 'dug pa la/ srin po dag ni gos med par nu ma g.yon pa phrag pa g.yas pa la bkal/ g.yas pa g.yon pa la bkal/ ya so'i mche bas brang khar non pa/ ma sku'i mche bas dpral ba na yar la lhag ge ba/ srin phrug dag kyang de'i cha dang mthun pa du ma gda' ba la/ rgyal bu mthong bas rkan sgra tog sha zhim po 'ong zer gnod pa byed ma nus/ de nas lde mig gcig pa de la thug pa na/ ma phye bas/ srin po dag na re/ sgo nag po 'di dag yang dbye 'tshal zhes zer te phye nas nang du phyin pa dang / mi khrag gi mtsho bskyil/ pags pa'i gdugs phub/mgo dang sha'i rtsig pa byas te/ mi mang po la la ni phur bzhi la brgyangs/ la la ni bsad zin tsam/ la la ni ma zin tsam/ khrag rtsa rnams nas khrag 'bab cing 'dug pa mthong / khrag gi mtsho de'i gseb nas zangs kyi khyi mo dmar mo cig thon byung ste/ rgyal bu la za bar brtsams pa dang / sor gdub bstan te/ sngar gyi tshigs bcad —299—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/brjod pas skyengs te/ khrag gi gseb tu bying nas song ngo / /rgyal bus slar log ste phyin pa na/ srin po dag na re/de ring bar gcod ma mchis sam/ rgyal bus lan du ltad mo chen po mthong ba las gnod pa 'ong ma myong zhes smras pa dang / srin po thams cad yid chad do/ / rgyal bus them skas brgya sum cu'i steng du sleb pa dang / bu mo dag gis gong bzhin bsu ste/ 'di skad du/ sgo brgya shin tu 'jigs pa der/ /gnod pa ma byung 'dir lhags sam / / pho brang nang du btagags par zhu/ /g.yos mdags sbyar ba gsol bar 'tshal/ /rgyal bus lan du smras pa / nyam thag snying rje ltad mor che/ /gnas 'dir bde bar sleb par gyur/ /de ring pho brang nang du gshegs/ /de nas rbha ga la ru 'gro /zhes pho brang gi nang du byon nas/ rin po che'i khri la bzhugs pa dang / sngar bzhin du mchod pa la sogs pa byas te tho rangs kyi cha la bab pa dang / lha mo gong bzhin du chas nas byung ste/ rgyal bu slangs (bslangasakanas srin po mgo bcu pa yan chad tshogs nas gros byed pa la sngar bzhin nyon cig ces bsgos nas mnyan pa dang / srin po cig gis sngar gyi byung tshul rnams kyang gleng nas/ da ci nas kyang mi phan nang par ni me tog ku sha na khrid de 'gro ba cig 'ong pas/ de tsa na thams cad kyis dpa' gdeng bskyed de brdeg pa las ma shes/ stobs che ba dag gis ri chung phal che ba'ang pang du long la rgyob/ lung chung thams cad sgang du thong / sgang thams cad lung du thong / de la thams cad thag chod zer te gros chod par shes pa/ dang / rgyal bus pho brang du 'ongs pa na/ lha mos sngar bzhin du mdzad do/ /zhus lan kyang mdang gi bzhin byas nas rin ngo/ che'i khri la bzhugs te bsnyen bkur ba dag kyang bzhes nas/ nang par rbha ga lar gshegs par gsol ba btab pa dang /lha mos zhal gyis bzhes te bslab bya mdzad pa/ nang par lang ka mgrin bcu'i drung / /der song rang re 'gro bar zhus / / rdzong ba ci dgos zer 'ong gis/ /mi dgos nor dag mi gnyer gyis/ /bde bar bu mo btang du gsol//nges par nor kyang ster zer na/ /'o na rin chen bum pa 'dod/ /ster gyis khyer la sdongs te 'gro /zhes smras te/nang par nyi ma shar ba'i dus su/ lha mo'i 'khor gtso mo bdun dang lhan cig tu yab rgyal po'i drung du btang ngo / /der lha mo bdun pos mgrin gcig tu/ rbha ga la yi chos rgyal 'di/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sras mo de/ shar phyogs rbha ga la zhes der/ /'gro ba'i don du 'khrid zer na/ /de la bskur ma gang byed pa/ /bslab byar bcas te dusal bab / / ces rgyal po la gsol ba dang / rgyal pos rgyal bu la smras pa/ mi dbang sras kyi thu bo khyod/ /ku sha na de 'khrid byed dam/ khyod la ci dgos rdzong ba ster/ /gang dgos nga la gsong bor spyos/ /rgyal bus smras pa/ bu mo 'dod kyi nor mi gnyer/ /thag rings lam du sdug par byed/ /sdug bsngal skyed byed nor ma yin/ /de bas bu mo dga' bar byin/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ bdag gi bu mo rdzong med par/ khyod la byin na gzhan dag gis/ /ci ste —300—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdar/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /dga' bar ster bar byed/ /des na gang 'dod sbyin par byed/ /rgyas bus smras pa/ ci ste nga dang bu mo la/ /brtse bar byed na ka lo kha'i/ /rin chen bum pa sbyin par mjod/ /des na nged la bzang por mdzod/ /rgyal pos smras pa / lang ka'i grong khyer 'dir gnas pa'i/ /srin po'i tshogs kyi bde skyid dag /bum pa 'di yi ster byed na'ang / / nor gzhan mi 'dod 'di khyer mdzod/ ces gsol ba btab pa na/ dgos 'dod byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa byin pa dang / rgyal bu slar log ste/ lha mo la gzigs pa phul ba dang / lha mo na re/ mi khyod kyis rnyed pa dang bkur sti spangs par byas te/ khengs grags mi byed par dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad pas 'dod pa'i don thams cad grub/ bar gcod gang gis kyang mi chugs par khyed kyi yul der 'gro ba la rin po che'i bum pa lon pa ni rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed do/ /da ni nang par rbha ga la'i gnas su 'gro bar byed pa la/ srin po gdug pa can dag zhe sdang langs te/ ri dang brag 'phangs te rdeg par byed pa na/ bdag gis lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo gsum dkon mchog gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas te lam gang na yod dri'o// khyed kyi phyag g.yas pas dkon mchog gsum gyi phyag rgya byas te lam 'di na phar la yod ces bstan par bya'o/ /bdag ni shes rab yin pas skye ba med pa'i lam la 'gro bar bya'o// khyed ni thabs dam pa yin pas tshad med pa bzhi'i lam la 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis ka'i ngo bo la dbye ba med pas tha mi dad par 'gro bar bya'o/ /tshad med pa bzhi ni/ lam thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bas khyed kyis sna drangs te 'gro bar bya'o/ /mjug mi dmigs pa'i rgyas 'debs pas / kho mo shes rab kyis mjug brtul te 'gro bar bya'o/ /de ltar rgyal bu la bslab bya byas te/ lha mo dag la bslab bya byas pa ni/ drug cu rtsa gsum lha mo dag /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba la/ /byams dang snying rje gzhi bzung ste/ /gnas lugs ngang las ma g.yos par/ /rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan 'tshal lo/ /rang gi bcan sa zin gyur nas/ /gzhan gyi mgon dang skyabs gyur ba/ /smon lam 'bras bu de bzang ngo / /nga ni rbha ga la ru 'gro /sum brgya drug cu'i yang steng na/ /mkhar dgu'i dbus mchog pho brang 'dir/ /sngar bzhin 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /nga la rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med/ /bsams pa nyid na sleb par mchi/ /chos kyi mthar thug gzhan don yin/ /de las nyams na log pa nyid/ /nor yod gang de longs spyod bzhin/ /yod bzhin ser snas bsdams pa ni/ /longs spyod med pa nyid las dman/ /rang gi btsan sa zin pa'i tshe/ /pha ma 'dren dang mi 'dren dag /de dang de bzhin mtshungs par spyod/ /ces bslab bya byas nas/phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'od zer kha dog du ma dag rab tu spros te/ /nang par sa la 'od 'bab pa'i dus na/ yab mgrin pa bcu gcig pa'i drung du phyin te/ /'di nas byang shar phyogs mtshams na/ /rbha ga la —301 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/zhes bya ba yi/ /mi dbang grong khyer dam pa yod/ /zhing der gzhan gyi don la 'gro/ /yab chen bdag la ma 'phreng bar / / gtan gyi btsan sa mchog tu bsgrubs(sgrubasaka/ /nga la rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med/ /gnas 'dir bsams pa tsam gyis 'ong/ /yab kyi smras pa/ gang gi sgron ma lha mo mchog /byang shar rbha ga la yi yul/ /chos rgyal dam pa'i zhing khams der/ /sras kyi thu bo 'di nyid dang / /gzhan don skyong du 'gro byed na/ kho bo khyod la 'phreng gyur kyang / /dkon mchog gsum gyis bka' mi bzlog /lha mo 'jig rten mthun spyod na/ /'jig rten na ni pha nyid gces/ /lha mo chos dang mthun spyod na/ /de las drin can nyid du bshad/ /slar yang bdag la brtse dgongs te/ /yang yang gnas 'dir byon par 'tshal/ /de ni bslab bya dam pa'o/ /zhes bslab bya byas pa dang / /rgyal bu dad pa brtan pas sna drangs te/ lang ka'i brag ri'i rked na phar phyin pa dang / srin po gdug pa can dag gis / brag ri chung chung rde'u dag tu 'phangs shing sgang dag gshongs su btang / gshongs dag sgang du btang /der mdang zer ba bzhin du/ lha mos phyag g.yon gdengs pa dang / ri brag dag g.yon la 'phar zhing song /rgyal bus g.yas gdengs pa dang g.yas la 'phar zhing song ste/ lha lha mo dang bcas pa la ni gnod pa ma byung ngo //der khong gnyis gar byon pa'i sar sa mer mer byed pa dang 'od phun sum tshogs pa byung ba la brten nas/ klu gdol ba'i rigs 'dzin pa lag mangs kyi rtog pa la lho nub kyi mtshams 'di nas 'od glog ltar khyug khyug byed cing sa 'di ltar mer mer byed pa 'di'i lugs kyis rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' des sprul ba'i lha mo ku sha na de khrid nas phyogs 'dir 'byon gyin yon par shes/ nga la khong gi drin cig yod pas 'di bzhin du bsdad na mi rung bas bsu ba bya dgos snyam nas rta nag po chen po cig la zhon (bzhonaka gos dang / phod dang dar mdung dang khyi dang 'khor dag kyang nag por byas te/ rgyang grags gnyis tsam 'das pa na rgyal bu byon pa dang mjal te/sprul pa'i rgyal bu ma nyams par/ lha mor bcas te 'dir lhags sam/ /bu mthong ltar dga' bdag gi gnas/ /phun sum tshogs der gshegs su gsol/ rgyal bus lan du/ dkon mchog mthu dpal rmad mnga' bas/ /bdag gis don bsgrubs 'dir lhags na/ /lag mangs bdag la ma 'phreng ngam/ /ji skad zer zhing 'gro bar byed/ /zhes 'dzin pa lag mangs kyi sar byon/ der klu'i rigs thams cad kyis mchod pa dpag tu med pa byas/ dgung zhag kyang bdun tsam bzhugs te/ klu rang rang dang mthun pa'i chos kyang bstan pa la/ klu'i rgyal po de la bu mo shel sngon po'i mdog lta bu 'od rab tu 'phro ba cig gda' ba de rgyal bu la shin tu chags nas zhus pa/ lha khyod dang nga yang lhan cig tu 'gro bar zhu byas pa dang / rgyal bu na re/ pha mas ma byin pa'i bu mo bdag tu bzung du mi btub pas pha ma la dris/ nga la yang dris shig yod pas dris la lan bya/ der bu mos pha ma gnyis la dris —302—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /te / rgyal bu 'di dang lhan cig tu 'gro bar 'dod do// khyed gnyis kyis gnang bar zhu byas pas/ pha ma gnyis na re / bu mo srin bu 'dra ba cig bskyangs nas smin nas gzhan du 'gro'am mi rigs pa'i gtam thos zer bas bu mo na re/ 'o na nga la thi gu mtho gang ma dang gri gu so bzhi las bshes med do shes (zhes1smras pa dang / pha ma na re / khyod de cam du lceb pa la thug na/ rgyal bu 'di yang drin che ba dge / bu cho/sa kyang pha gzhis bzung ba med par btang dgos zer nas khas blangs so/ /rgyal bus kyang ku sha na la zhus te/ bu mo 'di yang 'gro bar 'dod gda' ste gang 'thad zhus pas/ ku sha na'i zhal nas/ rigs bzang gi bu mo brgya rtsa brgyad byung kyang / byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don byed pa la mang ba'i skyon med pa yin pas khrid ces gnang ngo / /der klu'i bu mos kyang /rgyal bu'i drung du 'ongs te/ pha mas bu mo gnang ba gda' yi/ bdag gi rjes su nor gang ster kyang ma bzhes shiganan gyis ster ba'i tshe/ gser gyi gdang bu la ral (raka lpags nag po bkal nas yod kyis/ khyod de cam du nan che na 'di byin cig gyis la long cig ces bsgos nas bu mo song ba'i rjes su pha ma byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de la nged kyi bu mo 'di 'bul 'tshal te/ khyed nor gang la mnyes sam/ gang dgos pa 'bul 'tshal zhes zhus pas/ rgyal bus smras pa/ nor ni nyon mongs dgra bo yin/ /mi 'dod yul du bde bar 'gro/ /bu mos phongs pa med na yang / /pha ma'i don phyir blang bar bya/ /pha ma gnyis kyis slar zhus pa/ bdag gi bu mo gcig pur nor med du btang na/ gzhan sus nor ldan du gtong / cis kyang nor kyang bzhes par zhu zhus pas/rgyal bu na re/ khyed de tsam du nan che na/ gser gdang steng gi ra lpags 'di/ /yang zhing don che nor du byin/ /gang la chags na 'ching ba yin/ /chags pa med par btang na 'dod/ /ces smras pas/ pha ma gnyis na re/ nged 'byung ba chu'i bdag por 'dis byas/ bu mos bstan nam/ khyed kyi mngon par shes pas mkhyen te/ gang ltar na'ang khyed drin che ba'i stobs kyis dbul 'tshal zhes bu mo dang ra lpags gnyis phul ba dang / rgyal bus smon lam btab pa/ lag ma/ngas ra sgreng gnas chen du/ /gser ma'i rtsa bar chu bdag ste/ /nga yi dge bsnyen byang chub sems / / dkon mchog sbyin bdag nyid du shog /ku sha nas kyang btab pa/ /chu mig ring mo ma bskams par/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sras bcas rnams/ /rab tu mchod cing dad gyur te/ /'byung gnas de la spyod par shog /klu nyid kyis btab pa/ /byol song klu yi sems spangs te/ /mngon shes rig pa thogs med cing / /gser ldan zhes bya'i klu dbang ste/ /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod par shog /ces smon lam btab nas/ klu'i bu mos bum pa dang / ra lpags khur te bal gyi glang po che drangs te phyin pa dang / 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro zhing sa mer mer byed pa la brten nas/ klu dkar po dung skyong gi rtog pa la lho nub kyi mtshams nas 'od glog ltar 'khyug pa 'di —303—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/dang / sa mer mer byed lugs 'dis/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' des/ sprul ba'i bu mo ku sha na gnas 'dir khrid nas 'ong zhing yod par shes/ nga la khong gi drin zhig yod pas bsu ba ma byas na mi rigs snyam du rta dkar po/ gos dkar po/ phod dang khyi dang dar mdung dang 'khor la sogs pa thams cad dkar po byas nas rgyang grags gnyis tsam 'das par phyin pa na/ rgyal bu dang mjal te/ 'di skad du/ gang gis bar gcod ma mchis par/ /don grub rgyal bu 'dir lhags sam/ /da ni nga yi pho brang der/ /rab tu mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rgyal bus lan du/ dkon mchog mthu dpal rmad mnga' bas/ /bdag gis don bsgrubs gnas 'dir lhags/ /dung skyong bdag la ma 'phreng ngam/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir 'gro bar bya/ zhes dung skyong gi pho brang du byon no/ /der klu rnams kyis mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa byas te/ der kyang zhag bdun bzhugs nas/ klu rang rang dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pa na/ dung skyong la bu mo shes dkar phyis pa 'dra ba cig 'dug pa de yang rgyal bu la shin tu chags te 'gro bar zhus pa dang / zhus lan sngar bzhin du byas te/ rgyal bus me tog ku sha na la zhus pa dang/ ku sha na'i zhal nas/ rgyal bu gtam phyi ma la snga mas mi gnod pa cig dgos pa yin mod/ brgya rtsa brgyad byung yang mang ba med ces zhus pa de snyel lam dung skyong gi bu mos kyang rgyal bu la zhus pa/ pha mas bdag gnang bar gda' ba dang / nor rdzas gzhan ma bzhes par/ shing gi thum bu 'di 'dod gyis shig ces bsgos nas/ bu mo song ba'i shul du pha ma gnyis byang chub sems dpa' khyed la bdag cag gi bu mo 'di 'bul 'tshal na nor kyang 'bul bas gang 'dod par bzhes shig rgyal bus lan du/ nor ni nyon mongs lcags thag ste/ /thar pa'i gnas su phyin mi nus/ /bdag ni bu mos ma phongs kyang / /pha ma'i don du blang bar bya/ /yang dung skyong gis zhus pa/ bdag gi bu mo nor med par/ khyod la byin na gzhan gyis ci/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir nor kyang bzhes/ /gang bzhed bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /rgyal bu lan du/ ji ltar nan che shing thum 'dod/ /ma chags 'di byin kho bos khyer/ /dung skyong gis zhus pa/ kho bo shing gi bdag por grags/ /de yi 'bras bu 'di yis byas/ /nor mi 'dod na 'di nyid bskur/ /gzhan du nor nyid bzhes par zhu/ der rgyal bus / shing thum dang bu mo bzhes te/ smon lam btab pa/ dung skyong ra sgreng gtsug lag tu/ /g.yu ma'i rtsa ba der gnas nas/ /nga yi dge bsnyen nyid mdzad de/ /bsam bzang dkon mchog mchod par shog /ku sha nas kyang btab pa/ chu mig ring mo gnas kyi bar/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sras bcas rnams/ /dung skyong khyod kyi mchod byed cing / /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dzin par shog /klu dbang rang gis kyang btab pa/ rgyal ba khyed kyis dben gnas der/ /g.yu ldan klu dbang rin po che/ /dkon mchog rtag tu mchod byed cing / /rim gyis thar bar 'gro —304—

'brom sten pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bar shog /ces smras nas/ der dung skyong gi bu mos/ klu gnyis kyi rdzong ba dang / rin po che'i bum pa dag khyer nas rgyal bu yab yum rnams bal gyi glang po ches drangs te/ sngar gyi srin po'i lam srung de'i rtsar sleb tu nye ba dang / rgyal bu glang po che las babs te/ drin can 'di'i rtsa bar 'gro ba la khengs grags byas na mi rung zhes rkang thang gis byon pa dang / sngar bzhin 'od dang sa g.yo ba la sogs pa byung bas/lam srung gi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu de sprul pa'i bu mo dang bcas nas 'ong gin yod par der snyam nas/mda' rgyang gnyis gsum tsam du bsu ba la 'ongs pa rgyal bu dang mjal te/ rgyal bu la smras pa/ blo stobs can khyod kyis nye zho med par lha klu thams cad khrid de 'dir sleb bam/ rgyal bus smras pa/ drin can khyed kho bo la 'phreng bar ma gyur tam/ ku sha na'ang lhag dang bcas pa lon te gnas 'dir yang bde bar sleb bo/ der ku sha na'i zhal nas kyang / khyod gnyer kha 'di la bzhag nas gang gis kyang mi bzlog pa'i rgyal bu 'di nga'i rtsar gtang ba ci yin/ lam srung des smras pa/ nga'i ngag ni stobs can gang gis kyang bzlog par mi nus kyang rgyal bu 'di'i ngag ni kho bos kyang bzlog par ma nus te skyon chung / lha mo khyed rang gis kyang bzlog par ma nus par gda' ba/der lha mos 'dzum byas nas smras pa/ da lan go ma chod pas legs/ khyod min na rgyal bu 'dis kho rngo/ lon nga/ yang dka'/ des sems can la phan pa'ang rgya chung na/ da ni sems can gzhan la'ang phan pa ra byas/ (ka113 na4 rgokhyad par du 1khyod rang la yang phan par byas/ da rgyal bu 'di'i bzang lan la ngas /khyod la phan gdags kyis gsungs nas/ rin po che'i bum pa de la gsol ba btab pas/ kho la zas gos dang gnas mal la sogs pa tshe 'di'i 'tsho ba dgos pa thams cad byin no/ /de nas rgyal bus kyang / bzang lan du smon lam btab pa/ mtha' 'khob gangs ri'i khrod dag tu/ /rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs pa yi/ /dpal gyi ra sgreng bzhengs pa'i tshe/ /'di bzhin bdag la gus byed cing / /bag chags bzang snyel bag chags bzang / /rab tu 'phrod de chos la dkar/ /dper na bal la bal chags pas/ /phying ba'i tha snyad 'dogs pa bzhin/ /phying dkar bya bar khyod grags te/ /mthon po'i rtse na dge bar spyod/ /dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral bar/ /yul gyi lhar gyur skyes bos mchod/ /dpal gyi gzhi bdag gdam par shog /de tshe dus gsum dge ba yis/ /bdag gis khyod la chos bstan nas/ /phugs su byang chub thob par shog /ku sha nas kyang btab pa/ rgyab ri rgyal po rin chen gyi/ /dar gyi la thod lta bus brgyan/ /'jig rten dag gis khyod mchod cing / khyod kyang dkon mchog mchod par shogalam srung nyid kyis kyang / de tshe las ngan 'di 'dra dang / /skad cig tsam yang mi spyod par/ /brtse phyir dkar po dge ba'i bsnyen/ /'phral dang phugs su dge bar shog /ces smon lam btab bo/ /der rgyal bu 'khor dang —305—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bcas pa bal gyi glang pos drangs te/ za hor gyi yul du snyeb pa dang / me tog ku sha na'i zhal nas/ bdag cag 'di bzhin phyin gyur na/ /yab dang bdud mo mi 'chun pas/ /dmag dpung stobs su sprul te 'deng / /'dir bzhugs bdag gis gsol ba gdab/ /gsungs nas/ rin po che'i bum pa la gsol ba btab pa dang / za hor gyi yul de dag kha dog lnga pa'i dmag dpung chen po'i rnam par byas te/ rbha ga la nas mi ring bar sgar chen po btab nasabasdad do/ /der yul gyi mi thams cad kyang cung zad skrag rgyal po btsun mo dang bcas pa'ang 'jigs skrag ste/ 'di 'dra ba'i dmag dpung ci yin nam zhes dris pa dang / sprul pa'i gang zag 'ga' re na re/'di ni dad pa brtan pas srin po'i dmag bshams so/ /shin tu 'jigs so zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bu la 'dun pa dag na re/ sprul pa'i rgyal bu des rang la srin po'i gnod pa ma byung gi steng la dmag rum sbran nam/ rgyal bu las bden pa med/ bdag cag zos kyang bya rgyu med/ rgyal bu'i zhal tsam zhig mthong dbugs phyin zhes zer ro//ku sha na'i zhal nas/ rgyal bu la/ yab kyi drung du song la/ rje'i btsun mo la phan na/ ku sha na ni yod/ der ma zad / yang sha na dang / gsum sha na yang yod do gyis shig rgyal bus dang du blangs te yab kyi drung du phyin pa dang /yab kyi rtog pa la yang / nga'i bu de dgung lo bcu gsum pa la lho nub mtshams der gshegs pa yin pa la/ de nas de ring phan chad la lo bcu gsum thal/ da na tshod kyis 'di nyid yin zhing yod de/ kho bo ngo gnong ste the tshom bcad 'tshal snyam du yod pa la/ rgyal bus smras pa/ mi dbang chen po lags/ bdag gis ku sha na gsum lhag dang bcas pa gdan drangs 'ongs pas/ btsun mo la phan par bya 'tshal/ rgyal po'ang yus ches te spyan chab nyil byas nas/ snying dang 'dra ba khyed 'phreng bzhin du der btang na bar chad med par 'dir lhags na drin che/ btsun mo de sngar bde ste da dung ci 'dra yod dri bar bya'o/ /rgyal pos btsun mo'i thad du phyin nas/ khyed kyi sman de dag lhag dang bcas nas rgyal bus 'dir drangs yod par gda' ste/ da ji ltar bya zhes dris pa dang / btsun mo na re/phag sha gsar bas dug ro rnying pa bslang / da ni thar ba med pa'i nad byung / sman khyer nas 'ong mkhan ya ma che zer/ da khyed rang nga la sems na/ rgyal bu la mthu yod pas/ rgyal po'i yul 'di thams cad lcags ri po zhig gi nang du bcug /mkhar kyang dgu brgya dgu bcu (cukartsa gcig dbus kyi mkhar rtse dgu ba byas pa/phyogs bzhir lcags kyi zam pa 'phyang ba ka 114 na4 rgyangs pa/ / mkhar sgo gcig srung na thamasacad thub pa/ de'i nang thams cad shing gis gang ba/ shing thams cad kyi rtse la bya mang po 'du ba/ de'i rtsa ba thams cad na dang chu mig mang po yod pa/ lcags ri'i phyogs bzhi na sgo btod pa/ phyi'i dgra bo nang du mi chud pa/ de 'dra ba zhig byung na nga'i nad 'di e drag tsam yin zer ba dang / rgyal po'i rtog pa la/ bud med 'di la mi srid pa —306—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /thams cad dgos par 'dug 'di ltar rgya che ba lcags rir gang na tshud/ thang skam la chu shing bya tshogs ji ltar 'byung snyam nas bsams pa ngag bzhin tu smras te/ slar log nas sras kyi drung du 'ongs pa dang / mo zer ba bzhin du sras la 'chad ma nus/ bzhin gnag ste bsdad yod pa dang / rgyal bus yab la smras pa/ ci zer/bzhin gnag pa'i rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ rgyal pos mo ji skad zer ba bzhin snyan du gsol ba dang / rgyal bus lan smrasapa/ mi dbang thugs la bdud zhugs pa/ /bdud de thon par ma gyur bar/ /mi dbang bde ba'i skabs med cing / /bdag kyang dka' pa'i las la 'god/ /bcos su yod bzhin mi 'chos na/ /byad bzhin bsdus pas phan mi 'gyur/ /thugs khral ma mdzad drang por bzhugs/ /bsgrub (sgrubaka par nus sam lta bar bgyi/ /zhes sgar na gur dkar yod pa'i nang du byon te bzhin cung zad nag par bzhugs pa dang / me tog ku sha na'i zhal nas / lha bzhin 'gyur ba ci lags/ rgyal bus slar zer ba'i tshig de dag bshad pa dang / lha mos smrasapa/ de la bzhin 'gyur ga la 'tshal/ /drin can pha ma mang po dag /rang rang sdug bsngal du mas gzir/ /mgon med nyam thag gyur ba las/ /dmigs te sdug bsngal bya bar rigs/ /snang stong sgyu ma'i snang ba la/ /mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ /'di bas dka' ba du ma gda'/ /'khor ba thams cad stong par dka'/ /ngan song thams cad khegs par dka'/ /rtsa ba nyon mongs zhi bar dka'/ /chos kyi gnas lugs rtogs par dka'/ /mi bde mi mdzad kho mos bsgrub/ /ltad mo 'di la gzigs shig lha/ /zhes mkhar rtse dgu pa'i bu mo bdun po de dag der bsu ste/ glu gar rnam pa sna tshogs pa rtser bcug ste/ rgyal bu de la thugs yengs pa dang / klu dkar nag gnyis kyi bu mo gnyis khrid de ku sha nas rin po che'i bum pa de la gsol ba btab pas/ rbha ga la'i yul thams cad lcags ri chen po cig gi nang du tshud pa la sgo bzhi btod de/ /klu dkar nag gi bu mo gnyis la khyed rang gnyis kyang rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul ston cig ces smras pa dang / klu dkar bo'i bu mos shing gi 'bru de dag phyogs bcur gtor bas bza' shing gi ljon pa mang po spyig ma'i tshal bzhin du go mtshams med pa tsam du skyes so/ /klu nag po'i bu mos ra lpags sprugs pas de'i spu'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i chu mig dang / rdzing bu dpag tu med pa byung ngo / /thun mong du'ang ne'u gsing dang / me tog phun sum tshogs pa skyes pa byung ngo / yang me tog ku sha nas gsol ba btab pa dang / shing de dag rtse mo thams cad rin po che'i dra ba dra phyed kyis 'brel zhing shing gi rtse mo thams cad du/ bya'i rigs sna tshogs pa 'dus nas/ mdor na srin yul lang ka pu rangs dang 'gran na/ chu shing bya dang gsum gyis de lhag par byung ngo / /de'i mod la rgyal bu'i drung du phyin te/ lha thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas gda'o/ /lhas kyang de bzhin du —307—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gzigs nas/ yab kyi drung du phyin te/ btsun mo'i nad drag na de ni grub gda'o/ /der rgyal po'i rtog pa la/ de 'dra srid dam snyam nas bltas pas de bzhin du grub pa mthong nas/ yang bcun mo'i rtsar phyin nas/ rgyal bus ni mi srid pa srid par byas gda'o/ /btsun mo na re/ des nad kyi sum gnyis drag ste/ da dung rgyal po'i bla ri chen po 'di nang rdza ma kha sbub pa ltar srab mthug sgong skogs tsam du byas pa la nang thams cad chus gang ba/ de'i dkyil na yar tsan dan gyi sdong po chen po skyes te/ de'i nang na yar la rab tu byung ba sto phrag mang po bzhugs sa yod pa/ de'i yal 'dab bla ri'i spyi bor 'thon pa la sprul pa'i bya sna tshogs 'du ba/ bla ri'i logs thams cad la'ang rtse shing nags tshal rgyas pa/ de la bya tshogs 'du ba cig byung na/ nad kyi sum cha'o 'di'ang drag pa tsam yin zer ba dang / rgyal po'i rtog pa la 'gal ba de 'dra bsgrub (sgrub|par mi nus/ rgyal bu la yang zhu mi nus snyam du lan kyang ma btab par sras kyi drung du 'ongs te/ sngar bzhin du dris lan byas pa'i rjes su/ rgyal bus tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdud mo snying la zhugs gyur na/ /las ngan sna tshogs dag la 'god/ /'khor ba'i gting rdo nyid du skyur/ /mi srid las la 'god par byed/ /sdug pas ci phan 'gyod par mdzod/ /'gyod pas mi phan spangs na bde/ /zhes smras nas/ ku sha na can byon pa dang / bzhin cung zad 'gyur ba lha mos gzigs te smras pa/ lha ci la ma mnyes/ lhas sngar gyi byung tshul gsungs pa dang / lha mos smras pa/ de la mi mnyes ga la 'tshal / / rdzun la mi 'grub gang yang med/ /sdug bsngal sangs rgyas bsgrub (sgrub3par dka'/ /le los lam la phyin par dka'/ /zhes yang lha mo bdun pos rgyal bu dwangs bsring pa'i phyir du glu gar rnam pa sna tshogs pa rtser bcug ste/ klu dkar nag gi bu mo gnyis khrid de/ bla ri'i logs la byon nas nor bu rin po che'i bum pa la gsol ba btab pas/ bla ri de sgong skogs tsam gyi srab mthug la nang stong par gyur pa la/ klu nag po'i bu mo la / khyod kyis nang chus khong / zhes smras pa dang / klu nag po'i bu mo na re/ nang du 'gro ba la lam dgos/ lam btod na chu phyir 'bo zhes smras pas/ ku sha na'i zhal nas/ 'khrul ba'i snang ba ni nyams dga' kho mos bya yis zer nas sgo btod/ klu nag po'i bu mos ra lpags sprugs pas nang chus gang / der klu dkar po'i bu mos/ tsan dan gyi 'bras bu zhig khyer te/ chu de'i gting du phyin nas chu'igating du bzhag nas bu mo nyid kyis 'khor zhing bla ri'i rtse mor 'ongs pas/ shing yang de'i rjes su 'khyil zhing skyes te/ rtse mo bla ri'i steng du yal 'dab sna tshogs par gyes pa'i steng du bya sna tshogs pa 'du ba byung ngo / /shing de'i nang na yar kyang rab tu byung ba'i ji tsam bzhugs kyang shong zhing chus mi gnod pa byung ngo / /bla ri'i logs rnams la'ang shing 'bras btab pas rtse shing nags tshal rgyas pa la bya sna tshogs mang po 'du ba byung ste/ mdor na mos bsgo ba las gsum ldab kyis lhag par —308—

'brem ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /byung nas/ bcun mo gsum pos rgyal bu'i drung du 'engs nas thugs dgongs rdzogs pa byas lags so/ /rgyal bus gzigs pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug nas/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ bdag gis mi srid pa srid par byas bdog rgyal pos gzigs pas kyang de bzhin du 'dug nas/ btsun mo'i can phyin te/ khyod ci 'dra na'ang / rgyal bus ji skad/ smras pa bzhin byas 'dug go /mo'i rnam par rtog pa la 'jig rten la med pa/ rgyal bu 'dis yod par byas/ rgyal bu 'dis nga'i tshe srog la bar gcod byung na mi rung bas/ sngon la rgyal bu la bar gcod cig bya snyam nas/ rgyal po la smras pa/ nga yi nad rnams drag par byas/ /rgyal bus dka' spyad chen po la ma bltas par bdag gi don byas pas drin che/ da nga yang drin lan 'jal bas/ zhag gsum nga'i pho brang du stabs su sdod dgos/ mi tshangs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur ma gtogs pa gang yang bgyi 'tshal zhes smras pa dang /rgyal po na re/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpas khyod la mi tshangs spyod kyi nyan med kyang khyod rang gi ngos nas gang gsung ba bsgrub (sgrubaka pa'i 'bab par yod ces smras nas/ rgyal pos sras kyi drung du 'ongs te mo zer ba rnams brjod pas/ rgyal bu lan mi smra bar/ rang gi bcun mo ku sha na'i thad du byon te/ zer lugs bshad pas ku sha na'i zhal nas/ nged bdun mo'i sman yin pas/ sngon la mo'i nad de ma sos na mi rung bas/ khyed bu ro gnyis kyang gshegs so zer nas mo'i rtsar byon pa dang / ku sha na'i 'od dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa de mos ma bzod par mig 'degs mi nus pa cam du zhum par gyur ba la/ ku sha nas smras pa/ bcun mo khyed la snyung gzhi drag po byung zer nas/ rgyal bu na gzheon nu ma 'di sha za srin po la brdos te nga len du byung na/ da khyed la ci dgos/ bdud mos smras pa/ khyed sprul ba mo/ yin pas nga la gang phan pa zhig mjod cig 'o na rgyal po'i rtsar 'deng zer nas khrid de/ ku sha nas rgyal po la smras pa/ mi dbang khyed kyi bcun mo 'di nyid na zer nas/sras 'jigs pa la bsdos te nga len du byung ba la/ nga 'ongs pa yin/ khyed kyi btsun mo 'di su'i rigs shig yin / rigs la brten na/sa sman dpyad bya 'tshal gsungs pas/ rgyal pos dud mo rang la khyod su'i rigs yin dris pas/ mo na re/ nga lha mo yin/ ku sha na'i zhal nas/ nga lha thams cad kyi gtso mo yin pa la/ khyod 'dra ba lha yul na mthong thos gang yang med/ mo na re/ nga klu mo yin pa la lhar btags zer/ klu dkar nag gi bu mo gnyis na re/ klu thams cad nged dkar nag gnyis su 'dus pa la khyod 'dra ba mthong thos gang yang med/ rgyal pos smras pa/ nged mi la 'di 'dra ba de bas kyang med/ 'o na rang su zhig yin nam/ bdud mo ma yin nam zer/ku sha na'i zhal nas/ gang ltar kyang dkar po'i rigs kyi lha thams cad ma dga'/ nged kyis byas pa'i chus 'khrud dgos pas gshegs zer nas/ rgyal po'i bla ri chus gang ba'i 'gram du 'khrid de/ chus 'khrud bcug ste/—309—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/klu nag po'i bu mo de la khyed la ming po 'dra med dam bos dang byas pas/ des kyang ming po lag mangs chekha/bos pa dang / glang dmar po mig gcig pa rwa gcig yod pa zhig chu nang de nas byung ste/ rwa gcig po des mo'i zhabs nas spyi gtsug tu brtol te chu'i gting du khyer te song ngo / /de nas ku sha nas 'di skad du/ rnyed dang bkur sti spang byas shing / khye /ka 116 ba3 khyengs dang dregadra(/dang grags pa spang byas nas/ /ga'an don nyid la brtson bgyis na/ /rang gi don ni phun tshogasate/ /dad pa brtan pas bdag lon bzhin/ /rnyed dang bkur ste don gnyer zhing / khengs grags ma spangs ngan sems na/ /'bras bu rang nyid sdug bsngal te/ /dper na sman gyis bdud mo bzhin/ /de na rang don dor byas te/ /gzhan gyi don la 'bad pa bzang / /'phral bde phugs su bstan pa yin/ /zhes smras te/ thabs kyis rgyal po mya ngan mi skyed pa'i phyir/ /lha mo kun sha na nyid kyis/ bdud mo de'i sngar gyi gzugs ji lta bar sprul nas/ rgyal po'i mdun du phyin te/ rgyal po la 'di skad cesasmras pa/ rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo de kho mos bsad par byas kyis/ kho mo'i khyo de yang khyod kyi bu 'disabasad pasakho mo snying na ste / srin po'i kha rtsar btang yang bsad par ma nus kyi steng la/ slar las kho rang gi dngos grub kyi grogs su song nas gda'o// kho mos mi 'grub pa'i las mang po bsgo bas kyang tshegs med du bsgrubs byung / ngasargyal pos 'go byas yul khams 'di thams cad brlag par bya snyam na'ang / rgyal bu 'dis byar ma ster zer nas slar yang phag mo khra mo mche ba rno ba rgyal po la za ba ltar byed pa zhig tu sprul ba na/ rgyal po 'jigs skrag ste/ sngar ma zos pa mkhar che che/ da 'di dang ma bral na ci ma rung snyam pa las chags pa'i sems ma byung / de'i tshe rgyal bu rgyangs te byung ba dang / mo bos (brosaka pa dus mnyam du byung bas/ rgyal po shin tu drin/ du tshor nas 'di skad du/btsun mo byang chub sems ma de/ /bdud mo de yis med par byas/ /bdud kyis kho bo'ang gsod brtsamasan/rgyal bu khyod kyi de nyid bsad/ /yul khams thams cad bde byas na/ /glen pa bdag gis ma tshor bar/ /snying dang 'dra ba mtha' la spyugs/ sha za srin po'i kha rtsar 'phangs/ /e ma rgyal bu dam pa khyed/ /bsod nams bsgrub (sgrubaka pa'i grogs su song / /'dir lhags bdud mo ngan ma des/ /ma srid las la bkod gyur kyang / /lhag dang bcas par khyed kyis bsgrubs/ /glen pa bdag gis de 'dra'ang / /da gzod go ste cung zad 'phyis/ /go ma chod kyis las bsags pa/ khyed la gnong ste bshegs(bshagasaka par bgyi/ /da gzod grogs la skyon mthong bas/ /grogs spangs nges par byung gyur nas/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don la spyod/ /rgyal srid thams cad khyed kyis bzung / /blon 'bangs dag kyang khyed la 'dun/ /rgyal bus lan du smras pa/ skyes bu glen pa mtha' ma mthong / /sdug bsngal ma myong skyid mi tshor/ /mi shes spong na sa mi zin/ khesanas spong na brtan pa yin/ /mi —310—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dbang sngar gyi las la dpyod/ /da ni log pa'i lam la 'dzem/ /rang gis mi shes gzhan mi 'dri/ /mkhas pas bslabs kyang mi nyan par/ /log pa'i lam la 'jug byed cing / /yang dag lam ni rgyab tu skyur/ /dmangs rig dag kyang mi spyod na/ /rgyal po spyod pa'ang 'khrul tshabs che/ /mi dbang nga yis grogs byed pas/ /log pa'i lam la slan gyur kyang / /mgon med sems can mang po dag /rang dgar spyod de shin tu 'pham/ /snying re rje na pha ma rnams / / 'di bzhin bdag gis skyob par shog /mi dbang ma zhum nga la nyon// /nga la dkon mchog rin chen yod / / nga ni shes rab blo dang ldan/ /nga ni bsnyen bkur khengs grags bral/ /rgyal po bya ba khengs grags che/ /rgyal srid bya ba 'ching ba yin/ /'ching bas dgos med bde bar 'gro/ /nga yi mthun rkyen lha yis bsgrub (sgrubaka / khyed kyi rgyal srid khyed rang skyongs / /da gzod bag phebs bde bar bgyi/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal po spyan chab nyil le/ da ni sngar mthong grags par 'gyur/ khyed la smra yang mi spobs na/ khengs grags nga rgyal smos ci 'tshal/ khyed kyis rgyal srid ma bzung na/ /bdag gi mgon skyabs su yis byed/ /snyes mthong nges 'byung gnad du gsol/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal bus yab kyi dbugs phyung ba/ e ma mi dbang nga la gson/ /nub cig gnyid kyis log pa na/ /mi cig bdud kyis khyer ba rmi/ /'khyer dang 'khyer byed ma grub na/ /de la su zhig skrag par byed/ /nga med mtha' la phyin pa med/ /yab med yab kyis sprugs pa med/ /de bzhin mi dbang shes par mdzod/ /da dung mi dbang nga la gson/ /nub cig mi cig rmi lam na/ /chung ma shi ste phyis nas len/ /chung mas bu nyid sdebs pa rmi/ /sdeb dang sdeb byed ma grub na/ /de la su zhig skrag cing dga'/ /bdud mo ma/ grub kho bo med/ /de ltar gnyis med chen po la/ khyed la su zhig skrag par byed/ /bdud mos bslus pa'ang de dang mtshungs/ /da dung mi dbang nga la gson/ /nub cig pha cig rmi lam na/ /bu cig dgra bus khyer ba rmi/ /sprugs dang sprugs byed shes par mdzod/ /da dung mi dbang nga la nyon/ /nub cig sprang po'i rmi lam na/ /grong khyer dbus su khyi yis bskor/ /bskor dang bskor byed ma grub kyang / /sprang po nyen pa ji bzhin du/ khyed la sdug bsngal du ma yang / /de dang de bzhin shes par mdzod/ /ces yab la gsung snyan pas glu ru gsol ba dang / yab snyan cing yid 'gyur te/ sngar gyi sdug bsngal mtsho la kha ba babs pa bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas rgyal bus/ ku sha na'i drung du phyin te/ sngar gyi tsho snyad pas shin tu dgyes so/ /them skas sum brgya drug cu'i yang steng / mkhar rtse dgu ba'i dbus su/ yab yum bzhi pos bag phebs shing 'gro ba'i don las ma g.yos par bzhugs so/ /me tog ku sha nas/ bu mo lta bas chog mi shes pa cig tu sprul te/ 'di yab kyi btsun mor phul cig ces bsgos te/ rgyal bus kyang de khrid na/sa yab kyi drung du phyin te/ bu mo 'di bdag gi ma de'i tshab tu dbul lo zhes —3/1 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/gsungs pa dang / yab kyi zhal nas/ da ni lha mo las sangs rgyas ma zhig byung yang / btsun mo la dga' ma tshor/rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas/ kho bo la thugs brtse na/ bla ma mya ngan bral ba gnas 'dir spyan drongs la kho bo la sdom pa gnang bar mdzod cig rgyal bus lan du/ tshul khrims ni blang bar sla ste bsrung bar dka' / khyed rgyal po rang gnyen po chung / de bas btsun mo 'di bzhes la/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mdzod cig rgyal pos smras pa/ sngar kyang btsun mos bslus nas/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sdug na/ da ni khyim la brten re skan/ der rgyal bus/ rgyal po yid 'byung skyes par mkhyen kyang / da dung gnyen po brtan pa'i phyir du/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du sprul pa'i bu mo de bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed du bcug kyang / rgyal po nyon rmongs (mongasakapa don du mi gnyer bar nges par 'byung ba kho na don du gnyer bar mthong nas/ rgyal bus bla ma mya ngan bral ba la gsol ba btab pas/ skad cig yud tsam la gnas de nyid du byon te yab rbha ga rab tu byung nas mtshan yang nges par 'byung ba'i dpal du btags so/ /de'i dus su chos bstan pa ni nyin dang mtshan du ma yengs par/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dag la spyod/ /de las skyob pa dkon mchog gsum/ /skyabs su nyin dang mtshan du bsten/ /pha ma drang phyir byang chub tu/ /bsam pa bzang po skyed par mdzod/ /de ltar mdzad na mi/ dbang khyod/ /mi dbang thob pa don dang ldan/ /rgyal srid stong pas lhag par dga'/ /shes sam mi dbang brtan par mdzod/ /the tshom ma byed nyams su long / /dgon pa'ang pho brang rtse la mjod/ /sbyin bdag rang gi sras la brten / / dge ba byas dang byed 'gyur dang / /byed pa dmigs med bsngo ba yi/ /mchog gi blo yis zin par mdzod / / ces gsungs nas 'phags pa mi snang bar gyur to/ /der chos rgyal nges par 'byung ba'i dpal gyis/rang gi pho brang gi rtse mo la/ 'phags pas bstan pa'i chos nyams su len cing dgung lo sun cu'i bar du bsgrub (sgrubakapa mdzad de/ re zhig lha'i gnas su gshegs so/ /de nas rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa ni/ rgyal srid thams cad chos dang mthun par skyong zhing gnas pa na/ ku sha na la sras sangs rgyas 'dzin zhes bya ba yab nyid dang mtshungs ba zhig 'khrungs so// khro gnyer can ma'i sprul ba dung skyong gi bu mo la/ dharma 'dzin ces bya ba blo gsal zhing dad pa dang ldan pa che ba zhig 'khrungs so/ /nor rgyun ma'i sprul ba lag mangs kyi bu mo la/dge 'dun 'dzin ces bya ba blo gsal zhing dkon mchog gsum la yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa/ skyes ma thag nas rgan po'i spyod pa byed pa zhig 'khrungs so/ /de'i dus su rgyal po dad pa brtan pa zhes bya ba des lo brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun thub pa lo brgya dang gcig tu rbha ga la'i rgyal srid bzung ngo / /lo bcu gsum du rgyal bu gzhon nu ma pho brang gi nang du yab yum gsum dang 'bral glags med par shin tu gces pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs so/ /de —312—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nas lo bcu gsum du/ klu gdug pa can dang srin po'i tshogs btul te/ sgrol ma/ dang / khro gter can dang /nor rgyun ma gsum gyi sprul pa ku sha na dang klu nag po dang / dkar po'i bu mo dang gsum rbha ga lar bcun mor spyan drangs so/ /dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la sras gsum po 'khrungs nas/ yab rgyal po dad pa brtan pas dgung lo drug bcu (cukazhes pa'i dus su/ sras dharma 'dzin/ dge 'dun 'dzin gnyis bla ma mya ngan bral la rab tu byung ste/ bla ma mya ngan bral gyi rdzu 'phrul la brten te bde ba can du gshegs so/ /sangs rgyas 'dzin la btsun mo bram ze'i bu mo bzang ldan ma zhes bya ba cig khab tu bzhes nas/ lo bcu gsum song ba na/ sras sangs rgyas dpal zhes bya ba cig 'khrungs/ de nas rgyal bu dad pa brtan pa dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ste/ bde ba can du gshegs nas der bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dbon po sangs rgyas dpal la bram ze'i bu mo me 'od gsal zhes bya ba btsun mor bzhes te yod pa la/ bla ma mya ngan bral gyi zhal nas/ rgyal po dad pa brtan pa la/ khuod dbon po sangs rgyas dpal gyi sras su slar yang rbha ga la der song zhig ces bsgo'o/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di ni dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta / khengs grags dang nga rgyal mi mdzad/ nga'i tshig las 'gal ma myong / legs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal po rbha ga la de ni khyed yin te/ de'i dus na'ang de ltar bka' drin che'o/ /mya ngan bral ni nga la 'brul ba med/ btsun mo gsum ni lha mo gsum du sngar bsten te/ srin po dang klu 'dul ba'i don du der skye ba bzhes pa yin no/ /dad pa brtan pa ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba ste/ lha klu mi gsum srin po dang bcas pa 'dul ba'i don du rbha ga lar de ltar 'khrungs seo/ /da lta ni bod mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i don du dge bsnyen sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa 'dir 'khrungs so/ /yum nor 'byin ma ni/ khu bo 'od bza' len te/ der yang tshe thung nas sras lha mo gsum dang mjal ba'i rkyen du gyur to/ /sras sangs rgyas 'jin ni/ 'di nas lo mi mang ba na/ rin chen gsal zhes bya ba / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur/ dharma 'dzin ni gzhon nu rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ ding sang gi zhus lan 'di dag gi bdag po dam pa cig tu 'gyur/ dge 'dun 'dzin ni tshul khrims 'bar zhes bya ba rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdams pa mang po nyams su len cing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa cig tu 'gyur ro/ /de gsum la ni sku mched gsum du grags te/ rigs gsum mgon pos byin gyis brlabs nas/ sprul ba sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don byed/ da lta'ang la la ni btsun chung / la la ni khye chung du snang / rin chen gsal ni snye thang du khye chung cig nga'i rtsar chos shig nyan du byung ngo / /lar gsum po de ni tshe rabs thams cad du rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis yongs su bzung ba yin no/ /de ma bzung yang nyon mongs pa mi —313—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mnga' ste/ las 'brel zab pas da dung yang tshe rabs thams cad du yab sras su 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas dpal ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ rin chen gsal gyi sras/ sha ra ba yon tan grags pa zhes bya ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba zhig 'byung ste/ de yang lo mang po mi thogs par 'byung la/ da lta ni ri bo rtse lnga na khye chung legs po zhig tu gda' ste/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis ni mthong / rngog rang yang gzigasadang /khyed gnyis la khyad par chen po tsam yang med/ de'i dus su dad pa brtan pa la blo phugs gtod cing dad pa'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'byin la smon lam dag kyang btab pa'i blon 'bangs mang po de dag ni/ la la ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la dngos su slob/ la la ni rjes su 'jug thams cad kyang tshul khrims dang ldan par bka' gdams su ming cig par 'gyur ro/ /legs pa'i shesarab/ spyir yang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnasanyesan nga nyes nga nyesan bla ma gser gling pa nyes/ de nyes na bla ma gragasapa'i dpal nyes/ de nyesan dul ba'i sde nyes/ de nyesan rgyal sras mchog gi sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ 'phagasapa grol sde/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen/ de nyesapar gyur na 'phags pa byams pa'i dngos kyi slob ma 'phags pa thogs med/ de tes na sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po byams pa/ de nyes na bcon ldan 'dasashākya thub pa nyes pa las/ sangs rgyas ma nyes par thag chod/ nyesana'ang sangs rgyas mi srid pa la khong sangs rgyas/ byams pas kyang de'i rjes su bslabs te gsung dang du blangs/bka' tshad mar bzung bas/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba yin/ khong nyes na dbang mi bskur ba la/ ma nyesapa 'di'i gsung thogs med kyis dang du blangs pa nas/ bla ma grags pa'i dpal gyi bar du ma/ nyes shing gong ma'i gsung dang du blangs/ de la bla ma gser gling pas blangs/ de las kho bos thob/ der ma zad brgyud pa gsum po gzhan la de bzhin du zad do/ /des na kho bo ma nyes pa la rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis gsung dang du blangs/bka' tshad mar bzung / ngas kyang mi slu ba'i yon tan thams cad khong la bstan/ da yang nga'i rgyal tshab khos 'dzin mod ces thugs bzhag pa'i sgo nas gsungs pa la/ rngog na re/ bla ma'i gsung shin tu mad/ rgyal pa'i 'byung gnas 'dis de lta bu'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu skyong bzhin du sbas nas/ ma dag pa rnams kyis ma mthong /kho bos kyang tshig rkang pa gnyis las brtsams te zhus lan bya rin chog ces zhus lan mdzad do/ /de ltar rnyed dang bkur sti spang bya zhid / khengs gragasartag tu spang bar bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyio skyes rabs bstan pa las/ rgyal bu dad pa brtan par ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs drug pa'// //—314—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ja7 kul snye ga lar rgyal bu dad pa rab tu brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilegaka 120 na2 rgodage ba'i bshes gnyen pa rgyal bu dad pa rab tu brtan par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs so ka༄tsho/ /yang yer ba lha ri'i snying po'i mgul na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis jo bo yab sras la phyag gsum gsum btsal te/ jo bo dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs thun mong du / dngul gyi maṇḍal la dung chung dkar po'i rgyan bkod nas kyang phul/ yan lag bdun pa'ang rgyas par phul nas / jo bo la/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sprul pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin bzhin du/bdag cag lta bu'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ yon tan khyad par can mnga' bzhin du nga rgyal mi mdzad par gangs ri'i khrod 'dir byon pa la/ mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa'i bla ma khyed kyis yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas chu thigs tsam zhig ma brjod na ni dmus long gis rang gi khang pa na gter yod pa ma mthong ba dang 'dra bar/ bdag cag rnams la mngon par shes pa med pas mi rtogs la/ bla mas gzugs yod sgron mes gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin du/ skyes rab khyad par can de dag gis bdag cag gi rgyud tshim par mdzad pas bka' drin che ste da dung yang zhus lan 'di na mar la/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes dang / /byas la drin du gzo bar bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis/ sngon 'dod pa thams cad spangs nas bzang byas la drin du gzo ba ji ltar mdzad/ de yang bla mas gsung ba zhu zhing / kha sang gi 'phro de yang gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dpon slob dam tshig ma nyams shing thugs brtse mthun na rten 'brel chos nyid kyis sgrigs shing 'ong bar gda'/ de ring gang las brtsams te 'dri ba'i gzhi dang / kha sang gi 'phro gnyis lhag chad med par
