'grigs nas byung bas kha sang gi de'i 'phro la nyon cig yul ni bkra shis rghaṃ ga la nyid yin mod / yab ni dad pa brtan pa nyid kyi sras sangs rgyas 'dzin gyi yang sras rgyal po sangs rgyas dpal zhes bya ba de yin/ yum ni bram ze'i bu mo me 'od gsal zhes bya ba rig byed kyi sgra mtha' dag la mkhas shing gtsang sbra dang ldan pa/ bla mchod kyang nang pa'i dge slong 'ba' zhig la gus nga/ byed pa zhig yod do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po dad pa brtan pa zhes bya ba des dus gsum chags thogs med par ma/byeon cing bde ba can na dben par bzhugs pa la/bla ma mya ngan bral gyi zhal nas/ rghaṃ ga la'i rgyal po sangs rgyal dpal zhes bya ba 'di khyod kyis shes sam/ rgyal po dad pa brtan pas zhus pa/ bla ma bde ldan gsan du gsol/ /bdag gi srid skyong sangs rgyas 'dzin/ /tshe —315—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'thar phyin pa de yi sras/ /sangs rgyas dpal zhes bya ba de/ /bdag gi tsha yin 'khrul gyur tam/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin sras su 'gro/ /zhes gsol ba dang / bla ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi las ni 'gro don yin/ /da lta nyid du yul der song / /bdud rigs dag ni chos la sdang / /sangs rgyas dpal de chos spyod na/ / de ni bdud kyis khyer ta re / / le lo'i rigs ni bdud kyi lha/ /rbha ga la de chos kyi zhing / /dad pa can dag der 'du ste/ khyed kyis bsrung bar ma mdzad na/ /gzhan du nyams na mi rung ngo // khyod la'ang bar chad cung zad 'ong / /bram ze mo ni 'gum par 'gyur/ /sngar bzhin bdud mo shul du 'jug /de nas byang phyogs khaṃ dha'i yul/ /sngon gyis las kyis khyod der spyugs/ /sngon tshe bskal ba mang po'i dus/ /yul der rgyal po dpal bzang zhes/ khyod gyur khyod la blon po ni / / dpal dang dpal grub bya ba 'byung / /dpal ni phyi yi blon po yin/ /dpal grub nang gi blon po yichu/ /btsun mo lha mo phreng ldan yin/ /de la sras med blon po gnyis/ /bu bzhin bskyangasate rgyal srid phog / phyi blon dpal ni 'di snyam du/ /nga ni phyi blon blo mi 'bebs/ /dpal grub nang du bsten byed de/ /nor dang snying gtam kho la ster/ /'on kyang nga la'ang nor phogs yod/ /rgyal po 'di nyid gnas kyi bar/ /phyi yi gnyer kha kho bos byas / / de nas dpal grub dor byas te/ /phyi nang gnyis ka bdag gis bya/ /de tshe rgyal bu'i bsams pa la /byis pa'i rigs ni rtog pa ngan/ /bdag gis bu bzhin bskyangs na yang / /drin lan mi 'khur 'dor ba srid/ /de bas dkon mchog mchod byas na/ /gtan du bzang snyam mchod par byas/ /ring po ma lon phyi blon gum/ /rgyal pos dge byas nor lhag dag /nang blon dpal grub nyid la byin/ /ring po ma lon rgyal po gshegs/ /dpal grub rgyal po'i bya ba byed/ /rje yi don du dkon mchog mchod/ /'bangs la byams shing ma rabs bskyangs/ /thams cad bstod cing bkur bar 'gyur/ /ding sang dpal ni khaṃ dha yi/ /rgyal por gyur cing dpal grub ni/ /dpal gyi zhang po bram ze yi/ /ston pa rig byed mkhas par gyur/ /da lta'ang dpal dang dpal grub ces/ /yul de'i rigs can dam par grags/ /lha mo phreng ldan bram ze yi/ /bu mo phreng ldan bya bar skyes/ / 'di nas lo ni bco lnga na/ /rgyal po dpal de bu med 'gum/ /de rjes bram ze 'dzin par byed/ /de nas lo gsum lon pa na/ /rgyal po der 'gro bram ze yi/ /dpal gyi rgyal srid khyed la gtod/ /bu mo phreng ldan khyod la ster/ khyod kyis yul de skyong bar byed/ /ring bor mi thogs bram ze 'gum/ khyod kyis bram ze'i tshogs bsags phyir/ /dkon mchog mchod cing ma rabs skyongs/ /yul de'i skye bo khral nas 'byin/ khyod ni gang gis mthong thos tshe/ /skye bo thams cad tshim 'gyur zhing / /kun gyis rgyal bu bkur bar byed/ /sprul ba'i rgyal bu 'di byung bas/ bdag cag bde zhes smra bar 'gyur/ /legs pa'i shes rab nga la nyon/ /phyi blon dpal ni rgyal por gyur/ /ding sang brtson —316—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'grus seng ge yin/ /nang blon dpal grub bram zer 'gyur/ /ding sang chul khrims rgyal ba yin/ /phreng ldan bram ze'i bu mo ni/ /ding sang khu ston chen por grags/ /rgyal po dpal bzang zhes pa ni/ /ding sang rgyal pa'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /rngog gi sgyu ma'i blon po ste/ /da lta nyid du ston par byed/ /gzhan yang 'di yin rim gyis bstan / / 'di'i skabs su rngog na re/ lo tsā ba gnyis pos dus de tsa na'ang blon po byas nas gda'/ /rgya de sku tshe thung ba de/ de'i dus du bsam pa ngan pa cung zad 'khrungs pa des lan pa yin pa 'dra/ rgyal po'i nor la blon po khyed gnyis kyis spyad/ rgyal pos blon po gnyis bu bzhin du bskyangs pas da lta dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che lo tsā ba gnyis kyis rgya gar nas gdan drangs nas/ da lta dge bshes ston pa'i dngos grub tu shar ba 'di yang rten 'brel de rang yin las che/ rgyal po dpal gum pa'i dus su yang bram ze dpal grub kyis rgyal srid bskyangs/ bram ze'i rgyal srid kyang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa dad pa brtan par 'brungs pa de nyid bde ba can nas slar yang rghaṃ ga lar rang gi sras sangs rgyas 'dzin gyi yang sras/ sangs rgyas dpal gyi sras su 'khrungs so/ /lho nas byang khaṃ dha'i yul der las 'brel gyis byon nas/ jo bos gong du gsungs pa bzhin du yul de thams cad bde bar byed par gda'/ lar las 'bras 'di zab cing phra ba ste/ kho bos kyang rags pa de tsam zhig go zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de ltar na/ tshogs bsags pa'i las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu 'id du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun pas/ dge bar ma zad/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan dag gis kyang / rang dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu chud mi za bar de dang mthun no/ /rngog da ni gtam gyi 'phro la 'jug go /dad pa brtan pas kyang mya ngan bral gyi gsung de thos nas/ rbha ga lar rang gis bskyed pa'i pho brang du rta'i zla ba'i zla ba nya gang ba'i nub mo bram ze mo me 'od gsal gyi lhums su zhugs pa la/ bram ze mo'i rmi lam na nub nas khye'u dkar po cig byung ste/ khyed yab yum la sras mi gda' bas ngas bya dgos zer ba dang / bram ze mos lan du/ khyed su yin dris pas/ khye'u na re/ nga mes chen po dad pa brtan pa yin zhes smras pas/ bram ze mo na re/ mes chen po dad pa brtan par grags pa la/ khyed dad pa rab tu brtan pa zhig 'dug nged yab yum thugs kyis gzung ba'i phyir sras mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ khye'u de rgyal po'i thugs kar thim nas slar gsang gnas nas 'thon te 'od kyi rnam par yum gyi gsang gnas su thim ste song ba'i rmi lam bzang po zhig byung / nang par gnyid sad tsa na lus kyang shin tu bde ba / sems kyang dga' ba cig byung ste rgyal po'i snyan du zhus pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas rmi lam bzang phal cher bdag gi mes byang chub sems dpa' de yin 'ong / khong gsung ba mad/ dad pa rab tu brtan pa rang yin/ji317—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/zla ba dgu zhag dgu rang la byung na dga' ste zhes zer ro/ /de nas zla ba dgu 'das pa na/ rgyal bu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lta na sdug pa dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa yon tan thams cad skyes ma thag nas che zhing rab tu brtan pa zhig byung ste/ ma na re/ rmi lam du byung ba bzhin 'di ni dad pa rab tu brtan pa zhig 'dug zer te/rgyal bu'i ming yang dad pa rab tu brtan pa zhes btags/ de'i nub mo bya sgyu ma mkhan zhes bya ba'i sgyu ma mkhan zhig la'ang bu lta na sdug pa rna ba g.yas pa'i nang nas bye'u mchil ba'i dang sgro skyes pa 'dra ba zhig btsas pas/ming yang bye'u sgyu ma mchil bar btags/ pha'i rtog pa la/ nga'i bu 'di ya mtshan che ba zhig 'dug pa la/ mchil ba'i sgro skyes pa 'di ci yin nam snyam ste the tshom skye/ de'i tshe bla ma mya ngan bral de dge slong bde ster zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs te/ rbha ga la dang nyes ba'i dben gnas shig na bzhugs pa des/ rgyal po la sras btsas par mkhyen nas / pho brang du byon pa dang / rgyal po na re/ bu dad pa rab tu brtan pa 'brungs pa la khyed bde ster byon pa rten 'brel 'grigs pas/ bu 'di'i bar gcod rnams zhi bar mdzod cig ces zhusapas/ dge slong bde ster gyi zhal nas / khyed kyi bu 'di'i bar gcod ngas tshe rabs thams cad du sel sel ba cig yin gyis gsungs nas rgyal po la chos kyi sbyin pa byin pa ni/ sems can thams cad pha ma bu tsha yin pa la/ /brtse dang byams pa'i thugs kyis skyong ba la/ /dgra dang gnyen gyi phyogs ris mi mnga' zhing / /bu skyes 'di bzhin kun la'ang dga' bar mdzod/ /ces chos bstan no/ /de'i tshe bya sgyu ma mkhan gyis kyang / rgyal po'i pho brang na dge slong bde ster yod pa thos te/bu khyer nas rgyal bu la'ang gzigs pa 'phul ba dang / dge slong la bar chad sel ba zhu zhing mtshan bstan pa'i phyir 'ongs pa dang / rgyal po'ang shin tu mtshar/ dge slong bde ster kyang shin tu mnyes nas/ khyed kyi bu 'di la sprul pa'i rtse mo byed pa mkhas pa 'ong ngo / /bar gcodakyang ngas bsrung / rgyal po'i blon por da lta nas bskos shig ces de nas bzung ste lo lnga'i bar du rgyal blon gnyis po des sna drangs khye'u'i tshogs mang po dang lhan cig tu skyed mos tshal rnams su chos dang mthun pa'i rtsed mo sna tshogs rtses so/ /lo bco lnga pa la yum me 'od gsal ba sku tshe thung / de yang bar chad bdud mos byas/ dus re zhig blon po dag gis sna drangs sgyu ma mchil ba dang / rgyal bu gnyis gshibs te grong khyer gyi sgo bzhi la bskor zhing byon pa na/ lho sgo'i lcags chung gi steng na/bu mo chas mdzes pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ skra ring ring gis rked so non pa/ thung thung rna ba'i steng na phar la bkal la/ 'bring po dag sos bzung ba/ mig 'og mig tu blta zhing / glu snyan pa len pa zhig sa /thong / der blon po dag sna drangs nas 'gro ba de then byas nas/ bu mo 'di mi dbang sras bcas gang yang rung ba zhig gi btsun mo byed pa zhu zhus pas/ rgyal bus 'di skad du/ rtog dpyod med pa'i tshig ma smra/ /—3/8—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'phral dgas phugs kyi 'dun ma skyel/ /sgo yi steng du sdod pa ni/ /bran gyi nying bran yin par shes/ /mar mig zur gyis blta ba ni/ /ma rabs mtshang la spyod pa'i rtags/ /lus rgyan skad snyan mdzes pa ni/ /phyi yi spyod pas nang gi g.yo/ /sped cing grogs can bslu ba'i rtags/ /ring skras rked so non pa ni/ /grogs can ji ltar tshe ring kyang / / tshe phyed nyid las mi thub par/ /myur du bar gcod byed pa'i rtags/ /thung skra rna bar bkal ba yi/ /legs par nyan par mi byed pas/ /rna ba'i steng nas bskyur bar 'tshal/ /'bring skra so yis bzung ba ni/ /zas la dga' zhing nor la sdang / /mthun can rgyang du bcug par 'tshal/ /shes sam smra byed blon po rnams/ /blon po 'khrul lam rgyal po ngan/ /seng ge'i grogs su sgo khyi 'bod/ /rma bya bya gag nyid dang bsnol/ /'chol bar dga' ba ngan pa yin/ /zhes smras pa dang / blon po rnams kyi rtog pa la/ rgyal bu ma yar la mi dga' bar 'dug snyam du / grong khyer gyi sgo bzhi ka la phyin kyang bu mo de sngar gyi bzhin du byung ba dang / blon po de dag sprul ba'i bu mo mtshar snyam nas rgyal po'i snyan du zhus so/ /der rgyal po na re/ bu mo de khrid la shog ces bsgo ba dang / blon pos khrid de/ rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs so/ /der rgyal po na re/ bu mo 'di'i phyi ltas yid du 'ong ba zhig 'dug re zhig btsun mo bya/ 'di las 'gyur na bskrad par bya zhes smras nas btsun mo byas so/ /rgyal bus/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin pa dang / rgyal bus mthong ste/ 'di skad du/ da ni mi rung mtshan ma mthong //rgyal po rigs ngan dag dang sdongs(bsdongasaka / /bu skyes 'chol ba dag tu 'byung / /mi rabs gsum gyi gong rol na/ /rbha ga'i lha mo nor 'byin ma/ /bdud mos bkums te rgyal bu mchog /'grub dka'i las la rab tu bkod / / e ma da yang de snang shar/ /gang zhig brtag dpyad mi gtong bar/ /las la 'jug na las ro yin/ /dang po bcan sa mi 'dzin par/ /tha mar 'gyod na phyis pa yin/ /rgyal pos shes sam bdag tshig de/ /'on te nad kyis btab bam ci/ /zhes dris pas/ rgyal po spobs pa med par gyur to/ /de nas btsun mo de yang bsam pa ngan kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas la bkur sti phun sum tshogs par byas/ der rgyal po'i bsams pa la/btsun mo 'di phugs ci 'dra na'ang / 'phral bdag cag la shin tu gus snyam ste mo la shin tu byams par byas so//de nas btsun mo la bsam pa ngan pa skyes pa ni/ rgyal bu 'dis sngar kyang bzang po byas pa med/ da yang khaṃ dha'i yul du spyugs nas ma btang na/ kho mo la bar gcod ches che ba 'byung srid/ rgyal po 'di yang nga la chags shing shin tu byams pas/ kho mos kha ru rdzas sngo dmar bcug ste lud pa sngo dmar 'phen/ bul chu 'thung ste skyugs bshal bya/ de dus rgyal po nga la 'dri bas/ de'i dus su khaṃ dha'i yul du lo shas bzhugs na kho mo'i nad 'di drag rte / rgyal bu 'di'i lha dang lo dang rigs thams cad kho mo la gzan par gda' bas rgyal pos mkhyen nam zhes —319—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dris pas/ rgyal pos khong gtong bar 'ong / rgyal po de bu la brtse bar gda' ste/ nyon mongs pa'i skyes pa 'di bud med kyi dbang du 'gro ba mang / de nas rgyal bu med pa'i rjes su chos rgyal dang chos blon dag med par byas la gang dga' ba'i grogs dang 'grogs la yul 'di kho mos bzung ngo snyam mo/ /de nas btsun mo des ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du na rdzun chen po btab/ rgyal pos gang phan dris te mo zer ba bzhin rgyal bu la zhus te/ khyod lo shas khaṃ dha'i yul du 'byor ba gang dgos pa khyer la btsun mo 'di'i nad drag pa'i phyir du byon cig ces smras pa dang / rgyal bus lan du/ tha mal skyes pa bud med dbang / /rang gis skyed pa'i rgyal bu yang / /'dzin par mi byed gtong bar byed/ /nga ni thag ring yul 'gro na/ /nor ni dgra yin khur mi byed/ /slu ba med pa'i dkon mchog la/ /nyin dang mtshan du mchod par mdzod/ /tshe 'di ston ka'i glog dang 'dra/ /skyes shing byung ma thag tu yal / / 'bras bu snying po ci yang med/ /stong phrag 'khyug kyang gzung du med/ /shin tu gsal te yud tsam yin/ /glog gnyis bsdongs te 'gro ba dka'/ /cha shas phongs pa dag la byin/ /bsags pa'i mtha' ni 'dzad pa ste/ /nam zhig dbul por gyur ba la/ /'bras bu mi slu mdun du 'byung / /mkho la byin na mkho dus 'byung / /da ni khaṃ dha'i yul du 'gro /ma chags yul la snying po med/ /mdza' ba'i bshes dang sdang ba'i dgra /chags sdang mgo snyoms g.yin du 'gro /rang gi zas skal gang yod par/ /mi shes phyogs su phyin na gsal/ /sbyin pa'i zhing dag ma gdams par/ /chags med phyogs bcur btang gyur na/ /las kyis gar skyes sleb par 'gyur/ /mi rtag skye 'chi'i phreng ba la/ /yul dang gnas la nges pa med/ /gang du rgyu song med gyur na/ /der ni sdug bsngal phongs par gyur/ /sngon song rgyu ni mi shes pas/ /chags med thong dang nam zhig 'byung / /'di na nga las gzhan pa yi/ /stobs ldan su yang med gyur na/ khyod ni thogs ma med pa'i dus/ /da lta yan chod pha yin na/ khyod kyi drin las mi 'da' bar/ khyod kyi gsung bzhin 'gro bar bya/ /na gzhon thag ring 'gro ba la/ /brtse bas nyin cig skyel bar zhu/ /'phreng bar gyur na 'phyis par zad/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal pos lan du/ de ltar gsung na gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /gzhan du 'khor gyis bskor gyur te/ /phongs med nor gyis 'tsho 'gyur zhing / /lo gsum bzhugs la gnas 'dir byon/ /grogs med gtong bar mi nus pas/ /snying dang 'dra bas bzhugs su gsol / / rgyal bus lan du/ nor dang grogs ni 'ching ba yin/ /mi dgos nga nyid gcig pur 'gro /blo sna ma mang rang tshugs zung / /rgyal po smra ba lan gcig yin/ /zhes rgyal po chen po de blon 'bangs 'khor dang bcas pa 'phreng bzhin du/ rgyal bu nyid kyis khaṃ dha'i yul du phyin pa dang / rgyal po dpal gyi pho brang bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba de na/ rgyal po nyid gum ste/ bram ze'i ston pa dpal grub ces bya ba rig byed kyi sgra la mkhas —320—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /shing dad pa dang ldan pa thams cad kyi bye brag phyed pa lo brgyad cu tsam lon pa zhig gis rgyal srid de bzung nas yod pa'i sgo stong la rgyal bus brdungs pas/ bram ze na re/ rang gi bu mo la sgo 'di'i brdung lugs kyis ya rabs shig yin par nges ltos dang zhes smras pas/ bram ze mos slong mo ba zhig yin par bzung ste/ rin po che'i sder ma cig tu 'bras btsos ma zhig khyer te sgo drung du 'ongs pa dang / rgyal bu mthong bas/ der gnyis po'i 'od phan tshun du 'thabs te 'bras de dag kyang gser bzhin du gyur/ bram ze mos ster ma nus par chags bzhin du slar log ste pho brang gi nang du 'ongs pa dang / bram ze na re su 'dug zer bas/ bu mos kyang snang tshul tsho bsnyad pas / bram ze na re/ rgyal bu de thos pas yid bde/ khyod song la lho sgo nas byang sgo'i rtsar spyan drongs shog kho bo byang sgo la 'ong gis/ skyes bu dam pa la bsu ba bya 'tshal gsungs nas/ bram ze chen pos phyag g.yas su chu shing gi 'khar ba bsnams/ phyag g.yon du gser sder ma gang bsnams te 'ongs pas/ lcags ri'i shar lde'i zur du slebs te/ rgyal bu'i phyag tu gser de phul nas 'di skad du/ sngon gyi las ni phra zhing zab/ /da lta thog tu babs gyur kyang / /mi shes blun pos dpyad par dka'/ /rgyal srid bram zes bzung ba byung / /da ni rgyal bu byung ba'ang legs/ /rgyal srid skyong zhing bzhugs su gsol/ /lus la dbang sgyur ma thob pas/ /chu shing chu shing bzung bas gda'/ /gser mdog bzhin 'jam gnyer mar gyur/ /skra dkar lus sgur stobs zad cing / /chu shing snying po lta bur gyur/ /tshe la dbang sgyur ma thob pas/ /rgan po'i tha ma 'chi la nye/ /e ma dbyar gyi me tog mdzes / / mi rtag dus kyis rnying gyur tshe/ /ston tshe gsal ba'i me tog zhabrungs/ /dbyar gyis bskyed pa'i me tog dang / / rang byung ston gyi me tog gnyis/ /lhan cig rgyal srid gnas su bzhugs/ /snye ma rlung gis ma bskyod par / / dben par sems las chung bar mdzod/ /da ni pho brang nang du gshegs/ /rgyal bus lan du/ tshe mthar phyin pa nga la nyon/ /brjid la lhun chags shes rab can/ /nyin phyed sprin dang bral ba'i tshe/ /ljon pa'i steng na gser gyi bya/ /nyi 'od steng nas rab shar ba/ /rang gi grib ma 'og tu mnan/ /'od gsal nyi ma nub la nye/ /ljon steng gser bya nub tu 'phur/ /e ma gser bya gnas su 'phur/ /'og gi grib ma'ang de bzhin/ du/ /rjes su 'breng bar rigs na yang / /bteg pa nyid nas sa la babs/ /tshe mthar phyin pa nga la nyon/ /gang gis gang la byin pa'i tshe/ /bsod nams gsog par mkhas la grags/ /dngos po de ni ring bar gyur/ /bram ze chen po nga la nyon / / bya ni dpag tshad mtho stengs na'ang / /grib ma mi mngon sa la 'brang / /rdzas kyi dngos po gzhan gyis khyer / / mi mngon 'bras bu rjes su 'brang / /sbyin byed sbyin bya sbyin yul gsum/ /tha dad rgyang du gyur na yang / /'bras bu mi slu mngon du gyur/ /tshe mthar phyin pa nga la nyon/ /bya dang grib ma shin tu ring / /bya yis grib ma ma —32/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dmigs na/ /nub kyi ljon rtser babs pa'i tshe/ /slar yang grib ma brang 'og tu/ /lhan cig gang gis mi slu ba//rten 'brel dbang gis 'du bar 'gyur/ /shin tu zab pa'i rgyu 'bras yin/ /drang song chen po nga la nyon/ /gzhon nus skyes pa dar la bab/ /lang tsho rgas pa'i tha mar 'chi/ /mi rtag chos la snying por bzung / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mi gtsang la/ /nga ni gtsang sbra bram ze zhes/ /'khrul zhing bde bar bzung ba yis/ /dbang med rgan po'i lam du gyur / / bsod nams bsags pa'i 'byor ba rgyas/ /tshul khrims sngon song mi lus thob/ /srog gcod spangs pas tshe mthar phyin/ /mkhas pa bsten pas mkhas par gyur/ /gong du dpe bshad ji bzhin du/ /dge dang mi dge'i 'brasabu dag /da lta khyod kyi mngon du byung / /de bsadage ba'i sa bon thob/ /nges par mi slu mngon du 'byung / / mi yi lus 'di brgya lam na/ /gnyen po thob pa srid pa tsam/ /da lta long yod shesapar mdzod/ /ces chos kyi bgro ba mdzad cing pho brang gi nang du 'ongs so/ /de nas bram ze chen pos/ rgyal bu rin po che'i khri la bzhugs su gsol nas/ bsnyen bkur te 'di skad du/ da gzod phebs par gleng mo mdzod/ /rgyal bu gang nasa'adir byon pa'i/ /rkyen gang yab ni 'di skad ces/ khyed laji skad dgung lo du/ /rgyal bus lan du/ lho phyogs rghaṃ ga la'i rgyal po/ /sangasargyas dpal zhes kho bo ni/ /dad pa rab tu brtan par grags/ /bco lnga'i lo la ma gum zhing / /glo bur mas bskrad gnas 'dir 'ongs/ /rgyu ni sngon song mthu btsan to/ /bram zes lan du/ 'phral sdig ltar snang phugs su dge /glo bur ma des bzang bar byas/ /da ni rta brgya glang po brgya/ /ma he stong dang blon po'i tshogs/ /gang dgos rgyal po'i 'byor ba rnams/ khyod la 'bul gyis bde bar spyod/ /bdag gi bu mo phreng ldan ma'ang / /rgyal srid bskyang phyir bzhes su gsol/ /rgyal bus lan du/ /tshe mthar phyin pa nga la nyon/ /sngon tshe nga ni dpal bzang zhes/ /nga yi phyi blon dpal yin na/ /dpal grub khyod ni nang blon yin/ /lus kyis ma skyed khyed gnyis bu/ /ngas bsags 'byor ba gnyis kyis bcad/ /ding sang dpal gyi 'byor ba khyod/ khyod kyi 'byor ba nga la byin/ /sngon gyi lasa'abrel 'dir yang smin/ /ma zad ma 'ongs dag tu yang / /'di bzhin rgyun du 'brel bar spyod/ /ji skad gsung bzhin bskyang bar 'tshal/ /zhes rgyal bus phreng ldan ma dang rgyal srid blon 'bangs dang bcas pa bzhes so/ /de nas drang srong chen po drin che ba dbang btsan par byas te bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bskyangs/ de nas yun mi ring bar bram ze gum ste/ rgyal pos bram ze'i don du/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang / phongs pa rnams la spyin gtong rgya chen po dang / sngar gyi rgyal pos mnar ba re re gnyis gnyis yod pa dag kyang gnasanas thar bar byas so/ /der yul gyi mi thams cad kyang / rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' 'di drin che zer nas thams cad kyis bstod cing bkur bar gyur na'ang / btsun mo phreng ldan ma des/—322—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'phral gyi bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas te/ rgyal bu dang lhan cig tu mi gnas par pho brang gi nyin sgo phugs mi phye zhing sgo nang nas bsdams te/ nang par nyi ma shar tsam na/ de nas 'ongs na/sa yang bsnyen bkur byas te/ pho brang gi lho sgor rgyal bu dang gnyis mig mangs rtse bar byed do/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal bu'i bsams pa la/ phugs kyi sgo 'di nas phyin te pho brang gi rtse na 'di la grogs gzhan zhig yod de/ ngas btsun mo la bltas pa min/ bcun mo med kyang chog bram ze 'dis skye ba mang por bdag la phan 'dogs rgya chen po mdzad cing /khyad par du'ang tshe 'di la bu bzhin rgyal srid gtad pas byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba'i phyir du bu mo 'di yang kho'i bu mo yin pas mi dga' ba byar mi rung / 'on kyang thabs kyis 'di'i grogs de ma bslus na rgyal srid las nyams par byas srid pas/ bye'u /ka 126 na2 khye'u/ sgyu ma mchil ba de thabs kyis gnas 'dir khugs pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas/ mi rigs bzhi ka 'grim pa'i lam mdo zhig tu/ gser gyi mchog rten la g.yu'i gdugs bkal ba cig bzhengs te/ phyag dang bskor ba la sogs mdzad pa la skye bo dag gis rgyal po'i snyan du mchod rten 'di gang gi mchod rten su'i don du bzhengs pa yin zhus pas/ mchod rten 'di dkon mchog gsum gyi yin/ lho phyogs na kho bo la blon po bye'u /ka 126 na3 khye'u/sgyu ma mchil ba thekha bya ba zhig yod pa de gum zer ba thos nas kho'i don du phyi thag la bzhengs pa yin/ der skye bo dag na re/ rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' 'dis bram ze de la'ang de 'dra ba'i thugs brtse ba zhig mdzad/ blon po de la'ang de ltar du thugs brtse na/blon po de nyid rang sngar du rgyal po'i drung 'dir mi 'ong ba zhig zhan zer ba de cig nas cig tu brgyud nas blon po'i rna bar thos pas/ blon pa'i sems la zug ste/ re zhan na/ rgyal po de 'dra na nga 'di 'dra snyam nas che bya cig tu sprul nas/ khaṃ dha'i yul du phyin pa na/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas/ rgyal po gser gyi mchod rten la bskor ba byed kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ rnal 'byor ba cig tu byas nas/ drung du phyin pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor ba gang nas 'ongs/ lan du/ kho bo'ang lho phyogs nas 'ongs/ mchod rten 'di su'i yin/ rgyal po na re/lho phyogs ngos su nga'i blon po cig gum pa'i don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten 'di ngas bzhengs/ lan du 'o na khyod kyi blon po de nga yin zer nas rang lus su bstan pa dang / rgyal po na re/ khyod 'ongs pa legs/ btsun mos 'di ltar byas pa la sogs pa'i byung tshul rnams bshad pa dang / blon po na re/ mo'i rtsar nga yod tshul ma 'chad/do nub ngas brtag dpyad btang zer nas pho brang du byon nas/ blon pos bsnyen bkur ba gsol te/ bye'u mchil ba zhig tu sprul nas cig cigazer zhing bsdad/ de nas btsun mo byung nas/ de ring ka lan dha ka cig kyang gda'o zer te/ rgyal po la bsnyen bkur byas nas sngar bzhin du song ngo / /bye'us kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs te phyin pa —323—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dang / sgo cig phye ba'i nang nas g.yu'i gdang bu zhig la gos dri ma med pa mang po bkal/ de'i mdun na chu mig kyang 'dug pa la/ mos gos rnying ba de dag gdang la bkal/ lus legs par bkrus nas gos gsar ba zhig gyon te/ shing gi them skas la rin po che mang pos brgyan nas 'dug pa de la 'dzegs te/ pho brang gi sum thog tu phyin pa dang / sa gzhi thams cad ser 'jam/ logs thams cad sngo 'jam/ rked pa dkar por byas pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ mchod pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams shing nyams dga' ba'i mdun na/ rin po che'i khri gser gyi me tog dang g.yu'i me tog gis zur thams cad brgyan pa'i 'dab ma la gser g.yu'i bye'u chung mang po kha na dril bu g.yer kha bzung ste/ bu mo des khri steng du 'dzegs pa dang / 'brul mig dag khrol zhing bye'u dag mtho re khru re tsam du 'phar ba/ de lta bu'i khri steng der bu mo de 'dug pa la/ nyi ma nub tsam la 'od cig byung ba'i sna la sing khrol lo lo zer/ lha zur phud lnga ba 'phral rgyal bu las kyang mdzes mdzes 'dra ba/ legs par btud de bltas na rgyal bu nyid mdzes pa de 'dra ba zhig byung ste/ bu mos smras pa/ steng lha'i yul nas byon lags sam//gnas de na nam mkha' mi dkar ram/ /'og klu yul rong khung mi dog gam/ /bar mi yul phrag dog mi che'am /lha des smras pa/ steng lha yi yul nas 'ongs pa yin/ /gnas de na nam mkha' los kyang dkar/ /nged lha la ye shes spyan mig yod/ /'og klu la rong khung los kyang dog khong gti mug chu shing 'thab pa yin/ khyed mi la skye 'chi gnas pa yin/ khyod bram ze'i lha mo der bzhugs sam/ khong rgyal pos tshor bar ma gyur tam/ /bu mo na re/nged brar/ ze'i bu mo 'di na mchis/ khong rgyal pos tshor bar ma gyur to/ /zhes zer zhing lhan cig tu gnas pa mthong ngo / /sgyu ma mchil bas de ma thag tu/ rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te/ ngasam bshad kyang / khyed kyisamakhyen mchi ste/ nang par bzhes pa gsol nas/ lho sgor mig mangs rtse ba'i dus su/ khyed rang gi rde'u dkar po tsho phyag tu bzung / mos rde'u nag po lag tu bzung nas/ gang gis rdeg zer 'ong gis/ de'i dus su khyed rang gi 'di skad du / ma bshad na mi go ma g.yengs na mi rnyed/ nag po'i rtsar dkar po re ma rgyab na'ang nag po'i phyogs rgyal na mi rung bas/ spang bya byung dus su gnyen pos sleb dgos/ mtho ris kyi grong khyer brgya phrag gnyis dang / lnga bcu (cukartsa drug la shar nas nub tu rgya lam bcu bdun/ lho nas byang du rgya lam bcu bdun/ 'dzoms chen mo nyis brgya dang brgyad cu gya dgu khyed rang grong khyer du zhugs te/ rgya lam gang la 'ong ba shog cig de'i rjes su bdag gis 'ong ngo gyis shig de nas mo 'dzoms shig tu rde'u zhig rdeg gis/ 'dzoms de'i sna la rgyal pos kyang rde'u zhig rgyob la/ steng lha yi yul nas byon lags sam gyis/ de nas kyang mo'i rde'u bzhi rgyab kyi bar la/ rgyal pos kyang rde'u re re rgyob la/ 'di skad brjod/ gnas de na nam mkha' mi dkar ram la sogs pa gyis shig de nas —324—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /kyang rde'u lnga brgyab kyi bar la/ de la'ang re re lan du rgyob la/ steng lha'i yul nas 'ongs pa yin la sogs pa gyis shig de nas mo'i rde'us khyed kyi rde'u la bskor nas/ pham du bcug pa na/ 'gag che ba cig la rgyob la/rgyal pos kyang ma tshor bar gda'am gyis shig ces bslabs te/ nang par de bzhin du mos bsnyen bkur byas nas mig mangs rtse ba'i tshe/ blon po zer ba bzhin byas pas/ dang po byad la ches cher blta zhing / tha ma rgyal po 'di yang de ring bshad pa tsha zer nas steng du song ngo / /yang de bzhin du mo song ba'i rjes su bye'us zhugs te phyin pa na/ mdang bzhin du byas te dris lan kyang mdang bzhin du byas pa'i rjes la/ khong rgyal pos kyang ma tshor gda' lags sam/ zhes pa'i lan du/ mo na re/ rgyal pos kyang zur tsam zer zhing gda'o/ /zhes zer ba thos pa dang / bye'us log nas rgyal po kha sang ji ltar byas pa bzhin du mig mangs rtses la bshad pa gyis/ mthar mo'i rde'u zhig thus la rgyal pos kyang zur tsam thos nas gda'o gyis shig yang blon po zer ba bzhin byas pas/ kha sang nas rgyal po 'di bshad pa shin tu tsha zer nas langs nas song ngo / /de nub kyang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas te song ba'i rjes su bye'us kyang phyin pas/ kha sang nas bzhin du dris lan mang po byas pa'i rjes la / khong rgyal bus kyang ma tshor gda'am/ zhes pa'i lan du/ rgyal pos kyang da ni tshor ba 'dra bar gda'o/ /de nas lha de na re/ da 'o cag gnyis grogs su mi 'ongs ba yin nam/ rten 'brel cig brtsi yis zer nas/ mchil ma cig dor te/ nang par 'di'i shul du me tog cig skyes na grogs su 'ong / ma skyes na mi 'ong ba'i rtags yin zer ba dang / nang par bye'us bltas pas me tog cig skyes 'dug pa'i rtsa ba nas bcad de/ shul du mchil ma cig blugs te bzhag nang bar lha de blta zhing 'dug pas/ me tog ma skyes kyi steng du'ang skyong mor song grogs su mi 'ong ba'i rtags yin te/ nga'i yul zhig khyod la bstan gyis 'deng zer nas 'gro bar brtsams pa dang /bye'us khyi shig cig tu sprul te/ khong gi gos zhabs la 'jus te phyin pas/ lha'i yul na nyi ma/ snga skad lta bur gda' / lha des mo la/ 'di dpag bsam gyi shing yin/ khrus kyi rdzing bu yin/ 'di dag ni lha yi bu mo yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang po bstan nas/ tho rangs kyi cha la lha'i yul 'khor bar byas te/ pho brang gi khri de la lhan cig tu nyal ba dang / khyi shig gis zos te lus thams cad thor bar btang ste/ de ma thag tu rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te/ de ring brtse ba'i dus su lha cig ma rang rngun la rgyob cig /de ring rgya lam sum cu so bzhi la 'grim pa'i dus su'ang mi gda'/ grong khyer nyis brgya lnga bcu (cuka rtsa drug gi nang du dben par sdod pa'i lugs su'ang mi gda'/ des na kha phog sna yin gyis la/ 'dzoms shig tu rde'u zhig rgyob la/ 'dir nang par me tog cig skyes na grogs su 'gyur gyis/ de nas mos cig rdeg de'i lan cig rgyob la/ ma skyes kyi steng du gting du —325—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/brus / da yang nga'i yul bltar 'deng gyis la phyogs gzhan zhig tu rgyob/ de nas mo re re brgyab pa la/ lan re re rgyob la/ 'di dpag bsam gyi shing yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa gyis shig ces smras so/ /nang par yang blon po zer ba bzhin byas pas/ mo kha rog par ngo gnag ste pho brang du song / rgyal po la dro'i bsnyen bkur sngar bas snga ba cig byas te sngar gyi shul du song ngo / /de'i rjes su blon pos/ rgyal po la smras pa/ de ring ngas dmag dpung bzhi sprul gyis/ de'i nang nas khyed kyi ma yar de'i rnam par byas pa'i bud med cig la rta ba mang pos bskor ba dang / khyed la phyogs gachan nas kyi rgyal pos lha cig ma 'bul bar byas pa'i bu mo/ bram ze mo las kyang khyad par 'phags pa rta ba mang pos bskor ba zhig byas te/ de gnyis pho brang gi sgor 'ong ba bya yis/ de'i dus su ma yar gyi rnam pa de 'di skad smra'o/ /rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyod lo gsum 'di phyogs su bzhugasapar mdzad nas/ slar yul du 'byon par byas pa la lha cig ma 'di 'dra ba bzhag nas/ bram ze'i bu mo 'phyon ma cig dang lhan cig tu yod zer ba thos/ zer ba bzhin du 'di na yang khyed cig pur grogasamed du pho brang gi 'og na bzhugs / phal cher pho brang gi rtse na 'phyon ma de yod pa srid/ da rgyal po nyid yul du 'byon par mi bzhed na dmag 'di dag gis yul 'di brlag par byas nas/ nor dang rgyal po lhan cig yul du 'khyer bar byed do/ /lha cig ma 'di yang grogs med du yun ring po lus pa 'di yang / khyed kyi btsun mo 'phyon ma des lan/ de min na rgyal po yul du myur du byon te/ yul khams thams cad bkra shis par byed pa la des nyes/ da rgyal pos gang rigs pa bka' stsol cig ces bya'o/ /de'i dus su/ rgyal posakhyed bden nga yang myur du 'ong bar 'dod na'ang /bram ze de'i byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba'i phyir du yul khams 'di skyong zhing sngar lus par zad kyis/ da ni bram ze'i bu mo mo rang la'ang 'dod pa'i lha/ mi dang lhan cig tu gnas pas mi yul du lhung ba phog pa'i rngo can zhig dang pho brang gi rtse na lhan cig tu yod de/ bdag gis kyang lo de tsam zhig gi bar du mo dang cung zad tsam yang lhan cig tu gnas pa med cing / da yang rgyal srid dag mo la gtad de nga 'ong ba la tshegs med kyis gyis la/dmag la zas nor ster zhing lo rgyus zer ba la sogs pa du ma gyis/ de nas mo 'ong gis de'i dus su yang bu mo khyed rang la yang grogs shig yod par gda' na de legs/ sngar khyod kyi pha de'i phyi thag la bsams te bsdad pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na rgyal srid rgya mtsho lta bu'ang bzhag khyod lta bu brgya bas lhag pa'i pha bzang gi bu mo'ang bzhag ste 'dir bsdad na/ da ni 'gro ba'i dus la babasanasagada'o/ /yul khams 'di thams cad nga dbang ba yin te/ bram ze'i phyi thag la khyod la mi 'tshe bar ster bar byed do/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas mo skrag cing nyan nas khyed la zhu ba du mar 'bul gyis/ mthar zer ba bzhin du/ khas long zhig zer nas/ de'i mod la sgyu ma —326—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mkhan gyis sngar zer ba bzhin du sprul bas lha dang bram ze mo gnyis pho brang gi rtse na yod pa skrag ste/ bud med rta ba can nang du byung ba la mnyan pas/ sngar zer ba bzhin du thos shing mthong nas/ lha'i rtog pa la/ bu mo 'dis gtsang spras ma thon par nga la rnge byung nas yod pa rang yin nam snyam nas/ lus la bltas par khrag dang thor ba mang po 'dug nas ma legs/ mi yul du ma lus na rung snyam du skrag ste/ mkha' la bros nas song ngo / der phreng ldan gyi rtog pa la/ rgyal po la zog byas pa'i rnam smin gyis/ lha mi gnyis ka dang bral ba'i nyen 'dug rgyal po rang la zhu dgos te/ bu mo ma gi 'dra ba'i phun sum tshogs pa bzhag nas/ nga dang lhan cig tu cang sdod dam snyam nas bred de/ sprul pa'i bud med de dag phyir thon pa'i rjes su/ gser g.yu 'dres ma sder ma phyur ba gang khyer te/rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs nas phul zhing phyag 'tshal te/ do zhag dmag mang po lhags nas gda' ba ci lags zhus pas / rgyal po na re/ 'di dag nga yi pha tshan yin/ khyod la grogs shig yod par 'dug pas/ de la sogs pa sgyu ma mkhan gyis bslabs pa rnams smras pas/ mo na re/ nged bram ze gcang sbra che bas sngar khyed dang lhan cig gnas pa ra ma gyur na/ da ni grogs med sgro 'dogs gcod du pho brang gi rtse la gshegs/ khyed byang chub sems dpa' yin pa/sa thugs mi g.yo ba gal che mod/ da yang bdag gi pha de la bsams te dmag 'di dag gis mi gnod par gnas 'dir bzhugs par zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / rgyal po na re/ nga grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa snye pre lhar mi rung zhing bram zer mi rung ba bsdongs pa'i gnas der/ nga dkon mchog gsum gyis sras las rgyu 'bras snyespruchol ba las rgyab kyis phyogs pas mi 'grogs/ nga la lha dge sbyong dang bram ze'i gtsang sbra dang ldan pa ma/nga po yod/ mo na re/ kho mos dag byed kyi gzungs chus bkrus pas chog ste 'khrud bya gzhi ma grub/ 'o na yang khyed kyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i phyir du 'deng gis zer nas/ gzungs chus 'brud pa dang / mchod pa so ma brje ba la sogs pa byas nas/ rgyal po'i drung du log ste 'ongs pa dang / rgyal pos dmag thams cad phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i rnam pa ston pa dang / nor rdzas byin te khyed rang log la song / kho bos lho byang gi rgya srid bskyang bar bya yis gsungs pa dang / sgyu ma mkhan gyis de dag mi snang bar byas so/ /de nas sgyu ma mkhan rang nyid blon po dpa' ba brgyad du sprul te rgyal po'i drung du bsdad do/ /de nas phreng ldan mas gsol ba btab ste/ pho brang gi rtse nas nang thams cad ma tshang ba med par gzigs pa phul/ mi rigs pa 'gyod tshangs byas/ de nas rgyal po dang lhan cig tu pho brang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ blon posasgyu ma mkhan la'ang nor rdzas chen po byin/ rang gi bu bzhin du bskyangs/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis kyang / lho phyogs rghaṃ ga'i yul du'ang phyin te/ rgyal po sangs rgyas dpal gyi snyan du'ang mi dbang gi sras chen po/ khaṃ dha'i yul —327—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thams cad skyong zhing ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul/ ma nus thams cad bde ba la 'god/ theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig la spyod cing yod do/ /yab kyi zhal nas kyang / nga'i sras thugs rje can de/ de 'dra ba'i phyir ngas gtong nus pa yin/ khyod slar song la rgyal po de nga'i rtsar spyan drongs la shog sgyu ma mkhan gyis rang gi rgyal po rbha ga lar spyan drangs te/ yab la gzigs pa phul ba dang / yab kyis 'di skad du/ brtse ldan thugs rje chen po khyod / / byang phyogs gnas der ma snyel tam/ /las kyi rgyal srid der bskyangs sam/ /gnas 'di'ang khyed kyis bskyang bar zhu/ /rgyal po dad pa rab tu brtan pas lan du/ mi dbang gzhan du bde lags sam/ /las kyi dbang gis khaṃ dha bskyangs/ /chags pa med kyang gzhan don phyir/ /chos bzhin thams cad rang sar bskyangs/ /yab rgyal pos lan du/ sngon gyi dad pa brtan pa khyod/ /bdag gi mes chen ding sang bu/ /mes sras bdag gi rgyal srid 'di/ chos kyis chos bzhin bskyang bar zhu/ /nga ni khur med dben par 'dod/ /bsam pa bzang gis nyes na mthol/ /sras rgyal pos 'di skad du/ /grangs med bskal pa'i mgon po mchog /bde ster de la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed la mngon shesathogs med ldan/ /de ring gnas 'dir byon du gsol/ /zhes gsepa ba btab pa dang / dge slong bde ster zhes bya ba de rang gi pho brang du byon nas/ rgyal po sangs rgyas dpal la 'di skad du/rgyal srid bu la gtod la khyod rang nga'i rjes su rab tu byung zhes gsungs pas/ yab rgyal rnge/ shin tu dgyes te/ nga da lta nyid du rab tu byung du gsol/ dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ni ye shes dpal du btags nas/ rab tu byung ma thag tu/ mkhan slob kyi zhal nas 'di skad du/ nga ni khyod kyi mkhan slob sde/ /nga ni khyod kyi sras kyang yin/ /'di nas bzung ste ma 'ongs tshe/ /mi rabs nyi shu rtsa lnga na/ /za hor yul 'es/ grags/ pa/ 'dir / / rbha ga la yi rgyal srid 'dzin/ /mi dbang dge ba dpal zhes grags/ /me 'od gsal ni 'od zer can//yab yum gnyis la nga 'khrungs te/ /rgyal srid dug lo bzhin/ du snyil/ /bla ma bzang la rab tu brten/ khyod kyi sras 'di spyan ras gzigs/ /gangs ri'i khrod du legs bltams nas/ /'gro ba ma lus bde bar byed/ /nga yang de yi gnas su 'dren/ /'di bzhin 'gro la phan par spyod/ /de nas rgyal po dge ba dpal/ khyod kyi srasakyi srol 'dzin pa/ /shar ba pa zhes yul las grags/ /sangs rgyasabastan pa rgya mtsho 'dzin/ /chos tshul zab mo rgya mtsho ston/ /dgra bcom brgya phrag du ma sdud/ /e ma chos rgyal ye shes dpal/ /gsang ba'i gsang bsagab gyur kyang / /nga ni ma sgrib gsal ler gda'/ /sangasargyas 'dzin dang de yi sras/ /sangs rgyas dpal zhes gzhan ngo na/ /pha dang bu zhes tha dad kyang / /gdul bya'i dbang gis du mar ston/ /shes pas dpyad na dbyer mi nus / rbha ga 'jig rten tha mal skad/ /bud med dbang du song ltar ston/ /rgyal bu spyan ras gzigs dbang la//—328

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mi shes snying ring 'dra na yang / /gur gum gzhon nu snying rje'i dpal/ /pha dang bur 'khrungs rtog mi ma/nga'/ /rbha ga'ang dpyad na sangs rgyas 'dzin/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i chos rnams la'ang / /rten 'brel dbang gis sna tshogs byung / /las bzang dag la bde ba 'byung / /bag chags ngan la sdug bsngal skyed/ /dwangs pa'i chu la gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zla ba'i rnam par snang na yang / /zla ba chu la 'phos pa med/ /gal te bden na chur mi 'byung / / rdzun phyir chu la gnas pa la/ /byis pa chung chung bden par 'dzin/ /rgan po rten 'brel nyid du rtog /dad pa rab tu brtan pa yis/ /lho byang blon 'bangs skye bo'i tshogs/ /byis chung lta bu rje rgyal la/ /rgyal po bzang tsam nyid las ni/ /sprul ba nyid du ga la go /ngas ni rgan po bzhin du mthong / /shes sam dad pa rab tu brtan/ /sgyu ma mchil ba su zhig yin/ /dad pa rab tu brtan pas lan/ /sgyu ma mchil ba rbha ga yin/ /mi rabs nyi shu rtsa drug na/ /legs pa'i shes rab ces bya ba/ /dam pa khyed kyis legs bsdus nas/ /dregs pa'i skye bo mang po dag /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad gyur te/ /nga yi lag pa g.yas gyur cing / /nga yi zhing de spyod par byed/ /cirgyal po ye shes dpal gyis 'di skad du/ /rang gi yon tan stong phrag kyang / /brjod par mi byed phan par byed/ /nang gi gter bzhin legs bskyangs nas/ /'gag la spyod par byed na mkhas/ /gzhan du ma/ngon shes tshad med dang / / stobs dang rdzu 'phrul ston pa gang / /sems can chags sdang 'ching ba can/ /yul du byas nas bar gcod cing / sdig gsog sgro skur 'debs par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs bsam pa ngan/ /che ba'i che mchog bar gcod mang / /bde bar bshegs la'ang tho 'tshams na/ /bde gshegs sras la 'gran byed cing / /phan bde gnas la bar gcod 'byung / /des na yon tan sbas na bzang / /sprul pa'i sras kyis rgyal srid bzung / /nga ni bde bar thar lam 'gro /bdag gi tshigs las ma 'da' zhig /ces yab kyis gsungs pa dang / /sras dad pa rab tu brtan pas/ yab dang bla ma/ rang gi pho brang gi rtser theg pa dman pas dben par bzhugs su gsol te/lha dang mi'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs pas bsnyen bkur ro/ /de'i tshe bla ma bde ster gyi zhal nas/ mi dbang khyod kyi yab dben par gnas pa'i rjes su rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyongs (skyongasaka /de ring byang gi pho brang du 'deng zhes bla ma yab sras blon po dang bcas pas rdzu 'phrul gyis pho brang du byon nas/ blon 'bangs dad pa can mang po pho brang du bsdus nas/ las rgyu 'bras las brtsams pa'i chos mang po bstan te/ rgyal po dad pa rab tu brtan pa sngon rgyal po dpal bzang du ji ltar 'khrungs pa dang / dpal gyis phyi blon ji ltar byas pa dang / de nas blon po dpal khaṃ dha'i rgyal por ji ltar 'khrungs pa dang / nang blon dpal grub de'i zhang po bram ze ji ltar 'khrungs pa dang / da ltar gzhan gyi rgyal srid gzhan gyis ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul yang / sngon rgyal po dpal —329—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzang dang / btsun mo phreng ldan ma gnyis la bu med nas/ blon po gnyis po bu bzhin du phog pa la/ phyi blon dpal gyi rtog pa la nga phyi blon yin pas nga la blo mi phebs/ khong nang blon la blo 'bebs te/ 'on kyang nor ni gnyis ka la mnyam por byin pas/ rgyal po ma gshegs kyi bar du phyi'i gnyer ka 'di mthar phyin pa cig bya dgos / rgyal po med pa dang nang blon bor nas phyi nang gi rgyal srid thams cad ngas bskyang dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa ngan pa cung zad skyes pas sngon la kho rang gum ste/ rgyal pos kho'i don du dge las mang po mdzad nas nor lhag ma rnams nang blon la byin/ de nas rgyal po'ang gshegs pa'i rjes su nang blon gyis rgyal po'i don du'ang dge las dpag tu med pa byas/ phyis kyang de'i las 'brel gyis phyi blon kyang 'di nyid du rgyal po dpal du skyes / de'i rgyal srid kyang nang blon bram zer skyes pa des bzung / de'i rgyal srid kyang rgyal po 'dis bzung nas/phreng ldan ma la 'dir yang btsun mo byas te/ de thams cad bsam pa'i khyad par yin/ yang 'di nas mi rabs nyi shu rtsa drug na'ang 'di'i rten 'brel gyis rgyal po dpal ni/ /rgya bod kyi chos la mkhas pa skad du ma smra ba cig 'byung ste/ de'i mtshan ni brtson 'grus seng ge'o/ /rgyal bu dad pa rab tu brtan pa ni/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes gangs ri'i khrod du bltams/ nang blon dpal grub ni des byin gyis brlabs te/ lo tsā bas rgya gar nas kho bo 'dren/ de'i mthun rkyen thams cad brtson 'grus seng ges bsgrub (sgrub3 / nang blon kyang skad du ma smra ba chul khrims rgyal ba zhes yon tan gyi sgo du ma la mkhas par 'byung ngo / / /131na brtson 'grus seng ge / rgya nas bod du 'gro ba'i lam khar gshegs tshul bstan nas/ tshul khrims rgyal bas kho bo drangs te/ bod du rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi phyag tu kho bo phul te/ rang gis kyang lo bcu dgu tsam bsten nas/ nga'i yon tan phal che ba bsten no/ /sgyu ma mchil ba ni legs/ pa'i shes rab ces bya'o/ /phreng ldan ma ni brtson 'grus g.yung drung ngo / /de'i dus su'ang sgyu ma mchil ba 'dis 'dum pa'i rtsa ba thams cad byed ces bya ba la sogs pa 'byung tshul la brten nas las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang po bstan/ de nas rgyal po dad pa rab tu brtan pas kyang lho byang gi rgyal srid thams cad bskyangs nas thams cang/ bde ba la bkod/ yang rgyal po dpal dang dpal grub gnyis char dad pa rab tu brtan pa'i sras su phreng ldan ma la 'khrungs /ka 131 ba2 rgonas/ / dad pa'i 'od ces pa dang /dad pa'i lha zhes bya bar grags/ bla ma bde ster gyi yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen du gsol nas/ nang pa'i chos mang po'ang bslabs/ phyi nang gi sgra mang po yang bslabs/ sngon gyi bag chags khyad par can la brten nas thams cad kyang mkhas pa phul du phyin pa byung / de nas rgyal po da/da pa'i 'od rbha ga la 'dzin du bcug dad pa'i lha khaṃ dha'i rgyal srid 'dzin du bcug gnyis kar gyis kyang rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ thams cad kyis kyang —330—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' zhes su bstod pa byed do/ /de nas rgyal po dad pa rab tu brtan pas dgung lo bdun cu don lnga la po ta lar 'pho ba btab ste gshegs so/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di ni de ltar yon tan rgya che ba thugs zab la sgam/ khyod kyang yon tan che yang / nged la 'dri ba skad zer/ nga'i lo tsā ba gnyis po'ang de ltar ngo mtshar che/ rgya'ang bsam pa ngan ces bstan kyang drang don tsam yin/ cig gis cig la phan 'dogs pa'i snyad dkar (karakagada'/ 'u cag dpon slob kyang las smon bzang pos 'dir 'tshogs / skye ba thams cad du'ang sprul ba rnam pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don byed cing yang yang 'du bar smon lam 'tshal lo/ /sngar gyi de dag ding sang gi gang dang gang yin pa ni gong gi de dag gis go bas bshad mi 'tshal / phreng ldan dang mdza' bo'i lha de ni/ da gzod dbu ru'i phugs 'dir sgom chen du ming btags/ thos pa chung zhing 'dod yon la brtsi ba zhig gis rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams la brten cing de dag la smod/ gnod pa skyel te/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sprul ba zhig gis mgo gnon cing zhi bar byed do/ /rngog 'dis de'i dus su'ang khu dang 'brom gnyis mdza' bar byas so/ /da yang sang snangs (gnangasakakhu'i nga rgyal bcom nas 'brom la 'dud par byed/ de'i dus su nga'ang ltad mo zhig blta/ legs pa'i shes rab/ de ltar na bram/ ze mos de ltar mi rigs pa byas kyang / bram ze la byas pa shes shing drin du gzo bar byas so/ /rang 'dod chung zhing rang 'dod la chog shes par byas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar/ 'dod pa chung dang chog shes dang / /byas la drin du gzo bar bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skye rabs bstan pa las / rgyal bu dad pa rab tu brtan par ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bdun pa'o// //nya8 rgya yul hwa shang gnas pa'i sar rgyal bu blo gros 'phel du sku skye ba bzhesapa'i lesdo/ka 132 na4 rgorgya nag po'i yul ha shang gnas pa'i sar/ rgyal bu blo gros 'phel du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs so///༄༅/ /yang nyin cig jo bo yab sras gnyis po jo bo'i chab chu'i drung na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ yab sras gnyis la phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa legs par phul/ khyad par du'ang dngul gyi maṇḍal la dung gi phra bkod pa/ jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs la thun mong du phul nas/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi drung du thal mo sbyar te/ phyi rabs kyi mi dmu rgod dag sgro skur cing 'debs na'ang 'debs/ de ring lha —331 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tshogs mang po 'dir lhags pa la khyed kyi sku che ba'i yon tan brjod na khong rnams la yang mngon shes yod pa dang / jo bo la sgro skur mi mnga' zhing don chen por 'gyur bas de ring yang skyes rabs khyad par can zhig bkas gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ dge bshes pa la zhu na/ 'jig rten pa'i kha ngag la sgog pa che 'chos chung 'chos mnyam zer ba cig gda' ste/ de bzhin du 'u cag gi yon tan 'di kun yang ma brjod na legs te jo bos brjod/ 'on kyang bla ma la mi legs pa mi mnga'/ da dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas kyang / bu mo ngan ma bzhin du nang du ci labs phyir skyel ba de yang ma mdzad/ khyed gang zag dam pa cig gis zhus rting la/ jo bos kyang / bdag gis pha rol tu ma phyin pa'i stobs kyis 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams tshul mang tsa na/ dge bshes pa gang mnyes pa'i sa nas gsung mdzod cig der rngog gis kyang mthong bar bu mo shing lo sngo ljang gi gosagyon pa cig 'brom gyi mdun na phar 'chams tshur 'chams mdzad cing skyes bu dam pas yon tan thams cad ha cang rang sbas na'ang sems can nyon mongasapa can gyis/ yul khyad par can la brnyas pa byas na rung ngam/ he he zer te gar song cha med par song / rngog na re/ da cis kyang yi ge cig 'god par zhu/ da lta'i mo btsun de sgrol ma yin par 'dug ngas kyang shes/ yi ge 'brir mi btub na rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /yon tan da dung spos gsungs nas 'ong du gsha' ba la/ skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan sbas drags na rung ngam/ he he gsung khong shin tu mad zhus pas/ 'brom gyi zhal nas/ de bas ngasagatam gyis gong du sleb par byas/ bu mo ngan ma'i gtam bya ba de la zer ba yin rtag mi thub/ 'dir jo bos kho bo la brtsams te gsungs tshad yi ger bris na 'bum tsam zhig mchi / de bas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rtsod pa med pa 'dri mod/ rngog na re/ de ring gang ltar na'ang skyes rabs shig zhu 'tshal bas gegs ma mdzad ces/ jo bo la phyag gsum btsal te/ zhus len 'di na mar la/byams dang snying rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin po che 'dis/ sngon byams pa ji tsam bsgoms/ snying rje chen po ji ltar bsgoms/ ma bu gcig po la brtse ba ji ltar mdzad/ byang chub kyi sems rgya mtsho lta bu brtan par ji ltar bsgoms/ bla mas gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas sngon rgya nag po'i yul ha shang gnas pa'i sar rgyal po nag po lcags 'bar bya ba la btsun mo'ang lcags mo zhes pa yod de dag nang pa dang / phyi ba gnyis ka'i lta ba 'dzin pa la de'i tshe/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di po ta la na khye'u blo gros 'phel zhes bya ba sprul ba sna tshogs 'gyed pa cig tu yod pa des//nag po lcags 'bar mthong nas/ skyabs yul cha gnyis su 'dzin pa 'di cha gcig tu 'gril bar bya ste/ ding sang de bzhin gshegs pa snga ma dag 'das/ phyi ma dag ma byon pa'i skabs 'dir/ bdag gis nye ba bur sprul te/—332—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /thabs kyis kha ma drangs na rgyal po 'di yang nga rgyal che bas btsan lajun dang 'chos pas bzlog par dka' snyam nas / btsun mo lcags mo'i lhums su zhugs/ de nas skyes ma thag tu lha dbang phyug chen po 'dra ba/ /gzugs bzang zhing ngar che ba cig byung / phas mtshar nas lag tu blangs pa dang thal mo sbyar nas/ yab khyod bu dang ldan pa dga'am zhes smras pas/ pha na re/ chung ngu nas labs pa rung ngam/ bu na re/ 'o na rgan kyang mi smra ba cig dgos sam/ pha na re/ de yang min de yang min pa cig dgos/ bu na re/ gnyis ka min pa cig dgos na/ bu ma skyes pa cig 'tshal lam/ yab na re/ de yang mi rung / bu na re/ e ma yab la ni mi srid pa cig dgos so/ /bu skye ni dgos la/ rgan nas gzhon kyang rung ste/ smra ni mi rung ngo / /der yab na re/ de ma yin/ skyes ma thag nas mi smra/ nar son nas smra ba yin mod/ bu na re/ bu skyes ma thag pa la kha dang lce dang sems med la/ nar son pa dang da gzod byung na 'di 'dra ba zhig mchi/ pha na re/ khyod kyi smra lugs kyis sprul ba zhig rang yin nam/ gang gis gang nas sprul te 'ongs pa yin/ bu na re/ nga rgya dkar po'i cha cig nas 'ongs/ pha na re/ khyed la ji skad bya bar grags/ bu na re/ yul de na kho bo la blo gros 'phel zhes zer/ khyod sus btang / bu na re/ rgya gar gyi nang pa dag ni ntu na ras gzigs zhes zer/ /mu stegs kyi cha mthun la la dag la/ gshen lha 'od dkar zhes su grags zer bas/ pha'i bsams pa la/ 'o na 'di gshen lha 'od dkar rang yin nam mtshan ltas 'di yang bzang zer nas bu khur te/ grong khyer gyi sgo na mar phyin pas/ hwa shang gi ston pa dag na re/ 'di rang dbang phyug chen po'i sprul pa yin nam ma/chan ltas rang bzang zer/ pha na re/ bu 'di nyid la dris dang smra ba zhig yod kyis zer/khong rnams kyis kyang dris pas/ rgyal bu na re/ bon gyi gnas lugs la gzhan dang gzhan du khas blang du ga la rung zhes smras pas/ de rnams dga' nas mthong bar dka' ba mthong ba'i dus 'dir/ mchod par byed rdzas ci dgos zer ba la/ dong du yun ring du sdod pa'i btson mang po dgos/ rgyal bu btson gyis ci 'tshal zhus pas/ nga de dag la snying na zer/ des khyed la ci byas zhus pas/ nga'i lus ngan pa 'di de dag gis yang nas yang du bskyed nas 'khor ba 'dir sdug bsngal la btang zer/ de dag kho nas bskyed cing sdug bsngal ba ci yin zer/ kye ston pa dag dang po 'di nas 'ongs kyi khungs med cing / bar du skye 'chi'i phreng ba grangs med pas mi dag la rdzus skyes dang / drod gsher dang / sgo nga las skyes pa ni nyung / des bdag cag mir gyur ba dag la pha ma'ang mi dag 'byung gis/ de na mi de dag gis yang dang yang du skyed do/ /der ston pa de dag na re/ rgyal bu/ 'o na de cam du btson de dag tu ma zad/ khyod kyis lus sna tshogs su blangs pas/ sems can thams cad kyis khyod kyi lus ngan pa 'di bskyed cing 'khor ba 'dir sdug du bcug nas/ khyad par du btson de dag khyod kyi mchod rdzas su dgos —333—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa ci yin/ rgyal bus lan du/ ston pa dag mad/ sems can thams cad kyis sems can thams cad bskyed cing pha ma bu tshar mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor na mchod rdzas la de dag thams cad dgos mod kyis ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par sems can de dag kyang gnas na/ mchod rdzas la dgos pas ci phan/ dre'us glang po mi 'chun pa bzhin du/ de dag bsdu bar dka'/ btson de dag la mgon skyabs gzhan med rang re'i btson khang gi yang dong khri mun gyi nang na gnas te/ des na rang dbang pa'i mi yin pas gnas 'dir khrid la shog der rgyal po dang ston pa dag gis bsams pa la/ rgyal bu 'di'i zer lugs kyis sems can thams cad pha ma bu tsha'i 'khor lor gda' ba la pha ma'i sha khrag mchod rdzas su dgos zer bar 'dug de rigs sam snyam nas rgyal bu la zhus pa/ kye rgyal bu de ltar na ni pha ma yin par gda' bas/ pha ma'i sha khrag bza' bar rung ngam/rgyal bus lan du/ khyed rnams rgyu med cig yin snyam mam/ ding sang gi pha ma'ang ma mthong ngam/ byol song las mi skye ba mthong ngam/ bems po las rig pa skye ba mthong ngam/ rang nyid ma 'gags par rang nyid las rang nyid skye ba mthong ngam/ ston pa dag na re/ de ltar ni ma mthong ngo / 'o na pha ma las skye'am/ rgyu yod pa zhig las skye'am / kye rgyal bu/ pha ma las skye ba ni rgyu yod pa las skye ba'o/ /rgyal bu na re/ pha ma ni rkyen te/ rkyen gyis bskyed par nus pa ni rgyu yod pa'o/ /rgyu med pa ni 'bras bu'ang ma yin no/ /des na rang gi rgyu bsod nams bsags pa las ni mir 'byung gis/ rang gi rgyu bsod nams ma yin pa las ni 'bras bu ngan song ngo / /der ston pa dag gis bsams pa la/ 'di'i dgongs pas sems can thams cad pha ma/ chos thams cad rgyu ldan/rang rgyu las skye zhing rang la rang skye bar 'gal ba/ rgyu ma yin pa las 'bras bu ma yin pa skye ba khegs pa la rgyu 'bras thams cad zab cing phra bar ston pa cig 'dug snyam nas rgyal pos bka' bsgos te/ btson lnga brgya mdun du khrid nas 'ongs so/ der rgyal bus/ btson dag la smras pa/ khyed rnams las cis rgyal pos mnar/der la la dag na re mi bsad/ la la dag na re 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spyad/ la la dag na re ma byin pa chen po blangs/ la la dag na re/ mi bden pa'i rdzun tshig chen pos gzhan bslus/ des rgyal pos mnar zer ro/ /der rgyal bu na re/ las ngan bsags pa'i mthong chos 'di nyid du'ang 'byung na/ phyi mar bzod glags med pa'i ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid ni sdug bsngal chung zhing bzod par nus kyi/ 'dis mtshon nas rgyu mi dge ba bsags pas 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byin gyis shes par mdzod zer nas/ kha spos te/ rgyal po la 'di skad du/ bdag gis yab rgyal po khri mun du bcug na ci 'dra ba zhig mchi/ 'on te rgyal pos bdag khri mun du bcug na ji ltar mchi/ pha na re gnyis ka mi rung ngo / rgyal bus lan du/ 'di dag kyang pha ma bu tsha yin pas —334—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mnar bar mi bya'o/ /rgyal po nyid kyis kyang tshe la brtan pa ma thob pas srog 'gags ma thag tu rang gis bsags pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa rjes su 'brang bas 'di dag gis kyang slar mnar bar 'gyur gyis shes par mdzod cig rgyal po zer bas/ ston pa de dag gis bsams nga/ la/ 'di mtshan ltas la bltas na ni lha dbang phyug 'dra/ chos kyi gnas lugs la bltas na ni nang pa 'dra/ brjod chul ni bon gyi skad du gda' bas/'di la khyad par dri'o snyam nas phyi nang bar gsum gyi chos gang bden/ khyod lha gang gi yin/ rgyal bus smras pa/sems can dag la blo rigs re/ /ming kyang de dang mthun par 'dogs/ /lha yang tha dad du ma skad/ /rgya gar nang pa'i blo ngo na/ /nga ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /blo gros 'phel zhes 'bod par byed/ /bon po gshen lha 'od dkar zhes/ /da lta lcags 'bar bu ru 'bod/ /phyi ba dbang phyug chen po zhes/ /chos kyang de dang mtshungs par spyod/ /dpyad na tshad med bzhi ldan bzang / /ma dpyad bza' btung longs spyod skyid/ /rmongs pa mi dge'i las la 'jug /ston pas pha mar shes dpyod la/ /byams dang snying rje bsten na bzang / /zab mo smras kyang de ma shes / / rang gi dka' spyad don med 'gyur/ /des na chos lugs tha dad kyang / /don gyi snying po de nyid bzang / /de ltar min na ngan song 'gro /rang yang 'drongs par mi/ byed pa'i/ /log pa'i chos kyis slu bar byed/ /ces smras pas / ston pa de dag gis bsams pa la'ang / brtan pa med cing rkyen kha bar song bas rgyal bu'i byang chub kyi sems kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rang gi mtshan ltas la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis nang pa'i sgor zhugs te tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te sems las su rung bar gyur to// /dus re zhig rgyal po yab sras gnyis dben par yod pa na/ rgyal po na re/ nga skyabs gnyis la brten pa la/ khyod kyis skyabs gcig la brten du bcug /nges par chos dang bon dang / phyi ba dag gang bden/ rgyal bu na re/ lan cig hwa shang gi yul 'dir kho bo nag po ha su zhes bya bar gyur/ bon dang phyi ba'i chos la spyad/ bon po dang phyi ba gnyis kas kho bo mchod pa la/ kho bo gum ma thag tu dmyal bar skyes pas/ da/myal ba'i gnas de na/ dmyal ba'i thub pa zhes pa nang pa'i lha cig gda' ba de na re/ khyod kyis bon dang mu stegs kyi chos la spyod pas 'dir skyes kyis shes par mjod zer nas/ tshad med pa bzhi bstan pas/ sngar gyi las la 'gyod pa drag po skyes shing bshags pas/ da lta yan chod du mtho ris thob cing bde bar gyur pa yin no/ /rgyal po shes par mdzod cig ding sang yang / khyod cha cig nang pa'i chos la dad pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ khyod kyi bu skal mi bcad pa'i don du 'dir 'ongs so/ /da ni nang pa la nges par mdzod la gtan gyi btsan sa zung shig rgyal po yab yum gnyis kyis bu'i tshig de thos pa dang / rgyal po yab yum gnyis char gyis tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa la brten nas gnas lugs kyi don mthong / de'i rjes su sras yang —335—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/'bar dang / yang lcags gnyis 'brungs te bu gsum yod bzhin du/ rgyal srid thams cad phyogs med du sbyin par btang nas/ der pho brang min pa ni nor med pa'i dus su phyi rol pa dang bon po dag bu de skyes nas nor brlag mu stegs dang bon po'i zas skal tsho yang bcad rgyal po yab yum yang nang pa'i chos lugs su 'gyur zer zhing 'bar ba rgyal po yab yum gyis thos pa dang 'di skad du/ dman pa rang dang mi mthun pas/ /dam pa dag la smod par byed/ /mi sto rgyal srid me 'obs zhig /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab rang sar bskams/ /chagasamed 'ching grol bde bar 'gyur/ /gcan gzan lta bu'i grogs bral bzang / /srin po lta bu'i chos lugs shig khyi phag gnas nas nags kyi khrod/ /me bya dga' gar rtse bar 'gro /nam mkha' gar khyab pha mas khyab/ /stag dang spyang khyi'i snying rje bzhin/ /phyogs su ma lhung kun tu bsten/ /rgyal srid gnas nas bros pa bzang / /btson gyis gnas nasagrol ba bzhin/ /me'i 'obs nas thar ba bzang / /pazle'i sbubs kyi sprul ba bzhin/ /mi gtsang khrod nas thar pa bzang / /gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha dang mtshungs/ /bzang po'i ro lang zhen na 'ching / /rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ zhes rgyal srid spangs te chags pa med pa'i gnas su song ngo/ /der rgyal bu gsum gzhon pa dang pha ma dang rgyal srid med pa'i stobs kyis blon po dag gis kyang khur du ma 'dod/ dregs pa can gzhan yang ma 'chun/ der sngar gyis hwa shang gi ston pa de dag kyang / skyo nas pho brang gi nang rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs te/pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad du/ rgya nag zhang zhung rgyal po ni/ /longs spyod mnga' thang rgya mtsho 'dra/ /mchod gnas 'khor bzang smon pa'i gnas/ /kun gyis bkur zhing 'dud byed na/ /rgyal bu khyod bltams rgya mtsho bskams/ /'khor dengs mchod gnas bye bar gyur/ /da ni rgya mtsho bskams pa'i shul/ /sa skyong lha ba tsam zhig la'ang/ /klu dbang lta bu'i yab yum dag /mtsho med chu bya ji bzhin du/ khyod kyi gsung la tshad bzung nas/ /chags med gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ma rung sems can dmu rgod dag /gang gi drin lan mi gzo bas/ /nang gi blon po dgra bo yi/ /go cha len zhing rgyal bu 'dor/ /e ma 'di yi 'dun ma shor/ /da ni phyi ma'i btsan sa dag /zin par ma gyur 'gyod tshabs che/ /mi 'gyod brtan pa'i gdeng ci mchis/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ legs par dpyod dang shes ldan kun/ /mi rtag de la snying po med/ /longasaspyod mkha' dang mnyam gyur kyang / /'dab chags shugs kyis dpyad mi nus/ /rgyal srid dug gi sdong po 'dra/ /rma bya lta bu'i mthu ldan gyis/ /za yis phal bas zos na 'chi/ kha mngar dug gis tshe srog 'bral/ /'phral dga'i rgyal srid tshe srog skyel/ /rma bya rgyal srid spangs gyur te/ /nags kyi khrod du 'gro byed na/ /chags ldan su zhig rgyal srid 'dzin/ /klu dbang rgya mtsho mi rtag par/ /shes nas snying por mi 'dzin na/ /chags can su zhig lha ba 'dzin//—336

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /e ma shes ldan nga la nyon/ /nor med nor mchog bdun bstan bzang / /chags srid spangs nas chags med srid / / dga' bde'i btsan sar bskyangs na bzang / /rang don log pa'i lam zhugs pa'i/ /rgyud ngan drin lan mi gzo ba/ /grogs ngan spangs te gzhan gyi don/ /rtse gcig rtson pa spyan ras gzigs/ /lhar bzang dbang phyug gshen dkar ni/ /mi shes gzhan gyi sgro btags yin/ /bon dang mu stegs chos dag ni/ /g.yo can tshig bzhin ngo bstod byed/ /de yi phugs ni gzhan bslu zhing / /mthun pa'i 'byed cing dgra dang sprod/ /mu stegs bon ni dngosagrub myur/ /'phral dga' phugs su ngan 'gror skyur/ /mu stegs bon ni me dang 'dra/ /cung zad nye bas bder gyur na'ang / /nges par gtugs na 'tshig par 'gyur/ /nang pa'i chos ni me dang 'dra/ /gshe zhing lus kyis rdeg par byed/ /e ma na dang tshar gyur na'ang / /bdag gi bu na kye ma'o/ /sman dang sman pa gang nas rnyed/ /'di dang bral na ji ltar bya/ /rab brtse bzod glags med par 'gyur/ /de dag de bzhin dpyod par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs zhugs nas/ ston pa bcu gnyis mchis pa de dag nang pa'i chos la nges par gyur to/ /re zhig rgyal bu gsum dben par gnas pa na chung shos yang lcags na re / 'u cag gsum la pha ma yang med na/ nor kyang ye mi gda' na/ pha ma'i rigs ni bu la snying ni brtse/ bdag cag chung bas mgo mi thon gyis dogs/ phag na nor skal zhig yod nas mchi/ de gcen gyis 'tshol bar zhu zhus pas / gcen la sgrib pa mi mnga' bas/ rang gi ma lcags mo bzhugs pa'i 'og nas gser bum pa gang bton no/ /gser de byung ba mthong ba dang yang lcags na re/ pha ma snying nye de 'ong bar re/ da bdag cag spun gsum gyi mdun ma 'dis mi 'ong bar 'dug pas/ cig gis chos bya dgos/ cig gis nor bsags la rgyal srid 'di bzung dgos/ gzhan du na ngan pa dag ma 'chun par rang gi bstan pa la gnod par 'dug pas/ cig gis mu stegs byed kyi ngan sngags bslabs nas/ ngan pa dag tshar gcad 'tshal/ zhes smras pas 'bring po yang 'bar na re / gcen chen po chos pa yin pas/ chos byed pa las 'os med/ chos pas kyang ngan pa mi 'chun zhing / stobs kyis kyang ngan pa mi 'chun par gda' bas/ sngon la ngan sngags shig bslabs la ngan pa gcun dgos pas/gcen chen po dang / nor 'dir bzhag ste/ rang re gnyis ngan sngags slob tu 'deng zer ba la/ gcen gyis gdams ngag du ma'i sgo nas bzlog kyang las kyi dbang gis ma bzlog par song / dus re zhig rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyi dgongs pa la/ sa phyogs 'di bon dang mu stegs byed kyi yul yin/ gcung gnyis po grogs kyi dbang du song nas nor 'di don med kyi phyogs su bo srid/ bon dang mu stegs kyi yul 'di bsgral nas/ sa thag ring po —337—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/na a su ra gsang ba'i brag khung zhes bya ba na bdag gi tshe rabs thams cad kyi bla ma a wa sgru ti ba zhes bya ba grub thob chen po cig sprul ba gsum du mdzad de/ cig ni kha ba can gyi yul du sems can gyi don la yang yang gshegs / cig ni rgya nag gi yul 'dir yang yang 'ong / cig ni rgya gar gyi phyogs thams cad khyab par 'grim/sku ni nyan thos chen po'i rnam par byas shing gshegs pa cig yod pas/ de'i drung du ma phyin na drag po mi thul/sems can la phan mi thogs snyam du dgongs nas rang gis btul ba'i ston pa bcu gnyis po de pho brang du spyan drangs nas/ khyed bcu gnyis po phyi nang bar gsum gyi chos la mkhas/ nga'i pho brang 'dir dgon pa gyis la re zhig la rang gi gdul byar gyur ba rnams dam pa'i chos la 'khod/ cha lugs ni drang don du rang rang dang mthun par mdzod cig da ste lo gsum nas/ yang 'bar dang yang lcags gnyis ngan sngags bslabs nas 'dir 'ong gis / thabs kyis ngan sngags las bzlog la chos la tshud/ yang 'bar rgyal srid 'dzin du chug yang lcagasal chos slobs la don du gnyer ba la 'chad du chug kye nga ni 'di lta ste/ sngon tshe 'khor ba thog med du/ /yongasakyi bshes gnyen yongs kyi dpal/ /gtsug gi nor bu rin chen mchog /a wa dhū ti zhes byar grags/ /gsang ba'i brag khung zhes bya na/ /a su ra yi sgrub khang yod/ /de na byams dang snying rje yi/ /pad skor mdzes pa phyogs bcur bskor/ /bdag med chos kyi rdo rje gsor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min tshogs/ /gnas der bsdus te skrag par byed/ /dam pa de yi drung du 'gro/ /bla ma de yi zhabs la gtugs/ /zag med bdud rtsi snying po len/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i bka' lung len/ /chos dbyings chen por bsngo ba byed/ /ces ston pa de dag gi dbus nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /gnas a su ra gsang ba'i brag ces bya ba rtse mo mtho ba'i rtse la sprin dang na bun 'khrigs pa/ngos rtse shing nags tshal rgyas pa'i gseb na dug sprul dang gcan gzan gdug pa can 'grim pa/ padma khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i nang na dung dang chu srin la sogs pa chu'i skye bo du ma gnas pa/ gzugs med sgra skad 'byin pa'i lha ma yin mang po labs pa/ de lta bu'i brag khung na/ bla ma a wa dhū ti ba che chung rim pa gsum brag khung tha dad pa gsum na bsam gtan la rtse gcig tu gnas pa la gser bum pa gang po de cha gsum du btang ste/ bla ma a wa dhu ti ba chen po'i phyag tu sum cha phul te/ nga yi zhing khams kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /byams pas 'dul byed zhing khams rtsub po der/ /dpa' bo khyod byon sa bdag klu gnyan dang / /bdud dang lha min gdug rtsub chen po'i tshogs / / ma lus khyed kyis 'dul byed skal ba can/ /bdud rtsi dus la 'doms shing tshim par byed/ /e ma khyed la chags pa mi mnga' yang / /yang 'bar yang lcags la sogs 'gro don du/ /thugs rjes bzhes la de dag zhi bar mdzod/ /dge rtsa chos dbyings dag pas mchog tu bsngo/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ legs pa —338—

'bror/ sten pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /legs pa'i 'a/ma zhugs legs nga/ra ma/chi/ /bdag bis gzhan don dag kyang gco bor bde/ /zhes gzhan ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs/ yang gser gyi sum/ cha a wa dhū ti ba /ribring po'i phyag tu phul te/ rgya nag nga rgyal dregs pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /ma/khas dang mkhas pa ra rlom/ pa ma/nga pe'i cheogs/ khyod kyis 'dul zhing skal ldan zag re/da kyi / / bdud rtsis chim ma/jad bdud dang mu sdegs dag /rab 'jom/sa sprul ba chen ngo/ nyid la 'di/ /chags pa mi mnga' mod kyis 'bul gyis bzhes/ /bsam dang dngos bzang chos dbyings dag pa yi/ /zhing dag khyed la phul bas mchog tu shog /ces smras pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos kyi chos mchog tshad me/da mchog tu bzang / /gdug pa gang gis 'tshe tshe ma za gyis/ /zhes gzhan mi gsung bar bzhugs/ yang gser gsum cha bla ma/ a wa dhū ti ba chung ba la phul te/ rgya gar phyogs ris re/da par bla ma/ khyed/ /sprul ba du mas gang dang mthun pa'i chos/ /ston cing ma rungs gdug pa 'dul bar byed/ /skal ldan dus la bdud rtsis tshim ma/jad cing / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus par/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis sprul ba du ma 'gyed/ /'gro ba de dag thugs rjes 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma khyed la gser g.yu rdo shing dag khyad par mi ma/nga' rin chen 'di 'bul gyis/ /bzhes la chos ston 'khor ba ma/ stong nga/ra/ /nam/ ma/spa' bzhin du skye 'bri me/da nga/ra bzhugs/ /thams cad dag pas dag nga/'i dbyings su bsngo/ /'es zhus pa dang / bla ma spyan nam mkha' la cher gzigs nas/ 'di skad du/dpe med dpe 'das spyad bya spyod byed re/da/ /chags sngang 'dis chod dbyer med ngang du khyer/ /zhes gsungs nas ral gri cig gnang ste gzhan ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal bu blo gros 'phel gyis bla mas gnang ba'i gri de bsnams te gsang ba'i brag las babs te 'ongs pa dang / nags kyi khrod nas stag dang spyang rki 'dres pa drug tsam byung ste/ rgyal bu la za bar brtsam/sa pa dang / rgyal bu rang bzhin gyis byams nga/ dang snying rjer ldan pa la der de dag la dmigs te lhag nga/ra yang byam/sa pa dang snying rje dang de dag gis sangs rgyas thob 'dod bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'khrungs so/ /de'i tshe 'di skad du/ bdag gi pha ma/ ma/che ba can/ /pha ma/ zos shing bu la yang //za ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan rung ngam/ /ma za ma/ za las 'a/ soms/ /zhes smras pas/ gcan gzan de dag ngo zhum byasate/ 'di skad du/ sngon chad du ma zos gyur kyang / /bden pa'i tshig gis grol rma/ gyur/ /da lan khyed gsung mi bcag 'tshal/ /da dung 'jigs chen 'ong dogs yod/ /bsam bzang nged dang 'grogs par bya/ / ma 'grogs na ni mi thon no/ /zhes zer nas gcan gzan dag dang rgyal bu sdongs te/ rgyal bus rang bzhin la spyad pas gnas a su ra gsang ba'i brag gi mi ma yin gcan gzan gyi rnam par bar du gcod pa la byams pa dang snying rje'i chu rgyun la 'dod pa'i me phran gyis bar du ma chod par rang rang gi grogs su shar ba gzigs nas/—339—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par dpag tshad mang por 'grogs te phyin no/ /de nas gcan gzan de dag mi ring ba nas byer te song ngo / /de nas bsil thang zhes pa'i grong khyer chen po zhig na skye bo dpag tu med pa gda' ba la/ la la ni glu gar la sogs pa dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston/ la la ni ngu zhing smre sngags du ma 'don / mi dpa' ba zhig lus la go mtshon du las brgyan te rta cig la zhon (bayion1pa na/ skye bo gzhan du mas 'then zhing ngu / der 'di dag gi spyod tshul 'gal ba la snyam nas dris pa la/ grong khyer 'di'i dbus kyi pho brang 'di na/ sngar rgyal po 'jigs med bya ba yod pa la/ btsun mo shin tu mtshar ba zhig yod pas de la klu bdud zhugs te/ mos rgyal po'ang bkum/ blon 'bangs mang po'ang zos/ ding sang grong khyer ba 'di dag la mi re la zhag re za res bskor bas mi dpa' bo 'di yang zas (zakares la 'gro ba yin pas cha lugs 'di 'dra'ang nang par ldog mi nus pas ngu ba yin/ la la'i dga' gar sna tshos byed pa ni mos nam za cha med/ zos na dga' ba'i gar rtser mi 'ong bas/ dga' gar gyi snang ba yud tsam ston pa yin/ bzhin bzang khyed kyis mi shes sam / rgyal bus smras pa/ 'o na go cha sra zhing mtshoni cha rno ba du mas bcom na mi choms sam/ de dag na re/ kye bzhin bzang / dpa' bo mi ro mang bar zad/ mo la ni glags che bar mi gda'/ der rgyal bu'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams sdug bsngal ma byed cig do nub 'di'i tshab la kho bos cha'o/ /der thams cad byang chub sems dpa' zhes dga' ste/ mi de'i chas thams cad rgyal bu la brgyan nas btang ngo / /der pho brang de'i nang na rta dang glang po dang ma he la sogs pa nor mang po gda' ba la mi thams cad mdze mo zhig gis zos nas 'dug pa la/ rgyal busarta de rin po che'i bres shig la btags te phugs na mdze mo cig ga la ba de'i rtsa na rin po che'i khri cig 'dug pa de la rgyal bus bzhugs pa dang / mdze mo de rgyal bu la cher bltas nas/ mi khyod dang bzhin bzang rlom pa can zhig gda' ste nga'i lus la ni a tsi bho la zhes bya ba stobs che ba cig yod pa des/ nga rgyal can ngas bcings pa thams cad des za/ sngar mang bas kyang ma thub/ btsan pas kyang ma thub/ mi khyod reng bur zlums sam/ der rgyal bus/ gzugs de mthong ba dang tshig de thos pas dngos dang brgyud pa'i sdug bsngal la bsams te byams pa dang snying rje drag po skyes/ bla mas gnang ba'i ral gri de rtsig pa'i logs la bkal/ skye bo de dag gis bskur ba'i ral gri reg pa tsam gyis gzhan 'chad pa 'dra ba de lag tu bzung ste bsdad pa dang / mdze mo de na re/ shes rab kyi ral gri cig med na mtshon cha de la re na sdug mchi zer/ de nas nyi ma dmar thag chad pa dang mdze mo des mar me chen po cig bltams te byung / de nas re zhig nas/ mdze mo de'i sna bug nas sprul nag po gnya' shing tsam zhig bsnyengs te thon nas byung ba dang / rgyal bu'i dgongs pa la/ sems can de dag la gnod pa 'dis —340—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /byas / sems can gyi don du ral gri 'dis bsgral lam/ bla mas gnang ba'i ral gri 'dis bsgral snyam ste der bla ma'i ral gri de la bltas pas/ bla ma'i ral gri de'ang bzhi tsha cam shubs nas 'phar 'dug de nas sbrul de'i sum gnyis tsam thon pa na/ rang gri de yang sum gnyis tsam thon/ re zhig na sbrul de yang mar la thim ste song /ral gri de yang sprul ji ltar byed pa bzhin byed/ de'i tshe rgyal bus 'di skad du/ dug sbrul nag po ma nub cig /brtsams nas ldog na dpa' bo min/ /'thabs nas ma thub rang la ngan/ /mi thub sdo ba glen pa yin/ /las ngan rang gi rjes 'brang phyir/ khyod kyi mtha' lam ngan 'gro yin/ /zhes smras pas/ mdze mo de na re/ kye kha tsho sngon la ma che cig rjes su mthong na 'gyod par 'ong / zhes pa'i rjes la sna bug nas dug sbrul nag po de thon nas 'dom bdun tsam du byung ba dang / bla mas gnang ba'i ral gri de 'phar nas song ste/ rked pa nas bcad pa dang / lce dmar po zhig gis bldags pas slar 'byar/ de'i mod la ral gri'i so gnyis kas dum bu gnyis su btang /gnyis bzhi brgyad bcu drug sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du gtubs te/ rgyal bus sa btab pas lces bldags pas kyang / sa khal /ka 139 ba3 rgokhal khal cam las 'byar ma nus/ de nas ral gri'i so des dum bu rnams g.yabs pas sdud pa bzhin du bsdus te lud kyi khung bur sbas so/ /der sngar gyi mje mo de ni shin tu gsal ba mjes pa cig gyur te/ khang pa'i nang thams cad la byi dor byas/dri bzang gi chus chag chag btab/gos gsar ba gyon/ rgyan dag kyang btags te/ rgyal bu'i mdun du thal mo sbyar nas/ khyed lta bu'i stobs chen gang nas byon/ 'di lta bu'i yon tan 'ong ba ci lags/ klu bdud 'di ni sus kyang 'dul bar ma/ nus pa la khyed kyis btul/ khyed rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pas/ bdag gi lus longs spyod thams cad khyed la 'bul gyi / mi mang po'ang khyod kyi bde ba la bkod/ yul 'di thams cad khyod kyis skyong zhing bzhugs par zhu/ rgyal bu na re/ klu bdud nag po'i 'byung gnas khyod dang nga gnyis lhan cig tu gnas par byed dam/ bdag gis mi 'di dag gi srog bskyab pa'i don du 'dir 'ongs kyis/ khyod 'dod pa'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /yang bu mo na re/ khyed kyi gsung bzlog pa dka' na'ang / byang chub sems dpa' la sems can dmu rgod kyi don bya ba las med/ nga sems can nyon mongs pa can gyi lus mdzes pa 'di dgrar langs/ nges kyi grogs rgyal po chen po'ang 'dis bkrongs / blon po la sogs pa'i mi mang po'ang 'dis zos/ stobs chen gang gis kyang 'dul ba ma nus pa khyod kyis btul ba la/ khyed drin che ba'i ngos nas kyang ci'i phyir mi 'dzin/ thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas gzung du gsol/zhes nan du gsol ba dang / rgyal bus kyang brtse ba'i sgo nas zhal gyis bzhes/ bu mos kyang bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas te/ rgyal bus nang par grong khyer ba de dag gi dbugs 'byin du phyin pa dang / grong khyer ba —34 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thams cad ya mtshan nas rgyal por gsol ba btab/ rgyal bus kyang de'i rgyal po chen po mdzad do/ /skye bo de dag thams cad kyis kyang / rgyal po dang bla ma thun mong du bzung / thams cad kyang chos la spyod par gyur te/dus re zhig rgya nag hwa shang gi yul rang gi pho brang gang na yod pa der phyin pa dang / rgyal bu yang 'bar gyis ni rgyal po byed/ yang lcags kyang phyi nang gi chos la mkhas par byas nas thun mong gi dngos grub kyang lon/ rgyal bu gnyis kyang thams cad kyis bkur zhing gda' ba la/ rgyal po blo gros 'phel gyis kyang chos bstan pas thams cad kyis kyang grub pa thob/ legs pa'i shes rab/ da lta yang grub thob de dag rgya nag la sogs pa gnas sna tshogs pa na sprul pa du ma 'gyed cing gda'o/ /yang 'bar ni/ zla ba sngon ma de la lha ri snying po'i mgul na chos 'chad cing yod tsa na/ a tsarya cig byung nas 'brom la phyag 'tshal ba de yin te/ khyod kyis sems la zin nam gsung / rngog na re/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa nges pa mi gda' zer/ de ltar na de 'dra ba'i gdul bar dka' ba thams cad la/ byams pa dang / snying rje dpag tu med pa bsgoms shing / thams cad kyis sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pa brtan par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe blo gros 'phel ni/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la 'khrul ba med/bla ma a wa ddha chi ba gsum ri kho bo yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar byams dang snying rje bsgom bya zhing / /byang chub sem/sa ni brten ri/ra bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ rgyal bu blo gres 'phel du ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs brgyad pa'o// //ta9 yul ba ra na sir khye'u dga' 'dzin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilegaka 140 ba2 —yul wa ra ṇa sīr dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa khye'u dga' 'dzin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs so///༄༅/ yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa rgyasapapar phul/ khyad par du'ang dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal la dung gi rgyan bkod pa'ang phul nas/ bla ma dam pa lags/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin po che'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la da lta thob pa byar yod pa'i dus su chu thigs tsam zhig ma lon na/rgyal ba yab sras mi bzhugs pa'i dus su 'gyod pa mchi/ la la na phar la rang gi bla mas tshogs lam chung ngu'i yon tan tsam zhig ma thob pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skad du smra bar yod/ e ma thams cad mkhyen/ pa a ti sha khyed kyi spangs rtogs 'di 'dra na'ang la la dag sbyor lam pa'o zhes skur ba 'debs/ 'o na'ang khyed bod yul —342—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'di ni kha zin thams cad kyang dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas thams cad kyis dam/ par 'dzin/ mgon po rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'di ku su lu'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig la gnas pas/ mngon shes med pa rnams kyis 'di'i yon tan mi shes pa phyi rabs kyi sems can dmu rgod kyi sgro skur gyi tshig la 'jem na sangs rgyas rang gis kyang gsung ngo / /mi shes gal te 'bar ba zhig byung na'ang mu stegs kyi rigs sam/ bdud kyi rigs shig las 'os med/phyogs cig nas de dag ma mgu'ang snying tshim pa cam yin/ nga dam pa'i yon tan la kham chod hub chos thob rgyal yin / phyis yig chung cig tsam byed mi byed bla ma'i gsung bcag tu mi btub pas bka' gros byed pa las mi shes / yang phyogs cig nas rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di khyed kyi /ka 141 na1 waṃsras kyi/thu bo yin pas khong gi yon tan brjod pa rang gis khyed kyi yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pa shugs la rang shes/ khong mi chos pa kun gyi pha bu la'ang bu 'di kun skyes par shes/ pha dang 'dra ba cig byung nas gda' yi zer nas/ bu bzang po skyes pa rang gi pha'i yon tan du bzhed na/ khyed bla ma bzang po'i yon tan bum pa gang byo bzhin du yod na/ ci ste bla me bzang bar mi mtshon/ /spa tsang nas yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu thos pas shin tu yid tshim zhing / kha tsang nas kyi de nyid kyi 'phro la/ mi dge bcu ni spang bya zhing / /rtag tu dad pa brtan par bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin chen 'dis/ sngon lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu spangs te/ dge ba bcu ji ltar spyad/ yul khyad par can la dad pa ji ltar brtan pa mdzad bla ma gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas / legs pa'i shes rab/ de'i phyir na khyod legs pa'i shes rab yin pas khyod la bshad 'tshal nyon cigayang sngon yul ba ra na si na/ khyim bdag dga' ba zhes pa la chung ma dga' 'od ces bya ba yod pa la bu te dga' dang / dga' 'dzin ces bya ba gnyis 'khrungs te/ der nye dga' de gzugs mtshar/ spyir yang mi/ gzhi legs pa la de'i nang nas kyang dad gzhi che ba/ skye bo thams cad kyi yid du 'ong bas yul de'i rgyal po lha skyong zhes pa des kyang pang du blangs shing dga' dga' mang po byed/ 'di myur du tshar na dga' ste zer zhing / zla ba re la mtho dang sor gyis 'jal ba la sogs pa 'dod thag nye ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po byed/ des lo lnga lon pa dang / dga' 'dzin 'khrungs te/ de yang lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig byung nas zla ba lnga lon pa cig nye dgas khur te/ ba ra na sir rgyal po'i drung du phyin/ pa dang / rgyal po de shin tu dga' ste/ khye'u nye dga' 'di da gzod nga la tshad mar 'dzin cing nga khur ba cig 'ong bar 'dug 'di 'dra ba'i chung ba cig gis nu bo khur te nga la ston par byed zer/khye'u gnyis car gzugs mdzes drags pas khye'u gnyis rgyal po'i drung nas rgyang ring por song tsa na/ rjes na phar rgyal po nyid gzigs/ nye dgas dga' 'dzin rtag tu khur zhing skyong na'ang dga' 'dzin la bzhin mi legs pa —343—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/cung zad kyang mi ston/ khur mkhan gzhan yod kyang gam du sdod cing rjes su 'brang / dga' 'dzin kyang nye dgas skyong ba'i tshe na mi ngu / lus la dri chu mi 'dor ba de mthong tshad ya mtshan du byed pa cig byung / spun gnyis po rtag tu bzhin 'dzum pa dang ldan pas/ skye bo dag na re/ 'di gnyis la khro ba 'ong nge zer nas rdeg pa dang 'bar bar brtsams kyang bzhin 'gyur ba dang len byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gang yang mi 'ong / lan cig ba ra na si'i rgyal po de skyed mos tshal zhig na yod pa'i tshe/ dug sprul cig rgyal blon dag gi mdun na tshur byung ba la/ rgyal po na re/ nye dga' rang re dang nye ba na tshur dug sbrul byung ba 'di mthong ngam / 'di khyod kyis gsod la rang re rnams dga' bar gyis shig de ltar byas na nye dgar 'gyur gsung / der nyer dgas/ rgyal po la thal mo sbyar te/ gnyen po bskyed pa bas yul ngan spong ba sla bya ba yin/ gnod skyel rtsar nye tshad bsad na te dgar mi rung / gzhan yang srog gcod pa ni rigs ngan shan pa'i bu yin/ nga'i pha dga' ba ni srog mi gcod/ 2byor ba che ste dge phyogs su gtong / gong du rgyal po dang pha ma dang mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum/ las mi khur/ de'i bu nga yin na pha'i rigs las
