nyams su rung ngam/ de bas dug sprul gsod pa bas rje dang lhan cig tu dug sbrul las byol ba drag lags mod zhus pas/ rgyal po'i bsams pa la khye'u gzhon nu ma 'di 'dra ba zhig gi kha nas 'di 'ong na/ nga glen snyam nas/ skyed mos tshal gzhan zhig tu phyin pa dang / rgyal po na re/ khyed la tshig de 'dra sus bslabs/ nye dga' na re/ nga chung yang dbang po sgo lnga la skyon ma zhugs/ pha'i snyelas shes tsam yod/ gzhan yang rgyal po nged kyis khyim na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' klog pa'i nang na mar la sems can de 'dra ba 'ong ba la rtsi ma ghi zhes bya ba bsngags par bshad gda' zhus pas/ rgyal po'i bsams pa la khye'u 'di'i zer lugs kyis sprul ba zhig yin pa 'dug snyam ste dris pas/ khyod la sprul ba zhig yin nam/ nye dga' na re/ sems can thams cad rang rang gi las kyi sprul ba yin/ yang rgyal po'i bsams pa la khye'u 'di rang rab tu byung nas chos byed pa cig 'ong / de dus su 'di rgyal po gzhan la ma shor bar rang re'i bla mchod bya dgos snyam nas/ khye'u khyod da gzod khyim du gnas sam rab tu 'byung dris pas/ nye dga' na re/ khyim du las na mi lus thob pa don med zer ro/ /der rgyal po na re/ 'o na khyod rab tu gang du byung / nye dga' na re/ rgyal po mkhan slob gang na bzang / rgyal po na re / rdo rje gdan na shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya ba gang zag bzang po cig yod/ de'i drung du rab tu byung / ngas 'di nas pho nya bas khyed skyel du btang gsungs pas/ nye dga' na re/ da dung nga chung / nga lo gsum song ba dang 'gro / der rgyal po na re/ khyod de dus su rgyal po gzhan gyi bla mchod la ma song ba cig gyis/ khyod gang zer ba ngas kyang bsgrub (sgrub3kyis gsungs pas/ nye dga' na re/ gsung byon pa thugs la btags/ nga'i pha ma dang —344—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nu bo 'di rgyal po la 'chol/ rgyal pos kyang nyes pa cung zad la chad las mi gcod pa dang / gang dgos pa bsgrub (sgrubakapar zhu/ der rgyal pos kyang khas blangs/ nye dga' dgung lo dgu song ba na/ pha ma gnyis la nga rdo rje gdan du mkhan po shākya bshes gnyen gyi drung du rab tu 'byung du 'gro bas pha mas go skabs phye zhus pas/ pha ma gnyis na re/ nged la 'byor ba chen po yod/ sngar kyang dkon mchog gi mchod pa mang po byas/ ma nus pa la'ang mang po byin/ da dung bsod nams kyi tshogs su btang ba ma gtogs pa khyed gnyis la ster ba yin na/khyod la rab tu 'byung ba'i skabs med byas pas/ nye dga' na re/ khyed gnyis la nor yod na/ da dung dkon mchog la mchod pa gyis/ ma nus pa la'ang chags pa med par byin/ de'i lhag ma thams cad dga' 'dzin la phog ngas khyim gzung ste pha ma'i 'dod pa skong bar 'dod na ni pha ma'i bu skal chad/ ngas 'dod pa spangs nas bskal ba 'di snyed cig song / zhes brjod na 'ga' zhig gi sems la 'jigs skrag ldang / cis kyang khyed la bu gnyis kyis khyim 'dzin dgos na/ dga' 'dzin gyis lus kyi bkod pa du ma 'gyed shes zhes smras pa dang /dga' 'dzin dgung lo bzhi lon pa cig gis smras pa/ ba ra na si snye3di na kun gyis khur/ rgyal po dregs pa can des khyod mthong tshe/ /bu mthong bzhin du khra bzhin lag gis khyer/ /blon po'i tshogs rab rgyal po'i rjes su khyod//nyer dga' mthong bar dka'o ngas 'degs zhes/ /rgyal blon dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bkur bar byed/ /yul khams 'di na gnyen po tshad yin na/ /tshad ma yul 'dir mi bzhugs bdag 'dra yis/ khye'u ri mo'i gzugs 'dras chas mi phod/ /gcen po rdo rje gdan du gshegs gyur na/ /nga yang thugs rjes shul der khrid par zhu/ kho bo 'dod pa'i srin bu mi gtsang ba'i/ khrod du bying ba bya rog ngan pa yis/ khyed med khyed na kho bo ji ltar bya/ /pha ma snying nye'ang 'di yi gnyen du zad/ gcen po khyed bral gtan gyi gnyen dang bral/ /e ma las kyi srin bu tshad pa yis/ /nyon mongs thang la tshig cing skam par byed/ /gcen pos thugs rje'i chab kyis ma brlan na/ kho bo nyam thag snying rjer mi 'gyur zhes/ /snying rje rje skad du gcen la tshigs su bcad de zhus pas/ pha ma gnyis kyang nye dga'i byad la blta zhing / dga' 'dzin/ la pang gis 'khyud de/ mchi ma 'dzag cing gnas pa la/ nye dga' na re / rgyal po dregs pa blon pos rab bkur kyang / /nga yi bde 'bras thar bar mi phyin pas/ /gcung dang ma ma dag la brtse ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i gdan du nges 'byung dka' ba spyod/ /e ma pha ma gcung bcas thang skam la/ /nyon mongs tshad pa skyob cing byams pa yi/ /bsil ngad rab tu ldan pas kun tu 'dren/ /mi snyan 'phreng tshig ma smra khyim 'dir sdod/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i spyod pa skyong byed cing / /chags med chags ltar ston cing don la brtson / / mgon skyabs 'gro ba 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol/ /skyabs grol kun gyi bde ba mdzad pa po/ khyod la —345—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nyon mongs thang dang sdug mi mnga'/ /sems can de ldan rnams dang mthun slad du/ /de dang mthun phyir de 'dren de 'drar ston/ /gang gi blo ngor de spyod ma bstan na/ /de dag drang bar mi nus thabs dang bral/ khyed ni shes rab chags med kun la mkhas/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i lam zhugs mkhas la 'khod/ /dam pa'i spyod yin de spyod nga rab 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa dang / pha ma gnyis kyi bsam pa la/ 'di gnyis sprul ba zhig yin par 'dug gnyis kar rab tu byung ste khyim stong yang bya rgyu med/ gang dang gang gi sprul ba yin legs par dpyad na 'ong ste/gzhan gyis yon tan thos na/ bdag cag gi bu dbang gis bkug na mi rung / bu dga' 'dzin 'di rang /ka143 na6 rgomagon po /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa zhig yin par 'dug 'di'i yon tan brjod lugs rang gis shes snyam ste/ nye dga' la smras pa/ khyed rang gsungs pa bzhin du rdo rje gdan gnasabazang grogs bzang / shākya bshes gnyen de yang bla ma bzang bar byed cing 'dug khyed la 'byor ba gang dgos pa bdag cag gis dbul gyis der song la rab tu byung / der nye dga' na re/ bdag cag gi rgyal po 'dis/ khyed yul na gnas pa rnams la'ang byams pa byed par 'chad/ nga yang rdo rje gdan du skyel bar chad pas/ sngun la pha yis nga rgyal po'i sar skyol/ de yang 'di skad du/ gang la brten pa de dang bsdun/ /de sems bzung na de yisa'adzin/ /snying gzhung ldan na bslu mi srid/ /de min na ni bslu na yang / /da lan dga' 'dzin 'phags pa yin/ /nga yang tha mal ma yin pas/ /rgyal dang gzhan gyis bslu mi nus/ /rtsa bar rin chen gsum du bzang / /zhes zer te/ khye'u nye dgas sna drangs/ dga' 'dzin dbus su bcug /phas mjug btul te rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs pa dang /rgyal po dga' ste/ pha bu gsum bdag gi rtsar ci 'dod du 'ongs/ khyim bdag dga' bas smras pa/ nye dga' 'di rgyal po'i gsung la tshad mar bzung ste/ rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal na rgyal pos brtse bar mdzod cigargyas pos smras pa/ khyed pha ma dga' 'dzin dang bcas pa'ang ngas bde bar byas/ nye dga' rab tu byung ste bdag gi bla mchod bya/ de ring kho bos rdo rje gdan du nye dga' spyan drang gis khyed gnyis po ma 'phreng zhig dga' 'dzin gyis/ rgyal po la zhus pa/ rgyal po brtse bar nga la gson/ yang na nye dga' bzhugs su gsol/ /yang na bdag kyang 'gro bar zhu/ /de ltar mi byed kho bo 'chi/ /yang na rgyal po bdag zer dgongs/ /tshig mtha' de las ma 'das so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ dga' 'dzin khyod la ci dgos ngas bsgrub (sgrub1pa yin mod/ dga' 'dzin na re 'di skad du/ mi lus chud zos mi gtong phyir/ khyim na gnas na'ang sems 'dzin gyi/ /de tshe mi 'jigs skyabs spyin dgos/ /de grogs rgyal pos mdzad par zhu/ /phongs med zang zing sbyin par dgos/ /gtan phan chos kyi sbyin pa dgos/ /rgyal po phrag dog mi byed cing / /bzang grogs rtag tu mdzad par zhu/ /srog —346—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i snye'abyung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gcod 'dod log ma byin len/ /spong 'dod de grogs mdzad par zhu/ /rdzun ma phra ma ngag 'khyal dang / /tshig rtsub brnab sems gnod sems dang / /log lta rtag tu spong bar 'dod/ /rgyal ba de grogs mdzad par zhu/ /lus dang longs spyod sus khyer kyang / /dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i/ /rtag tu dad pa brtan par 'dod/ /rgyal po de grogs mdzad par zhu/ /rgyal po de ltar mdzad gyur na/ /nye dga'i rjes su 'brangs dang mtshungs/ /de lta min na bdag gi lus/ /mtho ris ngan song nyid dang mtshungs/ khyim na gnas kyang rgyal ba yi/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub (sgrub3 na dpa' bo yin/ /nags na gnas kyang rgyal ba yi/ /bka' dang ma mthun 'chal ba yin/ /zhes smras pas/ dga' 'dzin gyi tshig de la chos kyi sgo nas rgyal po 'jigs shing skrag ste/ kye ma ho khyim bdag gi bu khyod su zhig gi sprul ba yin/ khyod kyi tshig de lta bu ni blo yongs su rdzogs pa/ thos pa du ma la brten pa dag gis kyang brjod par mi nus na/ dga' 'dzin khyod kyis brjod par byas kyis/ nga kho bo la nus pa gang yong ba'i sgo nas khyed gsung ngag bsgrub (sgrubaka par bya'o/ /zhes rgyal pos kyang 'dar bzhin du nye dga' rta ba sum cu rtsa lnga'i dbus su bcug nas rdo rje gdan na bla ma shākya bshes gnyen bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin te rgyal pos thal mo sbyar nas khye'u nye dga' 'di skyes ma thag nas chos kyi snang ba can sgo gsum sum 'gyur dang cig gis lhag par dge ba zhig gda'o/ /dad pa brtan te srog la bab kyang dkon mchog mi 'dor ba zhig gda' bas 'di rab tu byung du gsol lo/ /bla ma'i zhal nas/ rgyal po lha skyong sprul pa'i khye'u 'di khrid nas 'ongs pa legs/ 'di'i gcung dga' 'dzin gang na yod/ rgyal pos zhus pa/ yul ba ra na si'i bu ram shing gi grong na yod/ bla ma'i gsung nas/ kho ci zer/ rgyal po na re/ yang na nga yang gcen gyi zla la khrid/ yang na nga yang 'gum/ yang na nga ci zer la rgyal pos nyan/ dgos/ bdag gis khyed la ci dgos byas pas/ kho bo la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mang po'i mthun rkyen 'tshal bar gda'/ bdag gis kyang mthu gang yod pa'i sgo nas bsgrub (sgrubaka par khas blangs zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo du ma nas sangs rgyas kyis lung du ma bstan pa'i dga' 'dzin de de 'dra'i sku gzhon nur gyur ba cig la gsung de 'dra ba 'byon pa kye ma'o / / legs so legs so/ /nye dga' yud tsam zhig la gcung dga' 'dzin khrid la shog der rgyal po'i bsam pa la/ de ltar thag ring ba la yud tsam zhig la nga'i khye'u 'dis /bye'u de khrid nas ji ltar mchi'am snyam pa la / yud tsam zhig la nye dgas/ dga' dzin khur te/ bla ma shākya bshes gnyen gi drung du byung ste/ sku mched gnyis kas phyag btsal nas/ dga' 'dzin gyis 'di skad zhus pa/ e ma lus 'di rdul phran tsam/ /rags pa'i 'ching ba ji ltar brjid/ /mi gtsang khrod kyi srin bu bzhin/ /sdug bsngal grong thab ngan pa la/ /bde 'dzin rmongs —347—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i khrod du zhugs/ /rdo rje rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje'i thugs mnga' rdo rje yi/ /srin bu blangasate rdo rje nyid / /brtan pa rdo rje mi sgyur bar/ /mi gtsang mi gtsang khrod du bying / /mi gtsang sbal ba'i rma bzhin du/ /g.yo ba mi gtsang nyid la sbyar/ /gzigs shig nyi ma'i spyan ldan pa/ /brtse ba brtse bar mi mdzad na/ /sdang ba sdang gyur 'dren 'gyur ram/ /'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni/ /nyi mas nyin mor byed dam ci/ /bdag 'dra mun khrod mi sel na/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rang rgyal 'dra/ /byams pa byams par mdzad phyir du/ /nyam thag thugs kyi dkyil du long / /bdag gi skyabs mchog rin chen gsum/ /gang la'ang mi ltos ngang gis dge /rang gis gdul bya mi 'dren na/ /las med mi 'drongs rtsol ba'ang dka'/ /don byed gnyis las ma 'das so/ / zhes zhus pas/bla ma'i zhal nas/ gzugs sku rdul phran lta bu la/ /snying rje'i 'ching ba ri bo tsam/ /sems can gang gis spyad gyur kyang / /snying rje'i ri bo zad mi 'gyur/ /nyi ma snang ba'i rang bzhin la/ /snang ba gzhan la ltosapa med/ /rgya mtsho chu yi rang bzhin la/ /chu thigs cig gis skye 'bri bral/ /dga' 'dzin thugs rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /thugs rjes gzhan gyis bzung mi 'tshal/ /sbas pa'i rin chen gter kha khyod/ /gzhan gyi mdzod yin khyod ma phongs/ /e ma dga' 'dzin thugs rje can/ /lha yi gnas na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /lha bu ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes/ /'dzam gling gnas 'dir rgyal ba dang / /chos kyi zhus lan mchog tu mdzad/ /ma 'ongs mi yul gangs ri'i mgul/ /nye dga' ye shes snying po zhes/ khyod ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin/ /mtho ris lha yi 'jig rten na/ /blo gros rab gnas zhes bya ba/ /'dzam gling gnas 'dir rgyal ba dang / /chos kyi zhus lan mdzad cing gsung / /mi yi 'jig rten dag pa na/ /dge bsnyen chos 'phel bya bar grags/ /bzang po'i gnas la spyod byed cing / /bde gshegs snying po dang du len/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /sems dpa' brgya phrag lhag pa la/ /sems dpa' nor bu bzang por grags/ /rang gi yon tan rgya mtsho yang / /bla ma dpag med mnyes mdzad cing / /nga yang dpag med bla ma bsten/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mi byed par/ /pha ma 'dren par thugs dam bcas/ /gzhan yang bde gshegs gsung rab las/ /dngos dang shugs kyi sems dpa' khyod/ /lung bstan dpag med yod na yang / tanis rab mig ldan gang dag gis/ /nges par 'gyur gyis gzhan gyis min / / da ni sems dpa' bu ram shing / /'khrungs pa'i yul du gdung ba sol/ /nga rgyal 'ching ba rab bcom ste / / 'gro ba zhi bas skyong bar mdzod/ /nye dga' 'dir bzhugs rab tu byung / /ding sang phu bo'i tshul du bstan//kun tu bla ma dam pa yang / /pha bzhin gcung dang mi 'bral bar/ /thugs rje'i chab kyis bum pa bzang / /rtag tu bde bar bltam par mdzod/ /snyigs ma'i dus su'ang mtha' 'khob tu/ /dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mar me mdzad/ /—348—

'brom sten pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon bzang po mchog /bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi/ /snying po 'jin cing gcung la'ang ster / / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bstan pa yi/ /rin chen 'brom zhes rje'u'i rigs/ /gcung ni sras su kho bos mthong / / nga ni khyod kyi bla ma mchog /rā hu la zhes gu pa ka 145 ba2 bu pa / ta/ khyod kyi rdo rje 'jin par 'gyur / / zhi khro snying po'i don rnams len/ khyod kyi nyon mongs kun bral yang / /nyon mongs can dag drang ba'i phyir / / nyon mongs phyin kyang 'byin pa ltar/ /nga yi rjes su rab byung ston/ /di paṃ ka ra mtshan du bsten/ /rgyal ba 'gro ba du ma yi/ /don las g.yel ba ma mdzad cig /ces nye dga' rab tu byung ngo / /de nas dga' 'dzin gyis rgyal po dang sdongs te/ bu ram shing gi grong du 'ongs pa'i lam zhig tu/ rgyal pos tshod blta ba'i phyir du dga' 'dzin khyod sems can gyi don byed pa la grogs ngan gyis gnod pa byas na mi rung bas/ ngas khyod la mnga' gsol bar bya yis/ nga'i gzhon pa dag chas thams cad khyod kyis zung shig ngas khyod bzhin du bya'o zhes smras pas/ dga' 'dzin na re/ rgyal po rgyal po'i bya bar bzang / /phal ba phal ba nyid du rigs/ khyod ni dus kyi rgyal po yin/ /nga ni rigs kyi rgyal po yin/ khyod kyi cho 'brang drung na 'bor/ /'khor kyang de bzhin nyid du spyod / / nga yi cho 'brang 'khor dag ni/ /lha klu dri za grul bum/ ste/ /sprul pa'i sems dpa' dag tu zad/ /e ma nges par spyad gyur na/ /rgyal po khyod kyang nga yi 'khor/ /grangs med pha ma byas pa'i phyir/ /cho 'brang dag tu nges par gda'/ /rgyal po ma gsung chibs la chibs/ /rang gi rgyan cha rang gis gyon/ kho bo tha mal rgyal mi rigs/ /stobs med rjer 'chos srog la gzan/ /nor me/da yid 'phreng yi dwags nyid/ /yod nas mi spyod de dang mchungs//shes sam rgyal ngo/ sems la gzigs/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po ya mtshan te/ khye'u khrid nas rang gi pho brang du 'ongs te/ zas dang gos la sogs pa 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa byin pa dang / de ma thag tu dga' 'dzin gyis dbul zhing phongs pa dag la byin nas/ slar rang gi khyim du phyin pa dang / pha ma dag gis smras pa/ dga' 'dzin gcen gar thal/ dga' 'dzen na re/ drin can thar ba'i lam la thal/ pha ma na re/ 'o na bla ma dang zhal mjal lam / bu na re/ smon/ lam bzang pos gzhan du gtong du ma 'dod/ pha na re/ 'o na khong rab tu byung nas yod dam / bu na re/ khong la sngar bas bzang du bsgyur du mi gda' ste/ de bas kyang bzang bar ston cing gda'o/ /pha ma na re/ bu khyod kyi gos dag gar song / bu na re/ pha ma dag la byin no// khyod la pha ma gzhan yang yod dam/ bu na re/ 'o na rtag tu khyed gnyis la bzlos shing skyes sam/ pha na re/ da lta ni pha ma shin tu mang ster gyis lang ngam/bu na re/ 'o na tshe 'di nyid la khyed gnyis la skye bas lang ngam zer/ der gang smras kyang phas bu'i gtam kha ma lon par/ gos shig g.yogs te btang bas yang phyir thon pa dang phongs pa cig la byin nas rgyal po'i pho brang du —349—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/phyin pa dang / rgyal po na re/ dga' 'dzin ngas byin pa'i gos dag gar song / /dga' 'dzin na re/ rgyal pos mdang brten pa'i mnal gar song / rgyal po na re/ de 'das pa la dri ba dang bshad par dka'/ rgyal po de ltar yin na kho bo'i de yang de dang mtshungs/ rgyal po na re/ mdang gi gnyid ni/ nga rang la'ang med/ gzhan la'ang med na/ khyod kyi gos ni de lta ma yin/ dga' dzin na re/ rgyal po'i mnal ni/ rang gzhan gnyisaka la med na/nga'i gos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ste/ sngar rang gis spyad/ ma 'ongs pa na brgya 'gyur gyis rang gis spyod / da lta ni pha ma dbul po dag la phan par gyur ro/ /rgyal pos kyang dga' 'dzin gyi tshig la len klan par ma nus par gos gyon pa dag khrid de/ nga'i khye'u gcer bur bzhag nas khyed rnams kyis gyon pa ci yin/ khyed kyis nongs nga sa khri mun du skyur bar byed ces gcun pas/ dga' 'dzin na re/ kho bos chu ma mthong ba'i gong du gos zhabs brdze bar byas kyis/ rgyal pos mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi grogs byed par byas na/ 'chi bdag bzhin du cis kyang mi bzlog par slu bar byed dam/ rgyal po na re/ dga' 'dzin khyod bden te nyes byed tshar ma bcad na phyis nyes pa dpag med ldang bas de khyod kyis dgongs shig dga' 'dzin na re/ lha khyed nyes byed dngos la gnod pa skyel lam/ 'on te brgyud pa 'ded/ rgyal po na re/ dngos la byed do zer/ 'o na nga dong khri mun du skyur bar byed rigs/ yang na rgyal po nyid bzhugs pa rigs/ dga' 'dzin de ci yin/ dga' 'dzin na re/ mi gsod pa las nyes pa che ba med pa la/ de'i sbyor ba byed pa dngos ni rgyal po yin/ gos ster bas nyes na ni dngos nga yin/ rgyal po na re/ de ma yin brgyud pa yin/ kye lha de na yang gnyis/ yang na thags mkhan skyur du rigs / yang na rgyal po nyid la bab/ dga' 'dzin de ci yin/ dbul pos gos len pa'i rtsa ba bdag la thugabadag la gos yod pa rgyal pos byas/ des na rgyal po la bab/ 'on te thags mkhan gyis btags pa las byung bas de bzhin no/ /der rgyal po'i bsam pa la/ dga' 'dzin 'di'i smra lugs dang bstun na su la'ang gnod pa skyel du mi rung ste / dngos dang brgyud pa las ni ma 'das de gnyis byas na rang gi ltag tu'ang 'ong snyam pa bzhin du/ dga' 'dzin la'ang smras pas/ dga' 'dzin na re/ lha da ci nas ni byis chung bsam med/ da ni rgan po'o/ /der rgyal po na re/ 'o na sngar nyes pa rnams mthol zhing 'chags/ da ni gzhan la gnod par mi bya'o/ /dga' 'dzin na re/bdag gis kyang rgyal po la phan sems smras pa la zur gda' na mthol/ gzhan yang lhas sngar ji skad zhus pa bzhin du/ phyi ma'i gsung dag gis snga ma'i gsung dag don med du mi gtong bar zhu zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos kyang / lo sum cu tsam du dga' 'dzin ji skad zer ba bzhin du sgo gsum mi dge ba dang ma 'bags par lha —350—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dkon mchog gsum la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bsgoms/ rgyal po dang dga' 'dzin gyi rjes su blon 'bangs thams cad kyis bslabs te/ rgyal po'i stobs kyis gcun/ dga' 'dzin gyis thabs dang shes rab kyis gcun/ lan cig dga' 'dzin grong khyer gi bzhi mdo na yod pa na/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ba zhig gis dga' 'dzin gyi mgo la sgyogs chung zhig 'phangs pas mgo las thal te ma phog dga' 'dzin lhag par 'dzum par byas pas lan du brdeg pa dang ngag gi nyes pa bzhi yang mi byed na/ yid kyi nyes pa gsum lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ der rgyal po'i blon po dag byung nas mu stegs byed kyi rnal 'byor ba bzung ste gsod par brtsams pa dang / dga' 'dzin na re/dngos ni rdo 'di yin/ brgyud pa ni sngon rang gis brgyab pas lan/ 'di mi srun kyang bdag cag rnams kyi pha ma yin pas bde bar thon cig ces gnod pa las bskyabs so/ /yang lan cig dga' 'dzin mu stegs byed 'ga' zhig gis bzung ste/ khyod dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing rten ri'i mna' skyol zhig mi skyel na ni gsod par byed do smras pas/ dga' 'dzin na re/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing bsten pa las cung zad zhig g.yos na dkon mchog gsum gyis chad pas chod cig mu stegs byed dag na re/ khyod bzlog ste mna' skyel ba'i gsod par byed do/ /zhes gri bton pa dang / dga' 'dzin na re/ ngas skye 'chi du ma zhig byas pa la/ dge bshes khyed lta bu'i bzang ba dang da lan min pa phrad ma myong / sangs rgyas las lhag pa med pa la'ang bzod pa bsgoms shig gsung pa las/ shes rab kyi mtshon cha phyar te dngos su nga bdag bcom nas/mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i sku skad cig ma'i phyi logs rang la ster ba ma byung / khyed drin che ba'i ngos nas phyag rigs te/ dmangs rigs bzang kyang rgyal po'i phyag yul min/ dga' ba'i nang nas kyang mchog tu de nyid de ring thob/ mthong lam skyes kyang chos nyid mthong cam gyi dga' ba las 'di 'dra ba'i bag chags ngan pa'i rten rtsad nas 'joms pa dka'/ da lta ba ra na si'i gnas 'di na phal che ba cig nga la 'dud par byed na/ da lta khyod kyis lus sems ngan pa phral ma thag tu tshangs pa dang bcas/ dbang phyug dang bcas/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis nga mchod pa zhig 'ong / de'i rgyu mtshan kyang / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsung / gsungs pas/ khong rnams kyi rtog pa la/ las ci byas kyang kho gang dgar dga' / da lta'ang kho'i snang tshul 'di 'dra na/ kho'i chos 'di bden na phyi ma'ang nged kyi chos 'di las bzlog ste 'ong bar 'dug pas reg pa tsam du'ang mi bya'o snyam ste gnod pa ma byas so/ /de lta bas na dgung lo bdun bcu (cu3don brgyad bzhugs pa'i bar du'ang mi dge ba bcu spangs/ dge ba bcu dang du blangs/ rtag tu dad pa brtan par mdzad de/ bdun bcu (cukadon brgyad bzhes nas yab (yangakapo ta lar gshegs so/ /legs —351—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i shes rab/ de'i dus kyi yab yum gnyis ni ding sang gi bdag gi pha ma yab rgyal po dge ba'i dpal dang /yum btsun mo 'od zer can gnyis yin te/ yab kyi dgung lo bdun bcu (cu3tham pa/ yum gyis drug bcu (cu|rtsa bdun bzhes nas/ rdo rje gdan du sras dī paṃ ka ra la dge bsnyen pha ma'i sdom pa mnos te/ zhing khams gtsang mar gshegs so/ /gcen nye dga' rab tu byung di paṃ ka ra ni nga nyid do/ /nga'i bla ma shākya bshes gnyen ni rdo rje gdan pa chen po'o/ /ding sang rā hu la gu pa ta badzra zhes kyang grags/ de'i yon tan ni kho bos lo dang bskal bar brjod kyang bstan par mi nus/ dga' 'dzin ni/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid de/ de'i dus na'ang de 'dra'o / / ba ra na si'i rgyal po lha skyong du grags pa ni ka ba shākya dbang phyug yin no/ /de'i dus na nged yab sras gnyis chos la spyod pa la spro dga' de lta bu mdzad do zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar/ mi dge bcu ni spang bya zhing / /rtag tu dad pa brtan par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ khye'u dga' 'dzin du ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs dgu ba'o// //tha10 yul ba ra na sir dge bsnyen btsun par sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilelga/ka 148 na1 rgoyul wa ra ṇa sīr dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ dge bsnyen bcun par sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lesdomi bsdokyigs so///༄7/ /yang yer ba'i rje btsun byams pa'i drung na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog gis kyang chos shig zhu snyam du phyin tsa na/ dge slong snam sbyar rdo tshos ma/ gsol ba cig jo bo yab sras gnyis kyi dbus na bzhugs nas/ 'tshang rgya ba 'dod pa la sangs rgyas kyi yum la rten (brtenakadagos te/ dngos po dang mtshan ma'i khong skran ma thon gyi bar du yum dang sras su mi mjal bas nad de 'don pa la brtson par mdzod/ a cang de kun grag stong ldem po'i tshig /rgyal bas mdun du rgyal sras bzang po skyongs/ /rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras bzang po skyong / /rgyal bar gnas kyang ma rgyal lta bur bstan/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir khyed gnyis mchog gyur ba / khyed kyi 'phrin las dpag med brjod las 'das/ /gdul bya gnas kyi bar du 'dir bzhugs la/ /bgro ba mdzad du dga' ldan gnas su byon/ /zhes gsung zhing gda' ba la/ jo bo yab sras gnyis gzhan gsung gleng mi mdzad par/ rngog la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad nas/ ting nge 'dzin zhig la bzhugs pa'i 'phro la/ byams pa'i thugs ka na 'od cig khyil khyil 'dug pa la/ rngog gis gzigs tsa na 'od de yal nas thal bas/ de ci yin nam snyam ste jo bo yab sras la gzigs pas dge slong de mi gda'/ der rngog gis kyang —352—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /phyag gsum mdzad de/ da lta chul dang mthun pa'i gsung gleng mdzad pa'i dge slong de su yin gar thal zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ de ni dge slong blo gros brtan pa yin/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho na re/ de ni mi pham dga' ldan chos kyi rje / nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i zhal nas/ de ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug byams pa yin/ dge bsnyen chen po rtag tu chos 'phel /ka 148 na7 rgo'abrom / na re/ de ni rgyal ba'i rgyal sras bzang po yin/ zhes gsung pa'i 'phro la jo bo mi gda'/ der rngog gis/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ bla ma paṇḍi ta gar gshegs zhus pas/ rgyal pa rgya mtsho'i zhal na/sa/ rdzu 'phrul can de dga' ldan gnas su gshegs/ /ring por mi thogs da lta gnas 'dir mchi/ /thugs rje'i sprin de thugs rje'i char rgyun dag /skal ldan 'dod pa'i sa chen spong pa'i phyir/ /myur du 'byon te e ma ma 'ongs tshe/ /sa bon rul ba dag la sa chu yis/ /mi gtong tshe na sprin bzang gshegs par gyur/ /re zhig bzhugs dang da lta chos ston mchi/ /zhes gsung / de nas re zhig nas/ phyi dag na sgra snyan pa dang dri zhim pa mang po zhig byung bas ci yin snyam ste/ rngog gis bzhengs nas bltar byon pa dang / shar phyogs nas 'ja' tshon sngon po mthing gi mdog 'dra ba zhig brag khung gi sgo la zug ste/ de'i sna la khye'u sngon po/ beeḍūrya'i mdog lta bu zur phud can mang po sgo drung na/ me tog dang spos bzang po mang po thogs te/ glu dbyangs kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang po sgrogs pa mthong / de la rngog ya mtshan skyes te nang du 'ong tsa na/ jo bos kyang slebs/ sman bla'i pho brang dpag tu med pa bzhengs te/ mchod pa yang mdo dang mthun par mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa'ang 'od kyi rnam par so so'i kha dog dang mthun par sgor re bzhugs nas 'dug der 'brom kyang sku nas lhag par kyang gzhon pa zhig mdzad nas khrus shig mdzad cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'ang yar 'byon par zhu/ bla mas kyang phyag phebs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang bzhugs/ las dang smon lam dag tsa na/ /gnas lugs 'di 'dra mthong ba yin/ /rang re'i lugs kyis chos thams cad cha bzhir byas pa la/ bzhi cha cig dga' ba bsgom pa yin pas 'di lta bu mthong ba la dga' ba bsgoms (sgomasaka mdzod/ khrus shig kyang mdzod gsungs nas/ der rngog gis kyang khrus/ byas te yan lag bdun pa gtsang sing nge ba cig phul nas dga' ba bsgom zhing bzhugs pa ni/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ rngog sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi zhal blta bar bzhed dam gsungs pas/ mgon po cis kyang smon no/ /zhes zhus pas/ 'brom na re/ nga dang khyad par chen po'ang med/ 'on kyang gzigs pa dbul 'tshal gsungs nas thugs ka nas sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de rnams/ sman bla'i mdo nas 'byung ba bzhin du mchod rdzas mang po khyer te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ thams cad sgyu ma sprul ba'i snang ba yin zer zhing mchod pa dag 'bul zhing gda'/ yang rngog gis/ 'o —353—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/na sngon gyi mkhan slob ngo mtshar can de dag kyang bstan par zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ 'brom na re/ de dag jo bo chen po dang tha mi dad pas khong la zhus shig gsungs nas/ jo bo la de bzhin du zhus pa dang / sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu rtag tu 'tsho zhing mnga' ba sprul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de jo bo'i thugs ka na tshur rgyang nge byon te/ dge slong legs pa'i shes rab yon tan thams cad bla ma la brten nas 'byung ba yin/ bla ma de yang yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu mnga' yang 'jig rten chos brgyad dang bral ba cig dgos pa yin/ 'jig rten chos brgyad mi mdzad na/ ku su lu'am sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa zhig cis kyang 'ong ba yin ngas kyang byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rgyal ba rgya mtshos dag byed kyi chu zhig snoms la byon zhig gsungs nas/ rgyal ba rgya mtshos kyang chu shel gyi bum pa zhig tu bsnams te mkhan po chen po'i phyag tu gtang (btangaka ba dang / sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shānti ku ru ye swāhā/ yon tan gyi brlabs thams cad 'byung ba/ tshul khrims kyi rgya mtsho rtag tu 'tsho bar gyur cig jo bo yab srasabazhin du mi dge ba mtha' dag zhi zhing / gzhan don du tshangs par spyod pa'i ljon pa chen po rtag tu 'tsho bar gyur cig ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa la bzhugs so/ /de'i dus su jo bos dbu mdzad nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabasapas byams pa gnas pa'i brag khung de'i sa dang logs dang bla gab dang bcas pa thams cad rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa/ mchu zheng 'phangs rgyas pa/ dbyibs zla ba nya gang ba lta bu zlum 'khyil ba/ sa gzhi de dag 'jam zhing snyoms pa/ rnga legs pa thang la phab pa lta bu gzhi brtan pa'i dbus na padma'i snying po 'dab ma brgyad pa la gzhi ser po dbus kyi ze 'bru beeḍūrya sngon po las byas pa/ de'i dbus na/ jo bo chen po res 'ga' bstan pa'i bdag po'i rnam par snang ba/ res 'ga' yum chen mo'i rnam par snang ba/ res 'ga' sgrol ma'i rnam par snang ba/ mdor na gdul bya rang rang gi bsam pa las dang smon lam dang mthun pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad kyis pad 'dab brgyad brgyan pa/ de las pad 'dab bcu drug gyes te sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ de las pad 'dab phra mo nyi shu rtsa gnyis gyes te gdul bya gang dag dngos grub gang 'dod pa'i phyag mtshan yang de dang mthun par bsnams pa/ phyogs kyi phyogs skyong bcu rang rang gis 'khor gyis bskor ba/ pad 'dab re re steng na du ma mi dog par 'dug go /de bzhin du pad 'dab re re la gnod sbyin bcu gnyis po re re la'ang 'khor bdun 'bum bdun 'bum dang bcas pa'ang mi dog par 'dug go /gzhan yang khye'u dag bu mo'i gzugs dpag tu med pa'ang mchod pa 'bul ba dang / phyogs bzhir padma re re gyes te/ phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa'ang pho brang —354—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /thams cad la bltas ca na pho brang gi phyogs bzhin gda'/pad sdong la bltas pas kyang de'i phyogs na rgyal po re re gda'/ de nas mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang / /ka139 ba6 /ldo/ pa li bha (sba/)ratna chen po dang / sprul ba'i sku (dmar/)shākya mu rne dang / chags pa med pa nam mkha'i (mes rin po che/) mdzod dang / dge ba'i (g.yo/)'byung gnas dpal gyi gzhi dang / thugs (bla chen po/)dgongs pa nyi ma'i 'od ltar rab tu gsal ba dang / ye shes chen po(ya bong /)bkra shis spel ba dang / ye shes rgyal mtshan(brum/)snying por rgyal ba dang shes rab chen po(kla mes/)kun gyi mes po dang / mi brjed bstan(gzungs/)/pa'irgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ bod kyi khrims ldan dag gi sbyin bdag chen po u pa la dag gis phyogs bzhi nas bskor te/chags pa med pa nam mkha'i mdzod kyis ni dbyangs sna 'dren/rdo rje dang g.yung drung bkra shis pa'i mtshan nyid kyis ni zur nas 'debs/ mdor na thams cad dgongs pa cig tu phyag 'tshal ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba dang / nyon mongs dang shes sgrib gnyis phyis mi byed pa'i bsam pas bshags pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rang rang phan tshun rjes su yi rang gsol ba dang / thams cad rang rang dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo du ma bskor bar gsol ba dang / khyad par du yang rgyal ba rgya mtsho bzhengs te / spyir yang sems can dang / khyad par du yang dus ngan pa'i sems can gyi snang tshul la dgongs rte mya ngan las 'da' ba'i go skabs med par gsol ba dang / nying dgos su'ang mkhan po rnams la khyed thugs rje chen po rnams kyis nga'i zhing khams gcig po 'di'i gdul bya dmu rgod dgatshul khrims kyi gos kyis bkab ste/ sngar yang bdag gi dpung grogs dpag tu med pa mdzad/ da yang mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i bsam pa brtan pos 'chad 'chad 'dra na rgyun bsring ba dang / gang dma' sa nas bstod pa dang / phan bde'i gnas sgo thams cad nas dar zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa dang / thun mong du yang 'phags pa dag mgon du gyur ba'i spyan sngar sems can gang gis sgo gsum gyi tshul khrim/sa las byung ba dang / blang dor gyi gnas thos pa las byung ba dang / gzhi lam rnam gsum gyi yon tan bsams pa las byung ba dang / thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyud la yod pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms te sems can thams cad kyi sku gsum mngon du 'gyur bar bsngo'o/ /de de bzhin du gyur cig rdzogs par gyur cigarab tu rdzogs par gyur cig dbang sgyur sna tshogs dang bkod pa mthun par 'jug pa sprul pa'i sku'i bkra shis shogadag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig gi yul du gyur ba mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i mthar —355—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung rdos kyi skor/phyin pa sku'i bkra shis shog dmigs pa thams cad las 'das pa dag pa chos kyi sku'i bkra shis shog gnas skabs bde spyod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog de bzhin gshegs pa dang thams cad thun mong du yang bkra shis 'di skad du/ 'jig rten mgon dang mgon po yis/ /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rab bsngags pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid du spyod par shog /dus gnas kun tu bkra shis shis shog /ces de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor bcas ma lus pa/ /mtshan legs rin chen zla ba'i thugs kar thim/ /de ni gser bzang mya ngan med la thim/ /de ni rgya mtsho mngon mkhyen dbyings su thim/ /de ni sman chen kun la snyoms par thim/ /de ni rang gi ston pa nyid la thim/ /de ni 'od dpag med pa mar me mdzad/ /dpal ldan bzang po a ti sha la thim/ /mkhan po gzhan rnams nam mkha' mdzod snyepa thim/ yākya mu ne shākya mu ne nyid/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan thams cad rdo rjer gyur/ /ratna thams cad ston pa'i ratna gyur/ /thams cad sems dpa' sems dpa' byang chub mchog /gcig tu bzlums te rje la thim par gyur/ /rgyal po blon bcas rim gyis 'brom rje la/ /thams cad gnyis med dbyings su thim par gyur/ /rgyal dang sems dpa' dge bsnyen srung ma'i tshogs/ /'od kyi rnam par yal te gshegs lags so/ /de nas legs pa'i shes rab dga' ba rgyas/ /ting 'dzin zhig la lhan gyis 'byams pa na/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang 'brom zhes pa/ khrigs rab phyag la 'jus te legs shes gsung / /dkon mchog gsum dang 'grogs na dkon mchog gsurma// /dug gsum spyod dang 'grogs na dugagasum nyid//ting 'dzin rtse gcig sems la dbang bsgyur zhes/ /shes rab shes rab dbyings su bsgom par mdzod/ /e ma snying rjes yar bzhengs yar la bzhengs/ /pha ma byas dang byed dang byed 'gyur rnams/ /thabs kyis 'dren 'tshal sems dpa'i khyad chos yin/ /bdag gis 'khor bar 'khor tshe dag kyang nyon/ /zhes mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs su gsol ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas kyang langs nas bltas pas/ jo bo yang thugs dam la skos phor zhig yod pas/ tsha tsha rdog po dgu ba cig 'debs shing ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du byang chub la brtson pa gal che ba yin gsungs nas/ phyag dang na bza' kun 'dag pa khal khal gda' ba la/ bshes gnyen 'brom gyi zhal nas/ ya rabs za hor rgyal po'i rigs su bltams/ /nges par byung nas thar ba'i btsan sa bzung / /mi chos lha chos gnyis su khyed che na/ /'jim g.yos bya ba dman pa ma mdzad cig /ces zhus nas/ 'jim pa dam dum 'dra 'dug pa rnams ting phor zhig tu bsdus/ rdo cig gi rtsa na ras ma ser po dum bu cig 'dug pa de phyag gis blangs nas dbu skra'i gseb tu re zhig bcug ste/ dus phyi rabs na phar 'di sus gyon kyang 'di bde bar gshegs pa'i na bza' yin/ gzhan yang 'di gsol ba phal —356—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /cher la sdom pa sna re cam med pa med mchi gsungs nas/ bum par chab cig khyer nas phyag 'khrud par zhu zhus pas / jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod kyi mi chen dang bas bslus/ khro dang nga rgyal dregs pas bzung / /mi chos lha chos 'dzom gyur kyang / /sgo gsum chos la ma bkol na/ /mi spyod phugs kyi gser bzhin du/ /bzang yang don med mchis par mdzod/ /ding sang kho bo'i gzugs mjes pas/ /chags med bla ma'ang byams gyur na/ /chags ldan phal cher smos ci 'tshal/ /sngar yang sgo gsum dge bkol bas/ /'dir yang 'di 'dra 'di 'drar 'gyur/ /da yang chu rgyun bcad par dka'/ /legs pa'i shes rab 'di 'dir sdod/ /spruo dang nga rgyal mi mdzad par/ /dman dman bzhin du sgo gsum thul/ /dris lan de na'ang 'di tshig yod/ /'phro la nyon cig kho bos bshad/ /slar yang yan lag bdun pa phul/ /zhes gsungs pas/ legs pa'i shes rab kyis kyang / ji skad gsung ba bzhin byas te thugs la btags de yang mnyan 'tshal te/ kha gcang (rtsang3dge slong de'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba gsum char zhig gsung bzhin gda' bas/ de bstan 'tshal zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ nge ngas bshad kyang mi 'ong /dge bshes lo cwa ba la zhus zhes te gsung du ma bzhed par/ sngon yang ba ra na si na/ /byim bdag bsod nams 'jin zhes pa la chung ma dpal mo zhes bya ba yod de/ dad pa dang nor rdzas kyi 'byor ba shin tu che ba la bu med pas / nub cig dkon mchog la gsol ba btab nas bu skal cig zhu zhus pas/ tho rangs rmi lam du rdo rje gdan du phyin pa na/ byang chub chen po la mchod pa 'bul ba'i dge slong zhig 'dug pa de na re/ khyod la bu cig dgos sam zer/ zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ 'o na dge bsnyen/ bcun pa bya ba rgya gar sto byang shar nub tu sprul pa du ma 'gyed / mis gnod pa ci byas kyang khro bar mi byed/ yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yod kyang nga rgyal mi 'jin/ sprang po des pa bzhin du dman cha blangs nas mtho sa'i yon tan thams cad rgyud la bsten pa cig yod/ de nang par nas khyed bza' mi gnyis kyi bu la gtang (btang 1 gis gsung / khyed kyi mtshan ci yin zhus pas/ nged la chos mchog ces 'bod kyin gda' gsung ba'i 'phro la gnyid sad de/ bsod nams 'dzin gyis rmi lam bshad pa dang / dpal mo dang mthun par byung / de nas lo gcig nas bu cig btsas pa la/ pha ma gnyis na re/ 'di dge slong chos mchog gis rdo rje gdan du nged la byin pa yin/ mtshan yang khong rang gis btags pa des chog zer te dge bsnyen btsun pa zhes 'bod/ bu de ma skyes kyi bar du dge 'dun rnams spyan ma drangs kyi bar du mi 'byon pa la / bu de skyes nas spyan 'dren pa la mi ltos par nang du 'byon pa cig byung / lan cig na rnal 'byor ba lwa ba'i gos gyon pa cig nang du byung nas/ si ka khyod mtha' 'khob kyi gnas su 'gro zer nas 'dir sdod pa ci yin/khye'u na re/ da dung mi rabs kha cig dus la ma bab/ yang rnal 'byor ba na re/ 'o na khyod yang yang sprul ba mang —357—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/po btang nas ci byed/ gang dang gang gi snang ngor sna tshogs su 'byung ba la/ 'di yin gyi nges nges ga la yod/tshul khrims bsrung ba'ang thar bar 'gro ba tsam yin mod/ ces smras pa dang / rnal 'byor ba de bsnyen bkur ba gsol nas gtam mang po mi smra bar 'dir song med par song ngo / /de bzhin du grub thob mang po/ gtam glo bur ba re smras shing bsnyen bkur ba dag gsol zhing song ngo /grong khyer ba thams cad grong khyer kyi dbus su gar mkhan la blta ba bzhin du/ khye'us gar phyin pa'i sar 'dug nas smra zhing ngo mtshar ba 'di la khro ba yod dam med zer zhing la las mi sdug pa bstan kyang cung zad kyang mi g.yo bar phar la thal mo sbyor zhing / ngag 'jam po smra ba zhig byung / de nas lo bdun lon pa na pha ma la rdo rje gdan du 'gro zhus pas/ pha ma na re/ nged la bu med nas khyed rdo rje gdan nas zhus pa yin/ da gtong ba ga la srid / bu na re/ 'o na slob dpon chos mchog 'dir spyan drongs/ nga dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len/ pha ma na re/khyed sngar nas dge bsnyen yin pa la/ da ci dgosazer bas/ bu na re/ sngar nas zhing yin kyang da dung meo 'tshal gsungs pa dang / de'i mod la/ slob dpon chos mchog der byon byung / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'ang zhus/ legs bshad kyi chos mang po yang bslabs/ gzhan yang paṇḍi ta bzang zer tshad la bsnyen bkur zhing bslabs pas/mkhas pa'i grags pa chen po'ang byung / la la'i snang ngor pha ma gang yin/ la la'i snang ngor grub thob chen po'i rnam 'phrul du song bas skye ba snga phyi bar gsum du dge bsnyen bcun pa zhes bya ba'i grags pa byung / de'i ngo bo ni sprul bar song bas 'phags pa gang gis kyang dpyad par dka'/ 'on kyang / gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /bcun pa spyan ras gzigs de dang mthun pa/ dge slong chos mchog de yang res ge sar gyi mtshan can / re mar me'i mtshan can/ res dri ma med pa'i mtshan can/ res byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan can/ chos mchog rang kyang du mar byung / skye bar rang yang phal cher rdzus te skyes/ de ltar dge bsnyen de dang dge slong des khro ba'i rnam 'gyur skad cig ma cig kyang ma bstan/ nga rgyal du mngon pa ni gsung 'phangs mtho ba tsam du yang ma smras / dam pa gzhan khur ba gtso bor byas te dman cha blangs te ku su lu'i spyod pa phal cher bstan/ de'i dus su yang yul khams de thams cad mi mngon par bde ba la bkod/ dge bsnyen gyis skye bo thams cad chos la bkod bla ma dge slong gis ni mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa dag la ni/ de'i blo ngo dang mthun pa'i chos bstan/ legs pa'i shes rab/ dge bsnyen btsun pa de shes sam/ dge slong de yang shes sam/ pha ma gnyis shes sam/ rngog na re/ dge bsnyen de dge bsnyen chen po 'dir gsal/dge slong bla ma chen po nyid du gsal/ yab yum gnyis gang lags/ rnal 'byor ba zhig khyed mtha' 'khob kyi —358—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yul du mi 'gro ba zer ba de yang su lags/ gzhan yang grub thob kyi rnam 'phrul mang po byung nas bdog de dag ni kho bos ma 'tshal/ gsal bar mdzad pa zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis ni ding sang gi yang pha ma gnyis rnal 'byor ba gcig po de ni rgya bod gnyis char na zhi ba lha zhes zer zhing gda'/ yin pa ni 'jam dpal yin/ da gzod kyang dbus gcang du 'brom gyi slob ma du mar sprul zhing 'ong / khyad par du'ang 'phan yul dang / dar yul gyi nang du dge slong snam sbyar gyon pa stong phrag gis bskor ba zhig 'ong / phal cher gyi rna ba na/ grwa sa las mtshan du gsol bar grags/ gzhan yang dge bsnyen bcun pa de'i rtsar grub thob chen po brgyad bcu (cukatsam byung zhing de dag gi mtshan brjod /153na bod /na'ang yam me ba gda'/ de ltar na da lta yan chod du/ dge bsnyen 'dis/ ku su lu'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig mjad de khro ba dang / nga rgyal 'bur 'joms byas shing da lta'i 'di bzhin du dman cha 'ba' zhig byed pa las/ mtho ba'i sems skad cig kyang ma mdzad do/ /chesko/gsungs so/ /de ltar/ khro dang nga rgyal gzhom bya zhing / /dman pa'i sems dang ldan par bya/ /zhes bya ba 'kho brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ dge bsnyen bcun par ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bcu pa'o// //da11 kul sgra bcas su khye'u nor bu bzang por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i leg/ka 153 na4 rgoyul sgrar bcas su dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa khye'u bzang por sku skye ba bzhes nga/'i le'u bzhugs sa//༄༅/ /yang yer ba'i byams pa'i drung du/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs thun mong du/ phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa dang khyad par du'ang dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal la byi dor legs par byas nas dung dkar gyi rgyan bkod de phul nas mdun du thal mo sbyar te 'di skad du/ yang zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di na mar la/ log pa'i 'tsho ba spang bya zhing / /chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zang zing thams cad spang bya zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis brgyan par bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ sngon rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dis/ log 'tsho ji ltar spangs/ chos kyi 'tsho ba la ji ltar spyad/'jig rten gyi zang zing gi nor ji ltar spangs/ 'phags pa'i nor gang dang gang gis brgyan par mdzad/ 'on te/dad pa'i nor dang tshul khrims nor/ /gtong ba'i nor dang thos pa'i nor/ khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ zhas rab kyi ni nor bdun te/ /zhes pa 'di rang lags sam/ zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma'i zhal nas/ sngon sgrar bcas —359—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ zhes bya ba'i grong na/ khyim bdag sgra 'dzin zhes bya ba la/ chung ma sgra'i phreng ba zhes bya ba yod pa la/ bu nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba cig zhabrungs te/ de'i tshe khyim bdag sgra 'dzin gyi bsam pa la/ bu nor bu bzang po ni rab tu byung na ni nged pha ma gnyis dang dngos su da lta rang 'bral ba srid/ rab tu ma byung na ni brgyud nas ma 'ongs par 'bral ba srid/ 'bral ba mnyam po la ma 'ongs pa phyi thag ring / de bas da lta rab tu byung nas/ khong rang btsun sa bzung ste/ bdag cag pha ma gnyis kyang drangs nas/ sems can gzhan yang bde ba la 'khod pa srid/ 'o na'ang bu rang gi las 'phro la rag las dri snyam nas/ sgra 'dzin gyis bu tshol ('tsholakadu phyin pas ma rnyed par/rnal 'byor ma cig dang phrad pas/ rnal 'byor ma de na re/ khyim bdag khyod ci tshol ('tsholakazer/ khye'u chung ngu zhig yod pa tshol ('tsholakab yin smras pas/ rnal 'byor ma na re/ 'o na 'od ma'i tshal na nor bu bzang po zhes bya ba'i khye'u chung cig bya ka lan ta ka dang lab lob mang po smra zhing 'dug de khyed kyi bu yin nam/ sgra 'jin na re/ de nga'i bu yin/ ka lan ta ka dang smra yin gda'am/ rnal 'byor ma na re/ gcig tu ma/ zad gnyis su ma zad / ldebs re la zur brgyad brgyad cam rang sgron nas smra yin gda'o/ /der sgra 'dzin rab tu dga' ste/ 'od ma'i tshal du phyin pa dang / ka lan ta ka zhig shing gi me tog gi dbus na bsdad/ me tog dang yal ga stong tsam la ka lan ta ka stong tsam gyis bskor te bu nor bu bzang po ljon pa cig gi steng na bsdad de/ de la dbus kyi ka lan ta ka de gshog pa krong krong dang ske snyeng snyeng mang po byed cing nor bu bzang po la bltas te smra ba la/ sgra 'dzin gyis kyang dpyad pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' zab/ /las kyi dbang gis 'thoms pa yi sems can dpag med der bying nas/ /gang du phyin kyang mtha' ma rnyed/ /bde ba'i skam la phyin ma nus/ /gzhan yang nad 'byin dug gi chu/ khol ma lnga yis rtag tu der/ /'bab cing phyir yang lnga 'phros te/ /dpag med drag po'i nad kyis gdungs/ /e ma sman pa chen po khyod/ /de dag bzod par ci bder spyod/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i ded dpon khyod / / mya ngan thang la 'khor tshogs dag /dor nas phebs par byed mi rigs/ khyod kyis phongs pa mi sgrol na//su zhig gnyen dang ldan par 'gyur/ khyed kyis rgya mtsho ma bskams na/ /su yis chu bo bcad par nus/ khyod kyis dug mtsho ma bsgral na/ /e ma gang gis dug mtsho sgrol/ /rang rang las kyis bcings pa la/ khyod kyisa'aching ba ma bkrol na/ /gang gis gang zhig bcings pa 'grol/ /rang gis las kyi chu bo gang / /rang gis bsdams la 'bab par byed/ /kun gyi rdzi bo dam pa khyod/ /gang dag 'ching bas rab bcings pa/ /skad cig nyid la'ang ma snyel bar/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bshig par 'tshal/ /thugs rje snyoms shing brtson pa yis/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon gyur ba/ /rang gis rang nyid gsod pa yi/ /mu cor rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /bag phebs —360—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bzhugs pa'i skabs ma mchis/ /zhes par go yang nor bu bzang pos ka lan ta ka de dag la smras pa la pha sgra 'dzin dpyod cing yod pa na/ ma sgra'i phreng ba'ang sleb ste bu de na 'dug pas dga' nas dpyod cing 'dug pa la/tshig 'di skad du/ ji ltar nam mkha'i mthas khyab na/ /rgyud can gang gis khyab par 'gyur/ /bdag gis bkod pa'ang de tsam ste/ /rgyud can de la'ang dug gi chu/ /drag po khol ma lnga ldan de/ /rtag tu 'bab cing rang rgyud bsreg / me tog gzhan du 'phros pa yin/ /rmongs pas 'ga' zhig bslus par gyur/ /de dag kun la mtha' med phyir / / nyi ma'i 'od zer stong ldan yang / /mun pa ma lus 'joms ma nus/ /las yod dus las ma 'das par//bde ba'i gnas su phyin par byas/ /da dung nam mkha' rlag gyur cing / /'khor ba stong par ma gyur bar/ /kye ma zhi bder mi 'gyur zhing / /snying brtse che las mi 'da'o/ /ji srid nam mkha' rlag kyang srid/ /rgya mtsho sbrang bus 'thungs kyang rung / /ri bo rlung gis khyer kyang srid/ /nga yi gzhan don g.yel ba dang / /dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer ba go nas/ ma sgra'i phreng bas/ pha sgra 'dzin la smras pa/ 'gro ba gzhan skad grags pa na//ma/bas pa meongs par gyur ba srid/ /ma dpyad ca co 'tsher bar zad/ /dpyad na legs bshad tshig 'brus brgyan//saṃ skṛ ta mchog phan tshun gleng / /'phral skad mkhas pa ci zhig go /lha dang klu dag gnod sbyin dang / /dri za grul bum sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshad ma'i skyes bus go 'gyur gyis/ /mkhas par rlom pa'i dregs pa rgyug /sgra 'dzin sgra de shes sam smros/ /bu ni dam pa'i dam par go /ka lan sprul pa'i bya ru shes/ /rgyud ldan blo yis mi lcogs pa'i/ /nyi zla lta bur kho mos shes/ /blo la shar ba ngag tu smros/ /sgra 'dzin na re/ chu dang rne'u sing me tog bkra/ /sbrang bu rab 'tsher snyan pa'i glu/ /nga dang nga 'dras go 'gyur gyis/ /gzhan gyis khyus bsten mthong ba tsam/ /e ma ljon pa ljon phran rgyas/ /'od ma 'od can me tog mdzes/ /bsil ba bsil mngar shing thog zhim/ /'dab ma 'dab rgyas srab 'jam la/ /shing ldan shing mchog phun sum tshogs/ /nor mchog nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung / /bzang po bzang po'i steng na bzhugs/ /bag ldan bag phebs smra bar byed/ /byang na byang chub shing mchog cig /bya sprul bya stong sprul bas bskor/ /sprul ba sprul ba'i tshig sgra sgrogs/ /'gro min 'gro ltar 'gro ba 'dren/ /'gro bral 'gro 'ong nyid du ston/ /'od dag 'od zer lho byang 'dzin/ /'dzin pa 'dzin med 'dzin no zhes/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' sgrol lo skad/ /dag pa dag par thugs dam 'cha'/ /ngas smra nga la 'khrul mi mnga'/ /sgra phreng sgra de shes gyur tam/ /sgra shes sgra yis sgra lan sgrogs/ /ces (zhesakasmras pa dang / sgra'i phreng ba na re/ de nyid de bzhin 'khrul mi gda'/ /de ni de ltar kho mos shes/ /sgra shes sgra la dpyod pa ni/ /bu can bu la blta bar byed / / mthong tshe mthong bas dga' bar 'gyur/ /rab mchog rab tu 'byung bar bskul/ /rab byung rab gyur —361 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/kun gyi dpal/ kun dga' kun gyi bshes gnyen mchog /kun spyod kun gtsang kun lam 'dren/ /'dren pa 'dren mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /spyan mchog spyan mnga' sgrib pa med / /sgrib dag sgrib pa sel gyur ba'i/ /bu 'di bu yun ring phyir du/ /'di nyid 'di la bskul ma thob/ /sgra 'dzin sgra la sgra lan mdzod/ /sgra de sgra bzang bzlog pa dka'/ /zhes pa dang / nor bu bzang pos pha ma la smras pa/ khyed gnyis khyed gsung kho bos bsgrub (sgrubaka / /nga dga' nga ni thar bar 'gro/ khyed 'dren khyed kyi mar gyur ba/ /ngas 'dren nga yi dam 'cha' yin / / nga med nga ni gzugs brnyan tsam/ /gzugs brnyan gzugs su 'khrul ma byed/ /sgra med sgra tsam brjod par zad/ /smra med smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /ka lan ka lan stong gis bskor/ /sprul ba sprul ba chig stong cig / nga ni nga med bzang po sa /rab kyis rab tu 'byin du mchi/ /dge 'dun dge 'dun cha lugs nyid/ /gnas mchog gnas 'dir bzhugs gyur te/ /rang gis rang gzugs nges bstan nas/ /chos can chos la 'god par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / ka lan ta ka dag phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'phur nas song ngo / /der pha ma dang bcas pa dga' bzhin spro bzhin du rang gi khyim du 'ongs te/ nang du pha mas zas phun sum/ tshogs pa sbyar te bu la drangs nas/ de ring gi bya ka lan ta ka chen po de ji 'dra zhig yin/ ka lan gzhan stong po de dag kyang ma 'tshal bas/ nor bu bzang pos gsung du gsol zhes zhus pas/ nor bu bzang po na re/ ka lan ta ka chen po de/bla ma mar me mdzad bzang po bya ba yin/ gzhan stong po de dag kyang sangs rgyas stong gi sprul ba yin te/ bstan pa'i gtso bo la bskor te gda' gsung / der pha ma na re/ stong rtsa gnyis su 'byung bar bshad pa ma yin nam/nor bu bzang po na re/ cig ni ri bo bya rkang can la ting nge 'dzin du ma mngon du mdzad cing gda'/ snyigs ma/'i dus su kho bo mtha' 'khob tu gzhan don byed du 'gro tsa na de yang byon/ nang par thams cad dge 'dun gyi cha lugs su nga rab tu byin du 'byon pas/ pha ma rang mchod rdzas mang po sogs (sogakagasungs nas/ pha mas kyang sbyor ba drag pos mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar te gnas pa na/ nang par stong phrag cig dang gnyis byas te 'od ma'i tshal du lhags pa dang / mchod rdzas sbyar ba dag phul te/ bla ma mar me mdzad bzang pos nor bu bzang po rab tu byung nas/ mtshan yang byang chub sems dpa' rin chenatshodapal tu btags te/ de nas dge 'dun de dag mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas rin chen dpal gyis khyim rnam pa thams cad du spangs nas bsod snyoms kyi zas kyis 'tsho zhing / phyag dar khrod pa'i gos gyon nas/ kha gsag dang / gzhog slong la sogs pa/ log pa'i 'tsho ba rdul phran tsam zhig kyang ma gsol/ spyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis kyis rtag tu 'tsho bar byas/ e ma 'phral gyi 'tsho ba la'ang mi lta na/ zang zing gi dngos po gya nom pa la smos ci 'tshal/ de ltar na/ 'jig rten gyi nor rdzas —362—

'akruor/ ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /thams cad spangs nas/ dad pa'i nor gyis gzhi brtan par mjad/ tshul khrims kyi nor gyis yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs par mdzad/ gtong pa'i nor gyis chags pa med par mdzad/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa las dam pa'i chos thos pa'i nor gyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin par mdzad/ khrel yod pa dang / ngo tsha shes pa'i nor gyis pha mar gyur ba'i sems can thams cad blos mi gtong bar mdzad/ shes rab kyi nor gyis chos thams cad so sor phyed par mdzad de/ sems can gyi don las skad cig kyang nyams pa med do/ /pha ma gnyis kyis kyang khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyi mi khyab par mdzad do/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ de'i dus na'ang nor bu bzang po zhes bya bar gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas btags/ da lta yang las dang ldan pa'i sems can thams cad kyis gsol ba btab na/ rgyal ba nyid du skyed par byed do/ /de ltar na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes bya'o/ /pha sgra 'dzin ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la bdag gi yon tan ston par byed pa'i paṇḍi ta sgra'i tsher ma zhes bya ba de yin te shes rab shin tu rno/ ma sgra'i phreng ba ni se btsun chen po yin te/ sprul pa'i sku yin/ nyon mongs pa mi mnga'/ lam khar pha dang phrad pa'i rnal 'byor ma de ni rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma yin/ ka lan ta ka'i dpon po ni kho bo yin/ ka lan ta ka gzhan stong po dag ni/ rgya bod kyi nga'i slob ma grub thob chen po dag yin/ lar bzang bzang thams cad la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku yin zer ba de/ chos dang mthun pas de ltar 'dogs pa yin mod/ nga ni sems can thams cad byang chub la sbyor ba'i lam tsam yin gsung ngo / /de ltar log pa'i 'tsho ba spang bya zhing / /chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zang zing thams cad spang bya zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis brgyan par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ khye'u nor bu bzang por ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bcu gcig pa'o// //na12 kul me ga dhar khye'u zla bar sku skye ba bzhes pa'ileg/ka 156 na7 rgoyul ma ga dhar dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa khye'u zla bar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs sa//༄tsho/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shesarab kyis/ jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs thun mong du phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa dang /khyad par du yang / dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal gsal bar phyis pa la dung chung dkar po'i 'phra bkod de phul nas/—363—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo nyid bla ma dam pa a ti sha yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod bzhin du mi mdzad pa'i gter bzhin du legs par sbas nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don du ku su lu'i spyod pa mdzad pa 'di'i yon tan de 'dra ba bdag gis thos su yod pa ni bsod nams bsags / yang zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di na mar la/ 'du 'dzi thams cad spang bya zhing / /dgon pa la ni gnasapar bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dis/ sngon rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad spangasanas grong khyer gyi 'du 'dzi'i dbang du ma song bar dgon pa la ji ltar gnas/ bla mas gsung par zhu zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ sngon yul ma ga ta na (dhwa naka / bram ze nyi ma zhes bya ba la/ chung ma dkar ldan zhes bya ba yod pa la/ bu zla ba zhes bya ba blo gsal ba skra dmar ser gser btso ma ltar yod pa/ pha mas rig byed kyi sgra smras pa tsam gyi blo la che re re zin pa de lta bu zhig byung ste/ rtag tu rdo rje'i gdan du phyin nas/ rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten la sogs pa la phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa byed cing / snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa mang po 'bul/ der gnas brtan bgres po dang brtag dpyad mkhas pa dag na re/ khye'u 'di kun la rab tu byung na mu stegs byed kyi rgyal mtshan babs kyis 'jig nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur rgyas par 'ong zer/ yang nyi ma nyin cig mu stegs byed kyi lha khyab 'jug gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mu stegs kyi chos la mkhas pa zhig rdo rje'i gdan du rtsod pa byed du byung ba dang / paṇḍi ta dang gang zag khyad par can mang po bzhugs pa la/ de dag gis kyang kho'i lan ldon par dgongs nas 'tshogs pa dang / khye'u zla ba'ang de'i gseb tu byung nas/ rab tu byung ba de dag la phyag dgu phrugs su btsal/ thal mo sbyar nas/ yul gyi rgyal po chen po grong khyer gyi sprang po la 'thab mo mi 'tshong ba yin/ khyed dam pa dag dben par bzhugs shig de ring kho bos zhabs thog pa bgyi yis zer nas/ mu stegs de dag la smras pa/ sdang 'dod bsam pa ngan pa yis/ /blo can log pa'i lam la 'gro /rtsod pa'i gzhi nyid sgra yin pas/ /gnas dang zur phyin smra bar byos/ /rkyen dang nyer sbyor bstan par 'tshal/ /de tshe nga yis de nyid dpyad/ /ces smras pa dang / mu stegs de dag gis sngar grags pa med pa'i zol sbyor gyi sgra mang po byas te/ rtsa ba re la mgo drug drug tsam/ bcu gnyis tsam bco brgyad tsam yod pa smras pas/ gzhan mkhas par rlom pa mang po yod pa'ang mgo 'thom ste song / de nas khye'u zla bas rtsa ba gcig bkag pas/ me bsad pas du ba 'gags pa ltar rtse mo brgyad po'ang pham/ de nas mu stegs dag na re/ khyed kyis rtsa ba khegs te/ gyes pa dag so na gnas so zer/ khye'u zla ba na re/ kha tsang nas nga'i 'byung bzhi chos kyi dbyings su thim pa la/ nad rang sor lus pa des lan zhes smras pas/ mu stegasan re/ nga la mi zhig na re/ chu —364—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'thungs pas mes tshig zer nas byung ste/ de'i dam bca' de legs sam zer/ khye'u zla ba na re/ bdag gi yab mes cig gis me bus pas khong rang gi smra ra tshig nas phyis ngas bu dgos pa cig byung / zhes smras pas/ mu stegs de dag na re/ 'o na khyod kyi dam bca' 'gal bar bstan pa la nged kyi ngag 'gal zer ba yin nam zer/khye'u zla ba na re/ 'o na zla ba ni gnag byas pas mun pa nyid gnag zer ba yin nam/ zhes pa la sogs pa phan tshun du mang po glengs kyang khye'u zla ba'i ngag ma bzlog par/ mu stegs dag gis mdze bo'i sha cig la ngan sngags btab ste/ dar gyis gtums (btumasakanas khye'u zla ba la byin/ khye'u zla bas kyang shog 'dag gi ri bong gi gzugs byas te/ de'i lto bar kho rang gis byin pa de bcug nas yi ge drug pa dang sbyar te/ log pa log pa log pa rakṣa rakṣa thum thumarbad rbad shag shag tshal tshal phyi rol ba zung zhig ces bgrangs pas/ khye'u zla ba nyid zla ba'i gzugs su byas/ kho'i ngan rdzas de ri bong gi khog pa na gnas pa de yig 'bru drug gis byin rlabs dang /ngan sngags kyi snying pos bshig ste/ mu stegs pa de dag sna zhom/ mig chu dang sna chu 'dzag lus thams cad skrangs nas gda' ba la/ der 'dus pa'i nang pa'i paṇḍi ta dang / gzhan yang nang pa dag kho'i rang mtshan de la/snying rje drag po skyes/ zla ba la dag pa'i snang ba rgya chen po skyes/ der mu stegs byed de dag na re/ khyod la 'di lta bu'i nus mthu yod pa ci yin/ khyod kyis nged la ci byas zer nas/ khye'u zla ba na re/ nang pa nang la dag byed chu//gzugs bzang gzugs kyis mi mthun bzlog /byams pa byams pas phan par 'dzin/ /zla ba zla min zla ba'ang yin / khyod kyis khyod kyis gzungs mi shes/ /zla ba zla bzhag ri bong bslu/ /ri bong ri bong nyid ma yin/ /sprul bas sprul ba'i rdzun pa yin/ kha yod kha skyengs kha yor gda'/ /sna yod sna rdugs sna chu 'dzag /lus yod lus 'gyur lus kyis bslus/ /sems yod sems zhus sems 'gyod gyur/ /zhes smras pa dang / mu stegs pa de dag na re/ snying rje snying rje che mchog la/ khyed bzang khyed kyi zhabs bsan na/sa/ /ngar 'dzin nga las bsgral ba'i phyir//lus ngan lus kyi na tsha sol/ /sems ngan sems kyis kun bslangs nas/ /ngan sngags ngan pa rdzas la sbyar/ /zla ba zla ba bzang thabs mkhas pas/ rang rdzas rang gi snying la gzer/ /da 'gyod da ni nges btud nas/ /phar 'dzin pha yi spyod pa mdzad/ /ces smras pa dang / khye'u zla ba na re/ shes ldan log pa'i lam zhugs pa/ /rna ba can ldan las la spyod/ /mkha' la zla shar 'od kyis gang / /nor bu gsum gyi mthu yin te/ /gsol 'debs bzang po'i las 'bras grub/ /sa chu me rlung cig yod na/ /bzhi 'byung cig nyid med gyur na/ /me med de yis 'gal ba'ang med/ /'gal rgyud srid rgyu med pa yin/ /sngon gyi las bzang pha ma 'dzom/ /'bras bu mi yi khye'ur gsal / / de mi ldan na de mi 'byung / /zhes smras pas/ mu stegs de dag gi bsam pa la/ mu stegs su phyi bar —365—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'jog pa nang pas byas/ nang par 'jog pa phyi ba mu stegs kyis byas/ spyir yang phyi med pa'i nang mi 'ong / nang med pa'i phyi ba mi 'byung / spyi bye brag bzhi po de dag la'ang cig med na ba'i mi 'byung / me dang chu 'gal ba la/me med na chu'i drod cha mi 'byung zhes pa la sogs par yang go 'ga' yang rgyu med pa ma yin te/ mu stegs byed kyi log pa'i sbyor ba de dag dang / nang pa'i yang dag pa'i sbyor ba de dag 'gal kyang / thugs rje'i thabs kyis rgyu rkyen du 'gro srid de/ dper na de ring gi 'di bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba la sogs par go /gzhan yang nam mkha' las zla ba byung ba ni/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings nas khye'u zla ba kho rang 'ongs pa sbyor bar 'dug de yang gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung ba nor bu rin po che dang / dkon mchog gsum 'dra por sbyor bar 'dug de'i byin rlabs kyis khye'u zla ba kho nyid byung bar bsgrub (sgrub1 par 'dug dkon mchog gsum po de yang las rgyu 'bras phyin ci ma log par bsgrubs pa la brten nas byung bar 'dug spyir 'gal ba'i rgyu las 'gal ba'i 'bras bu mi 'byung kyang / de ring rgyu ngan pa mu stegs byed kyi ngan sngags dang ngan rdzas sbyar te/ khye'u zla ba slu bar brtsams pas rkyen ngan pa rgyu ru song / de'i rkyen nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i thabasazab moo des byas nas/ 'bras bu bzang po nang pa sangs rgyas par 'jug pa la/ rgyu bsod nams shig bsag dgos pas/ nor khyer la nged nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lha dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs su shog de ltar na nad 'di las thar bar bya bar nus kyis/ rgyu ye med na ni rkyen gang gis kyang bya ba mi nus zer 'dug snyam du go nas langs te/ rang gi gnas su phyin nas 'byor ba chen po blangs te/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa la sogs pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang mthun pa'i bsod nam bsags so/ /de nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sngar gyi las la 'gyod pas 'chags pa dang / yig 'bru drug pa tshad med pa bzhi dang sbyar te bzlaspu brjod byed pa la sogs pa bstan pas lus sngar bzhin du gyur to/ /de bzhin du dka' thub chen pos sgrub kra rtse gcig tu byas pas grub pa thob ste mkha' spyod du gshegs zhes grags so/ /de ltar na khye'u zla ba des khye'u'i rnam par nyon mongs pa rang spangs su yod pa'i dus de na'ang rgol ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa dang / ma nus pa skyotha pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa dag mchod cing rgyas par byed pa dang / yon tan rgya che bas dam pa thams cad kyis bstod pa dang / byams pa dang / snying rje che bas ma rabs rnams kyis 'khur ba dang / gzhi legs shing bzhin phun sum tshogs pas gzhon nu ma thams cad kyis mchod cing 'khur ba dang / dkar po la dga' ba'i lha thams cad kyang stong grogs bsam gyi mi khyab pa byed do/ /de nas rdo rje gdan gyi dge 'dun de dag na re/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang / rab tu byung ba'i rten la brten nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas —366—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pas / khyed kyang sprul ba'i sku cig gda' ste/ rab tu byung ba la ma brten na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs thams cad theg pa chen po la bsgyur mi nus te/ skye bo khyim pa'i spyod pa dang 'dres pas so/ /gzhan yang ji skad rten lha dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su byed pa dang / khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu (cukalhag pa cig bsrungs nas las dang ldan pa gzhan la'ang de ster zhing padmo'i tshal rab tu rgyas pa bzhin du spyod/ dbang po dang /tshangs pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis mchod par byed do/ /zhes gsol ba yang yang du btab pas/ khye'u zla ba na re/ 'o na nga'i bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes bya ba cig yod pa de/ da lta 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams na phar gshegs / sang phod dbyar zla 'bring po'i dus su na lespror byon nas gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs/ sde pa phal cher sde zhes pa la spyod pas de'i dus su rab tu 'byung zer nas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus su song nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas ye shes skad pa theg pa che chung gi sdom pa ma lus pa thugs la rdzogs pa/ nyes lhung gi dri mas cung zad kyang ma gos pa de byon nas so sor thar ba'i sdom pa gnang bas/ khye'u zla ba rgyud tshod mtho bas sdom pa gsum ga thob pa tsam byung / de'i dus su'ang mtshan yang ye shes snying po zhes bya bar grags te/ de'i dus su bstan bcos la sogs pa mang po ni ma mdzad/ sprul ba du mas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad do/ /pha ma gnyisapo'ang bram ze'i rig byed la mkhas par grags yon tan gyi sgo dpag tu med pa rgyud la mnga'/ lan cig sangasargyas ye shes kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang de na ye shes snying po bzhugs te yod pa na/ khye'u dkar po zhig byung ste/ me tog dkar po kha ma bye ba cig phul nas/ 'di 'dra ba'i nang du 'di 'dra ba 'byung gis/ 'di lta sbas pa'i tshul du gnas na rung gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de skad/ gsung ba de mang pos mthong zhing thos / der ye shes snying po'i drung du phyin te/ da lta'i mi dkar po de su yin/ ye shes snying po na re/ de nga'i nu bo zhig yin te/ yun de tsam du da lta las lus ston du ma 'dod gsung / yang der 'dus pa rnams na re/ 'o na bram ze nyi modang skar ldan gnyis la bu gcig po las yod par ma thos na/ khyed la gcung zhig kyang yod dam zer/ye shesasnying po na re/ kye shes ldan dag 'jig rten na kho bo rang yang ma thos pa mang yul 'di rang na'ang la las mthong thosamed/ la las du mar thos rgyal po dag rgyal po'i bur 'dzin/ rje'u dag rje'u'i bur 'dzin/ bram ze dag bram ze'i bur 'dzin/ dmangs dag kyang re re dang re re'i bur 'dzin/ da lta yang mkhas pa rnams la ye shes snying por grags/ la la'i snang ngo na ming gzhan du mar gda'/ ma 'ongs pa na yang nga'i ming gi gnas lugs ma shes par snga phyi dang rang bzhin du mar 'khrul bar 'ong / sgro 'dogs nges par chod pa'i sgrib pa nges par spangs pa dag yin gsungs pas/ de dag na re/ 'o na khyed gang zag khyad par can zhig yin par 'dug pa —367—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la / btung ba yod dus su mi spyod par/ med dus su 'gyod na 'phyis pa yin pas/ chos kyi sbyin pa cig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ ye shes snying po'i zhal nas/ lus 'di sos ka'i me tog 'dra/ /shin tu mdzes te rkyen mi thub//tshe 'di nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra/ llen tu gsal te yud tsam yin/ /skye 'chi nyi ma'i 'char nub 'dra/ /rgyun chad med par babs kyis 'bab/ /sdug bsngal chen po'i phreng ba la/ /bde bar 'dzin pa shin tu blun/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub (sgrubakadus 'dir/ /dal bar ma sdod brtson 'grus bskyed/ /rang bde'i ro la zhen gyur bas/ /drin can pha ma 'phra yis sgyel/ /e ma rang gi btsan sa yang / /zin par gyur ba nyin skar 'dra/ /de ltar spyod la nga 'dir gnyer/ /chu shing 'phreng ba chod mdzod la/ /gser gyi brtan pa thob par mdzod/ /da lta nyes pa 'amosadusasu / / rang gi btsan sa ma bzung na/ /phyis ni ngan song pho nyas 'dren/ /ci bya la stor nyams pa na/ /'gyod pa'i rlabs kyis mchi ma 'byin/ /de bas da ltar btsan sa bzung / /bcosapa'i dus bab ma nyams par/ /bstan pa'i snying po thob par mdzod/ /gzhan don thar bas gzhi bzung la/ /rang nyid thul la gzhan gyi dpal/ /mchog tu rgyas pa nyid du mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / /phal che ba yang las sad pa 'ba' zhig tu song bas chosal blo phyogs cig tu nges par gyur to/ /de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgyas shing sku brten pa'i shing gi drung du padma 'dam gyis ma gos pa bzhin du grong yul gyi 'du 'dzi'i rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs/ nyan rang gi sems kyis dben pa'i dgon pa brten te/ gzhan don 'bab zhig lasam g.yos par bzhugasaso/ /der ma zad da lta yan chad du gzhan don chen po'i dgon par bzhugs te/ rang don gyis nyon mongs pa'i g.yeng ba thams cad las dben par mdzad do/ /legs pa'i shes rab rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di'i lugs kyi dgon pa ni lus dben pa la mi byed/ gnas 'gol sa la mi byed/ rnam pa nas rnam pa thams cad du theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig gi gnas su bzhugs te/ theg dman dang / lung ma bstan gyi sems rnam pa thams cad du mi byed pa'o / / legs pa'i shes rab de shes sam/ pha ma gnyis ni ye shes dpa' bo dang dpa' mo yin te/ da lta yang mkha' spyod na bzhugs/ zla ba ye shes snying por gyur ba ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po 'byung bar byed pa/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yin no/ /sangs rgyas ye shes ni kho bo yin zhes gsugs so/ /de ltar 'du 'dzin thams cad spang bya zhing / /dgon pa la ni gnas par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ khye'u zla bar ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bcu gnyis pa'o// //—368—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pa13 kul sgra ldan du khye'u rin chen snying por sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilelga/ka 160 na7 rgogrong gyer sgra ldan du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa khye'u rin chen snying por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i lesdog baṭa/gas so///༄tsho/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs la thun mong du/ phyag la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa dang / khyad par du yang dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal la dung dkar po'i rgyan bkram nas phul te/ thal mo sbyar nas yang zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di na mar la/ 'chal ba'i tshig rnams spang bya zhing / /rtag tu ngag ni sdam par bya/ /zhesagasungs gda' na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dis/ sngon gsung 'khyal ji ltar spangs/ ngag ji ltar bsdams/ bla mas gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ legs pa'i shes rab/ sngon grong khyer sgra ldan zhes bya bar rje'u'i rigs rin chen zhes pa la/ chung ma gser phreng bya ba yod pa la sras shig zhabrungs pas khang pa thams cad 'od kyis gang ba dang ltas khyad par can mang po byung bas/ ma'i bsam pa la ltas 'di bu 'dis smra shes nges snyam nas bu pang na yod pa la smras pa/ khyod lha'am klu'am su zhig yin 'od 'di ltar che zhes smras pas/ bu de ma la cher gyis bltas nas/ chos thams cad 'od dang 'ja'i rnam pa la 'od khang chung gang byung ba la ya mtshan che rgyu med / der ma nyid dga' ste/ pha la rin chen zer te/ bu 'di rang rin po che thams cad kyi snying po 'dzin pa cig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ ming rang yang de rang rigs snyam nas bu rin po che'i snying por btags pa dang / bu na re/nga la ming de skad gdags su btub tsam yin zer/ de nas cher mtshar nas pha'i snyan du gsol ba dang / pha na re/gang nas su zhig gnas 'dir 'khrungs/ /dmigs pa gang gis bdag gi bu/ /chos dang dpal 'byor gang la brtson / / gsung gi sgo phye bstan par 'tshal/ /zhes smras pas/ khye'u na re/ legs pa'i lam mchog kun 'gro yang / / gzugs kyi rnam par 'di shar mod/ /nges bzung tshig gis don ma mchis/ /'on kyang las kyis gnas 'dir bltams/ /yab yum rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /nga yi chos dang mthun slad du/ /dge ba'i grogs kyi skyong bar zhu/ /nga ni skye ba mi gnyer kyang / khyed gnyis bu dang sbyar slad du/ /skye ba tsam zhig bstan par zad/ /yab kyisasmras pa/ ding sang bdag cag padmo 'dra/ /sprul pa'i khye'u bltams par gyur/ /yul 'di zhing khams gtsang mar 'dra/ /skyon med khye'u gnas par gyur/ /gnas 'di mkha' spyod gnas dang mtshungs/ /skyes ma thag par chosagasung thos/ /ji ltar bdag gis bsgrub (sgrubakanus na/ /ri bo brlag par gyis gsungs kyang / /de nyid —369—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'dor bar mi bya'o/ /ji ltar bu yis bslus gyur kyang / /'byod par nam yang mi bya'o/ /gang dgos smros shig bsgrub (sgrub3 par bgyi/ /zhes zhus pas/ khye'u na re/ 'jig rten kun na pha ma dag /drin rab mchog tu rab tu gsungs/ /rgya mtsho chen po skra rtse yis/ /gtor bar nus kyi pha ma yi/ /drin len bgrang bar nus ma yin/ /'jig rten sgron ma de skad gsung / /de lta bas na khyod dang ni/ /'jig rten ma lus bdag gi gnyen/ /drin ldan phyir na drang slad du/ /lam mchog bzang la 'jug par bgyi/ /pha ma tshe 'di ji ltar yang / /ngan phyid tsam zhig sus kyang 'ong / /gtan gyi tshe ni de ltar min/ /chung dus chen po ma dor bar/ /bsgrub (sgrub3nus dus su bsgrub (sgrubakapar mdzod/ /nor ni sa 'og gser dang mtshungs/ /yod par zad kyis rjes mi 'brang / /mkhas pas gser de bton gyur nas/ /bdar zhing mkho bar spyad gyur na/ /nor du 'gyur gyis gzhan du min/khyed la 'byor pa dpag med kyang / /spyad par ma gyur de dang mtshungs/ /de yang chos min spyir gyur na/ /bor bar 'gyur gyis phan mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na nor rdzas kun/ /pha ma dkon mchog bzhi la mchod/ /chagasamed gnas su bsam gtan bsgoms(sgomasaka/ /zas su bzang zhing gos su'ang bzang / /ro brgya'i zas kyang ting nge 'dzin/ /gcig gi char yang ga la phod/ /srog chags bye ba stong tshogs kyang / /mi yi lus ni gcig tsam zad//e ma mi lus cig la yang / /srin rigs brgyad khri dag tu gnas/ /gzhan ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /de ltar dgongs dang pha ma gnyis/ /rnyed dka'i lus 'di chud ma gson/ /gzhon nu'i lus 'di me tog 'dra/ /ji ltar bad kyis ma pheg dus/ /shin tu mdzes te zhag gcig gis/ /nyams par byed pa ji bzhin du/ /gzhon pa'i tha ma rgas nga/ ste/ /skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin/ /rtag 'dzin ma che pha ma gnyis/ /lang tsho dar la bab pa yi/ /sgeg mo gzugs kyi nga rgyal can/ /zhal la lo yis rnying gyur te/ /dkar dmar sngo nag nyid du 'gyur/ /gzhon 'jam gnyer sgur sar gtugs te/ /na ning gzhon pa'i dus tshod de/ /nga yin da ni rgas par gyur/ /e ma phyi ma snyan gyur kyang / /da dung sdod rtsis gsog rum byed/ /snying med de la dpe long la/ /rang gi rgyud la'ang bsgom par mdzod / / de ni bdag gi snying gtam yin/ /dam par mdzod la nyams su longs/ /spyir yang sems can nyon mongs che/ /sgos su skye dman rnams la 'phel/ /ha ha hi hi 'dod chags smra/ /gzugs ni mdzes dang mi mdzes dang / / rigs ni bzang dang mi bzang zhes/ /gang du mang po tshogs gyur cing / /phan tshun du ma gleng bar byed/ /e ma bzhi mdor phrad gyur kyang / /'brengs te rnam g.yeng smra bar byed/ /e ma bud med skyon de la/ /dpyod la ngag gi nyes pa sdom/ /bre mo 'bum phrag bzlas pa bas/ /buddhā ya zhes cig brjod na/ /ngag gi nyes pa du ma mdzad / / de bas lce yi skyon bral tshe/ /tshigs su bcad pa mchog bzung ste/ /nyin mtshan dus gsum klags —370—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /(bklagasakagyur na/ /kun gyi bde ba tshe 'dir 'grub/ /gang yang dge ba'i rtsa ba dag /gcig tu bsdus te mchog tu bsngo/ /rtag tu dge ba'i smon lam btab/ /de ni dam pa'i spyod pa yin/ /nyams su long dang gdams pa yin/ /zhes chos kyi char ba du ma phab pas/ yab yum gnyis la dad pa chen po rab tu 'khrungs te/ mig mchi ma 'dzag cing bu la 'di skad ces smras pa/ chos kyi char ba rab tu phab/ /ji ltar rgyal pos mnar gyur te/ /dam chos gtong bar mi byed na/ /da lta lus dang srog 'bral zhes/ /gnad la bsgar yang mi g.yo ba/ khyod kyi gsung rnams nyams su blangs/ /dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ /dge ba thams cad mchog tu bsngo/ /smon lam dag pas bar mtshams sbyar/ /dga' bzhin spro bzhin thar bar 'gro/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu smra zhing sgra ldan gyi yul gang na skye bo du ma tshogs pa'i dbus su bu khyer zhing 'gro 'dug gi spyod lam byas pas skye bo thams cad ya mtshan du skyes shing yab yum gsum gang na yod pa'i sar 'khod de/ rin chen snying po pha ma'i pang na gnas pa zhig la me tog dag 'thor/ gos legs po dag 'bul zhing / chos zhus pas/ /rin chen snying po'i zhal nas/ grong khyer dbus kyi skye bo rnams/ /yud tsam zhig la 'du byed cing / /tha mar mi sdod myur du 'deng / /de bzhin lus dang tshe srog kyang / /yud tsam zhig la 'du byed cing / /mi rtag lus dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ /e ma sa dang gnam dag la/ /byol song rgyu ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /mi lus rnyed pa mkhar che che / / lag sor gshog par ma gyur cing / /mchu can sder mor ma gyur bar/ /las dang bsod nams skal bar ldan / / mi lus rin chen rnyed do kun/ /rwa can rmig pa mjug ma can/ /mche ba can dang rkang bzhi ba/ /dbang med bsad bkol sdug bsngal khur/ /nges par gsod kyang gti mug ste/ /'bros dang slu bar mi byed par/ /mchi ma 'dzag cing rab tu 'khrun/ /de 'dra'i lus su ma skyes par/ /srid pa'i mi lus thob dus su/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma ma bsgrubs na/ /nam zhig tshe srog 'gags pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal dpag med myong gyur na/ /bzod dam soms la dam chos mdzod/ /mi yi lus 'di srid pa tsam/ /srid pa bdud kyis ma bslus par/ /btsan sa zin la skyabs su song / /bdud rigs sha dang khrag la dga'/ /skye 'chi'i phreng ba rgyun du gtong / /phal cher dmyal ba dag tu skyur/ /la la yi dwags gnas su 'phen/ /la la byol song nyid du skyur/ /an lcags mtshon gyis brgyab pa yi/ /ngan btson dag la sdug zer na/ /lus ni stong phrag du mar btub/ /res 'ga' khro chu khol mar 'tshod/ /res 'ga' 'khyags shing sha rus 'byed/ /res 'ga' me yi 'obs la sdod/ /bskal ba brgyar yang sdug mi rdzogs / / tsha grang sdug bsngal mi bzod pa/ /thog tu bab na ji ltar bya/ /mi dge'i las ni chu rgyun bzhin/ /dge ba'i las ni srid pa tsam/ /e ma ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /bcos su yod do 'dir tshogs kun/ /yod bzhin —37/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'chos par mi byed par/ /nam 'ong cha med de myong na/ /'gyod de 'phyis so sems can pa/ /gdams pa yin gyis shes par mdzod/ /de ring nyid nas bsgrub (sgrub3par rigs/ /rtag pa'i tshe ni su yang med/ /cesasmrasapa dang / skye bo'i tshogs de dag dad pa'i mchi mas mig gang / sa ra ta'i yul du sleb pa bzhin du/ lus kyi ba spu langs / kye ma do nub 'chi bar mi 'gyur ram/ bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal mi myong ngam/ sprul pa'i sku bdag cag thugs rjes zung shig go sla zhing nyams su blang bde ba'i chos de lta bu bstan pa bka' drin che'o/ /bdag cag rnams ma grol gyi bar du/ /gnas gar yang gshegs pa'i skabs med 7do// khyed btsan sa zin pas bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs gnas mdzod cig khyed kyi gsung lhag chad med par bdag cag rnams kyis dang du blangs te/ drin can gyi pha ma gzhan ma 'drongs kyang / /re zhig rang gis btsan sa gzung bar bya'i btsan sa zin nas ma zin pa dag kyang drang bar bab bo/ /zhes zhus pa dang / rin chen snying po'i zhal nas/ lha ru dkon mchog bsten na byin rlabs su btsan sa'i rgyal srid ster/ grogs su brtson 'grus bstan na chosamin dang le lo'i bdud 'jig gzhi dad pa dang tshul khrims la byas na yon tan gyi 'bras bu 'phel/ 'khor du ma rabs snying rjes bskyangs na/ ded dpon chos kyi rgyal po thob rtag tu bzod pa'i go cha gyon na dgra bo thams cad gnyen du 'du/de ni bdag gi gdams pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa skye bo gang dang gang la de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan/ mi dge ba'i ngag thams cad bsdams pas ngag 'khyal ba dgras btsal kyang mi rnyed/ e ma dgra mi mnga' mod kyis ngag 'khyal ye mi mnga' ba'i tha tshig go /de ltar na gnas gang du bzhugs/ grogs su dang 'grogs/ spyod lam ci byed kyang chos kyi gtam 'ba' zhig las ngag 'khyal ba'i gtam gang yang ma smras so/ /de ltar na pha ma dag dgra (sgra3ldan gyi skye bo rnams yang dag pa'i chos la bkod/ thams cad kyi ngan song gi sgo khegs par gyur to//legs pa'i shes rab/ khye'u rin chen snying po ni rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid do/ /rin chen snying po zhes bya ba dus gsum gyi rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chos kyi gnas lugs so/ /yab rje'u rin chen ni/ se btsun chen po'o/ /yum gser phreng ni/ paṇḍi ta sgra'i tsher ma'o/ /pha ma gnyis khyim par bsten pa tsam du zad kyis/ nyon mongs pa mi mnga'o / kho bo de'i tshe bde ba can na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston cing gnas so/ /rin chen snying po dag 'bral ba ni med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar/ 'khyal ba'i tshig rnamasaspang bya zhing / /rtag tu ngag ni bsdam par bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyesarabs bstan pa las/ khye'u rin chen snying por ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bcu gsum pa'o// //—372—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pha14 grong khyer sgra ldan du khye'u padmar sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilelga/ka 163 na7 rgogrong khyer sgra ldan du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa khye'u pad mar sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bsdokyigs sa//༄tsho/ /yang yer ba lha ri'i snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ jo bo dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho thun mong du phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa 'phul/ khyad par du dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal la byi dor legs par byas te dung dkar po'i rgyan bkod nas phul te/ thal mo sbyar nas/yang zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di na mar la/ bla ma mkhan po mthong ba'i tshe/ /gus pas rim gro bskyed par bya/ /gang zag chos kyi mig can dang / /las dang po yi sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes bskyed/ ces gsungs gda' na/ bshes gnyen 'brom 'dis/sngon bla ma dang mkhan po la dang ba'i dad pas gus pa gtso bor byas te rim gro ji ltar mdzad/ gang zag chos kyi mig can rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes ji lta bu bsgoms/ las dang po ba'i sems can la ston pa'i 'du shes ji ltar bzhag sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes ji ltar bskyed/ kha tsang nas kyang rgyas par byung mod kyis/ da dung 'di bstan pa'i zhar la skyes rabs khyad par can 'ong bar gda' bas ston par zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ yang sngon grong khyer sgra ldan na/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba la/ chung ma me tog 'dzin zhes bya ba cig yod pa la sras shig 'khrungs te/ de yang bzhin bzang ba mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba lta bas chog mi shes pa cig byung / der pha ma gnyis dang gzhi che bas rab tu byung ba mang po spyan drangs nas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byed pa la lan cig paṇḍi ta ba su ban dhu zhes bya ba cig
