thar pa la tshul khrims gtsang la chog tu mi 'dzin pa cig dgos / brtul zhugs bzang la mchog tu mi 'dzin pa cig dgos/ lta ba bzang la der ma zhen cing mchog tu mi 'dzin pa cig dgos/ sems can re re'i phyir yang dka' spyad du ma bzod pa bdag dang gzhan du brje ba cig dgos / bstod smad dang thob ma thob pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo mnyam pa'i phyir du lo 'dod —402—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dang / grags pa dang / rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba ngan pa phugs su zhugs te phyi gnyen po'i sgo dam dam ltar snang yang / sgo cha dam po don med par mi rigs pas/ rang gi yon tan rin po che'i gter bzhin du dgos du ma gtogs par sped pa 'jig rten gyi sgron ma thams cad dang mthun/ jo bo'i grwa pa 'di na kho bo las rgan pa med de / jo bo'i yon tan phar zhog /bshes gnyen pa'i yon tan 'di kun la rtse gcig nas bltas kyang zab cing rgya che bas brjod ngo mi shes par gda'/ des rang re'i gtam cal col du song gis dogs pa dang / bdud sde'i rigs ni yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i chos dang gang zag la bzod bsran chung bas bdud sde gang nas ldang mi shes snyam ste/ rang dang rang re'i kha 'og tu 'du ba ma gtogs pa la yon tan/ rang brjod pa med/ rang re'i ngos nas re sa dang skyabs gzhan med tsa na blo phugs gtad pa yin pas thugs kyis 'dzin par zhu gsung /lo tsā ba'i zhal nas / chos dang mthun par byed na grogs po yin/ bstan pa ster na bla ma yin/ byin pa len zhing lag len la/ 'debs na slob ma yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar /ka 186 ba6 rgon//rtag tu sdig dang dga' bral bas/ /gang du mtho ba'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe nga rgyal gcag bya zhing / /bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par bya/ /zhus pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe/ /sems kyi gzengs ni bstod par bya/ /gnyis ka stong pa nyid du bsgoms(sgomasaka / /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skye rabs bstan pa las/rgyal bu bde mchog tu skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs bco brgyad pa'o// //dza19 chu bo ya mu na'i gling du lha'i rgyal bor sku skye ba bzhes pa'ilelga/ka 187 na1 rgochu bo ya mun gling du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa lha'i rgyal por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u bzhugs so///༄༅/ /yang yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul na/ jo bo yab sras gnyis/ ka ba shākya dbang phyug lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba rnams zhal 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis/ gong ltar phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa dang / khyad par du yang dngul gyi maṇḍal la dung chung gi rgyan bkod nas phul te/ jo bo'i drung du thalamo sbyar nas 'di skad du/ chosakyi gnas lugs rab ston cing / /mi shes 'ching ba dgrol mdzad pa/ /kun gyi bla ma lhar gyur mchog /sngon chad rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ /nyin dang mtshan du btud du byung / /de yang bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ /da yang thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /sngon nas skye mchog dam pa na'ang / /ma dag sgrib pas bsgribasapa yi/ /skye bo long ba du ma yis/ /e ma rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas mchog /bod kyi mig cig rin po che/ /—403—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dgos 'dod 'byung bar ma mthong bar/ /skye bo rang mtshan nyid du 'khrul/ /rgyal ba bzhugs bzhin 'di 'dra na//mi cig mya ngan 'das gyur te/ /bsgrubs kyang sgrib pas ma 'grub tshe/ /rmongs pa'i skye bo mi 'gyod dam/ khyed kyi mdzad tshul thos pa dang / /skal ba bzang ngo spyan ras gzigs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /'bral glags med do brtse ba che/ /da ni lus stong zhig gyur kyang / khyed dang bral bar mi bya'o/ /e ma drin can bla ma mchog khyed la 'dren pa'i mthu dpal mnga'/ /nga ni mi lus tshul khrims lung / /dad pa'i khug pa 'dren par bde / / bdag 'dra'i las can mi 'dzin na/ /las med 'drongs par ji ltar 'gyur/ /ding sang tshe tshad yar la brgal / / tshe lhag spyod pa mkhar rje bzang / /rgan po yal bar ma dor cig /nyi ma rgas pa'i 'od zer ltar/ /gsal bo ma de nub la lha/ra/ /nyi mjug 'de ba lnga brgya tsam/ /nam zhig kho bo pha rol tshe/ /e ma bdag cag mun par 'thoms/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub par 'gyur/ /dbang yod bzhin du phyin pa skad/ /bdag cag bzhag nas gar 'gro zhes/ /smre sngags 'don bzhin ngu ba'i tshe/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /mthu stobs dbang gis bskyab tu gsol/ /dbugs phyung mya ngan zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag kyang zhing khams dag par skyol / / lam gyi bar chad bsal du gsol/ /de ni bdag gi gsol ba'o/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nga la nyon/ /'bras bu rgyu yi rjes su 'brang / /phra zhing phra ba'i rgyu 'bras ni/ /zab cing phra ste rtogs par dka'/ /rgyu 'bras phra mo khyad gsod pa'i/ /lta ba mthon po las kyis bslu / / shes la lag len mi byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa de las rmongs pa med/ /mi shes mi byed nyes pa chung / zhas nas mi byed khyad gsod pa'i/ /log lta can de dmyal bar 'gro khres par mdzod cig bshes gnyen pa/ /dge dang mi dge'i rgyu 'bras la/ /phra yang blang dor mkhas par mdzod/ /de ltar gyur na kho bos 'dzin/ /'jig rten sgron ma kun gyis sras/ /smon lam dbang bas bsam pa 'grub/ /'bras bu bzang ngo bshes gnyen pa/ /las can lnga brgya'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /thar dang thar ba'i lam mchog ston/ /rgas kyang bya ba bzang por spyod/ /zhum par ma byed dge bshes pa/ /zhes gsung / jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs nas/ /yon tan rgya mtshos ma bcings par/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos byin brlabs pa'i/ /grub thob brgya rtsa'i gnas mchog / ting 'dzin 'phel ba'i pho brang 'dir/ /bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos dang dam tshig rab brtan pa'i/ /smon lam mthu btsan bdag cag gnyis/ /bzang po'i 'brel par 'gro ba'i tshe/ shwakya'i dge slong gnas 'dir byon/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i skyes rabs mchog /rba rlabs nor bu ster ba de/ /yun du mi thogs khyod kyis blangs/ /ye nas bzang po mi phyed pa/ /ding sang rkyen gyis brtan par mdzad/ /da yang bstan pa bskyang ba'i —404—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /phyir / / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yun ring dag /gnas pa'i phyir du spyi bos long / /yi ge gcig dang gnyis pa dang / / gsum dang drug pa la sogs pa'i/ /gdams pa thams cad phyin par long / /e ma legs pa'i shes rab khyod/ /'di nas 'pho tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ /dga' ldan padmo rab mdzes pa'i/ /sbubs su shes rab sgron me zhes / / gzungs dang ting 'dzin gsal ba yi/ /gtsang ma'i lha mchog nyid du 'brungs/ /de tshe rgyal ba rgya mtsho yis / / padma'i sbubs nas khyod blangs te/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug drug mchog tu/ /dri ma med pa nga mchod phyir/ /sras 'di sras su bzhes shig ces/ /dga' ba sgrog cing 'bul bar byed/ /dga' bar bsgoms (sgomasakashig shākya'i sras/ /de tshe shākya'i dbang phyug kyang / yākya dri med bya bar 'gyur/ /rje btsun byams pa'i drungs mchog tu / / rgyal sras bzang po dri med nga / /mchod cing gdams pa len par byed/ /dga' bar ba sgoms (sgoms1shig shākya'i sras/ /tshul khrims rgyal ba tshul khrims ldan/ /padma'i sbubs su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos chos ston pa/ /bag chags sad nas nga drung du/ /byams pa mchod cing gdams pa len/ /a mes byang chub me tog dpal/ /me tog sbubs nas me tog tu/ /'pho zhing zhing khams dpag med du/ /bzang po'i bzang po mchod byed cing / /rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byed/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims rab gcang ba'i/ /'brom la dag pa'i snang ba can/ /'ga' re zhing der bde bar spyod/ /gzhan yang bdag dang 'brel ldan rnams//rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bzang po 'dis/ /dngos sam brgyud pas 'dren par byed/ /e ma nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las can/ /sems can spyi dang bye brag la/ /dus drug rtag tu so sor gzigs / / e ma gsol ba 'debs so lha/ /byin gyis rlobs shig spyan ras gzigs/ /rab med sgrol zhig gru bo che/ /ma 'dul bsdus shig phyag stong pa/ /gang la'ang gzigs shig spyan stong mchog khyod yod rgyal ba ma lus yod/ khyod med 'gro ba'i bde ba zad/ khyod kyi yon tan rgyal bas kyang / /brjod par mi nus rlabs che na//e ma sbas pa ma grags sam/ /tshig tsam ma yin snying nas smras/ /nges par dgongs pa brtse bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ spyan snga na lo tsā ba ka ba/ rngog mchis pa gsum po na re/ bla ma dam pa a ti sha yang 'di skad gsung pa na/ bdag cag lta bu'i long 'on mig rna bas bslus pa/ yon tan de lta bu yod bzhin du ma mthong /dam pa rnams kyi yon tan brgyud mar brjod cing yod bzhin du ma thos/ /da gzod rab rib can la sman btang ba bzhin du/ yon tan gyi cha shas mthong ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin/ sman gzhan la brten nas mngon sum du thos pa'i dus tshod kyang byung zhing yus che ba'i sgo nas spyan chab kyang du ma byung / de'i mod la rngog gi spyan chab phyis te / nga dag pa'i snang ba rgya chen po'i gleng mo la zad pa'i dus med/ yang zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di na mar la/—405—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gang du chags sdang yul byung tshe/ /sgyu ma sprul ba bzhin du lta/ /mi snyan tshig rnams thos pa'i tshe/ /brag cha bzhin du blta bar bya/ /lus la gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las su blta bar bya/ /zhes gsungs gda' na/ bshes gnyen pa 'dis/ sngon chags sdang byung ba la sgyu ma dang sprul ba lta bu ji ltar mdzad/ mi snyan pa'i tshig gsan pa'i tshe na brag cha bzhin du ji ltar dgongs/ lus la na tsha la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung ba'i tshe na/ sngon gyi las su ji ltar mkhyen par mdzad/ bla mas gsung du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i 'kha nas/ sngon chu bo ya mun na'i gling zhes bya ba na/ lha'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ rgyal srid gzhan dang thun mong ma yin par rang gi gling de na gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad chos bzhin du bskyangs te/ kun gzhi bzang zhing chos la dkar ba zhig yod pa la sras med par 'di snyam du sems te/ nga la nges par 'byung ba ster ba'i sbyin bdag cig byung na/ nga rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu 'byung ba yin pa la/ de'i sbyin bdag cig nam rnyed dam snyam du nyin dang mtshan du/ lus kyis bskyed pa'i bu tshe 'di'i zang zing gi rgyal srid 'dzin par byed pa ni nga la med/ rab tu byung bas chos kyi rgyal po byas te/ chos kyis bskyed pa'i bu nam zhag gtan du chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bu zhig bskyed par bya'o snyam du dus 'da' bar byed na'ang nges par 'byung ba'i sbyin bdag ma rnyed/ der lha'i rgyal po'i rtogs pa la/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa 'di chos skyong bzang / lha phun sum tshogs lha rnams kyang spyan dang mngon par shes pa la thogs pa med/ rdzu 'phrul gzhan gyi rnal 'byor ba'i blor mi shong ba 'gyed mkhyen na/ bdag gi dbugs ci ste mi 'byin snyam du yus shin tu che ba'i sgo nas/ lha gsum la gsol ba drag po btab pa na/ byis pa ral bu se nyil le pa rin po che 'bar ba'i 'khar ba khyer ba cig rtsar byung nas/ rgyal po khyod sgo rtsa na thar bas ga na chog sems can gyi tshogs shin tu mang na/ de dag khyed kyi pha mar ma gyur ba ni cig kyang med/ khyod nges par byung ste/ bsod snyoms kyis zas kyi 'tsho zhing nyan thos kyi tshul du mdzad na/ gzhan don rgya chung 'gro de bas rgyal srid zung la sems can gyi don gyis/ khyad par du'ang gling 'di na khyod gnya' khung du khur ba las/ gzhan khur ba ma yin pa grong khri tham pa gda' bas/ de dag gis btsan sa zin par gyis/ gzhan yang chu bo ya mu na'i 'gram na khyod rang gi bla ma di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na bya ba yod pas de'i drung du song la the tshom chod dang / nged dang mi mthun pa mi 'ong ma 'ongs pa tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba sems can ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i dpa' bo chen po 'byung ste/ de'i bstan pa snyigs ma'i dus la nye ba na/ byang chub semasadapa' sgrib pa rnam par sel bsakhyod bskul te/ bod mtha' 'khob gyi yul du/ glo bur du rgyal po'i bya ba mdzad de/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i gzhi 'cha'/ skye bo mang po bde skyid la 'god/ de'i dus su da ltar gyi khur dang mthun par 'byung —406—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ste / khyod ni sprul ba'i rgyal po yin pas/ /ka 189 ba3 rgodang po/'di nas 'ong dang / tha ma 'dir 'gro bya ba la sogs pa'i nges nges tig tig med par mngon shes dang ldan pa'am/ skye bo pho tshod can dag na re/ gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi steng na gshegs bzhud byed pa'i grags pa 'byung / khyod kyi rjes su/ka 189 ba4rgo (gnam gyi/)khri bdun (bar gyi)lde gnyis (ltengs gcig)legs (sa la/)drug ces bya ba la sogs pa khyod kyi sprul ba bco lnga tsam 'ong zhing bar skabs shig tu/ nub phyogs nas bdud sde zhig sems can gyi las la brten nas khyod kyi rigs su(glang dar ma/)sprul te/ gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum pa la/ chos dang dpal 'byor dar ba la shin tu ma bzod nas/ khyod kyi bstan pa dang / de skyong bar byed pa dag shin tu nyams par byed do / / kye rgyal po/ de'i dus su yang khyod kyi sprul ba zhig gis bdud (lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/) /sde de bkum par byed do/ /kye rgyal po chen po/ /ka 189 ba6 rgokhri ral pa can yar chad/chu bo ya mu na'i 'gram na/ sprul pa'i byang chub sem/sa dpa' di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba yod pas/ bod mtha' 'khob cha gsum du byas pa'i dbus kyi cha'i bar du sprul ba du ma bkye ste/ dge 'dun gyi sde bsam gyis mi khyab par byed do/ /gtsug lag khang thams cad dar zhing rgyas par byed do/ /bdud sde thams cad pham par byed do/ kye rgyal po chen po khyod kyis/ bod mtha' 'khob kyi yul jer/ chos kyi rgyal po bco lnga/ khyim bdag rje'u'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa ni lnga/ de ltar na nyi shu tham pa ni 'jig rten khyim pa dang bstun te/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o / / gzhan yang zhi ba'i sprul ba dang / drag po'i sprul pa dang / yig 'bru'i sprul ba dang / gzings dang / zam pa dang / bzhon pa dang/ bran g.yog dang / bu dang / sman la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te/ mtha' 'khob tu sems can gyi don byed na/ de dang de'i dus su sems can las dang ldan pa phal che ba mi thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams su 'gro/ phal che ba ni zhing khams dag pa gzhan du 'gro/ phal che ba ni dbus kyi sa der thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa grags pa can /ka190 na5 rgo (srong btsan sgom po/)zhig gis rgya nag dang / bal po'i sanas sgrol ma (ong jo/)dang khro(bal za/) / gnyer can gyi sprul pa spyan drangs te/ mtha' 'khob kyi nang nas yul gyi dbus de chos gnas pa'i yul gyi dbus su byed do/ /de'i dus su dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun mang po der 'dus/ de'i dus su mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan nas brjod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku mthong zhing / chos nyan pa dang / gsung yi ge 'bru drug pa la sogs pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rim par ngo 'phrod de/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags ltar sgrog pa dang / mdo don snying rje chen po rab tu rgyas par byed pa la sogs pa po ta la'i zhing khams dang mtshungs par —407—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsuri chos kyi skor/'byung der lha'i rgyal po'i thugs ka nas khye'u dkar po zhig thon nas byung ste/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig 'gro ba drug rang grol bar gyur cig e ma gzhon nu gser ral can/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i 'khar ba can/ /kun tu bzang zhes 'gro ba'i dpal/ /mya ngan mi 'da' nga la gson/ /ji srid nam mkha' khyab gyur na/ /'gro ba drug kyang de dang mnyam/ /thams cad nyon mongs me lcer mched/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /me tshad zhi bar mdzad gyur kyang / /las rngams che bas bsil ma gyur/ /e ma semasacan grangasalas 'das/ /brjod med lam dag lam mchog la/ /bkod kyang bri bar cung ma nus/ /sems can lasazad gyur ba na/ /rgyal ba stobs chen mthu ldan kyang / /bsgral bar mi nus btang snyoms rigs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od gsal kyang / /sa 'og rdzas rnams gsal mi nus/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /sman chen mkhasapa'i man ngag ltar/ /sman dpyad du mas gsos gyur kyang / /tshe zad ma shi bu skyon min/ /de bzhin mtha' 'khob yul du yang / /spyan ras gzigs la skad cig tsam/ /nyon mongs gdungs pa'i sems can rnams/ /'dren par mi byed ga la mnga'/ /'on kyang dmu rgod log lta can/ /'dren par ma nus skyon ma yin/ /sems can spyi mthun las dbang gis/ /chos kyi ming can chos dgra de/ /bdag gi'ang dgrar gyur bkum byed na/ /nga la rtog med dgra bshes bral/ /'on kyang bstan pa bskyang phyir du/ /nga yi sprul bas bkum par byed/ /de nas chos rgyal 'byung 'gyur zhing / /slar yang chos 'byor rgyas par 'gyur/ /mtha' 'khob rgyal po du ma zhig /'byung ste phal cher chos rgyal yin/ /sdig rgyal dag ni srid par zad/ /nga dang nga yi sprul pa yis/ /srid pa nyid na 'jomasapar byed / / de ltar dgongs sam kun tu bzang / /'di'i skabs su ka ba'i zhal nas/ ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi rgyal rabs cig der kyang byung / jo bo rin po che lags/ bod du'ang rgyal po du ma zhig byung ba la phal cher yang chos rgyal de dag kyang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sprul ba yin par 'dug pa la/ de ring sna rtse zhig rnyed pas/ jo bos/rgyal rabs 'di tsho'i yin lugs shig bstan par zhu/ rgyal rabs 'di sngar kyang grags pas yi ger cis kyang 'god par zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ nga bod du'ang yun ring po song / nga'i gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa dag ni rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i chos bsten nas lam la bkod/ da re zhig bod na nga'i gdul bya tsam med/ 'di thams cad kyang rgyal ba rgya mtsho khong rang gi zhing khams yin/ sngar yang rgyal rabs thams cad gter yig tu bkod pa las/ bshad pa dang bcas te yi ger bkod pa med de/ kho bo sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can zhig yin/sngon lha ma srin 'dul ba'i dus su bsam yas na gter du sbas pa yod de/ nga'i sprul ba zhig gis 'don/ de nas rab tu byung ba thams cad gzhi tshul khrims la 'god pa'i dus su/ gter du sbas pa yod de/ de yang nga'i —408—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sprul ba zhig gis 'don/ de thams cad kyang 'jol mo nyog tu mi sgrog rgyal po'i bka' chems rim pa gsum rgyal rabs dang bcas pa ni/ sped mkhan yang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgyal po nyid kyang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/de'i blon po thabs la mkhas pa'ang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sprul ba/ de dag gi gter phal che ba ni lha sa nyid na yod de/ sngon skye ba snga ma phan chad du/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal por ji ltar 'gyur ba dang / des mdzad pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang / mdzad pa thams cad gter du ji ltar sped pa dang / gnyer kha mkha' 'gro mas ji ltar byed pa dang / deng sang ngas ka ba bum pa can nas gter yig ji ltar 'don tshul dang /mkha' 'gro mas ston tshul dang / dus 'di srid cig na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi bu slob ming can 'di tsam zhig 'byung ba ni/ sngon gyi dus na 'di yin la sogs pa nyid 'phros du ma zhig yod pa de dag bskal bar brjod kyang mi rdzogs/ da hril de gril (dril3na/ sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul bar grags te/ /ral ba can la sogs pa gcig gnyis ('jam dpal/) rigs ga'an (phyag rdor/)gnyis kyi rigs yin la/ phal che ba ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yin la/ mkhan brgyud byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na nyid yin gyis gzhan du ma sems shig gsungs nas spyan hur mdzad pas/ gzugs ma mthong ba'i sgra snyan pa cig tho phyi na yod pa'i khyi tshun chad kyisakyang thosapar gyur te/ khyi rnams phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed/ lha re snying po yang yom yom byed pa la/ yer ba na gnas pa'i skye bo dag na re/ 'di 'dra ba'i ltas shig ci yin nam/ nang par pha ston la dri dgos zer zhing gleng / der drung na 'khod pa kun rig pa thams cad 'ur nas song / yar la langs te 'khrab snying 'dod pa byung /yang re zhig na jo bo'i zhal nas/ mkhan brgyud du ma zad dge slong byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rdo rje'i thugs dang ldan pa mtsho skyes rdo rje(padma 'byung gnas)ni rgya gar na 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po cig gi sprul par kyang grags te/ dpal he ru ka'i bzhed pas ni kho bo kho na yin par byed/ gdul bya'i dbang gis bod khams 'dir lan gnyis gsum zhig 'ongs te sprul ba'ang de ltar du bstan to/ /de'i lo rgyus ni sngags pa phal che ba la grags pas khyed rnams la shes 'dod kyang med pas bstan mi 'tshal/ gzhan yang nga'i yon tan skye ba snga phyi du mar 'byung tshul ni/ mkhas pas bltas na mdo sde du ma na shin tu gsal bar yod de/ 'dir bla ma du ma bsten tshul la sogs pa dang / dka' spyad du ma byas pa dang / yi dam kyi lha du ma'i zhal mthong ba dang / mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi yon tan yod tshul/ lo tsā ba khyod rang gi rnam thar chen mor bkod pa la sogs pa gang zag gang gis gang la bsten nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na'ang yi ge du ma 'bri bas de dag tu shes par mdzod —409—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/cig lar khyed rnams la yon tan de dag la shes 'dod med de thugs la gsal/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi yon tan ni mdo rgyud du ma nas spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa dang 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas de dag la mkhyen pa can thams cad thugs rtse gcig tu mthun/ khyed rang yang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yongs su rdzogs par ltos shig ming gnya' khri btsan po zer na'ang gyis shig lha sems can gyi las la brten nas kha na ma tho ba med par ri rgyal lhun po ltar brjid chags par gnas pa lha tho tho ri zer na'ang gyis shig tho ba ni sems can gyi las la brten nas 'byung snying 'dod pa'o/ /ri zhes bya ni 'jam dbyangs kyi bzhed pas gdug rtsub can phye ma leb kyi gshog pa lta bus bskyod par mi nus pa la zer la/ kun tu bzang po ni sems can las bzang po can gyi snang ba la chos rgyal de lta bu 'byung ba ni/ ri bo zhes dper na nyo tshong lta bu la dper byas pa'o/ /gzhan ni gzhan du 'dogs te/ de la rgyu mtshan med do/ /gzhan yang thugs sgam pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma yo bar srong ba dang / rang gi thugasarje la gang gis kyang bar chad bya bar mi nusapas btsan pa ste/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yinapas/ srong btsan sgam po ste de skad zer na'ang gyis/ sngon zhing khams shig tu bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ nye ba'i sras bdun gyis gsol ba btab ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gzhi/ thabs shes rab gnyis su mi rtog pa rdo rje bsnol ba'i khri mi yo bar srong bar mdzad pa/ bdud sde gang gis kyang bar chod mi tshugs pas lha btsan po zhes 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhed pas khri srong lde btsan/ /ka 192 na6 rgo (de'i sras snga ma mu ne btsan po dang / mu tig btsan po gnyis/ sras phyi mo khri lde srong btsan te/ de la sad na legs 'jing yon kyang zer la/ des rgyal srid bzung ngo / /de la sras gsum gtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral pa can du grags/ lheb rje la sogs pa lnga tsam yong la lags sam yang gleng / gtsang mas rgyal srid bzung ngo / /glang dar ma'i sras ni/ 'od srungs dang / yum brtan no/ /phyag rdor gyi sprul pa khri gtsug lde btsan dpal gyis rgyal srid bzung ngo / /de'i nyan blon po sdig can gyis bkrongs nas/ khri glang dar ma u dum can gyis rgyal srid bzung ste bstan pa bsnubs de'ang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs so/ ) / zer na'ang gyis/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin pas yum brtan zer na'ang gyis/ phyag stong spyan stong dbu bcu gcig las 'od zer 'phros te sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ngan song srung bar byed pas na 'od srungs zer na'ang gyis/ 'on te yang bod na rgyal po'i 'og nas rigs bzang ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zer na'ang gyis/ gzhan yang da lta 'dzam bu'i gling na mtshan stong phrag gcig dang lnga brgya yod de/ rang rang gi snang ngo re la 'char lugs re re'i 'bod tshul du ma cig yod de/ sprul ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad spyod de rang yin/ ngo mtshar che bya ba las mang po smos rgyu med / nga dga' ldan du song ba'i nyin bar nas bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma nub kyi bar la dbus gtsang du —410—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /byin gyis brlabs shing / sprul pa'i slob ma kho rang dang dbyer med pa'i/ rin chen gsal nas bzung ste/ slob ma ming can /ka 192 ba5 rgo (spyir gang zag 'bum dang lnga stong las/)sum brgya dang brgyad/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa lnga brgya dang lnga bcu (cu) tham pa/ gzhan yang tshul khrims la gces spras su mdzad pa (dgu khri dang stong drug brgya dang zhe gnyis/)du ma zhig 'byung ste/ bsdoms (gsum po/)na/ khri phrag brgyad dang (dgu khri dang nyis stong lnga brgya tham pa/) / brgya phrag brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung ngo/ /de las gzhan pa dag ni rtags 'dzin pa'o//zhes gsungs pa'i 'phro la/ dge slong dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhes pa cig der byon pa dang / jo bo khag ste bzhengabatanas/ gnas brtan chen po byon pa thugs la btags gsungs pa dang / dge slong de'i zhal nas/snyigs ma'i dus kyi dge sbyong gi kun spyod cig khyed gsung bar 'dug pa la/ nga yang nyan du 'ongs pa yin/ der jo bo'i zhal nas/ e ma phal cher grogs ngan gis bslu/ phal cher khe tshong 'dod pas khyer/ phal cher chang sgog dus min zas la chags/ dgra bcom pa nye bar 'khor gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tshul khrims gtsang ma me tog padma ltar / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gnas pa'i gzhir gyur ba rnams la bka' gdams nyan thos kyi chos zer nas/rang gi chul khrims kyi btsan sa ma zin par/ theg po chen po'i kha lta gnam la phyar nas/ ngan song gi sna rdo sa la thug pa'i gang zag 'ong / tshe 'di kho na'i skyabs gnas dge sbyong gi cha lugs la byed/ nyon mongs pa can thams cad kyi rgyan cha'ang dge slong gi gos la byed/ grong nag gi bcan mdzod dgon par byed/ /dge slong gi spyil bu na byisapa ngu / gcug lag khang gi khyams smad dang / bla yi dag tu bud med la la dag bal 'khal/ la la dag zhud bzhu / la la dag thags 'gran 'thag byed/ e ma 'phongs rar tshogs shing nyon mongs pa'i gtam lab/ snang ba dag dag na re/ bzhi sde tsam zhi/ga byed zer/ dge sbyong la skye dman gyis phyag zhu zhe sa mi ldang / la la dag na re / jo bo su zhig mo 'di gzugs bzang bzhin mdzes 'byor ba yod zer nas ngo ci zin du 'dzin/ dge sbyong gi gzugs dag kyang 'di nga'i ma sring yin zer nas grong khyim bzhin du rang gi spyil bur ma sring bcol le sdod/ /sku ma kho'i ma sring yin te/ gzhan gyi min pas grogs mched mag skud du song ba mang / mchod khang du/ gnya' gzhol dang / mda' dong dang / grong khyim pa'i gos slog dag bzhag khyim pa'i mal zhabs na mar/ rab tu byung ba'i3sdur smig dag nyig nyig 'jog glegs bam gyi steng du gos dang mar me'i stegs byed/ nged chos kyi bdag po skadazeng nas chos la ji mi snyam par/ sku regs dang na bzas mi 'ching bar yig 'bru la sa yab 'thor bas byed pa'i dus tshod/ mkhas pas btsun po khyad du gsod/ btsun pos mkhas pa khyad du gsod/ sgom chen gyi ge bsam khyad du gsod/ thos bsam pas bsgom pa khyad du gsod/ rang las mtho ba mi theg dma' ba —411 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mi skyong / rang dang mnyam pa la 'gran sems kyis chags shing sdang / gnas brtan pas tshe dang ldan pa gral mtho/'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa gral gyi mjug na gnas/ nyon mongs pas phyug pa dang / ngo tsha dang khrel gzhud med pa dag ni gral gyi 'go na gnas/ e ma snyigs ma'i bstan pa ni chu dang 'dra/ bzang po gser gyi sbram bu dang 'dra ba ni gting du bying ste steng du mi theg /ngan pa sbar sbur dang 'dra ba ni steng du bteg bzang btsun yon tan gyi gang bu ni kha zhan dbang chung / ngan pa thamasacad kha 'gril te de la 'phya/ de ni snga dus brjod/ da dus gleng / e ma ho zhes yid 'byung / de'i dus su dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ming btags nas/ slob ma mkhasabatsun dman cha len pa dag la/ khyod skyid dam ja sun cig 'thung / lto khams cig zo/ khyod 'dra ba'i spyor ba lhod pa kha ning nas nga'i kha la nyan na lto gos kyang 'di bas grag (drag3pa cig 'obam̐ ba yin te/ zhing du ma de yang mi la skyel/ da mi gral du sdod pa la gos re tsam med na'ang / gzhan gyi rngan can byed pa yin zer nas/bstod 'os de la smad 'os su byed/ khur 'os de la gnon 'os su byed/ lha dang 'dra ba de la rje sa mi ster bar 'dre dang 'dra ba'i tshul khrims 'chal pa nor phyir 'chor ba nyon mongs pa'i gang bu de la ston pa la sogs pa'i ming snyan pa nasa'abod/ bstod/ khur/ rje saster/ zhabasatog che/ pho rusache/ gcesaphrug yin/ skyesapa yin zer / mi phan yang phan du re ngo bsrung / e ma slob ma che chung chags sdang che chung la byed/ sdig spyod rgyal blon dang / gnas brtan las byed pa dang / nang khrims pa dang / gang zag lasabyed rnamasakyi spyod pa la/ bdag gi bla ma klu sgrub la sogs pa ni smad pa'i gnas su byas nas/ mi skye bar smon lam 'debs na/ de'i dus su ni de dag pher mi pher gyi rjes su dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba 'brang / tshul khrims mi bsrung ba rnamasakyi bshad pa byed cing / tshul khrims can la 'phya/ meongs pa rnams kyis mkhas pa rnams la kha bshad zer nas 'phya/ rmongs pa rnams chos gtam 'phel/ zog po rnams lta ba mtho/ de 'dra ba'i dus su/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ma gtogasapa / 'phags pa dgra bcom pa thams cad zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/ gdul bya ma gzigab(nas rgyal ba rnams mi 'byon/ snying rje chen po rnams kyang de dag la shin tu brtse mod kyi/ las 'brel med pa'i stobasakyis brtse ba kho nar zad/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni thabs du ma la brten nas las kyi 'brel ba phra zhing phra ba'ang 'jog par byed do/ /des na shākya dbang phyug tshad mar 'dzin na/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnasakyis sprul pa'i rgyal rabs dang / bar skabs su sems can gyi lasal brten nas/ sdig to'i rgyal po sprul ba'i rgyal pos dngos su 'dul ba dang / gzhan gyis mi mngon par 'dul ba la sogs pa rgyal rabs kyi bem chag tu 'byung bsade dag tu blta bar bya'i/ 'dir ni bshad kyisami lang bas mi spro'o/ /legs pa'i shes rab/ de'i dus su lha'i rgyal po —412—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /de dang / kun tu bzang po'i sprul ba gnyis gsung gleng byed pa'i 'phro la'ang mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khye'u'i gzugs su lha'i rgyal po'i thugs ka nas 'thon te sems can gyi las la brten nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung tshulatsho gsungs so/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po dang / thugs ka nas phyung ba'i khye'u dkar po dang / kun tu bzang po'i sprul ba'i khye'u dang 'grogs te/ chu bo ya mu na'i 'gram du byon pa na/ shing ljon pa cig gi drung na rtswa'i steng du / khri snyan sa le'i pags pa bting ba la/ dge slong chos gos gsum pa spyod lam shin tu mdzes pa cig bzhugs nas gda' ba la/ lha'i rgyal pos phyag gsum btsal bas/ dge slong de'i zhal nas/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la sgrib pa mi mnga' na/ ci ste phyag mdzad gsung / der lha'i rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga gling 'dir grong khyer ba thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pa'i khur gnya' khung na yod na/nga la 'di'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bu med/ nga chos kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i bu 'dod pas rab tu 'byung bar 'tshal na / khye'u 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i 'byung tshul dang bcas pa bdag la bstan nas rab tu 'byung du ma ster bar khyed kyi drung du 'ongs so/ /da ji ltar legs pa bzhin du lung bstan 'tshal zhus pas/ dge slong de'i zhal nas/ kun tu bzang po la 'khrul ba ga la mnga'/ chos rgyal mya ngan med khyod bus ci zhig byed/ khyod de ltar bu dad che na ma 'ongs pa na 'dzam bu'i gling du mchod rten bye ba gyis la rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par gyis/ nga dge slong di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na bya ba/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ring srel gyi mdzod yin pas khyod la ring bsrel yang mang du sbyin/ 'u cag gnyis dpon slob kyi khyad par yin pas/ khyod kyis mchod rten de dag skad cig ma las ring tsam la bzhengs par gyis/ ngas skad cig ma cig las rab gnas grub par bya/ de ltar mdzad na sras gang 'dod pa 'byung / gzhan du na gling phran 'di skyong ba'i bus ci zhig bya/ 'di'i skabs su/ ka ba pa gsum la spyan chab mang du byung / chos rgyal thams cad rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes gsung / da ci nas kyi gnas brtan bgres po bzhengs nas/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la phyag gsum btsal te/ nga jo bo chen po'i bka' legs par bskos pa'i dge slong yin na/ da yun mi ring bar brag rgyab tu btsun chung zhig 'ong gis/ lo re re gnyis gnyis dge 'dun gyi gnyer 'dra ba byed 'tshal/ rgyal ba khyed kyis skyong bar zhu/ re zhig yang gangs chen po ti se la 'gro gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ der dge bshes lo tsā bas de su yin zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de ngas bshad pas chog gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung zhes bya ba/ lha mi thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi dpal las 'khrungs pa cig yin te/ dge bsnyen rgan po ri bong 'dra ba cig la khong gangs kyi seng ge zhig 'dud du 'ong skad de rgod (dgod3re bro/ blo phugs dkon mchog gsum la gtad na ci —413—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yang yod par 'dug g.yin yang 'jig rten gyi snang tshul 'di la tig po mi 'dug jo bo dang / rngeg la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis ni lha'i nang nas kyang gzhung dang phyi thag ring ba spyan ras gathigs su mthong / khu chen po la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis ni 'dre bas kyang btsog pa tsam du mthong / khyed rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gis ni/ mi'i lugs kyi yang chosapa yang rab cig tu mthong / nga rang gis bltas tsa na ni/ rlung bo gang che'i sbur ma/ ston dus kyi khug sprin dang 'dra ba ma dpyad rgyang nge bltas na mthug mthug 'dra ba/ gtugs de bltasapa tsam gyis gar song dang 'dir song med par 'gro ba dang po 'di nas byung gi mdzub bu gtad sa cig kyang mi gda' / da 'dir 'gro yang 'jig rten pa'i kha mngags la byi ba dang snyi mar gda'/ nged tha mal ba kun dang mthun par yang 'brog phrug stabs legs po bdag rkyen thugs rje chen pos mdzad pas/ rgya gar kha sbu can bod du sbyan drangs nas/ sprang mo ma smad bzhin du gar 'gro 'grogasanasasaṃ skṛ ta'i tshig sbram po ni ngasami go yul skad gyi steng nasasnabasa'aphyid pa yan chod/ masaslob cing 'gro/ lugs legasapa tsam la nga'i bu mtshar zhes ma dga' ba bzhin du/ ngas chos skad ma legs pa zhig byung yang / u pa si ka zhes jo bo mnyes/ nga la bod du bka' drin che ba byung ba la/ sdig rgyal nag po glang dar ma bka' drin che/ kho min na/ bod 'dir btsun par yang mi rung ste/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la cir yang mi sgom par/ rab tu byung ba'i rtagasabazung nasarab tu byung ba thams cad bsnubs nas thams cad ser khyim du shor/ da mu stegs pa yin zer ba'i ral ba can thor re ba cig byung nas rab tu byung ba bzhig mi nus te/ rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs re bzung / sman du rdzus nasand thams cad bskyed pa 'di nga 'dra zhig gis nga 'dra'i bstan pa 'jig par byas so/ /der khos cal le col le thams cad tshar bcad nas/ phyogs cig nas bstan pa bsnubs zer te/ phyogs cig nas bstan pa la ga dar byas/ kho min na khyim bdag gi rigs shing swā la zer nas cal col mi byed par pha mes kyi rnam srol bzang po skyong zhing dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa byed pa cig yod pa de yang med/ sngags pa yin byasanasabaskyed rdzogs kyi sgor zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir du/ dam tshig bsrung ba cig yod pa de yang med la/khas mi len ni dgu len/ bsrung rgyu ni sna cig kyang med/ bsgom pa yin byas nasasems kyi sna rtse zhig zin pa'am / lha zhig gi zhal mthong ba'am/ grub rtagasathon pa cig kyang med/ shesapa yin zer nasasde snod gsum blo la bsdog nas/ rang rgyud bslab pa gsum gyis phyug par byas te/ rang yang sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa la spyod/ gzhan yang de la 'god/ gzhan de la spyod pa la'ang mthun 'gyur brjod pa la sogs pa cig kyang mi byed par bstan pa'i bya ba ri tsam pa bas bya dga' sran rdog tsam pa cig la dga'/ e ma nya dang nyung mar bsres —414—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nas 'tshod/ gser gyi khu ba dang snag tsha bsres nas/ gnyis ka yi ge'i rgyu yin zer te/ gser dag bzang ste snag tsha la phan nam/ mar dang spu bsdoms nas longs spyod de/ de spu la ma phan par chud zos par zad/ nged bod kyi sems can 'khobs po che/ gang ma yog par do za/ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa so so skye bos kyang bsrung nus pa cig yod pa de mi thub par/ rdo rje theg pa 'phags pa kho na'i spyod yul du gyur ba de nyams su len/rdo rje theg pa ta ngo mtshar che ste/ de'i gzhi mar gyur ba'i so so thar ba'i rdzing bu ma bsral lam/ e ma khyed grogs po kun la zhu na/ de'i dus su yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig ngos shes pa cig yin na/ nga'i bla mas btsan pa cal col tsho med rting la/ bre khal zhig bkal nas mdo khams su gshegs pa bas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin/ mthu dpal dang mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab par mnga' bas/de gong du rgyal po gcig po de bkum pa las/ de nyid ma bkum par/ nga'i bla ma dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na/ mtsho lasaskyes pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho las skyes pa'i padmo de la brten te 'byung zhing gnas pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sdig to thams cad kyi sems zhi bar byed pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing 'tsho ba de/ rdo rje'i gnas nas sprul bas mdo smad du byon nas bzo ma legs pa gzhi nas bshig nas 'chos pa ltar/mar me shin tu gsal ba lnga las de dang mtshungs pa re re 'phel bar byas te/ nga'i zhing khams 'di chul khrims gtsang ma 'ga' zhig gis gang bar byas/ deng sang yang mar me mdzad sangs rgyas kyi dpal du grags/ kye ma'o / / nga ni 'di 'dra bla ma a ti shas byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha mo sgrol ma bzhugs pa'i lung pa na mar me mdzad dpal gyis byin brlabs pa'i rdo rje sa dar ma zur chag pa cig bcom skad/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zer na (lha lung /)de la zer ba yin/ nga 'dra ba rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes smos rin mi chog zur chag de ni ma rig pa'i glang bu dang 'dra ste/ me tog padmo'i tshal du phyin nas rmig pas brdzi/ de dag gi gseb tu dgar bar mi tshor/mi gtsang ba'i gseb tu btsog par ma tshor/ glang bu la'ang / glang bu skyes te me tog padma brdzis kyis dogs nas/rdo rje de nyid kyis 'od zer spros te glang bu'i bur rdzus nas glang bu'i bu rabs bcad/ sprul cig /ka 196 ba2rgogi /yid la (dar ma'i sras spyan ras gzigs kyi )la yum bton te bdud bzlog der sras cig gis /ka196 ba2 rgokyang /ni 'od zer gyi spro bsdu mdzad/ cig gis ni yum brtan par mdzad pas lha rnams na re/nged kyi ye shes rgyal mtsho 'dis/ bdud kyi bu rabs bcad/ byang phyogs kyi cha 'dir yum brtan par mdzad/'od zer gyis bdud sde bsrungs pas 'od /ka 196 ba4 rgo (chen ma'i sras/)srungs dang yum (chun ma'i sras/)brtan tu grags/ 'od srungs kyis(yab kyi rgyal srid bzung /)kyang sprul ba'i 'od zer(sras gcig dang —415—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tsha bo gnyis te/)gsum/ mar(skyed pa ni/)me mdzad dpal(sras rje/)gyi 'khor/ bar chod gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i btsan po zhes bya ba dang / de la'ang bkra(sras khri/)shis pa gnyis brtsegs pas/ mar me mdzad gnyis dpal du gyur ba(des yul dbus kyi rgyal srid bzung /)dang / de('i gcung /)la brten nasasems can thams cad skyes (skyid) pa'i lha (lde lde yin gsung /)'od nyi ma ltar gyur bas/ bod khams kyi sems can thams cad kyi(stod du byon/)mgon du gyur ba ('i sras gnyis/)dang 'od zer gsum mo/ /'od(dpal 'khor btsan / )dang po (spyan snga ba/)ni tshul khrims kyi 'od 'bar ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhon(phu chung ba/)nu sems(bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/)dpa'i 'od 'bar ba'o/ gsum (pu to ba/)pa ni rin(skyid lde nyi ma mgon / )po che'i gling thams cad gsal ba'i 'od 'bar ba'o/ /rin po che'i gling gsal ba ni nyi(skyid sde de mgon / )ma'i 'od (de'i sras/)gsum spro(sde skyid pa/)bar byed (che ba)de/ bkra shisapa lha'i 'od(sde lde /)'gro ba'i bde skyid(bar ba/)'byung ba dpal(sde dpal gyi lde/)lha'i 'od(chung ba/)lha nyid kyi(sde lde gtsug lde / )lha de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od de slar yang 'od gsum mo/ /bkra shis pa lha'i(che ba bkra shis lde)'od ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la rab tu gnas pa'i 'od du bzang ste/ tshul (spyan snga ba / )khrims kyi 'od 'bar na/ lha mi'i bde skyid 'byung ba'i phyir dang / de la brten nas thar ba'i yon tan kyang 'byung ba'o/ /dpal (dpal gyi lde/) /gyi 'od ni/ dpal mar me mdzad kyis byin gyis brlabasapa'i lha'i 'od yin pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la brten nas rgyal ba 'byung bas/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur(phu chung ba / )gyur ba ni/ sprul ba sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don byed pas/ gzhon nu nyid nas rgyal ba sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad la mchog tu bsngags so/ /lha'i(sde gtsug sde/) lhar gyur ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gi nor bu ni/ shes bya rab 'byams la shes rab kyi rtsal rgyasapa ste/ bstan pa rin po che'i (pu to ba/)gling /ka 197 na4 rgothams cad gsal bas gzhud lugs rgya mtsho 'byed ba'i mchog tu bsngags so/ /de'i dus su mar yul du (pu to bsagasal par byas/ dpal lhas zhad zhud du(phu chung bas / )gsal bar byas/ bkra shis pa'i lhas pu rangs su (spyan snga bas )gsal bar byas/ da lta ni de gsum dge slong gtsang ma gsum du byasate/ rgya gar gyi gnas chen thams cad 'grim par yang mthong / cig ni kha sang nyid du'ang 'di nyid du dge slong bgres po cig byung ba de nyid yin te gsal bar byas so/ /der ma zad/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ snye thang du chos shig nyan du byung gsung ba'i byis pa de yang yin/ na ning sos ka de gtsang po bar chu la 'gyur du cha ba'i dus der mang pos rags brtsigs kyang mi thub pa la/ khong mkhar gsil cig khyer te ma rtses—416—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /chu phra bsho zhing / da dung nga'i bstan pa ni ma nub par yod pas/ khyod tshur 'ong ma ran zer zhing gda'o// khong yang gsung btsan par yod pas nyan tshod du gda'/ tshur ma byung / yang kha sang tshes brgyad kyi nyin par ra sgreng zer ba cig na 'dir 'brom ston 'ong zer nas ga dar byed pa cig kyang mthong / lar de 'dra'i rigs mang gsungs pas/ rngog na re/ gzhan mang po mi 'tshal/ nga la 'dir rgyug zer mkhan yang khong yin zer/ bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'od zer de dag tu ma zad/ bkra shis pa lha'i 'od (spyan snga ba )kyis kyang / 'od zer(de bkra shis lde nyid/)gnyis(de sras/) 'gyed de/ sems can thams cad kyi snang ngor gang (che ba/)mkho ba de dang / bstan pa gang yo ba'i sa nas(chung ba/)srong ba re ste/ 'od zer gnyis po sems can thams cad la gang 'kho (mkho )ba'i 'od ni/ sangs rgyas gang la 'byung ba'i ('brom/) gzhi'o/ /bstan pa gang yo ba'i sa nas srong ba'i 'od ni/ (sha rab/)yonatan nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba'o/ /yang sangs rgyas gang la 'byung ba'i gzhi ni bshad par mi 'tshal/ yon tan nam mkha' ltar rgya che ba'i 'od ni shes rab kyi rigs nam mkha' gar khyab tu gzhud lugs rgya mtsho lta bu 'byed pa'o/ /snang ba la gar shar ba'i sar dgon pa 'debs te/ byang chub kyi sems che zhing bdag bzung chung bas grwa ba ni shin tu mang / gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du re shar du snang ba 'char/ re nub tu snang ba 'char/ gang du shar kyang snam sbyar gyon pa stong phrag re mi nyung ba sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis 'byung / lha rnams na re/ yon tan grags zhes zer/ byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad blo gros su (grags/)'bod/ lha mo rnams na re shes rab grags ces (zhes) zer/ gang ltar na'ang gzhud lugaba'irgya mtsho lta bu spyod pa la grags pas mtha' bsdus du /ka 197 ba6 sum /sgrigs su/ shar nub tu rgyu / shar du ni snang ba dang dgon pa la ming btags te grags pa cig go /nub tu ni gdul bya g.yin la dgongs pa'i grags pa gsum ste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed/ yang sems can thams cad la gang 'kho (mkho)ba'i 'od las 'od zer (de sras/)'phros te/ 'og gi klu thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i klu'i rgyal po(nā ga rā dza dang /)cig steng gi lha thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i lha'i rgyal po(de ba rā dza/)ciga'od zer spro byed kyis mi ('khor re ste yang /)thams cad zil gyis gnon pas zil gnon chen po'i 'od zer gsum / de la 'og gi klu zil gyis gnon pa'i zil gnon ni/ lha'i(pu to ba/) lha de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gi 'od zer gyi sprul ba ngo bo ni shes rab kyi lha/ rnam pa ni rdo rje 'dzin pa smon lam gyi dbang gis sprul ba du ma 'gyed cing shar nub tu gzhung lugs rgya mtsho 'byed cing / gdug pa can thams cad mi mngon par 'dul/'dis ri'i sne'u zhig la dgon pa btab ste/ gdug pa can rnams btul bas mtshan yang 'bar ba(sne zur ba ye —417—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/shes 'bar/)can/ yang 'bar ba can ri sna'i dgon pa dang mthun pa'i grags pa shar du 'byung / bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i sprul bar grags te/ khro bo thams cad bran du 'khol bas btags pa yin/ nub tu ni gos sngon po(pra ṇi dha/)can no/ /lha zil gnon ni byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur ba rgyal ba'i mtshan 'dzin pa ni ting nge 'dzin pa dbang thob pa'i sprul ba ste/ byams pa dang snying rje mtshungs pa med pas mgon po spyan ras gzigs las dbyer med de/ bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa bdag med pa'i rdo rjes(glang ri thag ba rdo rje seng ge) rang rgyud 'dul ba la seng ge bas dpa' bas/ shing glang ma skyes pa'i thang la dgon pa btab pas glang thang bar yang grags/ byang chub kyi sems la thugs 'byongs pa de nyid kyang shar nub tu mngon mtshan mi che bar sems can gyi don byed de/ rdo rje'am seng ge ltar dpa' bas gang gis kyang byang chub kyi sems la bar du mi chod cing / rdo rje 'od las 'od zer 'phro bas mi mngon bzhin du bstan pa mi nub par 'dzin par shar nub gnyisakar rdo rje'i mtshan du grags/ de ltar na zil gnon gsum bla ma mar me mdzad dpal rgya gar nas 'drongs pa'i bdag rkyen du bzang ste/ rgyal ba 'drongs('khor res rgyal srid bzung /)pas ye shes(srong lde de la gtad kyang zer/)kyi 'od du lhas (la la de'i sras/)btags/ des kyang ma dag pa'i sems can la dka' spyad du ma bstan pa'i phyir du/ mtha'(rgya gar mu stegs kyi rgyal pos bzung nas/)'khob tu 'gum pa la sogs pa du ma bstan / bstan ('bor re'i gcung /)pa srong ba'i 'od grags pa'i mtshan ldan de dag gis sprul ba'i 'od zer zhig 'byung ste/ lha'i lha'i 'od zer ro/ /des ni 'jig rten thams cad snang bar byed do/ /'di yang shar nub tu rgyu ste/ shar du mtshan nyid kyi gnas thams cad la mkhas par mdzad nas/ mkhas pa'i dregs pa can thams cad btul / chos rnams kyi nang nas chos kyi mchog tu gyur ba zab zab mo mang yang bka' gdams pa las lhag pa med do/ /zhes mthar thug bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' zhes yul las mtshan du gsol te(rin chen snying po/)stod lung pa zhes grags/ nub tu yang chosakyi nying khu bka' gdams/ bka' gdams kyi nying khu bden gnyis kyi bdud rtsi /ka 198 ba3 rgonying khu/'thung bar grags so/ /lha'i lha des 'od zer gsum 'gyed de 'od thams cad 'dus pa lha'i 'od/ sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed pa lha'i 'od/ sems can thamasacad kyi bde skyid 'byin par byang chub kyi 'od gsum ste/ de dag ni mjug sdud kyi 'od phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /'od thams cad 'dus pa lha'i 'od ni/ thugs rje chen po thamasacad kyi 'od 'dus pa ste/ rdo rje'i seng ge dang rdo rje'i 'od zer te/ rdo rje'i 'od zer de nyid slar nub tu 'phros pa ste/ rdo rje'i seng ge ltar mi skrag pa'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi don byed/ der yang ting nge 'dzin nam/ bsam gtan las ming grangs/ sdug bsngal thams cad —418—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /zhi bar byed pa lha'i 'od ni/ shar du chos kyi grags pa zhes / nub tu ni chos kyi bla ma'o/ /byang chub kyi 'od ni rgyal ba 'byung ba'i gzhi gang yin pa'o/ /de la bug pa can zhes kyang zer/ ri g.ya' yod pa'i dgon pa na/thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba gnyis/ rtsed zhes pa'i lung par nga'i sprul ba cig 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul ba'ang 'byung / gzhan yang nub tu shes rab grags pa dang / sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge nyid kyi nyan thos chen po shākya seng ge zhes yongs su grags pa dang / rin po che'i khang pa na rin po che gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag khyad par can gsum rigs gsum gyis thun mong du byin gyis brlabs pa gsum 'byung ngo // khyad par du'ang byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i lha gtsug gi nor bus byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bdag nyid las tha mi dad pa/ bdag med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig 'byung / de la'ang 'od zer bdun rim gyis 'phros te sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzod pa shas che/ de ltar na shar nub tu dam pa du ma rgyu/ sprul bas ni bod kyi cha gsum ga khyab par gnas so/ /de dag thams cad ni rgyal po de'i rjes su sems can la snying brtse nas byon te/ don /ka 199 na3 rgopor gdon/ la sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba ltar gyur to/ /rkyen ngan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du shar/ gdul bya thams cad shan shun phyed pa la ltos nas/ bka' drin che ba'i tha snyad du rung ngo / /'od de lu gu rgyud kyi phreng ba de dag ni phan sems che zhing phan sems don dang mthun pa'i sgo nas bka' drin che'o/ /mnga' ris stod du khu yi ger ma tshud pa go ma chod pa yin te/ 'on kyang dkon mchog gis byas / jo bo dbus du 'byon pa'i rkyen du bzang ba cig byung / rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ba'ang nge la zer ba yin/ de yang bka' drin che ba'i sna zhig yin/ de nas khus/ jo bo grangs su bcug pas/ sngar zhus pa bzhin sprang smad 'grogs pa dang 'dra bar bla ma gang gshegs su phyin cing yon tan thams cad 'phral skad la brten nas nya zin sbal zin zer ba'i tshul du spyad du byung / de yang rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bzang ba drin che ba cig byung / da ni mi bzlogs pa'i 'chi bdag ltag tu byung kyang 'gyod pa med ces 'phros pa'i gtam tho re ba gsungs pa la/ lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ 'o na de'i gong du chos rgyal mes dbon gsum ga byon pas thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas yin tshul zhig gsungs par zhu/ de /ka 199 ba1 bod/dag ni rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul bar bzhed zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang / rtsa ba cig las 'phros pa stod (stongakasmyon pa'i tshig dang 'dra bar dang po'i rtsa bar ston nas 'gro ba de mi 'thad pa yin/ re zhig kho bos rngog gi dris lan rdzogs par bya yis/de nasatshul khrims rgyal ba dang mthun par kho bos kyang zhu yis gsungs nas/ der shing ljon pa'i drung gi dge slong di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba de na re/ gzhan yang khyod nam mkha' ji srid ma rlag gi bar du rdzi bo lta bu'i —419—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byang chub sems dpa' byed par thugs dam bcas na 'dod pa lnga la spyod cing nyon mongs pas ma gos pa cig byung na/ 'gro ba drug la nges par phan/ des na gling 'di nyid du yang khri tham pa'o/ /'di dag rang dang mthun pa'i dge ba la sbyor ba/ 'di dag gi spyod pa dang mthun par sbyor cig kun tu bzang po zer ba bzhin du khyod po ta la na gnas pa'i tshe/ dang por sgrib pa rnam par sel bas bskul nas mtha' 'khob tu 'gro ba dang / kun tu bzang po nyid kyis bskul nas mtha' 'khob tu 'gro ba dang / khyed rang gi thugs rjes bskul nas mtha' 'khob tu 'gro ba dang / rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis bskul nas mtha' 'khob tu 'gro ba dang bzhi las/ phyi ma gsum chos dbu brtes srol btod/ dar rgyas kyi sgo nas phan shin tu che/ 'jam pa'i dpal gyis bskul ba ni/ khri srong lde btsan te / de ni spyan ras gzigs nyid du ma zad/ stod lung gi nang du mgon po spyan ras gzigasakyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' skyer pa sgang ba zhes grags pa 'byung / khri srong de las kyang 'od zer gnyis 'phros te/ thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i khri yongs su srong bar byed pa lha gzhan gyis bar du gcod par mi tshugs pas btsan pa/ spyan ras gzigs nyid kyis sprul ba ste/ de'i dpung ba'i 'od zer las brten te 'byung ba bar gcod phra zhing phra ba bsrung bar mi nus pas/ mi rigs pa'i sgo nas btags pa sad na mjing yon zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ de yang chos rgyal yin te sngon gyi las la brten nas bdud sde gcig pur skyes nas rabasacung zad gcod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'phro la/ shing ljon pa de'i rtsar/ lag na lcags mda' lcags gzhu thogs pa sham thabs sngon po gyon pa sems kyi gdug rtsub che ba cig der byung ste/ lha'i rgyal po la lcags mda' brgyab pas/ lha'i rgyal po na re/ mthar khyod rang gi steng du 'bab par gyur cig zer te ma tshugs so/ /der bdud sde de na re/ de'i dus su nga der nges par gyur cig lha'i rgyal po na re/ de ma thag tu bdag khyod kyi bu dang de las gzhan pa'i sprul bar gyur te/ khyod kyi rabs mngon sum du gcod par gyur cig khyod kyi 'khor thams cad kyang nga'i sprul bar byas te/ khyod shi ba la mchil ma'i thal ba skams pa tsam du yang mi rtsi bar gyur cigaces gsungs pa dang / dge slong dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes bya ba de zhal nag mdzad pa'i 'phro la yang 'dzum mdzad nas / lha'i rgyal po ji skad gsung ba bzhin du gyur cig lha'i rgyal pos bka' sde snod gsum la legs par gdams te/ gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa de dag thams cad dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig de'i dusasu bdag gi sprul ba du ma bkye ste/ tshul khrims dang mi ldan pa tshul khrims la 'god pa la sogs pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten dar zhing rgyas par byed par gyur cig de'i dus su bdud sde khyed kyang / spyan ras gzigs dang bdag gisayongs su 'drongs par gyur cig phyis rab tu 'drongs par gyur cig ces gsungs pa —420—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dang / bdud sde de 'dir song med par song / de'i dus su bdud sde des de 'dra ba'i chags sdang byas pa la'ang lha'i rgyal pos sgyu ma lta bu sprul ba lta bu gzugs brnyan dang sgra brnyan lta bu mig yor dang smig rgyu lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas/ kho'i chags sdang la sgyu ma dang sprul par lta ba dang / khos mi snyan pa'i tshig brjod pa la brag char lta ba dang / lus la lcags mda' 'phangs te gnod pa byed pa la sngon gyi las yin snyam du shes par mdzad do/ /de yang sngon gyi las ni lha'i rgyal po nyid/ sngon rgya gar mtha' 'khob kyi yul zhig tu rgyal phran de wa rā dza zhes par gyur ba na/ bdud sde 'di stag mo zhig tu skyes nas/ srog chags ri dwags dang mi phal kyang zos pas de'i dus su de ba ra dzas snying brtse bar dgongs te/ nags khrod du phyin nas/ stag mo de la lcags mda' brgyab ste bkum/de'i dus su de ba ra dza na re/ sems can mang po'i don du sdig pa can bkum par gyur cig thabs du mas sdig pa can 'dren par gyur cig zer/ de'i dus na'ang mi la sogs pa'i srog chags mang po bde ba la bkod/ yang mtha' 'khob cig tu nā ga ra dza zhes pa'i rgyal phran zhig tu skyes pa na/ bdud sdig can 'di chom rkun/ du byas te skye bo mang po nor dang phral/ kho rtsar ma byung yang khos 'jigs pas gdung bas gdungs pa'i dus su/ rgyal po nā ga ra dza snying rje skyes te/ chom rkun 'di dang sems can thams cad dngos dang brgyud pas bde ba la dgod par bya'o snyam ste mtha' zhig na chom rkun de 'dug par bzung ste/ khyod bya ba ngan pa 'dor ram/ kho bos bkum par bya zhes dris pas/ chom rkun na re/ nga'i zas 'di la re na bzhag pas mi 'ong zer bas/ snying rje drag po skyes te/rgyal po nā ga ra dza nyid kyis bkum mo/ /yang tshe cig gser gling du khyim bdag shrī phu la zhes pa'i bu bā la shrī zhes bar skyes pa na/ bdud sde 'di rigs ngan nya ba cig tu skyes nas nya mang po bsad pas/ phu la shrī snying rje drag po skyes nas/ nya'i tshogs 'di dag dang / nya ba 'di dngos dang brgyud pa'i sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya'o zhes zer nas/ nya ba dol 'dren pa la mda' brgyab ste nya ba bkum mo/ /de'i tshe nya ba'i 'brel ba mang pos btsugs pas/ sgyu ma dang sprul ba lta bur bsgom pa dang / mi bsnyan (snyanakapa'i tshig la brag cha ltar shes pa dang / nya ba 'dis sngon nags gseb na bsam gtan bsgom pa na/ dge slong ku su lu zhes bya ba/ khyod ting nge 'dzin brtan na zer nas 'od ma'i dzral ba cig 'phangs te nga bsam gtan bsgom pa'i lag pa la phog ste/ de'i dus su yang rtog pa ci yang ma byung / las 'bras phra bas da lan nya ba 'di bkum dgos par byung / kye nya ba'i gnyen dag bshes sam/ phu la shrī bkum par 'os na bkum zhes 'di skad du/ lus 'di sgyu ma sprul ba 'dra/ /ngag 'di grag stong brag cha'i tshul/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal sngon gyi las/ /ngan pa da lta zad na bde/ /zhegasmras pas / nya ba'i gnyen de dag kyang lhag par du yang rang gi bu la brtse ba ltar gyur to/ /legs pa'i shes rab rgyal —421 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba'i 'byung gnas lha'i rgyal por sku skye ba bzhes pa des/ nga dge slong dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na zhes par gyur ba de la gsol ba btab pas rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma cig kho'i btsun mo la byin nas/ de la lha'i sprul ba gsum 'khrungs te/ bkra shis lde/ da/pal gyi lde/ gtsug lde gsum mo/ /der yab srasabazhi pos chu bo ya mu na'i gling de bgo bsha' byas pas/ grong khyim thams cad la bzhi cha bzhi cha thob bo/ /der bzhi kas rang gi mnga' 'og la chos kyi khral bkral te thams cad kyis chos byas pa'i mi rabs mang pos bkra shisapar gyur/ legasapa'i shes rab de'i rten 'brel gyis dus phyis bod 'dir yang stod kyi lde gsum du grags/ de yang sprul ba yin/ da yang u pa si ka'i sras mched gsum du grags pa'o/ /de dag gis kyang dbusagatsang du sprul ba du ma 'gyed/ dge 'dun gyi sde yang du ma 'phel/ ngo mtshar che/ des legs pa'i shes rab kyis zhus pa'i lan thal/da mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis/ rgyal mes dbon gsum du sprul nas bod du ji ltar byon pa dang / de dag gi mes chen gnya' khri btsan por ji ltar sprul nas byon pa'i tshul rnams glu ru bzhes su gsol/ spyan ras gzigs / spyan ras gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs/ zhes lan gsum gsungs pa dang / bshes gnyen pa dbu skra lcang lo yar bteg mdzad nas/ nam mkha' la hrig hrig mdzad pa'i 'phro la/ dbu skra'am/ na bza'i khud shed nas / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba khye'u gzhon nu ma'i gzugs su byas pa dgung lo bdun brgyad tsam bzhes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa cig byung ste/ g.yas g.yon na phar yul yul mdzad nas/ mgon posakyang gsung byon par zhu / kye jo bo ba rnam pa tshos kyang nang mis gsang thub pa gal che ba yin/ ngas kyang dpang po'i tshul gyis tha mi dad par mnyan gyis gsung pa dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ hrīḥ po ta la yi ri bo na/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nga bzhugs tshe/ /sgrib pa rnam sel der byon te/ /mgon po bod kyi yul du byon/ /bod rje gnya' khri btsan por mdzod/ /'gro ba'i don du nges 'gyur gsung / /nga ni bde gshegs chos sku la/ /'gro 'ong tha dad mi mnga' mod / / bod rje gnya' khri btsan por grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / /gsungs pa dang / yang dbu skra'am na bza'i khud shed nas/ kun tu bzang po khye'u gzhon nu lo bdun brgyad tsam bzhes pa cig byung ste/ g.yas g.yon na phar yul yul mdzad nas/ mgon pos kyang gsung byon/ kye khyed jo bo ba rnamopa tshos kyang / nang mis gsang thub pa mdzod/ bdag gis kyang dpang po'i tshul du tha mi dad par mnyan gyisagasung pa dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ hrīḥ po ta la yi rtse mo na/ /snying rje chen po nga bzhugasatshe/ /kun tu bzang po der byon te/ /thugasarje po bod du byon/ /tho tho ri zhes bod rjer mdzod/ /sems can don du nges 'gyur ro/ /nga ni bde gshegasachos sku la/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /tho tho ri zhes bya bar grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 422—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'byung / / gsungasapa dang / yang dbu skra'am na bza'i khud shed nas/ spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ni'i cha lugasa'od dkar po 'phro ba lo bdun brgyad tsam bzhes pa cig byung ste/ g.yas g.yon du yul yul mdzad nas/mgon posakyang gsung bar zhu/ bdag gis kyang tha mi dad par dpang po byed cing nyan/ kye khyod jo bo pa rnam pa tshosakyang nang misagasang thub pa gal che gsungs pa dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ hrīḥ po ta la yi zhing khamasan/ /brtse ba chen po nga bzhugs tshe/ /thugs rje chen po nyid byon te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho bod du byon/ /bod rje grong btsan sgam por mdzod/ /sems can don du nges 'gyur ro/ /nga ni bde gshegs chos sku yin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /de tshe srong btsan sgam por grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / gsungs pa dang /yang dbu sgra'am na bza'i khud shed nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /lo brgyad gzhon nu'i cha lugs can/ /gser gyi mdog 'dra gser 'od 'phro/ /mgon pos kyang ni legs gsung bzhin/ /dpang po tha dad mi mnga' mnyan / khrimasaldan nang yin gsang bar 'tshal/ /zhes 'jam pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhalanas/ hrīḥ po ta la yi pho brang na/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nga bzhugasatshe/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje der byon te/ /dpa' bo chen po bod du byon/ khri srong lde btsan bod rjer mdzod/ /'gro ba'i don du nges par 'gyur/ /nga ni bde gshegasachos sku ste/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /de tshe khri srong zhes byar grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / / gsungs pa dang / yang dbu skra dang na bza'i khud shed nas/ khye'u lcags kyi rdo rje'i 'khar ba can shing lo sngon po'i gos gyon pa cig byung ste/ g.yas g.yon na phar yul yul byed cing / mgon pos kyang gsung du gsol / bdag gis kyang tha mi dad par dpang po'i tshul gyis mnyan par bya'o/ /kye khyed jo bo pa rnam pa kun kyang nang misagasang thub pa gal che ba yin zhesagasungs pa dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ ri rab ri yi rtse mo na/ /lha min 'dul zhing nga bzhugasatshe/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa der byon te/ /sprul ba'i rgyal po 'gro la gzigs/khyod kyi zhing khamasabod yul der/ /da yang bdud sde bsam ngan rgyu/ /mtha' yi gdug pa der lhags te/ /thams cad sdig la bkod pa srid/ /de bas rdo rje 'dzin pa nga / khyod dang dbyer med dpa' bo bgyi/ /de tshe bdag gisa'adi skad du/ /ral ba can zhesabod khams su/ /mtha' dmag la sogs bdud sde rnams/ /drag pos 'dul zhing bstan pa srungs/ khyod kyi nu bor sdig to zhig /'ong gis thul la rjes bstan srungs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di skad du/ /ci gsung bdag gisabasgrub par bgyi/ /de tshe khyod kyi sprul ba nga / /drag po'i spyod pas khyod bstan srungs ༈ / zhi ba khyod kyisazhi ba yi/ /spyod pas 'gro ba bde bar mdzod/ /hrīḥ rigs gsum mgon posang bskul bas/ /nga la rigs gsum mgon ces/grags/ /kun tu bzang dang sgrib pa sel/ /nga bskul rgyal por —423—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bori gsung chos kyi skor/bsten gyur na/ /ci ste nga la der mi smra/ /'on kyang phyogs dang mthun par grags/ /hrīḥ chagasamed shes rab rgyas gyur cig /rtse gcig ting 'dzin gnas gyur cig /spro dga' chos 'byor 'phel gyur cig /dka' spyad chos zab(bzod/)spyod gyur cig /sdom gsum tshul khrims dag gyur cig /sbyin pa mchog gsum yongs rdzogs te/ /bdag gi yig 'bru drug rdzogs shog da ni chos rgyal rin chen bzhi/ spyan ras gzigs dngos sprul ba yin/ /man chad gong du bstan pa rnams/ /sprul pa'i sprul ba nyid yin no/ /'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyang pa'i phyir/ /sgrib pa sel bar 'gal ba med/ /phyogs su'ang gragasate ngo bo'ang yin/ /dus dang gnas skabs thamasacad du/ /'gro ba'i don du bzang gyur bas/ /kun tu bzang du'ang 'gal ba med/ /phyogs su grags te ngo bo'ang yin/ /de yang rigs gsum mgon po las/ /tha dad nyid du ga la gyur/ /sems can kun la spyan ras gzigs/ /'di ni snying rje byams pa'i rigs/ /nga ni snying rje po nyid/ /nga la sbyan ras gzigs zhes grags/ /lus ngag yid gsum zhi 'jam pas/ /'gro ba kun gyi dpal du gyur/ /'jam pa'i dpal du'ang 'gal ba med/ /kun mkhyen shes rab che ba'i rigs/ /phyag stong re na mi rtog pa'i/ /rdo rje dpa' bo re bzung ste/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba nga yin na / / phyag na rdo rjer 'gal ba med/ /de ni dpa' bo drag po'i rigs/ /de gsum rigs gsum mgon po nyid//phyogs su ma zad dngos yin no/ /hūṃ nga ni lha yin mi yang yin/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'ang yin/ /lha min bar do'i gnas su'ang 'gro /sachu me rlung 'byung bzhi yin/ /des skyed snod bcud thams cad yin/ /gang la gang 'dod dngos grub yin/ /thams cad nga yin nga mi mnga'/ /nga ro'i brag cha de skad sgrog /yig 'bru ma yin thig le yin/ /thig le rang grol rang sar yal/ /yal med ye shes chen por thal/ /zhesagasungs nas/ sku thig le ser po zhig tu khyil khyil 'dug pa'i 'phro la/ bshes gnyen pa mi snang bar thal lo/ /der lo tsā ba rnam pa gnyis dang / rngog dang gsum ga bsam pa mthun zhing mgrin gcig tu/ sprul ba'i chos rgyal gang du thal /rgyal ba rgya mtsho gang du gshegs/ /thams cad yin zhes gsungs gyur nas/ /gcig kyang mi snang ji ltar lags//thig le chen po yin gsungs nas/ /sprul ba du ma rab tu bkye/ /da lta gcig kyang mi gda' na/ /chos sku bde gshegs gang du thal/ /mes dbon rnam gsum la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal blon sems dpar da bzod 'tshal/ /'tshal ma thag tu mi gda' na/ /sprul ba'i sku de gang du thal/ tags bya rab 'byams thugs chud na'ang / /mi shes skad du meongs tshul ston/ /ha cang sba bar grags mdzad na/ /tsam po de'ang gang du thal/ /yul dbus lha sa'i mthil dag tu/ /gab pa sngoon 'byung 'god mdzad pa/ /'dir yang de yi snang ba shar/ shar ma thag tu thig ler yal / / e ma ho dpal ldan a ti sha /rgyal dang rgyal sras bzang po yi/ /rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab bo rje/ /—424—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rgyal sras bzang po gang du thal/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin po che/ /dag par gshegs pa'i skabs ma mchis//sems can dmu rgod dpag med rnams/ /ngang ring khyed kyis ma bzung na/ /bdag 'dra rang 'dod 'khri ba can/ /bzod stobs chung la rna ba srab/ /dmu rgod rnams ni gshags ngan tsha/ /bzang lan ngan gyis 'jal ba'i dus/ /bzang bde tshe na rtsod pa mang / /rtsod dus sems can mi 'dul bar/ /thig ler yal ba'i skabs ma mchis e ma phyag stong mnga' mdzad na/ /phyag sor gcig kyang mi snang bar/ /thugs las chung ba ji ltar mdzad/ /spyan stong sgrib pa mi mnga' na'ang / /lha mig tsam kyang mi bzhugs par/ /rgyal ba'i spyan mchog gang du thal/ /mtha' med nam mkha'i dbyings shed nas/ /rten med 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar/ /slar yang nam mkha'i dbyings su yal/ /byung dus skyid nas 'gags dus skyo/ /chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po las/ /rgyal ba lnga yi 'byung gnas mchog /snang stong 'od du shar gyur nas/ /'od gsal 'brom rje mi snang na/ /yid skyo shes pa sor mi gnas/ /thugs rje can de gang du thal/ /ma cig bu yod dga' gyur te/ /'bral glags med par brtse ba'i tshe/ /glo bur bu stong nga re zhes / / bu de nam rnyed sems pa bzhin/ /thugs rje can de rnyed gyur nas/ /yud tsam zhig la thig ler stor/ /nam zhig mjal bar 'gyur snyam las/ /rtog pa gang yang mi rgyu'o/ /e ma mgon po a ti sha /rgyal sras mchog de bstan du gsol/ /dus la bab po thugs rje can/ /zhes rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das pa skad du smre sngags kyis tshigs su bcad pa bton pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas mthong 'dod na/ kho yi rang bzhin snying rje yin/ /'gro ba thams cad sprul byas nas/ /bzod glags med pa'i snying rje bsgoms(sgomasaka/ /ring por mi thogs mngon du 'gyur/ /gdams pa zab mo'ang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / zhu ba po gsum gyis snying rje drag po thun mong ma yin pa bsgoms pa la brten nas/ jo bo'i thugs ka shed nas/ thig le dkar bo zhig khyil khyil byung ba snyam pa la/ thig le de las 'od zer dkar po drug byung ba'i bzhi phyogs bzhir 'phros / gnyis steng 'og tu 'phros/ de nas slar 'khor te byung nas/ steng gi 'od de bla gab kyi rnam par khyil le ba / khang pa ka ba bzhi tsam gyi rgya khebs pa btud nas bltas na oṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa cig 'dug go /de bzhin du 'og gi 'od de yang dngul dkar gyi me long ltar mtho dman med par bla gab dang rgya mnyam par gnas te btud de bltas na hūṃ gi rnam par gnas so/ /de bzhin du shar gyi 'od de lho byang du ngos phun sum tshogs par gnas par btud de bltas na ma'i rnam par gnas so/ /de bzhin du nub kyi 'od de yang lho byang ngos phun sum tshogs pa btud de bltas na pad kyi rnam par gnas so/ /byang gi 'od de yang de bzhin du shar nub tu ngospophun sum tshogs par btud de bltas na me'i rnam par gnas so/ /lho'i de yang de bzhin du shar nub tu ngos —425—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/phun sum tshogs par btud de bltas na ṇi'i rnam par gnas so/ /mdor na 'od dkar po rnams gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa phun sum tshogs pa dga' ba bde ba rnam par rtog pas ma bcings pa de lta bu'i ga695 yas khang gi steng 'og dang ngos gang nas byung cha med par thig le dkar po sran ma'i ga'u tsam zhig byung ste/ de la semasabatud de bltas pas de 'gyur ba snyam byed pa'am/ de'i gseb shed nas hrīḥdakar po bkrag tsher ba cig byung /de yang 'od kha dog lngas gtums nas 'od kyi rnam par hril hril yod pa'i gseb shed nas res 'ga' a'i rnam pa / res 'ga' zla ba'i rnam pa 'dra ba cig byung ste 'od de bteg go /de nasacung zhig nas 'od de'i gseb na tshur / oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru drug rang sgra dang bcas te steng 'og phyogs bzhi dang bcas par 'od zer gyi rnam par 'phros shing slar yang 'od de'i dkyil du thim de nas re zhig nas 'od de je srab tu song nas/'od cung zad yod pa'i gseb na phar bltas pas/ da ci nas gnas pa'i shrī/ de la yi ge 'byu drug posagayasaphyogs nas bskor te de dag la yang dbus kyi yig 'bru de las yig 'bru drug po de dag gi rnam pa'i 'od zer 'phros te/ drug po de las kyang / yig 'bru re re la'ang yig 'bru drug gi rnam pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros te / mdor na 'od zer drug bcu (cu3drug bcu (cukagada'o/ /der 'od thamasacad dang / phyogasathamasacad kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgrar 'ur 'ur ba'i snang ba byung / de nas 'od zer drug bcu (cukadrug bcu (cu3po de dag tshur 'dus te la la steng 'og dang ngos bzhi la thim/ la la yig 'bru la bskor ba'i yig 'bru drug la thim/ la la dbus kyi gtso bo nyid la thim/ de nas re zhig na hrīḥde nyid bshes gnyen par 'gyur ba snyam byed pa'am/ yig 'bru drug po de dag gi gseb nas byung snyam pa'am/ 'og gzhi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de g.yo zhing 'dug pa'i gseb nas byung ba snyam byed pa'am/ res dga' steng 'og ngos bzhi gseb nas byung ba snyam byed de/ mdor na dag pa'i snang ba la ltad mo ches pa'am/ khong 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul la bdag cag byis pa'i blos 'chun tshad du gyur pas gsal la mi rtog pa'i 'od kyi rnam par byon te/ phal cher hrīḥ de rang 'gyur ba yin las che/ gang ltar na'ang 'od kyi gseb nas bshes gnyen pa byon pa'i zhal nas chos thams cad 'di lta bu'i rnam par gda'/gtad pa med gsung / de'i dus su bshes gnyen pa gang la byon dri par 'dod pa yin na'ang / rig pa dga' bde mi rtog pa'i dbyings su thim nas dris lan byed pa'ang ma byung / de nas yi ge la bskor ba'i yig 'bru drug po de dbus kyi yig 'bru la thim/ dbus kyi yig 'bru de yang thig le gcig tu khyil te thal/ thig le de yang 'od kyi rnam par 'od kyi gzhal yas khang la thim/ 'od kyi gzhal yasakhang de yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la thim zla ba de yang a 'od kyi rnam pa can cig tu gyur/ de dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa la g.yas phyogs nasakhyil le bskor —426

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /zhing gda' ba la bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ a gsungs pas ljags kyi steng khar rtsen te song ste/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i sgo gsungs te/ bshes gnyen pa'i sku ril bo a'i rnam par lam me gda'/ der bshes gnyen pa la nam bltas bltas kyi tshe/ a re lam lam byung nas/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i rnam par lam pa de byung / de nas a'i rnam pa de mi snang bar bshes gnyen pa'i sku 'ba' zhig tu gda'o/ /lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'i zhal nas/ ngas rgya bod du mngon par rtogs pa'i rigs mang po zhig thos bsam kyis nyams su blangs pa la/ 'di lta bu'i mngon par rtogs pa'i lugs da lan tsam du zad/ jo bo chen po sgra med du ston pa'i mngon par rtogs pa 'di la ming ji tsam skad du 'dogs/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dbang 'byor ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam sprul chos thams cad nges med du ston pa'i brda chos yin mchog gi sprul ba cig 'gyed shes na/ nyid 'phros las ma g.yos par 'phros pa bstim shes/ gzhi gang yin pa las 'phros pa'i bstim pa las/ 'phros pa'i dbyings su gzhi ma bstims pa shes te/ 'di ltar gsungs nas thugs dam la bskos phor cig yod pa der tsha tsha zhig btab nas/ tsha tsha de la ra gan dum bu zhig g.yogs pas yang / skol phor chung ngu zhig byung / bya las sgo nga ste / sgo nga las bya zer ba'i tshul du gda'o gsung / der lo tsā ba ya mtshan pa las/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ der ma zad gsungs nas/ bskos phor tshon gang ba cig yod pa de dbu la zhwa bzhin du gsol bas/ sku ril bo bskos phor des 'thums pa cig byung / der bshes gnyen pas bskos phor de yar la blangs pas/ jo bo'i sku dang mnyam pa'i tsha tsha lam pa cig byon gda'/ der bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ tsha tsha'am de ci tsha nga'i snying tsha/ nga'i bla ma la da dung du mchod rten byed sngas gsungs nas/ tsha tsha de chen /ka 205 ba2 btsen/de blangasanas/dbu thog tu bzhag pa dang / tsha tsha nyid bskos phor du gyur nas/ bshes gnyen pa'ang sngar bzhin tsha tsha cig tu gyur / der ka ba pa rnam pa gsum gyis/ kye rgyal ba yab sras bdag cag gis nongs na mthol gyis/ spyir sems can ldothugs rjes gzigs/ khyad par du bod la thugs rjes gzigs/ de'i nang nas kyang bdag cag gsum la thugs rjes gzigasashig ces gsum gas bshums pas/ jo bo yab sras ba'ad gad teg ge sngar bzhin du byon/ der jo bo'i zhal nas/ mi rgan gsum gyis byis chung gsum gyi rnam thar byas/ rtsed mo ma 'tshengs pa cig kha thal ba la ngus so gsungs pas/ gsung de 'dra grags nas thams cad bzhad gad shor/yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ de ring gi snang ba 'di kun ston gyi nyi ma dang 'dra ba/ res 'ga' gang nas byung cha med par char sprin langs/ 'brug thog thog skad du char sprin 'bab/ res 'ga' sprin gar dengs cha med par dengs nas / lus can 'tshig pa lta bu'i nyi ma'i 'od de gsal dwangs su 'char/ de ring yang res 'ga' ngu / res —427—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'ga' dgod/ bying rgod /ka 205 ba byis pa dku/bya ba logs na med de la zer ba yin/ u pa si ka khyod kyis rang tshang du bzhugs nas/ dag snang gi rtsed mo byas pas/ rang blo stobs chung ba kun de ltar mi sems par shin tu skrag khyod dbang 'byor ba'i rtsed mos sprul ba dam dum byas pa la grogs po kun skrag pa skye ru bcug gsungs pas / bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ de ring 'u cag dpon slob kyi rnam 'phrul de kun/ rigs pa smra ba'i rtog ge ba kun 'gal bar brtsi/ 'o na'ang brtsir chug chos kyi gnas lugs de 'dra zhig min re zhesargya bod 'grims nas mna' bskyal yang thon no/ /yang 'di skad du/ me long g.ya' yis ma gos par/ /byad kyi gzugasabarnyan shar ba na/ /byad kyi rnam 'gyur ji lta bzhin/ /snang yang gcig dang tha dad bral/ /e ma stong pa gzugasasu shar / / gzugs nyid stong pa'i ngo bor snang / /rtog byas rnams la 'gal gyur kyang / /rje yi lugs la 'gal mi gda' / / phor gang chu yi nang shes na/ /dpag tshad du ma'i nyi ma shar/ /rdzun pa'i phyir na chung ngur shong / bden na de ltar rigasa'agyur ram/ /chung ngur chen po mi shong ba/ /rtog ge'i gdon gyis brlabs lugs yin/ /ngesapa don gyi rjes 'brang ba/ /rgyal 'byung nga la 'gal mi gda'/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyod de ltar gnas pa'i phyir na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin/ nga la'ang gnas lugs zab mo 'di/ a wa sgru ti pasayod par byas/ khyod kyi nga bsten pa bzhin du/ ngas kyang khong lo ril bo dgu bsten/ ngo mthong tsam ngo mthong tsam gsum bsten pa bzhin du bcu gnyis tsam bsten/ de tsam zhig bsten pa la/ bla ma'ang nga la mgu rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul ba zla ba grags pa'i bzhed pa de khyod kyi 'di /ka 206 na5 rgoyin/gsung /nga'i bla ma shārnyi pa kun mang po bsten te/ nga la zur za mang po mdzad de/ bla ma'i skyon bshad du mi rung / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma 'di la/ dgag pa du ma mdzad tsa na chu'i mtshan nyid de shin tu tsha ba yin zer ba ltar ro//sngar las dbu mgo ba'i zhabs tog tu song / gzhan yang bla ma dag kho bo la shin tu byams pa ni byams/ la la sems tsam yin pas ngas grub mtha' ma bzung zer nas/ bka' bcag /ka 206 na7 bkuon/ pa skad gsung ba'ang yod de drang don yin/ hril te gril (dril3na de ring gi chos de dag 'dus che la zab/ las chung la go bde/ da lus rdzun pa la zas rdzun pa za ba dusal babs nas gda' ba/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang mi 'gal bar bya ba'i phyir du snga se gro (drokamadzod gsungs pa dang /bshes gnyen pa bzhengs nas/ rgyal ba yab sras gzims khang du gro (dro1la gshegs gsungs nas/thams cad kyis bzhengs te gom pa gnyis gsum re btegs tsa na me tog gi 'dab ma zhig gi steng na phar 'gro ba snyam byed/ ka ba pa rnam pas kyang rgya bskyed nas gzigs tsa na/ rdo rgyang gru bzhi zhig me tog padma khab —428—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /be /ka 206 ba2 khad de/ gda'/ der rngog gis/ kho bo'i dag pa'i snang ba lagasasam/ 'di ltar gda' zhus pas/ ka ba pa rnam pa gnyis kyang de skad gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas khyed gsum pos da dung ma mthong ngam / 'od kyi gzhal yas khang la sogs pa thams cad 'di'i steng du bzhengs pa yin na/ ngas ni mi rtog rdo rje'i gdan / rtog dpyod rnam dag padro'i gdan/ thugs rje chen po hūm̐ 'od gsal gyi gdan/ dkar yang bsil ldan zla ba'i gdan/ thams cad bsod nams bsags pa'i gdan dang lngar gda' ste/ sngar gab pa yin/ der ma zad ri 'di thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma'i sku ru gda'/ ri 'di la nyin re bzhin grub thob du ma re 'ong zhing / yang gshegs kyin gda'/ thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang bgro ba mdzad cing gda' ste/khong rang gi sprul ba'ang mang po gda'/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi slob ma'ang du ma gda'/ de yang 'di skad du/ mi rtog rdo rje'i gdan steng du/ /rnam dag padma'i ze 'bru la/ /snying rje hūm̐ gi dkyil 'khor mchog /bsil dwangs zla bas rab brgyan te/ /steg na hrīḥdakar yig 'bru'i mchog /yum drug g.yas su rab tu bskor/ /gcig las drug 'phro drug las kyang / /me tog drug bcur (curaka phyogs bcur 'phro/ /steng 'og ngos bzhi yig 'bru'i 'od/ khang bzang kun dga' nyid la'ang 'phro /'bru drug hrīḥ la thim pa mthong / /hrīḥyang gzhal yas dag la thim/ /gzhal yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /zla ba skye med a nyid de/ /a ni ston pa'i ljags la thim/ /ston pa smra bsam gzugs kyis stong / /'di ni gzhug ma'i gnas lugs yin/ /'gal 'brel legs bshad mkhas gyur kyang / /glo bur sgro btags don gyis stong / /skye ba med kyang thog mtha' bar/ /gsum po dag tu dge ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yun ring du/ /gnas shig kun gyis mthong bar shog /'di ni a nyid gzhan ma 'dzin/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na legs pa'i shes rab/ gang du chags sdang yul byung tshe/ /sgyu ma sprul ba bzhin du lta/ /mi snyan tshig rnams thos pa'i tshe/ /brag cha bzhin du blta bar bya/ /lus la gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sngon gyi lasasu blta bar bya/ /zhes bya ba las brtsams te/ khyod kyis dris na/ gzhi cig la dag pa'i snang ba du mar 'phros te/gtso che bar ni lha'i rgyal por ji ltar 'khrungs pa yin na/ ma 'ongs par ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul lung bstan yang shugasal rnal 'byor dag pa'i snang ba la/ sprul ba bstan pa'i le'u yang shugs la byung mod kyis/ gtso bo chu bo ya mu na'i gling du lha'i rgyal por ji ltar 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste 'di phan chod du nyid 'phros kyi skyes rabs ma gtogs pa bcu dgu thal lo/ /zhes gsungs nas gzims khang du byon te gro (dro3 gsol ba'i dus su/bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ dge bshes pa rnam pa gnyis po'ang nang par bzhugs par zhu/ kha tsang nas jo mo'i ri bskrusangab la sogs pa du ma byung ba de la khong yon bdag pa tsho the tshom zos nas bdag la 'drir 'ong bar —429—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chospokyi skor/gda'o / / de'i dus su grong pa dag dang mthun pa'i zhus lan mang rab byed pas/ de dus su nga yang kha phral re re gnyis gnyis 'debs pas khyed rnam pa'ang gsan par zhu/ khyed dge bshesagasang phu bsakyang / kha sang na thugs thag chod pa mang po dris/ jo bos kyang kho bo'i yon tan dang mi 'tsham pa mang po khyed labastan/ da nang par skyes rabs cig tsam dris/ de nas khyed pas kyang pho thu ba cig gang nasa'ong cha med tsa na khyod la'ang dri dbang mi 'ong ngo/ /yang de'i dus su sngar yang brgya tshar cig song ste/ pho khyo ga la ol lamadud pa dgosapa yin pas / kha rtsang nas kyi byung rabasamang po bshad mi 'tshal/ jo bo posakyang / nang par khong yon bdag pa tshos go ba'i skyes rabs thung ngu ma cig gsung mdzod zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ slob ma bya ba bla ma'i yon tan brjod dgosapa yin/ skur ba btab pasag na 'ong / nga'i bla ma a wa sgyu ti ba'i zhalanas/ khyed ji srid sangasporgyas ma thob kyi bar du las phra zhing phra ba la'ang 'dzem na/ khyod kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i gdul bya la phan pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pa yin gsungasanas/ de semasal bcagasapa cig byung ste/ lasa'abrasaphra zhing phra bamokyang gos ma myong / de'i bsod namasakyi mthus/ nga'i rjesasu 'jug pa tsho la'ang bzang po 'ong / da lta'ang nga ldobarten pa tsho btsun par 'dug ma 'ongasapa na'ang badzin gdamasabada' gdamasazer nas/ skye bo stong gibram ze bzhin du gtsang mo gtsang mo 'ba' zhig 'ong / u pa si ka skye ba mang yang bram ze gcig po de 'go bar darka' bar 'dug bram ze gtsang ma gcig po de yang kho rang gi mdzad spyod de yang gzhan stobs su mi gtong bar/ rang tshugs thub par byed par 'dug gsungs pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ ngas khyod la nam skur ba btab pa de skad ma gsung par zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'o na da ci rang du / kho bos khyod dang mi 'tsham pa'i yon tan mang po bsgragasazer nas/ kho bosani sgro 'dogasam myong / de ka skur ba yin mod/ bram rtsegatsang masami gtsang ba'i zas zos zer ba dang 'dra gsung bas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ desade kho bo la grub pa ma gsung / jo bo zhal 'dzum mdzad nas de grub gsung / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'o na khyed bram ze gtsang mar khasablangs pa rang gisaskur ba 'debs pa de ka yin/ snang bas mun pa mun pa rang sang ka 208 na1bang bar /btegs nas byung zer ba dang 'dra/ 'gal bsachog pa yin gsung / jo bo'i zhalanas/ lku pa gika'adi yang 'gag skugs byed pa rang mkhasagasung / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'gag pa sgugasapa de gtam gyi skyon min/ khyi gsar dang / bud med ga pa'i kha bzhin du/ yin rung min rung cal col byed pa de mi 'thad pa yin gsung / gzhan yang bla ma a wa dhu ti pa de ngo mtshar can yin pa la/ gsung de 'dra 'byon pa'i khrimasamed gsungs pas/ jo bo spyan hur la mnan te zhal 'dzum 'grum mdzad nasade ci yin gsung / bshesaganyen —430—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pa'i 'kho nas/ khong gi lugs su song na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la'ang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shig dgos par 'dug yang na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spangs rtogs las nyams pa cig kyang 'byung srid par 'dug de 'dra zhal gyisabazhes na bla ma a wa lha ti pa mi 'ong / ngas kyang mdo sde du ma cig bltas pa yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas gsung tsa na/ de las mthar phyin rgyu med pa cig la zer bar gda'/gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spangs rtogs las nyams pa dang / nam mkha' gang gis kyang bcom pa yod skad kyang mi gda'/ yod pa'i khrims kyang med gsungs pas/ de'i dusasu/ jo bo/ nga'i bla ma a wa sgru ti pa zhes gsungasapa ma gtogs pa/ bshes gnyen pa'i gsung la lan gdab rgyu tsam ma byung / de'i dus su lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ de ring gi snang ba de kun la ci yang byung / shin tu dga' bdo ba cig sangs rgyas yin lugs la sogs pa'i gtam mjug ma byung bas yid ma ches pa cig 'gal ba 'du khad pa cig byung gsungs/ ka ba'i zhal nas / rang re grub tsam nyid na rnam rtog lhan skyesasu yod pa lagasamod/ gzhan yang de ring gi de kun la 'gal ba mang po 'du don mi gda'/ jo bo yab srasakyi yin lugs mthar thug las mi gda'o gsung / de nas bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas / khyod ka ba pa rnam pa gnyis la'ang zhu don zhig yod/ rgya gar na phar la yin par gyur na/ semasabaskyed pa'ang gsod pa yin par 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sdig can dag phrag dog gi bsam pas / rgyal srid dang mgo bo dang / mig dang rkang lag la sogs pa khyod byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin pas 'dod do
