gsum phub pa cig dang / jo bo gnyis bgro gleng byas pas/ lung rigs kyi sgo nas jo bo rgyal/ de'i dus su khye'u dkar po zhig byung nas rgya ba rgya mtsho'i bla ma la gdugs mi 'bubs par/ khyod kyi gdugs dang zer nas gdugs bcu gsum po shog ril byed pa bzhin du sgril nas/khyod mgo thog tu gdugs dad che na zer nas spyi bo na mar la bstims/ der jo bo'i zhal nas/ u pa si ka mu stegs pa snying rje yar thon gsung / de'i tho skor na grub thob 'dra ba dang / paṇḍi ta lha mig dang mngon shes yod pa kun gyis mthong nas ya mtshan skyes/ thams cad kyis langs pa dang / mngon shes dang lha mig med pa kun ci yin snyam nas mig phar lta tshur lta byed/ de'i dus su bu mo gzhon nu ma lag na seng ldeng gi lo ma thogs pa cig byung nas/ si ka khyod sngar snying rje che ba yin te/ de rang ma drag gam gsung / der khye'u dkar po de na re drag pa dang ma drag pa dang / da rung mi 'ong ba gar phyin gsung / bu mo na re/ kho mos shing 'di skye ba'i nags gseb tu phyin mod/ khye'u na re/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po a ti sha la mi chags par shing des ci nyen/ nags la chagasapa stag ni min gsungs pas/ bu mo de 'dzum byas nas a ti sha'i 'jigs pa brgyad ka kho mosabasal te bsal —460—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /snyam du mi sems so/ /gsung / yang khye'u na re/ nga'i bla ma la 'jigs pa brgyad mi mnga'i/ dper na rgyal tshab mi pham mgon gyis gsung / /rgyal bar gnas kyang ma rgyal lta bur bstan/ /zhes pa 'dra'o gsung / der bu mo na re de la lan mi 'debs/ 'o na mu stegs kyi gdugs la thugs yon po de ltar mdzad pa gsungs pa dang / khye'u de zhal 'dzum mdzad nas shog ril lta bu de mu stegs de'i spyi gtsug nas bton nas bu mo'i lag tu gtad pa dang /mu stegs de'i lha yin tshod na 'dug gzugs can gdong ba sngon po bzhi byas pa lag pa gnyis yod pa cig gis shog ril lta bu de mu stegs de'i spyi gtsug la yul yul byed cing gda' ba la/ de ma thag tu khye'u dkar po de'i thugs ka nas skra ser mgrin sngo mig ser dbyug tho can lus dmar mer 'bar ba zhig byung nas bu mo de la gdugs kyi mya ngan lhag ma de tshur thong zer nas/ bu mo des shog ril 'dra ba de btang ba dang / da ci'i gdong ba sngon po bzhi byas pa de shog ril lta bu de'i dkyil du gtums nas zhal nas me stag 'phros te/ shog ril spra ba lta bu de mer mched la khad mched la khad byung ba la/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gangs ri'i mgon po gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ /gangs ri lhun po'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /ri phran nag po'i phyogs rnams skrag par byed/ /snying rje cher bskyed khro bo ma mdzad cig /rgyal ba lha rgyal mgon po thugs rje can/ /gangs ri gdol ba'i yul der smin mdzad nas/ /rje la thugs brtse mu stegs gdugs bcom mod/ /'byung gnas ma bcings mu stegs lhar bcas thong / /lan du khye'u dkar po 'di skad smra/ /lha mchog lha yi rigs su rab byung ba/ /lha rnams dkar bzhin lha min rab bcom nas/ /lha mir 'jig rten kun gyi mgon gyur na/ khyed la 'gran bral ngan pa 'gran rtsom pham/ /mu stegs lhar bcas pham bcas mtha' 'khob tu/ /nga yi zhing khams mu stegs cig mi 'gyur/ /de bas dogs pa'i mtha' bcad mkhas pa yin/ /e ma sems can snying la log zhugs kyang / /grub mtha' can gyi mu stegs med 'phags gsung / /bu mo na re 'di skad du/ rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /thugs rje stobs mnga' mod kyis de 'dul la/ /de 'drar ston yang mya ngan ga la 'da'/ /mu stegs zhi zhing mtha' 'khob smin byed rgyal/ /zhes bya ba de dag la paṇḍi ta grub thob kun gyis mthong thos phun sum tshogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa thugs su chud/ gzhan dag rnams kyis mthong thos la/ jo bo spyan nam mkha' la hrig hrig mdzad cing / bhir wa bhir wa snying rje/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la khro ba mnga'am ma bcings par bde bar thong gsungs pa thos/ der thams cad yid ches/ grags pa chen po'ang du ma byung / mu stegs lha dang bcas pa thugs rjes bkrol te btang / bod kyi tshe dang ldan pa de 'dra ba'i rngams chen po zhig byung / gzhan yang a ti sha 'di khyed bod kyi phyogs su gzigs shing/ nga'i u pa si ka zhes yang yang gsung ba —461 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/cig 'dug khyed bod na thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba'i dge bsnyen rten dkar po zhig yod par 'dug kho bosamathong ba la'ang de 'dra ba byung / ma mthong ba la'ang / nged a ti sha'i drung na yod tsa na/ semasa'adi 'bol ba nyams dga' yal ba byung tsa na/ a ti sha yang nga'i u pa si ka byung gsungasanas/ phyag brisamadzad 'phro la'ang snag tsha 'bo la khad par bzhengs pa cig yod/ gzhan yang sgrol ma 'disakyang / bod du u pa sika'i 'gro don gyi grogs la rgyug ces yang yang du bskul gyin yod tshod du 'dug da ci nasakyang khye'u dkar po zhig byasanas/a kar khyod 'gro don gyi gegs ma byed ngas gnam sngon po 'di byung dus nas/ paṇḍita 'di bdag tu bzung ba cig yin gyis/ paṇḍita bod du thong gsungs nasabyung / da tshe dang ldan pa khyed rang yang paṇḍita spyan drongs/ lo gsum 'gro don rgyas par mdzod/ de nas paṇḍita tshur skyol gsung ba la/ kho bos gnasakyi slobadapon la zhu na nga 'di na tshur 'ong ba 'di'ang nga rang gi dbang min/ phar 'gro ba'ang rang rang gi dbang min/ spyir yang tshe la brtan pa ma thob/ nam 'chi cha med/ kho bos skyel bar khas mi len zhus pas/ khyod mi skyel na dam tshig med gsung du byung / sems las chen po thog tu babs te/ phyogs gzhan zhig na phar la rang gcig pus phyin tsa na/khye'u dar dkar po'i gos gyon pa shel gzhu dkar po zhig la 'khar ba byasapa zhig byung nas/ khyod semasami bde mi dgos/ khyod rang gis skyel bar khasablangasapasachog khag thugs rje chen po dang jo bo la bkur gsung /der da khyed gar gshegs zhus pas/ bod dbu ru'i phug nasayar cig 'gro gsung / dge bshesaston pa byung snyam nas yus che la dga' ba cig byung ba'i 'phro la khong mi gda'/ 'phreng yang snyad btags sa ched po byung bsanyams dga'/ der jo bo ma ti'i gtsug lag khang du gshegs gsungasapa'i dusasu/ slob dpon ratna ā ka ra'i zhal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa la gong du labs pa bzhin du/ nga'i paṇḍita myur du skyel/ gzhan nged rgya gar du chosatshugs nub nas 'gro bar yod do gsung ba la/ kho bos nga so so'i skye bo 'ching ba mtha' dag gisabacingasapa la dbang med/ spyan ras gzigs dang jo bo gang gsung las ngas mi shes/ nga rang la dbang byung ba'i lugasal bka' gang na bcog zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas kyang / de yin mod skyon med gsung / kun gyi rna ba na thun mong du yod pa na sngar yang yi ger bkod zin/ 'di kun da lan min pa khar bton pa med gsungasapas/ jo bo shin tu mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad cing gda'/ der bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ dge bshes lo tsā ba la don med pa'i 'khrul snang dga' dga' 'dra ba mang po byung 'dug khyed lo tsā ba sde snod 'dzin pa bzang po zhig la/ sgom chen pa thosargya chung la dag snang che ba'i blo 'dra mo zhig shar nas gda'/ kha ning tsa na/ dge bshesagasang phu ba gsung ba zhig yod de gzhan kun na phar la/ yon tan til 'bru tsam la/ sgro ta la'i sdong po tsam pa btags —462—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nas / rang res tshogs lam ma zin par sangs rgyas pa skad zer ba cig yod skad de/ de lo tsā bas da lan nga la byas / da dge bshesaka ba pa rnam pa kun/ rang re kun la bden zhen ma 'cha' gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/u pa si ka yin rung min rung de skad ma zer/ rang re'i yon tan la sgro 'dogs pa dang / skur ba 'debs pa gnyis nyes pa mnyam gsungs pas/ bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'o na khyed rang gi yon tan thams cad sbas nas / mas bu mo khyim gsar ma rgyan gyis brgyan nas phyar phyar byed pa bzhin du/ nga'i yon tan yod sa med sa nas phyar phyar gcig pu mdzad/ der ma tshad/ da dge bshes pa rnam pa kun gyis kyang / nga'i yon tan dam dum kun zad zad gcig pu mdzad pa 'dug gsungs pas/ yon bdag shag mgon gyis phyag gsum btsal nas / nged grong pa la kha ngag mi brgya kha mthun na mi cig kha rog 'dug bya ba'i gtam dpe yod/ de bzhin du pha rin po che la'ang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par thag chod/ khong rgya bod gnyis na lhag pa rnams zhal mthun pa yin/ yon tan 'di kun sngar nas 'di bas che ba cig grags dgos pa zhig ma grags par 'dug khyad par du'ang / nged khyim pa blun po rnams kyi dad pa 'di snyan grags kyi rjes su 'gro ba yin/ snyan pa'i gragasapa 'di kun phyogs bcur bsgrag 'tshal/ da kun yul ba'i chags sdang shags 'thab byed pa la yi ger brisan 'bum tsam pa 'ong ngam snyam pa blo la zin te chos kyi phyogs 'di la tshig re ba re la'ang dka' las kyi rngams 'ong bar snang na'ang / de ring 'dir rgan po nyamasadaga'/ chos lugs dang lha lugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ de ring gi gsung thamasacad la ma zin rang mi gda'/ da khyed slob dpon ka ba pa rang gis kyang khong gi yon tan mang po gzigs par thag chod/ da gzod na phar gtam gyi rigs 'di rtsig gseb na phar la 'gro de la mi tshang ma mang po kha mthun na la las snyad gdags su ma bde/ nged grong ba'i gtso bo'i mdun stangs la dpe blangs pa yin/khyed kyis kyang mthong thos gcig gnyis shig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed yon bdag gi dbang ris dad pa yin pas sgoms/ bsnyen bkur gyi yul de dkon mchog dag pas ci 'byor ba ser snas ma bcings par phul/ nged chos pa'i bya rgyu gzhan don yin pas bya/ blang bya gnyen po dang dman cha yin pasablang / /spang bya lo 'dod dang sgrib pa yin pas spang / sba rgyu ni yon tan khyad par can gsang ba mchog tu bsngags / nga'i 'di la lung yod rigs pa yod/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa tsho yang gsan 'tshal/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud sde mtha' dag nas/ dkyil 'khor gcig pa ma gtogs par bshad nas gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa zer a tsi bar byed/ da lta'i ming btags kun dang rgyab bsnol nas dga' ste dusakyi snyigs mar song chos bza' btung gi phyi la shor bas lan/ lar gsang sngags zer ba'i ming de rang la'ang rtog dpyod mi gtong ba de —463—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ha re long du ma song ngam/ 'on te shes kyang de tsug byed nga/ yin nam/ de ltar byed na chos khyad du gsod pa bya ba lhag par du btsog mdo sde nas 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo smod par bshad/ bu bu mo rgyal srid dang snying sha khrag la sogs nga/ byin nas kyang ngas byas la sogs pa tshig gcig kyang 'don re skad du yod/ 'dul ba kun la/khong la la ni theg dman gyi chos su byed de/ nga'i lugs kyi theg pa thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin/ yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / da lta'i gsang sngags pa kun/ sngags dang 'dul ba 'gal ba skad zer te/ rang res mi bsrung ba'i snyad du gda'/ gzhan du dbang bzhi bskur ba'i rten/ rab dge slong mchog cig dgosapar bshad/ 'bring dge tshul zhig dgos par bshad/ tha ma'ang dge bsnyen zhig dgos par bshad/ nga kun dge bsnyen cig yin te/rtsa ba bzhi la rdul phra rab kyi nyes pa tsam gyis kyang gos pa med/ gzhan yang zang zing gi dngos po thams cad la chags par byed ma myong / 'dul ba theg pa thams cad kyi gzhi ma de las sangs rgyas kyis tshad thamasacad kyang bkag de'i rgyu mtshan yang so sor thar ba thams cad so sor thar ba'i sdom pa dang 'brel du 'ong / byang chub sems dpa' las dang po ba tshad med pa bzhi sgom pa la 'gal ba bzhi bskyed du 'ong / de dag gi yang dgag bya yin na/ rig pa 'dzin pa dag lha'i bskyed rim sgom pa'i skabs su rig pa shin tu gsal dgosapa yin mod/chang myos chu yin mod/ 'on te zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir dngos su sgyur shes dgos mod/ gzhan du na lha'i sku mdog du ma/ phyag mtshan du ma/ lha dpag tu med pa'i nang du lha dpag tu med pa bsgom (sgom1pa la sogs pa so so skye bos myos chu ma 'thungs kyang mi 'chun gyis/ mi thub pa la 'thungasan ci 'dra/ desan 'di bde bar gshegs pas bkag bkag bzhin du 'thungs na ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'das kyi rtsa ba'i lhung ba 'ong / chos rgyus chung ngu la la na re/ 'dul ba dang nyan thos pa'i lugs la chang btung du mi btub/ nged sngagasapa yin pas 'thungs pas chog zer te/ 'o na de tsam du khyod kyis rtswa mchog gang tsam 'thungs pas chog na/ nged kyis rtswa mchog stong 'thungs pas chog de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin na/ khyed kyi rtsa ba'i lhung ba shor bas chog la/ nged kyi yan lag gi lhung ba shor bas ci ste mi chog lar gsang sngags gsha' ma zhig mdzad na/ kki ya'i skor bzhin du mdzad na ngo mtshar che/ yang la la na re/ de kun kyang rtog pas bcings pa yin zer/ de yang bzang rtog gisabacings pa yin zer/ rtog pas mi grol zer ba'i kha ta can mthong / khong de kun gyi tshig de kun 'gal bar mi gda'am / rtog med khas blangs pas ni sangs rgyas sam 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag khas blangs/ da gzod grol bar 'dod pas ni so so skye bo rtog pa mtha' dag gis bcings par khas blangs/ rtog pa med dgag bems por mi 'dod de mchi/ lar da lta thabs sna tshogs kyis btsan sa'i lam la 'jug pa'i dus su/ bskyed rim la so —464—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sor rtog pa'i shes rab gsal la dag pa rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa/ tshul khrims kyi 'od kyis phyi gtsang ba/tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin gyis nang gtsang ba/ spang blang gnyis mkhas pas phyi nang gnyis ka gtsang ba/ de 'dra ba cig byung na 'jug ngogs bde mo la chu 'gro ba bzhin du/ mthar thug theg pa'i rgya mtsho bde mor 'gro/ lar de kun gzhan gyis ma lan/ thos pa rgya chung bas lan/ nges don la drang don du 'brul/ drang don la nges don du 'khrul bas/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad nas ma 'khrul ba cig gal che/ hril dril na/ 'dul ba theg chung gi chos su byed pa'i lugs su mi 'thad/ theg pa chen po'i dgag byar 'dod pa mi 'thad/ gzhi ma med pa'i sum thog dang mtshungs/ de la theg pa thams cad kyi gzhi ma 'dul ba nas gsungs tsa na/ rang nyid dgra bcom pa ma yin pa la dgra bcom par smra na/ rdzun smra ba'i pham pa 'ong / yin pa la yin zhes smra ba bden smra 'ong / de yang hril te dril na rang gi yon tan rnams gsang dgos zhes pa'i tha tshig tu gda'/ de kun yang rags pa tsam yin/ gsung rab mang po bltas tsa na rang gi yon tan thams cad sped par bshad/ skyon thams cad sgrog par bshad/ bde skyid thams cad pha ma la spyin par bshad/ gzhan gyi nyes skyon thams cad rang gis blang bar bshad/ blangs nas mi 'jog par bshags par bshad/ sems can gyi don mthong na dmyal bar yang 'gro bar bshad/ de ltar 'gro ba la yang nga 'gro'o zhes sgra sgrog par ma bshad/ mdor na de dag thams cad lung yin / rigs pas dpyad kyang / spyir sems can pa'i lugs/ sgos mi mjed 'jig rten pa'i lugs/ yang sgos 'u cag bod khams pa'i lugs kyis/ gzhan la yon tan 'dug na til tsam pa zhig kyang mi theg cig gis bstod ra cig btang na/ de'i rtsar de bas che ba'i smad ra cig gtong / nyams len byed pa'i lta ba mthon po blor mi shong / dge sbyor byed pa re re tsam mthong na zog por 'bod/ de'i nang nas tshul khrims srung ba re re tsam 'dug na nyan thos su 'bod/ de'i nang nas dman cha len pa re re tsam 'dug na phan mi 'dogs pa'i snying rje bsgom / dred po rnams chos rgyus chen pos lab/ 'chal ba rnams ngo so mtho/ nas rdog bzang mo brgya bskor re khur ba'i snye ma bzang mo mgo gug hril le sdod pa'i dus su/ de dag gi dbus su spre the yag yug lang long tsho mgo 'phang mtho/ gang ngan ngan mgo 'phangs mtho ba de dpe 'grig de ltar na ngan pa de dag gis bzang po yul du byas nas skur ba du ma 'debs shing mi theg pa'i sdig gsog gzhan yang grong yul kun na khyim mtshes pa kun gyi ba nu ma ldir re ba byung na de mi theg par/ rang re la med pa bas khong la yod pa sdug bsngal che ba du ma mthong /ya'i bsam shes kun/ nga'i pho chod yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kun na/ dpon skya'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam / pha tshan che cha'am gang mtho mtho rnams dug gis shi bya ba'i khrims 'ong / a tsa ma rang gi yon tan mngon —465—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mtshan ches pas lan/ yon bdag shag mgon la sogs pa kun/ nga'i yon tan gzhan la ma sgrog par de blo la bzung la sgrogs dang / da gzod lag len de byung ba'i dus su gtam 'di thos nas 'brom re bden zer ba'am 'ong nyan yod/ chags sdang bya ba gzhan gyi yon tan ma theg pas 'ong ba yin/ rgyu gzhan med/ nga yul du byasanas sdig gsog pa 'di mi bzang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang / bod 'di la nga shin tu drin che bar yod/ drin bgrang mang po mi byed par phan 'dogs pa 'di shin tu dkon pa yin/ rang sangs rgyas kun theg dman du byed de de yang rang yul du byas nas/ zhan sdig gsog mi gsog brtags nas gsog sar bsod snyoms la mi rgyu bar/dben pa'i gnas su rten 'brel zab mo bsgom pa yin/ nga sems bskyed pa zhig yin pas sdig bsag tu mi rung / khong rang ngan song gi sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ nga 'dren pa'i las kyis ngal/ nga la sdig ma bsags pa'i semasacan rnamasa'adren pa'i lasakyisachog par gda' yi/ hril te dril ba la 'di ma 'bri/ chos lugs mi cig pa'i skye bo la ma sgrogs/ chos lugasacig pa'i slob masakyang brisan dpe ma 'grim/ 'di slob dpon gyis sa bcad btab la ma bshad/ zhus lan gyi legs legs tsho 'dun pa can kun gyi blo la bzung la/nga'i chosalugs las gzhan ma 'dres pa'i gang zag tshe 'di'i dbang du ma song ba/ gragasapa dang lo 'dod kyi dbang du ma shor ba/ ri dwagasashi ba'i ro bzhin du rang gisarang sped pa/ nga'i lha mosabadun ldan nyamasalen gyi snying por byed pa rnams la bas mtha'i gnas mal lam/ nags khrod dben pa'am/ kun dga' ra ba stong pa'am/grong yul las rgyang grags du mar 'phags pa'i dgon pa'am/ mi rtag pa sgom pa'i gnasadur khrod la sogs pa'am / sa phug dang gad skyibs la sogasapa shin tu dben pa'i gnas su/ dngul gyi maṇḍal la sogasapa snying gi thig le nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin du byas te/ 'di la sgro ma btags skur ba ma btab par blo rno na lan cig bstan par bya/ des kyang ma go na gnyisadang gsum bstan par bya/ gzhan du mi byed des na spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub pa la brtson par bya ste/ gzhan du yang bstan par bya'o/ mdor na snod phun sum tshogs pasanges par bya'i / blo la mi zin pa'i yi ge dgos zer nas yi ger 'god pa'am/ des kyang ma chog par nyan bshad byed zer nas / zhusadag byed pa ltar 'chad gnon byed pa'am/ 'chad pa posasabacad 'debs pa la sogasapa byed na ni nga'i dam tshig nyams so gsungasapas/ lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ 'o na ngas phag cig na dpe chung dum pa cig byas yod de/ ji 'dra zhig mchi'am zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ dpe cha dang dpe cha 'khobs po che khyed la long nam byung / 'di'i zer lugs kyisaka bsakyang byas yod/ ka ba 'di yang de 'dra byed byed pa cig yin/gnyis ka'i dpe cha tshur la khyer la shog gsungasapa la/ ka ba'i zhal nas/ khyed rna ba'i zhor la 'gram lpags —466—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /stong bar 'dug khyed de skad zer du byung gis dogs nas rang da lta yan chod du 'bugs pa zhig kyang zer ma nus / da ci nas yon bdag shag mgon khyed kyis kyang labs zer ba la/ nga la tshig cig kyang lab long ma byung /bshad na nga la'ang bshad tshad yod de/ de skad mi gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ sgro btags shig min pa yod dogs ye med gsungs pas/ ka ba'i zhal nas/ 'o na gsung yang bya rgyu med/ ngas padma phug tu phyin tsa na/ khyed rang dang brag phug gi sgo phug su phrad nas ngas phyag btsal te/ khyed 'dir byon pa ci yin zhes zhus pas/ nga 'di na snang skad gzhan la ma zer/ khyod rang yang de ka nas log gsungs pa/ gsung bcag na mi nyan snyam dka' las che che la babs nas/ be'u se rur phyin tsa na/ nga'i sngon la yang khyed rang gis slebs nas 'dug pa de ci lags zhus pas/ khyed rang mig zhabrul nas 'dug pa gsung ba lags mod/ yang lan cig rdo rje phug tu phyin tsa na/ khyed bya rgod kyi thul ba cig gsol nas/ spyan snga na mi'i thod pa kha cig bzhag nas 'dug pa/ de'i dus su 'ongs pa legs gsungs nas nga la sha tsha bro tog tog pa zhig byin nas/ nga la spyan cig gzigasapas/ nga'i sems dbus mar tshud/ da lta rang khyed mi gda' ba/ yang be'u se rur phyin tsa na/ khyed rang bzhugs nas 'dug pa la/ khyed kyi gar phyin gsung du byung ba lags mod/ der da ci nas kyi snang tshul tsho zhus pas/ nga ta min te/ grub thob kyi rnam 'phrul zhig mthong nas 'dug pa gsung ba/ yang na ning bye la la phyin pa'i dus su yang / la khar sngags pa gzhon nu ma cig dang phrad nas/ khyed ga nas byon byas pas/ bsam yasanas 'ongs zer/ paṇḍi ta zhig yod pa de gang na bzhugs byas pas/ byang chub gling na bzhugs par gda'/ de ring 'jigs pa mi gda'am byas pas/ 'jigs pa byung gis dogs nas jo bo sang btang ba yin gsungs nas 'jigs pa sgrol sgrol du nga bskyal nas sngags chung phyir log gar gshegs byas pas lha sa na yar la 'gro gsung / da mi sleb bzhugs par zhu bya long yang med par gshegs pa lags mod/ de nas jo bo'i drung du sleb tsa na/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ u pa si ka gar song gsung / kho bos kho bo la rgyus med zhus pas/ 'o na khyed bsu ru btang nas de ci yin gsung / kho bos khong dang ma phrad byas nas/ gong gi tshul brjod pa dang / jo bo bzhad cing pha la pha la gsung zhing gda'/ lar de 'dra bgrangs na bshad kyis lang ba med ces gsungs pas/ bshes gnyen pa la 'bug rgyu ma byung / gzhan thams cad skyabs su mchi'i sgrar song / re zhig nas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ da de ring lab mda' mang po bya rgyu med/ lo tsā bas bris pa'idape cha de 'dir ston dang gsung ba la/lo tsā bas kha rtsang nas gsungs pa tsho zin bris byas nas 'dug bshes gnyen pas dpe cha de rtog (togakaste blangs nas dbu thog tu cig bzhag nasa'adi la thabs shig yod de/ chos spong ba'i las 'di mi rigs/ da —467—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di nga ci nas zer ba bzhin du/ khyed lo tsā ba chen po cig gis phyag len la btab kyi rting la/ da lo lnga drug nas khyed rang gi yul phyogs su dge slong bgres po zhig 'brom gyi rnam thar zhu zer ba cig 'ong gis/ de dus su mchod pa gang 'byor bshom du chug la/ srod tho rangs shig la khong gi lag tu dpe 'di ma gtad par/ dpe 'di phyag g.yas su khyer la khyed rang spyan ras gzigs su sgoms/ dge slong de la'ang nga'i 'du shes zhog /dge slong de la 'di'i don la rig pa gtod pa dang snying rje chen po bsgom pa gnyis gtso bor phog de'i dus su yi ge 'di/na ro 'greng bu gcig kyang ma lus pa/ sgro ma btags pa gyur bu lugs su ston/ de nas khong la dpe zhig dgos pa 'ong gis/ rab tu khyed rang gi 'di byin/ gzhan du na 'bri mkhan khyed rang gis gyis la/ dpe gnyis bsgrigs nas zhu dag ma byed/ khyed blo brtan pas the tshom mi 'ong ste 'ong / byung na mthong khungs su zla ba shar ba'i nub mo 'khar ba'i maṇḍal zhig gi steng du bris pa'i dpe zhog la/ dag ma dag khyed rang gi thugs kyis legs par dpyod / de ltar mchod pas tho na/ rgyal ba rgyal sras nas bzung nas/ thor bu ba'i bkra shis yan chad yi ger bris srid kyang / zhu thig mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis byed mchi/ ma dag pa'i rtog pa ma byed gsungs pa la/jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di dag byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yin pas/ byin brlabs bya ba sems la zhugs dgos pa yin/ sems bya ba bde stong rang grol du shes pa cig dgos pa yin/ 'di lta ste/ bde gshegasabyin brlabs sems la zhugs/ /sems ni rang grol chos dbyings te/ /chos dbyings dpe med yi ges stong / /stong pa nyams len mi byed par/ ri mos rig pa gzung ba ni/ /glen pa yin par shes par dpyod/ /phyag g.yas yi ge skye med la/ /g.yon pa me long gsal stong 'dzin/ /rig pa gcer bus yi ger bkod/ /dam pa'i snying po snying rje ste / / rig pa dbyer med don la dpyod/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i chos skad yin/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis med pas/brjod bya rjod byed pa yis stong / /dag pa'i steng du 'od bzhag pas/ /yi ger bral ba thig le'i sems rig stong dbyer med sems kyis dpyad/ /de ni dam pa'i dag byed yin/ /sgra med thos bral tshig gis stong / /tshig med yi ge brjod las 'das/ /brjod med yi ge a nyid yin/ /a ni skye med zla ba'i 'bru/ /zla ba bsil zer mun pa sel/ /mun bral sems nyid shes rab dang / khes ragremi rtog dbyings su thim/ /sa med sa la tshad gzung med/ /gcad bya gcod byed bshad pas stong / /rgyun med phyir na gcod byed bral/ /'on kyang lhag chad med pa gda'/ /tha snyad yi ger 'god pa gang / /ma dang bu la dgos pa yod/ /de bas bu yang ma lus pa/ /bris tshe bzlos kyang ma chad bzang / /gal te lus na sems nyes pa/ /rnam smin lce yis khur gyur te/ /de lta na ni rgyu 'bras 'khrul/ /spyan ras gzigs ni yi ge'i gzugs/ /na ro'ang lus na de lus 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas//—468—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bshes gnyen pa shin chu mnyes nas/ 'di skad du/ legs par gsungs so lha yi rgyal/ /'khrul ba med par yang dag gnas/ /legs pa'i lam ston mar me mdzad/ /ye shes snying po rgyal gyur cig /rgyal ba rgya mtsho gting dpag dka'/ /rgyal min gang gis bcad mi nus/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas te/ /bsgral dka' sgrol bar rgyal gyur cig /nor bu'i phreng ba gser gyi 'bru/ /phreng ba rab mdzes 'phags pa'i rgyan/ /dag pa'i blo la gnas gyur te/ /yi ge med pa rgyal gyur cig /nga yi rjes 'brang drang srong lam/ /skyon gyis ma gos nor bu'i mchog /sde snod gsum dang lha mchog bzhis/ /rang rgyud tshim par rgyal gyur cig /skyes bu gsum dang lha mchog gsum/ /stan thog gcig tu rab bsdoms nas/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma mar song bar/ /gtan gyi btsan sar rgyal gyur cigakhrimasaldan padmo'i sa gzhi la/ /tshad med bzhi yi ra bas bskor/ /rgyal yum drug gi ka bas bteg /mthar thug phugs su rgyal gyur cig /gnyen po'i chu bo bags kyis gzhol/ /spang bya'i me yis mi tshugs par/ /tshogs gnyisanyi zla'i 'od gsal te/ /mi rtog ye shes rgyal gyur cig /mi mjed 'dod pa'i 'dam gseb tu/ /'dam gyis ma gos padmo mchog /nyin dang mtshan du dge gyur ba'i/ /rnam thar gtsang mar rgyal gyur cig /ngos yangs brtan pa'i sa gzhi la/ khye las nyen che'i chos lugs kyis/ /log lta'i g.yang la ma lhung bar/ /bka' gdams rin chen rgyal gyur cig /zag bcas dge ba'i bsod nams las/ /zag med ye shes lo 'dab rgyas/ /kun tu dge ba'i 'bras bu can/ /las 'bras zab mo rgyal gyur cig /yul gyi dbu ru byang phyogs te/ /bstan pa'i dbu ru'ang byang phyogs yin/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas byang phyogs su/ /'byung gsung de bzhin rgyal gyur cig /nga yi gzhud lugs thug chol can/ /gzhan gyi dri mas ma gos par/ lha dang mi yi drang srong mchog /smon lam dag par rgyal gyur cig /smon lam cig la smon lam kun/ /'du ba smon lam kun gyi mchog /slu ba med pa'i rgya mtsho de/ /rgyun chad med par rgyal gyur cig /ces gsungs pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ pha la pha la/ khyed 'dra ba bod na yod bzhin du/ kho bos ci byed/ di ring bkra shis so byas pas/ thams cad bkra shis pa'i skad dir ba byung bas/byung ma thag tu/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ shes rab yum las ma g.yos par/ /re ltos ser snas ma bcings pa'i/ /phyi nang sbyin par gtong ba gang / bkra shis rin chen mchog tu shog /yang srid rang 'dod ma 'khrigs pa'i/ /sgo gsum dge ba bsil ba'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad med par gnas pa yi/ /bkra shis rin chen mchog tu shog /'gras dang khro zhabrugs mi mnga' zhing / /dka' spyad 'khor ba bzod gyur ba'i/ /snying rje'i dpa' bo go cha gang / /mchog gi bkra shis rin chen shog /skad cig cig la mar gyur la/ /'dod dgu thams cad spel mdzad pa/ /spro dga' brtson pa'i bkra shis gang / /thams cad 'grub pa'i rin chen shog /don mi 'gyur dang —469—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/btang snyoms las/ /g.yin pa'i ting 'dzin dpag med rnams/ /chags thogs med par spyod pa yi/ /bkra shis rin chen mchog tu shog khes bya ma lus gsal le bar/ /so sor 'byed dang sdud pa yi/ /bkra shisakun gyi bkra shis gang / /ma lus rdzogs par shisapa shog /dge ba gang byas lam 'gro ba'i/ /bkra shis rin mchog tu shog /lam bzang 'di nas mi ldog par/ /bstan pa'i bkra shis rgyas par shog /'gro ba gang gi don dag tu/ /de 'dren chos ston shis par shog /spyod lam 'di nas bzung byasanas/ /spyod lam ci byed dge ba yi//gzhan gyi mig 'dren phun tshogs pa/ /chos grogs bkra shis 'phel bar shog /bkra shisa'adi nas rab bzung nas / / mthar thugs bkra shis ma thob par/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro 'dren pa'i/ /bshesaganyen mchog gi bkra shis shog /'khor ba stong par ma gyur bar/ /nga nyid lham me lhan ner dpal/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab gyur te/ /thar ba'i sgo 'byed bkra shis shog /bkra shisacig tu bkra shis rnams/ /'dusapa bkra shisargya mtsho gang / / zab dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis rtag tu shisapar shog /cesagasungasapas/ gserdogyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog la sogasapa du ma nam mkha' las babs/ de'i dusasu rngog gisamachi ma phyung ste/khu / 'di lta bu'i yon tan gang la bltas kyang nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba thogasapa med pa'i yon tan bla ma rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rin po che la mnga' bzhin du mi spyod par/ don med kyi khengasagragasamang po byed cing 'gran semasadang lo 'dod kyi chos kyisaci la phan/ nga rgasanas 'dug ste/ kho'i rtsar phyin nas gros 'debs gzhan ma nyan yang / gyod bdal ring ba cig byed/ yugasas mo'i rtsar ma legs skyeladu phyin pa 'dra ba cig bya yis zer bas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de 'dra ma zer cig rang re tsho'i rnam rtog 'phrosapas ma chog par/ khong dge ba'i bshes gnyen grwa ba mang po dang bcas nasabastan pa'i bya ba thosabasam rtse gcig tu byed pa'i dus su/ thugs khros nas 'di na yar la byon bya ba'i khrims yod/ yang rgya gal te na/ thugasa'akhrugs nas kho bo la bka' bkyon byung bya ba yod/ lhag par du da lta khyod rang gnyisapo mdza' mo 'di la da gzod ma yar dang bu yar 'dra ba cig 'ong ngesashes so/ /ma 'gro cig gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de rang phye ma nye'o/ lung phug 'di na yar la mjal du 'ong gin ba cig yin na dag kho bo'ang grangs su mi 'jug mgon po la'ang 'di las bkur cha che ba cig kho bo bod du ma 'ongs gong du rang byed thang ba cig yod de/ da lta yan chod du 'di 'dra/ 'o na'ang 'brog phrug ngan par ma thal/ khong gang 'gro 'gro na gzhon nur gyur ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma 'od lham me lhan ner padma cig gi steng du'ang dog par mi mngon/ stong gsum tsam la'ang yangasapar mi mngon/ las gzhan don/ rnam pa 'od gsal/ ngo bo chosakyi sku/ e ma'o ngo mtshar che ma —470—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nus pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi yab yum/ sngon gyi dus na yang grong khyer gyi sprang po dbul po des pa bya ba/ ngo bo ni shākya thub pa dang dbyer med/ rnam pa ni tha mal ma nus pa/ sbas pa'i tshul gyis grong khyer ba'i 'gro ba mang po bde ba la bkod pa dang 'dra bar/ 'dir yang ngo bo ni spyan ras gzigs/ rnam pa ni dge bsnyen ku su lu/ yon tan thams cad sbas pa'i tshul gyis gangs ri'i khrod na gnas pa rnams thabs du ma'i sgo nas 'dren par mdzad pa ni sangs rgyasakyi bya ba byas so// kho bos kyang khyed kyi 'gro don lta bu bya bar mi nus so/ /nga'i.u pa si ka nga'i pha ma rnams thugs rjes zungs shig nad pa rnams sman pa khyed kyis ma bskyur zhig sman pa gzhan gyis ma gsos pa khyod kyis gsos shig gsungs pa dang / dge bshes lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ mkhas pa chen po 'phags pa'i dbyangs su snyod cig gsungs pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas bgyi'o gsungs nas/ 'di skad du/ ri rab ri yi khong shed nas/ /lha ma yin gyi rgyal po zhig /'jig rten mgon la mi 'dud pa/ /mgon po nyams par mi 'gyur bzhin / / yar klungasamathil gyi phyogs shed na/ /rang rgyud ma thul dregs pa zhig /gangs ri'i mgon la mi 'dud pa/ /lhun mchog nyams par ga la 'gyur/ /gzhon nur gyur ba sems dpa'i tshogs/ khrag khrig bye ba brgya stong rnams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dbang la/ /nye dbang 'dud cing 'khod pa ltar/ /nga yi 'brom la'ang de dag mtshungs/ /ngo mtshar che'o mig gcig po/ /mi mngon gzhan don dpag med pa/ /grong khyer dbus kyi des pa bzhin / / thabasakyi nyon mongs nad bsal to/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sman pa khyod/ /smon lam bcu gnyis 'debs mdzad pas/ /rab bsngags khyod ni dpal du gyur/ /bdun brgya bdun cu tshe rabakṣiṃri sku/ khrims dag gzhan don spyad gyur kyang / khyod kyis mtha' 'khob 'dul ba yi/ /'gro don dka' spyad ga la yin/ /lha mchog dka' thub mi mnga' bas/ /'khor ba ji srid shis par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa de/ /dge bshes lo tsā bas de ma thag tu thugs la zin nas bskyar bas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ me long la gzugs brnyan du shar nas/shog bu dang snag tsha spel ba la dgos pa ci yod gsungs pas/ rngog dgyes nas seg mul mul du song nas mgo thog tu thog babs kyang thang po che na phar la 'gro zer ba la/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ pho tshod bskyed/ mi lus rin po che bya ba yang yang rnyed pa ma yin/ khye chung la nyen che ba de na phar la ma 'gro/ gzhan phar bzhag pa'i chu cig phu la dka' las chen po yod/ der khyed kyis byon rting la dgos pa byung na des chog ste/ rgan po 'di 'dra ba cig gis grwa ba lnga brgya bzhag nas byin nas re zhig mjal kha med zer te byung na kha skyengs po 'ong / de bas labs tshad khar ma shor bar byas nas nged yab sras kyi gla bo mnyan na khe che gsungs pa la/ rngog na re/ khyed mad / kho la snying cig yod na 'ong mchi med na ci byas kyang mi phan/ sdod par zhu zer/ der yon bdag shag

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mgon gyi rtog pa la/ nga kun dge bshes pa de kun gyis ngo yang mi shes/ shes nas gros 'debs pa skad byas kyang dga' ru e 'gro yang mi shes/ ci ru song yang khong sems yod rna ba can zhig yin na/ thos pa dag rig pa cig 'ong ngos shes/ rgas nas 'dug ste de na phar zhig 'gro snyam pa byung nas/ jo bo dang bshes gnyen pa la phyag gsum btsal nas/ da kun bza' nyog mang po bskyang dgos pa dang bya ba che bas/ chos zab mo mnyan na'ang 'ong bar gda' ste/ do zhag g.yor phyogs su tshong la 'gro ba'i dus shig byas nas yod pas 'gro zhu zhus pas/bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ sngar gyi las la ma 'gyod na phyis 'byung gi nyes pa mi khegs pa yin/ tsab ta tsob ta bas nga'i chos thun 'di'i 'phro yang nyon/ de nas/ a ti shas nga'i skyes rabasakyang bshad par yod pas nga kun kyang nyon/ rgas khar rlung gis khyer ba la dgos pa yod de dpa' gsungs pas/ yon bdag shag mgon na re / chos thun gyi 'phro nyan 'tshal zer te sems kyi ni thang pho che na sleb tshod na 'dugajo bo'o zhal nas/ mgon med zas sbyin 'dir shog kho bos byin rlabs bya/ chos thun cig thos pa bas gzhan don mang po dga' ba yin/ bskyang bya bskyang ba'i phyir tshong la rgyug gsungs/ der yon bdag shag mgon na re/ gnang ba thugs la btagasazer nas/ btsan ne dang / btsan stag bya ba tsha bo mi gzhon btsan khros pa 'dra ba gnyis yod pa de la/ jo bo yab sras la byin rlabs zhus la/ ba rang nas rta long la sga chas gyis zer bas / tsha bo gnyis pos kyang byin rlabs zhus/ ba rang na khu mtshan gsum la rta bzang ba gsum yod pa la sga chas byas/ 'khor gsum tsher ma 'dra ba re btags nas/ chos ra'i gsham du rta khrid nas byung ste/ a khu byon par zhu zer zhig gda'/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di dag mi mi 'dra gsung / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ mad lags so dngos yin gsungs pas/ thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba cig byung / de nas nyi ma phyi mor song bas/rta bzang bas lha sar sleb skad/ mgron po gzhan kun na re/ khong tshong rang mi byed/ yar klungs mthil na nas 'bras bun btang ba mang po yod/ de tsho'i sgrug yar la 'gro ba yin mchi zer/ la la na re/ gang yin mi shes/mi rgod gting zab po yod tsa na zer/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ brgya labs stong labs kyang / snying gtam dgra la 'chad na glen pa yin/ gsang gtam khrom du sgrog na glen pa yin/ gter brgya lam du byed na glen pa yin / bla ma'i man ngag dang yon tan zong du 'tshong na log 'tsho khrel med yin/ gsang sngags khrom du sgrog na nyams pa yin/ snying gtam mi thub pa'i misanang mi mi 'ong / gsang gtam mi thub pas gros phugs mi 'ong /bud med ngan mas lus mi thub/ btsun pa ngan pas khrims mi thub/ sngags pa ngan pas dam tshig mi thub/grogs ngan gyis blo mi thub/ bu mo ngan mas kha mi thub/ bu ngan gyis dgra sar ltag mi thub/ blon po ngan pas —472—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rjes mi theg /gtso bo ngan pas 'dun stangs mi thub/ khyim mtshes ngan pas grong tshugs mi thub/ gnyen tshugs ngan mas nyon mongs pa brgyud mar bsten/ klad med kha yangs/ snying med col chung / mi shes pa bslabs kyang mi nyan / de dag skyon gyi rnam grangs yin/ skyon de khyed rnams la ma zhugs par bya ba'i phyir du/ yi ger 'bri ba la sogs pa'i bya byed ma mang / chos lugs mi cig pa'i sar khrom sgrogs ma byed/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyud ngan mang po la/ ma rtogs pa dang / log rtog dang / the tshom dang / shes bzhin du sgro skur byed pa la sogs pa sdig rtsa du ma 'byung ba'i phyir dang / de lta bu dang / gzhan yang rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / khe dang grags pa la sogs pa lo 'dod dang / zhe 'dod mang po/ skye bo mang po 'du ba'i sa dang / grong yul du gnas na/ zag pa chen po gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'ong / de spang ba'i phyir du/ grong med pa'i bas mtha'i gnas mal dben par bsdad de/ de dag spang par bya'o/ /yang na grong yul las dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa la sogs pa'i dgon par lus dben zhing dge ba rnam pa gsum/ ngag dben zhing dge ba rnam pa bzhi/ yid dben zhing dge ba rnam pa gsum ste/ dge ba bcu la'ang rang 'dod kyi 'khri bas dben par byas nas gnas par bya'o/ dper na/ ri dwags rgyal po bzhin du grong du mi gnas/ grong gi nyes skyon gyis ma gos/ khengs grags la sogs pa gong du bshad pa de dag gi phyir du / mi'i gral nas bud de/ ri sul dang / nags gseb dang / dben pa'i gnas su rang gis rang nyis sbas/shi na'ang rang min pas ma tshor bar ro bdag med du skyur ba cig dgos/ de ltar byas na mngon par shes pa can rnams la gsang bas mi thub/ spyan mnga' ba rnams la sbas pas mi thub/ rin po che'i gter sa 'og na yod pa 'od nam mkha' la 'phyo/ me khang nang du sbas kyang / de'i gtan tshigs su du ba chen po steng na 'phyo/ des na de dag gis ni yon tan thams cad sgrib pa med par rtogs la/ de'i dbang gis bstod bkur bsngags gsum phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /spyan lnga mngon shes med pa rnams la ni/ bstan kyang gong du bstan pa de dag tu zad do/ /rgya gal te grong yul la sogs par gnas kyang / ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ mi gral nas bud/yon tan thams cad mi mngon par byas te/ bag yod par gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i gnyer gtad ni/ dkar po brgyad cu/ brtan ma bcu gnyis/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin du ma'ang / dkar po brgyad cu'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ spyir bka' la 'dam kha gtad phyin chad nga'i bka' las 'das na/nyes par ltos shig nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba snying gi dkyil du len pa thams cad srungs skyobs shig 'di ni tshig tsam ma yin pa'i bka' rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na/ bas mtha'i dgon par rab gnas shing / /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /bdag gis bdag nyid sba bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /zhes bya —473—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba las brtsams te lha chos bdun ldan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs su nan gyi sgo nas bka' rgyas btab pa'i le'u ste/ pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug gi ya gyal zhig yin pas so// //'di yan dpal gling par mar mi 'dug/'a23 khudapadag snang 'breldoba'i tshomasadang bcasapa'i khu chosadang bo bzhugan(the(/ /༄tsho/ /yang gong gi 'phro la/ yon bdag seng ge la sogs pa yon bdag lnga brgya po dga' bzhin du rang rang gi gnas su dengs/ de nas yon bdag shag mgon pa khu mtshan gyis yar klungs sogs (sogaka khar gser zho lnga bcu (cu3khyer nas/ thang po cher snams (snam3bu mang po nyosapas/ tshong pa bag gro zer nas mi mang po /ka 244 na6 tshan chen po/'dus/ der snam bu la gong byas pa la khong gis rtsegs pas de tsam rtseg na tshong mi 'ong zer/ der yon bdag shag mgon na re/ nga gser dmar rkyang thil ma btsal nas zong snam bu nyo ba yin/rtseg pa nga bden/ yer ba'i nang na 'brom ston pa bya ba/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la ster ba yin zer te/'u cag kun de can du ma song tsa na rtseg 'tshal zer/ tsha bo btsan stag na re/ 'brom yin kyang gser rkyang mi la mi ster te 'ong zer/ yon bdag shag mgon na re/ khyed las nga rgyus che/ byang rtsa sgye bya ba'i yul du phyugs gzhan thams cad phar bzhag pa'i 'bri mo gcig pu rang yang stong khyu ma yod pa bzhag nas/ bla ma'i zhabs tog gcig pu byas/ khams sa mtha' bskor rgya gar gyi sa che ru sleb la khad tsam na yar la rkang thang du a ti sha bsu ru phyin/yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul du/ gser rang yang srang lnga brgya tsam jo bo la phul ba'i skad gda'/ gzhan yang rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la ster te/ dge bshes khu' ma cig gis/ jo bo'i rtsa phyi la/ khong gsod la khad pa mang po byas skad de/ de la'ang tshig mi legs pa gcig tsam yang phyir bzlog ma myong zer zhing yod pa'i 'phro la/btsun chung gzhon nu ma nag 'jur re ba cig rtsa ru byung nas/ yon bdag tshong pa gang nas byon zer/ /yon bdag na re/ nga 'brom chu ris ngos nas 'ongs byas pas/ btsun chung na re/ dge bshes ston pa'am de dang khyod zhal 'dris yod dam zer bas/ yon bdag na re/ zhal 'drisatsam med de/ khong grags pa che ba cig 'dug pa byas pas/ 'o na da ci nas kyi de 'dra ba nam thos zer bas/ yon bdag na re/ nged 'di ngosan tshur la tshong la 'ong tsa na/ de ngos kyi mi lnga brgya tsam pa 'brom la chos nyan pa yin zer nas song / la la phyin nas log cing yang byung byas/ der btsun chung na re/ de rnams kyi gseb na gtso che ba'i chos nyan ji skad bya ba yod zer gyin gda' zer / yon bdag na re/ dge bshes gsang phu ba bya ba grwa ba lnga brgya tsam gyi tshogs dpon yin zer ba cig sngar —474—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mnyam po bas kyang 'brom dman dman tshod du rtsi ba cig yod par gda' na'ang / phyis ngo mtshar can gyi ltas khyad par can mang po byung / da ci nas kyi skad/ khe dang rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la ster/ gyod dang bub kha thams cad khong rang gis len/ gzhan gyi yon tan ci yod pa la zur sgron cing bstod/ khong rang gi yon tan sbas pas ma chog par jo bos gsungs pa tshun chod la de 'dra mi gsung ba zhu cig gsungs pa cig yod par gda' bas/ dge bshes des kyang 'chad nyan khong rang gi grwa ba la bskos nas na ning nas yun ring por dge bshes ston pa la chos nyan cing gda' skad/ de nas la stod gung thang pa yin zer ba'i rgya bod gnyis ka'i chos shes zer ba cig 'dug pa de yang kha sing nas chos gsan cing yod par gda'/ yang len pa'i spyil bu na bzhugs pa'i ka ba shākya ji zhig cig zer ba'i dge bshes chen/ po cig kyang chos nyan cing yod par gda'/gzhan da ci nas zhus pa bzhin du mi tshan can 'du'i /ka 245 na rgoyin/yod par gda' byasapas/ btsun chung de na re/ yon bdag la khad khad mang po 'dug dge bshes ston pa de chos pa bzang por byed pa 'dugadage bshes khus khong la sdang po byas zer ba de 'dra su zer zhing 'dug zer/ yon bdag na re/ de na phar la chos nyan du phyin pa'i byis pa dang mi yis kha bdar ma mang po de 'dra ba'i gtam dpe mang po khyer cing 'phong ra na nyin re bzhin du bshad cing gda' byas pas/ btsun chung na re ji skad zer zhing 'dug zer bas/ de khong tshos chos nyan du phyin tsa na/ 'brom ston pa des chos bzang po zab la rgya che ba mang po gsungs/ ltas dang cho 'phrul mang po byung / der chegs pa thams cad shes pa 'ur la song / jo bo'i zhal nas/ ci la gsungasapa lags sam/ bir wa bir wa/ khu khu/ gang zag khyad par can 'di la sdig bsags gsung bzhin gda' skad/ dge bshes g.yin chen po de kun na re/ thos rgya che yang gnad du ma phog pa/ khu 'dra ba snying med po 'ong ba/ bshes gnyen pa la bzod gsol zhig kyang mi byed/ khengs grags dang lo 'dod kyi chos la shor nas/ tshe phyi mar 'pham po 'ong zer ba la sogs pa khong kun la mang po bshad rgyu gda'/ dge bshes gsang phu ba'am de na re/ khyed lo tsā ba rnam pa gnyisapos gros thob zer zhing 'dug khong pa rnam pa gnyis po na re/ nged kyis gros thebs na ta 'di la ma thug ste gros mi thebs/ snying cig yod na 'di phyogs su cig 'ong ste 'ong zer zhing 'dug dge bshes gsang phu ba na re / de nga yang rgas nas 'dug ste/ gros ma thebs kyang 'gyod brdal ring ba cig byed du 'gro zer zhing gda' lo/ /der dge bshes 'brom mam de'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams gang min min de 'dra ma gsung khong la skyon de 'dra mi mnga'/ ding sang jo bo jo bo yin mod/ gzhan bod na gzhung man ngag lung rigs pa thams cad la khong min pa su yod/ khong min na jo bo yang rgya gar du phyir ldog par bzhed nas gdan de'u ma 'drongs/ jo bo —475—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gdan 'drangs pa'ang khong gis go bcad pa yin/ gzhan yang nga la bka' bkyon bag re tsam byung ste/ nga rang gis go ma chod pa yin/ khong la skyon med/ phyogs cig pa nas bka' bkyon mdzad pa rang thugs la btags pa/rgyal po dmangs phal la mi 'thab pa'i gtam dpe mang po gsungs zhing gda' skad/ gzhan yang kha sang nas khong la mjal du 'gro ba cig nga la 'bab pa cig yod pa yin te/ spyir blo sna thung / de'i nang du myur du shi yis dogs/phyogs cig nas jo bo dang 'bral ma nus/ yang phyogs cig pa nas mi chen rnams kyis mnan byas nas de las thabs ma byung / da rngog khyed rang yang phyin pa mi drag rang res nyan bshad ma byung pa'i khong bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i thugs ma dkrug yang khong thugs gzhi drang tsa na khyed rang la bka' bkyon byung ba'i khrims yod gsung zhing gda' ba la/ jo bos dbu mdzad mi chen kun/ khyed ngo mtshar che/ khong gis zer rgyu khyod kyis byasagasung zhing 'dug pa lags so/ /gzhan yang dge bshes 'brom/ khu la bstod pa'i bstod ra chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing 'dug zer te ngas de las ma zin/ skabs don la/ khong ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa/ra gda' / de 'dra la dka' mo yod/ khong thams cad na re chosapa'am bya ba de 'dra ba cig dgos pa yin zer/rgan rgan la la na re/ de kun rang 'brom bden tsam yod/ khu ta thag ring na med zer byas pas/ btsun chung na re / 'brom mad/ 'brom de chos pa cig yod zer zhing 'dug da yon bdag 'dir ci tsam bzhugs/ yon bdag na re/ nged kyang 'dir di ring sang sdod byas pas/ go lags zer bas btsun chung de ga shed du yud de song / de nas btsun chung des nang du/ khu la phyi'i snang tshul tsho bshad pas/ khu na re/ tshong pa de nang du bos la shog zer nas / btsun chung gis yon bdag gi rtsar phyin nas yon bdag la/ da dung kha skad cig zhu rgyu yod/ nang du byon dang zer nas/ yon bdag gis kyang btsun chung dang 'grogs nas nang du phyin pas/ khu na re/ yon bdag khyed gang nas byon zer/ yon bdag na re/ kho bo 'brom chu ris ngos nas 'ongs zer te phyag gsum btsal te/langs ste 'dug pa la/ khu na re/ stan bzang ba cig 'dug pa der 'dug la gsung gleng thong zer/ yon bdag gis kyang dpa' ma zhus par bsdad pa na/ khu ston na re/ khyed la jo bo yab sras kyi kha skad cig 'dug zer gyin gda' ba 'dir shod dang zer bas/ da ci nas kyi tsho yang bshad pas/ khu na re/ 'o na dge bshes ston pa dang /khu gnyis po su bden zer zhing 'dug yon bdag na re/ blo spyi so nas 'jal ba thams cad 'brom bden zer bar yod par gda'/ khu dang 'brom gnyis po zhal 'cham par khu las bden pa med zer gyin gda' lags/yang khu na re/ dge bshes 'brom rang de skad mi zer de 'ong / yon bdag rang zhabrul ba yin nam zer bas/yon bdag na re/ de nga ta tsa na med de/ nged kyi yul phyogs de nas lnga brgya tsam chos nyan du 'gro zer nas song —476—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ba la/ rgan gzhon gnyis che chung gnyis/ bsam shes che chung thams cad kha mthun nas gda' ba/ yang re re tsam rna ba zhabrul pa srid pa yin te/ thams cad kha mthun tsa na bden pa ma lags sam byas pas/ khu na re/ de yin/dge bshes pa chen po de kun byon nas 'dug zer ba de kun bden par gda'am gsung / yon bdag na re/ de bden par gda' lags/ /lhag par du yang dge bshes rngog des gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i chos nyi shu tsam zhus pa yin zer zhing gda'o/ /yang khu na re/ de yin/ yon bdag la kha skad byung / dge bshes 'brom yon tan thams cad khus byas/ skyon thams cad ngas byas/ khu las bden pa med gsung ba de bden ngos shes par gda'am gsung / yon bdag na re/ de la 'khrul ba ga la yod/ snyan pa'i grags pa gtso che ba cig de la brten nas byung ba lags mod/ tha na nged tshong pa thams cad kyi gtam dper yang khyer nas 'ong ba de lags mod/ yang khu na re/ yon bdag gis chos nyan du ma phyin nam/ yon bdag na re/ kho bo bza' mangs kyi dpon por song rgyags zong mi yul nas sgrub dgos/ las ka lam gzhung la byed dgos par song nas khong rnams kyi gtam skyes nyan pa chos nyan pa'i skal ba dang mi gda' yis/ khu na re/ 'o na khyed kyis khong la bsnyen bkur 'dra bar byed myong ngam/ yon bdag na re/ nga rang gis sgos su ni byed ma myong / yul ba thams cad 'dus nas yer par mar me skyel du 'gro ca na dge 'dun kun la'ang bsnyen bkur re byed pas/ de dus su bu tsha bu mo kun btang nas zhor snyepa /bong la'ang bsnyen bkur byas tshod du yod par 'dug khu 'dzum byas nas/ yon bdag gis bltas na gang bden snyam par 'dug yon bdag na re/ nga la ta chos kyi go rtogs tsam med pas mi shes te/ dge bshes khu'am de yon tan rgya mcho chen po a tsi ba yin par yod par 'dug pa la/ dge bshes 'brom la sdang po sdang po mdzad zer/ de la 'brom mi rlog gi kha la/ jo bo gdan 'drongs pa'i bdag rkyen yang khus byas/ stod du jo bo gdan 'dren pa la'ang khu las brtson 'grus che ba byung ba med/ g.yin yang bod na/ gzhung man ngag thams cad la khu 'dra ba su yang med gsungs nas/ gzhan gyis tshig mi legs pa re tsam khu la gtong ba byung tsa na'ang /khong gis shin tu mi bzod par gda' skad/ gzhon pa slob gnyer gyi go cha can tho phyi ru byung tsa na'ang / slob gnyer byed na khu'i rtsar 'gro dgos pa yin/ bod na khong mkhas pa yin mod gsung zhing gda' lo/ /yang khu na re da dung gsungs shig yon bdag na re/ de 'dra'i rigs la bsam gyis mi khyab par gda' ste/ 'u cag gis mang po ma zin 'o na'ang / thos lo cig la yang / dge bshes gsang phu ba'am de'i zhal nas/ dge bshes ka ba dang /lo tsā ba gnyis yod pa la/ mkhas pa snying med po de la khyed gnyis pos gros thob/ 'di 'dra ba'i gang zag khyad par can la ma btud cing sdig bsags na/ phyi ma la 'gro sa mang po med ces zhus pas/ khong rnam pa gnyis kyi —477—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/zhal nas/ nged gnyis kyis gros btab kyang nged rang dang 'gras pa las mi 'ong / snying zhig yod na nang par nas 'ongs na 'ong gi gsungs pas/ gong bzhin du da khyod kyis gros mi thebalon nga rang gyod rdal la 'gro ba la sogs pa gsungs bar gda' ba la/ 'brom na re/ nga la mjal ba 'bab lugs la sogs pa da ci naba'izhus/pa bzhin du/ dge bshes khu la 'bab rgyu mang po khong gi mdzad lugasamang po gleng zhing gda' byas pas/ khu na re/dge bshes 'brom de chos pa bzang po cig yod par 'dug nged kun kyang grwa ba mang posamanar ba min na/ myur por de na phar 'gro dgos te/ khong der ji tsam bzhugs sam/ yon bdag de na phar nam gshegasagasungs pas / yon bdag na re/ nyid cag 'byon na myur du 'byon dgos pa yod par gda'/ do zhag dge bshesakab pa'am des len pa'i spyil bu ru gdan 'dren pa yod par 'dug de nas snye thang du 'byon pa yin/ yang 'brom gyi dgon pa so mang cig ga shed na yod dam zer bar gda'/ de shed du gshegs pa lags sam/ lar ga shed gshegs pa cig bzhed par yod par gda'/ gzhan yang dge bshesa'abrom khong / chosazhu rgyu yod na da lta zhus/de nas jo bo'ang gar gshegs cha med/ nga la'ang tig tig nges nges tsam med de tsa na gar 'gro dang / 'dir 'gro'i cha med gsungs pas/ dge bshes rngog na re/ khyed kyi skyes rabs khyad par can rnamasayi ger bri dgos zhes zhu ba zer ba la/ yi ge 'bri ba la dgag pa du ma mdzad cing gda' lo/ /gong du jo bos gsungasapa la'ang /dgag pa du ma mdzad cing gda' lo/ /yang khu na re/ 'o na khong kun 'brom de rang rgyud pa cig yin zer ram/ji 'dra zhig yin zer zhing 'dug yon bdag na re/ gzhan cha med/ jo bo kun yang thal lo sbyar nas/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs mgon po spyan ras gzigs zhes gsung zhing gda' lo/ /gzhan thams cad kyang spyan ras gzigs su byed cing yod par gda' zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i kha skad thabs mkhas po'i sgo nas bshad pa dang /khu'i yang rnam rtog thams cad 'gyur/ yon bdag la'ang bsnyen bskur bzang po byas nas/ yon bdag khyed gtam drang la smra mkhas pa cig 'dug da yang tshong thebs 'chag pas gsung gleng dga' ste/ tshong la byon zhig gsung / yon bdag shag mgon gyis tshong la ltos pa med tsa na/ de ma thag tu byon/ de nasakhusakyang le lo ma byas par gam na yod pa kun la/ 'brom ston de la ngag 'khyal en re shor/ de ru song tsa na/ khong chos pa bzang por yod par 'dug pa yin te/ tshig mi legs pa dam dum shor/ gzhan yin na dgra ru lta ru 'ong ste/ khong gi slob gnyer ba gzhon gzhon kun yang 'dir btang nas byung / dbon po btsun chung 'di yang 'dir btang nas byung / sngar nga mi chen gyi rta ba rol rol mang po byed/ khong skyesabu dam pa de/ gcig pur rkang thang du rgyug da nga rang la le len zhig gda' ba'i phyir du bye nag kyang bzhag kho rang gi dbon chung 'di gcig pu khrid la/—478—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /khal kun yang bong bu cig la bkal la 'gro yis gsungs pas/ dbon chung de spyan chab tsar tsar 'dug skad/de nas chibs pa cig khyer ba drag bye stong sa thag ring po la 'o brgyal du 'ong zer bas/ khu na re/ da lan 'o brgyal yang snying tshim/ gal te yang 'brom khong ngo mtshar can yin na/ 'bad rtsol med la myur bar sleb pa'i khrims kyang yod/ rta'i rol rol dang mngon tshan chen po byed mi dgos/ khyed rang rnams kyang / slob dpon pa lha sdings na/ sku mtshamasal bzhugs yod kyis/ gal chen po yod pasamajal phrad byed zer na/ da lo de lo dang gza' skar thams cad rtsub pas/ lto skyel re tsam las su la'ang phrad pa'i skabs med kyis/ khyed rang rnams kyang nga rang log nas ma byung gi bar du/ mjal ba dang snyad snyod mang po ma byed/ de 'dra byung na 'thab mo 'ong ngo //rgya gal te 'dir gum chad kyi rigs byung na'ang / bsod nams bsag pa'i yul/ dkon mchog gsum ni 'di na yod / nor rdzas ni 'di na yod/ khyed rang rnams kyis bya ba mdzad pa las bya rgyu gzhan med/ da dbon po khyed rang grwa ba rnams chosarar tshogasa'akha bskos yod do gyis la sogs/ dbon posakyang / da lta rang zhal bskos gags po 'ong ba yod de la tshogs byas pas/ yud pa cig la na ga ra dza la sogs pa'i/ dpon gnyer dang bcas pa thams cad tshogs nas byung / de dus su khu ston gyis zhal bskos gsungs pa ni/ 'dir tshogs byas pa'i kha ta'i skabs don la/ ngas sngar nyan bshad byas pa thams cad/ gzhung rgya chen po la byasa'abrom gyi bzhin du / dman cha blangs pa'i chos ma byas par/ nga rgyal dang lo 'dod bag re byas pa'i lugs yin/ de ring de 'brom dang jo bo'i lugs 'di sha tsha snying nye blo la phan skad pas/ khong rang gi lugs su gdams ngag tu bgyi/thams cad che sa chung sa rang sa nas rang rang gi blo la gros thob la/ dge sbyor gyi rim pa la 'bad par zhu ba dang / nga yang / da lo dge sbyor cig byed pas mtshams shin tu dam pa cig byed/ de la na tsha dang shi chad byung kyang / tshe zad na ngas kyang bshol mi thebs pas/ mjal sna dang zhu sna ma mang cig ces bya ba'i don ni/ de ring nyi ma dkar po la/ /dkar po'i sems kyis 'dir 'tshogs zhus/ /bya rgod nam 'phangasagacod pa ltar/ /sngon chad bshad pasamatha' rgya bcad/ /rgya khra gzan la gzhungs pa bzhin/ /da ni gdams ngag don du 'gril/ /grogs po 'brom rgyal ji bzhin du/ /dman cha blangs nasachos ma byas/ /da ni 'brom dang jo bo bzhin/ /sems la phan pa'i man ngag bgyi/ /rang sar blo la gros thob la/ /sems la phan pa'i dge sbyor gyis/ /nga yang da lo dge sbyor byed/ /sngar bzhin rnam g.yeng mi byed par/ /lcags kyi ga'ur zhugs te sdod/ /btsan po 'chi ba byung gyur kyang / /nga la zhu mjal ma mang cig /tshe 'di chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra/ /rba klong che la myur du 'gro /stobs gang gis bshol 'debs dka'/ /da ni rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing / /gangs chen mtsho der ma sleb par//—479—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gtan phan lam la bde bar 'gro/ kho bo chos la mkhas gyur kyang / /mkhas par ral gris byams desabacom/ /'di ched byis pa'i rtse mo 'dra/ /'phral dga' 'dra ste phugs dgos stor/ /da ni rgya gar mkhas pa'i chos/ /snying po'i don de blang ba'i phyir/ /rnam rtog sprin tshogs yer ba'i sa/ /rje btsun lha yi lha sdings su/ /gtan du phan pa'i stan thog tu/ /rin chen gser gyi phreng ba nyid/ /don med mi khrom dgos pa med/ /smra bcad byas pasalha rgyas 'brang / /srod thun nam gyi cha stod la/ /mchod tshogs sbyor ba bsham par bya/ /nam gung rtse gcig dran par bya / / tho rangs nam gyi cha smad la/ /dge sbyor lam la 'jug par bya/ /dge sbyor gnad du phyin pa'i tshe/ /da gzod mjal phrad du ma bya/ /de tshe rnam g.yeng mang gyur kyang / /nga rgyal mkhar ba thog gis bcom/ /bdag 'dzin 'khor ngan jo bosamanan/ /bde gshegs bstan pa spyi bor khur/ /de tshe 'phya smod rlung tshub zhi/ /rang gi gnas lugs byams pas bskor/ /de ltar gzhan la phan gyur na/ /bdud rtsi'i khu ba ston pa yin/ /gzhan du dug chus tshe srog 'bral/ /de ni 'dir 'tshogs zhu don yin/ /de bas sangs rgyas kun gyi yum/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas rab mnyes nas/ /de yi sras mchog 'gro ba'i dpal/ /mar me lta bur gsal gyur cig /snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs mthar khyab/ /rnyed bkur bla med rin chen gling / /rin chen spungs pa'i bkra shis gang / /mchog gi bkra shis ding 'dir shog /ces gdan las khag ste bzhengs nas gzims khang du gshegs/ thams cad kyang de ring gi chos de zab/ lung man ngag gang la bltas kyang 'dug zer nas/ rang rang gi go cha blangs nas / dge sbyor la'ang 'bad/ mjal phrad kyi kho thag yang bcad/ de nas dge bshesakhusasrod la/ 'brom la ther cham dkar po gcig /ther ma'i 'jol shag gcig /ther ma'i sham thabs gcig srin bal gyi ske rags bzang po gcig jo bo la'ang / ther ma'i thang sham zung cig gding ba ske rags dang bcasapa gcig gnyisaka snam bu bzang ba'i stobs kyis/ dar kha bzang ba re rer 'thums pa byas te/ gser srang drug bcu (cukatham pa gteg nas rked sor tshud pa mdzad/ gzhan yang lam gyi cha rkyen bong bu bzang po cig gis bde yang du theg pa cig byas/ 'phral gyi na bza' thams cad kyang / bde yang du mdzad nas/ gung thun la'ang nang pa ma 'phyisapa zhig dang / myur du sleb pa cig snyam pa lasagazhan ma byung / de'i gong yan chod du'ang / dge bshes gsang phu ba'i nga rgyal dang / thugs sbram mi sbram/ dge bshes ka ba'i thugasatshod che chung dang thugs sbram mi sbram/ dge bshes gung thang ba'i rgya bod kyi yon tan la nga rgyal lugs/ bod la bka' drin che ba'i yus che lugs la/'brom la chos nyan ci yod bya ba ci bden/ rmi lam min nam/ ngas kyang rnyengs pa cig ma phyin pas khrimasal mi shong / sngon la kha tshod lta ru 'gro yis/ sleb 'brog la 'brom la btong ba'i ther ma bubs cig bdog byas/—480—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /khong gsum po des btud kyi sting la/ 'brom la yon tan chen po cig yod par thag chod/ de tshong la btud dogs med snyam pa'am 'ba' zhig yid la rgyu/ de nas nang par tho rangs kyi skar chen shar ba dang / jo bos gnang ba'i paṇa zhwa cig yod pa gsol/ spang mkhar zhig yod pa bsnams te byon pas gru khar nam ma langs par sleb / da sngas pas ko mkhan yang yug cig mi 'ong snyam tsa na/ re shig nas ko skya lcob lcob pa cig byung / de ci yin nam snyam tsa na/ khyo ga dkar po cig cig pa cig byung / ko jag pa min na rung snyam tsa na/ gru kha'i de kun su yin zer/ der dge bshes khus 'di dge bshes khu ston pa'i mi rgya gar ba'i paṇḍi ta la mjal du 'gro ba yin/khyed gar 'gro ba yin byas pas/ nged kyang bang chen cig la 'gro ba yin te 'chis ('phyisakaskyon zhig byung zer bas / /ka 249 ba6 rgodage bshes khus//nged kyis sla (glakachen po sbyin gyis bsgral bar zhu byas pas/de na re nga rang kyang rings par yod/ gzhan yang khyed khu ston pa'i skor gyis paṇḍi ta 'di'i rtsa phyi la/ 'brom byang chub sems dpa' de la sdang po mig 'byin pa 'dra ba byas zer/ rgya sde thams cad kha 'cham nas 'dug da lan yang paṇḍi ta la mjal ba ngo mtshar che ste/ 'brom bzang po de la sdig bsags na/ nga rang la'ang sdig pa 'ong zer/de thos pa dang / khu lhag par du'ang dad pa skyes/ nga rang gis ma thos pa min pa thams cad kha 'cham nas yod par 'dug snyam nas/ yen bdag khyed las bden pa med/ khu nga rang yin te nyes pa la 'gyod nas da bzod gsol byed du 'gre ba yin/ da lan cis kyang khyed kyis gru thong / nges song skad kyang gsong da gzod kyang bzang lan che ba cig bya/ da lan kyang zho phyed dbul gyis gsungs pas/ de na re/ 'o na nga ring po ring po zhig yod de/de la 'gro na khyed mi chen po gsong (gsang3nas gshegs pa la ngas kyang bsongs(gsong ka / da gzod kyang bzang len che ba cig bya/ da lan kyang zho phyed dbul gyi gsungs pas/ de na re/ 'o na rings po rings po cig yod de/ de la 'gro na khyed mi chen po gsang nas gshegs pa la ngas kyang gsang ba las 'os med/ da lan gru sla (glakayang mi mtshal ('tshalaka gyi/ dge bshes 'brom de ngo mtshar can zhig yin par 'dug pas thugs mnyes par mdzod/ nga khyed kyis da bzod ngo mi shes te/ khyed mi chen po yin pas/ da bzod kha skad nyan la/ nga yin lugs zhus la drung du 'ong gis de tsa na gang phan mdzad par zhu zer/ khus khyed kyi ming ci yin/ de na re ming da lan bshad rgyu med tho rangs gru kha'i mnyan pa de byas pas nor mi srid zer/ dbon po na re/ ming las don dga' ba yin/ do nub khyed kyis gru btang na des chog da bzod mjal mi mjal yon bdag shes/ nged kyis ma bslus pa cig byed pa yin byas pas/ btsun chung bden zer nas khos gru sgral (bsgral|/ pha rol tu bsgral ma thag tu/ btsun chung na re/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho la rten (brtenakanas mnyan pa chos dang dpal 'byor gyis phyug par —481 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/shog / ces smon lam btab skad/ de nas mi 'ong (bong1gsum gyis nye zho dang chad 'khrugs med par yer ba na yar la myur por sleb/ dge bshes ka ba pa rnam pa gnyis kyang / yon bdag shag mgon tshong la 'gro zer nas blo phebs / dge bshes ka bas jo bo yab sras len pa'i spyil bur spyan drangs/ de'i lam khar bu mo g.yion nu ma cig gis jo bo la rang gis gos phud nas phul/ byin rlabs zhus pas/ de'i dus su bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ bu mo 'dis mthong chos la phyug mo cig 'ong / klung shod kyi zhang phyug po cig gi chung ma byed/ yon bdag mo khyod kyis paṇḍi ta ngo shes sam gsungs pas/ bu mo na re/ shes lags zer/ ji skad bya ba yin byas pas / jo bo rje lha cig bya ba yin zer/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de rten 'brel yin bu mo khyod la bu zhig skye / gcig po de jo bo rje lha cig 'dra ba cig 'ong ming yang nga'i ming la brten nas/ shes rab/ jo bo'i mtshan la brten nas 'ong / grags pa can zhang bu gcig po bya ba grangasanyung la 'bru bzang / do zhag zhusalan gyi skabasasu bu mos sleb/ 'di'i bu gcig po de'i slob ma gcig gisazhus lan 'di la/ nyamasalen byed pa cig 'ong srid gsungs pa dang / bu mo de shin tu dga' nas song / de nas len pa'i spyil bor byon nas yug cig bzhugs/ka bas de nyid du thugs dam mdzad cing bzhugs/ dge bshelolo tsā ba yang spyan 'dren pa cig byung nasayar klungs ngosal gshegs/ de nas slar yer bar byon pa'i dus su/ jo bo yab srasaganyisagasang phu ba dang gsum yod pas de'inyadus su/ bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ dge bshesagasang phu ba khyed rang yang / nagasakhrod du thugs dam mdzad cing gsang phur phyin na mi mchi'am gsungasapas/ gsang phu ba na re/ phyin na kha sang nasaphyin zin / blo bcad kyi mi la gros 'debs dka' bya ba yin zer/ der bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ thugasatshod rang dge bshesaka ba che/ kha sang nas gsung gleng 'phel po mdzad/ bcad rgyu tsho bcad/ gleng rgyu tsho glengs/thugs thog tu phebs pa dang thugs dam mdzad zer nas/ rang gi dgon par dben par bzhugasapar gda'/dge bshes lo tsā ba'ang de dang mthun par mchims phu na yar gshegs/ da do zhag lab lob mang po somi bsod (gsodaka pa la/ khyed bgresapo cig bzhugs par 'dug do zhag kun mi byung na/ chosadang mthun pa'i babs gtam smra ba ma gtogs pa/ nga'i yon tan brjod pa dang / nga la bkur bkur sti sti mang po bya mi 'tshal/dad gus thugs la byasapas chog pa yin gsungasapas/ dge bshelogasang phu ba na re/ da lug rgan cig gi tshe las med/ su byung kyang ngo bsrung ba mi 'ong / dbang che na'ang che thog tu skrur/ dge bshesache na'ang che thog tu skyur / mkhasapasang rgyal thog tu skyur/ phyug pos nga rgyal na'ang rgyal thog tu skrur/ sngar go ma chod pasa'agyod na da bkur 'osami 'khur te/ thig drang por mi 'debs ri zer ba dang / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ do zhag —482—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'thab mo cig 'ong / byas pa'i kha la mi nyan pa/ rus sbal kha nas shing shor 'dra/ zer ba'i gtam de 'ong ba'i mgo zhig byung gsungs pas/ rngog na re/ thal mo ya med sdebs shes na thal mo mkhas/ 'thab pa la 'thab ya dgos / da kun brgyab na mgo 'dzed/ shags su bden 'bul/ lan du 'o lags ka byed do gsungs pas/ jo bo shin tu mnyes/ khyed gnyis po'i 'thab mo de phyir gyis shig nga yang phyir 'gro'o/ tsha tsha dgu ldab ('dangakapa'i 'dam pa cig khyer la shog nyi ma shar gsungs bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ bgyid 'tshal gsungs nas/gzim khang gi phyi na spang ljongs legs po yod pa la/ jo bo bzhugs gdan bteg nas/ gzims khang gi rgyab na bzhugasapa dang / bshes gnyen pas 'dam pa chang bu cig la cang cang mdzad pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kho bo'i lag pa ni de la bkos (bskosaka pa yin/ tshur thong gsung / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ nga'i lag pa ni bal smel ba la bkos (bskos1pa ma lags kyi/ dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog 'di rang la nga bsgos bskal 'pham rgyu med/ g.yam gsung nas/ 'dag pa gtong ba dang / phyag 'bul ba stabs su mdzad do/ /de nas jo bo'i zhal nas/ ci byas rtag tu dge ba'i dpal/ /gang la'ang dus 'doms gnyen gcig pu/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs 'dzin/ lha/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khyed bden bzhugs/ kho bos bla ma'i rnam thar bskyangs/ /lag pa rdol te chos la rdol/ /mi lusachos la ma bkol na// /phyi nasayang yang rnyed pa min/ /sngon chad 'phrod pa'i gtam mang byung / /don du gnyer ba'i shes ldan 'dus/ /do zhag so bsod 'dun ma dge /bshes gnyen khyod kyi tshogs rdzogs shing / /de ring dga' bder longs spyod phyir/ /bod btsun bsod nams las zhabrungs pa'i/ /zhim ja skol la khyer la shog /de ring nyams dga' gleng mo bgyi/ /legs pa'i shes rab drung 'dir shog /gus pa'i sems kyisang la btud/ /nga dang phrad pa skal bar bzang / /'brom rje nyid pasakho bo bzang / /zhesagasungasapa dang / bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed gsung dri med byon pa legs/ /lce bde rig gsal 'gro na mgyogs/ /rin chen snod du bltams na mdzes/ /g.yo dag thon par byas te drang / /'od gsalabade ba'i zhing khams 'dir/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul ba nga / /dusagasum dge ba'i sgyed kha la/ /ma sbuspum brdol ma spangasapa/ /rin chen snod mchog rab btad nas/ /ye shes me dpung me bskyed de/ /bde skyid thugalorje'i du ba 'byur/ /zhi bde bsil ba'i chab bltams nas/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sdor du 'debs/ /tshod zin ro snyoms tshwa yi mngags/ /byang chub shing gi ngad pa can/ /'thungs pa tsam gyis bde skyid na/ /yar la gusapa'i skyogs kyis 'dren/ /mar la snying rje'i skyogs kyisa'adren/ /bar du gzhung ring grogasabaskyed la/ /snyan cing bde bar khyab par byed/ /sgyu ma'i skyesabu 'gron (mgronaka bu yin/ /sprul ba'i khye chung lag bde yin/ /snyoms 483—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i bsnyen bkur bag yod yin/ /sprul pa'i chos kyi dbyings nas byung / /'brel chags lo rgyus gtam gyis 'grol / / 'gron (mgron|rnams chos kyi dbyings su dengs/ /dge rtsa bde stong dag par bsngo/ /smon lam rtag tu bde bar 'debs/ /rkang g.yas sa la rab bsnun pas/ /ngan song yong ye yod ma gyur/ /g.yon pa cung zad gyen bteg pas/ /thams cad nga dang lhan cig tu/ /thar ba'i gnas su phyin par shog /phyag rgya phyogs su rab skyod pas/ /bkra shis phyogs mthar rgyas par shog /phyag rgya nang du rab bskums pas/ /dpal 'byor g.yang du 'du bar shog /'brom ston bka' gdams rin chen nga'i/ /dam pa chos kyi ja skol yin/ /da bzod zang zing rdzas kyis skol/ /bla ma yab sras dga' bder bzhugs/ /da ni nyams dga' nang du 'gro /longasapa'i nor rdzas chos la spyod/ /longs spyod bya ba de la zer/ /zhes gsungs nas/ bag phebs pa'i dga' dga' mang po mdzad pas/ jo bo du mar bzhad cing / dge bshes ston pa sku khams gsos pa'i ltad mo che gsung / de nasabashes gnyen pas nang du byon nas ja zhim po dang / dri mi kha ba'i sman mar phun sum tshogs pa dang / ka ra dang /rtsam pa spu bcad ma dang / zhib thud legs po sbyar nas/ sngar med pa'i ja rkyen legs po zhig tu ja blugs/dkar yol 'brug rgyab phun sum tshogs pa gnyis khyer/ 'brom chung gzhon nu ma cig la bsnyen bkur gzhan kun bskur nas byon te/ jo bo yab sras gnyis po la drangs pas/ rngog na re/ gzhon nu ma 'di kun gyi snang tshul lam rgyal bu byon tsa na bram ze rgas zer ba'i tshul de kun dran gyi gda'/ gzhon nu ma nga la spyan legs po des gzigs la drongs shig rgan po bung ba tsam pa 'di gzhon nu ma me tog khyod la yang yang blta zhing zungs shig lar khyod kyis nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ kho bo lcags zad brdar zad la song ba'i lugs su gda' gsungs pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de 'dra'i nyen skad cig 'don mi dgosakyi/ do zhag khyed nga la 'phreng ba min/ byis chung 'di la 'phreng ba yin/ gzhon nu rang yang rngog legs pa'i shes rab ces bya ba deng sang ngo mtshar che ba cig yin/ rgan po de la phyag gcig tshol khong gi drung du sdod/ nyen skad lhang lhang ba de kun sems gsos gsung ba dang / 'brom chung gzhon nu ma des 'dzum byas nas/ he he zer nas phyag gus gus 'dra ba drug byas nas ja sun re drangs shing / de ma thag tu rngog gi drung du lhan lhan bsdad pas/ jo bo dang rngog gnyis ka dges grags (dragasakanas mchi ma shor/ der gzhon nu de na re/ nga 'dra ba la mnyes rin mi chog /mnyes na pha ston bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 'dra ba la mnyes dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ de'i nyin par ja yang mang po skol / jo bo pa rnam pa gnyis pos kyang sngar chen po mi gsol ba la/ de'i nyin drangs tshad gsol/ de nas nang par kyang de bzhin du gzims khang gi phyi na bzhugs nas yod pa'i dus su/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed —484—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yab sras gnyis dus gsum du dge ba'i gsung gleng mdzad cing bzhugs shig gzhon nu rang kha sang bzhin du ga dar gyi thon po gyis la/ 'u cag 'brog pa'i lugs su phur ma dang / khams pa'i lugs kyi ja dang / bod pa'i lugs kyi rtsam zhib dang gyis la sdod cig kho bos khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung bya ba/ bod kyi sde snod 'dzin pa chen po cig yod pa de/ sa thag ring po nas zhabs thang du byon zhing yod/ bsu ru 'gro yis gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ kha sang yon bdag gtsang pas phul ba'i ras de khyer la song la gsungs nas/ bshes gnyen pas kyang ras yug de bsnams nas /ka 252 ba6 rgorabs/tsa na mar la slebs tsa na/ mda' rgyang gang gis slebs tsam na yar la sngar khu ston gyi rta ba'i rol rol dang grags pa la/ de ring khal pa (makabong bu zhig dang / 'khor du 'brom rang gi btsun chung khrid/ paṇa zhwa spu med cig gsol/ spang(sba1 mkhar cig la brten nas byung bas/ 'brom chen po la'ang de las thugs brtse ba ma byung gsung / de nas bshes gnyen pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ nged gnyis 'phrad 'phro la phyag cig byas na khong gis kyang phyag lan byed du 'ong snyam nas / rtsig pa mthon po cig 'bab cing yod tsa na/ btsun chung gis bshad pa lags sam/ khu ston gyis ngo shes nas / 'brom chen po 'di thugs bcam pas/ nga rang mjal 'phro la phyag byas na 'ong ste/ khong gis sngon la phyag byas pa srid/ 'di na mar la 'ong lugs 'di rang yang ci yin nam/ nga 'ong ba rgyang nas mngon par shes pa yod de rtogs pa yin nam/ gzhan 'di na mar la 'ongs dogs med/ phal cher nga 'ong ba shes pa yin nyen yod/'on kyang da lta rang phyag phar 'tshal tshur 'tshal rang bas 'di rang nas phyag byas pa grag (dragakasnyam nas phyag byas tsa na/ 'brom chen po'ang rtsig pa mthon po cig gi logs kyi dkyil nas/ phyag 'tshal bas rtsig pa la ma lhung phyag gus po cig shes te/ khus de mthong ma thag tu tshig lab la/ ya ya 'brom gyi rnam 'phrul la ltos /ka253 na waṃshig na tshos mnyam po la ngas bde mo la'ang gom pa 'khyor/ khong ni lha phrug nam mkha' lding gi phyag byed/ der ma zad sngar rta bzang po bye nag la bzhon na'ang rta thog tu chad/ dus deng sang du song tsa na byin pa la rta byas/ snying rus kyi lcag brabs nas 'ongs pas/ nyin zhag de tsam zhig 'ongs kyang ngal ba'i rtags mi gda' / / nas 'ong pas/ nyin zhag de tsam cig 'ongs kyang ngal ba'i rtags mi gda'/ bye nag la zhon (bzhonakanas 'ongs kyang de las mgyogs par mi sleb/ de yang 'brom chen po'i byin rlabs dang rdzu 'phrul rang yin gsung / der dbon po btsun chung gis slob dpon pa de skad su la gsung ba yin zhus pas/ da na re ji skad zer gsung / btsun chung gis gong gi rnams bskyar bas/ ngas de 'dra labs pa rang ma dran/ der bong bzang cig yod pa la btsun chung gis lcag yang yang brabs shing ded kyang / khu ston chen po'i rig pa 'ur la song —485—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nas rjes zin rgyu ma byung / de nas rdo rgyang gang tsam du khong gnyis po phrad de/ 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa byon pa thugs la btagasate 'di ltar 'o brgyal ba mdzad pa/ 'o na'ang 'o skol gnyisaphrad pa gcig pus chog gisagasung gi gda' tsa na/ khu'i mig mchi masa'agagasapa cig byas/ gsung 'bug rgyu med par yus ches nas 'brom chen po'i na bza' la 'changs/ der 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshesaganyen pa de 'dra cig 'ong ba de ci yin / bod 'di na khyed las mi che ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang ba su yod/ don med par mchi ma 'don pa byis pa chung chung dang / bu mo gzhon nu ma tsho'i lugs yin mod/ 'di 'dra ma mdzad gsungs nas 'brom chen po'i phyag gis spyan chab rnamasaphyisatsan/ btsun chung gisakyang slebasatsa na / khong gnyisapo'i spyod tshul mthong ste/ rjesasu yi rang ba'i sgo nas mchi ma 'don cing phyag 'tshal skad/ de nas 'brom chen po'i zhal nasa'adi skad du/ skye ba du ma'i tshogs gnyisalas 'brungasapa'i/ /bshesaganyen dam pa mchog tu legs bltams nas/ /brgya phrag mkhasapa'i dbus na lhang nge ba/ /nongasapa'i spyod pa sbyan chab ma mdzad cig khu na re/ bag med glang chen spyon pa ngas/ khrel yod ngo tsha'i tshal rab bcom/ /dga' bder gnasapa'i bung ba stor/ /smra zhing mi dga' phyogasabacur dengs/ /mthun pa'i grogasapo sun phyung bas/ /mya ngan gcig pu rang la gnas/ /bu tsha bu mo ngu bsatsog(btsog3/yus po bdag 'dra cisami ngu / /zhesayusakyisakha brgyal nas brid kyang ma nyan/ yang 'brom po'i zhal nas/ spyan chab ma 'don dga' bde thon/ /bdag cag gnyisal nongasapa med/ /sems kyi sgron me gcig tu gsal/ /ze 'bru gcig la'ang yangs dog med / khu ston chen po nga la nyon/ /'o skol bsod nams bsagasapa'i mi/ /tshe 'dir chos la spyad du yod/ /gnas lugasashesanasagayin la ston/ /rang gzhan don du skyes pa yin/ /ci ste spyan chab 'don par byed/ khu ston po nga la nyon/ /yer ba me tog sdong po 'dra/ /ze 'brusasbud pa'i zla steng na/ /mar me mdzad dpal bzang po bzhugs/ /'dab rgyas grub thob du mas gang / /legs pa'i shes rab mdun na 'khod/ /spyan chab ma 'don zhing der 'deng / /yid kyi mun pa sel byed yod/ /nor bu gser gyi phreng ba yod/ /'dzad med bdud rtsi'i chu mig yod/ /skye ba bzang po'i dpal 'byor yod/ /mchi ma ma 'don zhing der 'deng / /zhes gsungaspopa tsam gyis khu'i bsam pa la/sngar 'brom 'dis ji 'dra'i zog cig byas/ da lta tshigs su bcad pa lathogasapa mi gda' ba/ a tsa ma khong gi yon tan 'di lta bu'i rnam 'phrul yod pa la/ rmu thom sathom rdol (gdolanab ngas/ sngar de ltar nongasapa ngo re tsha nga la de dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i lha cig med dam/ ma tha bas rmi lam du 'ongs nasakha mi 'gegs pa snyam du sngar gyi nyes pa la 'gyod pa drag po skyes/ skyes pa tsam gyis kyang yusacher song nas/ 'brom chen pos—486—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /rten (brtenaka pa ma gtogs pa lus tshugs mi thub pa 'dra ba byung / de'i dus su 'brom chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la 'di sngar gyi nyes pas nongs nas 'dug snyam du dgongs nas/ da ni 'di'i sdig pa bshags pa'i dus la bab/ 'gyod pa mang bar ma tshad/ da de'i rang bzhin shes par bya dgos pa la/ 'gyod drags nas sems klong klong por gyur na rang bzhin shes par mi 'gyur bas/ 'di'i mya ngan dang yid 'thoms pa bsal te/de nas gnyen po byin la sor chud par bya'o snyam ste/ pho skad sangs pa cig bton pas/ der khu'i bsam pa la/'brom chen po 'di sngar de 'dra ye mi gsung ba yin te/ 'di 'dra cig ci yin nam snyam du the tshom zos/de nas rgya lam der bcun gzugs gnyis dang / bu mo gzhon gzhon gnyis gsum yang gsung de 'don pa'i sgang la slebs nas byung / dbon po bcun chung yang ma/chi ma 'don 'phro la dgod/ der mgron po de kun btsun chung mchi ma 'don cing dgod pa mthong ba dang / pha ston mi tshe la ngag kyal mi zer ba de de skad gsung ba mthong zhing thos pa dang / phyag 'tshal 'dod pa la dgos (dgodakabro grags (dragasakanas/ bu mo gzhon nu ma kun rang re rang re'i grogs mo la lta zhing brdeg de la rten (brtenakanas khu yang 'dzum pa cig byung bas/de dus su 'brom chen pos thabs mkhas pa'i gtam rgyud 'di gsungs pa/ de ring ya mtshan ci yang mthong /dge bshes chen po ngu ba'ang mthong / /gzhon nu ngu dgod gnyis ka mthong / /tha mal bu mo dgod pa mthong /btsun gzugs bzang la 'cha' dgod mthong / /rgad po gcig la gcig 'changs te/ /pha mes ma mes tsha gum nas / / yus gsol 'greng ste lab pa zhin/ zhes pa'i 'phro la/ yang bu mo de kun la gzigs nas/ bu mo gzhon nu'i glu tshig mdzod gsungs pas/ de shin tu 'dra ba cig byung nas yang khu ston shin tu yus pa de sangs pas/yang 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ sngon tshe rgya gar mtha' 'khob tu/ khyed ni swa lu khal gcig gi /zhing can phyug po nyid du gyur/ /nga ni ri bong mtho ris can/ /rtswa za longs spyod 'phel bar gyur/ /de tshe khyod kyi zhing steng der/ /yang yang swā lu'i ljang pa zos/ /phyug po ma mnyes mda' snun brtsams/ /de tshe nga yis bzhad rgad pas/ /ya mchu ral ba phyug pos mthong / /zhe sdang rgad mos chags par gyur/ /de yi snang ba de ring shar/ /zhes gsungs pas/'brom chen po'i byin rlabs la rten (brtenakanas/ khus kyang cung zad cig dran pa byung / khong gi de snyan nas rgya lam pa cig 'dus gnyis 'dus la mang po tshogs te/ thur la 'gro ba kun kyang gyen la ldog gyen la 'gro ba rnams kyang thur la ldog cing gsung gleng ba'i phyi la 'grengs/ de la'ang khu sku khams cung zad cig sos pas/yang 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ /lan cig rgya gar nags khrod du/ kho bo bsam gtan bsgom pa na/ /dug sprul gcig cig gam du byung / /rma bya cig gis de mthong nas/ /dug sprul de la za bar brtsams/ /dug sprul de yang —487—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/de bzhin gyur/ /de tshe dug sprul rtog gnyis langs/ /za bar 'dod dang zos kyis dogs/ /sdong dum cig la mjug 'thogs pas/ /rma byar 'phrul te de la rgol/ /mjug ma'i rtse la sdong dum 'byar/ /sdong dum ded pas mjug ma bros/ khor ma khor yug ngal bar zad/ /gnas lugs ma shes lan pa yin/ /de tshe kho bo gzhad (bzhad3gad shor/ /de gnyis khyed gnyis shes par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'brom chen po'i byin brlabs kyis khu dang btsun chung gnyis kyis kyang cung zad dran par gyur/ khams kyang cung zad sosaso/ /yang 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ lan cig rgya gar phyogs cig tu/ /rgyal po zhig gi bran mor gyur/ /de tshe bdag gis chu blangs tshe/ zangs skyogs nang du nya zhig zhugs/ /de yang zangs ban nang du shor/ /nang gi zangs kyi chu rar sleb/ /de dus nya yis bzhad gad pas/ /rgyal po mahās tshor bar gyur/ /ci yin dris pas byung tshul bshad//de tshe bran la le lan bdas/ /de tshe nya dang bran gyis rgad/ /rgyal po zhus ste 'khrugs pa zhi/ /zhes gsungs pasakyang / byin rlabs zhugs te khus kyang dran par byung bas de'i dus su khu sems rgod cing gsal bar gyur ba'i dus su/ 'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ da bzod bshes gnyen dam pa bzang / /da ni bzang po'i drung du 'deng / /bying dang rgod pa sna tshogs kyang / /legs par dpyad na rang stong yin/ /stong par shes na skyes bu dag /nyes gang mchis na'ang de tshe mthol/ /gsungs pas/ khu'i zhal nas/ thabs mkhas skyes bu dam pa bzang chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos par/ /sgo gsum nyes pa ci mchis pa/ /mgon po khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /bden med bzhin du 'khrul gyur bas/ /don med gyi na du ma spyad/ /da bzod (gzodaka 'gyod pas khyod mngon du / / sdom pa'i sems kyis khyod la bshags/ khu ston dregs pa'i sems spangs te/ /dman cha blangasate khyod la 'dud / / bder gshegs zhabs bzhin spyi bor blang / /drung du bdag nyid brten par mdzod/ /ces zhusapa dang /'brom chen po'i zhal nas/ nyes pa bshags pa bzod gsol mchog /mkhas pa nyes dang ma 'grogs na/ /bzang btsun kun gyis bkur bar 'gyur/ /'o skol gnyis kyi 'dun ma dge /zhes gsungs pa dang / khu'i zhal nas / de ltar sngon grogs ngan gyi stobs su shor ba dang / lo 'dod kyi grags pa la shor ba dang / shes 'dod kyis nga rgyal ba dang / mi mkhas pas bstun ma shes pa dang / bdag 'dzin gyis bzod stobs ma thob pa dang /bshad tshogs dang nyams len ma 'byor bas khyed la kha mi legs pa'ang mang po shor/ gzhan yang bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog 'bab pa bzhin du ma nus par/ phyin ci log tu spyad pas nongs pa thamasacad khyed thugs rje chen po la bzod par gsol/ phyis sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lar bdag 'dzin ngan pa'i bdud sde phugs su zhugs tsa na/ dam pa mi khur/ drin chen slu/ tshe 'di'i mdun ma bag res nam zhag 488

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma 'joms/ nyan bshad la sogs pa dge sbyor bag re byed na'ang lo 'dod kyi dbang du shor/ da gzod snying gtam yin/ da ni a bo khu ston la gzhan du ma 'dzin cig sngar gyi dge bshes ston pa mi ngan de'i snying gcig pa'i 'khor du song ba khu la snying tshim/ da khyod rang rgyud ngan pa de la 'khor dregs pa can mang pos bskor/ bye nag 'og tu bcug bsam yas thang chen/ rnams su/ nga rgyal gyi rol rol byed cing mi sdod par/da bong chung cig la khal bkal/ btsun chung cig la 'khor byas/ byin ngan gyi rta la 'gyod ngan gyi lcag brabs nas / khyo ro ro bshes gnyen 'brom nga'i/ snang tshul de gzigs sam/ sngar gyi snang chul de mthong ngam/ nga rgyal gyi ri chag pas/ nyi ma'i 'od snga la 'des pa cig byung gda' na/ da ni mi'i kha la g.yu ta med do/ /'o skol gnyisakyi sems la tha dad med/ khu thugs kyis zung zhig gsungs pa dang / bshes gnyen 'brom gyi zhal nas/ khyed mdang zhag 'o brgyal te 'di las lhag pa med pa yin gyi/ 'khor bzang gis bskor/ rta bzang gis bteg gos bzang gis skyabs/ chos bzang gis bsdus/ 'jig rten na nga zer kyang / lha tshangs pa'i dbags shig las med chos bya ba'ang sems la phan zhing las su rung ba cig dgos par gda'/ las su mi rung ba'i lo 'dod kyi chos de kun de/ slar las gsog pa cig 'ong bar gda'/ grong khyer gyi yon bdag dad pa can dad pa phyogs med du bsgom / sbyin pa phyogs med du gtong ba cig yod pa de slob dpon ltar snang cig gis bzung ba'i dgon chung cig tu chos ma 'tshengs pa cig gi sgo ru 'jug lo byas tsa na/ sngar dad pa dang sbyin pa phyogs med du byed pa de 'gags nas/ nga'i chos lugs dang / khong gi chos lugs gnyis su phye/ rang gi chos lugs sol ba bzhin du song kyang dkar/ gzhan gyi chos lugs dung ltar song kyang gnag ser sna dang gsog run che ru
