song ba cig byas nas / yon tan thams cad chags sdang gi gong bur hril gyis sgril/ ming yon btsun nam yon bsgom zhig tu btags / rang la btsun gzugs zhig yod pa de rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ btsun po rnams khyad du gsod cing mi khur / nor rdzas bag re yod pa des nga rgyal nas gong du 'tshangs/ chos skad 'brel med re khyer nas mkhas pa tsho la'ang 'phya/ rang res dga' rogs la lo 'dod bzhi sde tsam re byas pa la bzang por nga rgyal nas/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma hril te skyur nas btang ba'i mkhas btsun dam pa seng ge'i phru gu 'dra ba de la sngan can byed/ wa dmar po khu ston/ snying phebs pa'i sla'o (gle bon yin te/ de 'dra'i chos kyis ci byed/ chos bya ba mkhas btsun bzang gsum bya ba yin/ de yang mkhas pa bya ba sems can thams cad ma dri can du shes/ ma thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong nyid du shes/ stong nyid yin kyang 'khor ba rdzun pa'i snang ngor dmyal ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal du mas gzir bas snying rje bar shes/ snying rje ba'i sems can thams cad pha mar mnyam pas bde mnyam du dga'/—489—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/skyid mnyam du dga'/ sangs rgyas thob mnyam du dga'/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las thar mnyam du dga' ba zhig byas nas phan ci thogs su bya dgos par shes pa de mkhas pa yin/ de 'dra ba'i spang bya mtha' dag spang / blang bya mtha' dag len/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba nas khyad du mi bsad pa ni btsun po yin/ /tshad med pa bzhi po de dag rgyun chad med par lag len la 'debs shing nyams su len pa ni bzang po yin/ /chos bzhi bo de 'dug na grong na 'dug kyang ngo mtshar che/ su'i dgon pa na 'dug kyang ngo mtshar che/ cha lugs ji 'dra cig gis nyams su len kyang ngo mtshar che/ bzhi po de med par nga nga zer te/ nga sngo tsa na rlung gis khyer sngo/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i chos bya ba zur na med/ khu snying gtam yin/ chos mi zab na ngo mtshar che ba brgya tham pa byasakyang mi phan / chosazab na/ wa dmar po brgya tham pa byas kyang sems la phan na bden/ bku sti re ba cig 'ong bayin gsungs pas/ khu'i rtog pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa re bden/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos gnas du ma phyin par don med du de ltar 'khyams/ da ci nas nga shes pa 'ur nas phyag rten cig btang ba'ang ma byung snyam/ khar yang 'don cing / ther ma bub cig po phul/ bshes gnyen pas kyang ras shig phul/ de nas bshes gnyen pasachosazab la thugs la phan pa de dag gsan pas/ da ci nas bzhin du/ dad pa'i mchi mas mig gang nasabashes gnyen dam pa la/ kho bo la sngar de 'dra ba'i blo cig 'ong ba su'i bdud kyis brlabs na ang zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de kun la skyon med/ de kun dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ legs par shes nasasdom na mkhas pa yin gsungs pa dang / 'u cag gnyis la nong pa ni med/ khyed gang gsung ba ni kho bos sgrub gsung nas/khu yar la brten/ na bza' bud pa gce'ang (tsho'angakagasol te/ gdams ngag gis sems gso zhing byon pas/yer ba'i rong rtsub po thim (them1 tshegs can/ ma bde mo yod pa la bshes gnyen pas skyor nasabyon pas/gom pa 'dir rgyab dang 'dir ma rgyab cha med par yud pa cig la/ jo bo dang rngog yab sras gnyisakyi spyan mnga' na yar la sleb la khad par byung ba na/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ byang chub kyi sems che ba 'di ngo mtshar che/ khu ston gyi dregs pa'i che lugs la/ nga'i u pa si kas lcags bsregs la chu blugs pa bzhin du btang / de ring de ḍom bu ba skyes 'degs pa 'dra ba cig byas nas gda'/ e ma'o mig thams cad na mchi ma'i chu mig khyab byed du yod par 'dug khu'i mig nas kyang mchi la 'dzag pa mthong / de ring u pa si kas mas bu ngu ba brid pa bzhin du mchi ma phyi zhing skyor nas byung ngo / kho bos bod du 'ongs nas kyi bar la/ ltad mo la de ring bas che ba ma byung gsung /dge bshes gsang phu ba nyams dga' nas cam cam langs nas de ring smyon pas dran pa rnyed pa mthong /rang rgyud ngan pa lcags 'dra ba/ nga rgyal dregs pa'i me 'bar ba/ bshes gnyen thugs rje chen po'i chab kyis —490—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bcom pa mthong / tshangs pa mi yul du 'ongs nas chos dran pa mthong gsungs pas/ jo bo gzigs nas zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad de/ rngog de ring khu'i khams gsos shig de ring ni shin tu zhus nas yod do/ /dga' dga'i gtam smros gzhon nu des nang du g.yos kyi sbyor ba tshar ram ma tshar ltos gsung / khus kyang mchod rten dkar chen gyi rtsa nas/ gzims khang gi rgyab na jo bo paṇa zhwa lderme me bzhugs pa mthong / rngog sgres po (bgresakayang gyu reng reng las mi gda' ba mthong / de ring de khug rngog 'brom gsum bya ba byung ba yin// 'ongs kyi rting la rngog kyang 'di na bzhugs pa de legs/ de ltar rig pa phar 'ur tshur 'ur gyi ngang la 'brom gyi byin brlabs kyis yer pa'i mda' nas yud pa cig gis/ jo bo'i drung du sleb ste/ jo bo'i zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te phyag btsal nas / rgyal ba yab sras 'dun ma bkra shis pa'i drung du/ a bo khu ston bya ba thugs rgyal gyi gang bu la/ tshad med bzhi'i chu skam tog ge yod pa 'di/ sngon chad tshe 'di'i skyid kyi bde ba phral nas/ bya ba bzang po la go chod par mthong nas/ da bzod tshe 'di'i mdun ma bzang po de la ma shor na le lan cig 'ded cing / ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du sgrub par bgyi'o/ /gsungs pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ khu nyes pa de rnams la nyes par mthong ngam/khu'i zhal nas dug chu 'thungs so/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ phyin chad rtag tu sdom mam/ khu'i zhal nas/ sngar la 'gyod na/ da yang thar ba'i 'jug ngogs gcod dam/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de ni thabs dam pa yin/ legs pa la legs par shes par gyis gsung / rngog gi zhal nas/ bshes gnyen dam pa 'dir byon nam/ /lam du nyamasapar ma gyur tam/ /bye nag la sogs bzhon khal dang / /mdzes snyan 'khor bzang bzhag gyur nas/ /bzang po'i zas gos ra/ 'phreng bar/ /de ring nga rgyal ri bsnyil te/ /'thad pa'i go gyon 'dir lhags sam/ khrel yod gzhung lam spyad gyur tam/ /rgas khar chos dang mjal gyur tam/ /da gzod nyams su len 'tshal lo/ /grogs po dam pa byon pa legs/ /bag phebs gsung gleng nang du bgyi/ /snyel ja mdzad phyir nang du byon/ /mdun ma dge'o khu ston pa/ /zer nas khu ston chen po'i phyag la 'jus/ dbu dud dud mdzad cing / dga' dga' phun sum tshogs par mdzad pas/ khu'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ dug mtsho chen po skam par gyur/ /me dong chen po bsil bar gyur/ khrel yod lam la bde bar 'ongs/ /mgon po'i byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /de ring mkhyen pas nga gzigs nas/ /yer ba'i mda' ru rgyal ba byon/ /nongs pa'i stobs kyis mchi ma shor/ /yus pa'i stobs kyis gtam ma thon/ /rgyal bas thabs kyis nga dbugs phyung / /phan pa'i gdams ngag sems la btab/ /rkang pas ma'ongs gshog pa med/ /sems kyis ma 'ongs gnas 'dir sleb/ /e ma de 'dra'i 'ong lugs byung / /gzhan gyisabaltas na srid mi 'dra/ /sprul ba'i byin rlabs de 'dra byung / /sngon chad bye nag steng na'ang ngal/ /do zhag rkang —491 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thang ngal ma gyur/ /'on kyang a po khu ston nga / /de ring yus kyis sems las bab/ /da bzod cung zad skom par tshor / / myur du nang du ja la 'deng / kha ngoms dus na lab rgyu yod/ /sba gsang ma mang gsong por smyos/ /jo bo chen pos sna drongs mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bgyi'o khu ston nga phyir 'brengs/ /chos mthun gsung gleng nang du bgyi/ /don med bre mos dgos pa med/ /tshe 'di'i mdun ma mi bgyid 'tshal/ /zhesagasungs nas nang du byon pa dang / gzhon nu des kyang bkur sti la gdan phun sum tshogs par bting / g.yo mdag phun sum tshogs pa sbyar/ gtsang sbra dang ga dar gyis thon par byas 'dug pa la/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/gzhon nu dus la 'doms par mdzod cig gsungs pa dang / gzhon nu des khyug ste khu la phyag gsum btsal nas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa shul thag ring po la byon pa la sku ma snyel gsung pa thugs la btags/ bdag gisakyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa ji ltar 'byon pa khongs su chud nas/ skabs su ji ltar bab pa'i tshul phun sum tshogs pa sbyar nas mchis gsungs nas gus pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogasapar mdzad nas/ khu chen po'i zhal nas/ gzhon nu 'di 'phags pa'i phru gu 'dra ba zhig 'dug ji 'dra cig yin gsungasapas/bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'phags ma 'phags the tshom za/ phru gu 'di nged 'brog phyogasapa'i mi/ zhig yin gsungs pas/ 'brom khong rang gi dbon po de mig hrig hrig byas nasa'adzum zhing yid ma chesapar gda'/ der khye'u gzhon nu ma de/ ja 'dren zhing 'di skad du/ bshes gnyen dam pa 'brom rje yis/ /yul med dwa 'o /ka258 ba4 kho bo/'khyams pa'i tshe/ /bdag med mkhyen nas bdag tu bzung / /ding sang zhabasatog byasapar zad / / ces smras pas/ jo bo shin tu mnyes nas 'di skad du/ /chos rnamasasgyu ma'i slu khrid la/ /bden med don byed nus ltar snang / khye'u gzugs mdzes bde lab can/ /'brom rje'i bsod nams nyid las 'khrungs/ khu'i zhal nas/ de ring mig gdong mchi mas dag /na ma shes so na mi gnas pas/ /thams cad hrab hrib nyid du gyur//jo bos the tshom bcad du gsol/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ rgyus med byis pa glo bur yin/ /don med snang stong spyod yul yin/ /snang tsam ltos la 'dri ma zhag /tha snyad bcad na 'jig pa yin gsung / der khu'i rnam rtog la khye'u gzhon nu ma 'di rang sprul ba min na rung / 'brom 'di yang rnam 'phrul che snyam pa dang / khye'u de na re/ gang gi blo ngor don byed ltar/ /gzugs su rung bar grub pa ni/ kho bor ma zad gzugs can rnams/ /sprul ba nyid du rgyal bsabastan/ /yang khu na re/ de ring dag pa'i rnam 'phrul mang / dge bzhes gsang phu ba khyed kyisakha ning nas/bshes gnyen pa la chos mang po zhus/ lhag par du yang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyesarabs mang po zhu yin 'dug zer ba de dag thams cad la lhag chad med par thugs la zin gda'am/ gsang phu ba'i zhal nas/ zhus(—492—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pa'i dgos pa yin pas/ yi ger 'bri ru mi ster bar 'dug blo la lha'i bdag rkyen bzang bas tshud par byung /khu na re/ a bo khu ston yang chos kyi skal ba mi bcad pa'i phyir du khyed rang gis gsan cing blo la tshud pa rnams che rags shig mar sher dang / de nas nga la'ang dri rgyu yod/ de nas dge bshes gsang phu ba'i zhal nas/ mang po zin nas gda' ste/ ja gral du bshor ba'i chos de nga'i 'di min/ da lta spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs la 'jin cing yod pa'i dus su/ pha chos ma gtogs/ nga rang gi yang bu chos nyi shu'i bka' rgya sral yang dred po dga' ru ma tshor / ngo tsha can khrel shor ba cig 'ong / khu'i zhal nas/ nga a po khu ston bya ba gzhud lugs rgya mtsho lta bu blo la bdog nas 'chad tsa na/ grwa ba'i tshogs mang ba tsam gyis bshad pa bzang du 'gro/ chos zab mi zab dang gsang dgos mi dgos shes tsam nga la'ang yod/ zab mi zab dang legs mi legs mkhas pa'i rtsar thug na shes pa yin/ gzhan dmu long brgya'i rtsa gzugs dkar po cig gi yon tan brjod kyang yon tan ma mthong ba'i grags los ci la phan/ a po khu ston gyi tshad mas ma gzhal ring la mi shes gsungs pa dang / dge bshes gsang phu ba'i zhal nas/ pho gsar gzhon nu ma cig mda' gzhu legs pa cig lag na thogs/ khrom chen po cig gi dkyil du zhwa chung cig btsugs nas de la mda' zhig brgyab pa de phog pho khyo ga'am ste (dekang rang yin snyam nas kha tshabs 'don par gda' lo/ /da su cig snyog ge mo yin/ pha la bu skyes/ yul 'di na nga yin/ tha mal gyi khrom chen pos bzhad gad byas pa tsam gyis nga rgyal cher 'phel/ dge bshes khu ston pha la bu skyes kyi nga rgyal lo 'dod / tshe 'di phyir nam zhag gtan gyi mdun ma shor/ grags 'dod kyis dgra 'gugs/ lo 'dod kyis gnyen mi/ 'khyongs/ zhwa chung cig phug pa la'ang khrom du kha pho 'don rin mi chog phug nas ci byed/ ma phug nas ci byed/zhwa chung chung gsan par zad/ dpe de dang 'dra/ mi tshe hril te gzhung skam re la sgril bas/ de bzhin du mgo'o ser yor te song / sna sa la gtugs te song / 'jig rten phyi ma snyen tsa na thos pa'i 'bras bu yin zer nas zhi ba dul ba nga rgyal brus kyang mi 'ong ba gcam po las 'bras la 'dzem pa cig yod pa de yang med/ sgom pa yin zer nas grub rtags cig (shigaka bstan rgyu'am/ snying po'i don 'di yin zer nas gzhan la ster ba'am/ 'dod pa'i rtsa ba 'di ltar bcad bya ba cig kyang med par/ chos byas pa tsam gyis zur mgo rno ru 'gro/ lo 'dod dang khengs grags la sogs pa che ru 'gro/ de 'dra ba'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu 'khor mang gi dbus su bshad pa bzang bas phung / bdag med la phri nas nga yin la snon/ gnas lugs la phri nas log lta ba snon/ dag snang la phri nas ma dag ba'i snang ba la 'god/ 'o skol grogs mched gnyis kyi chos lugs de sgrag rin chog gi dpa'/ khu yang ngo mtshar che ste/ zab don zab mo bcud bzang grags nas seng ge'i 'o mas rdza bcag bya ba 'ong / lar kyang zab —493—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/don gsang chos thams cad khu ston gyi tshad mas gzhal bya ga na yin/ yin yang khu ston gyi tshad mas gzhal dgosapas ga na khyab gsungs pa dang / khu'i zhal nas/ khyab mi dgos te de ring srid pas chog nga yang phyi mi rang ciog kyango min/ da shes nas dad pa thob nas 'dri ba'i lugs yin/ rtog dpyod med pa'i dad pa nyin re ma dang pha khyad yad gsungs pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/ khu chen po la ngas dngos po dbul gyis/ yus kyis mi phan/ do nub spyan ras gzigasal tshogs 'khor bshams/ nang dug lnga'i mi gtsang ba la ga dar mdzod/ phyi 'bags gtsog (btsogakagi dri ma la ga dar mdzod/ bar btang snyoms dang le lo'i dri ma la ga dar mdzod/ dngosapo ngan pa sha chang dang sgog tsong la ga dar mdzod/ nged gtsang ma rigasakyi zas ma yin pa la ga dar mdzod/ nged longs spyod cing dulotshigasa'adzin pa rnams la dus tshigs ma yin pa'i mi gtsang ba la ga dar mdzod/ dam pa khur na byin brlabs 'byung bas dad pa brtan pa'i go cha gyon/ ma rab snying rjes bskyangs na thugs rje chen po mngon du 'gyur ba'i dgosapa yod pas snying rje dang phan sems bskyed/ lar che ba'i nga rgyal can dag snang gi chos kyis bslus/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can mkhas pa'i chos kyis bslus/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal can bdag med gnyisakyisabaslus/ rigasakyi nga rgyal can dran pa nyer bzhag gi chos kyis bslus/ de ltar shes par mdzod la dgos pa sgrubs/ mi dgosapa spongs / gdams ngag la gces cha gzung / tshad pa na ba'i dus su sman yul gru gang bsag bur thun cig dga' ba yin/ da khyod nga rgyal dang dregs pa'i tshad pas gdungs pa'i dus su/ snying gi thig le cig sbyin gyis gsungs pas / khu'i zhal nas/ a bo khu ston chos zhu ba'i dngos po gzhan la zhu dgos pa med gsung skag gseb nas gser bton te/ jo bo'i mdun du srang thum gsum cam bzhag pa la/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ u pa si ka yon bdag seng ge la dkar gsum mngar gsum rtsam zhib dang bcas pa mang po khyer la shog gsungs pas/ bshesaganyen pa'i zhal nas nga rgas/ gzhon nu khyod mgyogs pa yin rgyug gsungs nas btang bas/ yon bdag seng ge 'byor ba che bas/ de'i nub mo rang ja rdum cig bur ltang gnyis/ zhib phye khal bcu gnyis/ 'o ma dang zho 'dresapa bum pa /ka 260 ba2 rgobaca'/bcu gcig mar rkyal bcu tsam zhig thud rkyal bzhi/ tha na khur pa yan chod khyer nas byung / der khu chen po'ang mnyes nas/ gser srang gsum dus cig la yon bdag la bcal jo bo yang mnyes nas/ yon bdag seng ge pha la pha la gsungs nas/ khus phul ba'i ther ma bubs cig yod pa de yon bdag seng ge la gnang / yon bdag seng ges kyang gnang ma thag tu blangs nas/ paṇḍitas gnang ba'i gos yin zer te drubs nas gyon/ lan du jo bo la chos gos zung cig phul/ de nas srod thun la jo bo'i zhal nas/—494—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /phyi'i mchod pa shoms shig gsungs nas/ bshes gnyen pas khye'u dang bcas pas/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams nas/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sgo dang po phye nas/ yi dam gyi lha bzhi zhi khro dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi sgo yang rim pa bzhin du phye/ de nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs kyi padmo'i ze 'bru la rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs nas/ bla ma'ang mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis su med par/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa du mas bskor ba/ phyag mtshan yang gdul bya'i blo ngor de dang mthun pa dang / de dag gi gnyen por gyur ba la sogs pa du ma can no/ /de dag gi mdun du khu rngog gnyis kyang spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam pa de'i dus su rang rang gis ting nge 'dzin/ gyi mchod pa la sogs pa du ma can no/ /de 'dra'i gnas padma'i dbus zla ba'i steng / thugs kyi thig le zhig bla ma sku gsum dbyer med pa/ slob ma sprul sku dang longs sku'i rnam pa can/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu shar ba'i dus su/ sku gsum dbyer med kyi zhal nas / legs pa'i shes rab legs pa'i thabs dang lhan cig tu legs pa'i gsung gis legs pa'i gdul bya la / legs pa'i tshig 'brel chags pa rang bzhin gyi gnasalegs pa 'dir khrol cig 'di ni zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dus so/ /'di ni thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams/ 'di ni thun mong ma yin nga/ snying gi thig le'i nang yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ legs pa'i shes rab sku legs pa thugasarje chen po'i rnam pa/ gsung legasapa nor bu'i nga ro/ thugs legs pa thugs rje chen po las ma g.yos par/ rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi sa twa/ zhegapa nas bzung nas/ da lta'i tshig 'di yin chod dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas khu la legs par snyad do/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis dus byin gyis brlabs nas/ yud tsam zhig la du mar gleng ba'i nor bu'i phreng ba thon par mdzad do/ /spyan ras gzigasakyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i khu yang tshim/ rab tu tshim par gyur/ da bzod bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'thungs pas khu ru gyur/ de nas ting nge 'dzin zhig la 'byams nas nyin zhag phrugs cig 'das pa na/ ting nge 'dzin de las sad de/ rjes thob na'ang sngar gyi de dag lham me lhang nge tshig thams cad kyang so sor ma 'dres pa/ 'di ni mdor mtshon par zad kyi/ thig le'i gnas ji lta ba bzhin du ni/ bla mas sku'i sprul ba du ma bstan cing / yi ger 'god du shin tu ma gnang / de nas sgo'i 'byed tshul la sogs pa dang / bla ma'i sku'i bkod pa la sogs pa bka' gdams kyi lha bzhi po so sor pho brang gdan khri yig 'bru dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa yod pa ni snying gi thig le nyid du gsal lo/ /'di dag ni zhus len nor bu'i phreng ba las brtsams te/khu dang dag pa'i snang bas ji ltar 'brel ba'i tshoms so/ /yang sgrol ma'i pus mo g.yas pa'i steng nub na rgyal ba a ti sha sras rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ gsang phu ba —495—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/legs pa'i shes rab ste/ sku gsum zhal 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal mda' gang ba gsum gyi dbus su/ gser gyi mchod rten/ shel gyi mchod rten/ g.yu'i mchod rten dang gsum so sor bkod pa'i mtha' brgyad brgyad du dung chung dkar po la mu tig gi phra du ma bkod pa/ de dag gi dbus dbus na'ang gser gyi sbrang chung brgyad brgyad bzhag pa dngul gyi man 'jus (mnywas3 bteg pa phul bas sna drangs pa/ me tog bdug spos / mar me/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ sil snyan/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi steng du gdugasaphyogasabazhin ba dan dkar po brgyad bcu (cu3dang / brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtor ma/ yang 'gag 'gag la dag byed kyi chu gzhan yang spang ljongs kyi steng du sle'u rta 'phyag ma bzhi/ de dag las gzhan yang dngos su bshams pa dang /yid kyis sprul ba'i phyag la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa dang gus pa'i sems kyis nyan tshugs bzang po /ka 261 ba5 rgol sogs /byed pa can ni bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'thung zhing / brtson 'grusal le lo'i bdud mi 'jug pa bkra shis pa'i ston pa g.yung drung 'khyil ba yin no/ /der rgyal ba yab sras la thun mong du phyag 'tshal/pus po g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ bla gos phrag pa cig la gzar/ gus pa'i tshul gyis thal mo sbyar nas/zhus lan gyi nang nas/ skyes rabs khyad par can zhu bar rtsom pa na/ sku gsum gyi nang nas sprul ba'i sku shes rab chen po'i bzhengs nas byung nas/ bas mtha' dang dgon par gnas pa'i gnas lugs las brtsams pa yan chod la shes rab kyis lus pa med 'o na'ang le lo can bskul ba la brtson 'grus dgos pas bkra shis g.yung drung du 'khyil ba'i sgo nas/ rtag tu yi dam brtan bya zhing / /zhes bya ba a ti sha lasadrangs na/ lha'i zur gsum / bstan bcos kyi zur gnyis/ sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa'i zur cig ste/ zur drug pa cig yod/ de kho bos jo bo la dri dgos pa cig yod pa yin te/ khyed glo bur du byon pasayus che/ da yi dam ni gang yin/ lha yin na ni dad pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo'i skabs su gong du bstan zin/ chos la zer ba yin na ni/ chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zhes bya ba dang / 'phags pa'i nor gyis brgyan par bya/ /zhes bya ba dang / the tshom thams cad spang bya zhing gi gseb tu yang chos gsum la gdams pa dang / gong du bstan zin/ yang sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa yin na/ the tshom thams cad spang bya zhing / /sgrub la nan tan gces su bya/ /zhes bya ba'i skabs su gong du bstan zin / desan/ rtag tu yi dam brtan bya zhing / /zhes bya ba las rtsomasal zhusashig gsungasapa dang / khu'i zhal nas / jo bo chen po lags/ spyir yi dam bya ba gang la bgyid/ da lan dge bshesapa gsung ba bzhin du/ zur drug po gang yin/ de 'dra ba'i yi dam la dge bshes ston pas ji ltar brtson par mdzad/ sngon gyi byung tshul bstan par zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nasabagyi yis/ spyir yi dam bya ba/ lha'i yi dam/ chosakyi yi dam/ thun —496

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /mong du rtse gcig tu sgrub pa'i yi dam dang gsum yod pa las/ lha'i yi dam la gsum/ dam tshig pa dang gcigahphe shes pa dang gnyis/ rang nyid der mos pas bsgom pa dang gsum du byed/ chos kyi yi dam ni/ lung dang rigs pa gnyis phyogs cig tu dril ba yin/ de la bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis lung rig gi (rigs kyikaganas lugs de dag sems kyi steng du bag chags brtan par byed pa yin/ de la hril te gril (drilakate lung gi snying po rigs pas blangs nas/ nyams su blang bde ba de/ bla mas nye bar slob ma'i rgyud 'chos pa cig la zer te/ chosakyi yi dam bya ba gnyis yin/ lha yin rung / chos yin rung / gzhan don du rtse gcig pasathe tshom spangs te stan thog cig tu nyams su len pa la zer ba yin/ de yang lus yi dam lha'i rang bzhin du bya ba dang /sems chos kyi gnas lugs kyi rang bzhin du bya ba dang / sbyor ba kha ma 'thor bar rtse gcig tu hril te gril (dril1ba gsum du 'dusapa yin/ gsum po de yang chos nyid kyi nga ro shes pa cig tu 'dus pa yin/ brtan par bya ba/ gzhan gyis bar gcod byas kyang mi tshugs pa cig la zer ba yin/ de nged bshad pa lag len dang bstun pa'i skad yin/ khyed bod ston kun gyis mi shes/ 'o na'ang rngog gisa'adri shesapa bzang / ya gi dad pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zer ba de lha 'ba' zhig yin/ sgrub la nan tan ces su bya/ zhes bya ba de sgrub pa thamasacad thun mong ba'i lo rgyus yin/ 'phags pa'i nor gyis brgyan par bya/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos ni bye brag so sgoyin/ da lan gyi/ yi dam brtan par bya/ zhes bya ba 'di/ skyes bu dam pa khur lci khur kyang nyam nga ba'i lam du mi 'dor zhes bya ba dang mtshungs te/ dam bca' brtan po byed pa'i tshig yin/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis dam bca' brten po byas pa mang / blo gtad pa ma bslus pa mang / le lo dang snyoms las kyi dbang du ma btang ba mang / khu bzod stobs cher gyis la nyon cigasngon yul ba ra na si bya ba na/ tshong dpon dge ba bzang po bya ba yod/ de la blon po bya gnyis yod/ bya cig la sro long kun tu rgyu zer/ cig la ne tso g.yu mthing zer/ chung ma ma gol bya ba gzugs dang sgra phun sum tshogasapa cig yod/ de la bran mo mchu snyung bya ba/ za ba dang las ka gnyis ka rem po 'ong / gzhan blo gtad mi thub pa cig yod/ ba ra na si'i byang ngos na/ khyim bdag dge ba bzang po bya ba tshong dpon gyi snying grogs cig yod/tshong dpon de tshong phrug lnga brgya tsam byas nas/ rgya mtsho chen po la lo dang zla bar brgal nas/ rin po che'i gling nas rin po che 'don/ de la tshong dpon gyi rtog pa la grong khyer ba la sogs pa skye bo thams cad phongasapa las thar par bya bar 'dod na/ drin mang po bskur ba'i bza' mi la gzhung dang phyi thag ci yod dang / blon pos blo gtad thub bam mi thub/ bud med kyisalus dang khrel gzhung thub bam mi thub/ de dag grogs ngan kyi dbang du —497—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung ches kyi skor/'gro'am mi 'gro snyam du tshod blta ba'i phyir du/ khyim bdag dge ba bzang po'i khang par 'gron la (mgron1'gro ba'i dus su/ nga phyi'i rgya mtsho la 'gro ba'i shul du/ khyod kyis bdag gi chung ma la tshod ltos la gzhan bsrungs shig ces snying gtam du bsgos nas/ slar rang gi khyim du 'ongs nas/ bya sro long kun tu rgyu khyod gang la'ang go chod pas phyi'i gnyer 'ong bar gyis shig ne tso khyod rig pa cang zhing smra mkhasapasanang gi gnyer 'ong bar gyis shig khyed gnyis kyis phyi nang thams cad skyongs shig ma gol gyi lus dang gtam thub par gyis shigabran la g.yog gi gnyer kha las med pas ma bcol ba'i mdun ma ma byed cig nga ni phyi'i rgya mtsho la tshong phrug lnga brgya dang bcas te rin po che'i 'don du 'gro bas/ de'i bar du kho bo la brtse bar gyis shig de nasakho bos rang gzhan thams cad phongs pa las bsgral bar bya'o zhes tshong phrug lnga brgya dang bcas te phyi'i rgya mtsho la song ba'i shul du/ yul de'i rgyal bu dge ba bzang po zhes bya bas/ skye bo dang mthun pa'i ltad mo nyi ma bcu gsum tsam byasapa la/ grong khyer ba'i skye bo dregs pa can rnams 'jig rten pa'i nyams dga' rta dang / gos dang / rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor dang rang gi bzhin phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa rang gisagang 'byor tshad skye bo 'dus pa'i dbus su ngom zhing khrom thog gcod pa la/ tshong dpon gyi chung ma ma gol dang / bran mo mchu snyung gnyisakyis kyang tshor nas/ rta dang mdzes pa'i rgyan chas brgyan nas ltad mo la 'gro ba la/ bya sro long kun tu rgyu na re/ bud med kyi lus la dgra yod/ bya byed mang pos byur 'dren/ phyis kyi gyod brdal bas/ da lta'i bshol 'debs dga' ba yin/ ma gol khyod la khyim bdag mo mi zer ram/ phyi'i gnyer kha la khyod ma bskos/ kho bo bskos / bskos pa bzhin du gyisashig zer/ g.yog mo mchu snyung bya ba de na re/ bya ngan la mi'i rtogasamached med / smra rta ma mang yos sgum thus/ bal dud sed/ khyim du sdod zer nas/ rje mo'i rta mthur khrid nasasong ngo/ /der srong long kun tu rgyu na re/ nee tso la nga'i zasaskal dang las skal gnyis ka khyod kyis gyis shig ngan ma de gnyis dgra khur nas dgra g.yob tu song ngo / /snang tshul zhig ltas la 'ong gis zer nas 'phur te song / de nas kun tu rgyusaphyin pa dang / grong khyer gzhi (bzhi3mdo na skye bo du ma 'tshogs nasaglu gar du ma byed/ gang legs dang / gang mi legs dang / su bzang dang / su mtshar la sogasapa du ma gleng / de nasakhrom 'du ba'i lho zur zhig na/ mchod rten bang rim bcu gsum pa cig 'dug pa'i bang rim dang po la bsdad nas spyad (dbyad3pa dang / khyim bdag dge ba bzang po bya ba de/ khrom de na rgyan dang gos la sogs pa lhag pa cig byas nas skyes bo thams cad kyis bstod cing / ma gol dpon g.yog gi rtsar byung / de nas khrom nasamachod rten de'i rtsar byung nas/ khyim bdag na re/ de ring khrom 'di tsam cig tshogs pa la 'u cag gnyis las lhag pa cig —498—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /kyang mi 'dug 'u cag gnyis mthun par rigs so zer bas/ ma gol na re/ spyir yang bud med khyim pa mo khur che / de nas kyang tshong dpon chen po med pa'i shul du 'di mi 'thad/ pho khyo ga'i tshig min phyir log gzer ba dang /bran na re/ rje ma zer cig tshong dpon chen po kun ldog nyen yang med/ log kyang rang re ma shi na lus mi mdzad('dzadaka/ khyed gnyis las lhag pa su yang med/ do nub kho mos g.yo ta la sogs pa zhabs tog par bya / khyim bdag cis kyang do nub kho mo cag gi khyim du shog rje mos kyang 'di mi slu 'tshal zer nas mgul nas g.yu rdog cig bcad de khyim bdag la gtad/ kun tu rgyu de la ma mgu nas/ rang gi khyim du 'ongs nas/ g.yu mthing la 'di skad du/ grogs bzang rted pa rab tu dka'/ /blo gtad thub pa grogs kyi mchog /lde mig bzung la sgo cha sdoms/ /ngan mas dgra bo bkug nas yong / /g.yu mthing gis lde mig gnyer byas nas/ sgo cha sdams (bsdamasakate khang pa'i yang thog na gnas pa na/ gzhan dgra ma byung / rje bran gnyis byung / ma tshor ba bzhin byasate sgo phye/ nang du tshud pa dang / slar sgo sdam ste ldi mig sbas so/ bran na re/ bya kun do nub mngon mtshan skyungs la dben par nyol/ 'gron (mgronakachen po 'ong bar yod do zer/ kun tu rgyus 'di skad du/ ded dpon chen po med shul du/ /'gron (mgronakapo'i gnyer kha bdag la med/ /smra ba ma mang rang lasagyis/ /rje mo 'khor gyis ma bslus sam/ /zer nas khang pa'i yang thog tu 'phur nas song / de nas srod kyi cha la sleb pa na/'gron (mgron3 po sgo rtsar sleb ste sgo ma phyed pas/ bran na re/ bya ngan kun gang na yod lde mig khyer la shoga'agron (mgronakapos slebs nas yod/ g.yu mthing na re/ 'gron (mgronakabyung gis dogs nas bsdams/ /srod dus 'gron po dgra ru ldang / kha rog sdod zer khyod ku 'thag /da cir bslabs pa mnyan par bgyi/ /zer nas 'bag cig 'bug cig med do/ /'gron (mgronakapos nam phyed phyed sgugs te log nas song / thag chod pa dang / rje mo na re/ blon po chen po'i gsung mad/ 'dir byon tsha ba gsol ba drag zer nas/ mar me bteg pa dang / kun tu rgyu na re/ khrel med grogs kyis blo mi thub/ /ded dpon chen po med shul du/ / bran gyis rje mo'i rkang de drangs/ /bza' btung tshud pa'ang dka' mor gda'/ bran mo na re/ do nub bya ngan kha bdar/do nub rngams chen byas/ kun tu rgyu na re/ bran bzang khyod bden rngams re che/ khyod kyis stod kha ma thub pas/ /rje mo'i smad kha de shor byas/ /tshong dpon 'khor tshe ji skad zer/ /zhes zer te/ tshong dpon gyis bsgo ba bzhin du yi dam brtan par bya'i /khuka 264 ba2 byas/ rgoya'i khu// tshong dpon chen po nga yin/ kun tu rgyu 'brom yin / g.yu mthing rngog yin/ ma gol ka ba yin/ mchu snyung khyod rang yin/ khyim bdag lo tsā ba yin/ lo tsā ba kha tshod lta ba yin skyon med/ de dusasu'ang skyon khyod kyis byas/ 'brom rngog gnyis min na/ ka ba dang kho bo khyed —499—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/kyis 'bral bar byas/ de gzhi ma yin/ gzhi 'di'i steng du/ khyod lasabartsams te skyes rabasa'aga' zhig gsal bar bya/yang khu nyon cig dus de'i tshe sngar bzhin/ rje bran gnyis kyis gong gi rta dang / rgyan la sogasapa byasate skye bo'i dbus su phyin pa dang / kun tu rgyus kyang gong gi bzhin du g.yu mthing la bsnyad nasamachod rten bang rim gnyis pa'i khar du bsdad de spyad (dpyadakapas/ khyim bdag dang rjesabran gnyis mchod rten gyi rtsar 'khod de/kha sang gi la gyod rtol (rdolakazhing / do nub 'ong bar gleng zhing gda' ba la/ rje mo na re/ /bo mo kha sang gi tshig las ma 'das de 'dra ma zer/ skye bo'i dbus su don med kyi gtam ngan mched nasad gzod tshong dpon gyi snyan du song na shin tu mi rigs so/ /bran na re/ bya ngan cig gis lan/ do nub mi slu byon/ yang rje lasagayu cig bcad de byin/ yang kun tu rgyu rje la ma mgu ste/ g.yu mthing la/ kha sang las kyang gnyen po cher skyed cig cesabasgos nas/ rje bran gnyis kyis nang du sleb pa dang / sgo cha bsdamasate lde mig sbasaso/ /do nub bran na re/drang po yin sgo cha bsdams na 'thab mo 'ong ngo zer/ kun tu rgyu na re/ drang po yin sgo mi 'byed zer/ bran tshig pa zos te/ kun tu rgyu bzung ste 'phangs pas thal phung cig la brgyab/ de la kun tu rgyu mi 'khrugasapar 'di skad du/mkha' la song ste gshog chags yin/ /sa la lhung ste 'bol sar song / /rdul gyis gob(te sprugs pathasa'agro /tshong dpon mnyes na de kas chog /zer te phrug phrug cig byas nas/ yang thog tu 'gro ba'i them skasabacu gsum yod pa'i gnyis pa'i steng du bsdad de/ ma gol ded dpon chen po ma slebs kyi bar du gnyen po skyed la lus sems la gros thob/ skyo na'ang khams gsos kyi gtam rgyud cig bshad kyis zhesapa gsung 'phro'i skabasa'adir khu na re/ da lan min pa ma dran/ yid yul na de 'dra cig 'dug shes rab sprul pa'i bya 'disagatam rgyud cig 'chad par 'dug go /rtsa tshig khyer la shog khu rtsa tshig 'di skabs la babs nas gda' yis/ 'di na mar la/le lo snyoms pa'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe bdag la rngan bgrang zhing / /brtul zhugs snying po dran par bya/ /de la rtsoms la zhus shig ste/ /bya la 'dri na ni 'das/ 'phro ni bya'i 'phro yin/ jo bo la zhu na ni bya'i sgrung skor ba'i 'phro ru gda'/ rtsatshig 'dri na de yin/ der jo bos rtogs /ka 265 na tog/te blangasanas/ rngog mkhasapa labya rog gi rigs pa bya ba g.yas g.yon thams cad la lta ba cig dgos dus ngan gyi sems can 'dul ba la seng ge'i rigs pa bya ba phyi rjes mthong ba cig dgos/ dpa' bo bya ra byed pa 'dra ba phyis ci byung blta zhing shesapa cig dgos/ byung nasadus 'doms shing chomasapa cig dgos/ khu rngog gnyis nga la nyon/ 'brom kun tu tu rgyur skyes pa de'i dus su'ang nga byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon la zhabs tog par byas/ ya'i khu/ de'i dus su'ang —500—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nga'i phyi la 'brom sprul ba'i bya kun tu rgyu la/ khyod kyis sprugs sdebs mang po byas/ tshig mi legs pa mang po byas/mthun grogs rngog gis byas/ rtsod gzhi ka ba la byas/ ka bas kyang de dus su khyed gsum ga'i ngo bsrungs/'dir yang 'di 'dra zhes gsung zhing yod pa'i 'phro la/ rten 'brel gyis/ ka ba dang lo tsā ba gnyis kyis kyang /khu de na yod pa rig nas/ ci la'ang ma chags par slebs nas byung / jo bo spyan thad tshugs su che re gzigs nas / bod phrug 'di kun gyi rnam 'phrul la ma 'jigs/ khyed gnyis po la mngon shes yod dam gsung / lo tsā ba na re/ rgya bod gnyis 'grims pas pho tshod chen po yod/ ka ba na re/ gnyer ma mang bas nyams myong chen po yod / 'brom na re/ dman cha blangs pas mtho sa chen po thob/ rngog na re/ snying rus bskyed pas 'brog pa lasabal ci dgos byung / grang ba'i dmyal bar skyes kyang mi grang ba tsam yod/ khu na re/ a bo'ang thams cad la skal ba ma chad kyi/ da khyed rang rnam pa gnyis nang du snyel ja la byon/ nga la chos kyi zhu 'phro zhig yod/ ka ba rnam pa gnyis na re/ nged snyel ja la 'ongs pa min/ 'phro la bltar 'ongs pa yin/ khyed bya ba'ang gsung 'phangs dang mtho ba yin/ thug chol dang byung na bar 'bab snyam du myur du 'ongs pa yin/ thams cad sleb 'phrog la bzhad gad dir ba cig byung / ka bas/ rngeg la do zhag skyes rabs 'dra gsung zhing yod dam zhes shib ste dris pas/bshes gnyen pas gsan nas yod de/ /do zhag grong ba'i bu tsha bu mo'i sgangs /ka 265 ba5 bsrung 'dra ba/kho bo sro long kun tu rgyur skyes pa dang / de la sogs pa tsho gsung zhing gda'o/ ka ba 'dzum mdzad nas/ skyes rabs zer kyang nga'i 'tshang klong (mtshang slongakazhing yod par 'dug pa/ khu na re/ do zhag a pho khu ston gyi 'tshang klong (mtshang slongakazhing yod pa lags mod/ lo tsā ba na re/ nga la sgugs yun ring po byung bya ba'am/ kha skyengs bya ba'am/ nga'i bstod ra tsho 'chad cing yod mod/ rngog na re/ de dus su'ang nga las dbang chung ba/ za ma ru rdo tshigs / las kar bal dud g.yeng ba/ khur du lde mig chen po zhig bskur/ tshong dpon gyis ma sleb par gnyid sad res kyis nam mkha' la bltas tsa na skar ma bkra chem me/ bran bran gyis sdebs/ rjes rjes sdebs/ de dus su kun tu rgyu med na/ rkyang chu kong /ka 265 ba7 sngon/ mo cig tu lci ba khal le ba cig 'ong bar yod/'tshang tsho ngas na ning du slong dgos pa cig yod pa lags te/ rten 'brel de ring las ma 'grigs zer/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'u cag gnyis la de 'dra ba 'ong 'ong ba cig yin/ khyed cung drag nga la mjug sgro nas bsdus nas/ rgyang du 'phangs pa la zad pa med/ g.yu mthing min na byes su phyin na gzhi shor/ gzhi la bsdad na byis shor/ bya la mi'i mgo sdud bab/ legs bshad kyi len po la tshig ngan byung / kho bos gzhung bsrings tsa na gzhan gyis khrel btang / tha mal gyi tshogs pas skyes dman snying stor gyi mig brid/ lo tsā ba'i zog gis phyi —501—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nas stems/ a bo khus nang nas stems/ jo bo la 'byon dus med/ nam ring la them skas re'i steng du yod pa med pa nas/ spu gzings nas rang res go ma chod dang / khyed kyis sngar yang gsha' ma ma byas lugs kyis/ rlung gisabad mkhris zil gyis non non du/ gtam brgyud bshad dgos pa byung gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ de dus su ta khyod kyis go chod de/ lar go ma chod shags (sha3 tsha ba yin/ nags khrod kyi stag rtsal stobs che yang / seng ge mi 'chun pa yin/ 'o na'ang thabs kyis byi bas glang po che klong (slongakapa yod/ de dus su'ang kun tu rgyu na re/ spyir yang ded dpon chen po gzhan don la phyi'i rgya mtsho nas rin po che 'don du song /dgos su'ang yul ba ra na si ba'i dbul ba sel du song / yang dgos su'ang rang res khyim gang gi don du/ sngar bsags pa'i nor za ru bcug nas phyis 'byung 'tshol du song ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang khyod khyim bdag mo khur che sngar bsags kyi nor mdzangs kyis chud ma zos par bya ba dang / phyis kyang gnyen 'khor mang po bskyang ba'i phyir du/ srod dang tho rangs la mi nyal bar brtson 'grus drag pos bya ba rem par byas te/ rang gi phugasasu sogs pa dang / gzhan la ngag 'jam zhing snyan par smra ba dang / 'khor rnams skyong mkhas pa dang / chen po rnams zhe sas bkur zhing zhabs tog par bya ba dang / gal te le lo dang snyoms las byung na'ang / bdag 'dra ba'i bud med go ma chod/ khyod kyi le lo dang snyoms las 'di 'dra na/ 'khor mi 'khyongs/ rje mi thegs/ rang gi lto yang mi byed / de bas mdzangs la 'phrul chags pa cig dgos/ de rnams ma byung na'ang / khyed khyim pa mo'i brtul zhugs skyes pa gzhan bsrung ba yin pas/ 'phyon ma'i sgo bsdamasate/ rang lus gcig mi thub pa'i thabs med/ nga ni tshong dpon po ma byung gi bar du/ yi dam gyi khur mi 'dor/ khyed kyi spyod pa la rdzi ma mgu bas/ 'di'i skabs su le lo dang snyoms las shor na/ gyod sdal (rdal1 dang rngan bgrangs pa rang las med/ da kun gyi brtul zhugs gzhan don la kun tu rgyu ba yin/ sngon yul 'dir pho reng po ra dza bya ba/ las ka skyabs 'gro/ nor dad pa / zas slong mo la brten pa cig byung / des re shig (zhigakabod mdo khams kyi yul du phyin nas/ khyim bdag cig la zas blangs pas/ zan mar cig byin nas de khyer te phyin pa na/ khyi rgad po stobs med pa lam ga'i bzhi mdo na nyal ba cig mthong / 'di mi zas la brten dgos pa la bza' rgyu med pa snying rje snyam nas lag gi zas de rlung gis rung ba byas te byin / de nas yul zhig gi dbus su phyin pa na/ mi bag re gzer gyis gum pa mthong / slar khang bzang zhig gi nang du phyin pa na/ mdzo rta du ma'i dbus na khams pa'i bran gum pa mthong /sgeg mo g.yos 'phro la thab 'gram du gum pa mthong / lang tsho g.yion nu bar dor 'gyel te gum pa mthong rje dpon khri la zas kyi 'phro la gum par mthong / de'i tshe rā dzas 'di skad du/ bag med 'chi bdag byung ba'i tshe/ /—502—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sgeg mo gzhon nu lang tsho yang / /dbang med dus la 'gum par gyur/ /rje dpon rang dbang ma thob par zas dang bral te gzhan du gyur/ /bran khol dbang med gyur pa yang / /mi 'khol bzhin du gum ste gda'/ /'di bzhin nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis mkhyen par mdzod/ khyim pa 'di yi tshogs bsag phyir//mchod yul dam pa btsal bar bya/ /rnyed ma thag tu khyim 'dir 'ongs/ /zer te phyir byung ste/ rgya lam zhig la zhugs te 'ongs pa na/ a tsarya gsum dang phrad de / de la 'di skad du/ rtog med cha lugs 'dzin pa gsum/ /mthu dang nus pa dpal mnga' na/ khyim bdag tshe srog phral ba mthong / khyim 'dir gshin sbyod bya ba rigs/ /a tsarya gsum po na re/ rdo rje gdan du de 'jin pas/ /dbang bskur mchog tu rab tu bsngags/ /rnam rtog mi byed g.yang du len/ /sna drongs ga la ba der 'dengs zer te/ rā jas khyim du khrid pa dang / a tsarya gsum gyis ro zhig bshas/ gsum gas drag po'i gtor ma chen po btang / mar me chen po cher sbar ba na/ srod la gzugs chen po mig gis gang ba'i mi ma yin byung ste/ mthong khung gi steng nas phus btab pas/ khang nang gi mar me chen po bsad de babs nas/ a tsarya bkum par rtsom pa na/ gcig gis gtor ma brgyab pas 'gyel ma thag tu langs te gsum ga bkum nas/ rā dza la 'di skad du/ byang chub sems kyis ma btul na/ /drag po lta bus drag mi/ thul/ khyod blo dkon mchog gsum la nges/ /do nub de yin sang ma khyod/ /gzhan du gab pas ga la thub/ /dbugs phyung bza' zo kho bo 'gro /zer nas song / nang par yang rgya lam la zhugs te phyin pa na/ dge slong bgres po bsod snyoms pa'i cha lugs su zhugs pa cig dang mjal te 'di skad du/ nyan thos gzugs 'dra zhi dul can/ /dam pa yin na khyim zhig na/ / gdug pas du ma'i tshe srog phral/ /mdang gi dus su rtog med bcom/khyed spyan drangs na ji ltar mchi/ /mthu dang nus pa dpal mnga'am/ /dge slong na re 'di skad du/ nga rgas mthu nus ga la mchi/ /mthus stong mthu nyid dbyings su thim/ /'on kyang lto phyir khyim der 'deng / /rgan po'i tshe srog bral kyang sla/ /der rā dza gus pa cig byung nas nang du spyan drangs pa dang / chab tshas bsnyen bkur nas 'di dag la gzigs shig zhus pas/ mar me dang lha bshos la sogs pa'ang ma bcos par mdzad/ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa mi gsung bar/ thugs dam dkyus ma mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ rā dzas mdang gi byung lugs dang / do nub kyang mi ma yin drag po'ang / thugs dam 'dis 'ong ngam mi 'ong ngam/ nga yang gab ste sdod/ dge slong na re/mdang yang gab pasathub pa min/ dkon mchog gis skyabs/ lha gsum la gsol ba thob/ sngar kyang dkyus ma 'dis rtsub po btul ba yin/ spyod lam 'dis khyod kyang du ma cig bskyangs/ da gzod kyang yul de nas khyod kyi yul der shing gi bye brag bya shing 'di 'dra ba 'tshong du 'gro ba'i dus su spyod lam 'dis sems can 'dul —503—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gsungs nas/ slar yang tsog pur dge sbyor mdzad cing bzhugs pa na/ mdang bzhin mig mangs des mthong steng nas phus btab pas/ mar me bsad par ma nus/ babs te phus 'debs su byung ba na/ dge slong gis(se gol cig gtogs pas/ mig mangs gan rkyal du 'gyel/ de'i tshe/ dge slong na re/ nga'i pha ma sbyin bdag srog dang phral nas/ slob ma a tsarya gsum yang med par byas/ da khong gsum gyis drag po'i las byas nas khyod thal bar gtong gis/ gzhan yang grong khyer ba'i nad rims gcod par mi byed na 'di nyid du rlag par byed do zhes gsungs pa dang / khos mna' bskyal/ dam la btags/ grong khyer ba'i nad rims bcad/ kye ma gol de dus kyi rā dza nga yin/ tshong dpon dang dge slong tha mi dad/ gtor ma 'phen pa'i rnal 'byor ba khyed yin/ gzhan gnyisagayu mthing dang mchu snyung yin/ de dus su mi ma yin drag po la'ang drag pos ma tshugs na/ rang res khog ma cig naso g.yos za ba la drag po rung ngam zhes zer/ khu shes par mdzod cig de ni a tsarya'i them skas te gnyis pa' / / yang khu/ sang nub kyang gong bzhin du gyur ba las/ kun tu rgyus them/ skas gsum pa la 'dug ste/ sngon gyi byung tshul 'di btang ba/ yang sngon yul 'di na rgyal po padma dang / ud pal (utpalakabu mo 'dab mdzes bya ba yod / /ka 268 na1 rgopadma la bu ge sar bya ba yod/ ātpal la bu mo 'dab mdzesabya ba yod// ge sar la ma bzang mo bya ba yod/ rgyal po padma de dbang che/ yul thams cad kho'i dbang du 'du/ de'i dus su'ang 'dab mdzes de/ ge sar la dmigs/ de dus su rgyal po padma la bran mo pre te/ ud pal (utpalaka la sgyid ma (steka/ gnyis po rang rang gi khyim gyi gtam rnams skyel res byed/ de dbyen du song nas rje bo gnyis mi 'cham / dus re shig (zhigakargyal po padma gum/ de dus su ge sar gyi blon 'bangs nor dang bcad pa ud pal (utpalakal shor/ pre te la'ang bza' rgyu ma byung / der ge sar gyi ma pre te la gyod rdol zhing / nga la mi dag bzang mo zer ba min pa/ ngan ma zer ba med pa la/ khyed kyis gtam ngan phyir bskyal bas 'di 'dra zhes gyod rdol bas pre te'ang 'gran pa'i g.yog mo la shor/ de nas ge sar ma mad la 'byor pa med par bzang mos phyags shing blan te grong khyer du btsongs nas ma mad gnyis za ba la kha ba babs te phyags shing ma lon/ rgyags chad par skabs cung zad byung nas bzang mo song ba'i shul du/ sgo drung du bsod snyoms pa cig byung / ge sar gyis mkhar ('khar3gsil gyi sgra thos nas dad de drung du phyin pa na/ bsod snyoms pa na re/ ge sar longs spyod che zhing des phan thogs pa ni sbyin pa dag pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /mkho dus su sleb pa ni dus la 'doms pa'i gsungs pa dang / ge sar na re/ 'bras bu 'byung ba la rgyu dgos te mi mthun pa'i phyogs su song / bsod snyoms —504—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /pa na re/ 'bras zer ma cig las med kyang phul cig ge sar gyis nang du btsal bas/ 'bras phul chung gang rnyed / shin tu dga' ste nang du spyan drangs/ zhing na re/ zangs chen gtong la tshos zer/ der ba ra na si'i khal nyi shu shong ba'i zangs su btsos pa'i 'phel gyis gang ngo / /zhing la lhung bzed bkang ste drangs pa na/ ud pal (utpal1 gyi pho brang gi nying thog na/ 'dab mdzes yod pa mthong ste/ mchil ma'i rgyang mda' 'phangs pas/bsod snyoms pa'i lhung bzed du phog nas 'bags par btang ngo / /zhing mi rtog par gsol zhing gda' ba la/ge sar blo ma bde nas/ bsod nams ma yin pa bsags pa 'dis/ bdag gi bsnyen bkur ma dag par byas/rjes na dkor du 'gro/ ma brjes na 'bags pa la gsog 'jog tu 'gro snyam pa na/ 'phags pas mkhyen nas/sems dang sbyor ba dngos dag cing / /zhing dang chos dbyings rnam dag pas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug rab dge ba'i / / ge sar phun sum tshogs par shog /pha ma'i drin lan gzhal bar dka'/ /bzang mo nang du bzang bar mchod / / phyogs mthar song la rnyed pa tshol/ /rnyed dang bskyang ran kho bos sbyin/ /zhes mi snang bar gyur/ da lta rang mas slebs nas 'bras chan khal nyi shu tsam bsten pas ma'i khams sos so/ /de'i dus su ma la 'di skad du/'phags nga 'i byin brlabs 'di zo la/ khyim du dad pa'i sems kyis sdod/ /lo drug gzhon nu 'phags bzung bas / rīd pa bkur stis bskyang bar bya/ /ma na re/ de skad ma zer khyod shin tu chung / bu na re/ sta re chung ste thang shing sgyel/ /mde'u chung ste glang po 'joms/ /'dom gang gru bzhis gnam mkhar rtsig /ma 'phreng da lta kho bo 'gro / / zhes shar gyi nags khrod chen po cig tu phyin pas/ ci bsams pa'i lham rnyed/ nub kyi nags khrod du phyin pas/ lha sman gyis 'tsho ba'i g.yang rkyal byin/ ring po ma thogs par rang gi khyim du sleb/ ma'i dbugs phyung ste/ g.yang rkyal nas zas phun sum tshogs pa byung nas ma la byin/ de nas ud pal (ātpalaka gyis 'byor ba mi mngon par ma mad gnyis skyid pa de mthong nas/ tshod blta ba'i phyir du/ 'dab mdzes rgyan dang 'byor bas spras nas ge sar la byin/ 'dab mdzes kyis khyim du mi dga' ba'i tshul bstan/ ge sar gyis lham ya cig tu 'dab mdzes kyi rkang ba bcug cig tu rang gi bcug ste rgya mtsho'i chu sle yid la byas pas skad cig la de nyid du sleb / ge sar gyis khyod nga dbang ba'i mi yin pas/ nga la dgar ma tshor gyi rting la 'dir sdod byas pas/ 'dab mdzes bred nas zhu ba drag po phul/ de nas ge sar gyis/ 'dab mdzes kyi pang par mgo bzhag nas gnyid log pas / 'dab mdzes gyis ge sar bzhag ste/ lham gyon pha khang yid la byas pas der sleb/ ge sar gnyis sad ma thag lham dang bcas pa mi 'dug der bar snang la sgra zhig byung ste/ /ge sar mtsho la ma skrag par/ /rtse gcig shugs la rab tu bzhon/ /bde bar bde ba'i skam la thar/ /myur du ma dang phrad par 'gyur/ /zhes pa grag ste/—505—

bka' gdams dme dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bltas pas sems can dmar po rwa gcig pa mdun na 'dug pa la bzhon pas yud cig la rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thon te/ sems can mi 'dug par sgrib shing cig rnyed/ de khyer nas grong khyer gyi dbus shig tu phyin pa na/ skye bo mang po yul ston za zhing 'dug pa dang phrad/ skal ba blangasapa mi ster bar/ gral mgo ma cig gi zasal zos pas / mi 'gegs par zos kyang ma 'grangs zer nas/ ldum ra cig tu song / shul du phyin pas/ me tog dmar ser gnyis 'dug pa ladamar po de zos pas spre'u cig tu gyur te shing thog yod pa'i ljon pa la 'dzegs nas shing thog zos nas slar babs nas me tog dmar po zos pas mi ru song / sprul bas sprul ba'i glags rnyed nas/me tog dmar ser khyer te/ ud pal (utpalaka gyi sgo drung du phyin nas bos te/ sgo drung na spre'u ya mtshan che ba cig mchis pas zhag shas btsan sa khyed la 'tshol zhing / phyis nga rang la zhu zhes bos nas/ me tog dmar po'i rkyen gyis spre'u zhig byasate/ sgo drung na 'dug pa na/ blon pos nang du khrid de/ de nas rgyal po la phyag byed pa dang / gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma bstan pa dang / rgyal po dga' ste 'di 'dab mdzes la ma ston cig mthong ste bdag tu bzung na gzhan gyis blo gtad pa bslus par 'gro gsung / de nas spre'us 'dab mdzes rgyu 'phrul byed pa na/ pus mo 'dzugs pa dang gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma byas pas/ 'dab mdzes dga' nas bdag tu bzung /tshe gcig 'dab mdzes kyi zas kyi gseb tu me tog bcug nas longs spyad pa dang / 'dab mdzes spre'ur gyur/rang gi lham khyer te rang gi khang par 'ongs/ lo bdun gyi bar du spre'u'i sdug bsngal myong bar byas te slar mir bsgyur / de nas ge sar rnam 'phrul che grags te/ ud pal (utpalaka skrag nas/ sngar gyi 'byor ba lhag dang bcas pa phyir gtad/ rang gi blon po rnams kyang bred de/ nyes pa bzod par gsol zhing ge sar gyi zhabs la gtugs / der ud pal (utpal3la sogs pa ud pal (ātpalaka gyi sgor thams cad dang / rang gi 'khor thams cad chos la bkod/ ma gol dge slong bsod snyoms pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i dbus kyi sems can rwa gcig pa/sems can rwa gcig pa ni/ do zhag phyi'i rgya mtsho la song ba'i tshong dpon chen po'o/ /pre te ni mchu snyung ngo / /sgyid ma ni khyod yin/ 'dab mdzesani da ci nas kyi sgo'i rtsa'i khyim bdag de'o/ /ge sar ni kho bo'i/ /ma bzang mo ni g.yu mthing ngo / /de'i dus su'ang khyed gnyis kyisanged dang g.yu mthing gnyis sdug la gtad/ khyad par du'ang mchu snyang khyod kyis rang gi bde skyid kyi pho brang bshig khu rgyal po padma ni rgyal gyi ka ba chen po'o/ /rgyal po ud pal (utpalakani mgar dge'o/ /ge sar gyis ud pal (utpal1de dus su'ang smin par byas/ 'dir yang thabs kyis smin par mdzad do/ de ltar na kun tu rgyus sngar gyi byung lugs dang bcas pa bshad pas/ phyi mi'i nang ma thub par log ste khyim bdag mo thub par gyur to/ khu shes par gyis shig de ni them skas gsum pa'o//—506—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /sang nub kyang de bzhin du them skas bzhi ba'i steng du 'dug ste/ yang sngon 'di'i nub phyogs mtha' 'khob na / pho reng bo dbul zhing gnyen dang bral ba cig mchis pa la gsung ba la/ 'di'i skabs su/ shes rab na re/rtsa tshig 'bri na/ gal te gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /zhi des gsong bor smra ba dang / khro gnyer ngo 'dzum spang bya zhing / / rtag tu 'dzum zhing gnas par bya/ /zhesapa yang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ dus la bab pa yin/ 'o na'ang kho bos gsal bar bya/ kun tu rgyu na re/ mi des 'bras khal gcig gi zhing yod pa btab nas/ skyabs 'gro bag re byed cing / zhing thog tu ma phyin pa'i bar du/ phan sems dang ldan pa'i ri bong cig 'ong nas/ kho'i zhing gi su lu'i ljang pa zos/ lan cig zhing steng du phyin pa na/ btab pa'i 'bras bu ma mthong nas sems 'khrugs te/mda' gzhu khyer nas za ba po sgugs pa na/ ri bong mthong ste pho reng bo na re/ kho bo'i lto 'dis 'tsho ba la khyed kyis med par byas zer nas mda' brdeg par rtsom pa la/ ri bong na re 'di skad du/ phongs par gyur ba'i sems can la/ /bzang byas lan du bde ba mchis/ /'khrug par ma byed sdug bsngal rgyu/ /de bas nga zer mnyan na bde/ /mi de'i rtog pa la/ khyod kyi chos bshad dang 'di'i 'byor ba dang bral bar byas/ 'o na'ang phan 'dogs lugasadri'o snyam ste/ khyod kyis nga la bzang lan ji 'dra byed dris pas/ ri bong na re/ ri dwags rgyal po ri bong la / / rtswa yis phongs pa mi gda' ste/ /zhim zhim 'dra nas swā lu zos/ /za kham chesapasamachu la gas/ zer te/ri beng mi 'bros bar dgod cing 'dug pa la bltas pas mchu ral ba mthong / mi'i rtog pa la 'di'i bag phebs lugs sam sprul ba cig yin nyen yod snyam nas/ phan bya 'tshal zhes smras pas/ ri bong na re/ da dung 'bras yod chang du tshosi/ /mda' dang gzhu gog lcags mig sogs/ /mtha' 'khob rgyal po glen pa la/ lha yi lha mo bu mor skyes/ /de phral khyod la sbyin par bya/ /lho nub mtshams na srin po zhig /mi nor yod bzhin mi sha za/ /sdig can bkum la zas nor rnams/ /len du khyod la sbyin par bya/ /the tshom ma byed bden gyis bsgrubs/ /zer te/mis ji skad zer ba bzhin du bsgrubs pa rnams khur te/ sprul ba'i ri bong gis sna drangs mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po yod pa'i chu'i 'gram na sbang ma dang / rdza dum la sogs du mas bkang / mda' dum dang gzhu dum gyis tho re long nge khengs par byas/ bye 'gram rta rjes kyis bkang nas rgyal po'i sgo drung du phyin nas mi bzhag ste/ sprul bsargyas po khri la yod pa'i mdun du phyin te 'di skad du/ rgyal po khyod kyis mi shes pa/ /do zhag dmag tshogs du ma lhags/ /bdag cag lha'i (yisaka brtser dgongs nas/ /bden med bzhin du bzlog par byas/ / da yang mchod pa mi byed par/ /mtha' 'khob glen pa'i tshul 'dzin nam/ /lho nub phyogs na gnas pa yi/ /'byor ba dpag med rgyal po zhig kha tshod blta phyir khab na mchis/ /bu mo phyin na dmag mi 'byung / /rang gi pho brang bkra —507—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/shis shing / /mnga' 'og bkra shis rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po'i rtog pa la/ lha'i sprul ba yin par thag chod/ g.yin ri bong gis 'di 'dra ba'i chos smra mi shes snyam nas/ rgyal pos lan smras pa/ ri brag dben par bzhugs pa yi/ /ri bong gzugs can lha mchog khyod/ /mchod pa bya phyir gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /tshod lta'i mi de nang du bos/ /zhes zer nas/ rang gi blon pos mi de rnyed de pho brang gi nang du bos nas/ rgyal po nyid dang mnyam pa'i gdan la bzhag ste/ bsnyen bkur ba na/ mi de dpa' zhus nas sprul ba la 'di skad zer/khyed thabs mkhas te da bzod (gzodaka 'dzol mchi 'ong zer bas/ rgyal po the tshom zos te/ lha khong ci zer/mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po bya ba bsnyen bkur la sogs chung dus nga rgyal nas 'ong ba yin/ phra mo 'di 'dra ba la grogs med pas bde skyid kyi zhing du myur du 'gro bas/ lhas rgyal po la khrol bar gyis shig zer zhing gda'o/ /de nas rgyal po des kyang tshig de ma theg par rta ba lnga brgya'i tshogs dang bcas/ 'byor ba bsam gyisami khyab pa dang bcas nas/ lha'i lha mo brdzangasate btang ngo / /de nasasprul ba'i ri bong gisasna drangs/ lho nub kyi mtshamasanas / srin yul lang ka kyog mo bya ba mis spyad par mi nus pa'i sar phyin/ stobs po che'i dmag chasapa bzhin du byas nas/ sprul bas mig rgyang re tsam gyis sngon la phyin nas/ srin po'i rta dang ma he dang / lug la sogasapa skyong ba'i rdzi bo du ma rim bzhin du byung ba nas sprul bas 'di skad du/ mi nor yod bzhin mi za ba'i/ /sdig can tshe srog 'brel ba gang / /stobs chen dmag gis 'joms par yod/ khyod rang gus pas nor 'doms la/ /'di dang phyi ma'i tshe srog skyobs/ /dmag dpung dbus na gos dkar cig /yod kyis rang gi rgyal po zhes/ /dga' zhing byon pa legs zhes phul/ /de nas lang ka'i phug ring na/ /srin po mi gzugs gdug pa can/ /yod pa'i drung du bred bzhin phyin/ /stobs chen de ring dmag dpung lhags/ /'thabs pas mi thub dong bcan du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan nas brjod/ /nges par gab na tshe srog thar/ /snyom las ma byed sbyor bas gob//de nas srin pos dmag dpung mthong nas rngam stabs su/ dong dgu rim du bros/ sprul bas kyang rim pa re re'i phyir 'brangs nas 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas skyob la skyabs su mchi/ /lam rab btsan la skyabs su mchi/ /dge 'dun grogs la skyabs su mchi/ /'dun ma nges par ngas shes nas/ /dgu rim blo phugs lha la gtod/ /lha ni dkon mchog gsum nyid de/ /da ni skyabs gzhan mi gda'o/ /btsan sa btsan te phyi ma yin/ /sngar 'dasalasangan mthol lo bshags/ /da bzod 'gyod de phyis mod kyis/ /'on kyang bshags pas sprul bas 'dren/ /da ni dkon mchog yang yang bos/ /zer te phugs thub par bskyal nas/ rgyal po dmag 'di sngar byas kyi lasakyi nyes pas de la sdug pa dran tsa na 'gyod pa dran par gyis/ lha gsum po de la skyabasasu 'gro na dmag myur du —508—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dengs shing steng du thar ro/ /da kun 'tsho ba dag ste rtswa'i rtse mo chu'i dwangs ma/ gnas mal shing drung / lag pa thung ste gyen la mgyogs pa cig yin zer nas bzhud de song ngo / /de nas dong dgu rims kyi kha legs par bcad de/glo bur du lhags pa thams cad la 'byor ba du mas bsnyen bkur nas tshod lta'i rgyal po la gos dang gdan khri phun sum tshogs par bshams/ srin po'i 'khor ba thams cad la/ 'o skol gyi mes sdig can de sdig rngams ches nas / de ring thar ba med pa'i gting du shor/ khyed rang rnams kyang smra ta ma mang bar/ rgyal po'i zhabs la gtugs la nyin dang mtshan du 'di skad gyis/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ /skyabs gnas mdzod cig ngan song las/ /tshod lta'i rgyal pos mi dgra bcom/ /bka' drin che'o bdag cag skyobs/ /zhes nyin mtshan med par khar thogs shig de ma byas na bde ba'i thar ba'i tshe srog dang 'bral du 'ong ngo / /zhes bsgo ba la brten nas / thams cad nyes kyis dogs nas/ nyin dang mtshan du skyabs 'gro 'ba' zhig byed/ yang sprul pas mi mngon par tshod lta ba'i rgyal po la khyod kyi bde skyid dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la brten nas 'byung gis/ da dung nyin dang mtshan du skyabs 'gro gyis shig lus kyi shig yan chad kyi srog ma bcad cig ngas nor byin pa'i nor 'di las gzhan pa ma len cig lha'i lha mo las gzhan pa'i grogs ma bsten cig gtam bden zhing snyan pa ma gtogs pa ma smra cig ci za'i phud kyis dkon mchog mchod cig lhag par du'ang dgu rim du gnas shing gus par sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos dang dge 'dun la'ang skyabs su mchi'o/ /de'i lan chags 'khor zhing sha 'khon byang bar gyur cig dkon mchog gsum la brten nas yongs su 'drongs par gyur cig ces rang gi 'khor thams cad la'ang bsgo zhing dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa dge ba'i sbyor ba la ma spyad na/ khyod kyis 'khor dang longs spyod 'di dag gi bdag po dgrar ldang ngo //zhes bsgo bas/ tshod bltas kyang sprul bas bsgo ba bzhin du rtsa ba bzhi'i sdom pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la nyin dang mtshan du dus 'da' bar byas/ sprul ba ni nags khrod chen po cig tu zla ba dgur gnas te/ tshod lta'i rgyal po'i sar 'ongs pa dang / rgyal po na re/ khyed 'dra ba'i snying ring po zer nas gyod rdol byas / sprul ba khong mi khro bar khyed las bden pa med zer te/ gtam gsong bor smras/ ngas le lo dang snyom las byas pas lan/ ngas go ma chod zer nas brtul zhugs byang chub kyi sems yin pa de dran par byas so/ /de'i dus su/ srin po tshe phyi mas rgyal/ tshod lta gnyis ka las rgyal/ 'khor thams cad kyang dngos shugs lasargyal / gzhan yang mi thams cad bde ba la bkod pas rgyal/ mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po sprul ba'i lhas gnyen bzang dang sbyar bas rgyal/ kye ma gol gyi sngar byas kyi las kyi 'gyod pa bya ba ma byung bar mdzod/ sprul ba'i ri —509—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/bong nga yin/ tshod lta'i rgyal po mchu snyung yin/ lha'i lha mo khyod yin/ mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po g.yu mthing yin/g.yu mthing 'dis dus thams cad du nga gang dga' dga' byas/ mchu snyung la nga 'di 'dra'i phan zhig btags nas nga la gyod rdol byas te/ de'i dus su'ang khong khro ma byung da yang mi khro/ de'i dusasu'ang ngasabaslabasapa la gsha' ma ma byung ba med/ 'dir yang snying gtam la nyan na bzang zer/ khu shes par mdzod cig them skasabazhiba'o/ /sang nub kyang sngar bzhin du them skas lnga ba'i steng nas 'di skad du/ sngar ni zhi des 'jam por bshad/ /gtam rgyud tshul du gsong bor smras/ khro gnyer ngo zum mi byed pa'i/ /rtag tu 'dzum pa'i khyim bya nga / /le lo mi byed rje don du/ /bsrung ba zab mo'i gtam cig bshad/ /sngon dus nub phyogs nags khrod du/ kho bo zasamed shing thog za/ /lo brgyad byis pa'i gzugs su yod/ /de tshe mchu snyung dmag phrug cig /nga yi drung du nagasasu byung / / de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /ma gol phyug phrug 'byor ba can/ /nor gyisang rgyal khrod der byung / /de nasagasum po mthun gyur te/ /rab tu rtse zhing nags su 'dug /lan cig dmag phrug dmag dang bcas/ /nags khrod de ru nga drung bsdad/ /de nasaphyug phrug de 'gran nas/ /nor dpung bcas te nga drung bsdad/ /lan cig nga la ma he lnga/ 'bri mo lnga dang lug lnga byung / /de nas re zhig gzugs mdzesapa'i/ /lha mo sgeg mo gsum tsam zhig /nged kyi gnas su byung gyur nas/ /nub kyi dgon sde cig tu song / /dmag phrug de rtog 'di skad du/ /nga la nyon dang grogs po gnyis/ /lta na mdzes pa 'dir byung ba/ /gsum gyi grogs su blangs na bzang / /phal cher dbang gis khug par 'gyur/ /phyug phrug lan du 'di skad du/ /nor la mi dga' su yang med/ /phal cher nor gyis khugs par mchi/ /dbul po kho bosa'adi skad du/ /thams cad sngon gyi 'brel ba yin/ /ngesamed kho bosakhugasakyang srid/ /dmag phrug ma nyan rgyal ba thong / /phyug po'ang ma nyan des chog zer/ kho bosam he 'bri lnga lnga/ /lug lnga rgyal la gtad bar bya/ /zhag bdun tshad du byas gyur nas/ /dmag phrug phyug posabacu bzhi ste/ /rim gyis bdun bdun sgugs byas kyang / /lha mo ma lon rang sar log kho bosatshogs khang sgo drung du/ /bsdad tshe sprang mo sro ma can/ khyod la ci dgosasmros zhes zer/ /byung tshul brngod nas grogs dgos smrag /'o na lho'i ljon rtsan / / der sdod gcig pur mig mangs rtses/ /de tshe lha mo der 'ong gis/ /ye shes lha mo grogasashig cig kho bo dpa' bor gyur cig smros/ /thos ma thag tu ljon rtsa mā /mig mangs rtse zhing bsdad pa na/ rnal 'byor ma yi gzugasacan ma/ /gzhon nu mdzes ma der byung nas/ /lce phyung 'dzum ste log nas song / /de ma thag tu sprang mo byung / khyod kyi 'dod pa grub bam zer/ /byung tshul brjod pas mo na re/ /do nub ljon rtsa'adir ru nyol/ /bya —510—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /gnyis 'ong gis ci zer nyon/ /ji skad zer bzhin der nyal tshe/ /de na ljon pa gnyis gnas te/ /gcig la pho 'dom dgus 'khyud tsam/ /gcig la pho 'dom bco brgyad yod/ /der 'dra'i thang shing mthon po'i rtser/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer nub pa na/ /'ur sgra chen po rab tu byung / /'dom dgu pa yi rtse mo la/ llen tu che ba'i khyung cig babs//g.yas dang g.yon du gug gug gsum/ /de nas drang por tshugs par gyur/ /de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /bco brgyad pa yi rtse mo la/ /de las ldab kyis che ba'i khyung / gug gug la sogs sngar bzhin no/ /snga ma na re 'di skad du / / ha shang de ba 'dir lhags sam/ shar du 'byor ba che lags sam/ /lus 'phags gling dag bzang gyur ram / / phyi ma na re 'di skad du/ /'dir sleb lus 'phags gling shed na/ /mi ro rta ro dpag med gda'/ /zosabasalto ba'i gru zur khengs/ /rdo rje gzhon nu sngar sleb bam/ /nub phyogs bde zhing bza' 'phel lam/ /ljon pa'i rtse na ci 'dug ltos/ /lan du bya phrug 'di skad zer/ /ljon pa'i rtse na mi cig gda'/ /da ni zos tshad ji tsam gyis / khyed kyi lto ba khengs dris pas/ /nga ni glang chen sha stong gis/ kho bo'i lto ba khengs par 'gyur/ tho rangasabya gnyis 'phur nasathal/ /rgan mo byung nas ci zer 'dri/ /gong bzhin brjod pas rgan mo song ring por ma lon bu mo yis/ /glang chen sha stong bskyal nas song / /do nub ha shang de bas sleb/ /cig min zas nas glang sha cig khyer nas ljon pa'i rtse la bkal/ /cung zad lon tshe bya phrug byung / /gzhon nu sleb bam glang sha de/ /ti ka gyis la mi 'di la/ /ci dgosadris la gang zer sgrubs/ /de nas kho bos 'di skad byas/ /bdag la ye shes mkha' 'gro dgos/ /bya de babs nas nga la zhon(bzhonaka/ /ma 'jigs mkha' 'gro'i gan du bskyal/ /bzhon te nub kyi mkha' la phyin/ /rgya phibs sngon po dpag med pa'i/ /dgon sde cig gi bla yer sleb/ /de nas sa khang nang 'jug tshe/ /'gag 'gag seng ge snol ba yang / /stobs med gyur te 'gyel nas snang / /phugs su zhugasate phyin pa na/ /su yang mi 'dug stong bar gda'/ /gcig la ḍa ma ru cig gda'/ khyer nas slar log bya bzhon te/ shar gyi mkha' la phyin pa na/ /rnal 'byor ma dang phrad gyur nas/ /ḍa ma ru de phrogasanasathal/ /de nasaljon pa'i rtsa bar sleb/ de nas su yang ma byung ste/ /slar yang bya la bzhon gyur nas/ /nub kyi mkha' la phyin gyur te/ /slar yang babasate nang zhugasatshe/ /seng ge bsnol ba'i stobs rgyas te/ /nang du ma thar re shig na/ /sngar gyi bu mo gzhon nu byung / /dga' dga' bzhin du nang du bos/ /de nas mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs te/ /dpa' bo chen por rab tu gsol/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul chen po yis/ /nags khrod gnas der phyin pa na/ /btsan phrug gnyisapo 'di skad zer/ /bdag cag gnyis kyis ma lon na/ khyed 'dra ngal bar ma gyur tam/ /le lo snyomasapa'i semab(spangs pas/ kho bos mkha' 'gro grogs su thob/ /bdag gi brtul zhugs gzhan don yin/ /chad 511—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i rgyal de byin na legs/ /mi ster na yang rtag tu 'dzum/ /e ma ma gol nga la nyon/ /dmag phrug zer yang mchu snyung yin/ /mchu snyung de yi dus na yang / khyed kyis rgyal la ngan chen brdungs/ /re shig (zhig1lha mo der byung nas/ ngan pa'i rgyal gyis dgos pa med/ /da lta bde ba'i gnas su 'deng / /ma he la sogs bco lnga yang / / bozlog ste 'dod pas gdungs la byin/ /lha de ded dpon sprul ba yin/ khu shes par gyis shig them skas lnga pa'/ /sang nub kyang de bzhin du/ them skas drug pa'i steng nas/ rje mo g.yog mo nga la nyon/ khrel med rigs ni phyi thag thung / /phyi thag med pa bshes dang bral/ /phyi mi nang du zhugs pas 'phung / /nang mi phyi la shor bsa'aphung //gnyis ka rje mo'i skyon du mchis/ /lan rtsa grogs ngan dbang song yin/ /lan cig ma la'i 'dabs shed na/ /rgyal bu sarba bya ba yod/ /de yi drung na bud med cig /nor med bu yis phongs pa na/ /bdag gis bur skyes rdzi bo byas / / phan pa'i semasakyisam bskyangasate/ /lan cig g.yu zhig rnyed gyur te/ /dga' ste ma la byin pa na/ /ma dga' nang du khrid gyur te/ /'bras chang cig byin de 'thung tshe/ /phyogs nas bung ba cig byung ste/ /chang der lhung ste gum par gyur/ /mod la bung ba cig byung tshe/ /rgya mdud mgo zhes ming 'bod cing / /dkar nag phyed de gang du thal/ /skad snyan 'tsher te mi gda' ba/ /zer zhing mya ngan byed pa mthong / /de tshe snying rje skyes gyur kyang / /'on kyang tshig la gad mo shor/ /don med ma ngan the tshom zos/ /gsong por smras pas rdzun zer nas/ /ma de ma rig rgyal po'i sar/ /song ste rgyal po nga la nyon/ /'u ci'i bu ngan rdzi bo de/ /rgyal po'i khrims la mi skrag par/ /bskyangasapa'i ma yis chang byin pas/ /lan du rdzun gyis bslu ru byung / /rgyal po chad las bcad par rigs/ kho bo khri mon dong du skyur/ /g.yu mthing nas zan cig tu 'byungs/ kho bo'i steng du chu shel skyur/ /'od kyisagang zhing bsil bar gyur/ /rgyal po dga' nas steng du bton/ /de tshe yul der then pa byung / kho bos klu la phan btagasapas / / char phab lo tog 'phel bar gyur/ /de nas klu yis yul du bos/ /nub gsum rta yi bresasu bzhag /gnas 'dir gang byung zung shig bsgo/ /sbal ba sprul dang sdig pa yi/ /gzugs su lan gsum byung ba'i mthar//tha mar sdig pa bzung gyur bas/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i bu mor gyur/ /klu des nor dang lhan cig tu/ /mi yi yul du bskyal ba na/ /bu mosasprul ba'i pho brang bzhengs/ /nyes pa thams cad rang sar bzlog /de nas kho bos yul khams rnams/ /sprul ba du mas chos la bkod/ /e ma ma gol nga la nyon/ /rgyal po de ni khyed nyid yin/ /ma ngan de ni mchu snyung yin/ /mchu snyung bu skal ma bcad par/ /rdzi bos nor gyis bskyangs lan du/ /phan semasakhri mon dong du skyur/ /g.yu mthing lha mo'i gzugasasu gyur/ /nga la ma 'jigs legs bsgo nas/ /nags khrod cig tu —512—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /yal te song / /da lta'ang sems gsos du ma byas/ khu shes par gyis shig them skas drug pa'o/ /yang sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ /them skad bdun pa'i steng nas 'di skad du/ ma gol rje bran nga la nyon/ /bshad kyang mi go spyon pa yin/ /de 'dra bstan kyang mi grol na/ /bdud mo yin par the tshom med/ /lhag par mchu snyung nga la nyon/ khyod sngon mdze yi nad kyis gdungs/ /nga ni bram ze rin chen mchog /shin tu gtsang ba'i spyod pa can / / grong khyer 'di yi sum mdo na/ /zas med nad kyis gdungs gyur nas/ /ldang bar ma nus gnas pa na/kho bos der 'ongs snying rje skyes/ /gtsang sbra chen pos khyod khur te/ /dben pa'i gnas su zas kyis bskyangs/ /kun gyis mdze mo bshes med zer/ /ming yang gcig pu nyid du 'bod/ kho bos yang yang sngas khar 'ongs/ /snying rje chen po dmigs par bstan/ /skyabs su 'gro ba dmigs par bstan/ /spu med 'jam po gos su g.yogs/ /rma rnag bkrus shing sman gyis gsos/ /de tshe skye bo ma rungs pas/ /bram ze'i rigs las nyams so zhes / / nga la 'phya smod skur ba btab/ khyod la gnod dang dgar ma tshor/ /de tshe rin chen mchog shes dang / /rtag tu gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /ser sna med cing sbyin la dga'/ /gzhan la yod pa'i dngos po la bzang na phra dog mi byed cing / /ngan na thabs kyis spong la dga'/ /gzhan gyi sems ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rtsod nga thams cad mi byed cing / /ngan zer bzod pas brgyan pa ni/ /sems dpa' nga'i brtul zhugs yin/ /ya'i mchu snyung de go'am/ /de'i dus na'ang khyod rin la/ /dka' spyad du ma thog tu babs/ khyod la mgu ba'i dus ma mchis / / da yang ngan tshod bzung gyur te/ /nga zer mnyan na tha mar dge /ma gol rna bar zhog mdzod la/ /bran zer ma nyan rang lus bsrungs/ /tshong dpon byon tshe ngo mtho mchi/ khu shes bar gyis shig them skas bdun pa'o/ /sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ them skas brgyad pa'i steng nas 'di skad du/ /lan cig dpal gyi yang mgul na / / nga ni bsam gtan bzang po zhes/ /dben par dge slong dka' ba spyod/ /de tshe mchu snyung grong khyer gyi/ /rdzi bo bag med gyur ba cig /nyin re bzhin du nga drung du/ /dad pa skyes te 'ongs gyur na'ang / /don med ku co du ma 'thab / / de tshe bdag gis 'di skad du/ /sngon yang bag med gyur ba yis/ /ding sang bag med rdzi bo'i lus/ /phyugs sogs du ma bskyangs gyur kyang / /nga la bkus 'debs byed par zad/ /rang la dbang ba cig kyang med/ /sgra chen ma 'bod bsam gtan 'drog /gal te dad na rtsa 'dir sdod/ /nga la skyob pa'i lha yod cing / /'dzad pa med pa'i bde skyid yod/ /gang gis mi 'phrog nor bzang sbyin/ /gzhan du gnas 'dir ma 'dug song / /mchu snyung rtag tu 'di 'dra bas/ /de tshe'ang mi snyan 'di skad du/ kho bo'i dad de 'dir 'ongs na/ /bag phebs skad kyang 'don dbang med/ /'di dag skyong ba las ka yin/ kha rog gab pas skyong mi 'gyur/ /gal te go ma chod gyur na//—513—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sngon du gyur ba'i tshe 'di la/ /gos med zas kyis phongs kyis dogs/ /rang thog ma bab nyi tshe ba/ /e ma zer nas ldog tshig smra/ /bsam gtan bzang po snying rje skyes/ /mtha' la yan pa'i phyugs sogs rnams/ /skad cig nyid la mdun skyil nas/ /rdzi bo ngan la 'di skad smras/ khyugs shing ku cos ma btab kyang / /bsam gtan bzang pos gnas 'dir bsdus/ /gtan don gnyer dang 'di tshul 'dra/ /smras kyang ma nyan gzhan du song / lkeng gi tshal ba rkang la zug /smre sngags 'don zhing 'dug pa'i tshe/ /bsam gtan bzang po der phyin nas/ /skad cig nyid la rkang pa bcos/ /des kyang dga' ba ma tshor bar/ khyod min bdag gi yan lag bde/ /nga ni bde bar gyur na yang / /rang gis byas te gsos pa yin/ /'on kyang lus gsos 'tsham par gda'/ /de ltar drin lan mi sems par/ /yul la'ang zhakhrug pa ma skyes shing / /thabs kyi mtho ris 'amo la bkod/ /ma gol shesasam mchu snyung yin/ /de yi dus na'ang de 'drar gyur/ /'dir yang mdza' ba dkrug par byed/ khu shes par gyis shig them skas brgyad pa'/ /yang sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ them skas dgu ba'i steng du 'dug nas/ 'di skad du/ dgu ba'i nyin mor gyur ba na'ang / khyim bdag tshod ltas sgo drung mnan/ /rje yi rgyan g.yu dgu shor kyang / /g.yu mthing brtan pas sgo bsdams nas/ /'phur ma lding zhing 'di skad du/ /ded dpon chen po 'ong re ran/ /sprul ba'i bya yis nub brgyad du / / grol bar ran pa'i chos bstan kyang / /da dung mchu snyung thul ba med/ /e ma snying med khyim bdag mo/ kho bo'i gtam 'di rna bar nyon/ khrel dang gzhung dang phyi thag gsum/ shar na mi bzang brtan na mdzes/ /ded dpon po byung gyur tshe/ khrel shor grong pas 'phya bar 'gyur/ /gzhung shor khyim nas 'don par mchi ngo tsha med cing 'gyod pa na/ /ngo tsha ma bsrungs 'bras bu yin/ /kun rgyu mkhas pas de thos nas/ khyod bden da dung gtam zhig 'chad/ kho bo'i 'gro lugs gong sa yin/ /de ring sa dga'i khri steng du/ /rje bran yid 'dzin chos shig 'chad/ /gus pa med kyang bden snyam du/ /gtam 'di nyon dang khrel med gnyis/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /sngon dus kho bo rtog med pa'i/ /gar dga' ro nyal zhig tu skyes/ 8 ba'i rusapa gdan du bting / /dman pa'i ro gos gos su gyon/ /ro zan za zhing rang don bral/ /bdag lta rgyun du 'joms pa na/ /mchu snyung lce spyang dmar po zhig /ro yod bzhin du nga la 'dzing / /g.yu mthing mi reng dmar po zhig /glo bur byung ste lce spyang ded / kho bos de la 'di skad du/ /mi dmar stobs can gnas 'dir shog sha za mo de ma yin no/ /nye ring ma byed de zhog la/ /byams pa'i ral gri gnad du snun/ /snying rjes 'khor ba'i srog rtsa chod/ /ma zin shes rab rgyang mda' 'phangs/ /cig gis chog gis thabs mkhas po/ /mi dmar ma nyan snying rje yis/ /mda' cig bsnun pas —514—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /spyang mo rmas/ /snying rjes ro nyal langs te phyin/ /gnag sha bcad de mo la byin/ /ring por ma thogs gsos par gyur / / de nasathabs kyis lam la bkod/ /lan cig lce spyang des bzung ste/ /rtog med chul du gnasapa na/ /mgo phreng rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ /dmar khro 'dzum pa'i mdangs can ma/ /dga' ba'i gar byed mdun du byung / /rtog med chen po ci dga' dbul/ /'o na sha za mo 'di drongs/ /de yis de tshe snying bton nas/ /snang stong 'od du yal nasasong / /e ma ma gol nga la nyon/ /da tshod mchu snyung grol ran na'ang / /da dung nyon mongs dbang gyur te / khyod kyang nyon mongs nyid la 'god/ /mchu snyung bzlog ste semasal ltos/ /lan du mchu snyung 'di skad du/ /de ltar bden na skyon ma mchis/ /'on kyang gtam la the tshom za/ /'on te gtam rgyud 'grigs po 'dug /bden na bdag gis ci zer nyan/ /do nub rje yi rgyan g.yu dgu /mi lag tshud de ldog par dka'/ /ded dpon chen po mi bzhugs shul/ /zhag cig khyim gang nyams dga' bskyangs/ /kun tu rgyu yis 'di skad du/ /ring por mi thogs ded dpon 'ong / /da ste nam langs gyur ba na/ /bde mal gcin gyis ga la 'gengs/ /sleb dus nyams dga' dpag med 'ong / /gzhi byes bkra shis smon gnas yin/ /ma gol shes sam nyams su long/ khu shes par gyis shig them skas dgu pa'o/ /yang sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ them skas bcu ba'i steng du 'dug ste 'di skad du/ rje dang bran bcas nga la nyon/ khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa gang / /'jig rten kun gyi bstod gnas yin/ /gzugs mdzes rgyan gyi kha na med / / gzhi 'jam gzhan sems 'dzin mkhas na/ /kun gyi yid du sdug cing byams/ /bran g.yog rje yi ngo 'dzin na/ /phra mar ma song rtag tu skyongs/ /mi shes nyes pa nongs pa chung / /gang gisade la snyad mi rigs/ /shes nas khyad gsod khrims dang 'gal/ /rtag tu byung tshe snying tshim 'ong / kho bo sngon tshe gling phran du/ /rgyal phran zhig tu skyes pa na/ /ma gol btsun mo 'od ldan zhes/ /mchu snyung rgyal po 'od stag ces/ /'khor g.yog dpal gyis brgyan pa yi/ /bza' mi lhan cig 'khod pa na/ /'od stag nags khrod cig tu song / /ring por ma byung blon po btang / /nags kyi khrod du mtha' 'khob kyi/ /rgyal po cig gis 'od stag bzung / /yan lag bkyigs te shing la bkal/ /de dus blon pos de mthong nas/ /blon po byung ste 'di skad du/ /lha yi sras de nags khrod na/ /mtha' 'khob rgyal pos shing la bkal/ /rgol bar ma nus ji ltar bgyi/ /de tshe bdag gis lcags gzhu dang / /lcags mda' zangs gshog rab sgron te/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs su phyin/ /rgyal po dpung bcas 'khod de snang / / dbus su phyin te mda' bkang nas/ /thang shing cig la bsnun pa na/ /thang shing 'gyel te shing mang mnan / / rgyal po skrag ste 'di skad du/ /stobs chen khyod ni su zhig yin/ /'dod pa smrosashig ci zer sgrub/ /—515—

bka'agadarda sangapedakon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lan du kho bos 'di skad du/ /bdag gi lus skyes gzhon nu 'di/ /don med khyod kyis ci ste gsod/ /stobs kyi ri bo sgyel nus kyang / khyong pa phyag bzhag khyod la 'dri/ /rgyal po 'di snyam 'di skad smra/ /stobasayod bzhin du brtser dgongs na/ /seng ge'i sanas la wa yis rgol/ khyod bden bu mo nor bcas dag /'di bkrol 'di la sbyin par bya/ /mi rigs mod kyis byams sems kyis/ /ji skad zer bzhin snyan du gtong / /de nas thabasakyi chos la 'god/ /'od stag chos dang nor la bkod/ /drin du mi sems 'di skad du/ /bsad par 'os pa mi gsod rting / /gnyen du mi 'os gnyen du sbyar/ /zer zhing le len 'ded par byed/ /ma gol lan du de bsad na/ /yul der 'brug pa du ma ldang / /phyi ma'ang srog gi lan po mchi/ /bzang po'i bzang lan ma 'jal bar / / ngan pa'i tshig ngan log par 'debs/ /ma zad der yang der 'dra 'gyur/ khu shes par gyis shig them skas nga'iglu pa'/ /yang sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ them skas bcu gcig pa'i steng du 'dug nas 'di skad du/ nga la nyon cig rje bran gnyis/ /las can 'brel ba'i lde mig yin/ /dad can spel ba'i rgyu rkyen yin/ /'khor g.yog skyong gis gdams ngag yin/ /rgan rabs kun gyi bstan bcos yin/ /gzhon nu 'dzin pa'i snyan ngag yin/ /sngon chad byung nged gtam rgyud yin/ /go ba rnams la sman du che/ /ma go'ang nam ring skyel la dgos/ /them skas bcu gcig yang steng na/ /sprul pa'i lha bya kun tu rgyu/ /tshe rabasakun tu tshong dpon gyis / /blo gtad thub pa'i grogs mchog yin/ /mtha' 'khob ra yi shug gseb tu/ /sprul pa'i lha bya mdzes pa nga / /gsog run mi byed bya 'tshol ba'i / / rdzu 'phrul mkha' spyod dpag med sdud/ /de dus tshong dpon thugs bzung bas/ /thugs rjes dga' bder gnas mchog der/ /lung bstan rnyed nas lha bya nga / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gling shed na/ /nor bu'i rin chen rnyed pa rnams/ /ded dpon drin la za bar shog /de tshe mchu snyung khyod nyid kyang / /lha ri'i mgul du lha bya nga / /ded dpon lha cig nyid gyur nas/ /ding sang byung gyur brjod gyur te/ /ding sang legs bshad 'di bshad rnams / / bag chags bzang por smin gyur nas/ /mkhas par khyod gyur smin par shog /de nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bdag la snying bzhin bzung gyur nas/ /lhan cig thar ba'i lam 'jug shog /lha ri'i mgul nasar zhes pa'i/ /rang bzhin bzang po shug gnas 'dra/ /padma 'ba' zhig gnas gyur ba'i/ /byang chub shing du'ang gnas pa'i tshe/ /dbyibs ni bde gshegs dbu 'dra ba/ /zhal gyi steng du gtsug lag rgyas/ /thog mtha' kun tu rab dge ba/ /chu rgyun mi chad sgrogs par shog /mchu snyung lta bu'i gdul bya rnams/ /skyo shas med par 'dren par shog / kun tu rgyu zhes mgyogs pa nga / /gling gzhi gling phran nyin re bzhin/ /chags med gzhan don rgyu bar shog/—516—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bden gnyis gshog pa'i rlung stobs kyis/ /nam mkhas khyab tshad khyab byed cing / /bya rang chos su 'bab par shog / dag byed zag med bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rdzing bu brgya dang bcu gsum la/ /rtag tu bde bar 'brud par shog /gzhan yang chu mig brgya rtsa la/ /bcus kyang 'dzad par mi 'gyur bar/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel bar shog /gzhan yang bkra shis 'di lta ste/ khye'u'i mdun na khye'u'i gzugs/ /mdzes shing bu mo'i mdun na yang / /bu mo gzugs mdzes nyid gyur te/ /thabs kyis chos la 'god par shog /bud med pa la bur ston cing / /nor med pa la nor du shog /bzhon pa med la bzhon gyur cig /chu bo chu bran du ma la/ /gzengs dang zam pa brtan par shog / mdor na gdul bya'i snang ngo la/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dga' bder shog khyim bdag dge bzang gyur ba yang / / gang gi skad la'ang mkhas gyur pa'i/ /nga yi bshes cig dam par shog /ded dpon chen po'i zhabs tog pa/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rtsod med gyur/ /ma gol gnyug mar gnas pa yi/ /mkhas pa'i dam pa mchog tu shog / rtsod pa thams cad spangs gyur nas/ /nga dang nga yi tshad ma yi/ /dpang bo dam pa nyid du shag /g.yu mthing nga dang ded dpon gyi/ /nyer mkho bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas par legs sprul cing / /rtag tu chos 'byor rgyas pa yis/ /ngang du thar bar 'gro bar shog /gzhan yang 'dir tshogs ma lus pa/ /bdag gisabadag rkyen byas gyur nas/ /mchog rab lam la phyin par shog /rje bran de 'dra'i dam chos nyon/ /ding sang dus na snying gtam yin/ /tshong dpon byung tshe drin du mchi/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi gleng gzhi yin/ /da lta nga yi blo bag (ka 277 ba blag1yin/ /gnyis ka de la ya mtshan skyes/ /dam chos zab mo kun tu rgyu/ /snyel bar gyur to zas 'di gsol/ /zhim par sbyar te bdag la sbyin/ khu shes par gyis shig them skad bcu gcig pa'o/ /yang sang nub kyang gong bzhin du/ them skas bcu gnyis pa'i steng du 'dug nas 'di skad du/ g.yu mthing nga yi g.yon du sdod/ /mdang sum rmis pa'i rmi lam 'chad/ /thabs mkhas nyams kyi snang ba skyong / /lce bde blo gsal ne tsho'i gzugs/ /g.yu bzhu mthing la blugs 'dra ba/ /bya yi gzugs su 'di 'dra na/ /mi lus blangs te rje bkur na/ /mi yi nang nas mi mchog ste/ /skad cig nyid la brgyad khri yi/ /nyon mongs sgo mo rab bsdams te / / de yi gnyen por brgyad khri yi/ /pho brang rin thang med pa yi/ /sgo mo phye nas nying phugs su/ /bzhi stong gsang ba zab mo'i sgo/ /phyed par dka' ba 'byed par byed/ /mi lus bstan na de 'dra'o/ /lha lus blangs na lha dbang ste/ /de 'dra'i sgo mo sdom zhing 'byed/ /de 'dra'i g.yu mthing nga la nyon/ /phyed yol skya rengs dang po'i tshe/ /dag pa'i snang ba nyi ma shar/ /mthun grogs dpag med dga' ba'i dbus/ /nyams dga' ci zer nan pas 'khyod / / rje mo bran kyang 'dzum chags nas/ /'di 'dra'i spyod tshul mi ston par/ /ded dpon gsung rnams dang —517—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/du len/ /bdag cag gnyis la'ang blon por btags/ /zhim pa'i zas kyi phud nas mchod/ /de dus kho bo nyams dga'i tshe/ /bdag gi spyi spu gzengs pa'i gseb/ /ser bu'i rlung zhig 'phyo ba na/ /bshugs (shukaglu len pa'i khye'u cig /dkar po'i mdangs kyis dkar gong 'apa /mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis tshong dpon bsu/ /dpa' ba'i stobs kyis khyim bdag bzlog /de bzhin mkha' la ci dgar rgyu/ /zhim pa'i g.yo mdag dpag med za / / gnangasakyi nyin mo tshong dpon 'ong / /lus la skyon med rin chen len/ /tshong phrug thamasacad bu bzhin skyong / / de dag gis kyang ma bzhin khur/ /de tshe g.yu mthing 'di skad du/ /skya rengasabar pa shar ba'i tshe tshong phrug lnga brgya'i dbus shed na/ /nor bu 'dren de bde bar mchis/ /mchu snyung gab cing rdul nag 'dzag /ma gol dpa' zhus gdong 'dzum nag kho bos de yi sems gso zhing / /mi phan ma 'gyod ngo so bskyed/ /byasakyang mi lo ngo bzhin gnag /rang gis nyes pas 'gyod pa rmis/ /ma gol tshig de nyams su long / /zhes bag phebasapa'i gnas su nyal te gnas so// khu shes par gyis shig them skas bgraganyisapa'o/ /yang sang nub kyang sngar bzhin du them skas bcu gsum pa'i steng du gnas te 'di skad du/ sngon dusasum cu rtsa gsum na/ kho bo lha drug 'od zer mchog /lha phrug du mar rab bskor nas/ /gling bu la sogasasnyan pa'i sgra/ /tshig 'bru 'di skad kun dga' ba/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba gang / /bde dang sdug bsngal mi lta ba'i/ /gnasalugs don can shes rab des/ /btsan sa bzung ste grol bar byed/ /e ma mtho ris mdzesapa'i bu/ /'phraladaga'i bde ba kun snang yang / /bden pa'i snying po ci yang med/ /de bsami rtag sdug bsngal rgyu/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rab spangs nas/ /thar ba'i grong du 'gro bar bya/ /de skad smra zhing lha phrug rnams/ /chosalabakod de mi yul 'dir/ /bkod pa du ma rab bkye
