nas/ /thamasacad bde ba'i lam la sbyar/ /ngas byasarlom semasami byed par/ /'di bzhin bya dang ri dwags tshogs/ /rnam pa du ma'i lus sprul nas/ /'di bzhin thams cad dag (dgekal bkod/ /e ma ma gol rje bran gnyis/ /nang par ded dpon chen po 'ong / /srang gi bzhi mdo ga dar gyis / / zas kyi tshogs rnams mchod pas sbyor/ /de phan le'u bcu gsum yin/ /zhesaso/ /de ltar na nyi ma brgyagasum du ltad mo'i rigs kyang de tsam zhig byas pa la/ dran gyis g.yu yang bcu gsum bskyal/ khyim bdag gis kyang sngar gyi le lan dang bcas shing g.yu khyer te/ gtam rgyud ma rdzogasakyi bar du nub re bzhin sgo drung du sdad nasardzogs pa dang / gnyugs bu de langasanas song ngo / /mchu snyung gisakyang / /mdang yang bya ngan 'disadon med pa'i gtam rgyud gtong gtong nas/ /'dun ma chen po bshig bya ba la sogs pa smra zhing / /sprugasasdebs du ma byas na'ang sprul ba'i thabasakyisam shor/ nub bcu gsum pa'i nub mo bran gyis/ khyim bdag khang pa'i rgyab —518

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nasa'athen pa na/ kun tu rgyus khang pa'i shar zur la bsdad/ g.yu mthing gi nub zur la bsdad/ /de nas kun tu rgyus 'di skad du/ /'then zhig 'then zhig yar la 'then/ /rab tu 'then zhig gtam ngan 'then/ /da dung drongasashigabyur ga drongs/ /mi 'dod mgo rtsa byur du che/ /g.yu mthing gis 'di skad du/ thong zhig thong zhig skye 'chad do / / skyur zhig skyur zhig nyen nasagada'/ /phus thob phus thob lud nas byung / /rmeg shud rmeg shud a tsa ma /zhes smras pa dang / /bran mchu snyung tab tob langs nas/ ngal ba dang dgod bro ba la sogs pa du ma byung ste/'then thag shor nas/ ma gir mgo chag pa'i skad thos nas/ de ma thag tu kun tu rgyus 'di skad du/ /lhung ngo lhung ngo gtam ngan lhung / /chag go chag go mgo rdza chag /chad do chad do kho thag chad/ /slar mi ldog pa nyid du nges/ /ha ha zer ba dang / g.yu mthing na re/ bran rul ma yis thag rul drangs/ /gros rul mi rul 'ong 'dod tshe/ /rma khrag lhag pa'i 'gong bos 'then/ /kun tu bslu ba blo ngan yin/ /gzhan bslus rang gi ltag tu 'khor/ /legs so legs tho'iokun tu rgyu/ /dgra mgo choms zhes smre sngags 'don/ /'gron (mgronakamago choms so mchu snyung ma/ /da ste rje shul legs par skyongs/ /gtam ngan phung po phyi la bor/ /go chod phung po nang du tshud/ /go ma chod pas sngar bslus kyang / /da lan go ma chod pa des/ /shin tu sman no mchu snyung ma/ /phyi ba phyin song nang pa nang du 'dus/ /mtshan mo bkra shis/ yang bkra shis pa'i nyin mo ded dpon chen po tshong phrug lnga brgya dang bcas te rang gi khyim du bde bar sleb/ de nas sngar gyi byung tshul du ma tshong dpon gyi snyan du gsol ba ni/ kun tu rgyu yis tādi skad du/ sprul pa'i sprul ba ded dpon mchog /tshong dpon gshegs nas zla dgu nas/ /tha mal mig 'brid ltad mo byung / khyed kyi rje bran der song tshe/ khyim bdag dge ba bzang gis bslus/ /thabs med sgo cha legs bsdamasanas/ /gtam brgyud thabs kyis legs par bsrungs/ /bcu gsum 'das tshe khyed kyis sleb/ /rgyan g.yu de tsam med na yang / /gzhog thogs bya yis mtshon bzhin bcom/ /da ni ngan pa'i gdul bya dag /skye dman dgagis mi thub bas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgom du 'gro khyod kyis blo gtad khur khur nas/ /rang gi bya spubazang po sgrubs/ /g.yu mthing gsungs nas 'di skad du/ /ded dpon byon pa legs par rnyed/ /sngon chad khur:sa mnan par gyur/ /da ni gshog chag nags su 'gro/ /rin chen gling na gser mang yang / /nya sbal gser gyisaci zhig bya/ /thams cad nor gyis gang gyur kyang / /g.yu mthing nga la cis mi phan/ /nga ni nags gseb 'ga' zhig tu/ /bya spu lang nge gum pa na/ /cis kyang mi phan chos shig dgos/ /mtho ris snang tshul 'di 'dra na/ /byol song nga 'dra ji ltar bde/ /de nas ded dpon spyan chab shor/ khyod bden yid rab ma 'byung bar/ /nga yi longs spyod dpal la zo/ /'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs su/ /bdag gis chos bzhin bskyang —519—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bar bya/ /tha ma mtha' 'khob bod khams su'ang / /chos kyi dpal gyis bsdu bar bya/ /sprul pa'i lha bya ku tu rgyu/khyed 'dra'i dam pa yid 'byung na/ kho bo khyim 'dir rab spangs nas/ /nges 'byung bskul bar the tshom med/ /da ni thams cad nga sems na/ /kun tu rgyu yi chos la nyon/ /bslu ba med pa'i bdud rtsi 'byung / /de nas nga yang rab tu 'byung / /kun tu rgyu yis 'di skad du/ /skye 'chi chu bo'i rba klong 'dra/ /gyen thur rtsub cing gnasasamed/ /skye 'chi nyi ma'i 'char nub 'dra/ /rim pa bzhin du ltos te 'byung / /tshe 'di dug gi mtsho dang 'dra/ kha nang mngar te phugs srog 'bral/ khyim pa mi gtsang srin bu 'dra/ /shin tu btsog ste bde bar zhen/ /ma dag sems can yid 'byung gzhi/ /mi shes bslabs pa mi nyan cing / /phan lan log sgrub gnya' bar bzhon/ /ma yi 'gram lcag mi theg par/ /dgra yi phye 'thor bden par 'dzin/ /ded dpon chen po khyim 'di nas/ /rab tu byung ba pad tshal du/ /tshong phrug bung ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /dga' bde chosakyis bskyangs ran mdzod/ /bud med phra men mkha' 'gro 'dra/ /'phral dga' tshe srog nyid la gzan/ /de nas tshong dpon chen po yis/ /skad cig nyid la rab tu byung / /tshong phrug lnga brgya chos la sbyar/ /mtshan yang dge slong nyid du grags/ /ma gol mchu snyung g.yo can yang / / dam chos zab mo de thos nas/ /yun ring drang na lcags 'dzad bzhin/ /nges par byung nas chos la spyad//dngos po thams cad btang gyur bas/ /yul khams 'byor bas rgyas par gyur/ /kye khu chen po/ de'i dus kyi mchu snyung ni khyed yin/ /tshong dpon ni nga yin/ kun tu rgyu ni 'brom/ /g.yu mthing ni legasapa'i shes rab/ /ma/ gol ni ka ba/ khyim bdag de ni lo tsā ba chen po yin no/ /lo tsa ba ni tshod lta bar zad kyi nyes pa can nee ma shā /na no/ /gzhan gyis nyes na'ang khyim bdag tu gyur ba de nyid kyis srung bar byed do/ /lo tsa ba'ang de snar thugs zab/ /kye khu/ 'brom chen po ni de 'dra ste/ /them skas la brten pa'i skyes rabs de tsam zhig brgyud kyang / rtag tu yi dam brtan pa dang / /le lo snyom las mi 'ong la/ /byung yang rang la rngan bgrang zhing / /brtul zhugs snying po dran par byed/ /gzhan la zhi des gsong por smra/ khro gnyer ngo 'dzum mi byed par/ /rtag tu 'dzum la gnas par byed / / rtag tu gzhan dag mthong ba na/ /ser sna mi byed sbyin pa gtong / /bzod stobs chen posaganas par byed / / gzhan sems thams cad bsrung ba dang / /rtsod pa thams cad mi mnga' bar/ /brnyas pa spangs pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /gzhan la gus pa chen por byed/ /ces gsungasaso/ /de ltar/ rtag tu yi dam brtan bya zhing / /le lo snyoms pa'i sems byung tshe/ /zhes bya ba nas/ /gzhan la gdams ngag byed pa'i tshe/ /snying rje phan semasaldan par bya/ /zhes bya ba'i bar la brtsams te/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnasakyi skyes rabs bstan pa las/ khu'i them skas bcu gsum pa ste/ bshes gnyen pa sprul ba'i bya sro long kun tu rgyur ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste/—520—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /skyes rabs nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// // khu dang dag snang 'brel ba'i tshoms dang bcas nas khu'i chos dang po'o/ /ya24 khu chosaganyisapa/ grong khyer bde ldan du rgyal bu skyabs sbyin du sku skye ba bceXsapa'iletha//ka 280 ba1 rgogrong khyer bde ldan du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa/ rgyal bu skyabs sbyin du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste khu chos gnyis pa yin la/ 'dis bu chos nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs so/ /ci/yang sgrol ma'i pus mo g.yas pa'i steng na/ rgyal ba a ti sha sras rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ gsang phu ba legs pa'i shes rab ste sku gsum zhal 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ dngul dkar gyi maṇḍal la sogs pa gong bzhin mchod pa la sogs pa rnams gong bzhin phul nas/ yang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gis/ jo bo la 'di skad du/ zhus lan gyi phreng ba 'di'i 'phro nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin du/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas sngon skye ba khyad par can bzhes lugs kha sang gsungs pa ltar bzhad gad theg ge ba cig zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/yang mchu snyung cig 'chad dam/ 'on te yang sngon bzang po bzang por skyes pa cig 'chad dam/ 'on te dkyus thub pa cig 'chad dam gsungs pas/ khu na re/ bzang po bzang po byas pa ji cam yod/ /jo bo'i zhal nas / mkhas pa byas pa'ang mang / btsun po byas pa'ang mang phyis bzang po'ang shin tu mang / rgyal po chen por skyes pa'ang mang po yod/ gzhan skyes rabs sangs rgyas kyis kyang bgrang bar mi nus gsungs pas/ bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ /sngon glang po che'i ro bton pa'i gtam rgyud de gsung zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas de bya gsungs nas/ yang sngon grong khyer bde ldan bya bar/ 'brom chen po/ rgyal po skyabs sbyin bya ba chos rgyal cig tu skyes / khu chen po de'i blon po kun du 'gro zhes bya bar skyes/ nga'i a mes chen po btsun mo chags med ster zhes bya ba/ yar dkon mchog mchod pa'i dad pa can/ mar ma rabs skyong ba'i snying rje can/ bar ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod kyi gos kyis brgyan pa/ thams cad bu bzhin du skyong ba la/ grong khyer de'i dbus na khron pa gting rgya shin tu che ba zhig yod pa'i nang du/ glang po che zhig lhung / de nas skye bo thams cad kyis drang bar ma nus par glang po che'i sha rul myags la song ste/ klu gtsang sbra can yang 'bros nas chu bskams/ der grong khyer ba thams cad chu med par sdug bsngal ba na/ rgyal po skyabs sbyin 'di snyam du grong khyer ba 'di dag chu med par sdug bsngal / da thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu la brten nas glang po che —521 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/de drangs nas sems can rnams bde ba la dgod par bya'o snyam te/ rgyal blon gnyis kyis 'grogs nas/ khron pa'i 'gram du phyin te/ blon po la 'di skad du/ nga'i lus 'di ma nyams par zungs shig /bdag gi rnam par shes pa glang po che'i ro la zhugs te drang bar bya'o zhesabasgos nas/ khron pa'i gting du phyin pa na/ blon pos rang gi gzugs bzhag ste/ rgyal po'i lus la zhugs so/ /de nas rang gi lus de la rma btod de nyams par byas so//de nas rgyal pos glang po che'i lus la zhugs te steng du thon pa dang / rang gi lus med par blon po'i ro nyams pa cig 'dug ste/ de la zhugs kyang phan par ma mthong nas/ phyogs gcig na ne sdu'i ro ma nyams pa cig 'dug pa de la zhugs so/ /de nas phyogs cig na tshong pa du ma lhagasate skyed mos tshal zhig tu babs pa na/ nub mo tshong srang gi gseb tu phyin nas khal ma phyir 'thor ba rnams sdud pa dang / mel tshe'i sgra du ma 'don pa dang / tshong pa dag la'ang phebs par gnyid log cig ces bde ba ster ba dang / ya mtshan pa'i gtam du ma byas pa ni/ rnyed par dka' ba mi yi lus/ /dbang po'i nyi ma mun bral ba/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma khyed gnyer yang / /nam zhig 'chi bar gyur ba na/ /'bad rtsol nor rnams lhag gyur te/ /gos med gcer bur 'gro tsa na/ /gtan gyi gosacan tshul khrims bstan/ /de las gzhan pa don med soms/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba snying zhugasatshe/ /bkur 'os pha rje'ang slu bar byed/ /cig gis du ma bskyangs gyur kyang / /du mas cig tu mi theg pa/ /gdeng med drin can ltog lta 'phel/ /gtan phugs lasa'abras ma mthong ba'i/ /nye tshe'i bde ba ster ba gang / /dge ba phran tshegs byasagyur kyang / /bar chad phra mo ma khegs na/ /chos kyang mi bden 'di 'byung zhes/ /thabs shes med de ngan 'gror 'gro / / e ma 'dir tshogs tshong pa kun/ /nam zhig 'chi ba nges par 'ong / /de dusabade ba'i khe zhig mdzod/ /'di yi mdun ma gnyer gyur kyang / /nor dang longs spyod sdug bsngal 'phel/ /med pa 'tshol ba'i sdug bsngal dang / / yod pa skyong ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis/ /brgya phrag lhag par yod skyong tshe/ /e ma don gnyer tshong pa rnams / / nor re'i rting la dgra bo re/ /dgra bo re yisasdug bsngal re/ /nor bdag cig gis gnya' bar bkur / / bde 'dod nor gyi dbang song ba/ /bzlog na sdug bsngal chen po gda'/ khes par mdzod la nyamasasu long / /zhesapas tshong pa rnams rab tu tshim ste/ tshong dpon des ne tso bdag tu bzung / ne tso nyin cig rang gi pho brang gi steng du phyin te/ sngar gyi tshul la spyad (dpyadakapa na/ rang lus blon posa'adzin pa mthong / /btsun mo'ang mi dga' shugs ringasa'abyin/ /pho brang 'khor kyang bkrag nyamasagyur/ /bkra shisarol mo'ang mi gda' bas / / btsun mo de la 'di skad du/ /sngar ni rgyal po btsun mor bcas/ /mthun zhing dpal 'byor chos la spyod / / pho brang nyams dga' glu gar gang / /ding sang btsun mo'ang nyams par gyur/ /rgyal po 'di yang bag —522—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /khums gda'/ /btsun mo bag phebs nga la smros/ /zhes smras pa dang / /btsun mo de yang cung zad yis phebs te/lan du 'di skad du/ bya yi mkhas pa nga la nyon/ /sngon chad bkra shis de 'dra na'ang / /deng sang bdud sdes bde ba phral/ /dpag med 'thung ba'i khron gting du/ /bag med glang po zhig shor nas/ /chu bskamasarang gzhan sdug la bkod/ /rgyal pos ma bzod de 'dren song / /de shul blon pos zhabs thogs na'ang / /blon po ma log lha cig pu/ /sngar dang mi 'dra zhal tsha zhing / /rgyal srid bkrag kyang nyams par gyur/ /rol mo mkhan med glu gar nyams / / mchod yul bzang po'ang ma byung bas/ /sngon chad blon po'i bsod nams la/ /byung nas blon po med nyamasasam/ /'on te rgyal la bar chad byung / /mkhyen nam bya yi mkhas pa mchog /lan tu ne tsosa'adi skad du/ /legs par nyon dang chags med sbyin/ /nga la rgyal po skyabs sbyin zhes/ /nga ni 'gro la snying brtse'i phyir/ khron par glang shar 'don dus su/ /kun 'gro 'khor snyam blo gtad nas/ /lus bzhag rnam shes khron gting du/ /phyin nas glang zhugs slar log tshe/ /blon po'i lus nyams rgyal mi gda'/ /blon la zhugs kyang don ma mthong / /lus 'di rnyed nas 'dir zhugs te/ /do zhag skyed mos tshal rab na/ /glo bur tshong pa'i dbusadag tu/ /phan semasachosabastan tshong pa dga'/ /de ring 'dir 'ongs khyed mthong tshe/ /dga' ste'ang ma dga' skyo bar gyur/ /de ring tshong pa'i 'brang du song / /nga nyos dga' bzhin nang du khur/ /de nas rgyal po zas za tshe/ /sa sbur gseb tu nyal gyur te/ /langs nas gshog sprugs zas bkang bas/ /nga la bsnun te nga 'gum 'gyur/ khyed kyis nga yi nee tso zhesaske/ / snyan pa'i sgrung gis gtam zhig shod/ /'phur lding gshog pa dga' dgar khrom/ /zer zhing ngus dang rgyal po nyid/ /ne tso gso ba'i ma ngu zhes/ /pho brang nang du lus bzhag nas/ /ne tso zhugs nas gtam smra zhing /khyod dga'i rnam 'gyur byed pa'i tshe/ kho bos rgyal la 'jug par bya/ /thos ma thag tu btsun mo dga'/ /myur du tshong ba'i dbusasu phyin/ khyed kyi bya 'di nga la tshong / /tshong pa 'di skad mi nyan cing / /mi 'tshong rin chen nga la dgos / / ne tsosalan du 'di skad du/ /btsun mo 'di la kho bo tshong / /gshog chagasamakha' la bros gyur na/ /rin med dngosapo'ang stong par 'gyur/ /da ni rang gong rang gis byed/ /bzhon pa cig dang ma he gnyis/ /gsum gyis btsun mos de bcol mdzod/ /de ltar rjes nas khab tu phyin/ /rne tsos tshigasabacad gtam smras shing / / btsun mos dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byas/ /re shig (zhig3sngar bzhin byas pa na/ /rgyal pos lcagasabasnun ne tso gum/ /btsun mos sngar bzhin smras gyur bas/ /ma ngu kho bosanee tso gso/ /zer nas nang song ne tso langs / / gtam smra 'phur lding byed pa'i tshe/ /rgyal pos rang gi lus la zhugs/ khang pa thams cad 'od kyis gang / / pho brang thams cad rgyas par gyur/ /nyi ma shar bzhin skyes bu yang / /glo bur nyid du rig pa gsal/ /de —523—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nas rgyal pos sbas pa yi/ khyad nor bton zhing bya la bstan/ /de nas rgyal pos 'di skad du/ /drin can log par slu ba yis/ /blon po byol song nyid du gyur/ /rang lus nyams par ma byas na/ /blon po'i go cha bdag gisagyon / khyod nyid bdag gis bkur na yang / /log pa'i sems kyisarang lusabashig / lusamachog med par bya lus gyur/ /rgyal po'i gzugs 'dras srid ma skyongs/ /bsod nams med na'ang gzugs mi phan/ /nga ni rgyal pos dgosamed na'ang / khyod kyis lus khams mi skyong bas/ /rang lus bzung ba gzhan don bgyi/ /nyams dga' mdzod cig chags med ma/ /bsod nams gsog cig sbyin shugs can/ /'khor tshogs skyongs shig mdzangs ldan ma/ /mtho ris rgyal po'i pho brang yin/ /mi lus rin chen gling bzang thob/ /pha rol 'gro ba'i gru nang du/ /skye rgas na 'chi'i rgya mtsho mnan/ /rba rlabs nang du mi tshud par/ /bag phebs bde bar 'gro bar byed//de 'dra'i chos sgra rab bsgrags pas/ /btsun mo'i rnam rtog chos la 'byams/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin rab brtan pas / / mi g.yo gnas lugasangang bzhag ste/ /rjes gsal shes pa'i nyams steng du/ /ma 'ongs bde gshegasasprul ba cig /dbus dang mtha' 'khob dpag med 'dul/ /de tshe byang chub don gnyer ba/ /rnal 'byor mchog ldan bsam mi khyab/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mchog brnyes nas/ /mtha' 'khob rba rlabs rab mnan te/ /bde gshegs sprul dang mi 'bral bar/ /rgya dang bod khams rab rgyu zhing / /chosargyal khyod kyi zhabasabatud5nas/ /mi mngon dbyings su mchod par shog /slar yang khyod kyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dpal gyi gnas//gtsug lag rin rang dwangs pa/ /lhun po bdun gyi mdun dag tu/ /pad sdong gser ldan du ma'i drung / /rtsibs stong g.yu mtsho'i 'khyil steng du/ /gnas lugasabasam gtan bsgom par shog /blon po ne sdu'i gzugs can yang / /'di bzhin rang nongs rjes gyur nas/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas par gyur na yang / khyod kyi zhabs la rab btud nas/ /chos 'byor bkra shis spel bar shog /nga la gson dang sprul pa'i rje/ /nga yis khyod zhabs la brten nas/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas par ji ltar 'gyur/ /rje yi zhal nas 'di skad du/ /ma 'ongasatshe rabs nyi shu tsam / / mkhas pa nga la legs btud nas/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams mkhas gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pa nyi shur brgyud mar 'byung / /mthar yang smon lam btab pa bzhin/ /mtha' 'khob gnas su khyod btul nas/ /bde gshegasasprul la rab mchod cing / /bzang po'i gnas su phyin par shog /ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub gyur cig /e ma rje bos thugs brtse bas/ /'khrul mig gzugs mdzes rab sbyar nas/ mdzes pa'i gos kyis rab g.yogs shing / / blon po'i rnam shes de la bstim/ /zas za'i tshe na ne tsor bsten/ /chos spyod dag la rab tu bkod/ /'gyod pa'i sems kyis nyes pa bshags/ /sdom pa'i sems kyis gus pas mchod/ /lan cig bram ze'i —524—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /khye'u yi/ /ma nyams ro gcig rnyed gyur nas/ /rje yis dri bzang chu yis bkrus/ /blon po'i rnam shes de la bkug / de nas legs bshad du ma bslabs/ /sgra dang gtan tshigs bzo ldan pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa mchog tu phyin/ /de nas sgyu ma mig 'phrul ltar/ /bden med snang ba'i chos la sbyangs/ /rtsom bshad legs bshad mkhas pa yi/ /mkhas pa dam pa mchog tu phyin/ /gzhan yang nad gso'ang mkhas par gyur/ /de nas sprul pa'i dge slong cig /mkha' la byon te skyabs sbyin la/ /bram ze'i khye'u rab tu byung / /nags khrod gnas su dben par zhog /rang rgyud thul nas tshe rabs kun/ /bdag cag gnyis kyis skyong bar byed/ /de nas sprul bsasdom pa byin/ /rgyal pos 'tsho ba rab sbyar nas/ /nags khrod gnas su ngom par gyur/ /chags med sbyin de mkha' la yal/ /skyabs sbyin 'gro don rgyun chad med/ /yid mi skyo zhing bzod stobs che/ /skye bo du ma chos la bkod / / de nas chags med dbyings su gshegs/khu chen po/ khyed mtha' bzang nged gnyis pos skyong ba'i rten 'brel yang de yin/ /rgyu mtshan de ltar na/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /mdzad pa dang 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ 'khor ba'i gnas su mi skyo bar gzhan don byas pa'i rnam grangs 'di khyed khu rngog gnyis kyis dris tsam zhig ma chad par bshad kyis/ /sngar bshad pa bzhin du/ rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rjes su rab tu byung ba du ma cig byung ba de dag gis zhabs la gtugs shing mchod pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i smon lam btab pa dang / de dag 'di'i sprul ba yin pa dang / lha 'dis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'dir 'gyur ba dang /mtshan 'di skad bya ba la sogs pa ni bsam gyi mi khyab cing / kho bos bshad par nus kyang / 'brom gyi bka' rgya du ma btab mod kyis/ gdul bya skal ba can gyi ngor rang byung gi yi ge cig tsam byung srid na/ glegs bam che ste dad pa'i rjes 'brang dag gis 'chang ba dang klog pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher ston pa dang / blo la kun chub par byed pa dang / phun sum tshogs par bskyang bar dka' bas/ thun mong gi yi ge rnams na med pa dang / yod kyang mi mthun pa dang / nges par dgos pa dang / phan pa'i gnas du ma las brtsams te che rags tsam zhig blo phebs par bshad kyis/ da 'di dag mi dad pa dang bag med pa'i gnas su ma 'chad cig so so skye bo chos lugs mi mthun pa rnams la ma 'chad cig chos lugs mthun yang dam pa ma yin pa la ma 'chad cig 'di ni kho bo'i bka' rgya'o/ /yang bka' gdams pa la dad pa dang / bka' gdams nyams su len pa dang / blo ru shong ba dang / /yid ches pa'i gnas dang / snying gi thig ler nyams su len pa dang / bla ma'i yon tan la shin tu mos pa rnams la bshad par bya'o/ /yang rang gi bla ma la gus kyang / dge bsnyen rang mtshan par 'dzin pa dang / che —525—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chosakyi skor/chung gi tshod 'dzin pa dang / yon tan 'di tsam zhig mnga' bya ba dang / mtshan 'di yin bya ba dang / /gnas 'dir 'brungs bya ba dang / mdzad pa 'di mdzad bya ba dang / bla ma drug bsten bya ba dang / de nasasku gshegasabya spudang / gang zag 'dis sdig bsags bya ba dang / gus bzhin du tshod 'dzin pa'i gnas du ma can rnamasal bka'i gdams lugs 'di yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa shin tu nges par bshad par bya'o/ /yang yul 'di ltarteslob dpon gyis nga rgyal ba dang / 'dod pa can nor gyisang rgyal ba dang / dbang po che kha drag gisang rgyalab dang / ya rabs rigasakyis nga rgyal ba dang / dregasapa can gnasastobs kyisang rgyal ba dang / lang tsho mdzesapasang rgyal spudang / nga rgyal ba rnamasal bstan par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /rin po che'i 'byung gnasal phyag dar khrod bzhin du 'byung gnas su mi rtsi ba'i phyir dang / kun gyisatshad mar mi 'dzin na dam pa yin kyang gang gi chos la yang dag par mi 'dzin par chos can la rten (brtenakanasachosakhyad du gsod pa'i phyiraro/ /yang ston byed ni 'di lta ste kun gyis bkur ba'i dge ba'i bshesaganyen thams cad ldogusapa'i byang chusasems dpa' / gzhan gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i gang zag gang zag de nyid kyang sgro mi 'dogs skur pami'adebasapa glegs bam las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du snod brtagasate ston pa de dag gisabashad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang log lta can log lta las ldog srid na'ang bshad par bya'o/ /dad pa la sogs pyodage ba snyeriphel srid na'ang bshad par bya'o/ /dpe yod na dpe nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsgomasate/ rang nyid spyan rasagazigasasu byas nas/ tshig nor bu'i phreng ba klog par bya'o/ /dpe med na'ang lhag chad bzod par gsolazhing bstan par bya'o / / zhes gsungs pa dang / lo tsā ba na re/ rgya gar gyi phyogasacig na paṇḍita cig them skasabacu gsum la sogs pa 'di dag sngon klu sgrub dang rgyal po bde spyod gnyisakyis mi ro la gser sgrub pa'i dusasu/ rgyal busadur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du lan bcu gsum mam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du ro len du phyin pa la/ slobadapon gyisaro ma lon gyi bar du phyi mig blta ba dang / gtam smra ba dang / ngal bso (gsokab la sogasapyomabyed cig byasan mi lon no zhesabasgo ba la/ rosagatam rgyud de 'dra ba re re btang ste/ rgyal busadran pasam zin par / de snyan bya ba bag re tsam shor bas/ gsang dgos pa'i gnas mi gsang zer nas ro shor song zhing mthob / rosakyang sprul pa'i bya gnyis las brtsams shing bshad/ mthar ro na re/ skasagadangasabacu gsumagyi steng du bye'u bcu gsum bcu gsum/ bye'u re'i kha na'ang nasardog bcu gsum bcu gsumayod de/ de dag bsdoms na du 'ong zer ba'i grangs ma chod pa'i rin la slob dpon gyi rtsar sleb/ de nasanugregasum du ro langs la gser bsgrubs te/ /ro gser du song nasad dung rgya gar na yod par byed/ gong gi gtam brgyud de kun paṇḍi—526—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so//ta cig la'ang yam me thos/khong gser le bcu gsum mam//nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byed cing gda' zhus pas/jo bo'i zhal nas/lo tsā ba 'dis ci yang gsan cing thos//rgyal bus slob dpon gyis brlabs pa'i gsung ma mnyan pas ro shor ba'i gtam de 'di kun du'ang khyer la kha dam du gyis/gsang ba gal che/khu de ltar na 'brom 'disagang dang gang du skye ba bzhes kyang chos la skur ba mi 'debs shing /gang mos de la 'dun pa dang chos dge ba bcu'i sgo nasanyin mtshan phyed par 'bad pa dang /dus gsum gyi dge ba sems can rnams kyi don du bsngo ba dang / rtag tu yan lag bdun pa dang mi bral ba dang /ngag gi nyes pa shes shing sems kyi skyon dang bral bar byasate/de ltar na/chos la skur ba mi 'debs shing //gang mos de la 'dun pa dang //zhes bya ba nas bzung ste/mang po'i nang du ngag la brtag/gcig pur 'dug na sems la brtag /ces bya ba'i bar las brtsams te/'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnasakyis skyesarabasabastan pa rnams khu la legs par rdzogs par byas pa las rgyal po skyabs na du ji ltar skye ba bzhes pa'i le'u ste skyes rabs nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de dgagis bu chosanyi shu rtsa gnyis po las khu'i chos gnyis pa thal lo// // dge'o//'bul mo che dang lung bstan sogasathor bu rnams dpa' gling par ma 'dir mi snang ngo //ra25'busardzochedang lung brton sogasathor burnamasabazhugasaso///ka85na4rgoyer ba lha ri snying bo'i mgul du/bla ma la 'bul mo che mdzad pa las 'phros nasam 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'i le'ulte/pha chosakyi le'u gcig yin no//bsam gyis mi khyab lhun po mchog/gang gis bstod pa rab mdzesapa//bsam gyisami khyab lha rnams kyis//de ring mchod pa rgyal gyur cig/gza' dang nyi ma rgyu skar tshogs//bkra shisalhun gyis grub pa'i rtse//yar ngo dkar bo'i lha rnams kyis//rab tu gsal zhing mdzes pa'i dus//dad pa'i nagasatshal rgyas pa yi//gnyen dang yon bdag bsam mi khyab//rang rang 'byor ba du ma khyer//dusal 'doms par zhing der 'dus//thamasacad nyamasadaga'i dgar gar rtse//'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shisayin//snyigasama'i gdul bya ma rungasapa//'dul ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen//de yi zhabasakyi padmo la//dam pa mchog na'ang 'dud byed pa//bstan pa'i ka chen shākya dbang //'phags pa'i nor gyisaphyug par 'khod//bde legs kun gyi rgya mtsho mchogakhresarab mkha' dang kha dog gcig/rnam dag gusapa'i tshul bzung nas//rgyal ba'i drung na 'khod par gyur//dbang 'byor dpal gyis mkhas pa mchog/brtson pa'i rdo rje dpa' bo yin//dam pa'i don la 'grusapa gang //g.yung drung chosakyi rgyal po zhes//rgyal ba'i drung na 'bod de bzang //yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu na'ang / /nag po'i tshogasarnams rab skrag pa//tshul khrimasame tog rgyasapa la//skal ldan bung

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba'i tshogs rnams rgyal/ /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i drung na 'khod/ /rang gis sprul pa'i khye'u yang / /stobs chen rdzu 'phrul lag bde 'khyug /kun la sleb par bde bar mchis/ /dkar po'i gos kyis rab spras te/ /rab tu dkar ba'i sems dpa' mchog /skra ni sil bu bye brag phyed/ /mig ni thabs shes dwangs par gyur/ /rna ba kun gyi yul can de/ /sna ni dri med bzang por spyod/ /bde gshegs ljags kyis skyed pa'i lce/ /ros stod ro smad chags mi mnga'/ /lus kyang du ma'i bkod pa can/ /yid ni kun gyi yul can yin/ /'brom rigasalha yisarab btags pa/ /'dus byas skad la rje'u rigs yin/ /de 'dra'i skyes mchog dam pa yis/ /lha ri'i mgul du rgyal ba yi/ /rdo rje'i gdan khri legs bshams te/ /lha yi snang bar lha rnams kyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gdan khri bshams / / lha yi gos kyis brgyan par byas/ /mi yi snang bar mi yul gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gdan bshams te/ /mi yi gos mchog bde bar gsol/ /lha dang mi yi mchod rdzas rnams/ /lhun po'i phyogs bzhin gling ltar bkod/ /nam mkha' 'ja' yi gur gyisaphub/ /phyogs rnamasa'od kyi yol bsabres/ /sagazhi me tog sil mas bkram/ /sngar med dri yi phyogs mthar rgyas/ /de bzhin sgra yis yid dbang 'dzin/ khye'u chung gzhon nu dpag med rnams/ /ya mtshan me tog len cing rtse/ /mi mjed zhing khams dag par gyur/ /'jig rten dag pa'i bkra shis yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bkra shis dbus/ /tshogs gnyisardzosapa'i gzhel yasan/ /bsam gyisami khyab gral du bkod/ /sprul ba du ma lag bde byed/ /mgon po rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang / /lha bzhi'i dbu rgyan 'di gyon no/ /ji srid jo bo chen po'i sku/ /dpral bar thub pa gser mdog can/ shar na mgon po spyan ras gzigs / / nub na lha mo sgrol ma mchog /byang na bcom ldan mi g.yo ba/ /dar dkar sham bu skyer khas bcings / / g.yang lugs bde ba'i cha lugs su/ /glog ltar 'od gsal rab tu 'khyug /nor gyi lhun po dbusasu sbungs/ /mi chos lta bu'i sprul ba rnams/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis nor thogs nas/ /gus pa'i tshul gyisachagasamed gtong / /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i rgyan chas spras/ /lha chos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yin/ /mi chos rgyal ba'i sbyin bdag yin/ /thams cad yid smon mdzub rtse 'dzugs/ /sngon la spyan gzigs bsam mi khyab/ /cesapa ste/de ni tshogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis dge ba'i tshoms te dang bo'o/ /de nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bul ba btang ba ni/ khye'u dkar po zur phud can cig la gser srang bco brgyad bskur/ khye'u ser po zur phud can cig gis rta cig khrid de/ des sna drangs / gzhan yang nyi shus rta nyi shu khrid de/ rta nyi shu rtsa gcig phul/ yang khye'u sngon po zur phud can cig gis 'bri gcig khrid de/ gzhan bcus 'bri bcu khrid nas 'bri bcu gcig phul/ yang khye'u ser po zhig gis ber —528—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /zhig khyer/ gzhan zhig gis ber zhig khyer te/ ber gnyis phul/ rang gis sprul ba'i khye'u des/ g.yi lpags gnyis dang / spyang lpags gnyis/ de nas gzhan 'ga' zhig gis khrab bzhi/ khye'u zur phud can dkar po zhig gis dngul da/kar kyi skyogs gnyis khyer/ bu mo sngo ljang zhig gis gla gor gyi sder ma zhig khyer te/ de dag ni sna 'dren pa brgyad do/ /de la sogs pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i 'bul ba brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad nas/bshes gnyen pa dar dkar gyi ral dgu zhig gsol te/ da ci nas kye khye'u bzhi dang / rang gis sprul ba'i khye'u dang lngas bskor te/ skya btsun gyi mgron bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i dbus su/ bla ma la phyag dgu phrugs su mdzad nas / gsung gleng ba'i tshig ni 'di lta ste/ /legs bshad 'od kyis rab mdzes pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs pa/ tags ldan thams cad 'di gsan 'tshal/ /'brel chags lhag chad med pa yi/ /skabs don snyan du legs par sprad/ /lo 'dod ma yin legs par gsal/ /kang dag yi rang skyes shing bde/ /de 'dra de yang bdag bzhin gyur/ /phan bde'i bde 'bras kun mdzad pa'i/ /nyin dang mtshan du 'gro ba'i dpal/ /thugs rjes kun la snyoms pa rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum du bla na gnyan/ /rin chen gsum dang dbyer med pa/ /bsam gyi mi khyab rgyal ba'i sku/ /dus gsum dge ba seng ge'i sgra/ /mdzad pa dbyer med zag med thugs/ /dkon mchog gsum ldan rgyal ba yis/ /de ring kun gyi spyi gtsug brgyan/ /bstan pa'i ka ba rin chen gyis/ /rin chen tshogs pa'i yar gung mnan/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mched gsum gyis/ /tshogs pa dge ba'i gzhung chen bsrang / / kun mkhyen sprul ba lte mig can/ /'phrul can rnams kyis zur mdzes pa/ /brgya phrag du mas gus pa'i tshul/ /dam pa'i zhabs pad spyi bor len/ /de dag dge ba'i las tshogs pas/ /chos skyong rnams kyang thams cad bsrung / /nag po'i phyogs rnams byer te tshogs/ /tshogs pa dpal gyi rgya mtshor bzang / /'di 'dra'i dbus su lo rgyus 'byung / /de la rnam pa gnyis su byed/ /'khor ba'i chos la spyod na yang / /ngo tsha khrel yod gos can de/ /ya rabs dam pa mchod pas dge /ma rabs snying rjes skyong bas rje/ /kun gyis bkur bas ya rabs nyid / / de ni lo rgyus dang po ste/ /mi chos kun la cha tsam bshad/ /da ni lhag pa'i lo rgyusa'abyung / /mi lus rin chen khrims kyis brgyan/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gong 'phel ba'i/ /skyes bu 'gro ba'i don gnyer rnams/ /dus gsum rgyal bas rjes su bzung / /ding sang bstan pa rin chen 'dir/ /rgyal ba stong gis rab tu skyabs/ /mi mjed gnas 'dir lhag brtse ba/ ākya'i rgyal gyis rab tubazung / /bde gshegs de yi srol 'dzin pa/ /dgra bcom chos kyi ming can rnams/ /lo paṇa thams cad bzung byas nas/ /'di 'dra'i gnas kyang dbus su mdzad//bka' drin chen po'i lo rgyus te/ /de ni spyi tsam brjod pa yin/ /lhag par nga yi bka' brgyud 'di/ /thub pa —529—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byams pa thogasamed dpal/ /dbyig gnyen grol sde rnam gnyisadang / /mchog sde dul sde gragasapa'i dpal/ /seng bzang ku su lu zhes pa/ /bla ma gnyisakyisathugasakyisabazung / khyad par bla ma gser gling ba/ /'gro ba'i mig gcig dam pa des/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa bod la byin/ /gzhan yang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /ti lo nā ro ḍom bī ba/ /bla ma bzhi yis thugasarjesabazung / /rgyal ba'i mar me bod du bltams/ /gzhan yang 'jam dbyangasaklu sgrub dang / /zla gragasarig pa'i khu byug dang / /bdag gi bka' brgyud byin gyis brlabs/ /gnyis su med pa'i bla ma mchog /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rin po che/ /bstan pa'i sgron me bdag gis pha/ /byin gyis brlabasanas bdag la gnang / /bka' drin che'o drin chen gsum/ /rgyal ba lta bu'i bla ma bzang / /brgya dang lnga cu'i yon tan rnams / / ding sang rgyal ba gnyis pa rje/ /bum pa bzang 'dra'i nang na gda'/ /da ni klu dbang rgyal po nga / /bu ma 'di dang mi 'bral bar/ /rtagatu bstan pasagazhan don 'phel/ /de nasagangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /a ti sha nyid drin du mchog /de ni lo rgyusaganyis pa yin/ /de dang rjes su mthun par yang / /cung zad 'brel ba'i bla ma dang //lusaskyesagaso ba'i pha ma gnyis/ 8na tu nye bar bka' drin che/ /de ring dpal la sogs pa rnams/ /zhing dang dpang bor bka' drin che/ /de dag dril bsalo rgyusayin/ /mdor na 'dir tshogasam lusapa/ /tshul khrimasazhing sagacig nyid la/ /dkar po dge ba'i sabon thebs/ /rkyen bzang smon lam mtshamasakyisasbyar/ /gong ma dam tshig dpalagyisasbrel/ /mnyam pa mtshungasapa'i grogasakyisasbrel/ /'og ma'ang lasa'aphro smon lam yi na/ /'brel zab chu bo chen po'i gzhung / /stobasachen bdud kyisakhegasami 'gyur/ /tshogasapa lo rgyusa'abrelab brten / / da ni nyid 'brel skabasadon 'chad/ /de ni gtan gyi 'dun ma yin/ /byang chusachen po la sogasapa/ /lha dang lha mosalung bstan nas/ /gnasa'adir 'gro ba'i dpal gyur ba/ /ji srid mjal nasading sang bar/ /nyin dang mtshan du gleng na yang / /tha malatshig gisacig ma gos/ /yer ba'i gnas dang gnas mchog 'dir/ /zag med dam mosachu yisabarlan/ bdag lta'i ri bo rtsad bcad nas/ /bdag 'dra'i skye bo gzung drin du/ /de ring ci 'byor mchod byasanas/ /thams cad 'dusapa rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /rnam dag thugasabartse mthun rnams la//tshigs su bcad de rab dge ba'i/ /snyan pa'i gleng mo cung zad 'bul/ /da ni skabasasu bab pa yi/ /bde 'brasarin chen bang mdzod du/ /yan lag brgya rtsabargyad gyur pa'i/ /gusapa'i mchod rdzasarnam dag 'di/ /legs par phul te snyan gsol ba/ /lusastong bye ba dpag med sprul/ /gdul bya'i blo dang 'tsham bkod pa/ /bla ma'i thugasadagongasardzogasaslad du/ /phul bsa'akhor ba stong gyur cig /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos/ /gdul bya'i blo ngor gang 'tsham par/ /bkod nas rab tu bsgragasagyur pa/ /rgyalaba'i thugs dgongasardzogs slad du/ /phul —530—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bas 'khor ba stong par shog /nyin dang mtshan du dge bcus brgyan/ /gdul bya'i blo ngor legs bkod nas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs rdzogs slad du/ /phul bas 'khor ba stong gyur cig /sgrub pa'i mchod pas nyin mtshan 'das / / dri med mnyes slad dga' ldan 'gro /lus ngag dge ba 'bad byas nas/ /thams cad mtho ris lam bkod pas/ /dri med mnyes phyir dga' ldan 'gro /zho dgu gser gyi tshad du byas/ /dgu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig yang / / nyis ldab nyid du phyag tu phul/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba dgu sel ba'i/ /gsum gsum rang rang nyid du shog/phye na brgya dang drug cu gnyis/ /bsdus na gser srang bco brgyad do/ /legs par bsdus dang rab dbye dang / /nyon mongs drungs 'byin rin chen spel/ /gcig gcig nyid las gsum gsum spel/ /spang blang grangs ldan gnyan rgyal ba'i/ /'bul bkod khyad 'phags klu dbang lugs/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pas dpyad na mtshar/ /rta mchog rin chen nyi shu gcig /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i rten 'brel 'bul/ /nyi shu kha longs ci gsog cing / /chagasathogs med par gzhan don du/ /'jig rten kun tu bgrod par shog /'dod 'jo'i ba ltar 'bri gcang ba/ /bcu gcig phul bas 'dod 'jo la/ /bde ba'i nor 'jo bcur longs nas/ /bcu gcig dbang 'byor gzhan 'dren shog / stan yangs rab mthug khur med pa/ /thabs dang shes rab ber gyon pa'i/ /go cha'i dpa' bo nyid gyur te/ /bsgral dka' mang po sgrol gyur cig /mi mngon dpa' bo g.yi 'dra ba/ /dpa' bo'i gos gyon 'dren dka' rnams/ /'dren zhing spyang ki'i gos lpags can/ /dpa' la rig stan 'jam sha can/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dus 'doms te/ /ma rungs sgrol ba'i gtan tshigs yin/ /dmag dpon lta bur go cha can/ /thabs shes khrab kyis btsan sa bzung / /phyogs bzhir brtan zhing rgyas par 'tshal/ /byams dang snying rje 'od gsal ba'i/ /rin chen dngul gyi 'dren skyogs kyis/ /'gro la snyoms par bdud rtsis 'dren/ /phyogs ris med par skyong ba'i rtags / / bla med bla ma mkhas drung du/ /bla gor brtan yangs phun tshogs pa/ /sde snod gsum brtan yangs pa yi / / chos la rtag tu spyod par 'tshal/ /na bza' rab mdzes khrims kyi gos/ khrel yod ske rags phun tshogs sdom / / rab tu brtan pa rdo rje'i gdan/ /ngan 'gro'i sa skyob rin chen lham/ /'di dag zang zing sdud pa yin/ /gzhan yang gdugs lnga ba dan lnga/ /phye phur lnga dang rnga yab brgyad/ /bsil zer rtag tu bde ba'i gnas/ /dung gnyis dril bu bzhi dang ni/ /'bru sna lnga dang mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dpag med maṇḍal bkod pa rnams/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yin/ /legs par bsdus na brgya rtsa brgyad/ /grangs la dga' ba'i snang ngor phul/ /chags med dge ba 'ba' zhig gis/ /'gro ba'i don g.yin ma gtogs pa/ /re ltos ci yang ma mchis pas/ /thugasadagongs rdzogs phyir phul bzhes ngoms/ /gzhan/ yang rgyud nas bshad pa yi/ /mi mngon 'bul ba'ang du ma —53/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mchis / / mngon la gtor ma cig mchis pas/ /bstan pa'i gnyer gtad mdzad pa dang / /bdag cag rjes 'brangs thams cad kyi/ /tshe dang bsod nams bkra shis dang / /dpal 'byor gong nas gong 'phel zhing / /bar chod thams cad mi 'byung bar/ /gnyer gtad pa ni mdzad du gsol/ /de las gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ /bsngo ba smon lam kun dge ba/ /mchog gi rgyas 'debs brtan pa dang / /gnas lugs zab mo ston pa'i mdo/ /chos dbyings ngang du gsung du gsol/ /ring por mi thogs dga' ldan du/ /'di bas khyad 'phags chos bcu la/ /gdul bya thams cad der drangs nas/ /bzang po'i las la 'tshogs par bgyi/ /zhes phyag dang bcas nas drung du 'khod pa dang / jo bo'i zhal nas/ gang gi lan du dus 'doms pa'i/ /lan dang ldan na dam par gsungs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin dpung nas/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las phun tshogs pa'i/ /dkon mchog rin chen skyabs 'og nas/ /ka ba bgres pas dbu mdzad de/ /mkhas pa kun gyis gzhud bsrang ba'i/ /mtha' na gusaldan sbyin bdag dang / /zur zur bzo ris 'phrul gyis spras/ /sprul ba'i khye'u du ma dang / /bsam mi khyab par 'khod pa la / / shin tu mang na la la'i blo/ /'khrug cing shin tu bsdus gyur na/ /ka ba la sogs mkhas pa rnams/ /thugs mi ches mod 'on kyang yang / /'brom bzhin skye bos go bar gleng / /sngon gyi bde gshegs bla ma yi/ /drin lan chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ /'gro ba yongs la mgon che zhing / khyad par bdag cag rjes bzung ba'i/ /ding sang gnas 'dir khyed rnams 'dus/ /de yang chos dang dam tshig dang / /las dang smon lam mchog gis sbrel/ /dge ba'i las la rgya mtshor tshogs/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas nyid gnyer ba/ /'dun ma mchog la tshogs pas bzang / /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i rjes 'brang rnams/ /chos kyi chu bo rgyun chad med/ /bsdus na brgyud pa gsum ldan yin/ /kun gyis kho bo byin brlabs nas/ /bod la'ang phan thog drin du mchis/ /gang la brten pa'i lo rgyus yin/ /de yis skabs don gang 'brel na/ /bka' drin che ba'ang skabs don yin/ /'brel ba shes pa'ang skabs don yin/ /bkra shis tshogs shes skabs don che/ /des na gtan gyi 'dun ma yi/ /shes na chos la spyod pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas spyi rdzas 'dis/ /brgya dang drug cu'i gser zho yis/ /tha ma mdzes pa'i snod kyis bsdus/ /mthar yang 'gro ba gzhan don du/ /bla mas bskor te byin pa yi/ /zho sha sde snod gsum la spyod/ /dang por gser srang tshad las 'das/ /tshad med bzhi la spyod par 'tshal/ /bsam gtan sa dgu'i rnam pa can/ /legs bshad gsum gyis rim bzhin phye/ /sa lam phun tshogs bgrod par 'tshal/ /rdzu 'phrul bdun la bdun bskor te/ /slar bdun rdzu 'phrul 'khor gyis bskor/ /mkha' khyab gzhan don spyod par 'tshal//gcig bcu 'dod 'jo'i 'bri phul bas/ /sa bcu brnyes nas rgyal bar 'tshal/ /sprul ba'i khye'us 'bul —532—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /byed pa/ /ma 'ongs thu bo gsum dang gcig /nga yi rnam srol 'jin pa 'tshal/ /gzhan yang dbu la lha lnga ste/ /lha bzhi rtag tu bsten par 'tshal/ /sprul ba du ma 'gyed pa ni/ /phyogs bcur du ma 'gyed na yang / /shar nub rgyu 'dis ma 'ongs nges/ /ma 'ongs shar nub rgyu bar byed/ /bshad na blo yis bgrang mi nus/ /dga' ldan gnas su lha yis mchod/ /mi yi snang ngor de tsam yin/ /da ni dge rtsa bsngo bar bgyi/ /mdang gsum rmi lam rmi ba'i tshe//gser rta 'bri dang ber gos dang / /g.yi spyang khrab dang skyogs sder sogs/ /gzhan yang mchod rdzas dpag med rnams / / lhun por spungs te nga mchod bzhin/ /bden par ma 'dzin dag snang la/ /dus gsum bde gshegs bla ma rnams/ /mkha' la me tog dpag med steng / /'gro la skyabs spyin/ phyag rgya yis/ /dge ba thams cad bsdus byas nas/ /'di na'ang gang yod bsngo mdzad cing / /dpang po'i tshul gyis bzhugs par mdzod/ /de la skyabs 'gro nges mdzod la/ /'gro kun byang chub sems su bskyed/ /da ni bdag gi rjes 'brang gis/ /mgrin pa gcig tu rjes zlos mdzod/ /mkhyen brtse dpag med ma lus pa/ /dpang po dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las/ /mthun pa'i dge ba rten 'brel rnams/ /dus gsum bsdoms nas gong nas gong / /mthar thug theg ba'i mchog tu bsngo/ /gnas skabs 'di bzhin longs spyod rnams/ /gzhan don chos la spyod par shog /phar phyin drug rnams yongs rdzogs te/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod par shog /smon lam gang btab 'grub pa yi/ /nor bu rin chen las byed shog /ces ga/sungs te/ de dag ni 'bul ba'i tshoms so/ /de nas jo bo la sogs pa thams cad thugs mthun pa/ra bshes gnyen pa nyid kyis/ /sngon yang mjang pa de 'dra ba mdzad nas mang po las 'brel la bkod/ ma/ 'engs pa na'ang smon lam btab byas pa mang po zhig mchis na / dus 'di nas bzung nas khyed kyi rjes 'dir ci 'dra ba'i chos grwa dang gang zag khyad par can ji lta bu mchis/grangs nges pa can sngar nas kyang mdzad na'ang da dung yang tho re ba cig gsung bar zhu/ zhes thams cad phyogs gcig tu nges pa la/ lhag par du ka ba chen po bzhengs nas cis kyang phyi rabs kyi gdul bya la dgongs nas gsung bar zhu gsung / bshes gnyen pas rngog la gzigs pa dang / rngeg 'di skad du/ rgyal ba'i spyan gyis gzigs pa ni/ /'jig rten na ni srid pa tsam/ /de ni rang gis mthong la dgongs/ /rgyal ba dus drug phyogs bcur gzigs/ /phan tshun gleng bslangs skal bar bzang / /nges par ma 'ongs bstan du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa dang / de nas bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'das pa'i rjes gcod pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sdun bsu ba bya ba byis pa nged 'dra ba'i rnam 'phrul ma yin/ 'on kyang sngar gyi la the tshom byung na thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung yin pas bya rgyu med/ sngar gyi kun bshad na/ 'das pa'i byung tshul la the tshom skye ba dang / gang zag nged 'dra ba la tshad —533—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/jo bo' gsung chos kyi skor/mar mi 'dzin pas bshad par yang dka'/nd+ra ma 'ongs pa 'di 3na/khong bkaX gdamasapa'i ༷sa po 'brom de ༅ de sprad zer te/khong yang dga' tshad yan rdod na bogaphyas dgon pa 'dar/gang zag 'ad rnamasakhozlo zer ba bzhan du byung nasa'adug zer ba'ang 'ong srad gsungs nas/jo bo laphyag gsum mdzad ṭwāṃs/tshad ma' skyesabu bdaX ༷ dgongs//ma 'ongs 'byung tshul cung zad bshad//sngaralungabastanapabasprad 'bye///kun la grags pa' mang mā 'ga'//dgon sder dkusate bsnyad par bya//lhag ༷ra gyur na 'ang byed //༷ par gyur na kha ḍiskangasal//legardzu nyes byung na zur gsosate'i//nyesapar ma 'gyur sdung po /tshod//nga ya cho1grwa rwa sgreng na//rgyal ba khyed 'ikyasagasal bar bstana'i//da na zlos la dgosam ma //'ast+ri na spyan rasagagaX dbang dang //'jam pa' dbyangardzund+rang gsaX ba' bdag/ga༈ yang 'jam dābyangasduto sprulab//sprul ba' khye'u gzugs mdzesapo//rtse lnga' ra lasa'adar lhags gda'//dang po gsum na nga ya ṭwāṃs//puktob dang phu wo ba/'a/sbyan snga zhes bya sku mne gsum//spus gsung 'phro la/khus/sa skaXsa'ar nged 'dar tshogs pa kun gyas mgo byas/jo bo dang thun mong ba' slob ma bzang po du ma rnams gā dgon sde yang smosadagosamod/de kun 'ong ba la lo kha sdur yod sduod/gzhan yang a mesabyang chub/rgyal gya ka ba/zlogan dge ba / rnal 'i'abyor ba 'igasdunagasum/'arsharnamasakyamatshan ma smosan/da gzod sngi co 'ong /khyed 'izhabasala'adud pa' dam pa na dadī snang mang po 'ig ༷dug 'go/da'i gzod dgon pa rwa sgrong rtsab/ dus sunged sazha che che stan ma gtogs pa/mang po braḍi khang ga gzha 'dangs shāX /'inged kun la lung bstan med de/spyaswā bu bya yasazer ba 'ong nyen yod/nga kun rag pa sngon la gtoo ba' ma rdzun gsungasapas//bshesagasan pa' ༷la nas/smra ta ma mang/chos 'brel yod ṣka bgrangs na/da gzod mang 'dzin mkhan susabyed/nga' rjesa'ad tso tu khyed 'dra ba'i blo lkobs can ngang ring po 'ong ba min/nam 'chi cha med/de tsam pa'i tshig tshogasache ba mi zin zer nasdu//spre'u shig sngi ṭwāṃ bzhin du mang tsa na bsumasanas sgom thun re tsam bsgoom du 'gro//de las blo che ba rnams kyas che rags gā nga re tsam 'dzin/gsung sgros ragaswārags tsam 'dzina'i//gsung sgrosporagasaragasare i snror ba 'ong ba yan/ga༈ yang 'gro rkyen byung nd+ra khang shang kaur nasache tso kha drag 'ong ste/shagasasu/aḍi tsi phyan pas goom/saX med zer nasa'agro tsoo duosardzo cag 'ong /dgeske gesapa marngoo suomadu yod badron du lung bstan nasaca bgya/ga/na yang da gzad chasapa bzang yang smasaXn mchag pa' dgan pa ku/ 'dar lung bstan na/la la de 'dra ba ga ga na yod de a zer nas/lung bstan gya mthong rgya bsadaṣkasbyor gya sna 'drogang rang la dbusan bzhugasapa 'di tsam zhig yod/gtsang na 'di tsam zhig yod/man ngag pa 'di 4

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /tsam yod/ 'phyi mo na phar la dgon pa chen po 'di tsam zhig 'ong bya ba'i tig ge ba cig yod kyis gzhan grwa tshogs brgyad khri tsam zhig gi chags pa med par gcig nas gcig tu 'pho ba'i gnas mal la dgun gcig pu sdod pa'i gnas mal kyang bgrang gis ga na lang / des na 'brog pa skyas bteg pa 'dra ba thor re long nge ba zhig 'chad / 'ubs te dril na/ jo bo dang thun mong ba mjug nga la brten pa rnams bshad mi dgos/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mdzad pa'i bzang po 'ga' re 'ong ste/ de ba'ang bshad mi 'tshal/ gong bzhin du rigs gsum gyi sku'i ngo bor gyur ba/ dge slong byang chub sems dpa'i rigs skyed pa de yang thams cad thams cad la mkhas mod kyis/'on kyang gcig ni/ kho bo'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu 'byed/ de'i brgyud pa la'ang / bka' gdams gzhung par grags nas gzhung ba'i chos grwa rgya mtsho lta bu dbus gtsang gnyis su lnga'am drug la nye ba 'ong / dbus su gzhung gsum par grags te/ de dag gi ma lag ni/ lung ba'i sul/ ri'i skyibs/ spang ljongs/ ne'u gsing gi 'gram / nags span spun gyi gseb/ /nags tshal mthug po'i gseb/ 'gram/ brag skyibs/ gad skyibs/ e ma dge sbyor byed pa'i gnas mal/ rang don mi byed par dben par gnas pa'i sa/ 'dul ba dang mthun par grogs po bzang po ha cang mi mang / ha cang mi nyung ba/ nyung shos dpon g.yog gnyis gnyis nas bzung ste/ bzhi sde / lnga sde/ brgya/ bcu/ nyi shu tsam/ bzhi cu/ lnga cu man chod rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten bzhin du dkar po sib sib tu 'byung / de dag phal che ba'ang / thub pa'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gnas brtan chen po dag gi sprul ba 'ba' zhig 'ong ste/ de dag sbas pa 'ba' zhig yin pas kho bos mi slong / gzhan yang la la lung bstan na/ khyed 'di na tshogs pa rnams kyis snyan du skyal nas rlom sems phra mo skye srid/ gzhan yang lung bstan pa yin zer nas/ skye bo mang bos bkur bkur sti sti skad byas nas/ mjug rnam g.yeng gi dpon por song srid/ dbus gtsang du bzang bzang por grags pa can 'ga' zhig jo bos dga' ldan du sgrogs pas 'dir lung bstan yang mi 'tshal/ gtsang du'ang kho bo'i dgon pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong las gras pa dang /ri stod kyi 'od zer las gras pa dang / rtsed par yang btags te gsumatsam mo/ /cig la yang gong bzhin du bzang po nyung ngu na 'ga' re ba'i dgon pa dang / bzang po mang po phyogs bzhir mchod pa dang bcas pa'ang 'ong ste / de dag kyang gong dang 'dra/ gzhan yang mnga' ris mdo khams bal yul la sogs par yang tho re ba cig 'byung ste/ dga' ldan du mi gshegs pa'i dam pa mang po zhig ni kha cher 'gro/ la las ni 'dul grwa bzang la mang bar 'dzugs/ la las ni bka' gdams su khas mi len par don bka' gdams su mdzad de/ de dag ni gzhud ba'i rnam grangs yin gsungs pas/ jo bo spyan hrig hrig mdzad cing / a ti a ti pha la pha la/ khye'u so —535

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ma kun gzhung ma de su yin gsungs pas/ khye'u ser po zur phud can snga ma de langs nas byung ste/ rje btsun pa 'dir las 'brel 'jog tu mchis pa las/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung lam kho bos bshag zer bas/ gsung las pha la pha la/ bod na mig 'phrul lta bu 'dug gsungs pas/ bshes gnyen pa mnyes la nyung chags pa cig mdzad nas / 'dis nga'i bstan pa rin chen gsal bar gyur cig gsal ba khyod kyis shar gsal nas/ /nub kyi phyogs su'ang gsal ba ni/ /lus skyed pa yi pha ma dang / /sems bskyed pa yi bla ma dag /mtshungs par ldan pa nub phyogs su/ /smon lam dbang gis tshul khrims dag /rgyal las lhag par dga' ldan 'gro/ /mi dang lhar bcas gsal ba yin/ /rje cig gis ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshad las lhag pa tsam du bstan na yang / de dag bsdus nas bcad bde bkol bde skyong bde ba'i chos su mdzad de/ rin po che'i tshom bu 'ba' zhig tu byed la de yang mi mngon zhing / chags pa med par sems can gyi don byed de/ man ngag gi bcud thams cad khong gis len pa'o/ /de yang sprul ba du mas 'gro ba'i don byed/ slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med par shugs la spel na'ang sbas pa'i tshul du mdzad do/ /yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ khye'u so ma kun man ngag thams cad kyi snying po len pa de su yin gsungs pas/ khye'u dkar po sngon ma de bzhengs nas byung ste/ 'brom la gzigs te che re 'dug pa na/'brom na re/ zhus shig gsung / khye'u na re/ shes bya ma lus pa la dpyad kyang 'bras bu snying po yin/ rje/ da lan las 'brel 'jog tu mchis pa lags/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu thams cad kho bos blang bar bya'o zer bas / gsung las a ti a ti pha la pha la/ bod na mig 'phrul lta bu 'dug gsungs pas/ yang bshesaganyen pa na re/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur ba'i rgyal mtshan thams cad 'dzin par gyur cig rje 'dis sprul ba du ma bkye nas 'gro ba'i don byed na yang / lhag par shar nub tu don byed de/ de yang / nub tu rgyal mtshan rab bsgreng zhing / /byang chub mchog ldan dben pa'i gnas/ /rtsibs stong sems dpa'i byang du gnas/ /bsam gtan bzang pos skye bo'i tshogs/ /mnyam pa nyid du bsdus byas nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum dkar po'i lam/ /shel gyi khye'u mkha' la gshegs/ /lha mi'i 'jig rten seng ge'i sgra/ /sgrogs shing slar yang mi yul du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis sprul zhing 'byon/ /rje/ yang cig gis ni/ man ngag bdud rtsi'i thigs par bsags nas phan bde'i rgya mtsho bskyil te/ skye bo nyon mongs pa'i sna du ma dang ldan pa la phan pa'i sna du ma ster zhing / nga'i gdams ngan dam pa mchog tu rgyas par byed/ dbus kyis 'di na'ang / bya dang bra khra la sogs pa dgon sde phun sum tshogs par spel te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar ba la 'god cing / thabs kyis nang gi cha la mos pa rnams nang gi cha la 'god/ thun mong bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa'ang rang rang dang 'tsham par 536—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'god la/ mdor na gdams pa'i gter mdzod dam pa yin te/ mkhas pa'i mchog tu phyin pas/ bstan bcos du ma yang gzhan la ston par mdzad de/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ sems nam mkha' ltar rnam par dag par gyur nas kho bo'i drung du yun du bstan pas spyan snga ba zhes grags pa 'byung / des ni dbus 'dir sprul ba du mas 'gro ba'i don ma/ring nge/ nub kyi phyogs su yang snyigs ma'i gdul bya stobs kyis 'dul gsungs pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ yang khye'u zhig man ngag gi gter sku dzod dam pa 'di su yin/ khye'u sngon po de langs nas byung nas/ rje/ de ring las kyi 'brel pa 'jog tu ma/chis lags/ nam mkha' sngon po dang 'dra ba'i khye'u kho bo 'gro ba ma lus pa la khyab mod/ khyad par du gdul dka' ba'i gdul bya 'dul ba la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho las gdams pa'i thigs pa bsags te/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po nam ma/kha' dang mnyam par bskyil bar byed la/ de la sems can du ma 'thung du 'jug go /ring po ma lon par chos grwa du ma/ 'byung / thams cad kyang chul khrims dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig go /kye/ chul khrims 'od 'bar bas bla ma mnyes par gyur cig zer bas / bshes gten pa na re/ yang de bzhin du gyur cig gsung / jo bo'i zhal nas kyang / a ti a ti pha la pha la / bod na mig 'phruspru lta bu 'dug gsung / de nas bshes gnyen pa na re/ dbus 'dir de ltar byed par ma/ zad gtsang gi phyogs su'ang / mkha' la rtsibs stong rab mdzes pas/ /sa yi snod bcud zil mnan nas/ /grags pas 'jig rten mnyam par khyab/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /nam mkha' lta bur dag pa yis//nam mkha' lta bur dag par ston/ /stobs dang mkhyen rab phun tshogs pas/ /nga rgyal dregs nga/'i tshogs rnams 'dul / / mkhas pas 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya/ /lhag par gza' yi tshogs rab 'jom/sa/ /gza' thul lta bur ston na yang / /ma dag gza' yi nyes par smra/ /'jig rten zil gnon stobs chen la/ /nyes par gyur nga/ ga la mnga'/ /bskal ba sum cu lhag par ni/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab nyid mdzad de/ /nub tu gdul bya smin byas nas / / thams cad brtse bzhin dga' ldan 'gro/ /de nas dbu ru'i phug cig tu/ /mthu chen mkhas par rab tu grags / / zhes gsung ba dang /khu na re/ thams cad dus mnyam du 'ong ngam/ dus tha dad par 'ong ngam/ 'on te dus mnyam pa'ang du ma 'ong / da gzod gzhan gyi 'gal gyis mi dogs sam zhus pas/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ 'gal na'ang 'gal/mi 'gal na'ang mi 'gal/ dpon slob bcu bcu tsam la sprul ba po cig las med pa'ang 'ong / de dag la'ang la la'i tshe'i mgo la la'i mjug tsa na yang 'ong gsung bas/ jo bo'i zhal nas hu 'um/ khye'u dkar po 'di la da lta ngas bod 'di na'ang bkod pa drug cu rtsa lnga mthong / der khye'u ser po na re/ kho bo la bkod pa dgu cu mchis/—537—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/khye'u sngon po na re/ kho bo la'ang byang phyogs na brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga yod/ 'di na drug gi gdul bya las ma mchis / khye'u ser po ber 'bul ba de byung nas/ rgyal dang rgyal la 'dus pa yi/ /tshogs rab bzang po nga la gson / / skad cig bkod pa du ma'i lus/ khye'u'i gzugs can rin chen nga / /sngon tshe skye ba dpag med du/ /bag chags bzhag pa de ring yang / /yongs su gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung du 'ongs/ /rgyal bas byin brlabs 'brom rje zhes/ khyed kyis bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen ri yi rtse mo la/ /rin chen gsal ba'i drung mchog tu/ /nga yi bkod pa dpag med snang / /zhad rje rom po'i mi rigs cig /gtan gyi don gnyer gus pas mchi/ /'brom rje'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gsal ba khyed kyis byin brlabs nas/ /zhes zer zhing / skabs 'dir khye'u ser po snga ma'i phyag la 'jus nas/ dag pa'i snang ba rab shar ba/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing / /yon tan rgya mtshor grags pa yi/ /mkhas pa nga ni las can rnams/ /phyogasabazhir 'gro zhing 'dren na yang / /dbus 'dir shar ba pa zhes grags/ /'dir ni shar gyi mtha' 'khob 'dul/ /de nas nub phyogs mtha' 'khob tu/ /shar ba ci 'dra rtswa chu dang / lkeng dang grong pa dag gis dben/ /skye bo rgya chen zhag med cig /snum zhing skal bzang du ma sdud/ /grags dang yang grags rin chen gyi/ /grags pa'i mtha' bzang dpal du grags/ /blo gros shes rab can du gsol/ /gzhan yang grags pa'i mtshan rab can/ /mang bos 'gro ba'i bde skyid bskrun/ /zhes gsung / slar khye'u ser po sngon mas/ sngon tshe bde gshegs byang chub pa'i/ /gnas su kho bo dpa' ba yin/ /mu stegs ri dwags phal ba rnams/ /zil gnon mkhas pa'i mkhas par gyur/ /de tshe khye'u rin chen khyod/ /gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /tshe yi rigs 'dzin grags par gyur/ /lan cig bu mo sngo ljang 'di/ /bdag cag gnyis kyi drung du 'byung / /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa yab sras gnyis/ /ma 'ong mtha' 'khob gnas shed du/ /mkhas pa'i dbus su chos ston tshe/ /yab sras dam par yang yang 'gyur/ /de tshe'ang kho mos bskyang bar bgyi/ /ci ste khyod kyi rjes 'brang rnams/ /'jigs parubargyad las bskyab phyir ro/ /zhes mi snang bar gyur ces gsung / de nas bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ de kun la bar srabs kyi tshigs bcad bya bar la la ming 'dogs pa yin/ da ni skabs su bab pa mdor bstan nas rgyas nga/nga rechad do gsungs nas 'di skad du/ de nas rin gsal ba 'dis/ /brag gi skyibs shig bsten pa'i tshe/ /gzhud gi mkhan po yod ces grags/ /gnas de gzhung mkhan gdong zhes grags/ /de nas stag ma'i lung pa bstan/ /de tshe phyogs nas slob ma'i gzugs / / chos par rlom zhig der byung nas/ /chos nyan dgon pa blang zer nas/ /mkhyen mod thugs rjes ma chags byin/ /de yis dus ma chos bkod kyang / /la las gzhung la gnod par gyur/ /tshogs rab 'phel te —538—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /g.yeng bas khyer/ /slar yang brag skyibs der bzhugs tshe/ /dbus gtsang mtshams nas dam pa cig /bstan pa'i gzhung 'dzin spyan snga nas/ /gdams pa'i nying khu gnad cig zhu/ /mkhyen bzhin su yin dris gyur bas/ /gangs kyi kha brag 'ga' zhig tu/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma rtse gcig na'ang / /mkhas pa khyod thos lha yis bskul/ /sgom pa chung chung zhig yin no/ /drung nas lan du 'di skad gsung / /mi rtag gtan gyi bcan sa zung / /tshe 'dir snum zad mar me 'dra/ /bya ba skyungs la sngar bzhin sgoms/ khyed la bsgom gegs mi mnga' yang / /byung na kho bo mkhas pas bsal/ /slar yang lan du 'di skad zhu/ /sems can rang 'tsho'i sdug bsngal ba/ /dpag med thugs rjes bskyab slad du/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin bsgom par 'tshal/ /de nas phu chung zhig tu gshegs/ /nyin cig bla mas der byon tshe/ /sgom chung sha ba che chung la/ /chos gos 'gel zhing 'dug pa mthong / /nga rgyal bsal phyir mkha' la byon / / slar yang sgom chung drung byung ste/ /byung nas mkha' la ji ltar ldog /lan du kho bo mkha' las 'ongs/ /'gro yang mkha' yi dbyings su 'gro/ /chos gyi gnas lugs spros bral yin/ /mnyam nyid ngang du rtse gcig zhog/de nas sras kyi nang du byon/ /ri chung nor bu lta bu zhig /'dug pa'i rtse la thugs dam mdzad/ /de nas po to ba zhes 'byung / /gnas der dam pa dpag med 'du/ /rdo rje seng ge yon tan grags/ /gzhan yang du ma 'byung na yang / / dngos 'brel mang po bshad gyur na/ /skabs don thos par mi 'gyur bas/ /yon tan grags pas zab gzhung rnams/ /rdzogs par mdzad nas dar yul mdar/ /dag snang gang shar dgon pa bzhengs/ /de nas shar ba pa zhes grags/ /de la dar ma grags zhes pa/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba zhig /zab gzhung mang po thugs chud nas/ /gnas dag gang zag spel ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i dben gnas lho nub tu/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'byung tshul ni/ /mtha' 'khob bra ba rta ltar rgyug /skyi ser lhags pa me ltar tsha/ /gan na skye bo grong pas dben/ /bra ba gla ba sgo khyir 'khor/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid dus bzhi sa /mi rtag thun bzhir ston par 'gyur/ /dbyar ni rlan drod ri klung rnams/ /sngo zhing sbrang char zim bur 'bab/ /res 'ga' drag char chen po yis/ /sa rnams bangs shing thigs pa 'dzag /gang zag blo can de mthong nas/ /rang gi rgyud la dpe len to/ /dgun ni grang ngar shin tu skye/ /ston ni ser bu ser bur ldang / /dpyid ni khra khro rlung 'tshubs ldang / /gla ba gong mo la sogs pa/ /bya dang ri dwags mang pos gang / /rgyang ltas re rul bzhin du skyo/ /nang na gzhal yas btsun pas gang / /de 'dra'i chos grwa dam pa la/ /tha mal skye bo yid mi chags/ /dam pa rnams kyis bltas tsam na/ /shar gyi ri mchog dam pa ni / / mi g.yo glang chen rin chen tshul/ /theg pa brtan par g.yas phyogs phab/ /de bzhin nub kyi ri bo yang / /thegapa brtan par g.yon phyogs phab/ /gnyis ka thabs dang shes rab tshul/ /theg pa'i sne mo gang du 'phrod/ /—539—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chosakyi skor/thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i rtags/ /lung ba'i dbyibs ni rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /de yi gzhung la 'jug ngogs yod / / rgyal mtshan gyen la 'degs pa 'dra/ /tog la rin chen 'bar ba yod/ /bkra shis sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rtags / / mdun ri glang chen sga steng na/ /dung kha gye la slong ba yod/ /snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab pa'i rtags/ /de yi 'dabs na chu bo yod/ /bstan pa yun du ring ba'i rtags/ /rgyal mtshan stong la chos grwa 'ong / /chos rgyal dharma kirti yis/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin par byed/ /de nas zhang zhes mkhas pa mchog /ston pa gnyisapas 'gro ba 'dzin/ /chags pa mi mnga' blo mnga' ba/ /bla ma mchog gi rgyal sa skyong / /gdung ba mi mnga' mtshan ldan pa / / bshes gnyen mchog gis 'gro ba 'dzin/ /brtson ldan shākya'i sras po mchog khrims ldan mang po sdud par byed / / g.yeng med chos kyi rgyal po mchog /skyes bu gsum la rtag tu spyod/ /blo gros chen po mi pham pa/ /rgyal ba'i yum la 'jug par byed/ /dge bshes bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pa/ /ston pa mchog gis 'gro ba 'dzin/ /me zhes skyes bu dam pa mchog /sangs rgyas bstan pa rma med 'dzin/ /mdor na nga yi srol 'dzin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen bcu gcig lhag par 'ong / /de la'ang dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan/ khrims ldan brgya phrag lhag par 'ong / / skal ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba mo la/ /'o ma rtag tu 'jo ba bzhin/ /zhing der bla ma dkon mchog lha/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis 'od 'phros pas/ /'dod ldan rtag tu 'jo bar byed/ /de la'ang 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /dbusagatsang khams la sogs pa yis/ /zhing khams dag tu dgon sde 'byung / /mdor na bzhi sde yan chad de/ /dgon pa bre dang phul lu tsam/ /che ba rgya mtsho tsam yang rung / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa 'byung / /e ma/ /bdag gi gnas chen 'di la ni/ /ji srid bstan pa gnas kyi bar/ /bstan pa'i me ro ston par byed/ /'di ni ji ltar rgud gyur kyang / /re rul nyid du 'gro ba las/ /skye bo'i gnas khang ga la 'tshal/ /'di la'ang gzhan du zer cig 'byung / / sgom grwar ming btags thos pa bral/ /las med 'ga' zhig 'khrid par byed/ /'on kyang rang tshugasami 'chor bar/ /chags med bsod snyoms rgyu bar byed/ /dman cha blangs nas mtho sa 'dzin/ /de nas grwa tshogs du ma dang / bcas te yung ba'i nang du 'byon/ /de nas ri yi sgang zhig la/ /sprul ba'i khye'u du ma zhig /yul ba'i phyugs ma skyong zhing gda'/ /dharma kirtis 'di skad du/ /lung ba 'di la ji skad zer/ /'di la yung ba pa zhes grags / / de bzang nyon mongs nad 'joms yin/ /'di la sgos ming ji skad zer/ /lan du khra zhes bya bar grags / / de bzang shin tu dpa' bar mchi/ /sgos su phug 'di ci zhes smra/ /lan du khra yi phu zhes grags/ /de bzang rub la btsan par 'ong / /'o na sgang 'di ci zhig yin/ /lan du bung sgang bya ba yin/ /mnga' thang dgung dang mnyam par mchi/ /ri 'di ji skad bya ba yin/ /lan du phag ri thel zhes grags/ /grwa ba phag pas 'phel —540—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /bar 'ong / /thang 'di ji skad bya bar grags/ /mkhas rnams stong thang zer zhing gda'/ /grwa ba stong phrag yan chod mchi / / 'o na khyed rang su zhig yin/ /gtsang ma lha yis rab tu bkod/ /gtsang ma phun sum tshogs par mchi /de nang rdzing khang gda' ba'i sar/ /rten 'brel bzang zhes gzims khang rtsig /phyogs rnams spyil bu du mas bskor / / de nas thams cad chos spyod 'phel/ /de nas rim bzhin mkhas grub kyang / /bcu las chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la'ang bre dang phul lu tsam/ /dge 'dun bzhi sde yan chod de/ /gtsang ma phun sum tshogs pa 'byung / / bstan pa ji ltar rnying gyur kyang / /chos grwa de yang bkra shis te/ /yun ring bar du lha mi yi/ /mchod gnas dam pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de yang phar phyin drug ldan pa'i/ /chul khrims ldan pa phun tshogs te/ /dbang phyug chos kyi brgyan pa yin/ /pha dang de yi gdung 'dzin pa/ /rim bzhin bcu las lhag pa 'byung / /de nas dar gyi nang du 'byon/ /thang chen gser gyi maṇḍal 'dra/ /mdzes pa'i steng du chags phebs ste/ /phun tshogs sgatshogs bro 'debs tshe/ /byang ri shug par brgyan pa gzigs/ /ri yi dbyibs ni pad 'dab 'dra/ /de yi dbus na spang 'debs shig /ne le'i rkyal ba lta bur gda'/ /gnyis par dpyad na rnam thos sras/ /sgrub la dngos grub ster ba 'dra/ /gzhan yang g.ya' ri rgyal mtshan 'dra/ /ri brag gdugs ltar 'dra bar gda'/ /shar ri byang du bstan pa ni/ /bkra shis sna tshogs rtsi shing rgyas/ khyim bdag nor bu 'dzin pa 'dra/ /mda' dog phug yangs chu shing 'dzom/ /sa gtsang 'bru mod gzhan 'tshe med/ /dgon pa'i gnas su bzang mthong nas/ /byams pa cig la bzhugs pa na/ /grwa ba kun nas 'dir skad du/ /de ring thang 'di nyams dga' bas/ /dgos pa stabs kar thogs la thong / /dharma gīrti mnyes gyur nas/ /de bzhin mdzod la spyil bu brtsigs/ /de nas spang shing g.ya' mod pas/ ring por mi thogs brang khang rnams/ /chos dang mthun par bzhengs pas 'grub/ /der tshogs skyes bu dam pa ni/ /tshogs ni spyod pa'i rang rgyal bzhin/ /gtsang ma phun sum tshogs gyur na'ang / /byang chub spyod pa'i grogs kyis phyug /de ni snyigs mar gyur ba na'ang / /gtsang ma 'ba' zhig nyid gyur te/ /lha dang mi yis mchod 'gyur zhid / /tha mal chags med bas mtha' 'dra/ /dam pa dam pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /gzhan yang dge gong zhes par 'byon/ /dge gong de yang 'di skad du/ /ser po thang gi dkyil shed du/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i grwa tshogs rnams / / chos mthun chos grwa 'debs par 'gyur/ /de tshe klu yi rgyal po zhig /glang bu ltag skyed cig tu sprul/ /de ring dge 'dun thang gong 'dir/ /byon la sa phyogs dul bar gyis/ /skye bo kun la'ang phan par mdzad/ /de nas dharma gīrti'i gsung / /rab dges bstan pa'i thang gong 'dir/ /zhag 'ga' dge sbyor gnas shig 'cha'/ /der bzhugasachos kyang mang du gsung / /de tshe dge gong ba zhes grags/ /de 'dra'i skyes mchog dam pa yis/ /sangs —541 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rgyas bstan pa 'dzin par byed/ /slar yang stabs ka'i dgon pa der/ /po ta la yi lha tshogs kyis/ /spyan 'dren dga' ldan gnas su'ang 'gro /sprul ba de yang 'di na mchis/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / khye'u dkar po rting ma de langs nas byung ste/ bshes gnyen pas zhib po zhig kyang ma gsungs te/ de dag ni kho bo la nye/ da dung yang bshes gnyen pa de dag gi mtshan gsal ba cig mi mdzad dam zer bas/bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ ci zer/ bka' gdams gzhung pa la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mtshan can gyis chog mod/ yang shar ba pa'i sras/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa snying rje chen pos bdag gzhan brje ba mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / khyad par du theg pa chen po la blo sbyong ba bod kyi byang chub sems dpa'i yab cig gis yul mal gro'i nang du byon te 'chad pa chen po zhig gi steng du blo sbyong bsgom zhing 'di bzhin du bdag cag kyang mi rtag pa'i khang bu na yod de/ rang dbang ni med/ 'chi ba la ni 'tsher/ nyesapa ni rang gisanyes/ shi ba gcig pusani mi chog ngan song gsum gang du skyes kyang grogs med/ de bas na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag gis blang ngo / spyi'i sdug bsngal sgos kyis 'khur bar bya'o/ /de yang brdzun pa'i rnam pa yin pas bshags pa bya'o snyam du yun tu bzhugs te/ re zhig spyil bu cig mdzad nas bzhugs pas/ dge slong dang dge tshul gyi byang chub sems dpa' du ma 'dus te/ seng ldengs nags kyi ri bo la seng lding nagasakyi sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig drung du bsten pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhal nas/ khyed sngon bdag cag gi bla ma rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi bla ma se btsun bya ba cig yod/ de yin par 'dug de'i rigs su'ang gda'/da khyed rang yul klung shod kyi nang na spyil bu bya ba'i lung ba yod/ de lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul yin der song khyed la shākya'i gdung rigs 'dzin pa lha'i lha zhig nas bzung nas lnga las mi nyung ba 'byung / de dag ni thub pas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la nges par phan/ sems can du ma 'dren/ mthar yang dag pa'i gnas su 'gro ba 'byung / des der byon pa dang / nga'i rwa sgreng dang 'dra ba g.ya' yi 'od zer/nags kyi 'od zer/ spang gi 'od zer/ chu'i 'od zer/ thang gi 'od zer bkra shisapa/ lha bya lding ba'i mgul/lung sul du ma'i mdo'i steng / bya dang ri dwags bag phebs bar rgyu ba/ rkyen yang rwa sgreng dang 'dra bar phun sum tshogs / ya rabs du ma rab tu 'byung zhing / ma rabs rab tu 'byung ba dag bde bar byed/ de ni lha chen/ lha btsun / lha/ lha'i lha/ lha'i zhing phun sum tshogs par byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang gang zag phun sum tshogasapa gzhon nu zhes pa 'ga' zhig go /de las kyang dgon bu bre tsam phu lu tsam/ khu chen po'i yul phyogs yan chod —542—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /tsam spel bar byed de/ shākyas shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rigs yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje na re/khye'u zhig 'dir bskul gsung ba dang / e ma'o zhes khye'u dkar po zhig byung ste/ hrīḥ bde bshegs gsung 'bru rab tu bzang / /zer ba 'dra ba'i tshig cig mdzad/ /ces dang / zur tsam rab tu gsal bar mdzod/ /ces bskul ba dang / rje na re/ mkhas pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i 'dri lugs mkhas/ /'dus mkhas rab mkhas legs 'byung gsal la 'doms/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzod bshes gnyen pa na re/ gdul bya dang mthun pa'i zur 'debs dbyung 'tshal gsungs nas/ yang shar ba pa las gtsang du mched pa ni/ chos dge ba bcu yi khyad 'phags pa'i/ /gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /dgos nyang shab sa yi lte ba yin/ /sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun mo'i 'dabs/ /nor padma rā ga lta bur mdun/ /gnas g.yeng med bsam gtan 'phel ba yi/ /dpal chos kyi thang zhes grags pa 'byung / /gnas de nas byang ri lhun po la/ /chos dge ba'i 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ gnas g.yeng med bsam gtan 'phel ba'i gnas/ /de yang byang chub gnas zhes grags pa yin/ /kye de yang rgyal ba'i gnas chen yin/ /da ni bshes gnyen dam pa mchog/gsum gsum dam pa mchog tu 'byung / /yon tan mtshan ldan grags pa'i rgyal/ /blo gros mtshan ldan mtshungs pa med / / shes rab mtshan can kun la mkhas/ /rdo rje'i mtshan ldan mi nub 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i mtshan ldan dpal mnga' ba/ /chos kyi bla ma chos kyi rje/ /seng ge lta bur mi skrag pa'i/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba 'dzin/ /nam mkha' lta bur kun khyab pa'i/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pas 'gro ba 'dzin/ /smon lam dag cing tshul khrims ldan/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /tsha zer dpal ldan mtshan mnga' zhing / /gsum phrag tha mar 'gro ba 'dzin/ /rtsod dus dgu yi tha ma la/ /bsod nams mchog gi mtshan ldan pa/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso bar byed/ /bshad tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu na'ang / khrims ni cung zad lhod par 'gyur/ /rmig gcig pa dang mche ba can/ khrims 'chal byol song skyong bar byed/ /sdig grogs 'phel zhing skye bos gang / /rang nyid mi srun g.yin la 'phya/ /nor bdun 'dor zhing nor min sgrub/ khrims bor 'dod yon don du gnyer/ /e ma de 'dra'i bstan pa la/ /chos grwa de yang g.yel bar 'gyur/ /gnas de la ni zer bzhi 'byung / /rig pa 'dzin par kha lta ba/ /tshul khrims mig 'bras sa yis 'gegs/ /rang rgyud tha rgod ma thul bar/ /sangs rgyas skad du khas len byed/ khrims ldan nyan thosayin zhes smod/ /klad chung bden zhes phyi bzhin 'brang / /bdag gi sde snod rin chen mchog /nyi zla rgyu skar lta bu de/ /ma dag rnyog pa'i sprin gyis bsgribs/ /la la sprin par nyi ma lde/ /snga dus bzang po nub ces smra/ /da dus ngan pa byung zhes 'khang / /mdor na nga yi srol 'dzin pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa bcu phrag lhag /nub nas —543—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dgon pa sde bar 'gyur/ /'on kyang lnga brgya'i tha mar yang / /bstan pa'i me ro de na gnas/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /ring bsrel skye dgus mchod par byed/ /byang ri lhun po brtan pa'i rtser/ /byang chub gnas zhes grags pa'i sar/ /bdag gis byin brlabs seng ge'i sgra/ /sku gdung dam pa der gnas te/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /dad ldan brgya phrag du ma sdud/ khugs rings 'don cing mchi ma 'byin/ /gsol ba snying nas 'debs par byed/ /nga la mthu yod dpung yod kun/ /ma yengs da lta byang chub gnyer/ /phyi nas byang chub rnyed dka' bas/ /byang chub mchog la brtson par mdzod/ /de ni rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /mi dang dri za dag gis mchod/ /gang nas bltas kyang lhang nger gsal/ /bdag gi sprul ba dam pa cig /res 'ga' dge slong nyid du sprul/ /des ni gnas de skyong bar byed/ /res 'ga' byis pa'i gzugs su 'ong / /res 'ga' dbul phongs sprang po'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' byol song bya khyi'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' gsol 'debs dbyangs kyi gzugs/ /res 'ga' yig 'bru gzungs kyi gzugs/ /grags pa can ni dge slong ngo / /bstan gnas bar du yang yang 'ong / /de ni brgyud pa nyid dang mtshungs/ khrims ldan de yis byin brlabs shing / /skyes bu gsum ni don gnyer ba'i/ /bya ba myong ba brgya phrag tsam/ /gnas der bsam gtan sgom par byed/ /de la'ang cung zad lta bas gnod/ /'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung / /bsam gtan chags sdang dag la 'chor/ /'on kyang sprul bas byin brlabs pas/ /lha dang bcas pas mchod pa'i gnas/ /bkur 'os nyid du nges par 'gyur/ /mdor na gnas mchog de dag tu/ /dang po bzhi grwa nas bzung ste/ /tha mar stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /bslab pa gsum ldan shākya'i sras/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon du gyur/ /gnas der phyogs dang phyogs mtshams nas/ /'dun ldan dpag med 'du bar 'gyur/ /spyir yang las can phyogs bcur 'phro / / phyi yi rgya mtsho dag dang mtshungs/ /chu bo brgya yis gang mi nus/ /de tsam zhig gis dma' mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / /jo bo'i zhal nas/ /'brom bsdu 'tshal gsung / bshes gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'o na gtsang gi la kha ming nas kyang bshad/ da ci nas kyang mdor bstan zhig kyang song / gzhan yang kho bo dang dbyer med pa/rgyal brten pa dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / bug pa la brten pa dang / spyi bo la brten pa dang / gser la brten pa dang / chos la brten pa dang / gdengs ka la brten pa dang / chu la brten pa dang / brag la brten pa dang /gong gi rtse dang / g.ya' gnyis dang / rong po rdo rje dang / /lum na lum mchog rin chen mchog dang / gnasachen po nyid las tha mi dad pa'i gnas gnyis pa dang / kho bo'i sprul pa mnyam med thugs rje chen po bu rong ba dang /gzhan yang mnga' ris skor gsum gyi skor na'ang / dam pa khyad par can 'byung ba dang / sprul ba re re tsam rgya —544—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /nag po'i yul du 'gro ba dang / 'bring gi mtshams dang / ru'i mtshams te/ de dag ni rin chen gsal bas byin gyis brlabs pa rgyal ba 'byung ba'i gnas bstan pa/ sprul ba du ma 'gyed pa mda' dog phu yangs me tog padma 'dra ba'i gdan steng na/ sprul ba du ma'i 'od zer 'gyed cing / /dam pa de nyid kyi rnam thar yang phyis gsal la/de nyid kyis kyang bya'i gdong ba can 'di tsam nas 'byung ngo zhes lung ston cing / de yang bra zhes pa'i dgon par drug cu kha ral nas 'gro ba 'dzin/ brgyud pa la dam pa khyad parabyā lnga yan chod 'byung / khye'u zhig byung nas sding ma bya ba yin zer/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ de kun gsal drags/ khye'u zer ba'i gnas der 'byung ba ni kho bo ste rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas can no/ /ka ba na re/ bshes gnyen pa'ang mad/ de dus su sprul ba des skye bo chen po gang ga'i klung stong gi bye ma snyed bcu drug tsam sal le seng nge mkhyen par ston pa la blun pos gnyis pa can byas te stong mi gsal par phyis/ bcu drug gsal bar bstan/ gang gā'i klung bar du gtor/ grib gnon gyi bdud zhugagapa yin/ gzhan yang zhabs tog tu rlom pa zhig gis 'dra min re re gnyis gnyis bar du zhugs te rtsod pa gnyisa'ong / bshes gnyen pa na re/ de 'dra 'ong bas ka skyes rabs dang snyad snyod ma mang zer ba yin/ de dus kyi skye ba de me'i sa bon las rus byas pa'i lugs yin/ chos gang byas dar che/ lhag par drag po'i bsnyen pa la bsngags / bdud sde dang sdig can gyis mi bzod pa'i rigs yin/ des rtsod pa dang phar zer chur zer mang /'on kyang rang pham par mi nus/ hrīḥ de kun theg ler slon/ gzugs med cig na re/ spru ru bcun pa byas nas 'u yug tu btul bya ba 'ong / jo bo dbu 'phur nas bzhad/ gzhan rnams sgra de gang nas byung na zer/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ de yang gsal drags/ da ni rus mtshams nyid na mdo gsum gyi phug cig na/ ngas byin gyisabarlabs pa'i bzang po bzang po 'ga' zhig 'ong / mi ring ba ni lcang ma can no/ /de dag ni chung chung yang bstan/de yan chod na'ang gdams pa 'ga' re 'ga' re 'byung / sgra zhig na re/ drang por gnas dang bar gcod med pa dang / / dpal ldan 'dul ba spyod pa'ang khyod rigs yin/ /mu man bka' gdams drang por smra ba yang / khyod kyi spyan lnga'i rigs 'dzin yin pas gsos/ /bzhi po der yang gang zag dam pa 'byung / /de yang khyod rigs yin par nges par mdzod/ /bshes gnyen pa na re de yang yin/ de dag gis ni shar ba pa'i zhor dang bcas pa bstan no / / da ni rin chen gsal mdzad pas/ /thugs rje chen por byin brlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje seng ge glang ma'i ri/ /'dabs kyi thang sman bkram pa la/ /thugs rjes dgon pa rab bzhengs nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med sdud/ /de yis mdo sder smra ba dang / /zhang zhes mdung gi phur bzhugs dang / /gzhan yang sha bo pa zhes pa/ /brtse ba'i brtse mchog snying rje can/ /dam pa'ang dgon bur bcas te 'byung / /phyibs lung gnas kyi dam pa —545—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dang / / gdugs 'dres dro ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /byang chub mtshan ldan dam pa yang / /bu bzang bcas te nga yi sras / / nga yis byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /gzhan yang dam pa mang na yang / /gzhan dag the tshom skye srid pas//drang srong chen po'i sras kyi mchog shar nub bcu drug la sogs pa/ /ming can rnams kyang zhib ma smos/ /smon rnams dgos pa'i dbang nyid yin/ /stag khang rgya ser la sogs pa/ /gser gyi ga'u 'dra ba yi/ /dgon bu drug cu yod pa yang / /dbus gtsang rgyan te ngas ma smras/ /gzhan yang ri yi sne'u la/ /po to ba dang dbyer med cing / /yi dam lha yi dngos grub brnyes/ /gdug rtsub drag po 'dul byed pa/ /des na de nyid sne zur te/ /sprul pa du ma shar nub tu/ /des kyang dgon sde spel ba yin/ /rgya yi ming can gnas dgon yang / /nga yi gdams pa nyamasasu len / / de nas zang zing bdud zhugs te/ dgon pa'i ming yang sde bar 'gyur/ /rin po che yi sgang zhesapar/ /dpon zhes lha yi sprul ba cig /'gro ba mang po bde bkod nas/ /gnas der dam pa mang po spel/ /chos spyod dge ba 'phel na yang / /phyi mar bar gcod bag re mchi/ /da dung 'bar ba'i mtshan ldan pas/ /bu gcig bu zhig legs smin nas/ /chu med gnas su dgon pa 'debs/ /sngar bzhin dam pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /g.yin yang khang dmar mkhar thog dang / /sdings bu lta bu la sogs pa/ /de yang dam pa'i gnas su 'byung / /zhang sgom tshul khrims rgyal ba dang / /zhung btsun 'di bzang gsal bor smos/ /rig pa thug chol gar thon yin/ /de 'dra'i bzang po dpag med na'ang / /de ring khye'u mang po rnams/ /de kun smos par mi 'tshal zhes/ /lo 'dod dgos med ma smra gsung / /bdag gis smras par ma gyur kyang / /bka' gdams ming can mang po 'ong / /lung bstan nyid las lhag par mdzod/ /de ni po to skor ba lags/ /che rags tsam zhig brjod gyur gyis/ /spyan snga'i gdul bya'ang zur tsam song / /gzhan yang shugs la'ang byin brlabs pa'ang / /'dul grwa phal cher bstan pa yin/ /bstan pa'i gzhi mar nges pas so/ /jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'dul grwa mang po 'ong ba ci yin gsungs pas/bshes gnyen pa na re/ rje da gzod kho bo la bslab bya zhig mdzad de/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa ci mang du gyis gsung / jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i slob mar 'dug pa la/ khyod kyi rjes 'brang la 'bar ba bag re 'ong / de ci yin gsung pas/ kho bo'i tshad med bzhi dang skyes bu gsum la sogs pa hril de dril ba'i chos kyis 'dul ba'i skal ba med/ thun mong ba'i chos 'dul ba tsam gyi skal ba yod/ jo bo/ 'di 'dra mang po 'ong bas/ nga yon tan gyi chos rnams la sba gsang la sogs pa rim pa gsum du byed pa'i yin zhus pas / jo bo'i zhal nas/ zab zab kho bo dang mthun/ nga slob ma mang po yod de/ khyod min pa la yon tan thams cad nas thams cad ma bstan gsung / khu na re/ ngas shes/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa mang po zhig 'ong ba'i skad du —546—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /'dug nga bzhin du drin 'og na yod kyang drin gzo mi phyed par zur thug byed pa bag re 'ong zer bar gda' yis zer / ka ba na re/ mi gnyis bzhugs pa'ang 'ong pa yin zer/ rngog na re/ ring ring 'dra la 'byar 'dod zer bas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge ba cig gi 'phro la/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ yang ngas chos le ba cig 'chad de nyon cig mi zhig gis/ nged yab sras kyis bstan pa'i chos thum hril te bsdus nas/ po ti kha ser ma cig byas / na bza' dgu rim zhig g.yogs/ phu chung chung zhig tu lo gcig gnyis shig bsdad grogs dang dge bshesathams cad mdo sde la byed cing dben gnas nas dben gnas su brgyud cing dam pa mang po mi mngon par spel/ de kun kyang thig le'i gseb tu rgyob/ sgra cig na re/ thig le'i gseb na yar la hrīḥ dkar po zhig phu zheng ba yin zer ro/ /jo bo snam sbyar gyi dbu phur nas bzhad/ g.yin rnams the tshom skyes/ ka ba la sogs pa zasamo sbyor/ bshes gnyen pa na re/ yang gson cig da ni tshul khrims 'bar gyi rnam thar 'chad do/ /'dis ting nge 'dzin cig la mnyam par bzhag ste sa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ khyad par du lung pa (nyan lung pa/)dog po cig gi nang du byon nas gzigs pas/ phu cung zad yangs/ mda' dog cing rtsi shing rgyas ri mtho/ phu chu drag shing sna rnams la bya du ma 'du/ de la dpyad pas/ dgon pa phu ru byas na drag drag nas sems can mang po la rgyal po ngan pa'i spyod pa byas nas gnod pa byas kyis dogs/ ri chen po zhig gi rmangs su brtsigs na rgyab btsan pa la cung zad dman/ mdun na brag gdong (lo zhes grags pa/)'dzug pa 'dra ba mthong /cung rtsod pa 'ong ste bzod pa bsgom pa'i gnas su bzang / mda' dog ste chos bka' dog rang gi chos la mchog 'dzin cung zad skye/ 'on kyang 'chal ba dang / thug chol mi tshud/ lo cung zad 'dod/ de la brten pa'i dgon pa'ang 'byung / chos khrims dam pas g.yin zur za/ phu yangs te 'bras bu bzang / des na gnod pa'i phugs la ma gzigs par/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge ba la gzigs nas bya gnas pa'i yul der dgon pa btab/ lo tsā ba na re/ ming gi sgra de la bltas na bzang rgyu yang med/ 'on kyang ngo mtshar che ba mang po 'byon par gda'/bshekhrigaganyen pa na re/ bsam gtan (sangs rgyas sgom pa/)pa dang gzhon nu(glang lung ba brtson 'grus/)dang / /rgya9cadang rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / /yon tan (spyan snga/ dge bshes rtsab/ snubs glang lung / sangs rgyasasgom pa/daṣkabashesatshe ring / khams lung ba/ dge bshes gtsang
