ston/ jo bo da ltar/ gram 'dzer ba'o/) phun tshogs dam pa 'byung / / rba klong du ma'i tha mar yang / bstan pa'i gnyer can du ma 'byung / /gtsang gdangs tshe ring nad medapa / / de yang dam pa nyid du bzang / /bya yi nang nas khra zhes pa/ /nam mkha' rnam dag dwangs pa'i dbyings / / gser sdong shes rab mtshungs med pa/ /tha mar bstan pa'i me ro dag /grags pa'i dbang gis gso —547—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bar byed/ /du ma'i phan bde skrun byed pa/ /de yang gnas mchog dam pa yin/ /lo tsā ba na re/ yan lag gi ming 'di ma mo la btags na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin/ lus pas yan lag rgyas bya ba'i lugs yin/khye'u sngon po na re/ dam pa'i blo rgya ma chung bya ba yin/ yan lag gis glags che na yan lag gis skyong / mas thul na mas 'dul/ lar bstan pa spyi la bsam 'tshal/ snyug ma'i rum dang thu zhing skam/ /drag po drag byed mda' gseng la/ /rgyu skar nyi ma'i tshogs rab 'jig /mthu chen bdud sde 'joms pa rgyal/ /gzhan yang rjes 'brang bzang po rnams/ /zhib par mi byed theg ler bstim/ /zhes gsung / yang bshes gnyen pa na re/ gzhung dang man ngag phun tshogs pa'i/ /nga yi rjes 'brang rin chen rnams/ /gnas dang gang zag 'gro ba'i dpal/ /nga yi bka' gdams thun mong bar/ /gang dang gang gis yi ger 'debs/ /skyer sgang ba dang mkha' ru ba/ /gang zag khyad 'phags sbas pa rnams/ /bka' gdams thor bu mdzad pa can/ /gzhan yang bka' gdams don gnyer ba/ /mdzad pa can rnams yi ger 'byung / /'dir bshad mi 'tshal shes par mdzod/ /jo bos dpang mdzod grogs po rnams/ /de ring yod nges dam pa rnams/ /gang nas zin zin thor bur bsgrags/ /de la nyes gang mthol lo bshags/ /la la chad dang lhag srid na/ /dgos pa'i dbang yin nongs pa med/ /dngos su bstan dang shugs las byung / la la bsres pa nyid du bstan/ /de yang dgos pa'i dbang nyid yin/ /dgos ldan bshad pa gang yin pas/ /bka' gdams phyogs mthar rgyas par shog /gzhud pa dang po nyid la yang / /dbus gtsang khams gsum la sogs par/ /'dod 'jo'i 'od 'jo byang chub gnas/ /du ma yod kyang 'dir ma smos/ /de ni ma 'ongs 'byung tshul yin/ /cha tsam brjod kyis nges par mdzod/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /la la zhib po zhib por byung / /la la 'brel can 'brel can byung / /la la zur tsam tho re byung / /la la don gyis bstan te byung / /chos grwa che rab ma smos pa'i/ /bzhi sde lnga sde'ang brjod de byung / /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di skad gsung / kha skongs legs nyes dpang mdzad gsung / /de ring khu yis gsol btab ngor/ /dar la brtan te tsha tsha gter/ /thams cad mkhyen par zhal gyis bzhes/ /dgos pa'i dbang du kho bos go /de las lhag pa bshad ma mchis/ /de las dri rgyu'ang mi gda' bas/ /thams cad legs zhes chim par smros/ /kun gyis legs so sgra chen bsgrags/ /de nas rang rang gnas dag tu/ /rjes su yi rang zer zhing dengs/ /de nas re zhig lon pa na//legs pa'i blo ldan drung byon nas/ /de ring chos 'di yi ger bri/ khrom du bsgrags nas bka' rgya yang / /bden par sus kyang ga la rtsi/ /brgya 'bul tsam zhig byas pa las/ /da gzod 'di 'dra grags mi 'byung / /bshes gnyen zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /thun mong brgya 'bum tsam zhig las/ /gzhan gyis ma thos thun mong min/ /—548—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ma 'ongs mi grags kho bo bzhad/ /de bas yi ge don ma mchis/ /de ni bdag gi snying gtam yin/ /snying gtam phyi la mi spel 'tshal/ /e ma bka' rgya du ma btab/ /da ni de tsam nyid la brten/ khyed kyang de la tshim par mdzod / / ces bya ba ni yer ba lha ri snying po'i mgul du/ bla ma dang grogs tshangs par mtshungs pa zhal 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar rwa sgreng la sogs pa'i gnas dang / sku mched gsum la sogs pa'i gang zag khyad par can 'byung tshul tho re gsungs pa ni/ spyir ka ba la sogs pas zhus na'ang / khyad par du legs pa'i shes rab la snying gtam du gdams pa ste/ pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o/ /pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i ya gyal gcig 'di'o/ /shing pho rta'i lo la/ lha ri snying por bzhugs pa'i tshe sgrol mas snye thang du byon par bskul nas/ /mthar bla ma dga' ldan du byon pa'i bar gyi tshul rnams mgur du bzhes pa/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i glu'i le'u zhes bya ba tha ma pha chos le'u gcig ste/ pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug po'i ya gyal 'di gcig gu ru sarba na mo// dbyings stong dag pa'i gur shed na/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pa yi/ /skyabs kyi dam pa bla ma mchog /a ti sha zhes dpal tu gyur/ / lan cig rgyal bas byin brlabs pa'i/ /yer ba'i gnas chen dam pa der/ /mdzes nga/'i lha mo zhig byung nas/ / rgyal ba sras bcas snye thang du/ /snyerigro ba'i don la gshegs gsung thos/ /de nas mar me mdzad gsungs nas/ / lha dpe phal cher gnas 'dir zhog /shākya thub pa'i zhal lta zhing / khyod kyi pho brang lha sa der/ /gter kha gcig cam sped du 'deng / / de nas snye thang 'or du gshegs/ /gsung bzhin lha sar byon gyur nas/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar byon pa na/ /dge slong gzhon nu snam sbyar can/ /'od stong ldan pa glegs bam 'dzin/ /po ti 'di khyer nga khri la/ /'dug la nga bzhin bde bar ston/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang nga drung du/ /'gro ba'i spyi rdzi mdzad gyur cing / /gnas 'di skyong zhing bzhugs par mdzod/ ākya'i rgyal pos 'di skad du/ /mar me mjad dpal bzang po khyod//rdo rje'i gdan nas 'dir 'ongs nas/ /mang po bzang po'i dpal la bkod/ /yang yang nga bstan gsal gyur ba//sgron me rlung gis ma bskyod cing / /gang gi mun pa gsal lo rje/ /da ni sras kyi thu bo 'di/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam par zhog /dga' ba'i zhing khams dag par gshegs/ /dad ldan bzang po'i lam la khod/ /nga dang nga 'dra'i tshogis rab spel/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang yang / /sngar bzhin thugs rje chen por bzhugs/ khyod la dben pa'i skabs ma mchis/ /gnas 'dir mi mthun phyogs rnams srungs/ /phyogs bcu'i skye bo gnas 'dir bsdus / / nga dang nga yi ye shes lha/ /sgrol ma khyed rang sku gdung dang / /lha brgyad spros pa'i sku mchog rnams/ /yan lag bdun pas rtag tu mchod/ /gzhan yang gnas 'dir chu rags rtsigs/ /chu 'gor khyod kyi sku gdung —549—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzhengs / / e ma 'jig rten mig gcig pu/ /nga yi mar me mdzad dpal yod/ /mar me mdzad dpal 'jigs bral na'ang / /nya 'dra sbal 'dra lcong 'dra ba'i/ /sa dbyibs 'gro ba'i bsod nams las/ /'ong ste khyod kyis bstan par mdzod/ /grwa ba sngon 'byung spel mdzod la/ /mang po 'dren pa bzang por mdzod/ /mar me mdzad kyang gnas mchog 'dir/ /sgrol mar bcas te sprul stong 'gyed/ /lhag par chags med bsod snyoms pa/ /snyan pa'i dbyang kyi gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs bzhi'i las can dbang du sdud/ /nga yi mchod tshogs rgyas par byed/ /mar me mdzad dang byams pa yang / khyod kyi grogs bzang spel bar byed/ /ring por mi thogs gnas mchog 'dir/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'dul bar 'gyur/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzang por sprul/ /lan du rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /dga' ldan mun pas bsgribs gyur tam/ /mi yi mar me 'khyer ci lags/ /da dung bstan pa ma nub pas/ rgyal ba bzhugs par cis mi rigs/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'phel 'grib med/ /ci ste gdul bya med gsung ba/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dpag med pa'i/ /skye bo bzhag nas dben ci lags/ /da dung bde gshegs gsung ma byon/ /rgyal ba gnas 'dir spyan 'dren phyir/ /nga yi mi nor du ma god/ /'jig rten pa yang gzhung srid na / / rgyal bas bzod pa ji ltar lags/ /brtson 'grus seng ge gang du gum/ /lha yi rgyal po gang du gshegs / / rgyus med thag ring bgrod pa rnams/ /nyam nga bzhin du shul ring bgrod/ /rgyal ba spyan 'dren dka' spyad la/ /mar me rlung las thar gyur nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su ji ltar yal/ /legs par dgongs shig skyabs gcig kun/ /de nas snye thang 'or du byon/ khreng pho rta lo'i dus tshod yin/ khrums zla'i bco lngar gyur ba na / / bdud sde mang po dga' ba sgrog /'jig rten bshes de dga' ldan 'gro /sgron me'i 'od de mi yul yal/ /phal cher rang gi spyod yul yin/ /e ma 'dod pa grub ces thos/ /ma dga' rgyal ba'i drung du phyin/ /de ring bdud sde dga' sgrogs thos/ /mi yi mar me yal zhes smra/ /bod khams mun par 'thibs gyur nas/ /mar me yal bar mi 'gyur ram/ /e ma bdag gi yid shes 'khrugs/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /mi tshe ri gzar rbab dang 'dra/ /gang gi bshol 'debs ga la nus/ /'on kyang kho bo sprul ba yin/ /'chi ba mi mnga' bde bar bzhugs/ khrums zla'i bcu drug gyur ba na/ /thugs rje chen po 'di skad gsung / /sngon chad lha tshogasadapag med rnams/ /shin tu dga' ba'i lha bro 'khrab/ /mchod tshogs 'bul zhing 'dir 'ong na/ /do zhag lha bro 'khrab mi gda' / / nga yi bshes gnyen mi gda' ba/ /rgyal ba thugs kyis bzod lags sam/ khrums zla'i bcu bdun gyur ba na/ /thugs rje chen po 'di skad gsung / /de ring mi dga' snying rtsa 'dar/ /gang du phyin kyang yid mi chags / / slar log stan la 'dug ma 'dod/ /sngar ba de ring 'di 'dra 'gyur/ /bde gshegs snga ltas ma yin —550—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /nam / kho bo bor bar bzod lags sam/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /spyan ras gzigs dbang nga la gson/ /tshe 'di la kha'i sbur ma 'dra/ /rlung bo gar che'i rkyen dbang yin/ kho bo'i tshe yang de dang mchungs/ /sgrub par mi nus chos can yin/ /'on kyang sprul ba'i dge slong la/ /'chi ba sgyu ma/'i chul du zad/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mig gcig pu/ /mya ngan ma ma/jad bde bar bzhugs/ khrums zla'i bco brgyad gyur ba na/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad zhus/ /de ring shar ri'i rtse la phyin/ /lo stong bzhes pa'i drang srong 'ig /smon lam dbang ba'i drang srong ngas/ /ma thebs rgyal ba gshegs zhes thos/ /de tshig thos rnga/sa rab lang nas/ /lus zungs 'khyog cing gnas 'dir 'ongs/ /smon lam/ dbang ba de smra na/ /rgyal ba 'da' chul mi ston nam/ /ci ste thugs kyis bzod par byed/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /lus 'di chu bur rdol ba 'dra/ /glo bur rkyen gyis skyed par zad / / rten cing 'brel 'byung gnas lugs la/ /blo gtad thub pa su zhig yod/ /a cang de kun ldem po yin/ /sprul ba skye 'chi ga la byed/ /mgon ngo/ thugs ngan ma mdzad par/ /'gro ba'i don du bde bar bzhugs/ /nyin cig bcu dgur gyur ba'i tshe/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad zhus/ /de ring lho yi lhun rtser phyin/ /bram ze skal ba bgrangs/ sgo/ cig /mig gdong mchi mas dag cing ngu / /da ni rgyal ba gshegs zhes thos/ /'gyel kyang langs te 'khyor zhing 'ongs/ /e ma kho bo cis mi 'dzin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad du/ /tshe 'di nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra / / skyes pa 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /gang gis bshol 'debs ga la nus/ /byas pa'i mtshan nyid bshig pa dka'/ /a cang de kun ldem po yin/ /mya ngan 'das nga bde ba'i mchog /rkyen med bde ba'i gnas su bzhugs / / skye 'chir gnas na sprul ba min/ /nyi shu nyin par gyur ba'i tshe/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad zhus//nub kyi ri dbang mtho steng na/ /bskal stong bzhugs pa'i drang srong zhig 51gas ring 'don cing bub ste gda'/kho bos ci nongs dris pa'i tshe/ /da ste nyi shu rtsa dgu na/ /lha rnams phal cher mi yul lhags/ /nang par rgyal ba dga' ldan du/ /dri ma med par spyan 'dren zhes/ /mi yul gnas 'di stong par 'gyur/ /de thos dngangs pas myur du 'ongs/ /sems kyis lus 'di rab bskyod pas/ /gom pa'i bzhag sa mi gda' lags/ /rgyal ba dga' ldan gshegs gyur na/ /bdag cag bod khams su yis 'dzin/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'brom rje zhabrul ba'i snang ba yin/ /rdzun snang bden par ma 'dzin par/ /rang gi gdul bya bde bar skyongs/ /'di ltar thig le chen po yin/ /yud cig thig le'i dbyings su thim/ /'brom rje'ang gzug 'dzin bral bar gyur/ /rgyal ba'ang gzung 'dzin mi mnga'o/ /de ni thig le dang po'o/ khrums zla'i nyer gcig gyur ba na/ /sa phyogs thams cad 'od kyis gang / /'od kyi gseb nas bu mo zhig /shing lo sngon po'i gos gyon nas/ /thugs rje chen po'i drung —55/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/du byon/ /mya ngan ma mdzad rgyal ba la/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba thob/ /do zhag kho mo'ang yid 'khrugs gyur/ /lha cig dam pa lha yul du/ /byams pa'i rnam thar skyong du 'gro /zer ma thag tu bu mo yal/ /yus kyis brnangs nas drung du 'ong / /sngon chad rje bcun sgrol ma nyid/ /rnam dag cha lugs 'od kyis gang / /dga' bzhin rgyal la mchod 'ong na/ /de ring 'od dang bkrag med par/ /'dzum zhal gnag nas nga drung byon/ /gsol ba thob ces bskum zhing gda'/ /sgrol ma'ang yid 'brugs gsung byon na/ /bdag snying lcags sran cis mi mtshungs/ /'on te med dgag yin nam ci/ /yod na 'gags par cis mi rigs/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /de ring lha mos sdigs ri btang / /lha la mya ngan ga la mnga'/ /nga ni sprul ba'i dge slong yin/ /de la skye 'chi ga la lta / nyi shu gnyis su gyur ba'i tshe/ /rgyal ba'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /de ring byang ri lhun po la/ /gnod sbyin 'ga' zhig 'bod cing ngu / /mthu stobs can de gang du gshegs/ /brtse bar dgongs shig zer ba thos/ /rtol med sems kyis gnas 'dir 'ongs/ /theg mchog chen po mi gshegs sam/ /glang khal be'u la mi 'byo'am/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /rgyas sras bzang po nga la nyon/ /tshe 'di nub ri'i nyi ma 'dra/ /gsal te sus kyang bzung ba dka'/ /a cang thig le chen po la/ /gshegs dang bzhugs par mi 'tshal lo/ /yud cig thig ler yal te bzhengs/ /gshegs dang bzhud par mi mnga' ba'i/ /'di ni thig le gnyis pa'o/ khrums zla'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ /mi reng dkar po du ma zhig /dar dkar gos kyis rab brgyan nas/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon dkar po 'then/ /rgyal ba 'di la 'byon zhes thos/ /e ma chags sdang ma ches sam/ /e ma mnyam nyid gang du thal/ /kyi hud thugs rje phyogs gcig pa/ /nga/ re nyon mongs pha mas mnar/ /dpung tshan ches pas 'phreng zhing lus/ /rgyal ba bde bar gshegs gyur na/ /bdag 'dras bzod dka' ci ste theg /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / kho bo tshogs gnyis rgyu las 'khrungs/ /lus can dus las mi 'da' bar/ /dus la 'doms par thogs med 'chi/ /nyi shu bzhi yi gung babs tshe/ /yi dwags dpag med mya ngan byed/ /da ni zas skom bshes dang bral/ /mig gcig mya ngan 'da' 'gyur ro/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'di skad du/ /re bden bkres skom pha ma rnams/ /bkres skom pha ma bzhag gyur nas/ /rgyal ba bdud rtsis 'tsho byed dam/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /mya ngan ma byed phongs pa rnams/ /bdag la 'chi ba'i dus ma mchis/ /gang na gnas kyang mig gis blta/ /zas skom bde bar sleb par bya/ /spyan ras gzigs la mgon skyabs zhus/ /yi dwags rnams kyi mgon po yin/ /snying rje chen pos bde bar skyongs/ /nyi shu lnga yi gung tshigs la/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad gsung / /de ring thogs med dga' ldan phyir/ /rgyal bas sprul pa'i pad sdong 'brungs/ /dag pa'i —552—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdam/sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /lha yis rab tu bskor/ /ring por mi thogs dri me/da 'byor/ /mchod tshogs phul /'es dga' ba thos/ /gling gzhan nyi mas dkar gyur kyang / /gling 'dir mun pas rab tu g.yogs/ /yid rab dga' bar ga la 'gyur/ /dga' ldan mchod pas bzang gyur bas/ /gangs can rje dang 'bral bar 'chal/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / / gang du skyes kyang padma'i spubs/ /su yis bskor kyang lha tshogs yin/ /gang na gnas kyang zhing kham/sa gtsang / / da ni thig le'i rang bzhin la/ /dga' ldan 'gro ba ga la bden/ /yud cig thig ler yal te byon/ /chags dang sdang ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /de ni thig le gsum/ pa'o// khrums zla'i nyer drug gyur ba na/ /'ur zhing sa rnams phapa cher g.yos/ /na la padma phub chung cam/ /lta bas chog mi shes pa'ang 'khrungs/ /jo bo der bzhugs lha bzhis bskor/ /de che rgyal bas 'di skad du/ /thugs rje che ldan gco bo bzhi/ /bshes gnyen 'di dang mi 'bral bar/ /gdul bya mtho dang thar la 'khod/ /de nas bdag la byas pa yin/ /lha bzhi ma/grin gcig 'di skad gsung / /mgon po skyo bar ma mdzad cig khyod kyi byang chub bzang po'i grogs/ /rgyun chad med par nged shes so/ /thugs rje chen pos 'di skad du/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol btab kyang / /rgyal ba zhing khams gzhan btanags na/ /mya ngan 'das ston bzhugs gsol ba'i/ /dam pa'i lag len mi nub bam/ /mgon pos gsung de byon pa'i tshe/ /lha bzhi'ang 'dzum pa yal gyur to/ /jo bo'ang mi smra yun ring lus/ /re zhig lon nas 'di skad gsung / kho bo sems dpa' serme/sa dpa' che / / zhi bar sdod pa ga la srid/ /nyin mtshan med par gsol ba thob/ khyod dang 'bral ba ga la srid/ /lha dang nga la dbye ba med/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsungs nas dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ /gcig po'ang thig le yungs kar tsam/ /de yang rang gi snying gar byung / /de nas bla ma'i gzugs nyid do/ /de ni thig le bzhi pa'o//khrums zla'i nyi shu bdun gyi tshe/ /thugs rje chen pos gzigs pa yis/ /sa rnams skya zhing snum zhag med/ /rtsi shing phal kyang ser por gyur/ /lo 'dab phal cher sa la nyil/ /mgo bo phal cher nang du dud/ /de tshe 'di snyam thugs ma dga'/ kha ning spang ljongs me tog bkra/ /g.yu 'brug dal bus sgra 'byin cing / /char rnams dus su snyoms par 'bab/ /shang shang gsig ma shin tu mdzes/ /gzhan yang me tog du ma rgyas/ /sprul ba'i me tog du ma 'bab / / lha yis me tog tshogs rab 'thor/ /klu yis me tog du ma spel/ /'gro ba rigs mi mthun par yang / /rang rang mchod tshogs dga' bzhin 'bul/ /deng sang 'di 'dra gzhan du gyur/ /'od dang ldan pa'i lha tshogs kyang / / bkrag med gzi brjid nyams par gyur/ /da dung rtsi shing kha dog rnams/ /ser dang lo 'dab nyil ma ran / / me tog 'dab mdzes gyur ba yang / /da dung dus kyis yal ma ran/ /da re bems po gyur ba yang rang —553—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dus dor nas gzhan du sgyur/ /bems po'i rnams 'phrul 'di 'dra na/ /nges par rgyal ba 'da' tshul ston/ /bems po'ang mya ngan byed dus su/ kho bo bag yod tshugs gyur tam/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /bems po'i snang tshul ma ltar bar / /sems kyi gnas lugs nyams su long / /de 'dra'i rtog pa spros gyur na/ /sdug bsngal sprul te khur ba yin/ /nyi shu brgyad du gyur ba na/ /thugs rje chen pos slar yang brtags/ /sa yis mi tshugs g.yo zhing gda'/ /skye chu dal bus 'bab pa'i sar/ /de ring mi snyan chu sgra sgrogs/ /res 'ga' 'khor zhing gting du 'bros/ /res 'ga' rba rlabs gyen la g.yo/ /res 'ga' lhag par 'khyil zhing sdud/ /res 'ga' drag po'i gzhung du 'chang / /res 'ga' rlabs chen rgyang du 'phar/ /dwangs ma'i chu gtsang lha bas gang / /rgyal ba'i snyan du 'di skad gsol/ /bems po'i chu yang 'di 'dra ba/ /'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung 'di/ /sngon chad sgra med babs kyis gzhol/ /phrugs re'i char gyis bri gang dka'/ /de ring nga bzhin mya ngan byed/ /kyi hud mi yul rin chen gyi/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho bskams kyis dogs/ /chu bo'i 'gro sa gar byed ces/ /de ring smre sngags tshig tu 'don/ /'byung ba sems med de smra na/ /nga yi sems 'di ci zhig yin/ /rgya mtsho chen po mtshungs pa med/ /skyabs gcig gzhan du gshegs gyur nas/ /nya phran skam la ma gtor zhig /rang rgyud tshad pas bye ma bsregs / / chu med sdug la ma rngod cig /rgya mtsho skam pa'i skabs ma mchis/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / glu/ma cig bu dang 'bral ba yang / /thabs mkhas brjod na mya ngan zhi/ /'phagasapa ci ste rtog pa 'phro/ /nga yi tshig la tshad mi 'dzin/ /ci zer bde ba chen po yin/ /hrīḥyi ngo bor bde bar bzhugs/ /nga yang thig le hrīḥl thim/ /gsungs nas yab sras gnyis med gyur/ /de nas sku yi rnam par byon/ /'di ni 'chi ba mi mnga' ba'i / / thig le chen po lnga ba yin/ khrums zla'i nyer dgur gyur ba'i tshe/ /sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs/ /gshegs ltas du ma gzigs gyur bas/ /sku la snyung ba mi gda' yang / /zhal la ltas na yus kyis gang / /phyir la phyin yang skyo shas skyes/ /des na thi ba tshang stor bzhin/ /ri bo'i rtse dang lung ba'i sul/ /g.ya' yi rtse dang spang gi ljongs/ /gangs kyi mgul dang nags kyi khrod/ /lung ba'i sul dang spo yi steng / /sems phyir lus kyi 'brangs gyur kyang / /rmi lam bar do ji bzhin du/ /kun tu thogs med rgyug pa na/ /rang gi spyod lam ji bzhin du/ /bya dang ri dwags tshogs kyang rgyug /bya rnams phal cher spu rtsa gzengs/ /la la sprug cing gshog pa rdebs(rdebaka / /la la mgrin pa gsum snyeng byed/ /la la mchu bskams rab tu gdengs/ /rang skad thams cad gzhan du 'gyur/ /la las la la gdung zhing 'ded/ /la las la la'i spu nas 'then/ /la la nges par 'chi 'gyur yang / khra la rgol zhing rjes su 'brang / /bya rog skad ngan sna tshogs 'don/ /sngon chad sha dang zas sred na/ /de ring dang gar mi 'ong —554—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhusas so/ /'bros / / ri dwags rnams kyang ri sul na/ /bag phebs rtswa chu mi spyod par/ /rab tu 'drog cing 'bros tshul ston / / res nyal res ldang yang yang du/ /mi snyan ltongs ltongs dgra (sgra3 rab 'bod/ /e ma bya dag ri dwags rnams/ /nga la 'dud cing rang tshugs shor/ /rang 'tsho'i sdug bsngal du mas gzir/ /rab tu spungs te nga la bskor/ /bdag med bya dang ri dwags kyang / /de 'dra'i mya ngan byed gyur na/ /nga 'dra'i snying med su zhig yin//de skad smra zhing drung du zhus/ /byol song rnams kyang sdug bsngal te/ khyed gshegs bzod par mi gda' na/ /mya ngan 'da' pa'i skabs mchis sam/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /e ma bya dang ri dwags rnams/ /re sdug bdag la de ltar brtse/ /bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /nga la brtse rnams yar la drongs/ /gsungs nas tshad med bzhi la bzhag /de tshe 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /de nas 'od zer slar 'dus nas//thugs rje chen po'i spyi bor thim/ /bla ma'ang thig le'i rang bzhin du/ /sras kyi spyi bor thim par gyur/ /de nas lham mer rnam par byon/ /sprul ba'i sprul ba bde bar bzhugs/ /de ni thig le drug pa'o/ /nyin cig khrums zla'i stong chen la/ /dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal ba la/ /gnas brtan bcu drug nyid kyis bskor/ /mar me mdzad pa'i drung na 'khod/ /mar me mdzad la 'od 'phros nas/ /sras kyi mchog la 'di skad gsung / /rgyal ba mya ngan yongs mi 'da'/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur ba/ /nga yi bka' la tshad mar bzung / /ded dpon bde mchog rin chen gling / khyod kyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig /dgos 'dod 'byung bar mchis na yang / /rlom par mi byed go cha can / khyod la mya ngan mi mnga' bas/ /mgon po mya ngan mi mdzad 'tshal/ /rtag tu khyod dang mi 'bral bar/ /nga dang nga yi bka' sgrub rnams/ khyod dang khyod kyi sras mchog rnams/ /thar par spel phyir rgyun chad med/ /dgos 'dod spel phyir slad bzhin 'brang / /tha dad ma mdzad 'phags pa mchog /'jig rten bde ba'i skyabs gcig po/ /mthu yod rnams kyis mi skyobs na/ /bde ba'i nor bu rin chen 'di/ /dgyes par bzhugs zhes thugs kar bstim/ /de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /dag pa'i me tog sdong po 'khrungs/ /zer 'brur bcas pas nam mkha' gang / /dbus su bde gshegs dpag med bzhugs/ /re re'i pad sdong sems dpas gang / /steng 'og phyogs bcu 'od kyis phub/ /de yang 'ja' tshon du mas bskor/ /sngar gyi bde gshegs gnas brtan la/ /nyanastathosacha lugasadu ma rnams/ /glo bur nyid du 'khod de bskor/ /thams cad mthun par 'di skad gsung / /mar me 'gro ba kun gyi dpal/ /mdzad pa bzang po bsam mi khyab/ /dus min rgya mtsho skam mi srid/ /don med ri bo 'gyel mi 'gyur/ /lha bzang dpag bsam ga la 'chag /nyin phyed nyi ma ga la nub/ /sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs| |rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas thugs rje can/ /'gro ba yongs kyi mgon po mchog khyod rang drung na —555—

bka' gdams dnge/ dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kye skor/bzhugs snang ba'i/ /'jig rten sgron ma de nyid kyang / /mi rtag chos la bskul ba dang / /dgos pa bsam gyi mi khyab phyir/ /lham mer bzhugs par mi mdzad par/ /brgyad cu'i dus su 'da' chul bstan/ /gzhan gyi snang ngor de bstan na'ang / /mya ngan 'das pa ga la mnga'/ /deng sang bcom ldan bsam mi khyab/ khyod la mya ngan ma 'das par / / mkhas pa chen po'i drung mchog na/ /mkhas pa khyed nyid bde bar mchis/ /nges par mya ngan 'das gyur na / khyed la snang bar ga la 'gyur/ /de bzhin mar me mdzad dpal yang / /gdul bya gzhan la 'das ston yang /khyed la 'da' bar ga la srid/ /lan du mgon pos 'di skad zhus/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul nyes tshogs bshags / / rjes su yi rang 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rjes bzhugs/ /bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sras dang bcas te nga la dgongs/ /'gro ba rnams kyi snang tshul gzigs/ /chos pa phal gyi gnyen po dgongs/ /lhag par snyigs ma'i sems can rnams/ /drin lan 'jal tshul ji ltar byed/ /ngo tsha khrel gzhung ji ltar srid/ /yon tan gzhi rten khrims la dgongs/ /rgyal yum spyod pa ji tsam mchi/ /e ma bde gshegs sprin tshogs rnams/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes thogs med ldan/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje bsam mi khyab/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las dpag med na/ kho bo skal ba bzang bzhin du/ /gsol ba btab pa cis mi thebs/ /e ma nyon mongs gdungs pa rnams/ /las med gyur bas 'dren mi nus/ /gsol ba btab kyang ga la thebs e ma bde gshegs thugs rje'i tshogs/ /skal ba yod kyang mi 'dzin cing / /med pa 'dzin par mi nus pas/ /lung ma bstan rnams ji ltar dgongs/ /gsum las gzhan pa'i gdul bya med/ /gzhan du bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /thugs rjes ci 'tshal su zhig skyob/ /gsol ba btab pas mi thebs shing / /ma btab de bas mi thebs na/ /bde ba rtsol byed dgos pa ci/ /mthu yod rnams kyis mi skyobs na/ /mthu med rnams kyis ji ltar skyob/ /mar me mdzad dpal kho bo'i mig /myur du long bar ma btang cig /mar me mdzad dpal kho bo'i snying / /myur du snying med ma mdzad cig /kun mkhyen pha gcig gshegs gyur na/ /bdag gi gros phugs su la bgyid/ /dmu rgod rnams kyis sdig bsags tshe/ /de tshe sdug yus su la gsol/ /tshig rtsub mtshon gyis 'bugs pa'i tshe/ /bdag gi bzod phub gang la bgyid/ /de ring thugs rjes bzung du yin/ /'on kyang nongs na bzod par mdzod/ /de nas bde gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi 'od zer rnams/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la phog /rgyal ba'ang 'od dang thig ler gyur/ /thig le rang gi sems la thim/ /bde gshegs sras bcas 'od du yal/ /mgon po mnyam nyid ngang du 'byams/ /rjes la rgyal ba sras bcas gyur/ /'di ni thig le bdun pa'o/ /gu ru na mo / / rgyal ba mya ngan 'das ston pa'i/ /snga ltas khyad 'phags rab bdun te/ /bshes gnyen 'brom rje 'ba' —556—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /zhig las/ /mngon shes med pas ma rtogs so/ /mkhas pa gang dag the tshom zos/ /rje btsun snyung ba mi gda' yang / / 'brom ni cung zad brel zhing 'dug /phebs pa la la 'dri zer nas/ /mgon po dben par gshegs pa'i tshe/ /mngon tshan che bar shugs phyin nas/ /rgyal ba bdag la zhu rgyu mchis/ /rje bcun pa ni sku khams bzang /khyed ni cung zad 'brel bar mthong / /ci yin the tshom bcad du gsol/ /thugs rje chen pos lan gsungs pa/ /rang rtog ngan pa dgra ma langs/ /da dung chos 'phro du ma yod/ /rje bcun zla ba yar ngo bzhin/ /sku khams je bzang lha yis mchod/ /do bzhag bsgoms pas gegs shig byung / /jo bos du mar bsal na yang / /tshe thung nam 'gro cha med snyam/ /bsgoms pas slar yang che ru song / /de stobs rnam g.yeng che bar byung / /sngar yang 'ja' 'od rgyun chad med/ /do bzhag lhag par dge ltas bzang / /de 'dra'i gleng mo ma mdzad cig /cal gyi rigs 'di mched pa mang / /skung ba med par la bshags med/ /rtog pas khong na sgul ba srid/ /mgon po'i gsung de thos gyur nas/ /bag phebs des kyang phebs la bshad/ /e ma yab sras thugs zab pa/ /che ba'i rnam 'phrul sus ma tshor/ /grags pa thig le'i dbyings su yal/ /thams cad the tshom zhi bar gyur/ /thos pas rje mthong yid ches skyes / / de ni thig le brgyad pa'o/ /des ni khrums zla yar la bcad/ /shing pho rta lo gzhi ma yin/ /yar ngo dbyug gu'i tshes gcig la/ /gzugs med nam mkha' sgra yis gang / /me tog char kyang rab tu babs/ /spos ngad bzang po rab tu 'thul/ /shar sprin dkar po nub tu rgyu/ /lho sprin ser po byang du rgyu/ /nub sprin dmar po shar du rgyu/ /byang sprin sngon po lho ru rgyu/ kha dog gtso bo dbus na gnas/ /ri mo mkhan gyis tshon dkrugs bzhin/ /res 'ga' dbyer med khrug khrug 'dres/ /res 'ga' ma 'dres zur na gsal/ /res 'ga' 'ja' tshon gur bzhin gsal/ /'di ni phal ches mthong bar gyur/ /mgon pos gzigs pas rigs lnga'i tshogs/ /sras bcas 'od zer mchod pa mthong / /gzhan yang rang gi zhing khams kyi/ /bkod pa du ma ston pa mthong / /lhag par 'od zer sna lnga yi/ /rnam par rgyal ba rin chen lnga/ /jo bo'i dbu la rgyan du gsol/ /gzhan yang rgyan cha du ma rnams/ /rgyan pa'i gnas rnams brgyan par mdzad/ /gzhon nu sems dpar gyur ba rnams/ /jo bo'i mdun du rab 'khod nas/ /jo bos rgyal yum ston pa mthong / /de nas re zhig lon pa na/ /byang chub sems rnams 'di skad gsung / /grogs po bde ba chen po'i lam/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgya mtsho ste/ /skye 'bri med par brtan par bzhugs/ khyed kyi chos grogs bdag cag yin/ /bdag cag zhing 'dir dus drug tu/ /mgon po khyed la mchod du mchi/ /bde gshegs yal bar ma sems shig /sprul ba'i rgyal ba 'da' mi mnga'/ /thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin yin/ /'di ni 'od kyi —557—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/thig le yin/ /'di ni thig le chen por gcig /thig le hrīḥyi dbyings na bzhugs/ /gsung ma thag tu sras dang bcas / kha dog lnga yi 'od du gyur/ /'od rnams a ti sha la thim/ /bla ma'ang thig le chen por gyur/ /theg le'ang dag pa'i dbyings su yal/ /ring por ma lon bla mar byon/ /de ni thig le dgu pa'o/ /dbyug gu'i tshes gnyis gyur ba na/ /mkha' la shes rab chos kyi sgra/ /zag pa med par rgyun chad med/ /sa ri rtsi zhing nags tshal yang / / zag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /grag stong chen por rab tu 'ur/ /bdud sde'i gnas rnams rab skrags shing / /sprin med nam mkha' dwangs par gyur/ /mgon po thugs kyang shin tu gsal/ /skye bo rnams kyang yid dga' zhing / /rig pa dag kyang gsal bar gyur/ /sngar gyi bems rig la sogs pa'i/ /ltas rnams de ring zhi zhing gsal/ /rang gzhan rnam rtog mi mnga' ba'i/ /zag med chos kyi snang ba rgyas/ /yig 'bru la sogasami mnga' ba'i/ /thig le 'ba' zhig gnas gyur te/ /thig le'ang stong pa nyid du yal/ /stong pa'i ngang las bla ma byon / / de ni thig le bcu pa'o/ /dbyug gu'i tshes gsum gyur ba na/ /rjes kyi snang ba gzigasapa'i tshe/ /bden dngos ci yang mi gda' na'ang / /dbyibs dang kha dog dpag med rnams/ /bkra ba'i mdangs shor nyams te gda' / / 'on kyang ci yin dpyad pa na/ /lho sprin dkar po gug po zhig /'brom rje bzhugs pa'i steng du yal/ /yal ma thag tu dbyings shed na/ /klu sgrub a wa sgru ti'i bar/ /mar me mdzad bzang bde gyur tam/ /spros pa'i mtha' yis ma gos pa'i/ /zag med thugs de gsal gyur tam/ /sras kyi thu bo thugs rje can/ /chos nyid dag las ma g.yos par/ /bla ma'i sgo gsum rab mdzes par/ /gsol ba thob la rgyun tu bzung / /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'di gnas tshe/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje'ang mi 'grib pas/ /mar me mdzad dpal bde bar mchi/ /de ring thugs rje chen po khyod/ /cung zad mya ngan mnar bar mthong / khyed kyi bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /lta ba rnam dag gnas 'dir mchis/ /jo bo yab la gzigs gyur nas/ /bla ma yab sras byon pa mtshar/ zhasabya'i dkyil 'khor ma sbyangs pas/ /phra rab nyes pa'i tshogs mang mthong / khrims ldan nga la gos srid na/ /rnam dag skyabasal mthol lo bshags/ /thos bsam sgom pas dus 'das kyang / /bsrung dka'i dam tshig gos srid na/ /bden med nyes pa mthol lo bshags/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos sku rnams/ /dngos 'dzin khong skran sngar dag kyang / /bden med gzung 'dzin mthol lo bshags/ /rnam dag sku gsum byin rlabs dang / /zag med dge ba'i byin rlabs dang / /zhing rab dge 'dun byin rlabs kyis/ /gsum dang dbyer med nyid du bsngo/ /bde bar gyur cig sems can rnams/ /'phags pa'i gnas su phyin gyur cig /de nas rgyas sras dbyings su yal/ /jo bo'ang rnam dag mkha' la gshegs/ /thig le nyag cig yin gsung byon/ /dbyug dgu'i tshes bzhir gyur ba na/ /sa yi —558—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdar sa bu chos bzhugs so/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yos/ /bar snang thams cad 'od kyis gang / /sngar med me tog so ma babs/ /phyogs bzhir sa 'brug du ma langs/ /yi dam thams cad mkha' la byon/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor 'od dang bral/ /'jig rten sgron me nyid la gzigs/ /kyi hud nyam thag du ma'i gnyen/ /kyi hud mar me mdzad dpal gshegs/ /kyi hud yongs kyi bshes gnyen khyed/ /rigs 'dzin grub na gang la dgongs/ /sa rnams phal cher bcud dang bral//bcud rnams phal cher zhag gis bor/ /'od rnams kun kyang bkrag med gyur/ /chu bo dag kyang 'khyil zhing mtsho / / ri bo dag kyang rab tu 'dar/ /rtsi shing phal che sa la 'gyel/ /'di 'dra bems po'i rnam 'phrul la/ /sems ldan su zhig phebs par 'gyur/ /'on te nam mkha'i mtshan nyid la/ /kyi hud 'di yang sngar shul stor/ /shin tu dwangs pa rdul gyis gang / /sngo ham dud kha'i sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ /ci ste mig dang ldan pa yi/ /'phags pa rnams kyis bzod par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba 'jig rten sgron me rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'dar khyod bskul na/ /mig gcig glog ltar gang du gnyegs/ /rang gi thugs rjes ma dor cig /de ltar rgyal ba yab sras rnams/ gnas lnga mkhyen la rab brtse bas/ /mya ngan bral kyang mya ngan ltar/ /rje la bskul ma 'debs pa mthong e ma 'jig rten mgon po khyod/ /yongs su 'da' ba'i skabs mchis sam/ /'phags pa rnams kyis mi bzod na/ /btson rar bsdams pa'i sems can rnams/ /ci ste rang tshugs thub par 'gyur/ /mar me mdzad dpal khyed med na/ /bdag gis mun pa ji ltar chod/ /kyi hud thig le'i dbyings nas byon/ /mtshan dpes spras de nga la ston/ /drug cu'i gsung gis bdag dbugs phyung / /ye shes snang ba dus la bab/ /bdag 'dra yal bar ma dor cig /de nas nam mkha'i mthongs shed na/ /ltong ltongs rab 'tsher sgra cig byung / /zag med bde ba'i chu klung la/ /zhi bde'i bde 'bras bskrun pa las/ /'ching ba'i rtag phur ga la mchis/ /skye med 'ching bar gang 'dzin 'khrul/ /nga ni sprul ba'i dge slong yin/ /nga nyid bden par ma 'dzin par/ /nga yi gdams pa nyams su long / /re zhig lon nas paṃ zhig byung / /'dab stong rgyas pa'i pad mor gyur/ /de steng a las zla rgyas shar/ /de steng oṃ las thub pa mchog /mtshan dpes spras te lham mer gda'/ /de nas chu bo'i 'gram shed nas/ /mi snyan shub dus byed pa cig khar tsang dbyug gu'i zla tshesanas/ /mar me mdzad dpal dga' ldan du/ /mi yi skyabs de gshegs so skad / / da yang mkha' la 'od skor bcas/ /'jig rten sgron me 'ongs so skad/ /mun pa don gnyer ji ltar bya/ /lusacan tshe srog skyob ces grag /sha za'i tshogs rnams ji ltar bya/ /gnod sbyin rnams ni khrag la dga'/ /da ni skom pa gdungs par gyur/ /kyi hud ces pa nged kyi tshig /'brom rje dga' ba'i 'od zer shar/ /bdag cag 'ug pa lta bu'i tshogs/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ji ltar bzod/ /bdud kyi mthu dpung gang du nyal/ /nag po'i ngan —559—

bka' gdar/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/sngags gang la rdugs/ /zhes pa'i sgra skad de byung nas/ /'brom rje rig pa cung zad sos/ /rgyal ba'i sku la yar bltas pas/ /nyan thos chen po bcu drug tsam/ /mdun gyis bltas te rje la bskor/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs chags 'brom la gzigs/ /gangs ri'i mgul na 'brom rje khyed/ /mi mngon dbyings nas gzhan don brtson/ /bzod pa gsum gyi go cha can/ /bdud sde'i tshogs kyis mi phyed par/ /gangs ri'i rgyal po'i ngos la gnas/ /sprul ba'i nyan thos du ma yis/ khyod bstan bsrung zhing bka' bzhin sgrub/ /gang gi nyes tshe bdag cag khol/ /'di nas mi rabs du ma na/ /'dir tshogs las sbyor mngon du 'gyur/ /ding sang spyan ras gzigs dbang khyod/ /dngos kyi 'gro ba 'dren dus yin/ /po ta la yi rtse mo nas/ /dharma 'dir lhags rgyal ba bskrun/ /de yi gnas lugs spros bral la/ /skye 'jig gnas pa ga la mchis/ /bla ma bla na med pa la/ /btagags dang bzhugs pa ga la mnga'/ /'di ltar bla ma chos kyi sku/ /'jig tshogs gzugs su ma 'dzin gsung / /de nas 'brom rjes 'di skad zhus/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gsan du gsol/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i g.yo 'bul la/ /nyam thag gyur ba ji ltar bstan/ /rdo rje'i sku yi 'pho 'gyur la/ /chu shing snying po ji ltar rtag /chos kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur la/ /mi gtsang lus 'di ji ltar bde/ /nyi ma'i 'phel 'grib 'di 'dra na/ /srin po'i 'od kyis ji ltar tshugs/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i rba rlabs la / / ri gzar chu 'dra ji ltar gnas/ /ri rab lhun po skyod byed na/ /phra rab rdul 'dra gang du gnas/ /btsan sa zin nas gshegs gyur na/ /dbang med su zhig phebs par byed/ /kyi hud mar me mdzad dpal khyed/ /sos ka'i dus kyi nyi ma 'dra/ /gsal dus nyid na sprin gyis bsgribs/ /'grib pa ltar snang slar yang gsal/ /e ma bde mchog skrun pa khyed/ /nyi ma rgas kha'i 'od zer 'dra/ /shin tu gsal te nub la nye/ /bdag cag mi khom las kyis g.yengs/ /da ni mun yugs 'bab ste gda'/ /kyi hud nyam thag bdag la gzigs/ /thugs rje'i pha tshan dpung du bskyed/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun yun bsrings shig /kyi hud mtsho yi padmo khyed/ /ngang gis mi thub gshegs gyur na/ /chu med thang la skyes pa yi/ /me tog tshad pas gdungs pa nga / /'chi bdag glang pos mi rdzi'am/ /ro ma rlung gis mi bskyod dam/ /mkhyen par gzigs shig brtse ba can/ /dar gyi srin bu lta bu nga / /rang gi rnam rtog kha chus bcings/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus gyur na/ /skyabs gnas mchog gis bslu phod dam/ /e ma ltas chen 'di gzigs la/ /gzhan du gshegs pa'i skabs ma gzigs/ /bla ma bla ma zhes zhus pas/ /lan du snying cig glu la nyon/ /kye ho mar me mdzad dpal nga / /nam mkha' dag pa'i me tog 'dra/ /dang po'i skye tshul dbyibs dang 'dra / / bar du gnas tshul kha dog 'dra/ /tha mar 'gag tshul yal dang mtshungs/ /'chi med rdo rje'i glu de soms//kye ho mar me mdzad dpal nga / /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'ja' mtshon 'dra/ kha dog sna lnga mdzes pa'i dbyibs/—560—

'brom/ ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /skye ba me/da ceng gzugs su shar/ /bden pa med kyang byis pas ma/thong / /'jig pa re/da kyang yal chul ston/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum de dang 'dra/ /'chi med rdo rje'i glu de sems/ /kye ho mar mer mjad dpal nga / /me long dag pa'i ngos shed nas/ /gzhon nu'i byad bathin shar dang mchungs/ /'phos nga/ re/da pas gzugs shig byung / /byung ba nyid de stong pa nyid/ /stong pa nyid de gzugs su shar/ /de yang de ba'in shes par mdzod/ /'chi med rdo rje'i glu de soms/ /kye ho kye ho dge slong nga / /padma'i sbubs su rnam/ thar skyong / /seng ge'i khri la bstan pa 'dzin//rdo rje'i gdan la mnyam par 'jog /mya ngan sel byed glu ru len/ /'brom rje brag ri'i khrod dag tu/ /sprul ba nga yis glu blangs pas/ /rten 'brel brag cha khyod las byung / /glu de grag stong chig 'brus brgyan/ /skye gnas 'jig par mngon gyur na/ /brag cha rang nyid 'khrul bar zad/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs de bsgrags pas/ /bdud dang mu stegs rang zhi ste/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal gyur cig /sgra de drang ba'i don du sgrogs/ /tshig de ma 'dres so sor gsal/ /don de chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /sras khyod mya ngan ma byed cig /lan du smre sngags glu 'di blangs//rje mnyam pa med pa'i a ti sha /mi nyam thag bdag gi snying dkyil du/ /gdan rin chen padma'i lte ba la/ /sku mi 'gyur lhun por lham mer bzhugs/ /thugs mkhyen brtse'i ngang du lhan rner gson/ /gsung bden pa'i tshig gis byin gyis rlobs/ khyod 'gro ba yongs kyi chos rgyal la/ khong 'chi bdag su zhirga/ dgra bor ldang / /sku skye ba med pa'i rdo rje la/ /bdud sbrang bu'i gshog pas ji ltar sdigs/ /gsung grag stong snyan pa'i nga ro la/ /rgyud ma dag su yis brnyas par 'gyur/ /thugs bdag med rtogs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /las mi rtag rlung gis bskyod par nus/ /rje rkyen kha 'grim na dam pa min/ /rje 'chi ba med pa'i glu de dgongs/ /pha skye ba med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /gsung ca co ma mang glu dbyangs can/ /thugs 'pho 'gyur ma mang 8lhan rner bzhugs/ /mi kho bo'i spyi gcug mdzes par mdzod/ /mi kho bo'i ngag gis bka' gdams nas/ /nga yid dbang dkrug par ji ltar phod/ /lha gshegs par ma mdzad ze 'bru non/ /nga bka' gdams gnyen po bsten pa la/ /chos sde snod gsum las ma g.yos par//bka' rgyun chad med par stsal du gsol/ /gzhi lhag pa khrims kyi bslab pa de/ /nga gnyen po bstan pa'i sgos snangagayin/ /lam lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa de/ /nga gnyen po bstan pa'i sgo chos yin/ /mthar lhag pa shes ranga'ibaslab pa de/ /nga gnyen po bsten pa'i sgo chos yin/ /chos bslab pa gsum ldan rje yi sras/ /lha gdams pa bzhi yi skyabs 'og tu/ /bka' nyams pa med par tshad mar bzung / khyed bla ma'i gsung rab za ra tshags/ /rgyud nor bu'i phreng ba ma nyams par/ /dus 'di na bzung ste 'khor ba yi/ /gnas stongs kyi bar du rgyas par sgro'ikau ༈bka' legs par gdams so chos kyi rje/ /'di nyams pa med par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos 'di dang —56/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye skor/ldan par dpa' bor gyur/ /bka' legs par gdams pa'i dpa' bo nga / khyed lha dang bcas la 'bral glags med / / lus byin gyis rlobs shig mar me mdzad/ /ngag byin gyis rlobs shig a ti sha /yid byin gyis rlobs shig jo bo rje/ /bu ma smin ma yis 'bor glags med/ /rje 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i glu/ /bu skrag pa med pa bde ba'i mchog /don nyams pa med pa 'gro ba'i dpal/ /nga rnam thar gtsang ma'i glu tshig yin/ /kye pha gtsang bu gtsang brgyud pa gtsang / /las rgyu gtsang rkyen gtsang 'bras bu gtsang / /nga thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma yin/ /nged padma'i 'byung gnas rgya mtsho khyod/ /bka' rgyal ba'i mtsho las legs 'khrungs pa'i//sku 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje rgyal/ /don 'chi ba med do bla ma ba/ /bkra shis par gyur cig 'brom rje'i rgyud/ /de nasarje btsun che po ba/ /thu bo'i glu la dgyes bzhin du/ /ljags kyi padmo bkram gyur te/ /dung gi tshems las 'di bshar to/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'chi ba mi rtag lcag /'khor 'das gnyis kyi skyon yon soms gsungs nas/ /skyes mchog dam pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /sprin dengs 'od yal na/ma mkha' dag par gyur / / snying rje rje skad du rgyal ba 'brom/ /dus ngan pa dbyug gu 'chos (tshesakabazhi 'dir/ /rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nyi phyed nub/ khong thugs rje'i sprin tshogs mkha' la yal/ /zer stong ldan 'od zer mi gda' ba/ /mi snying med bdag gi snying rtsa 'dar/ /lus snying po med pa'i ba spu langs/ /mig me long 'dra ba mchi mas gang / /lar ldang snying 'dod de stobs dang bral/ /phyogs 'gro snying 'dod de byin pa 'dar/ /ngag shugs rings 'don pa'i dus tshod byung / /pha phyi rjes gzigs shig dri can rje/ /dus ding sang lo tog smin pa'i dus/ /tshes de ring nam yer chen po byung / /nga ma smin sad kyis mi 'khyer ram/ /pha ston dus mu ge ma btang cig /deng 'dus pa 'bral du ma gzhu cig khyed mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs te mchi/ /da la mor dbyings nas char sprin bsdus/ /chos gdams pa sbrang char zab mo phob/ /nga mya ngan tshad pas gdungs pa 'di/ khyed zhi bde'i chab kyis gsos par mdzod / / kye kyi hud bla ma a ti sha /kye kyi hud bla ma a ti sha /zhes smre sngags chen po rab bton pas/ /'brom bden zhes bu mo ljang gu zhig /shing seng lding 'khar ba phyag bsnams nas/ /rje shing la snying po che ba 'di/ /dus rgyun chad med par 'khor ba mdzod/ /pha mi mngon dbyings nas yang yang 'byon/ /shing 'di las skyes pa'i lo 'dab 'di/ /gzhi tshul khrims rlan gyis rgyun du bron/ /mi nga yin khyod dang 'bral mi srid/ /rlan sde snod gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i/ /bu rnam thar brgyud pa yab yum shes/ /'brom chos kyi spyan ldan yar la gzigs/ /skra lcang lo can de yar la theg /bzhin mthong bar dka' de nged la gzigs/ /rgyud nyon mongs rdul gyis ma gos pa/ /rkyen sa rdul bag res gos mi rigs/ /spyan mchi mas gang ba phar phyis la/ /pha 'jig rten sgrol ma'i zhal la —562—

'bror/ ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdar/sa bu ches bzhugs so/ /gzigs / / rje dri ma med pa byon gda' ba/ /sras ma ngu ma/ ngu snying rje can/ khyed mya ngan ridas pa'i mig gcig pu/ /yar bde ba chen pe'i sku la lhos/ /lha mar me mjad dpal ye shes 'a / /nged sgrol ma zhes byar tha snyad btags/ /des mun pa tshogs rab sgrol bar rgyal/ /sras rang rig ye shes ma bying zhig /bu yar gzigs yar gzigs yab la gzigs/ /nga yi phyag 'dis gang la reg gyur kyang / /rgyud bying ba gang dag gses par gyur / / 'brom dbugs phyin dga' bas yar bzhengs nas/ /ma/ sgrol ma'i phyag la brten te bltas/ /ma/dun mi gang cam gyi steng kha na/ /chad sran ma cam/ gyi thig le zhig /'od nyi ma zil gnon sa ler gda'/ /ga'i thig le de yi dbyings shed nas/ /pha 'od kyi rnam par ma/dun du byon/ /'brom de lta bas na de ltar spyod/ /rje nga ni thig le'i rang bzhin te/ /nga thig le'i ngang du stong par yal/ /nga stong pa'i ngang las thig ler shar/ /nga yi ge bral ba thig le'i chos/ /nga blo las 'das pa chos kyi sku/ /nga gzugs kyi rnam par 'gro la snang / khong 'gro ba'i blo ni zhabrul ba yin/ /sems 'khrul ba la snang rdzun pa yin/ /rdzun bden pa nyid du nga mi smra/ /bu rtsed mo yin no gro khar song / /zas bde ba bskyed pa'i ro mchog can/ /su zhen pa med par longs spyod pa/ /dus da lta nyid du g.yo mdag gyis/ /dus gung tshigs ma yol drongs nas 'doms/ /gsung de skad zer nas 'brom rje yis/ /nyams dpag med dga' bo gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /zas zhen pa med par tshogs su phul/ /ro chos kyi dbyings su bde bar shar/ /gnas snye thang 'or du de 'dra ba/ /chos zab mo'i mgo bo mi rtag pa'i/ /don gdams pa zab mo dngos su bstan/ /las rgyu 'bras med na mi/ 'byung bas/ /rje che mthar phyin pa'ang de 'dra na/ /lus chu bur lta bu'i srog ldan rnams/ /sems rtag par ma 'dzin snyug gis snun/ /lam bzhon pa bzang ngo/ smon lam gyis/ /gnas thar pa'i lam du kha lo bsgyur/ /chos 'chi ba med pa'i myang 'das de/ /don ye stong thig le chen po yin/ /de gnyis su med par nyams len mdzod/ /kye 'chi bas 'jigs rnar/sa/ 'chi med pa'i/ /glu bcu gcig thig le bzang po yin/ /dbyug gu'i tshes lngar gyur ba na/ /bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /rdo rje'i gdan gyi byang chub drung / /rgyal ba'i drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /mar me mdzad dpal bod du 'byon/ /u pa si ka la brten nas//gdul bya kun la phan thogs gsung / kho bos yang yang spyan drangs nas/ /lung bstan tshogs pas gnas 'dir byon / / e ma thugs rje mi pham par/ kho bo bzhag nas gang du btagegs/ /dga' ldan gnas su lung ma bstan//nga dang bod la thugs rtse gtad/ /nged kyi gnas lugs ji ltar gda'/ /rgyal ba gshegs pa'i skabs ma/chis sam / / dbyug gu'i tshes drug gyur ba nas/ /thugs rje chen po rab 'khrugs nas/ /a ti sha yi drung du phyin/ /rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su/ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma byon/ /rgyal ba bod kyi yul du byon/ /u pa si ka nyin —563—

bka' gdam/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mtshan du/ /rgya gar gnas nas paṇḍi ta/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas ma/cheg rin chen de/ /bod kyi mun pa sel slad du/ /da tshod 'byon par rig shes smra/ /e ma/ skyabs gcig bod du byon/ /gdul bya kun la phan thogs gsung / /lha mo'i thugs rjes 'dir lung bstan/ /dga' ldan gnas su 'gro ci lags/ /dbyug gu'i tshes bdun gyur ba na/ /bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /bde gshegs bde mchog mkha' la byon//mtha' 'khob gangs ri'i khrod du song / /gsang sngags chul dang mthun par mdzod/ /gar phab rdol thabs rab tu skyungs/ /rgyan rnams gsang ba'i gnas su gyon/ /thig le'i dbyings su 'brom rje thul/ /gsang sngags snod ldan de nyid gsung / /bka' lung gsan nas gnas 'dir byon/ /gsang ba du mas bdag smin nas/ /gcig pu smin zhes rgyal ba khyed/ /gzhan la ma gzigs gshegs ci lags/ /nyin cig tshes brgyad gyur ba na/ /ka ma la yi gtsug lag tu/ /mkha' 'gro dmar mo rgyan cha can/ /hur bag 'dzum gyis gar byed cing / /gangs ri'i khrod du khyed byon gsung / /sla la phan che'i nyams len rnams/ /thig le gcig tu nga la bskur/ /jo bo 'phrin las byon nam ci/ /dga' ldan gshegs pa'i skabs mchis sam/ /bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / khyed kyi gsung rab bzlog ka na'ang / /tshig gi rgya gar nyid du sleb/ /rgya gar bsdad na dgu cu gsum/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis bod yul du/ /don gsum bsten nas dga' ldan 'gro /da ni dus kyi tshigs la bab/ /zhing rnams lo tog smin pa'i dus/ /rta rnams gzhud lam gcod pa'i lo/ kho bo rdzu 'phrul bzhon pa bteg /dus la bab pas zhing gzhan 'gro / / ji ltar lung bstan kho bos sgrubs/ khyod kyi gnas 'dir bya ba byas/ khyod la khur bskur khur bor nas / / nyag cig byams pa'i zla la 'gro/ /hrīḥde kun da res smras pa yin/ /e ma/ bde gshegs bdun po byon//mig gcig gzigs la gsol ba thob/ /de nas bde gshegs thugs rje can/ /yab sras 'od kyis mchod par byas / / yab sras ting 'dzin cig la 'byams/ /rjes la'ang bde gshegs lham mer gda'/ /gsung las 'brom la khams gsos byon/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag cag gi /bya ba khyod kyis mdzad do 'brom/ /da dung go cha lhag par gyon/ /rgyal ba gshegs kyang bdag cag mchi/ khyod rjes bdag cag mchod tshogs dang / /nged kyang khyed dang dbyer med yin/ /legs so mgon po thugs rje can/ /legs so dga' ba'i ting 'dzin mdzod/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /ji skad gsungs pa de bzhin no/ /ji skad gsungs pa de bzhin te/ /nga yang khyed dang lhan cig tu /'bral med rgyun du sleb par mchi/ /de nas bde gshegs sras dang bcas/ /thams cad chos kyi dbyings su yal/ /'brom rje hrīḥdang bla ma nyid/ /ser po'i oṃ du gnas par gyur/ /de nas yig 'bru thig ler dril/ /dbyer med ro cig thig le 'di/ /bcu gnyis thig le bzang po'o/ /dbyug gu'i tshed dgur gyur —564—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ba'i tshe/ /'brom rje da dung yid ma ches/ /chu dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i/ /phyi yi chos la dpyad pa na/ /sngar las mya ngan che ba cam/ /shin tu dngangs te drung du zhus/ /na lend+ra yi gcug lag tu/ /bla ma/ dpag med der byon nas / / mgon po gangs ri'i khrod du byon/ /'gro ba gdul ba'i dus la bab/ /myur du kho bo la sogs pa'i//gdul bya mang po smin gyis gsung / /gnang ba zhus nas bod du byon/ /thugs dang yun du mi srid par/ /dga' ldan gshegs pa ji ltar lags/ /'on te dga' ldan gangs ri'am/ /'on te drin can gsung slu'am// /'on te spangs rtogs nyams srid dam/ /e ma da re nam zhig nongs/ /ma chor su yis dkrugs par 'gyur/ /dbyug gu'i tshes bcur gyur ba na/ /'brom rje tshogs 'khor shoms zhes gsung / /mthun pa'i tshogs 'khor dpag med bshams/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba dpag med 'dus/ /nang gi lha tshogs grangs las 'das/ /thams cad dkyil 'khor cig tu bzhugs/ /ting 'dzin la sogs mchod par mdzod/ /rdo rje nyams gar mchungs pa med/ /yud cig lon nas lha mchog bzhi/ /rang mtshan gzugs su 'brom la bskor/ /ma lus nged dang dbye ba med/ /bla ma'ang nged dang tha mi dad/ /mgon po de ring nyams dgar mdzod/ /de nas thugs rje chen po yis/ /bcu drug gzhon nu rgyan cha can/ /'od kyi gur nas dpag med rtse/ /res 'ga' hūm̐ dang phaṭa du sgrog /res 'ga' 'jum/ zhing 'jam pa'i gzugs/ /res 'ga' sku gsung yig 'bru gsum/ /res 'ga' sa bon hrīḥ dkar brjod/ /bla ma yi dam dpag med rnams/ /shin tu mnyes par dam tshig rgyas/ /de nas 'brom rje 'od du yal/ /re zhig gzugs su bstan pa na/ /lha tshogs thams cad yig 'brur gda'/ /yig 'bru bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ /bla ma thig le 'ba' zhig go /smra brjod mi mdzad dbyings su yal/ /de nas nyid kyi skur bstan te/ /bcu gsum thig le bzang bo'o/ /dbyug gu'i bcu gcig gyur ba na/ /bla ma cung zad snyung chul ston/ /sngon chad cung zad bstan pa'i tshe/ /rim/ gro mdzad cing lha re byon/ /de tshe sku khams dwangs mar gyur/ /da ni lha tshogs dpag med kyang / /bla ma'i sku khams gsos ma gyur/ /e ma da re 'di 'dra mthong / /bstan pa'i srog shing mi 'gyel lam/ /dam chos dpag bsam mi chag gam/ /dge ba'i rgya mtsho mi skam mam/ /phan bde'i chu rgyun mi chad dam/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi nub bam/ /ding sang las kyi rlung po che/ /bdag 'dra'i sgron mas mthong gyur tam/ /mun pa sol cig mar me mdzad / / mgon skyabs mdzod cig a ti sha /bod 'bangs ma 'bor jo bo rje/ /dga' ldan chos rgyal dam pa'i sa / / der gshegs drang bya su zhig yod/ /rgyal ba rang bde lhur len nam/ /bcu gnyis dus su 'di skad zhus//sngon chad rgyal ba dpag med dbus/ /bla ma chos ston mdzad gyur cing / kho bo'i zhing khams 'og min 'dra/ /e —565—

bka' gdams ngape dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i ga3 zos kyi skor/ma nga ni ci 'dra mchi/ /'brom rje rmus long 'khyams shing dogs/ /nyi ma sprin gyis g.yogs kyis dogs/ /zla ba gza' yis mi 'dzin nam/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyis ji ltar dpyad/ /bcu gsum gyur tshe 'di skad zhus/ /sngon chad byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor/ /dpag med sher phyin ston gyur na'ang / /rgyal ba gshegs na su yis ston/ /bdag cag nyan thos lta bu rnams/ /bshes gnyen dam pa khyed med na/ /lam mchog bzang po su la nyan / /gdul bya gang la dmigs nas sgrog /skyabs cig bka' lung bstan du gsol/ khyed kyi dgongs pa ngas ma lon / / bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / khyod kyi dgongs pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgya mtsho bzhin/ khyod kyi 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas/ khyod kyi mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /nam mkha'i mthas khyab sems can gyi/ /re re'i mdun na khyed sku re/ /de dang mthun pa'i chos ston na/ /de 'dra'i thugs rje chen po khyod//'di na dpal du gnas bzhin du/ /nga la dgos pa ma mchis pas/ /da ni zhing khams mang po lta/ /sdod na'ang nga la dbang yod mod/ /'di 'dra'i lus kyi bkod pa rnams/ khyod la bstan gyis ltad mor gzigs/ /de nasasteng 'og phyogs bcu rnams/ /rje bcun sku yi khyab par gyur/ /de mthong 'brom rje sku khams gsos/ /snyug til 'bras kyi zhing 'dra ba'i/ /bsam mi khyab sku ji ltar lags/ /sras shig gzigs la cig ma 'dzin/ /nga ni sprul ba'i dge slong yin/ /nga ni bdag med rdo rje yin/ /rdo rjes shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gang / /rdo rje 'chi med phun tshogs la/ /rdo rje mchog gis rab tu bskor/ /'brom rje rdo rjes rtag tu skyobs/ /de ni rdo rje'i glu tshig yin/ /'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi thob/ /de phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ /di paṃ ka ra rdo rjes bskyed/ /gang na gnas kyang 'chi med brtan/ /rdo rje nyid yin nga la gzigs/ /sra ba'i rdo rje phar 'joms yin/ /gang gis tshur la 'jig mi nus / / 'on kyang thig ler gnas kyang shes/ /yungs kar tsam zhig 'brom la thim/ /slar yang rgyal ba'i skur bstan to/ /thig le nyid las ma 'das gsung / /bcu bzhi thig le bzang po'o/ /dbyug gu'i bcu bzhir gyur ba'i tshe/ /de ring mchod pa shoms shig gsung / /'gyur khyad bsam mi khyab pa 'ong / /'od dpag med pa'ang 'byon par yod/ /gzhan yang lha tshogs dpag med 'byon/ /bla ma rnams kyang mkha' la gda'/ /'brom rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /phun tshogs 'byon pa'ang nyams dga' ste/ /nga yi bla ma mi gshegs sam/ /gsung zhing mchod tshogs du ma sbyar/ /re zhig lon tshe 'di skad gsung / /u pa si ka 'dir sdod dang / /nga la dri rgyu ma mchis sam/ kho bo yar la 'gro ba 'dug /lhan skyes lha yang ngu zhing 'dug /nag po rnams kyang de ring ngu / /bdun cu don gsum phyi bzhin 'brangs/ /da ni dus la bab ces thos/ shar la gzigs dang lha yis gang / /dri za rnams kyang mchod par byed/ /sngar gyi glu dbyangs deng mi gda'/ /lho yi phyogs la phar gzigs dang / /rgyal —566—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /ba mang pos spyan 'dren gda'/ /grul bum rnams kyang mchod pa 'bul/ /sngar gyi gzi brjid deng mi gda'/ /'brom rje nub kyi phyogs la gzigs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bsu zhing gda'/ /glu yi tshogs kyang mchod tshogs khyer / / 'dzam bu'i chu bo bkrag can yang / /de ring sngar gyi 'od mi gda'/ /klu rnams phal kyang mchi ma 'byin/ /la la gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ kho bo 'gro ba'i ltas su gda'/ /'brom rje rgyab phyogs byang la gzigs/ /byang gi rgyal ba sras bcas lhags/ /bdag la bsu ba byed cing gda'/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyang mchod tshogs khyer / / sngar gyi stobs rnams deng mi gda'/ /gzi nyams gdong la lag gis bkab/ /mig 'bur mchi ma'i rba rlabs g.yos/ /ri 'gul sa g.yo rtsi shing 'gyel/ kho bo 'gro ba'i ltas su gda'/ /mkha' 'gro mang po'ang spyan chab 'byin/ /lha tshogs rnams la'ang 'od mi gda'/ khyod la snying gtam tsam zhig bshad/ /'on kyang mya ngan/ ma mdzad cig /'brom rjes gsung de thos gyur nas/ /yus che ltas kyang ngu ba mthong / /rnga mo bu dang bral ba bzhin//dngangs skrag chen pos sa la 'gyel/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor mchis mas dag /yun ring rig pa 'gags par gyur / / bla ma'i thugs kyis ma bzod pas/ /e ma kho bo'i tshig gis nyes/ /nga yi bu gcig sa la 'gyel/ /spyan chab 'don zhing 'brom la 'jus/ /phan bde'i phyag gis dbu nas bteg /pha bzang sras po yar la bzhengs/ kho bo mi 'gro drung na mchis/ /mgon po'i dbu mchog yar la bteg /lcang lo can yang rdul gyis gos/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sa yis gang / /sa dang spyan chab 'dres gyur nas/ /thugs rje'i spyan de 'gro bar gda'/ /e ma mig gcig pha la ltos/ /e ma rgyal ba 'gog ma mdzad/ /'di 'dra tha mal spyod pa yin/ /da re gsung zhing dbu nas 'degs/ /lha mo sgrol ma'ang der byon nas/ /'degs 'os 'degs par mi mdzad par/ /dpa' bo bzod phub gang du 'gyur/ /e ma khyod bden 'brom rje mchog /gsung zhing lha mo'ang spyan chab 'byin/ /de nas dran pa rnyed tsam na/ /jo bos 'brom rje brten gyur nas/ /phyag g.yas sa rdul sol zhing gda'/ /sgrol ma'ang rgyan cha ma gsol bar/ /'brom la gzigs te 'di skad gsung / /'phags pa thugs ngan ma mdzad cig khyod bden 'jig rten skyabs gcig pu/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' tshul ston/ /bstan pa'i khur chen khyod la bskur/ /ma dag sems can 'dul ba bab/ /bzod par mdzod cig 'brom rje mchog /gang bskur khur zhig theg pa can/ /gsung zhing me tog 'dab ma zhig /bzung nas 'brom gyi spyan chab 'phyid/ /mchi ma'i gseb nas bla ma mthong / /thub pa'i sku mchog nyid du gda'/ /ji ltar bla mas brten gyur tshe/ /lhag par yus che ma brten 'gyel/ /slar yang bla mas yar la skyor/ /mgon pos bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /snyigs ma'i sems can gdul ba dka'/ /bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib rba klong 'dra/ kha phub zhabs rdol sbags pa mang / /phan bde'i bcud rnams gang du blugs/ /—567—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/e ma rgyal ba gshegs gyur na/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang la bgyid/ /dmu rgod sems can ji ltar 'dul/ /brel gang bzhag nas gshegs khom mam/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i drin po che/ /phal cher 'dul khrims gtsang la bkod/ /dam tshig can 'dod dam tshig la/ /bkod nas drin lan ma 'khor bar/ /phyi rjes mi gzigs gang du gshegs/ /snga lugs ngan pa dor byas nas/ /tha mal khyim pa'ang rang mthun pa'i/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims mchog la bkod/ /mi lus longs spyod srog med pa/ khyod kyis snying por sbyar mdzad nas/ /da dung bsngo ba mdzad gyur cing / /yun du skyong bar mi mdzad par/ /phyi thag mi sring ji ltar lags/ /bdag cag rmongs pa'i bod khams rnams/ khyed gsung sgrub par ma nus pa/ /rgyal pos rgyal po'i khrims lugs bzhin/ /la la'i zhor la dpag med rnams/ /tshad las zhor la gcod mdzad dam/ /e ma chos rgyal rin po che/ khyed min skyababakagazhan mi gda' bas/ /da dung yun du bzhugs su gsol/ /brtse bar dgongs te bzhugs su gsol/ /gsol ba thebs par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrol ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /rgyal ba 'brom rje gang gsung ba/ /bla ma khyed kyis sgrub tu gsol/ /jo bo'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /rtag tu 'di bzhin dman cha long / /bdag 'dzin skad du gzhan don mdzod/ /mdo sde zab mo ma gtogs pa'i/ khyod la bshes gnyen ngas ma mthong / /rtag tu mdo sde bsten par mdzod/ /bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'dul ba yin/ /ston pa'ang 'dul ba nyid du bshad/ /rtag tu 'dul bar 'dzin byed cing / /gzhan yang 'dul 'dzin ci mang mdzod/ /tshul khrims rin chen spel byas na/ /dgos 'dod thams cad de las 'byung / /rgyu 'bras zab mo 'gro la phan/ /skyes bu gsum po rgyun tu brten/ /bdag med thabs kyis ma go'i bar/ /lta ba mthon po bstan mi bya/ kho bo rgyal po'i rigs yin yang / /rgyal bzhin chad las ga la byed/ kho bo'i rgyal tshab khyod la bskur/ /rgyal ba rgyal po'i spyod pa mdzod/ /de ni chos rgyal dam pa yin/ /bstan la phan na ci yang mdzod/ /nyi chos spyi chos ma slu cig /phan na shin tu dben par ston/ /de ni bslab bya dam pa yin/ /'brom rje 'od dpag med la gzigs/ /rgyal ba khyod kyis lung bstan nas/ /bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes/ /da ni dga' ldan 'gro'o gsung / /dam pas bslu bar ji ltar rung / /bla ma bzhugs sar bka' lung gsol/ /'od dpag med pas 'di skad gsung / /bdag dang bla ma dbye ba med/ khri/na chad med par gnas 'dir 'ong / /gzhan yang lha tshogs dpag med rnams/ /de bzhin bdag kyang de bzhin no//gsungs nas thams cad 'od du yal/ /'od rnams bla ma'i sku la 'dus/ /bla ma thig le chen po nyid/ /'brom rje rong gio thugs la thim/ /yan chod mngon gyur tsam zhig brjod/ /slar yang bla ma nyid skur gda'/ /thig le chen pa bca lnga ba'/ /—568—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dbyug gu'i nya la sleb pa'i tshe/ /mchog dang thun mong dpag med pa'i/ /snga ltas khyad par 'phags pa byung //bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ kho bo ma dag rmi lam na/ /yer ba'i brag ri 'gyel ba rmis/ / nyi zla gza' yis zin pa rmis/ /char med chu bo skams pa rmis/ /rtsi shing thams cad 'gyel ba rmis/ /spang ljongs thams cad sgrogasapa rmis/ /me tog thams cad rnyings pa rmis/ /chu mig khron pa skams pa rmis/ /zhing rnams phal cher 'busakhyer gyur/ /dka' spyad 'bras bu ser bas khyer/ /sngar rgyas me tog sad kyis bcom/ /sngon chad snying gi sgo'abru la/ /rgyun chad med par bla ma bzhugs/ /de tshe ze 'bru nyid kyang stor/ /bzhugs gnas thams cad stong par gda'/ /de 'dra'i rmi lam rung gyur tam/ /e ma bag chags de 'dra gda'/ /ring por mi thogs rgyal ba 'da' / / bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /bstan pa'i bdag po bshes gnyen 'brom/ /lha cig dag pa'i rmi lamon/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar/ /zla ba'ang rang 'od nyams pa med/ /rgyu skar tshogs kyang gsal zhing gda' / / bstan pa'i ljon shing rab rgyas te/ /ljon pa 'brom gyis skyong ba rmis/ /ljon pa re re'i rtsa na yang / /dag byed rdzing bu dpag med rmis/ /'brom rjes klu bzhin skyong ba rmis/ /rdzing 'brom gser gyi bye ma brdal/ /'brel sras dpag med spyod pa rmis/ /g.yin yang utpal dpag med 'khrungs/ /ātpal re la sgrol ma re/ /sgrol ma re re drung na yang / /sprul ba'i 'brom rje dpag med gda'/ /'brom rje re yi spyi gcug na/ /'od dpag med la phyogasabacu yi/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bskor te gda'/ /'brom rje re re'i 'khor na yang / /lo brgyad gzugs 'dra dpag med pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor/ /gzhan yang pad sdong nam mkha' gang / /thams rtad bde bar gshegs pas khyab/ /bde gshegs cig gis bya ba sprul/ /des kyang sprul te de tsam zhig /re re'i masdun na'ang 'brom rje re/ /snying po 'dzin pa'i 'brom ni cig /ting 'dzin zhig la bzhugs pa rmis/ /bu ga cig rmeske / bltas pa na/ /phyi yi lnga ltas 'od 'phro tsam/ /re zhig lon nas sprul ba rnams/ /'od kyi rnam pas bu sko gder / / bstims te bdag kyang de shul du/ /phyin pas bskal ba dpag med 'byams/ /de nas bu gar thon pa na༈ / dag pa'i gnyid las sad par gyur/ /dge ba'i rmi ltas shin tu bzang / /de ring sgyu ma'i sprul ba cig /slar yangaglang po brgyad sprul nas/ kho bo dga' ldan gshegs zhes zer/ /gzhan yang sgyu ma'i skyes bu zhig /sprul ba gsheg shesangu ba thos/ /sgyu ma mi bden sprul ba rdzun/ /ngu ba rdzas su grub 'gyur ram/ /gzhan yang sprul ba'i khyekhung zhig /sro ma'i yan lag brgya ru bshags/ /gcig gi nang du dga' ldan bkod/ /dga' ldan gnas na lha lhagasarnams/ /pad sdong bzang po skyong byed cing / kho bo 'ong zhes dga' ba bsgom/ /gnyis par gling bzhi ri rangabakod/ khong seng rnams na lha min dga'/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gshegs zhes ngu / kha ba can rnams 'brom —569—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rjes gang / /re re'i mdun na'ang kho bo gnas/ /bla ma dga' ldan gshegs so zhes/ /don med mchi ma 'don pa mthong / / sgyu ma'i glang po chen po zhig /mgo dgu'i stag gis rab ded nas/ /dga' ldan ma gshegasang skyobasazer / / mig gcig de 'dra'i ltad mo mthong / /ri bong g.yu yi ral ba can/ /mgo na rnon po'i rwa yis brgyan / / dpal rtsal shugs kyis sder mo bgrad/ /seng ge glang chen rab 'das nas/ /dngangs skrag sems kyis nga drung byung / /dga' ldan ma gshegs nged skyobasazer/ /gzhan yang sras shig nga la nyon/ /mo sham bu zhig tshad pas gdungs/ /rab skom mig sgyu'i chu mthong nas/ /'thung du phyin pas rus sbal zhig /ral ba ring po mtsho la drangs/ /chu med skyes bu rab bcings nas/ /dbang med smre sngags chen po 'don/ /dmu rgod rusasbal gdug rtsub can/ /snyigs ma'i dus tshod ngan pa byung / /dbang med kho bo bcings gyur nas/ /dge ba'i gnas su 'gro ma ster/ /da re jo bo chen po zhes/ /dga' ldan ma gshegs kho bo khrol/ /bden med khur chen gnya' bar khum//'brom rje de don shes lags sam/ /a cang de yang grag stong yin/ /dang por ma skyesargyu yis stong / /bar du mi gnas rkyen gyis stong / /tha mar mi 'gag 'bras bus stong / /skye 'gag gnas gsum rang grol ba'i// 'chi med rdo rje kho bo yin/ /'chi med 'chi ba de dang mtshungs/ /lta ba spros bral chen por shor/ /sgom pa 'od gsal chen por yal/ /spyod pa thabs mkhas gzhan don yin/ /bdag med dbang gis gsum ga rdzogs/ / bdag med rdo rje chen po nga / /rkyen gyis 'jig par ga la nus/ /skye 'chi med pa'i dge slong yin/ /'chi med 'chi ba de dang mtshungs / / sbyan ras gzigs dbang nga la nyon/ /nga ni rnam dag chos sku yin/ /ye stong lhun gyis grub pa la/ /'chi med 'chi ba de dang mtshungs/ /padma 'dam na gnas gyur kyang / /mi gtsang 'dam can ga la yin/ /nga ni 'khor bar gnas 'dra yang / /skye 'chi'i dge slong ga la yin/ /dī paṃ ka ra mar me mdzad/ /ye shes snying po'i grag stong glu/ /bdag med shes nas 'chi med sgrogs/ /rdo rje'i glu yin ga la 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas de mkhyen nam/ /phyi rol yul lnga'i snang bas stong / /yul can dbang po skye bas stong / /gnyis med gzung 'dzin rang grol bas/ /'chi med rdo rje de dang mtshungs/ /stong pa'ang stong pas stong gyur na/ /'dus byas chos lugasag la srid/ /'dus ma byas min mtha' las grol/ /thog mtha' med pa'i dge slong yin/ /lus 'di dor ba ci yang med/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs gnyen pos stong / /chos rnams thams cad skye med na/ /rang gi mtshan nyid rang grol yin/ /rten med gzhan ni ga la 'byung / /dngos dang dngos med ye stong na/ /'chi ba dmigs par ga la 'gyur/ /rang gi ngo bor rang stong yin/ /byis pas ma bslad 'phags pas kyang / /bzang por btang ba cig kyang med/ /bla ma chos dbyings chen por yal/ /'brom rje dga' bde chen pos tshim/ /bcu drug nyin par 'di —570—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /skad zhus/ /lan du rdo rje'i glu 'di gson/ /dbyings rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /rje sangs rgyas stong gi sprul bas bskor/ /dpal 'gran zla med pa'i rje btsun pa/ /mi kho bo'i spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /ngag yan lag drug cu'i nga ro yis/ /dus thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos/ /rje bla ma'i snyan du mchod pa 'bul/ /ma grangs med 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /lus bkod pa stong gis tshad med 'gyed/ /nga bka' gdams rin chen rgyas gyur cig /tshes bcu bdun nyin par 'di skad zhus/ /rje rnam dag chos kyi zhal yas na/ /'od dpag med 'gyed pa'i mar me mdzad / /dpal 'gran zla med pa'i a ti sha /mi kho bo'i snying gi rgyan du bzhugs/ /sems 'od gsal chos kyi dga' ba can/ /nyams rtag tu dga' bar bla mas mdzod/ /rje yun ring khyed la brten gyur bas//dus lan cig nyes pa srid gyur na/ khyed mtshungs med rje la gshegs su gsol/ /nga mar gyur 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs su/ /ya'i ku re ma yin byin gyis rlobs/ /dus nyin mtshan bsams pa'i gsol 'debs yin/ /mi nga la 'khor ba dgos mi gda'/ /ma yal bar dor na 'brom rje min/ /mi nga la rang 'dod ci yang med/ khyed rgyal ba rnams kyi bka' srol yin/ /nga dge bsnyen mi gcig ci yang bde/ /gnas 'khor ba'i ljon pas 'gab rtsa mnan/ /dus da lta phyin kyang thar gyur te/ /drin dpag med che ba'i khrel gzhung skyong / /hrīḥbade gshegs gsung 'bru rab tu bzang / /hūm̐ snying rje chen pos phyogs mtha' khyab/ /a skye ba med pa'i gnas lugs yin/ /lha khyod la 'chi ba ga la mnga'/ /snying nye ba'i sems khral khur lugs yin/ /phaṭa rnam rtog thams cad zhi bar mdzod / / phaṭa nga ni bdag med dbyings su thim/ /nga bdag med ngang nas bsngo ba byed/ /rje rnam rtog sprin gyis ma g.yogs pa'i/ /kun sa le mkhyen pa'i tshogs rab rnams/ khyed rnam dag mkha' la dpang por bzhugs/ /nga byas dang byed 'gyur byed pa rnams/ /ma mtha' med don du rgyal bar bsngo/ /zhing bzang po skyabs dang pha ma rnams / / sems bzang po gzhan don nyag gcig yin/ /rgyu dngos bzang phyin drug tshad med yin/ /las smon lam bzang pos sbrel ba yin/ /rten skye 'phags rnams kyis dus gsum du/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa gang yin pa/ /dus gcig tu bsdus te bsdoms byas nas/ /ma grangs med byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /sgos 'brom rjes nga yis dus gsum du/ /las tshul gnas thos dang bsam bsgoms pa'i/ /tshogs bzang po thob pa gang yin des/ /kun kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog /rje bla ma dam pa gsan du gsol/ /sngar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /dus da lta yan chod 'di lta ste/ /lus ngan pas sku la ma nyes sam/ /ngag ngan pas gsung skad ma bcag gam/ /sems ngan pas thugs sun ma phyung ngam/ /sgo nyes par gyur na gsung du gsol/ /gzhan mthong thos dogs gsum gnas mchis pa/ /thugs ma bsgribs mkhyen pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /de bzod par gsol —571 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gyis bzhes su gsol/ /de mi ldog rdo rje'i glu len yin/ /thugs dpag med dges pas glu de gzigs/ /lha 'jig rten sgrol ma 'di skad gsung / /mi kho bos mi mthong cing yang med/ /mi khyod kyis nyes pa ri bong rwa/ /dus rtag tu dad pa'i ljon shing rgyas/ /da gus pa'i 'bras bu tshim par gyur/ /rje bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ khyod nyi ma'i 'od la 'phel 'grib bral/ /gling rim kyis bskor kyang nye ring med/ /lar ma dag gdul bya'i bsod nams la/ /'od sprin gyis g.yogs pa'i snang ba byung / /sprin dus kyi char sprin bzang po mā /rje rgyal ba khyod kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /dus rgyun chad med par bdag gi mgon/ /rgyud 'khor ba'i don du brtse bar mdzod/ /sku sprul ba bsam gyi mi khyab cing / /gsung dam pa chos su rab tu sgrogs/ /thugs gnyis su med pa'i dge 'dun te/ /yum dbyer med cig tu tshim par mdzod/ /rje bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsung / /'brom byams pas dbu mdzad dga' ldan pa/ /sngar 'dzam gling don du bzhugs gsung na'ang / /dus di ring yar la gshegs zhes 'dzer / / 'brom zhabs tog che'o dad gus can/ /las smon lam bzang ngo sras gcig pu/ /da bstan pa'i khur chen mgo la gyon/ /las ci yang bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /rdzas gang yang phigs pa'i mtshon cha zungs/ /gzhi rab tu brtan pa'i mkhar la bzhugs/ /bu khyod kyi 'dun ma kho bos sgrub/ /dus rgyun chad med par drung du 'ong / /dus gnangs nas nga yi rjes 'di zung / /'phral 'dzer ba 'dra yang 'og tu mchi/ /mi khyod kyi mdun ma lha mos sgrub / / rdzas dngul dkar maṇḍal bzhi po la/ /rje mtshan nas brjod cing gsol ba thob/ rten dge 'dun bzhi sde yod na bzang / /dus de nas nga yang rgyun par 'byung / /rje bla ma'i zhal nas de gsungs nas/ /sku thig le chen po gcig tu mdzad/ /kye da dung thig le ma mdzadacig /dus de ring kho bos mnyam par gzhag /bdag ting 'dzin brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ dbyug gu'i bco brgyad nyin mo'i tshes/ /rje bla ma'i drung du 'di skad zhus/ /dus na ning da tshod nas bzung nas/ /dus de ring phan chad nyin re bzhin/ /'brom nga yi sprul ba du ma yis/ khyed bzhugs su gsol phyir mchod par 'bul/ /dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba btab/ /sgos khrums zla'i bco lngar gyur ba nas/ /dus de ring phan chad bzhugs su gsol/ khong bu slob gzhan yang snyung bstan nas/ /thugs dgyes par ma gyur mchod cing gsol/ /dus de ring dga' ldan gshegs zhes gsung / khyed bzhugs par ma gnang bod khams kyi/ /las bsags pa thogs tu smin pa yin/ /da mi phan dag par gshegs rting la/ /thugs brtse ba chen pos rgyun du zung / khong ma dag gdul bya'i blo ngo la/ /phyi bems rig la sogs mya ngan pa'i/ /ltas ngan pa zhi nas bzang por mdzod/ /kun dag pa'i snang ba mchog la 'khod/ /rje bla ma'i zhal nas bgyi gsungs nas / / gnas thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang / /dgung 'ja' tshon shig shig rab tu shig /'od stong ldan —572—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /phyogs bcur rab tu 'phro/ /sngar ma grags snyan pa'i sgra chen grags/ /dri phun sum tshogs pa'i ngad pa ldang / //rdzas rin chen gser g.yu'i me tog babs/ /gzhan sprul ba'i me tog blos mi 'khyud/ /kye snang ba thams cad dag par byas/ /ltas phun sum tshogs par du ma shar/ /blo tha mal rnams kyang ngo mtshar skyes/ /'ja' kha dog lnga ba rje la zug /rje bla ma'i 'od zer 'brom la phog /gsung dag pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsung / /oṃ āḥhūm̐ thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkra shis kun gyi gzhi/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ rin chen pad sdong mdzes/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sku gsung thugs rje rgyas/ /rje dus gsum rgyal ba dpag med kyis/ /rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i bkra shis gang / / dus de ring de 'dra'i phun tshogs rnams/ /yul du ma'i slad du bkra shis shog /rje rgyal ba stong gis dus gsum du/ /rgyud phun sum tshogs pas phyug mdzad pa'i/ /phugs kun gyi dpal gyur smon lam gang / /dus de ring gnas 'dir 'grub par shog /las bzang pos rtag tu 'grub gyur ba'i/ /rje rgyal ba stong gi bkra shis rnams / / dus de ring gnas 'dir phun sum tshogs te/ /da phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i/ /rje rgyal ba'i sku mchog gang yin pa/ /gnas 'khor ba'i sems can dpag med kyis / / dus ring bor mi thogs myong bar shog /gsung bzang po yan lag drug cu'i chos/ /dus rtag tu dge ba'i 'bru chags te/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ zhes pa/ /mi kho bo'i rjes su 'grub par shog /de smon lam bkra shis spel ma yin/ khyed rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'di gson mdzod/ /gnas thugs rje'i sprin gyi dbyings shed na/ /skyabs mtshungs pa med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /bu rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas yun ring du/ /'di sras kyi thu bo mchog tu skyong / / nga mar me mdzad dpal de ring nyid/ /blo the tshom mun gyis ma bsgribs par/ /sems rtse gcig mi g.yor gsol ba 'debs/ /hrīḥbadag gi sras 'di byin gyis rlobs/ /da ni zhu ba nyid du gsol/ /da ni smon lam bzang por 'debs/ /skyon gyis ma gos rab mdzes pa'i/ /padma'i sbubs nas legs bltams nas/ /seng ge'i khri la seng ge yi/ /nga ros bdag med chos ston shog /srid pa'i chu klung nges sems shing / /sdug bsngal ri bo bsnyil gyur nas/ /thar ba'i them skas gsos gyur te/ /'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog /ser sna'i 'ching ba rab grol zhing / phongs med 'byor ba rgyas par shog /mtho ris bzang po rab brgyud de/ /sgo gsum khrims kyis brgyan par shog /tshad med go char rab gyon zhing / /bzod pa'i stobs kyi 'chun par shog /chos la chog shes mi mnga' zhing / / spro dgas thams cad sdud par shog /glang chen bzhengs dang bzhugs 'dra ba/ /mthar thugs bsam gtan lhun grub shog /spyi dang bye brag ma lus pa'i/ /gnas lugs yul can shes par shog /phan bde'i thabs dang ma bral bar/ /pha rol phyin pa mchog tu shog /bde gshegs bdun dang kun bzang gis/ /smon lam ci —573—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/btab stobs ldan pa/ /thams cad nges par 'grub par shog /ye shes gnad du phyin gyur te/ /bsam gyisami khyab mthar thug pa/ /'bras mchog sku gsum mnyes par shog /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab dpal gyur ba/ /bkra shis dam pa mchog ldan gang / /deng 'dir bde legs bkra shis shog /nyi zla sprin gyis ma g.yogs ltar/ /gzugs can ma lus gsal byed cing / /rnam rtog mi mnga' 'gro ba'i dpal/ /de 'dra'i bkra shis lhun grub shog /rin chen lhun po lta bu yi/ /lta bas mi ngoms gzi brdzid can/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i bkra shis gnas/ /bkra shis lhun po rgyas gyur shog /'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /de dang mthun pa dpag bsam shing / /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bkra shis gnas/ /bkra shis mchog rab rgyas gyur shog / lha dang mi yi bkra shis pa/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin shis par shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis gang / /shin tu shis pa mchog bsngags pa/ /skad cig nyid la gnas mchog 'dir/ /bde ba por shis par shog /de nasasku lus stong du sprul/ /la la rgya gar phyogs la gshegs/ /bla ma'i zhing khamasalta zhes gsung / /la la kha che'i yul du gshegs/ /la la bal po'i mthil du'ang gshegs/ /e ma de kun mtshon don yin/ /zhing khamasadapag med khyab par gshegs/ /lha yi tshogs rab 'od du zhu/ /'od kyi rnam par rje la bskor/ /rje ni mi gang tsam du 'phags/ /de nas sras la mdun gzigs nas/ /mtshungs med rgyal ba rgya mtsho khyod/ /nyin dang mtshan du thugs rje'i dpung / /snyil bar ma mdzad yun du srings/ /sras kyi thu bo go cha gyon/ /bdun cu don gsum bzang po'i dpal/ /mi yi 'brel ba de tsam yin/ /de ring lo zla tshes grangs bzang / /bde 'dod skye bos bcu gnyis zlar / / dka' spyad 'bras bu lo tog yin/ /'bras bzang dus su kho bo 'gro /utpal sngon po sa la rdol/ /ston dus bzang po'i dus tshigs yin/ /dus tshigs bzang po'i zla dus la/ /bzang po dpag med khyod la gtad/ /'di bzhin dge ba'i lo tog rnams/ /mchog rab mchog tu 'ong zhes gsung / /de nas 'od kyi gzhal yas su/ /mi mngon chos kyi dbyings su yal/ /gzhan snang rtog pa brid pa'i phyir/ /sku gdung 'ba' zhig shul du bzhag /a mes rgya gar gnas su btang / /lo tsā ba yang bal por btang / /'brom rje 'ba' zhig dgongs pa yis sku gdung gnyer du rab tu bsngags/ /mi snyung dus su mya ngan mdzad/ /gshegs tshe bon ston la sogs pa/ /thugasakhral mdzad rnams dbugs 'byin cing / /gdul bya'i las la ma bskos na/ /rgyal ba'ang de ltar gshegs gyur te / / 'dasapa'i las la 'gyod mi phan/ /thugs khral ma mdzad gsol ba thob/ /mchod pa gang 'byor myur du shoms / / ngu cong tha maldospyod pa yin/ /gsung zhing thams cad sems gso byed/ /de bzhin 'jig rten mthun par mdzad/ /nang du lha tshogs dpag med rnams/ /rgyal ba'i zhing spyod thugs dam mdzad/ /gzhan yang khye'u —574—

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dkar po'i gzugs/ /yang yang dga' ldan bla ma'i drung / /byon zhing myur du snye thang du/ /gdung dang ring bsrel gzhan la ston/ /thun mong lha sku'ang g.yin la ston/ /mi mngon zab la rgya che ba/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag rin chen yin / / shing pho rta yi lo dus su/ /dbyug gu'i gung tshes bco brgyad la/ /rtag 'dzin mi rtag bskul ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba dbyangs su thig ler yal/ /bcu drug sbas pa'i thig le'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'phrin las can/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sku bltams yang / /rtag par brtse bar mtshan gsol ba/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshungs pa med/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas kyang / /za hor rgyal po'i sras su bltams/ /dī paṃ ka rar mtshan gsol ba/ /thub pa che zhes mtshungs pa med/ /e ma rgyal ba yab sras gnyis/ /smon lam dbang gis gnas 'dir 'dzom/ /las can bzang po'i lam la bkod/ /sras kyis bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhus/ /bla mas bdud rtsi'i sbrang char phab/ /tha rgod sra ba'i dad med kyang / /yun du bsrings pas tshos par gyur/ /gsang sngags phyi nang lha tshogs dang / /bka' stod (sdod3chos skyong srung ma dang / / gzhan yang dpag med skyabs mchog gi /rgyal ba'i zhing 'dir lung bstan nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag rkyen gyis/ /mtha' 'khob yul gyi dbus su mdzad/ /bka' drin can de bco brgyad la/ /bdag cag bzhag nas gshegs gyur to/ /bla ma'i lha dang chos skyong rnams/ /dwa phrug khyed kyis ma bskyangs na/ /bar dor sgyid lug gyur gyis dogs/ /nges par skyobs shig bka' stod (sdodakarnams/ /dpag bsam sdong po 'gyel rting la/ /'bad rtsol zas skal ma bcad cig /nor bu rin chen stor rting la/ /'phrin las gang bcol khyed kyis sgrubs / / btsan sa ma zin sgyid lug rnams/ /phan pa'i bshes dang bral te gda'/ /'dod 'jo'i ba mo nyin phyed stor/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dus min nub/ /da ni lha dang chos skyong rnams/ /dus la bab po legs par dgongs / / kye ma khyed rnams shin tu zhan/ /nyin dang mtshan du gsol ba btab/ /'bral glags med pa'i rje dang bral/ /gsol ba las ror ma gyur tam/ /ma phan da gzod bskyab pa'i dus/ /rgya gar yul nas 'dir 'brengs pa'i/ /bcu gnyis bstan ma'i tshogs rnams kyang / /bzhi bzhi gsum cha gsum du mdzod/ /bzhi tsam khu yi phyi la song / /bzhi tsam rngog gi phyi la song / /bzhi tsam 'brom gyi bstan pa skyongs/ /gzhan rnams btang snyoms nyid du gda'/ /bcu gnyis bstan ma 'di skad gsung / /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba 'brom/ /bla mas gnyer gtad bdag cag bzung / /yul khams 'dir stod 'brom rje shes/ /mthu stobs gang yod mgon po'i grogs/ /bstan pa 'di la ci phan bya/ /bstan ma gcig cig 'di skad zer/ /gsang phu ba yis 'brom rje khur / / gser gyi phreng ba lag du chud/ kho mos kho yi rjes su 'breng / /bcu gcig 'brom la jo bo zhus/ /de yang —575—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nyid 'phros nyid du zad/ /dngos gzhi bzang po'i lam du rdzogs/ /zhus lan nor bu'i phreng ba zhes/ /gnas lugs dag pa'i dbyings shed du/ /bla mas legs par phyin pa yin/ /man ngag blo dang ldan pas bsdus/ /bla mas bka' rgya bkral pa la/ /legs 'dod bsam pa 'ba' zhig las/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba cig ma mchis/ /nyes gang thugs rje che la bshags/ /chos skyong bstan ma'i tshogs rab rnams/ /'di bkod nyes par gyur ba la//chad las ma byed gtor ma bzhes/ /nongs pa'i dngos po bzod par gsol/ /'di bkod bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs/ /mnyes par gyur nas po ta lar/ /rnam dag sprul ba stong 'gyed cing / /spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med shog /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /blo rab mtshan ldan dga' ldan du/ /rgyal ba yab sras mnyes byed cing / /'di mnyes 'khor ba ngan song las/ /nges par skyabs nas 'gro ba yi/ /dpal mgon dam par bdag gyur cig /ces bya ba ni pha chos nyi shu rtsa drug las/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i glu'i le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o/ /tha ma 'di pha chos nyer drug gi ya gyal gcig 'di'o/ /ngo mtshar ba'i gtam thor bu ba rnams lo tsā ba la sogs pa'i rjes sras dam pa rnams kyis zur du glengs pas/ kha bskang ba'i le'u ste tha ma yin no/ /lo rgyus 'di'i dbang du byas na/ 'o skol mi lus thob pa rnams kyis gzhi tshul khrims rin chen la gtso bor bzung nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i lcag gis bskul te/ nyin dang mtshan du gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la 'chol/ ci nas kyang sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas ci thob tu byed par sems bskyed/ sbyor ba yan lag bdun pa sngon du btang / dngos gzhi stong pa'i ngang las/ tshad med pa bzhi spel mar bsgom/ mjug stong pa nyid kyis rgyas btab cing dge rtsa bsngo/ rang gi gi yon tan thams cad rin po che'i gter bzhin du sped/ theg pa che chung la mos mi mos/ rang gi gnyen po che chung dang sgrub nus mi nus dang bstun nas sgrub/ gnyen pos mi thub cing sgrub mi nus na chos zab kyang mi phan/ blo sna mang po bdud las kyi bya ba yin/ 'jig rten pa'i kha mngags la'ang mi thub pa la do ma bdo/ mi 'grub pa'i mdun ma ma bsham/ mi yog pa'i zas zos na dug yin bya ba la sogs pa yod/ de yang bsams na 'byung khungs ma gtogs pa zab par gda'/ /dpe de ltar zab zab po'i chos mang yang / skyes bu gsum gyi rgyud tshod gang yin pa'i chos dang bstun nas/ blo phugs ma 'phyugs par lam rim gyi 'dzegs nas snga ma snga ma mthar phyin par byas na phyi ma'i btsan sa zin/ sngar byas rnams las ror mi 'gro ba mkhas pa cig 'ong ba yin gsung ba de/ bla ma yab sras gnyis kyi bzhed par gda'/ yang chos gsha' ma cig byed pa la mi gzhi ci legs su byed pa dang / dad pa ci cher mdzad pa dang / dad gus kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa ci 'phel du mdzad pa dang / desda ༵༵ ༈ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la nyin mtshan du blta ba

'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs bka' gdams bu chos bzhugs so/ /dang / mar gyur ba'i sems can dang lhan cig tu ci nas kyang sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba dang / de dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pas chos 'brel med gong du brtags shing gdams nas/ gzhan zer gyi rkyen du ma btang bar rang gis/ bzang por nges ngos shes nas spyi bor blangs te/ yon tan ma gtogs pa ci la yang mi lta
