su rnam par 'phel te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de la byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni rnam pa gnyis te/ smon pa'i phan yon dang / 'jug pa'i phan yon no/ /smon pa'i phan yon dpag tu med de/mdor bsdu na 'jig rten du dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi 'chad par byed pa dang / dkar po'i chos thamasacad kyi rgyu'am/ sa bon yin pa dang / sdig pa 'joms pa dang / ltung ba las ldog dang mi ma yin pa dang / rims dang / bar du gcod pa thams cad med par byed pa las stsogs pa'o/ /—606—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ sha rwa dwa te'i bu sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni/ ngan ngon tsam dang cung zad tsam ma yin te/ 'di ltar bskal pa brgya'am/bskal pa 'bum gyis kyang brjod par mi nus na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad shes par ta ga la 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /yum brgyad stong pa las dmigs pa can gang zhig gis skal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa bas/ gzhan zhig gis nyin cig gam nyi phyed dang se gol gtogs pa gcig tu byang chub tu sems bskyed na bsod nams che'o zhes gsungs so/ /spyod 'jug las kyang / byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyams thag rnams/ /de la bde gshegs sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /gser sgyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku / / rin rin thang med par sgyur bas na/ /rin chen byang chub sems legs gzung bar bya/ zhes bya ba las stsogs pa gsungs so/ /'jug pa'i phan yon ni spyod 'jug las/ byang chub smon pa'i sems kyis su/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang / /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min / / yang de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' gang bar 'byung bar 'gyur zhes gsungs te/ 'di gnyis kyi phan yon ni / spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sdong po bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa las stsogs pa dang / rgyas par mdo sder blta bar bya'o / / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ sems can rnams 'khor ba las 'don pa ma yin pa'i 'phrin las gzhan ni ci yang mi mnga' ste/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga na/sa/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /'bras bu'i gtso bo yin par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas mnyes stsogs de las gzhan/ /de dag don gyi 'bras bur bzhed/ ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de bas na sangs rgyas kyi sku dang / ye shes dang yon tan dang / 'phrin las rnams ni gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig mdzad pa las grub pa yin no/ /'di ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya'i mgon po yang / sngon bskal pa brjod du med pa'i sngon rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas nas da ltar yang sangs rgyas pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang / sngon bskal pa grangs med pa'i chos pha rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yong dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar sangs rgyas nas/ da yang bde ba can du bcam ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas srad la mya ngan las 'das nas/ tha rangs kha 'phags pa spyan ras —607—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gzigs 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun phyag na rdo rje yang bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dgu cu rtsa gnyis kyi pha rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes sgron ma zhes bya bar sangs rgyas nas / da yang bskal pa bzang po 'di tid rjes la de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rtsal gyis 'gro bar sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar 'khor ba thog ma dang tha ma med pas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la yang thog ma med nge// dang po'i sangs rgyas yin no/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i thugs ye shes yin no/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs drug tu 'dus la/ rigs drug gi thugs kha na rdo rje rnon po las stsogs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi lha rnams kyi gtso bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje kun tu bzang po dang / dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud kyi lha'i 'bor lo mdzad pa dang /dpal rdo rje 'jig byed he ru kar snang ba dang / dpal bde mchog gi bshad rgyud a bhi dha na'i lha'i 'khor lo'i gtso bo mdzad pa dang / seng ge sgra dang / ku mu ta dang / khye'u bzang dang / 'jam dpal tshig sbyin gzhon nu las stsogs par gdul bya gang ltar mos par snang ba yin no/ /de sems bzung / nam yang bya ba'i las la shi shir zin pa med pas cog ge zhog la lhod kyis sdod/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dge ba bsngo zhing rtag tu rang sems bya ra gyis/ /gdams ngag yod pa sgom pa min nam ci byed bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs/ /gus pa chen pos bsgrubs na ring por mi thogs 'bras bu 'phral du 'byung / /snying nas chos bzhin byas na lto rgyab gnyis ka zhor la 'byung tshul 'dug /grogs dag 'dod pa rnams la tsha chu bzhin du ngoms pa med pas chog shes mdzod / / dregs rlom nga rgyal khengs pa'i sems kun smod la zhi zhing dul bar gyis/ /bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang bar chad yin pas spongs/ /snyed dang bkur sti bdud kyi zhags pa yin pas srang kha'i rnge bzhin sol/ /bstod dang grags pa'i tshig rnams bslu brid yin pas mchil snabs bzhin du bor/ /da lta'i bde skyid snyan gsum 'dzom kyang yud tsam yin pas grogs med tshe 'di rgyab tu bskyur/ /'di bas phyi ma bshul thag ring bas phyi ma'i rgyags phyer nor rnams gter du sbos/ /thams cad bor nas 'gro bas cis kyang byar med gang la'ang zhen med gyis/ /dman pa rnams la snying rje bskyed la khyad du gsod dang brnyas pa spongs/ /dgra zin sde ris kun la phyogs ris zhen phyogs med par mdzod/ dpe gcig na / dgra zin sde ris kun la nye ring ma byed phyogs ris med par mdzod zer/ /yon tan can la phrag dog mi bya gus par gyis la yon tan longs/ /gzhan skyon mi brtag rang skyon brtags la ngan khrag bzhin du phyung / /rang dge ma bsam gzhan dge soms la kun la bran bzhin gus par mdzod/ /'gro ba kun la phan pa'i 'du shes bskyed la bu bzhin byams par gyis/ /rtag —608—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /tu 'dzum pa'i bzhin du byams pa'i yid kyis gsong por smos/ /'brel med smra ba mang na 'khrul pa 'byung bas tshod zin ran par smros/ /don med bya ba mangs na dge sbyor 'chag pas chos min bya ba zhog /snying po med pa tshe 'di'i las la rtsol ba ma che ngal ba don med yin/ /gang yang 'dod khar mi 'chi pha rol las las grub pas lhod kyis glod na bde/ kwa ye/ grogs po dam pas khrel na shi dang 'dra bas g.yo med drang por srongs/ /tshe 'di'i bde sdug snga ma'i las las byung bas gzhan la gyod mi brdal/ /bde ba thams cad bla ma'i byin brlabs lags pas drin du gzo bar mdzod/ /rang rgyud ma thul bar du gzhan rgyud mi thul bas na thog mar rang rgyud thul/ /mngon shes med par gzhan dag smin par mi nus pas na sgrub la brtson par gyis/ /bsags pa'i nor rnams bzhag nas 'gro bar nges pas nor phyir sdig ma sog /longs spyod g.yeng ba 'di la snying po med pas sbyin pa yon gyis brgyan pa thong / /'dir mdzes phyi mar bde bas rtag tu tshul khrims rnam dag srungs / / snyigs ma'i dus su zhe sdang bsdo bas bzod pa'i go cha gyon/ /le lo'i dbang du da rung 'dus pas sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus me ltar sbor/ /yengs ma lam la mi tshe zad pas da ni bsam gtan bya bar ran/ /log lta'i dbang gis gnas lugs don ma rtogs pas yang dag don la gzhigs/ /grogs dag 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'di na skyid med thar pa'i skam sar gshegs/ /bla ma'i gdam ngag tshul bzhin bsgoms la 'khor ba'i rgyun bzlog sdug bsngal chu bo skoms/ /de ltar mdzad na bdag kyang dga' la rang gzhan kun kyang skyid par mchi / / rmongs pa bdag gi gdam ngag 'di la khyed kyis cis kyang gsan par zhu/ jo bo rje lha gcig gis lha btsun pa byang chub 'od la gdams pa'o// //ga2 sna ltakyi dbyingasasu blta ba'i glu bzhugs/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dharma dhwa du sa ra gi ta/ bod skad du/ chos kyi dbyings su blta ba'i glu/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings lta zhing gzhan min pa/ /de dag rim bzhin brjod par bya// zab zhing spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa gang / /ma skyes mi 'gag bzod nas dag /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /chos dbyings mtha' dang dbung med par/ /blo mig zhib mo rtog bral ba/ /bying rgod rab rib med pas blta/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid sbyang ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid myang ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /ji lta 'o ma dang 'dres pa/ /mar gyi snying po mi snang ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs dang 'dres pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar 'o ma —609—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/rnam sbyangs pas/ /mar gyi snying po dri med 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam spangs pas/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me bum nang gnas/ /cung zhig snang bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bum nang gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi mthong ngo / /phyogs ni gang dang gang dag nas/ /bum pa bu ga gtol gyur pa / / de dang de'i phyogs nyid nas/ /'od kyi rang bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ting 'dzin rdo rje yi/ /bum pa de nyid bcag gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni nam mkha' yi/ /mthar thug bar du snang bar byed/ /chos kyi dbyings ni skye ba dang / / nam yang 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /dusarnams kun tu nyon mongs med/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma bral / / ji ltar rin chen beeḍūr ya/ /dus rnams kun du 'od gsal yang / /rdo rje'i nang na gnasagyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyisabasgribs pas/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med pa'ang /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /ji ltar sbun pas g.yogs gyur pa/ /so ba 'bras nyid mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas ces mi brtag gal te sbun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs las grol na/ /chos kyi sku nyid rab tu gsal/ /ji ltar sbrum ma'i lto na bu/ /yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pa/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyisagayogasapa'i/ /chos kyi dbyingasakyang mthong ma yin/ /chosadabyings gang phyir bdag ma yin/ /bud med ma yin skyes pa min/ gzung ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ji ltar 'dzin par brtag par bya/ /mi gtsang mi rtag sdug bsngal zhes/ /bya ba gsum pos semasasbyong byed / / stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mod/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa de/ /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs ldogakhams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /mchog tu sems de sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin// ji ltar ri bong mgo yi rwa/ /brtags pa nyid de med pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyang / /brtags pa nyid de yod ma yin/ /phra rab rdul gyi ngo bo yis/ /glang gi rwa yang dmigs ma yin/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin / / de la ji ltar brtag par bya/ brten nas 'byung bar 'gyur pa dang / /brten nas 'gag par 'gyur ba dang / / gnas pa dag kyang yod min na/ /byis pa ji ltar rtog par byed/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin nam mkha' yi / khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /skye dang rga dang gnas pa dang / /'jig pa med pasa'adus ma byas/ /sangasargyas chos dbyer med pa dang / /de rigasade bzhin thob pa dang / /brdzun med bslu med 'tsho med pas/ /gdod nas rang bzhin zhi nyid do/ /gang phyir de ni rgya mtsho ltar/ /sgra dang dpe dang blo rnams kyis/ /gting dang pha rol mi rnyed pa/ /de phyir rab tu zab pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /lta ba tha dad rung ma yin/ /'on kyang blo yi bye brag gis/ /lta ba tha dad cung zad brjod/ /dbu ma nyid du smra ba rnams/ /de don bden pa —610—

mdo phyegs lta ba'i sker bzhugs so/ /gnyis su 'dod/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam mo/ /bden gnis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /bdag dang bdag gir rtag chad dang / /nyon mongs rnam byang rgyu 'bras dang / /gzung dang 'dzin par gang spros pa/ /'di ni kun rdzob bden pa'o / / stong nyis bdag med zhi ba gang / /spros pa rnams kyis ma/ gos pa/ /tha dad don min rnam mi rtog / 'di ni don dam bden pa'o/ /yang dag yang dag ma/ yin dang / rnam/ grangs rnam grangs ma yin pas/ /de gnyis so sor dbye ba byas/ /btags cam/ snang grags dngos po dang / /tha snyad 'khrul pa sgyu ma dang / /kun rdzob nyid ni rnam grangs so/ /stong pa nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma/ med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnams grangs so/ /gang phyir sgrib pas kun rdzob ste/ /'gyur ba med phyir don dam/ mo/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /shes pa gnyis phyir bden pa gnyis/ /yang dag shes pa med ce na/ /bden te tha snyad cam du yod/ /de nyid tshol la thog mar ni/ /thams cad yod ces brjod par bya/ /don rnams rtogs shing chags med la/ /phyis ni rnam par dben don nyid/ /bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad min/ /nyes pa bzhi ba'i gsung phyir ro/ /gcig dang tha dad gang rtog pa/ /de ni chul min zhugs pa yin/ /dngos ngo/ra khas len yod na ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang mi bzad 'byung / /lta ba ma rungs yongs su 'jin/ /de las byung ba'i rtso da nga/ra 'gyur/ /darnge/gas pa'i 'du shes can la ni/ /thob pa med cing mngon rtogs med/ rjes mthun bzod pa'ang yod min na/ /mya ngan 'das pa smos ci dgos/ /stong pa nyid la blta nyes na/ /shes rab chung ldan phung bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar skrul la bzung nyes dang / rig sngags log par bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyis stong nyid ni/ /lta kun nges nga/ra 'byin pas gsungs/ /gang dag stong nga/ nyid lta ba/ /de dag sgrub tu med par gsungs/ /gang dag rang dngos gathen dngos kyi/ /dngos dang dngos med nyid mthong ba/ de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /yang dag mthong ba ma yin no / / med pa yod pa'i zlas drangs te/ /yod pa'ang med pa'i zlas drangs pa/ /de phyir med par brjod mi bya/ /yod pa nyid du'ang mi brtag go /yod pa pa ni bde 'gror 'gyur/ /med pa pa ni ngan 'gror 'gyur/ yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes phyir/ /gnyis ma mi brten thar par 'gyur/ /chul gnyis shing rta then nas su/ /rigs pa'i srab skyogs 'ju byed pa/ /de dag de phyir ji bzhin don/ theg pa chen po de nyid 'thob/ /gzugs sogs ji ltar snang ba ni/ /de shes pa ni chos rnams kun/ /ri bong ba glang rwa yi dpes/ /dbu ma nyid du bsgom par bya/ /yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis min bdag nyid du yang min/ /mtha' bzhi las ni nges grol ba/ /de nyid dbu mar mkhas rnams bzhed/ /dbu ma'i mtha' las rnam grol na/ /mtha' dang bral zhing dbu ma'ang med/ /—()// —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mtha' dbus med par gang lta ba/ /de ni yang dag lta ba ste/ /bla na med pa'i lta ba yin/ /blo ldan rlams kyis rtag tu sgoms/ /gang zhig lta ba 'dir zhugs pa/ /des ni thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /rnam rig cam du smra ba rnams / / ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub bo/ /brtags dang rgyu las skyes pa dang / /mi 'gyur phyir na go rim bzhin/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa/ /de nyid kun tu brtags pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid de de med do/ /gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam rtog yin te rkyen las byung / /grub ni de la snga ma po/ /rtag tu med par gyur pa gang / /yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis kyis/ /de phyir de nyid gzhan dbang las/ /gzhan min gzhan ma yin pa'ang min/ /mi rtag la sogs bzhin du brjod/ /chu shel beḍār ya yi dpes/ /ngo bo nyid gsum shes par bya/ /bdag dang chos gsum brtags pa dang / /rnam par dag dang ma dag dang / /'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa/ rim bzhin re re'ang gnyisaganyis so/ /blo gros bzang po thams cad ni/ /nang sems pa la brtson pa yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa lasagrol ba'i / / rnam shes dam pa'idon du 'dod/ chos rnamasagapayang skyerteb dang/ /'gag pa cung zad yod min te/ /shes pa 'bab zhig kho na de/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag par 'gyur/ /yod min chos rnams de dag snang / /bem po las min gzhan las min/ /med pa las min nyes gnyis phyir/ /de phyir shes pa'i bdag nyid yod/ /rnam shesabem po'i rang bzhin las/ /bzlog pa rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /bem min rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de 'dir bdag nyid rig par 'dod/ /nam mkha' sa rlung nyi ma dang / /rgya mtsho'i phyogs dang 'bab chu ni/ /nang gi shes pa yang dag gi /cha yin phyi rol ltar snang ngo / /gsal ba'i rang bzhin du snang ba/ /de dang 'brel ba lkog gyur min / / gang dang 'brel pas gang rig pa/ /de yis rig byed de rig 'gyur/ /ral gri'i so dang so rtse bzhin/ /blo yis rang 'dzin dor zhe na/ /rang nyid snang po dor min par/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel las gsungs/ /de phyir blo yis mtshan nyid ni/ /rang rig par ni grub pa yin/ de nyid rtogs par dka' bas na/ /'di'i ngo bo dpyad mi nus/ /rang gi de yang phra ba'i phyir/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyisaphra bar gzigs/ /rang la gnas kyang bdag 'dra bas/ rmongs pa'i phyir na mthong ba med/ /gsal dang blo ni bdag nyid kyi/ /'brel pa yod phyir blo tsam yin/ tanasapa'i rang bzhin bden pa ste/ /rnam pa brdzun zhing 'khrul pa yin/ /sems ni rnam par bslad pa'i phyir/ /gcig nyid gnyis su snang ba yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba la/ yīn tu mkhas pa cis ma yin / / gzung ba'i rnam pa mi g.yo phyir/ /phyi rol lta bur snang ba yin/ /'dzin pa'i rnam pa rab g.yo bas/ /nang lta bur ni snang ba nyid/ /mtshan ma de ni spangs nas su/ /ye shes nam mkha' lta bur sgoms/ /sems kyi rang —612—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /bzhin zag pa med/ /zag bcas sa bon ma zad bar/ /kun bzhi'i gnas skabs de bdag nyid/ /zad nas zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /rnam par grol ba'i sku dang ni/ / rtag tu nyi zer nyi ma bzhin/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams gnas yin pas/ /skyob pa rnams kyi chos sku'o/ /nyan thos theg par zhugs pa rnams/ /bdag dang bdag gis dben pa yi/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /bzhi lnga'am dus ni gsum yang rung / /yod pa thams cad gzung bya yin/ /dmigs dang bcas par 'dzin par byed/ /de gnyis dam pa'i don du 'dod/ /bden pa mthong dang goms pa las/ /nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa/ / bden pa dag ni rnam bzhi ste/ /sdug bsngal de bzhin kun 'byung dang / /'gog dang lam ste de lta na/ /de dag ji ltar mngon rtogs rim/ /sdug bsngal nyer len phung po'o/ /kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs te/ /'gog pa mya ngan 'das pa gnyis/ /lam ni phyogs mthun sum cu bdun/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam gtan pa/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /dge sbyong tshul ni dri med lam/ /'bras bu 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de dag brgyad cu rtsa dgu'o/ /grol lam zad pa rnams dang bcas / / 'bras bu bzhi rnam bzhag pa ni/ /rgyu lnga dag ni srid phyir ro/ /nyan thos rnam bzhi sprul pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'gyur ba dang / /zhi bgrod grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /de ni gnyis bzhi bco brgyad de/ /gnyis ni bye brag smra ba dang / /de bzhin rme do sde smra ba'o/ /rnam pa med pa'i shes pa yis/ /gzugs la sogs pa don rig 'dod/ /de ni bye brag smra ba yin/ /gang zhig don gyis phan btags pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan rnam pa nyams myong bas/ /don rigs 'dod pa mdo sde pa'o/ /bzhi ni dge 'dun phal chen dang / /thams cad yod smra gnas brtan pa/ /mang pos bkur ba'o bco brgyad ni/ shar dang nub dang gangs ri gnas/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba'i sde/ /btags par smra ba'i sde pa dang / /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun yod smra 'od srungs sde/ /sa ston sde dang chos srung sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ / gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan pa/ /sa sgrogs ri dang bsrung ba po/ /gnas ma bu'i sde gnas ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul don slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad do/ /rang rgyal byang chub don gnyer ba/ /gzung ba rtog pa spangs phyir dang / /'dzin pa ma spangs phyir na de/ /rten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /bskal pa brgya yi mthar thugs par/ /bsgoms pas byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /de ni rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum mo/ /sngon dang phyi mthar gnyis gnyis dang / /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan pa/ /ma rig nyon mong sngon gnas skabs/ /'du byed dag ni sngon gnas kyi/ /rnam shes mtshams sbyor phung po yin/ /ming dang —613—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi skor/gzugs ni de phan chad/ /skye mched drug dod tshun chod do/ /de ni gsum 'dus tshun chad do/ /reg pa bde sdug la sogs kyi/ /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /tshor khrims tshun chad sred pa ni/ /longs spyod 'khrig pa chags bcas kyi/ /nye bar len pa longs spyod rnams/ /thob par bya phyir yongs rgyugs pa'o/ /de srid 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /las de nyid ni srid pa yin/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba skye ba yin/ /tshor ba'i bar ni rga shi yin/ /'di ni gnas skabs par 'dod do/ /gtso bo'i phyir na yan lag bsgrags// sngon dang phyi mtha' bar dag la/ /rmongs pa rnam par bzlog phyir ro/ /nyon mongs gsum mo las gnyis po/ /bzhi bdun de bzhin 'bras bu'ang yin/ /gnyis kyis rgyu 'bras mdor bsdus pa/ /bar ma'i rjes su dpag pa las/ /'dir ni 'byung ba rgyu yin te/ /byung ba 'bras bu nyid du 'dod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis de dag las/ /rgyu ni rnam lnga 'bras bu bdun/ /'phel par byed dang phangs pa dang / /mngon par 'grub byed grub pa dang / /nyes dmigs kyi ni yan lag ste/ /gsum bzhi gsum gcig gcig rim bzhin/ /'du byed sdug bsngal 'gyur ba yin/ /sdug bsngal nyid ni rim bzhin du/ /lnga dang gnyis dang lnga yin no/ khams gsum na ni rim bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu yis ni/ /brdzus skyes yan lag bcu gcig gis/ /mngal dang sgong skyes bcu gnyis kyis/ /drod gsher las skyes ci rigs 'jug /de bzhin 'gro ba lnga la sbyar/ /gsum po dag las gnyis 'byung ste/ /gnyis las bdun 'byung bdun las kyang / /gsum 'byung srid pa'i 'khor lo 'di/ /nyid ni yang dang yang du 'khor/ /'khor ba'i ngo bo nyid rnams dang / /gang zhig gang du gang gis dang / /ji ltar ji srid nyes dmigs ni/ /mtha' yas tshogs kyi bar du 'jug /brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ / chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ / mya ngan gang las 'das/ pa dang / /gang zhig gang gis gang gi tshe/ /gang du gang phyir ji lta bur/ /ji srid ngo bo rnam pa dang / /thob pa dbye ba 'phrin las dang / /yon tan tshogs kyis ldog pa'o/ /mu stegs pa'i rnam pa gnyis/ / sprul pa pa dang rang rgyud dang / / de yang skyes thob sbyor byung ngo / /skyes thob rigs gcad log sred can/ /sbyor byung bsas gtan rtog ge ba / / bsam gtan pa ni sngon shes mthus/ /lta ba drug cu gnyis su rtog /rtag par smra ba rnam bzhi dang / kha cig rtag par smra ba bzhi/ /mtha' yod sogs bzhi mi spong bzhi/ /rgyu med gnyis ni mngon mthar rtog /'du byed yod smra bcu drug dang / /med smra brgyad dang de bzhin du/ /yod min med min smra ba brgyad// chad smra bdun dang tshe 'di la / / mya ngan 'da' bar smra ba lnga/ /phyi ma'i mthar rtog blta ba'o/ /rtog ge pa ni grangs can sogs/ /tshad mas —614—

mdo phyegs lta b.re skor bzhugs so// /grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /grangs can yon tan gsum du brjed/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa'o/ /rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang / /bde dang zhi ba'i sems 'id dag /res 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag snying stobs yon tan no/ /mi dga' ba dang yongs gdung dang / /myang ngan 'das dang mi/ bzod dang / /gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /de dag rdul gyi rtags su 'dod/ /rmongs dang de bzhin gti mug dang / /bag med gnyid dang g.yom pa dag /lan 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag mun pa'i yon tan no/ /yon tan gsum/ gyi rang bzhin can/ /mthong ba'i snyelam du 'gyur ba yin/ /mthong ba'i lam du gang gyur pa/ /sgyu ma/ bzhen du shin tu gsog / rang bzhin las ni chen po ste/ /de las nga rgyal rnam gsum 'byung / /de las nga/bang po bcu gcig ste//de tsam lnga po de lnga las/ /'byung ba lnga skye nyi shu bzhi/ /gtso bo nyid dang rnam 'gyur ro/ /de dag sems pa yod ma yin / / skyes bu kun rig sems dpa' can/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga shes na/ /ral pa'am spyi bo'am gcug phud kyi//gti gnas gang du dga' ba der/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bye brag nga/ ni don drug 'dod / / rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /rdzas dgu yon tan nyi shu bzhi/ /las lnga spyi gnyis bya brag gnyis / / de bzhin 'du ba'ang rnam gnyis te/ /de nyid drug shes rig pa'i ma/chog /rig byed kun gyi pha rol phyin / / gcer bu pa rnams don dgu smra/ /srog dang zag/ pa sdom pa dang / /nges par rga dang 'chi ba dang / /las dang sdig dang bsod nams dang / /thar pa zhes bya ngo/na ngagu po/ /gang gis mthong de rnam par dag /rigs pa can don bcu drug 'dod/ /tshad ma gzhal bya the tshom dang / /dgos pa dpe dang grub mtha' dang / /cha shas rtog ge gtan la dbab/ /rtso dang brjod dang rgol ba dang / /rgyu dang snang ba tshig ngor dang / /rtag chod chad pa'i gnas rnam te/ /bcu drug gi ni nges par 'byung / /dpyod pa ni don bzhir brjod/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /de dag 'dus ma byas pa ste/ /rtag tu skye 'gag med par gnas/ /de bas las 'bras yod ma yin / / sngon dang phyi mtha' de bzhin med/ /gang zhin de ltar rnam dpyod pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rnam grol 'gyur/ khyab 'jug byed rgyur smra ba rnams/ /nyi ma'i nang na bdag khyab 'jug /skar snang 'od ldan zla ba yin/ /rlung na/nga na ni 'od zer can//snang ba can na nyi ma bzhin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang / /lha nang na ni brgya byin te/ / dbang po'i nang na yid yin no/ /'byung ba'i nang nas sa yin zhing / /nga ni bde byed drag po'ang yin/ /srin po gnod sbyin nang nor bdag / nor lha nang na me lha nga / /ri bo'i nang na nga ri rab/ /nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ /nya dang rus sbal phag dang ri/ /mi'i seng ge mi'u thung dang / /dga' byed rā ma na nag po/ /sangs rgyas tsar ti ka dang bcu/ /gang gis khyab 'i〈cog yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgom na bde thob 'gyur/ /dbang phyug byed rgyur 'dod pa rnams//—615—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung ches kyi sker/'gro ba 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /byed pa po ni dbang phyug yin/ /de ni yon tan brgyad dang ldan/ /rab phra yang ba mchod pas 'os/ /bdag por gyur dang dbang du gyur/ /gar yang phyin dang 'dod dgur ldan/ /de bzhin dga' mgur gnas pa'o/ /lag pa dang ni rkang pa dang / /mig dang gdong dang lus rnams kyis/ /mang po skyed cing 'jig byed pas/ /des na phra bar brjod pa yin/ /mkha' dang rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chu dang me dang gnas byed cing / /sdud pa dang ni rgyas byed pas/ /des na yang bar brjod pa yin/ /'jig rten gsum na mchod gyur zhing / /gnas pa dag dang rgyu ba dang / /'byung po kun gyis brjod pas na/ /des na mchod par 'os pa yin//dbang po kun la dbang byed cing / /brtan pa dag dang g.yo ba dag /gang dang gang 'dod de byed pas/ /des na bdag por gyur zhes bya/ /bdag la rag las rang dbang can/ /'ga' la'ang 'jigs pa yod min te/ /thams cad dbang du gyur pas na/ /des na dbang du gyur zhes bya/ /yul dang bca' ba bza' ba dang / /gzhan yang yid kyis gang bsams pa/ /yid kyi rjes 'gro mi sdod pas/ /des na gang yang phyin ces bya/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa gsum/ /de dag gang la gnas gyur pa/ /mig 'byed tsam gyis byed 'gyur bas/ / des na 'dod dgur ldan zhes bya/ /thar pa'am yang na lha'i lus/ /gang du'ang bdag nyid 'dod pa dag /thams cad 'dod pas thob 'gyur bas/ des na dga' mgur gnas shes bya/ /gang zhig phrad gyur cig pa skye gnas 'dug/ de yis 'di kun skye zhing 'jig par byed/ /de ni dbang bdag mchog sbyin lha mchod bya/ /yon tan byed po shin tu zhi ba 'thob / / skye ba po 'di shes pa yod min te/ /bdag gi sde sdug bdag la rang dbang med/ /dbang phyug gis btang yang na mtho ris sam/ /g.yang sa dag tu 'gro ba kho nar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug rdza mkhan lta bur sna tshogs 'di sprul byed por ma gyur na/ /ri rab 'di mi 'grub cing sa gzhi 'di min rgya mtsho ma yi te/ /nyi zla skar ldan 'di ltar bkod pa 'di dag mig yul du mi 'gyur/ /yod pa'i phyir na dbang phyug 'gro ba'i byed po yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ /phra zhing bsam gyi mi khyab rab srab byed pa kun rig kun byed pa/ /rnal 'byor goms pas thob pa blo can bsam gtan pa'i bsam gtan yul/ /nyi ma zla ba sa chu me rlung phyogs dang nam mkha'i lus can te//zhi ba'i bde dga' 'dod pa rnams kyis dbang phyug sgoms/ /dus la ltos par smra ba rnams/ /dngos kun dus kyis sgyur ba ste/ /gang gi zhang po nor lha dang / /gang pha nor rgyal yin pa mi/ /'jigs med khro bo'ang bsad gyur pas / / dus ni 'da' bar dka' ba yin/ /bsrung ba sum brtsegs 'bos ni rgya mtsho dang / /dmag mi srin po nor ni nor spyin sbyor/ /gang gis bstan bcos pa sangs rtsad mnyam pa'i/ /sgra sgrogs bu de'ang dus kyi dbang gi nyams / / ngo bo nyid rgyur smra ba ni/ /dngos rnams ngo bo nyid kyis sgrub/ /me yi dmar ba nyid dang ni/ /dam pa —616—

mde phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs se/ /ga༈/ don byed nyid dang / /dam pa min pa'i brtse med nyid/ /gsum po ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /tsher ma rno bar gyur pa su yis byas/ /ri dwags bya'i ri mo su yis byas/ /bu ram shing ma/ngar nus pa kha ba dag /'di ltar thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /nyi ma tsha zhing zla ba rab bsil dang / /skyes bu chags bcas thub pa de min la/ /bde ba rab sim sdug bsngal rab gdung ba/ /drug po 'di dag ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /gang dag rgyu med smra ba ni/ /thams cad rgyu la ltos med par/ /dngos po rnams ni skye ba ni/ /nyi ma pad ma'i ge sar sogs/ /sna tshogs gang gis byas pa yin/ /rma bya'i dngos la sogs pa yang / /sna tshegs gang gis sprul pa yin/ /ji ltar char rlung la sogs pa/ /blo bur 'byung phyir rgyu med ltar/ /sdug bsngal la sogs rgyu med nyid/ lken tu rgya che rab zab la/ /sgyid lug shin tu ma sbyangs pa/ /bdag gzhan dgra dag gti mug gis/ /de ltar theg pa ched la smod/ /chul khrims las ni nyams sla yi/ /lta las cis kyang ma yin te/ /chul khrims kyis ni tho ris 'gro/ /lta bas go 'phang mchog tu 'gyur/ /gti mug dbang gi sgrib gyur te/ /gang zhig yang dag bgegs byed pa/ /de la bde ba'i 'gro ba'ang med/ /thar pa med pa smos ci dgos/ /gnod pa'i sa bon gyur pa yi/ /mu stegs byed mang mthong nas ni//thar 'dod skyes bu pa rnams la/ /snying rjer mi 'gyur su zhig yod/ /de phyir thar pa don gnyer rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta bar gyis/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu/ slob dpon chen po di paṃ ka ras mdzad pa'o/ /bod kyi lo cwa ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /shes bya'i mkha' la tshad yod ma mchis kyang / /stong dang snying rje gnyis su nyams len pa'i/ /mar me mjad dpal la sogs bla ma la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i yid kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /'gro mgon bod du 'byon khar gdams pa ni/ /brtse bar gyur pas nor bu bdag la gnang / /nam mkha' 'di la rgyu rkyen nam/ mchis bu/ /yod par su 'dzin med par su zhig 'dzin/ /chos rnams de bzhin shes par gyis shig bu/ /'di ma go na gol sa shin du mang / /nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par zhog cig bu/ /'on kyang mkha' la 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa na/ /yod yod lta bur mdzes shing mtshar ro bu/ /'di la'ang rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong / /'on kyang rten 'brel lags mchi mkhas pa'i bu/ /'ja' tshon mkha' la byung zhing mkha' la yal/ /'di la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma mthong / / 'di na'ang rten snyesprubrel lags mchi mkhas pa'i bu/ /legs par brtags na 'ja' tshon nam mkha' gnyis / / tha dad rnam dbye 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu/ /ye nas stong pa chos kyi gnas lugs la/ /'gro la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje 'khrigs/ /snying rje byung yang chos kyi dbyings nas byung / /thim yang chos kyi dbyings su thim mo bu/ /'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems nyid de/ /de la rgyu rkyen yod par sus ma —6/7—

bka' gdam/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mthong / / brtags shing brtags shing spyad na nam ma/kha'i 'ja' bzhin gda'/ /des na nam mkha' 'ja' tshon ji lta bur/ /stong nyid snying rje shes par mdzod cig bu/ /gang yang rgya mche'i gting mtha' zab pa las/ /stong nas g.yo ba'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa mthong / /rba rlabs dbyung yang rgya mtsho nyid las byung / thim yang rgya mtsho nyid la thim mo bu/ /g.yo ba'i rlabs dang zab pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /tha dad rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong de bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i stong nyid la/ /'gro la g.yo zhing 'khrug pa'i snying rje byung / /snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung / /thim yang stong nyid ngang du thim mo bu/ /me long g.ya' yis dag pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan bkra shing shar ba de/ /me long nyid dam phyi rol gzugs las byung / /de las gzhan nam 'on te rgyu med pa/ /gang du'ang dpyad na 'jig med rten 'brel tsam/ /byad bzhin yod ma myong dang snang ba gnyis / / tha dad rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong / /de bzhin stong nyid me long lta bu las/ /yod ma myong ste gzugs brnyan 'char ba ltar/ /stong dang snying rje bsten cig mkhas pa'i bu/ /rnyog med chab kyi dkyil 'khor dwangs pa la/ /chu shel zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar na'ang / /gnyis snang lta bur rang nyid zhabrul mod kyi/ /grub pa'i rnam dbye yod par sus ma mthong / /rnyog med nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid las/ /'gro las bzod glags med pa'i snying rje shar/ /snying rje byung yang stong nyid ngang las byung / /thim yang stong nyid ngang du thim mo bu/ /ji ltar gzugs kyi brag ri mthon po la/ /lhang lhang 'tsher ba'i sgra snyan byung na yang / /sgra snyan brag la rnam dbye su zhig yod / / 'o na'ang grags mod yod med su zhig 'dzin/ /de bzhin ye nas dag pa'i stong nyid la/ /'gro la shin tu brtse ba'i sgra 'byung mod/ /stong dang snying rje de bzhin sgoms shig bu/ /rtog med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dwangs pa la / / 'gro la dngos su phan pa'i 'od 'byung mod/ /nyi 'od tha dad nyid du su ma mthong / /stong nyid snying rje chen po'i gzugs su shar/ /snying rje de yang stong pa 'ba' zhig ste/ /stong pa nyid las snying rje gzhan yod par//mgon po gang gis ma bshad mkhas pa'i bu/ /kye ho stong nyid ngang du tshur nyon cig /'gro ba thams cad nyon mongs sdug bsngal yang / /stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyis shes par mdzod/ /de yi gnyen por yon tan mtha' yas kyang / /stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin gyis goms par mdzod/ /spang gnyen tha dad lta bu mthong na yang / /'khor gsum dag par bsam gtan lam du sgoms/ /de ltar ma go 'gro ba mtha' yas pa/ /rang la bsdus kyang yangs dog cang gda'am/ /rang nyid snying rjer ltos dang cang zhabrul lam/ /snying rje stong par 'dug gam mkhas pa'i bu/ /stong pa snying rjer shar ram rtog dpyod can/ /stong dang snying rje rnam dbye 'dug gam a/ kho bos zhe sdang rlung dmar 'tshub pa yang / /stong pa nyid las tha dad med par mthong / /de bzhin rnam par rtog pa mtha' —618—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /yas pa/ /stong nyid ngang las nges par byung par mthong / /rnam rtog rnams la cer re bltas cam/ na/ /bden narme/ rdzun nam grub par ngas ma mthong / /stong nyid ngang la lhod kyis glod tsa na/ /rtog pa cig kyang 'char ba ngas ma/ mthong / / des na stong dang snying rje 'gal zla yang / /dbye ba rdul tsam yod par ma mthong gi /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med smos ci 'tshal/ kyi ho/ da ni 'gro'am 'dug na yang / /gnas de dgon pa yin no mkhas pa'i bu/ /dbu ma'i ngang du sems nyid gnas pa de/ /stong pa'i gnas lugs yin no mkhas pa'i bu/ /de yi ngang du snying rje bsgom pa de/ /dbye ba med pa'i rnal 'byor yin no bu/ /de ltar shes pas snying rje bsgom pa na/ /shin tu brtse yang stong nyid 'ba' zhig yin/ /stong nyid bsgoms pas snying rjer ma khyab mod/ /snying rje bsgom pa stong pa kho na yin//stong pa tsam zhig zhi gnas 'tshol ba'ang sgoms/ /theg pa 'di yi stong nyid snying rje yin/ /snying rje 'di yi rang mtshan stong nyid yin/ /de na gnas don snying rjer shes par mdzod// khyod la bya ba'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang / /rgya phrag dos kyis rtsar phur chen po 'di/ /tshe 'di'i nyan bshad snying gtam tha mar bsten/ /da ni kho bo mi sdod bod du 'gro/ /'phrin las dag kyang rdza dang la cha 'dra/ /tshe yi 'du byed mi rtag glog ltar g.yo/ /lus sems 'du ba'ang mgron khang mgron po 'dra/ /da ste phyogs 'dir ldog pa srid pa bas/ /'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 'dus byas chos/ /gdams ngag sems la 'chang na bu yin a/ /bslabs pa'i ngag la nyan na yun du dge /ring por mi thogs byams pa'i zhabs drung du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshig don rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par bya phyir dga' ldan 'gro/ khyod kyang skye ba 'di yi 'og rol du/ /de drung snyegs nas gsung gleng byed par smon/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /dus gsum 'khor tshe skye gnas thams cad du/ /sgo gsum dge ba'i las la bkol ba rnams/ /gcig tu bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sku gsum 'phrin las rdzogs par ma gyur par/ /gang gi lus su skye ba mdzin na yang / /pha rol phyin bcus sgo gsum 'khor ba dang / /bla ma mnyes shing 'phrin las spel bar shog ces pa 'di 'gro ba'i mgon po bod du byoon pa'i tshe/ lam du 'jug pa na/ rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu bdag la/ phyi chos su gdams pa 95ba/thag thag// //nga4 lta sgom chung ngu bzhugs so/ /༄tsho/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs rim nyams su len par 'dod pa'i 'od gsal zung 'jug tu shes par bya ste/ de dpe chen rnam pa gsum gyis zung 'jug gtan la dbab/ gsal la rdzogs pa chu zla lta bu/ sna yang rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon —619—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lta bu/ sgro skur dang bral ba me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar bu/ sems bskyed pa gsum la brten nas rang gi sems su rtogs pa bsgrub ste/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bu/ sems bskyed pa ni bla ma'i sgom khrig lam pa'o/ /sems lus ltar sems bskyed pa ni stong pa nyid las lha'i skur langs pa'o/ /lus sems lta bur sems bskyed pa ni 'od gsal bsgom pa'o/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bu de la shes rab kyi mig gis ma yengs par blta ba dang / 'bad pas yid ches par bya ba la blta ba dang / btson 'grus kyis 'jig rten pa'i sems med par byas nas lta ba rgyal po'i sgo srung ba lta bu'o/ /dran pas ma brjed par byas la blta ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig par gsal ba'i chos thams cad snang ba med pa snang ba rnam par dag pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ dad pa dag pa la nges pa'i shes pa skyes te/ shes rab kyis ma yengs par blta ba dang / 'bras bu mar lag tu bskur nas bdas pa lta bu/ dad pas yid ches pa'i dpe ni gzhon nu ma bde ba myong ba lta bu/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig par blta ba'i dpe mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa lta bu/ shes rab kyi mig gis ma yengs par blta ba'i dpe ni sngar gyi mi 'dris pa dang 'phrad pa lta bu/ chos thams cad bsgom bya yid la byar med par bzhag chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas la bzhag snang ba med par snang ba rnam par dag pa ni nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu gsal ba/ dwangs pa dag pa'i ngang du blo bzhag bsgom bya sgom byed yid la byar med par bzhag gsal ba dwangs pa dag pa'i ngang du yid ma yengs par bzhag glod pa'i dpe ni bram ze'i skud pa 'khel ba lta bu/ bram ze'i skud pa ni grim na chad de/ lhod nas rnal mar 'dug pa ltar rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa yang lhod na gsal ba dwangs pa'i ngang du 'dug pa'o/ /gar dgar bzhag pa'i dpe ni mkhas pa ba glang 'tsho ba lta bu ste/ de la dpe gnyis / yan par btang ba dang / yid kyis ma yengs par 'tsho ba'o/ /de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa yang gsal ba dwangs pa'i ngang du yan par bzhag dang / shes rab kyi mig gis mnyam pa nyid nam mkha'i dkyil du bzhag pa'o/ /dpe drug ni/ gsal ba'i dpe mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa lta bu/ dwangasapa'i dpe chu ma rnyog pa lta bu/ mi g.yo ba'i dpe rgya mtsho lta bu/ brtan pa'i dpe ri bo lta bu/ dag pa'i dpe nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu/ gdung ba tshad pa'i dpe skom pa chus gdungs pa lta bu'o/ /lus kyi bcos thabs ni rtsa rlung gnad drug cu shes pa byas la bcos so/ /sems kyi bcos thabs la gnyis te/ gzings la 'phur ba bya'i dpe dang / nags kyi me lce'o/ /bya gzings la 'phur ba ni/ rgya mtsho min pa 'phur sa med nas/ sngar gzings la log pa dang 'dra ste/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa'i shes pa yang —620—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs se/ /bzung na 'chor bas nam mkha'i dkyil de'i ngang du mi dgag mi dgug par bzhag nags la me lce mched pa'i dpe de'i ngor ci snang bsregs/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor pa shes pa'i ngor ci snang ci skye thams cad dgag med du shes par bya/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su chos thams cad snang ba med pa/ snang ba'i rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag thabs lnga dang / nyams bcur shes par byas la sgoms/ mkha' ltar 'phangs mtho rten dang bral/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar gsal zhing phyogs cha snyoms//ri bo rgya mtsho lta bur brtan cing ltem/ /skyes bu'i 'phangs ltar dka' la thogs pa med/ /mkha' la brnyes shing 'jug la don mi dmigs/ spyod lam gyi nyams bdun ni/ bslus pa'i grogs bzhin rnam grangs dad mi 'gyur/ / gdungs pa'i bu bzhin zab tshig don la mos/ /'dod ldan yul bzhin snying rje ngang gi 'byung / / blo ngan don bzhin stor la don mi rnyed/ /thar pa brtson bzhin bol te grol ba'i sems ka la ping ka lta bur zab/ /tshig khong nas 'byin/ zhes gsungs so/ /lta sgom chung ngu rdzogs so/ /༄tsho/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rdzogs rim nams su len par 'dod pas 'od gsal zung ngag du shes par bya'o/ /ste/ de dpe chen rnams pa gsum kyis zung ngag gtan la dbab/ gsal la rdzogs pa chu zla lta bu/ snang yang rig 'dzin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bu/ sgro bskur dang bral ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu/ sems bskyed pa gsum pa la brten nas rang gis sems su rtogs par bsgrub te/ sems tshig tu brdzod pa lta bur sems bskyed pa ni bla ma'i bsgom khrig lam pam pa'o/ /sems lus lta/ra sems bskyed pa ni stong pa nyid las lha'i skur langs pa'o//lus sems bskyed pa ni 'od gsal bsgom pa'o/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu de la shes rab kyi mig gis ma yengs par blta' ba dang / dad pas yid ches par bya ba la lta ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi 'jig brten pa'i sems med par byas nas lta ba rgyal po'i sgo bsrung lta bu'o/ /dran pas ma brjed par byas pa la blta' ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig par gsal chos tham cad snang ba med pa snang ba rnam par dag pas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ dad pa dag pa la nges pa'i shes pa skyes te/ shes rab kyi ma yengs par blta' ba dang 'brus mar lag tu bskur nas bdas pa lta bu/ dad pas yid ches pas dpe ni gzhon nu ma bde ba myong ba ldu/ ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig par lta ba'i dpe mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu/ shes rab kyi mig gis ma yengs par lta ba'i dpe ni sngar kyi me 'dris pa dang phrad pa snyelta bu/ chos tham cad bsgom bya yid la byar med par bzhag /chos tham cad rang gi sems su shes par byas la bzhag/—62/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kye skor/snang ba med pa snang ba rnam par dag pa ni nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur gsal ba/ dngas pa dag pa'i ngang du blo bzhag /bsgom bya bsgom byed yid la byar med par bzhag /gsal ba dngas pa dag pa'i ngang du yid ma yengs par bzhag /klod pa'i dpe ni bram ze'i skud pa 'akel ba ldu/ bram ze skud pa ni drims na ched/ lhod nas rnal mar 'dug pa ltar rnorapa'i shes pa yang lhod na gsal ba dngas pa'i dang du 'dug pa'o/ /gar dgar bzhag pa'i dpe ni/ mkhas pa ba glang 'tsho ba lhu ste/ de la dpe gnyis yan par btang ba dang / yid kyis ma yengs par 'tsho'i/ /de bzhin du rnor pa'i shes pa yang gsal ba dngas pa'i ngang du yan par bzhag pa dang / shes rab kyis mig gis mnyam pa nyid nam mkha'i dkyil du bzhag pa'o/ /dpe drug ni gsal ba'i dpe mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa ldu dngas pa'i deng chu ma rnyog pa ldu/ mi g.yo ba'i dpe rgya mtsho lta bu/ brtan pa'i dpe ri bo ldu/ dag pa'i nga/pe nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil sdu/ gdungs pa tshad pa'i dpe skom pa chus gdungs pa sdu/ lus kyi bcos thabs ni rtsa rlung gnad drug bcu shes par byas la bcos so/ /sems kyi bcos thabs la gnyis te/ gzing la 'phur ba bya'i dpe dang / nags kyi me lce'o/ /bya gzeng la 'phur ba ni/ rgya mtsho min pa 'phur ba ni/ rgya mtsho min pa 'phur pa med nas/ slar gzengs la log pa 'dra ste/ de bzhin du rnor pa'i shes pa yang bzung na 'tshor bas nam mkha'i dkyil de'i ngang du mi bsgug par bzhag /nag la me lce mched pa'i dpe' shes pa'i de'i ngor ci snang bsregs/ de bzhin du rnor pa shes pa'i ngor cir snang ci skye tham bcad 'gag med du shes dpar bya/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su chos tham cad snang ba med pa/ snangaba'i rnam par dag pa'i rig 'dzin 'od gsal ba'i ngang la bzhag thabs lnga dang / nyams bcur shes pa byas la bsgom/ /mkha' ltar 'phangs mtho rtan dang bral/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar gsal zhing phyogs cha skom/ /ri bo rgya mtsho lta bur brten cing ltem/ /skyes bu'i 'phangs ltar dka' la thog pa med/ /mkha' la brnyes sheng 'jug la don mi dmigs/ /spyod lam gyi nyams bdun ni / bsdus pa'i grogs bzhin rnam grangs dad mi 'gyur/ /gdungs pa'i bu bzhin zab tshig don mi rnyed/ /thar pa brtson bzhino bol te grool ba'io sems/ /ka la bing ka ldur zab tshig khong nas 'byin/ /zhes gsungs sa/ /lta bsgam chung ngu rdzags sa// //—622—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /ca5 lta lha/ma 'bring 21 bzhugs theg/ /༄༅/ /dpal mkha' 'gro dang 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir tshe thung brtson zhan pas/ /gzhung la lta dang nyan pa mi nus pa'i/ /de phyir rdo rje'i phugs lam skud pa'i rtse sgros ltar/ /blo mchog dam pa rnams kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /dpe bzhi'i don ldan de ni rin po che/ /gang gis mi rnyed par mi 'gyur de'i phyir/ /mig bral thabs med rten bral long ba ri 'dzegs la/ /phan phyir mdor bsdus kyis ni bri bar bya/ 'dir thabs kyi rgyud dang shes rab kyi rgyud do/ /de la bstan pa bsgrub pa ste bdun dang bcas pa rnams kyi brjod par bya ba'i don ni 'di yin te/ /lta ba dang / sgom pa dang / spyod pa dang / sgrub byed bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang / / bsgrub bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang / tshul ji ltar sgrub pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid do/ /lta ba dang mig mthong byed ces bya'o/ /rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bo/ de la lta ba'i yul ni gnyis te 'jig rten pa dang yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / 'jig rtan las 'das pa'i lta ba'o/ /dang po shes rab kyi mig des/ las rgyu 'bras kyi mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par mthong ba'o/ /rgyas par ni bsgrub bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa las shes par bya'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lta ba la gnyis te/ med pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba dang / yod pa'i rang bzhin mthong pa'o/ /med pa'i tshul rol mthong ba'i ngo la snang ba ci srid srid pa gsum dang / cir snang 'jig rten pa'i sems brgya drug cu la sogs pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad nam mkha'i me tog la sogs pa ltar gang yang ma grub par mthong ba'o/ /de'i phyir ma lus rnam par rtog pa yin/ /dri ma chen po 'khru ba yin/ /nam mkha'i ni me tog dang / /srid pa mnyam par rtogs pa'o / / zhes pa dang/ rab rib can gyis mkha' la skra mthong smra/ /rab rib can dang 'gro kun khyad med bskyed / / ces pa dang / srid pa gsum po nam mkha'i me tog dang mnyam zhes pa dang / yang slob dpon ratna kirtis kyang / skra zla zhes pa'i dbye ba bzhin/ /gang tshe 'di'i rnam gzhag byas/ /de tshe gzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ /mtshan nyid cung zad yod ma yin/ zhes pa dang / yang 'dod dang mya ngan 'jigs dang bsnyo/ /rkun mo mig sogs slad na yang / /mdun na gnas pa bzhin du mthong / zhes pa'o/ /de rnams kyis yod pa ma yin pa'i don mthong ba'o/ /dper na rab rib can gyis skra zla la sogs pa mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /lang kar gshegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo ni ma brjod do/ /yod pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba la gsum ste/ rten rang bzhin rnams mthong ba dang / brten pa de'i yon tan gyis chos mthong ba dang / /de gnyis zung 'jug tu mthong ba'o/ /rten rang —623—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/bzhin rnal ma mthong ba'i dbang du byas nas/ gang lhan cig skyes pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ snang ba med cing snang ba rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu/ gang gi yang rang bzhin ma yin pa/ khyad par gang gis kyang khyad par du ma byas pa/ gsal ba dang / dwangs pa dang / dag pas te/ de yang gsal ba ni mar me lta bu/ dwangs pa ni chu ma rnyog pa lta bu/ dag pa ni nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang sems de'i mtshan nyid smrar med pa/ bsam du med pa/ brjod du med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gag pa/ nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid rang gis rang rig par bya ba dang / ye shes dam pa'i yul du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de'i phyir rtog ge rnams kyis yul ma yin/ /so so rang rig ye shes 'di/ zhes pa dang / de nyid rnam par snang mdzad byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang / byang chub kyi sems de gang zhe na/ sems de rang bzhin yongs su dag pa yin te/ de nang dang / phyi rol dang / bar dang nam yang mi dmigs so/ /sems de ni de bzhin shegs pas kyang ma gzigs so/ /mi gzigs so/ /de kha dog dang dbyibs dang snang ba dang mun pa ma yin/ /skyes pa bud med ma min/ ma ning mtshan gnyis pa ma yin no/ /sems de ni khams gsum la mi gnas/phung po dang khams dang skye mched la mi gnas te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems de nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do/ /de'i phyir rtog pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ / de bas na nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de byang chub kyi sems te/ de'i phyir sems dang nam mkha' dang dbyibs dang byang chub kyis sems de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang mdo' las/ sems ni sems ma mchis pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o / / zhes pa dang / yang he badzra nas/ rang rig dag pa ma gtogs pa/ /dag pa gzhan gyi rnam mi grol/ /zhes pa dang / dpal ye shes grub pa las kyang / dbyibs kun las kyang rnam grol cing / /grol dang 'ong bas rnam grol bdag /rlung kun gyis kyang rnam mi bskyod/ /me yi phung po mi tshig bzhin/ /chu rnams kyis kyang g.yo mi 'gyur/ /rab 'bad pa 'di mtshon cha ni/ /rnon pos kyang ni chod mi 'gyur/ / ci ltar mi rnams nam mkha' ni/khyab cing mtshan nyid rnams dang bral/ /'di ni don dam de nyid de/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med yin/ /kun tu bzang po zhesabashad cing/ /phya rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las / sems gsang mchog gi dgyes pa ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid zhes pa ste/ / gsang ba ni gang lhan cig skyes ye shes 'od gsal ba ste/ de yang mi mngon pa dang sbas pa'i don gyis gsang ba'o/ /ye shes dam pa'i yul du gyur las dgyes pa'o/ /thams cad la khyab pas bdag nyid do/ /dus gsum du brtag pas rtag tu —624—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /bzhugs pa'o/ /yang 'dus pa'i le'u bcu bdun pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /bzod nas dag pa rnyog pa med/ /sems can med cing srog kyang med/ /sangs rgyas 'od gsal nyid nas dag /byang chub sems med zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas de nyid du blta' bar bya'o/ /pha/ e'i cha byad bzang po la / / dbus su bam gyis rgyan pa'o/ /zhes de bas sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de gnas zhes bya/ rten zhes bya/ don dam pa zhes bya/ chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ste/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas byung yang rung/ ma byung yang rung ste/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid ni rtag tu gnas zhes bya'o/ /de ltar shes rab kyi mig gis bltas pas/ci yang ma mthong ba de ni/ de nyid mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /de'i yon tan gyi dpal he ru ka la mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/phun sum tshogs pa drug gi bdag nyid/ bden don bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ rnam par thar pa sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid / rten dang brten par bcas pa ste/ de nyid nyer len gyis rgyus sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ de la lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen rlung rkyen thu mong ma yin pa bla ma'i gdams ngag de'i yon tan gyis khyad par du byas pas/mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa bdun thabs dang bcas par snang ba'o/ /de nyid rgyu rkyen las skyes pas sgyu ma zhes bya/nyams su myong ba gsal bas rmi lam zhes bya/ rang bzhin med kyang lus dang gnas dang longs spyod du snang ba'i dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra ba zhes bya/ kha dog du snang bas 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba zhes bya/ sgrib pa'i don gyis kun rdzob zhes bya/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gzhi gyur pas thabs shes rab zhes bya/ rten de mtshon byed zhes bya/ dbus su bam gyis brgyan pa zhes bya/ de ltar thabs dang shes rab dang dbyings dang rig pa dang/ snying rje dang shes rab brten pa dbyer med pas zung 'jug du rtogs pa de ni byang chub sems zhes bya ste / de yang 'dus pa las/ thog ma tha ma med zhes pa/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /stong dang snying rje mi phyed pa/ /byang chub sems zhes bshad pa yin zhes pa dang/ mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa las kyang/rnam rtog rnam pa bstan pa dang / /sngags bzlos cho ga bstan pa bzhin/ /'jig brten kun rdzob bden pa yis / / 'jig rten dngos grub sgrub byed pa/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas su/ /ye shes sku ni bsgoms pa yis / / don dam bden pa bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgrub byed pa/ /stong nyid snying rje dang tha dad med / / 'jig rten mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang du gsal bar bya 'gyur ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyud / / zhes gsungs pas/ de gnyis med zung 'jug tu rtogs par bya'o/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro las kyang /gnyisasu med pa sgyu ma dang bral ba/ / gzhan du gal te sbyar ba ni/ /ma tshang mar me lta bur 'dra'/ zhes —625—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/gsungs pas kyang/ zung 'jug gi mtshan nyid mar me lta bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin zhes bya'o/ /de nyid ma shes pa'i nyes pa ni/ he badzra las/ tham cad rig byed grub mtha' la sogs pas/ /dga' ba'i dngos kyi ma yin te / / nang ni srid pa'i nang du skye/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /de med pas na dngos grub med/ /gang gis mi shes kye'i rdo rje/ /de ni ngal ba 'bras bu med/ zhes pa dang/ bgrod dka' 'di ni mi shes pa'i/ /byis pa rnams ni shes pas sgrib/ /rmongs pa de rnams 'khor ba ste/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson rar chud/ zhes pa dang/ yang slo dpon pad mas kyang/ ji ltar me ni 'bar gyur pas/ /der ni rtsa dang shing gi phung po dag /bcug na thal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /myu gu la sogs 'byung mi 'gyur/ / de bzhin de nyid med bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar che ba ltar byed pa/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ khre ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar 'gro/ zhes gsungasapas/ khyad par can gyi bla ma bsten la sems legs par rtogs par bya'o/ /rtogs pa dang mthun par so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi yang nas yang du brtags par bya'o/ /de ltar shes rab gsum gyis goms pa'i dpe ni/ nags la mched pa'i me dang / sngar shin tu 'dris pa'i me dang 'phrad pa dang 'dra ba dang / rgya mtshor kha ba bab pa dang 'dra'o / / de ltar shes rab gsum la goms par byas pas/ de yang / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gang tshe 'di byas chos rnams ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyi rgyu/ /me long lta bur rab shes pa/ /de ni shes rab bstan pa yin/ /glog dang chu bur ltar ma yin/ /gang tshe 'du byas tshul rnams ni/ /gang gi ji ltar mthong gyur pa / / de ni shes rab bstan pa yin/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma dri za'i grong / /mig 'phrul mtshungs pa gang gis mthong / /de ni shes rab brtan pa yin/ /de ni gang du yang mngon zhen dang / /gang du yang gnas pa yod na yin/ zhes pa dang / yang de nyid dka' thub dang brtul zhugs su bstan pa'i phyir/las rnams kun la thabs bcas shing / /dgos pa med par gang spyod pa/ /rnam par mi rtog bsgom pa ni / / brtul zhus rnams kyis mchog gis mchog /las rnams kun la kun du ni/ /rnam par mi rtog bsgom byed cing / /dgos pa med par kun du spyod/ /de ni dka' thub rnams kyi mchog gi mchog zhes pa dang / shes rab thabs ni rtogs gyur nas/ /gang tshe sems gzhan mi g.yo na/ /de tshe byang chub chen po ni/ /nges par skye ba nyid du bshad/ ces gsungs so/ /de ltar thos bsam gyis shes rab kyis shes pa yul/ gang lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba de/ gsal ba'i shes rab kyi dag par shes nas/ dran pa ma brjed pa ni dran pa'o/ /de la rtse gcig pa'i ting ngen 'dzin no/ /rtse gcig pa la bzhag thabs lnga dang / dpe drug dang / nyams bcu bdun no/ blo bzhag thabs lnga ni/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyis yid la byar med par bzhag pa dang / ngang du bzhag pa dang / sor —626—

mdo phyogs lnga ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /bzhag pa dang / glod la bzhag pa dang / gar dgar lhug par bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'od gsal ba de'i ngang du bsgo bya sgom byed kyis blo dang bral bar bzhag go/ de las ma yengs par bzhag pa'o/ /sor bzhag pa dang glod pa'i dpe/ bram ze'i skud pa ltar sems glod pa dang / mkhas pa ba glang skyong ba ltar yan par btang ba dang / ma yengs nga/ra btang pa'o/ /pe drug gi gsal ba 'di mar me lta bu'o/ /dwangs pa ni chu ma rnyog pa lta bu'o / / mi g.yo ba'i dpe rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /brtan pa'i dpe ri bo lta bu'o/ /dag pa ni nam/ mkha'i dkyil lta bu'o / / gdung pa tshad pa'i dpe skom pa chus gdungs pa lta bu'o/ /mnyam bzhag gi nyams bcu ni/ mkha' ltar 'phangs mtho rten dang bral/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar gsal la phyogs med snyoms pa dang / /ri bo rgya mtsho lta bur brtan la ltem/ /skyes bu'i 'phong ltar dka' la thogs pa med pa dang / /mkha' la mnyes shing 'jug la don mi dmigs/ /spyod lam gyi nyams bdun ni/ bslus pa'i grogs bzhin rnam grangs dang mi 'gyur/ /gdungs pa'i bu bzhin zab tshig don la mos/ /'dod ldan yul bzhin snying rje ngang gis 'byung / /blo ngan don bzhin ster la don mi rnyed/ /thar pa'i btson bzhin 'bol te grol ba'i sems/ /ka la ping ka lta bur zab cing khong nas 'byin / zhes gsungs so/ /de yang lam ma bgrod par mi thob pas/ lam la gnas par bya ste/ de yang lam bgrod pa de nyid yin/ de bas lam la gnas nas/ bsgrub na ye shes thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / dang po rnal 'byor pas 'khor ba mtha' dag gis nyes pa dran par byas la/ de dag las byas pa shes pa dang / byas pa gzo ba dang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bar du sgom par bya'o / / de nas bskyed rim tshul bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /lam de ni gang zag dbang po rab/ 'bring / tha ma gsum gyi thun mong pa'o/ /de slob dpon padma sam bha was kyang / ci tar mtha' med rgya mtsho las/ /gru med gzhan zhig 'jug gyur pa/ /thabs dang rten ni med gyur nas/ /skad cig gcig gis 'chi bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas/ lam shes na gus par bsgom par bya'o/ /spyod pa ni he badzra dang / 'dus pa dang / gsang ba grub pa nas shes par bya'o/ /sgrub byed bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong la gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /gzhung thun mong ma yin pa lta spyod sgom tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa/ dbang gi man ngag dang ldan pa'o/ /bsgrub bya slob ma'i mtshan nyid byang sems brtan par byas pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa dbang bzhi kar rdzogs par bya'o/ /de yang dang po snying rje'i stobs las byung / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems brtan byas/ /bum pa la sogs dbang bskur ba/ /bla ma'i drin gyis man ngag thob/ /gzhan yang / srid pa'i longs spyod bde ma chags/ /yongs su 'dzin pa rgyab kyi phyogs / zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /tshul ji ltar bsgrub na/ dbang gi ma/na ngag la gnyis te/ byin gyis brlabs —627—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nus pa'i bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba dang / snod shes pa'i bla mas snod/ rtogs pa'i dbang gis rtogs pa skye ba dang / gdams ngag shes pa'i bla mas/ gdams ngag btab pa dang / rtogs pa skye ba dang gsum mo/ /de ltar gang la brten nas rtogs pa shes pa dang / goms pa'i thabs kyis bsgom na phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgya gar gyi mkhas pa paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa'i lta sgom 'bring po rdzogs so// //cha6 lta sgom chen mo bzhugasaso/ /༄༅/ /gang gis drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad mor 'dud/ /mdo rgyud dang bstan chos thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa man ngag yid bzhin nor bu lta bu 'di la don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan te/ bsgrub bya bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang / sgrub byed slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang / tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa'i gdam ngag gi mtshan nyid dang gsum du bstan/ bsgrub bya bla ma'i mtshan nyid la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su gsungs/ thun mong ba ni bshes gnyen dam pa dul zhing nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan cher ldan lhag pa'i lung gi phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs shing smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal med ma bsten/ zhes lung las gsungs/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ bla ma dam pa de/ lta ba dang / sgom pa dang / spyod pa rnam par dag pas/ gzhan smin par byedo pa'i mthu yod pa cig dgoos/ de yang lta ba rnam par dag pas skal ba dang ldan pa rang sar gral ba dang / sgam pa rnam par dag pas snad dang ldan pa byin gyis rlobs pa dang / spyod pa rnam par dag pas gzhan nges shes bskyed de/ dad pa dang ldan pa rim gyi lam du 'jug pa'o/ / sgrub byed slob ma'i mtshan nyid la/ dur khrod brgyad kyis dben pa la brten nas/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang / sdul bsngal la rtog par bya ste/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems legs par sbyangs pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa ni/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par byas pa/smin brtan par byed pa/ dam tshig rnam pa gsum bsrung bar byed pa/ brtan pa grol bar byed pa/ thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis rgyud yongs su sbyangs pa'o/ /de yang dang po snying rje stobs las byung / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems gtad byas/ / bum pa gsang sogs dbang bskur ba/ /bla ma'i drin gyis yang dag thob/ /srid pa'i long spyod bde ba spangs/ / yongs su 'dzin pa rgyab kyis phyogs/ /zhes gsungs/ tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa gdam ngag gi mtshan nyid la gnyis thun mong gi gnas kyis yan lag dang / grogs kyi yan lag dang / zas kyi yan lag —628—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /dang / spyod pa'i yan lag dang / rtags kyis yan lag dang / lam gyi yan lag dang drug go /gnas kyi yan lag ni/ dad pa can gyis gnas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dgon par gnas pa dang / sbyangs pa can gyis gnas ri bo'i khrod du gnas pa dang / rtogs pa can gyi gnas dur khrod las sogs par gnas par bya'o/ /de yang rgyud nas/ ri bo'i phug na ri sul dang / /chu'i ngos dang chu mdo dang / /rgya mtsho'i ngos ni nyams dga' dang //shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /sems bral lha khang stong pa sa /dang po gtso bo bsgom par bya/ /bstan pa yis ni gnas dag gam/ / yang na yid ni dga' bar ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rim gyis gnas par bya'o/ /grogs kyi yan lag ni/ las dang po pas/ grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa dang / las goms pa pa'i grogs brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / las shin tu goms pa pa'i grogs rtogs pa dang ldan pa'o/ /zas kyi yan lag ni/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su smin par byed pa'i zas dang / 'byung ba ro snyoms par byed pa'i zas dang / zhen pa log cing rtog pa 'joms par byed pa'i zas so/ /spyod pa'i yan lag ni/ 'jig rten pa dang sgo bstun pa'i spyod pa dang /zhershams su myong ba dang sgo bstun pa'i spyod pa dang / zhen pa ldog cing rtog pa 'joms pa'i spyod pa'o/ /rtags ni yan lag gi gnyis te/ 'dod pa'i rtags dang mi 'dod pa'i rtags so/ /'dod pa'i brtags ni ཿ lus yangs sems gsal 'khrul rtog rim gyis 'gags nas lam rtogs dbang po lngar 'char te/ dad pa'i dbang pos lam gang la yang dad pa dang / gus pa dang / mos pa gsum gyis 'jug pa'i lam 'char/ brtson/ 'grus kyis dbang pos brtson pa dang / 'grus pa dang / le lo med pa gsum gyis 'jug pa'i lam 'char/ dran pa'i dbang pos / dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang / bag yong/ pa gsum gyis 'jug pa'i larme 'char/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos sems la yengs pa med pa dang / rgyun chad med pa dang / gsal 'grib med pa gsum gyis lam 'char /shes rab kyi dbang pos/ thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa gsum las byung ba'i tshig gis don gtan la phabs na/ shes rab gtan dri ma med pa'i lam 'char ro/ /mi 'dod pa'i rtags ni/ lus lci/ sems rmongs/'khrul rtog rim gyis 'phel nas/ gegs dang / bar chod dang / bdud rtags rim gyis 'byung ste/ shin tu khro 'dod / 'dod chags che ba dang / lhag par gnyid 'byung dang / de bzhin rab tu mi dga' dang / rgyu mar 'dod pa dang /bsam gtan khang pa spangs te/ sems ni gzhan du 'gro ba 'dod pa dang / /bsam gtan gnas su mi bzad sgra 'byung de bzhin sgo dag la/ /'jigs pa'i sgra 'byung ca co smra ba'i sgra dag thos pa dang / /nang nas gnas pa'i ming nas phyir phyir 'bod pa dang ni rgod/ skyug pa dang ni glu len dgra dang se gol sogs 'debs shing / /shin tu mi bzad dri mi zhim pa'i ngad/ /bden gyis hud zhes/ 'jigs dang gzugs mi sdug pa mthong dang bsteg —629—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye sker/dang 'phul bar byed/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal 'byung zhing 'dre yis non pa dang / /shin tu dga' dang spro dang mkha' 'phur snyam byed cing rgyu mi rgod/ /glo bur du ni gzhan gyis sem/sa shes la sogs 'byung / /'jigs pa'i 'od zer khang par rab tu 'byung bar byeng/ pa dang / /dman pa'i gdam ngag ston pa rang lha'i gzugs sam bla ma'i gzugs su mthong / /sngon du steng nas shin tu non cing mthong bar byed pa dang / /mdor na gang gis bzlas dang bsam gtan dge ba kun la bar chod byed/ /de bzhin blo ni sngar bas ngan dang dad pa med la sogs pa dregs//de dag gang yang bla ma'i man ngag kha nas bzlog par byed pa ste/ bla ma'i man ngag med pa bsgrub la brtson pa 'dir / / srog dang dngos grub gnyis ka gdon chen rnams kyis 'phrog par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i man ngag can la bgegs rnams mi 'byung zhing / /byung yang blo can de yis myur du bzlog par byed/ /ces 'byung bas/ bla ma'i man ngag ni 'di yin te/ dang po sgrub pa pos 'khor ba 'di ni bdag gis ma yin pa gzhan mi gnas pa ni mdo las gsungs pas 'khor ba'i sems can rnams bdag gis mar ma gyur pa ni gang yang med la/ bdag gis ma rnams shes rab kyi mig dang bral/ thabs kyi rkang pa med/ rten pa'i gnas dang bral ba/ kha cig ni ngan song du lhung / la la lhung ba la phyogs par 'dug pas/ bdag sngon du dran pa'i ma 'di bdag la phan pa dang / bde ba'i blo ma yin pa gzhan mi bskyed pa dang / sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis bdag la phan btags pa dang / de bzhin du bdag gi ma rnams kyis kyang de bzhin/ du byas pas/ ma 'di la bdag gis lan blan nga/'i thabs la/ gzhan gyis lon par mi nus pas/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byas la/ 'di dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las thar bar bya'o/ /snyam du dmigs pa'i byams pa dang snying rje 'ba' zhig la bslab/ de yang dang po tshe 'di'i ma bde bar 'dod cing / sdug bsngal bar mi 'dod pa la bslab pa dang / de la lobs nas ma gzhan la bslab/de ltar 'khor ba na gnas pa rnams la/ bu me nang na gnas pa la mas mi bzod pa 'dra ba'i shes pa khyad par can ma skyes bar du bsgrub/ mi bzod pa khyad par can skyes nas/ chos thams cad sems tsam du bslabs/ de nas chos thams cad sems las gzhan du med par shes pa khyad par can skyes pa de ni bla ma'i man ngag yin no//de ltar snying rjes bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa dang ldan pa/ don dam par chos thams cad sems su shes pas/ gnod bya la gnod byed gnyis su ma grub pa shes pa'i blo khyad par can la bgegs mi 'byung la/gal te'am brgya lam na bdag gis tshe sngon ma phan chad la/ mi dge ba byas pa'i dbang gis gzhan la gnod pa byas pa'i rgyus srog dang dngos grub la gnod na 'di ltar bzlog bdag la tshe dang longs spyod dang / srog la sogs pa la gnod na zhe sdang gi kun nas bslangs nas bzlog par mi bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems nyams pas —630—

mde pyoges lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /bzlog par mi 'gyur 'es bya bas/ gang gnod pa'i bgegs de la yang zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa bsgrags la/ 'byung po 'di dag 'khor ba na gnas pa la bar chad byas pas ngan song du 'gro ba 'di dag gnod sems dang / rnam par 'tshe ba'i sem/sa dang bral snyam du bsams la/ byams pa dang snying rje bskyed/ des zhi bar 'gyur / de yang mdo las/ mi'i rijig rten 'byung po'i gdon dang nad mang ba/ /phan dang snying rjer ldan pa'i byin gyis brlabs zhi zhes byas so/ /des kyang ma zhi na bgegs su snang ba dang / rang gi sems su snang ba thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas la/ gang gis gnod par bya ste/ chos thams cad ni sems tsam yin la/sems spros pa dang bral ba rang bzhin med pa la ji ltar gnod/ gnod pa dang gnod byed du snang ba ni nam mkha' la skra shad mthong ba dang 'dra ste 'khrul pa yin/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal ba dang / bdag gi sems nyid tha mi dad/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs mkhyen pa yang tha mi dad/de bas na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad bde ba chen po chos skur gcig pa la su yis gnod/su la gnod/ ji ltar gnod de mi gnod snyam du bsam la yang dang yang du goms par bya/ rjes shes byams snying rje sgoms/ bsod nams kyi las ka mang du bya/ sdig pa bshags/ nyams pa bskang / gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol/ de ltar chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i chos kyi skur gcig par shes la/ kun rdzob byams snying rjes bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo khyad par can yod pa cig la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pas byin gyis rlobs/ de yang ye shes grub pa las/ 'di byas pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid/ cig kun mnyes/ /stobasachen pha rol gnon pa rnams/ /byin rlabs par rab tu mdzad/ /bdud dang bgegs la sogs pa kun/ /glag skabs 'tshol bar mi byed cing / /phyab/ na rdo rje la sogs pa/ /dgyes shing rtag tu bsrung bar 'gyur/ /yang 'tshe ba med pa nyid phyir dang / /tshe dang nad med 'phel ba dang / /rnal 'byor pa la nges par 'byung / / dpal dang yang dag 'byor pa las/ /dpal ldan de ni rin po che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungasaso / /de'i thabs sam phan yon gyis rgyu la 'bad par bya/ de lta bu'i man ngag dang bral ba/ brda' dang mtshan ma la zhen pa bskyed rdzogs kyi mtshan ma tsam la brten nas/ gnod bya dang gnod byed tha dad du rtog te/ bzlog pa rnam kyis bzlog par mi 'gyur ro/ /rang gi ngo bo de byang chub kyi sems nyams pa las ma gtogs pa gnod pa zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phan yon ni rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / sangs rgyasardo rje 'dzin bcas kun/ /de la byin gyis rlobs mi mdzad/ /lha la sogs pa thams cad kun/ /de mi bsrung zhing rnam par spangs/ /mdor na rnal 'byor pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdam ngag la brten nas phyag rgya chen po thob par 'dod pas/ bla ma man ngag can la —631—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsten par bya'o/ /de bas rnal 'byor pa gnod bya gnod byed tha dad du rtog pa'i sgrub pa po ni/ bdud kyi lag na 'dug pa'o/ /bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa la sgrub pa'i 'bras bu med do/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa de ni/gzhan gyis skyon bajood pa la dga' ba dang / bre rma'i gtam gyis dus cig 'da' bar byed pa dang / gzhan gyi yon tan la 'phrag dog byed pa dang / gang zag gzhan la tshigasasu bcad pa ma yin par brjod pa la dga' ba rnams kyis ni// rang gi khams zad pa ma gtogs pa gzhan ci yang mi 'grub bo/ /de bas bla ma dam pa la bsten par bya'o/ /bla ma dam pa la bsten na bdud mi 'byung / byung yang myur du bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rtag tu rang gi sems la blta' bar bya'o/ /lam gyi yan lag bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis su bstan pa'i lam dang / zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis su bstan pa'i lam/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su bstan pa'i lam mo / / de las slob dpon klu sgrub gyi zhal nas bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams kyis/ /thabs ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi ldang bu lta bur gsungs/ /zhes pa la/ bskyed rim rgyas pa/ bsdus pa dang / shin tu bsdus pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyisasu bstan pa'i lam la/ rgyu dang grogs dang mtshan nyid dang / nyams dang rtags dang dpe dang drug zhesagasungs te/ rgyu ni sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs pa dang / tshogs rnam pa gnyis bsags pa dang / rgyu rnam pa gnyis sbyangs pa'o/ /grogs ni mi mthun pa'i yul spangs/ mthun pa'i yul na gnas pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i bla ma dam pas yongs su bzung ba'o/ /mtshan nyid ni sems rangatshosar gnas pa dang / sems rtse gcig las mi g.yo ba dang / sems yongs su dag pa'i ngag tu rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba'o/ /nyams ni bzhi 'char te/ bde ba dang / gsal ba dang / mi rtog pa dang / bsam gtan pa dang bzhi'o/ /nyams ni nyams myong skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mnyam rjesamed par bde bas khyab/ /tha mal shes pa gsum las log /dngos por 'dzin pa yongs su spangs/ /legs nyes rkyen gyis sems mi g.yo/ /bgegs dang bar chad bdud rigs kun/ /ngang gis rtogs pa'i mthu yis sel / / sems la nges pa skyes gyur pa'i/ /gzhan gyi yon tan gtso mi bslu/ /'jig rten chos brgyad zil gyis non / / rang gi yon tan rlom pa med/ /dngos gang la'ang zhen med pas/ /yongs su 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /rtags ni gsum ste/ dmigs pa rtags su 'char ba dang / /'byung ba rtags su 'char ba dang / yon tan rtags su 'char ba'o/ /dang po/ gsal la mi rtog mi g.yo dang / /mnyen zhing 'jam la zhi ba dang / /dwangs shing bde la yid ches dang / /zab la rgya cher snyoms pa dang / /mnyen dang yang dag bstsal slad dang / /ji lta bur yang brtags dka' ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sdom du gsungs/ /'byung ba rtags su shar ba ni/ sa'i rlung zin na —632—

mde phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /du ba lta bu/ chu'i rlung zin na smig rgyu lta bu/ me'i rlung zin na srin bu ye khyer lta bu/ rlung gi rlung zin na mar me lta bu / nam mkha'i rlung zin na nam mkha' gsal ba lta bu'o/ /yon tan rtags su shar ba ni/ sa'i yon tan brtan pa dang / 'thug pa dang / 'gyur ba med pa dang / chu'i yon tan gsal ba dang / dwangs pa dang / kha gting med pa gsum / me'i yon tan tsha ba dang / rtsub pa dang / bud shing bsregasapa bzhin/ me'i ting nge 'dzin kyang de bzhin du 'byung ngo / /nam mkha'i yon tan rdul dang dri ma dang dngos po dang mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i yon tan no / / nyi ma'i yon tan ni/ myu gu la sogs pa smin par byed pa dang / 'dam rdzab la sogs pa skems par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba'o/ /zla ba'i yon tan ni/ mun pa thams cad sel bar byed pa dang / tshad pa'i gdung ba zhi bar byed pa dang / bsil ba'i 'od zer dang ldan pa la sogs pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ zla ba lta bu'i ting nge 'jin la yang sbyar ro/ /thams cad kun du song ba'i yon tan dang brgyad do/ /dper na/ dad pas yid chesapar byas nas/ lta ba'i dpe gzhon nu ma'i bde ba nyams su myong ba snyelta bu/ brtson 'grus kyi 'jig rten pa'i sems med par byas nas/ lta ba'i dpe rgyal po sgo bsrung pa lta bu/ dran pas rtse gcig la ma g.yon par byas nas lta ba'i dpe/ 'bru mar lag tu bskur ba 'das pa lta bu'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig lasami 'gyur ba'i dpe/ rin po che gser gyi snying po lta bu/ shes rab kyi snang ba nges pa'i dpe/ sngar gyi mi 'drisapa dang 'phrad pa lta bu/ gsal ba'i dpe/ mar me rlung gi ma bskyod pa lta bu/ dwangs pa'i dpe chu dwangs pa lta bu/ dag pa'i dpe/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i dkyil lta bu/ brtan pa'i nga/pe/ ri bo lta bu/ mi g.yo ba'i dpe rgya mtsho snyelta bu/ gdungasapa'i dpe phongs pa nor la gdungs pa lta bu/ yid gzhan du bsgyur du mi btub pa'i dpe/ skyes nad kyis gdungs pa lta bu/ 'khor ba'i btson dong nas thar bar 'dod pa'i dpe/ skyes bu me sha bos dong du bcug pa lta bu/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la chen pa log pa'i dpe/ dug can gyi zas mthong ba lta bu/'dod yon lnga la zhen pa log pa'i dpe/ gshed ma mkhan gyis mtshon thog nas 'das pa lta bu/ sems can la snying rje skyes pa'i dpe/ bu gcig pa me nang na gnas pa las mi bzod pa lta bu/ de dag gis ni sngon 'gro thun mong du bstan pa'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa la gsum/ 'jig rten pa'i sems kyi lta ba dang / shes rab kyi mig gidra(lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i yid kyis lta ba'o/ /'jig rten pa'i sems kyis lta ba la gsum/ las dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan gsum la dbal lta ba'o/ /des rab kyis mig gis lta ba la gnyis ste/med pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba dang / yod pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba'o/ /med pa'i tshul rol mthong ba'i ngo la snang ba ji srid pa gsum dang / cir snang 'jig rten pa'i sems brgya' drug cu la sogasapa bzung ba na nga / 'dzin —633—

bka' gdar/sa da pe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i sasurnga rlos kyi sker/pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad nam mkha'i me tog snyepa so/gas pa ltar/ gang yang ma grub par mthong ba'o de phyir ma lus rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dri ma chen po 'khru ba re/ /narma/ mkha' dang ni me tog dang / /srid pa mnyam par rtogs pa'o/ /zhes nga/ dang / rab ri can gyis nam rme/kha' la/ /skra shad zla ba mthong ba dang / /rab rib dang ni 'gro ba kun/ khyad par yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes srid pa gsum po nam mkha'i me tog dang / mnyam zhes pa dang / yang slob dpon ratna kistis kyang / sgra zla shes rnga/'i dbye ba bzhin/ /gang tshe 'di yis mnyam bzhag byas/ /de tshe bzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ /mtshana'id cung zad yod pa min/ /zhes pa dang / yang 'dod dang mya ngan 'jigasadang smyo/ /rkun mo mig sogs slad na yang / /mdun du gnasapa gzhan du mthong / /zhesapa dang / de rnarmas kyisayod pa ma mthong ba'i don mthong ste/ dper na rab rib can gyis skra zla la sogs mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /lang kar ga/shegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo ni ma/ brjod do/ /yod pa'i rang bzhin mthong ba la sa/sum ste/ rten rang bzhin rnal ma mthong ba dang / brten pa de'i yon tan gyitshochos mthong ba dang / de gonyisazung 'jug tu mthong ba'o / / rken rang bzhin rnal mthong ba'i dbang du byasanas/ gang lngan cig skyes pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin/ 'od gsal ba snang ba med cing / snang ba rnam par dag pa/ nar/ mkha' rnam/ nga/ra dag pa'i dkyi'/ sna bu'o/ /gang gi yang rang bcin me/ yin nga// khyad par gang gis khyad par du ma byas pa/ gsal ba dang / dungs nga/ da/nga / dag nga ste / de yang / gsal ba ni mar me lta bu/ dwangs nga/ ni chu ma rnog pa lta bu'o/ /dag pa ni natsha/ mkha' dag pa'i dkyil lta bu'o/ /ga'an yang sems nge/'i mtshan nyid smrar med pa/ bsam du med pa/ brjong du meng nga// ma skyes pa / ma/ 'gag pa/ na/ma mkha'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i ma rang gis rig par bya ba dang / ye shes dam pa 'i yul du gyur pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de'i phyir rtog ge rnams kyis yul ma yin pa/ so so rang rig ye shes 'di zhes pa dang / de nyid rnam par snang mdzad byang chub pa'i rgyud las kyang / byang chub kyi sems de gang zhe na/ sems de ni rang bzhin yongs su dag pa yin te/ de ni nang dang / phyi rol dang / bar du yang mi dmigs so/ /sems de ni de bzhin gshegs pas kyang mi gzigs so/ /de kha dog dang dbyibs dang / snang ba dang mun pa ma yin/ skyes pa dang bud med ma yin/ ma ning dang mtshan gnyis pa ma yin no/ /sems de ni khamasartsogasum la mi gnas/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la mi gnas te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems de nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ de'i phyir rtog pa dang rnam par mi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /de bas na nam mkha'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de byang chub kyis sems te/ de'i phyir sems dang nam mkha' dang dbyings dang / byang chub kyi sems de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med do/ /zhes —634—

mdo phyogs lta ba'i skor bzhugs so/ /gsungs pa dang / yang mdo las/ sems de ni/ sems mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pa dang / yang he badzra las/ rang rig nga/ga pa ma gtogs pas/ /dag pa gzhan gyi rnam mi grol/ /zhes pa dang / dpal ye shes grub pa la kyang / dbyibs kun las kyang rnam grol zhing / /'gro dang 'ong las rnam grol bdag /rgyud kun gyis kyang rnam mi spyod/ /me'i phung po mi tshig bzhin/ /chu rnams kyis kyang g.yo mi 'gyur/ /rab tu 'bad pa'i mtshon chas ni/ /rnon pos kyang ni chod mi/ 'gyur/ /ci ltar mi rnams nam mkha' ni/ khyab ceng mtshan nyid rnams dang bral/ /'di ni don dam de nyid de/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med yin/ /kun tu bzang po zheru bshad cing / /phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ /thekha gsungs pa dang / yang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las/ sems gsang mchog gi dgyes pa ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid zhes pa ste/ gsang ba ni gang / lhan cig skyes pa'i 'od gsal ba ste/ de yang mi mngon pa dang / sbas pa'i don gyis gsang ba'o/ /ye shes dam pa'i yul pa las dgyes pa'o / / thamabasacad la khyab pas bdag nyid do/ /dus gsum du rtag pas rtag tu bzhugs pa'o/ //yang 'dus pa'i le'u bcu bdun pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhen 'od gsal bas/ bzod nas dag pas rtog pa med / /sems can med cing srog kyang med/ /sangs rgyas 'od gsal nyid nas dag /byang chub sems med zhes bya ba la sogasapa gsungs pa de nyid du blta' bar bya'o/ /yang e'i cha byad bzang po la/ /dbus su baṃ gyis brgyan pa'o//zhesade bas sems gyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de la gnas zhes bya/ rten zhes bya don dam nga/ zhes bya/ chos kyi dbyings 'es bya ba ste/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas byung kyang rung / ma byung yang rung ste/ chos rnams kyis ches nyid ze/ rtag tu gnas zhes bya'o/ /de ltar shes rab mig gis bltas pas/ ci yang ma mthong ba de nyid la mthong ba zhes bya'o / / byang chub kyis phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun/ de'i yon tan ni/ dpasnyespru snye ru ka la mkhari 'gro ma su cu rtsa bdun gyis bdag nyid/ rig lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi bdag nyid/ dag pa bcu'i bdag nyid/ bden don bcu gnyis kyis bdag nyid/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid/ rten da nga brten par bcas pa ste/ de nyid nyer len gyi rgyud sems rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de la lhan/ cig byed/ pa'i rkyenatshothun mong pa rlung / thun mong ma yin pa'i yo na tan gyis khyad par du byas/ mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa bdun thabs dang bcabashapar snang ba'o/ /de rgyu rkyen las skyes pas/ sgyu ma zhes bya/ nyams su myong ba gsal bas ri / lam ces bya / rang bzhin med kyang lus dang gnas dang longs spyod du snang bas/ dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra ba zhes bya ba/khadogatu snang bas 'ja' tshon/ dang 'dra ba zhes bya ba/ sgrib pa'i don gyis kun rdzob zhes bya/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho lasasgro ldoba'i gzhi/ra gyur pas/ thabs da/nga shes rab ces bya/ rnam par rtog pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar —6kye5—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ rdzo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/byed pas snying rje zhes bya/ rten de mtshon byed zhes bya/ dbus sam baṃ gyis brgyan pa zhes bya/ de ltar thabasadang shes rab dang / dbyibasadang / rig pa dang / snying rje dang shes rab dang / dbyibasabarten pa dbyer med pa/zung 'jug tu rtog pa de ni byang chub kyi semasazhesabya ste/ de yang 'dusapa las/ thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer mi phyed/ /byang chub sems zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhesapa dang / mngon par brjod pa 'bum pa lasakyang / rnam rtog rnam pa bstan pa dang / /sngagasasogasacho ga bstan pa ste/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa yi/ /'jig rten dngosagrub bsgrub byed pa/ /rnam rtog thamasacad spangs nas su/ /ye shes sku ni bsgom pa yis/ /don dam bden pa bstan pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegasapa sgrub byed pa/ /stong nyid snying rje tha dad med/ /'jig rten mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gang du gsal bar byasa'agyur ba / / de ni sangasargyasabastan pa'i rgyud/ /zhes gsungasapas/ de gnyis med zung 'jug tu rtogasapar bya'o/ /de'i phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro lasakyang / gnyisasu med pa sgyu ma dang bralab/ gzhan dang gal te spyor na ni/ /ma tshang mar me lta bur blta'/ /zhesagasungasapasakyang / zung 'jug gi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba ni/ mar me lta bumya ngan las 'das pa yin zhes bya'o/ /de nyid ma shes pa'i nyesapa ni he badzra las/ thamasacad rigs byed grub
