hri da ya ni kri ba ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ snying po nges par bsdu ba zhes bya ba/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon mtho nges par 'byung ster ba/ /dkon mchog gsum la gus btud nas/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba yi/ /snying po bsdu ba bshad par bya/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid sdug bsngal dang / /las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog ste/ /de dag rgyu 'bras go rim can/ /'khor ba bsdus nas bstan pa yin/ /thar pa'i mtshan nyid byang chub ste/ /shes rab thabs dang spyod pa dang / /lam lnga dang ni tshogs gnyis las / / mya ngan 'das pa'i sku gsum 'byung / /de yang rgyu 'bras go rim can/ /thar pa bsdus nas bstan pa'o//khams gsum sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che/ /rba rlabs shin tu 'khrug pa ni/ /dge dang mi dge la sogs pa'i/ /zag bcas las las nges par 'byung / /de dag chags sdang gti mug sogs/ /nyon mongs rgyu yis skyed pa ste/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong la sogs pa'i/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa nyid las byung / /thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu nyid ni/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin las byung / /gzhan yang 'byung ba'i rgyu nyid ni/ /rtag dang cig pu khyab la sogs/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon yin te/ khes rab ldan pas spong bar bya/ /de bas skal ldan skyes bu yis/ /bdag gzhan ma lus grol ba'i phyir/ /mi bslu ba yi lung dag dang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung la sogs pa'i/ /rigs pa gang la —754—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bzhugs so/ /goms pa yis/ /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon chen po/ /ma lus par ni bzlog par bya/ /'di ltar phyi nang chos rnams ni/ /mtshan ma kun bral rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur shes byas la/ /rtag tu goms par bsgrub par bya/ /'khor ba thog mtha' med pa nas/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis brlabs gyur pa'i/ /'gro kun yul du byas nas ni/ /thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa yi/ /byams chen tshad med sngon 'gro bas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems byed pa'i/ /snying rje chen po tshad med pas/ /bdag dang gzhan don grub pa yi/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che / / yang dag brtan par bskyed par bya/ /bdag gzhan 'byor pa bcu ldan pas/ /'khor ba'i chos la yid 'byung bya/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob pa yis/ /skyabs gsum po dang ldan pa des/ /so so thar pa legs gnas bya / / tshul khrims bzang po dang ldan zhing / /theg chen rigs yod skyes bu des/ /'gro ba skyabs med bskyab pa'i phyir / / skyabs su 'gro ba sngon 'gro bas/ /smon pa'i sems ni bskyed par bya/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas / / 'jug pa'i sems ni bskyed byas pas/ /sngar gyi smon pa'i sems de nyid/ /rgya cher rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur / / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni/ /rlabs chen pha rol phyin drug sogs/ /mnyam gzhag langs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshogs kyi lam 'di bstan par grub/ /lam lnga rim gyis bgrod byas te/ /sgrib pa gnyis ni bsal byas nas/ /'di ltar tshogs gnyis rdzogs byas te/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'grub par bya/ /sku gsum grub pa'i mtshan nyid kyang / /chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la/ /rtsol med thugs rje'i sprin byung bas/ /sku gnyis bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ khams gsum tha ba'i rgyud brlan te/ /byang chub snying po'i sa bon las/ /dge ba'i lo thog smin par 'gyur/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ /snying po 'dir ni bsdus pa yin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spong 'dod na/ /de ltar brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha ma la/ /tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /rkyen ngan bar chad mang ba yis/ /yun ring gnas pa'i mthu med pas/ /tshig rjes bcad par mi nus kyis/ /rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ /bshes gnyen dam pa brten byas la/ /shin tu brtson pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran byas la/ /bdag gzhan grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ /snying po myur du bsdu bar bya/ /brtse bas 'di byas dge ba des/ /skal ldan sems can ma lus kun/ /byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan te// snying po myur du sdud par shog snying po nges par bsdu ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar ma mdzad ye shes kyi zhal nas dbus kyi snye thang gi gcug lag khang du mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lotsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //—755—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nga4 byang sems nor bu'i 'phrong ba/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi satwa ma ṇi ā wa li/ bod skad du/ byang chub sems nor bu'i 'phreng ba/thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo the tshom thams cad rnam spangs shing / /sgrub la nan tan gces su bya/ /gnyi rmugs le lo spang bya zhing / /rtag tu brtson 'grus 'bad par bya/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod pas/ /dbang po'i sgo rnams rtag tu srungs/ /nyin mtshan dus gsum yang dang yang / /sems kyi rgyud la brtag par bya/ /bdag gi nyes pa bsgrag bya zhing / /ga'an gyi 'khrul pa btsal mi bya/ /gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag bya zhing / /bdag gi yon tan sba bar bya/ /snyed dang bkur sti spang bar bya/ khe grags rtag tu spang bar bya/ /byams dang snying rje sgom bya zhing / /byang chub sems ni brtan par bya / / mi dge bcu po spang bya zhing / /rtag tu dad pa brtan/ par bya/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes dang / /byas pa drin du gzo bar bya/ khro dang nga rgyal gzhomu bya zhing / /dman pa'i sems kyang ldan par bya/ /log pas 'tsho ba rnams spang zhing / /chos kyi 'tsho bas 'tsho bar bya/ /zang zing thams cad rnam spang zhing / /'phags pa'i nor gyis rgyan par bya/ /dad pa'i nor dang tshul khrims nor/ khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i nor/ /thos pa'i nor dang gtong ba'i nor/ /shes rab nyid kyi nor bdun no/ /nor gyi rnam pa 'di dag ni/ /mi zad pa'i gter bdun te/ /mi ma yin la brjod mi bya/ /rtag tu 'du 'ji spang bya zhing / /dgon pa la ni gnas par bya/ /'khyal pa'i tshig ni spang bya zhing / / ngag rnams rtag tu bsdam/ par bya/ /bla ma mkhan po mthong ba'i tshe/ /gus par rim gro bskyed par bya/ /gang zag chos kyi mig can dang / /las dang po'i sems can la/ /ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya/ /sems can thams cad mthong ba'i tshe/ /pha ma bu tsha'i 'du shes bskyed/ /sdig pa'i grogs po spang bya zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /sdang dang mi bde'i sa spang zhing / /gang du bde bar 'gro bar bya/ /gang la chags pa spang bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /chags pas bde 'gro mi 'thob cing / /thar pa'i srog kyang gcod par byed/ /gang du dge ba'i chos mthong ba/ /der ni rtag tu 'bad par bya/ /thog ma brtsams pa gang yin pa / / dang po nyid tu bsgrub bya ste/ /de lta na ni kun legs byas/ /gzhan du gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu sdig la dga' bral bya/ /gang du mtho ba'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe nga rgyal bcag bya zhing / /bram ze'i gdams ngag dran par bya/ /zhum pa'i sems ni byung ba'i tshe/ /sems kyi gzeng ni stod par bya/ /rtag tu stong nyid bsgom par bya / / gang du chags sdang yul byung der/ /sgyu ma sprul pa bzhin du blta'/ /mi snyan tshig rnams thos pa'i tshe/ /—756—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bzhugs so/ /brag cha bzhin du lta bar bya/ /lus la gnod pa byung ba'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las su blta bar bya/ /bas mtha' dgon par rab gnas shing / /ri dwags shi ba'i ro bzhin du/ /bdag gis bdag ni sba bya zhing / /chags pa med par gnas par bya/ /rtag tu yi dam brtan bya zhing / /le lo rnyog pa'i sems byung tshe/ /de tshe bdag la rngan bgrang zhing / / brtul zhugs snying po dran par bya/ /gal te gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /zhi des gsong por smra ba dang /khro gnyer ngo 'dzum spang bya zhing / /rtag tu 'dzum zhing gnas par bya/ /rtag tu gzhan dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /ser sna med cing sbyin la dga'/ /rtag tu phrag dog spang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi sems ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /rtsod pa thams cad spang bya zhing / /rtag tu bzod dang ldan par bya/ /ngor dga' med cing gsar 'grogs med/ /rtag tu zungs ni thub par bya/ /g.yin la brnyas pa spang bar bya/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas par bya/ /ga'an la gdam ngag byed pa'i tshe/ /snying rje phan sems ldan par bya/ /chos la skur pa gdab mi bya/ /gang mos 'di la 'dun par bya/ /chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgo nas ni/ /nyin mtshan med par 'bad par bya/ /mang po'i nang du ngag la brtag /gcig pu 'dug na sems la brtag /dus gsum dge rtsa ci bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /bsod nams sems can rnams la brdar/ /rtag tu yan lag bdun pa yi/ /smon lam chen po gdab par bya/ /de ltar byas na bsod nams dang / /tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sgrib pa gnyis kyang zad par 'gyur/ /mi lus thob pa don yod pas/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa byang chub sems nor bu'i phreng ba rdzogs so// //ca5 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdams ngag tu byas pa/༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdam ngag tu byas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nges par legs pa'i byang chub dang / mngon par mtho ba thob 'dod pas//dkon mchog gsum la lhar bzung nas/ /dang po snying rjes kun la blta'/ /de nas byang chub sems bskyed de/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i spyod pa yis/ /rang gi sems nyid dang por gdul/ /dang po rang nyid ma dul bar/ /gzhan dag gdul bar ji ltar nus/ /ji ltar 'dab shog ma tshang ba'i/ /bya yis mkha' la 'phur mi nus/ /de bzhin lta spyod med pa yi/ /gang zag de ni ji ltar grol/ /de phyir de gnyis grub pa'i phyir/ /dka' ba'i 'bad pa chen po bya / / dka' bas sbyang ba ma byas par/ /sla bas goms par ji ltar 'gyur/ /go bgos khur khyer rgyal sras des//dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /shes rab gsum la gzhi bcas nas/ /go 'phang mchog tu 'gro ba yi/ /—757—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/lta ba nyid la gtsor sbyangs te/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos gyon nas/ /sgrub la nan tan gces su bya/ /chos kyi rjes su bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /dus dang gnas skabs kun tu yang / /sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kun gyi/ /las rnams dran pas zin par bya/ /skyon spang legs sgrub don yod bya/ /spyod lam don med du mi gnas/ /rtag tu rang gi yon tan sbyang / /dge ba'i phyogs kyi sbyor ba la/ /spro bya zhus dang sems mi bsad/ /nyes spong yon tan dge 'phel ba'i/ /grogs btsal mthun pas de sems bzung / /yon tan can la gus phyag bya/ /nyon mongs skye grogs thabs kyis spang / /mtho dman grogs kun dag la yang / /chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /nyesapa dor la legs pa blang / /byas la drin gzo slar phan gdags/ /gzhan gyi sdig rkyen mi bya zhing / /dge ba'i bar chad mi bya'o / / mtho la phun tshogs phrag dog med/ /grogs dang dman la brnyas thabs dang / khyad du bsad pa 'di mi bya / / rang skyon gzhan gyi yon tan bsgrag /gzhan skyon mi gleng rang mi bstod/ /'di bsaphyi ma gtsor bya ste/ /byed dgu chos dang bstun te bya/ /'di'i zang zing rnam spangs te/ /'phags pa'i nor gyis lus rgyan bya/ /sdug bsngal dag la bder mi gzung / /gnyid rmugs le lo g.yeng spangs te/ /nges par 'chi ba'i 'du shes bskyed/ /dge ba chung yang 'bad pas sgrubs/ /sdig pa chung yang rnam par spangs/ /chos kyi ched du ma gtogasapa/ kha zas gos sogs don mi gnyer/ /'dod pa chung dang chog shes bya/ /'jig rten chos brgyad rnam par spangs/ /ngo dga' gzhogs spong sogs mi bya/ /rang la skyon yod mi tshor bar/ /gzhan gyi skyon la dpyad mi bya/ /smra dga' khas len spang byas nas/ /de bzhin mi sgrub spang bar bya/ /g.yo sgyu dag ni mi bya zhing / /log par 'tsho ba rnam par spang / /chos dang mthun par bsgrub par bya/ /nye du 'brel pa la sogs la/ /zhen pas chags par mi bya zhing / / phyogs ris zhen phyogs med par bya/ /gzhan la re ba chung bar bya/ /mi dge'i las la mi bstod smad/ /dgos pa med pa'i 'du 'dzi spang / /bre mo'i gtam la dga' mi bya/ /zhen pas 'dod pa'i yid smon dgag /yon tan 'thob dang tshogs 'phel ba'i/ /las la zhus dang nga tsho spang / /nga rgyal khengs pa gnyen pos gzhom/ /zhe sdug khe grags rnam par spang / /dngos dang brgyud pas sems can kun/ /nye du 'brel bar gyur pas na/ /lus ngag yid gsum dri med pas/ /de dag kun la bu bzhin blta/ /snying rjes bzhin 'dzum gsong por smra/ /dga' ba'i mig gis kun la blta/ /'khor grogs nye ring mtho dman snyom/ /bstod dang bkur bstis mi dregs shing //smod dang brnyas la zhe mi sdang / /'phongs pa rnams la snying rje yis/ /phan ni gdags pa nyid du bya/ /gang la chags pa spang bya ste/ /dman pa rnams la snying rje dang / /phan pa'i bsam pas gdams ngag bya/ /sems can bsam pa tha dad pas/ /bya ba don chen brtags bya ste/ /thams cad mgu bar su yis nus/ /'on kyang 'gyod pa —758—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor sten pa bzhugs se/ /med pa yis/ /sdug bsngal khyad bsad bde mi chags/ /rang gi sems sbyangs gzhan sems bzung / /brnyas dang nyes pa byung la sogs/ /gnyen po las dang rdzun las sbyang / /de ltar blta zhing byang chub kyi/ /spyod pa yi dam brtan par bya/ /mi lus rin chen chud mi gzan/ /nges par 'chi bas long med srid/ /brtson 'grus me bzhin drag du spyod/ /mngon zhen bdag lta'i rtsa ba chod/ /dug gsum 'khor ba gnyen pos choms/ /phyin ci log gi g.yang sa dor/ /'khor ba'i rgyun chod las chu spongs/ /ngan song gsum gyi sgo chod la/ /sdug bsngal gsum po'i nad zhi ste/ /mtho ris thar pa'i skas la 'dzegs/ /sgrib pa gnyis sbyong tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /sku dang ye shes sa thob ste/ /'bad pa med par g.yin don sgrubs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam gdam ngag tu byas pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/ pa'o// //cha6 theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdusapa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ mahā yā na sa tha swā dha na warṇa saṃ gra ha/ bod skad du theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gyis mi khyab che ba mnga'/ /bla med byang chub theb 'dod na/ /byang chub sgrub la rag las pas/ /sgrub pa lhur blang snying por bya//dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus/ /shin du rnyed dka' rnyed gyur cing / /phyis kyang shin tu rnyed dka' bas/ /sgrub la 'bad pas don yod bya/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang dge slong dang / /mi lus rnyed dka' rnyed gyur cing / /dge bshes 'phrad dka' phrad gyur nas/ /don med par ni ma byed gsung / /rlung gi nang gi mar me bzhin/ /tshe 'di gnas pa'i gdeng med phyir/ /mgo'am lus la me 'bar bzhin/ /sgrub la bsnyur te brtson 'grus brtsam/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang / /sgrub pa'i mthu las 'byung rig mdzod / / sgrub pa gtsor mdzad blo ldan rnams/ /'di dang gzhan du bde ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig the tshom za/ /de nyid phyir na blo ldan rnams/ /sgrub pa snying por bya bar rigs/ /'dod pa'i gzhi la chags pa'i rgyus/ /sgrub pa'i spyodalam nyams pa'i mis/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad las/ shaṃn tu ring ba kho nar 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i btson ra nyam nga sa /nyon mongs 'ching ba sna tshogs kyis/ /rab tu sdang bsanyams thag cing / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med kyis/ /de yi rgyud gdung mi bder 'gyur/ /de nyid phyir yang blo ldan dag /'dod pa'i gzhi la chags spangs te/ /chos sgrub gtso bor bya bar rigs/ /'dod la chagasadang bral ba'i phyir/ /'dod pa'i nyes pa dpag med pa/ /gzhung las 'byung ba rtogs byas la/ /rtag tu —759—

bka' gdam/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/tshul bzhin yid la bya/ /mnog chung nyes pa che ba ni/ /btung ba dug can lta bur blta'/ /chos min sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa/ /rtswa yi me bzhin shes par bya/ /'dod pas mos par mi byed cing / /skom pa'i sred pa 'phel byed pa / / lan tsha'i chu 'thung lta bu mā /thub pa'i dbang po'i lung las byung / /'dod pa gnod pa mang pa ni/ /shing gi rtse mo'i shing thog dang / /lam ka'i shing gi shing thog 'dra/ /byis pa rnams ni lan mang du/ /'dod pa'i gzhi la chags pas phung / /'dod pa skyon du ma gyur pa/ /de ni 'ga' yang med rigs bya/ /de yi las ni sdug bsngal bskyed / / thog ma med pa'i dus nas kyang / /'dod la chags pas rtag tu 'khor/ /'dod pa'i chu bo'i shugs kyis ni/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khor byed cing / /de yis nyes pa grangs med bskyed/ /'khor ba'i skyon ni mtha' yas kyis/ /skom pa'i sred pa 'phel byed pa/ /sngon mtha' da lta phyi mtha' sa /gdung byas gdung byed gdung byed 'gyur/ /de don rtag tu sgom bya zhing / /btson khang lta bu'i 'khor ba la/ /btson ltar skyo ba goms par bya/ /ji ltar btson ni btson ra yi/ /sdug bsngal mang myong de dran pas/ /skyo sems rtag tu ngang gis 'byung //ji ltar btson ni btson ra las/ /'bros pa'i glags ni byung ba'i tshe/ /ched kar gzhan dang mi snyoms ge /ra/ /de yi gnas nas 'bros pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che 'di las/ /brdal ba'i glags dag byung 'gyur na/ /ched kar gzhan dang mi mnyam par/ /srid pa'i khyim nas 'byung bar bya/ /bdag g.yin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag /mthar 'byung phyi yang blo ldan dag /'dod pa me bzhin myur spangs te/ /chos sgrub gcor bya mi rigs sam/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ /sa ltar chos nyid gzhir gyur pas/ /dang por skyabs su legs 'gro zhing / / de yi bslab pa'i chos la bslab/ /rjes su dran drug rtag tu sgoms/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas pa / / sgrub pa pos ni dran/ byas la/ /de la dad pa brtan par bya/ /chos kun rtsa ba dad pa yin/ /rtswa rtse'i zil thigs lta bur ni/ /ring du mi gnas tshe 'di'i phyir/ /mkhas pas sdig pa yong mi spyad/ /de 'bras ngan 'gro sdug bsngal 'byung / /dge bcu'i tshul khrims dag bya zhing / /so so thar pa'i sdom dag kyang / /ci nus rim gyis dag par srung / /de ni 'phags nor kun gyi rgyu/ /mang thos nor yin de ldan bya/ /tshul khrims nor nyams gyur pa bzhin / / mang thos nor las nyams pa'i mi/ /phyi phyir 'gyod par gdon mi bya/ /rang las nga rgyal gzhom pa dang / / chos smra ba la gus par bya/ /theg chen chos sgor 'jug 'dod pas/ /mun sel gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /nyi zla lta bu'i byang chub sems/ /bskal par 'bad pas skye yang rung / /dang por de bskyed rab sbyangs pas/ /ri rab lta bur de brtan bya/ /de bskyed sbyong bar 'dod pa yis/ /byams sogs tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi po/ /'bad pas ring du bsgom byas pas/ /chags sdang phrag dog bsal bya zhing / /yang dag cho ga byas pas skye/ /bag yod —760—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gce bor ston pa bzhugs so/ /chos las nyams pa'i mi/ /chos kun las ni nyams par 'gyur/ /chos de rnal 'byor nyid du bya/ /bu gcig pha ma bsrung ba dang / /zhar ba mig gcig mig bsrung dang / /lam zhugs rnams kyis ded dpon dang / /sman shing chen po'i 'bras bu ltar/ /bag yod sems kyis sems de bsrung / /sems de byang chub rtsa bar gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /byang chub sems kyi mthu las byung / /sems mchog de dang mi ldan pas/ /sbyin nas shes rab bar dag gi /spyod pa drug la slob byed kyang / /rten dang bral ba nyid kyi phyir/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ming yang med/ /nyan thos bse ru'i drug po bzhin/ /bsod nams thams cad sdud pa yi/ /ting 'dzin sems de ma bskyed na/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi'i/ /ting 'jin lan mang thob gyur kyang / /srid pa'i mtsho las rgyal mi nus/ /byang chub sems kyi bzhon pa la/ /brten nas 'chi ba rjes dran gyi/ /lcag ni yang dang yang gdab cing / /srid lam 'jigs pa che sa yi lam 'di myur du 'da' byas la/ /'jigs med sangs rgyas sar phyin bya/ /skyabs 'gro lhag pa'i chul khrim/sa dang / / smon nga/'i gzhi la gnas pa yis/ /sems dpa'i sdom/ nga/ rab bzung zhing / /pha rol phyin drug la sogs pa/ / sems dpa/'i spyod pa thams cad la/ /ci nus rim gyis chul bzhin spyad/ /'jug pa'i spyod pa gtsor ston pa'i/ /mdo sde blta zhing bstan bcos nyan/ /chos kyis mi ngoms mtsho 'dra'i mis/ /rin chen nor bu'i rgya mtsho bzhin/ /yon tan kun 'byung 'byung gnas dang / /theg chen gzhung las bsngags pa yi/ /bshes gnyen ring du chul bzhin bsten/ /rgya mtsho chen por chu bo bzhin/ /de'i rten la yon tan 'du/ /sems dang/'i spyod pa de mkhas 'gyur / / sems dpa'i spyod pa che ba la/ /dad pa shin tu brtan par bya/ /bag yod dran dang shes bzhin dang / /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yis/ /kun nas nyon mongs dmigs pa la/ /rang sems yan pa phyir zlog ste/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi dmigs pa la/ /rtag tu bzhag pa nyid du bya/ /de ltar slob pa'i rgyal sras gang / /de'i spyod lam nyams mi 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis gdams pa bzhin/ /brtson pa dag ni thams cad kun/ /theg chen gzhung dang bstun te brtsam/ /gros kyi phugs ni chos la gtad/ /chos dag 'gal na gang yang spang / /chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pa spyad/ /blo ldan gang zhig rtsom pa kun/ /chos gtsor byed pa dpal ldan no/ /de la 'di dang gzhan du yang / /bde bar 'gyu bar the tshom med/ /thos pa nyung dang 'khor spangs shing / /bas mtha' dgon par gnas par bya/ /zhi ba dang ni dul ba yi/ /sbyor ba de la brtson 'grus brtsam/ khyim ni gang la'ang mi lta zhing / /gzhan skyon mi brtag bdag skyon blta/ /gzhan gyi snying la mi 'bab pa'i/ /tshig de mkhas pas ring du spang / /'di dag dang ldan rgyal sras gang / /phyi mtha'i dus su mi nyams par/ /bde bar thar zhes thub pas gsungs/ /—761 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ gzhan brnyas khyad du gsod cing smod/ /de yis bdag nyid nyams par 'gyur/ /kun la ston pa'i 'du shes sbyang / / chos sgor zhugs dang rgyal sras la/ khyad par du yang blo de sbyang / /rab byung 'ching ba dam po gang / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti ste/ /de'i gzhi la chags pa spang / /'ching ba de las grol ba gang / /me'i nang gi padma bzhen//mkhas pa'i ngo mtshar gnas su 'gyur/ /rab tu byung ba'i sgrub po pos/ /sangs rgyas chos kun 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pas/ /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes bya/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis te/ /de'i bslab par thub pas gsung / /yo byad bsnyungs pa la gnas shing / /yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad la/ /rgyab kyis phyogs te gnas par bya/ /rgyus med yul du grong rgyu zhing / /bya bzhin 'tsho ba 'phral btsal bya / / rang sems sbyong ba lhur len pa/ /ngo mtshar thub pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /gdul dka'i semasargyud yan btang nas/ /grags sogs 'jig rten chos kyi phyir/ / nyin mtshan gyi ni dus kun du/ /rtsod pa slob phyir rtsod pa sbyongs / / nyan bshad la sogs chos la 'jug /tshe ni don med myur du 'da'/ /mchog gi lam la de nyams 'gyur / / 'chi bdag nye bar gyu ba'i tshe/ /'byod pas de rgyud gdung bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten chos la mnyam sems bslab/ /de yis byis pa bslu bar byed/ /'jig rten gang gi blo la yang / /bdag gi ming yang mi gnas shing / / bdag gi lus kyi rus pa'i rdul/ /shin tu phra ba'ang 'jig rte na/ /gnas par mi 'gyur de dus 'byung //de tshe rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /grangs sogs med 'jig smos ci dgos/ /de tshe bdag la gang phan pa/ /blo dang ldan pas spya pa 'thob/ /las dang po pa'i sems can gyis/ /lus dben pa la ma brten par/ /sems dben rnyed par dka' ba'i phyir/ /'dres spang nags su gnas par bya/ /'dres pas 'dris shing chags par byed/ /de yis 'khor ba'i 'khor lo skor/ /de ltar 'dre ba spang ba la/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan par bya/ /gnyid la dga' spangs chos kun phyir/ /der gnas de yis brtson 'grus brtsam/ /de yis chos kun rdzogs par byed/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi sgom zhing / /phyin ci log bzhi rab tu spang / /smra la dga' spang don bsam bya/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug khun pa zos pas mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no/ khun pa ji bzhin 'di la smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin/ /de lta bas na mi rigs rnam spangs te/ /rtag tu bag yod gyis la don soms shig /nam mkha'i mtha' klas semasacan gyi/ /ched du go bgos rigs mdzod la/ /'ga' yi ched du sgrub pa yi/ /spyod pa dag las nyams mi bya/ /'khor dang rted pa bkur sti dang / /grags pa 'dod pa'i blos bskyed nas/ /smra la dga' ba'i sems byung na/ /sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa'i gdon// /rang gi sems de yin rigs mdzod/ /spros la dga' ba rab spangs te/ /bzod la —762—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor ston nga/ bzhugs seo/ /des pas bdag nyid brgyan/ /bzod pa'i che ba dpag tu med/ /rnyed dang bkur sti la sogs pa'i/ /chos drug nyes pa mthong bar bya/ /sems dpa'i spyod pa grangs med kyang / /bsdu na thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /thabs dang shes rab pha ma yis/ /sangs rgyas sras ni skyed par byed/ /bder gshegs sras ni don gnyer bas / / thabs dang shes rab pha ma yi/ /sgrub pa 'di gnyis 'brel bar bya/ /sgrub pa 'di gnyis bral gyur na/ /sangs rgyas sras skyed mi nus te/ /skyes pa dag dang bud med dag /cig la cig ni zla med bzhin/ /gang phyir ya bral 'ching bar gsungs/ /chos kun rtsa bar rab bstan pa'i// 'dun pa rtag tu sgom byas shing / /mdza' bshes la sogs gang la yang / /gces dgos mkho ba chung bar bya/ / mkho ba'i sgo nas nyams gyur cing //chos la'ang bar chad mang du 'byung / /las la dga' ba rab spangs te/ / gdul dka' sems gdul dge ba spyad / / zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du/ /sgrub blo rtag tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ / stobs dang ldan pa nyid du bya/ /sgrub pa'i blo ni 'phel gyur na/ /brlan ldan ri rtse'i rtswa shing bzhin/ /sgrub pa 'phel bar gdon mi za/ /sgrub blo stobs dang ldan gyur na/ /spyod pa'i khur lci yun ring du/ khur yang skyo zhing ngal mi 'gyur/ /chos spyod rnam pa bcu la sogs / / tshogs 'phags sgo ni thams cad nas/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa lhur blang bya/ /slob pa'i dus na che ba gang / /de'i rten la chos kun skye/ /sems can don la mthu ldan 'gyur// sku dang ye shes 'bras bu 'byung / /thabs dang shes rab snying po gang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong rnal 'byor sgoms/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /chos kun de gnyis 'bras bur gsungs/ /mngon shes mthu dang ldan bya dang / /zag med lam ni bskyed bya'i phyir/ /dang por zhi gnas skyed par bya/ /zhi gnas tshogs ni nyams pa yis/ /ring du 'bad kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin tshogs la nges par bslab/ /ting 'dzin gnod pa kun spangs te/ /mthun pa'i dmigs pa gang yin la/ /spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad ldan par/ /me don gnyer bas rtsub shing 8ltar/ /chags pa'i brlan dang bral ba yis/ /rtag tu rgyun ldan gus par sgoms/ /nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal bya'i phyir/ /zhi gnas la rten lhag mthong sgoms/ /lhag mthong 'grub par gyur pa yis/ /mnyam bzhag langs pa'i dus dag tu/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lta bur ni/ /chos kun lta ba goms byas pas/ /rjes kyi rtog pa sbyang ba dang / /thabs la slob pa gtso bor bya / / mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus dag tu/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong cha mnyam zhing / /de rgyun rtag tu goms par bya/ /de ltar tshul bzhin bslabs pa'i mthus/ /drod sogs nges 'byed bzhi thob nas/ /sa bcu'i ye shes rim gyis skye/ /de yis myur du de 'tshang rgya/ /nor bu bzhin du gzhan gyi don/ /lhun gyis grub par de byed 'gyur / / shin du bsdus na go mi 'gyur/ /shin tu spros na gzhung mangs 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pas legs —763—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kye skor/spyad na/ /go ba'i ched du bdag gis gdams/ /bdag gi bla ma yon tan mang mnga' rgya mtsho che dang mchungs/ /'jig rten chos la mi gzigs nyid gzhan don phyir sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ /'jig rten ma rig gis longs shes rab mig 'byed mthu mang du ma yis/ /gdams pa'i don dang gtsug lag bstan bcos las bshad bslab dgos na/ /gzhan la phan pa 'byung srid bsams nas yi ger bsdus pa yin/ /dad dang shes rab nor ldan sgrub pa snying por byed 'dod gang / /theg chen lam gyi sgrub thabs yang dag yi ger bsdus 'di la/ /gang ste mos pa yod srid 'di bzhin byas te rang gzhan don du 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs yi ger bsdus pa/slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / lo tsha ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o /ja7 theg pa chen bo'i lam gyi sgrub thabasashin tu bsdusapa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ mahā yā na pa tha swā dha na saṃ gra ha/ /bod skad du/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das dang da ltar bde gshegs kun/ /skyed pa'i yab dang yum gyur pa/ /sgrub pa'i chos la rab gus shing / /ngag yid dang bas phyag 'tshal lo//bsam gyis mi khyab che mnga' ba/ /bla med byang chub 'thob 'dod na/ /byang chub sgrub la rag sa pas/ /sgrub pa lhur blang snying por bya/ /de yis gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /mi dge kun las ldog pa yis/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims dag par bsrung / /byang chub sems kyi bzhon pa la/ /rten nas 'chi ba rjes dran gyi/ /lcag ni yang dang yang gdab cing / /srid lam 'jigs pa che ba yi/ /lam 'di myur du 'da' byas la/ /'jigs med sangs rgyas sar phyin bya/ /smon pa'i gzhi la gnasi pa yis/ /sems dpa'i sdom pa rab bzung zhing / /pha rol phyin drug la sogs pa/ /sems dpa'i spyod pa tshul bzhin spyad/ /de bsdus thabs dang shes rab la mi gnas mya ngan 'das phyir bslab/ /de'i snying po rnam pa gnyis/ /me don gnyer ba rtsub shing ltar/ /chags pa'i brlan dang bral ba yis/ /rtag tu rgyun ldan gus par sgom/ de yis myur du de 'tshang rgya/ /nor bu bzhin du gzhan gyi don/ /lhun gyis grub pa de byed 'gyur/ /theg chen sgrub thabs 'di bsdus la/ /skal ldan rnams kyisalegs par bslab/ /snying la bdud rtsi'i thigs pa chags/ /blo ma sbyangs pa'i blos re dka'/ /'di bsdus dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /theg chen sgrub pa lhur len shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas sa thob nas/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa byed par shog theg pa chen po'i lam gyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes —764—

mdo phyegs spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bzhugs so/ /kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o//nya8 mdo sde kun las btusapa'i man ngag༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ snyu tra arsha sa mud tsā ya u pa de sha/ bod skad du/ mdo sde'i don kun las bsdus pa'i man ngag dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya mtsho nam mkha' ltar zab rgya che ba'i/ /mdo sde'i sde snod ma mo kun bltas shing / /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal las byung ba yi/ /rted par dka' ba'i don rnams bri bar bya / 'dir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nor lta bu'i chos ni lnga cu ste/ srog lta bu lwa sogs pa'o/ /de rnams cung zad bshad par bya ste/ ji skad du/ /srog ni tshe yin drod dang ni/ /rnam shes rten nyid yin pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sems can rnams la srog gces shing / /srog la rten pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la yang /srog lta bu'i byang chub sems gces shing de la brten pa'o/ /pha ma lta bu'i chos ni stong rnga/ nyid dang snying rje yin te//des ma skyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byan mo lta bu ni/ 'chi ba dang / /las kyi bsags pa bgrangs pa rnams te/ nyin mtshan lan gsum du 'grogs dgos pa'o// khang pa lta bu ni dge ba bcu po yin ste/ 'di ni khang pa nyid de/ ngan 'gro dag gi sgo gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /nor lta bu ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang / 'dod pa chung ba dang chog shes pa'o/ /grogs po lta bu ni/ sbyor ba khams gsum na byed kyang bsam pa mya ngan las 'das pa dang / sbyin pa rgya chen po gtong yang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa dang / chos thams cad skye ba med par shes kyang las kyi rnam par smin pa mi 'dor ba dang / chos thams cad bdag med par shes kyang sems can rnams la snying rje bskyed pa'o/ /rtsa ba lta bu ni dad pa dang / thos pa dang / gtong ba dang / bzod pa'o / / zhing lta bu ni/ tshul khrims so/ /te du lta bu ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o/ /slob dpon lta bu ni rjes su dran pa drug go /mkhan po lta bu ni 'phags pa 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las byang chub kyi sems mi brjed par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi'o/ /tshong dpon lta bu ni bslab pa kun las btus pa'i gnod pa bcu bzhi'i gnyen po rnams so/ /sring mo lta bu ni tshad med pa bzhi'o/ /bran lta bu ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'o/ /'bangs lta bu ni/ khyi dang bran lta bu nga rgyal bcag pa'o/ /mig lta bu ni bsam pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /ma ma lta bu ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no/ /rgyal po lta bu ni dkon mchog gsum yin no/ /chu lud lta bu ni 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'o/ /lan mkhan lta bu ni dran pa dang / /shes bzhin dang / tshul bzhin du sems pa dang —765—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bag yod pa dang / phyin ci log bzhi'i gnyen po brten pa'o/ /lpags pa lta bu ni sems can mi gtong zhing rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyan lta bu ni dad pa dang tshul khrims dang gtong ba dang thos pa dang shes rab bo/ /nad dang zug rngu lta bu ni phyi nang gi dngos po la zhen pa'i sems so/ /skyes bu mnar sems lta bu ni/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du bdag nam zhig na tshangs par spyod par 'gyur zhig gu zhes pa dang rab tu byung bas 'di snyam du nam zhig na bdag gis 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal las thar bar nus zhes pa'o/ /le lo can lta bu ni khyim pas zhing la sogs pa ma spangs pa'o/ /rab tu byung nas tshul 'chos la sogs pa ma spangs pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi phung po'i mdo las dge slong dag rab tu byung bas glang po che 'thab pa la bltas na yang tshul khrims ma dag pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gshis bzang po lta bu ni/ tshul bzhin sems dpa' dang ldan pa'o/ /dig pa lta bu ni/gzhan gyi nyes pa dang 'khrul pa mi brjod pa dang / rang gi yon tan mi brjod pa dang / gzhan la mi smod pa'o/ /long ba lta bu ni 'khrul pa la ni mi lta ba'o/ /rkun ma zin pa lta bu ni dam pa'i chos 'jig pa na dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'o/ /byis pa lta bu ni bka' blo bde ba dang / /nga lo yang ba dang 'grogs na bde ba dang / mgu sla ba dang /gso sla ba dang dgang sla ba dang chog shes pa'o/ /pho nya lta bu ni byang chub sems dpa' don mang ba dang / bya ba mang ba dang snying la che ba'o/ /blon po lta bu ni dam bca' brtan pa'o/ /mdzangs pa lta bu ni sems can dang zhe 'gras pa med pa dang bcos su btub pa'o/ /slob ma lta bu ni nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla ma la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang / sdom pa gso ba'o/ /bsu skyel ba lta bu ni sems can thams cad sangs rgyas par byas nas/ gdod bdag nyid sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'o/ /long khrid pa lta bu ni bdag sangs rgyas par byas nas gdod gzhan gyi don byed pa'o/ /bskal pa dang po'i mi lta bu ni spyod lam dang / chul khrims dang 'tsho ba dang / cho ga dang lta ba phun tshogs pa'o/ /skyes bu 'dod pa can lta bu ni spyod lam thams cad gzhan la bsngo ba ste/ /'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las byung ba lta bu'o/ /mun pa lta bu ni dbu ma chen po'i don la rtag tu gnas pa'o/ /gshed ma lta bu ni log par lta ba skyes pa ste spang bar bya'o/ /chom rkun lta bu ni/ /bag med pa dang / ma gus pa ste spang bar bya'o/ /dgra lta bu ni ni ngo tsha med pa dang / bag med pa'o/ /glen pa lta bu ni dran pa dang shes bzhin med pa'o/ /ra ro ba lta bu ni nag por gyur pa bzhi'o/ /byol song lta bu ni bslab pa'i tshul rnams mi shesapa'o/ /shan pa lta bu ni snying rje dang bral ba'i spyod lam can no/ /byas pa la drin du mi gzo ba lta bu ni so so thar pa'i sdom pa bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /dwa phrugs lta bu ni thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba'o/ /smyon pa lta bu ni bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pa'o/ /bdud rtsis brlabs pa lta bu ni bar du gcod pa'i chos —766—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bzhugs so/ /lnga cu rtsa lnga dang sum cu rtsa gnyis mi shes pa'o/ /lnga cu rtsa lnga po yang gang zhe na 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las 'byung ba lta bu ste/ 'di ltar bar du gcod pa'i chos ni cig ste bag med pa'o/ /glen pa lta bu ni dran pa dang shes bzhin med pa'o/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos ni gnyis te/ ngo tsha med pa dang khrel med pa'o/ /gsum ste 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug go /bzhi ste dam pa ma yin par 'gro ba bzhi'o/ /lnga ste srog gcod pa dang ma byin par len pa dang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang rdzun du smra ba dang chang 'thung ba'o/ /drug ste sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang / /tshul khrims dang slob dpon dang / /rgyan pa rnams la ma gus pa'o/ /bdun te nga rgyal rnam pa bdun no/ /brgyad de log pa brgyad do/ /dgu ste kun nas mnar sems kyi dngos po rnam pa dgu'o / / bcu ste mi dge ba bcu'o zhes 'byung ngo / /bar du gcod pa'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi mdo las byung pa lta bu ste/ ji skad du/ bu mo theg pa chen po'i bar du gcod pa'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ bar du gcod pa de dag gis thams cad mkhyen par myur du nges par mi 'byung ngo / /sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'dod pa dang / brgya byin dang tshangs par 'dod pa dang / skye ba la gnas te tshangs par spyod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig la chags pa dang /longs spyod bdag po rnams la ser sna byed pa dang / sems can rnams la mnyam par mi sbyin pa dang / chul khrims la lhod pa dang / byang chub kyi sems mi bsrung ba dang gnod sems dang / khong khro ba'i bag la nyal byed pa dang des sems zhus pa dang / brjed ngas pa dang / thos pa don du mi gnyer ba dang / spyod pa med pa dang /'phags pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa dang / nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal 'phel ba dang / lus dang ngag dang sems kyi las yongs su ma dag pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su mi bsrung ba dang / slob dpon dang chos 'chab pa dang /bsdu ba'i dngos po thams cad 'dor ba dang / yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba'i chos gtong ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po bsten pa dang byang chub tu yongs su mi bsngo ba dang / phung po gsum pa dang mi mthun pa dang dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngus brlom sems su byed pa dang / thabs med par lhung ba'i blo dang / phyir zhing dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags pa mi smra ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' la gnod par sems pa dang / ma thos pa'i chos spong ba dang / bdud kyi las khong du mi chud pa dang / /'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i gsang tshig smra ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par mi byed pa dang / 'khor bas yongs su mi skyo ba ste/ bu mo sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag gi ni theg pa chen po'i bar du gcod pa yang dag pa'i phung po yin te bar du gcod pa de dag gis thams cad mkhyen par nges par mi 'byung ngo / /de lta mod kyi 'on kyang bu mo theg pa chen po'i yon tan ji tsam pa de tsam du bar du —767—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gcod pa yang de tsam mo zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bar du gcod pa'i chos dpag tu med pa dag mdo sde du mar mthong mod kyi/ 'dir gzhung mang bar 'gyur bas ma bkod de/ lam 'di la ched cher byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pas mdo sde de dang der lta bar bya zhing nyams su blang ba la brtson par bya'o/ /gtam du bya ba gzhan yang mang du yod de/ /rtsub cing drag la yun ring sdug bsngal bzod dka' bzod par byed pa 'di yang ngo mtshar che/ /chu bo bzhis g.yengs yang dang yang du keng rus bzhon pa bzhon pa de yang ngo mtshar che/ /chung ma khyim spangs brtul zhugs bzang blangs rtag tu lus ngag g.yengs pa de yang ngo mtshar che/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu tsam yang med par de nyid don gyi sangs rgyas ye shes rtsad dpyod 'tshol ba 'di yang ngo mtshar che so so thar pa'i bslab pa med par theg chen byang chub mchog gnyis rtsad dpyod 'tshol ba 'di yang ngo mtshar che/ /de la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar che ba mang du yod mod kyi/ /'dzam gling skyes bu'i rtog dang dpyod pa smra bar ga la nus/ /de bas thar 'dod mkhas pa khyod cag smyon pa de dag dang / /lhan cig 'dre bar ma byed bag yod gnas par gyis//'di ltar de dag snying po'i yul du bya ba ma gtogs par/ /lam mchog bshad kyang de la 'jug par mi 'gyur bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /ji srid mngon par shes pa ma thob bar du mi nus bse rur gnas par bya/ /bla ma bzang po btsal bya rtag tu mdo sde dag la blta bar bya/ mdo sde'i don kun las btus pa'i man ngag slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te/ gtan la phab pa' ta9 rigasakyi smon lam/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku la pra ni ṅgā ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /dbang po gsal bar 'chi ba dang / /gnad gcod sdug bsngal med pa dang / /srid pa bar ma do ru yang / /rang byung ye shes rtogs par shog /rang byung ye shes rtogs nas kyang / /gar skye rang dbang yod par shog /gang du skyes pa'i sa der yang / /nyon mongs mtha' dag chung pa yi/ /chos ldan rigs su skye bar shog /chos ldan rigs su skyes nas kyang / /chos ldan grogs dang phrad par shog /chos ldan grogs dang phrad nas kyang / /gtso bo dkon mchog mchod pa dang / /sdom pa gsum la gnas par shog /sdom pa gsum la gnas nas kyang / stong nyi dam pa bsgom pa dang / /thos pa'i chos rnams dran —768—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor sten pa bzhugs se/ /par shog /thos pa'i chos rnams dran nas kyang / /theg pa chen po'i don rtogs nas/ /rang don gtso bor mi byed cing / / 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal bdag la smin par shog /sdug bsngal bdag la smin nas kyang / /lus ngag sems la mi gnod cing / /mtshan ma'i spyod pas mi g.yel ba'i/ /gzhan don dmigs pa'i sems kyis su/ /gzhan don thams cad byed par shog /gzhan don thams cad mthar phyin nas/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog rigs kyi smon lam zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //tha10 theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa drig dzo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa bzhugs/༄༅/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon bla ma rnams la phyag 'chal lo/ /dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /dngos gzhi gtong len spel mar sbyang / /len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsi/ /de nas ma la bsgom par bya/ /de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsumu/ /rjes kyi man ngag mdor bsdus pa'o/ /snga ma dag ni bsdus nas ni/ /stobs lnga dag dang sbyar bar bya/ /'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /gnyis po tshad nas thams cad blang / /'phral la gang thug bsgom dang sbyar/ /rnal 'byor tham/sa cad gcig gis bya/ /cir snang lam du shes par bya/ /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang / /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang / /rtag tu yengs ni thub par bya/ /kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /le lan thams cad gcig la gda' / / chos rnams dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /spyi don gsum dang ldan par bya/ /skyid kyi yan lag sdug mi btsal / / rkyen la ltos pa med par sbyang / /go log mi bya gtong log min/ /rgyu yi gtso bo nges gzung la/ /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo gzung / /lha ni bdud du mi dbab bo/ /nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsten/ /bla ma'i dam tshig spyi dang mthun/ /gnyis po srog dang bsdos la bsrung / /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /yud tsam mi bya res 'jog spang / /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /gzhung bzang mi bsten 'phrang bsgug spang / /'od che ma 'dod yus mi bsgom/ /'bras bu re ba thams cad spang / /lto log tu yang mi sbyang ngo / /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /shags ngan ma rgod ko long min/ /mgyogs rtse ma gtod gnad mi dbab/ /mdzo khal glang la mi dgal zhing / /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /rtog spyod gnyis kyi thar bya zhing / /dol chod du ni sbyang bar bya/ /bkol ba gsum la rtag tu —769—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bslab / / log na gnyen po de nyid sgoms/ /brtan pa thob nas gsang ba spyad/ /rmi lam snang ba sems kyi ngo bor bstan / / sems nyid sgyu ma ji bzhin stong par rtogs/ /sna tshogs sprin bzhin stong pa'i ngang las byung / /chu'i chu bur bzhin du dbye ba med/ /de phyir brjod med spros bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig jo bo chen po rjes mdzad pa'o/ /bla ma gser gling pa las brgyud pa'o/ /༄7/ /mgon po gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ jo bo la bu khyod mtha' 'khob 'dul ba la chos 'di rnams dgos gsung / rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms ste/ /gnyen po thams cad bcom brdeg yin/ /'dun ma thams cad chig dril te/ /lam rnams thams cad chig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid yo lang yin/ /kun nas nyos myongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ mtha' 'khor/ snyigs/ skyid kyi kha gnon chen po ste/ /sdug gi mjug 'thud chen po yin/ /na na nad g.yog chen po yin/ /gcig pur sdod na skyo rogasayin / / gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste/ mtha'/ 'khor/ snyigs/ log rtser log la gcer tser ltos/shig gis shig la 'bol le zhog /des ni 'ching grol bar 'gyur ces gsungs se/ /༄7/ mgon po gser gling ba bla ma rin po che yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mgon po gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ jo bo la bu khyod snyigs ma'i dus su gzhan don byed pa la/ bka' sde snod/ lung rigs pa/bla ma'i man ngag thams cad hril de gril nas stan thog gcig tu nyams su len na/ nad dang gnod pa dang gdon bgegs dang bdud dang mu stegs la sogs pa'i rkyen bar chad thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa'i chos 'di rnams dgos te/ 'di skad du/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ /gnyen po thamasacad bcom brdeg yin//mdun ma thams cad gcig dril te/ /lam rnams thams cad chig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyig pa ma'i dusasu mkho ba yin/ /ces pa'i don ni/ rnam par rtog pa gang byung sa nas 'bur 'joms dang 'jomasasu bya dgos te/ kho gdan snang dbang po gang gi yul na snang / dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa ji ltar bu gcig snang btsal lo/ /'di dug sbrul lam/ khyi smyon dang 'dra ste/ nyer mi rung byung 'drog rang la/ gnyen po la le lo ma shor bar bcom —770—

mdo phyogs spyod pa gtso bor ston pa bzhugs se/ /te / mdo las/ 'dod pa khyod kyi rtsa ba shes/ /shin tu rnam par rtog las byung / /ces dang / rnam rtog ma rig chen ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur byed do/ /ces dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ so so skye bo rnams ni rtog pas bcings/ /mi rtog rnal 'byor pa ni grol bar 'gyur/ /rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin pa/ /rnam par spyod pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsung / zhes bya ba la sogs pa thag pa chen po'i bka' bstan bcos thams cad nas/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i gegs chen por bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na le lo ma shor ba gal che'o//'dir blo sna mangs na mthar mi phyin pa'i rgyu yin pas/ chos zab zab po la'ang ma 'byams par mdun ma thams cad rtog pa 'joms pa la chig chod du 'dril dgos te/ mdo las kyang / yid la byed pa thams cad bdud las su bshad/ des na ji srid rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du tshogs sbyor mthong bsgom pa la sogs pa'i sa dang lam thams cad rtog pa 'bur byung res kyis gnyen pos 'joms pa la mdun ma 'dril ba 'dis chig chod du bya ba'o/ /mdor na rtog pa 'bur de byung res kyis gnyen po nas kyang de'i tsar slob dgos/gnyen pos rnam rtog de 'joms pa la mdun ma thams cad 'dril dgos lam thams cad kyang de kho nas gcod dgos/ de ni blang bya gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad gsungs te/ rkyen na dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste/ sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo lang yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log bsgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ de nas na tsha dang sdug bsngal la sogs mi 'dod pa'i 'gal rkyen gang byung yang des bskul ma byas la/ de'i steng du sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal yang blos lings te blangs/ longs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'du shes bya/ de bzhin du bde skyid la sogs mthun rkyen gang byung yang sems can la byin pas sems can gyi tshogs rdzogs pa la dga' ba'i blo sbyong ngo / /de bzhin du gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs pa snang ba'i rkyen gang byung yang btsal bas mi rnyed/ ma rnyed pa'i don la glod la bzhag pas/ chos nyid la bskul ba'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs yin pas dga' ba bsgom mo/ /rgyal 'gong bsen mo sa bdag la sogs pa'i gnod pa byung tsa na/ des bskul ma byas nas sems can la gnod pa dang sdug bsngal ci yod pa blos lings te blangs nas/ longs nges snyam du dga' ba'i 'du shes bya/ gnod byed rnams la byams pas snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis/ lus kyi sha khrag gang 'dod byin pas byang chub kyi grogs su 'gyur grogs byed pa yin pas/ gdon thams cad sangs rgyas —77/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/kyi sprul pa yin pas de dag la dga' ba dang gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom mo/ /lhag par du na tsha byung ba'i dus su sems can thams cad kyi na tsha sdug bsngal rang gi snying du blangs nas/ sems can thams cad spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin/ go bcad snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ nad med pa'i dus su des bskul nas rang gi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa 'gro ba la byin pas/ sems can thams cad kyi rtog pa phun sum tshogs pa thob pa yin/ go bcad snyam du dga' ba bsgom pas sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma yin te/ sdig sgrib la skad cig cam yang bsdad pa'i glags med do/ /sdug bsngal brgya tham pa byung na 'tshol thebs brgya tham pa yong / de yod ma myong bas ma rnyed thabs brgya thams cad spong bas/ de la spangs pa brgya tham pa rtogs pa brgya tham pa ste/ chos nyid kyi yo lang chen po yin te/ de la dga' ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o/ /de rnams ni spang bya kun na/sa nyon mongs lam khyer gyi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ skyid kyi kha non chen po ste/ /stug gi mjug 'thud chen po yin / / ltas ngan g.yang du 'gugs pa ste/ /mi mkho shos la 'dod thog yin/ /gnyen po log non gyi chos bzhi ste / mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin / / zhes pa'i don ni/ de nas dge sbyor gyi gegs su 'gro ba'i bza' btung / /longs spyod snyan grags pa sogs skyid 'dod kyi kha mnan la 'dod pa chung la chog shes pa'i sgo nas sdug gi mjug 'thud de/ rkang pa na na bskor ba bya/ sked pa na na phyag bya/ 'dod pa che na gzhan la sbyin/ g.yeng ba la dga' na mtshams bcad/ smra ba la dga' na smra bcad bya'o/ /gtam ngan nam/ byur shan nam/ byad kha'am/ phur kha la sogs mi 'dod pa'i ltas ngan chon byung na/ bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dul ba'i thabs yin pas bkra shis dang g.yang du 'gugs shing /da dung thong shig ces shes pa'i dpa' bskyed la/ de 'dra'i rigs mi mkho shes thams cad bdag la byung bas/da 'di thul nas da phyin chad 'khor bar mi skye snyam du de la 'dod thog tu bya ste/ bzod pa gsum la mthu thob par bya'o/ /'di ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa log non gyi chos bzhi yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos gcig yin/ /gzhan ni byang chub kyi 'byung khungs ste/ /bcangs kyis len pa'i chos cig yin/ /spang gnyen/ mjug sdud kyi chos gnyis ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin / / 'khor ngan log sgrubs bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /ces pa'i don ni/ mdor na bdag mi 'dod pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ las ngan thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'di gces spras ma byed par lings kyis skyur la/ dgra dga' na dgra khyer/ 'dre dga' na 'dre khyer/ mi rings na chos la zong rings —772—

mde phyegs spyod pa gtso ber sten pa bzhugs so/ /la khur las rgyugs/ zhes rang thod la btang la/ sems can thams cad don byed pa ste/ rang don yal bar dor nas brtson pas gzhan don lhur mdzad pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'byung khungs yin pas/ sems can thams cad brtse bas bcangs te rang la blang ba ni/ spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos rnam pa gnyis yin te/sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi lag len khyad par can yin no/ /yang 'di skad du/ rgyangs kyi skyur la lhod kyis glod / / shigs kyis bshig la 'bol le bzhag /stong nyid kyi rgyas 'debs bzhi yin te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /de ltar nyams su blangs gyur na/ /skyes bu mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /ces pa'i don ni/ bzung 'jin gyi rtog pa thams cad phar rgyangs te skyur la/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings su/ shes pa gsal la rtog pa med par lhod de slod la/ gang gis kyang ma bcings par bzhag par bya'o/ /de yang shes pa snga ma/'i rjes su mi 'brang / ma/ 'ongs pa'i sngun mi/ bsu/da ltar ba ma bcings par shigs te bshig bcas bcos dang sgro skur med par rang sor 'bol le glod la bzhag ste/ de ni stong pa nyid kyi rgyas 'debs bzhi yin/ nyams len de ltar byas na si/sa kyi 'khor bar mi 'ching / grosnye ri ba thar pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /nyams len 'di las gzhan cig yin na/ dus snyigs ma/'i sem/sa can rmu rgod thur/ bar mi/ 'gyur la/ 'di dang ldan na bar chad kyis mi chugs pas 'gro don ngang gis 'byung 'edra/ gsung ngeo / /bla ma gser gling pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin du bkod pa'o/ /'khor ba'i nags su dka' thub bzod / / skyo ba spangs te rang 'dod 'joms/ /mi 'dod 'jig pas mi brdzi ba'i/ /dpa' bo rnams la gus btud nas/ /bde gshegs rnam srol bskyang ba'i phyir/ /rgyal bu snying stobs chen po ltar/ /g.yin don 'ba' zhig rab bsams nas/ /bdag gzhan nges par brje bar bya/ /de la bdag rgyud rengs pa ngas/ /bcud kyi bdag po dpa' bo la/ /bde legs gsung rab dpang bzhag nas/ /yus pa'i tshig gis gtam 'di zhu/ /e ma dpa' bo snying rje can/ /bdag gis chags pa'i gnas rnams spangs/ 'jigs pa'i lam la dka' ba spyad/ /phyogs las rgyal te drung 'dir slob/ /da ni nad kyis mnar ba yi/ /log sgrub skye bo bzod pa'i phyir/ /mi gtsang 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab tu/ /mi phod brdzi ba'i chos shig zhu/ /snying rje chen pos lan gsungs pa/ /dka' ba spyad nas 'ongs pa la/ /'jigs dang dub pa spang ba'i phyir/ /blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa yod/ kha sprub snod de thos pas rtogs/ /zhabs rdol snod de bsam pas sdo/ba/ /sbags pa'i snod de bsgoms pas khru/ /snod kyi skyon spongs bcud 'di longs/ /kwa ye thog ma med dus nas/ /da rung bdag rgyud ma thul bas/ /gshis ngan bdud kyi khang —773—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa na/ /nyon mongs las kyi pho nya 'khol/ khyod kyi pha ma ma bsams pas/ /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal kyang / / da rung bag phebs bde gyur te/ /gnyen po'i go cha mi gon a/ /de ni gyod brdal chen po yin/ /phyin chad ldog pa'i go ba longs/ /bdag rgyud 'gong po ma thul na/ /pha ma'i srog la 'brab bo a/ /rang gi bde skyid 'joms so a/ /'khor ba'i gting rdo mchi'o a/ /gshis ngan rang mgo ma 'chings na/ /thams cad dgra bor langs gyur te/ /dug mda' snying la zug pa'i tshe/ /nges par phungs par 'chi'o a/ /rang 'dod khyi rkan ma phyung bar / / gnyen po'i sgo cha bsdams gyur kyang / /nang du phung khrol byung ba'i tshe/ /sman sbyar dug tu 'chor ro a/ /dug lnga'i srog rtsa ma chod par/ /le lo'i blo rgya skyed gyur kyang / /tshe thung rlung gi khyer ba'i tshe/ /snying nas 'gyod po mchi'o a/ /de ni bslab bya chen po yin/ /phyin chad sems la brtag gzhig 'tshal/ /rnam rtog bdud kyi rgyal po yin / / gshis ngan las kyi gshin rje yin/ /rang 'dod dug gi sdong po yin/ /skyon 'di semasadang le lo can//tshe 'di'i tshe thabs bslu brid yin/ /bsrung skyob mang po mgo bskor yin/ /lha 'dre mang po brdzun khrigs yin/ /rnam rtog dgra tu ma blang cig /byas pa'i las la zin pa med/ /bskyangasapa'i 'khor la khrel gzhung med/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying po med/ /phugs gzhigs g.yab kyis thob cig a/ /'chi bdag rang gi snying la gnas / / srog ni rang gis gcod par byed/ /dug chu rang gis 'thung bar byed/ /nges par bdud 'di sems cig a/ /'dis ni nyams myong chen po yin/ /bdag gi tes dmigs bshad pa yin/ /gtam 'di 'jigs par rab bsams na/ /phyin chad go ba 'tshal lo a/ /nges par snying la ma bsams pa'i/ /bya byed mang po srog la gzan / / gang la'ang phan sems ma mchis pa'i/ /gtong chen mang po mi kha sdang / /pho tshugasaganyen po med pa yi/ /grogs po ngan pa chos la gzan/ /'dod yon sdug kha ma khegs pa'i/ /chos pa'i gzugs brnyan rgyu la gzan / / byas shes bka' drin mi gzo ba'i/ khrel med de ni yongs la gzan/ /rang don yal bar ma dor ba'i//gzhan don tshig gis bslu yo a/ /blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa las gzhi nyon mongs pa gtan la dbab pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so/ /snying rjesagadungs pa'i sman gcig pu/ /bdag lta thul ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /chags sdang skyob pa'i lha cig pu/ /gnyen po rtsad chod de la 'dud/ /nyon mongasarnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe/ /rgyab khrasabye'u ded pa ltar/ /dmigs su skor la bkar ded gyis/ /lag tu zin tshe brlag par gyis/ /rjun rtog snying la zhen pa'i tshe/ /dgra rkun ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar/ /dbyibs dang sbu ris spyod mdzod la/ /phyin chad ldog pa med par gyis / / bzang rtog dgra ru langs pa'i tshe/ /gshed ma bur rdzus zin par ltar/ /zin ma thag tu mgo non la/ /—774—

mde phyegs spyod pa gce bor ston pa/ ba(zhugs se/ /sreg ched ldog pa med par gyis/ /skyid 'dod le lo byung ba'i tshe/ /ston g.yog gnyid log slong ba ltar/ /bsdad pa'i skabs med drags 'chun gyis/ /rnam grol las la 'da' bar bya/ /che 'di'i che thabs bsgrub pa'i che/ /srin pe me zan mthong ba ltar/ /dngangs shing las de 'phror bzhag la/ /mi khom las la rgyang ring bros/ /zla dang rgayeng bas khyer ba'i tshe/ /g.yul ngor mi ro mtheng ba ltar/ /grogs dang bcas la rab dngangs shing / /dben pa'i nags khrod dran par gyis/ /chags sdang bdud kyis g.yengs pa'i che/ khyi smyon dug sprul ma/thong ba ltar/ /'khor ba'i bde ba rgyab phyogs kyis/ /bcan sa myang 'das dbyings su bros/ /rtag 'jin btson rar bsdams pa'i che/ /rgyal po dong du mnar ba ltar/ /nam 'chi cha me/da rab bsam/sa la/ /yid 'byung skyo shas drag po bsten//thes bsam le 'dod shor ba'i tshe/ /zlos gar mkhan gyi bshad pa snar/ /lag len med nga/ra rab bsam/sa nas / rang la khrel bdas chen po bya/ /nyin mchan chos la 'bad gyur kyang / /da rung skya dri ma/ yal na/ /bdud kyis byer bar rab bsams la/ /bzlog ste gnyen ngo/ bsten par bya/ /byas pa/ chos la bsam/ gyur kyang / /ci byas leg nga ge song gyur na/ /'geng pes khyer bar rab bsams la/ /nges par dkon ma/chog ra mdar spran/ /bla la 'i grwa sar bsdad gyur kyang / /mkhan slob grogs ngo/ ltar bcos pa'i/ /chos nga/sa chags sdang gos gyur na/ /bdud las bsams la nags khred bsten/ /rtse gcig sgom sgrub byas gyur kyang / /da rung grol/ cha ma/ rnyed na/ /thos pas gesnyepa sa la rted skyon/ /bsams la med deo zab cho/ ste/ /blo sbyong sem/sa nga/'i rim nga/ las zlog phyogs gten po'i chos yongs su rdzogs so/ /rang 'dod 'khri ba ma/ zhugs pas/ /theg dman lta bar ma/ lhung zhing / /srid pa'i bcen rar ma bsdams nga/'i/ /grol ba de la phyag 'chal lo/ /nga'o bya ba ma/ge skor yin/ /dgos zhes bya ba ngo dga' yin/ /gzhan la zhes nga/ dgra cheg yin/ /mi/ dgos zhes pa bar chad yin/ /bdag gzhan zhes nga/ 'byed tshig yin/ /chags sdang zhes pa 'khrug pa yin/ /de 'dra'i rnam dbye su byed nga// /de ni zab mo'i chos las nyams / / mkhas pa dgra bo 'joms 'dod na/ /dang por nga bdag khyad du bsad/ /gang gis skur pa btab gyur kyang / / de la dag tshangs rnam mi byed/ /gang gis gnod pa skyal gyur kyang / kha 'dzin shags 'debs yong mi byed / / lus srog longs spyod phral gyur kyang / /rang gis bsags pas lan no zhes/ /lhag par rang la snying tshim bsgrang / /gang gis 'dre gdon rbad gyur kyang / /de la 'khu 'phrig mi bya ste/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa tshim par bya / / mi phod bsam pa brdzi ba ste/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i 'khor la sogs/ /sha la brtse ba phrogs gyur kyang / /rang la gal med snying tshim bsgrang / /phan btags drin lan log 'jal tshe/ /skad cig tsam yang mi 'khrug par/ /—77ze —

bkasnyeri gdar sa dadre dkon gces btās snyespru/sa/ pe prarī rgasung ches kyi sgor/bzod bskul bka' drin dran nga/ra bya/ /da ni sdig pa spong ba'i thabs/ /zhe sngang med nga/ra g.yo bar bya/ /de la bkar kyin byis pa sgoms/ /rang la snying chim/ ma/the les gdab/ /de ltar bzod pa ma theb bar/ /grogs ngan gshis ngan dag dang 'grogs/ /de la dmi/gas rkyen rab byas nas/ /'khor ba nga/ yi skyon bsam/ zhing / /snying rje chen pe lhag par sgom/sa/ /gnas mal sa phug gad skyibs dang / khang rul thigs nga/ 'dzag ri/ dang / /snyelha khang phyugs lhas 'brog steng dang / /gcong rong yi mi/'am/ chags par bsdad/ /de che shes nga/ mi/ dga' zhing / /klung du bsngad na ri la 'gro/ /der yang sdod snying mi/ 'dod de/ /gso dang skyibs dang zur 'a/ bsnyags/ /yang yang sdod sa rab spong zhing / /shes pa mi dga' skye ba na/ /rang la shags 'debs 'di snar bya/ khyod kyi gshes spyod 'di 'dra na/ /gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin/ /blo sems 'di kun bde rmo/ yin/ /gzhan du khyod kyi sdug sran 'dis / / dmyal bar ma skyes khar rje ches/ /btso sreg ma myong khar rje che/ /yi dwags bkres skom grong khyer du/ /bskal nga/ra ma skyes khar rje che/ /mi gcang srin bu'i grong /byer du/ /'dam rdzab chen por rab 'tsho zhing / /bskal par ma skyes khar rje che/ /gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsam/ 'ing / /bdag la khrel bdas chen po bya/ /lte la gyong skur dka' thub bya/ /gso la gyong skur dam/na cha blangs/ /bde skyid khyad bsad gnyen nge/ sgom/sa/ bya byed lings skyur byar med bsten/ /ci byed byang chub grogs su bsgyur/ /blo sbyong sems pa'i rim/ pa las rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so/ /lus dang srog la mi lta zhing / /rgyal srid bya dga' mi bsden par / / dka' spyad bzod pa goms pa yi/ /dpa' bo de la phyag 'chal lo/ /gtam/ 'di zhon dang rtag 'jin can / / las 'di sems dang khur po can/ /skye ba gtan gyi so nam de/ /tshe thung 'di la sgrub dgosan/ /long yod ston pa'i snying med po/ /gdon 'di gang gis brlams pa yin/ /sngar yang skyid 'dod ches pas phung / /de ltar yin mod zur mgo rogs/ /da rung gshis ngan ma spangs na/ /rgyu 'dis shin du phung ba yin/ /da dung gzhan don ma bsams par/ /nga dgos 'ba' zhig bsten byas nas/ /rang gathen thams cad mgo basme/ra nas/ /mnar med gnas su nges par 'i〈cog /tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin shags 'debs kyis/ /'dre rtog zur mgo su bas rags / / na tsha sdug bsngal sdo/ bas mang / /gzer zug sdug bsngal nad du che/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'dra / / dbul phongs sdug bsngal sdo/ bas che/ /bkres skom 'jig skrag yi dwags 'dra/ /dug ༷/la khyi smyon nyid dang mchungs/ /yod na yod pas skyong phyir sdug /med na med pas 'tshol phyir 'khyis/ /gang ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal g.yos/ /ji ltar byas kyang skabs don stor/ /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin ches pas lan/ /sdug sran snying 〈cos —776—

ra jo pyokas trīng pa gco bor sde na ge krasnyespushar se / /chung bas lan/ /byis nga/'i rshang nga/ ral bas snye3 na/ /sdi/nga rje'i rtsa ba chad nga/sa/ snye pan/ /sem/sa bskyed dge ba stor bas lan/ /ma rabs grogs la brten pa/sa lan/ /de rmam/sa tham/sa cad ridas nga/'i chos/ /ra/dun ma/ brlag zin ras la chod/ /da re su la/'ang re ma/ che/ /phyi nang gang lasnyering dgos ra/ 'cha'/ /den re nga rteg pa'i sngan ra/ bsu/ /sngar 'das ngan nga/'i rjes ma bcad/ /bdag 'jin byed ri 'e mna' skyol/ /ngabe shags byed ri 'e ma/na' skyol/ /rme gral 'jug ri zhe ma/na' skyol / /'dod yo na sems/ ri 'e rlo nari skyopa/ /nga bo se'i /sa/ can ma/ra se/ma/sa/ snyel/ /sdug byur tham/sa cad rang gis khur/ bub kha tham/sa/ cad rang rges longs/ khrel bdas chen kro/ rang la gyer// /soms cig soms cig 'jigs nga/ra som/sa/ /zleg cig sngar byas las ge na zlog /de ltar zhon cho/ngas rabs chod na/ /phyi nang dus skabs tham/sa cad du/ /bdag 'di'i sdu ga /ba ma / bzung cig /las ngan seg na khrom du sgrogs / / ngo lkog byed na kha sma phob/ /nang dbyen gyis la nang ma/chang shig /spyo/da ngan dgugs la the les thob/ /gcang rtog skyes che mje ros 'dul/ /gden rteg skyes che gnyan dgu 'grims/ /skyug bro skyes che rnag /brag 'jibs / /ba rgyangs rma/ che bangs 'jin skyur/ /byin rla/bas ma/ zhu 'dre la byen/ /ma/thu bo che la blo ma gtad/ /mo/ bon ngag la blo ra/ dbab/ /drag sngags dag la sem/sa mi/ gtad/ /rdzas ngang ling ga rang la bya/ /'dre gdon nad kyis btab pa na/ /rnge rje 'jin ri/ la sogs pa'i/ khro bo tham/sa cad phye la khyod/ /ma/hā ka la la sogs nga/'i/ /gtur/ po thams/ cad ri kro da /byed/ /nga ni de ring lan chags 'jal/ /srung skyob ra ma/dari sbyon ri shi /de ring 'khor 'das shan shun 'byed/ /'dus shig 'dus shig sha za dang / /dbugs len tham/sa cad rtsa 'dir 'dus//bsha' bshu'i regs la slob par shog /sha bgos regs la slob par shog khyod rnams nga yi pha ma/ yin/ /bu'i sha khrag rol tu shog khyod ni drin can pha ma yin/ /de ring bzang lan len du shog /sngon chad lus sems gces par bzung / /rgyu des da dung 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sngen chad bya dga' rang gis khyer/ /rgyu des da dung na chas btab / / sngon chad gnod pa gathen la bskyal/ /thre/ des khur po re bas lci/ /sngon chad byas pa 'gyod 'u gas las / / da ni 'khu 'phrig za ri shi /sngon ni bdag 'dzin srung srung nas/ kha cam chig gis skyabs 'gro dran/ /da ni skyabs gsum mthu che yang / /nga bdag 'di'i rgyab ma byed/ /phung byed 'di'i gting ma brdzi/ /gal te thugs rjes skyob byed na/ /'dzin pa nang du brlag par gyis/ /gzung ba phyi na rgyabarlag par gyis/ /chags sdang rang sar brlag pa gyis/ /phyis ni ldang ba med par gyis/ /da ni lan chags ston mo 'gyed/ /mgron ris srid rtse man chad nas / / dmya04 khams bco brgyad yan chad na/ /'a/sa dang longs sbyod bya dga' dang / /dbugs dang mdangs 777—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo pe'i gsung chos kyi skor/dang gzi brjid rnams/ /gang la dgos pa thams cad 'dus/ /bgegs ris stong phrag brgyad cu shog /thogs med dus nas gces bzung ba'i/ /sha khrag 'di la dga' bar rol/ /lan chags zol gyi phyis ma snyags/ /mgron ris stong phrag nyi shu shog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga shog /gnod sbyin sha za 'byung po shog /pho bdud bdud kyi pho nya shog /mo bdud las kyi srin mo shog /pho bdud rgyal 'gong sa bdag shog /thams cad 'dir shog sha khrag rol/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas/ /rkang mthil sor mo yan chad la/ kho bo chen chags mi byed kyis / / thams cad bag phob tshim par zo/ /sha khyer khrag 'thung rus pa mur/ /mgo bo yan lag don snying khyer//lhu chigs nang grol chu ser khyer/ /mdor na klad lpags la sogs pa'i/ /lus 'di'i phyi nang thams cad kyis/bzar nyan bcar nyan thams cad la/ 'khu 'phrig ma za tshim par rol/ / zhi bar gyis cig brlag par gyis/ /phung bar gyis shig rtsa ba chod/ /chom chom myogs myogs bdag la ya/ /shag shag tshal tshal bdag la ya/ /rbad rbad thum thum bdag la ya/ hūm̐ dzaḥphyis 'di med par gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun chod cig /las ngan phung po rab gtor cig /sngan chad 'di ni gces par bzung / /da ni 'di nyid brlag par mdzod/ /ma rungs lhags pa'i mthu stobs can/ /sha khrag rol pa'i gdug pa can/ /dbugs len gshed po sa ma/ ya/ khyod kyis bdag 'di choms par gyis/ khyed kyis bdag 'di choms pa na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams pas snyesnag /khyed kyis bdag 'di ma choms na/ /rang rang las kyis brlag par 'gyur/ /nga rni shes nas 'jig pa yi/ /chegs rdzogs 'ching ba grol bar 'dod/ /de las grol bar ma gyur na/ /'dir tshogs gshed ma thams cad kyis/ /rlung dang 'khris pa bad kan dang / /'dus pa nad kyi phung po dang / /mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po thong / /snang yul srid pa 'khor 'das na/ /mi 'dod ji snyed yod pa rnam/sa/ /thams cad bdag gi steng du thong / /'gro kun nyon mongs las rang ni/ /sdug bsngal srid pa khogs par gyis/ /nges par sems can thams cad kyis/ /sdug bsngal rang gi snying nang du/ /da lta nyid du smin par shog /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /las ngan rgyu 'brasadrungang phyung nas/ /spangs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag la yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /thams cad 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs thob gyur te/ /byams dang snying rje chen po'i dpal/ /chos sku nyag cig thob pa na/ /de lasabyung ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis/ /bdag nyid 'khor bar ga la lus/ /gang yang byang chub ma thob par/ /myong 'gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /tshe 'dir rgyud la smin par shog /tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams/ /da leo —778—

mdo phyogs spyod pa/ gce bor sne/na pa/ bzhugs so/ /nyid la smin par shog /de yang zla ba 'di la shog /de yang de ring nyid la shog /de yang skad cig 'di la shog /de ring gzer thung la sogs pa'i/ /zug gzer drag po myong ba'i che/ /nad 'dis 'gro ba yongs kyi nad/ /sgos khur nyid du blangs pa yin/ /da ni thog tu phebs pa yin/ /gtong len gnad du song ba yin/ /a la la ho nga re dga' / / nges par sems can bde ste mchi/ /sdug bsngal bdag gis len pa yin/ /da ni go re bcad do zhes//na tsha skyes pa tsam gyis kyang / /'os med na cha 'dus pa yin/ /nad go bdag gis chod pa yin/ /tsha go bdag gis chod pa yin/ /bkres skom/ 'khyags go chod pa yin/ /lus la na tsha skyes gyur kyang / /sems kyi dga' ba 'phel bar bya/ /blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa las zag bcas dge ba'i stobs bskyed nga/'i chos yengs su rdzogs so// //da11 rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba dang nga55sa pa badzolta/sa the(/ /༄༅/ /rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba dang bcas nga/ yi ger bris pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tham/sa cad la phyag snyerichal lo/ /'a/bor ba thog ma/ med nga/ nas/ /nyon cho/ngas bag chags tshad me/da pas/ /yul ngan rkyen dang phrad nga/ las/ /nyon mo/ngas sdug bsngal skye ba'i che/ /rang gis dran pa'i phyir du ni/ /byas nga/sa de che dran par shog /nang gi sems ni dul gyur na/ /phyi'i dgra 'dis gnod mi/ nus/ /rang gi nang sems g.yo ba na//phyi'i dgra 'dis rkyen byas nas/ /nang gi dgra 'dis rang rgyud sreg /des na nang gi dgra 'di gzhom/ /dug can gnod kyis zas brlag bzhin/ /nang gi dri mas dge tshogs brlag /gnyen po'i chu yis khrus byas nas/ /dag pas bde ba chen po thob/ /gang na gnas tshe gang gi tshe/ /gang gi dri ma/ ldan pa dang / /nang gi dgra ni byung ba'i tshe//thabs ni sna tshogs gsungs pas spongs/ /dgra gzhom dri ma bkru ba'i phyir/ /de che 'bad pa chen po bya/ /gang gis rang gi rgyud 'di la/ /nang du bltas te rang sems brtag /de tshe yul la shes pa skye/ /shes pa skye ba'i yul rnam gsum/ /nyon mongs bar ma dge ba skye/ /rgyu rkyen yul gyi bye brag gis/ /nyon mongs skye ba dag la gsum/ /chen po 'bring dang chung ngu'o/ /gnyen po'i rim pa de bzhin te/ /chen po skye ba'i yul de la/ /brten te tshogs chen 'bad pas bskyed/ /'bring gi yul la 'bring yin te/ /chung ngu la ni chung ngu'o/ /chen po kun la skye na mchog /bar ma lung ma bstan pa yang / /dran pas zin pa'i sems de yis/ /kun slong rjes kyi dge bar 'gyur/ /thabs —779—

bka' gdam/sa dnge/ dken gces btus snyepas/ ji be'e gsung ches kye skor/sgo sna tshogs pa yis su/ /dge ba che 'bring chung ngu dag /ngang gis skye ba'i yul de la/ /sbyor ba dngos dang rjes dag las/ khyad 'phags bsod nams kun bsngo bya/ /shes na gang la'ang tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /thog med dus nas ji srid du/ /bdag ni dug gsum zhen pas 'khor/ /de srid skye shi kha rgyud pas/ /de srid las rnams chud re zos / / ji srid dge sems 'phel 'gyur ba/ /de srid sangs rgyas mngon sa/ngas rgyas/ /bdag ni gti mug mun pas bsgribs/ /mun nag glog 'gyu snang ba cam/ /ji zhig ltar te dran snyed che/ /de tshe 'bad pas sgrub par bya/ /'chi bar nges pa cha yod cing / /gnas pa'i dbang ster med mod kyi/ /bdag ni re shig mi 'chi snyam/ /dran pa btang te byang chub sgrubs/ /gzhan dag la yang bsgrub par gyis/ /dper na byis pa rig med pas/ /me dang g.yang sogs 'jigs pa med/ /de bzhin 'gro ba gti mug rnams/ /ngan song dag la 'jigs pa med/ /dper na zas mchog ro dang ldan/ /nad pa dag la byin pa'i tshe/ /zas la smod cing mi 'dod bzhin/ /thabs kyi bye brag 'di dag kyang / /rmongs pa nyon mongs ldan pa la/ /bstan yang de 'dra nyid du 'ong / /dnge/ra na za la dga' ba'i mi / / zas brlags bsags phan cha yod kyang / /'dod pas mi chugs za ba ba'in/ /snga nghru rgyu 'bras cha yod kyang / / nyen mongs zhen pa stobs che bas/ /dge med sdig pa sna tshogs spyod/ /darnge ro na kha bya ma//ban dag ni/ /kha la bya dgos kun sgrub zer/ /gzhan gyi dran pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin dge ba bya dgos zer/ /ba cig kha la gleng byed cing / /zhe la don du sgrub mi byed/ kha cig 'bras bu don chen po/ /btang nas bya ba chung ngu bsgrubs//de yang byis pa'i spyod pa can/ kha cig bsam pa rlung bzhin g.yo/ /rung dang mi rung gnyis ka byed/ kha cig kha dog dkar po bzhin/ /rkyen gang ldan pa de ltar 'gyur/ /ba cig rang nyid ngang gis dge /grogs kyis spangs pas nyon mongs skyed/ kha cig rkyen med rgyu dang ldan/ /dam pa'i grogs kyis zin pa na/ /sdig spong dge byed dge la bskul/ kha cig dag la skul mi dgos/ rang gi bya ba'i rim pa bskul ba dang bcas pa/ yi ger bris pa/slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mjad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mjad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur te gtan la pha9pe pakhurdo/ //—780—

mde pyegs spyed pa/ gco ber sdezho pa/ ba(hūṃgs so/ /na12 mi dge nga57ri las rtu/ lam ngayand pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ dwa shā ku sha la karma pa thā/ med skad du/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam/ bstan pa/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'chal lo/ /gang zhig bde 'gre theb par snyeridod pa spang bar bya ba'i mi ge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa 'di lta ste/ lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / yid kyi rnam pa gsum ngo/ dang / /'di bcu mi dge ba ru gsungs/ 'di rnams rab tu phye nas bshad par bya ste/ de la re zhig lus kyi ni srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par spyod pa'o/ /ngag gi rdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / ngag rtsu ba po dang / chig 'khyal pa'o/ /yid kyi ni brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang / log par lta ba'o/ /de la srog gcod pa ni srog chags su gyur pa dang / srog chags su 'du shes par gyur pa dang / gsod pa'i sems nye bar gnas par gyur pa dang / de'i thabs kyang byed pa dag srog 'gags par gyur pa ste/ yan lag lnga de dag dang ldan na srog gced pa yin no/ /de la ma byin par len pa gang zhe na/ gzhan gyir gyur pa dang / pha rol gyis yongs su bzung bar yang 'du shes pa dang / rku ba'i sems kyang nye bar gnas par gyur pa dang / de'i thabs kyang byed pa dang / gnas nas spos pa ste/ yan lag lnga po de dag dang ldan na ma byin par len par 'gyur ro/ /'ded pas log par g.yem/ pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ yul ma yin pa dang / dus ma yin pa dang / yan lag ma yin pa dang / bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /de la yul ma yin pa ni/ dam pa'i chos dang sku gzugs la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gnas dang slob dpon dang mkhan po dang / sbyin gnas dang pha ma la sogs pa dang bla ma dang he bar gyur pa'o/ /dus ma yin pa zhes bya ba ni / / nyin par dang zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang sbrum ma dang bu chung 'tsho ba dang mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde bas nye bar gdungs pa dang / bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad la gnas pa'o/ /yan lag ma yin pa zhes bya ba ni kha dang bshang ba'i lam dang / khyi'u dang bu mo'i mdun dang / rgyab kyi bug pa dang rang gi lag pa'o/ /bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa ni gzhan gyi bud med thams cad dang chos dang rgyal mtshan dang / rigs kyis bsrungs pa dang / rgyal pos bsrungs pa dang gzhan gyis blangs pa'i smad 'tshong ma dang / gnyen 'brel can dang byol song ngo / /de lta bus rang gi chung ma la brten na yang 'dod pa log par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de la rdzun du smra ba zhes bya ba ni/ /dngos por yang gyur pa dang / dngos po'i gnas skabs las nyams par yang gyur pa dang /—78/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je be'i gsung ches kye sker/log par 'du shes par gyur pa dang / leg pa'i thabs kyang te bar gnas par gyur pa dang / de'i thabs kyang byed pa dang rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra ba'o/ /yan lag lnga po 'di dag dang snyeldan na rdzun du smra bar 'gyur ro/ /phra ma zhes bya ba ni nyon mongs pa'i sems kyis gzhan la 'byed pa'i chig go /tshig rtsub po zhes bya ba ni pha rol gyi gnad la phog pa'i sdang tshig go /tshig 'khyal pa zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa dang te bar ldan pas sam/ chags pa dang nye bar ldan pas smra bar bya ba ma yin pa smra ba'o/ /brnab sems zhes bya ba ni/ pha rol gyi rdzas dang dbang phyug dang / longs spyod rnams la chags pa'i sems mi bzad pa'o/ /gnod sems zhes bya ba ni sems can la rnam par sdang ba dang sems can 'di dag gsad do bcing ngo rdeg go btag go zhes sems pa'o/ /log par lta ba zhes bya ba ni/ sbyin pa med sbyin sreg med 'jig rten 'di med 'jig rten pha rol med dge sbyong med bram ze med lha med sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das med dgra bcom/ pa med/ rang sangs rgyas med legs nga/ra spyad pa re/da/nyes par spyad pa med/ legs par byas pa dang nyes par byas pa'i lam rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa med ces pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa zhes bya ba dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo las byung ba mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam 'di ni dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu yin te/ mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam brten pas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /mi dge ba bcu'i las kye lam bstan pa/ slob dpon dpal mar me ma/jad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mjad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo cwa ba dge slong chul khrims rgyal bas sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o //pa13 las rnam par 'byed pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma bi tā bā ma/ bod skad du/ las rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /deng sang dus kyi skyes bu 'di dag gis/ /mtho ris bde ba dag kyang thob dka' na/ /mya ngan 'das la re ba yod min pas/ /bdag nyid kho na dran phyir bri bar bya/ /yod med rtag chad dang bral ba/ /bde ba'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /'gro rnams yongs su smin mdzad pa/ /dam pa'i skyes mchog de la 'dud/bcom ldan 'das gang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chen po las kyang phul du byung zhing / khyad par du 'phags pa de la phyag 'tshal nas/ ji ltar bya zhe na/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba rnam par dbye bar bya ste/mngon par mtho ba mtho ris lha dang mi/ /thob par byed pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin/ /de nyams gyur pas ngan —782—

mde phyags spyod pa gce bor sten pa bzhugs so/ /song 'gro ba ni/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byom song 'di dag go /lha dang mi'i gtam rgyas pa 'di ni 'jig rten bzhag pa dang / 'jig rten gdags pa dang bye brag tu bshad pa chen po'i nang nas che long du bsdus pa mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa la sogs pa lta bar bya'o/ /'di ltar tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba ni 'jam bu gling 'di'i 'og na dpag tshad khri phrag gnyis na sems can dmyal ba chen po gnas so/ /gzhan bdun ni de'i steng na rim pa bzhin du gnas so/ /de dag gi tshe'i tshad kyi rim pa ni/ mi rnams kyi lo'i rim pa rnams las 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha rnams dang yang sos la sogs pa dmyal ba rnams kyi nyin zhag dang zla ba dang lo'i rim pa rnams bsgres nas shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar mi rnams kyi tshe lo lnga bcu la sogs pa las sgyur nas zhes bshad pas so/ /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba yang ni te se'i 'og na snga ma de dag gi thad ka na gnas pa ste/ de dag gi tshe'i chad kyang yul dbus kyi bres bcas pa'i til khal brgyad cus phyur bur bkang ba'i nang nas/ skyes bu zhig gi lo brgya brgya na til re re phyung bas zad pa na sems can chu bur can gyi tshe zad pa yin te/ 'og ma rnams kyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi don yang cung zad cam zhig mdo las bshad pa bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar de dag dmyal ba ni / bcu drug ces bya rgal bar dka'/ /drag po'i las kyis kun tu gang / /re re la yang lhag bcu drug /rtsig pa bzhi dang ngos bzhi ste/ /rnam phyed ris su chad pa yin/ /lcags kyi ra bas kun nas skor/ /lcags sreg dag gis gang ba yin/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag du mar ni/ /me lce dag gis khyab par gnas/ zhes bcom/ ldan 'dasakyis gsungs so/ /mardzed las kyang / de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags dang / /spu gri'i lam/ sogs chu bo yin/ zhes bshad do/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po /ba cig na re cha ba la sogs pa bdun po dag rne mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i g.yas ngos dang g.yon ngos na gnas so zhes zer ro/ /te tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba'i sems can dmyal ba dag la ni gnas kyi nges pa med do/ /chu bo dang ri dang mya ngam la sogs pa'i thang dang steng na gnas pa'o/ /gtam rgyas pa ni dran pa lte bar bzhag pa dang 'jig rten bzhag pa dang / 'jig rten gdags pa la sogs par lta bar bya'o/ /yi dwags kyi rtsa ba'i gnas ni rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya na yod do/ /de na yi dwags kyi rgyal po gshin rje gnas so/ /gzhan ni de las 'phros pa yin no/ /gtam rgyas par ni yi dwags kyi rtogs pa brjod par lta bar bya'o/ /byol song gi rtsa ba'i gnas ni rgya mtsho chen po yin no/ /thang dang chu dang ri dang dur khrod la sogs pa na gnas pa ni de las 'phros pa yin te/rgyas par ni de dang de dag tu lta bar bya'o/ /gnas gsum po ni bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa'i gtam / / mdo dang bstan bcos dag na gsal/ /blo dang ldan pas lta bar gyis/ dmyal ba dang yi dwagasadang —783—

bka' gdar/sa dpe dkon gces bzhus las/ ji bo'i gsung ches kyi sker/byol song gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa mdo dang bstan bcos dag na gsal lo/ /mi'i sdug bsngal brgya rtsa cu dag ni/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis ma/jad pa'i yo ga carya ru lta bar bya'e/ /lha dag ni sdug bsngal gzhan ni med kyi 'on kyang 'chi ltas lnga dang nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga byung ste 'di ltar gos dri mas chags pa dang / me teog gi phreng ba rnyings pa dang / mchan khung nas jul byung ba dang / lus la dri ma 'byung ba dang / rang gi stan la mi dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /nye ba'i ltas lnga ni gos dang rgyan dag la yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra 'byung ba dang / lus kyi 'od chung bar 'gyur ba dang / khrus byas pa'i chu yi thigs pa lus la chags par 'gyur ba dang / g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can yang blo yul cig la chags par 'gyur ba dang / mig 'byed pa dang 'jum pa srid par 'gyur ba dag ste nye ba lnga ni ma nges pa'o/ / sdug bsngal de dag ci las byung zhe na/ las ni lci dang yang ba dag /yul dang bcas pa'i dbye ba yis/ /nyan thos theg pa chen po'i lugs/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ lci ba ni gnyis te/ yul gyis lci ba dang bsam nga/sa lci ba'o/ /yang ba yang de dang 'dra'o/ /de yang nyan thos dang theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis lci ba dang yang ba so so tha dad par shes par bya'o/ /de la nyan thos kyi yu gyis lci ba ni/ 'di ltar mtshams med pa lnga la pha bsad pa ma gtogs pa bzhi'o/ /de dag las kyang dge 'dun gyi 'khor lo'i dbyen lci ba'o/ /gzhan yang byams pa'i ting nge 'jin la stoms par zhugs pa dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang srid pa'i rtse mo'i ting nge 'jin las langs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge slong dang dge slong ma dang pha dang ma dang / srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang nad pa dang chos smra ba dang nges pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang dgra bcom pa dag gsod pa dang de dag la brdeg pa dang / lcags sgrog la sogs pas sdom pa dang de dag gi yo byad rku ba dang / mchod rten gyi dang dge 'dun gyi dang / chos kyi dang sangs rgyas kyi yo byad rku ba dang / gang zag snga ma de dag dang dkon mchog gsum la rdzun smra ba dang / de dag phan tshun 'byed pa dang tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa ni yul gyis lci ba'o/ /bsam pas lci ba ni log par lta ba chen po skyes pa dang / yid kyi nyes pa chen po'o/ /yul gyis yang pa ni byol song dang dur khrod kyi sha za gsod pa la sogs pa'o/
