sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /ma16 gshin rje gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ kṛṣṭa ya mā ra su dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrubs thabs zhes bya ba / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rdo rje sems bdag sngags/ /'jigs byed dpa' bo dgra nag la/ /btud de rgyud rim las snyed pa/ /dngos grub 'grub phyir bshad par bya/ /rang gzugs rdzogs pa'i snying ga rtswa /ya yig las ni 'gro ba sbyang / /bdun po yis kyang sbyang byas nas/ /tshangs pa'i gan/sa la bzhag par bya/ /stong pa'i snying po gsal bar bsam/ bsrung ba pad mar ldan pa'i nang / /chu skyes ri bong can rnon po/ /byang chub lnga las rgyu'i gshin gshed/ /rtsa ba'i zhal gyi khyad par can/ /zhu ba'i thig le byang chub sems/ /ya las mtshan mar bsdu bar bya/ /de las 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /ind+ra ni la lta bu te / / ser mdzes spyan dgu zlog cing 'gyur/ /lnga cu'i do shal mnyam du dpyangs/ gdug pa brgyad kyis sku brgyan cing / / rus pas brgyan cing dum bus sgeg /mtshon cha bcu gnyis 'khrug par bsam/ /ma he la bzhugs srid rtser 'bar/ /sku gsung thugs dang skye mched dang / /dbang dang byin brlabs mchod dang bstod/ /bdud rtsi myang dang spro bsdu dang / bzlas pa'i rim pa man ngag las/ /shes pas dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ io kā la rū pa hūṃ/ oṃ ya ma rā dza/ sa do me ya/ ya me do mā ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni/ ra ya kṣe ya yakṣe ya tstsha ni ra ma ya/ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ io hrīḥsgyiḥbi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ drug pas gtor ma'i bsnyen pa bya/ /sum cu brgyad pas nye bar bsnyen/ /bco lnga pas ni thams cad 'grub/ /las kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /gshed nag rgyud du byung ba las/ /snyed de sgrub thabs 'di bris pas/ /blo ni rab dag gyur nas kyang / /gshin rje'i gshed du 'gyur bar shog gshen rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal mar me mdzad pas mdzad pa'o// //tsa17 lasasgrib rnam spyong gi sgrub thabs/༈bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub po dam tshig dang ldan pas/ dgon pa grong mtha' la sogs pa'i/ sems kyi bsgom par bya ba ni/ las bya bde ba'i stan la 'dug /rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka sa /padma zla ba'i steng du hūm̐/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa/ /spyan —963—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ je bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan pas ni/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyi bsgom par byas nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam / / rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ bsams te dam tshig phyag rgya bca'/ /de nas rang gi sa bon las/ /phyag rgya phyag mtshan byin gyis brlab/ /de rnams gyur las mi 'khrug pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/g.yon pa spang bzhag rdo rje dang / /g.yas pa sa gnon tshul can sgoms/ /steng 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur bya/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /rang nyid rang lhar sgoms la ni / / mi 'khrug mkha' la spyan drangs te/ /mchod dang bstod pa chul bzhin bya/ /rang lus mi 'byug bsgoms la bstim / / thugs kar pad zla hūm̐ las ni/ /bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar bya/ /dbus su mi bskyod pa nyid sgoms / phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas bzhi yang sgoms/ /mchod dang bstod dang bzlas pa bya/ /rang lus sgra dang bsam dang gzhi dang gzhol/ /yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum/ /rang dang gzhan don rnyed pa ni / / grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o/ /ngag tu shub shub rdo rje'i bzlas/ /yid dang brjod dang bcas dang bzhi / / me dang sgra dang sgra mtha' gsum/ thun gsum dag tu bzlas pa bya/ /gnyis ni mchod bstod gtor ma spyin/ /de ltar thun gsum sbyor ba yis/ /bsnyen pa sngon du rab song bas/ /gang 'dod dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de nas las la sbyar bar bya/ /padma'i drod las char chu'o/ kha zlum drod kyis 'byed pa dang / /nyi ma'i me shel me 'byung bzhin/ /mi'i lus la dngos grub gtor/ 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ dī saṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //tsha18 ngan song spyong rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga༈bden pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya/ /gang du las ni yod gyur pas / / las kyi cho ga rnam dbye ba/ /gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dag las/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten / / dkyil 'khor sum stong dag dang ni/ /lnga brgyar gsungs pa gang yin pa/ /spyi'i cho ga bshad par bya / / yid dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngags ma/khan gzhan la phan brtson pas/ /snying rjer ldan pas dbang bskur ro/ /grangs sam dus sam mtshan ma'am/ /bsnyen pa tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ /sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin bya / / sa brtag slang sbyang byin gyis brlabs/ /dbang du bya ste spyi dang mthun/ /ma 'grub na mi dgos/ /stegs bu —964—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /rnying pa yin na mi dgos/ lha dang bum pa lhag gnas dang / /gson gshin slob ma gang yang rung / /bdun po rnam par dag par bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sbyin par bya/ /so shing skyur la bsrungs skud gdags/ ku sha gtad la chos bshad bya/ /gtad dang drag po'i las la ni/ /sa sbyang byin rlabs mi dgos so/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhir thig btab la/ /de'i dbus la padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa khru de bri/ /dkyil 'khor lhag ma'i tshad dag kyang / / ci 'dod par ni nyid du bri/ /yo byad chung ba dag gis kyang / /bzlas brjod byas la dkyil 'khor bri / / chig kyang du ni bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu zlum por bya/ /de nas phyi mtshams skyong ba dang / /'dod pa'i lha la stsogs pa kun/ /so so'i sngas kyis rim bzhin mchod/ /de nas mi 'brug spyan drangs te/ /bdag po sngags kyi snying po mis/ /de'i 'og tu mchod nga/ bya/ /bum pa bkang la steng du bzhag /cho ga bzhin du rdzas gsog go /las kun grub byed dkyil 'khor te/ /gsang ba sngags kyi bdag pos gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni kun bris nas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa dang / /sgrub pa po la dbang bskur ba/ /dkyila'akhor 'di dag nyid du bya/ rgyud las bshad pa bzhin du bya/ zhes bshad nga/sa/ 'dir khyad par ni / 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su ni/ /rdo rje chen po bri bar bya/ /'dab ma brgyad la rdzas brgyad dgod/ / dpal be'u dang 'khor lo dang / /padma dang ni rgyal mchan dang / /gdugs dang bum pa dung dang nya/ /rim/ pa bzhin du bri bar bya/ /phur pa dra ba dra ba bzhin/ /bsrung ba rtsa ba'i sngags sam ni/ /yang na de'i snying pos bya/ /bla re ba dan gdugs la sogs/ /mchod pa gtor ma la sogs bsgram/ /'bru sman rin chen lnga ldan pa'i/ /bum pa de'i dbus su bzhag khrus dang cho ga ldan/ pa yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam bzhag pa'i/ /bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung / / ram̐ gis thams cad stong pa las/ /baṃ mo rghaṃ las gzhal yas khang / /de nas padma zla dbus su/ /dam tshig pa'i mi 'khrug bskyed/ /spyan drangs bstims la mchod pa bya/ /de'i thugs kar zla ba las/ /gsang sngags dmigs te ci nus bzlas/ /de nas mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ khrus byas rtsa ba'i slob ma de/ /dkyil 'khor de'i mdun nyid du/ /'dug la bdun po rnam dag bya/ /'gyod sems gdung bas bshags par bya/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbog /gshin po yin na bra ba bya/ /'byor na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur bya/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /sbyin pa chu yis rjes dgongs la/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar pha rol phyin drug po/ /gson na bkris rdzas brgyad sbyin/ /rakṣa zhes pas bsrung bar bya/ /a pa ya nas bsrung bar bya/ /mchod rten rab gnas tsha tsha btab / / ngan pa bzlog la las 'di bya/ /'di ni yid bzhin nor lta bu/ /spyi bo gcug tu bskur —965—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bar 'os/ /rgyal po bzhin du mnyes dka' bas/ /mnyes par gyur na de bzhin du/ /yon tan mchog gi sbyin par byed/ /'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga 'dis/ /kun gyis mtho ris thob par shog dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dza19 bcom ldan 'dasami 'khrug pa'i sgrub thabs/ ༈bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub po dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dgon pa'am grong mtha' la sogs par/ khrus byas gtsang mar byas pa yis/ /las byas bde ba'i stan la 'dug /rang lhar gadra55 ba'i thugs ka mā padma zla ba'i steng du hūṃ/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni mi bskyod pa/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa bya/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par ni/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis sgom par byas nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam / / rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams nas dam tshig phyag rgya bca'/ /de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag mtshan phyag rgya de byin brlabs/ /de rnams gyur pas mi 'khrug pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo/ g.yon pa phang bzhag rdo rje dang / /g.yas pas sa gnon chul can bsgom/ /lha 'og rim pa ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rang nyid rang lhar bsgoms la/ /mi 'byug mdun nam spyi bor bsam/ /rang lus mi 'khrug bsgoms la bstim/ /thugs ka'i pad zla'i hūm̐ las ni/ /dbus su mi bskyod pa nyid sgoms/ /phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas bzhi bsgom bya/ /mchod dang bstod dang bzlas par bya/ /sgra dang sems dang bzhi la gzhol/ /yan lag bzhi dang dmigs pa gsum/ /gzhan dang rang don brnyes pa ni/grangs dang dus dang mtshan ma'o/ /dngos grub bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ /ngag dag shib bu rdo rje bzlas/ /yid de brjod dang bcas pa bzhi/ /me dang sgra dang sgra mthar gsum/ /thun gsum dag tu bzlas par bya/ /gnyis ni mchod bstod gtor ma sbyin/ /de ltar thun gsum sbyor ba yis/ /bsnyen pa sngon du rab song bas/ /gang 'dod dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /de ni las la sbyar bar bya/ /padma'i 'od las char chu yis/ kha zum 'od kyis 'byed pa yis/ /nyi ma me shel 'byung me bzhin/ /mi'i lus la dngos grub ster/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing / /sems can sdug bsngal gzir las sgrol bar shog bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //—966—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gce bor ston pa'i smor bzhugs se// /wa20 sbyin sreg gi ces ga༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho ma bi dhi/ bod skad du/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin sreg chen po'i rim pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su ni/ /thab khung zlum po khru do bya / / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bri/ /yang na ma bris nga/ yang rung / /bud shing brtsigs te sreg rdzas gsog /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs dgram/ /bla re bres pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste sgoms / / thab tu rdzas la brag rdeg bya/ /me sbar me lha bskyed nga/ ni/ /ram̐ las me/ lha drang srong ni/ /bgrang phreng ril pa phyag na 'jin/ /chur gshegs chur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me/ lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /dgang blugs zhal zas bzhes slad tu/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag rbe ye ja la ya ja hūm̐ baṃ ho/gnyis su med par bsdims pa la/ oṃ baju yakṣe hūm̐ zhes bsangs te mar gyi dgang blugs ribul/ mchod bstod sreg rdzas rim par dbul/ /de nas mchod bstod me lha ni/ gshegs pa'am/ 'bar ba'i rnam par ro/ /de nas padma zla ba la/ /dad nga/ dang ni dam chig gis/ /chur gshegs chur gshegs bcom/ ldan 'dir/ /bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par ma/dzod/ /oṃ bi gha nan ta krid hūm̐ phaṭa/ /thal mo sbyar la mjub gnyis dgyed/ /rmeo ta thā ga tor bha ba ye swāhā/ ja hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ /ma/chod dang bstod nga/ byas nas ni / / mar dang gro dang sran ma dang / /zho dang sman dang dur ba dang / /sha sha yam shing me tog dang ri/ /til dang yungs kar la sogs bsreg /thams cad rgyun gcod sngags kyis byas/ khyad par las su bya ba ni/ /til dang yungs kar dag la ni/ /brgya'am stong ngam/ khri ru bsreg /sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i las su bstan/ /de nas mchod bstod gtor ma thong / /bsngo dang bzod par gsol te gshegs/ /rdzas kyi lhag ma me lhar 'bul/ /mchod bstod bzod par gsol te gshegs/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol / / sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /dman pa bsdu zhing a kar bzlas/ /ji ltar grags pa'i bkris brjod/ /me yis sbyangs pa'i nor bu bzhin/ /rang gi spyi bo'i gcug tu skur/ sbyon sreg gi cho ga di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mjad pa rdzogs so// //—967—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung ches kyi sker/zha21 dam tshig zung ba'i sgrub thabs/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya rakṣa su dha rna/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgrub thabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i snying la phyag tshal lo / / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /gang 'dod dngos grub sbyin mjad pa'i/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul la ni / / dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rgyal sras thu bo rnams la yang / /dngos kun phyag byas 'od zer gyi/ /dri med snying po sgrub thabs bshad/ /bkra shis yid 'ong bde gnas su/ khrus byas bde ba'i stan la 'dud/ /gsum la skyabasasu 'gro ba dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /sdom bzung tshad med bzhi la gnas/ /rang snying alas 'od byung bas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i ngos la bsam par bya/ /phyag 'tshal mchod la sogs pa bya/ /de nas stong pa'i ngo bor bsam / / rmeo shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bha wa ārma ko3 haṃ/ de nas las rjes dran par bya/ /a las zla ba rdo rje bskyed / / de yis ji ltar 'dod rgyal pos/ /bgegs rnams thams cad bskrad par bya/ /de dbus mkha' gzhu gru gsum zlum/ /gru bzhi ri rab rnam par bsam/ /gru bzhi sgo dang rab ldan pa/ /'od dang ldan pa'i khang bar bsgom / / lte bar padma zla ba la/ /a dang mi sum̐ hrīḥhūm̐ las/ /a las nor bu 'bar bar gyur/ /sku mdog sna tshogs ma nges pa/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan dang ldan/ /g.yas pa skyabs sbyin g.yon nor bu/ /mtshan dang dpe byad tshogs pa dbus/ /g.yas su 'jam dpal rnon po la/ /rgyab tu shākya thub pa nyid/ /g.yon du seng ge sgra bsam bya/ /mdun du phyag na rdo rje sgoms/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes bsam/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur bsam par bya/ /mchod stod legs par rdzogs pa dang / /rtse gcig yid kyis bsgom par bya/ /de la skyo na snying po bzlas/ /gtsug tu bzlas dang smin phrag dang / /snying ga nyid du bzlas pa'o/ nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mu dra a dhinyi te swāhā/ de nas gtor mas mchod nas gshegs/ /bdag nyid spyod lam nyid bya zhing / /snang ba sgyu ma bzhin du spyad/ /'di byas nges pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'di byas ngal bas sdig pa dag /dri med 'khor lo'i skur gyur shog de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi mkhan po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / bod kyi lo cwa ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /de nas khrus byas gos gtsang bgos/ /spos kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya/ /mchod rten lnga btab 'gro ga la/ /'khor lo bya ྅ 3sdoogs par bya/ /ba dan gdugs dang rgyam mtshan sogs// me togs phreng —968—

sngags phyegs sgyu lus gce bor ston ru /'i skor ba(྅gas/ so/ /bas brgyan pa ni/ /dbus dang grwa la bzhugs su gsol/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi la ni/ /byin gyis brlabs la phyegs bzhir bzhag /rma bya'i sgro lnga mu men dang / /spes kyi sdong po'i sdod bzhi yang / /grwa la legs par bzhag par bya/ /mchod yon spos dang me tog tshogs/ /mar me dri dang lha bshas dang / /rol mo sna tshogs reg byas mchod/ /a las byung ba'i ngo mchar mchog /thugs ni nam ma/kha' sangs rgyas nyid/ /gcug tor dri med snying po'i mchog /yid bzhin nor bu khyod phyag 'chal/ /shes rab ma/chog gyur 'jam/ pa'i mgon/ /a la la ho ngo bo'i chos/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog 'byung ba/ /'jar/ kra/'i mgon la phyag 'chal bstod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shukya thub/ /thugs rje mchog tu gyur pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mchungs/ /shākya thub la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje chen po'i mchog gyur ji/ / /dri re/da dag nga/'i snying de/'i sku/ /'od zer 'bar bas gsung dag pa/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'chal bstod/ /bdud rnams 'jom/sa nga/'i rdo rje can/ /thugs kyi rdo rje yid bzhin chul/ /nad rnam/sa sel ba sman pa'i mchog /phyag na rdo rje phyag 'chal bstod/ /sdig gshags bsod nams rjes yid rang / /'khor lo bskor dang myang mi 'da'/ /bsngo dang gsosnyel gdab 'dod don zhu / / gang 'dod nga/ yis las la lajug /rgyun dang nar ma/ra tshogs bdag bya/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mjad nga/ rdzogs so/ /dang ngo/ra sems bskyed la gang dmigs pa'i bsam rgyud dang bcas par bya'o/ /dang por bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sem/sa dpa' rnams dang / gcug tor dri ma/ me/da pa la sogs pa mdun gyi nam/ mkha' la bzhugs par bsam/sa la ma/chod pa rgya chen po dngos su 'bul lo/ /de rnams kyang bdag dang / bum pa dang /nad pa'i gang la sgrub par byed nga/ de la byin gyis brlob par gsol ba gdab cing byin gyis brlo/ba par bsam mo / / bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa de la bdag rang kyang khrus bya/ gos sbyong la sogs pa gcang mar byas la gzungs char brgyad bzlas so/ /de nas gang la dmigs pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob par bsam la khrus bya'o/ /bsam rgyud dang bcas pas so/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gal te cho ga bya bar 'dod na/ des khrus byas la/ gos gcang ma bgos/ spos kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bya'o / / snying po'i rig sngags gro ga la bri bar bya'o/ /mchod rten lnga gdab par bya/ rig sngags 'di yang mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug par bya/ mchod rten bzhi ni grwa bzhir bzhag par bya/ gcig ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag par bya/ shing bu gtsugs te ba dan dmar po dpyangs par bya'o/ /me tog gis gtor la bum pa gang ba bzhi gzhag /grwa bzhir spos phor bzhi dang / du ru ka dang / a ga ru dang / gu gul gyi dud pas gdug par bya'o / / spos kyi mchod yon gyi snod cig gzhag par bya/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i sngags 'di gnyis —969—

bka' gdar/sa dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji pe'i gsung chos kye skor/kyang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya'o/ /nad kyis brtab pa/ gnod pa/ nad tshabs che ba/ tshe zad pa/ dus ma yin par 'jigs pa/ rgyal po dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa dang /bu 'dod pa rnams dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs par 'dug go /rma bya'i sgro lngas byab nga ra bya'o/ /mchod yon gyis dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di lan gcig byas na bskal pa 'bum du byas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa dang bral nas sgrib pa med par 'gyur ro/ /kun nas sgor 'jug nga/'i 'odazer gcug tor dri ma med par snang ba / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang / dam tshig la rnam par lta ba'i gzungs sngags 'di bris la mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug go /mchod rten gsar pa'am rnying pa bcos pa'ang rung ste/ de'i nang du gzhugaspos dang byugs pa yang 'bul lo/ /gzungs kyi sngags bzlas shing brgya rtsa brgyad bskor bar bya/ nyin zhag re la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dran par bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma shar ba dang shar phyogs su spos kyi dkyil 'bar bya/ nyi ma logs su me tog gis gtor ro/ /de nas a ka ru dang du ru ka'i du bas bdug ste/ de bzhen gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya'o/ /mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad btab la rigs sngags kyi snying po bris te/ mchod rten gyi nang du bcug dkyil 'khor steng du bzhag nas gaṅga'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum khrag dgu'i bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gdung gi ring bsrel mchod rten re re'i nang du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /snying po 'di bris la gzhug go /gcug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //za22 gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog 7/'phags pa 'jams dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga la/ dang por ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la/ de la tsan dan gur kum la sogs pas gtor la me tog sil ma'ang gtor ro/ /de'i steng du gcug tor dri ma med pa'i yang snying gur nu 'am 'gi haṃ gis me tog dkar po 'byung ba'i smyu gus gro ga la bris la/ de dkyil du gcug pa'i satstsha lnga'am/ mun nam dgu tsam byas la / maṇḍal gyi me tog phung po'i steng du bzhagade nas mchod rten re re la lha bshos la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa lnga re re bshams la/ maṇḍal gyi steng du skor ba ltar bzhag yang maṇḍal gyi steng du gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che'i bum pa bzhi'am lnga tsam dang skyogs la sogs pa'i snod bzhi tsam/ a ga ru dang du ru ka la sogs pa dri bzang pos bkang la phyogs dang mtshams rnams su bzhag go /de nas mchod pa bshams pa rnams sku —970—

sngags phyogs sgyu rus gce bor ston pa/'i sker bzhugs se/ /gzugs dang sasme la sogs pa'i dkon mchog la dbul zhing / bsod nams kyi yan lag rnam/sa tshang bar bya'o / / de nas mchod g.yog gcig bdag gis bzlas brjod ma zin gyi bar du a ga ru la sogs pa'i spos dri zhim po bsreg tu bzhug bzlas pa'i dus su gtam gzhan dang ma 'dres par bya/ bzlas pa zin pa dang / yang snying po 'ba' zhig zlas shing bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad bya/ de ltar zin pa dang rin po che'i snod rnam/sa kyi chu kun las cung zad blud cing khrus bya/ de ltar byas na glo bur ba la sogs pa'i nad tsha bas che bas las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe zad pa las ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa chen po rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur te / de dag la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med pa ni de nyid kyi cho ga rgya chen po las shes par bya'o/ /cho ga gang byed kyang 'byung po thams cad gtor ma gsum bzhi btang bar bya'o/ /slon dpon chen po dpal mar me mjad ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gcug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //'a23 dpal mgon po nag bo'i gartasno ma/nyu/ /rgya gar skad du/ mahā kā la ba li ta su nā ma// bod skad du dpal mgon po nag po'i gtor ma/ zhes bya ba / dpal lcam dral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su/ byang chub kyi sems sngon du gtang la/ baṃ sgrub baṃ gtor ma dbul te/ gtor ma la gsum bdag khyad par du bya ba dang /gtor ma khyad par du bya ba dang / mgron khyad par du bya'o/ /dang po ni/ rang skad cig gi la bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo bar sgoms la sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni banta'am thod pa'i nang du mi'i sha chen nam sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mgon po'i gtor ma bzang po bsham/ de med na snod gzhan du mar gyis brgyan pa bsham mo/ gtor ma bshams zin pa dang / eo su bhā ba bi shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥsu bha ba bi shuddha hūm̐ zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod pas gtor ma mi dmigs par stong par sgoms/ stong pa'i ngang las ye sngon po gcig yongs su gyur pa la/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngo skyar 'dug pa dbyibs gzhu bzhin nar mor 'dug pa / gzhu mchog gnyis na mar dar gyi ba dan gyis mtshan pa cig sgoms/ de'i steng na ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor grwa gsum 'bar ba tsha ba gcig sgoms/ de'i steng na a yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba gcig bsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'odazer 'phros gtor ma la mar la 'phos song bas/ gtor ma'i mi gtsang ba dang / snod kyi dri ma dag par bsam mo/ /der hrīḥyang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ de nas gtor —971 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung ches kyi sker/ma khru gang gis mtho ba'i steng du/ re las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du mthing nag de yongs su gyur nas rngo rje nag po rtse dgu pa khong seng can cig bsam/ de'i steng du ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyir 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bzhengs nas bzhugs par bsams nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros nas/ rdo rje'i khong seng nas song / rdo rje'i 'og ma nas gnyis su gyes nas song bas/ gzhu mchog gnyis kyis ba dan la brgyab pas ba dan gyis rlung g.yabs rlung gis me 'bar mes thod pa khol/ 'od yar 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga yi / char 'bab par bsams la ngag tu io a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā nam arya nud pan na twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāta /zhes bya ba'i sngags lan lnga'am/ bdun brjod/ a ṇa hūm̐ dang de bzhin brjod/ de'i steng gi nyi ma/ dang / 'og rgo nyi ma gnyis hūm̐ dang gsum 'khyags pa'i zar bu zhu ba gcug tu bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la/ de nas sgo nga rgo lag pas rdo rje blangs nas lan gsum dkrugs pas bdud rtsi dkar chil bar gyur bar bsam me// /de nas rang gi lag pa'i rdo rje mi dmigs par sgoms/ de ni gtor ma khyad par bya'o/ /mgron khyad par du bya ba ni/ gtor ma'i mdun gyi nam mkha' la ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de nas 'od 'phros sems can thams cad la phog sdib sgrib dag thams cad dpal mgon po'i skur/ de slar 'dus pas dpal mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas g.yon mi shes pa gcod pa'i ral gri dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal dang stag gi sham thabs can cig bsam/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las g.yas su phaṭa dmar nag gcig chad song ba las/ nyi ma'i gdan la dpal legs ldan nag po sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas g.yon na tsan dan gyi be con dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon pa cung zad brkyang pa/ g.yas pa cung zad bskum pa'i 'gying bag can rus pa'i ze 'phrog can 'jol ber sum brtsegs gsol ba gser gyi ske rags bcings pa cig tu bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs kyi bang rim nas mgon po dpon g.yog spyan drangs la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs stim mo/ /dpal legs ldan la yang de bzhin du bstim mo/ /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs so/ /yang mgon po'i g.yon phyogs su yam̐ sngo skya yongs su gyur pa las / rlung gi dkyil 'khor de'i steng na bhyoḥsmug nag de las 'od 'phros sems can la phog sdig sgrib dag thams cad dpal lha mo'i skur slar 'dus pas dpal lha mo sku mdog smug nag bong bu ga dmar la chibs pa —972—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso ber sten nga/'i skor bzhugs so/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ ga yas g.yon du ral gri dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa mche ba gcigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ gong smed gong thag sbrul la byas nga/ / snga sha phyi sha la mi ro btags pa/ nad gi brkyal pa dang mtshon gyi gru gu thogs pa gcig bsgom mo / / de'i thugs ka na ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng na bhyoḥsmug de las g.yon phyogs su bhyoḥnag po cig chad song pas/ dpal re ma ti sku mdog nag mo/ re ba'i gos gyon pa/ dre'u nag mo la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas g.yon na ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa mche ba gcigs pa skra gzings pa/ gong smed gong thag sgrul 8la byas pa/ snga sha phyi sha la mi ro btags pa/ nad kyi brkyal bu dang mtshon gyi gru thogs pa gcig bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gis thugs ka nas 'od 'phros song bas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i kha bzang gi byang shar mtshams kyi mtsho mu le ldings nas ye shes kyi lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim mo/ /lha mo drel bzhon ma la yang de bzhin bstim mo/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas bzlas pa byed na rang gi snying ga nas ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na hūm̐ mthing nag bzhengs nas bzhugs pa la/ eo caṇḍa mahā kā la badzra rda shri na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi g.yas skor du bskor nas yod par bsams la/ de rang gi snying ga nas mgon po'i zhal du song /lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar yang rang gi kha nas thon mgon po'i zhal du de bzhin khor yug tu 'a/bor bar bsam zhing bzlas par bya'o/ /dpal lha me'i bzlas pa byed na khor yug gi bzlas pa mi bya bar dpal lha mo la dmigs la/ rmeo ru ro ru ru ca pa la/ a shung me ma hūm̐/ bhyoḥrdzo rdzo zhes bya ba'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa mi byed par gtor ma gtor na/ bskyed pa bzhi po la lce'i stod hūṃ re yod par bsams la/ hūm̐ bzhi po de yongs su gyur pa las lce stod rdo rje lce smad sbu gur yod par bsams la/ mgon po la bstod na hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/gtor ma la gtar gtsugs nas gsol bar bsams la/ hūm̐ oṃ tsaṇḍa mahā kā la ba ling ta /khā hi khāhi zhes bya ba lan gsum gyis bstab bo/ /io tsaṇḍa dho ba mahā kā la ba ling khā hi khā hi zhes bya ba lan gsum gyi lha mo dpon g.yog la btab bo/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo/ /oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad / rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang sems can don la gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ māṃḥzhes bya bas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs bskyed pa bzhi po mi dmigs par sgoms/gtor ma sa gtsang sar skyal lo/ /dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba 'brom ston gyis bsgyur ba'o// //—973—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/ya24 sgrol ma dkar smro'i skub thabasajo bo a ti shasamadzad pa bzhugasaso/ /ra29/ /rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por sngags pas gdong bkru ba la sos pa byas te/yid dang mthun par bsam gtan gyi gnas gtsang zhing dri zhim po gcal du bkram par/ stan gtsang ma bde bar dkyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ io āḥbi ghānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa / zhes bya ba'i sngags lan bcu'i bar du brjod de/ phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar chos thams cad kyi chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin skye ba med pa ston par byed pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba 'od zer dkar por 'phro bas rang gi lus gsal bar byed pa shin tu 'phro ba bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po'i thig le shel gong dag pa lta bu de rim gyis 'phel bar gyur pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs su bsam zhing / de'i steng du yi ge two 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phro ba'i rin po che'i sgron ma ltar dkar ba rnams par bsam mo/ /de nas yi ge twe de'i 'od zer shin tu dkar ba'i tshogs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gsal bar byas pa sngon du 'gro bas lha mo sgrol ma la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / bla ma rnams bskul te spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs la rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du yid kyi rang bzhin gyi mchod pa bya ba yin la/ de la mchod pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/ io badzra puṣṭi hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi ge two las byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas eo badzra dhū pe hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge twe de nyid las yang dag par spros pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu eo badzra di pe hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge tī de nyid las rin po che'i sgron ma spros la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas io badzra garnye hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge tī de nyid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o / / de nas oṃ badzra nai wi dhya hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la yi haṃ de nyid las rin po che sna tshogs su bcug pa'i lha'i zhal zas ro mchog dang ldan pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par spros pas mchod par bya'o / / de nas oṃ sarba bi shiṣṭha pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dre āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod la/ yi ge haṃ de nyid las rin po che sna bdun gyisagadugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang ba dan dang / bla bres la sogasapa dang / 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa byas nas de dag gi —974—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gce bor snen pa'i skor bzhugs se/ /spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byas la/ byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms te/ tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi bsgoms nas byang chub kyi sems brtan por bya'o/ /de nas io swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum brjod la/ 'gro ba thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma dang mig sgyu lta bur stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du dmigs par bya'e/ /de nas yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsam de'i steng du yi ge twe dkar po 'od zer dkar po 'khrigs pa bsam/de yongs su gyur pa la utpal sngon po de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na yi ge haṃ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pa des sems can thams cad sbyangs nas lha mo sgrol ma'i skur gyur pa 'od zer de nyid kyis bkug pa utpal dang yi ge haṃ la bstims pa/ padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /mchog sbyin pa dang utpal bsnams/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra ba/ /zla ba la ni rgyab bsten pa/ rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de 'dra'i sras/ /kun gyi yum gyur 'dod sku 'chang / 'phags ma sgrol ma de'i snying gar zla ba'i steng gi haṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo 'od zer dkar po sgoms/ /rtsibs brgyad pa la yi ge ni/ /brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba la/ /lte bar io hā yi ge yi/ /dbus gnas bsgrub bya'i ming dang ldan/ /zla drug brtan zhing nges pas ni/ /rtse gcig pa yi sems kyis sgoms/ /yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni/ /skyo bar ma gyur sems kyis bzlas/ /dang por oṃ ni bzhag nas su/ /de 'og tā re rab tu sbyar//de 'og tutpā re tu re/ /swāhā'i mtha' can las kun byed/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo de las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas / dam tshig sems dpa' 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin gyis grub pa bskul nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams la/ snga ma bzhin du yang dag par mchod de/ de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis gung mo gnyis kyi rgyab tu sbyar la/ mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug pa ni ātpa la'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i dbus su yi ge tī dkar po bsams te/ de las 'od ser dkar po 'phros pa des ye shes sems dpa' la bskor ba byas la/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge bzhis spyan drangs nas dam tshig sems dpa' bdag nyid la gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dgyes pa byas la/ oṃ dharmā dhwa tu dzñā na badzra su bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'khor lo yi ger bcas pa las 'od zer spro ba byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams la/ dbang bskur ba'i tshigs su —975—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsupa chos kyi skor/bcad pa 'dis don du gter bar bya ste/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchog chen gsol ma jad pa/ /bdag la bsrung ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag bstsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sku las byung ba'i lo tsa nī dang / mā ma ki dang / gos dkar mo dang / tā rā rin po che bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba phyag na bsnams pas/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ khams gsum po yis phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ zhes bya ba 'don cing dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /dbang bskur ba rdzogs ma thag rin po che'i cod pan gyi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can bsam mo/ lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyis byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir/ spyi bor yi ge io dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / lkog mar yi ge āḥdamar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / snying gar yi ge hūm̐ nag po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa rnam par bkod do/ /yi ge bcu po las 'od zer dkar po spros pas 'gro ba kun sbyangs nas sangs rgyas su bsgrubs nas/ slar bkug ste 'khor lo dang yi ge la bstims te gsal bar bsgom zhing bzlas brjod bya'o/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa byas nas de las ldang bar 'dod na cho ga nyams pa bskang bar bya ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bzlas nas ye shes sems dpa' yang dag par mchod de bsod nams yongs su bsngos la gshegs su gsol lo/ /de la ye shes sems dpa' gshegs su gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs na/sa ni/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol / / muḥzhes bya ba 'di yin no/ de la bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ io tā re tustu re tu te swāhā/ de la rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe ne pa tigli dri dho me bha wa / su to ṣṭio me bha wa/ su pokhyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yasmo sarba karma su tsa me tsitt+waṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥzhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun/ /rje btsun sgrol ma 'dra bar shog /bdag kyang ting 'dzin 'di bsgrubs nas/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas shog rje btsun sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ slon dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //—976—

sngags phyegs sgyu lus gco bor ston pa/'e skor bzhugs so/ /ra25 'phags ma 17la ma'i sgrub thabs/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya tā rā swa dha na/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ la phyag 'chal lo/ /'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma/ /sgrol ma'i zhabs kyis padmo la btud nas / / yun ring bla ma bsten las gang 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa bshad bya/ /yid 'ong gnas ni la la sa /me tog dri zhim gcal bkram ste/ /spos kyis nyams dgar byas nas ni/ /de dbus stan bzang bde ba la / / srid pa'i 'dod pa yongs btang ba'i/ /rnal 'byor can gyi nyer 'dug ste/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i / / 'od zer tshogs kyis bla ma dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /spyan drangs de dag mdun nyid du/ /mchod pas yang dag rab mchod nas/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs rjes dran bya/ io su bhā wa bi shuddha sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shuddhi3 haṃ/ io shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swā bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ de nas brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ de nas paṃ las byung ba'i padma chad chen po'i dbus su rab tu rdzogs pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ yi ge haṃ ljang khu bsams te/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje bcun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon pas352 la sngon po 'jin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ gzi brjid bzod par dkar ba dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing yid 'phrog ma/ skra'i tshogs ltag par bcings shing zla ba'i 'od can/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mnan pa/ spyan gnyis padma gzhon nu'i 'dab ma ltar cung zad 'dzum pa dang /mdun du gzigs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma/ nu ma'i dkyil 'khor mkhrang ba dang ldan par rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i haṃ las 'od zer byung ba rnams kyis rje bcun ma yang dag par bkug la/ sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod nas/ ātpa la'i phyag rgyas rang gi lus la bstims par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbang bskur ba don du gnyer te/ bdag gi dbu brgyan la gsung rdo rjes rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu rang gi snying ga'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge tī la sogs pa rnam par bkod de/ spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pa bsgom par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe skyo ba na/ oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /de las gang gi tshe ldang bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros te/des sems can thams cad la sbyangs la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas de dag gi snying gar zhugs par blta —977—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/zhing / de cam nyid kyis de dag thams cad lha mo'i skur gyur par lhag par mos pa bya'o/ / de nas slar yang sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gtor ma'i snod yongs su bkang la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi ārya nutpanma twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bya ba lan gsum gyis phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas rang gi ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la dmigs pas/ legs par mchod de mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub la gsol ba btab la/ yi ge brgya pa yongs su bzlas nas/ bsod nams yongs su bsngos la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re muḥ/ zhes pa 'dis gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis thun mtshams bzhir bsgoms nas myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe thun mtshams la sogs par bstod pa 'don par 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te/ me tog la sogs pas mchod la/ dngos grub gang 'dod pa la dmigs te/ ji tsam nus pas bstod la/ gsol ba btab ste gshegs par bya'o/ /da ni bsdu ba'i sbyor ba cung zad brjod par bya ste/ sngar brjod pa'i chul nyid kyis rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag bcu bzlas pa bya zhing / sgrol ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas bzlas pa'i cho ga snga ma lta bu nyid las/khyad par du bsgrub par bya ba'i ming sngags kyi yi ge'i dbus na gnas par bsams la/ bzlas pa ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bya'o/ /de nas sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer byung bas bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad khyab par bltas te/des lus rab tu tshim par gyur zhing nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang bral bar mos pa bya'o/ /'di ni zhi ba'i bsrung ba'o / / de nas bsrung ba'i mchog ni/ snga ma dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rang gi snying gar yi ge tt+waṃ ljang khu 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba 'khrugs par byas la/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'bar bas/ gdug pa'i lus gcer bu skra grol ba 'dre zhing skyabs dang bral ba'i snying la zhugs pas de rengs pa dang / mnan pa dang / rmongs pa dang / bcings par rnam par bsam mo/ /gang gi tshe de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skyo ba na/ sa bon gyis yi ge la dmigs pas gzungs sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ na maḥ.ārya lo gi te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ mahā satā ya/mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ tā re tustu re ru re ma ma kṛ te/ sarba duṣṭa na/ pra duṣṭan/ dzee bha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya / banta ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba du:na stambha ni tā re swāhā/ bsrung ba 'di dag kyang thun mtshams bzhir bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lam du 'gro ba ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas mdud pa dor nas/ sngags yid la dran pa dang ldan par phyin na chom rkun dang / rgyal po dang / dgra dang / stag dang sprul gyi me dang / chu la spyod pa rnams kyis brdzi bar mi nus so/ /gang gi tshe 'jigs pa dang bral nas mdud pa slar dgrol bar bya'o/ /—978—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gce ber sten pa/'i skor bzhugs so/ /de ltar yun ring bla ma bsten nas gang thob pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rlo ga 'di ni legs bkod pas/ /sgrol ma zhes bya sras bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gru 'jin dpal du 'gro rnams myur 'gro shog 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dī paṃ/ kā ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang / nag tsho chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba las/ yang rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha kā ra warma/ bod kyi lo cwa ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab nga/'o// //la26 'jigs pa brgyad laba'iskyob pa/7/bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la phyag 'chal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa'i dbang phyug bsam gtan gyi khang par zhugs te/ stan bde ba la 'dug cing snying rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad gdon par bya'o zhes dam bca' nas/lha mo sgrol ma bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang rim pa 'di ltar bya ste/ rnal 'byer pa rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge two bsams la/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu 'dra ba spros pas lha mo dang rang gi bla ma dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mdun gyi nam/ mkha' la gsal bar bltas te/ de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / lus dbul ba dang / smom lam gdab pa rnams byas la/ de nas don dam par bdag dang lha la sogs pa rang bzhin med cing / gdod ma/ nas ma skyes par bsam zhing / de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ eo shu n+ya tā dzñā na baja swa bhā wa ātma/ ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas stong pa nyid du bsgom/ mo/ /de nas paṃ las padma 'dab ma/ brgyad pa'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis yi ge haṃ las lha mo sgrol ma bskyed par bya ste/ de yang sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas gnas pa/ g.yon pas ༷yin la bsnams pa / don yod grub pa'i dbu brgyan can skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa ci srid mi skyo bar du sgoms la/ skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba rang gi snying ga nas phyung ste yang rang gi zhal du zhugs/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'byung ba'i rim pa sngags kyi kha dog dkar po dal bus 'gro bar bsam zhing bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pas kyang skyo na mchod pa dang gtor ma btang ste/ smon lam gdab / lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad la gnas par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid du zhugs te nyal bar bya'o/ /yang langs pa'i tshe skad cig tsam gyis lha mo'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //—979—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sha27 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya tā rā a bhi sa ma ya pikṣiṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mngon par rtegs pa bsdus pa/ rje bcun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje bcun gyi mngon par rtogs pa bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod pas/dang po skyabs gro lan gsum bya/ sems can gyi don du sems bskyed/ snying gar a las zla ba/ de'i steng du twe yig ljang gu des sdig sgrib dag nas rje bcun gyi skur gyur par bsam/ de'ang padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon ātpa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ phyag dang mchod pa la sogs pa byas la dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing / de nas spyi bor io/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de rnams la rtse gcig tu bsam/de nas skyo bar gyur na thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la twe yig gnas pa'i tha mar/ rmeo tā re tutpā re tu re swāhā/yi ge bcu gsal bar dmigs te/ rkyen pa/ bul ba/ g.yeng ba'i skyon rnams spangs te bzlas so/ / na maḥ.ārtswa wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ mahā satwa ya/ mahā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ tā re tutwe re tu re/ sarba dudzin/pra duṣṭan ma ma kṛ te/ ji bha ya jambha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ banta ya banta ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / sarba duṣṭa stambha ni tā re swāhā/ zhes pa'i gzungs 'di yang mang du bzlas so/ /thun 'jog dus su sems can ma lus pa'i don du bsngo'o/ /rje bcun gyi bstod pa 'don par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/rang gi snying gar a las zla ba/ de'i steng du haṃ yig ljang khu/ de'i 'od kyis sdig sgrib dag nas rang rje bcun sku mdog ljang khu pad dkar dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag mtshan bzhugs chul snga ma lta bu las/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pa'i rje btsun spyan drangs la/ bdun rnam dag bya/ g.yas skyabarmi sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag nyid chud par bya/ gzhan sems can ma lus pa'ang chud par bsam/ phyag 'chal zhes byung res yid kyis phyag re bya/ mdun gyi sku la rtse gcig pa'i chul gyis bstod pa mang du 'don/ yang rjes la bzlas pa ci nus re bya'o / / rje btsun gyi bsrung ba byed na/ sngar bshad pa'i chul gyis rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas shing /rje btsun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngar bshad pa'i sngags kyi dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming bcug nas ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bzlas so/ /de nas sa bon las 'od zer byung bas bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad khyab par bltas ste/ des lus tshim zhing nyer 'tshes mi chugs par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni zhi ba'i bsrung ba yin —980—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtse bor sten pa 'i sgor bzhugs se/ /no / / de nas phyir bzlog ni/ snga ma'i ting nge 'jin dang ldan pa'i sngags pas rang gi snying gar twe yig ljang khu 'od zer 'phro ba de bsgrub bya'i lus la phog pas/ gcer bu skra grol ba 'dar zhing / skyabs med pa/ rengs pa/rmongs pa/ mnan pa/ bcings par bsam mo/ de las skyo bar gyur na/ gong gi bsngags bzlas seo/ /'di thun mtshams bzhir byas nas/ pha rol bcings pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du lam du 'gro na ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas mdud pa dor nas/ sngags dran pa dang ldan par phyin na chom rkun dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / skrul dang / nags kyi ba men dang / chu la spyod pa rnams kyis brdzi bar mi nus so/ /gang gi che 'jigs pa dang bral ba dang mdud pa slar dgrol bar bya'o/ /dpal mar me mjad ye shes kyis mjad pa 'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'don thabs mngon par rtogs pa'i bsdus pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po buddha ka ra warma dang / bod kyi lo cwa ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //sa28 sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs byin brlab myur 'jug ma/ 7/rje bcun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rje bcun ma/ bsgrub par 'dod pas/mdun gyi nam mkha' la rje bcun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa utpa la bsnams pa/zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de la yid kyis mchod pa phul la bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /phyag 'chal re re la yid kyis phyag 'chal bas/ sgrol ma de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / bdag gi lus la phog pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag ngag la phog pas ngag gi sgrib pa dgasnying gar phog pas yid kyis sgrib pa dag mngon zhen dang chags sdang gi bag chags sbyangs nas/ de yang rje bcun ma dang bdag tha mi dad par rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgom mo/ /de nas bstod pa gsum mam bdun la sogs pa ci thon bton nas/ gang gi rje btsun ma spyi bo nas mar stim mo/ /bdag gi lus 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar stong par song bar bsam la/ lus sems glod la sems gsal ba dwangs pa zhig yong bas de ngo shes par byas la shes pa'i nyams dar gcig sgoms/ de nas bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum bsngo'o/ /de ltar bstod pas gzhung nas bshad pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bas 'di bstod pas 'grub pa yin no/ /jo bo rje la sgrol mas lung bstan te thugs dam du mdzad nas dngos grub brnyes/ de nas rim pas bka' gdams pa thams cad kyis thugs dam mjad/ bar chad sel/ dngos grub dang byin rlabs 'di las che ba med gsung ngo // //—9ni/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung ches kyi skor/han9 sgrol masalung bstan pa'i skor/ 7/rje bcun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo bo bod du 'byon pa'i dus su/ rdo rje gdan du bskor ba la byon nas jo mo la bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod cing bskor ba byas pas/ sgrol mas lung bstan gyi mchod rten gyi rtsar jo mo dngos dang mjal te bod du bzhud cig par lung bstan nas bod la khyed kyis phan thog par yod pas/ bstod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po 'di la yid dam gyis shig thugs dam la bar chad mi 'byung gsungs nas sha lo ka nyi shu rtsa gcig dang sbyar nas 'di gnang ngo / /phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo / / spyan ni skad gcig glog 'dra ma/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chu skyes zhal gyi/ /ge sar bye ba las ni byung ma/zhes pas rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dgra bgegs dang rnam par 'tshe ba zhi bar 'dod na/ 'phags ma sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba la gsol ba gdab ste/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la rje bcun ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyis steng na dbang du sdud pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon ātpa la bsnams pa/ skad cig la bsams te gsol ba gdab po/ /oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re ba shaṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal ston kha'i zla ba kun tu/ /gang ba brgya gnyis brtsegs pa'i zhal ma/ /skar ma stong phrag 'tshogs pa rnams kyi/ /rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma / zhes pas rnal 'byor 'ga' zhig nad dang gdon bgegs zhi bar 'dod na sgrol ma dkar mo la gsol ba gdab ste/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' la skad cig gis sgrol ma ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyis steng na zhi bar mdzad pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la brkyang bskum du bzhugs par sgoms la gsol ba gdab ste/ eo tā re tutpā re tu re shanting ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas nad dang sdig pa mi mthun phyogs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal ser sngo chu nas skyes kyi padmas phyag ni rnam par rgyan ma/ /sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub zhi ba/ /bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul nyid ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod 'phel bar 'dod na/sgrol ma gser mdog g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na rgyas pa'i bum pa gser mdog can dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ padma dang zla ba la brkyang bskum du bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re puṣṭi ku ru swāhā/zhes bzlas pa'i tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gcug tor/ /mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma/ /ma lus pha rol phyin/ pa thob pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras —982—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs se/ /kyis shin tu brten ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa tshe sgrub par 'dod na/ rje bcun ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis sgrol ma gcug tor rnam par rgyal ma gser mdog can/ g.yas mchog spyin gyi steng na tshe'i bum pa dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re ā yu dzñā na swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas tshe lo bcu pa yang tshe lo brgya 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal tustu ra hūm̐ gi yi ge /'dod dang phyogs dang nam/ ma/kha' gang ma/ /'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te/ /lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa bud med dbang du bya zhing dgug par 'dod na/ rje btsun ma hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa la gsol ba gdab ste/mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis sgrol ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na yid 'phrog pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tutwe re tu re che ge mo a karṣa ya hri swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas gang la dmigs pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshangs pa/ /rlung lha sna tshogs dbang phyug mchod ma/ /'byung po ro langs dri za rnams dang / /gnod spyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa 'byung po thams cad 'dul bar 'dod na/ 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam/ mkhar skad cig gis sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dmar nag g.yas mchog sbyin gyis steng na 'byung po myos par byed pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re bhū ta hūṃ u tsa ta ya swāhā/ zhes pas 'byung po dang dbang phyug chen po dang lha dang sa bdag la sogs dbang chen thams cad bran du 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal trad ces bya dang phaṭa kyis/ /pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'bus kyis mnan te/ /me 'bar 'khrug pa shin tu 'bar ma// zhes pas rnal 'byor pa gzhan gyi rig sngags bzlog par 'dod na/ 'phags ma gzhan 'joms ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na rig sngags bzlog pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon ātpa la bsnams pa padma zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ eo tā red tutpā re tu re sbod gzer sarba bzlog bhyo swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas rig sngags kyi smod mo dang sbod gzer thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal tu re'i 'jigs pa chen po/ /bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma chu skyes zhal gyi khro gnyer ldan mdzad/ /dgra 'o thams cad ma lus gsod ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa dgra gsod par 'dod pas/ sgrol ma bdud dang dgra 'joms ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig —983—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gis sgrol ma bdud dang dgra 'joms ma sku mdog dmar nag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na dgra 'joms pa'i bum pa dang g.yon utpa la la bsnams pa/ pad zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re che ge mo a mu kai mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas bdud dgra thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i/ sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma/ /ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i//rang gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrugs ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung bar 'dod na/sgrol ma dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis sgrol ma dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na 'jigs pa skyob pa'i bum pa dang g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ pad zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re che ge mo la gnod pa sarba rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes pas ngan song gsum du tshe phyi ma la gnod pa dang bdud dang 'byung po tshe 'di la gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' bar brdzid pa'i/ /dbu brgyan 'od kyi phrengo ba spel ma/ /bzhad pa rab bzhad tubhā ra yis/ /bdud dang 'jig rten dbang phyug mdzad ma/ zhes pas rnol 'byar pa bdud dang bar chad 'dul bar 'dad na/ 'phags ma bdud dang bar chad dbang du sdud ma la gsal ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sgrol ma bdud dang 'jig rten dbang du sdud ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na bdud 'joms pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon utpa la bsnams pa/ pad zla la zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re sarba pā paṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas bdud dang mu stegs log par lta ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi skyong ba'i tshogs rnams/ /thams cad 'gugs par nus ma nyid ma/ khro gnyer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /phongs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar 'dod na/ 'phags ma 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ba la gsol ba gdab ste/ 'phags ma sgrol ma gser gtso ma ltar dmar ser du yod pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng na phongs pa sel ba'i bum pa dang g.yon ātpa la bsnams pa pad zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re dha re swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas nor dang 'bru dang rkang 'gro dang rin po che dang nor 'phel te phongs pa skyob pa yin no/ /phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mo'i dbu rgyan/ /brgyan pa thams cad shin tu 'bar ma/ /ral pa'i khrod nas 'od dpag med las/ /rtag par shin tu 'od rab mdzad ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa bkris par 'dod na rje btsun ma bkris 'byin ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rje btsun ma bkris thams cad 'byin ma gser mdog can/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bkris 'byin pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon —984—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /utpa la bsnams pa/ pad zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas bkris dang bde legs thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal bskal pa'i tha ma'i me ltar/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dbus na gnas ma/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dga'i/ /dgra'i dpung ni rnam par 'joms ma/zhes pa rnal 'byor pa bgegs dang bar chod bsrung bar 'dod na/ rje btsun ma me ltar 'bar ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun ma me ltar 'bar rma sku mdog ser ltar dmar ba/g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bar chad bsrung ba'i bum pa dang / g.yon ātpa la bsnams pa/ pad zla la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re po ta ya smi ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas dgra dang bar chod kyi dpung thams cad rab tu 'joms shing bsrung ba dang rengs par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal sa gzhi'i ngos la phyag gi / / mthil gyis bsnun cing zhabs kyis brdungs ma/ khro gnyer can mdzad yi ge hūm̐ gis/ /rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gengs ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa bgegs la bsnun par 'dod na rje bcun ma khro gnyer can la gsol ba gdab ste/ skad cig la mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun khro gnyer ma sku mdog nag mo khro gnyer cung zad yod pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyis mthil na bgegs la bsnun pa'i bum pa dang / g.yon ātpa la bsnams pa/padma dang zla ba la bzhugs par sgoms la/ io tā re tutpā re tu re badzra mahā po ta ya smi ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas dgra bgegs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma/ /mya ngan 'das shing spyod yul nyid ma/ swāhā io dang yang dag ldan ma/ /sdig pa chen po 'joms pa nyid ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pas sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na/ rje btsun ma zhi ba chen mo la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig la rje btsun ma zhi ba chen mo sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na sdig pa zhi bar byed pa'i bum pa dang g.yon utpa la la bsnams pa/ padma dang zla ba la bzhugs par sgoms la/ io tā re tunywa re tu re sarba pā paṃ pra sha ma na ye swāhā/zhes bzlas pas sdig sgrib bag chags ngan pa mi gtsang ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i/ /dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gengs ma/ /yi ge bcu pa'i ngag ni bkod pa'i/ /rig pa hūṃ las sgrol ma nyid ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa shes rab dang blo 'phel ba dang ngag gi rtsod pa las rgyal bar 'dod na/ rje btsun ma rigs pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ skad cig gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rigs sngags 'phel bar 'byed pa'i bum pa dang g.yon utpa la bsnamasapa/ padma dang zla ba la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re sarba dharma pra ti pa ri sho dha ya swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas gzhan gyi rigs sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'joms zhing rang gi shes —985—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/rab dang blo 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal tu re'i zhabs ni brdabs pas/ /hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i sa bon nyid ma//ri rab manta dha ra dang 'bigs byed/ /'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba nyid ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa bdud dang bar chod gnon par 'dod na/ sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum g.yo ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig la rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar gser g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na rig sngags gnon pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon ātpa la/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re sarba tambha ni ta re swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas gzhan gyi rig sngags kyi las thams cad gnon pa dang / dgra dang chom rkun thams cad gnon par 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i/ ri dwags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma/ /tā ra gnyis brjod phaṭa kyi yi ge /dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa gang zhig klu'i tshogs kyis dug zhi bar 'dod na/ rje bcun ma dug nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa la gsol ba gdab ste / mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rje btsun ma dug nad zhi zhing sel bar byed ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na dug nad sel ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon ātpa la/ pad zla dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re nā ga shān ho ku ru ye swāhā/ klu'i dug dang nad dang gnod pa las sgrol bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po/ /lha dang mi'am ci yis brten ma/ /kun nas go cha dga' ba brjid kyi/ rtsod dang rmi lam ngan pa sel ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa rtsod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa bzlog par 'dod na/ rje btsun ma sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba'i sgrol ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig la rje btsun ma sdug bsngal thams cad sel ma sku mdog dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na sdug bsngal sel ba'i bum/ pa bsnams pa/ g.yon ātpa la padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tustu re tu re sarba mos tsa na ye swāhwa/ zhes bzlas pas phan tshun 'brugs pa dang / rtsod pa dang khri mon du bcug pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal nyi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i/ /spyan gnyis po la 'od rab gsal ma/ /ha re gnyis brjod tutpā ra yis/ /shin tu drag po'i rims nad sel ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa rims nad bsrung bar 'dod na/ rims nad sel ba'i sgrol ma la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la skad cig gis rje btsun ma rims nad sel ma sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchod sbyin gyi mthil na rims nad sel ba'i bum pa bsnam pa/ g.yon ātpa la/ pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tutpā re tu re bi sa ra ta hūṃ hā/ zhes bzlas pas rims nad dang yams thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag 'tshal de nyid gsum rnams bkod pa'i/ /zhi ba'i mthu dang yang dag ldan ma/ /gdon dang ro langs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams//—dngha986—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa/'i skor bzhugs so/ /'joms pa tu re'i rab mchog nyid ma/ zhes pas rnal 'byor pa 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs par 'dod na/ rje btsun ma 'phrin las thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa la gsol ba gdab ste/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rje bcun ma sku mdog dkar mo/ g.yas mchog spyin gyi steng na dngos grub sna tshogs pa'i bum/ pa bsnams pa / g.yon ātpa la/ padma dang zla ba la zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa gsal bar sgoms la/ oṃ tā re tutwe re tu re sarba swā dha na swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad rab tu sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /jo bo rje la rje btsun mas lung bstan nas gnang ba yin no/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma / jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'brom ston dbang phyug grags/ sang ston shākya gzhon nu / zla grags gsar ma/ rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na zla grags gsar ma/ slob dpon shes rab dpal/ rong ston blo bzang pa/ des bdag la'o// //a30 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya a ca la sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /thugs sprul khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon/ /phyi nang bar chad sel mjad lha/ /sku gsung thugs la phyag 'chal nas/ /brtse ldan nyid kyis 'gro don du/ rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag la/ /brten pa yang dag bsrung ba'i rim/ khro rgyal mi g.ye'i sgrubs thabs bri/ dang po skyabs 'gro so sor thar/ /byang sems rig 'dzin sdom pa rnams/ legs par thob bsrung sngags pa yis/ /dben pa'i gnas sogs nyams dga'am/ khang bzang gtsang sbra byas pa'i nang / /maṇḍal la sogs mchod pa dgram/ /sku gzugs la sogs de bzhin du/ /gtsang ldan yo byad gang 'byor pa/ /tho rangs khrus sogs chu sbyin bya/ ku sha la sogs stan la bsdad/ /hā hūm̐ hrīḥdang haṃ me sogs/ /sngags brjod khro bos bar chad bsal/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rnams/ /dag pa'i gnas su gdan bzhugs la/ phyag dang mchod pa sdig bshagasadang / /rjes su yid rang bskul gsol dang / /byang chub bsngos la skyabs su 'gro /bsam gtan ting 'dzin mos pa bya/ /byang chub sems kyi rgyun spel phyir/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshad med rnam pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya/ /'gro rnams bde la dgod pa'i phyir/ /byang chub chen po'i sems rgyun sgoms/ /sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs dang / /mi 'bral dad pas bsgrub par bya/ /phyag rgya dang bcas sngags 'di brjod/ /na maḥs manta badzra ṇḍaṃ dharma ṅgā tu ya swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ /rdo rje skyil krung rab —987—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bcas te/ /snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /sa bon 'od sgra'i spro bsdu las/ /chosakun nam mkha' lta bu la/ /mtha' bzhi lasagrol rnam par sgoms/ /de nas stong nyid ngang las ni/ /skad cig sgyu ma'i lus su lta/ /'od kyi thams cad hūṃ la bsdu/ /de nyid stong par brtan par sgoms/ /de'i ngang las nam mkha'i 'od/ /'dra ba'i thugs kyi sa bon no/ /sems kyi bdag nyid gsal bar lta/ /de 'og gam spros tshogs bdag ste/ /paṃ spros(sna tshogasapadmar lta/ /de steng ram̐ las rta bdun pa/ /der ni hūṃ nyid lta bar bya/ /de lasabyung ba shes rab kyi/ /ral gri sngon po'i 'od zer gyis/ /nam mkha' ma lus 'gengs par blta/ /de las khro bo chen po ni/ /dri ma med pa gzhon nu'i sku / bdud la sogs pa rab 'joms pas/ /rnam rtog thams cad 'joms par sgoms/ gzhon zhing sku rgyasasku mdog gnag /'od kyis nam mkha' ma lus 'gengs/ /dbu skra dmar ser bcings shing 'phyangs/ /sku ni 'gying bag rab tu g.yo/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas ni cung zad bskum/ /spyan gsum nyi zla bzhin du dmar/ /steng 'og phyogs bcur lta bar mdzad/ /mche ba rno dkar rab tu gtsigs/ /ljags ni glog ltar rab tu 'gyur/ /smin ma khro gnyer rab tu bsdus/ /phyag gnyis ral gri sbrul zhag bsnams/ /stag dang sprul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mi bskyod la sogs dbu rgyan can/ /ma rungs 'dul zhing 'gro don mdzad/ khro rgyal sna tshogs sku las spro/ /ji ltar 'dod pas yongs su bskor/ /thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra sgoms/ /yang de'i thugs kar nyi ma la/ /hūṃ ni 'dod dang bcas pa blta/ khro bo rdo rje shugs can ni/ /sku mdog nag po'i 'khor lo 'dzin/ rdo rje chags chen sku mdog dmar/ /chags par byed pa'i mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /rdo rje rnon po ljang khu ste/ /'dzin pa'i bdag nyid lcags kyu 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dkar po ste/ 'joms byed rdo rje'i brag 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje khro bo ser po ste/ /phyag na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ /rdo rje gtum po ljang nag ste/ /sprin gyi zhags pa phyag na bsnams/ /rdo rje thabs bdag dud pa'i mdog /bya ba byed pa'i rdza rnga bsnams/ /rdo rje stobs chen mthing ga ste/ gnam lcags 'khor lo rab tu 'dzin/ /rdo rje rgyu stobs dmar nag ste/ /rdo rje be con phyag na 'dzin / / rdo rje rab byed sna tshogs mdog /'joms byed rdo rje rtse gcig bsnams/ /sa bcu'i yon tan bdag nyid can/ /sku 'od me las 'phro bar bsams/ /hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /rang dang 'dra ba spyan drangs la / / dza ༷hūṃ baṃ hoḥyi ge bzhis/ /dgug gzhug cing dang dgyesapa bskyed/ /hūṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ dang gsum/ /dkar dang dmar dang nag po yis/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying kha ni/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /sabon las 'phros 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa la/ /dbang skur yid kyis gsol ba gdab/ /thugs las sprul pa lhag pa'i lhas/ /rin chen bum pa bdud rtsis bkang / /spyi gtsug dbang bskur rigs —988—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ / —bdag mtshan/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /byams pa'i blta bas blta ba'i phyir/ /mig tu hūm̐ ni ser po dgod/ /srog gi lam du mo nag po/ /spyi bor haṃ ni rab tu blta/ /lus kyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya bca'/ /ngag tu sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /na maḥs manta badzā rṇa tsaṇḍam hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ /'di yi rkyen gyis ma rig pa/ /'jig cing ye shes skur byin rlab/ /de ltar rab rdzogs gsal bar bskyed/ /de nas sgyu ma lta bu'i skur/ /ji srid 'dod kyi bar du sgoms/ /de nas nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i sngags phreng gis/ /de nyid la ni g.yas bskor la/ /dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sngags 'di bzlas/ /na maḥs manta badzā ṇḍaṃ tra tha a mo gha tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇḍaṃ/ /slo ṭa ya hūm̐ tru sa ya tru sa ya/ a kra ma ye/ a kra ma ye hūm̐/ tra ta haṃ mo ces pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭa / a tsa la ka na tsaṇḍatsaṇḍa na ta na ta ma tra ta ma tra ta mo tra ta/ sha ta sha ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/mo ha sarba pā paṃ ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badzra ha sa a mo ka ka jam ha sa ha sa/ matta matta/ gardza gardza/ baddha banta/ ha na ha na/ tiṣṭha tigli a bhi sha ye a bhi sha ye/ mahā mant+ra pa la ka dhu na dhu na/ ti ni ti ni/ kha ta kha ta/ sarba bi ghān/mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba duṣṭan/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ sarba birtswan/ ku ru ku mā mahā sgyi sha /sarba pā paṃ/ mahā badzra spo ṭa ya/tri bha li ta ra ga na ta ka/ hūṃ hūṃ mo mo haṃ haṃ/ na maḥs manta buddha nī/ tsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ya/ a mo gha ho hi/ a pra ti ha ha a tsa la tsa dha/ ā nānta ka nī/ tiṣṭha tilga tsa ru tsa sa ṭa ḍi ṭa ḍi/ ṭa ta ṭa ta/ bi ghā ga ta ya/ ma ra ya/ kha ta ya/slo ṭa ya/ sha chun tsa le/ a nadmanta/ a tsa ku sa a ha sa/ a dha na gra ka tra ta ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ haṃ haṃ/ a ti bhal e hi/ mahā gu ṇa bhi ṣa ṇa/ na ṭa ta na ṭa ta/ a bhe sha ya/ a tsa la cedha/ sarba ta tra a nud re/ a ce ṭa ta ṭa ta ḍa ma ḍa ma/ haṃ haṃ/ me me/ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ na maḥs manta badzra ṇḍaṃ/ tra tha a mo ka tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa/ slo ṭa ya spo ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tra ma ya tra ma ya hūm̐/ tra ta haṃ ma/ oṃ bha lenta te dza ma li ni swāhā/ na maḥs manta budha nī/ tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a tsa la snro da spo ṭa ya hūm̐/ a sa ma rnyi ka tyā hā/ mahā bha ma shad te/ pa ra mant+ra/ oṃ e hūm̐ hūm̐/ shuddha tree lokya tu shi tu badzra a pra ti a ta/ bhya li bhya/ na ma dzwa la ya tra ta/ a ta sa na/ mo hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa 'bum la sogs par ni/ /man ngag can gyis bzlas pa bya/ /des ni 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar 'gyur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ ji skad bshad pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas chos dbyings rang bzhin las/ /yongs su gnas pa bsgom par bya/ /de las skad cig lhar dmigs la/ /rin chen snod du gtsang ma'i rdzas/ /dkar gsum la sogs rtsi sman bcas/ /cha lnga'i bdun du bsham par bya/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /oṃ sarba dharma ta badzra pa ti hūm̐/ /lan gsum brjod pas dag par bya/ /lus kyi mchog sbyin phyag rgya bcas/ /'bru gsum sngags kyi 'byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a mṛ ti oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ/ /zhes brjod 'dod pa'i —989—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/don du brlab/ /yid ni mchog sbyin phyag rgya bca'/ /ngag nas sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥsarba bhyaḥthā khaṃ ātpa te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ/ /lan gsum brjod pas spel bar bya/ yang na rang gnas dbul ba'i/ /rje btsun phyogs skyong 'gro drug bcas/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ /byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa ni/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ /oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ /zhes pa lan bdun sngags kyis ni/ /bcom ldan 'byung po 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā khaṃ/ /ārya nutpan twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ chos bshad bstod la bden stobs brjod/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /don rnams bsam pa gang dag kun/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /de dag thamasacad ri rigs su/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur shog gang 'dod 'phrin las gzhol bar bya/ /lusakyis thal mo sbyar byas ste/ /sngags 'di brjod pas dam tshigs so/ /oṃ na maḥs manta buddhā nī/ tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa/ a same tri sa ma ya/ mahā sa ma ya/ sarba pā paṃ shuddha swāhā/ /badzra muḥyis ye shes gshegs/ /dge rtsa bsngo la smon lam gdab/spyod lam dag ni thams cad du/ /lha'i nga rgyal gsal bas bya/ /thun bzhi ru ni brtson pas bsgrubs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa/ /ji skad bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /yang dag par ni bsrung bar bya/ /bsnyen pa tshad dang ldan pa yis/ /bsrung ba bdun sogs las rnams 'grub/ /rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā / / oṃ slu ta sgru ta mahā krodha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dzha ti dzha ti spo ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas klu la mngags par bya'o/ /mā ra ya dza dzā a ti ṭaṃ sum̐/ rbad rbad shag shag tsha la tsha la/ tsitra ta ra ti ta gri tna tsitta phyung / dha dang po dam tsag sa ma ya phye snying sa ma ye phye/ rbad rbad phye/ snying la ya/ sa ma ya tre he/ snying la gser duḥkha phye pa phye/ oṃ sgru ta spru ta mahā krodha hūm̐ / dzha ti dzha ti/ spo ta ya spo ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas srog sngagasaso/ /ming 'jug gcig gsum bzhi drug dgu /gnyis po dag pa yang dag sbyar/ ma ra na sod sod dang / ma ra na bying bying ma ra na rmugs rmugs/ ma ra na ha la ha la/ ma ra na dun dun/ ma ra na myogs myogs/ ma ra na sum̐ ril ril/ ma ra ya dza/ man ngag ji bzhin bzlas pa bya/ /drag sngags 'bru btus bsdebs pa ni/ /'bru sdebs gsum dang de bzhin drug /duḥka kun thub gzugs brnyan can/ bhandhe sha yā bhadhe sha yā ha ha/ st+waṃ bha ya st+waṃ bha ya/ ma ra yā dza dzā:thum ril ril/ man ngag bzhin du las ldosbyar/ /ting 'dzin bsrung ba zab mo ni/ /lus kyi gnod chen bcu gsum du/ /pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ las ni/ /rdo rje rgya gram re re sgoms/ /spyi bo dpral ba mig gnyis dang / /rna ba gnyis dang sna gnyis dang //kha dang dpung pa gnyis dang ni/ /snying ga gsang ba lte ba dang / /bshang sgo pus mo gnyis po dang / /rkang mthil —990—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /rnams su gnas pa'o/ /de nas gsang sngags gang rung bzlas/ /me yis phyi nang bar chad bsal/ /bza' btung sngags kyis byin rlabs spyad/ /ngag nas rdo rje rgya gram ni/ /gser las grub pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ /ngag dang yid kyis bzlas pa yang / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin bzlas par bya/ /nang gi sbyin sreg klu la bya/ /mi ldog rtags kyis klu rnams mnan/ /mahā kā las bstan pa bsrung / /'khor lo sbas pa'i klu la sbyar/ /rnal 'byor bsrung phyir ral gri bzlog /yul khams bsrung dang sri'u gso/ /nad chen gso dang 'byung po bskrad/ /tsoo ra shing ltar bya ba dang / /dbang du bya dang rmongs pa dang / /ral gri bum pa sa spyod dang / /rkang mgyogs mkha' spyod mig sman sogs/ /las rnams the tshom yod ma yin/ /'di bkod dge ba gang yin dpe/ /bar chad sel zhing tshogs rdzogs nas/ /'gro rnams 'bad pa chung ngu yis/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /slob dpon di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad nas/ dge slong dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang ba'o// //ski31 khro rgyal mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya a tsa la kro dha rā dza su dha rna/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por mtho ris thar pa yi/ /bde 'byung dkon mchog gsum btud de/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba/ /sgom pa'i rim pa bri bar bya/ /sngags pa kun la chags med la/ /byang chub tu ni blo brtan zhing / /rnal 'byor tshogs 'di phun tshogs pa'i/ /dngos grub snod du gyur pa yin/ /dang por sngags pas rnal 'byor dang / rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i hūm̐ nag po bsams la/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyi rang gi lus phyi nang dang bcas pa gsal bar byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ga ta pū dza badzra su bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /yi ge hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskul zhipa spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rnam par bsams te/ de dag la phyag bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badzra puṣṭi āḥhūm̐ swāhā / zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas yi ge hūm̐ de nyid las mngon par byung ba'i 'od zer sna tshogs pa'i sgo las yang dag par byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa'i lha mos me tog dri zhim pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams khengs par byas te mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas de bzhin du yi ge hūm̐ las mngon par byung ba'i 'od zer spros pa las yang —991 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/dag par byung ba'i bdug spos kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i lag pas bzung ba'i spos khang las dri zhim po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bdug spos kyi sprin byung bas nam mkha' khengs par mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badzra di pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā / zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas phyogs bcu ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i rin po che'i sgron ma 'dzin pas brel ba'i lag pas mar me'i mchod pa'i lha mos mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas rin po che'i snod lha rdzas kyi dri zhim po rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bkang ba 'dzin pas lag brel ba'i dri'i mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs dang lang tsho dang ldan pa dag gis nam mkha' khengs par byas la mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su oṃ badzra nai we du āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa'i rjes la yi ge hūṃ de nyid las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang reg pa phun sum tshogs pa'i lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi dpe med pas yongs su bkang ba'i rin po che'i snod yongs su 'dzin pas lag pa brel ba'i ro rdo rje'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros la mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ sarba bi shiṣṭha pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mu dre āḥhūṃ swāhā/zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa'i rjes la/ nam mkha' ma lus pa khyab pa'i rin po che'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla bre rnam pa sna tshogs dang / glu dang rol mo'i sgra la sogasapa dang / 'khor losabasgyur ba'i rin po che dag gis kyang mchod par bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi mdun du pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar ste thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas byas shing bsags pa'i sdig bshags pa dang / phyin chad bsdom par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / gang yang nyan thos dang /so so skye bo rnams kyi bsod nams la rjes su yi da rang ba dang / byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams la snying rjes dmigs shing / de dag mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub smon pa'i sems brtan po bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bskyed nas ye shes kyi tshogs bskyed par bya ba'i phyir oṃ su bhā wa shuddha:sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du brjod la/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang bral ba rdzun pa'i rnam par rtog pas goms par byas pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis yongs su bsgos pa'i rang gis sems kyi snang ba tsam rmi lam dang / mig 'phrul dang / chu zla dang / mig yor rnamasadang / khamasagasum po 'di dag thamasacad khyad par med do zhes nges par brtags la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar du brjod la rdzun pa'i rnam par rtog pas goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyi dbang du gyur pa'i —992—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /rang gi sems mig 'phrul mkhan gyis sprul pa'i sems can dang / snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam par 'khrul ba'i dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir/ rdul dang khug sna dang du ba dang / kha ba dang / sprin gyi sgrib pa dang bral ba'i ston ka'i nyi ma phyed kyi nam mkha' lta bu chos kyi dbyings mtha' dag dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du phyi dang nang du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum ma lus par bltas la/ yud tsam rnam par rtog pa med pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas te/ paṃ las padma'i steng du nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis rgyas par byed pa'i yi ge ram̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'od zer rab tu 'gro ba'i hūm̐ nag po bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa gyes pa bsams la/ de'i lte ba la yang nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ nag po bsgom par bya'o/ /de las byung ba'i thams cad du khyab pa'i 'od zer de dag gis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par
