po yin par bshad/ /zhi las stsogs pa rab bskul bas/ /las rnams byed pa rigs par bshad / / 'phreng ba'i sngags kyang rigs bshad de/ mkhas pas de rnam kun tu bzlas/ /ci rigs par ni bzlas byas dang / /rang bdag las stsogs bka' thob pa'am/ /'gog pa'i 'khor lo goms pa yis/ /rang sems dag nas bri bar bya/ /ting 'dzind gsum po byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas las stsogs lhag gnasabya/ /bgegs rnams bsal te phur bus gdab/ /bsang byugs sa la gsol ba gdab/ /mchod yon mchod dang gtor byin nas / / sbyin sreg tshim byas mkha' la dgod/ /bgegs myed sa ni brkos nas su/ khung bu dgang ba'ang rim 'di yin / / 'jam rdo rje'i bdag rtsal 'byord ldan/ /sngon du bsnyen ba rdzogs byas la/ /grogs dang mchod pa dang ldan par/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni yang dag sbyang / /bgegs dgra'i 'khor lo'i sbyor la gnas/ /rang gi dbang bskur yang dag blang / /de ltar gdug pa tshar gcad pa/ /yang na rang lha'i sbyor bar bya/ /oṃ hā bhū khaṃ gyi sngagasakyis ni/ /sa ni nam mkha' gyurd par bya/ /hūm̐ lo hūm̐ ga se rdo rje'i bdag sa byas de ni byin kyis brlabs/ /oṃ me de ni badzrī bha ba badzra ban da hūm̐/ /sngar bzhin bgegs gzhom sbyor pa'i bdag /bsnyen stsogs rjes chags mthar 1022—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /thug pa'i/ /dang po'i sbyor ldan rang 'khor lo'ang / /rab phyung bdud rtsi'i mthar thug de/ /'khor lo'i rgyal mchog sbyor ba'i bdag /'khor lo'i las ni las mchog byed/ /las rgyal mchog gi sbyor ldan pas/ /ting 'dzin gsum po dam pa yin/ /de lta'i sbyor gnas slob dpon ni/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag lus can te/ /ngo bo nyid bdag rdo rje'i bdag /'khor lo'i sa bzhi'i dbus legs gnas/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin dpa' bo la/ /rdo rje dril mchog 'dzin pa'i grogs/ /rtags stsogs bdag nyid gzugs can gyis/ /'khor gsum sprul la gsol ba gdab / / de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag myed pa'i mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan myin thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /kun tu bzang po sku'i mchog / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog 'khor lo sgyu/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas 'gro khams mun nag rten/ /'jam rgyal khros pas bltas nas ni/ /hūm̐ badzod ti sha thas rang myig dang / /sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'degs par bya/ /yi ge ma tas gnyi zla'i myig /phyogs dus thams cad sur ba dang / /blo ldan 'gro la bstas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i sa ni yongs su bskor/ /rkang 'og rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje gsor bar shind tu brtson/ /rol pa'i rdo rje 'gros kyi gar / / mche ba gtsigs bcas hūm̐ sgrogs shing / /lha lcegs bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rab gtug bgegs tshogs bskrad bar bya/ /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs ni thams cad nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs te/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor rab sbyor ba/ /gal te bdag bsgo las 'das na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs ldan pa/ /sku gsum byung bas dgas bya ste/ /'jig par 'gyur bar gdon myi za/ /sa ni yongs su gzungs byas nas/ /gegs myed phyir ni phur bur gdab/ /sngags la oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya/ /gha ta ya/sarba duṣṭan phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya/ /sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra kri la badzra dha ro dzñā pa ya ti/ /ka ya bag tsid ta badzra ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ /smad du rtse gcig stod bgegs dgra'/ /bsams nas dbus su phur bur gdab/ /phyogs bcur kun tu gnas pa'i/ /bgegs tshogs thams cad 'jom bar bya/ /sa ni shind tu bgegs bral zhing / /'bar ba'i gzer rnos khyab bsams la/ /mtshams dang ra ba phyogs bcing ba/ /blos byas nas ni lhag gnas bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyad pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rold pa phyind la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyurd/ thukya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin — 1023—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kye sker/bdag gi bdud kyi sde/ /pham bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /sa gzhi dri zhim stsogs byug cing / /me tog sna tshogs sil ma bkram/ /zla stsogs 'khor lo can gnas su/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor rab tu bya/ /de la 'khor lo spyan drang ba/ /byas nas mtshams las stsogs bcings te/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang byas nas/ /bum pa lhag par gnas par bya/ /mgrin pa gos mchog gi dkris la/ / a mra stsogs 'dab kyi kha dag pa/ /dkyil 'khyor pa'i bum pa ni/ /de'i sngags kyis lhag gan/sa bya/ /'bru sman rin chen lnga rnams dang / /dri bzang chu dang 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /me tog 'phreng btags rdo rje ni/ /steng bzhag 'khor lo gtso rgyal la/ /mchod yon phul te yang dag mchod/ /me tog dkar po gzhug par bya/ /der ni spos stsogs dris bsgos pa'i/ /pad snod dri bzang stsogs ldan bya/ /nyin re bzhin du thun gsum du/ /gtor ma byin la de bzhin bzla'/ /de la yang 'khor lo'i phyir mtshams su/ /rnam rgyal 'khor gasdu'i g.yas su'o/ /de las mchod yon snod du chu/ /bcug nas de yis dbang bskur nas/ /bdag dang slob ma thams cad ni/ /chu yis dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur/ /slar yang 'khor lo mchod byas la/ /lag par bdug spos thogs nas ni/ /blo ldan pus btsugs 'khor lo'i gtso'/ /bde gshegs rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo / / slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi / / dkyil 'khor bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad pa'i rigs / / sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang g.yin gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong pa'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu can dang / /gang yang lha'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba'i rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag mying 'di zhes bgyi pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'jam dpal 'byung ba ni/ /'gro ba dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byord pas 'dri na/ /de bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin kyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum de gsol gdab/ /gtso bo mchod la stsogs byas te/ /yang dag bsrungs la phyir phyung nas/ /mye tog 'phreng thogs rang slob ma/ /yid gzhungs spro ba che ba dang / /byas pa gzo zhing nga rgyal myed/ /rigs mtho yon tan ldan zhing dad/ /gzugs dang kha dog lang tshor ldan/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsang ba ni/ /bsgrub la don gnyer mngon brtson na/ /gzugs ngan yon tan myed pa'am/ /dman ba'ang lhag par gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga las/ /'khor bzhi car yang rjes su gnang / /rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan/ /theg pa che la dga' ba'i bdag /la la — 1024—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par spyon/ /bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan//gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten/ pha rol don gnyer ba'i/ dad pa mang du byed pa yis/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya'i/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras bu 'dod myi bya/ /tshe 'di 'dod par gyurd pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don myi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rold don gnyer skyes/ /'jig rten 'di'i 'bras bu rgyas/ /de skad brjod nas slob ma de/ /blo yis rang gi nang du gzhug /sngon bzhin rdo rje chu skyes kyis/ /dag byas khyim sgor gsol ba 'debs/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul brtan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du stsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /slob ma des ni lan gsum brjod/ /rab gus mnyes gshin shes nas su/ /slob ma gtso bo gcig la ni/ /daphyigs byas tshig 'di brjod par bya/ khyod ni chul chen snod yin te/ /bu chung theg pa chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod chul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams / / 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dang / /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan myed brnyes/ / gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam myed de/ yākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu myi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom / / de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bshags stsogs lan gsum brjod nas ni/ /de nas bla mas byang chub sems/ /ma skyes pa ni bskyed par bya/ /bskyed pa slar yang dran du gzhug /las kun byed pas bsrung gnas ni/ /snying ga lkog ma spyi bo sa /rdo rje pad ma 'khor lo dang / / hūm̐ ā māoṃ las de ru dgod/ /spos chu rdo rje khu chur mchog /snying ga lkog ma spyi bor gtug /de bzhin hūm̐ āoṃ ā brjod bya//mye tog la stsogs rims bzhin sbyin/ /spyi bor mye tog mdun du spos/ /mar mye dri yang snying ga sa / kun byed bzlas nas gus pa'i/ /slob ma rnams la sbyin bar bya/ /a shad u dum pa ra yi/ /so shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa / / ma yo ma gas srog chags myed/ /rtse mo mye tog bcas pa sbyin/ tanar tam byang du kha bltas gzhag /bcas nasabaltos pa myed par ni/ /ba bsko tsam ni byugs par dor/ /zhi las stsogs pa'i dngos grub bstan/ /'thor 'thung skyor chu lan gsum blud/ /phyi rol du ni nges bshag ste/ /stan dang sngas phyir ku sha sbyin/ /dpung par skud pasabasrung bar bya/ /skyor chu lan gsum blud pa'i sngags ni/ /shweo hri bhi shud dha dharma sarba pa bā ni/ /cwa su sho dha ya — /025—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sarba bi kal pa a pa na ya hūm̐/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyend rnams/ /u dum ba ra'i mye tog bzhin/ brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang na myi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon ba ste/ /gang gis mnyam myed sems can don/ /mya ngan myi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru / / sdig pa bgyis par gyurd pa gang / /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas byang bar 'gyur lags na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyad pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci 'tshal/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na myed par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyad pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shind tu myi g.yo' ba / / de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis / / rnyed pa mnyam nyid de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcasapa/ /bdag nyid chen po kund kyisani/ /bstand pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg chen po cher 'byung ba yi/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyod rnams der ni 'dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skald pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /don bshad bsrung ba byas nas ni/ /ku sha'i stan la nyal du gzhug /rmi lam gang dag ci mthong ba / / de kun nang par nga la zlos/ /bsrung dang byin brlab stsogs gang gang / /de ni las kun byed pa bzla'/ /rigs lnga 'khor lo gsum gyi ni/ /las kun byed pa thab sbyor yin/ /rmyi lam bzang ngan dris nas ni/ /mi dge thab sbyor dag gis gzhom/ /slob ma legs bsrungs skal ldan pa/ /de nas sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /bstsal nas mgon po bdag la ni/ /'khor lo lha'i de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig dang / /sdom dang gsang ba dam pa dang / /sems can kun kyi don bgyid phyir/ /rtag tu slob dpon bdag gyurd gsungs/ /slob ma slob dpon nyid don gnyer// sdom pa rnams kyang 'dzin du gzhug /rnam 'byor mnyam bzhag 'khor lo mchog /legs mchogs blo yis mkha' la gzhag / rtag pa las stsogs dngos 'dra zhing / /de'i mdog sa bon las byung ba/ /ye shes lnga ldan srad bu ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar rnam phye ba/ /dza dang nyi ma zla ba'i myig /'jam ba'i rdo rje dag gzugs kyis/ /'bar ba'i lta ba'i lcags kyus dgug /rang gi mgo bo gnang du gzhug /rnams snang las stsogs thugs ye shes/ /srid bu thams cad byed dang bcas/ /rang gi 'khor lo thig gdab phyir/ /rtag pa'i thig na stsol tu gsol/ /ji srid phyi bskyod mthar thug pa/ /'di dag de nyid gsung dang spel/ /a n+yo rgyu na ga ta sarba/ dharma zhes bya stsogasadran bya/ /chur ni 'khor lo'i nyis gyurd la/ suoms su sgo'i nyi shu cha/ /myi 'chi bcu phyed dri bzang gis/ /sungs nas kyang ni bsrung — /026

sngags phyegs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /par bya/ /yig gsum chud par rnal 'byor pas/ /thig 'dzin pa dang bsgril bar bya/ /rdzo gsum gyis ni de gtang zhing / /rang yang rdzo rdzo zhes zlo/ khu tshur g.yon pas lte bar ni/ /bzung ste nub dang shar du gnas/ /blo ldan nam mkha'i thig gdab ste/ /de bzhin 'og du thig rab gdab/ /oṃ badro sa ma ya su tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ khyed kyi 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /thig gi sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /de rnams 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /gnod sbyin yi dwags dbang po klu yi/ /phyogs bltas mye dang rlung la rtend / / dngos por shar dang nub byang lho/ /phyogs kyi phyi rold srad bu gdab/ /mye dang bden bral phyogs gnas te/ /mtshams kyi srang bu'ang yang dag gdab/ /shar lho nub byang de bzhin du/ /byas pa dkyil 'khor brgyad du 'gyur/ /thig de nyi rim byas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i dbus su bzhag nas su/ /'khor lo'i rnam par de rgyab tu/ /rdo rje'i srad bu gnyis kyang gdab/ /dbang ldan las ni lcags ri dag /yang dag rim pa g.yas nas bskor / / mkhas pas thig gis thig btab nas/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid du bya/ /ltas ngan byung na dngos myi 'grub / / srad bu chad na bla ma 'chi/ /ring thung chad na bla ma 'chi/ /ring thung khyer na na bar 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma nyos par 'gyur/ /zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi ni rnam par mjes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me tog 'phreng bas brgyand/ /grwa'i phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /de'i nang gi 'khor lo ni / / dkyil 'khor brgyad pa 'dra ba la/ /phyi'i 'khor lo'i phyed kyi tshad/ /kun nas yongasasu zlum por bya/ /ka ba 'khor lo las stsogs spras/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng ba bzang pos bskord/ /de nas hrī dang khro bo'i/ /lta bas sgo ni rnam par dbye/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ kha khyer myed pa nyid du 'dod/ /sgo khyud sgo'i tshad yin te/ /lha'i snam bu'ang de'i tshad/ /sgo phyed kha khyer kun nas bskor/ /logs dang 'gram ni de bzhin te/ /dra ba dra phyed gnyi zla dang / /dar stsogs snam bu'i tshad de bzhin/ /tshon gyi sa ni de'i phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig sa'i phyi rold du'o/ /'khor lo las stsogs ka ba'i thig /tshon gyi sa dang sa bzhi mnyam/ /rta babs sgo'i sum 'gyur te/ /ba dan 'phreng ba rnams dang ldan/ /dril bu mchog ni rlung gis bskyod/ /ba dan phyi'i mtshams su bya/ /gzhan dag 'khor lo'i rjes mthun bar/ /ji ltar mdzes par rna bar brtag par brtag /rdzogs sangs ye shes sku yin phyir/ /chos sku'i bdag nyid shind tu dag /gsung dbang rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /'di ni thugs kyi dkyil 'bor yin/ /sems can bsam pa la brten nas/ /tshad las stsogs pa nges mdzad kyi/ /thabs shes las byung dngos grub la//tshad stsogs nges pas ci zhig bya/ /de ni khrud cig nas brtsams te/ /ji srid khrug stong bar du'o/ /de ltar 'khor — 1027—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kye sker/lo de thig gdab/ /tshon la 'bar ba'i lta bas kyang / /snga ma'i rim kyis ye shes swar/ /yang dag gzi bskyed gsang sngags bzla/ /oṃ badzra tsid ta sa ma ya hūṃ/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni grol byed pa / /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun nas rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /bla mas g.yon pa'i khu chur gyis/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /mnyam zhing g.yas bskor rgyun ma chad/ /ma yo bar tshon rtsi dgye/ /sgo'i nyi shu'i cha ru ni/ /ri mo mnyam bar dgye bar bya/ /sbor por bkye bas nad kyis 'debs/ /phra mos nor ni rnam par 'jig /yon pos rnam grangs chad pa yis/ /bla ma dang ni slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas bskor min par bkye ba yis/ /tshon ni phur bus btab par 'gyur/ /dkar po rdo rje rtse'i rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser la dmyigs pa ste/ /pad ma ra ga'i rang bzhin rtse/ /de bzhin gzhan dag ma rgad yin / / nag pe nang du shes bya ste/ /'di 'di'i tshon kyi rim par bshad/ /dkar po chen po shar phyogs su/ /lho ru ser dang yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang dang yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi'i cha dag ni/ /in dra ni la'i 'od gsal bar/ /rtag par shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /shind tu mnyam bzhag legs par bri/ /ri mo'i phan chun nas gang gis/ /ma reg par ni bri bar bya/ /bdud rtsi thal sbyor rdo rje yis/ /gdug nga/ thabs cad rnam par gzhom/ /'di'i rgya chen mtshe bar bshad/ /gdug pa'i dgra ste gsang sngags rgyal/na ma sa man ta kā ya bā ga cid ta badzra na ma/ /mo badzra krodha ya/ mahā dang khyod ka ra lha ra ha ya/ /a si mu sa la bar shu pā sha ha sta ya/ /oṃ a mri ta kun ta li/ kha kha khā nyi /khā hi/ tiṣṭa tiṣṭa/ ban dha ban dha/ ha na da ha/ gardza gardza / bi spo ta ya/ /bi spo ta ya/ sarba bi ghan/ /bi nā ya kā na/ mahā ga na pa ti ji bi ta an ta an ta ka rā ya hūm̐ phaṭa / / de ltar dkyil 'khor kun bris nas/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gdan byas te/ /ral gyi sngo bsangs dbus bri ba/ /shind tu rnam dag stegs 'od ldan/ tanard tu 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad mchog /me long las stsogs yang dag 'bar / / lho ru rin chen sngo bsangs 'od/ /cha dgu pa mthong mnyam pa nyid/ /nub du pad ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /so sor rtog las stsogs ldan dmar/ /byang du ral gyi dam pa ni/ /bya ba las stsogs kyis rab brgyand/ tanar lhor spyan te thabs yin la/ /lho nub rdo rje smon lam ste/ /nub byang kha ni bye ba yi/ /pad ma sdong bu bcas pa stobs / / byang shar ud pal ye shes te/ ser dang sprin sngon lta bus mdzes/ mye las stsogs pa'i mtshams bzhi dang / / shar sgor yi ni ngos gnyis su/ /mye long de bzhin pa'i beng dang / /dri'i dung dang bcud len snod/ /gos dang chos 'byung nyid dag ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims stsogs pas brgyan/ /dang stsogs thob pa dbyig pa dang / /— /028—

sngags phyegs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs se/ /pad ma rdo rje bzhi pa yin/ /sgo rnams kun tu shes byas la/ /rang gi 'khor lo rab gsal sgoms/ /sngar bzhin shes rab yan lag 'dus/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rang nang bzhugs/ /sems bzang nam mkha' khyab byas pa/ /'khor lo'i ngos su gnas bya'o/ /de dang lhag cig 'ongs pa'i bgegs/ /de ni kun bskrad mngon bar bsrung / /gshind rje'i dgra stsogs kyis bkug la/ /bcu ste bcings nas dbang du byas/ /mig dang sku stsogs byin brlabs la/ / mchod yon dbang bskur ma/ngon mchod pa/ /byas nas bstod de chim/ bya zhing / /rnam bsgoms bzlas pas mnyes par bya/ /sngon bzhin pad snod dmar par yang / /bdud rtsis ye shes bdud rtsi bya/ /phyogs skyong rang rang sbyor la gnas/ /rab tu mchod de dkyil 'khor lajug /'jig rten gsum las rgyal gyurd pas//gos dang rgyan ni ci rnyed dang / /'khor lo bskor ba byas nas ni/ /phyag byas spyin bsreg dag gis mchod/ /kun nas sor bzhi dor ba sa kha khyer de'i tshad pad ma kha bye/ khru phyed pa dang khru gang pa/ /'khor lo lta bu las kun byed / / ral gyi chu dang dpangs su ni/ /sor bgyad sor gcig pa'i chad/ /thab nang 'a/bor lo rin chen dang / /pad ma ral gyi dbus chud bri/ /phyi rol rdo rje 'phreng bas bskor/ /sngags pa shard tu kha bltas te/ /kun byed bzlas pas kun tu bsrung / /mchod yon lcegs g.yon de las gzhan/ /yo byad g.yas bzhag bsangs nas ni//'jam ba'i rdo rje'i sbyor bdag ldan/ /'o ma can shing gis sbar pa'i/ /mye ni yi ge gsum gyis bsangs/ /rlung yab g.yabs pas rab sbar la/ /g.yas nas bskor zhing ku sha dgram/ /dang po'i snying byung ra gu gsum/ /pad gnas sa bon ram las byung / /ser zhing zhal ras gsum pa la/ /shes rab yan lag rgyas dang ldan/ /spyi blugs mi 'jigs dbyig pa 'phreng / /phyag na bsnams par 'dir me bams/ /sngar bzhin de nyid gsum 'don pas / / ye shes dam pa'i me spyan drangs/ /de las bsang gtor las sdegs pa/ /byas nas gdan la bzhugs su gsol / / dgang gzar glugs gzar yu ba khru/ /'og tu rdo rje rin chen bya/ /de'i steng dgang gzar rgyar ni sor bzhi / / zabs su sor gnyis nang rdo rje/ /seor bzhi'i mthar ni rdo rje ste/ /rab du pad ma'i 'dab ma'i dbyibs//blugs gzar pad ma'i dbyibs sor gnyis/ /zabs su sor gcig nang rdo rje/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar khar rang gi /lha'i sa bon rab 'bar bsam/ /de'i khar yi ge ram bkod la/ /de la dgang lugs sbyin bar byi//mye la 'byor ldan yam ste/ /yam shing mye la mar dang til/ /ma grugs dur ba 'bras can zho/ /ku sha cho ga'i rim pa yin/ /de nyid ye shes dam pa'i me'i/ /thugs zlar mo skyes bdag po ni/ /'khor lo mchog bsams phyi mchod stsogs / / sngon du 'gro bas sbyin bsreg bya/ /io ag na ye swāhā/ mar gyi'o/ /io sarba pad ta ha na/ badzra ya sarba pā paṃ da ha suhā/ /til gyi'o/ /eo badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/ /dur b.li 'o/ /io badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ /'bras ma grugs pa'i 'o/— 1029—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo be'i gsung chos kyi sker/māoṃ sarba saṃ ba de swāhā/ /zho dang 'bras chan gyi'o/ /oṃ a prad ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ /ku sha'i 'o/ /rgyas dang zhi dang dbang dang dgugs/ /sdang dang bskrad dang mngon spyod la/ oṃ swāhā ho dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ /sngags kyi mtha' ni bskul ba'ang bya/ /rang bdag snying ka'i sems dpa' yis/ /lha kun tshim pa nyid du bya/ /zla stsogs de las g.yin pa'i rdzas / / snying zla'i 'khor lo'i lcags kyi mchog /bsgoms nas snon bzhin tshim par bya/ /mthar ni de bzhin dgang blugs dbul/ /bsad dang 'thor 'thung mchod yon dag /phul nas mchod de gshegs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rdzas lhag ma/ /me la phul nas de bzhin du/ /cho ga snga mas gshegs gso la la/ /'khor lo mchod de yang dag 'jug /slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga yis/ /dang por zhugs la rang gi ni/ /dbang bskur bya ba rdzogasabyas shing / /rigs bdag rjes gnang thob pa dang / /'dod chags che las byung de nyid/ /'khor lo'ang gzugasabarnyan lta bu'i/ /grong du slob ma 'jug bya'i phyir/ /bden pa 'di ni bsgrag par bya/ /nam mkha' lasabyung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha myed pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che'i rang bzhin/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer deng grub mdzod / / kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun kyi rgyal/ /myi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchod dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje'i 'dzin pa kun kyi rgyal/ /phyi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa phyi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /'dod chags kun kyis rjes chags pa/ 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shind tu dag pa kun kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /dngos grub chen po kun kyi mchogadabang phyug chen po kun kyi mchog /dbang phyugs chen po rgya mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje bsnyems bdag bdag mdzod cig /sems can kun kyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun kyi snying la bzhugs/ /sems can kun kyi yab gyurd nyid/ /'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyurd pa'o/ /bden bgang gis ye shes mchog / shes rab thams dag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ khyed kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa myed/ /gzung du myed cing brjod du myed/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yisadakyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyen gsal ba slob ma ni/ /kun kyis dri ma myed mthong shog /bslob ma spyi'i sdom pa dang //sngon bzhin sku stsogs 'od gsal bya/ /kun byed bum pa'i chu yis ni/ /yol ba'i mthar ni bsang gtor bya/ /de nas gos dmar gis gdong g.yog /sdug pa khyod su zhes dri/ /de nas slob mas tshig tu ni/ /bdag ni skal pa — 1030—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs seo/ /bzang zhes brjod/ /sgor ni 'phreng thogs yang dag mchod/ /de bzhin yon ni phul ba dang / /rnal 'byor sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /snying kar rdo rje snying pos bsam/ /sngags la/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsid ta ud pā ta yā mi/ /su ra te / sa ma ya st+waṃ ho/ /sid dha badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis brlabs kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog du gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /dad pa dang mi ldan ba rnams la/ yang ma yin no zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed stsogs rang sngags ni/ /dam pas dgug dang gzhug par bya/ /yi ge lnga yang de bzhin du/ /brjod de dam tshig mchog 'dzind gzhug /deng khyod de bzhin gsheg pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ /ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong pa rnams la ma smra shig /dam tshig nyams par gyurd ta re/ /de'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ /rmeo rdo rje sems dpa' dang deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag bzhugs par gyurd/ /gal te chul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs / / pad snod yi ge gsum gyis sbar/ /myi 'chi lnga pa 'thung du gzhug /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par 'gyurd/ /dam tshig bsrungs pas dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /eo badzo da ka thā thā thā/ /dam bca' ba brten bar 'di skad ces brjod do/ /deng phyin cad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje ni nga yin gyis/ /ngas 'di byos shog ces pa'i bsgo ba gang yin de yang bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /mi bde ba ma spangs pas khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyurd ta re zhes smras la/ /de nas slob ma la 'di skad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis rlobs la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyurd cig ces smos shig par bsgo'o/ /de skad brjod nas de'i snying gar/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje mtshal pa kha dog ser/ /las lang byung bar hūm̐ bsgom bya/ /baṃ byung chu ni kha dog dkar / / bum pas mtshand cing yongs su zlum/ /yeo las byung ba'i g.yo ba'i rlung / /ba dan sngo mtshan gzhu'i dbyibs / de la sku gsung ha ā bsgom/ /rkang 'og dze ni rab 'bar ba/ /rlung las ram byung gru gsum par/ /gnas par sbor la slob ma dbab/ /ā be sha ya stu bā ya ra ra ra ra bā ya rtswa la ya/ /hūm̐ ha ā dzhai/ /lce la swe ni dmar po zhig /bsams te babs la slar yang bsgo/ /'dod chags rdo rjer de gnas pa/ /smos shig rdo rje dge myi dge /babs pa de ni rtag bya ba/ /de la tiṣpe badzra brjed/ /me tog 'phreng ba 'khor lo dor/ /prad ti tsha badzra ho zhes brjod/ /de ni spyi bor bcing bar bya/ /pra ti gri hā twa mi ma sad twa ma ha ba la/ /blangs pa'am ma —1031 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/blangs pa gnyis ni/ /mtshan ma'am mtshan ma nye ba mā /babs sam dad kyang de'i sbyor ba/ /skal can nyid la sbyin bar bya/ /myig tu 'bar bcas oṃ bsams la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /myig 'byed par ni brtson bar mdzad/ /myig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i myig ni bla na med/ /de nas 'khor lo bstan par bya/ /'khor lo'i bdag po nas brtsams te/ /bdud rtsi thab sbyor bar du'o/ /badzra a bhi ṣi na tsa zhes/ /brjod te spyi bor chus dbang bskur/ /sngon bzhin cod pan gyi rang bdag /lha'i dbang bskur spyin bar bya/ /snying kar rdo rje de 'dzin la/ /rdo rje yis kyang dbang bskur bya/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod ni bskur bar gyurd/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub pa'i/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /rdo rje dril bus 'byud nas ni/ /rang gi bdag pos dbang bskur spyin/ /oṃ badzra a di pa ti twe a bha ṣi na tsā mi tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ /spyin bor lag pa mying gi ste/ /oṃ badzra sad twa tt+waṃ a bhi ṣi na tsa mi/ /badzra nā ma a bhi she ka ta/ /kye che ge mo rdo rje/ /rang gi dngos kun gang gang snang / /gtso cher de ni 'dzam rgyal dang / /chos rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gang yin de'o/ /rang nyid 'khor los skur nyid pas/ /mtshan kyi thog mar dpal gyi sgra/ /kun la'ang bdag po thams cad las/ /kye dang rdo rje mtha' mar sbyar/ /chu khams dag pa'i myi bskyod pa/ /cod pan mnyam pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje so sor rtog mchog bdag /bdag po bya bsgrub don stsold pa/ /ye shes rig yin 'dir rdo rje/ /rgyu dang rigs kyi dbang du byas pa/ /brtul zhugs lung bstand dbugs 'byind pa/ /rig dbang bskur la'ang 'di ming yin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na gnas/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan māoṃ sarba ta tha ga ta sid dha badzra sa ma ya ti ṣa e ṣa tt+waṃ hā ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs kun byin nas/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis 'dzin gzhug/thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dril bu de nyid kyis bzung la/ /chos kyi sgra yis dkrol du gzhug /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab sgra'i rjes 'grol bshad/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /de chos kyi dkrold du gzhug ste/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyisa'agal srid byas/ /rang bzhin gyis dag sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /bsnyen stsogasasnying por bshad pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen por byin rlabs la/ /gzugs stsogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gsang sngags ma tshang myed pas bzla'/ /rang rig pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gzhugs pa de/ /rang gi lha'i spyod pa yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /dka' thub sdom ba mi bzad pa/ /bsten na mi snang mngon —1032—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /shes dang / /mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid/ /las byung dngos grub 'grub myi 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so/ /bde' dang sdug bsngal de'i bdag min/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten/ /ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can/ /sbyor bas bsgrubs na myur du 'grub/ /sku gsung thugs ni yang dag grub/ /gang gzhan dman bar bshad pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pas so/de nyid kyis ni rdo rje gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkro'/ bar bya/ /dam chig gis ni phyag rgya cher/ /byin kyis brlabs nas snying po bzla'/ /zhes gang bshad pa/ de'i phyir de skad ces bshad pa yin no/ /slob ma sdom pa gzung ba dang / /de bzhin yon ni phul ba yis/ /dbang bskur phyir ni gsol 'debs shing / /tshigs bcad 'dis kyang phya bya'o/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas kyis/ /mchod chen ji ltar gsol ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam kha rdo rje bdag la stsold/ /'jug sgo pad ma 'dab brgyad par/ /rang lha'i sbyor bas khri la gnas/ /dus gsum phyogs kun nam mkha' khyab/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rang snying 'byung / /rol mo dri las stsogs ldan des/ /snga ma bzhin du rig dbang bskur/ /rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ khams gsum gyis ni phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung / /sangs rgyas kun kyi sbyin pa bya/ /mi log dbang bskur byin nas ni/ /'khor lo'i de nyin sbyin bar bya/ /mi mnyam myed pas zur bzhi pa/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas min mnyam nyid/ /lus chor sems dang chos rnams kyis/ /gcig dang sna tshogs sbyor bral nyid/ /de dran de la dad pa gang / /shar sgor byang chub phyir 'dod do/ /de nas byung dang 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /phyin ci log spang ma skyes bya/ /ma skyes skyes pa'i yang dag kyang / /bskyed pa dang ni gnas bya ba/ /brtson 'grus rnam bzhi lto'i sgo/ /'dun dang spro dang gnas dang blo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang dang dran pa 'dir/ /nub kyi sgo ni yin bar bshad/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /shes rab dbang po stobs mnyam med/ /ting nge 'dzin yang byang de ltar/ /dran na/sa dbang po sgo bzhi yin/ /dang po las stsogs bsam gtan bzhi/ /rta babs bzhir ni byung ba yin/ /dpa' bar 'gro dang mkha' mdzod stsogs/ting 'dzin kha khyer yin par bshad/ lag na mchod thogs g.yen sbyor rnams/ /tshig las stsogs pa'i gzungs tshogs yin/ /gang phyir sna tshogs rgyan ldan ba/ /bsam ba thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /gdul bya bskyod pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /yan lag dgu sgra kun 'gro ba/ /ba dan sna tshogs rlung gis bskyod/ /rtse mor dril btags sgra sgrogs yin/ /ye shes me long byang yan lag /phyogs kun tu ni 'od rab gsal/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /rnga —1033—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/yab me long me tog 'phreng / /'khor lo rin chen stsogs ka ba/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sbyangs pa yis/ /de'i nang gi 'khor lo de/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa lta bu yin/ /phyogs kun dus gsum rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje theg pa rab stond pas/ /kun nas yongs su zlum bar ni/ /rdo rje'i thig gis bskord pa yin/ /ye shes kyis 'grol zhes pas/ /tshon ni rdzogs sangs rgyas lnga yin/ /dbang po don stsogs rnam dag pa/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dben pa nyid / / shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ /rdo rje can gsol bum pa'ang de/ /tshogs rdzogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa/ /thugs rjes brlan nyid bum pa gang / /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog spos/ /mar me che dang drir bshad pa/ /byang chub yan lag yid rab tshim/ /chos kyi snang ba grags bsdus yin/ /chos kyi zas ni lha bshos yin/ /ngo tsha khrel yod pa'ang gos/ /glu snyan gar dang rol mo rnams/ /bde ba chen po rnam 'phrel ba'o/ /grong khyer thard pa'i grong khyer bas/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin/ /'khor lo'i de nyid legs bstan nas/ /lha'i de nyid bstan par bya/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /rnam dag sgo srungs mchog gi gzugs/ /sku stsogasarnal 'byord 'dzin pa'i sems/ /shes rab dag pa rab dri myed/ /sbyin stsogs drug po'i phyi rol dag /gzugasardo rje stsogs rang bzhin can/ /sa thabs las stsogs mtshan myed phyir/ /span las stsogs pa'i ngo bo yin/ /non dang sems can bdag kun rtog /'jug pa'i shes pa'i rnam dag pa/ /me long las stsogs ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi ngo bo yin/ /ma skyes ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo lta bur snang / /gzugs stsogs zhabruld pa legs dag pa/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams so/ /ser sna las stsogs gnas gyurd pa/ /mchog dang sar ni shind tu brtan/ /rang gi rnam rtog gnas gyurd pa/ /stobs stsogs tshang zhing dri ma myed/ /rnam par myi rtog zab pa dang / /rgya che ba ni rang gzhan 'byung / /zab dang rgya chen 'di dag nyid/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid gang ste / / so so rang rig chos yin phyir/ /dbye yod dbye myed stsogs myi gnas/ /de ltar spros par gyurd pa ni/ /pha rol phyind stsogs 'bras bur snang / /de nas rnal 'byord dam tshig mchog /gzugs dang lang tsho yon tan ldan/sbyor byas slob dpon deng 'dug la/ /ye shes 'bab pa rab tu brtag /rdo rje sa chu skyes kha phye la/ /sangs rgyas rang nang gzhug par bya/ /pad ma la gnas bstan byas te/ /rigs bdag gnang ba thob pa dang / /rdo rje'i bdag nyid rang myin brjod/ /'khor lo'i sbyor bas spro bar bya/ /rdo rje chu skyesasgras sangs rgyas/ /spyan drangs 'khor lo'i phyogs logs su/ /bgegs rnams bsal la yang dag bsrung / /mchod yon phul la rab tu'ang mchod/ /yang dag bstod de sgo bas skor/ /las rnams byas nas bsgrub par bya/ /mig dang sku stsogs byin brlabs la/ /dbang skur mchod pa las stsogasabartag /dngos grub kun phyir sems can dond/ /mdzod cig ces ni gsol ba —1034—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gartsa bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /gdab / / 'khor lo yang dag bris nas ni/ /dang po rab gnas cho ga'ang 'di/ /sku gzugs glegs bam las stsogs la/ /skyes bu'i mthar thug pas dbang bskur/ /bum pa mchod yon bla re stsogs/ /bsrung dang sbyin bsreg stsogs bshad gang / /yi ge lnga gsum sngags mchog gam/ /sngar btus pa'i sngags kyis bya/ /phyi'i khrus ni byas pa dag /'khor los sgyur 'dra de rang nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid gang / /de nyid mchog ni 'di nyid yin / / rgyu mthun chu dang 'phreng ba ste/ /rnam smin rdo rje'i bdag por bshad/ /skyes 'bras rdzogs sangs kyis dbang bskur/ /dbang 'bras gsang ba'i sbyor ka 'di/ /de nas gzugs stsogs yon tan ldan/ /'khor lo'i rnal 'byord shin tu goms/ /dam tshig sdom la gnas pa nyid/ /'khor lor phyag rgya'ang byin kyis brlabs/ /thub pa'i dbang tshogs rdo rje'i mthar/ /yang dag dbab ste bden mchog de/ /thu bo tha ma min bar bsdam/ snod gyur sgor ni nges par dbab/ /brtan pa'i blo ldan snod kyis kun/ /rnam snang bdag nyid can 'thungs la/ /sna tshogs bzhin te sna tshogs gyurd/ /kye ma shind tu bde tshig brjod/ /shes rab yang dag 'dus dpal ldan/ /de nyid nye bar shes par bya/ gzungs 'di shind tu yid la ste/ /bsten byas sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags/ /'khor lo'i rim kyis rab sbyor bas/ /bde ba dam pa yang dag spyad/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung nyid dang sems/ /nor ldan khongs su gtogs par bsam/ /dkyil 'khor lha'i de nyid dang / /bslob dpon kyi ni las rnams dag /rab gsang shes rab mchog gi ni/ /dbang bskur de nyid yang dag bshad/ /dbang bskur 'di ni ji lta bar/ /byang chub spyod gzhan de gzhin du/ /dge ba'i chul ni gzhan gsungs pas/ /sangs rgyas kun stsogs thob mi 'gyu / / dam tshig dag ni bsrung ba dang / /rtag tu sdom pa brkyang bar bya/ /bcu phyed sgron ma mi 'chi spyad/ /dam tshig gzhan yang bsrung ba ni/ /dkon mchog gnod gzhoska bud myed kun/ /mchog myang log pa'i dag ma yin/ /'di dag cho ga bzhin srung ba/ /rnal 'byord rgyud tu gang bshad pa'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs gyurd la/ /gzengs bstod 'di dang lung bstan te/ /g.yon pa snying gar khu tshul dang / /chos gos 'dzind chul g.yas mchog sbyin/ /oṃ/ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i go ni nyid las bton/ /kye de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje che ge mo zhig bya ba sing dha bhur ha ba swa/ /'di yis dbang bskur gyur pa yi/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun kyi bdag /bla na myed pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs kyis kyang lung bstand mdzad/ /ngo bo nyid kyis sems can rnams/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar chags las stsogs/ /gtsang bas sems can don bya'o/ /nyin re bzhin ni thun bzhi ru/ting 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor ldan par/ /gyurd pas thun mong gcig shos kyi/ /dngos grub thob pa bsgrub par bya/— 1035—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/mi snang ba ni stong yin te/ /mngon shes ldan pa nyid stong yin/ /rdo rje can ni 'gro kun bdag /zhi dang rgyas stsogs las gang dang / /de las gzhan pa ci 'dod pa/ /'khor lo rjes mnyes sbyor ba yis/ /bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de yang rdo rje bdag po thams cad ni/ /'dod chags de nyid don sems pa sems can kun la phan bzhed pa/ /'dod chags las byung byang chub byed/ /de bas byang chub 'dod sngags pas/ /lusangag yid kyi spyod pa rnams/ /thams cad byang chub par 'dod pas/ /cho ga bzhin du las rnams bya/ /zhes gzungs pa yin no/ ji bzhin zhugs pa'i slob ma dang / phan yon don gnyer rnams la yang / /gang phyir dbugs 'byin dam tshig gsum/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyin par bya/ /mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa ni/ /mthong ba la ni zhugs gyurd pas/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ khyed rnams de nyid legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod myin te/ /myi tshugs par dang mi gsod pas/ cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis / / srid pa shind tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shind tu grub pa'i phyir / / stond pa'i mchog tu gyurd pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /rtag tu khyod kyisabasrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis ma thun bar gsungs/ /dam pa rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni//sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa yi/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /phyag rgya rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /tshul bstand par mi bya'o / / bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas su/ /dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs shig /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / / 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang yongs su mi dor zhing /slob dpon smad par myi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi/ slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ /rtag tu bsdug bsngal 'thob 'gyurd te/ /rimasadang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems dmyal lhung rab 'gyur/ de bas nan tan thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros chen/dge ba bar tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyisasbyin bar bya/ /des na rims stsogs gnod ba rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig srung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra / / de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogasayin te//tshogs las dngos thub mchog tu 'gyurd/ /gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pas/ deng khyod skye ba 'brasabur —1036—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor ston pa'i skor bzhugs so/ /bcas / / dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ /deng khyod gyurd pa the tshom myed/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa / / kun kyis deng khyod dbang bskurd pas/ khams gsum kyi ni rgyal po che/ /rgyal po'i bdag por brtan ba yin / / deng ni bdud las rnams rgyal te/ /grong khye/ ra mchog tu rab zhugs pa/ khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid / / deng nyid thob par the tshom myed/ /de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde skyed bsten par gyis/ /deng ni 'gro la myur bde rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /slob ma rab dang mnyes gshin pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsald pa'i/ /gsung ni de bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /gal te 'byor na de rnams kyi/ /mthe bo g.yas pa lag g.yon gyis/ /legs par bzung ste re re nas/ /zhi ba'i cho ga bzhin du bya/ /de nas rgyal po'am sa bdag phyir / / sbyin blugs gsum mam bdun gcig bya'o/ /phyogs skyong bdag nyid zhi bya'i/ /bsreg blugs phul la yon bslong ba/ /mnyam pa las stsogs re re zhing / /sems can kun/ kyi don bya'o/ /sa gzhi rgyal srid stsogs gser stsogs/ /yang na rang grub phyir grogs nyid/ /gang de btang nas legs blangs pa'i/ /yon phul bas ni mgu byar bya/ kha zas dang ni spyod kun kyis/ /dong gzhan 'khor lo mchod par bya/ /legs gzung snod gyurd slob ma mchog /sna tshogs cha mchog rnams kyis ni/ /tshim byas mu'i mtha' can gyi/ /yi ge gsum gyi yang ngag bsdu / / a kā ra stsogs sngags kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa dbyi bar bya/ /slong la tshon rtsi cung zad sbyin/ /tshon rnams chu bo chen por dor/ khung bu 'gengs dang rab gnas dang / /sbyin bsreg dkyel 'khor noor gang yin / / de kun slob dpon nyid dbang zhes/ /rdo rje mchog ni 'dzin pas gsungs/ /de ltar dang po'i las can gyi / / dkyil 'khor cho ga gsal bar bshad/ /ye shes dbab pa legs thob pa/ /sems dpa' dbab pa nyid bshad de/ /lo bcu gnyis lon byis pa dang / /bu mo dbab byas yang dag mchod/ /de gnyis kyis bris 'khor lo gang / / thugs gsung sku'i yin par 'dod/ /thugs la mi bskyod ma ma ki /dbab pa yin par yang dag bshad//gsung la dag myed gos dkar mo// sku la rnam snang mdzad dang spyan/ /thugs gsung sku ni/ legs dbab pas/ /bris pa 'di ni rmad byung yin/ /thugs babs bas ni yengs shes pa/ /gsung bas gsang sngags smra ba'o/ /sku'i dbabs su mkha' la gtad de dbab// g.yo ba'i cho ga 'di'o/ /slob dpon slob ma dbang bskur 'dir/ /snga ma'i tshul ni nyid kyis gnas/ /ye shes dbang thob pa yis sems/ /nyid kyis 'khor lo gsum pa bya/ /byind brlabs des ni 'khor lo de/ /gang phyir rang gzhan dag la snang / /'dir ni 'jug dang rjes gnang bas/ /rmi lam gsal ba bzhin du bya/ /gang phyir sems kyi tshul brtan pas/ /de ni mchog tu shes par bya/ /rnal 'byord — 1037—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa gsum car kyis kyang / /gsung sku'i gsang ba dag bya'i phyir/ /gsung sku'i 'khor lo'i cho ga ni/ /snon bzhin gnas der mi bskyod mtshan/ /ye shes las dang po cung zad/ /thob dang yang dag thob pas kyang / /yid kyis cho ga kun bya ste/ /de myed par ni grub myi 'gyur/ /rdo rje slob dpon slob ma mchog /rgyu mthun las stsogs dga' ba'i bdag /yid bshad cho ga mchog yin gyi/ /tshig tsam gyis 'dir ci zhig 'gyurd/ /'jug pa tsam gyi 'tshang mi rgya/ /thos tsam gyis kyang myi 'gyur ro/ /ji srid bsams par gyurd pa dang / /bsgoms pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /ji skad du gsang sngags smra rnams mang du ni/ /spros te smras pa ci zhig bya/ khyad par du ni semasabasgrubs te/ /sems las rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byung zhes gsungs pa dang / ji skad bu/ byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu gang / /de ni sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin de'i/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /tha mal rnam rtog ma gtogs par/ /srid bdag sdug bsngal gzhan myed de/ /de ltar 'di ni mngon 'gag 'di/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag can yid/ /dus chosaphyogasakun khyab pa yis/ /ma chags 'khor lor snang ba na/ /rtog de snang bar mi 'gyur na/ /legs par gomasapas de ltog 'gyur / / 'di na gang gi lan 'da' yang / /mi mthun gyurd te rtag pa yin/ /gang gi rgyu ni goms gyurd las/ /de ni shin tu ldog par 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan tha mal gnyom ba ni/ /'khord lo mchog la de yod de/ /chosakun bdag nyid 'khor lo mchog /'gro ba yongs dag mngon gyurd las/ /mngon sum rgyu las byang chub 'gyur/ /bskal par rtog 'di 'bras bur myed/ /rim gyisaspyi stsogs blang bya dang / khrims stsogs ma chags lasazab yin / / tha mal ma spangs rgya chen min/ /dus kyi tshad kyis 'dir byang chub/ /rang gi yul dusabadag nyid can/ /mkhas pas tha mal pa ru bshad/ /'gro ba rdzogs byang 'khor lo'i bdag /skad cig gis 'dir byang chub snod/ /sbyin bya las stsogs mi dmyigs kyang / /sbyin stsogs tha mal bdag nyid can/ /bdag myed tha mal mi 'joms kyi/ /'khor lo mchog la de yod min/ /de bas kun rtog rnam bsal cing / /kun nas 'od zer rab 'phro ba/ /bdag nyid kund tu bzang por ni/ / bsgoms pa nyid kyis byang chub 'thob/ /de bsa'akhor lo gsum bstand pa/ /chos dang longasaspyod rdzogs spruld pa/ /thugasadang gsung dang sku'i gsang ba/ /sku gsum rim pa dag pa nyid/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum ni/ 'khor lo'i sbyor bdag nyid kyis 'grub/ /rnam pa thamasacad mkhyend 'grub na/ /mi 'grub de las gzhan ci yod/ /gang phyir byang chub pha rold phyind/ /gzungasadang sa rnams grub pa dag /bde chen rnal 'byord 'di las ni/ /rang nyid rjes su 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i dpal ldan de/ /'phags chos mchog kun bsdus pa yin/ /'phra rab kun na'ang 'khor gsum —1038—

sngags phyogs sgyu lus gtso bor sten pa'i sker bzhugs so/ /mchog / rang gi yid ni su mi bsgom/ /dam chos ro mchog myong gyurd dang / /thos pa mang po'i gnas byas pa'i//skyes mchog tshad mar 'di 'gyur phyir/ /rang sems kyis 'dir nan kyis byas/ /bla ma dam pa'i gzhung bzung ba/ /dad pa yis ni gsal bar byas/ /dad stsogs nor ni bsten bya yin/ /bstend 'od skal ldan smad bya myin / / bdag las dman pa'am mtshungs don yod/ /sems can dam pas legs bshad ni/ /byis ba las kyang blang bya yin/ /de ltar rang sems nyid kyis brtags/ /rim las brgyud cing yang dag rdzogs/ /'khor lo bris pa'i dga' ba bzhag /'dis 'gro 'jam ba'i rdo rjer shog /bdag kyang 'jam rgyal nyid gyurd cig /bsdeb sbyor byas pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ /bzhi brgya lnga cu pa nyid du/ /rab phyed 'jig rten legs dran phyir/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di byas so/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa// //rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pad ma ka ra bar ma dang / zhu chen gyi lo che ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyurd cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /— /039—

༄༅/ /gsang ba sngags kyi blo skyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ka1 sngags kyi stordon la 'ildogag pa bzhugs/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ man tra ā wa ta ra/ bod skad du/ sngags kyi don la 'jug pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la mngon par 'chol ba'i rtog ge pa rnams ni/ sngagasazhes bya ba 'di ci zhig ji ltar sgra la 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan du 'gyur/ rnam par dbye ba du ma dang ldan/ ji ltar lam du khyer nas 'bras bu ci 'dra ba zhig thob par 'gyur zhe na/ zhes the tshom du gyur pa las/ de dag gi the tshom yongs su bcad pa'i phyir/ 'di skad ston pa yin te/ sde snod gsum las lhag tu gyur pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod zhes bya ba yin te/ de yang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ zhes gsungs pa'i don gyis na/ gsum ni rgyu yin la/ gcig ni 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid du bstan pa yin no/ /de rang gi ngo bo yang so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes dngos dang mthun pa'i rnam pa zhen pa dang bral ba de tsam ni sngags te/ rang bzhin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la sgra 'jug pa ni man tra'i sgra las drangs na/ shes pa skyob par byed pa'i don ldan du gyur pa'o/ /de yang shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ skyob pa ni ngo bo nyid yongs su shes pa'i dbang las 'dzin chags dang bral ba'i nges pa rnyed pa nyid do/ /de yang 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i phyir/ mtshan nyid las khyad par du gyur par ston te/ shrī si ta a ba ta ra las/ don gcig la ni ma rmongs las/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i yul du gyur/ sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes pa'i rigs pa 'dis ni/ khyad par bzhis sngags kyi theg pa phul du byas pa yin no/ /de kho na nyid la ma rmongs pas gol sa ma yin pa dang / thabs mang bas 'jug sgo yangs pa dang / dka' ba med pa'i man ngag gis le lo can yang sangs rgyas pa dang / dbang po rnon po'i yul du gyur pas zab cing dpag dka' bar bstan to/ /de'i dbye ba yang sku rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje dang / thugs rdo rje dang dam tshig rdo rje'i dbang gis/ lus ngag yid dang las kyi rtog pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi gsang sngags dang / rig sngags dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya zhes pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar lam du byed na dbang po dman pas rang gi rtog pa —1040—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi sker bzhugs so/ /ltar byas pa dang / lha nyid kyang sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du shes pa dang / sgyu ma nyid kyang rnam pa'i mchog dang ldan pa la / yid la mi byed pa'i tshul gyis gnas cing rol pa'o/ /dbang po mchog gis ni/ snang ba 'di dag sems su byed pa dang / sems kyang rang rig tu byed pa dang / rang rig pa de yang bde ba chen por byed la/ bde ba chen po nyid kyang don gyis stong bar byed pa'o/ /'di'i dpe yang gser 'gyur gyi rnam pa bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /'di 'dra ba zhig thob par gyur na/ goms pa rab kyis mtha' las skyes pa'i shes pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings/ sangs rgyas ni chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi dngos gzhir gyur pa'o/ /des na don chen po las ni ma nyams la/ chegs med par rang gi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas pa 'di ni/skyes bu rnams kyi don du gnyer ba kho na'o/ /sngags kyi don la 'jug pa/ slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo cwa ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //kha2 dam tshig sbas pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma ya gu pa ta/ bod skad du/ dam tshig sbas pa/ rje bcun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo / / dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor blo ldan pas/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang bar bya/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje dang / /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /tha dad par ni ma mthong ba/ /de ni dam tshig dang po yin/ /thos pa'i spun dang dbang gi spun/ /man ngag spun dang sgrub pa'i spun/ dam tshig spun dang lnga po la/ khro ba spong bar byed pa ni/ /dam tshig gnyis pa brjod pa yin/ /yig 'bru dang ni gang zag dang / /dgra don dang ni rnam par shes/ /de la yid brten mi byed pa/ /de ni dam tshig gsum pa'o/ /ri mo can dang dung can dang / /padma can dang glang po can/ /phur bu can gyi bud med bsten/ /de ni dam tshig bzhi pa'o/ /bza' btung rnam pa ci mthong ba/ /go stsogs sha'i rnam pa dang / /gci stsogs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin shes/ /de ni dam tshig lnga pa'o/ /snod bcud bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /'dod lha'i dkyil 'khor snang ba mā /dran pa gcig pa gang yin pa/ /de ni dam tshig drug pa'o/ /bstod smad bkur dang ma bkur dang / /grags dang ma grags rnyed pa dang / /ma rnyed pa la snyam sems pa/ /ma ning drang srong dka' thub dang / /rang gi bud med rgyal po dang / /bram ze mu stegs dbang mi 'gyur/ /de ni dam tshig brgyad pa'o/ /mos pa dman dang le lo can/ g.yo ldan snying stobs med pa la/ /bstan pa'i gsang ba sgrog byed pa/ /de ni dam tshig dgu pa'o/ /snying rje byams sems gathen la med/ /des pa srog chags chos rnams la/ /dngos por mngon par chen byed pa/ /de —1041 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ni dam tshig bcu pa'o/ /rtag tu mi rtag sdug bsngal dang / stong pa dang ni bdag med pa/ /byang chub sems ni dran byed pa/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gcig pa'o/ /chos la ming ni yod min zhing/ /'phags pa la ni gzugs med la/ /gang zag ngo bo nyid med shes/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gnyis pa'o/ /rdo rje tshig ni bcu gsum pa'o// gang gis bsrungs na thar pa che/ /gal te nyams par gyur pa na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed pa yin/ /des na gsang sngags sa la ni/ /skyed pa gnyis yin bde gshegs gsungs/ /ji ltar smyug dong sbrul bcug bzhin/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /dam tshig sbas pa/ slob dpon po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la pab pa'o// //ga3 dbang gi man ngagabyu/ /rgya gar skad du/ she ka pa ste na/ bod skad du/ dbang gi man ngag rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo / / rnal 'byor smin pa'i lam gyur pa/ /dbang ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /bum pa la brten dbang dang ni/ /de bzhin shes rab la brten pa'o/ /bum pa'i rten can la yang gnyis// sgrub pa po dang slob dpon gyi/ /dbang ni so sor nges pa yin/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa ma lus pa/ / bum pa de yis zhabru byed cing / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / / ming dang bdag po'i dbang du bcas/ /rigs pas phyir mi ldog pa ste/ /sgrub pa po'i dbang du nges/ /dkyil 'khor lha'i de nyid dang / /slob dpon las la bslab pa dang / /gsang rgyal dang ni nges pa che/ /slob dpon nyid du shes par bya/ /gzengs bstod pa dang lha mchod pa/ /dam tshig bsgrags pa thun mong ste/ /lung bstan pa dang rjes gnang mchog /so so nyid du nges pa dang / /de yang bri ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /brten pa nyid du shes par bya/ /phyag rgya ston pa'i dbang la yang/ /phyi dang nang du shes par bya/ /phyi ni lce la byang chub sems/ /dkar dmar thig le sbyin byed cing / /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyong ba can/ /de yang pha las thob pa dang / /ma las thob pa'i bye brag gis/ /dbye ba rnam pa gnyis su nges/ /de nas nang gi dbang bshad pa/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste / / shes rab dbang dang dang ye shes kyi/ /dbang mchog nyid du shes par bya/ /de la shes rab bsten pa ni/ /bu mo rigs lnga gang rnyed kyang / /lha mo nyid du byin brlab cing / /cha lugs nyid kyang de 'dra la/ /yi ges nye bar bsrung byas nas/ slob ma'i lag tu gtad pa dang / /rdo rje padmar snyoms zhugs pas/ /rang lus gnasapa'i bde ba dang / /mtshan nyid nor pa med shes pa/ tanas rab stobs las skyes pas na/ tags rab dbang du brjod pa yin / / de nas de'i rjes la ni/ /de'i mtshan nyid ci 'dra ba/ /nam zhig shes par ma gyur pa/ /lkugs masabade —1042—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ba myong ba'i tshul/ /dran med dran pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /ye shes dbang du brjod pa yin/ /de bas dbang rnams rdzogs pa dang / /rgyal rigs pa la bkod pa dag /spyi bo nas ni dbang bskur bzhin/ /dus der thams cad rigs kyi bu/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan stobs rnams chub pa yin/ dbang gi man ngag tu dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo cwa ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan 95 phab pa'// //nga4 lta ba'i lung /༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ dṛ sha tra ā ga ma/ bod skad du/ lta ba'i lung/ rje bcun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo//'di ltar chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gzhal bya ni/ chos nyid skyon med pa kho na yin par khong du chud par bya ste / de nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgrib pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin yin par shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes gang yin de bzhin gshegs/ zhes gsungs pa'i chos thams cad/ rnam par rigs cam du khong du chud pa yin la / dharma kirti'i zhal snga nas kyis/ tshad mar gyur pas 'gro ba la/ /phan par mdzad pa nyid yin te/ zhes pa'i rigs pa 'dis na/ ye shes de nyid tshad ma'i skyes bur yang gsungs pa yin no/ /shan ti pa'i zhal snga nas/gnyis su bdag nyid thams cad med/ /gnyis su snang ba'i bdag nyid yod/ zhes pa'i rigs pas chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i rnam par shes pa shel sgong dag pa lta bu la mtshan nyid spros pa ma lus pa nye bar zhi ba ste/byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang / chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/zhes gsungs pa'i don gyis na/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa sgrib pa med pa ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal bar grub pa yin no/ /klu grub kyi zhal snga nas kyis kyang / don de nyid gsal bar mdzad pa ste/ ma skyes chos kyi de nyid ni//ngo bo nyid kyis rig pa gsal/ zhes pa'i rigs pas so/ /ye shes snying po'i zhal snga nas kyi kyang / yod med dngos po mkhyen pa po/ /kun mkhyen pas kyang gang ma gzigs/ zhes gsungs pa dang / de kho na la dngos po yod pa bzhin yin na tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa/ rigs pa la ma gyur pa ste/ des na rnam par dben pa'i don yin pas bstan no/ /zhi ba 'tsho'i zhal snga nas kyang / yang dag don du spros pa yin/ /chos rnams kun ni de 'grol yin/zhes gsungs pa dang / 'dis ni don dam pa'i mtshan nyid spros pa'i chos las 'dasapar gsungs pa yin la/yang don 'di nyid gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ ka ma shi la'i zhal snga nas/ don dam par ma skyes pa'i phyir/ /— 1043—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/res 'ga' ba yod pa ma yin pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rigs pas/ 'di ni don dam pa la skye ba med pa'i rgyu las skyes pa'i 'bras bu res 'ga' ba yang med pa'i don can du bstan to/ /chos can gyi bdag nyid chos can chos kyi dbyings rnam par rig pa'i ngo bo nyid spros pa ma lus par zhi bas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ gnyug ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig gi mkhyen pa'i snang ba yin par nges par bzung ba yin no/ /de nyid kyis 'phags pa rnams kyi gshegs pa'i shul yang yin la/ shes bya chen po dngos po'i gnas lugs yin par shes par bya'o/ /lta ba'i lung du dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur ba'o// //ca5 zab pa'i rim pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ gam sgyi ma ra kra ma/ bod skad du/ zab pa'i rim pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis na/ khams gsum na ni rgyud drug dag /sdug bsngal mi bzad sna tshogs pa/ /myong zhing bskal pa'i bar du gnas/ /de 'dul ched du sangs rgyas kyis/ /thabs kyi thabs kyang rnam gsum nges/ /sems kyi ras yug dkar po la/ /kun rtog dri ma dag gis bsgos// de yang rlung la brten pas te / / rlung yang 'byung ba'i dbye ba can/ /de'i skye 'gag shes pa dang / /tshig nyung don du 'gril ba la/ /dgos pa tshang zhing gang zag gi /cha rkyen slong la the tshom med/ /de yang thabs kyi rnam gzhag gis/ /so so'i 'jug sgo ston pa yin/ /gti mug nad kyis ldongs pa la/ /gnyid dang bsre ba'i gdams pa sbyin/ /bying ba ye shes sbyor byed pa/ /'di ni thabs chen byang chub nyid/ /zhe sdang nad kyis gzer ba la/ khro dang bsre ba'i gdams pa spyin/ /gtum pa ye shes sbyor byed pa/ /'di ni thabs chen byang chub nyid// 'dod chags nad kyis myos pa la/ sred dang bsre ba'i gdams pa sbyin/ /zhen pa ye shes sbyor byed pa/ /'di ni smon chen byang chub nyid/ /byang chub lam ni mdor bsdus pa/ /gang du rnam rtog 'khor ba'i lam/ /ci la mi gnas 'khor ba'i lam/ /mnyam pa'i gzungs kyis zin pas na/ /dug nyid bdud rtsi sman du 'gyur/ /mtha' las 'das pa'i don go na// gang du lhung pa'i dgos pa med/ bde chen rang lus sus shes pa/ /de yis nyon mongs gnas 'gyur shes/ /rnam g.yeng dbang po sgo khog la/ /dbang po dam pa'i sgo 'di phye/ /zhen pa rang log ma gyur na/ /srid pa'i chu klung 'khyams par 'gyur / / mtshon pa dpe'i ye shes kyis/ /mdzes pa'i lus la rtogs par bya/ bde chen bag chags sad byed pas / / 'gro ba bzang 'di man ngag yin/ /gang la zhen pa yod pa thong / /bag chags dge ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur//—1044—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /bdag kyang dka' thub la 'chel bas/ /zab mo'i lugs las cung zhig gol/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga shes mod kyang / de nyid dbul na rtog ge yin/ /de bas 'bad de skyes bu rnams/ /bla ma dam pa bsten pa gces/ zab pa'i rim pa/ slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //cha6 spyod pa'i de kho na/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsarya tad twa/ bod skad du/ spyod pa'i de kho na/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo//bzod pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bsam gtan dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ /spyod pa kun tu 'di ltar bya//kun rdzob bden pa la brten nas/ /sbyin stsogs pha rol phyin pa lnga/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsod nams tshogs kyi don du spyad/ /don dam bden pa la brten nas/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med/ /smon pa med dang rang bzhin gyis/ /'od gsal dus gsum mnyam pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /yang dang yang du rgyud la klan/ /chos dang chos nyid nges bzung ba/ /tha dad dag tu mi lta zhing / / res 'jog bya ba ma yin no/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyang / /spang bar bya ba yod ma yin/ /chags par bya ba 'di yang min/ /zhe 'dzin mdud pa ma dgrol zhing / /rang gi nga rgyal zhi bar bya/ /chos la mi mthun mi bzung zhing / /gnyen po phyogs la re ba med/ /nyams pa rlom sems mi bya zhing / /kun tu rtog pa'i rjes mi 'brangs/ /'jig rten pa'i chos rnams la/ /ya mtshan dag tu mi bskyed cing / /sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan la/ /bdag blo 'dod pa'i gdung ba min/ /bla ma'i bka' rnams mi gcog cing / /dam tshig yan lag nyams mi bya/ /mi rtog dran pa'i blo yod kyang / /bsod nams tshogs kyi rgyun mi 'chad/ /ji snyed dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams / / stong nyid shes rab stobs kyis gzugs/ /shin tu nyon mongs me 'bar kyang / /snying rje'i chu bo rgyun mi gcad / / gang du rnam par g.yengs mod kyang / /rang 'dod lha dang bral mi bya/ /lus ngag yid kyi bkod pa kun/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i don du bsngo/ /ltas ngan sdig pa'i grogs po dag /nyams dga' ba'i gtam ster kyang / / dam pa rnams dang dben spyod phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa yis yal bar dor/ /sdug bsngal 'og ma rnams la ni / / chos kyi ston mo rgya chen bya/ /rang nyid bskyed nas rgan rgon la/ /byams pa'i chu bo rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyon mongs rgyu 'drul mang po la/ /las 'bras dran pas zhi bar bya/ /gnas lugs dang ni rtogs tshul dang / /rtag tu dbyer med mkha' ltar dag spyod pa'i de kho na/ slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā — 1045—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //ja7 mya ngan lasa'adasapa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sho nir ma na ya/ bod skad du/ mya ngan las 'dasapa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gtan mtha' las byung pa yi/ /ye shes de ni rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de yang kun rdzob don dam gyi / / dbye bas mkhyen pa rnam pa gnyis/ /ji snyed mkhyen pa rgya che ste/ /ji lta mkhyen pa zab mo nyid/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rgyu yis/ /mkhyen pa'i bye brag snang ba yin/ /thugasarje'i chu rgyun skad cig gis/ /'jig rten yul la dmigs pas na/ /dag pa'i ye shes kun khyab cing / /dri med shes rab rtog bral ba/ /gnas skabs kun du g.yo ba med/ /ye shes gnyis kyi dngos gzhi la/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i don can yin/ /de ni rten pa'i khyadapar la/ /brten 'gyur sku yang rnam pa gnyis/ /semasasku zhesapa dang posate/ /mtshan nyid med cing rtsis las 'das/ /sangs rgyas nyag cig spyod yul te/ /gzhan la gtan du yod ma yin/ /de yang phyogasagacig nyer mtshon na/ /rang rig rtog med ma 'khrul ba/ /phyogs dang bral ba rdo rje ltar/ /gnyen po med par gnas pa yin / / bdag med goms pa'i mthu yis ni/ /nges 'byung de la phyir mi ldog/ sangasargyas chosani ma 'dres pa/ /kun gyi ngo bo nyid du bzhugs/ /de'i dbye ba rnam gnyis te/ /chos dang ngo bo nyid du grags/ /yul dang yul can tshul gyis na/ /chos kyi sku yi dbye ba byas/ /gnyis pa gzugs kyi sku yin te/ /mtha' yas phyogs su med par gnas / / 'ja' tshon nor bu'i rnam pa bzhin/ /gdul bya tha dad yul la snang / /snying rje goms pa'i mthu yis ni/ /sprin bzhin blo bur 'byung ba yin/ /mtshan la dpe byad 'bru chags dang / /skal yod gzugs can snying po yin/ /de'i dbye ba rnam gnyis te/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul par nges/ /de'i dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / /gdul bya nyid kyis byas pa yin/ de ltar yang mdo las/ rnam rtog mi mnga' cir yang sa la mkhyen/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes par ldan/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la/ cir yang sa le mkhyen pa ni dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes so/ /gzhan mkha' zhes pa chos sku ni sems yin la/ gzugs sku mdzes zhes pa ni rigs pas gdul bya'i rnam pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du byon cing don spyod pa'o/ /mya ngan 'das pa ru dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ //—1046—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /nya8 longs spyod kyi rnal 'byor/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ bho ka yo gi ni/ bod skad du/ longs spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar gang zag longs spyod dag /mdor bsdus pa ni rnam gnyis te/ /btung ba dang ni bza' ba'o/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor yang ni gnyis/ /de la btung pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /'dod lha'i sbyor ba sngon 'gro bas/ /lce lkog byin gyis brlab pa dang / /zla ba la ni rdo rje bzhag /snod ni ka pā lar brlabs la/ /snying ka'i yi ge ha 'phros pas/ /ro stsogs tha mal rtog pa bsreg /hṝḥs ni dri med bdud rtsir gyur/ /lag g.yas mthe bong lam las ni/ /gser gyi sa gzhir byin brlab cing / /srin lag gsum las ri rab du/ /byin/ gyis brlabs pa'i bang rim la/ /yi ge mo gi 'od 'phros te/ /'og min gnas na bzhugs pa yi/ /mā ma gī la phog pa dang / / bum pa bzang po'i nang du ni/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun chen po 'bab/ /dam tshig chu dang 'dres pa dang / /ri rab chen pos dkrugs pa yis/ /bdud rtsi dri med dkar por 'gyur/ /'thung bas lus kyi lha mnyes shing / /srin bu'i sems can thams cad kyang / /de 'thung cam gyis lhar gyur nas/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed do/ /de la bza' ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ /'dod lha'i sbyor ba sngon bzhin du/ /yud tsam gsal bar byas pa dang / / lte ba'i lkog tu rlung bsams la/ /de'i steng du rang byung me/ /rlung las skyes pa sgom pa dang / /'dod lha'i dkyil 'khor snying kar gnas/ /'bar ba me'i dbyibs su bzhugs/ /lce ni hūm̐ las rdo rje 'bar/ /ya rkan paṃ las pad mar bsam/ /de gnyis thabs dang shes rab chul/ /'dir ltar kha ni dgang gzar la/ /lag pa blugs gzar nyid du nges/ /snod ni a las ka pā la/ /rdzas ni bdud rtsi'i sa bon gyis/ /sbyang zhing 'bar dang rtogs pa byas/ /ro mchog brgya ldan bcud du gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta sirnyi swāhā/ /gsang sngags rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /bza' ba bdud rtsi'i ri bo la/ /bdag gi phung po khams dang ni/ /skye mched lha tshogs mnyes pa dang / / lus kyi srin bu ji srid pa/ /dpal ldan zhing khams bzang por dmigs/ /khyi'u dang bu mo rab byung dang /khyim pa lta bu'i gzugs can la/ /theg pa chen po'i blo can gnas/ /bdag gis longs spyod dus de na// /thams cad tshim zhing rgyas par gyur/ /'di ni longs spyod rnal 'byor zhes/ /rje btsun tsin dha ma ṇi gsungs/ longs spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gnas la phab pa'o// //— /047—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ta9 khrusakyi cho gabyu/ /rgya gar skad du/ proka ṇa bi dhi/ bod skad du/ khrus kyi cho ga rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po sngags pas bya ba yi/ /sdig pa dri ma dag byed pa'i/ khrus kyi cho ga la brtson bya/ /rin pa che yi bum pa sa/chu gtsang srog chags med pa dang / /tsandan dri yis dgang bar bya/ /bdag nyid snying ka'i zla ba la/ /yi ge khaṃ gi 'phro 'du bas/ /bum nang nam mkha'i dbyings su sbyangs/ /slar yang snying ka'i sa bon las/ /padma bum nang bsgom bya zhing / /de nas padma'i lte ba la/ /zla ba rgyas pa la gnas pa'i/ /sna tshogs mdog can rgyu sgoms la/ /de'i 'od zer 'phro 'du yis/ /'khor lo 'od 'bar bsams nas ni/ /de nyid 'od zhu gong bu las/ /rig ma dang bcas snang mdzad gyur/ /de las gzhal med khang chen ni/ /sna tshogs rin chen rang bzhin can/ /de steng dbyangs dang gsal byed las/ /zla ba kha sbyar ga'u'i nang / /rang 'dod sa bon snying nas skyes/ /rnam par shes pa'i rten du sgoms/ /de las so so'i rang mtshan skyes/ /phyis ni 'dod pa'i lha nyid 'gyur/ /de nas de nyid 'dra ba yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug cing gzhug /de mchod nas ni sngags bzlas pas/ /bdag nyid kyi ni thugs ka yi/ /sa bon las ni 'od 'phros pas/ /bum nang 'dod lha'i thugs dam bskul/ /stong rtsa brgyad kyi grangs thems pas/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'od zhu ste/ /bum nang chur thim bdud rtsir gyur/ /de'i mdun du snying ka yi/ /sa bon las skyes paṃ yig las/ /padma 'dab ma lnga pa la/ kha dog dmar po 'od ldan sgoms/ /de steng bdag nyid rnam smin lus/ /thal sbyar gus pa'i sems kyis gnas/ /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams dag byed cing / / sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya/ /slar yang snying ka'i sa bon las/ /nam mkhar lha mo spyan drangs te/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa steg nas ni/ /spyi bo nyid nas brtsams nas ni/ /rnam dag khrus ni legs byas nas/ /bkris gar dang glu len cing / /gsang tshig 'di yis byin gyis brlabs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga pra wa ra sata ka ra pra dza sarba pā pa bi shodha a dhi tiṣṭha sa ma ya/ /de nas bdag gi lus nyid kyang / khel dkar lta bur dri med cing / /bdag gis 'gro ba gang mthong ba/ /kun kyang de dang 'drar gyur bsam/ khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon chen po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1048—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /tha10 gzhal yas khang sbyin pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra na khyad ni/ bod skad du/ gzhal yas khang sbyin pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / stong nyid sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ snying rje chen pos 'gro ba ma lus pa yul du byas la/ cho ga gsum las nges par byung ba'i 'dod pa'i lha ru rjes su dran pa dang / gnas gsum du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum la gnas pa'i yi ge'i rgyal po 'bru gsum gyis/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyang byin gyis brlabs pas / 'khor lo dang padma dang rdo rje'i nang du chud pa'i sku rdo rje la sogs pa dkar po dang dmar po sngon po'i rnam pa de dang de'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa sgom pas ni/ ji ltar me long bzhin gyis gang ba'i rnam par blta'o/ /de nas snying ka'i zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon las bla ma mchod gnas spyan drangs la/ bdun po rnam par dag pa dang / /tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan ldan pa'i blos/ /byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed la/ eo sarba dharma a kā sha bi sa ma ya su tu sa twa haṃ/ zhes pa'i don gyis chos thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sbyor bas gnas pa dang / ye baṃ le sum̐ gyi sa bon las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rtseg ma dang / zlo las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i lte ba la/ paṃ las padma'i mchod sdong bzang po 'dab ma stong gis brgyan pa dmigs pa la/ yang bdag gi snying ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshogs bsags pa'i yul rnams phab nas padma'i mchod sdong la bzhugs nga/ 'od dang gzi mdangs kyi rnam pa can mngon sum lta bur dmigs la/ srog chags spangs pa'i sa dang chu la dri zhim pos bsgos pa'i maṇḍal me long gi logs lta bu byas la/ baṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lngas byugs la bdud rtsi chen pos chag chag btab la/ me tog sna tshogs bkram pa dang / sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /io a ka ni ni ka zhe a sbyi la maṇḍa la swāhā/ oṃ badzra re khe hūm̐/ zhes pas bla ma la ni rin po che'i bye ma bdal bar mos pa dang / 'phags pa la ni rin po che'i gzhal med khang du dbul te/ de yang sil ma dang / tshom bu'i rnam par dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /'dir ni bla ma mchod pa'i maṇḍal du nges par bzung bar bya'o/ /de yang bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pa yi/ /maṇḍal rtag tu bya ba dang / /sdig pa thams cad mi byed pa/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa yis /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'khyams su/ /dal 'khyor phun sum tshogs par 'khru/ra/ zhes gsungs/ gzhal yas khang sbyin pa ru di paṃ gyis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ //— /049—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/da11 lha mchode pa'i rim pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ de pa pū dza grwa ma/ bod skad du/ lha mchod pa'i rim pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ 'dod lha'i thugs dam yongs su bskul ba ni mchod pa chen po yin te/ 'di ltar dang po'i rnal 'byor pas mkha' 'gro 'pho ba'i dus shes par byas la/ mchod pa'i yo byad phyi dang nang dang / gsang ba dang de kho na'i rim pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa tshul bzhin du byas la/ spros pa med pa'i don la lhag par mos pa'i blo sngon du song bas/rang gi 'dod pa'i lha cho ga ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' sgrub pa dang / ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer las yi ge saṃ chas pa las kun du bzang po yab yum du gyur nas/ de 'od du zhu ba las chos kyi 'byung gnas kha dog dkar ba zhabs phra ba kha yel ba dbyibs gru gsum gyi rnam par sgoms la/ de nas yang yi ge hrīḥchad pa las byung ba'i padma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa bskyed pa'i ze'u 'bru la nyi ma'am zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bskyed la/ de'i steng du yi ge eo las rtag pa yab yum du gyur pa dang / de 'od du zhu bas gzhal med khang rgyu rin po che las grub pa/ rgya phyogs su ma chad pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba mthong ba tsam gyis nyams dga' ba chen po bskyed pa sgoms la/ rang lus ji ltar mos pa'i lha'i tshogs kyis rnams par sprul nas gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khod pas dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa dang / bdag gi rnam par smin pa'i lus logs su chad pa las/ de'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo mang po spros pa yis/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pa dang / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bla ma dang bcas pa mnyes nas/ sems can gyi tshogs thams cad la chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po byin pas/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed nas/ sdom pa gsum la gnas shing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sne snod kyi lam phyag rgya bzhi rgyud la bskyed nas/kun gzhi rnam par shes pa sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po rtogs pa dang bral ba'i ro mchog gtor nas/rang gi nyams la dga' ba chen po bskyed nas bstod pa mnyam nyid mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o / / de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs kyis rang gi lus la dbang bskur ba dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rdo rje'i glu ru gyur pa brjod pa nas/ bdag gi re ba ji lta ba bzhin dngos grub kyi rjes su gnang ba dang / zhing khams ji lta ba ru dbang 'byor lung ston pa'i nges pa yang ston par 'gyur ro/ /lha mchod pa'i rim pa/slob dpon chen po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa/—dio~X kṇi lo tsa ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur

sngags phyegs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //na12 tshogab(kyi mchod pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa pu dza/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi mchod nga// rje bcun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar dbang bskur ba lugs bzhin du thob pa'i yon tan dag gis/ ri dben pa la sogs pa skye bo'i tshogs dang bral ba'i gnas su/ sa'i bdag po la gtor ma byin la/ yo byad rnams ma smas pa phun sum tshogs par byas pa dang / stegs bu phyogs ma 'a(gral ba bzang po la/ 'go rme/ yengs la sogs pa lugs bzhin du byas pa dang / e waṃ gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bris la/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la shes rab mtshan dang ldan pa phul te/ gsol ba gdab pa dang mgron du 'os pa'i rnal 'byor pa nyams kyi bstan chos dang ldan pa rnams spyan drangs la/ mdun du maṇḍal dbul zhing dgongs pa bskul lo/ /de nas rdo rje bla ma la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi yid dam la brtan par bzhugs pa dang / las kyi sems pa bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gar byas zhing / shes rab yum gyis dga' ba'i dbyangs kyi glu blang zhing sems can gyi don la bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas bza' ba btung ba'i phud ka pā la'i nang du spros la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlab pa dang / bla ma brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa dang / de'i rjes la dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bsngo ste/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams rol pa ni/ dang po bla ma la shes rab mas sbyin pa dang / de nas shes rab ma la bla mas sbyin pa dang / de nas shes rab mas las kyi sems pa la sbyin pa dang / de nas las kyi sems padra/ rnal 'byor pa rgan po 'a/ sbyin pa dang / rgan po nas kyang rim pa bzhin du rnal 'byor pa'i gral gyi mthar thug pa la sbyin par bya'o/ /de ltar bza' ba dang btung ba 'grims pas ni/ rigs la mngon par 'chel ba'i rnam nga ra rtog pa 'jil ba yin no/ /de la sbyin len gyi tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rtogs shig dga' ba yi ni chos/ /'di la rnam rtog yod ma yin/ /khyi dang bram ze rdol ba gsum/ /rang bzhin cig pas lhan cig bza'/ zhes pa dang / yang bde gshegs chos la sdig med cing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chags pa la sogs skyon dang bral/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas 'dod pa'i yon tan la longs spyod par bya ba'i phyir / yang yum thabs dang shes rab kyi gar bsgyur cing / 'dus pa rnams kyis kyang rdo rje'i glu dang / gar la sogs pa brjod par bya 'ing ji ltar dga' bar rol bar bya'o/ /de nas 'tshogs pa rnams kyis kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i smon lam lastsogs pa ji ltar mos pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol gtor ma btang zhing slar — 1051 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/log pa dang / tshe bstim zhing / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod par bya'o/ /tshogs kyi mchod pa/ slon dpon dī paṃ ka ra dang / lo tsā ba gyi jo ban des bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //pa13 dkyil 'khor gyi cho gabyu/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṇḍa la bi dhi/ bod skad du/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma byin gyis rlob par 'dod na/ dang po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i nga rgyal byas la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍali ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar byas la/ bdag med pa'i don la mos pa'i rjes la/ sems nyid snying rje chen po rjes su dran pa dang / snying ka'i sa bon las bla dang sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la blos mngon sum lta bu dmigs la tshogs bcu rnam par dag pa dang / bdag gi sdig pa bral zhing /ye shes sems dpa' phab pa dang / gzhan gyi ngan song ba bkug nas sbyang ba byas nas/ sems dpa' gsum lus la sgrub pa dang / mnyam pa gsum gyi ro myong bar byas la/ 'byung ba rim par brtsegs pa'i steng du/ gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sgoms la/ dbang blangs la sgom zhing bzlas pa bya zhing mtshan ma mthong ba dang / sa phyogs nyams dga' bar song la/ sa gzhi sbyang ba dang / sa gzhi bsang ba dang / sa gzhi brtag pa dang / sa gzhi bzung ba dang / sa byin gyis brlab pa dang / sa gzhi bsrung ba dang / lha sta gon la gnas pa dang / bum pa sta gon la gnas pa dang / slob ma sta gon la gnas pa dang / thig bri ba dang / bgegadra'ibasal ba dang / tshon dgye ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad bsags pa'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang / ye shes dbab pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'jug pa dang / chu dang dbu rgyan dang / rdo rje dang dril bu dang ming dang /brtul zhugs dang / de kho na nyid bstan pa dang / gzengs bstod pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / dbugs dbyung ba dang / dam tshig sbyin pa dang / sngags dang phyag rgya sbyin pa dang / lha gshegs su gsol ba'i mthar thug byas la / phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa dang / smon lam gdab pa dang / rjes gcod kyi sbyin bsreg bya ba dang /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang / sman ma chu bo chen por dor ba ni/ cho ga bsdus par shes par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ru di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ /bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1052—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ / ba14 rab tu gnas pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ a dhiṣā na/ bod skad du/ rab tu gnas pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid bcu shes slob dpon gyis/ /gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /sku gzugs mchod rten gsung rab dag /rab tu gnas par bya ba ste/ /cho ga nyams pa yong mi bya/ /yongs su brtag pa'i gnas chen du/ /gdugs dang ba dan la sogs sgrengs/ /me tog la sogs mchod pa dgod/ /slon dpon la ni gsol ba gdab// des kyang cho ga ji bzhin du/ /'dod lha'i dkyil 'khor nye bar bya/ /sa gzhi yongs su bzung ba dang / /sta gon la yang gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bris nas ni/ /bsgrub la bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ de nas sku gzugs kyi rab gnas ni/ mdun blangs dga' ldan tshig bshad brjod/ /bzhugs su gsol zhing mchod pa dang / /rgyab tu zhal bstan ras kyi g.yog /me dang chu'i nang du ni/ /sngags bzlas nyungs kar brdeg par bya/ /eo sarba pā sa da ha na badzrī ya swāhā/ /de nas rnam pa'i mchog ldan gzugs/ /dgug gzhug byas la til mar byug /eo sarba ta thā ga ta bi sho dha ni swāhā/ /de nas gser dngul bdag gis ni/ /spyan dbye ba ni byas pa dang / /zhal zas gdab cing sngags 'di brjod/ /io cakṣu sa manta bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ /de nas sku gzugs byin rlob pa'i/ /gsang sngags rgyal po nges brjod bya/ /io su pra ti bisba a dhiṣā na ye swāhā/ de nas nag po dgug pa dang / /bka' bsgo ba yang bya ba yin/ /mchod rten rab gnas byed 'dod na/ /rdo rje snang mdzad sbyor ba yis/ /mchod rten gzhal yas khang du sgoms/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas dgug byas la/ /mchod rten nang du gzhug pa dang / /mchod pa'i yan lag kun gyis mchod/ /oṃ su pra ti ti a dhiṣṭha na badzra ya swāhā/ /glegs bam rab gnas byed 'dod na/ /rdo rje chos su bskyed byas la/ /de'i zhal gyi 'od zer nas/ /don dam skye med ston byed cing / /gang gis thos pa'i yul can kyang /
