/mi rtog ye shes skye gyur la/ /oṃ pra dzña shu ti ma ti ba dzi swāhā/ /'gro ba'i don la bskul ba dang / /sil snyan rol mos btanags su gsol/ /sku gzugs dbyangs kyi yan lag dag /bskal pa chen po'i bar gnas shing / / sa'am chu'am me'am ni/ /rlung gi rnam pa lta bur gnas/ /rab tu gnas pa ru di paṃ gyis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1053—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ma15 bdun tshigasakyi cho ga༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sī ma a thā bi dhi/ bod skad du/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pas gzhan shi ba la phan gdags par 'dod na/ shi ba'i bdun tshigs la cho ga 'di ltar bya ste/ dang po gshin rje dang dbral ba dang rnam shes gta' ru bzung ba dang / khrus bya ba dang / lhar bskyed pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / lam bstan pa'o/ /de la gshin rje dang dbral ba ni/ slob dpon bdag nyid yang dag pa'i mtha'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ yi ge yam̐ las gshin rje shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ 'od zer kun nas 'bar bar bskyed la/ kā la ru pa ya ma a ri badzra kro dha hūm̐/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' bkug la bstim te/ byin gyis brlab pa dang /yang thugs ka'i 'od zer las sangs rgyas grangs med pa thugs kyi zhal du zhugs pa las/ zhe sdang gdul ba'i khro bor gyur nas mdun na ro la 'khor ba'i gshin rje bsad nas dur khrod du byas pa dang / slar yi ge ya las lhar bskyed de/ dam la gdags par bya'o/ /de nas rnams par shes pa gta' ru bzung ba ni/ rus pa'am gos sam ming byang la ming rung bris la rten bca' ste/ nor dang drung po la sogs pa shes pa gang la chags kyang bris la bcang ngo / /de nas khrus bya ba ni/ bum pa sngon po mgul bcingasaldan pa la/ 'bras bu can gyi kha brgyan dang / snying po lastsogs pa bcug la byin gyis brlabs la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la sogs pa'i gdung ba'i dbyangs brjod cing / me long gi logs la bkru bar bya oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni bi sho dha ni sarba karma ā wa ra ḍa bi sho dha ni swāhā/ de'i stobs kyi nyon mongs pa dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa ma lus par dag par byas nas/ rnam par shes pa mar me lta bur gyur pa yin no/ /de nas lhar bskyed pa ni cho ga gsum gyis der bskyed min na nor bu dri ma med pa'i nga rgyal du mos pa dang / de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ snying ka'i sa bon las yang 'od 'phros pa las / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa spyan drangs la/ phyag na rdo rje thugs ka nas bton la bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo bton la gshin po'i ro la dbang bskur ba rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas lam bstan pa ni/gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /bdun tshigs kyi cho ga ru dī paṃ gyis mdzad pa/ lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o // //—1054—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /tsa16 sbyin sreg gi cho ga༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho ma bidhi / bod skad du/ sbyin bsreg gi cho ga rje bcun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo / / thog ma sngags pa dam tshig dang ldan pas chos bdag med par mos pa'i rjes la/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la lha'i rnal 'byor yud tsam byas la/ dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor khru gang gru bzhi ba la/ thab khung mtho gang pa padma'i dbyibs lta bu byas la/ zabs su sor drug pa la/ kha khyer la sor phyed dang gnyis pa/ nang chag gang pa'i tshad do/ /de nas 'o ma can gyi shing la sor lnga pa'i yam shing byas la/rtsub shing las byung ba'i me spar la/ yi ge ram̐ dkar po las me lha drang srong gi rnam pa lta bu la bgrang phreng gi do shal byas pa/ dbyug pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ra skyes kham pa la bzhon pa sgoms la/ bdag gi snying nad nas yi ge hūm̐ las 'od lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu spros pas rang bzhin gyi me lha bkug te/ las kyi me lha la bstim la/ mchod yon phul la bsreg lugs bdun byin te/ bdag gi sdig pa'i ming nas chug la snying ka nas nag po spre'u'i rnam pa lta bu la bya zhing me lha'i kha gdangs par bsreg par bya'o/ /bsreg pa 'i rdzas ni til dang / can dan dang / gu gul rnams la gsang sngags 'di bzlas shing bsreg go /eo badzra a na la sarba bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba pā pa shan ting ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing bsreg rdzas byin pa'i rjes la dgang lugs sbyin no/ /de nas rdzas rnams la bsang gtor byas pa la me lha'i snying kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ñtsā las gzhas yas khang sgoms la/ de'i nang du cho ga gsum gyis 'dod pa'i lha bskyed la bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis 'og min gyi gnas nas de'i rnam pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bstim pa dang / bdag kyang mar me chad pa'i tshul du me lha'i lte bar bskyed pa'i lha la zhugs pa dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab pa/ de la bsreg blugs dang dgang blugs sbyin par bya ste/ de yang rang gi ming dang zhi ba'i tshig gi bar du sngags 'di bcug la bzlas so/ /oṃ dza ga ti ad mo sarba pā pa da ha na pra mo sha tra ya shan ting ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod cing bdag gi snying ka nas/ sdig pa'i gzugs gnas par bya zhing bsregs pas/ bdag gi byang chub kyi sems dri ma med pa zla ba rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bur gyur pa de yang rnam par rtog pa med cing / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba bde ba chen/ po chos kyi sku lhun gyis grub par bzhugs so/ /sbyin bsreg gi cho ga slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas ma/dzad pa/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi jo ban de zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1055—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/tshanya7 ro sreg gi cho ga༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ mu la lo le la/ bod skad du/ ro bsreg pa'i cho ga rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo / / 'jig tshogs phung po rgyun gcad phyir/ /ro bsreg cho ga brtsams par bya/ /thal sbyar ro'i snying ka sa /'dod lha gang yin snying po dang / /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i/ /snying po spyi bo'i gtsug tu gdags/ /gnasagatsang ma'i khri stegs na/ kha ni nub tu bstan la bzhag /maṇḍal bcas pa'i steng du ni/ /shi dang mthun pa'i mchod pa dgram/ /lan chags gtor ma gtang nas ni/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs dam bskul/ /nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang / /de nas sa chog byas nas ni/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /rtsa ba'i lha rnams tshangs pa dang / /'jig rten gtso bo bran du dgod/ /dbus su thab khung bris pa dang / /yam shing sbyin bsreg byin rlobs la/ /shing ni thab kyi nang du gzugs/ /ro la sngags kyis btab nas ni/ /tsan dan dri yis gdug pa dang / /gos dang rgyan gyis mdzes pa las/ /snying ka spyi bo lkog ma mā /sarba bid kyis byin gyis brlab/ /lus gzhan dag la sngags gzhan dgod/ /de nas ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir / / rten du bcas te dbus su bzhag /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs la/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /lha rnams rang rang sngags kyi su/ /bsreg blugs nyi shu rtsa re bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag na ni/ /phyag na padma zhags pa bsnams/ /zhabs kyi padmas sdig gnan cing / /rgyan rnams kun ni rab rdzogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan 'thob/ /bsam mam yang na bris kyang rung / /dang po'i snying po de bzhin du/ /brgya phrag gam ni stong phrag gi /sbyin bsreg ji ltar nus tshad bya/ /sbyin bsreg yon tan nges brjod pa/ /shi ba'i ming nas phyung nas ni/ /mkhas pas sbyin bsreg rab 'bad na/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yang / /sdug bsngal las grol the tshom med/ /gang zhig ro ni med pa la/ /bzlas shing bsgoms pa'i tshul las ni/ /cung zad nus pa rnyed pa dang / /dkyil 'khor 'tsham pa bris nas ni/ /mchod rten phreng ba bya ba'am/ /yang na sku gzugs byas kyang rung / / sbyin bsreg mngon par dbang bskur na/ /gdon mi za bar grol ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pas nges par gsungs/ /sdig can le lor gyur pa la/ /tshe 'dir bde ba ma mthong mod/ /rdo rje bla ma stobs ldan gyis/ /bsreg blugs rim par thob pa na/ /bar ma do la byang chub 'gyur/ ro bsreg pa'i cho ga ru dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa/lo tsā ba gyi jos bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1056—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /tha8 ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi legabyu/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa mā dhi sa ma pa ri pa ta/ bod skad du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi lelu 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po snying rje'i stobs las byung / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems brtan bya/ /srid pa'i longs spyod bde ma chags/ /yongs su 'dzin la rgyab kyi phyogs/ dad sogs nad ni phun sum tshogs//bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam gus/ /de bstan dam tshig ldan pa ni/ /yongs su skyongs la rab tu brtson/ /bum pa gsang ba'i dbang skur ba/ /bla ma'i drin gyis yongs su thob/ /lus ngag sems ni rnam dag pa/ /sgrub pa po de dngos grub snod/ /ting 'dzin yan lag las byung ba'i/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar gsang sngags chul gnas yin/ /ting 'dzin yan lag nyams gyur zhing / /de'i mi mthun phyogs gnas na/ /skye ba bye ba stong gis kyang / /ting 'dzin rab tu 'grub mi 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rab grub phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod na rnal 'byor dang / /de las gzhan pa'i sems spangs te/ /g.yeng med brtson pas 'bad par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dang / /mi mthun phyogs gang spang bya'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin yan lag mi mthun phyogs/ /de ni mdor bsdus nas bshad bya/ /chul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang / /bzod ldan dam bca' brtan pa dang / /skye bo'i 'du 'dzi rnam par spongs/ /lus dang ngag yid las rnams la/ /shes bzhin dang ni ldan pa dang / /sangs rgyas skur rtogs dran pa yi/ /lus kyi rjes dran yang dag ldan/ /dus gang du ni gang bya ba'i/ /rjes dran de dag brtan pa dang / /sgrib pa lnga ni spang ba dang / /zas kyi tshod rig spyod lam ran/ /'jig rten chos ni thams cad la/ /rtag tu sems ni btang snyoms dang / /yo byad snyungs 'di yan lag ste/ /go bzlog pa ni mi mthun phyogs/ /ting 'dzin tshogs kyi le'u bkod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro bas ting 'dzin rdo rje lta bu thob par shog ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba dge glong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //— 1057—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/wa19 sku dang gsung dang thugasarab tu gnasapa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya bag tsitta pra gwan sha ne na tiṣṭha nā ma/ bod skad du/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs rten bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal rten gsum la / / rgyud dang bla ma'i gsung brten nas/ /sgrib sbyong rab gnas bri bar bya/ /slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing / / mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes/ /las rnams kun la mkhas pa ste / / dam sdom byang chub sems 'byongs pas/ /bsnyen pa rnam gsum rdzogs byas la/ /de dang 'dra ba'i grogs bcas kyis/ /dus zla gza' skar tshes grangs ni/ /nyi ma'i khyim ni bcu gnyis te/ /dgun dpyid ra 'bring ro hi ta'i / / dus su dpyid ma log nas ni/ /byang 'gro zla drug nyin mo 'phel/ /de drug zhi ba rab gnas shing / /dbyar ston ra 'bring zla drug lhor/ /nag 'phel drag nyid der mi brtsam/ /phur bu lag dang pa ba sangs/ /zla ba bzang ldan gza' ste shis/ /nyi spen dmag dpon nor 'joms ngan/ /chu smad snar ma gro zhin dang / /lag dang snron sgrubs rgyal chu stod/ khrums smad skye dgu 'phel ba dang / /rab tu gnas pa'i mchog tu byed/ /yid 'dod dngos grub me bzhis ster/ /snubs dang gro bzhin de bzhin te/ /lag gisaskal bzang snar mas rgyal/ /mgo yis nye bar zhi bar byed/ /chu stod kyis ni bu dag gson/ khrums smad rtag par dngos grub ster/ /rgyal gyis tshe ring brtan par 'gyur/ /snron gyis mchog tu bde bar byed/ /lha mtshams kyis ni beechog ster 'gyur/ /gza' dang skar ma de dag kyang / /dar gud mi rigs las dang sbyar/ /tshes gcig gsum lnga drug bdun bcu/ /drug po nor 'joms yang gzhan shis/ /gza' skar tshes grangs mthun 'dzom na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang bya bar shis/ /gnam stong bcu bzhi kun tu spongs/ /zla ba gza' dang skar ma dang / /nyi ma du 'dzom skad cig la/ /ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byas na/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rab tu gnas pa mchog gyur te/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal dbang phyug ni/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /slob dpon mtshan ma thob pa na/ /gza' dang rgyu skar brtsi mi dgos/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'ang med/ /gza' rnams thams cad rjes mthun zhing / /bgegs dang rgyu skar lha rnams nyid/ /de drung bka' sgrub kun gnas shing / /gzugs brnyan mchod rten la sogs kyi/ /dngos grub dag ni ster bar mdzad/ /yid kyis cung zad gang bsam pa/ /skye dang skye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang thog mchod rten la sogs gnas/ khyim dang lha'i gnas rnams su/ /sangs rgyas —1058—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong rgo skor bzhugs so/ /la sogs rab gnas bya/ /brdung lugs 'bur bris stsogs rten ni/ /rang rang mtshan nyid ldan pa ste/ /zhi khro la sogs rang tshul mthun/ /tshad kyis tshad la phab cing bzang / /de/ 'dra rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /bzlog na skyon 'gyur de phyir gzab/ /rab gnas dgos dang mi dgos gnyis/ /dam pa'i don du dpyad pa na/ /gang zhig gang gis gang du brlab/ /gdod ma nas zhi skye med la/ /ji lta ji ltar rab tu gnas/ /chos rnams thams cad 'od gsal du/ /rtogs dang ldan pa'i mchod gnas la/ /rab tu gnas pa mi dgos ste/ /yang na stong nyid ma rtogs kyang / / mchod rten glegs bam sku gzugs sogs/ /sangs rgyas rnams 'phrul byin brlabs las/ /byung ba min na mi 'byung bar/ /rtogs te shin du dad ldan na/ /rab tu gnas la mi dgos so/ /dang po'i las can ma 'byongs la/ /'jig rten tha snyad kun rdzob tu/ /'gro bas de nyid mi shes la/ /ston pas rab tu gnas pa bshad / / dbye ba sgra don skyon yon las/ /bya ba'i thabs dang rnam pa drug /don dam spros med rab gnas dang //kun rdzob sku gsung thugs gsum ste/ /yon tan 'phrin las zhar byung dang / /dam tshig sems dpa' sbyangs bskyed la/ /ye shes sems dpa' yun ring du/ /gnas pa'i phyir na rab gnas bya/ /gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la/ /byin ma brlab bar ring gnas na/ /de la bkra mi shis 'gyur zhing / /de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /dper na skyes bu la la shig /rigs pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /de bzhin byin ma brlab sku la/ /gang zhig phyag 'tshal mchod byed pa/ /dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman te/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mchungs/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ /skyes bo chul khrims 'chal 'di la/ /bde 'gro mtho ris yod min la/ /bde ba mchog tu'ang mi 'gyur na/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngags rnams ni//'grub par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /ta la'i mgo bcad sngo min ltar/ /de bzhin sngags sgrub rmongs pa dang //chul khrims nyams shing sdig las byed/ /rtag tu bud med chags pa la/ /'di ni rab tu bstan ma yin/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen bsten pas ni/ /sngags kyi rgyal po ga la 'grub/ /yon tan yang ni rtsa rgyud las/ /'jig rten sngags rnams ji snyed dang / /de slob bse ru byang chub sems/ /bdag nyid chen pos gsungs pa yi/ /cho ga gzhung dang mthun par ni/ /rab tu gnas pa byas nas kyang / /ri mo 'di ni mdun bzhag na/ /sngags rnams ma ru sa 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin mchod dang phyag 'tshal dang / /mthong dang reg pa tsam gyis kyang / /sdig pa'i rnyeg pa kun las grol/ /ras ris la sogs mthu chen la/ /don du gnyer dang bskul bas ni/ /myur du skye ba don yod 'thob/ /rjes su yid rang de bzhin no/ /rten 'di mthong ba'i skye bo yi/ /bsod nams thob pa don yod pa//bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang / /brjod par yang ni mi nus so/ /las ni yon bdag bsod nams spel/ /— 1059—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji be'i gsung chos kyi skor/sngags pas dge ba rnyed par byed/ /de bzhin slon dpon sngags gnas pas/ /chos ldan mchod pa byed pa gang //de yis skye bar mchod par 'gyur/ /bya thabs cho ga dag par bya/ /mchog dman rab gnas bkra mi shis/ /'dir sdug pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /dngos grub 'dod pas cho gar 'bad/ /cho ga'i tshul legs bsod nams ni/ /mthong dang mi mthong rnams su skye/ /sku gzugs sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /rten la byin brlabs 'jug par 'gyur/ /gang zag blo rigs tha dad pas/ /yon mchod 'byor chog tshogs pa yis/ /rab gnas rgyas pa spros bcas bya/ /'bring pos cho ga tshang tsam dang / /bsdus pa ting 'dzin thun cig la/ /rdul tshon la sogs mi dgos bya/ /rgyas pa mtshan ldan bla ma la/ / slob mas lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /bka' bsgo slob mas rdzas gsog ste/ /yid 'ong gnas su bsnyen gsum bskyal/ /sa'i cho ga gzhung bzhin bya/ /lha bum sbyin bsreg pa yi lha/ /sta gon spyi dang mthun par bya/ / 'di skabs slob ma sta gon ni/ /gang byed gzhung dang mthun gnas yin/ /de yang sngags grogs slob dpon 'dra/ /yon bdag sta gon gnas pa ni/ /rgyas pa bkra shis cho ga 'di / / brtsams nas yongs su rdzogs kyi bar/ /yon mchod la sogs mi rnams kun/ /lus ngag yid spyod bzang ltas bya/ /na ba'i phyogs kun thag ring spongs/ /bzang ngan gang byung mi rabs bdun/ /'byung bas ngan na 'bar stsogs bzlog /nang par dkyil 'khor rdzas tshang bshams/ /shar lhor rab gnas dbang stegs ni/ /dpangs khru rgya ni rten dang sbyar/ /ba yis lngas byugs pad 'khor ser/ /nyi nub dpon slob khrus byas brgyan/ /bgegs bskrad chad lhag bskang byas te/ /bum pa'i bsnyen sgrub ltar bya/ /de yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo nas/ /mchod bstod bsgom bzlas bar du ni/ /mtshan ma byung gi bar du bya/ /de rjes rang 'jug dbang yang blang / /de rjes snyan gsan gsol ba gdab/ /phyir phyin gtor ma rgya chen btang / /bgegs la bka' bsgo bden bdar bya / / nang zhugs nye reg mthor 'thung byas/ /sngon du yon bdag dbang rgyas bskur/ /de nas rab gnas sta gon te / / rten gsar rnams ni der drangs la/ /dkyil 'khor mkhar bteg bdag khror bsgyur/ /bgegs la bka' bsgo stang stabs bya/ khro bo'i bstod bzlas ra dra sogs/ /bsrung 'khor rgyas par bsgom par bya/ /gong nas rten gsar bzhugs pa na/ /na bza' car g.yogs zhal phyir bstan/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas sta gon te/ /ma bris rab gnas dbang nus med/ /slob dpon brtan ma thob dus med/ /dkyil 'khor bris chog dgos med 'gyur//des na rgyud dang bla ma ni/ /dam pa'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag dgos/ /sta gon bgegs ni bskrad pa'i gnad/ /dngos gzhi byin brlabs sbar ba'i gnad/ /rjes ni bstan pa dar rgyas gsum/ /sta gon nub mo phyag rgya dgrol// kekyil 'khor shar sogs ku sha'i steng / /seng ge'i nyal stabs chod nyid nyal/ /skya rengs shar dus chos nyid — 1060—

sngags phyegs blo sbyong gi sker bzhugs so/ /las / / langs te khrus byas brgyan lhar bskyed/ /rten gsar tha mal dri sbyang phyir/ /shing bu gru gsum me sbar la/kham phor steng du bag zan gyi/ /kong bu gsum la mar me sbar/ /'bras kyi chang bu gsum la ni/ /rdo rje gcug tor gnod byin gyis/ /sku la phyi bkru lan gsum bya/ /'bras med bag phyes bya bar 'os/ /sngags gnyis zlos shing yungs dkar brab/ /mi gtsang dor bsams slang bar blug /de rjes chu mes de ltar bya/ /yang na g.yem steng chu me dang / /zho zan bsres dang yungs dkar la/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badrwa ya swāhā/ /zhes bzlas mer bsregs bzhi mdor dor/ /'dag chal sug pa nye shing ba/ khu ti sran phyed ba'i lnga/ /til mar gyis ni sngags bcas bkru / / bag chags sbyang phyir chu brgyad khrus/ /rdul yab me long bstan byas te/ /chab gcang chu gcang sman chab dang / / spu chab 'o ma 'bru sna lnga/ /rin chen mchod yon khrus byas la/ /shing bal ras kyis sku phyis la/ /dbang stegs steng du bzhugs gsol la/ /mar dang dri lnga ga bur dang / /candan dza ti gur gum dang / /gla rtsis byugs te stong bar sbyongs/ /stong pa'i sngags gsum rim bzhin brjod/ /de nas lha bskyed dngos de'am/ /dkyil 'khor gang bris yi dam lha/ /gtso 'khor bcas pa'am gtso rkyang ni/ /mngon par byang chub lngas bskyed la/ /rab gnas dbang bskur mnga' gsol gsum/ /rab gnas ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /spyan drangs chos brgyad snyan gsan dbab / / spyan drangs bzhugs gsol khrus mchod yon/ /phyag 'tshal gsum bsres sku gsung thugs/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar du bya/ /de la mchod nga/'i rim pa ni/ /rin chen maṇḍal thun mong lnga/ /rgyan dang gzhal yas gdugs rgyal mtshan/ /ba dan 'phan dang bla re dang / /me tog phreng ba rol mos bskor/ /na bza' nam mkha' mdzod zhal zas/ /gling gzhi'i maṇḍal dbul bar bya/ /rang dang sngags dang rten 'brel gyi/ /snying po brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /de nas rdo rje'i sems dpa' yi/ /yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas pas brtan par byed pa yin / / de dag spyi yi rab gnas te/ khyad par sku gsung thugs rnams la/ /rang rang cho ga gzhung bsrang la/ /mchod rten la sogs thugs rten la/ khyad par chos bzhi byin gyis brlabs/ /rdo ring them skas chu srin gyi/ /rgyal mtshan la sogs dbul ba'o/ /byin brlabs sa gzhi chos kyi dbyings/ /seng khri mi 'jigs bzhir byin brlab / / rmang ni dge bcu khri 'phang ni/ /dang po dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /gnyis pa yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /gsum pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /bzhi pa snang ba'i dbang po lnga/ /bum rten stobs lngar byin gyis brlabs/ /bum pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ kha khyer 'phag lam yan lag brgyad/ /de dag rgyu chos byin brlab ste/ /'bras bu'i chos su 'di ltar rlabs/ /srog shing mkhyen bcu bre logs ni/ /ye shes bzhi dang rnam thar bzhi/ /'khor lo bcu gsum sa bcu dang / /dran pa nyer bzhag gsum du rlabs/ /char khebs gdugs ni thugs rje'i skyabs/ /— 106/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sgor/tog ni chos dbyings ngo bo nyid sku/ /phyi ni sku gsum nang gzhal yas/ /rdo ring rin chen them skas dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan dar dpyangs dang / /rin chen phreng ba nyi zla dbul/ /gdan mtho dbul ba rgyas pa yin//mchod rten kun bsdus rab gnas bya/ /rang rang rab gnas legs par bya/ /sku gzugs khyad par chos brgyad de / / spyan dbye dbu skra sprul sku'i bzhar/ /longs sku'i dung gi so mangs bshad/ /shangs dbye spru btog tshems rtsa bru / / ljags bzhar snyan sbabs bru zhing bsal/ / nam bza' sprul pa'i sku la ni/ /smad gsum chu tshags par 'khar bsil/ longs sku zhi la dar gyi ste/ khro bo stag lpags dar sngon gyi/ /stod g.yogs rgyan ni sprul thod sogs / / sprul sku rgyan med longs zhi la/ /bris bkod 'bul bsams cho gas 'bul/ dngos su 'bul du yod na rab/ /gsung rab zhal bsre'i khyad par dgu /don gsungs skye 'gag med par brlab/ /tshig gsung yig 'bru gsung rab ni/ /yan lag tshad med bzhi cur brlab/ khri dbul glegs shing glegs thag dbul/ /na bza' zhal khab rgya rim bdun/ /pha rol phyin pa yum chen mo/ /mdo sde 'dul ba byang chub che/ /rgyud sde rdo rje chos sogs te/ /cho ga yi dam lha sogs pa/ /ngo shes bye brag mi shes ci/ /yang na bden gnyis yi ger bsam/ /dri lnga yis ni de nas byug /sa bon lnga'i gtor bya'i don/ /skye med rtogs pa gsal ba yis/ /chos sku la ni chos sku thim/ /gnyis su med bsam me tog dbul/ thugs kyi mchod pa dri yis byug /de nas spyir ni dbang bcu gcig /bum pa dbu rgyan cod pan dang / /phyag rgya ming dbang las bzhi'i dbang / /chos kyi rgyal po gsang ba'i dbang / / thabs shes gdugs dang phreng dbang bskur/ /rjes la mnga' gsol rten kun la/ rdzas brgyad sna bdun dbul ba dang / /bkris byin cher gsol ba ni/ /'brang rgyas la sogs bkris rdzas/ /mang la 'jig rten dge ba dang / /mdzad pa bcu gnyis dkon mchog gsum/ /rigs lnga la sogs mang po ni/ /brlag dang gyes pas zhal bsro bya/ /gong du cod pan dbang bskur ram/ /yang na sngags 'dis bcing byas te/ /oṃ hūṃ e dzi khaṃ/sku'i gsum 'gyur khri la ni/ /mdun du ma nub mi yor bzhugs/ /de ltar ma byas skyon mang 'byung / /de nasaslob dpon yon bdag gnyis/ /me tog gtor te gdan khri nas/ /gzungs la bzhugs par lan gsum gsol/ /de nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sogs/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ /de yi yon tan la dad pas/ /me tog sposadang de bzhin dri/ /mar me lha bshos na bza' sogs/ /sngags ldan rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ de nas yon bdag mdun bzhag la/ /me tog dri yis mnga' gsol ba/ /rten 'brel snying po zlos bzhin du/ /lha la 'bu la ba bzhin byas la/ /gzengs bstod mchod pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/ /gsang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das / / phyag na rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ gtor ma phul la gsol ba gdab/ /spyi'i chos skyong phyogs skyong bcu/ /—1062—

sngags phyorgas blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /rnam sras mgon po gzhi bdag la/ /gtor sbyin 'phrin las bka' bsgo bya/ /phyi rjes bzo bo grogs byed sogs / / 'di skad brjod do mchod par bya/ /kye gson dga' ba 'di nyid du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i mchod pa rnams / / bdag la mthun pa'i nus pa med/ /de phyir khyed ni bzod par gsol/ /de nas gang dag brtul zhugs can/ /dge slong dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma/ mchog tu gus pas mchod byas la/ /ji ltar 'os pa'i yon yang dbul/ /rab tu byung ba'i gnas brtan dang / khyim pa'i gtso bo la sogs la/ /gnyer gtad bka' bsgo 'di skad brjod/ /snyigs ma lnga'i dus 'di yi/ /mchog gi sku dang mnyam pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sku ni 'di yin gyi/khyed kyis ma nyams srungs mchod gyis/ /sngags kyi bza' bcas yon bdag la/ /skabs 'dir sbyin te 'di skad brjod / / sngags kyi gcang sbra'i bza' bca' dag /gzugs brnyan bdag po khyod la sbyin/ /bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zos na sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /gal te lha nyid dge 'dod na/ /bla ma gus pas dgyes bya zhing / /de ltar rnam pa tham cad du/ /bla ma yang dag mnyes bya ste/ /yon gyi dam pa dbul ba ni/ /rta dang glang po shing rta nor/ /longs spyod yo byad dbul 'di brjod/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes pa yis/ /las dang dngosagrub tham cad 'thob/ /de bas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par byed nga/ra shog /de nas mtshan mo gtang rag ste/ /gnyen dang rigs brgyud 'khor rnams kyis/ /bzang ba'i glu gar rol mo ster/ /dung la sogs pa'i rol mo dbul/ lho phyogs rgyas nga/'i thab byas la/ /'o ma can gyi bud shing brtsig /'bru dang mngar gsum mar 'o mas / / dang po mjug tu me lha mchod/ /bar du dkyil 'khor rab gnas lha/ /stong dang lnga brgya sogs sngags 'dis / / io badzra ā yu ṣe pusting ku ru ye swāhā/ /sdig zhi tshe dang/la rgyas pa ra 'phel/ /btang rag lhag chad bskang ba yi/ /mchod bstod bzod gsol skabs sbyar bya/ /rten gsar ye shes mi gshegs te/ /tsa ru'i ston mo rgyas pa bya / / dkyil 'khor lha gshegs dam tshig bsdu/ /rdul tshon a kar sngags bsdus te/ /chu sogs dor la ba lngas byug /de nas 'gro rnams dad bya'i phyir/ /shing rta khri sogs mtho bar bteg /mchod pa rol mo dad bcas pas/ /grong khyer rnams su bskor bar bya/ /spros mi dga' la bsdus pa ni/ /bsnyen pa sa chog sta gon dang / / dkyil 'khor bri sgrub rten gsar la/ /bgegs yi ge brgyas btab par bya/ /grong bzhin spyan dbye la sogs pas/ /nub gcig la ni kun rdzogs bya/ /mnga' gsol rgyas par ma grub kyang / /'di la nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i rab gnas ni/ /brtan pa thob pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /gza' skar tshes grangs mi brtsi ste/ /rdul tshon mi rten thun gcig la/ /dkyil 'khor bsgoms te brgya rtsa bsnyen/ /bgegs bskrad bkru sogs gong ltar bya/ /bskyed de spyan drangs sku gsung thugs/ /byin gyis brlab dang dbang bskur ba/ /snying ka'i — 1063—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /'og min rigs lnga'i thugs kha nas/ /bkris lha mo bum rol bcas/ /dbang bskur rigs bdag rgyas btab bsam/ /rten 'brel yig brgya brgya rtsa res/ /dri dang me tog gtor byugs te/ /rang rang lha la chos skur thim/ /bsams la de rjes mchod bstod bya/ /rjes sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ /lha khang rab gnas 'dir ma bshad/ /da ni phyag mtshan byin dbab ste/ /su bha'i sngags kyis stong ngang las/ /dkar rigs lha khang mched rten gnas/ khang khyim rghaṃ las 'khor rnams snang / /gsung rigs dmar dang po ti cong / /'gan de cha lang dril bu sogs/ /dzi las padma snang mtha' yas/ /nag sngo rdo rje phur phreng thugs/ /hūṃ rdo rje lasami bskyod bskyod/ /ser po bang mdzod yon tan rigs/ /e las rin chen rin 'byung bskyed/ /lasarigasaljang khu rgya gram gri/ khaṃ las ral gris don yod grub/ /chos skyong rnams la'ang rang rang gis/ /'jig rten 'bab la rigs gsum gyis/ /rigs kyi 'bab la rang rang lhas/ /ngo ma shes kun de 'dra re'am/ /rigs bstan gong gis shes par bya/ /srog chags gtso bo'i sprul sku bya/ /bsrung 'khor kun dga' rwa bkang ba/ gzhal yasakhang ngam a mo li/ /chu mig khron sogs mā ma gi /bza' shing rwa dang ldum rwa sogs/ lkeng gi lha mo 'od 'chang ma/ /phyugs lhas parṇa sha ba ri/ /'bru dang bang mdzod dzam bha la/ /yon bdag dkyil 'khor mthong na lha/ /ma mthong na ni sprul skus bya/ /bla ma'i sku 'gab thugs dam ste/ /mi shes rang gi yi dam lha/ /sngags la ma zhugs sprul pa'i sku/ /kun las dgug gzhug gong bzhin bya/ /'phrin las rgyas pa'i cho ga ste/ /rab gnas rim gsum 'khor bcas 'di/ /bdag gi rang bzor ma byas te/ /gtso cher klu sgrub lugs gtsor bzhag /rdo rje 'chang nas gnyis brgyud pa'i/ /lung dang 'dra ba'i nā ro dang / byang chub sems lasathob pa yi/ / sgeg pa rdo rje skal ldan mchog /de gsum snyan nas snyan brgyud pa'i/ /man ngag bla ma mnyes pas thob/ /rgyud dang bstan bcos legs brten nas/ rang nyid dran pa gso ba dang / /gzhan yang bdag 'dra gti mug la/ / phan phyir gzhan gyisabaskul nas bris/ /ma rtogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ /brtsams pa'i dge ba cung zad des/ /sems can bde chen sku thob shag sku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po di paṃ ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ges bi kra ma la shi lar bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //—/064—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ā ba da tid shan bi dhi bi dza hā ram̐//zha20 lhung ba bshags pa'i tāpyo ga bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā ba da tid shan bi dhi/ bod skad du/ lhung ba bshags pa'i cho ga /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ gang bdag gis byis pa nyid dang / mi shes pa nyid kyis 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna'i dbang gis lus ma bsgom pa dang / chul khrims ma bsgom pa dang / shes rab ma bsgoms pa dang / dran pa nyams pa nyid kyis/ gang lus dang ngag dang yid kyis dge slong dang rjes su mthun pa ma yin pa bgyis pa dang /bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba bdag gi de dag thams cad bzod par gsol gyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ khyod la ji ltar bzod par gsol ba de bzhin du mkhan po dang slob dpon dang lhan cig skyes pa dang / chos dang lta ba mthun pa dang / rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba dang / gcug lag khang dang brang khang na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha dang / lam dang nye ba'i lam na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha dang / bstan pa 'di la mngon par dga' ba'i lha dang / gzhan gyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha dang /pha dang ma dang gtong ba po dang / sbyin bdag dang / ji srid srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi sems can te/ 'phrog pa'i bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa dang / mnar med pa nas bzung ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i sems can 'gro ba lnga po nag po chen po la sogs pa rnams kyis/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sems can thams cad la gnod pa bgyis pa gang lags pa de chul khrims kyi phung po la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ bzod par gsol gyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum bzlas thabs yin no/ /legs so brjod/ nyes pa thun mong ba'o/ /bcun pa dgongs su gsol/bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ lhung ba ris lnga po las/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug rnams su/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslang ba dang / zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang ba dang / gti mug gis kun nas bslang ba dang / chad pas kun nas bslang ba dang / rkyen gyis kun nas bslangs pa dang / de'i tshan du gtogs pa dang / de'i sder gtogs pa dang / de'i ris su gtogs pa dang / de'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i ngo bo nyid dang / nang du btsos pa dang / nang du zhag lon pa dang / ched du byas pa dang /—1065—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/btang nas za ba dang / kha 'phror gcod pa dang / kha bkang nas za ba dang / lag nya ba dang /byin len ma byas pa dang / gsog 'jog pa dang /dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / mdor bsdus na phas pham pa'i chos bzhi dang des kun nas bslang ba'i lhung ba sbom po sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug gisabasdus pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum dang des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbom po sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug gis bsdus pa dang /spang ba'i lhung byed kyi chos sum cu dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug dang lhung byed kyi chos dgu cu dang des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug dang / so sor bshags pa'i chos bzhi dang / des kun nasabaslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang dngosagazhi dang mjug dang / bslab pa'i chos mang po dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug dang / rtsod pa nye bar zhi ba'i chos bdun dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug ste/ de dag dang gzhan yang gang sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa'i bslab pa dang / dge 'dun gyis bcasapa'i nang khrimasadral ba dang / 'goms pa dang gus par ma bgyis pa de dag thams cad bdag gis tshul khrims kyi phung po la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du btsun pa'i mdun du mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bsgrags so/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum brjod/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /mdor bsdusapa'i ngakhrinags pa'// //btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ rab tu byung ba'i dusanasanye bar bzung / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dus nas nye bar bzung nas/ tshad ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i lhung ba byung ba de dag mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis btsun pa'i mdun du 'thol bar bgyi'o/ /de yang 'di lta ste/ chos gos dang sham thabs zlum po ma yin par gyon pas kun nas bslang ba dang / rung ba ma byas pa dang rung ba ma yin pa'i 'tsher bas btsos pa dang / shin tu 'tsher bas btsos pa dang / rung ba ma yin pa'i chos gos longs spyod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / mchil lham rim pa mang po dang / ri mo can dang / sgrog pa dang dus ma yin par nye bar longs spyod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / lhung ba thams cad kyi rgyu dran par bya ba la dran pa brjed pas kun nas bslang ba dang / brel zhing yengs pa'i dus su phyag la sogs pa byas pa dang / bdag gir byas pas kun nas bslang ba dang / kun tu ma brtags par sa dang chu dang / lci ba la sogs pa longs spyad pas kun nas bslang ba dang / bshang ba dang lci ba'i 'chag sar chos gos legs par ma brtul bar zhugasapa dang / 'chag sa khung gi dkyil ma yin par zhugs pa dang / khrus dang gtsang sbras gus par ma byas pas kun nas bslang ba dang / tshad —1066—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /pas thung ba dang / lhag pa'i so shing dang gnas ma yin par dor ba dang / bkru ba dang sa la ma drud par dor bas kun nas bslang ba dang / se gol la sogs pa'i sgra ma byas par chu dang so shing dang mchil snabs dang /bong ba la sogs pa dor ba dang / gsung rab la sogs pa mi 'don par dkon mchog gsum gyi phyir nye bar byugs pa dang / sa gzhi byi dor byas pa 'goms shing brdzis pas kun nas bslang ba dang / dus byin gyis ma brlabs par mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang me la reg pa la sogs pas kun nas bslang ba dang / gsung rab brjod pa med srog shing dang mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang gtsug lag khang gi grib ma 'goms pas kun nas bslang ba dang / kun tu ma brtags par sa la sogs pa rtsom zhing sgrub pas kun nas bslang ba dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon dang gnas la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams la/ g.yog la sogs pa ma byas pas kun nas bslang ba dang / gtso blag dang bkru bshal dang khab kyi la sogs pa'i 'os pa'i chos gos dang lhung bzed kyi las bya bar 'os pa btang snyoms su 'jog pas kun nas bslang ba dang / lhung bzed dang chu tshags dang gding ba la sogs pa nye bar ma bcangs pas kun nas bslang ba dang / rjes su ma gnang ba'i 'khar ba la sogs pa'i snod spyad bcangs pas kun nas bslang ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa la sogs pa nye ba'i tshig gis stong bas tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi ming brjod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / de dag bya bar 'os pa rnams la phyag dang bsnyen bkur la sogs pa ma byas pas kun nas bslang ba dang / chags pa'i sems kyis chags pa'i yul la longs spyad pas kun nas bslang pa dang / 'dod pa dang gnod sems dang rnam par 'tshe ba'i rnam par rtog pa mngon du byed pas kun nas bslang ba dang / zas dang skom dang rgyal po dang / rkun po dang / skye bo'i tshogs dang / rgya mtsho dang 'jig rten pa la sogs pa'i gtam gyis kun nas bslang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' la mngon par brtson pa btang nas 'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos la brtson par kun nas bslang ba dang /shes bzhin gyi rdzun dang dge slong gi dbyen dang / /gtam gzhan dang gzhan du rlung la bskur ba dang / bdag nyid la bstod cing gzhan la smod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / dge 'dun gyi rdzas bla gab med par dor ba dang /rnyed pa bdag gir byed pa dang / rdzas rlag tu nye ba btang snyoms su 'jog pas kun nas bslang ba dang / chu dang rtswa sngon po dang bcas pa dang ma gnang ba'i sa phyogs su lud pa dang mchil ma dang phyi sa dang gcin dor ba dang /rkang pa dang lag pa la sogs pa bkru bas kun nas bslang ba dang rtswa gcod pa dang sa rko ba dang / dri ma dang ma ku ta dang shig bskyur bas kun nas bslang ba dang / gus par ma byas par lag pa dang lhung bzed bkrus pa dang /gzhan gyi stan la 'dug pa la sogs pas kun nas bslang ba dang / gus par ma byas par bsod snyoms — 1067—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la sogs pa blangs nas nye bar spyad pas kun nas bslang ba dang / rtogs pa mngon par sgrub pa la phan pa'i kha zas rnam par 'gegs pa'i bsam pas spyod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / dge slong gis btsos pa dang nang du zhag lon pa dang / lag nya dang chad pa dang / skyed kyis kun nas bslang ba dang / dge slong mas sbyor du bcug pa longs spyad pas kun nas bslang ba dang / kham shin tu chung ba dang / 'phros gcod pa dang / kha bkang bsasmra bas kun nas bslang ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i zas dang / kham ri lu byas nas kha'i nang du 'phen pa dang / dpyad bya ba'i bsam pas gzhan gyi stan la sogs pa la dpyad par bya ba la blta bas kun nas bslang ba dang / dad pas byin pa chud gzan pa dang /ji ltar bde bas sbyin rabs mi byed pas kun nas bslang ba dang /phyed zas dang 'dres pa dang / zas dang bcas pa'i chus longs spyod pas kun nas bslang ba dang / chu dang btung ba / spyad pa na gtsug lag gi tshigs bcad gnyis tsam mi 'don pas kun nas bslang ba dang / dus byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i khrus dang / chu la rtse bas kun nas bslang ba dang / gzhan gyi sgo la brda' ma byas par phul cing 'jug pas kun nos boslang ba dang / lus dang ngag rgod cing 'gyuro bas kun nas bslang ba dang / kuon tu ma brtagos pa dang chas gas mdud pa ma daro ba dong / snom sbyar ma bags par grang du 'jug pa dang / spyad yul la spyad pas kun nas bslang ba dang / chas gas bzlag pa la sags par bags pa dang /mig gnya' shing gang tsam du lta ba la sogs pas grong du ma zhugs pas kun nas bslang ba dang / ma gnang ba'i lha'i khyim dang rgyal po'i pho brang du 'jug pa dang / ma gnang ba'i stan la 'dug pas kun nas bslang ba dang /tshul 'chos pa dang kha gsag dang / khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba dang 'dre zhing 'du 'dzir gyur pas kun nas bslang ba dang / ma gnang ba'i stan ri mo can dang gdugs dang zhwa dang / mchil lham 'chang bas kun nas bslang ba dang /kha ma bkab par glal ba dang / sham thabs mdud pa ma dor bar skas la 'dzegs pas kun nas bslang ba dang /bdag dang gzhan gyi lhung ba 'chab pa dang / phyir bcos par nus pa dang / sdig bshags pa dang /gso sbyong dang dgag dbye btang snyoms su 'jog pas kun nas bslang ba dang / gar dang glu dang rol mo dang 'thab mo dang 'khrig pa la lta bas kun nas bslang ba dang rin po che dang der gtogs pa la reg pa dang / sa le sbram dang dngul bdag gir byed pas kun nas bslang ba dang / gnang ba ma yin pa'i gos btso blag mkhan 'khrur 'jug pa dang / gnang ba ma yin pa'i spu 'thog pas kun nas bslang ba dang / bud med kyi yul dang 'od kyi snang ba dang bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang / nub gsum du nyal bas kun nas bslang ba dang /sgo ma gtan pa dang dben pa ma yin pa dang / dge slong gis ma bsrungs pa dang / gos mdud pa ma bor bar nyin — /068—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /bar nyal bas kun nas bslang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang pha ma dang mkhan po dang slob dpon dang nad pa rnams kyi g.yog ma byas pa dang / lhung bzed dang chos gos dang dbyar gyi ras chen dang chu tshags dang gding ba dang / 'chi ba dang / lhung ba dang rung bar bya ba dang / sbyin pa blang ba dang nyin zhag dang bya ba dang / seng ge'i nyal thabs dang / myur du ldang bas nyal bar bya ba rnams la dran pas ma zin pas kun nas bslang ba dang /mdor bsdus na phas pham bzhis kun nas bslang ba dang / dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba dang / ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang spang ba'i lhung byed sum cus kun nas bslang ba dang / lhung ba dgu cus kun nas bslang ba dang / so sor bshags par bya ba bshis kun nas bslang ba dang / bslab par bya ba'i chos mang pos kun nas bslang ba dang / rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba bdun gyis kun nas bslang ba dang / gang sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa'i bslab ba dang / dge 'dun gyis bcas pa'i nang khrims dral ba dang / 'goms pa dang gus par ma bgyis pa de dag thams cad btsun pa'i mdun du bdag mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol zhing bshags so / / de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du brjod/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /btsun pa dgongs su gsol / bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di'i nang du ji ltar yongs su bsgrags pa'i gzhi 'di dag las / lhung ba mang po byung ba dang / nyes pa tshad ma mchis pa byung ba dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dag 'dul ba las 'das pa de dag bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas btsun pa'i mdun du/ lhung ba mang po de dag dang nyes pa tshad ma mchis pa de dag dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'dul ba las 'das pa de dag thams cad dag pa'i mtha' nas bzung nas gang ris mthun pa de dag thams cad ni byin gyis brlab par bgyi'o/ /gang ris mi mthun pa de dag ni nges par bgyi ste bshags par bgyi'o/ /rab tu bstan par bgyi'o/ /mi bcab par bgyi'o / / bshags pa dang rab tu bstan pa nyid kyis bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la lhung ba mang po byung ba de dag byung ba dang / nyes pa tshad ma mchis pa byung ba de dag dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dag 'dul ba las 'das pa'i lhung ba'i sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang mjug tu byung ba'i nyes byas dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i lhung ba so so rnams las mthol zhing bshags na bde ba la reg par 'gyur gyis/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar ma lags so/ /lhung ba de dag la lhung bar mthong ngam/ kha cig mthong lags so/ /phyin chad shin tu legs par yang dag par sdom mam/ chos ji lta ba dang 'dul ba ji lta ba dang ston pa'i bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu legs par sdom lags kyis/ yang 'di ltar shes bzhin du phyin chad mi bgyid do/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ thabs yin no/ /legs so zhes brjod par bya'o/ /lhung ba bshags pa'i cho — 1069—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ga rgyas pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo cwa ba dge slong chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //za21 sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsitta ud pa ta saṃ bha ra bi dhi kra ma/ bod skad du/ sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song thams cad 'jig pa dang / /sgrib pa thams cad las grol zhing / /rdzogs sangs go 'phang stsol mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo / / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang sems dpa'i chos/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /ji bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sdom pa'i rim pa bri bar bya/ de la dang por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po sa chen po la zhugs pa rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang / slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol / zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasarnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bur du/ chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid kyis dmigs te/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa la sogs byas la/ slob dpon mdun du byas te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am/ tsog pur yang rung — /070—

sngags phyogs ble sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /bas 'dug te/ thal mo sbyar bas sems bskyed par bya ste/ phyogs bcu rnams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ skye ba 'de dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrim/sa kyi rang bzhin dang / sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis bgyis pa dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yid rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o / / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon med kyang bdag nyid byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dang / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs nga/ thams cad yid la bsams te phyag btsal ba dang mchod pa'i cho ga las stsogs pa byas nas/ gsol ba gdab nga/ dang slob dpon zhes bya ba'i tshig spangs pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba las stegs nga/'i go rim/sa gong ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa'i gang zag gis/ byang chub sems spel bar bya ba'i phyir/ tha na nyin lan gsum ma/chan lan gsum/ du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs byas pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o / / byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi las ldog par bya ste/ ba'i gang zhe na/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa bslu ba dang / gzhan dang 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma/ yi/na pa brjed pa dang / sem/sa can thams cad la yang g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi 'a/ bslab par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ srog gi phyir yang bsams bzhin du rdzun du mi smra ba dang / sems can thams cad la lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya'i g.yo dang sgyus ma yin pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing phyogs bcur yang dag pa'i yon tan brjod — 107/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa dang / sems can 'ga' zhig dge ba la 'god pa de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dgod kyi nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la ni ma yin no/ khyad par du mngon par shes pa myur du thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo la bslab par bya'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las stsogs pa las shes par bya'o/ /de la dang por cho ga bzhin du byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la legs par bslab par 'dod pas/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su bzung bar nus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag byas te/ de'i rkang pa la gtugs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/slob dpon khyod las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa de len par 'tshal gyis/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing gsal ba'i rigs so/ /zhes de ltar lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig khyod 'di ltar sems can ma bsgral bo rnams bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yangs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yangs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung mi rgyud mi gcod par 'dod dam/ de la khyod kyis sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bya'o/ /gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ gzhan/ gyis nan gyis len du bcug pa ma yin nam zhes dri'o/ /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i lugs sku'am ras ris las stsogs pa mdun du bzhag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa las stsogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun du bsams la / ci nus pa'i phyi'i mchod pa lngas mchod pa dang phyag byas la/ de ma thag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen stan mthon po la 'dug pa la ston pa'i 'du shes kyis phyag byas te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am tsog tsog por 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod par 'di ltar bskul bar bya ste/ slob dpon gyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba bdag la myur du gsal du gsol/ zhes de ltar lan gsum du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bskul nas/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dug pa'am langs pa yang rung ste/ des byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod pa de la 'di skad — 1072—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ces dri bar bya ste/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam zhes dris pa na/ len pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des kyang btab pa lags so zhes khas blang ba bya'o/ /de nas mi zad pa dpag tu med pa bla na med pa'i byang chub bsod nams kyi gter chen por gyur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gter yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rin po che ma thogs par thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes snyam du bsam zhing sems rab tu dad par gyur pas dga' ba dang bcas pas cang mi smra bar thal mo sbyar te 'dug par bya'o/ /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims mdor bsdus pa slob ma la go bar bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag ci bdag las len par 'dod dam zhes slob ma la dri bar bya'o/ /len par 'tshal lo/ /nges de ltar len par 'tshal lo zhes khas len par gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa sbyinapar bya ste/ btsun pa'am tshe dang ldan pa'am rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang dag dang / tshul khrims gang dag la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs par gyur pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang / phyogs bcu dag na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims nod dam nyid mi dgos sam zhes smros shig des kyang nod lags so zhes smros shig de ltar slob dpon gyis lan gsum gyi bar du len nam zhes brjod cing / slob mas rab tu len lags so zhes lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa blangs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des slob ma la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa byin nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal —1073—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ba sngon du btang bas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces lan gsum brjod par bya/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par mnos lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa la bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la dpang du gyur pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brjod de/ phyag 'tshal nas bla ma dang slob ma ldang bar bya'o/ /de nas langs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mnos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig 'di ni chos nyid de/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnasam la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blang ba mnos so/ /zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /de las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis chos kyi brtse bas/ bu dang spun zla'i dgongs pa mdzad la de ltar dgongs pa mdzad pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba brjod par bya'o / / de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des byang chub sems dpa' de la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan pa na/ dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la ma dad pas spong par byed de/ de nas ji snyed byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ba de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po ma dad pa de snyed dang ldan par 'gyur ro / / gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems can sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su bsrung bar bya ba yin pas/ gzhan sdig pa las bzlog par bya ste/ de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gsang —/074—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs se/ /bar bya ba yin no/ /de nas bslab pa'i gzhi pham pa'i gnas su gyur pa sdom pa 'jig pa'i rgyu bstan zhing / nyes byas kyi lhung ba nyon mongs can dang / nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa yang bstan par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdor bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i chul khrims kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho gaslob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas ma/dzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba lags so/ /slad kyis paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo cwa ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa'o// //'a22 lasakyi sgrib pa thamasacad rnam par 'thag par byed pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba sman bla'i sgrub thababa'ibazhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddha ka ra bi dhi/ bod skad du/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam/ par 'thag par byed pa'i cho ga /rje bcun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyi bka'i gdams pas blo'i padma kha bye ba/ snying rjes rgyud brlan zhing byang chub kyi sems brtan pas/ maṇḍal la sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga byas la/ snying brtse ba'i sems kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan por byas nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags par bya'o/ /eo a kā ro mu kham sarba dharmā ṇi ārya nutpasmi twata/ tshig gi don rjes su dran pas ji tsam nus pas ngal gso bar bya'o/ /dam bcas pa'i rjes su dran pas de nyid las bskyod bzhin du sems nyid sgra'i rnam par gyur pa la sogs pas gzugs kyi sku mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ a ru ra dang bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ /sems dpa' gnyis po ser dang dkar ba ste/ /nyi ma zla ba cig shos 'dud par byed/ /rnam par dag pa'i cho ga rdzogs par byas la/gzhan thams cad snying po byang chub la bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi sku rjes su dran pa brtan por sgoms la/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdam ngag gi oṃ bhi ṣa dze bhi ṣa dze mahā hai ṣa dze sa mud ga te swāhā/ /zhes ji tsam nus pa bzlas la bcom ldan 'das mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun de nyid kyi smon lam chen po bcu gnyis po lan gcig brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rmi lam gyi shes pas dge ba'i las la 'bad par bya'o/ /thun mtshams su ji 'jigs la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen po bcu gnyis la gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang thun mtshams su bcos ldan 'das de — 1075—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/nyid kyi mdo'i pu ti bklags pa dang kha ton du gdon par bya'o/ gal te las kyi sgrib pa shin tu che na mdo de nyid nas gsungs pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya'o/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'thag par byed pa'i cho ga slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //ya23 sagazhi byin che ba'i 'khor lo bca' thabs/ /༄༅/ /jo bo rje lha cig gis 'gro ba sems can gyi don du/ 'khor lo 'di kha che'i yul nas zhus nas 'ongs so / / sgrol ma rang tshig bdag gnyis phel ba yin gsungs/ 'khor lo'i bca' kha 'di ma log na gang ran ci yang mi dgos so/ /byi ba zla ba yin gsungs/ 'khor lo ngo mtshar can yin gsungs/ 'khor lo gnyisabyas la thad ka thad kar blan/ lha sbyor bar du rin po che blugs la lam phor ram nas 'chu ba'am/ phye 'gul chu skyogs la blan la mis mi mthong bar bya'o// //rgya gar skad du/ /n-i rghaṃ rghaṃ rghaṃ ṇi ha/ /bod skad du/ bkra shis nor 'phel ba/ sa gzhi byin che ba/ lo legasapa phyug pa bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa/ zas nor thams cad 'du ba/ mi mang po 'du ba/ /nyams dga' ba / de la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sa gter rin chen me long ni/ gnas gzhi dang dgon pa dang / rgya po'i pho brang / khang gcig mo dang de rnams su zas nor gos dang bsod nams 'phel zhing bskyed pa'i thabs la/ rdza sar pa bre gang shong ba sen du spra/ tshil la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas kyi rub sor brgyad pa cig byas la 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha lugs can/ sbrul gyi gdeng ka bdun yod pa/ g.yas na rin po che 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon na bdud rtsi sman gyi snod bsnams pa/ lte ba man chad sbrul du song ba bya'o / / 'gi haṃ gis byugs la bum pa'i nang du gzhug go /yum gyi nus pa sor bcu pa byas la sbrul gyi gdengs ka lnga yod pa thal me sbyar nas yab la gzigs pa byas la lto ba sbyar pa bum pa'i nang du gzhug go / lung pa gsum mam lnga'am bdun nam dgu la sogs par 'bru sna dang / mi btsan phyug la blangs la brum par blangs la dar tshon sna lnga sman la 'gro tshad mngar gsum la sogs blug go /bud med rigs bzang sdug bsngal gyis ma phog pa'i nu zho mdun du drang ngo / /ba dmar dang yab yum gyi bar du ra dmar gyi lo ma blug go /zla ba ra ba bzhi'i yar ngo'i tshes grangs bzang po la/ sngon pa dkon mchog la mchod pa bzang po byas la/ bum pa mdun du bzhag la/ yang na dge slong gcig yang na sngags pa dam tshig can gyis lha'i rgya mtsho'i nas klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas spyan drangs la btsun mo dang bcas bum par lan gsum bsam —1076—

sngags phyegs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /mo/ /rten 'brel gyi snying pa bzlas/ bkra shis brjod pa dbu' rtse'am lha khang gi ka ba'am mdzod dam khang pa'i dbus su khru gang yan chod du rtsig pa'am ka ba la sba'o/ /de'i steng du zhal gdan ba la byas bzhin bya la nyi ma dang zla ba bsam mchod rten bzhin bris la bzhag go /yang na yab na re nag po chos bris sa tshon ser pos bris te bzhag go /'di'i yon tan ni bsod nams 'phel ba dang / yo byad 'phel ba dang / longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /sa gzhi de bkra shis la bstan par 'gyur ro// //brgyud pa ni dge bshes bya yul bas dge bshes 'o rgod 'dul ba 'dzin la gnang / des dge bshes nam pa la gnang / des dge bshes jo brten la gnang / des bla ma rdor yum la gnang/ des bla ma gdung skyabs la/ des bla ma kun bzang la'o// //ra24 dusamachod chen po bzhi'i phan yon bzhugasaso/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka la mahā pan tsa pu tsa ka sa/ bod skad du/ dus mchod chen po bzhi'i phan yon zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na dge slong dge slong gtso bo yin dge chul dang dge bsnyen yang ngo / /rman ma brgyad kyi rma yang sos par 'gyur te/ dge slong men ma brgyad ji ltar yin mi shes pa yin na/ sdig pa'i grogs po gco bo yin la lhag par chags shing sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ skyes pa'i yul la lhag par chags shing skyes pa'i yul dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ nye du dang 'brel pa la lhag par chags shing nye du dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ ma brtags pa'i dngos po 'bru dang dud 'gro dang bran dang zhing dang sman dang bzo ba'i lag cha dang mtshon cha dang byug pa dang brgyad la lhag par chags shing ma brtags pa'i dngos po brgyad dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ 'du 'dzi la lhag par chags shing 'du 'dzi dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ sha chang la chags shing sha chang dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ chos dang ma 'brel ba bre mo'i gtam la lhag par chags shing bre mo'i gtam dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin / dge slong ma la lhag par chang shing dge slong ma dang 'bral mi phod pa dge slong rman ma yin/ dus mchod chen po bzhi'i mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na sos par 'gyur ba yin/ ji ltar yin snyam nas mi shes pa yin na de rnams las ldog par 'gyur ba chos nyid yin/tshe 'phos ma thag tu dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba'i gang zag bcu/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'brel byas nas dpon slob kyi dam tshig nyams pa'i gang zag dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin / byang chub sems dpa' la yang dang yang du ngan sems skyed pa'i gang zag dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa — /077—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la chags nas chos 'dra ston pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ dge ba bcu la mos pa'i gang zag dge ba'i grogs po dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phral nas mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig pa'i grogs po dang sbyor ba'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ dge 'dun sde'i yo byad la rku 'phrog byed pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba bzhi byung ba'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ lha dkon mchog gsum la rgyab kyis phyogs nas byad byed pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ mtshams med pa byed pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas rtsod pa'i las byed pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ mja' bshes phan par sems pa la 'khu zhing 'drid pa'i gang zag sems can dmyal bar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du 'gro ba yin/ gang zag bcu po des dus mchod chen poo bzhi'i dus su mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag pa byas na las tshan po ches dar cig sems can dmyal bar skyes su zin kyang de nas myur du thon nas yi dwags dang dud 'gror mi skye bar mir skye ba yin/ phyi ma la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes nas bde ba cung zhig spyad nas mthar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba chod nyid yin no/ /sems can ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ldongs nas lam log par zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rma 'byin pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i zer can gyi phung po bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyis kyang dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na/ skye ba 'phos ma thag tu nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin thob nas sems can rnams kyi dgos 'dod dang re ba char bzhin du 'bebs pa chod nyid yin/ de nas ring po mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sems can gyi phung po bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ 'grogs par mi/ 'os sdig pa'i grogs po khyad par du chos shes nas mi byed pa pa dang 'grogs pa dang / spyad par mi 'os so nam na bzhi sbyod pa spyod nga/ dang / bcang bar mi 'os pa ma brtags pa'i dngos po brgyad phyogs mthun dang bcas pa 'chang ba dang /bya bar mi 'os dngos po phran tshegs ster ba la brubs byed pa byed pa dang / bgo bar mi 'os pa lus gcong ḍa ṇa par mche ba can gyi pags pa dang dar zab la sogs pa gon pa dang / 'gro bar mi 'os ra dza'i pho brang da dung bu chung chom rkun shan pa yugs za mo smad 'tshong ma'i par 'gro ba dang / blta bar mi 'os gzhon nu rol rtsed dpung bu chung bro ltad pa blta ba dang / mnyan par mi 'os te du dang 'brel ba'i gtam pa nyan pa dang / smra bar mi 'os rdzun la sogs pa bzhi po —/078—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /pa smra ba dang / bza' bar mi 'os sha sgog sgong zan la sogs pa za ba dang / btung par mi 'os khrag dang chang la sogs pa 'thung pa dang / bsam par mi 'os pa sems pa'o/ /dus tshigs bcu gnyis kyi dus su rin po che bcu gnyis la bsnyen bkur byas na myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yongs su grags pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba chos nyid yin/ dus tshigs bcu gnyis ni mu ge chen po byung ba'i dus dang / sde rtsod chen po byung ba'i dus dang / yams nad chen po byung pa'i dus dang / mdza' bshes phan par sems pa shi ba'i dus dang / zla ba shi ba'i dus dang / nyi ma shi ba'i dus dang / lus dang longs spyod la ma chags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' shi ba'i dus dang / theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen grongs pa'i dus dang / dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus dang bcu gnyis so/ /rin po che bcu gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos 'chad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / ye shes dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / ye shes dang ldan pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dge 'dun rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / dge slong byang chub sems dpa' rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / nyon mongs pa zad pa'i dge 'dun rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / nyon mongs pa zad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i dge 'dun rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / 'jig rten mtha' dag la mngon par mi dga' ba'i dge 'dun rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum bzhengs su gsol ba'i bzo bo rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / 'gro ba mtha' dag gi nad sel ba'i sman pa rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos dang sprod pa'i pha ma rin po che la bsnyen bkur bya ba'o/ /yongs su grags pa bcu gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ tshe 'di la bzhi phyi ma la brgyad/ 'di la bzhi'i dbang du byas nas/ rang rin po che'i rten bzhengs su gsol/ gzhan rin po che'i rten bzhengs su gsol ba'i grogs byed/ gsol ba la phra dog mi byed par yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / rang sbyin pa gtong / gzhan sbyin pa gtong ba'i grogs byed/gzhan sbyin pa gtong ba la phra dog mi byed pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / rang sdom pa dang dam tshig la gnas/ gzhan sdom pa dang dam tshig la gnas pa'i grogs byed/ g.yin sdom pa dang dam tshig la gnas pa la phra dog mi byed pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / rang bzod pa bsgom/ g.yin bzod pa bsgom pa'i grogs byed/ gzhan bzod pa bsgom pa la phra dog mi byed pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba'o/ / phyi ma la brgyad kyi dbang du byas na/ mi lus rin po che thob pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / rin po che sna — 1079—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/tshogs kyi gzhal yas khang na gnas pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / zhal zas dam pa'i char 'bebs nus pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / na bza' dam pa'i char 'bebs nus pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / rin po che'i char 'bebs nus pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / me tog dam pa'i char 'bebs nus pas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang mi 'bral zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi che ba'i yon tan mthong bas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang mi 'bral zhing 'gro ba rab tu mang po la theg pa chen po la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas yongs su grags par 'gyur ba'o/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su mchod pa ma chag par byas na phan yon chen po bcu drug 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ phan yon bcu drug ni/ skye ba 'di phyi ma la brgyad kyi snga ltas su 'di la brgyad 'byung gsung la brgyad/ phyi ma la brgyad/ 'di'i brgyad po la/ dge ba'i grogs dang mi 'bral bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' dang mi 'gal bar sgrub nus pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / sdig pa'i grogs po spong nus pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngag mi nyan pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / skyes pa'i yul spong nus pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / nye du 'brel pa la ma chags pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / ma brtags pa'i dngos po brgyad spong nus pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / lto gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba'o/ /phyi ma la brgyad kyi dbang du byas nas/ skyes ma thag tu lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / gzhon nu la rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims rnam par dag pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che brtan pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten gsum bzhengs su gsol bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byed pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge slong la mkho ba'i dus/ sdom pa dang dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byed pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / lus longs spyod dge ba dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams la gtong bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba'o//rab zla ba gcig 'bring nya tshun chod/ tha mas nya ba mi byang ba med/ dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na dam tshig nyams pa bcu gcig kyang byang bar 'gyur ba yin/ dam tshig nyams pa bcu gcig ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi der gzhi rtsa log na de mi 'byung ba yin/ la skyabs su song nas dam tshig — 1080—

sngags phyegs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /nyams pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la tid ti skyabs su song ba dmyal bar nges par skye ba'i rgyu skyabs su song nas dam tshig nyams pa dang / dam sems can dang zhe 'gras pa yin te de spang ngo / /pa'i chos la skyabs su song nas dam tshig nyams pa dang / 'phags pa'i tshe 'di'i nus pa la sogs pa'i yi dwags thang lha la sogs pa dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dam tshig nyams pa dang / grogs po dam pa mnyam por thar par bsgrub par khas blangs nas dang blo phugs ma mthun pas dam tshig nyams pa dang / nad pa rnams kyi rim gre ku bar khas blangs nas grogs ra bor nas mi byed pas dam tshig nyams pa dang / rang la nyes pa yod bzhin du pha ma la bsnyen bkur ma byed pas dam tshig nyams pa dang / mdza' bshes phan par sems pa la thabs du mas 'drid cing yo byad 'brel ba 'khu zhing 'drid pas dam tshig nyams pa dang / phongs pa rnams sbyin rgyu yod bzhin du med zer ba kyi re ba thag bcad pas dam tshig nyams pa dang / yi dwags rnams la gtor ma ci za yang phud 'bul ba ltar pre ta la yang bha ling btang dgos ma tha yang rje dus dang dgong mo gtong dgos gtong bar khas blangs nas mi gtong bas dam tshig nyams pa dang / sbyin bdag gi don mi byed pas chos ston nam ka ca blangs nas dge spyor mi byed pa thams cad dmyal ba'i rgyu'o/ /dam tshig nyams pa'o//dus mchod chen po bzhi'i mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na dam tshig nyams pa bcu gcig po de dag byang nas kyang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba chos nyid yin/ sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yang dal 'byor gyi lus brgyud mar blangs nas ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang bral ba chos nyid yin/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su tshogs chen po lnga bsags na/ dngos grub chen po brgyad 'thob ste/tshogs lnga ni/ lha dkon mchog gsum/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dge slong gi dge 'dun/ yi dwags/ dbul 'phongs pa'o/ dngos grub brgyad ni/ 'di la bzhi/ phyi ma la bzhi'o/ 'di'i bzhi la/ gnas lus sems bde ba sa phyogs bdag gir ma bzung pas rtsod pa med pa mchog du 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod chos dang mthun pa'i 'tsho ba tshegs med par brnyed pa mchog tu gyur ba dang / rgyan so so'i thar pa'i sdom skyes la ma nyams pas mchog tu gyur pa dang /lta ba mthar thug pa mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /phyi ma'i bzhi la/ rnyed pa dal 'byer gyi lus thob pas mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / grogs po lta spyod mthun pas mchog tu 'gyur pa dang / bsam pa mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas mchog tu 'gyur ba'o/ /skal ldan rigs la gnas pa bde ba 'dod rnams kyis/ /ston dus zla tha chungs tshes zla bstod gcig nas/ /nya la thug gi bar dag du/ /bde gshegs rgyal sras rnams la 'khor bsgrub pa dang zang zing gis mchod byed pa//rab phan yon du mdzes pa bcu dang ldan/ /de yang tshe rgyu 'bras goms par bya tshe 'di la gnyis/ phyi ma la brgyad do/ /— 1081 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/'di la gnyis ni 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dang / dus rtag du yid bde ba mang bas mdzes pa lha'i bu rnams kyis bsrung pas dge ba'i sbyor ba la bar chad mi 'byung pas mdzes pa'o/ / phyi ma'i brgyad ni/ ser sna'i thag pa bcad pas zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya chen po byed pas mdzes pa dang / dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan pas tshul khrims rnam par dag pas mdzes pa dang / /byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas skye bo mang po dga' bas rjes su 'brang pas mdzes pa dang / lus dang longs spyod la ma chags bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas nas dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pas mdzes pa dang / 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal ma bzod pas skad lha dri med pa'i don/ cig kyang ma yengs par rnal 'byor ma rtse gcig tu byed pa'i mdzes pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba skyes nas gzhan don du bdag gi bde ba chen po dang gdul bya gzhan gyi du kha chen po rje phod pas mdzes pa dang / /bdud kyi bar chad mi 'byung pas lhun gyis grub pas mdzes pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'od zer chen pos 'gro ba mtha' dag gi ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bas mdzes pa'o/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su zas sman rin po che byin pas grags pa chen po drug thob ste/ gang zhe na/gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pas grags pa dang / tshe ring zhing nad kyi bar chad mi 'byung pasagrags pa dang /longs spyod che zhing ma chags pas grags pa dang / rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims rnam par dag pasagrags pa dang /byang chub kyi sems brtan zhing 'gro ba'i mchod rten du 'gyur bas grags pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi mgon dang gling dang dpung gnyen dang skyabs su gyur pas grags pa'o/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i phan yon dpag du med kyang mdor bsdu na mdzes pa rnam pa brgyad 'thob ste/ longs spyod tshegs med par khas blangs dang mi 'gal ba 'byung zhing sbyin pa'i las la brtson pas mdzes pa dang / dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan zhing chul khrims kyi rkang pa mi 'chag pas mdzes pa dang / ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pas grogs dam pa dang mi 'bral bas mdzes pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang mi 'bral zhing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' bzhin du bsgrub pas mdzes pa dang / skal ba dang ldan zhing 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal srid la ma chags par rab du 'byung pas mdzes pa dang / 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pas bslab pa gsum dang ldan pas mdzes pa dang / 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi gnas su 'gyur zhing bkur pa'i gnas su 'gyur bas mdzes pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub nas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal sel bas mdzes pa'o//dus mchod chen po bzhi'i phan yon ni/ tshe rabs thams cad ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal sel zhing mtho rigs su skye ba dang / gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa dang / yon tan thams cad dang ldan pas 'gro ba thams cad — 1082—

sngags phyogs blo sbying gi skor bzhugs so/ /zil gyis gnon pa dang / /tshe rabs thams cad du bkres pa dang skom pa dang 'khyags pa'i du kha thams cad spangs nas chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod tshegs med par 'byung pa dang / tshe rabs thams cad du myang ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa'i du kha thams cad spangs nas sems bde zhing dang bar 'gyur ba dang / tshe rabs thams cad du nad kyi du kha thams cad spangs nas lus bde zhing yang bar 'gyur ba dang / 'chi ba'i dus su yang gnad gcod pa'i du kha tsam yang mi 'byung ste lha'i bu rnams kyis bde bar bsu ba dang / ring po mi thogs par 'tshang rgya ba chos nyid yin no/ /sems can ma rig pa'i dri mas bsgribs nas gti mug gi mun khung nas mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam ngo mi shes pas ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar bsnyen pa'i sems can gyi phung po bcu gcig gis kyang dus bzhi'i dus su g.yo sgyu med par shin tu gus pa'i sems kyis sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byas pa yin na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od zer gyi sgron mas ma rig pa'i mun pa dang gti mug gi dri ma bsal nas 'phral la lha dang mi'i bde ba dpag du med pa 'byung pa dang / mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba chos nyin yin no/ /sems can gyi phung po bcu gcig gi dbang du byas nas/ mi 'chi ba'i rnam par rtog pas bcings nas bslab par mi 'os mtha' dag slob pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang / ngan skyugs 'du 'dzi'i 'dam rdzab tu tshud pas dbyar zla ba gsum du tshul du zhugs mi khom pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang / dgra zin ltar bcos pa'i gnag gi gnyen 'tshams dang 'bral mi phod pas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis bsdams pa'i sems can gyi sems can gyi phung po dang / skyes pa'i yul spong mi phod pas so nams na bzhi'i 'dam rdzab du chud pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang /mthong du mi rung pa'i mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang / za'i dam tshig nyams pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang / phrad du mi rung ba'i sdig pa'i grogs pos zin pa'i sdom pa nyams pa'i sems can gyi phung po dang / dug lnga shin tu che ba'i sems can gyi phung po'o/ /dus byin gyis brlabs pa khyad par can bzhi'i dus su mchod pa byas nas bkra shis pa brgyad 'byung pa chos nyid yin/ bkra shis pa dam pa brgyad ni skye ba 'di la bzhi/ phyi ma la bzhi'o/ /'di'i bzhi la/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun rnams kyi rgyan du 'gyur bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsod nams kyi las rlabs chen byas pas rgyan du 'gyur bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs dgongs pas rgyan du 'gyur bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur pa dang / tshe'i dus byed dkar lha rnams kyis lha rdzas kyi me tog sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba'o/ /phyi ma la — 1083—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ mthab bral gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes nas rgyal ba byams pa la theg pa chen po'i chos rgyas par thos nas chos nyid kyi don ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba dang / de nas lam rnams rims kyis bgrod nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams kyi dgos 'dod dang re ba rin po che lta bu'i tshul du 'byung pas bkra shis pa dam par 'gyur ba'o/ /dus mchod chen po bzhi'i dus su tshogs chen po brgyad bsags na dngos grub chen po brgyad 'thob pa chos nyid yin/ /tshogs chen po brgyad ni/ mchod rten zhig pa gso ba dang / rin po che'i mchod rten khru gang yan chad chen po bzhengs su gsol ba dang / lha dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rgyas par 'bul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la chos ston yon dang bcas pa gsol ba dang / 'byung po rnams la gtor kha 'bar ma'i gtor mas kyang chos ma gtong pa dang / sems can dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams kyi tshe bsrings pa dang /sems can mi mthun pa rnams
