kyi sdums byas pa dang / sems can mya ngan gyi non pa rnams kyi mya ngan bsang pa dang / sems can tshogs sogs pa la rjes su yi rang par bya ba'o/ dngos grub chen po brgyad ni/ tshe 'di la bzhi / / phyi ma la bzhi'o/ /'di'i bzhi ni/ sems can gdug pa can sa bdag gnod sbyin gcan gzan mi gdug pa can bzhis srog gi bar du gcod par mi nus pas dngos grub chen po thob pa yin/ dge ba bcu'i lam du zhugs pa la mi dge ba bcu'i gno/da pa mi 'byung pas dngos grub thob pa yin/ chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod tshegs med par 'byung pas dngos grub thob pa yin/ 'chi kar dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyi bo na bzhugs pas dngos grub thob pa yin no/ /phyi ma la bzhi la/ rgyal po chen po'i sras su skyes nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang mi 'bral bas dngos grub thob pa yin/ 'thab bral gyi lha'i nang du skyes pas 'thab dang rtsod pa dang bral zhing rgyal ba byams pa la bsnyen pas dngos grub thob pa yin/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i gnas su skyes nas rgyal ba byams pa'i sras kyi thu bor gyur nas dngos grub thob pa yin/ de nas ring po mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i tshul gyis sems can rnams kyi dgos 'dod re ba thams cad 'byung pa chos nyid yin no/ /dus mchod chen po bzhizhi dus su mchod pa dam bcas nas ma chag par byas na phan yon bcu bzhi 'byung ste/skye ba 'di la bzhi/ phyi ma la bcu 'byung ngo / 'di'i bzhi ni gdams ngag dang ldan pa sangs rgyas sgrub rgyud ma chad pa — /()84—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'bral mi phod pa dang / dge ba'i bla ma bsten pa'i chos bzhi'i mnyes par byed pa/grogs po dang 'bral mi phod pa dang / rten sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchod pa dang mchod rdzas gnyis ga gsum mchod pa dang bcas pa dang 'bral mi phod pa dang / las kyi lhag mas sdug cing sdug bsngal ba'i sprang po rnams la snying rjes 'bral mi phod pa'o/ /skye ba phyi ma'i bcu ni/ yon tan sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang mi 'brel ba dang mi 'bral bar dang / yon tan sems can thams cad gnyen du mnyam pa dang / yon tan ka rgyu'i bsam pa dge ba rgya che ba dang /yon tan byang sems legs par skyes pa dang / yon tan 'jug pa'i sdom pa legs par thob pa dang / yon tan rang gi khas blangs pa las mi nyams pa legs par brtan pa dang / yon tan legs par bdag gi bde ba chen po dang gzhan gyi du kha chen po rjes bde ba 'phel ba dang / yon tan phyir nyan rang du mi ldog pa dang / yon tan mthar sangs rgyas phyino pa dang / yon tan don sems can rnams 'khor ba las bsgral nas sangs rgyas la dgod par spyod pa don yod pa' / / dus mchod chen po bzhi'i phan yon la spyir dpag tu med kyang mdor bsdu na bcu 'byung ste/ skye ba 'di la lnga/phyi ma la lnga'o/ /'di'i lnga ni/ zas tshegs bza' shing gi ra ba rang dgar 'dug pa'i sar med par rnyed/ /btung ba chu yan lag brgyad ldan rang gar 'dug pa'i sar tshegs med par 'byung / gos mchog tu 'gyur pa tshegs med par 'byung /tshe'i tshad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la nyon mongs pa'i bar chad mi 'byung ngo / / phyi ma'i lnga ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa buddha'i 'du shes skye ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i bo dhe'i 'du shes skye ba grogs po dang mi 'bral ba dang / so so thar rang ngag dang bcas pa las pa'i sdom pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang mi 'bral pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /dus tha mal pa las zla ba gzas zin pa'i dus su bye ba phrag bdun 'gyur gyis che ba yin/ nyi ma gzas zin pa'i dus su bye ba phrag 'bum gsum 'gyur zer ri phug dpe las 'gyur gyis che ba yin/ dus mchod chen po bzhi la bsod nams la tshad bzung med ches chen po 'byung zhes gsungs so/ /dus tshod chen po bzhi ni dpyid zla ra ba gnam la sa skar ma rta rgyu ba 'bab pa'i dus 'phrul chen po yin/ dpyid zla tha chung mya ngan 'bring po myang 'das ri phug dpe las 'das pa'i dus yin/ dpyid zla 'bring po skar ma sogs rgyu ba mngon par byang chub pa'i dus yin/ ston zla tha chung skar ma dbyug pa rgyu ba cho 'phrul chung ba'i dus yin gsung ngo / /a ti sha'i zhal nas rgya gar na dus tshod chen po bzhi po 'di kho na la tshogs che bar mdzad pa yin/ a ti shas 'di'i dus su phyag len mdzad pa yin/ a ti sha'i zhal nas nang pa sangs rgyas par rtogs pa'i mi rnams — 1085—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/kyis dus mchod chen po bzhi po 'di la 'chag thabs med pa yin gsung ngo / /jo bos rnal 'byor pa chen po la gdams ngag gsungs// //la25 snye ga la'i 'od ma'i tshal me rtag gilhang du mdzad pa'ibade mchog gi bstod pa the(gabangabazhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /bde chen zung du 'jug pa'i sku/ /sgyu ma stong la rnam rol ba/ /bde mchog phag mo yab yum bstod/ /phung po bzhi ni rnam dag pa'i/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bdag nyid can/ /stong pa bzhi'i rang bzhin sku/ /ḍā gi ma sogs bzhi la 'dud/ /nyon mongs bzhi po rnam dag pa'i/ /ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam snang mdzad sogasasangs rgyas sku/ /bum pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /nam mkha' spyod pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / /rnam thar brgyad kyi rang bzhin sku/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sa la spyod pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /so so kun rtog ye shes bdag /'phags lam brgyad kyi bdag nyid sku/ /gsung gi 'khor lo phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sa 'og spyod pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /me long ye shes bdag nyid can/ /'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag sku/ /sku'i 'khor lo phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bka' bsgo la sogs rnam pa brgyad/ /mos dang dad pa 'phel byed pa/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes sku/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam gzigs la sogs sangs rgyas shing / /byang chub shing brgyad rnam dag sku/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam dag skur ston pa/ /dus khrod gnas gnad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji ltar bde mchog rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /drag po 'jigs byed brtul ba ltar / / bdag kyang bde mchog la gus pas/ /de'i mdzad dang mtshungs par shog jo bo rje lha cig shar phyogs bhe ga la'i tshal me tog gling na bzhugs dus su bde mcho gi dkyil 'khor gzigs nas de'i dus su bstod pa 'di mdzad do// //—1086—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /sha26 rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la bstod pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra yo ga nī sta ba/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hrīḥlas gyur pa'i mkha' spyod ni/ /nyon mongs gdung ba bsil ba'i phyir/ /mkha' la dri med pad zla'i steng / /lang tsho shin tu mdzes pa la/ /bcu drug lo lon lta bu'i tshul/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos phyir / / ston zla'i mdog ltar 'od zer 'phro/ /'gro rnams gnyid las sad mdzad phyir/ /grags stong hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrog /bde dang stong pa lhan cig skyes/ /gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug thugs/ /mkha' la spyod phyir zhabs gnyis ni/ /rgyab nas phrag pa gnyis la bka'/ /'gro rnams mkha' spyod 'dren pa'i phyir/ /bha ga rgyas shing shin tu yangs/ /thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /sku smad rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas/ /chags shing bde ba rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur/ /ma rig rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /phyag g.yas gri gug mkha' la 'phyar/ /gnyis med bdud rtsi 'dzed pa'i phyir/ /phyag g.yon thod pa mkha' la 'dzin/ /'gro ba'i don la dgyes mdzad phyir/ /zhal ni 'dzum khro dag dang ldan/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzigs pa'i phyir/ /spyan gsum mkha' la drag tu gzigs/ /sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /dbu la thod skam lnga yis brgyan/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ /dbu skra mthon mthing shin tu gnag /nyon mongs bag chags bsnyil ba'i phyir/ /rus bcas lcang los se stod non/ /sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /'gying chul dar gyi cod paṇa mdzes/ /yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa'i phyir/ /dbu brgyan snyan cha dpung rgyan dang / /mgul rgyan do shal do shal phyed/ /phyag gdub zhabs gdub rgyan rnams ni/ /rin po che yis rab tu spras/ /rnam rtog spangs phyir mi mgo'i phreng / /brgya phyed dag gis ga shal byas/ /nyon mongs bud shing sreg pa'i phyir/ /mi ri dkar po'i gseb na bzhugs/ /sgyu ma'i don dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /'ja' 'od tshogs kyis kun nas bskor/ /mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /mchod bstod gsol ba btab gyur na/ /yang dag mkha' spyod gnas su ni/ /'dren mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mdun gyi mkha' la lha mo khyod bzhugs nas / / lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang / /bem rig 'bral tshe bar chod med pa mā /yang dag mkha' spyod thugs su drang du gsol/ mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i bstod pa paṇḍi ta di paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur pa'o// //— 1087—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/sa27 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra yo gi nī sta ba/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod pa/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /stong nyid rdo rje ldan pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrog /rdo rje gtum mo de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phag gdong rtog med chos sku 'gyur med ston/ khro mo thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /'gro don rdzogs mdzad mdzes pa'i cha lugs can/ rtog med 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rab 'jigs dpa' mo ma rung tshar gcod ma / / spyan gsum mche gtsigs sku gsum don dang ldan/ /nyon mongs gcod mdzad 'jigs pa'i nga ro can / / bdud 'dul 'joms pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skra grol gcer bu skyon bral 'jigs pa'i gzugs / / nyon mongs skyon bral sems can don mdzad ma/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren/ /'phrin las rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod gnas bzhugs ru dra pho mo 'dul/ /drag mo 'jigs tshul phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing / /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma / / bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos nyid don rtogs 'chi ba'i tshul spangs kyang /ro dang nyi zla padma gdam gyi yum/ /brgyan rnams kun gyis rab mdzes khro mo'i sku/ /yon tan rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs gcod mdzad ye shes don dang ldan / / dug gsum gcod mdzad sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod / / bde chen rang byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi 'gyur ye shes rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /rtog med spros bral ye shes chos dbyings don/ yang dag gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo drug gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i rigs / dpal 'bar 'jigs mdzad khro tshul 'gying bag can/ /bde chen rang byung phyag rgya chen po'i don/ /nyon mongs sgrol mdzad de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin phag mo ste/ /sku mdog dmar ba thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /'dod dgu phun tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bde chen rang byung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dur khrod rgyan rnams sku la rdzogs pa ste/ /gri gug kha ṭwāṃ phyag mtshan so sor bsnams / / thugs rje'i rang bzhin skra grol thur du spungs/ /spyan dmar 'dzum zhal de la phyag 'tshal bstod / / 'phrin las grub pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bde 'gro'i gnas su 'dren pa'i thugs rje can/ /skyon bral yang dag lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /rdo rje 'phrul mo kai ༵ ༵ka 'tshal bstod/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la bstod

sngags phyegs ble sbyong ge skor bzhugs se/ /pa paṇḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba khu ne bcos bsgyur ba'o / / dpe 'di jo bo'i slob ma sum pa ra'u nas rgyud pa'o// //ha88 dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstod pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu hya sa mā dza sta tro/ bod skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu rtog pa ma lus spangs/ /dri med dang bral bdag nyid can/ /kun bzang chos dbyings ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ /'od zer brgya phrag rnam 'gyed pa/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta ngan rtog pa dang bral zhing / / skyon med mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen dbang la phyag 'tshal lo / / dpag med 'od kyi mkha' kun khyab/ /tshad med yon tan phreng ba yi/ /kun rtog ye shes mkhyen pa yi/ /'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po/ /ji bzhin du 'byung 'gyur ba yi/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /don yod grub pa de la 'dud/ /sa ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu rnam par 'dzin spyod pa/ /thugs rje spyod pa g.yo ba po/ /lha mo can mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu yis sems can rnams/ /nyon mongs nyid ni rab zhi ba/ /chu ltar phan pa don chen gyi/ /mā ma ki la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs nyid ni bsreg par brtson/ /bya ba rtse mo mchog grub pa/ /na bza' dkar mor phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlung ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa'i/ /rtsad 'byin 'gro la bde ba stsogs/ /ātpa la'i spyan mnga' ba/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gzugs ni rgya che zhing / /rnam pa kun ldan du ma 'phro/ /rtags bral gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /mnyam med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang gi mthu yis sgra rnams kyi/ /de nyid dam pa sangs rgyas shing / /rna ba'i bde ba bstsol mdzad pa/ /sgra rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo / / gang gi longs spyod lhun grub pa/ /sems can ma lus la sems pa'i/ /bung ba'i sgra mdzad rdo rje dri/ /ma smad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang rig bstan du med/ /gnyis med ro myong stobs kyis su/ /sems can bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /ro rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji bzhin du ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /re ba gang la srid mtha' mā /'gro gsung rtag tu dga' mdzad pa'i/ /reg rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang phyir kun nas nyon mongs pa / / rtsod pa'i rgyur gyur chos rnams kyis/ /kun la rtag tu rtog mdzad pa/ /bla med chos kyi rdo rje 'dud/ /gang phyir theg pa chen po la/ /mi rnams dga' ba bskyed mdzad pa/ /dad pa rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /gshin rje'i gshed — 1089—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/por phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas pa gang gi stobs skyes su/ /byang chub tshogs rnams rdzogs mdzad pa/ bcom ldan rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab mtha' byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mthu yis sems can rnams/ /dge ba brjod med bskyed mdzad pa/ /dran pa rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ padma mthar byed phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis stobs kyi sems can rnams/ /bgegs bral bde la gnas mdzad pa/ /bsam gtan rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /bgegs 'dzoms mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bstod pa/ slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'// //a29 dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badzra pā ṇi sto tra/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin mang po rnams dang bcas pa'i lha/ /sde dpon chen po phyag na rdo rje bsnams / / rigs dang mthun pa'i na bza' mthing ka'i mdog /mthu mchog khyod kyi yon tan rtag par bgyi / / rtsis mkhas chen pos grangs las 'das pa yi/ khyod ni sangs rgyas du mas dbang bskur bas/ /gdul bya mchis pa'i zhing du rol pa'i mchog /bsgrub bya khyod nyid nam yang mi gtong ngo / /bag gzhi gzings nasamache ba gtsigs pa ni/ khro bor bcas pa khyod kyi rkyen du mtshams/ gdug pa 'dul phyir skye shi rtsad gcod rtags / / tshems kyi phreng bas bdag la gzhan du gsol/ /spyan rtsa dmar po sdang mig bzlog pas ni/ /ma rungs log 'dren mod la skrag par mdzod/ /lha mchog spyan ni me 'dag phung po 'dra/ /sgrib med spyan gyis bdag la gzigs su gsol/ khyod kyi dbugs ni me lce bzhin du 'bar/ /bye ba ther 'bum stong gsum bdudarnams kyang / / dpag tshad 'bum gyi mthar yang mi bzod pas/ /bdag gi nyon mongs bag chags bsreg par mdzod / / gtum khro che bas sgra skad drag po ni/ /nga ro 'jigs pa'i 'brug stong lhag pa yis/ /'jig rten che btsan gtum po rnal ba rnams/ gsung mchog seng ge'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal rigs dbang chen pa la dbang ba'i klu/ nor rgyas bu ni ser khra chen po ste/ /lto 'phye chen po'i gdub bus phyag zhabs brgyan/ /ra sbyin mchog gi zhabs la phyag rtag 'dud/ /dmangs rigs gdug rtsub gtum pa rlung gi klu/ /brang gis 'gro ba nag po chen po ste/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po'i sku stod rnam par brgyan/ khyod ni byams pa'i rnam pas spyi bos blang / /glang chen lta bu'i snyan shal g.yas g.yon la/ klu rgyal rigs mchog dga' bo nyer dgas brgyan/ /dug can rnams kyi — 1090—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /klu rgyal dpa' bskongs nas/ khyed kyi sku la gzi brjid rgyan du 'bar/ /ro nyi'i mgo la nor bu gser can dag /lha mchog dbu la cod pan gdengs kas mdzes/ /rtsub cing gnag pa'i dbu skra gyen du 'greng / /rnam thar mchog gi dbu la bdag kyang bstod/ /sprul gdug 'bar ba mi bzad gang lags pa/ /rdo rje'i mche bas bcad cing zad par gsol/ /zhe sdang rgyun gcod rnam grol thar pa'i lam/ /byams pa'i 'od zer bdag la reg par mdzod/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la/ khro gnyer 'dus pa'i spyan gyis gzi brjid 'bar/zhal ras mchog la rtse gcig ma gtogs par/ /gzhan du bdag gis gus par mi bgyi'o/ /smin gnyis 'thab pa'i 'gyur rlabs bskyodapa yi/ khro gnyer 'dus pa'i phreng ba dpral bar 'brug /snying rje khros pa'i 'od zer stug po yis/ /nyon mongs khro ba'i mun/ pas 'joms paradmamadzad/ /steng gi tshoms kyis kos ko bsdams pas ni / / gdug pa zhe la gnod cing thugs rjes sgrol/ /thugs kyi brnag pa dregs pa tshar gcod pa'i/ /'dul mdzad mngon spyod sku la gus pas 'dud/ /'chi bdag gshin rje'i cha lugs 'jigs 'dra ba'i/ khyod kyi sku'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba snang / /rdzu 'phrul mchog gis rol pa'i bdag nyid can/ /gzung 'dzin 'joms pa'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs/ /zhal gyi rngam tshul 'gyur ba du mar gdangs/ /glog stong 'gyur ba'i ljags ni rnam par 'gyu/ /'bar ba'i ljags las thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro/ /bdag blo'i mun pa myur du sangs par mdzod / / dpa' bo chen po lto 'phye za ba'i mchog /khyod kyi gsungs pa kun tu rgyas shing 'phyang / /'jig rten gdul bya sku'i khrod du rngam/ /gzi brjid mchog gi sku la skyabs su mchi/ khros te lag pa brdabs pas 'jig rten 'khrug /gdug pa'i snying 'dar 'jigs pa che mjad pa/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams la dus kun du/ /thugs rjes phyag mthil spyi bo'i gtsug tu zhog /'dab bzang klu rgyal skul bar mdzad pa ni/ /drag po'i rlung gis shing lo skyod pa ltar/ /'dar zhing a la la zhes sgrog par mdzad/ /klu rgyal mchog gis spras pa'i sku la 'dud/ /don dam chos sku mtshan mar ma nges kyang / /snying rje khros pa'i sku la dpag tshad ni/ /sum 'bum nyi khri 'dod pa'i khams na 'phyo/ /rgya mtsho spus mor phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyin pa'i rnam smin gtso dang 'dod mchog gis/ khyod ni yon tan gdeng du gyur pa ltar/ /bdag gis mi bskyod dad pas dus kun tu/ /lha mchog zhabs mchog spyi gtsug gdeg par bgyi/ /klu gdug thams cad gtan du rlag mdzad pa/ khyod kyi rnam par smon lam mchog lags te/bdag 'dra sdug bsngal dug gis gzir ba la/ /thugs rdo rje'i bdud rtsi myur du 'byon par mdzod/ /gad rgyangs che sde sdigs phyir dgod pa yis/ /ji snyed log 'dren gnod sems bgyid pa rnams/ /ri mo'i gzugs 'dra mi g.yo rengs par mdzad/ /'khrug mdzad chen po'i dbang mchog bdag la gsol/ /rtag tu dmigs med zhi — /091 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba'i sku brnyes kyang / /'chi bdag zlog phyir gshin rje'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /gtum po thams cad kun tu zil gyis gnon/ /'jigs pa'i tshogs chen 'jigs par mdzad la bstod/ khams gsum 'di na snod ldan skye bo gang / khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pas zil gyis gnon/ /thams cad btul te yang dag lta la dgod/ /'di ltar gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /mche gtsigs dbugs rgyu me ltar 'bar ba ni/ /thabs kyi spyod pas nyon mongs bsregs pa'i rtags/ /spyan gsum dmar ba khro bos lta ba ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi don dang ldan pa'i rtags / / a la la'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i rtags/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs stong gsum rgyal ba ni/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /hūṃ gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba ni/ khro bo'i rigs rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /phaṭa kyis rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs pa ni/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /gshin rje'i gzugs can rgyan dang cha lugs ni/ /sku che yan lag rags te che ba'i rtags/ /sku stod seng ge'i lpags pas brgyan pa ni/ /chos nyid don ldan spros dang bral ba'i rtags / / na bza' chos gos sngon/ po 'chang ba ni/ /tshul khrims don ldan dri ma med pa'i rtags/ /stag sham pa ti khro bos brgyan pa ni/ /zhe sdang 'dul mdzad sgrub mchog skyob pa'i rtags/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i sbrul gyis dbu brgyan pa/ /'dod dgu bsam pa re ba skong ba'i rtags/ /dga' bo nye dga'i snyan chas brgyan pa ni/ /bram ze'i klu rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /gdug pa 'bar ba zas su gsol ba ni/ /gdol pa'i rigs rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /klu nag se ral kha ru brgyan pa ni/ /dmangs rigs klu rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /'dab bzang dkar po ske rags bcings pa ni/ rgyal rigs klu rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags / / nor rgyas bu yis phyag zhabs brgyan pa ni/ /rje rigs klu rnams dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /nyi zla'i steng na gar byed dgyes pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel pa'i rtags/ /sna tshogs padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /rdo rje rigs mchog bcom ldan gtum po ni / / thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don chen byed pa'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i skur bstan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las mdzad pa'i thabs/ /sku'i yan lag rags te dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan te sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /zhe sdang 'joms mdzad stag gi sham thabs can/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang / /bcom ldan gtum po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ slob dpon dī paṃ ka ra shri dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba rgya — 1092—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o// //gi30 khro rgyal mi gabo ba la bstod pa/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ arya a tsa la kro dha rā dza sta ba/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi g.yo zhes bya'i khro bo ni/ /ral gri zhags pa legs par thogs/ /spyi bo'i zur phud g.yon du 'khyil/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor 'od la bzhugs/ /klu chen la sogs thams cad kyi/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu brgyan/ /byis pa'i gzugs can 'gying bag can/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan nang na thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir phyi rol khro tshul ston/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag zhal/ /bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo / / thugs rjes dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i sku mchog ni/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag rngam pa'i sku/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bgegs chen du ma gzigs/ skye shi rtsad gcod rno dkar mche ba gtsigs/ /spyan gnyis dmar zlum thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs/ /thugs rje khros pas dbu skra gyen du 'khyil/ /mibaskyod la sogs rigs lngas dbu la brgyan/ /ma rung 'dul zhing 'gro don rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal sna tshogs sku las 'phro/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing / /bde ba dag la rim gyis dgod mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po shin tu thugs rje can/ khyod nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad lags/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad khyod lags pas/ khro rgyal ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed drag po'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ gnyis med rtsi gcig thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag kyang khyod ltar 'gro don bgyi slad du/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bsgom pa gsang sngags bzlas/ /dus rnams rtag tu khro rgyal khyod brten na / / thugs rje chen pos byin gyis brlabs mdzad de/ /ye shes sku mchog mngon sum bstsal nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la gsol/ /sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bdud dgra rnams/ /pha rol 'joms pa'i stobs kyis med par mdzod/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lha mchog khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ dus rnams rtag tu khyod kyis bsrung du gsol/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ paṇḍi ta dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas — /093—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //khu31 khro rgyas 'phags pa mi gaskum ba la ba41da pa/༅/ /༅rgya gar skad du/ ārya a tsa la kro dha rā dza sto tra/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid khro rgyal brtan pa'i sku / / brkyang bskum thabs las byung ba'i khro rgyal dang / /bcas te nam mkha'i 'od kyi dkyil na bzhugs / / tshangs pa la sogs 'bum ni skrag byed pa/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs rnams dang ni/ /klu dang gnod sbyin sha za yi dwags sogs/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus skrag mdzad pa/ khro rgyal khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar bas ma rungs 'dul/ /rnam rtog 'joms phyir rab tu grim pa'i sku/ /sku mdog mthing nag char sprin nag po 'dra/ /dbu skra ardza ka'i 'bras bu 'dra/ /sku ni shing mchog yongs 'du sa rtol 'dra/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyad kyis khros 'gros 'dra/ /lha mchog khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ spyan mig pa la sha yi me tog 'dra/ /mche ba gtsigs pa zla ba tshes pa 'dra/ /ljags 'gyur ba ni nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /smin ma'i khro gnyer bṛ shi'i lo ma 'dra/ /ral gri zla tshes mtshor lhung 'od dang 'dra/ /sprul gyi zhags pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'dra/ /sku yis phyogs skyong dbang sdud ma rungs 'dul/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs dang log 'dren ma lus zhi mdzad cing / /'byung po 'khrugs sogs nad rnams zhi mdzad pa/ /mi dang mi min mtshon chas 'joms mdzad pa / / dus min 'chi dang sdigs pa rnams las grol/ /dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i mi g.yo ste/ /mtshams bzhi nas ni khro bo bzhi po dang / /gru chad phyogs mtshams lha mo brgyad ldan pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku las sprul pa'i khro bo bcu po ni/ /rdo rje shugs can sku mdog mthing nag ste/ /nga dang ngar 'dzin gnam lcags dkyil 'khor bsnams/ /bgegs tshogs skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo / / sprul pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje chags chen ni/ /gdul bya'i don du sku mdog dmar po ste/ /chags dang chags pa'i don du mda' gzhu bsnams/ /ma rungs 'dul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje rnon po ni / / gdul bya'i don du sku mdog ljang khu ste/ /'dzin cing 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid lcags kyu bsnams/ /'gro ba 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba ni/ /sku mdog gangs ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/ /mi shes mi shes 'joms pa'i brag 'dzin pa/ /ma rungs 'dul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje —1094—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /khro bo sku mdog ser po ste/ khro dang khro ba'i bdag nyid ral gri bsnams/ /rnal 'byor bar chod rab tu zhi mdzad pa/khro rgyal stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje gtum chen sku mdog ljang nag ste/ /btang snyoms btang snyoms gyur pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /phyag mtshan phyag na sprin gyi zhags pa rnams/ /'gro ba 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje thabs bdag ni/ /sku mdog ser nag du ba'i mdog 'dra ba/ /bya dang byed pa'i bdag nyid rdza rnga bsnams/ /sgra chen sgrog pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje stobs chen ni/ /sku mdog mthing ga sku gsum rang bzhin can/ /sman pa'i rang bzhin gnam lcags 'khor lo bsnams/ /nyon mongs sel ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i rgyu'i stobs ni dmar nag ste/ /rten 'brel rten cing 'brel pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir phyag na be con bsnams/ /bdud rnams skrag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rab byed sna tshogs 'phrin las kyis/ /'dod chags thams cad thabs las grol ba yi/ /bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje rtse gcig bsnams/ rdo rje rab byed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bstod pa 'di yis bstod byed na/ bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub kun/ /bstod pa sgrub pa rnams la gsol bar 'gyur/ /'di bstod 'di ni mchod byed na / ske/dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ 'phags pa khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ slob dpon chen po dpal dmar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang lo cwa ba dge slong chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ //ge32 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ arya tā rā sto tram̐/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ rje bcun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis/ /zhabs kyi padmo la btud de/ /'phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad cing / /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'bar dra bas khyab pa yi/ /mnar med me yis gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma/ /sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro drug gnas su yun ring du/ /yang dang yang du 'khor ba yi/ /dub pa dag la bde chen gyi/ /bde ba mchog gi ngal gso mdzad / / gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha mo khyod/ /dran pa tsam gyis phong sel ma/ /thugs rje brtse ldan khyod kyis ni / / srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol mdzod/ /dus rnams rtag tu sems can la/ /bu bzhin snyoms pa'i lha mo khyod / / 'gro ba'i lo tog thams cad la/ /char rgyun 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma zla ba ji bzhin du/ /'gro — 1095—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ rje bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /mun pa'i gdung ba sel mdzad ma/ /lha mo mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma zla ba utpa la/ /de bzhin dri med gdan steng du/ /sku mdog sngo ljang 'gying bag can/ /utpal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo / / bskal pa grangs med du mar tshogs bsags shing / /bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa kun spangs nas/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yis 'gro rnams sdud mdzad ma/ /thugs rje dang ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs/ thugs kyi skyon spangasashes bya mtha' dag mkhyen / / bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar nor bu chu dwangs ltar/ /lha mo khyod kyisartag par ni/ /'gro ba'i sems rtog sel mdzad cing / /'gro don brtson la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis khyod kyi mtshan bzung zhing / /bstod dang sgrub pa byas pa rnams/ /rtag tu 'bras bu yod par mdzad/ /mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ rje bcun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ di paṃ ka ra shri dzñā nas mjad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo cwa ba chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //ngu33 tshogasabadag chagasapa rdo rje la bstod pa/byu/ /rgya gar skad du/ arya ga ṇa pa ti rā ga baju sa ma ya sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa chegs/ kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje'i dam tshig gi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rje bcun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan zhi ba ste/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan khro bo che/ /che 'di nyid la dngos grub ni/ /ci 'dod par ni stsal bar mdzod/ /lha'i rgyal po'i mnga' thang ni/ /sgrub pa po la stsol bar mdzad/ /shin tu thugs rje'i bdag nyid la/ /tshogs bdag chen po thugs rje che/ /thugs rje chen pos dbul ba skyabs/ /nor lha chen po khyod nyid la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan tshogs bdag chen po ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /glang chen byi la spre'u'i zhal/ /la phug ral gri rin/ chen dang / /chang snod la du dgra sta 'dzin/ /brkyang bskum skyil krung yum steng bzhugs/ /zhal nang rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /sgrub pa po yi dbul ba sel/ /gsus rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag la'o/ /chang dang la du la phug dang / /'bras chan khur ba'i gtor ma bzhes/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /nad dang 'byung ba zhi bar mdzod / / mi dang 'byung po gnod sbyin bdud/ /thams cad bran du 'gyur bar shog /lha yi longs spyod mang po las / / 'dod pa'i yon tan 'byung bar shog /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang phyug can/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis sku /096—

sngags phyogs blo sbya ri ge skor bzhugs so//sprul ba//lha chen tshogs bdag chen po ste//'jig rten 'dir yang bsrung ba dang //byang chung thob pa'i grogs mdzod cigaces bstod la gsol ba gdab ste bzlas pa thon nas gtor dbul bar bya'o//tshogs kyi bdag po chags pa rdo rje dam tshig gi bstod pa paṇḍi ta di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so//paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang /lo tsā ba chul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur pa'o//— //rtsa34nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga la bstod pa dbyig gi char 'bebs/༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ba su pa ti u pa dhya pañtsa tra ba su me gha a be sha nā ma/bod skad du/nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i bstod pa dbyig gi char 'bebs zhes bya ba/'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo / / e ma 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bdag sku spul 'phags pa ni//gti mug rnam/ dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid//zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra gyen brdzes nor bus brgyan//sha rgyas gsus 'phyang sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas bklubs//phyag g.yas be con 'jin pas 'jig rten dbang du sdud/g.yon pa rne'u le 'ardzen pas longs spyod char bzhin 'bebs//sku mdog dkar la dam/ra ba'i mdangs chags 'brug la chibs//sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal bstod//g.yon gyi gru cho/ra rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ bsnams pa ni//nyid kyi sku la gnyis med 'khril ba'i yum mchog mtshon//spyan gsum khro gnyer cung zad bsdus pa zhi khre'i chul/yid la re ba'i 'bras bu sbyin la phyag 'tshal bstod//shar du zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku//rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma//g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa rten 'brel rdzab rnams 'dzin//bgegs rigs kun 'joms rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod//lho ru ser sna rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku//rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa nor bu g.yon pa rin chen bum pa bsnams/dbyig gi char 'bebs rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod//nub du 'dod chags rnams dag kun rtog ye shes sku//padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma//g.yas pa padma g.yon pa 'gugs byed lcags kyu bsnams//'gro rnams dbang sdud padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod//byang du phra dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku//las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma//g.yas pa rgya gram g.yon pa rne'u le'i rkyal pa /097

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bsnams / / las kun 'grub byed sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces mar me mdzad ye shes kyis nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga zhal gzigs pa'i dus su bstod pa/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta chen po de nyid dang lo tsā ba chen po brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o// //chu35 rtsa ba'i lhung ba'i rgya cher 'grel ba dang / dam tshig thamasacad bsdusapa bya ba zhus/'a(the(/ /༄tsho/ dze/rgya gar skad du/ mū la pa ti ṭī kā/ bod skad du/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel ba/ 'phagasam sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ltung ba bcu bzhi po ni skyus su bsdebs pa bdun te/ bdun po de dag la lhung ba'i ngo bo bdun dang / rgyu bdun dang / dngos bcu bzhi zung phral na bcu bzhi po tshan tshan gsum mo/ /de la ltung ba dang po dang gnyis pa'i ngo bo dang rgyu gcig ste/ bla ma la brnyas pa nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pa ste/ de yang bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad par ni mi brtag go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /desan rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / bla ma tha mi dad pa'i phyir lhung ba gnyis ngo bo gcig go /brtas pa'i yul bla ma de yang thun mong gi lam 'khor ba yid la byas pa 'di las blo log pa byas na shes shing byas pa gzo ba la brten nas byams pa dang snying rje brtan par byas pa de nyid kyi stobs las byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ snying rje med pa khro la 'dugakhengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang / /spyoms dang bcas par mi bya'o zhes gsungs pas thun mong gi lam gyi mi mthun pa de rnams log nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gnas nyid dbang bzhi'i sgo nas lta ba dang / spyod pa dang sgom pa gsum gyi man ngag dang ldan pa de yang dang du goms par byas yon tan dang brtan zhing dul la bla gros ldan/ bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med / / sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying rjer ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes / / dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes/ /rab tu zhi dang dbang po dul/ /zhes bya bas de ltar yon tan bcu bzhi dang ldan pa rnam gnyisagrub par gnas pa'i don dang / nges par grub pa'i thabs lnga dang / spyod pa rnam gnyis dang / dbang rnam pa bzhi'i man ngag dang ldan pa'i grub pa thob pa'i tshig gis nyams dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa nye bar bsten pa'i sgo nas slob —1098—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ma de rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya ba dang / 'jug rdzogs pa'i sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan par bya ba ste/ 'og na mnyam par batheg pas bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod byas la/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de bzung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma des dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la bya ba dang /skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byams pa dang snying rje'i sgo nas byang chub tu sems brtan par byas/ 'jug sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa la dbang bzhi'i snod du bsgrubs nas lta spyod sgom pa gsum gyi man ngag dang ldan par sgrub pa de'i phyir ro/ /de nas sngags sogs sbyin pa yis/ /dam chos snod du byas nas so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro / / de bla ma la rag las pas dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs par / / shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes bya ba de lta bu'i bla ma des rtag tu phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas byin te byed dngos grub thams cad kyi rag las pa yin pas de'i phyir/ gdan gdab pa dang ldang ba dang / don gyi bya sogs/ bsnyen bkur zhes pa dang / bla ma las ni dngos grub dang / /mtho ris dang ni thar pa thob/ /ces pa nas mdun du dul bas 'dug par bya zhes bya ba'i bar du bya ba mtha' dag dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis ma yengs par bya ba'i tshul gyis bla ma bsten par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bla ma la brnyas na sangs rgyas thams cad la brnyas pa ste/ de 'dra'i mgon la bsam bcas pas/ /slob mar gyur nas brnyas na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na/ /des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob ces pa nas der ni gnas pa yang dag shes zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis / / rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge ba yongs su mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa de ni rtsa ba'i lhung ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid do/ /sbyor ba la sogs pa ni phal cher bla ma gser gling ba la sogs pa'i bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /lhung ba de gnyis kyi rgyu ni bla ma grub pa thob pa'i tshig gis nyams dang bral ba rnams dang 'phrad pa'i dbang gis lam gyi snod du ma gyur ma bsgrubs par/ dbang la sogs pa byas kyang / rtsa ba ma brtan pa'i dbang gis nges pa dran par ma nus shing / nges pa med pa'i phyir bla ma gtso bo mi byed de/ de phyir slob dpon brnyas pa la sogs pa thams cad 'byung ste/ de ni log par bstan cing bsgrub ces bya ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i sbyangs pa gang yang med par dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag bstan du zin kyang rtsa ba med pa'i dbang gis rgyur du 'jigs pa nges par phyung ngo / /de bas na de nyid ni bka' 'das dang gnyis kyi rgyu yin pas na/ gnya' na pi ti las/ rang nyid kyi lam mthong bas/ /ji ltar bzhin du gzhan dag 'dren/ /log pa — 1099—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/gnyis ni 'grogs gyur na/ /gnyis ka lhung bar the tshom med ces pa dang / /yang sdig pa can gyi lam de yid//bgrod pa nyams par thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bla ma dang ma dang / la bstan par bya/ sbun la nyes pa brjod pa dang / byams pa sbong ba gnyis lhung ba'i ngo bo gcig la de 'byung ba'i rgyu yang gcig ste/ de'i rgyu ni sngon du thun mong gi lam byams snying rje ma sbyangs pas sems can la phan 'dogs pa dang bcas par 'dzin pa'i blo med / de'i dbang gis snod cing gnon pa la sogs pa'i rkyen phra mo mi bzod de/ de'i phyir spun la nyes pa brjod cing sems can la byams pa spong ba des de nyid ngo bo gcig de gzhan la gnod par 'dra bsaso/ /byang chub sems spong dang grub pa'i mtha' smod pa gnyis rgyud dang ngo bo gcig ste/ rgyu ni sems pa dang snying rje'i stobs kyis byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas par blangs su zin yang ma brten de/ de yang thams cad la ni lhag pa'i gnas/ /gang du thams cad 'jigs pa ste/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du yang / /yang dag bskyod pa'i dge ba che/ /byang chugresems ni skyed pa yis/ /bsod nams tshogasani gsags pasaso/ /bskal pa bye ba 'byung ba ni/ /skad cig nyid la rnam par 'jig /de bas don gsung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs zhes 'byung bas/ byang chub sems de spang ba dang / spangs pa'i tshad dang de'i nyesapa'o/ /spang ba ni gsum ste/ bla ma ma bsten nas dang / spun la brten nas dang / sems can la brten nasaspong ba'o/ /tshad ni bsten gsum po de dag la brten nas nyon mongs pa'i bsam pas g.yo rgyu la sogs pas nyin mtshan cha ci rigs par 'das pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba brtsad nas 'byin pa ni nyes pa'o/ /g.yin gyi byang chub kyi semasakyi bar chad byas na yang nyes pa che bar shes par bya'o/ /de la rang gi theg pa chen po chen po gnyis so/ /gzhan ni nyan thos kyi'o/ /smod pa ni gong ma ltar mi sbyong zhing smad pa ste/ rang mi gnas shing gzhan mi 'jug pa'o/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa dang phung po smad po gnyis rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/ rigs kyis ma sbyangasapa'i phyir snod du ma gyur pa la gsang ba'i don grub pa'i gnas pa'i don rnam gnyis la sogs pa brtan pas/ phung po lha'i bdag nyid la sogs pa bskyed pa'i go rim spong bsargyu dang po gcig go /de yang lha'i gzugs ni bsgoms pa la sems kyi brtson pa dag la ni/ /glegs bam tsam yang bstan pa ni/ /spyin par mi bya shes bya ste/ /rdo rje ye shes rab spong ba / / meongs pa dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yi dmyal ba rgyu gyur pa/ /mi de'ang dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur//de dang bdag gzhan phung ba ni/ /'byung bas nges par bsrung bar bya/ /zhes so/ /chos la yid gnyisaza ba dang / /sdug la byams sems gnyis rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/ de yang sems can thams cad rang bzhin dag par 'od gsal ba dang zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du gcig nga/ 'a// nge nyid the tshom za ste/ 'khor ba dang zhi ba'i — // (/—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /phyag rgya chen po zung du ma gtogs pa'i dbang gis gdug pa can de gnod cing mod pa la sogs pa byang chub kyi rkyen du byung ba la brdeg pa la sogs pa la drag shul gyi sbyor bas ngan pa ma yin par bsgrubs pas rgyu dang ngo bo gcig go /ming sogs bral ba'i chos la der rtog pa dang / dad ldan sems sun 'byin pa rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/ming la sogs pa bral ba ni grub pa'i gnas pa'i don nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang / dngos po dang mtshan mar brtag pa'i rgyud de la dad pa'i sems can dbang po rab dang ldan pa rnams sun 'byin pa ste/ma zhugs pa la mi 'jug pa zhugs pa bzlog cing bstan par mi byed pas so/ /dam tshig mi brten pa dang shes rab smod pa gnyis kyang / bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig mi brten pa ni/ shes rab smod pa'i rgyu yin te / de la smod pa nyid de spong ba'i rgyu'o/ /des na dang por bla ma grub pa thob pa tshig gi nyams dang brtags la legs par blang gi gzhan du ma yin no/ /de nas bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs pa dam tshig nyams gyur pas / / dpa' bos dang po slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i 'brel ba brtags par bya zhes pas so/ /de lhung ba de rnams las 'das pas na nyes pa brten pa ni slob dpon la smod pa de zhes pa ni mtshon pa'i don te/ lhung ba gzhan la yang nyes pa 'dra bar shes par bya ba'i lci yang ni yod de/ de nyid ni sems dang zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go /rgyal po me dang zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go /de'i phyir nam yang tshigs su bcad pa gsum mo/ /gal te gnas pa'i sgo nas nyams na bla ma'i spyan sngar maṇḍal la sogs pas mchod la nyes pa ming gis bshags te phyis bsdam zhing bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi bla gnyis 'gyur du bslab ste/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'i phyir bla ma la zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go /de bzhin du ltung ba lhag ma rnams kyang bsam pa'i bye brag gis bskang bar bya'o/ /de nas dang por bla ma legs par brtag cing legs par bsten la de nas snod du bsgrub par gsol ba gdab des kyang rjes su brtse ba'i sgo nas snod du bsgrubs te/ dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / /lha dang bla ma la brten du gzhug go /de nas thun mong ba'i skyabs 'gro la brten nas / / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa brtan du gzhug /de nas khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro la brten nas byang chub sems brtan du gzhug de nas 'jug pa'i sdom pa legs par byin nas dbang bzhi'i sgo nas lta spyod sgom gsum gyi rtog pa bsgrub pa'o/ /de nas rtogs pa dang mthun pa'i lam la sbyar te/ de yang dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dus su bla ma dang lha dang tha mi dad pa la tshogs bsags pas ltung ba dang po'i rgyud spang go rims de rnams dbang po rab kyis chos thams cad zung 'jug tu rtogs pa bsgrub pa'i thabs su shes par bya ba'i phyin ci ma log pas lhung ba gnyis pa dang / bdun pa dang brgyad pa dang drug pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i rgyu spangs/ thun mong —1101 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ma yin pa'i lam rnal 'byor dang bdag dang gnas bsrung bas lhung ba gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang dgu pa dang bcu pa'i rgyu spangs de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa la brten nas chos thams cad 'od gsal du rtogs pa bsgrubs nas bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig brten pas bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa dang bcu gcig pa'i rgyu spangs/ yang na lha la gsang ba dang shes rab dang bzhi pa blangs pasabacu bzhi pa dang bcu gsum pa'i rgyu spangs/ de ltar na bcu bzhi po rnams mnyam bzhag gi las kyi rim pa la 'dusapas rjes kyis kyang de'i bdag nyid du bya dgos pa'i nges pa bskyed cing brtan par bya'o/ /dngos bzhi'i dbang du byas nas lhung ba re re la lhung ba'i ngos 'dzin dang / rkyen gang gis byung ba dang nyes pa dang / tshul ji lta ba mi 'byin pa'i thabs so/ /bde gshegs bka' ni 'khor ba'i nyes pa nas byas shes dang byas gzo dang / byamasasnying rje dang 'jug pa'i sdom pa'i bar du brtan par bya ba dang / khyad par can dbang rnam pa banyis snod du bsgrubs nas lta ba la sogs pa'i man ngag gi bde gshegs kyi bka'o/ /'das pa ni ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / mi shes pa dang /nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis so/ /des na bla ma'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa brtan par mi byed par nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das pa ni lhung ba'o/ /rkyen ni ma dad pa la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /nyes pa ni sngar yams dang / zhesapa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi ste/ bla ma'i skabs su bka' las 'das pa dang shes rab smod pa thekhi/re re la sbyar ro / / mi 'byung ba'i thabs ni bla mas bstan pa'i lam dran pa dang / shes bzhin gyis mar me dang chu'i rgyun ltar yid la bya'o/ /spun ni sbyor ba gcig pa dang de las gzhan pa dang sems can mtha' dag go /nyes pa brjod pa'i yul las brda phrad cing nyin mtshan gyi sum cha 'das na lhung ba'o/ /rkyen ni yul gsum po gang yang rung bas sems dang mthun par ma byas pa dang / mi byed pa'i dbang gis zhe sdang dang phrag dog gam nyon mongs pa gang yang rung ba dang / mtshungs par khro ba'o/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni khro bo'i rkyen nye bar gnasapa'i tshe byas pa shes pa la sogs pa byams pa yid la bya ba dang / yang na chos thams cad skye med du yid la bya'o/ /byams pa ni byas pa shes pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa'o/ /spong ba ni phan pa ma yin par bsgrub pas nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das na lhung ba'o/ /rkyen ni gong ma ltar yul gsum la brten nasabadag gi bsam pa dang mthun par mi byed pa dang / ma byas pa'i dbang gisaphan pa ma yin pa bsgrub cing spong ba'o/ /mi 'byung ba'i thabs ni rkyen nye bar gnas pa'i dus de la ched du gtang ba'i tshul gyis byams pa yid la bya ba'am zung du 'jug pa shes par bya'o/ /byang chub ni semasacan gyi don du rdo rje 'chang 'dod pa'o/ /de spong ba ni yul gyi dbang gis gsum ste/ bla ma dang rdo rje sbun dang sems can la g.yo sgyu spyod pas yon tan thob par bya snyam —1102—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /pa dang / don dor bas nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni snga ma ltar ro/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni mi mthun pa'i rkyen nye bar gnas pa'i dus su phan yon dang nyes dmigs shes pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o / / yang na skye ba med par yid la bya'o/ /rang gi grub pa'i mtha' ni theg pa chen po rnam pa gnyis so/ /gzhan gyi ni nyan thos dang bse ru'o/ /he badzra 'dus pa'i le'u ltar rim gyis mi sbyong bar smod pas nyin mtshan 'das pa'o / /rkyen ni bla ma tshiganyams dang bral ba rnams dang 'phrad pas lam rim gyis sbyor ba rnams smod cing khro ba'o / / mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni blo rim gyis bslabs pas theg pa gcig tu shes par bya'o/ /yongs su ma smin pa ni lam rim gyis ma sbyangs pa'o/ /gsang ba ni drug pa gnas pa'i don nam mkha' dang 'dra bar lta ba gnyis so/ /sgrog pa ni lus ngag gi sbyor bas nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen ni ma sbyangs pa dang phrad pa'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni yul de lta bu dang phrad pa na blo'i bye brag dris nas de dang mthun par bya'o / / phung po smod pa ni bskyed pa'i go rim mtha' dag bzung ngo / /smod pa ni de mi bsgom par nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen ni zab mo ston pa'i lung dang yongs su 'dzin pa ngan pa las so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni lha bsgoms pa'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa ni lta ba gnyis so/ /som nyi zla ba ni de gnyis kyi rtog pa ma skyes pa'o / / de'i bdag nyid du rtogs pa med par nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen bla ma dam pa dang bral bas dngos por lta ba'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni bla ma dam pa'i ngag la brten nas lta ba go nus par bya'o / / gdug pa can ni mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams so/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dbang gis zhe sdang gis bslangs nas phan pa ma yin pa drag po byed pas nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen ni nges par byas dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni bzod pa bsgom pa ste/ bdud phyir bzlog pa'i lung las shes par bya'o/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos ni 'od gsal ba dang zung du 'jug pa'o/ /de rtogs pa ni de nyid kyi rang bzhin dang mi mthun par gzhan du rtog pas nyin mtshan 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma 'phrad pa'o/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni de'i gdams pa las so/ /dad ldan ni lam rim gyis ma sbyangs kyang grub par gnas pa'i don la 'dod pa'o / / sun 'byin pa ni ma bstan pa dang log par bstan pa'o/ /rkyen ni mos pa'i gang zag dang 'phrad pas so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni rtogs pa dang sbyar te chos bstan pa'o/ /dam tshig ni bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'o/ /mi brten pa ni mi gtsang ba'i blos dor te/ dus 'dasapa'o/ /rkyen ni rdzas nye bar gnas pa'o/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabasani mi rtog pa'i sems kyis so/ /nyesapa 'di rnams lci yang yod kyang gnod pa ni 'dra'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na rtsa ba'i lhung ba yin pas so/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs na ni/ /dngos grub nges — /103—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/par thob par 'gyur zhes bya ba ni spang bya spangs pa'i yon tan no/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ nyams pas bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur/ de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro zhes bya ba ni nyams pa'i nyes pa mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya zhes bya ba ni bag bya ba la bslab par ro/ /dbang bskur nas balhung ba bcu bzhi pa dang bla ma lnga cu pa gang 'dod pa'i sgrub thabs dag ni don rgyas par ston pa yin pas nges par nan tan gyis brlabs pa ste gzhan du na bla ma'i nyes pa'o/ /de ltar bcu bzhi po bsdusan gsum ste/ thun mong gi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa dang / khyad par gyi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa dang / de gnyis ka mi nyams par byed pa'o/ /ltung ba dang po dang gnyis pa ni/ gnyis ka mi nyams par byed pa'o/ /spun la khro ba dang / byamasapa spongs ba dang / byang chub sems 'dor ba dang / grub pa'i mtha' smod pa dang / gdug la byams pa spong ba ste/lnga papo de dag ni thun mong gi sems mi nyams par byed pa ste/ de bsan 'bad pas bsrung ngo / /gsang ba sgrogs pa dang / phung po smod pa dang / dag pa'i chos la yid gnyis dang / ming sogs bral la der rtog dang / sems sun 'byin dang / dam tshig mi brten pa dang / shes rab smod pa de rnams spangs pas khyad par gyi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'o/ /yang de ni lta spyod sgom gsum gyi rang bzhin yang yin te/ chos la yid gnyis dang / ming sogs bral ba de rtog spangs pas lta ba rnam gnyisartogasapa'o/ /dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang drug pa dang bdun pa dang brgyad pa dang bcu pa'i dgu spangs pas sgom pa'i man ngag dang / sems sun 'byin pa dang / dam tshig mi brten pa dang / shes rab smod pa dang / gsum gyis dgu spangs shing spyangs pas spyod pa'o/ /de gsum spangs par bsgoms pas bka' 'das dang / bla ma brnyas pa ma spangs pa yin no/ /de bas na bcu dang bzhi dang lnga cu la nan tan yang dang yang du bya ste dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyams na nyes pa thams cad kyang 'byung ngo / /de ltar ma yin par sngags tshig tsam gyis man ngag bstan nas/ bla ma khas che ba lhung ba'i snod du bsgrubasami dge rgyu byas pa bas/ mi dge ba'i bdag po'i rkyen zhes bya ba/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang / bdud sdig can dang / slu bar byed pa zhesabya ba ste skyon mang du mi brjod do/ /de lta bu'i bla ma dang slob ma de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasakyi chosakyi phung po rnams rnyed pa dang bkur bsti'i rgyud bsgrubs pas ngan song bsgrubs pas ngan song bsgrub pa'i thabs dang rkyen des dug dang bdud rtsi 'dres pa dang 'dra'o/ de bas na bla ma dam pa bsten pa gcesapar rdo rje 'chang chen posagasungs so/ /dam pa'i grogs dang bla ma dang / /ma phrad srid par 'khyamasapa las/ phan phyir bla ma'i lung — //()4—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /bzhin du/ /bris pas de dag la phan shog /'di mthong tsam gyis skye bo rnams chos la nan tan byed pa'i rgyur / / gyur nas bla mar gtso bor byed cing / bsgrub la nan tan byed pa'i rgyur/ /skal ngan skye bo rnams dang phrad pa na/ /rang skyon dbang gis smod par byed mod kyi/ drang srong chen po'i lung ni su zhig spong / de phyir de dag la'ang snod ma gyur/ gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa rnam bslab pa'i phyir/ /gsal byed man ngag bgod pa'o/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bslab pa gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba'i 'grel ba/mkhas pa chen po dī paṃ ka ra shri rnya na'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/ paṇḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsa ba dge glong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //re36 dam ཿga thamasacad bsdusapa/rgya gar skad du /sarba pa ma ya sang gra ha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /eo āḥhūm̐ rdo rje mi phyed gsum bdag nyid / / dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje la/ /btud de gsang sngags theg pa'i gzhung / /rgyud las gsungasapa bri bar bya / / byang chung sems dpa' gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pas/ 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /theg pa chen po'i yang po ni/ 'og ma rnams las khyad par du 'phags te/ ji ltar zhe na/ 'di skad du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas / thams cad chos kyi skur rtogs pas kun tu bzang po'i rgyas thebs pa/ 'jig rten gyi lha chen po dam tshig can 'khor dang bcas pas bkur gnas byed pas byin gyis brlabs dang ldan pa dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas thugs la dgongs shing / byin gyis brlabs pas dngos grub myur ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa rnams dang spyod yul cig pas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa dang bral zhing dbugs phyin pa dang / rdo rje byang chub sems dang ldan zhing sku dang gsung dang thugs mi phyed pas/ bar du gcod pa gang yang med pa dang / phyi nang thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par yid ches pas/ dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang / gal te nyams na yang / rang gi rtsal gyis bskongs par 'gyur ba'i khyad par ro/ /yang slob dpon chen po ind+ra bo dhi'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i khyad par dang / snod kyi khyad par dang / cho ga'i khyad par dang / las kyi khyad par dang / dam tshig gi khyad par dang / lta ba'i khyad par dang / spyod pa'i khyad par dang bdun gyis 'phags zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon ye shes 'khas kyi zhal snga nas/ sngags kyi theg pa ni rnam pa —1105—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gsum gyis thun mong ma yin te/ 'di ltar sgrub pa po dang / lam dang / 'bras bu gsum mo zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon tri bi ta ka ma'i zhal snga nas ni/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi bstan bcos khyad par 'phags zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon ḍosdi he ru ka'i zhal nas kyang / 'dir ni snod kyi khyad par dang / snod du byed pa'i khyad par cho ga dang /gzhung dang lam gyi khyad par dang / 'brabashabu dag gi khyad par gyis/ sngagaba'ikyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ ceXgagasungs pa dang / g.yin yang slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i zhal snga nasakyang / gsang sngags theg pa ni/ theg pa chen po yin te/ 'di ltar rten gyi gang zag gi khyad par dang / 'jug pa lam gyi khyad par dang mthar thug pa'i khyad par dang / mngon par 'byung ba'i khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungasaso/ /slob dpon ratna a ka ra shan ti ba'i zhal snga nas/ 'di dmigs pa rnams par dag pa dang / grogs kyi mthu dang spyod pa yis/ /gro ldan rnams kyi theg pa ni/ /theg pa po nyid du bsgrubs/ /zhesagasungs so/ /bdag gi bla ma rje btsun dam tshig rdo rje'i zhal nas ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las/ theg pa 'di gong du gyur pa yin te/ bla ma dang dbang bskur ba dang / dam tshig dang / man ngag dang / brtson 'grus kyisakhyad par du 'phagasapasaso zhesagasungasaso/ /de las 'dir dam tshig 'ba' zhig brjod par bya ste/ dam tshig ni sngags pa rnams kyi gnad kyi gnasasu gyur pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi lo tog skye ba'i sagazhir gyur pa yin pasade bri bar bya'o/ /dam tshig de gang su zhes na/ rten dang rgyu dang / rtsa ba dang / ngo bo dang / ngesapa'i tshig dngabyu/ dbye ba dang / ming gi rnam grangasadang / rkang grangasadang / brda dang / bdud dang / dgra dang / nyams pa'i tshad dang/ nyamasapa'i rtagasadang / bskang ba dang / bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / skong ba dang / ma nyamasapa'i rtagasadang / bsdusapa'i dam tshig dang / nyams pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ma nyams pa'i phan yon dang / 'brasabu rnams so/ /de la rten ni theg pa chen po'i rigs can skyabs su 'gro ba gnyis sngon du song na bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa / dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur thob pa'o/ /de la rgyu ni byang chub kyi sems so/ /rtsa ba ni snying rje'o / /ngo bo ni ngo tsha shesapa dang / khrel yod pa dang / snying rje dang / shesarab dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i shesapa'i rgyun yin no/ /ngesapa'i tshig ni rtogasapa'i phyir ram/ mnyam pa nyid du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /thob cing 'gro ba'i phyir ram mi 'dra ba'i phyir ram mo/ /de la dbye ba ni/ rtsa ba dang / sbom po dang / yan lag gi sgo nasadabye ba dang / bsrung ba dang / sgrub pa'i sgo nasadabye ba dang / spyod pa dang / lta ba'i sgo nasadabye ba dang / spyi dang khyad par dang / lhag pa'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas dbye gredang / rag —1106—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /pa dang / phra ba'i sgo nas dbye ba dang / bsrung bar bya ba dang / nyams su blangs pa dang spyad par bya ba dang / spyod lam dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /de la ming gi rnam grangs ni/ dam tshig dang / sdom pa dang /brtul zhugasadang / spyod yul dang / dka' spyod dang / spyod pa dang / tshul khrims las sogs/ de'i rkang grangs ni / thun mong gi rtsa ba'i lhung ba bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu gnyis dang / kri ya'i lhung ba bcu gsum dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi dang / rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi dang / yang lnga dang / yang bzhi dang / rtsa ba'i lhung ba bdun cu tham pa'o/ /de la yan lag gi dam tshig rnams ni 'di rnams so/ /zhes bgrang bar mi nus te/mdo sde dang / mngon pa dang / 'dul ba dang / rgyud sde dang de rnams su lta bar bya'o/ /de la dam tshig gi brda ni/ ji skad du/ mi shigs pa ni seng ge ste/ gcan gzan rgyal po yin pas so/ /za ma tog ni rgyal mo'i mdzod / dug spyod pa ni der mi rigs/ rin chen myu gu lcug phran dang / breg ste dbyung rgyun bcad mi bya/ /gangasakyi zhun chu phal ba dag /mkhas pas btung bar mi bya'o/ /pad ma'i ze 'bru kha ma dbye/ /zla zer ma yin dbye mi bya / / ma brtags bug rtol can snod du/ /bdud rtsi sman blugs zag par 'gyur/ /don med bcos ma'i tshul brtags can/ /bsrel zhing spyad par bya ba min/ khrel dkar rin chen sgong nga dag /'dam rdzab khung du bsnub mi bya/ /seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma dag /gser snod ma yin blugs mi bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /bsreg par bya ba yong ma yin/ khyung chen gshog pa gar brkyang ba/ /de dag gcig par bya ma yin/ /gnam lcags mo yi dur ma dag /rdo rje brag chen gtams pa yin/ /gzhig par bya ba ga la yin/ /bud shing bsregs pa'i sgron ma des/ /'thor rlung drag pos bskyod mi bya/ /rdo rje tshig gi chu rgyun dag /'ol dgar gcag par bya ba min / / rgyal po'i bka' rtags phyag rgya dag /nam yang zhig par mi bya'o/ /gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu'i de/ /rgyal mtshan rtse las dbog mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / bza' ba'i dam tshig kyang brdas gsungs te / dpal dgyesapa'i rdo rje las/ tsa u sa ma kastu ri/ sahla ga pur/ 'ba' la zhes pa dang / snyomasa'ajug gi dam tshig kyang / bo la ka ko la/ kun tu tu zhes gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi yang brdas gsungasate / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ ri bong can dang mig dang yon tan rigs byed dang / mda' dang dbang po ri dang bkris gza' phyogs dang / drag po nyi ma yan lag rnams yin te zhes gsungs pa ste lta bu ste/ de la dam tshig gi bdud ni rnam rtog 'khrig pa'i bdud dang btang snyoms le lo'i bdud dang / longs spyod g.yeng ba'i bdud dang / tshig rtsub mtshon cha'i bdud dang / khro gtum zhabrug pa'i bdud do/ /de la dam tshig gi dgra ni/—1107

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gsang ba 'phel bas bcas kar song ba'i dgra dang / chos log par spyod pa bar chad 'ong ba'i dgra dang / rtsa ba byung bas chad pa chen byung ba'i dgra dang / sgrub pa la mi brtson pas dge ba 'phrog pa'i dgra'o/ /de la dam tshig nyams pa'i tshad ni gnyis te/ nyams pa che chung gi tshad dang / dus kyi tshad do/ /de la nyams pa tshechung gi tshad ni / kun tu nyams pa dang chen po dang / rtsa ba nyamasadang / yan lag nyamasapa dang / zlasanyamasapa dang / zhal nyamasapa'o/ /de la dang po bla ma'i dam tshig ni/ de dkrongasapa dang / de la tshon la sogasapa brgyad pa dang / sku la smad pa dang / 'khus pa dang / brnyas pa dang / 'khon pa dang / bka' bcag pa dang / ngan semasadang phyos sems pa'o/ /rdo rje spun pho mo'i dam tshig ni/ de gsang ba dang / 'khrus pa dang / rdzoogs pa dang /nar rdzas dang / chung ma la sags pa 'phrags pa dang / skag kha dang / ngar dga' dang / nang du bar kha dang /brnyas pa dang / mtshang brusapa dang / ngan sems dang / 'khon pa dang / brtse dung med pa la sogs pa'o / / gzhan byang chub kyi sems gtan spangasapa ni kun nas nyamasapa dang chen po'o/ /de la rtsa ba'i lhung ba/bdun bcu las bla ma dang rdo rje spun dang / byang chub kyi sems ma gtogs pa drug cu rtsa gsum nyamarsāpa dang /gzhan yang rang gi dbang ma thob par/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang / mi shes par dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang /rab gnas dang / sbyin sreg dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lor zhugasapa dang / gsang sngags rang shes su bla ma med par spyod pa dang / thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor chag pa dang / lha dang bla ma mchod pa dus su chag pa dang / mi dge bcu dang mtshams med pa dang nye ba'i mtshamasamed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa dang / rang gi gsang bar bya ba bzhi po bag med par smra ba dang / ngo tsha dang khrel med pas/ sdig pa ci la yang mi 'dzem pa rnams so/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba zhig ral du 'gyur ro/ /de la rtsa ba'i yan lag du gyur pa yan lag gi lhung ba bdun/ bco lnga la sogs pa sngags kyi rgyud la sogs pa nas gsungs pa ji snyed pa rnams dang /gzhan yang sku gzugs dang po ti dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / nor bu 'dzoms pa dang / 'tshong ba dang / bgong ba dang / mchog tu yi dam lha'i sku dang / glegasabam dang / phyag rgya rnamasabyin pa dang / 'tshong ba la sogasapa rnams ni yan lag gi lhung ba zhig ral du 'gyur ro/ /de la byang chub kyi semasagatan spangs te/ rtsa ba mang du byas pa ni kun tu nyamasapa chen po'o/ /de ma shor yang rtsa ba'i nyes pa gcig gam/ 'ga' 'byung ba ni rtsa ba nyamasapa'o/ /rtsa ba ma shor yang nyes pa gzhan byung bani yan lag nyamasapa'o/ /bla ma ngan pa dang / grogasangan pasanyesapa byung ba ni zlas nyamasapa'o/ /mi shesapa dang / ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / nyon mongasapa che bas nyes pa byung ba ni/ zhal la nyamasapa'o/ /de la dus kyi nyams pa ni/ btson pa rab kyis nyes pa byung ba'i —//08—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /rjes de nyid la ma bskangs na nyams so/ /rab kyi 'bring gis snga dre/ nyi ma phyed dang / phyed kyi dgong kha dang / de bzhin du dus gsum ma bskongs na nyams so/ /rab kyi tha ma ni nyin gyi nyes pa mtshan mo la/ mtshan mo'i nyes pa nyin par ma bskangs na nyams so/ /'bring gi rab dang / 'bring gi 'bring gi tha ma/ zhag bdun dang / dus khyad par can zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tshun chad du ma bskangs na nyams so/ /tha ma'i rab dang / tha ma'i 'bring dang / tha ma'i tha ma ni/ zla ba gcig dang / zla ba bdun dang / zla ba bcu gcig tshun chad du ma bskangs na nyams so/ khren tu dman pas kyang skye ba 'di la nyes pa 'dus pa dang / 'chi khar ma bskangs na yang / de skong na/ nyams so/ /de las dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags ni/ gdung sha ri ram dang / khrol ma khrol dang / rmi lam dang /bar chad mang nyung las brtag par bya'o/ /de la dam tshig bskang greni/ so sor dang thun mong gi'o/ /de la so sor bskang ba ni/ spyad pa rlabs po che/ tsha tsha dang sbyin bsreg dang / gtor ma dang yan lag bdun pa dang chos spyod bcu dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / nye'u 'don pa dang / dge 'dun la chos ston yon dang bcas pa dang / gra chen/ po bzhi gzugs pa dang / gzungs 'uri pa ra can dang / rang gi lha'i snying po bzlas brjod bya ba dang / 'bum phrag lnga dang / khri phrag lnga dang / sko nga sre ga gsum dang / stong phrag lnga dang / brgya phrag gsum dang / brgya phrag lnga dang / bcu phrag gsum dang / bcu phrag lnga dang / nyi shu rtsa lnga gcig ste/ nyams pa chen po la sogs pa lnga dang / rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig nyams na/slar yang dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya ba dang / rdo rje spun gyi dam tshig nyams na/ tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang ba la sogs te/ nyes pa so sor bskang ba'i thabs/ so sor ji skad bshad pa bzhin du bskang bar bya'o/ /de la thun mong gi bskang ba ni/ gshags pa dang / gso ba dang / sbyang ba dang / slar bslang ba'o/ /gzhan yang gong du bshad pa'i dge rtsa'i las kyis bskang ba dang / don gyi bskang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis bskang ba dang /gsang ba'i thabs kyis bskang ba'o/ /de la dang po ni gong du bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni bla ma spyan drangs nas rin po che rdzas khyad par can phul nas nyes pa bshags te/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ rdzas de dag slar ba'i tshul du bla ma las dam tshig bslu bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar rnam par dag par bsgom pa dang / chos zab mo mnyan pa dang / bsam pa dang / bklag pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / de la brtag pa dang / bri ba dang gzhan la sbyin par bya ba'o/ /de la bzhi pa ni/ sdig pa bkru ba dang / sdig bsreg pa dang /sdig pa gtong ba dang / dam tshig can rdo rjer bsgoms nas ting nge 'dzin gyisabaskang ba'o/ /de la lnga pa ni bla ma la rdzas dang / rang gi chung ma phul te/ gsang ba'i dbang dang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang / bzhi —1/09—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i dbang zhu bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bzlas pas ni shin tu skong nga // khyad par du rdo rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms na bskang du mi btub pa yang skong ste/ mdzod kyi mdo la sogasapa blta bar bya'o/ /de la dam tshig rnams bsngo bgrang bya ba ni/ mdor bsdus nas dran pa'i tshul gyisabasngo zhing bgrang ba dang / kha ton du dus gsum du bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / dus drug tu yi dam nar ma'i dus su bskang zhing bsngo bgrang bya ba dang / glegs bam blta bas bsngo bgrang bya ba'o/ /de la dam tshig skong ba dang / ma nyams pa'i rtags ni sngar bshad pa bzhin du shes pa'o/ /de la dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ ji skad du dpal sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur dngosagrungathob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur thob nas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa gnos kyang / phyis de ma bsrungs na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten lasa'adasapa'i dngosagrub mi 'byung la/mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams la/ sngagasadang phyag rgya mi sbyin zhing / de dang 'grogs par mi bya ste/ snying rje skye la spang bar bya/ zhes pa dang / dang po bla ma rje btsun las / dam tshig thos nasami bsrung ba/ /mkha' 'gro srin pos bsad nasasu/ /ngu 'bod la sogs dmyal bar 'gro/ khresaraspusnyi rje mi ldan pa/ /gsang sngags la ni 'jug mi bya/ /yan lag dam tshig nyamasagyur na / / mi 'dod pa ni sna tshogs 'byung / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/rdo rje dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /de bas dam nyams sdig can de'i/ /nyams pa'i grib ma 'gos pas na/ /lhan cig gnas par mi bya nyid / /de la snying rje skyed par bya zhes gsungs pa dang / dpal sangs rgyas thod pa 'kho re zhig dam tshig nyams pa la / / dngos grub thob pa lta zhog gi /mi yi skye ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ /gang yang bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /rim 'ongs te nyid man ngag ni/ /de yis ji ltar bsgrub snyam dgongs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyamasan/ dper na shing chen po rtsa ba tshig pa'am/ bskams pa'am/bcad pa dang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /sbom bo'i nyes pa ni/ sngar bshad pa bzhin du/shing po'i sdong po dang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten gyi dngos grub chen po brgyad mi 'byung ngo/ /yan lag gi lhung ba ni/shing gi yal ga dang 'dra bar/ 'phrin lasarnam gzhi'i dngosagrub kyisabar du gcod do/ /gzhan yang yid dam lagayel ba dang / mchod pa dang / gtor ma chag na byin brlabasachung zhing / rnala'abyor snga skomasaso/ /bla ma'i thugs ma zin cing bka' bcag na/ bgegasaldang ngo/ /spyod pa rtsing ba dang bag med pa dang / 'byor pa brlag par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dam tshig ma bsrungs kyang / bkris pa 'dra na yang / 'phral du tshe 'di la gnod pa —1110—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /med kyang / de nyid chad pa chen po 'byung ba'i rtags yin te/ dper na rgyal po'i bka' chad 'byung ba na/ de la zas dang chang mang mos brid nas bzi bar byas nas phyi nas bsad do/ /dam tshig kha cig legs par bsrung ba las / sdug bsngal dang bar gcad mang ba ltar 'dug kyang / de tshe rabs snga ma'i lasakyi lhag ma lus pa yin pa las/ des ni myur du phyag rgya po'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa ni/tshe 'dir bkra mi shis pa mang po 'byung la/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgya dang / gshisangan du 'chi ba bcu gnyis kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas shi nas rdo rje dmyal bar skyes nas/ de nas thon pa'i dus med do/ /de la dam tshig ma nyams pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe ring ba dang / longs spyod che ba dang / ci bsams pa 'grub pa dang /mthu dang byin gyisabarlabs che ba dang / bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /bsgom pa dang / bzlas pa dang / mchod pa la brtson pas rnal 'byor ba sngo ma skams par longs spyod che ba dang / bla ma la gus shing bka' ma bcag pas bar chad med pa dang / rdo rje spun la brtse gdung byas pas/ mi ma yin pa rnams kyis bkur bstir byed de/ g.yo sgyu med pas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags 'chol bar ma byasapas/ 'byor pa gtan pa dang / bkris so/ /'chi ba'i dus su yang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsrungs/ rig 'dzin gyi gnas su khrid do/ /gzhan yang des skye ba 'di dang / bar ma do dang / skye ba phyi ma dang / skye ba bcu drug tshun chad kyis 'grub pa la the tshom med do/ /de la dam tshig thams cad bsdu na gnyis te/ snying rjes su rus pa'i gting nas skye ba dang / shes rab tshig tsam min par blos gting nas go ba'o/ /'di gnyis rgyud la brten na dang po nyes pa mi 'byung la/ gal te byung na myur du skong bar 'gyur ro/ /g.yin yang dam tshig thams cad kyi sems su 'dus te/ de yang bzhi ste/ byang chub kyi sems dang / bla na med pa byang chub kyi sems dang / kun tu bzang po'i byang chub kyi sems dang / rdo rje lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /de la so sor thar pa'i sgom pa ni/ las dge sdig gtsor ston te/ bo de ni snying rje gtsor ston no/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa gtsor ston no/ /de la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po las skye'o/ /bo de'i sdom pa ni lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang po can las skye'o/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni rdo rje byang chub kyi sems las skye'o / / de la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni spong ba bdun no/ /bo de'i sdom pa ni spong ba bcu'o/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni sbong ba gcig go /yang so sor thar pa'i gzhung du ni kha na ma tho ba gnyis ka brjod do/ /bo de'i gzhung du ni rang bzhin 'ba' zhig brjod do/ /sngags kyi gzhung du ni de gnyis ka tha snyad ma brjod do/ /yang so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni/ rdzas kyi bdag nyid du yod par 'dod do/ /bo de ni btags pa tsam du 'dod do/ /sngags su ni — /11/ —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/gnyis ka'i tha snyad ma brjod do/ /yang nyan thos kyi theg pa la bar chad kyi chos mang du brjod do/ /bo de'i sdom pa la ni bar chad kyi chos nyung zad cig go /sngags kyi sdom pa la bar chad kyi chos bshad pa med do/ /yang sdom pa dang po de la pham pa byung na phyir blang ba'i skal ba yod do/ /tha ma la ni rdo rje byang chub kyi semasadang ldan na nyams pa med do/ /de la sdom pa dang po de la ni mkhan po dang slob dpon dgos so/ /bar ma'i sdom pa de la ni bla ma gcig pu'am yang na med par yang ngo / /tha ma de la ni bzhi ste/ bla ma'i zhal nas byung ba'i dbang dang / /ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi dbang dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas lung dbang dang / rang nyid kyi sems kyi rtsal gyis thob pa'i dbang ngo / /yang snga ma ni gzhan la gnod par byed pa las log pa'o/ /bar ma ni de'i steng du gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'o/ /phyi ma ni de'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod nyams su len pa'o/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa ni dgra bcom pa rnams kyi rjes su slob pa'o/ /bar ma'i sdom pa ni sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su slob bo/ /snga gas kyi sdom pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi rjes su slob bo/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa bdag 'ba' zhig gi don no/ /phyi ma'i sdom pa ni gnyis ka'i don no/ /yang dang po'i sdom pa ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mnos pa'o/ /bar ma'i sdom pa ni snying byang chub la 'dug go /tha ma ni nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar du'o/ /sdom pa dang po'i 'bras bu ni sa bcu'am/ sa bcu gcig pa'o/ /tha ma'i 'bra bu ni sa bcu gsum pa'o / / gzhan yang bsgom grub dang chos spyod yid dam gyi lhas ma khrel bas dang / /dad pa dang dam tshig bsnyen bkur bla mas ma khrel ba dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ma khrel ba dang / brtse gdung phan gnod rdo rje spun pho mo ma khrel ba dang / bzlas brjod dang / gtor ma dang / cho ga'i nus pa dang /byin gyis brlabs pa mtshan mo rgyu ba'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyi ma khrel ba dang / rdo rje bla ma'i man ngag zab mo zab rang gi bla mas ma khrel ba dang / lta ba zab ma mi zab mkhas pa paṇḍi ta rnams kyis ma khrel ba dang / ji ltar dam bcas pa'i don rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba dang / spyod pa bzang ngan rang gi grogs pos ma khrel ba dang /gtong phod dang / gsal gshog dang / ro tsho dang zhi des dang / mthun 'jug 'jig rten rnams kyi ma khrel ba'o / / mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /spyod lam rnal 'byor dus su ni/ /phyi nang thams cad gzhan min te/ /sems nyid lha yid sgyu ma nyid/ /'od gsal yin te mnyam nyid bzhi/ /bdag pa bzhi yang de nyid yin/ /nyin dang mtshan mo rtag par ni/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la / / de ltar mos pa yang yang bya/ /de rjes shugs dang mi ldan yang / /snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ /de lta bu yi sngags pa ni/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgos pa med/ /bha ga lar skyes dge slong ni/ /mar me mdzad dpa' ye —1112—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /shes kyi/ /gzhung dang bla ma'i man ngag gis/ /dam tshig thams cad bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ /mkhas pa chen po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs// //rje btsun chen po bla ma de nyid dang / /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bsab sgyur cing zhusad pa ste gtan la phab pa'o// //nyu3tre dam tshig kun gyi cho ga kun lasabatus pa le'u nyer lnga pa/rgya gar skad du/ /sarba sa ma pa bi ti pa mud tsa ya pa ri tshe da bi shi ga pa na tsa nā ma/ bod skad du/ dam tshig kun gyi cho ga kun las btus pa le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / / dri med rgyal ba'i bka' 'di rab tu rnyed dka' zhing / /snyigs ma lnga'i dus 'dir gang zag skal zad dus/ /zhal gyi bdud rtsi spangs nas chos gting snyab bslabs/ /gzhung lugs bzang po 'di nub rba mchod btsan thabs dang / /be sbrel g.yang la lhung bzhin/ gnyis ka ngan song 'gro/ kho mthong nyen ma mthong la the tshom spyi brtol che/ /yon bdag slob dpon rnams dang slob ma dag /gnyis kas gzhung ma srong bas dus kyi srin pos zin/ /rnyed pa'i don du dam chos zong du gcod/ khe grags don du rnam smin khyad du gsod/ /lcags kyu med pa'i glang chen smon pa ltar/ /dam tshig lcags kyu spangs nas 'dod lngas spyod/ /chos 'dod rnams kyang 'di ltar g.yo sgyu dang / /zol thabs sna tshogs dag gis dam chos thos par 'dod/ /longs sbyod snying po spangs nas mtho skor dman pa 'bul/ /kye ma 'jig rten dag la phar bltas nas/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal snod / / da lta'i gzhung lugs can la 'di 'dzin pas/ /dgod nas thos don med shin tu dge /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul nus pa ma skyes par/ /rang sems dbang du bcug ste mi skyo bas/ /mdo rgyud rtogs pa dag gi gzhung gsang la/ /rang gi sems la lta ba goms par bya/ /byin brlabs nus pa dag gi brtags pa na/ /rgyud rgyal kun dang ma 'gal 'gro don spyad/ /mig dang ldan pas lam sna khrid pa na/ /grong khyer chen po dag tu phyin par 'gyur/ /bza' btung dgon pa dag la longs spyad pas/ /dmus long dmigs bur bcas te dga' bar 'gyur/ khyim par gyur pa'i sngags pa yis/ /gsang sngags rgyal po gdon par bya/ /gal te rab tu byung zhe na / / sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so sor thar pa byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi sdom pa'o / / rig 'dzin sdom pa spyod pa dang / /dam bcas yul la nges pa ni/ /dam tshig zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /bum pa'i dbang gi dang po ste/ /gsang ba mchog ni gnyis pa yin/ /shes rab ye shes gsum —1113—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa ste/ /'di ltar de bzhin bzhi pa ste/ /dbang bzhi yi ni grangs kyisakyang / /dam tshig ngesapa bzhi yin no / / bsung dang bza' dang brten pa dang / /shes par bya ba go rim bzhin/ /de dag rnam pa gnyis su bsdu/ /de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba spyi'i dam tsheg dang / /bye brag khyad par dam tshigadang / /rgyalaba'i rigs lasdom pa gsum/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag mtshan dang / /bla ma mnyes byed de'i rigs/ /rin chen rigasal sbyin pa bzhi/ /pad mo'i rigs la phyag mtshan gsum/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdomopa dang / /mchod sogasabartson 'grusalasakyi rigs/ /de la bla ma'i dam tshig ni/ /gnyesapar bya ba thamasacad blang / /rnyed dang bkur bsti grub pa ste/ /chung jun 'bring dang por 'gyur/ /bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungasapar dam tshig nyamasa'agyur bas/ /dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang / /slorgama'i 'brelaspurtagapar bya/ /blo ldan slob masabla mar ni/ /snying rje med cing khro lagadug khengs shing chagasal ma bsdamasapa/ /spyomasadang bcas pa spang bar bya/ /brtan zhing dulalablo grosaldan/ /bzod ldan drang ldogayo sgyumed/ /sngagasadang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes / / snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongasashesashing / /dkyila'akhor 'bri ba'i lasal mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes/ /rab tu byung zhing dbang po dul/ /de lta'i bla tshiyon tan can / / srog dang bcas te btsal bar bya/ /gus dang bcasapa'i slob ma la/ /snying rje ldan zhing gtong la dga'/ /tshul khrimasabazod sogasabasam gtan ldan/ /thosa'atshola'adzin la rnam par mkhas/ /spyomasashing rdeg la lhag/ par bzod/ /drang la g.yo sgyu med pa dang / /ngo sha shesashing khrel 'dzem che/ /slob dpon dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad par ni mi rtog par/ /de 'dra rjesasu bzung bar 'os/ /slob mas mnyesaparnam gsum gyis / / bla ma yon tan ldan pa la/ /ci rigasapa yi mchod pa ni/ g.yo spangasapa yi semasakyisabya/ /dgos pa kun gyi 'byung gnas phyir/ /'jig rten rin chen kun gyisagang / /phangs med 'gyod pa med pasa'abul/ /bu dang chung ma yul 'khor dang / /bran g.yog rgyal srid glang po rta/ /yid la lhag par bcagasapa'i rdzas/ /gzhon pa mal cha la sogs pa/ /'dod pa lnga yi longadraXspyod 'bul/ /gang zhig srog lusa'abul byed na/ /longasaspyod g.yo ba smosaci dgos/ /rgyu dgagal po nor pi ka /rjesabastanagadams ngag mnosapa dang / /dkyil 'khor 'jug dbang bkur ba dang / /rigasakyi snying po nod pa'i tshe/ /chang spustong pa ma yin pas/ /bla ma la ni gusabacas yon/ /rjesasu mthun pasadabulabar bya/ /de ldobyin brlabasathamasacad 'byung / /bsnyen bkur byasapasanus pa che/ /gsang ste brjod pasabar chad nyung / /yon che dbul bar byasapa yis/ /rang sems rin chen rnam gnyisa'agyur/ /dkon par gyur nasabasngags pa brjod/ /bsngags na yon tan kun dbyung ste/ /ji ltar —1/14—

sngags phyags blo sbyong ga skor bzhugs so//rnam rtog med pa yi//yid bzhin nor bu rin chen yang //sngags dang bkur bar mi byed pa//de la'adod yon gter mi byed//de bas nan tan thams cad kyis//rtag tu
