rang gi dam tshig bsrung //rtag tu de bzhin gshegs 95 tshogatshogapa mchod//rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul//rtag tu dam pa' chos la brten//'ad yas sangasargyas kun mahūm̐s te / 'i / sdusod namasaye ༷sa sabosags nd+ras//tshoXsaladangos grub mchog thobo 'gyur//mchod rten 'ojag 'dra' sdag sdod bas//grab ma'ang 'ang bar ma bya ba//ṭwāṃbs dang chakris gdaspya la sags pa//'gang ༷nga 'ag 'ilogasasprosaca dgos/sa/blo gros chen po 'a3'a semasdu kyas//bla ma' bags na 'bad de nyan//bla ma' dzosan srog bayin bskyang //de' sdug pa bla ma bzhan//de' 'bor dang gnyen bzhan du//mnyam par bzhag pa rtag tu bsam / tso/malastan 'dug dang sngon 'gro daX //mdun du 'dug dang steX 'gro dang //gtsug kyāor dag dang bcas pa dang //bstan la ṭwāṃng pa rked par nd+ra//lag bzhag mnyen par ma bya'o//bla ma dag na 'bazhengs ༷ na / / nyaladang 'dug ༷ra ma bya ste//de bzhan bla mobazhugasapa na//'greng dang 'chagapar ma bya'o/'i/phya nang 'byung 'dug byed pa' tshe//ldang mkhasaphun sum tshogs pa dang //phyag dang 'dud pa ldan par bya//mchal ma lathogs dor ba dang //stan la rkang pa skyong ba dang //'dig daṭī rtsod pa smra ba dang //yan lag mnye dang gar dang //glung dang rolamo'i rnam pa dang //lusapo bcu zhang 'gang ba dang //stong ༷nga kasogs brnyes pa dang //sor moX tshig pa drang ba dang //rkang pa 'khrud dang lusa'akhru darda //dral dang gahen pa lasogasadang //'ja/ rten/ spyad pa thams/da spyad//rgod ༷nga ḍid pa g.yaladang sdid/'i /lag 'ipa kha 'igadan nan // gā//byabazanapa/ga'ajam pa yasa'i//tshig dag ga na ༷dasapar bya//ca rags pa yasam nus na / / ga ga bskang ste bya ba yan//maXs sngi 'jags bcas lam du na/ /bsdi ba thob nas masngin 'gro bya//bsnyen bsngir sbyod ༷ thamasacad la//yad na nga rgyal med pa dang //ngo rdo shesashang bsdams pa yas//drog ma gsar ba' tshulabazhan du//grogadang ma bsdamasast+riod pa kun//bla swā' mdun du spang bar 'ibya'i//ngag ga tshig khyaldolasogs sbangs//longasasbyod ṭwāṃgaspyad blang ṭī bya//dge ba despu mdun du spyad//despu maḍi nas brjod par bya//rang gnas mtshan brjod snade'atshe//mang mazlor khyad par tshig /daXsabya//kun gyasabakur na hūm̐s su 'brang //de las bzlog na ranga'iX'abad//de bzhan gasduḍi ba ras ras man//bla mas zloosapar chos ma brjod//gaXn dasngi gusapar gyaba' phyar/khyad par cana'i gya tshag kyang brjod//bla ma la na bka' stsol zhu / /bka' bzhan bgyad cesabarjod byasal//thal yoosbyar ༷nga moyengasapar//bla mas bsgo ba thamasacad mnyan//mdun du dul bsa'adug pa dang //gosasogs tshul na gdams pa dang //pus btsugasathalamo sbyar

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/ba yis/ /mnyam sogs 'dod la gsol gsum gdab/ /slob dpon la ni gang 'bul dang / /bla mas kyang ni gang gsol ba/ /de la btud de lag gnyis kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas blang bar bya/ /bla ma zhabs drung la sogasapa / / bsnyen bkur ba thams cad la/ /'dud dang phyag sogs 'don byas la/ /de nas ci bder 'dug par bya / / bla ma'i byin ma slob ma min/ /bslob ma bla ma'i mdun du min/ /bsnyen bskur bdag gir bya ba dang / /phyag sogs byed la bzlog par bya/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /slob ma sdud dang 'chad pa dang / /yul der bla ma gnas pa na/ /rjes ma gnang bar mi bya'o/ /spyan 'gyed la sogs ci thob pa/ /de kun bla ma dag la dbul/ /de'i nang par blangs nas ni/ /gzhan dag la yang ci bder bya/ /mdor na dad pa'i slob ma yis/ /mi mnyes gyur pa thams cad spangs/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /de lta'i mgon la bsam bcas nas/ /kun tu sems dkrugs mi bya ste/ /gal te mongs pas brnyas gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas dkrugs pas/ /des ni sdug bsngal rtag tu thob/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams dang / /rgyal po me dang dug sprul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro chom rkun dang / /gdon dang log 'dren 'byung po dang / /lus sems phral te bsad nas kyang / /dmyal bar nges par skye bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'bad pa thams cad yis/ /bla ma la ni gus par byos/ /mchog tu 'dod pas dus gsum du/ /dkyil 'khor me tog bcas thal mos/ /ston pa bla ma bkur bya zhing / /zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ khyim pa'am ni gsar bu la/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pas blos phyag bya/ /gdan stabs pa dang ldang ba dang / /don gyi bsnyen bskur thams cad kun/ /brtul zhugs can gyis kun bya ste/ /phyag rgya dam pa mi las spang / /'jig rten smod pa spang ba'i phyir/ /phyag nad nyes pa spang ba dang / /sems kyis gus pa bya ba'am/ /dam chos la sogs bdun bdar bya/ /bsam pa dag pa'i slob ma ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song la/ /bla ma'i rjes 'jug bya ba ni/kha ton bya ba byin par bya/ /de nas gsang sngags sbyin pa yi/ /dam chos snod du byas nas su/ /rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi dang lhung ba bco lnga grags pa dang / /brgyad pa dang dam tshig sbasapa dang / /brda dang rtsa ba po dang / /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /yan lag spros pa thams cad kun/ /bklag dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya / / dam tshig cho ga btus pa las/ /gsang ba spyi'i dam tshig gi le'u dang po rdzogs so// //khyad par dam tshig bshad bya ste/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor mchog dbye bas/ khyad par dam tshig rnam pa gsum / / skyabs su gyur pa dkon mchog dang / /rgyu yi gtso bo byang chub sems/ /rkyen gyi gtso bo bla ma —1116—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /mgon / / lam gyi gco bo yi dam lha/ /spyodapa sngags dang phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin rtags kyi tshul/ /bya ba spyod pa'i rgyu dag las/ /mi spyad dam tshig rnam pa lnga/ /srog gcod ma byin len pa dang / /'dod log brdzun dang myos 'gyur 'thung / /rtsa ba lhung ba lci ba ste/ /mi spyad dam tshig rnam pa lnga/ /rdo rje slob dpon grib dag rjes/ /mchod rten grib dang me tog brnying / khra bo'i stan dang phyag rgya gzhon/ /mi 'gong dam tshig rnam pa lnga/ /rdo rje spun dang theg pa dman/ /spyod ngan 'jig rten pa ni/ /'jig rte lha dang mi smad lnga/ /sngags pas 'bad des bsrung bar bya/ /sha dang la phug sgog gtsong 'bags/ /mi bza' dam tshig rnam pa lnga/ /le'u gnyis pa'o// //rnal 'byor rigs kyi dam tshig las/ /spyi dang bye brag sogs dang / khyad par gyur pa'i dam tshig kyang / /ci rigs rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /mi dang lha'i rnam pa gnyis / / mi'i rgyud la grags pa yi/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig gnyis/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gi /rdo rje sems dpa' gshin rje'i gshed/ /nag po'i rgyud las bdun phyag gnyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ /bla ma spyod cing bder gshegs bka' las 'das/ /spun la nyes smra byams pa chen po spangs/ /byang chub sems spangs theg pa gsum la smad/ /skal min gsang sgrags bdag nyid phung po smad/ /chos la yid gnyis sdang la chags bral byams/ /chos la gnyis 'byed dad pa'i sems la smod/ /dam tshig ji bzhin rten par mi byed dang / /brtags pa'i rim pa smod par byed pa ste/ /sngags pas 'di dag rnam par spang bar bya / / le'u gasdo/ma pa'o// //dam pa dang po'i rgyud las grags pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig brda yis grags pa ni/ /lha dang lha blang dor mig du brjod/ /de nyid dus 'das ri bong can/ /lha gzhan dga' ba yon tan no/ /rigs byed dngos la zhen pa yin/ /ma rdzogs rdzogs byed mda'i grangs/ /'jig rten phyir na dbang po ste/ khyad du gsod pa ri yin no / / gon min tshul ston bkra shis lags/ /'phrin las ma gtogs gza' zhes grags/ /don med gnas pa phyogasayin no/ /brtse ba 'dor ba dregs pa ste/ /dman pa'i spyod pa nyi ma yin/ /zang zing rtogs pa yan lag go /yongs su mi 'dzin pa zhes bya/ /rang spyod 'dor ba tshe sa zhes grags/ /le'u bzhi pa'o/ /de nas gzhan/ yang bshad par bya/ /dam tshig spyod pa ngesapa ste/ /mi smra ba dag mi bya nyid/ /de bzhin du mchod pa dang / /tshim bya yid gnas bsgom bya dang / /mkhas pa gzhom dang meongs bya ste/ /brgyad po 'di dag rnal 'byor pa'i/ /dam tshig du yongs su grags/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi rang bzhin dang / /dam tshig dang 'dra ba dang / /rdzun du smra ba dang —///7—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces ba.a las/jo bo' gsung chosakyi skor/rtsub yam̐ ngag/bkyal yom̐ rdzo tu smra ba dang //phra ma srog sas 6 bast+ring//gtolasagashka byemosabartas pa//rku dang phrag dag nga yi dang / /sgyu dang khi rnams bya baman//rang lngagasasngagags nar bu dang ne//oṃ dang rdzasadang snyuldob dang //bde nges spyod dang groldorgadang//dngosagrub mtshan ༵ sba bar bya—// byas pa nad pa a med rgan/ /dag dang maso med sman pa dang //skul nasadatso sdospu'asazho mongs—/ / 'phags pa dge 'dun tram̐hoo par bya/ /slob dpon med dang pha rdzu dang //lha dang ༈ ga zog po dang / /duzlo khrod ༅sapa' wīng ba dang 'i/ /kho' 'gro rnamasakyas྾ panee bya//darsā maspuo gsum dang de bas bdag/phyaX rgya me shesarang ga dngos//cha shās ngo dag cha med skas//bla masasan bsgom par bya//dzos sdang gta mugaser sna dang //le lo7sa rmu0the ྾ dang //dad pa med dang bakhi datso dang //da4 gdon rnams kyang gzhoX par bya//dadku sa ga gtso lastod byed dang //zhe sna phrakridogatso dang dug/saryā lhoor dang sdowāo rje dang //glaskyo rje 'dzin pa dang //podad par sngi ma mthong ba//de na dam snyo dang bo yin//thosatsho kaudangadarwag sa/༷ ngag sbun dang bsawo sbun/'i/dam rdzo sa dang lnga ོ༷ la/khro' sbang dayoghogardzatsoo/khig hrū daḍi na gang zagadang //drang don dang na rnam bar nges//de āoya datshim byeḍi pa//de na ḍim dkugasngotshoo//ra sduo can dang dung ho dang //pad swā ho dang glang pom/bur ḍi tso gya bud spu na//de tsonaṭīswāṣka3 pa'o / dzo/dzi ko dngos po ca mthong ba//go gosdusha' rnam pa dang //rgashordzubasdod rtsa' rnam par shes / de/ na 'idam spyoX yo//snoX gad bsdusaphro mroornamasatso//'dod tso dkyalatsoor snarospuru / / dran ba cagaspragang yan pa//de na dam rdzo drug pa'o//barṣosmadaspakur dang masprakur dang //gragasadang mgragasarnyed pa dang /lkarnyed pa la rnyed semasadaba'//de ni dam rdzo bdun yo//ma ning drang 4shā mi thordo mi 4shā ri ///khogrong dakhi thubatso//rang ga cusmad sto po dang //sngaze castegasad4 gsahphar//de na dam 'i baglo tshoo//mosapa dakhodang lolophywa//g.yo sa snyang tsoosamed pan//gsangargabaska spuphaskam ḍi / / de ni dam rdzo dgu tsoo//gas la snying rje hrūsacusaṣka/zhasapa si sasamroornamasal/'i/de na dam ṣkasapa'o//rho spepanyid dang mawo tram̐d dang //smon gretram̐d dang dusagasum mkho//rangadzo sasapar ma byed pa//de na dam rdzo stsokhig pa///rtag tu ma rtagasdugabasngaladang //yio bodangan

sngagasaphyogasablo sbyong gi skor bzhugasaso/ /bdag med dang / /byang chub semasani dran byasal/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gnyisapa'o/ /chos la mig ni yod min zhing / / 'phagasapa ldoni gzugasamed pa/ /gang zag ngo bo nyid med pa/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gsum pa'o/ /rdo rje tshig ni brgyagasum pa'o/ /gang gis gsungasapa thar pa che/ /gal te nyams par gyur pa ni/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'tshed pa yin/ /le'u drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rtag par dngos grub rnamasakyi rgyu/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang bar bya / / rigs gzhan las byung pho nya mo/ /'dod la chagasapas skyob mi chags/ /gnyisasu med dang thogs med dang / /dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa dang / /bud med spyod pa la sbyor ba/ /tshangasapar spyod pa de bzhin 'dod/ /'dren cing rtsa rgyun kun spyod pa/ /zhesabya dam tshig brgyad pa'o/ /rnal 'byor dbang po gang gis gsungs / / denai dngosagrub myur du thob/ /le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ste/ /dam med gnod dang mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma brten par dga' ba dang / /tshogasakyi 'khor lo rtsod pa dang / /sems can dad dang ldan/ pa la/ /dam chosagayin du ston pa dang / /nyan thosadag tu mi byed pa'i/ /nang du gzhag bdun gnasapa dang / /sbyor ba nges par ma byas par / / skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /phyag rgya mthong ba'i skal med la/ /lusakyi phyag gyoston pa dang / /snyen sogasadag par ma byasapar/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom gnyisargyal bas bcas pa la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba ni/ kha na ma tho chen po ste/ /sngags pasadam tshig zad 'gyur zhing / / bdud dang sdug bsngalashin tu 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /sngagasapasabazlas pa dag la 'bad/ /le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nasayang dag bshad bya ba/ /dam pa gnyer brten cig shos min/ /snod dang ldan pa rnams las brtag /'dod phyir gzhan laganod pa spang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor ba min/ /gzhan don skad cig yal mi 'dor/ /byang chub min par dge mi 'jug /rnam shes 'phos pa'i de nyid mkhas/ /gzhan du lag mnyesabyasapa ste/ /de las sdug bsngalachen po thob/ /le'u dgu pa'o// //de nasayang dag bshad bya ba/ /thamasacad dusakyisadam tshig ni/ /lus ni sku'i rdo rje bsgom/ /ngag gi gsung gi rdo rje ste/ /rnam shesathugasakyi rdo rjer bsgom/ /'di dag bzhi dag rab ldan na/ /bsod namasade las gzhan du min/ /tha mal spyod pas dusa'adasan/ /dngosagrub 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje dam tshig bshad bya ste/ /mi 'chang lhag gnasam byasadang / /rgyu dang tshad las 'dasapa dang / /'tshongasa'ajug ma gus spang — 1119—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/bya ste/ /dril bu 'phreng ba la sogs pa/ /kun kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /de las gzhan du nyams par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dam tshig ni/ /g.yin du 'gro dang gzhan la phan sems/ the tshom dang ni le lo dang / /de bzhin bzang ngan spong len byed/ /'di yi dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /gsang sngags zlos pa'i dam tshig ni/ /mi zlos bar du bcos pa dang / /tha mal tshig dang 'dres pa dang / /mi dge dang 'brel yan lag nyams/ /lhag par skyes bu'i sgra che chung / /'di yis dam tshig nyams par gyur/ /gang yang grogasakyi dam tshig ni/ /tha mal grogs dang sdig pa'i grogs/ /mkhas pa rnam par spang bar bya/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam du/ /sa ris 'bri sogs ma bsdams pa/ /dri ma gnang yid mi bde ba/ /sems 'brul grogs dang ldan 'gyur na/ /nyon mongs dgra ni bskyed mi bya/ /tshangs par spyod pa'i gnas dag na/ /mi tshangs spyod na nyams par 'gyur/ /man ngag mdos pa'i dam tshig ni/ /mi len dman la brnyas pa dang / /rang gi ral gris bcod pa dang / /ma byin len dang bsam pa nyams/ /kun gyis bstod na bsnyen bkur zhing / /gzhan gyisasmad ma zhus par byed/ /ngag rtsub pa la brnyas pa ste/ thob nas gzhan spel bsam dang ldan/ /ma thosadon la dpog pa dang / /mngon shes ldan la smos par byed/ yon tan min la yon tan 'dzin/ grags pa thob na rang chen 'dzin/ /'dus pa'i nang du ston pa smod/ /gang yang nyon mongs dbang gis nyams/ /snod kyi dam tshig chen po ni/ /mi 'tshang snod dang dman par lta/ /gang yang gzhan la ston pa dang/ /lhag par gnas med nyams par 'gyur/ bza' btung dus kyi dam tshig ni/ /dus min zas dang sman la za/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnam rtog ldan / / rgyags skye ro la chags pa yis/ /bza' btung dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi dam tshig chen po ni / / lha dang grangs dang rdzas la sogs/ ma 'tshogs bstan dang bral nyams/ /gang yang gtor ma'i dam tshig ni / / mchog min la bsngo 'jig rten don/ /rnal 'byor dang bral rdzas rnams/ /gzhan gyis mthong dang sbyor ba log / 'di yis nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /langs pa'i dus kyi dam tshig ni/ /myur du langs dang bsngo langs dang / /langs ma thag tu 'gro ba dang / /dor ni yang dag bsam dang bral/ slob dpon lha la phyag mi byed/ /de dus sdig pa sems dpas nyams/ /'gro ba dus kyi dam tshig ni/ /rgan pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dang / /rnal 'byor glo glor 'gror/ /rings par 'gro zhing mig rtsa dgod/ /sa mi rgyun gcod dbyar dus 'gro/ /phyin srog gcod khus 'debs pa dang / /gcig pur 'gro dang dus gcig 'gro/ /rtsod 'gro bud med dang 'grogs dang / /sdig pa'i grogs dang lhan cig 'grogs/ /phal che'i nang du 'gro ba dang / /mtshon sogs rta sogs zhon pa dang / /nyos yod shes kyang 'gro ba dang / /gang zhig zas dang 'grogs pa dang / /mtshan mo 'gro —1120—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /ba nyams par 'gyur/ /'dug pa'i dus kyi dam tshig dam tshig ni/ /dge slong ma'i 'og 'dug dang / /'dus pa'i rgya chud cig tu 'dug /bud med sdig grogs lhan cig 'dug /rnal 'byor dang bral rings par 'dug /rkang lag brkyang bskum ma bsdams dang / /gdan med 'dod pa'i gdan dang ldan/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba spangs / / dran dang shes bzhin rnal 'byor dang / /sems pa'i 'dug stangs dag gi 'dug /yid la byed pa'i dam tshig ni/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed cing / /dug lnga rnam par 'phel bar byed/ /'tshang 'bru yi bsam dang ldan/ /'di yis nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /le'i bcu pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam tshig ste/ /gang du rang gi sgrub pa yi/ /phyag rgya smra bar byed pa dang / /phyag rgya'i gzugs brnyan ston par byed/ /gang zhig gsang sngags smra ba dang / /sngags kyi gzugs brnyan ston par byed/ /gang gi cha rkyen phyogs su gtogs/ /thams cad ston par byed pa dang / /gsang ba'i bdag mo smod par byed/ /lha la mchod pa rgyun gcod dang / /tshogs dang grogs kyi nang du byed/ /gzhan du yid kyis brjed pa dang / /maṇḍal tsha tsha la sogs spong / /rtags rnams 'chang bar mi byed pa'i/ /skyes bu dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /le'i bcu gcig pa'o / / de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sgo gsum las kyi spyod pa ste/ /don gnyis gyur pa'i lus spyod dag /lus kyi le lo spangs pas bya/ /don med spyod pa sems kyi mnan/ /snying spyod dang phan pa'i gtam / / ma rtogs pa ni rgyun bcad de/ /le lo spang pas gsum sgrub bya/ /ca co nam yang ma yin pa/ /sangs rgyas chos su 'di bshad do/ /bsam gtan shes rab ma dang ni/ /snying rje 'dom dang bsngo ba'i sems/ /g.yeng dang bying rmugs rnam/sa spangs pa/ /bsam bya rtag par gang dran pas/ /sangs rgyas chos bzhir 'di bshad do/ /sgo gsum chung bar mos gus pas/ /rtag tu nyams smod byed pa/ /dam tshig sdom pa bzhir zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thob par 'gyur/ /rgyas par yon tan brjod mi lang / /le'u bcu gnyis pa 'o / / 'khrus pa'i zhing du gyur rnams la/ /sdug bsngal yin yang mthar phan bya/ /bstod cing mtho semasarab spangs pas/ /'khrul pa ji snyed brjod mi bya/ /mi 'dri ba yang gnod la smra/ /rgad po bla ma'i 'du shes bskyed / / phrag dog can la sems ngam bskyed/ /dpag tshad du ma'i mthar gnas bya/ /don yod sdig pa dang du blang / /ma bsngo 'tsho ba rtag tu spangs/ /grags dang 'gran 'dod dge ba dor/ /nyams la snying rje btang snyoms spangs/ /don 'gyur phyir na bdag dge spangs/ /de ni bzlog par ma gsungs so/ /'dzin pa spong ba'i sbyin pa bzhin/ /lci ba'i sbyin pa zlog par bya/ /lus 'dod dum bu'i sems dag gis/ /sprul sku thob phyir spyir bar bya/ /nyams sod log lta sun dbyung zhing / /bskal pa'i sbyin pa bzlog par bya/ /bsam gtan ro —//21 —

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/jo bo' gsung chos kya skor/martog klug gnas bya//thegadaman sbyod padorab med//'dod pa'i semasakyis 'gro mi gnyer//'dod ༵'a sems kyis grodā rgyu ba//chos skye dang 'gro bar bya//nad dang sdug ba/sdu can g.yog byed//tshuX khrams spyod pa lhur ma' 'dzin/'a/snyemasadang bral na dag par gsungs//rtsod pa zha phyar 'du ba spaX /rtsod pa' rtsabasems dran ṭwāṃng//rnamasman dran pas bzlog par bya/khong khro nyer 'tshe ldan gyur pa//'ad ldan byang chub semasadaX' na//chosaspyodabacu la dam bcardzunas//thun mong zhen pa bswoog par bya//sdug bsngal bsal ba rnaspra sman dor//sprod ma brtags pa sems dor//de la don 'gyur sbang ma bya//phan byed rnamasalalan ldog zhang //gzhan gya mya ga bsal bar bya//sgro ༷kur spangs te yon to brjod//leX bcu gsum pa'o / / de nd+raswāyang dag bshad bya ba//bya ga byed mthong ma smon dang //dngosag mtho baṭwāṃbazhan te//smon ༷ma dag 1 spyo du gdab//bzang po spyod dang dngordzupo bzang //marnyo rdzasamathong ba snyed pa/du/dag zhang kun gya spyod par smon//'dug pa sdungasargyaXzhang gnardzudang //'gro ba sprul pa don byed dang //byang ba bsam gto bde 3nas dang //bsam rtsas chos kya bsam rtsardzu dang //'dre ba bsam gtan don rto/sna daḍi //dpa' bo bdud bzha g.yul 'jomasadang //thamasacad spyod bzhan ma gos dang /sruog gcod ḍiphro ba' 'phran sdus dang //'dod chags mnyam pas sbyor ba dang //rku ba dngos grub len pa dang //ra bo rtog pas ma 'phrogs dang //chu rgyun mosaspyodā rgyun lam dang //'braswā bu sku dang ye shes dang //me kho rnasdu grol 'phung po dang //yul khamasarnam dag 'jag 'irten dang /kha zasatang 'dzin ro sprachog dang //snom pa snyang rje' chu masnron soogs/khams gsum gnas pa' semasacan la/ /smon lam yad kyas de bzhan smon//le'u bcu bzha pa'// // 'i'ide nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rtsa ba' spyod pa gsu/ sogs pa/ /semasabaskyed sdom ḍi blangs pa yan//nyams len bsam pa dran pa dang / khesabazhan tīn pas brtag bsam te//gang zhag sngon goms dbang nyamasapa//'gyod dang bcaswā pas ོ༷rda gzhug bya//ya ge la sogasadrozo mtha' rnams//rtsol ba rgyun du 'jug byed pa//goms te slozlo dro yan pa ya//daṭwāoṃsapo gang sding yod ma yan//spyod lam rnam gsum dran par bya//byang chub sems dpa' mang thob ste//de ldog par ma byed do//dper na phyag po nor bsngo ba / / med par gyur na sor 'jug bzhin//spyod pa nyamasapa'i rnal 'byor pa//zhig pa bzhin du mi gnas te—/ / bzhingam 'on te gzhan dag gam/ /dbang por gyur pa'i rten dag la//mdun du maṇḍal mchod sbyar nas / / me tog phyag 'tshal lus gus pas/ /'gyod sems dngos po dag gis bshags/ /de bzhin 2

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /slar yang blang bar bya/ /bdag dang dngos po 'bras bu rnams/ /mi dmigs sems kyis bshags byas la/ /de ni nyes par ma gsungs so/ /le'u bco lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /man ngag nyams nga/ rnam gsum ste/ /dpon la brten te nyams pa dang / /yi ge la brten nyams pa dang / /bshad pa la brten nyams pa'o / / dang po rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /dman pas nyams dang nan gyis len/ /gdams ngag dang du mi len dang / / g.yo sgyus man ngag len pa'o/ /yi ge la brten rnam pa bzhi/ /yid mkhan nan gyis len pa dang / /g.yo sgyus 'bri bar byed pa dang / /dman pa dag la nyams pa dang / /gzhung nyams pa ste rnam pa bzhi'o/ /bshad pa nyams pa rnam bzhi ste/ /brnyas dang bcas pa nyams pa dang / /bshad pa nyam/sa pa dag dang ni/ /bshad pa log pas nyams pa dang / /mi mthun lung gnyis bsdebs pas nyams/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /nyams pa med pa thub pa yin/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kun/ /dus gcig srog dang phral ba'i sla'i/ /man ngag nyams pa de lta min/ /rang nyid srog dang bral ba sla'i/ /dam tshig nyams pa de lta min/ /srog dang bral ba gang yin pa/ /tshe yi skye ba zad pa cam/ /dam tshig nyams pas bskal pa'i grangs/ /dpag tu med pa sdug bsngal spyod/ /sems can thams cad kun bsad pas/ /tshe 'di'i lhag ma zad pa cam/ /man ngag nyams su par gyur pa yis/ /de yi sgrub dang bzlas brjod sogs/ /ci byas 'bras bu med pa dang / /'bad pa don med gyur pa yin/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /man ngag nyams pa spang bya zhing / /dam chig nyams las bzlog par bya/ /le'u bcu drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /lha brgyad dam tshig zhes bya ste/ /mdor bsdus rnam pa lnga ru brjod/ /thun mong spyi'i dam tshig dang / /sgrub pa khyad par dam tshig dang / /spyod pa rgyud kyi dam chig dang / rang bzhin lta ba'i dam tshig dang / /gal mdor nges pa'i dam tshig go /thun mong spyi'i dam tshig ni/ /byang sems rnam gnyis slob dpon drug /mched bzhi sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi/ /gsang bcu rtsa bar shes pa/ra bya/ /spyad pa lnga dang mi spang lnga/ /dang du blang dang sgrubasmode bzhin/ /shes bya lnga rnams thun min bshad/ /nyin lag skabs su shes par bya / / sgrub pa khyad par dam tshig ni/ /rnam pa nyi shu 'di lta ste/ /gcan gzan seng ge mi bsad cing / /za ma tog tu dug mi brag cing / /rin chen cug phran mi brag cing / /gangs kyi zhung chu khol mi btung / /pad ma'i 'bru kha ma bye / / snod rdol nang du bcud mi blug /ma brtags pa'i rdzas mi bsrel/ /shel sgong dag pa 'dam mi gzhug / snod ngan seng ge'i zho mi/ gzho/ /yid bzhin nor bu mer mi sreg khyung chen lding ba'i gshog pa mi — //23—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi sker/gcag / gnas lcags rngur mo nang mi 'thab/ /stag gzig rol pa'i god mi sgrub/ /rdo rje gtams pa'i brag mi 'dral/ /rdo rje ra ba 'dral mi bya/ /mun pa sel ba'i sgron mi bsad/ /rdo rje chu bo'i 'ol mi bsgyur/ /rgyalapo rtags kyi brgya mi byin/ /rdo rje mkhar gyi rdzom mi bzlog /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ /rgyal mtshan rtse nas dbog mi bya/ /spyod pa rgyun gyi dam tshig ni/ /rnam pa bzhir ni shes bya ste/ /rtag tu gnyid dgra zhom par bya / / rmugs dang chang la brten pas myos/ /gsang ba'i brda la nan tan bslab/ /le lo spangs la brtson 'grusabartsam / / rang bzhin lta ba'i dam tshig ni/ /rnam pa bzhin brjod 'di lta ste/ /ma khrel tshul dang ldan pa dang / /ma nyams thub pa'i sdom pa dang / /mthar phyin rtags kyi mtshan mo'o/ /ma khrel tshul ni rnam bzhi ste/ /lta spyod yi dam ma khrel ba dang / /srid zhu slob dpon ma khrel dang / /brtse gdung grogs kyis ma khrel cing / / g.yo sgyu rang gi ma khrel ba/ /ma nyams pa ni 'di bzhi ste/ /rtsa ba nyams pa dag pa dang / /yan lag nyams pa dag pa dang / /bzlasabarjod nyams pa dag pa dang / /zhar gyis nyamasapa dag pa'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i rtags bzhi te/ /dam can 'di zhing mthun rtsal che/ /byin brlabs che zhing rigs pa chags/ /gzhan gyi yid bzhin bsam pa 'grub/ /mang pos bkur zhing grags pa che/ /le'u bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sngags pa dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste/ /snga rtags phyi la 'byung ba dang / /snga rtags sngon du 'byung ba ni/ /ya nga ba'i nad rnams dang / /dgra bgegs gnyis la bden mi 'jug /'khor dang longs spyod yid 'ong bral/ /ya ga ma nyes kha yogs 'byung / /brtsams pa'i las la 'bras bu med/ /de las sogs pa'i nyes pa ni/ /yid du mi 'ong sna tshogs 'byung / /gal te nyamasal rtags med cing / /legs par snang na mi 'byung ste/ /bde ba zad bya bstan du bdug gal te dam tshig ma nyams kyang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags byung na/ /sngon gyi las kyi 'phro yin pas/ /bskang gso la sogs gtsor byas nas/ /rnam smin lhag ma 'dir zad pas/ /ngan song sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur/ /phyi rtags phyi nas 'byung ba ni/ /byang chub sems gnyis spangs gyur na/ /bskal par dge ba ci bsags kyang / /gzhi rten med par gyur pa yis/ bskang gso la sogs gtsor byasanas/ /gzhi rten med par 'khor ba'o/ /sdug bsngal khams su zag par 'gyur/ /sku'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /ya nga'i nad sogs sdug bsngal 'byung / /dus min tshe zad bar chad mang / /bskal par rdo rje dmyal bar lhung / /bde bas rab tu 'phongs par 'gyur/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /gang yang bsgrubs la rtags med cing / /lce la zhing rmo la sogs pa'i/ /dmyal bar bskal pa gsum du gnas/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /dmyo 'bob dbang po nyams dang 'tshal/ /dran —1124

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /pa nyams shing 'khrul pa dang / /myos shing lkugs pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /rtsa ba kun nyams phyal pa dag /bcos la nyer bar mi brtson na/ /rdo rje dmyal ba ste/ /dmyal ba phal pa thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal gcig tu bsdoms pa yis/ /de'i 'bum gyis char mi phod/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'od zer dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'phrin las kun/ /rgyun tu mdzad kyang phan mi thogs/ /bskal pa ther 'bum la sogs su/ /de nas 'thon par mi 'gyur zhing / /'jig rten 'jig na gzhan du 'pho/ /se gol gcig gis phyin par byed/ /de bas nan tan kun gyis byos/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /longs spyod mang du 'phel ba dka'/ /theg pa che la dpyas 'dogs shing / /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams/ /shin tu ring por 'gyur ba ste/ /lha spyod ya char gyur pa yis/ /theg pa phyi nang 'dres gyur na/ /bka'i byin brlabs grub par dka'/ /bsrung ba'i lha g.yeng ba dang / /zab mo'i chos la ring 'gyur zhing / /bskal par ngan song lhung gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor nyi sngo skams nyid du 'gyur/ /le'u bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor skyes bu chen po yis/ /dam tshig ma nyams gzhung thub na/ /lus la nad nyung mtshan ldan zhing / /'khor dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /thun mong nyes pa dag par 'gyur/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /theg pa chen po'i don thob 'gyur/ /gsung gi lha ma nyes rgyu 'phel zhing / / mthu dang byin brlabs bsam mi khyab/ /las rnams dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs par/ /thugs la skyob dub med pa dang / /man ngag snod 'gyur dngos grub nye/ /dgongs pa'i don la mkhas pa dang / /lha rnams kun gyi dbang bskur 'gyur/ /yan lag dam tshig ma nyams na/ /skyon bzlog pa nyin yon tan te/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing ngan song sbyong / /theg chen lta spyod gzhung bsrang bas lha rnams 'go zhing bsam pa 'grub/ /don gnyis yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /theg chen dam tshig la gnas na / / 'og min 'dul rdol dam tshig gsum/ /bsrung ba med par thub pa nas/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang / / rnal 'byor dbang phyung chen po yin/ /le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /nyams na bskang thabs bshad par bya/ /byang chub sems kyi dam tshig ni / / rang las bslangs te gnas pa 'byung / /sku yi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /gang las nyams par der song la / / nor rdzas 'byor pas mnyes phul la/ /gang nyams tshig tu bshags byas la/ /phyin chad sdom pa legs par bca'/ /gal te grongs chad gyur pa na/ /de'i slob dpon bzhugs pa la/ /de tshe gong ma bzhin du bshags / / med na mnyam pa brgya la bshags/ /de yang rnyed par ma gyur na/ /de dang mnyam pa gsum bkug —/125—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/la / / sbyin bsreg me thab rab brtsegs ste/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod rjes su/ /spyan drangs gsang mtshan la sogs mchod/ /gong du smos pa'i yon rnams kyang / /dbang po gsum la 'bul bar bya/ /gal te gusapa mi len na/ /gnyis ka rdo rje dmyal bar skye/ /de bas myur du tshangs par bya/ /gsung gi dam tshigs nyams gyur na / / sgo gsum sku gsung thugs nyid du/ /nges par shes pa bskong bar 'gyur/ /bzlas pa ldab gyi gsab pa dang / /bsgrub pa chen po gsum gyis bskang / /thugs kyi dam tshiganyams 'gyur na/ /'gro drug sems can gsal rtogs ste/ /bdag nyid bdagal gsal ba skyed/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin klong zhugs ste/ /ma yengs blo la 'dris par bya/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /gang nyams de nyid song bcu ste/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tshogaso kyis bskang / /de ltar nyams su blangs na skongs/ /snga rtags sdug bsngal mi 'byung 'gyur/ /le'u nyi shu pa'// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bsod nams tshogs ni yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /phyi'i dam tshig yongasardzogs nas / / nang du ye shes 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /nang gi dam tshig bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rgya mtsho yi/ /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung ba na/ /rakta shu tra dang bcas pa/ /brtul zhugs brtan pas rab tu bza' / / mi phyed lam la gnas pa yis/ /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bya/ sha chen rtag tu bza' bya ba/ /'di ni dam tshig mchog yin no/ /gsung gi rdo rje yi ge che/ /dam tshig bzhi pa bsrung ba ni/ /bshang lci rtag tu bza' bya ba/ /'di ni gsang ba med byung ba'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /dam tshig bzhi ni ’bsrung ba na / / go ku da ha na rtag bza'/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu ste/ /sbrang ma skyugs pa de bzhin no/ /le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rig ma'i dam tshig nges pa ste/ /ri mo can dang dung can dang / /padmo can dang glang chen dang / /lan gyis lan dang thabs med dang / /brtags med rdzas med phyis 'byung dang / /dbang dang mi ldan dam tshig med/ /sgrub pa po la mi mos shing / /srab la 'phyar zhing gsang mi thub/ /'dod chags stobs can ma snang dang / /ye shes don du mi gnyer dang / /yul dus khams dang mi mthun spang / /de nas gzhan du nyams par 'gyur/ /le'u nyi shu gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ste/ khyod kyi sku la sha khrag med/ /bshang lci shu tra yod ma yin/ /de bzhin khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ stunan tu mnyam bzhag sgrub pa pos/ /rtag tu dam tshig bskyang bar bya/ /gsang ba'i padma'i 'gro 'ong ston/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /dga' ba'i dbye ba rnam pa — 1126—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs se/ /bzhi / / skra'i thig le ces bya'o/ /'du byed sha chen bza' ba ste/ /rab tu sad pa'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /gnyis log gnas skabs skye byed pa/ /thugs kyi thig le zhu ba na/ /snying kha'i pad mar chud pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /sna tshogs dga' ba'i bye brag gis/ /thig le dam tshig ces bya'o/ /yan lag drug pa'i ma gnas pa / / rakta shu tra'i bdud rtsi ni/ /tshor dang 'du shes bza' ba ste/ /dmigs med bsgrib pa dang bral ba/ /brtul zhugs rtag pa thob pa'i phyir/ /rig ma'i stobs kyang mi 'joms pa/ /bod pa'i ye shes bza' ba'o/ /thig le ye shes mtshan nyid can/ /bzhi'i gnas skabs bskyed par byed/ /lkog ma'i pad mar 'gro 'ong ston/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /lhan skyes dga' ba'i bye brag gi /mi phyed lam la gnas pa yis/ /go ku la sogs rtag bza' ba/ /dmigs sna rna ba lus dang ni/ /sbrang ma smyugs pa yid kyis bsad/ /yul dang dbang po rnam par shes/ /bcu gnyis skye mched bco brgyad khams/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bza'/ /nang stong sogs lo bcu drug ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi lo grangs can/ /mkhas pas rtag tu shes par bya/ /de'i khyad par rnam gsum ste/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med dang / /de'i rgyu mthun zab pa dang / /sna tshogs tshul rnams ston pa ste/ /'di ni dam tshig chen po'o/ /le'u'i nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig chen po dpe bstan te/ /sa gzhi lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /dam tshig med par 'byung mi srid/ /so mtshams mkhar gyi rang bzhin pas/ /srung ba thub dang ma thub pas/ /legs nyes stobs chen byed pa'o/ /rin chen lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar byed/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /'di yod thams cad shor b.rabyed/ /rbal mtshon gyi rang bzhin pas/ /'khor ba'i dra ba ma lus gcod/ /pha ma lta bu'i rang bzhin pas / / dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus skyed/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /brlabs chen dus su 'byung bar byed / / me dpung lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /gang 'phyongs thams cad 'tshig par 'gyur/ /rtsi sman lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /'khor ba'i lcong rnying ma lus 'byung / /rgyal po lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /phyogs 'da' brten pas ris kyi 'tsho/ /ded dpon lta bu'i rang bzhin pas/ /thog ma nas mthar 'dir 'byin byed/ /'di la shin tu nan tan gyis/ /le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de la dam tshig ces bya ba ni bsrung bar byed pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams bsrung bar bya ba'i chos rnams bsrung ba'o / / grangs ni rtsa ba dang yan lag go /'di ni legs pa thams cad 'jig pa'i las can yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /sa ma ya zhes pa ni mna' dang sdom pa dang / rtogs pa dang / gsang ba dang / mnyam — /127—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ jo bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa dang dus dang / yan lag la 'jug go /de la rtsa ba'i dam tshig dang / bla ma bskur ba'i skabs su thamasacad bkur bar bya ba yin na lhag par yang dbang dang dam tshig dang / man ngag mnos pa ste/ rnarma sa bskur bar bya ste/ de yang sangs rgyas pas lhag par ram/ /mnyam pa'am/ dkon mchog bzhi par bskur bar bya'o/ /rdo rje sku mched la byams par bya ba yang / /theg pa chen po la zhugs pa kun yang yin la/ lhag par sngags sdom pa lhan cig mnos pa ste/ de dag la phan pa'i bsam pa btang zhid / khro ba spong ste/ 'a9gya zhing ldog pa lta mosakyang ci dgos/ 'di dag la 'gal 'khrul shor na/ myur du mthong ba'i chos la sor gzhug go /yi dam lha sgom pa dang sngags dang phyag rgya rgyun mi bcad pa dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang du blang ba ni dus gcig pa ste/ brtson pa rab 'bring gi dbang gis zhag dang zla ba dang / lo dus la sgom pa dang / bzlas brjod dang / /bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dag la ma chag par bya'o/ /de yang ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas pa ni/ /dam bcas pa las lhag par yang bgyi'o / / mchod pa'i lo zla las 'dar mi rung ngo / /gsang ba'i man ngag dag las slob dpon dang / /mchedadang gnas dang / /dus lta bu'i gsang sngags 'tshol ba'i dus su bsrung bar bya ba'i ni ma yin no/ /yi dam gyi lha dang / /yi dam sngags dang / /yi dam phyag rgya ste/ /'di gsum ni dam tshig med pa dang / /dam ma 'dresapa la bstan na ni/ /dam tshig las nyams so/ /dam tshig 'dres pa la bstan na ni dngos sdi/ba las nyams so/ spyod pa rlabs po che ni dam tshig 'dres pa la mi bstan no/ /lta ba zab mo ni theg pa dman pa dang / /blo dman pa la mi bstan no/ /gal te 'di las nyams na bskang ba'i thabs gzhan med de/ /snying rje chen po sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po can yin pas kun kyang snod yin par bsam pa dang / shes rab kyis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas bskang ngo / /spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga las/ sgrol ba'i skabs su bsgral ba'i zhing bcu gsungs pa las/ ngan song gsum bsgral bar gsungs pa ni/ dud 'gro las zhing khud par gyur pa ni/ snying rje dang shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin phal gyis de la phan thogs par dka' bas/ dngos su bsgral ba mi brtsam mo / / yi dwags las khud par gyur pa gdon chen po dag gtsug lag khang du zhugs nas/ dge 'dun rnam/sa la bar chad byed pas/ dbyen tsha kha kha'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la gnod pa byed pa dang / srog chags mang po dag la rnam par 'tshe ba dag drag po'i 'phrin las kyis mnan cing / gzir ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /dmyal ba ni zhing khud par gyur pa mad/ mi'i skye dgu rnams la 'dus par 'os pa bsgral ba'i zhing du gsungs pa ni/ sngon dus dang po'i tshe/ gsang bzhi la spyod pa'i dus su/ /gsang sngags zhes bya ba gang zag 'ga' zhig spyod pa yang / /skye bo su la yang ma grags pa'i dus na bsgral bar bya ba'i zhing yin te/ phyis gsang sngags thun mong du grags pa'i tshe —1128—

sngags phyogs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /bsgral ba'i zhing ma yin no/ /gzhan yang dkon mchog gi bstan pa 'jig pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon skad dgra dang / rnal 'byor pa yongs la gnod pa dang / slob dpon dang mched la 'khu ldog pa dang / dam tshig gi rtsa ba chen po nyams shing log pa dang / gsang ba'i theg pa sgrub pa po dang bcas pa la 'phya zhing bkur pa 'debs pa rnams ni sngon spyod la sogs pas ched du blangs te bsgral ba yin no/ /dngos grub kyi rdzas bsgral bar gsungs pa ni/ 'bras bu chen po lnga la sogs pa ni/ /gang zag phal pa'i yul ma yin pas bsgrol bar mi brtsam mo / / sbyor ba'i skabs su rgyan cig pa dang / /smon pa lam cig pa rnams ni/ /'di ltar dam 'cha' nus pa'i gang zag yod na/ /gang zag phal pas nus kyang mi rung ngo / /brtson 'grus kyis mi nus nod par bya ba ma yin no / / rigs lnga tshul gcig pa ni spyod pa dang dam tshig mthun pa yod na nod du rung ngo/ /phyal pa ni kun gyis nod cing bsrung bar bya ba ma yin no/ /ma byin par len pa'i skabs su dkon mchog la bsngos pa la sogs te/shin tu lci ba'i rdzas rnams blang bar mi bya'o/ /bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa rnams ni rdzas dang / shin tu ser snas bcings pa rnams kyi nor ni snying rje'i dbang gi nan gyis blangs la/ mchod sbyin chen po bya bar gsungs so/ /rdzun du smra ba'i skabs su dam tshig la gnod pa'i rdzun dang / sems can la gnod pa'i rdzun dang / gang zag gzhan spyod pa'i chos kyi gzhung la gnod pa'i rdzun dang / rang la lung nges pa med par pha rol gyi bden pa'i tshig la gnod pa'i ngag rtsub dang / lan 'don pa'i rdzun rnams smra bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang bla ma dang 'grogs pa la phan par 'gyur ba'i rdzun dang / sems can gyi srog la phan par 'gyur ba'i rdzun dang / rdzas la phan par 'gyur ba'i rdzun rnams ni ched du blangs te smra bar bya'o/ /ngag rtsub pa'i skabs su dam tshig la gnod pa'i ngag rtsub dang / sems can la phan pa la kun nas gnar sems kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i tshig rtsub mo ni smra bar mi bya'o / / gzhan gong du bstan pa'i dmigs rnam bstan par 'dul ba'i phyir ngag rtsub mo smra ba dang / drag por gyur pa'i sngags bzlas pa dang / gnod du gyur pa'i gang zag la chos mi 'tsham pa lta bu bshad pa ni tshig rtsub mo rnams ni dmigs kyis smra bar bya'o/ /dam tshig 'di dag ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bar bya ba yin pas cung zad kyang 'gal du mi snang ngo / /de yang bshad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga las ji skad du bstan pa bzhi du ma nus na dngos las nyams par 'gyur te/ sgrib pa gsog par mi 'gyur bas ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor grol la sogs pas kyang dag go /nyon mongs pa lnga'i spang ba'i dam tshig dang / shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni spyir shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin gyis rtogs bcing goms par bya ba las ma rtogs pa/ lus ngag gi lhag par spyad cing bsrung du med do/ /bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga ni/ dam tshig 'di rnams tshul bzhin du bsrungs — 1129—

bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus las/ ji bo'i gsung chos kyi skor/pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /de bzhin du brtson par bsrungs pa las ma gtogs par lhag par spyad cing bsrung du med do/ /'di dag rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig mdor bsdus pa yin no/ /spyir dus dang rgyun du gsungs pa rnams ni brtul zhugs kyi dam tshig rnams dang / dus skabs su bsrungs par bya ba lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams ni dam bcas pa'i bsnyen sgrub chen po dang / dus dus su bya ba'i bsnyen sgrub rnams bya ba'i tshe bsrung bar bya ba yin pas lhag par bla ma la gong du gnod mi dgos so/ /dang po dbang nod pa'i dus su phyi'i dam tshig 'ji/ rnams mnos nas/ phyis brten zhing legs par gtan la phab ste/ dus dus su gso sbyong gis brtan par byas nas / bslab pa phra mo de dag dus skabs kyi bslab pas chog go /dam tshig 'di dag nyams na gso ba'i thabs kyang gnyis te/ gzhung kha cig gi dam tshig nyams na slar dkyil 'khor du bzhugs te/ dbang dang dam tshig nod par bya zer ro/ /gzhan dag ni nyams pa'i dus rnams ni/ tshe'i bar chad kyis bskal na sor bcu nas bkos so zhes 'dod do/ /yang gzhung gzhan gyi gzhan dag tu 'chad do/ /gso sbyong gi brtson pa rab kyis rtag tu sems chul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang ldan pas tho ras kyi thun dang po la nyams pa dang ma nyams pa bsgrang zhing gso ba 'byung ngo / /'bring gis la tshigs kyi mchod pa la bsgrang zhing gso ba 'byung ngo/ /tha mas ni lo dus kyi mchod pa'i dus su bsgrang zhing gso ba 'byung ngo / /yang dam tshig ces dam tshig ces bya ba ni/ logs na yod pa ma yin te / rang gi sems nyid kho na la dam tshig ces bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ sems ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams su rang rig pa'i ye shes nyid rkyen dang bral bar snang bas na ji ltar yang rang gi sems phyi rol ltar snang ste/ khams gsum 'gro drug gar skyes kyang / /snying po'i don dang 'gal mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dam tshig chen po ni/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i don la rig pa'i don la rig pa phyin ci ma log na/ kun btags ming dang mtshan ma rnam par rtog pa ni/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong bas lta ba'i dam tshig chen po 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i don la blo 'dris pa yes/ spyod lam kun tu mnyam par yid la byas nas spyod pa rgyun gyis dam tshig kyang de nyid yin no/ /de lta bu'i don dang ma bral bar gnas pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang spyod yul gcig ste/ 'di la bsrung ba ci yang med pas nyams pa rdul tsam yang mi 'byung la/ ma bkag pa spyod pa thams cad dang bral ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsrung ba med pa zhes bya ba yin/ dam tshig thams cad kyi rgyud kun las btus pa phral gyi bdud rtsi'i phra bkod po zla5sa/ le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //gsang sngagaba'isgo bzhi'i rgyud las gang bshad pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rim pa las 'ongs/ /rgyud pa'i gzhung las nyams pa'i don dang 'gal/ /thun mong ma yin theg pa'i — 1/30—

sngags phyegs blo sbyong gi skor bzhugs so/ /sgo 'byed 'di/ /rang gi sems la dran pa gso phyir bris/ /skal ba zhan pa gzhan la phan yang srid/ /de las dkar po'i las 'bras ci bsags pa/ /snyigs ma'i dus la spyod pa'i sems can rnams/ /nan tan snying pos dam tshig gtsor gzung nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i skas la legs 'dzegs nas/ /phyir phyogs ngan song g.yang la ma lhung bas/ /rigs 'dzin rtsa 'chang la gnas pa dang / /dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi grol thab ste/ /rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang thob pa dang / /nyon mongs dug lnga'i nad kyis gzir ba rnams/ /ye shes lnga yi sman gyis gso bar shog /slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa dam tshig thams cad kyi rgyud kun las gdams ngag dang mi 'gal bar bsdus pa/ le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po 'di nyid dang / lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /slad kyis dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// //

༄༅/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' gsung snying po'i bcud/ /ngo mtshar med byung gdams ngag mchog 'di nyid/ /dad brtson shes spyan rab yangs yon bdag ni/ /hphan wis sogs kyis par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnasabastan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs brtan bzhed don 'grub/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe ring nad med cing / /stobs dang mnga' thang chos 'byor dpal gyis 'tsho/ /de'i mthus yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du/ /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /nad mug zhabrug rtsod dus kyi rgud pa zhi/ /dge legs snang bas bshagasdo/ma yongs khyab shog /ces pa'i smon tshig 'di 7skyabs rje mchog sprul gzan dkar rin po ches bka' gsung gser gyi cod paṇa spyi bor stsal ba bzhin/phran dung dkar sprul ming 'dzin pa ngesadon chos kyi rgya mtshos me khyi lo'i zla 1bo'i tshes 25la gus pa chen pos sbyar ba'o//'di ni bka' gdamasadape dkon gces btus deb dang po par grangasanyisastong dpar du bsgrun pa'i rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po hphan lis dang / sku zhabs mar sel rnam gnyis kyi legs byas dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang smon lam zhig ljagamortsom gnang rogs zhes phran thub bstan nyi masazhus pa'i ngor 7skyabs mchog dung dkar mchog sprul rin po ches bka' drin du bstsal ba lags so//

༄ga /(bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus 〉bsdu sgrig dang dpe skrun las zhugs mi sna'i mtshan tho/byu khyab 'char 'god pa/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/dpe spun sbyi khyab rtsom sgrig pa/ rgyal mo 'brug pa/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gartso bo/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gzhon pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ shes rab bzang po/ karma bde legs/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/deb 'di'i las zhugs pa/ thub bstan nyi ma/ thub bstan 'od zer/ bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ blo bzang stobs bcu/ zla ba/ tshe ring chos sgron/ye shes lha mo/ skal bzang lha mo/ 'chi med thar mtsho/deb 'ji'i zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ bstan 'dzin rab rgyas/ karma bde legs/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ ye shes byang chub/deb 'di'i par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring sgrol ma/ ngag dbang dbyangs can/rin chen chos mtsho/ ye shes byang chub/ bsod nams 'brug rgyas/
